_readme: 英文、日文簡介的繁體中文翻譯（translate-summaries，Claude API）。鍵為原文 SHA-1 前 16 碼，原文在 en 或 ja 欄。

0056d7dfe76de5a6.en: The Hirado Dutch Trading Post (平戸和蘭商館, Hirado Oranda shōkan ato) was a trading base of the Dutch East India Company on the island of Hirado, Nagasaki Prefecture Japan.  It was established in 1609 and lasted for 33 years. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1922.
0056d7dfe76de5a6.zh: 平戸オランダ商館是荷蘭東印度公司位於日本長崎縣平戶島上的貿易據點。於1609年設立，存續33年。該遺址於1922年被指定為日本國家史跡。

0057b8a50d9537c2.en: Otsuki Town is a seaside town located in the southwestern part of the prefecture. In the town, agriculture such as rice cultivation, leaf tobacco cultivation, and horticulture are practiced, and fishing is practiced in the coastal area that forms a rias coastline. In one part of the town, there is a tuna aquaculture industry. The production of tuna is one of the highest in Japan.Koshi-meshi" is a dish that the people of Otsuki eat on New Year's Eve.
0057b8a50d9537c2.zh: 大月町是位於縣西南部的海邊城鎮。町內從事稻作、葉菸草栽培及園藝等農業，在形成谷灣式海岸的沿岸地區則從事漁業。町內一部分地區有鮪魚養殖業，鮪魚產量為日本最高之一。「こうし飯」是大月居民在除夕吃的料理。

0061b4b4facbd391.en: Misawa Aviation & Science Museum, Aomori (青森県立三沢航空科学館, Aomori Kenritsu Misawa Koku Kagaku Kan) is an aerospace museum in the city of Misawa, Aomori Prefecture, Japan. The museum was opened on August 8, 2003, and is located adjacent to Misawa Airport.
0061b4b4facbd391.zh: 青森縣立三澤航空科學館是位於日本青森縣三澤市的航空太空博物館。該館於2003年8月8日開館，位於三澤機場旁。

0098788004c73d08.en: The Jike Site (寺家遺跡, Jike Iseki) is an archaeological site located in the Jike neighborhood of the city of Hakui, Ishikawa in the Hokuriku region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 2012.
0098788004c73d08.zh: 寺家遺跡是位於日本北陸地區石川縣羽咋市寺家一帶的考古遺址，2012年被指定為日本國家史跡。

00c7d31a15687949.en: Gappo Park (合浦公園, Gappo kōen) is an urban park in the city of Aomori, Japan, located in the eastern part of the city. Major features of the park include a public beach on Aomori Bay, various decorative trees, and the Aomori City Baseball Stadium.
00c7d31a15687949.zh: 合浦公園是位於日本青森市東部的都市公園。園內主要設施包括面向青森灣的公共海灘、各種觀賞樹木，以及青森市營棒球場。

00ee7df41b5f74f2.en: Ōno-ji (大野寺), also known as Ōno-dera, is a Buddhist temple located in the Murō-Ōno neighborhood of the city of Uda, Nara.  It belongs to the Murōji-branch of Shingon Buddhism and its honzon is a statue of Miroku Bosatsu.  The temple is located at the western entry to Muro-ji and is known for its rock-carved image of Miroku Bosatsu carved into a natural face on the bank of the Uda River, which was  designated a National Historic Site in 1934.
00ee7df41b5f74f2.zh: 大野寺（亦讀作Ōno-dera）是位於奈良縣宇陀市室生大野地區的佛教寺院，屬真言宗室生寺派，本尊為彌勒菩薩像。寺院位於室生寺的西側入口，以雕刻在宇陀川岸邊天然岩壁上的彌勒菩薩磨崖佛聞名，該磨崖佛於1934年被指定為國家史跡。

00f72b44dba8841d.en: Asuka Historical National Government Park (国営飛鳥歴史公園, Kokuei Asuka Rekishi Kōen) is a National Government Park established in Asuka, Nara Prefecture, Japan, in 1974. The park comprises five areas: the Amakashi-no-Oka Area, where there is an observatory with a view over the old capitals of Asuka and Fujiwara-kyō and of Yamato Sanzan; the Iwaido Area, similarly with views to Yamato Sanzan as well as over the terraced rice fields of "Inner Asuka"; the Ishibutai Area; the Takamatsuzuka Area; and the Kitora Tumulus Area.
00f72b44dba8841d.zh: 國營飛鳥歷史公園是1974年設立於日本奈良縣明日香村的國營公園。園區分為五個區域：甘樫丘地區，設有可眺望飛鳥與藤原京舊都以及大和三山的展望台；祝戶地區，同樣可眺望大和三山及「奧飛鳥」的梯田；石舞台地區；高松塚地區；以及龜虎古墳地區。

0102ac83b3ab212d.en: Pia Arena MM (ぴあアリーナMM) is a dedicated music arena in Minatomirai, Nishi-ku, Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan, operated by Pia Corporation. It has a capacity of 12,141 people.
0102ac83b3ab212d.zh: ぴあアリーナMM（ぴあアリーナMM）是位於日本神奈川縣橫濱市西區港未來的音樂專用場館，由ぴあ株式會社營運，可容納12,141人。

010c508d570c5d18.en: The Tachineputa Museum (立佞武多の館, Tachineputa no Yakata) is a museum located in the city of Goshogawara, Aomori Prefecture, Japan.
010c508d570c5d18.zh: 立佞武多の館是位於日本青森縣五所川原市的博物館。

011bdd57fd412c73.en: In the autumn season, you can catch fresh salmon in the Matsukawaura and Hamadori rivers. The Kakedo River is well-known as the first place in Fukushima where salmon were artificially hatched, and a salmon festival used to be held every year when the salmon were caught. During the peak season, 1,000 to 3,000 salmon were caught every day, as per the information provided on the Namie Town website.
011bdd57fd412c73.zh: 秋季可在松川浦和濱通的河川捕到新鮮的鮭魚。請戶川以福島最早進行鮭魚人工孵化之地而聞名，過去每年捕鮭時都會舉辦鮭魚祭。根據浪江町官方網站的資料，盛產期每天可捕獲1,000至3,000條鮭魚。

0123a9cc1b770b1d.en: Takanashi family garden (髙梨氏庭園, Takanashi-shi teien) is a Japanese landscape garden and nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty located in the city of Noda, Chiba Prefecture, Japan.
0123a9cc1b770b1d.zh: 髙梨氏庭園是位於日本千葉縣野田市的日本庭園，為國家指定名勝。

013a546e221c0860.en: Karasawayama Castle (唐沢山城, Karasawayama-jō) was a Japanese castle originally built in the Heian period and used through the end of the Sengoku period. It was located in what is now part of the city of Sano, Tochigi Prefecture, in the northern Kantō region of Japan. The site has been protected as a National Historic Site, since 2014.
013a546e221c0860.zh: 唐澤山城（唐沢山城）是始建於平安時代、一直使用至戰國時代末期的日本城郭，位於今日本北關東地方栃木縣佐野市境內。遺址自2014年起被列為國家史跡受到保護。

01480f472e613e67.en: Uda Mikumari Shrine (宇太水分神社, Uda Mikumari-jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Uda, Nara, Japan. It is dedicated to mikumari, a female Shinto kami associated with water. The honden was built near the end of the Kamakura period, and is listed as a National Treasure of Japan.
01480f472e613e67.zh: 宇太水分神社是位於日本奈良縣宇陀市的神社，供奉與水有關的女性神祇「水分神」。本殿建於鎌倉時代末期，已列為日本國寶。

015412789687a753.en: Tō-no-Hetsuri (塔のへつり; lit. "tower cliffs overlooking a river") is a 200 metre long natural cliff formation located in Ōkawa Hatori Prefectural Park in Shimogō in Fukushima, Japan.
015412789687a753.zh: 塔のへつり（字面意思為「俯臨河川的塔狀斷崖」）是位於日本福島縣下鄉町大川羽鳥縣立自然公園內、長200公尺的天然斷崖地形。

015f4b2e6e98ab0e.en: Wada-shuku (和田宿, Wada-shuku) was the twenty-eighth of the sixty-nine stations of the Nakasendō highway connecting Edo with Kyoto during the Edo period. It was located in the present-day town of Nagawa, in the Chiisagata District of Nagano Prefecture, Japan.
015f4b2e6e98ab0e.zh: 和田宿是江戶時代連接江戶與京都的中山道六十九宿中的第二十八宿，位於今日本長野縣小縣郡長和町。

01678d04e3daa2f6.en: “Hiyashi-shiru-Miso-jitate” (Chilled soup with Miso) is a cold soup seasoned with dashi (Japanese soup stock) and miso, and eaten mainly in summer. It has been eaten as a local dish in various parts of Japan since ancient times. The name and ingredients used vary from prefecture to prefecture, including Yamagata, Saitama, and Miyazaki prefectures.Miyazaki Prefecture's “Hiya-jiru” is made with fish, such as grilled and shredded horse mackerel, or small dried sardines, sesame and barley miso, and served over rice, or barley rice.
01678d04e3daa2f6.zh: 「冷やし汁みそ仕立て」（味噌冷湯）是以高湯和味噌調味的冷湯，主要在夏季食用。自古以來在日本各地作為鄉土料理食用，名稱與使用的食材因縣而異，包括山形縣、埼玉縣和宮崎縣等。宮崎縣的「冷や汁」使用烤過撕碎的竹莢魚或小魚乾等魚類、芝麻和麥味噌製作，淋在白飯或麥飯上食用。

017c93ab642c683c.en: Futahashira Shrine (二柱神社, Futahashira jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Sendai, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan. The main kami enshrined here are Izanagi and Izanami.
017c93ab642c683c.zh: 二柱神社是位於日本宮城縣仙台市的神社，主祭神為伊邪那岐與伊邪那美。

01924abb5f2f3396.en: Kaidan-in (戒壇院) is a Rinzai temple in Dazaifu, Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan. It was founded by Ganjin in 761. Together with Tōdai-ji in Nara and Yakushi-ji in Tochigi Prefecture, it was one of Japan's three official ordination halls during the Nara period.
01924abb5f2f3396.zh: 戒壇院是位於日本福岡縣太宰府市的臨濟宗寺院，由鑑真於761年創建。奈良時代時，與奈良的東大寺、栃木縣的藥師寺並列為日本三座官方戒壇。

019d8b66071e5822.en: The Hirayama Ikuo Silk Road Museum is a museum named after the painter and collector Ikuo Hirayama located in Hokuto, Yamanashi Prefecture of Japan.
019d8b66071e5822.zh: 平山郁夫シルクロード美術館是以畫家暨收藏家平山郁夫命名的美術館，位於日本山梨縣北杜市。

01a34b91a3d22d23.en: The Ancient Orient Museum (Japanese: 古代オリエント博物館, Hepburn: Kodai Oriento Hakubutsukan) is a private museum in Tokyo, Japan, specializing in artifacts of the ancient Near East and Central Asia. Its permanent exhibit features a collection of Greco-Buddhist art of Gandhara, and several works of art pertaining to the art of ancient Palmyra and Persia.
01a34b91a3d22d23.zh: 古代オリエント博物館是位於日本東京的私立博物館，專門收藏古代近東與中亞的文物。常設展展出犍陀羅的希臘式佛教藝術收藏，以及多件與古代帕爾米拉及波斯藝術相關的作品。

01a418d2f21e6a23.en: Naganuma Dam (Japanese: 長沼ダム) is a dam in the city of Tome, Miyagi, Japan, completed in May 2014. The dam is located on the Hasama River, a branch of the Kitakami River system.
01a418d2f21e6a23.zh: 長沼ダム是位於日本宮城縣登米市的水壩，2014年5月完工，位於北上川水系支流迫川。

01a93d0fb34bba9f.en: Originating in the Andes mountains of South America, peanuts entered Japan via East Asia in 1706. They were first cultivated in Okinawa, but their production began in earnest in the Meiji era (1868 - 1912). As well as Chiba, the main peanut producing areas also included Ibaraki, Kanagawa, Kagoshima, Tochigi, Nagasaki and Shizuoka prefectures. In Chiba, peanut farming was first trialled in 1876, in the Kujukuri Plain around Nango village, Sanbu district (now part of Sanmu city).
01a93d0fb34bba9f.zh: 花生原產於南美洲安地斯山脈，1706年經由東亞傳入日本。最早在沖繩栽培，到明治時代（1868～1912年）才開始正式生產。除千葉外，主要產地還包括茨城、神奈川、鹿兒島、栃木、長崎及靜岡等縣。千葉於1876年在山武郡南鄉村（今山武市）一帶的九十九里平原首次試種花生。

01ab4bc239842577.en: "Kenchin-jiru" is a soup flavored with soy sauce and made with finely cut carrot, daikon radish, gobou (burdock root) and other vegetables which are stir fried with tofu. The soup was first made in Kanagawa prefecture and is also a traditional soup made in Iwate, Oita, Ibaraki, and other prefectures. The ingredients used for the soup differ depending on where it is made. In Iwate, there is no meat used for the soup and stir-fried tofu is used instead. In the past, women would make firm tofu at home to be used for the soup.
01ab4bc239842577.zh: 「けんちん汁」是以醬油調味的湯，將切細的紅蘿蔔、白蘿蔔、牛蒡等蔬菜與豆腐一起拌炒後煮成。此湯起源於神奈川縣，也是岩手、大分、茨城等縣的傳統湯品。所用食材依地區而異。在岩手不使用肉，而以炒過的豆腐代替。過去婦女會在家中製作硬豆腐用於此湯。

01acaf7e8fa48ea0.en: Institute of Developing Economies (IDE; アジア経済研究所) is a semi-governmental research institute under the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry, and the largest institute on social science in Japan. Current status is a body of the Japan External Trade Organization. It is located in Kaihin-Makuhari area of Mihama Ward, Chiba City. The President of IDE is Takashi Shiraishi (白石隆), who is the vice president of the National Graduate Institute for Policy Studies.
01acaf7e8fa48ea0.zh: アジア経済研究所（IDE）是隸屬經濟產業省的半官方研究機構，也是日本規模最大的社會科學研究機構，目前為日本貿易振興機構的下屬單位。所址位於千葉市美濱區的海濱幕張地區。所長為白石隆，同時擔任政策研究大學院大學副校長。

01b463dce1ff3aa2.en: Minakuchi Castle (水口城, Minakuchi-jō) is a hirashiro-style Japanese castle located in the former town of Minakuchi, in the city of Kōka, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. The castle is also known as Hekisui Castle
01b463dce1ff3aa2.zh: 水口城是位於日本滋賀縣甲賀市舊水口町的平城式日本城郭，又稱碧水城。

01ceb915c00a091a.en: Ōta-juku (太田宿, Ōta-juku) was the fifty-first of the sixty-nine stations of the Nakasendō connecting Edo with Kyoto in Edo period Japan. It is located in former Mino Province in what is now part of the city of Minokamo, Gifu Prefecture, Japan.
01ceb915c00a091a.zh: 太田宿是日本江戶時代連接江戶與京都的中山道六十九宿中的第五十一宿。位於舊美濃國，即今日岐阜縣美濃加茂市的一部分。

01cf200cc9b33f26.en: It is said that "Tororo-jiru" grated Japanese yam mixed with "dashi-jiru" (Japanese soup stock liquid) made from "iriko" (small dried sardines) or bonito flakes, helps digestion, and it was served on January 2nd in Tamba-Sasayama City to help digestion after eating heavy New Year Dishes. This custom can be found in the areas eating "tororo" (grated Japanese yam).
01cf200cc9b33f26.zh: 據說「とろろ汁」，也就是將山藥泥與以小魚乾或柴魚片熬製的「出汁」（日式高湯）混合而成的湯，有助於消化。在丹波篠山市，人們會在1月2日食用，以幫助消化吃完油膩年菜後的腸胃。這項習俗可見於食用「とろろ」（山藥泥）的地區。

01d9f3a8e79bba4d.en: Hiroshima National Peace Memorial Hall for the Atomic Bomb Victims is one of the National Memorial Halls in Hiroshima, Japan.
01d9f3a8e79bba4d.zh: 國立廣島原爆死沒者追悼平和祈念館是位於日本廣島的國立追悼館之一。

01ecf5d48c4612f1.en: Minochi Dam (Japanese: 水内ダム) is a dam in the Nagano Prefecture, Japan, completed in 1943.
01ecf5d48c4612f1.zh: 水内ダム是位於日本長野縣的水壩，1943年完工。

02197922817f0462.en: Mount Kamurigi (冠着山, Kamuriki-san) is a  1,252 m (4,108 ft) mountain peak on the border of the city of Chikuma and the village of Chikuhoku in Nagano Prefecture in the Chūbu region of Japan. It is also called Ubasuteyama or Obasuteyama (姨捨山) after an old legend. the mountain is located within the borders of the Yatsugatake-Chūshin Kōgen Quasi-National Park.
02197922817f0462.zh: 冠着山是位於日本中部地方長野縣千曲市與筑北村交界、海拔1,252公尺（4,108英尺）的山峰。因古老傳說，也被稱為姨捨山。此山位於八ヶ岳中信高原國定公園範圍內。

02214ba91bed46a0.en: Soba is a typical local cuisine, so much so that Nagano Prefecture is known for its "Shinshu soba" (buckwheat noodles). Soba has been cultivated as an agricultural product in highland areas where the cool climate makes it difficult to grow rice and wheat. In high altitude areas around 700m above sea level, where morning mist hangs in the air, delicious soba is produced because the mist gently protects the buckwheat, which is vulnerable to frost.
02214ba91bed46a0.zh: 蕎麥麵是代表性的鄉土料理，長野縣甚至以「信州蕎麥麵」聞名。在氣候涼爽、難以種植稻米與小麥的高地，蕎麥一直作為農作物栽培。在海拔約700公尺、晨霧瀰漫的高地，霧氣會輕柔地保護不耐霜害的蕎麥，因此能生產出美味的蕎麥。

02263cc4c9b60d87.en: The Toyohashi City Museum of Art and History (豊橋市美術博物館, Toyohashi-shi Bijutsu Hakubutsukan) is a purpose-built municipal art museum and local cultural museum in Toyohashi, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. It opened in 1979.
02263cc4c9b60d87.zh: 豊橋市美術博物館是位於日本愛知縣豊橋市的市立美術館兼地方文化博物館，為專門興建的館舍，於1979年開館。

02349e5715c070fe.en: The Goishi Coast (碁石海岸, Goishi Kaigan) is section of the coastline of the Pacific Ocean located in the city of Ōfunato, Iwate Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan. It was  nationally designated a Place of Scenic Beauty and a Natural Monument in 1937. In 1996, the Ministry of the Environment also selected the sound of the waves breaking over Kaminari iwa (雷岩) (lit. 'Thunder Rock') as one of the 100 Soundscapes of Japan.
02349e5715c070fe.zh: 碁石海岸是位於日本北部東北地方岩手縣大船渡市的一段太平洋海岸線。1937年被指定為國家名勝及天然紀念物。1996年，環境省亦將海浪拍打雷岩的聲音選入「日本音風景100選」。

023d190c6dfbff73.en: Chōgaku-ji (Japanese: 長岳寺) is a Japanese Buddhist temple of the Kōyasan Shingon-shū sect in the city of Tenri in Nara Prefecture, Japan. It is located within Yamato-Aogaki Quasi-National Park along the Yamanobe no michi (Japanese: 山辺の道), the oldest road in Japan, at the foot of Mt. Ryūō in the Sanuki Mountains. The temple is the fourth of the thirteen Buddhist sites of Yamato, and the nineteenth of the twenty-five Kansai flower temples.
023d190c6dfbff73.zh: 長岳寺（日語：長岳寺）是位於日本奈良縣天理市的高野山真言宗佛教寺院，位於大和青垣國定公園內，沿著日本最古老的道路山邊之道（日語：山辺の道），坐落於讚岐山地龍王山山麓。該寺為大和十三佛靈場第四號，以及關西花之寺二十五所第十九號。

024187ef44d41f81.en: The most famous specialty of Kumamoto, Japan's largest producer of horse meat, is "Basashi(Horse sashimi)". Thinly sliced raw horse meat is served with thinly sliced onions, grated ginger, garlic, etc., and dipped in sweet soy sauce.
024187ef44d41f81.zh: 日本最大馬肉產地熊本最有名的特產是「馬刺し（馬肉刺身）」。將生馬肉切成薄片，搭配洋蔥薄片、薑泥、大蒜等，沾甜醬油食用。

0249f4cff0070a36.en: The Museum of the Meiji Restoration (維新ふるさと館, Ishin-furusato-kan) is a history museum in Kagoshima, Japan. Located by the Kōtsuki River, it is a gallery where visitors can learn about the Meiji Restoration. In the basement hall, sound, light, and robots are used to present a three-dimensional experience of the Meiji Restoration. On the first floor, exhibits describe the people, things, and events of Satsuma Province.
0249f4cff0070a36.zh: 維新ふるさと館（維新故鄉館）是位於日本鹿兒島的歷史博物館，坐落於甲突川畔，是讓參觀者了解明治維新的展館。地下樓層的展演廳運用聲音、燈光與機器人，以立體方式呈現明治維新。一樓的展示則介紹薩摩國的人物、事物與事件。

0276e6183a9faab3.en: "Yakitsuke" is a local dish that has been enjoyed in rural areas since the early Showa era. It is a simple and rustic dish made by kneading glutinous rice flour with fragrant mugwort, then baking it in a large iron pot. During the difficult times of food shortages in the early Showa era, leftover broken rice that couldn't be shipped was ground into flour and used for this dish. The dough was spread thinly in a large iron pot and baked, then cut into pieces and shared with everyone, with a miso-based sauce applied on top.
0276e6183a9faab3.zh: 「焼き付け」是昭和初期以來在農村地區食用的鄉土料理。將糯米粉與芳香的艾草揉合，再用大鐵鍋烘烤，是簡單樸實的料理。在昭和初期糧食短缺的艱困時期，無法出貨的碎米被磨成粉用來製作這道料理。麵糰在大鐵鍋中攤薄烘烤，再切成塊分給大家，上面塗上味噌基底的醬汁。

0298ca35e33bfdeb.en: The Kosuge Ship Repair Dock (小菅修船場跡, Kosuge shūsen-ba ato) is the remains of Japan's first western-style dock, erected in the Bakumatsu period in what is now the Kosuge neighborhood of the city of Nagasaki of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site in 2009. and was later designed as a component of the Sites of Japan's Meiji Industrial Revolution: Iron and Steel, Shipbuilding and Coal Mining, which received UNESCO World Heritage Site status in 2015.
0298ca35e33bfdeb.zh: 小菅修船場跡是日本第一座西式船塢的遺跡，建於幕末時期，位於今日本長崎市小菅地區。該遺址於2009年被指定為國家史跡，之後列為「明治日本的產業革命遺產：製鐵・鋼鐵、造船、煤礦」的構成資產之一，該遺產於2015年登錄為聯合國教科文組織世界遺產。

02ab4a1f951402cb.en: Gankei-ji (元慶寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Kitakazan Kawaramachi, neighborhood of Yamashina-ku, Kyoto, Japan. It belongs to the Tendai sect of Japanese Buddhism and its honzon is a statue of Yakushi Nyorai. It is more commonly known throughout its history as "Gangyō-ji" from an alternative transliteration of the kanji in its name. The temple's full name is Kachō-zan Gankei-ji (華頂山 元慶寺).  The temple is a "bangai" temple located between the 14th and 15th stops on the Saigoku Kannon Pilgrimage route.
02ab4a1f951402cb.zh: 元慶寺是位於日本京都山科區北花山河原町的佛教寺院。屬於日本佛教天台宗，本尊為藥師如來像。依寺名漢字的另一種讀法，本寺歷來更常被稱為「がんぎょうじ」。寺院全名為華頂山元慶寺。本寺是西國觀音靈場巡禮中位於第14與第15番札所之間的「番外」寺院。

02be99f6a64207d3.en: In 1892, Soseki Natsume visited Matsuyama for the first time and stopped by Shiki Masaoka's house. During his visit, he was treated by Yae, Shiki's mother, to Matsuyama zushi. Soseki was delighted with the dish and consumed it without spilling a single morsel. Shiki also loved Matsuyama zushi and even wrote a haiku titled "I love Matsuyama sushi." Later, in the spring of 1895, Soseki returned to Matsuyama as a teacher at Matsuyama Junior High School and ordered Matsuyama zushi as soon as he arrived.
02be99f6a64207d3.zh: 1892年，夏目漱石首次造訪松山，順道拜訪正岡子規家。造訪期間，子規的母親八重以松山鮓招待他。漱石非常喜歡這道料理，吃得一粒不剩。子規也很喜愛松山鮓，甚至寫了一首題為「我愛松山壽司」的俳句。之後在1895年春天，漱石以松山中學教師的身分再度來到松山，一抵達就點了松山鮓。

02c716e6768840b0.en: Hattori Ryokuchi Park (服部緑地公園, Hattori Ryokuchi Kōen) is a large, hilly park in northern Osaka.  It is most famous for its Open-Air Museum of Old Japanese Farmhouses, which contains examples of rural architecture from various parts of Japan.  It also contains tennis courts, bamboo gardens, ponds, playgrounds, flower gardens, a concert hall, a "flower road", a horseback riding track, and a "water world".
02c716e6768840b0.zh: 服部緑地公園是大阪北部一座地勢起伏的大型公園，最著名的是日本民家集落博物館，展示來自日本各地的農村建築。園內另有網球場、竹林園、池塘、遊樂場、花園、音樂廳、「花之道」、騎馬場及「水上世界」。

02c7eff29f9653d2.en: Ilichee, often heard of in Okinawa's local cuisine, is a dish made by stir-frying dry foods and root vegetables and then simmering them to add flavor. Among the various types of Ilichee, "Koob Ilichee" is the one that was mainly prepared for special occasions. Kubu" means kelp, and "kubu irichi" is stir-fried kelp, sometimes called "kubu iricha" or "kelp irini. Combining the words "kelp" and "yorokobu," it has become an indispensable dish for weddings and other celebratory occasions.
02c7eff29f9653d2.zh: 沖繩鄉土料理中常聽到的「イリチー」，是將乾貨與根莖類蔬菜炒過後再燉煮入味的料理。在各種イリチー中，クーブイリチー主要是在特別的場合製作。「クーブ」意為昆布，「クーブイリチー」就是炒昆布，有時也稱為「クーブイリチャー」或「昆布イリニー」。由於「昆布」與「喜ぶ（よろこぶ）」的發音相關，成為婚禮等喜慶場合不可或缺的料理。

02c9b290d55571d2.en: Jōkō-ji (定光寺)  is a Buddhist temple belonging to the Myōshin-ji branch of the Rinzai school of Japanese Zen, Buddhism located in the city of Seto, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. Its main image is a statue of Jizō Bosatsu. The temple is noted for the mausoleum of Tokugawa Yoshinao, the son of Tokugawa Ieyasu and founding daimyō of Owari Domain; however it was not the bodaiji of the clan.
02c9b290d55571d2.zh: 定光寺是位於日本愛知縣瀨戶市的佛教寺院，屬日本禪宗臨濟宗妙心寺派。本尊為地藏菩薩像。寺內有德川家康之子、尾張藩初代藩主德川義直的陵墓而知名，但此寺並非該家族的菩提寺。

02d8c34c6f69ea1c.en: Kannon-in (観音院, Kannon-in), formally known as Fudarakusan Jigen-ji Kannon-in (補陀落山慈眼寺観音院), is a Buddhist temple in Uemachi district of the city of Tottori, Tottori Prefecture, Japan. Kannon-in was built early in the Edo period (1603 – 1868) and is noted for its Edo-style Japanese garden.
02d8c34c6f69ea1c.zh: 觀音院（観音院，Kannon-in），正式名稱為補陀落山慈眼寺觀音院，是位於日本鳥取縣鳥取市上町的佛寺。觀音院建於江戶時代（1603－1868年）初期，以江戶風格的日本庭園聞名。

02e3546b6eece5e5.en: Shiinoki Cultural Complex is in Kanazawa, Japan. It is housed in the former Ishikawa Prefectural Government Building, which was completed in 1924 and designed by architect Kenkichi Yabashi (1869–1927). It is located at 920-0962 Ishikawa, Kanazawa, Hirosaka, 2 Chome−1−1 on the south side of Kanazawa Castle Park.
02e3546b6eece5e5.zh: 石川縣政紀念しいのき迎賓館位於日本金澤市，設於舊石川縣廳舍內。該建築於1924年落成，由建築師矢橋賢吉（1869–1927）設計。地址為石川縣金澤市廣坂2丁目1-1（郵遞區號920-0962），位於金澤城公園南側。

02fa546bdf6e89b1.en: Yunokuni no Mori (ゆのくにの森) is a crafts village in Komatsu, a city located in the southern portion of Ishikawa Prefecture in Japan. It is located near Awazu Onsen amid over one hundred acres of natural forest, and contains a cluster of traditional Japanese houses, each containing a working display of traditional handicrafts native to the Hokuriku region of Japan.
02fa546bdf6e89b1.zh: ゆのくにの森是位於日本石川縣南部小松市的工藝村，鄰近粟津溫泉，四周為一百多英畝的天然森林，村內有一群日本傳統房屋，每棟都有日本北陸地方傳統手工藝的實作展示。

02fb0259d1ea7047.en: Susaki Shrine (洲崎神社, Susaki Jinja) is a Shinto shrine in the Susaki neighborhood of the city of Tateyama in Chiba Prefecture, Japan. It is one of two shrines claiming to hold the title of ichinomiya of the former Awa Province. The main festival of the shrine is held annually on August 20.
02fb0259d1ea7047.zh: 洲崎神社是位於日本千葉縣館山市洲崎的神社。為兩座自稱舊安房國一宮的神社之一。例大祭每年於8月20日舉行。

02fc190601dd6ce0.en: Tsukuba Circuit (筑波サーキット, Tsukuba Sākitto) is a motorsport race track located in Shimotsuma, a neighboring city of Tsukuba, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan, about 60 km (37 mi) north of central Tokyo. It is 2.045 km (1.271 mi) long, with 32 pit garages and a 437 m (0.272 mi) long back straight. There is a small chicane used only for motorcycle racing that increases the track's total length to 2.070 km (1.286 mi).
02fc190601dd6ce0.zh: 筑波サーキット是位於日本茨城縣下妻市（筑波市的鄰近城市）的賽車場，距東京市中心以北約60公里（37英里）。賽道全長2.045公里（1.271英里），設有32間維修區車庫，後直線段長437公尺（0.272英里）。另有一段僅供機車賽使用的小型減速彎，使賽道全長增加至2.070公里（1.286英里）。

03099059c476c9b4.en: Otaru Aquarium (おたる水族館, Otaru-suizokukan) is a public aquarium operated by Otaru Public Aquarium Corporation, Third Sector, in Otaru City, Hokkaido, Japan. It is one of the largest aquariums in Hokkaido, and It is a member of the Japanese Association of Zoos and Aquariums (JAZA). The aquarium is accredited as a Museum-equivalent facilities by the Museum Act from Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology.
03099059c476c9b4.zh: おたる水族館是位於日本北海道小樽市的公立水族館，由第三部門的小樽公立水族館公社營運。它是北海道規模最大的水族館之一，也是日本動物園水族館協會（JAZA）的會員。該館依文部科學省《博物館法》被認定為博物館同等設施。

030b78c026dde9c8.en: This dish is made by frying daikon radish, carrots, and other vegetables in oil and then simmering them. There are various theories as to its origin.
030b78c026dde9c8.zh: 這道料理是將白蘿蔔、紅蘿蔔等蔬菜用油炒過後燉煮而成。其起源有多種說法。

0310439df1241cdc.en: Yubeshi is a rice cake confection made with yuzu and walnuts, historically developed as a portable and preservable food but also given as a gift, with roots in many regions of the country. The Yubeshi made in the Tohoku and Kanto regions contain walnuts, but in Okayama prefecture, where large amounts of yuzu are produced, Yubeshi is made with yuzu. Takahashi City and Yakage Town are representative regions, with a history dating back to the Edo period.
0310439df1241cdc.zh: 柚餅子是以柚子和核桃製作的麻糬點心，過去發展為便於攜帶、可保存的食物，也用來送禮，源自全國許多地區。東北和關東地區製作的柚餅子含有核桃，但在柚子產量大的岡山縣，則以柚子製作。高梁市和矢掛町是代表性地區，歷史可追溯至江戶時代。

03450a4471b7ab6b.en: Tōri Tenjō-ji (忉利天上寺), officially Mayazan Tenjō-ji (仏母摩耶山天上寺) or Mayazan Tenjō-ji (摩耶山天上寺), is a Shingon Buddhist temple in eastern Kobe, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan. The temple is located on Mount Maya (699 metres (2,293 ft)) in the Nada ward of Kobe.
03450a4471b7ab6b.zh: 忉利天上寺，正式名稱為佛母摩耶山天上寺或摩耶山天上寺，是位於日本兵庫縣神戶市東部的真言宗佛教寺院。寺院位於神戶市灘區的摩耶山（699公尺（2,293英尺））。

034985abe81f6c1e.en: Miya-juku (宮宿, Miya-juku) was the forty-first of the fifty-three stations of the Tōkaidō. It is located in former Owari Province in what is now part of the Atsuta-ku section of the city of Nagoya, in Aichi Prefecture, Japan. It was six km from Narumi-juku, the preceding post station.
034985abe81f6c1e.zh: 宮宿（Miya-juku）是東海道五十三次的第四十一個宿場，位於舊尾張國，即今日本愛知縣名古屋市熱田區。距前一個宿場鳴海宿6公里。

037195e25bedecf1.en: This is a precious feast using chicken kept at home during the time when it was difficult to obtain meat like today, and it was cooked a lot and served when people gathered during new year or event like wedding and memorial services. ‘Ugui’ (Japanese dace), caught in its peak season in winter, is used instead of meat, or beef or pork were also replaced with chicken in some areas.The name ‘Jabu’ came from liquid out a lot (in Japanese ‘jabu jabu’ to express liquid is flowing) from tofu and vegetables while simmering them.
037195e25bedecf1.zh: 這是在不像現在容易取得肉類的年代，使用自家飼養的雞製作的珍貴宴席料理，在新年或婚禮、法事等人們聚集的場合大量烹煮供應。有些地區會用冬季盛產時捕獲的「うぐい」（三塊魚）代替肉類，或以雞肉取代牛肉、豬肉。「じゃぶ」這個名稱來自燉煮時豆腐和蔬菜釋出大量湯汁（日文以「じゃぶじゃぶ」形容液體流動）。

03aaca47d1e33d42.en: “Imo mochi” is a traditional dish that is eaten across Japan, in prefectures such as Hokkaido, Wakayama, and Kochi. Imo means potato in Japanese and different types of potatoes are used depending on the region such as white potatoes, sweet potatoes and satoimo(=Japanese taro) and the way the dish is prepared also differs.“Imo mochi” from Gifu is made with satoimo(=Japanese taro) and rice. The satoimo(=Japanese taro) and rice are cooked together and mashed.
03aaca47d1e33d42.zh: 「いももち」是在北海道、和歌山、高知等日本各縣都有食用的傳統料理。「いも」在日文中指薯類，依地區不同會使用馬鈴薯、地瓜、里芋（日本芋頭）等不同種類，做法也各不相同。岐阜的「いももち」是以里芋和米製作，將里芋與米一起煮熟後搗碎。

03ae0e8216506816.en: City Football Station (シティ フットボール ステーション) is a football stadium in Tochigi, Japan, which has a seating capacity of 5,085. It has been the home of Tochigi City since 2021.
03ae0e8216506816.zh: CITY FOOTBALL STATION是位於日本栃木市的足球場，可容納5,085名觀眾。自2021年起為栃木City的主場。

03c2f1887e12a563.en: Izumo soba is representative of the Izumo region. Along with "wanko soba" in Iwate Prefecture and "Togakushi soba" in Nagano Prefecture, it is one of the three most famous soba in Japan. It is said that soba spread to the Izumo region in the early Edo period when Naomasa Matsudaira, the first lord of the Matsudaira family of the Matsue domain, brought soba chefs with him when he moved from the Matsumoto domain in Shinshu.Izumo soba has a darker color than most soba.
03c2f1887e12a563.zh: 出雲そば是出雲地區的代表性料理，與岩手縣的「わんこそば」、長野縣的「戶隱蕎麥麵」並列為日本三大名蕎麥麵。據說蕎麥麵是在江戶時代初期傳入出雲地區，當時松江藩松平家第一代藩主松平直政從信州松本藩移封時，帶來了蕎麥麵師傅。出雲そば的顏色比大多數蕎麥麵深。

03c3f150bcea5c1c.en: Sangojima (珊琥島) in an uninhabited islet located in the center of Ōfunato Bay, on the Sanriku Coast of Japan.  It has been designated a National Place of Scenic Beauty and Natural Monument since 1946.
03c3f150bcea5c1c.zh: 珊琥島是位於日本三陸海岸大船渡灣中央的無人小島。自1946年起被指定為國家名勝及天然紀念物。

03c5a73e10cad471.en: Fresh raw shirasu (baby sardines) on vinegared rice (or white rice) is served on top of a bowl of rice. It is a well-known specialty of the Shonan area, including Chigasaki, Kamakura, and Enoshima.Shirasu are young sardines. Boiled shirasu is called "kama-age shirasu" and sun-dried shirasu is called "shirasu-boshi." Nama-shirasu, as the name implies, is raw unprocessed shirasu.
03c5a73e10cad471.zh: 在醋飯（或白飯）上鋪滿新鮮的生魩仔魚（沙丁魚幼魚）的丼飯。是茅崎、鎌倉、江之島等湘南地區知名的特產。魩仔魚是沙丁魚的幼魚。水煮的魩仔魚稱為「釜揚魩仔魚」，日曬乾燥的稱為「魩仔魚乾」。生魩仔魚顧名思義，就是未經加工的生魩仔魚。

03cb66af2b703779.en: Oku-noto no Aenokoto (奥能登のあえのこと) is a ritual passed down from generation to generation by farmers in the Noto Peninsula, in Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan. Ae is an old Japanese word for a banquet; therefore, Aenokoto essentially means "banquet ritual."
03cb66af2b703779.zh: 奧能登のあえのこと是日本石川縣能登半島農民世代相傳的儀式。「あえ」是日本古語中「宴席」的意思，因此「あえのこと」大致意為「宴席儀式」。

03d13ca35870e975.en: During the Taisho era (1912-1926), as the outbreak of World War I made it difficult to import wool, there was a national policy to encourage sheep farming. In Hokkaido during that time, sheep farming became popular, and it is said that this period marked the beginning of the consumption of lamb in the region. After World War II, due to a shortage of clothing resources, the demand for wool increased across Japan.
03d13ca35870e975.zh: 大正時代（1912－1926年），因第一次世界大戰爆發導致羊毛難以進口，國家推行獎勵養羊的政策。當時北海道的養羊業興盛，據說這段時期就是當地開始食用羊肉的起點。第二次世界大戰後，由於衣料資源短缺，日本各地對羊毛的需求增加。

03db101096d9e6d0.en: Yokohama International School (横浜インターナショナルスクール) is a co-educational international school located in Naka-ku, Yokohama, Japan.
03db101096d9e6d0.zh: 橫濱インターナショナルスクール是位於日本橫濱市中區的男女合校國際學校。

03e1ed68ee61d6c1.en: Our Lady of the Angels Trappistine Abbey (天使の聖母トラピスチヌ修道院, Tenshi No Seibo Torasupichinu Shūdōin) is a women's abbey of Trappists located in the outskirts of Hakodate, Hokkaido, Japan.
03e1ed68ee61d6c1.zh: 天使聖母トラピスチヌ修道院（天使の聖母トラピスチヌ修道院）是位於日本北海道函館郊外的熙篤會女子修道院。

03e818eea14a4e2b.en: Unpen-ji (雲辺寺) is a Shingon Buddhist temple in Miyoshi, Tokushima. It is the 66th temple in the 88 temple Shikoku Pilgrimage. It is the highest point in the Shikoku pilgrimage, at 927 meters elevation.
03e818eea14a4e2b.zh: 雲邊寺（雲辺寺）是位於德島縣三好市的真言宗佛寺，為四國八十八所遍路的第66番寺院。海拔927公尺，是四國遍路的最高點。

041c9d828a7415d4.en: "Mimigar" is pig's ears, and "Sashimi" is a dressed dish. In Okinawa Prefecture, where pork culture has long been rooted, the word "everything is edible except the squeal" is practiced by cooking not only the meat but also the internal organs, face, feet, and even the blood. "Mimigar" refers to the ear itself, although it is called "ear skin," and the dish using the ear, which is rarely distributed outside the prefecture, is known as a unique Okinawan local cuisine.
041c9d828a7415d4.zh: 「ミミガー」是豬耳朵，「さしみ」是涼拌菜。在豬肉文化長久扎根的沖繩縣，人們實踐「除了叫聲以外全部都能吃」的說法，不只烹調豬肉，連內臟、臉、腳甚至血都會料理。「ミミガー」雖然稱為「耳皮」，指的卻是整個耳朵，使用耳朵製作、在縣外很少流通的這道料理，是知名的沖繩獨特鄉土料理。

0427b656adf515bd.en: The number of sardines, caught has been decreasing in recent years, but in the past, a large number of sardines were caught in April and May along the coast of the Sea of Japan. The gills and innards of the sardines were removed and marinated in a large amount of salt, to make "Shokkara-Iwashi“."Shokkara-Iwashi" is a kind of Japanese anchovy, made from 90 sardines, and one sho (1.5kg) of Salt.
0427b656adf515bd.zh: 沙丁魚的漁獲量近年逐漸減少，但過去每年4月和5月，日本海沿岸會捕獲大量沙丁魚。沙丁魚去除鰓和內臟後，以大量鹽醃漬，製成「しょっからいわし」。「しょっからいわし」是一種日式鯷魚，以90尾沙丁魚和一升（1.5公斤）的鹽製成。

04319d26bdeadf85.en: "Matsumae-zuke" is a local Hokkaido delicacy made by shredding dried Squid, and Kelp, and marinating them with Soy sauce, Sake, Mirin, and Sugar. In the past, Squid, was pickled with Salt, but due to changes in taste preferences, Soy sauce,-based seasoning is now widely used.As the name suggests,"Matsumae-zuke", originated in the Matsumae Domain, where they were made from locally harvested ingredients.
04319d26bdeadf85.zh: 「松前漬」是將魷魚乾與昆布切絲，以醬油、酒、味醂和砂糖醃漬而成的北海道鄉土美味。過去魷魚是用鹽醃漬，但隨著口味偏好改變，現在普遍使用以醬油為基底的調味。如其名稱所示，「松前漬」源自松前藩，當時以當地採收的食材製作。

043548cf6cae8d96.ja: 海老ヶ池（えびがいけ）は、徳島県海部郡海陽町の室戸阿南海岸国定公園内にある県内最大の湖。面積は18ha。四国地方で唯一の天然湖（国土交通省のコード登録湖沼）である。
043548cf6cae8d96.zh: 海老ヶ池位於德島縣海部郡海陽町的室戶阿南海岸國定公園內，是縣內最大的湖泊，面積18公頃。為四國地區唯一的天然湖（國土交通省代碼登錄湖沼）。

0442753dd789ba1b.en: Bank of Iwate Red Brick Building (岩手銀行赤レンガ館, Iwate Ginkō Aka-Renga kan) is a former bank building located in the city of Morioka, Iwate Prefecture, Japan. The building is an example of Meiji period western style architecture in Japan, and is listed as an Important Cultural Property. The building is now used as a museum.
0442753dd789ba1b.zh: 岩手銀行赤レンガ館是位於日本岩手縣盛岡市的舊銀行建築。此建築為日本明治時代西式建築的代表例，並被列為重要文化財。目前作為博物館使用。

0452742596bf8ce5.en: "Iyachi" is a traditional preserved food from Taketomi Island in the Yaeyama Islands, where glutinous rice is mixed with glutinous millet or red beans and cooked. Taketomi Island is located just a 10-minute boat ride from Ishigaki Island and is known for its tranquil tropical scenery, attracting many tourists.The most significant festival on Taketomi Island is the "Taketomi Seed Festival," which is said to have a history of approximately 600 years.
0452742596bf8ce5.zh: イーヤチ是八重山群島竹富島的傳統保存食，將糯米與糯小米或紅豆混合後炊煮而成。竹富島距離石垣島僅約10分鐘船程，以寧靜的熱帶風光聞名，吸引許多觀光客。竹富島最重要的祭典是「竹富島種子取祭」，據說已有約600年的歷史。

045b0c59bd1e2d26.en: Mount Washu or Washū-zan (Japanese: 鷲羽山) is a 133 meter hill in Shimotsui (下津井), Kurashiki, Japan, but famous traditionally for viewing the Seto Inland Sea dotted with various small islands, and now for commanding the majestic view of the Great Seto Bridge, one of the three bridges connecting Shikoku Island with the main Honshu Island.
045b0c59bd1e2d26.zh: 鷲羽山是位於日本倉敷市下津井、高133公尺的山丘，自古以眺望散布著眾多小島的瀨戶內海聞名，如今則以能俯瞰瀨戶大橋的壯闊景色著稱。瀨戶大橋是連接四國與本州的三座橋梁之一。

04684f08ce2fb85f.en: Kaerikumo Castle (Japanese: 帰雲城, Hepburn: Kaerikumo-jō / Kaerigumo-jō / Kiun-jō; lit. 'Castle Clouds Back') is a castle that is said to have existed in Shirakawa Village in the Hida region, Japan, being served as the castle of the Uchigashima clan, from the end of the Muromachi period to the end of the Azuchi–Momoyama period. It is well known a castle that was buried overnight by 1586 Tenshō earthquake. The exact location of this castle is unknown.
04684f08ce2fb85f.zh: 歸雲城（帰雲城，Kaerikumo-jō／Kaerigumo-jō／Kiun-jō；字面意思為「雲歸之城」）據說曾存在於日本飛驒地區的白川村，從室町時代末期至安土桃山時代末期為內島氏的居城。此城以在1586年天正大地震中一夜之間遭掩埋而聞名。此城的確切位置不明。

048346340ce7e30d.en: The Museum of Modern Art, Gunma (群馬県立近代美術館, Gunma kenritsu kindai bijutsukan) opened in Takasaki, Gunma Prefecture, Japan, in 1974. The collection includes works by Monet, Renoir, and Soga Jasoku.
048346340ce7e30d.zh: 群馬縣立近代美術館於1974年在日本群馬縣高崎市開館，館藏包括莫內、雷諾瓦及曾我蛇足的作品。

0483df7b79bafa76.en: Obama Bay (小浜湾, Obama-wan) is a bay within Wakasa Bay in the Chūbu region of Japan, within the municipal boundaries of both Ōi and Obama. Its surface area is about 58.7 square kilometres (22.7 mi2), with a mean depth of 25 metres (82 ft). Due to its clear waters and large beaches, it is a popular beach destination in the summer.
0483df7b79bafa76.zh: 小浜湾是日本中部地方若狹灣內的海灣，範圍跨越大飯町與小濱市。面積約58.7平方公里（22.7平方英里），平均水深25公尺（82英尺）。由於海水清澈、海灘寬廣，夏季是熱門的海水浴地點。

048ea28495b6884e.en: Shima Onsen is a name of Japanese town and hot springs -  onsen, the part of Nakanojō city in the Gunma Prefecture.
048ea28495b6884e.zh: 四万温泉是日本一處城鎮與溫泉的名稱，屬於群馬縣中之條町的一部分。

049494306b8c0eb1.en: Fukushima Prefectural Museum of Art (福島県立美術館, Fukushima Kenritsu Bijutsukan) is a museum located in Fukushima City, at the base of Mount Shinobu. It shares a campus of over 60,000 square meters with Fukushima Prefectural Library. The two facilities were established together in July, 1984. However, the museum maintains its own grounds and gardens, separate from the library.
049494306b8c0eb1.zh: 福島縣立美術館位於福島市信夫山山腳，與福島縣立圖書館共用占地超過6萬平方公尺的園區，兩館於1984年7月同時設立。不過美術館有獨立於圖書館之外的腹地與庭園。

0498c64a9e3c2bbf.en: It is a local dish of Iiyama, a hot spring village known as Oku-zashiki of Tokyo, in which tanishi are simmered in salty-sweet Miso.
0498c64a9e3c2bbf.zh: 這是有「東京的奧座敷」之稱的溫泉鄉飯山的鄉土料理，以鹹甜的味噌燉煮田螺。

04a84068bf425790.en: Nagano Castle (長野城, Nagano-jō) was a Muromachi period  "yamashiro"-style (castle located in the Misato neighborhood of the city of Tsu, Mie Prefecture, Japan. The ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1982.
04a84068bf425790.zh: 長野城是室町時代的山城式城郭，位於日本三重縣津市美里町。遺址自1982年起被指定為國家史跡加以保護。

04c49bcaa6df4aab.en: The Noto Peninsula is surrounded by the sea on three sides. The sticky soil, represented by red soil, gives the vegetables grown a unique flavor. The vegetables produced by taking advantage of this climate are branded as "Noto vegetables". They are categorized as "traditional Noto vegetables" or "Noto specialty vegetables" based on the criteria such as: they must have been cultivated for at least 30 years, have an organization such as a subcommittee, and be widely distributed to the public.
04c49bcaa6df4aab.zh: 能登半島三面環海。以紅土為代表的黏質土壤，使當地種植的蔬菜帶有獨特風味。利用這種風土生產的蔬菜被打造為「能登蔬菜」品牌，並依據栽培至少30年、設有分會等組織、廣泛流通於市面等標準，分為「能登傳統蔬菜」或「能登特產蔬菜」。

04d1e527a253c15f.en: Bustumoku-ji (Japanese: 佛木寺) is a temple belonging to the Omuro School of Shingon Buddhism, located in Uwajima, Ehime Prefecture. Its formal mountain name is Ichika-zan , and it bears the honorary title Birushanain. The main image is of Dainichi Nyorai. It is Temple # 42 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage.
04d1e527a253c15f.zh: 佛木寺（日語：佛木寺）是位於愛媛縣宇和島市的真言宗御室派寺院。山號為一顆山，院號為毘盧舍那院。本尊為大日如來。為四國八十八所靈場第42號札所。

04d41619c9586f06.en: Mount Kubote (求菩提山, Kubotesan) is a mountain on the border of the city of Buzen and the town of Chikujō, in Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan. It is 782 metres (2,566 ft) in height. It is within the borders of the Yaba-Hita-Hikosan Quasi-National Park. Noted for its connections to the Shugendō mountain cult it was designated a  National Historic Site of Japan in 2001.
04d41619c9586f06.zh: 求菩提山是位於日本福岡縣豐前市與築上町交界處的山，高782公尺（2,566英尺），位於耶馬日田英彥山國定公園範圍內。此山以與修驗道山岳信仰的淵源聞名，於2001年被指定為日本國家史跡。

04dc031030b362a3.ja: 福山市鞆の浦歴史民俗資料館（ふくやましとものうられきしみんぞくしりょうかん）は、広島県福山市鞆町後地にある博物館。「潮待ちの館」の愛称をもつ。
04dc031030b362a3.zh: 福山市鞆の浦歴史民俗資料館是位於廣島縣福山市鞆町後地的博物館，暱稱「潮待之館」。

04f3471635c470aa.en: Zensui-ji (善水寺) is a Buddhist temple in the Iwane neighborhood of the city of Konan, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Tendai school of Japanese Buddhism. Its main image is a hibutsu statue of Yakushi Nyōrai, which was carved in 993. Its Hondō is a National Treasure.
04f3471635c470aa.zh: 善水寺是位於日本滋賀縣湖南市岩根地區的佛寺，屬日本佛教天台宗。本尊為雕刻於993年的祕佛藥師如來像。本堂為國寶。

04f9047d95b08ebf.en: Rokusonnō Shrine (六孫王神社) is a Shinto shrine located in Minami-ku, Kyoto, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. It is one of the Three Genji Shrines, a group of three Japanese Shinto shrines connected with the Seiwa Genji group (the descent from Emperor Seiwa) of the Minamoto clan.
04f9047d95b08ebf.zh: 六孫王神社是位於日本京都府京都市南區的神社。為源氏三神社之一；源氏三神社是與源氏中的清和源氏（清和天皇後裔）有淵源的三座神社。

04fd1c8e2715f5d9.en: Enkū Museum (円空館, Enkūkan) is a museum dedicated to Japanese monk and sculptor Enkū in the city of Seki, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. Enkū was born in Mino Province, present-day Gifu Prefecture, in 1632 and died in Seki in 1695.
04fd1c8e2715f5d9.zh: 關市圓空館（関市円空館）是位於日本岐阜縣關市、紀念日本僧侶暨雕刻家圓空的博物館。圓空於1632年生於美濃國（今岐阜縣），1695年逝於關。

052fa781f0e4590b.en: Gori tsukudani" is a dish made by tsukudaniing gori, a small fish that lives in Lake Biwa. Gori tsukudani is a local dish that has spread throughout the prefecture. Gori tsukudani" used to be so commonly eaten that it was considered a household delicacy, but in recent years the catch has decreased and gori is becoming a luxury food.Gori is a species of goby called yoshinobori that lives in Lake Biwa and is also called urori in some areas.
052fa781f0e4590b.zh: 「ごりの佃煮」是將棲息於琵琶湖的小魚ごり做成佃煮的料理，是流傳於全縣的鄉土料理。「ごりの佃煮」過去非常普遍，被視為家常的美味，但近年漁獲量減少，ごり逐漸成為高級食材。ごり是棲息於琵琶湖、名為ヨシノボリ的一種鰕虎魚，部分地區也稱為「うろり」。

0534d2ac81ab7d9d.en: Shinjuku Southern Terrace (Japanese: 新宿サザンテラス) is a commercial zone located at Yoyogi 2-chōme, Shibuya, Tokyo, at the western side of Shinjuku Station Southern Exit.
0534d2ac81ab7d9d.zh: 新宿サザンテラス（新宿サザンテラス）是位於東京都澀谷區代代木2丁目的商業區，在新宿站南口西側。

054284939c3d2c10.en: Matsuyama Castle  (松山城, Matsuyama-jō) was a  Sengoku period Japanese castle located in what is now part of  the town of Yoshimi, Hiki District, Saitama, in the Kantō region of Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site, since 2008. It is also referred to as Musashi-Matsuyama Castle, to distinguish it from the more famous Bitchū Matsuyama Castle or Iyo Matsuyama Castle.
054284939c3d2c10.zh: 松山城是戰國時代的日本城郭，位於今日本關東地方埼玉縣比企郡吉見町境內。城址自2008年起受指定為國家史跡並受到保護。為與較知名的備中松山城或伊予松山城區別，也稱為武藏松山城。

054dff41cf9ead83.en: Since ancient times, farmers have often grown "wakegi" as a spring vegetable. Similar to "hoso-negi" (Japanese leek), an essential condiment for Udon noodles, and "shiro-negi" (Japanese leek), a familiar winter Nabe dish, Wakegi is an indispensable ingredient for the spring table. It is a hybrid of Japanese leek and onion, and has a softer aroma than Japanese leek and a sweeter flavor when cooked.
054dff41cf9ead83.zh: 自古以來，農家常把「分蔥」當作春季蔬菜栽種。如同烏龍麵不可或缺的佐料「細蔥」，以及冬季常見火鍋料理中的「白蔥」，分蔥是春季餐桌不可少的食材。分蔥是蔥與洋蔥的雜交種，香氣比蔥溫和，煮過後味道更甜。

05616044dbe34326.en: Kobe City Koiso Memorial Museum of Art (神戸市立小磯記念美術館, Kobe Shiritsu Koiso Kinen Bijutsukan) is an art museum that opened on Rokkō Island in Kobe, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan in 1992. The collection includes some 2,500 works by Koiso Ryōhei, as well as those of artists associated with the yōga painter and the city.
05616044dbe34326.zh: 神戸市立小磯記念美術館是1992年於日本兵庫縣神戶市六甲アイランド開館的美術館，收藏小磯良平約2,500件作品，以及與這位洋畫家和神戶市有關的藝術家作品。

0562540076b4924a.en: The Yamaguchi Center for Arts and Media (山口情報芸術センター, Yamaguchi Jouhou Geijutsu Sentaa), (YCAM) is an art center located in Yamaguchi, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan. The structure was designed by the Arata Isozaki and opened in 2003. The building hosts a museum for contemporary art operated by the Yamaguchi City Foundation for Cultural Promotion, as well as the Yamaguchi City Central Library.
0562540076b4924a.zh: 山口情報芸術センター（YCAM）是位於日本山口縣山口市的藝術中心。建築由磯崎新設計，2003年開館。館內設有由山口市文化振興財團營運的當代藝術館，以及山口市立中央圖書館。

05793cb972412e38.en: Nisshō Pass (日勝峠, Nisshō-tōge) is a mountain pass 1,022 metres (3,353 ft) high at the north-end of the Hidaka Mountains of Hokkaidō, Japan. The east side feeds into the Tokachi River system and the west side the Saru River system.
05793cb972412e38.zh: 日勝峠是位於日本北海道日高山脈北端、高1,022公尺（3,353英尺）的山口。東側流入十勝川水系，西側流入沙流川水系。

05a03d88c809b08e.en: Toba Sea-Folk Museum (鳥羽市立海の博物館, Toba Shiritsu Umi no Hakubutsukan) is a museum dedicated to the area's fishing traditions in Toba, Mie Prefecture, Japan. Having first opened as the private Sea-Folk Museum in 1971, the museum reopened in its current location in 1992, and in 2017 was reestablished as a public, municipal museum under its current name. In 1998, the museum buildings, designed by Naitō Hiroshi, were included amongst the 100 Select Instances of Public Architecture (公共建築百選) by the then Ministry of Construction.
05a03d88c809b08e.zh: 鳥羽市立海の博物館是位於日本三重縣鳥羽市、以當地漁業傳統為主題的博物館。1971年以私立「海の博物館」開館，1992年於現址重新開館，2017年改制為公立市營博物館並改為現名。1998年，由內藤廣設計的館舍獲當時的建設省選入「公共建築百選」。

05b1cbdb78a2a734.en: The Hiroshima City Museum of History and Traditional Crafts is a history museum in Ujina-nishi Park in Hiroshima, Japan.
05b1cbdb78a2a734.zh: 広島市郷土資料館是位於日本廣島市宇品西公園內的歷史博物館。

05bd32dc4f9c269e.en: Tokyo Station Gallery (Japanese: 東京ステーションギャラリー, Tōkyō Sutēshon Gyararī) is an art museum in Marunouchi, Chiyoda, Tokyo, Japan. Located within Tokyo Station's Marunouchi building, it opened in 1988 and occupies part of the red-brick station complex designed by Tatsuno Kingo. The museum is especially known for exhibition rooms that expose the station's original structural brick and steel frame, and it is listed as a registered museum in Japan.
05bd32dc4f9c269e.zh: 東京ステーションギャラリー（東京ステーションギャラリー）是位於日本東京都千代田區丸之內的美術館。館址在東京車站丸之內站舍內，於1988年開館，占用辰野金吾設計的紅磚車站建築群的一部分。美術館以展示室中裸露的車站原始結構紅磚與鋼骨架特別知名，並列為日本的登錄博物館。

05bf491d0db959b1.en: "Akadatsu no subute" is a dish made by dressing the stalk part of the satoimo(=japanise taro) leaves (zuiki) with seasoned vinegar. "Datsu" refers to "zuiki," and when it is red, it is called "aka-datsu" (Red Taro Stalk).In the northern part of Yamagata City, which is an area with a rich tradition, there is limited flat land due to the mountainous terrain, making rice cultivation challenging. However, the lime-rich and lean soil is suitable for growing taro.
05bf491d0db959b1.zh: 「赤だつの酢ぶて」是將芋頭葉的葉柄部分（芋莖）以調味醋涼拌而成的料理。「だつ」指的是「芋莖」，呈紅色的稱為「赤だつ」（紅芋莖）。在傳承這道料理的山縣市北部，由於地勢多山、平地有限，種稻不易；但富含石灰的貧瘠土壤適合種植芋頭。

05d085875edf2a07.en: In Miyagi Prefecture, there are many opportunities to eat mochi, and it is said that mochi is eaten without fail at New Year's, weddings, Buddhist memorial services, funerals, and other annual events. In the past, rice cakes were made at home, but in recent years, many people have begun to purchase ready-made rice cakes.Perhaps because rice cakes are eaten so frequently, there is a wide variety of rice cakes available.
05d085875edf2a07.zh: 在宮城縣，吃麻糬的機會很多，據說在新年、婚禮、法事、喪禮及其他年中行事時必定會吃麻糬。過去麻糬都在家中製作，但近年來許多人開始購買現成的麻糬。或許因為食用頻率高，麻糬的種類也相當多樣。

05fd8d2225070688.en: Jōjō Castle (上条城, Jōjō-jō) was a hirashiro (平城, castle constructed on the plains) located in Kasugai, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. It was built in 1218 by Osaka Kouzen. Currently only ruins are left.
05fd8d2225070688.zh: 上條城是位於日本愛知縣春日井市的平城（建於平地上的城），1218年由Osaka Kouzen興建。目前僅存遺跡。

061fc270bd485f0c.en: The Cormorant Fishing House (鵜飼資料園, Ukai Shiryō-en) is a museum dedicated to Cormorant Fishing on the Nagara River and located in the city of Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. In addition to viewing artifacts from the history of cormorant fishing, visitors can also view the cormorants actually used in the process. The museum is run by the cormorant fishing masters, who are Imperial Agents of the Imperial Household Agency.
061fc270bd485f0c.zh: 鵜飼資料園是介紹長良川鵜飼（鸕鶿捕魚）的博物館，位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市。參觀者除了可觀看鵜飼歷史相關文物外，也能看到實際用於捕魚的鸕鶿。本館由身為宮內廳職員的鵜匠經營。

0629e36a2e16447d.en: Okayama Orient Museum (岡山市立オリエント美術館, Okayama Shiritsu Oriento Bijutsukan) is a museum of Ancient Near Eastern, Roman provincial, Byzantine, Sassanian, and Islamic Art in  Kita-ku, Okayama, Okayama Prefecture, Japan. As of 2007 there were some 4,852 items, including a winged Assyrian relief from the palace of Ashurnasirpal II in Nimrud, Mesopotamia, acquired to mark the institution's 25th anniversary.
0629e36a2e16447d.zh: 岡山市立オリエント美術館位於日本岡山縣岡山市北區，收藏古代近東、羅馬行省、拜占庭、薩珊及伊斯蘭藝術。截至2007年，館藏約4,852件，其中包括為紀念建館25週年而購入、出自美索不達米亞尼姆魯德亞述納西拔二世宮殿的有翼亞述浮雕。

064c1dd74f10810d.en: Tokutan Castle (徳丹城, Tokutan-jō) was an early Heian period jōsaku-style Japanese castle located in what is now the town of Yahaba in Shiwa District, Iwate Prefecture in the Tōhoku region of far northern Honshū, Japan. The site was proclaimed a National Historic Site of Japan on 5 August 1969.
064c1dd74f10810d.zh: 徳丹城是平安時代初期的城柵式日本城郭，位於今日本本州最北部東北地方岩手縣紫波郡矢巾町。遺址於1969年8月5日被指定為日本國家史跡。

06711aff53c99228.en: Strawbi produced in Yamagata Prefecture, which boasts the largest production volume in Japan, is soft and slimy, and is popular even in the Tokyo metropolitan area as a high-quality strawbi. Generally, after removing the scum from the bracken, the bracken is eaten as a dish such as chopped, boiled, simmered, or in miso soup.Tataki" in "Warabi Tataki" refers to a method of cooking in which the strawbi is placed on a cutting board and beaten with a knife as if cutting it, thereby breaking the fibers of the strawbi into small pieces.
06711aff53c99228.zh: 山形縣的蕨菜產量居全國之冠，所產蕨菜口感柔軟、帶有黏性，作為高品質蕨菜在首都圈也很受歡迎。一般而言，蕨菜去除澀味後，會做成切碎、汆燙、燉煮或味噌湯等料理食用。「わらびたたき」中的「たたき」，是指將蕨菜放在砧板上，用菜刀像切菜般拍剁，使蕨菜的纖維斷成細碎的烹調方式。

067399a448ee51c5.en: Mount Saga (嵯峨山, Saga-yama) is a mountain located on the border of Futtsu and Kyonan, Chiba Prefecture. Mount Saga has an elevation of 315.5 m (1,035 ft) and is one of the peaks of the Mineoka Mountain District of the Bōsō Hill Range.
067399a448ee51c5.zh: 嵯峨山（嵯峨山，Saga-yama）是位於千葉縣富津市與鋸南町交界的山。嵯峨山海拔315.5公尺（1,035英尺），是房總丘陵嶺岡山地的山峰之一。

0681ab8a7fa465eb.en: “Oshibori Udon” is a local dish that originated from the Sakaki area in Hanishina County. It is made by grating spicy daikon radish and squeezing out its juice. “Oshibori udon” is characterized by the use of squeezed daikon juice instead of dashi broth. The word “oshibori” in oshibori udon refers to this unique feature. This dish became popular during the Edo period (1603-1868) to the Meiji period (1868-1912). It gained fame because of the excellent combination of spicy daikon squeezed soup and Shinshu miso (rice miso).
0681ab8a7fa465eb.zh: 「おしぼりうどん」是源自埴科郡坂城地區的鄉土料理。作法是將辛辣的蘿蔔磨成泥並擠出汁液。「おしぼりうどん」的特色是以擠出的蘿蔔汁取代高湯，「おしぼり」一詞即指這項特點。這道料理在江戶時代（1603-1868）至明治時代（1868-1912）普及，因辛辣蘿蔔汁與信州味噌（米味噌）的絕佳搭配而聞名。

0682679e9b7ff359.en: The Kubosō Memorial Museum of Arts, Izumi (和泉市久保惣記念美術館, Izumi-shi Kubosō Kinen Bijutsukan) opened in Izumi, Osaka Prefecture, Japan, in 1982. The new wing was added in 1997. The local Kubo family, founders of the Kubosō cotton textile business, donated the land, buildings, collection, and funds for the museum's management to the city.
0682679e9b7ff359.zh: 和泉市久保惣記念美術館於1982年在日本大阪府和泉市開館，1997年增建新館。當地創辦久保惣棉紡織事業的久保家，將土地、建築、收藏品及美術館營運資金捐贈給市政府。

068fc4ad0318aacf.en: Shasui Falls (洒水の滝, Shasui-no-taki) is a waterfall on the Tanzawa River in Yamakita, Ashigarakami District, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan.
068fc4ad0318aacf.zh: 洒水の滝（洒水の滝，Shasui-no-taki）是位於日本神奈川縣足柄上郡山北町丹澤川上的瀑布。

069149fd31ef790a.en: The Kumayama ruins (熊山遺跡, Kumayama iseki) is a presumed Buddhist temple ruin located on Mount Kumayama of what is now the city of Akaiwa, Okayama, in the San'yō region of Japan. It consists of a stone stepped pyramid of unknown date and origin, and was designated as a National Historic Site in 1956.
069149fd31ef790a.zh: 熊山遺跡是位於日本山陽地方，今岡山縣赤磐市熊山上的一處推定佛寺遺跡。遺跡由一座年代及來歷不明的石造階梯狀金字塔構成，於1956年被指定為國家史跡。

06950d5ee3600452.en: Enichi-ji  (恵日寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Shingon-shu Buzan-ha sect in the town of Bandai, Yama District, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. The temple was founded in the Heian period as Enichi-ji  (慧日寺), and the ruins of its previous incarnation were designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1970.
06950d5ee3600452.zh: 恵日寺是位於日本福島縣耶麻郡磐梯町的真言宗豐山派佛寺。此寺於平安時代以「慧日寺」之名創建，其前身的遺址於1970年被指定為日本國家史跡。

06aa098519e60beb.en: Oiso Shrine (奥石神社, Oiso Jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in the Azuchi neighborhood of the city of Ōmihachiman, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. It located on the old Nakasendō highway connecting Kyoto with the eastern provinces of Japan, and part of the precincts are a National Historic Site. The main kami enshrined is Ame-no-Koyane, who at this shrine is worshipped as the kami of then kitchen and protection against fire, and for easy childbirth.
06aa098519e60beb.zh: 奧石神社是位於日本滋賀縣近江八幡市安土町的神社。神社位於連接京都與日本東國的舊中山道沿線，部分境內為國家史跡。主祭神為天兒屋根命，在本神社被奉為廚房與防火之神，以及安產之神。

06fb2cadd80966c6.en: “Hakozushi” can be found all over Japan. It is a type of sushi made by filling a square wooden box with sushi rice, placing the ingredients on top, and then pressing them down from above. The history of "Hakozushi" is older than that of nigirizushi. It started with “Narezushi”, which is made by marinating fish, rice, and salt for a long period of time, and by the Muromachi period (1336-1573), “Hannare” appeared, which is made to mature in a relatively short period of time.
06fb2cadd80966c6.zh: 箱ずし在日本各地都看得到，是將醋飯填入方形木箱，放上配料後從上方壓製而成的壽司。箱ずし的歷史比握壽司更久遠，起源於將魚、米和鹽長時間醃漬而成的「熟壽司」，到了室町時代（1336-1573）出現了在較短時間內熟成的「半熟壽司」。

07061059cf0fda0c.en: Shrimp and Beans is a local dish of Shiga Prefecture made by boiling sweet and spicy shrimp from Lake Biwa with soybeans and is rich in calcium and protein.In Shiga Prefecture, soybeans and azuki beans are grown on the banks of rice fields. Since ancient times, dishes using soybeans have often been eaten at celebrations, rituals, and festivals. Shrimp and Beans is one such dish. Shrimp and Beans can be made with inexpensive ingredients and are also eaten daily because it is easy to preserve.
07061059cf0fda0c.zh: 「えび豆」是滋賀縣的鄉土料理，將琵琶湖產的蝦與黃豆以甜辣口味燉煮而成，富含鈣質與蛋白質。滋賀縣會在稻田的田埂上種植黃豆與紅豆。自古以來，使用黃豆的料理常在慶典、祭祀和節慶時食用，えび豆就是其中之一。えび豆可用便宜的食材製作，又容易保存，因此也是日常食用的料理。

072b6c8998001eca.en: Mount Chigogabaka (稚児ヶ墓山, Chigogabaka-yama) is a 596.3 m (1,956 ft)　mountain of Tanjō Mountains, located Iwatani, Yamada, Kita-ku, Kobe, Hyōgo, Japan.
072b6c8998001eca.zh: 稚児ヶ墓山是丹生山地的一座山，海拔596.3公尺（1,956英尺），位於日本兵庫縣神戶市北區山田町岩谷。

074c036c3a9ba7ed.en: Kōriyama Castle (郡山城, Kōriyama-jō), also known as Inari Castle (稲荷舘, Inari-tate; lit. "Inari palace"), was a castle in Kōriyama, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. It was the seat of the Kōriyama clan (part of the Itō clan, which was a branch of the Date clan).
074c036c3a9ba7ed.zh: 郡山城又稱稻荷館（意為「稻荷宮殿」），是位於日本福島縣郡山市的城。這裡是郡山氏（伊東氏的一支，伊東氏為伊達氏的分支）的據點。

074f72d9c137648d.en: Sagae Dam is a rockfill dam located in Yamagata Prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for flood control, water supply and power production. The catchment area of the dam is 231 km2. The dam impounds about 340  ha of land when full and can store 109000 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1972 and completed in 1990.
074f72d9c137648d.zh: 寒河江ダム是位於日本山形縣的堆石壩。用於防洪、供水及發電。集水面積231平方公里。滿水時淹沒約340公頃土地，蓄水量可達109000千立方公尺。水壩於1972年開工，1990年完工。

07713401ab833e03.en: Kakinohana Castle (垣花城, Kakinohana jō; Okinawan: Kachinuhana Gushiku) is a Ryukyuan gusuku in Nanjō, Okinawa.
07713401ab833e03.zh: 垣花城（垣花城，Kakinohana jō；沖繩語：Kachinuhana Gushiku）是位於沖繩縣南城市的琉球御城（グスク）。

0782bea8d0f949d1.en: The name of this sweet comes from the fact that it is made by locking up soybeans with a sweet wheat flour dough. In the cities of Yamaga and Kikuchi, and the areas surrounding them, “tojiko mame/mame gashi” was prepared at the same time as osechi to be eaten during New Year’s. Sugar and water are cooked in a pan and after that, roasted soybeans are added. Once the soybeans become soft, wheat flour is added, and the ingredients are mixed. Oil is heated in a frying pan and the dough is kneaded until it becomes transparent.
0782bea8d0f949d1.zh: 這種點心的名稱，來自於用甜麵粉麵糊將大豆封住製成。在山鹿市、菊池市及周邊地區，「とじこ豆／豆菓子」會與年菜同時準備，於新年期間食用。在鍋中煮砂糖與水，之後加入炒過的大豆。大豆變軟後加入麵粉，將材料混合。在平底鍋中熱油，揉拌麵糊直到變得透明。

079297b691c7d3e5.en: Fukushima Prefecture is a famous producer of "Egoma" (Perilla). It is said that the history of "Egoma" dates back to before the Meiji Era (1868-1912), and it has been cultivated for a long time. “Egoma” is called "Junen" in the prefecture. It is said that the name "Junen" comes from the fact that “Egoma” is so nutritious that people are said to live ten years longer after eating it, and that the harvested seeds will sprout even after ten years if they are sown.
079297b691c7d3e5.zh: 福島縣是知名的「荏胡麻」（紫蘇籽）產地。據說「荏胡麻」的歷史可追溯至明治時代（1868-1912）以前，栽種已久。「荏胡麻」在縣內稱為「じゅうねん」。據說「じゅうねん」這個名稱的由來，是因為荏胡麻營養豐富，吃了可以多活十年，以及採收的種子即使過了十年再播種仍會發芽。

079daa93810e6be1.en: “Manba no Ken-chan” is a representative dish of Kagawa Prefecture's local cuisine, particularly during the winter months. Manba, a type of mustard green, is in season from October to April and is known for its unique bitterness. It is cultivated throughout the prefecture, and can even be seen in backyard gardens. The name "Manba" means "ten thousand leaves." The plant was given this name because it continues to sprout new leaves even after the outer ones are harvested.
079daa93810e6be1.zh: 「まんばのけんちゃん」是香川縣鄉土料理的代表菜色，尤其常見於冬季。まんば是一種芥菜類蔬菜，產季為10月到翌年4月，以獨特的苦味著稱。縣內各地都有栽種，連住家後院的菜園也看得到。「まんば」意為「萬葉」，因為外側葉片採收後仍會持續長出新葉，故得此名。

07b76b2c24028a06.en: Sennindani Dam is a gravity dam located in Toyama prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for power production. The catchment area of the dam is 284.1 km2. The dam impounds about 6  ha of land when full and can store 682 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1936 and completed in 1940.
07b76b2c24028a06.zh: 仙人谷水壩是位於日本富山縣的重力壩，用於發電。集水面積284.1平方公里。滿水時淹沒面積約6公頃，蓄水量68.2萬立方公尺。水壩於1936年動工，1940年完工。

07cc5a82215a4b92.en: Chōmei-ji (長命寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Chōmeiji neighborhood of the city of Ōmihachiman, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Tendai sect of Japanese Buddhism and its honzon (primary image) is a statue of Senjū Kannon Bosatsu (Sahasrabhuja), the bodhisattva of 1000 arms. The temple's full name is Ikiya-san Chōmei-ji (綺耶山 長命寺). The temple is the 31st stop on the 33-temple Saigoku Kannon Pilgrimage route. It is unique in that its honzon is a trinity of Senjū Kannon, Jūichimen Kannon Bosatsu and Shō-Kannon statues.
07cc5a82215a4b92.zh: 長命寺是位於日本滋賀縣近江八幡市長命寺町的佛教寺院，屬日本佛教天台宗，本尊為千手觀音菩薩像，即千臂的菩薩。寺院全名為綺耶山長命寺。本寺為33所西國觀音巡禮的第31號札所。其特殊之處在於本尊為千手觀音、十一面觀音菩薩與聖觀音三尊像。

07e60f8a8150ed1e.en: There are plenty of agricultural products in Gunma Prefecture; ‘Joushu-ushi’ (Beef from Joushu area, first beef in Japan exported to EU), ‘Shimonita-negi’ (Japanese leek from grown in Shimonita-cho in Kanra District. It’s thick and soft.) and so on. ‘Sukiyaki’ is a dish you can fully enjoy these great agricultural products in Gunma. All ingredients used in this dish is ‘100% self-sufficient’, meaning these are grown in this prefecture.
07e60f8a8150ed1e.zh: 群馬縣有許多農產品，例如「上州牛」（上州地區的牛肉，是日本第一個出口到歐盟的牛肉）、「下仁田蔥」（產自甘樂郡下仁田町的日本大蔥，粗而柔軟）等。「すき焼き」是能充分品嘗群馬這些優質農產品的料理。這道料理使用的所有食材都是「100%自給」，也就是都在縣內生產。

0811e01bf9d15df3.en: Yamasaki Cirque is a cirque located on the North-West side of Oyama peak of Mount Tateyama, Hida Mountains, Japan.
0811e01bf9d15df3.zh: 山崎圈谷是位於日本飛驒山脈立山雄山西北側的冰斗。

0818fa543a78a046.en: Tokiwa Park (常盤公園, Tokiwa Kōen) is a park located in Ube City in Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan.
0818fa543a78a046.zh: ときわ公園是位於日本山口縣宇部市的公園。

0846f8498e5949b0.en: "Ocha no ha tempura (=Green tea leaf tempura)" is a local dish eaten when freshly harvested green tea leaves are ready.
0846f8498e5949b0.zh: 「お茶の葉天ぷら」（綠茶葉天婦羅）是在剛採收的新鮮茶葉上市時食用的鄉土料理。

086d98eaccedddb5.en: Ki Nira is a specialty of Okayama Prefecture which accounts for 70% of the national production. It is said to have been cultivated circa 1872 in the Musa and Tamagashi areas of Okayama City. Through a unique cultivation method called "light shielding cultivation," which sunlight is blocked, it takes on a vibrant pastel yellow color. In addition to the inherent sweetness of chives, its fibers are soft enough to be enjoyed raw. Originally, it was discovered during the process of covering chives to soften them for cultivation.
086d98eaccedddb5.zh: 黃韭是岡山縣的特產，產量占全國70%。據說約於1872年開始在岡山市牟佐與玉柏地區栽培。透過遮斷陽光的獨特「遮光栽培」法，呈現鮮明的粉黃色。除了韭菜本身的甜味外，纖維柔軟，可以生食。最初是在為使韭菜軟化而加以覆蓋栽培的過程中發現的。

087d7c30a5c08d0b.en: The Kyū-Yodo River (旧淀川, Kyū-Yodo-gawa) was the main stream of the Yodo River before 1907, when the current (new) Yodo River was constructed by a normalisation project. Now called the Kyū-Yodo River, it is a major waterway in central Osaka and the main drainage of Neyagawa river.
087d7c30a5c08d0b.zh: 旧淀川在1907年以前是淀川的主流；同年透過河道整治工程開闢了現在的（新）淀川。現稱旧淀川，是大阪市中心的主要水道，也是寢屋川的主要排水河道。

087e6e5e76474c13.en: The Higashiyama Sky Tower is a pencil-shaped building located in the Higashiyama Zoo and Botanical Gardens in the city of Nagoya, central Japan.
087e6e5e76474c13.zh: 東山天空塔是位於日本中部名古屋市東山動植物園內的鉛筆形建築。

088fc10a7468157b.en: Matsuri-zushi, also called "Okayama-bara-zushi" or "Bizen-bara-zushi," is made for festivals, celebrations, and entertaining guests in the Bizen-Okayama area. It is a gorgeous chirashizushi filled with vegetables, seafood, and rich ingredients from the Seto Inland Sea. During the Edo period (1603-1867), Lord Mitsumasa Ikeda, the feudal lord of Okayama, issued a decree to economize, telling the common people to eat only one soup and one vegetable so that they would not be extravagant.
088fc10a7468157b.zh: まつりずし又稱「岡山散壽司」或「備前散壽司」，是備前岡山地區在祭典、慶祝及招待客人時製作的料理。這是一道華麗的散壽司，放滿蔬菜、海鮮以及瀨戶內海的豐富食材。江戶時代（1603-1867），岡山藩主池田光政頒布節儉令，要求平民只吃一湯一菜，不得奢侈。

08945a60a64343a0.en: The Aloha Garden Tateyama (アロハガーデンたてやま, Aloha Garden Tateyama) is a botanical garden located in Tateyama, Chiba, Japan. It is open daily; an admission fee is charged.
08945a60a64343a0.zh: アロハガーデンたてやま是位於日本千葉縣館山市的植物園。每日開放，需付費入場。

08a8336c31d25841.en: "Yama-no-imo" (Japanese mountain yam) in a "Suribachi" (Japanese mortar) and mixing it with a thick miso soup to create a spread. In the Akita style, it is made with a type of "Yama-no-imo" that has a firmer texture than "Nagaimo" (Japanese long yam). Yama-no-imo is often circulated as "Tsukuneimo," characterized by its round, black appearance resembling a fist and its low moisture, dense, white, and sticky interior.
08a8336c31d25841.zh: 將「山の芋」（日本山藥）放入「擂鉢」（研磨缽）磨碎，再與濃味噌湯混合成泥狀。秋田的做法使用口感比「長芋」更紮實的「山の芋」。山の芋常以「つくね芋」之名流通，特徵是外觀圓而黑、形似拳頭，內部水分少、質地緻密、色白且黏稠。

08aae340e02e02dd.en: Nasu-Kanda Castle (那須神田城, Nasu-Kanda jō) was a Heian period Japanese castle located in what is now part of  the town of Nakagawa, Tochigi Prefecture, in the northern Kantō region of Japan. The site has been protected  as a National Historic Site, since 1984.
08aae340e02e02dd.zh: 那須神田城是平安時代的日本城郭，位於今日本北關東地區栃木縣那珂川町。遺址自1984年起列為國家史跡受到保護。

08b8751f9f5cba12.en: Utsunomiya Museum of Art (宇都宮美術館, Utsunomiya Bijutsukan) opened in a wooded area some 5 kilometres (3.1 mi) north of the centre of Utsunomiya, Tochigi Prefecture, Japan, in 1997. The collection includes works by Kuroda Seiki and Asai Chū, Paul Klee and Wassily Kandinsky, and special exhibitions are also held.
08b8751f9f5cba12.zh: 宇都宮美術館於1997年在日本栃木縣宇都宮市中心以北約5公里（3.1英里）的林地中開館。館藏包括黑田清輝、淺井忠、保羅・克利及瓦西里・康丁斯基的作品，並舉辦特別展。

08c83c65eb48b912.en: Taihō-ji (大宝寺) is a Buddhist temple in Matsuyama, Ehime Prefecture, Japan. The Hondō has been designated a National Treasure and a number of the temple's treasures are Important Cultural Properties.
08c83c65eb48b912.zh: 大宝寺是位於日本愛媛縣松山市的佛教寺院。本堂已被指定為國寶，寺內多件寶物為重要文化財。

08da30550fa75358.en: "Komo-dofu" is a simple tofu dish wrapped in a "komo," a roughly woven straw mat. "Komo-dofu," which has been passed down for over 100 years, is one of the traditional foods of the central area which includes Kurayoshi City, and is an indispensable dish for special days such as important family ceremonies, festivals and Buddhist rites. Tofu is commonly eaten in Tottori Prefecture, where fish is hard to obtain, and it served as a precious source of protein for the masses.
08da30550fa75358.zh: 「こも豆腐」是用「こも」（粗編的稻草蓆）包裹的簡樸豆腐料理。流傳超過100年的「こも豆腐」是包含倉吉市在內的中部地區傳統食物之一，在家族重要儀式、祭典、佛事等特別的日子不可或缺。在不易取得魚類的鳥取縣，豆腐是常見的食物，也是一般民眾珍貴的蛋白質來源。

08e4152443e701d9.en: Aqua World (アクアワールド・大洗, Akua Wārudo Oarai), formerly the Ibaraki Prefectural Oarai Aquarium (茨城県大洗水族館, Ibaraki-ken Oarai suizokukan), is a 19,800 square metres (213,000 sq ft) aquarium in the Higashiibaraki District of Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan, north of Oarai port at the mouth of the Naka River.
08e4152443e701d9.zh: アクアワールド・大洗舊稱茨城縣大洗水族館，是位於日本茨城縣東茨城郡的水族館，面積19,800平方公尺（213,000平方英尺），位於那珂川河口大洗港以北。

08ed518d78ea405b.en: Kensan-yaki is a local dish of grilled rice balls topped with ginger miso or sweet miso. It is also called "kensashi-yaki," "kenshin-yaki," or "kensayaki." The name is said to have originated when Kenshin Uesugi used to eat rice balls that had become cold and tough by stabbing them with the tip of his sword as food for his soldiers during war. In the old days, transportation was not well developed, so people had to travel on foot along snow-covered roads when returning to their hometowns.
08ed518d78ea405b.zh: けんさん焼き是在飯糰上塗抹薑味噌或甜味噌後烤製的鄉土料理，也稱為「けんさし焼き」、「謙信焼き」或「けんさ焼き」。據說其名稱由來是上杉謙信在戰時，將變冷變硬的飯糰用刀尖刺著烤來吃，作為士兵的糧食。過去交通不發達，人們返鄉時必須徒步走在積雪的道路上。

08faeabcabfe044c.en: Shiraishi Island (白石島, Shiraishi-jima) is an island in the Inland Sea of Japan and is considered part of the municipality of Kasaoka, Okayama Prefecture. It is one of six inhabited islands in the Kasaoka Islands, a chain of islands most easily reached from the port city of Kasaoka on Japan's main island, Honshū.
08faeabcabfe044c.zh: 白石島是日本瀨戶內海的島嶼，隸屬岡山縣笠岡市。它是笠岡諸島中六座有人島之一，這群島嶼從日本本州的港口城市笠岡前往最為便利。

0900d804875a80d0.en: Tottori Prefecture faces the Sea of Japan, and in winter, the cold air from the north causes a lot of snow to accumulate, making it difficult for people living in mountainous areas to procure food materials during the winter. In Tottori Prefecture, squid, or Japanese common squid, is harvested in autumn (from September to November).
0900d804875a80d0.zh: 鳥取縣面臨日本海，冬季來自北方的冷空氣帶來大量積雪，使山區居民在冬季難以取得食材。在鳥取縣，魷魚（太平洋褶柔魚）於秋季（9月至11月）捕撈。

0901b70fb94c68b0.en: In Takasago City, there is a dish called "nikuten," which is a type of okonomiyaki (Japanese pancake) made by folding thinly stretched dough over seasoned potatoes, beef tendon, konjac(=yam cake), cabbage, etc., and then grilling it. It is commonly enjoyed as a home-cooked meal. While the exact origin is unclear, it became popular after World War II when wheat flour started to be imported from the United States. It is said that people started making nikuten using leftover oden ingredients the day after enjoying oden at home.
0901b70fb94c68b0.zh: 高砂市有一道料理稱為「にくてん」，是一種大阪燒（日式煎餅），將擀薄的麵糊摺疊包覆調味過的馬鈴薯、牛筋、蒟蒻、高麗菜等食材後煎烤而成，常作為家常菜食用。確切起源不明，但在第二次世界大戰後開始從美國進口麵粉時普及。據說人們在家吃完關東煮的隔天，用剩下的關東煮食材做成にくてん。

091d1296474786ac.en: Tofu was first eaten in Japan in the late Heian period (794-1185). It is said to have been introduced from China.In Kochi Prefecture, tofu was introduced by Park, who was brought back by Chosokabe Motochika, a feudal lord of Tosa Province, when he went to Korea. It is said that Yamauchi Kazutoyo, lord of the Tosa domain, also recommended the monopoly of tofu in Karajinmachi.
091d1296474786ac.zh: 日本最早食用豆腐是在平安時代（794-1185）後期，據說是從中國傳入。在高知縣，豆腐是由土佐國大名長宗我部元親前往朝鮮時帶回的朴氏傳入。據說土佐藩主山內一豐也曾推動唐人町的豆腐專賣。

094d43ff0abfcebf.en: ”Tofu Castella” is a confectionery made by taking tofu that has been squeezed and had the water drained from it, mixing it with sugar and eggs, and baking it in to the shape of a “castella” sponge cake. As a tofu dish that has been handed down in the southern region of Akita Prefecture, it has long been eaten as a side dish at ceremonial occasions, as a snack, or as an accompaniment to tea.
094d43ff0abfcebf.zh: 「豆腐カステラ」是將豆腐擠壓瀝乾水分後，加入砂糖和雞蛋混合，烤成「長崎蛋糕」形狀的點心。這是秋田縣南部地區流傳下來的豆腐料理，長久以來作為婚喪喜慶場合的配菜、點心或配茶的茶點食用。

09515fe57bcedde6.en: Subari Dam is a gravity dam located in Akita Prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for flood control, irrigation and power production. The catchment area of the dam is 100 km2. The dam impounds about 192  ha of land when full and can store 42500 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1966 and completed in 1970.
09515fe57bcedde6.zh: 素波里水壩是位於日本秋田縣的重力壩，用於防洪、灌溉與發電。水壩集水面積為100平方公里，滿水時淹沒面積約192公頃，蓄水量可達4250萬立方公尺。水壩於1966年動工，1970年完工。

095cd0f8d687282e.en: "Fuka" refers to sharks, and sharks of about 1m long are often caught in Nanyo, including Isabafuka, Mabuka, Hoshibuka, etc. This dish is said to have began when, in the past, fuka that were caught by fishermen but could not be sold were mixed with vinegared miso and made into a side dish. It has a pleasant texture, with firm flesh and crunchy fins. The preparation is so time-consuming that even if you start making it in the morning, it won't be ready until the evening, so it is only made by a small number of businesses.
095cd0f8d687282e.zh: 「ふか」指的是鯊魚，南予地區常捕獲長約1公尺的鯊魚，包括いさばふか、まぶか、ほしぶか等。據說這道料理的起源，是過去漁夫捕到卻賣不出去的鯊魚，拌上醋味噌做成配菜。口感良好，魚肉緊實，魚鰭爽脆。製作非常費時，即使早上開始做，也要到傍晚才能完成，因此只有少數業者在製作。

0965b5efec960209.en: Hasuimo, eaten mainly in Tokushima and Kochi, is a type of satoimo(=Japanese taro). It is said to have originated in Southeast Asia, but is sometimes called "ryukyu" because it was introduced from Okinawa. As the name suggests, it is a taro, but it is mainly the stems and leaves that are eaten. Among them, the stems of hasuimo are used in various dishes such as miso soup, salad, stir-fry, simmered dish, and dressed dish, and one of them is a local dish of vinegared hasuimo with swordfish.
0965b5efec960209.zh: はすいも主要在德島與高知食用，是芋頭（里芋）的一種。據說原產於東南亞，因為是從沖繩傳入，有時也被稱為「りゅうきゅう」。如名稱所示，它屬於芋頭，但主要食用的是莖和葉。其中はすいも的莖可用於味噌湯、沙拉、熱炒、燉煮、涼拌等各種料理，搭配旗魚做成的醋拌はすいも就是其中一道鄉土料理。

09660fd9fe986c5c.en: Both "flat dago" and "dagojiru", local dishes of Saga Prefecture, are made with "dago". “Dago” is a corruption of the word “dango,” and "flat dago" is a snack made by boiling flat wheat dough and sprinkling it with brown sugar. "Dagojiru", on the other hand, is a soup made by simmering wheat flour dumplings with plenty of seasonal vegetables.
09660fd9fe986c5c.zh: 佐賀縣的鄉土料理「平だご」和「だご汁」都是用「だご」製作。「だご」是「だんご」的訛音，「平だご」是將壓平的小麥麵團煮熟後撒上黑糖的點心。而「だご汁」則是將小麥粉做的麵疙瘩與大量當季蔬菜一起燉煮的湯品。

0976cdca8da53c5d.en: Seki Art Gallery (セキ美術館, Seki Bijutsukan) is a private art museum that opened in Matsuyama, Ehime Prefecture, Japan in 1997. The collection includes sculptures by Rodin and Bourdelle, Yōga by Asai Chū, Fujishima Takeji, and Koiso Ryōhei, and Nihonga by Yokoyama Taikan and Kayama Matazō.
0976cdca8da53c5d.zh: セキ美術館是1997年於日本愛媛縣松山市開館的私立美術館。館藏包括羅丹與布爾代勒的雕塑，淺井忠、藤島武二、小磯良平的洋畫，以及橫山大觀、加山又造的日本畫。

0978a8fb945d184d.en: Nagano Sports Park (長野運動公園, (Nagano undou kouen)) is a park located in the Yoshida area of the city of Nagano, Nagano, Japan,  approximately 5 km northeast of Nagano Station. The facilities are owned by Nagano Prefecture and by the Nagano municipal government.
0978a8fb945d184d.zh: 長野運動公園是位於日本長野縣長野市吉田地區的公園，在長野車站東北方約5公里處。設施由長野縣及長野市政府所有。

097967483da7e880.en: A local dish of Ena City and the surrounding area using the larvae of hebo (black hornet, a bee about 2 cm in length that nests in the ground). High in protein and calories, hebo was a valuable source of protein in this region far from the sea, and was served as a treat to important guests as well as to promote the health of the local residents.The culture of eating hebo is flourishing in the mountainous areas from Shinshu to Okumikawa.
097967483da7e880.zh: 惠那市及周邊地區使用へぼ（黑胡蜂，一種體長約2公分、在地下築巢的蜂）幼蟲製作的鄉土料理。へぼ富含蛋白質與熱量，在這個遠離海洋的地區是珍貴的蛋白質來源，除了用來款待重要客人，也用於增進當地居民的健康。從信州到奧三河的山區，食用へぼ的文化相當盛行。

097ea8ded207d876.en: "Yukina no Fusubedzuke" is a pickled dish using yukina, a snow cabbage. Yukina is one of the Yamagata-Okitama traditional vegetables, a special vegetable of the Okitama region. The name "Fusubezuke" comes from the dialect word "fusuberu," which means "to quickly dip in hot water". Yukina cabbage is a rare, blanch vegetable that grows in the snow in Japan. It is said that Lord Uesugi Takayama encouraged its cultivation in order to secure fresh vegetables in snow country.
097ea8ded207d876.zh: 「雪菜のふすべ漬け」是使用雪菜製作的醃漬料理。雪菜是山形置賜傳統蔬菜之一，為置賜地方的特產蔬菜。「ふすべ漬け」之名來自方言「ふすべる」，意思是「迅速浸入熱水」。雪菜是在日本雪中生長的稀有軟化蔬菜。據說上杉鷹山公為了在雪國確保新鮮蔬菜而獎勵栽培。

0989ee17b19f4575.en: The Shijimizuka ruins (蜆塚遺跡, Shijimizuka iseki) is an archaeological site containing a late to final Jōmon period settlement trace and shell middens, located in what is now Chūō-ku, Hamamatsu, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. The settlement was inhabited from approximately 2000 BC to 1000 BC. In 1959, the site was designated a National Historic Site and expanded and opened to the public as an archaeological park in 1984. A number of pit dwellings have been reconstructed. The site also preserves a late-19th-century farmhouse.
0989ee17b19f4575.zh: 蜆塚遺跡是位於日本靜岡縣濱松市中央區的考古遺址，有繩文時代後期至晚期的聚落遺跡與貝塚。聚落約在西元前2000年至西元前1000年間有人居住。1959年列為國家史蹟，經擴充整備後於1984年以考古公園形式對外開放。園內復原了多座豎穴住居，也保存一棟19世紀後期的農家建築。

098e64e5e309b8d2.en: The Rock-Breaking (or Rock-Splitting) Cherry Tree (石割桜, Ishiwarizakura) is an approximately 400-year-old cherry tree growing out of a crack in a granite boulder. It is located in front of the district courthouse in Morioka, the capital of Iwate Prefecture in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan.
098e64e5e309b8d2.zh: 石割桜（又稱裂石櫻）是一棵樹齡約400年的櫻花樹，從花崗岩巨石的裂縫中生長而出。位於日本北部東北地方岩手縣縣廳所在地盛岡市的地方法院前。

09a95fed0d5971a6.en: Katusrao Castle (葛尾城, Katsurao-jō)) is the remains of a castle structure in Sakaki, Nagano Prefecture, Japan. It is located on a 816-meter mountain. The castle was a main bastion of the Murakami clan.
09a95fed0d5971a6.zh: 葛尾城是位於日本長野縣坂城町的城郭遺跡，坐落於海拔816公尺的山上。此城曾是村上氏的主要據點。

09ab81c55c463404.en: The Akita Akarenga Museum (秋田市立赤れんが郷土館, Akita shiritsu akarenga kyōdokan) is a museum of local history and culture in Akita, Japan.
09ab81c55c463404.zh: 秋田市立赤れんが郷土館是位於日本秋田市的地方歷史文化博物館。

09b15b31a0ba0815.en: Kiyotaki-ji is a Shingon Buddhist Temple located in Tosa, Kōchi, Japan. It is the 35th temple of the Shikoku Pilgrimage. The Honzon of Kiyotaki-ji is Bhaisajyaguru.
09b15b31a0ba0815.zh: 清瀧寺是位於日本高知縣土佐市的真言宗寺院，為四國遍路第35號札所。清瀧寺的本尊為藥師如來。

09bc4bd3df9efecd.en: The Katsuei area (Mimasaka City, Katsuo Town, Nagi Town, and Nishiawakura Village), located in the northeastern part of Okayama Prefecture, is one of the leading black bean production areas in Japan. The black beans produced in the Katsuei area are named Sakushu Guro and are branded as such. These large, tasty black beans are attractive, and various products such as tea and edamame made from Sakushu Guro are being developed and marketed throughout the country.
09bc4bd3df9efecd.zh: 位於岡山縣東北部的勝英地區（美作市、勝央町、奈義町、西粟倉村）是日本主要的黑豆產地之一。勝英地區生產的黑豆名為「作州黑」，並以此作為品牌。這些大顆美味的黑豆頗具魅力，以作州黑製成的茶、毛豆等各種商品正在開發，並行銷全國。

09cf4377fb03b0b7.en: The Gōkei area (豪渓, Gōkei) is a river valley formed by the Makidani River (a tributary of the Takahashi River) which stretched from the extreme northern part of Sōja to Kibichūō (formerly Kayō) in Okayama Prefecture, Japan. The area is only about 600m long, but the area is filled with strange granite rock formations resulting from wind and rain erosion. The area has become a local attraction for those wanting to view the scenic beauty and the strange formations, leading to its listing in 1923 as a national scenic spot in Japan.
09cf4377fb03b0b7.zh: 豪溪是由槙谷川（高梁川支流）形成的河谷，從日本岡山縣總社市最北部延伸至吉備中央町（舊賀陽町）。此區長約600公尺，但遍布因風雨侵蝕而形成的奇特花崗岩地形。這裡成為當地欣賞景色與奇岩的景點，並於1923年被列為日本國家名勝。

09d3f3bd547bca51.en: Oishi Kōgen Prefectural Natural Park (生石高原県立自然公園, Oishi Kōgen kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1955, the park spans the borders of the municipalities of Aridagawa and Kimino. The park's central feature is the eponymous Oishi Plateau (生石高原).
09d3f3bd547bca51.zh: 生石高原縣立自然公園是位於日本和歌山縣的縣立自然公園。公園設立於1955年，範圍橫跨有田川町與紀美野町。公園的主要景觀為同名的生石高原。

09e72164568ffdf0.en: "Shoyu no Mi" is a preserved food that has been passed down in the Ashiyasu region, made by fermenting soybeans and koji (malted rice). It is a local dish unique to the Ashiyasu region. The Ashiyasu region has long been characterized by its sloped terrain and cold climate, making it unsuitable for conventional vegetable cultivation and rice farming. Soybeans, known for their cold resistance, have been cultivated abundantly in this region.
09e72164568ffdf0.zh: 「しょうゆの実」是蘆安地區流傳下來的保存食品，以黃豆和麴（米麴）發酵製成，是蘆安地區獨有的鄉土料理。蘆安地區自古地形多坡、氣候寒冷，不適合一般的蔬菜栽培與稻作。以耐寒著稱的黃豆在此地大量種植。

09eac8d11756e86d.en: Cape Kannon (Japanese: 観音崎, Kannonzaki) is a cape at the easternmost point of the Miura Peninsula, which divides Tokyo Bay from the Pacific Ocean.
09eac8d11756e86d.zh: 観音崎是位於三浦半島最東端的岬角，為東京灣與太平洋的分界。

09f2cff33f04ae6a.en: “Oshimon” (or “okoshimon”) is a seasonal confectionery from Aichi Prefecture made by kneading rice flour with boiling water, shaping it in a mold, and decorating it with colored powder. In the Nishi-Mikawa region it’s customary to eat “Igamanju" during the Doll’s Festival (Momo no Sekku).“Igamanju” is a confection made by coating either coarse or fine red bean paste in rice flour and then decorating the surface with colored glutinous rice.
09f2cff33f04ae6a.zh: 「おしもん」（或「おこしもん」）是愛知縣的季節點心，以熱水揉和米粉，用模具塑形後撒上彩色粉末裝飾。西三河地區有在女兒節（桃の節句）吃「いがまんじゅう」的習俗。「いがまんじゅう」是以米粉皮包裹粒餡或豆沙餡，再於表面裝飾彩色糯米的點心。

09fceadaf7d0bfb8.en: This is a staple summer dish in Yamagata Prefecture in which you can easily eat vegetables in their raw form. This dish has been mainly eaten in the Murayama region, which is surrounded by mountains and has extremely hot and humid summers, and is still a part of the local people's lives today.
09fceadaf7d0bfb8.zh: 這是山形縣夏季的家常料理，可以輕鬆生食蔬菜。主要在群山環繞、夏季極為炎熱潮濕的村山地區食用，至今仍是當地人生活的一部分。

0a1e6521807119fc.en: In Ishikawa Prefecture, “Oshi-zushi” is eaten on festivals and celebratory occasions. In Kanazawa City, “Sushi” is made by layering vinegared fish, Sushi Rice, and dark blue seaweed in a wooden frame and pressing it overnight. It is said that by weighing down the fish overnight, the fish and sushi rice bring out the best of each other and harmonize with each other.The moderate acidity also whets the appetite.
0a1e6521807119fc.zh: 在石川縣，「押しずし」是在祭典及喜慶場合食用的料理。在金澤市，「壽司」是將醋漬魚、壽司飯和深藍色海藻層層疊放在木框中，壓製一整晚而成。據說將魚壓上一夜，魚與壽司飯能相互襯托出彼此的美味並融為一體。適度的酸味也能促進食慾。

0a34583311aaaca1.en: The Miyajima Natural Botanical Garden (宮島自然植物実験所, Miyajima Shizen Shokubutsu Jikkensho; 11.5 hectares) is a botanical garden operated by Hiroshima University and located at Mitsumaruko-yama 1156-2, Miyajima-cho, Hatsukaichi, Hiroshima, Japan. It is open daily except New Years and August; admission is free.
0a34583311aaaca1.zh: 宮島自然植物實驗所（宮島自然植物実験所，面積11.5公頃）是由廣島大學經營的植物園，位於日本廣島縣廿日市市宮島町三丸子山1156-2。除新年期間與8月外每日開放，免費入園。

0a40f2a83c01c6b7.en: Mie Prefecture has many edible natural seaweeds such as sagarame (Alaume), akamoku (red seaweed), hijiki (dried seaweed), aonori (blue-green laver), maksa (Chinese bamboo grass), and wakame (seaweed). Cultivation of asakusa nori and aosa nori is also popular.Arame is a member of the kelp family and looks similar to kelp, but it is called arame because it has rougher surface wrinkles than kelp.
0a40f2a83c01c6b7.zh: 三重縣有許多可食用的天然海藻，如さがらめ、アカモク、ひじき、青海苔、まくさ、裙帶菜等。淺草海苔與石蓴的養殖也很盛行。荒布屬於昆布科，外觀與昆布相似，但因表面皺紋比昆布粗糙，所以被稱為「荒布」。

0a56b0ee6edcb67e.en: "Suguki" is a type of turnip greens, a traditional vegetable in Kyoto, known for its distinctive acidity. It is rarely consumed outside of pickles, and "Suguki Pickles" is as famous as "Senmaizuke" and "Shibazuke," making it part of the trio of famous pickles in Kyoto.
0a56b0ee6edcb67e.zh: 「すぐき」是蕪菁葉菜的一種，屬於京都的傳統蔬菜，以獨特的酸味聞名。除了醃漬之外很少食用，「すぐき漬け」與「千枚漬け」、「しば漬け」同樣知名，並列為京都三大醃菜。

0a6785a71b455152.en: Zenkō-ji (有珠善光寺, Usu Zenkō-ji) is a Buddhist temple located in the Usu neighborhood of the city of Date, Hokkaido, Japan. It belongs to the Jōdō-shū sect of Japanese Buddhism and its honzon is a statue of Amida Nyorai. The temple has been designed a National Historic Site since 1974.
0a6785a71b455152.zh: 有珠善光寺是位於日本北海道伊達市有珠地區的佛教寺院，屬日本佛教淨土宗，本尊為阿彌陀如來像。寺院自1974年起被指定為國家史蹟。

0a97e99c2b5ebaeb.en: Sōfuku-ji (崇福寺) is a Rinzai temple in Hakata-ku, Fukuoka, Japan. Its honorary sangō prefix is Yokodakezan (横岳山). The temple was founded by the monk Tan'e (湛慧) in Dazaifu in 1240, but was moved to its present location in 1600 after it became the Kuroda family temple.
0a97e99c2b5ebaeb.zh: 崇福寺是位於日本福岡市博多區的臨濟宗寺院，山號為橫岳山。1240年由僧人湛慧創建於太宰府，成為黑田家的菩提寺後，於1600年遷至現址。

0aa5f0a23b1abadb.en: Nezame no toko (寝覚の床), meaning "Bed of Awakening" is a scenic spot in Japan, located in Agematsu, Kiso District, Nagano Prefecture. It is a nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty.
0aa5f0a23b1abadb.zh: 寝覚の床意為「覺醒之床」，是位於日本長野縣木曾郡上松町的風景名勝，為國家指定名勝。

0aa64a6583902430.en: The Tohoku University Museum (東北大学総合学術博物館, Tōhoku Daigaku Sōgō Gakujutsu Hakubutsukan) is a university museum affiliated with Tohoku University in Sendai, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan. From the collection of over 2,000,000 items, including rocks, minerals, fossils, archaeological materials, and maps, approximately 1,000 are on display at any one time.
0aa64a6583902430.zh: 東北大学総合学術博物館是隸屬於日本宮城縣仙台市東北大學的大學博物館。館藏超過200萬件，包括岩石、礦物、化石、考古資料及地圖等，常設展出約1,000件。

0aaca28a7fadaeae.en: Mibu no Hana Taue (壬生の花田植) is ritual of transplanting rice that is held every year on the first Sunday of June in Kitahiroshima, Hiroshima, in hopes of a good harvest. It is a traditional event. It has been designated as an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property of Japan and is listed in the Representative List of Human Intangible Cultural Heritage of the UNESCO Convention for the Safeguarding of Intangible Cultural Heritage.
0aaca28a7fadaeae.zh: 壬生の花田植是每年6月第一個星期日在廣島縣北廣島町舉行的插秧儀式，用以祈求豐收，屬於傳統活動。已被指定為日本重要無形民俗文化財，並列入聯合國教科文組織《保護無形文化遺產公約》的人類非物質文化遺產代表作名錄。

0aae53e57aec87d1.en: Imogushi" is a local dish of roasted sweet potatoes on skewers with a savory miso sauce, which has been prepared for ceremonial occasions and events. Sato-imo was introduced to Japan from tropical Asia during the Jomon period (before rice cultivation). In Tochigi Prefecture, sato-imo has been cultivated in a wide area except for the former Kuriyama Village, which is unsuitable for sato-imo cultivation due to its cold climate.
0aae53e57aec87d1.zh: 「芋ぐし」是將芋頭串在竹籤上烤，並塗上味噌醬的鄉土料理，一直在儀式場合與節慶活動時製作。里芋在繩文時代（稻作開始之前）從熱帶亞洲傳入日本。在栃木縣，除了因氣候寒冷不適合栽培里芋的舊栗山村之外，里芋在廣大地區都有栽培。

0abc13f90cb3b690.en: Kii Castle (基肄城, Kii-jō or Kii-no-ki) was an ancient castle (also known as a Korean-style fortresses in Japan (朝鮮式山城, Chōsen-shiki yamajiro) straddling Mt. Kizan(ja:基山) where the border between the city of Chikushino, Fukuoka and the town of Kiyama, Saga Prefecture Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1937, and raised to a  Special Historic Site  since 1954.
0abc13f90cb3b690.zh: 基肄城（Kii-jō或Kii-no-ki）是古代城郭（亦即日本的朝鮮式山城），橫跨位於福岡縣筑紫野市與佐賀縣基山町交界處的基山。其遺跡自1937年起列為國家史跡受到保護，1954年升格為特別史跡。

0ad008a76fdcbb91.en: "Sawachi" cooking refers to regional cuisine from Kochi prefecture and it is served for weddings, funerals, ceremonies, and Shinto rituals. "Sawachi" cooking are served on large platters that are around 36cm to 39cm in diameter. "Saba no sugata zushi" is one of the main dishes in "sawachi" cooking.
