Fresh mackerel is cut open and soaked in vinegar. Sushi rice is then stuffed into the mackerel. The head and tail of the mackerel which has been cut off is placed on the platter with the sushi as decorations.
0ad008a76fdcbb91.zh: 「皿鉢」料理是高知縣的地方料理，用於婚禮、喪禮、儀式及神道祭祀。「皿鉢」料理盛裝在直徑約36公分至39公分的大盤上。「さばの姿ずし」是「皿鉢」料理的主菜之一。將新鮮鯖魚剖開後浸泡在醋中，再將壽司飯塞入鯖魚中。切下的鯖魚頭與尾則和壽司一起擺在盤上作為裝飾。

0ada9ad290f7c455.en: The Shi-gakkō or Shigakkō (Japanese: 私學校; literally "Private school") was a system of military academies in Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan during the early Meiji era (late 19th century). Created by Saigō Takamori, the building of these schools and the organization of a political clique inside its walls was a cause of the Satsuma Rebellion. Many officers involved in the rebellion on the side of the Satsuma Domain were graduates of the Shi-gakkō.
0ada9ad290f7c455.zh: 私學校（日文：私學校，字面意思為「私立學校」）是明治初期（19世紀後期）設於日本鹿兒島縣的軍事學校體系。由西鄉隆盛創設，這些學校的興建及校內政治派系的形成，是西南戰爭的起因之一。參與這場叛亂、站在薩摩藩一方的軍官，許多是私學校的畢業生。

0aea465b393897ec.en: Futamigaura (二見ヶ浦, Futamigaura), also known as Sakurai Futamigaura (桜井二見ヶ浦, Sakurai Futamigaura) and Chikuzen Futamigaura (筑前二見ヶ浦, Chikuzen Futamigaura)  is a coastline spanning Itoshima and Fukuoka in Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan, and is part of Genkai Quasi-National Park.
0aea465b393897ec.zh: 二見浦又稱櫻井二見浦、筑前二見浦，是橫跨日本福岡縣糸島市與福岡市的海岸，屬於玄海國定公園的一部分。

0aeef0a90b37f315.ja: 平塚競輪場（ひらつかけいりんじょう）は、神奈川県平塚市にある競輪場。通称はABEMA湘南バンク (ABEMA SHONANBANK)。
0aeef0a90b37f315.zh: 平塚競輪場是位於神奈川縣平塚市的自行車競速場，通稱ABEMA湘南バンク（ABEMA SHONANBANK）。

0b3735fe0ba38bab.en: Jikō-ji (慈光寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Nishidaira neighborhood of the town of Tokigawa, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the  Tendai sect and its honzon is a statue of Jūichimen Kannon Bosatsu.  The temple's full name is Toki-zan Ichijōhōren-in Jikō-ji  (都幾山 一乗法華院 慈光寺).The temple is the 9th stop on the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route.
0b3735fe0ba38bab.zh: 慈光寺是位於日本埼玉縣ときがわ町西平地區的佛教寺院，屬天台宗，本尊為十一面觀音菩薩像。寺院全名為都幾山一乘法華院慈光寺。本寺為坂東三十三所巡禮路線的第9號札所。

0b3d43c5115792b4.en: Katsurayama Castle (葛山城, Katsurayama-jō), also known as Kazurayama Castle, was a Japanese castle in Susono, Shizuoka, Japan.
0b3d43c5115792b4.zh: 葛山城又稱「かずらやま城」，是位於日本靜岡縣裾野市的日本城堡。

0b45b264889e6c11.en: The World Freshwater Aquarium (世界淡水魚園水族館, Sekai tansuigyo en Suizokukan) is a Public aquarium located in Kawashima Kasada-cho, Kakamigahara City, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It is nicknamed Aquatotto Gifu (アクアトト・ぎふ). It is an inland aquarium, opened on July 14, 2004, and is the largest freshwater aquarium in Japan. The aquarium is accredited as a Museum-equivalent facilities by the Museum Act from Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology.
0b45b264889e6c11.zh: 世界淡水魚園水族館是位於日本岐阜縣各務原市川島笠田町的公立水族館，暱稱アクア・トトぎふ。這是一座內陸水族館，於2004年7月14日開館，是日本最大的淡水魚水族館。該水族館經文部科學省依《博物館法》認定為博物館相當設施。

0b48caa834f7294e.en: The Noritake Garden (ノリタケの森) is located in the city of Nagoya in central Japan, founded in 2001.
0b48caa834f7294e.zh: ノリタケの森位於日本中部名古屋市，2001年設立。

0b50262ca97d8ad3.en: Imohori Tōgoro Shrine (芋堀藤五郎神社, imohori Tōgoro-jinja), also known as Tōgoro Shrine (藤五郎神社, Tōgoro-jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in the hillside community of Yamashina-machi, Kanazawa, Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan. It is a one-bay shrine built in the nagare-zukuri style.
0b50262ca97d8ad3.zh: 芋堀藤五郎神社又稱藤五郎神社，是位於日本石川縣金澤市山科町山坡聚落的神社。社殿為一間流造樣式。

0b60917a85f9df8f.en: Shunkō-in (春光院, Temple of the Ray of Spring Light) is a Zen Buddhist temple in Kyoto, Japan and belongs to the Myōshin-ji (Temple of Excellent Mind) school, which is the largest among 14 Japanese Rinzai Zen Buddhist schools. The temple was established in 1590 by Horio Yoshiharu, who was a feudal lord, or daimyō, of Matsue in present-day Shimane Prefecture.
0b60917a85f9df8f.zh: 春光院（意為「春之光芒之寺」）是位於日本京都的禪宗寺院，屬於妙心寺派（「妙心之寺」），為日本臨濟宗14個派別中規模最大者。寺院由堀尾吉晴於1590年創建，他是現今島根縣松江的封建領主，即大名。

0b7a95a39943c70b.en: Long time ago, there was less rice available in rural areas, so local foods used buckwheat or buckwheat rice instead of white rice were popular in Tokushima. ‘Houhan’, one of these foods, is prepared by making buckwheat porridge and rice separately, then served the porridge on top of rice, and mixed to eat. This dish was invented to keep it stomach for a long time by adding buckwheat and vegetables. The name ‘Houhan’ means that buckwheat rice ‘wraps’ (‘tsutsumu’ in Japanese – the Chinese letter for ‘tsutsumu’ can be pronounced ‘hou’.) rice.
0b7a95a39943c70b.zh: 很久以前，農村地區的米較少，因此在德島，以蕎麥或蕎麥米代替白米的鄉土料理很普遍。「包飯」是其中之一，做法是分別煮好蕎麥粥和米飯，將粥盛在米飯上，拌勻後食用。這道料理是為了加入蕎麥和蔬菜，讓人吃了能長時間有飽足感而發明的。「包飯」之名的意思是蕎麥米「包」住米飯（日文為「つつむ」，「つつむ」的漢字可讀作「ほう」）。

0b995eb808335637.en: Dewazakura Museum of Art (出羽桜美術館, Dewazakura Bijutsukan) opened in Tendō, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan in 1988. Owned and operated by the Dewazakura Sake Brewery Corporation (出羽桜酒造), the collection focuses on traditional Japanese and Korean arts and crafts, including ceramics, paintings, and calligraphy. The museum building dates to the Meiji period.
0b995eb808335637.zh: 出羽桜美術館於1988年在日本山形縣天童市開館，由出羽桜酒造擁有並經營，館藏以日本與韓國的傳統美術工藝為主，包括陶瓷、繪畫與書法。美術館建築建於明治時代。

0baa34451f784f8b.en: The Chōkokan (徴古館, Chōkokan) opened in Saga, Saga Prefecture, Japan, in 1927. Founded by Nabeshima Naomitsu (鍋島直映), son of Nabeshima Naohiro of the Nabeshima clan, the last daimyō of Saga Domain in Hizen Province, the collection comprises historical materials and artworks relating to the Saga Domain and the Nabeshima family. The museum closed in 1945 but was reopened by the Nabeshima Hōkokai Foundation (鍋島報效会) in 1998. The museum building itself is a Registered Tangible Cultural Property dating from 1927.
0baa34451f784f8b.zh: 徵古館於1927年在日本佐賀縣佐賀市開館，由鍋島直映創立。鍋島直映是肥前國佐賀藩末代藩主、鍋島氏的鍋島直大之子。館藏包括與佐賀藩及鍋島家相關的史料與美術品。該館於1945年閉館，1998年由公益財團法人鍋島報效會重新開館。館舍本身建於1927年，為登錄有形文化財。

0bd046b52ff18c9b.en: In Gunma, where wheat production is thriving, many dishes using wheat flour are enjoyed. Originally embraced as an alternative to rice, Gunma is widely recognized as a major wheat-producing region, leading to the diversification of local dishes using wheat flour. In this context, the prefecture has also witnessed the development and cultivation of its own wheat varieties.One such regional dish made in the heartland of wheat production is "Gyuuten," a popular everyday food in Kiryu City.
0bd046b52ff18c9b.zh: 在小麥生產興盛的群馬，當地人食用許多麵粉料理。麵粉原本是作為米的替代品，而群馬被廣泛認為是主要的小麥產地，使得麵粉鄉土料理日益多樣。在這樣的背景下，縣內也開發並栽培自有的小麥品種。在這個小麥主要產地製作的地方料理之一，就是桐生市常見的日常食物「ぎゅうてん」。

0bd3136b8eab5f3e.en: Black bean from Tamba-Sasayama is considered the highest quality among any black beans because individual beans are bigger than other beans and its sugar content is higher due to clayey and fertile land in the area and big temperature difference between daytime and night. Its characteristics are slightly sweet big bean and hard-to-tear skin. There are some stories about the origin of black bean in Tamba-Sasayama.
0bd3136b8eab5f3e.zh: 丹波篠山的黑豆被認為是所有黑豆中品質最高的，因為當地土地黏質肥沃，且日夜溫差大，每顆豆子都比其他豆子大，糖度也較高。其特色是豆粒大而略帶甜味，豆皮不易破裂。關於丹波篠山黑豆的起源，有幾種說法。

0bf0955d7d5e89af.en: Ryori was a launching site for sounding rockets in Japan at 39°02′N 141°50′E in Iwate Prefecture. It was operated by Japan Meteorological Agency, in use since April 1970 until March 2001.
0bf0955d7d5e89af.zh: 綾里是日本岩手縣境內的探空火箭發射場，位於北緯39°02′、東經141°50′。由日本氣象廳營運，自1970年4月使用至2001年3月。

0c03eca14f63da38.en: The Tochigi–Gunma–Saitama border, or the Tochigi–Gunma–Saitama tripoint (Japanese: 栃木・群馬・埼玉の三県境, Hepburn: Tochigi-Gunma-Saitama no Sankenkyō), or simply Sankenkyō (三県境; lit. "Three prefectural borders"), is a tripoint between Tochigi Prefecture, Gunma Prefecture, and Saitama Prefecture in Japan. It is the only tripoint in Japan that is not located on a mountain or a river.
0c03eca14f63da38.zh: 栃木・群馬・埼玉の三県境，或簡稱「三縣境」（字面意思為「三個縣的邊界」），是日本栃木縣、群馬縣與埼玉縣三縣交界的地點。這是日本唯一不位於山上或河川中的三縣交界點。

0c0e1e7c01b7e2ea.en: The Eizō & Tōichi Katō Memorial Art Museum (加藤栄三・東一記念美術館, Katō Eizō, Tōichi Kinen Bijutsukan) is a museum located in Gifu Park in the city of Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It is dedicated to the works of the brothers Eizō and Tōichi Katō, who were born in the city. It is part of the Gifu City Museum of History.
0c0e1e7c01b7e2ea.zh: 加藤榮三・東一紀念美術館（加藤栄三・東一記念美術館）是位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市岐阜公園內的美術館，展示出身本市的加藤榮三、加藤東一兄弟的作品，隸屬岐阜市歷史博物館。

0c130ef2913b559d.en: Canadian World (Japanese: カナディアンワールド), or Canadian World Park (カナディアンワールド公園), is a privately-run park and former theme park in Ashibetsu, Hokkaido, Japan. It was a failed business venture intended to boost tourism in Ashibetsu, a former coal mining town. The park contains various replicas of landmarks in the Canadian province of Prince Edward Island (PEI), notably buildings featured in the film adaptation of the Canadian novel Anne of Green Gables, which is popular in Japan due to its inclusion in the Japanese curriculum.
0c130ef2913b559d.zh: カナディアンワールド，又稱カナディアンワールド公園，是位於日本北海道芦別的民營公園，前身為主題樂園。它原是為振興前煤礦城鎮芦別的觀光而推出的事業，但經營失敗。園內有多座加拿大愛德華王子島省地標的複製建築，特別是加拿大小說《清秀佳人》改編電影中出現的建築；這部小說因列入日本課程而在日本廣受歡迎。

0c33644d134e689d.en: Ōmeguri-Komeguri Mountain Castle (大廻小廻山城, Ōmeguri-Komeguri yamajirō) was an ancient castle (also known as a Korean-style fortresses in Japan (朝鮮式山城, Chōsen-shiki yamajiro) located in what is now the Kusakabe neighborhood of Higashi-ku of the city of Okayama, Okayama Prefecture, in the San'yō region of Japan.  Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2005.
0c33644d134e689d.zh: 大廻小廻山城是一座古代城郭（亦稱為朝鮮式山城），位於日本山陽地區，即今岡山縣岡山市東區草壁一帶。其遺跡自2005年起被列為國家史跡加以保護。

0c545b01753054ca.en: Mount Koma or Hakone Komagatake (Japanese: 箱根駒ヶ岳), with the altitude of 1,356 meters, is one of the peaks of the central cone of Mount Hakone, located in Hakone, Kanagawa Prefecture. Its summit, a grass field that offers a great view of its surroundings, is visited by many hikers, using the 1,800-meter-long Hakone Komagatake Ropeway from 　the Hakone Resort Complex on Lake Ashi.
0c545b01753054ca.zh: 駒岳，又稱箱根駒ヶ岳（日語：箱根駒ヶ岳），海拔1,356公尺，是箱根山中央火口丘的山峰之一，位於神奈川縣箱根町。山頂為草原，可眺望周邊景色，許多登山客由蘆之湖畔的箱根度假區搭乘全長1,800公尺的箱根駒岳纜車前往。

0c5ccf56e0e430e3.en: Chiba Port Tower is a tower located in Chiba Port Park, Chūō-ku, Chiba, Chiba Prefecture, Japan. It is 125.1 m (410 ft) tall and has four stories. It was built in 1986.
0c5ccf56e0e430e3.zh: 千葉港塔是位於日本千葉縣千葉市中央區千葉港公園內的高塔，高125.1公尺（410英尺），共四層，建於1986年。

0c600c6b6cdd626d.en: Meimei-an (明々庵) is a tea house originally constructed in 1779 by Lord Matsudaira Harusato, daimyō of the Matsue clan at that time. It is located in Matsue, Shimane, Japan.
0c600c6b6cdd626d.zh: 明々庵是一座茶室，最初由當時的松江藩大名松平治鄉於1779年建造，位於日本島根縣松江市。

0c6ec13015c438ed.en: Yoshino Mikumari Shrine (吉野水分神社, Yoshino Mikumari-jinja) is a Shinto shrine located on Mount Yoshino in Yoshino district, Nara, Japan.  It is closely associated with Emperor Go-Daigo.
0c6ec13015c438ed.zh: 吉野水分神社是位於日本奈良縣吉野郡吉野山的神社，與後醍醐天皇關係密切。

0c7dc9992e103300.en: ‘Sanma zushi’ is prevailed as a local cuisine mainly in Yoshino-gun Totsukawa Village in Nara Prefecture, and was an important ‘nare-zushi’, type of traditional sushi fermented with salted fish and rice, at auspicious occasions and new years. The name ‘nare-zushi’ came from the Japanese word ‘nareru’, means ‘’get used to’ or ‘ripen’ because the ingredients get ‘nareru’ as they are fermented. ‘Narezushi’ originally used to be one of the methods to preserve fish longer, and rice, working as fermentation accelerator, was discarded.
0c7dc9992e103300.zh: 「さんま寿司」主要是奈良縣吉野郡十津川村流傳的鄉土料理，是喜慶場合與新年時重要的「なれずし」（以鹽漬魚和米發酵的傳統壽司）。「なれずし」的名稱來自日文「なれる」，意為「習慣」或「熟成」，因為食材在發酵過程中會「なれる」。「なれずし」原本是延長魚類保存期限的方法之一，作為發酵促進劑的米會被丟棄。

0c7e7ad738e39a0b.en: The Chōshū Domain Shinomoseki Maeda Battery (長州藩下関前田台場跡, Chōshū-han Shimonoseki Maeda Daiba-ato) was a Bakumatsu period coastal artillery battery erected by Chōshū Domain in the Kanmon Strait separating the islands of Honshu and Kyushu. It was the site of the Shimonoseki campaign of 1863-1864, when joint naval forces from the United Kingdom, France, the Netherlands, and the United States launched a punitive attack against Chōshū for its attempts to close the Kanmon Strait to foreign vessels.
0c7e7ad738e39a0b.zh: 長州藩下関前田台場跡是幕末時期長州藩在分隔本州與九州的關門海峽所建的海岸砲台。此地為1863年至1864年下關戰爭的戰場，當時英國、法國、荷蘭與美國的聯合海軍因長州試圖封鎖關門海峽、禁止外國船隻通行，而對長州發動懲罰性攻擊。

0c81bfa1aca2edca.en: The Koito River (小糸川, Koito-gawa) is a river in Futtsu and Kimitsu, Chiba Prefecture, Japan. The river is 82 kilometers (51 mi) in length and has a drainage area of 148.7 square kilometers (57.4 sq mi). The Koito is the third-longest river in Chiba Prefecture, and under the Rivers Act of 1906 the Koito is designated as a Class 2 River. The name of the river in Japanese is a combination of two kanji characters, the first meaning “little”, and the second meaning “thread”.
0c81bfa1aca2edca.zh: 小糸川是流經日本千葉縣富津市與君津市的河川，全長82公里（51英里），流域面積148.7平方公里（57.4平方英里）。小糸川是千葉縣第三長的河川，依據1906年的《河川法》被指定為二級河川。河名在日文中由兩個漢字組成，第一個字意為「小」，第二個字意為「線」。

0c8ada1ea0112bd2.en: Tsuboi Hachimangū (壺井八幡宮, Tsuboi Hachimangū) is a Shinto shrine located in Habikino, Osaka Prefecture, Japan. It is a Hachiman shrine, dedicated to the kami Hachiman. It was established in 1063 by Minamoto no Yoriyoshi. Its main festival is held annually on May 15.
0c8ada1ea0112bd2.zh: 壺井八幡宮是位於日本大阪府羽曳野市的神社，屬八幡神社，供奉八幡神。由源賴義於1063年創建。主要祭典於每年5月15日舉行。

0c96eb59d4379ca0.en: Mt. Bessan (別山, Bessan) is located on the border of Takayama, Gifu Prefecture, and Hakusan, Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan, and rises to a height of 2,399 m (7,871 ft). There are two triangulation stations at the top of the mountain. Mount Haku can be seen from the north. Bessan Shrine (別山神社 Bessan Jinja) is a short distance from the peak. This area is part of Hakusan National Park. (Note: there is also a Mt. Bessan in located in Toyama Prefecture.)
0c96eb59d4379ca0.zh: 別山位於日本岐阜縣高山市與石川縣白山市交界，海拔2,399公尺（7,871英尺）。山頂設有兩個三角點。從北側可望見白山。別山神社距山頂不遠。此區域屬於白山國家公園。（註：富山縣也有一座別山。）

0cac5fa552ac339e.en: The Akita City Port Tower Selion (秋田市ポートタワーセリオン, Akitashi Pōto Tawā Serion) is one of the landmarks in the city of Akita, Japan.  The sightseeing tower with 6,272 tempered glasses was completed in 1994.  It is located in the Tsuchizaki District, Akita, Akita Prefecture, Japan. The steel tower is the tallest structure in the 3 northern Tohoku prefectures with its observation deck at 100 metres (328 ft) and its spire at 143.6 metres (471 ft).
0cac5fa552ac339e.zh: 秋田市ポートタワー・セリオン是日本秋田市的地標之一。這座觀光塔使用6,272片強化玻璃，於1994年完工，位於秋田縣秋田市土崎地區。這座鋼構塔是東北北部三縣最高的建築物，展望台高100公尺（328英尺），塔尖高143.6公尺（471英尺）。

0cbdc626b0a88702.en: KidZania Tokyo is a family edutainment center amusement park, in the LaLaport Toyosu, Tokyo, Japan opened in October 2006. A part of the Mexican Kidzania franchise, Kidzania Tokyo is the third ever Kidzania theme park ever built, preceded by Mexico City and Monterrey, and succeeded by Kidzania Jakarta.
0cbdc626b0a88702.zh: キッザニア東京是位於日本東京ららぽーと豐洲內的親子寓教於樂主題樂園，於2006年10月開幕。キッザニア東京屬於墨西哥KidZania連鎖品牌，是史上第三座KidZania主題樂園，前兩座位於墨西哥城與蒙特雷，之後則是KidZania雅加達。

0cbdffcb5119c0a4.en: Kōchi Prefectural Museum of History (高知県立歴史民俗資料館, Kōchi Kenritsu Rekishi Minzoku Shiryōkan) opened in Nankoku, Kōchi Prefecture, Japan, in 1991. Located on the site of Okō Castle and the Chōsokabe clan residence, the collection relates to the archaeology, history, and folk customs of the area.
0cbdffcb5119c0a4.zh: 高知県立歴史民俗資料館於1991年在日本高知縣南國市開館，位於岡豐城及長宗我部氏宅邸遺址，館藏與當地的考古、歷史及民俗相關。

0cd0122d562fdf84.en: Kōon-ji (孝恩寺) is a Jōdo-shū Buddhist temple in Kaizuka, Osaka, Japan.
0cd0122d562fdf84.zh: 孝恩寺是位於日本大阪府貝塚市的淨土宗佛教寺院。

0d0556ed2f5eb43f.en: Miki" is a lactic acid fermented beverage made from rice, sweet potatoes and sugar, and is drunk in Okinawa Prefecture as well as in the Amami area. In Okinawa Prefecture, barley is used instead of sweet potatoes.The word "miki" is written "kamishu," and is said to have its origins in a mouthful of sake that was offered to the gods during festivals. Kuchibi-zake was made by mixing two or three bites of rice in the mouth of a young woman.
0d0556ed2f5eb43f.zh: 「みき」是以米、番薯和砂糖製成的乳酸發酵飲料，在奄美地區及沖繩縣飲用。沖繩縣則以大麥代替番薯。「みき」寫作「神酒」，據說源自祭典時供奉神明的口嚼酒。口嚼酒是由年輕女性將兩三口米在口中咀嚼後製成。

0d1d9fa37278f0f4.en: Fish sushi" is a type of zushi made with mackerel or horse mackerel, and is commonly called "saba-zushi" or "aji-zushi". It is a specialty of the coastal areas of Miyazaki Prefecture, especially the town of Kadokawa, which was a territory in the Edo period (1603-1868). It is said that in the old days, along with imo shochu, it was a highly anticipated dish for officials coming to the territory. In addition to mackerel and horse mackerel, sardines and barracuda are also used.
0d1d9fa37278f0f4.zh: 「魚ずし」是用鯖魚或竹筴魚製作的壽司，一般稱為「鯖ずし」或「鯵ずし」。這是宮崎縣沿海地區的特產，尤其是江戶時代（1603-1868）曾為領地的門川町。據說從前它和芋燒酎一起，是前來領地的官員們十分期待的料理。除了鯖魚和竹筴魚，也會使用沙丁魚和梭魚。

0d2fed40d5c962f1.en: Tama Tech was an amusement park that operated in Hino, Tokyo, Japan from 1961 to 2009. It closed permanently on September 30, 2009.
0d2fed40d5c962f1.zh: 多摩テック是一座遊樂園，1961年至2009年在日本東京都日野市營運，2009年9月30日永久關閉。

0d3d9a2b1c232d4a.en: Mount Makihata (巻機山, Makihata-yama) is a mountain on the border between Niigata Prefecture and Gunma Prefecture in Japan. The mountain is listed as one of the 100 Famous Japanese Mountains in a 1964 book by mountaineer/author Kyūya Fukada. It has a peak elevation of 1,967 meters (6,453 ft).
0d3d9a2b1c232d4a.zh: 巻機山是位於日本新潟縣與群馬縣交界的山。登山家暨作家深田久彌於1964年的著作中，將此山列為日本百名山之一。山頂海拔1,967公尺（6,453英尺）。

0d3f0321b2f92b50.en: Yarazamori Castle (屋良座森城, Yarazamori jō; Okinawan: Yarazamui gushiku) was a Ryūkyūan gusuku in Naha, Okinawa, Japan. It was located on the southern mouth of the Kokuba River in Naha Port.
0d3f0321b2f92b50.zh: 屋良座森城（屋良座森城，Yarazamori jō；沖繩語：Yarazamui gushiku）是曾位於日本沖繩縣那霸市的琉球御城（グスク），位於那霸港國場川河口南側。

0d53f05c76e4fc0d.en: Tōson Memorial Museum (藤村記念館, Tōson Kinenkan) is a museum in Magome-juku, Nakatsugawa, Gifu Prefecture, Japan dedicated to the life and works of Shimazaki Tōson. The writer was born in the former Honjin in 1872, but his birthplace and childhood home was mostly destroyed in the conflagration of 1895. Rebuilt to designs by Taniguchi Yoshirō in 1947, the museum opened in 1952. The core of the collection comprises some 5,000 items donated by Shimazaki Tōson's eldest son.
0d53f05c76e4fc0d.zh: 藤村記念館（藤村記念館）是位於日本岐阜縣中津川市馬籠宿的博物館，介紹島崎藤村的生平與作品。這位作家於1872年出生於舊本陣，但他的出生地暨童年故居大部分在1895年的大火中燒毀。1947年依谷口吉郎的設計重建，博物館於1952年開館。館藏核心為島崎藤村長子捐贈的約5,000件物品。

0d5ce8ce05052363.en: The Hirota Site (広田遺跡)  is an archaeological site with the remains of a late Yayoi Period to late Kofun period cemetery, located in the town of Minamitane,  Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan, and teb island of Tanegashima.  The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 2008.
0d5ce8ce05052363.zh: 広田遺跡是保有彌生時代後期至古墳時代後期墓地遺跡的考古遺址，位於日本鹿兒島縣種子島的南種子町。該遺址於2008年被指定為日本國家史跡。

0d7af14aee26b3a9.en: Lake Usori (宇曽利湖, Usori-ko) is a volcanic crater lake in northern Honshū island, Japan. It is also referred to as Lake Usorisan (宇曽利山湖, Usorizan-ko). Located in the Shimokita Peninsula of Aomori Prefecture, it is within the borders of the city of Mutsu and Shimokita Hanto Quasi-National Park.
0d7af14aee26b3a9.zh: 宇曽利湖是位於日本本州北部的火山口湖，又稱宇曽利山湖。湖泊位於青森縣下北半島，在陸奧市及下北半島國定公園範圍內。

0d883c78a5e60c9c.en: In Gunma, where there is a deeply rooted culture of consuming wheat-based dishes, "Udon" is a beloved staple food. There are "Udon" noodles made here with distinctive characteristics, which are influenced by the climate and unique features of the various regions in Gunma. The people of Gunma Prefecture, as well as tourists from outside the area, enjoy Gunma's "Udon" noodles as a gourmet dish.
0d883c78a5e60c9c.zh: 群馬有根深蒂固的麵食文化，「烏龍麵」是當地人喜愛的主食。受到群馬各地區氣候與特色的影響，當地製作的烏龍麵各具特色。群馬縣民以及外地觀光客，都把群馬的烏龍麵當作美食品嘗。

0d93f2c082112adf.en: Kariya City Art Museum (刈谷市美術館, Kariya-shi Bijutsukan) opened in Kariya, Aichi Prefecture, Japan in 1983. The collection focuses on local, modern, post-war, and contemporary art, and includes some 3,441 works by 168 artists, as of April 2020.
0d93f2c082112adf.zh: 刈谷市美術館於1983年在日本愛知縣刈谷開館。館藏以在地、近代、戰後及當代藝術為主，截至2020年4月，收藏168位藝術家的作品約3,441件。

0dab8c0f8243a746.en: okushima is home to several varieties of sushi, including boze no sugatazushi (pieces of sushi made up of a whole fish), kakimaze sushi (where the rice is mixed with kidney beans), and amego (trout) sushi. Among these, oshizushi, or pressed sushi, is familiar in the areas around Kaiyo and Mugi. Its rice is mixed with a yuzu vinegar known as yunosu, which is then placed in a square box with a lid that can be pressed down on its contents.
0dab8c0f8243a746.zh: 德島有多種壽司，包括ぼうぜの姿寿司（以整條魚製成的壽司）、かきまぜ寿司（米飯拌入菜豆）以及アメゴ（鱒魚）壽司等。其中押し寿司（壓製壽司）在海陽與牟岐一帶較為常見。米飯拌入稱為「ゆのす」的柚子醋，再放進附有可向下壓的蓋子的方形木盒中。

0dabca7683dcb8e4.en: In November, when the rice harvest is over and the farming season has come to a close, there is a custom called "Autumn Festival". Neighbors and relatives are invited to celebrate the successful completion of rice cultivation, and a feast is served in appreciation of the year's hard work. Keiran" is one of the most popular dishes among the autumn-finishing feasts. It is a light-flavored clear soup with two white egg-shaped dumplings floating on the top of the bowl.
0dabca7683dcb8e4.zh: 11月稻米收成結束、農事告一段落時，有稱為「秋祭」的習俗。人們邀請鄰居與親戚慶祝稻作順利完成，並準備宴席慰勞一年的辛勞。「けいらん」是秋收宴席中最受歡迎的料理之一，為口味清淡的清湯，碗中浮著兩顆白色蛋形糰子。

0dabd828399fc4db.en: Gumyō-ji (弘明寺) is a Buddhist temple located in Minami-ku, Yokohama, Japan. It belongs to the Kōyasan Shingon-shū sect and its honzon is a hibutsu statue of Jūichimen Kannon Bosatsu ( Sahasrabhūja).  The temple's full name is Zuio-zan Renge-in Gunmyō-ji (瑞應山 蓮華院  弘明寺).The temple is the 14th stop on the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route. It is also called the "Gumyō Kannon".
0dabd828399fc4db.zh: 弘明寺是位於日本橫濱市南區的佛教寺院，屬高野山真言宗，本尊為十一面觀音菩薩祕佛。寺院全名為瑞應山蓮華院弘明寺。本寺為坂東三十三所巡禮路線的第14番札所，又稱「弘明寺觀音」。

0dac0724a4d791a3.en: Kujūkuri Prefectural Natural Park (県立九十九里自然公園, Kenritsu Kujūkuri shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Chiba Prefecture, Japan. First designated for protection in 1935, the park extends along some sixty kilometres of the coast between the Minami Bōsō and  Suigo-Tsukuba Quasi-National Parks. The park spans the borders of twelve municipalities: Asahi, Chiba, Chōsei, Chōshi, Ichinomiya, Kujūkuri, Ōamishirasato, Sanmu, Shirako, Sōsa, Tōgane, and Yokoshibahikari.
0dac0724a4d791a3.zh: 千葉縣立九十九里自然公園是位於日本千葉縣的縣立自然公園，於1935年首度劃定保護，範圍沿著南房總國定公園與水鄉筑波國定公園之間約六十公里的海岸延伸。公園橫跨十二個市町村：旭市、千葉市、長生村、銚子市、一宮町、九十九里町、大網白里市、山武市、白子町、匝瑳市、東金市及橫芝光町。

0dacb90373a2e970.en: Kirarahama (きらら浜) or Kirara Beach is a recreational beach located on the Seto Inland Sea in Ajisu, Yamaguchi City, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan. The name Kirara (雲母; "mica") or "isinglass," is similar to the Japanese sound effect "kirakira" used for something glittery. Kirara Beach glitters in the sunlight, fitting the appearance of mica.It is a manmade beach that has a few restaurants and a glass-making factory.
0dacb90373a2e970.zh: きらら浜（又稱Kirara Beach）是位於日本山口縣山口市秋穗、面向瀨戶內海的休閒海灘。名稱中的「きらら」（雲母）與日語中形容閃閃發亮之物的擬聲詞「きらきら」相近。きらら浜在陽光下閃閃發光，與雲母的外觀相符。這是一處人工海灘，設有幾間餐廳和一座玻璃工房。

0dcbd00c7cdb31c4.en: "Koi no Ama-ni” (Sweet and savory simmered carp) is a dish prepared by slicing carp and simmering it slowly after removing the blood. It is enjoyed not only in Akita prefecture but also in other regions such as Yamagata, Ibaraki, and Nagano prefectures.Carp has long been valued as a precious source of protein, and in the inland areas of Akita prefecture, it has been enjoyed as a special treat on festive occasions such as New Year's, festivals, and weddings.
0dcbd00c7cdb31c4.zh: 「鯉の甘煮」（甜鹹燉鯉魚）是將鯉魚切塊、去除血水後慢火燉煮的料理。不只秋田縣，山形、茨城、長野等縣也有食用。鯉魚自古被視為珍貴的蛋白質來源，在秋田縣內陸地區，是新年、祭典、婚禮等喜慶場合享用的特別料理。

0dd03b5b2ee7d460.en: “Todomese” is sushi simmered in a mixture of rice and vinegar. Its history stretches back to the Kamakura period of the Middle Ages. Back then, the “Fukuoka Market” was held in Bizen, Fukuoka (in modern day, Osafune Town in Fukuoka and Setouchi City in Okayama), which thrived as a commercial city with water transportation. As such, once drunken samurai added sour doburoku (unrefined sake) to the rice and meals cooked by the Takase River boatmen, it became more delicious.
0dd03b5b2ee7d460.zh: とどめせ是將米飯與醋混合燉煮而成的壽司。其歷史可追溯至中世的鎌倉時代。當時備前福岡（今岡山縣長船町福岡及瀨戶內市）舉辦「福岡市」，這裡作為擁有水運的商業城市而繁榮。據說喝醉的武士將酸掉的濁酒（未過濾的酒）加入高瀨川船夫所煮的飯菜中，結果變得更加美味。

0dd2890766290737.en: Cha-meshi is said to have originated from "Nara Cha-meshi," which was first served at Todaiji Temple and Kofukuji Temple in Nara, and was handed down by travellers to Imajo, which was an post town. "Cha-meshi" is mainly used for Buddhist ceremonies and has been passed down as a specialty of Imazu. Nowadays, it is consumed not only during Buddhist ceremonies but also on various occasions.
0dd2890766290737.zh: 茶飯據說起源於最早在奈良東大寺與興福寺供應的「奈良茶飯」，後由旅人傳到宿場町今庄。「茶飯」主要用於佛事，作為今庄的特產流傳至今。現在不僅在佛事時，也在各種場合食用。

0dda85cd8a8c4b2d.en: "Udo no Sumiso Ae" (Udo with vinegared miso) is a typical dish using udo, one of the few vegetables native to Japan."Udo" has been cultivated in Tokyo since the late Edo period (1603-1868) and is one of the traditional Edo Tokyo vegetables along with Nerima Daikon and other vegetables.It grows in a pit called a "Muro", which is about 3 to 4 meters deep, and because it is not exposed to light, the white fiber is soft and has little bitterness, giving it a unique flavor and texture.The entrance to this "Muro" is small enough to fit one person, and vegetables are labor intensive in this small space from planting to harvest.Since the late Edo period in the 1830s, "Udo" cultivation began around Musashino Hachimangu Shrine. This area, formerly the village of Kichijoji in Bushu-Tama County, has had a thriving agricultural industry since the Edo period (1603-1868). The firm geological formation of the Kanto Loam layer and the temperature and humidity are suitable for "Udo" cultivation, and production began to flourish in this area. Since 1948, research has been done on softening "Udo", which is cultivated in a cellar, and the "Udo" softening method has since spread to the Kita-Tama area.
0dda85cd8a8c4b2d.zh: 「うどの酢味噌和え」（醋味噌拌獨活）是使用獨活的代表性料理，獨活是少數原產於日本的蔬菜之一。「獨活」自江戶時代（1603-1868）後期起便在東京栽培，與練馬蘿蔔等同為江戶東京傳統蔬菜之一。獨活生長在深約3至4公尺、稱為「室」的地窖中，由於不照光，白色纖維柔軟、苦味少，具有獨特的風味與口感。「室」的入口僅容一人通過，從種植到採收都在這狹小空間中進行，十分費工。自江戶時代後期的1830年代起，武藏野八幡宮一帶開始栽培「獨活」。此地原為武州多摩郡吉祥寺村，自江戶時代（1603-1868）起農業便很興盛。關東壤土層堅實的地質以及溫度與濕度適合栽培「獨活」，此地的生產因而興盛起來。自1948年起，開始研究在地窖中栽培的「獨活」軟化技術，此後「獨活」軟化栽培法推廣至北多摩地區。

0de78041ae98ce55.en: “Kankanzushi” is a preserved food that has been passed down since the Edo period. It originated in the Kamobe area of Sanuki City and has been passed down throughout most of Sanuki City.Sushi rice is packed into a sushi box that can hold about 1 sho of rice, Spanish mackerel soaked in vinegar is laid on top of that, the lid is put on, and wedges are hammered into the wooden frame. The name comes from the sound this makes.Since the sushi boxes can be stacked one on top of the other, a large quantity can be made at once.
0de78041ae98ce55.zh: 「カンカンずし」是自江戶時代流傳至今的保存食品，起源於讚岐市鴨部地區，並流傳到讚岐市大部分地區。將醋飯裝入約可容納1升米的壽司木盒，上面鋪上醋漬土魠魚，蓋上蓋子，再將楔子敲入木框。名稱即來自敲打時發出的聲音。由於壽司木盒可以層層疊放，一次能製作大量。

0debbfa51baadf41.en: This is a type of "asazuke", a lightly pickled dish. It involves chopping radishes and turnips, and pickling both the roots and leaves with salt. It can be consumed after a few hours to overnight. The name is derived from its popularity in the Osaka region, where it is frequently prepared.
0debbfa51baadf41.zh: 這是一種「淺漬」，屬於輕度醃漬的料理。做法是將白蘿蔔和蕪菁切碎，根與葉一起用鹽醃漬。醃幾個小時到一個晚上即可食用。名稱來自它在大阪地區很受歡迎、經常製作。

0e13de74fa5c1303.en: Nihon-ji (日本寺, Nihon-ji) is a Buddhist temple in the city of Kyonan, Chiba Prefecture, Japan. The temple is located on the slopes of Mount Nokogiri and is known for its Nihon-ji Daibutsu. Nihon-ji was established as a Hossō sect temple, was transferred to the Tendai sect, and is now a Sōtō Zen temple. Since its founding the temple has fallen into ruin and been revived numerous times.
0e13de74fa5c1303.zh: 日本寺是位於日本千葉縣鋸南的佛教寺院，坐落於鋸山山坡，以日本寺大佛聞名。日本寺創建時屬法相宗，後改屬天台宗，現為曹洞宗寺院。自創建以來，本寺曾多次荒廢又復興。

0e21706784942115.en: Sakura shrimp are only caught in the Suruga Bay, at Yui Port in Shizuoka City and Yaizu City's Oigawa Port. The shrimp were first fished in 1894, when they were coincidentally caught when pulling in horse mackerel. For purposes of conservation, the fishing season for sakura shrimp is limited to twice a year: in spring from mid-March to early June, and in fall from late October to late December. Okiagari is a hot pot dish where fresh sakura shrimp are simmered with tofu and spring onions in sukiyaki-style seasoning.
0e21706784942115.zh: 櫻花蝦只在駿河灣的靜岡市由比港與燒津市大井川港捕撈。櫻花蝦的捕撈始於1894年，當時是在拉竹筴魚網時偶然捕獲。為了資源保育，櫻花蝦的漁期限定一年兩次：春季為3月中旬至6月上旬，秋季為10月下旬至12月下旬。沖あがり是以壽喜燒風味的調味，將新鮮櫻花蝦與豆腐、蔥一同燉煮的火鍋料理。

0e2753e9eb086d58.en: Sukagawa Peony Garden (須賀川牡丹園, Sukawaga Botan-en) is a nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty in the city of Sukagawa, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan.
0e2753e9eb086d58.zh: 須賀川牡丹園位於日本福島縣須賀川市，為國家指定名勝。

0e2aa6108a163751.en: In the mountainous northern part of Okayama Prefecture, a surprisingly large number of fish dishes have been handed down from generation to generation. Saba-zushi is an autumn festival feast mainly made in the northern central part of Okayama Prefecture. In the old days, when transportation was not convenient, it was difficult to obtain perishable raw fish in mountain villages far from the seashore, so people thought of using fish brought in from Tottori Prefecture in the San-in region to make a feast for the autumn festival.
0e2aa6108a163751.zh: 在多山的岡山縣北部，代代相傳的魚類料理數量多得令人意外。さばずし是主要在岡山縣中北部製作的秋祭宴客料理。過去交通不便，在遠離海邊的山村難以取得容易腐壞的生魚，因此人們想到利用從山陰地區的鳥取縣運來的魚，製作秋祭的宴客料理。

0e46f4fe72576b47.en: Kuzū Fossil Museum (佐野市葛生化石館, Sano-shi Kuzū kaseki-kan) is a registered museum in Sano, Tochigi Prefecture, Japan that opened with the merger of Kuzū into Sano in 2005. The collection and displays relate to the geology and natural history of the area, with a particular focus on local fossil finds. Species represented include Palaeoloxodon naumanni, Stephanorhinus kirchbergensis, and Sinomegaceros yabei.
0e46f4fe72576b47.zh: 佐野市葛生化石館是位於日本栃木縣佐野市的登錄博物館，於2005年葛生町併入佐野市時開館。館藏與展示內容與當地地質及自然史相關，尤以本地出土的化石為重點，涵蓋的物種包括諾氏古菱齒象、梅氏犀與矢部巨角鹿。

0e48f7170d513b53.en: The Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennial (ETAT) is an international contemporary art festival held once every three years in Niigata Prefecture, Japan. The festival was created by the Tokyo commercial gallery Art Front Gallery (AFG) and is directed by gallery director Fram Kitagawa.  It was first held in 2000, and has since become one of Japan's largest art festivals, recurring every three years with the exception of 2021 when it was postponed to 2022 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
0e48f7170d513b53.zh: 大地の芸術祭 越後妻有アートトリエンナーレ是在日本新潟縣每三年舉辦一次的國際當代藝術祭。藝術祭由東京的商業畫廊Art Front Gallery（AFG）創辦，並由畫廊總監北川フラム擔任總監。首屆於2000年舉辦，之後成為日本規模最大的藝術祭之一，每三年舉辦一次，唯2021年因COVID-19疫情延至2022年舉行。

0e793614ce865ebf.en: Shoyu Okowa" is a local dish of Nagaoka City that is colored with soy sauce. It is a local dish characterized by the inclusion of fluffy cooked kidney beans. It is not red like ordinary sekihan, but brown because it is colored with soy sauce. It is eaten only in Nagaoka City and its vicinity, and for those who grew up in this area, sekihan has been flavored with soy sauce since childhood.
0e793614ce865ebf.zh: しょうゆおこわ是長岡市以醬油上色的鄉土料理，特色是加入煮得鬆軟的菜豆。它不像一般的紅豆飯是紅色，而是因醬油上色而呈褐色。只有長岡市及其周邊地區食用，對在當地長大的人來說，紅豆飯從小就是醬油口味。

0e7bb233243e54c6.en: Tamukeyama Hachiman Shrine (手向山八幡宮, Tamukeyama Hachimangū) is a Shinto shrine near Tōdai-ji, Nara, Nara Prefecture, Japan. It is a Hachiman shrine, dedicated to the kami Hachiman. It was established in 749. Kami enshrined here include Emperor Ojin, Emperor Nintoku, Empress Jingū and Emperor Chūai in addition to Hachiman.
0e7bb233243e54c6.zh: 手向山八幡宮是位於日本奈良縣奈良市東大寺附近的神社，為供奉八幡神的八幡宮，創建於749年。除八幡神外，亦供奉應神天皇、仁德天皇、神功皇后及仲哀天皇。

0e833d2b6a15aff0.en: Yagen Onsen (薬研温泉) is a hot spring located in the former town of Ohata, which is now part of the city of Mutsu in northern Japan.
0e833d2b6a15aff0.zh: 藥研溫泉（薬研温泉）是位於日本北部舊大畑町的溫泉，該地現屬陸奧市。

0e9c607c87b2707e.en: "Nasuno-koujizuke" is a pickle made by marinating eggplant in rice and Kouji.It is pickled mainly in the southern part of the prefecture. In the old days, during the eggplant harvest season from July to October, every household would lavishly use the second-best rice from the new crop and make it as one of their winter preparations. Akita Prefecture is home to many traditional vegetables, and there are many varieties of eggplant. The famous "Aradokoro eggplant" from Yokote City, characterized by its drawstring shape, is valued as "Hana-zushi".
0e9c607c87b2707e.zh: 「なすのこうじ漬け」是將茄子以米飯和麴醃漬而成的醃漬物，主要在縣南部製作。過去在7月至10月的茄子採收期，各家庭會大量使用新米中的次等米來製作，作為過冬準備之一。秋田縣有許多傳統蔬菜，茄子的品種也很多。橫手市知名的「荒處茄子」以束口袋般的形狀為特徵，被珍視為製作「花ずし」的材料。

0ec521e265174067.en: Lake Tega (手賀沼, Tega-numa) is a lake located in the Chiba Prefecture of Japan, northeast of Tokyo.
0ec521e265174067.zh: 手賀沼是位於日本千葉縣的湖泊，在東京東北方。

0ec646b49bcb5481.en: This dish is made by mixing finely chopped cabbage, meat, squid, etc., into a batter of flour dissolved in Dashi (Japanese soup stock). The mixture is then spread flat on a griddle and cooked on both sides. Alongside “Takoyaki”, it is a representative dish of the Kansai region's “Konamon” (flour-based) culinary culture. Its roots are said to trace back to the Azuchi-Momoyama period when Sen no Rikyu, the famed tea master, served a confection called "Funoyaki" at a tea gathering.
0ec646b49bcb5481.zh: 這道料理是將切碎的高麗菜、肉、花枝等拌入以高湯調開的麵粉糊中，再攤平在鐵板上兩面煎熟。與「章魚燒」同為關西地區「粉物」（麵粉類）飲食文化的代表料理。據說其起源可追溯到安土桃山時代，著名茶人千利休在茶會上供應一種名為「麩の焼き」的點心。

0ed30f4ab4e69839.en: "Junsai nabe" is a one-pot dish in which a large amount of junsai is added along with chicken, gobou(=burdock), and other ingredients. "Junsai" is characterized by its smooth and juicy texture, and it goes very well with chicken. Having an abundant amount of junsai in the pot is the local specialty. "Junsai", often called “watershield” in English, grows in freshwater marshes and ponds. It is a perennial aquatic plant and is from the water lily family with round leaves floating on the surface of the water.
0ed30f4ab4e69839.zh: 「じゅんさい鍋」是加入大量蓴菜，搭配雞肉、牛蒡等食材的火鍋料理。「蓴菜」的特色是口感滑溜多汁，與雞肉非常搭配。鍋中放入大量蓴菜是當地特色。「蓴菜」英文常稱為「watershield」，生長於淡水沼澤與池塘，是多年生水生植物，屬睡蓮科，圓形葉片浮於水面。

0ed4a449a596eed6.en: Jizō-ji (地蔵寺) is an Omuro Shingon temple in Itano, Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. Temple 5 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage, the main image is of Enmei Jizō Bosatsu. The temple is said to have been founded by Kōbō Daishi, who carved the image. The Hondō (1711–16), Daishidō (1711–16), Fudōdō (1751–1830), Kyōgura (1810), and Gohyakurakandō (1922) have all been placed on the cultural properties register.
0ed4a449a596eed6.zh: 地藏寺（地蔵寺）是位於日本德島縣板野的御室派真言宗寺院。為四國八十八所遍路第5番寺院，本尊為延命地藏菩薩。據傳由弘法大師創建，本尊亦為其所雕。本堂（1711–16）、大師堂（1711–16）、不動堂（1751–1830）、經藏（1810）及五百羅漢堂（1922）均已登錄為文化財。

0edbdbe0bf17308e.en: Whitebait is one of the fish that represent the so-called "seven treasures of Lake Shinji", a brackish lake in Shimane Prefecture where fresh and salt water mingle together. Whitebait from Matsue has been valued highly since the Edo period, with restaurants all over the country endorsing it as the best in Japan.The fish range from 5-10cm in length. They are transparent when at their freshest, but turn opaque after a few hours.
0edbdbe0bf17308e.zh: 白魚是代表所謂「宍道湖七珍」的魚類之一，宍道湖是島根縣淡水與海水交匯的汽水湖。松江的白魚自江戶時代起便受到高度評價，全國各地的餐廳都推崇其為日本第一。這種魚體長5至10公分，最新鮮時呈透明，數小時後會變得不透明。

0ee74fd3f6e3172b.en: Rakkasei (peanuts), also known as "Nankinmame," are said to have been introduced in Japan during the Edo period. The cultivation of peanuts in Chiba Prefecture is said to have started when Manuemon Makino, a farmer from Nango Village, Sanbu District (now Sanmu City),purchased the seeds from Nakazato Village, Miura District, Kanagawa Prefecture and began a trial production. Chiba prefecture accounts for 80% of the domestic peanut harvest in Japan today.
0ee74fd3f6e3172b.zh: 落花生（花生）又稱「南京豆」，據說在江戶時代傳入日本。千葉縣的花生栽培，據說始於山武郡南鄉村（今山武市）的農民牧野萬右衛門向神奈川縣三浦郡中里村購買種子並開始試種。如今千葉縣占日本國內花生收穫量的80%。

0efed62614bfcf8d.en: Najima Castle (名島城, Najima-jō) is a hilltop castle, located in Fukuoka City, Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan. Today, only its ruins still stand.
0efed62614bfcf8d.zh: 名島城是位於日本福岡縣福岡市的山城，現今僅存遺跡。

0f29808bd0966685.en: “Suzuke (pickling in vinegar) of Japanese smelt and lotus root” is made with Japanese smelt and lotus root, which are local specialties of Kasumigaura, the second largest lake in Japan. Blessed with an abundance of water and fertile wetlands, the Kasumigaura area has been cultivated for more than 40 years and is now known as the leading producer of lotus root in Japan.
0f29808bd0966685.zh: 「わかさぎとれんこんの酢漬け」（以醋醃漬的公魚與蓮藕）使用霞浦的在地特產公魚與蓮藕製作。霞浦是日本第二大湖。霞浦一帶水源豐沛、濕地肥沃，蓮藕栽培已有40多年歷史，如今以日本首屈一指的蓮藕產地聞名。

0f327e25be750e13.en: Tanasoko Castle (棚底城跡, Tanasoko-jō) was a Muromachi period Japanese castle located in the Kuratake neighborhood of the city of Amakusa, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan.  Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2009.
0f327e25be750e13.zh: 棚底城是室町時代的日本城池，位於日本熊本縣天草市倉岳町一帶。遺址自2009年起被列為國家指定史跡。

0f3538dc7397409e.en: Moto-Sumiyoshi Shrine (本住吉神社, Motosumiyoshi Jinja) is a Japanese Shinto shrine in Higashinada ward, Kobe. It is one of the biggest shrines in western Kobe. It is next to Sumiyoshi Station. The shrine has existed since the 13th century.
0f3538dc7397409e.zh: 本住吉神社是位於神戶市東灘區的神社，是神戶西部規模最大的神社之一，鄰近住吉站。這座神社自13世紀起即已存在。

0f529bcd978df6fb.en: "Goae" is a local dish in Nichinan Town, located in the western region, where boiled and mashed soybeans ("go") are used as a coating to mix with vegetables and mushrooms. Nichinan Town is situated in the mountainous area of the Hoki region, accounting for 90% of its area covered by forests.
0f529bcd978df6fb.zh: 「呉和え」是西部地區日南町的鄉土料理，將煮過並搗碎的黃豆（「呉」）當作拌料，與蔬菜和菇類拌在一起。日南町位於伯耆地區的山區，森林占全町面積的90%。

0f7a5c60e02f8227.en: Splendid alfonsino fishing in Inatori began in the Meiji era. The dish handed down in this area for special occasions is pressed sushi topped with red and white soboro (locally known as oboro) made from splendid alfonsino. It is made during celebratory events such as weddings, Shichi-Go-San, and coming-of-age ceremonies.
0f7a5c60e02f8227.zh: 稻取的金目鯛漁業始於明治時代。當地在喜慶場合流傳下來的料理，是鋪上以金目鯛製成的紅白魚鬆（當地稱為「おぼろ」）的押壽司，會在婚禮、七五三、成年禮等慶祝活動時製作。

0f86110d1f44d69e.en: Iwadono Castle (岩殿城, Iwadono-jō) was a yamajiro located in present-day Ōtsuki, Yamanashi Prefecture, Japan. The castle was active during the Sengoku period and served as a strategic outpost of the Takeda clan of Kai Province. Though now in ruins, it remains a popular destination for hikers and history enthusiasts.
0f86110d1f44d69e.zh: 岩殿山城是位於今日本山梨縣大月市的山城。該城於戰國時代使用，為甲斐國武田氏的戰略據點。現雖已成遺跡，仍是登山客與歷史愛好者常造訪的地點。

0fd5686baade2405.en: Anraku-ji (安楽寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the town of Yoshimi, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the  Shingon-shū Chisan-ha sect and its honzon is a hibutsu statue of Senjū Kannon Bosatsu (Sahasrabhūja), displayed only on June 18 annually.  The temple's full name is Iwadono-zan Kōmyō-in Anraku-ji (岩殿山 光明院  安楽寺).The temple is the 11th stop on the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route. It is also called the "Yoshimi Kannon".
0fd5686baade2405.zh: 安樂寺是位於日本埼玉縣吉見町的佛教寺院，屬真言宗智山派，本尊為秘佛千手觀音菩薩像，每年僅於6月18日公開。寺院全名為岩殿山光明院安樂寺。本寺為坂東三十三所巡禮路線的第11號札所，又稱「吉見觀音」。

0fe2a75c99d09d5c.en: Toyokuni Shrine (豊国神社, Toyokuni-jinja) is a Shinto shrine located on Mount Utatsu in Higashi-Mikage-machi, Kanazawa, Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan. Under the shrine ranking system, it was listed as a village shrine. Its annual festival day is May 2.
0fe2a75c99d09d5c.zh: 豊国神社是位於日本石川縣金澤市東御影町卯辰山上的神社。在社格制度中列為村社。例祭日為5月2日。

0fe4c73d6618f64f.en: "Shottsuru Nabe" is a hot pot dish in Akita, featuring Dashi(=Japanese soup stock) made from the traditionally handed-down fermented salted fish sauce known as "Shottsuru," with the addition of "Hatahata" (=Japanese sandfish).This winter specialty is popular in Akita because, from November to December, the prime season for "Hatahata" (=Japanese sandfish), it is most abundant in the waters off the coast of Akita Prefecture compared to the rest of Japan.
0fe4c73d6618f64f.zh: 「しょっつる鍋」是秋田的火鍋料理，以傳承下來的魚露「しょっつる」製作高湯，再加入「ハタハタ」（叉牙魚）。11月至12月是ハタハタ的盛產期，此時秋田縣近海的漁獲量為日本各地之冠，因此這道冬季名產在秋田很受歡迎。

0ff5d31e715a3564.en: In Japan, as part of the preparations to welcome Toshigami (the deity of the New Year), there is a tradition of preparing a special feast called "Toshikoshi" on New Year's Eve. Toshikoshi Soba (buckwheat noodles eaten on New Year's Eve) is one such dish, symbolizing longevity and prosperity as the long and thin noodles are associated with a wish for a long and healthy life.Fish also plays a significant role in Japanese New Year cuisine, often being offered as a sacred dish during rituals and festivals.
0ff5d31e715a3564.zh: 在日本，迎接年神（新年之神）的準備之一，是在除夕準備名為「年越」的特別餐點。年越蕎麥麵（除夕吃的蕎麥麵）就是其中之一，細長的麵條寓意祈求長壽健康，象徵長壽與繁榮。魚在日本新年料理中也占有重要地位，常在儀式與祭典中作為神饌供奉。

0fff75a71002f08b.en: The "Naruto Tai" (=Naruto sea bream) caught in Naruto City, Tokushima Prefecture, is one of the top-class premium fish in the country. Raised in the whirlpools of the Naruto Strait, its flesh tightens, resulting in a sea bream with umami and a delightful texture. It is delicious to enjoy it as sashimi while it's fresh, but a dish particularly beloved in Tokushima Prefecture is "Tai meshi". This dish involves cooking the Naruto Tai, either whole or in chunks, together with rice.
0fff75a71002f08b.zh: 德島縣鳴門市捕獲的「鳴門鯛」是日本頂級的高級魚之一。在鳴門海峽的漩渦中成長，肉質緊實，成為鮮味十足、口感絕佳的鯛魚。趁新鮮做成生魚片也很美味，而在德島縣特別受喜愛的料理是「鯛めし」。這道料理是將整尾或切塊的鳴門鯛與米一起炊煮。

101d29fd547223d4.en: Hakuba Ski Jumping Stadium is a ski jumping hill in Hakuba, Japan. It hosted the ski jumping and the ski jumping part of the Nordic combined events at the 1998 Winter Olympics. The stadium holds a maximum of 45,000 spectators, and was built in 1992.
101d29fd547223d4.zh: 白馬ジャンプ競技場是位於日本白馬村的跳台滑雪場。1998年冬季奧運的跳台滑雪及北歐兩項的跳台滑雪項目在此舉行。競技場最多可容納45,000名觀眾，建於1992年。

1021c355d19eb9df.en: ‘Kusa-mochi’ is a mochi mixed with mugwort and served at the events from mid March to mid April, when mugwort sprouts and grows. There is a custom to offer ‘Kusa-mochi’ to the ‘Hina-kazari’ (decoration during the Girl’s Festival) during Girl’s Festival (also known as Doll’s Festival or March Festival) and to enjoy with ‘kinako’ (roasted soybean flour), but it was the Girl’s Festival in the luna calendar (in early April). Now we celebrate the Girl’s Festival on March 3rd, and it is not possible to obtain mugwort at that time.
1021c355d19eb9df.zh: 「草餅」是混入艾草的麻糬，在艾草發芽生長的3月中旬至4月中旬的節慶活動中食用。女兒節（又稱人偶節、三月節）有將草餅供奉於「雛飾り」（女兒節的擺飾）並沾「黃豆粉」享用的習俗，但那是指農曆的女兒節（4月初）。現在女兒節在3月3日慶祝，這個時期無法取得艾草。

10371c0e21097b21.en: Daishō-ji (Japanese: 大聖寺); full name Daihonzan Naritasan Nagoya Betsuin Daishō-ji (Japanese: 大本山成田山名古屋別院大聖寺), also known as Inuyama Naritasan Temple (Japanese: 犬山成田山), is a Shingon Buddhist temple located in Inuyama, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. It is a branch of the famous Naritasan Shinshō-ji in Chiba and is known for its striking red architecture, panoramic views, and blessings for traffic safety.
10371c0e21097b21.zh: 大聖寺，全名大本山成田山名古屋別院大聖寺，又稱犬山成田山，是位於日本愛知縣犬山市的真言宗佛教寺院。此寺為千葉著名的成田山新勝寺的分院，以醒目的紅色建築、全景視野及交通安全祈福而聞名。

10771c1cfe74b94f.en: “Chimushinji” is a combination of the two words “chimu” (=pork liver) and “shinji” (=broth) and is a soup that is served to those with anemia or those feeling unwell or tired. It is a popular soup enjoyed by the local people of Okinawa. Okinawan cuisine is unique and influenced by the subtropical climate of the region. The concept of “Ishokudougen” (=food is medicine) is reflected in everyday cuisine and in the local dialect, this is “kusuimun” (=nourishing food is medicine) and “nuchigusui” (=medicine for longevity).
10771c1cfe74b94f.zh: チムシンジ由「チム」（豬肝）和「シンジ」（湯汁）兩個詞組成，是給貧血或身體不適、疲倦的人喝的湯，深受沖繩當地人喜愛。沖繩料理獨具特色，受到當地亞熱帶氣候的影響。「醫食同源」（食物即是藥）的觀念反映在日常料理中，在當地方言中稱為「クスイムン」（滋養的食物就是藥）和「ヌチグスイ」（長壽之藥）。

107bcdb4eddd480c.en: Tazawako Dakigaeri Prefectural Natural Park (田沢湖抱返り県立自然公園, Tazawako Dakigaeri kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Akita Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1960, the park lies within the municipality of Semboku, and takes its name from Lake Tazawa and Dakigaeri Gorge (抱返り渓谷).
107bcdb4eddd480c.zh: 田沢湖抱返り県立自然公園是日本秋田縣的縣立自然公園，設立於1960年，位於仙北市境內，名稱取自田沢湖與抱返り溪谷。

107de179776c1417.en: Matsuyama City General Community Center is an arena in Matsuyama, Ehime, Japan. It is the home arena of the Ehime Orange Vikings of the B.League, Japan's professional basketball league.
107de179776c1417.zh: 松山市綜合社區中心（松山市総合コミュニティセンター）是位於日本愛媛縣松山市的體育館，為日本職業籃球聯賽B.League球隊愛媛橘色維京人的主場。

1090dc49bf287cdf.en: The Kamikuroiwaiwakage Site (上黒岩岩陰遺跡, Kamikuroiwaiwakage iseki) is an archaeological site consisting of a Jōmon period rock shelter dwelling in the Mikawa neighborhood of the typo of Kumakōgen, Ehime Prefecture in the island of Shikoku Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1971.
1090dc49bf287cdf.zh: 上黑岩岩陰遺跡（上黒岩岩陰遺跡）是位於日本四國愛媛縣久萬高原町美川地區的考古遺址，為繩文時代的岩陰住居遺跡。1971年被指定為日本國家史跡。

10918be1c9f5b30e.en: ‘Shiki shiki’ is a local snack in Nara by grilling dough made from wheat flour, water and sugar, and has been eaten since before war. Eggs can be added these days. It’s like a crape.As wheat cultivation was active in Nara Prefecture, the locals have had dishes and snacks with wheat flour, like ‘Miwa soumen’ (=thin wheat flour noodle from Miwa area), ‘Hagesshou-mochi’ (=mochi mixed with wheat flour) and ‘Shiki’.
10918be1c9f5b30e.zh: 「しきしき」是奈良的鄉土點心，將小麥粉、水和砂糖調成的麵糊煎烤而成，戰前就有人食用。現在也會加入雞蛋。類似可麗餅。由於奈良縣小麥栽種興盛，當地有許多使用小麥粉的料理與點心，例如「三輪素麵」（三輪地區的細麵）、「半夏生餅」（混入小麥的餅）及「しき」。

109b435462fb530f.en: Mount Tanzawa (丹沢山, Tanzawa-san, -yama) is a mountain of the Tanzawa Mountains, with an elevation of 1,567.1 metres (5,141 ft). Its summit marks the border between Sagamihara,  Kiyokawa  in Aikō District, and Yamakita in Ashigarakami District.
109b435462fb530f.zh: 丹沢山（丹沢山，Tanzawa-san、-yama）是丹澤山地的一座山，海拔1,567.1公尺（5,141英尺）。山頂為相模原市、愛甲郡清川村與足柄上郡山北町的交界。

109bc1b333378a07.en: Rokko Yahata Shrine (六甲八幡神社, Rokkō Yahata-jinja) is a Japanese Shinto shrine near Hankyu Rokko Station in Nada-ku, Kobe. It is one of the biggest shrines in western Kobe, alongside Sumiyoshi Shrine. The shrine hosts several events throughout the year, including New Year's Day celebration, the yakujin festival, setsubun and Shichi-Go-San. Notably, the big red torii gate at the entrance to the shopping mall is large and is at least 110 years old.
109bc1b333378a07.zh: 六甲八幡神社是位於神戶市灘區阪急六甲站附近的日本神社，與住吉神社同為神戶西部規模最大的神社之一。神社全年舉辦多項活動，包括元旦慶祝、厄神祭、節分及七五三。商店街入口處的紅色大鳥居規模很大，歷史至少有110年。

10a10c5364d8a411.en: Kyushu Natural Animal Park African Safari (九州自然動物公園アフリカンサファリ, Kyūshū Shizen Dōbutsu Kōen Afurikan Safari), also referred to as simply African Safari, is Japan's largest safari park and is located at the base of the Kunisaki Peninsula in Usa, Ōita Prefecture.
10a10c5364d8a411.zh: 九州自然動物公園アフリカンサファリ，亦簡稱非洲野生動物園（アフリカンサファリ），是日本最大的野生動物園，位於大分縣宇佐市國東半島的基部。

10abfd5ac80bbb73.en: The Izumo Science Center (出雲科学館, Izumo Kagakukan) is a science center located in Izumo-shi, Shimane Prefecture, Japan that operates both as a school and as a center for public education. The pupils in Izumo-shi, from third grade through junior high school, take lessons in natural science. On weekends, the center hosts events about science and manufacturing for the general public. About 150,000 people, as many as the population of Izumo-shi, visit there every year.
10abfd5ac80bbb73.zh: 出雲科学館是位於日本島根縣出雲市的科學中心，兼具學校與公眾教育中心的功能。出雲市國小三年級至國中的學生在此上自然科學課程。週末則為一般民眾舉辦有關科學與製造的活動。每年約有15萬人造訪，與出雲市人口相當。

10d58813baa213a3.en: Itokazu Castle (糸数城, Itokazu jō; Okinawan: Ichukaji Gushiku) is a  Ryūkyūan gusuku fortification located in the Tamagusuku neighborhood of the city of Nanjō, Okinawa. The castle ruins were designated a National Historic Site on May 15, 1972.
10d58813baa213a3.zh: 糸數城（糸数城，Itokazu jō；沖繩語：Ichukaji Gushiku）是位於沖繩縣南城市玉城的琉球御城（グスク）防禦設施。城址於1972年5月15日被指定為國家史跡。

10d84ed3d4c6618c.en: The giant cuttlefish is another name for the bluefin squid, which is a relatively large squid with a body length of 40 centimeters. Because of its translucent appearance, it is often called "mizu-ika" in Kagoshima Prefecture. The Nansei Islands, to which the southern part of the Kagoshima mainland and the Amami Islands belong, are the main fishing grounds in Japan. Eging is a typical squid fishing technique, coined by combining the English progressive form of "ing" with "egi," and is said to have originated on Amami Oshima Island.
10d84ed3d4c6618c.zh: 巨墨魚（cuttlefish）是軟絲（アオリイカ）的別名，是體長達40公分、較大型的烏賊。因外觀透明，在鹿兒島縣常被稱為「水イカ」。鹿兒島本土南部與奄美群島所屬的南西諸島是日本的主要漁場。木蝦假餌釣法（エギング）是代表性的釣烏賊技法，名稱由「餌木」加上英文進行式「ing」組合而成，據說起源於奄美大島。

10e0535d2613540f.en: Miyazaki prefecture is blessed with a mild climate and the hours of sunlight it receives is one of the highest in Japan. “Kurokawa Kabocha” (=black-skinned pumpkin) is a specialty of Miyazaki which needs a lot of sunlight to grow and has an impressive glossy black skin.
10e0535d2613540f.zh: 宮崎縣氣候溫和，日照時數居日本前列。「黑皮南瓜」是宮崎的特產，生長需要大量日照，具有醒目的光亮黑色外皮。

1103c2a915f684ac.en: Murone Kōgen Prefectural Natural Park (室根高原県立自然公園, Murone Kōgen kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Iwate Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1974, the park spans the municipalities of Ichinoseki and Rikuzentakata.
1103c2a915f684ac.zh: 室根高原県立自然公園是位於日本岩手縣的縣立自然公園。設立於1974年，範圍横跨一關市與陸前高田市。

110e1ba6b40e1b93.en: Dainichi-ji is a Shingon Buddhist Temple located in Kōnan, Kōchi, Japan. It is the 28th temple of the Shikoku Pilgrimage.
110e1ba6b40e1b93.zh: 大日寺是位於日本高知縣香南市的真言宗佛教寺院，為四國遍路的第28番札所。

111bd6cd8f3e71c4.en: Tango-no Sekku, May 5, is celebrated as Children's Day in modern times. Depending on the region, various sweets such as chimaki, sasamaki, and beko-mochi (rice cake) are prepared and eaten. Kashiwa Mochi, which is eaten throughout Japan, is a celebratory rice cake made of fine white rice flour and white bean flour, and filled with red bean paste or miso bean paste.
111bd6cd8f3e71c4.zh: 5月5日端午節在現代作為兒童節慶祝。依地區不同，會製作並食用粽子、笹巻、べこ餅等各種點心。柏餅在日本全國都有食用，是以上新粉與白豆粉製成、包入紅豆餡或味噌豆沙餡的慶賀用麻糬。

112c8e15eebf9a8f.en: "Okutamawasabi no TOKYO-X maki" is a dish in which chopped root wasabi is wrapped around pork and grilled.Okutama wasabi, one of the Edo Tokyo vegetables, grows in a cool clear stream near the headwaters of the Tama River and is characterized by its cool spiciness and rich flavor, and has been cultivated since the Ashikaga period.
112c8e15eebf9a8f.zh: 「おくたまワサビのTOKYO-X巻き」是用豬肉捲起切碎的山葵根後燒烤的料理。奧多摩山葵是江戶東京蔬菜之一，生長在多摩川源頭附近清涼的溪流中，特色是清爽的辛辣與濃郁的風味，自足利時代起便有栽培。

114c69a2e279f870.en: Gichū-ji (義仲寺) is a Tendai Buddhist temple in the Baba neighborhood of the city of Ōtsu, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. Its honzon is a statue of Shō-Kannon Bosatsu.  It contains the grave of the late Heian period warlord Kiso Yoshinaka and the Edo period poet Matsuo Basho. Its precincts were designated a National Historic Site in 1967.
114c69a2e279f870.zh: 義仲寺是位於日本滋賀縣大津市馬場的天台宗佛教寺院，本尊為聖觀音菩薩像。寺內有平安時代末期武將木曾義仲與江戶時代俳人松尾芭蕉的墓。寺域於1967年被指定為國家史跡。

11686d015c63413c.en: Miyakojima City Museum (宮古島市総合博物館, Miyakojima-shi Sōgō Hakubutsukan) opened as the Hirara City Museum of History and Folklore (平良市歴史民俗資料館) in Hirara, Okinawa Prefecture, Japan in 1989. Upon the merger of Hirara into Miyakojima in 2005, the museum reopened as the Miyakojima City Museum. It is dedicated to the area's natural history, history, folkways, and culture.
11686d015c63413c.zh: 宮古島市綜合博物館（宮古島市総合博物館，Miyakojima-shi Sōgō Hakubutsukan）於1989年以平良市歷史民俗資料館（平良市歴史民俗資料館）之名，在日本沖繩縣平良市開館。2005年平良市併入宮古島市後，博物館以宮古島市綜合博物館之名重新開館。館方以當地的自然史、歷史、民俗與文化為主題。

1175eb527600dc8d.en: In the Kyushu region, chicken is called "kashiwa," and "kashiwa-meshi" is a local food that combines chicken and boiled-down ingredients to cooked rice. It is a local home cooking staple made throughout homes and restaurants in Fukuoka Prefecture since long ago, and is also eaten during special occasions such as festivals and sporting events.
1175eb527600dc8d.zh: 在九州地區，雞肉稱為「かしわ」，而「かしわめし」是將雞肉和燉煮過的食材與米飯一起炊煮的鄉土料理。這是福岡縣自古以來在家庭和餐廳普遍製作的家常料理，在祭典、運動會等特別場合也會食用。

11a06c00730884bd.en: Matsuo Pond (松尾池, Matsuo-ike) is a pond in Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It is located at the southern base of Mount Dodo, the city's tallest mountain. The area around the lake is known as the Hagi Falls Nature Park (萩の滝自然公園 Hagi-no-taki Shizen Kōen). The park is very popular in the fall when the leaves are changing color.
11a06c00730884bd.zh: 松尾池是位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市的池塘，位於該市最高峰百百峰的南麓。池周邊一帶稱為萩之瀧自然公園（萩の滝自然公園）。秋季樹葉轉紅時，公園遊客眾多。

11a700d2c73b71aa.en: The Hiroshima City Transportation Museum (広島市交通科学館, Hiroshima-shi Kōtsū Kagakukan) is a transport museum in Hiroshima, Japan, opened in March 1995.
11a700d2c73b71aa.zh: 広島市交通科学館是位於日本廣島市的交通博物館，於1995年3月開館。

11b459daf90d733a.en: The Nara Prefecture Complex of Man'yo Culture (奈良県立万葉文化館, Nara-kenritsu Man'yō Bunkakan) is a museum located in Asuka Village, Nara Prefecture, in Japan. It is dedicated to the Man'yōshū, an 8th-century anthology of waka poetry. Its honorary director is Susumu Nakanishi.
11b459daf90d733a.zh: 奈良県立万葉文化館是位於日本奈良縣明日香村的博物館，以8世紀的和歌選集《萬葉集》為主題。名譽館長為中西進。

11ce8922230ffa65.en: Obama City, the center of Wakasa Bay, was the starting point of the "saba kaido" (mackerel road), which was a route used to transport fish on foot to Kyoto, called "shokuyaku" (carrying on one's back). Known since the Asuka and Nara periods as the "Miketsukuni," or "Land of Food," Obama City played an important role in the food industry, being authorized to deliver foodstuffs to the Imperial Court.
11ce8922230ffa65.zh: 位於若狹灣中心的小濱市，是「鯖街道」（鯖魚之路）的起點；這條路線用於以徒步方式將魚運往京都，稱為「背負」（揹在背上搬運）。小濱市自飛鳥、奈良時代起就被稱為「御食國」，即「食物之國」，獲准向朝廷進貢食材，在飲食方面扮演重要角色。

11d1ece150244bd6.en: Inohana Castle (亥鼻城, Inohana-jō) was a Japanese hirayama-style (lowland hill) castle located in Inohana (formerly Shimōsa Province) in the Chuo district of Chiba City, Chiba Prefecture. It is commonly known as Chiba Castle. The surrounding area of the castle ruins have been developed into Inohana Park. The castle ruins, including its earthworks and moats, have been designated as a cultural property of the city. The Chiba City Folk Museum, a Japanese castle replica, was built on the site in 1967.
11d1ece150244bd6.zh: 亥鼻城（亥鼻城，Inohana-jō）是位於千葉縣千葉市中央區亥鼻（舊下總國）的日本平山城（低丘城郭），一般通稱千葉城。城跡周邊已整建為亥鼻公園。城跡包含土壘與壕溝，已列為市指定文化財。1967年在原址建造了仿日本城郭外觀的千葉市立鄉土博物館。

11f9ccb8047fe263.en: City Hall Plaza Aore Nagaoka is a multi-purpose arena and city hall in Nagaoka, Niigata, Japan. It is the home arena of the Niigata Albirex BB of the B.League, Japan's professional basketball league.
11f9ccb8047fe263.zh: 長岡市シティホールプラザアオーレ長岡是位於日本新潟縣長岡的多功能體育館兼市政廳，為日本職業籃球聯賽B.League球隊新潟Albirex BB的主場。

11fb41167f5cb57f.en: Akita Museum of Art (秋田県立美術館 平野政吉コレクション, Akita Kenritsu Bijutsukan Hirano Masakichi Collection) is an art museum in the city of Akita.
11fb41167f5cb57f.zh: 秋田県立美術館 平野政吉コレクション是位於秋田市的美術館。

120ed86903cf4534.en: Senmaizuke" is a pickle made by pickling thinly sliced Shogoin turnips in salt. It is one of the three most popular pickles in Kyoto, along with "sukkizuke" and "shibazuke". Unlike conventional pickles, it is not intended to be preserved for a long period of time and is delicately pickled.It is said to have been invented by Ohfuji Tozaburo, a chef at the Imperial Palace during the Edo period (1603-1868). Later, Ohfuji Tozaburo became a pickles merchant and sold "Senmai-zuke" (pickled sliced radish), which quickly became popular.
120ed86903cf4534.zh: 「千枚漬け」是將切成薄片的聖護院蕪菁以鹽醃漬而成的醃菜，與「すぐき漬け」、「しば漬け」並列為京都三大醃菜。與一般醃菜不同，它並非以長期保存為目的，而是經過細緻的醃漬。據說是江戶時代（1603-1868）宮中的廚師大藤藤三郎所發明。之後大藤藤三郎成為醃菜商人，販售「千枚漬け」，很快就廣受歡迎。

120f48b603f6b053.en: The Harmony Hall Fukui (ハーモニーホールふくい, Hāmonī Hōru Fukui), formally called Fukui-kenritsu Ongakudō (福井県立音楽堂), often abbreviated as HHF, is a concert hall located in Fukui, Fukui, Japan.
120f48b603f6b053.zh: ハーモニーホールふくい（Hāmonī Hōru Fukui），正式名稱為福井県立音楽堂，常簡稱為HHF，是位於日本福井縣福井市的音樂廳。

1229afd1be2bf192.en: The Jōkyō Gimin Memorial Museum (貞享義民記念館, Jōkyō Gimin  Kinen-kan)  is a museum dedicated to the Jōkyō Uprising that occurred in the Azumidaira area of  Shinano Province of Japan in 1686 (the third year of the Jōkyō era during the Edo period).  The uprising, also called the Kasuke Uprising (the leader of the peasant uprising was Tada Kasuke), is portrayed by the museum to be a struggle for the right to life.  Thus the founders of the memorial museum erected two plaques at the front entrance of the building.
1229afd1be2bf192.zh: 貞享義民記念館是以1686年（江戶時代貞享三年）發生於日本信濃國安曇平地區的貞享騷動為主題的博物館。此次騷動又稱加助騷動（農民起義的領導者為多田加助），館方將其描繪為爭取生存權的抗爭。因此，記念館的創建者在建築正門口設置了兩塊匾牌。

1238cb5a619af372.en: Kakinomoto Shrine (柿本神社 Kakinomoto-jinja) is a Shinto shrine in Akashi, Hyōgo. It is also referred to as Hitomaru-san.
1238cb5a619af372.zh: 柿本神社是位於兵庫縣明石市的神社，也被稱為「人丸さん」。

123a678443a32ff0.en: Miyagikyo distillery (Japanese: 宮城峡蒸溜所, Hepburn: Miyagikyō jōryūsho) is a Japanese whisky distillery. It is located near Sendai (仙台市, Sendai-shi), the capital city of Miyagi Prefecture, Tōhoku region, Japan.
123a678443a32ff0.zh: 宮城峡蒸溜所是日本威士忌蒸餾廠，位於日本東北地方宮城縣縣廳所在地仙台市附近。

124d4076a1148356.en: Gushikawa Castle (具志川城, Gushikawa jō; Okinawan: Gushichaa Gushiku) is a Ryūkyūan gusuku fortification in the Nakamura-do neighborhood of the town of Kumejima, Okinawa, on Kume Island. It has been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 1975.
124d4076a1148356.zh: 具志川城（具志川城，Gushikawa jō；沖繩語：Gushichaa Gushiku）是位於沖繩縣久米島町仲村渠、久米島上的琉球御城（グスク）防禦設施。自1975年起由中央政府指定為國家史跡加以保護。

1253a86b8a785c60.en: Hirara-yaki is made by heating a flat stone and grilling fish and vegetables on it with miso. The name "Hirara-yaki" comes from the flat stone called "Hirara" in Japanese. It is one of the local dishes eaten in the Iya region of Miyoshi City, and was popular as an outdoor dish in the old days. A flat stone is placed on top of the kamado and heated to warm the stone like an iron plate, and then the ingredients are grilled on the stone.
1253a86b8a785c60.zh: ひらら焼き是將扁平的石頭加熱，在上面用味噌燒烤魚和蔬菜的料理。「ひらら焼き」之名來自日文中稱為「ひらら」的扁平石頭。這是三好市祖谷地區食用的鄉土料理之一，過去作為戶外料理很受歡迎。將扁平的石頭放在灶上加熱，使石頭像鐵板一樣變熱，再把食材放在石頭上燒烤。

1288505f2ea027ab.en: Wheat manju is a steamed bun made by wrapping red bean paste in a dough made of wheat flour. It is also simply known as “manju” and, because it is made by adding carbonic acid (sodium bicarbonate), “carbonated manju” as well. It is a hometown flavor that has been made at home in each household for a long time.Tochigi Prefecture employs a two-crop system with many wheat crops, and their people have loved dishes made with wheat for a long time. Wheat manju is also one of the indispensable dishes for annual events and ceremonial occasions.
1288505f2ea027ab.zh: 小麥まんじゅう是用小麥麵粉做的麵皮包紅豆餡蒸成的饅頭。它也簡稱為「まんじゅう」，又因加入碳酸（小蘇打）製作，也稱「炭酸まんじゅう」。這是長久以來各家庭在家中製作的家鄉味。栃木縣採行二期作，小麥種植多，當地人長久以來喜愛小麥製作的料理。小麥まんじゅう也是年中節慶與儀式場合不可或缺的食物之一。

12dad3c565385e0a.en: The Miura peninsula's Misaki Harbor is known as the preeminent harbor for tuna fishing in Japan. Grilled head of tuna is a local delicacy in Misaki: a hearty dish where, as the name suggests, an entire tuna head is grilled as-is. It originally arose from the fishermen of Misaki when they boarded their boats and set out for the open sea. They would suspend tuna heads that they could not sell at market from their ships' funnels, grilling it in covered pans before eating it.
12dad3c565385e0a.zh: 三浦半島的三崎港以日本首屈一指的鮪魚漁港聞名。マグロのかぶと焼き是三崎的在地美食，正如其名，將整顆鮪魚頭直接燒烤，是一道份量十足的料理。起源於三崎漁夫乘船出海時，將市場上賣不掉的鮪魚頭吊在船的煙囪上，放入加蓋的鍋中燒烤後食用。

12dad782c8ee6c7a.en: Sliced Spanish mackerel is seasoned with kombu (kelp). Spanish mackerel is known as "Spanish mackerel" used for Saikyo-yaki (grilled fish). However, in Ishikawa Prefecture, marlin tuna is called "Sawara" in the local dialect. Marlin and blue marlin are also lumped together under the name "Spanish mackerel," and this name is also used in supermarkets and restaurants.
12dad782c8ee6c7a.zh: 將切片的鰆魚以昆布調味。鰆魚一般以用於西京燒（烤魚）的「鰆魚」而為人所知。然而在石川縣，當地方言將旗魚稱為「さわら」。旗魚與藍旗魚也被統稱為「鰆魚」，超市和餐廳也使用這個名稱。

12e1100815c949e6.en: Mount Kōbō (弘法山, Kōbō-yama) lies east of Hadano in Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan.
12e1100815c949e6.zh: 弘法山位於日本神奈川縣秦野市東部。

12fc904ab2bd93f4.en: The Unpenji Ropeway (雲辺寺ロープウェイ, Unpenji Rōpuwei) is a Japanese aerial lift line in Kan'onji, Kagawa, operated by Shikoku Cable. Opened in 1987, the line climbs to Unpen-ji, the 66th temple of Shikoku Pilgrimage. The temple is at the highest altitude point of the entire pilgrimage. At the summit, Shikoku Cable also operates Snow Park Unpenji, a ski resort, as well as Wind Park Unpenji, a paragliding field.
12fc904ab2bd93f4.zh: 雲辺寺ロープウェイ是位於香川縣觀音寺市的日本空中纜車路線，由四國纜車經營。該路線於1987年啟用，可登上四國遍路第66號札所雲辺寺。該寺位於整條遍路路線的最高海拔處。四國纜車在山頂另經營滑雪場「Snow Park雲辺寺」及滑翔傘場「Wind Park雲辺寺」。

1300ff1ac466b217.en: “Akumaki” is a traditional snack eaten on “Tango no Sekku,” also known as Children’s Day, and is sometimes called “chimaki.” It is said that Yoshihiro Shimazu of Satsuma first took the “mochi” (=Japanese rice cake) with him during the Battle of Sekigahara because it remained edible for several days and was satisfying to eat, making it suitable to carry during battles. It is also said that Saigo Takamori ate “akumaki” during the Satsuma Rebellion. People began to eat “akumaki” for “Tango no Sekku” with hopes of raising strong boys.
1300ff1ac466b217.zh: 「あくまき」是在端午節（又稱兒童節）吃的傳統點心，有時也稱為「粽」。據說薩摩的島津義弘在關原之戰時，因這種「麻糬」（＝日式年糕）可放置數日仍能食用、又有飽足感，適合在戰時攜帶，最先將它帶上戰場。也有一說是西鄉隆盛在西南戰爭時吃過「あくまき」。人們開始在端午節吃「あくまき」，祈願男孩健壯成長。

13166a5602a1f525.en: Senkō-ji (全興寺) is a Buddhist temple in Hirano-ku, Osaka Prefecture, Japan.
13166a5602a1f525.zh: 全興寺是位於日本大阪府平野區的佛教寺院。

132b78477930d0f7.en: Tokorozawa Civic Cultural Centre Muse (所沢市民文化センター ミューズ, Tokorozawa Shimin Bunka Sentā Myūzu) is a concert hall complex consisting of the main "Ark Hall", with a pipe organ, and other facilities, located in Tokorozawa, Saitama, west of Tokyo, Japan. It opened in 1993, and is operated by the Tokorozawa Cultural Foundation. It is also called "Tokorozawa Muse", or sometimes just "Muse" for short.
132b78477930d0f7.zh: 所沢市民文化センター ミューズ是位於日本東京以西埼玉縣所澤市的音樂廳綜合設施，由設有管風琴的主廳「Ark Hall」及其他設施組成。1993年開幕，由所澤文化財團營運。亦稱「所澤Muse」，有時簡稱「Muse」。

133b2d3fc2b1f6a4.en: Hachinohe Sansha Taisai (八戸三社大祭) is a Japanese festival celebrated from July 31 to August 4 in Hachinohe, Aomori Prefecture, Japan. Its rites center on three Shinto shrines: Ogami (霊神社), Shinra (新羅神社), and Shinmei (神明宮) shrines. There is a procession of twenty-seven floats and three mikoshi are also borne through the streets. It has a two hundred and ninety-year history and in 2004 was designated an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property.
133b2d3fc2b1f6a4.zh: 八戶三社大祭（八戸三社大祭）是7月31日至8月4日在日本青森縣八戶舉行的日本祭典。祭儀以三座神社為中心：靈神社、新羅神社及神明宮。祭典中有27台山車遊行，另有3座神轎在街上巡行。祭典已有290年歷史，2004年被指定為重要無形民俗文化財。

133f528eefb21636.en: Toyota Arena Tokyo (stylized in all caps) is a multi-purpose indoor arena located in the Aomi district of Kōtō Ward, Tokyo, Japan. Built on the former site of Palette Town, the arena serves as a prominent sports and entertainment venue in the Tokyo waterfront.
133f528eefb21636.zh: TOYOTA ARENA TOKYO（名稱以全大寫表示）是位於日本東京都江東區青海地區的多功能室內體育館。場館建於Palette Town舊址上，是東京臨海地區重要的運動與娛樂場地。

1350246835f2c45f.en: The "Kashima Sea", which stretches from Oarai in Ibaraki Prefecture to Inubosaki in Chiba Prefecture, is an excellent fishing area where the "Oyashio" Current and "Kuroshio" Current collide. During the Showa period, both before and after the war, great numbers of sardines were caught in autumn and distributed to households. The sardines, which can be caught in large quantities, are pickled in salt from around November. Once they’re fermented, they’re pickled together with daikon radishes.
1350246835f2c45f.zh: 從茨城縣大洗延伸至千葉縣犬吠埼的「鹿島灘」，是「親潮」與「黑潮」交會的優良漁場。昭和時代戰前戰後，秋季捕獲大量沙丁魚，分送到各家庭。可大量捕獲的沙丁魚約從11月起以鹽醃漬，發酵後再與白蘿蔔一起醃漬。

13686c78589d44fa.en: Ikinari dango" is a simple local snack made by wrapping sliced sweet potatoes in flour dough and steaming them. Because of the volcanic ash in Otsu, the largest producer of sweet potatoes in the prefecture, and other areas around the foot of Mt. Aso, farmers in the Kikuchi Plain and Kumamoto Plain used to make these dumplings as a snack to eat during the fall farming season when sweet potatoes are harvested.
13686c78589d44fa.zh: いきなり団子是將切片的番薯用麵糰包起來蒸熟的簡樸鄉土點心。縣內最大番薯產地大津等阿蘇山麓一帶因有火山灰，菊池平原與熊本平原的農家過去會在收成番薯的秋季農忙期，製作這種糰子作為點心食用。

1383189a7cc11108.en: Tochigi Prefectural Museum of Fine Arts (栃木県立美術館, Tochigi Kenritsu Bijutsukan) opened in Utsunomiya, Tochigi Prefecture, Japan, in 1972. The collection includes works by Hamada Shōji, Takahashi Yuichi, Constable, Corot, Gainsborough, Monet, and Turner, and special exhibitions are also mounted.
1383189a7cc11108.zh: 栃木縣立美術館於1972年在日本栃木縣宇都宮市開館。館藏包括濱田庄司、高橋由一、康斯塔伯、柯洛、根茲博羅、莫內與透納的作品，並舉辦特展。

1392e3d45fdf7c69.en: A "yuzu roll" is a regional dish in which you wrap the skin of a "yuzu" fruit with daikon radish and pickle the roll in sweet vinegar for about 2 ~ 3 days. It is an indispensable item for autumn festivals and the New Year.Cold "yuzu" fruits are cultivated mainly in the northern part of Utsunomiya. They have a stronger aroma and are meatier than "yuzu" fruits cultivated in warm regions. "Yuzu" fruits evoke images of people enjoying their fragrance such as when using them as udon noodle condiments or putting them into the bath.
1392e3d45fdf7c69.zh: 「ゆず巻き」是一道鄉土料理，以白蘿蔔包捲柚子皮，再用甜醋醃漬約2～3天，是秋祭與新年不可缺少的一道菜。耐寒的柚子主要栽培於宇都宮北部，比溫暖地區栽培的柚子香氣更濃、果肉更厚。提到柚子，會讓人想到用來當烏龍麵佐料或放進浴缸等享受其香氣的情景。

13965cc0dc9b28bf.en: Kōken-ji (高顕寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Kōyasan Shingon school located in Bizen, Okayama Prefecture, Japan.
13965cc0dc9b28bf.zh: 高顯寺是位於日本岡山縣備前市的高野山真言宗佛寺。

13a45deca269e651.en: Tsugi-jiru, a local dish of the Kanomizu district of Meiho, is a rare soup that can only be tasted here. It is characterized by the spiciness of red pepper, the sweetness of sugar, and the inclusion of small cubes of firm local tofu.
13a45deca269e651.zh: つぎ汁是明寶鹿ノ水地區的鄉土料理，是只有在當地才能品嚐到的少見湯品。特色是辣椒的辣味、砂糖的甜味，以及加入切成小丁的當地硬豆腐。

13a4d152baac6336.en: This dish was called "Inari-zushi" because fried thin tofu is said to be the favorite food of the fox, which is believed to be the messenger of the god Inari, and because sushi made with fried thin tofu is an essential part of the offerings made at Inari shrines. In Tochigi Prefecture, fried thin tofu stuffed with "sushi rice(=vinegared rice)" is wrapped with seasoned "kanpyo (=dried gourd)" in the center to make it look like a bale.
13a4d152baac6336.zh: 據說油豆皮是被視為稻荷神使者的狐狸最喜愛的食物，而以油豆皮做的壽司是稻荷神社供品中不可缺少的一項，因此這道料理被稱為「いなりずし」。在栃木縣，會在塞入醋飯的油豆皮中央，以調味過的干瓢綁起，做成米袋的樣子。

13a676ba331f54f5.en: Shiga Prefecture has a large number of temples per capita and a deeply religious climate, and “Shojin-ryori” (vegetarian cuisine) using Tofu has often been made. In “Tofu- Dengaku”, drained Tofu is put on a skewer and grilled. When it browns slightly, it is dipped in” Kinome-Miso” or “Negi-Miso” and grilled again. In the “Kohoku” region, there is a custom of making and eating “Tofu- Dengaku” on the occasion of “Houon-ko”, festivals, and the winter solstice.
13a676ba331f54f5.zh: 滋賀縣人均寺院數量多，宗教風氣濃厚，常製作使用豆腐的「精進料理」（素食料理）。「豆腐田楽」是將瀝乾水分的豆腐串在竹籤上燒烤，烤至微焦後沾上「木の芽味噌」或「葱味噌」再烤一次。「湖北」地區有在「報恩講」、祭典及冬至時製作並食用「豆腐田楽」的習俗。

13b8af324e83b3f1.en: The coastal area from Hinomisaki to Wakayama City faces the bountiful Kiisuido Strait, where abundant seafood can be harvested. The shallow average depth of the strait allows sunlight to reach the seabed, making it suitable for the cultivation of wakame seaweed. Additionally, the Wakame seaweed grown in the rough waves of the Kiisuido Strait is well-flavored with a vibrant color.In Yura Town, Hidaka District, farmed Wakame seaweed is well-known, and the area is recognized as one of the leading wakame-producing regions in the prefecture.
13b8af324e83b3f1.zh: 從日之御埼到和歌山市的沿岸地區面向物產豐饒的紀伊水道，能捕撈豐富的海產。紀伊水道平均水深較淺，陽光可照射到海底，適合養殖裙帶菜。此外，在紀伊水道的大浪中生長的裙帶菜風味佳、色澤鮮豔。日高郡由良町的養殖裙帶菜相當知名，該地區被視為縣內主要的裙帶菜產地之一。

13ca37af0e7841b8.en: The Kyoto Art Center (京都芸術センター, Kyōto Geijutsu Sentā) is a venue for promoting the arts which is located in the heart of Kyoto, Japan. The center, a three-story reinforced-concrete building, occupies the site of the former Meirin Elementary School (founded by the people of Kyoto during the Meiji era).
13ca37af0e7841b8.zh: 京都藝術中心是位於日本京都市中心、推廣藝術的場館。中心為一棟三層樓鋼筋混凝土建築，所在地原為明倫小學（明治時期由京都市民創辦）。

13d0a01fe02bc141.en: Sakai Matsuri (堺まつり) or Sakai Festival, is one of the three largest annual events in Sakai City, along with the Sakai Citizen’s Olympics, and the Sakai City Agricultural Festival.
13d0a01fe02bc141.zh: 堺まつり（堺祭）與堺市民奧林匹克、堺市農業祭並列為堺市三大年度活動之一。

13df60d7da1dddec.en: Kiyama Castle (城山城, Kiyama-jō) was an ancient castle (also known as a Korean-style fortresses in Japan (朝鮮式山城, Chōsen-shiki yamajiro) located in the city of Sakaide, Kagawa, Japan, and extending partly into the neighboring city of Marugame.  Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1951. It is also known as Shiroyama Castle or Sanuki-Shiroyama Castle.
13df60d7da1dddec.zh: 城山城是一座古代山城（亦屬日本的朝鮮式山城），位於日本香川縣坂出市，部分延伸至鄰近的丸龜市。其遺跡自1951年起被列為國家史跡，又稱城山城（Shiroyama）或讚岐城山城。

13f519decf46bb19.en: Renkei-ji (蓮馨寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Jōdo-shū sect in Kawagoe City, Saitama Prefecture. Its mountain name (sangō) is Kōhozan, while its monastery name (ingō) is Hōchi-in. The temple is dedicated to Amida Buddha.
13f519decf46bb19.zh: 蓮馨寺是位於埼玉縣川越市的淨土宗佛教寺院，山號為孤峰山，院號為寶池院。本寺供奉阿彌陀佛。

1416d1b7712ee0ef.en: Fuji (AGB-5001) was an icebreaker of the Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force (JMSDF) in the mid-1960s. She is now a museum ship in Nagoya.
1416d1b7712ee0ef.zh: ふじ（AGB-5001）是日本海上自衛隊於1960年代中期的破冰船，現為名古屋的博物館船。

142bafda40b09f4d.en: Mount Sen (千ヶ峰, Sen-ga-mine) is a 1,005.2 m (3,298 ft)　mountain of Chūgoku Mountains, located on the border of Taka and Kamikawa, Hyōgo, Japan. This mountain is one of Hyōgo 50 mountains. This mountain is an important center of Kasagatayama-Sengamine Prefectural Natural Park.
142bafda40b09f4d.zh: 千ヶ峰是中國山地的一座山，海拔1,005.2公尺（3,298英尺），位於日本兵庫縣多可町與神河町交界處。此山為兵庫50山之一，是笠形山千ヶ峰縣立自然公園的重要中心。

1458ecf1bf7f1bd9.en: Kota-jinja (巨田神社) is a Shinto shrine located in Miyazaki, Miyazaki Prefecture, Japan. It is dedicated to Futodama, Empress Jingū and Emperor Ōjin.
1458ecf1bf7f1bd9.zh: 巨田神社是位於日本宮崎縣宮崎市的神社，祭祀太玉命、神功皇后與應神天皇。

148902e9313f11d2.en: Yaegaki Shrine (八重垣神社, Yaegaki Jinja), formerly known as Sakusa Shrine (佐久佐神社, Sakusa Jinja), is a Shinto shrine in Matsue, Shimane Prefecture, Japan.
148902e9313f11d2.zh: 八重垣神社舊稱佐久佐神社，是位於日本島根縣松江市的神社。

148d377f75517ea6.en: Katemeshi, or loaded rice, is a local dish of Sagamihara City that has been passed down over many years. It is a kitchen-sink meal made by mixing together white rice and broth-simmered vegetables.At one time, much of Sagamihara’s soil was covered in volcanic ash and sterile. Rather than rice, sweet potato and wheat were widely cultivated. Katemeshi is a dish that adds vegetables like radish and potato to rice in order to make the most of that precious ingredient.
148d377f75517ea6.zh: かて飯是相模原市流傳多年的鄉土料理，將白飯與用高湯燉煮的蔬菜混合而成，是一道什錦料理。過去相模原的土壤大多覆蓋火山灰而貧瘠，比起稻米，更廣泛種植番薯和小麥。かて飯是在米飯中加入蘿蔔、馬鈴薯等蔬菜，以充分利用珍貴米糧的料理。

14a943163ecdec70.en: Taisan-ji (大山寺) is a Daigo Shingon temple in Kamiita, Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. Said to have been visited by Kōbō Daishi, the main image is of Senjū Kannon. The Shōrō-mon and Kairō of 1830–68, Hondō (mid-Edo period), and Daishidō (1863) have all been placed on the cultural properties register. The temple was renovated in 1985. A bronze canister containing documents dating to 1126 has been designated an Important Cultural Property. The temple is the first of the 20 Fudasho Bangai and also Temple 1 of the Shikoku 36 Fudō pilgrimage.
14a943163ecdec70.zh: 大山寺是位於日本德島縣上板的醍醐派真言宗寺院。據傳弘法大師曾到訪，本尊為千手觀音。1830–68年的鐘樓門與迴廊、本堂（江戶時代中期）及大師堂（1863）均已登錄為文化財。本寺於1985年整修。一件內有1126年文書的銅製經筒已被指定為重要文化財。本寺為二十番外札所的第1番，也是四國三十六不動靈場的第1番。

14d366c23713dd7a.en: Naha Municipal Tsuboya Pottery Museum (那覇市立壺屋焼物博物館, Naha Shiritsu Tsuboya-yakimono Hakubutsukan) is a ceramics museum that opened in Naha, Okinawa Prefecture, Japan in 1998. The collection focuses on Ryukyuan pottery, in particular Tsuboya ware.
14d366c23713dd7a.zh: 那覇市立壺屋焼物博物館是1998年於日本沖繩縣那霸市開館的陶瓷博物館。館藏以琉球陶器為主，特別是壺屋燒。

14db06477c3513ac.en: “Tako-meshi” (octopus rice) is said to have been a type of fisherman's meal in which octopus caught by fishermen was chopped into small pieces on the boat and cooked with rice. In addition to Aichi Prefecture, it is often eaten in the Seto Inland Sea region, including Ehime, Kagawa and Hiroshima prefectures. Himaka Island, located in Mikawa Bay, is called the "Island of Octopus" because it is rich in high-quality octopus.
14db06477c3513ac.zh: 「たこ飯」（章魚飯）據說原本是一種漁夫餐，漁夫在船上將捕到的章魚切成小塊，與米一起炊煮。除了愛知縣，愛媛縣、香川縣、廣島縣等瀨戶內海地區也常吃這道料理。位於三河灣的日間賀島盛產優質章魚，因而被稱為「章魚之島」。

14e09dc62158c02a.en: Ōkaburaya Shrine (大鏑矢神社, Ōkaburaya jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Tamura, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. It enshrines the kami Takamimusubi (高皇産霊神), Ōkaburaya no kami (大鏑矢神), and Sakanoue Tamuramaro no mikoto (坂之上田村麿命). Its main annual festival is held on November 1.
14e09dc62158c02a.zh: 大鏑矢神社是位於日本福島縣田村的神社，祭祀高皇產靈神、大鏑矢神及坂之上田村麿命。每年的例大祭於11月1日舉行。

14e49f2712fb48d1.en: Traditional nori(seaweed) rolls from the Eba district in the central area of Hiroshima City, where nori cultivation has been thriving for a long time. This type of nori roll has been consumed since ancient times. It consists of rice, Hiroshima-style pickled vegetables, bonito flakes, soy sauce, and sesame seeds mixed together, then rolled and wrapped with roasted seaweed. Instead of vinegar rice, regular rice is used, and the filling includes pickled vegetables and other easily preserved ingredients.
14e49f2712fb48d1.zh: 江波巻き是廣島市中區江波地區的傳統海苔捲，當地長久以來盛行海苔養殖。這種海苔捲自古以來就有人食用。做法是將米飯、廣島風味的醃漬蔬菜、柴魚片、醬油和芝麻拌在一起，再用烤海苔捲起包覆。使用的不是醋飯，而是一般米飯，內餡則包括醃漬蔬菜等容易保存的食材。

14f01113ab474e69.en: Chichibunomiya Rugby Stadium (秩父宮ラグビー場, Chichibunomiya Ragubī-jō) (also called Prince Chichibu Memorial Stadium) is a rugby union stadium located in the Aoyama district of central Tokyo, Japan. It is the spiritual home of Japanese rugby union and the headquarters of the Japan Rugby Football Union. Named for Prince Chichibu, the late brother of Emperor Hirohito, the venue is used mostly for rugby sevens and rugby union matches.
14f01113ab474e69.zh: 秩父宮ラグビー場（秩父宮ラグビー場，又稱秩父宮紀念競技場）是位於日本東京都心青山地區的英式橄欖球場，被視為日本英式橄欖球的精神殿堂，也是日本橄欖球協會的總部所在地。球場以裕仁天皇已故的弟弟秩父宮親王命名，主要用於七人制橄欖球及聯合式橄欖球比賽。

14f05f301c8f8f0a.en: Mikami Shrine (御上神社, Mikami Jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in the city of Yasu, Shiga Prefecture, Japan.  The kami worshipped at this shrine is Ame-no-mikage-no-mikoto, Amaterasu's grandson, who in legend, descended onto 432-meter Mount Mikami during the reign of Emperor Kōrei (290 - 215 BC) to become the shintai of the mountain.
14f05f301c8f8f0a.zh: 御上神社是位於日本滋賀縣野洲市的神社。祭祀的神祇為天照大神之孫天之御影命，傳說祂於孝靈天皇在位期間（西元前290年至前215年）降臨海拔432公尺的三上山，成為該山的神體。

14f355ce75906e23.en: Ainoshima (Japanese: 相島) (Aino-Island) is an island in Shingū, Fukuoka, Japan. Many feral cats and strays live on this island. Hence, it is known as "Cat Heaven Island".
14f355ce75906e23.zh: 相島是位於日本福岡縣新宮町的島嶼。島上住著許多野貓與流浪貓，因此被稱為「貓的天堂島」。

14f9a33cf08a4945.en: The "Shima Somen" enjoyed in Mugi Town, Tokushima Prefecture, is distinct from typical somen, because it uses broth made by simmering fish instead of mentsuyu. "Renko-tai" (yellowback sea bream) caught at Teba Island is boiled in a sweet and savory seasoning, and the resulting broth is used. It is one of the most creative dishes that ensures the leftover broth is equally delicious to savor.
14f9a33cf08a4945.zh: 在德島縣牟岐町食用的「島そうめん」與一般素麵不同，使用燉魚的湯汁而非麵露。將在出羽島捕獲的「れんこ鯛」（黃鯛）以甜鹹調味料燉煮，再使用燉煮後的湯汁。這是讓剩下的湯汁也同樣美味可口、極具巧思的料理之一。

14fc73e357ca6cd0.en: "Jabara Daikon" is a dried daikon radish traditionally made in the Minami-Aso region using the cold winter winds. It is also known as "Fusakiri Daikon" or "Kirikake Daikon." While it can be made using "Aokubi Daikon" (a variety of daikon radish), it is more commonly made with daikon radishes specifically chosen for drying, often referred to as "Ideal Daikon."The method for making "Jabara Daikon" involves a unique cutting technique. Lay the daikon radish horizontally and use a knife to make slices about 2-3mm thick.
14fc73e357ca6cd0.zh: 「蛇腹大根」是南阿蘇地區傳統上利用冬季寒風製作的蘿蔔乾，又稱「房切り大根」或「切りかけ大根」。雖然也可以用「青首大根」（白蘿蔔的一種品種）製作，但更常使用專為晒乾而挑選的白蘿蔔，通常稱為「理想大根」。製作「蛇腹大根」需要獨特的切法：將白蘿蔔橫放，用刀切出約2-3mm厚的薄片。

15027ae738d1a713.en: It is a hybrid of leek and shallot, and has a unique aroma different from that of green onions. It is a member of the leek family, but has a unique aroma that is different from that of green onions. It is called "wakaegi," meaning "a leek whose root is divided into many plants. The Seto Inland Sea coast has a mild climate suitable for growing wekegi, and Onomichi in particular boasts the nation's largest production (Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries "Survey of Regional Specialty Vegetable Production in Fiscal Year 2008").
15027ae738d1a713.zh: 分蔥是韭蔥與紅蔥的雜交種，具有與青蔥不同的獨特香氣。它屬於蔥類，但香氣與青蔥不同。它被稱為「分蔥」，意思是「根部分生成許多株的蔥」。瀨戶內海沿岸氣候溫和，適合種植分蔥，其中尾道的產量為全國第一（農林水產省「平成20年度地域特產野菜生產狀況調查」）。

1508dcc19a09e642.en: Kashiko Island (賢島, Kashiko-jima) is an island in Ago Bay. It is in the city of Shima, Mie Prefecture, Japan.
1508dcc19a09e642.zh: 賢島是位於英虞灣內的島嶼，屬日本三重縣志摩市。

153250111dd6e88a.en: "Sado no Nishime" is a local dish eaten on Sado City in Niigata Prefecture, where broth is made from grilled flying fish and ingredients such as vegetables, kombu(=kelp), and grilled tofu are slowly simmered over a long period of time. Oden-style nishime is well seasoned and delicious. In some areas, pollack, squid, and fu are added. It is called "nishime" because it is boiled until there is no liquid left, and has been enjoyed by the islanders as a long-standing family favorite.
153250111dd6e88a.zh: 佐渡の煮しめ是新潟縣佐渡市的鄉土料理，以烤飛魚熬製高湯，將蔬菜、昆布、烤豆腐等食材長時間慢慢燉煮。關東煮風格的煮物入味且美味。部分地區會加入鱈魚、魷魚和麩。因為要煮到湯汁收乾，所以稱為「煮しめ」，長久以來是島民喜愛的家常菜。

153cd9fba44569b6.en: Mount Shigi (信貴山, Shigisan) is a mountain located in Ikoma District, Nara, Japan.
153cd9fba44569b6.zh: 信貴山是位於日本奈良縣生駒郡的山。

154b6ca13745a90a.en: The Kushimoto Turkish Memorial and Museum (Japanese: トルコ軍艦遭難記念碑), aka Frigate Ertuğrul Memorial and Museum (Turkish: Ertuğrul Anıtı ve Müzesi,), is a monument and a museum to commemorate the sailors of the Ottoman frigate Ertuğrul, which sunk in 1890 off Kushimoto, Wakayama in Japan.
154b6ca13745a90a.zh: トルコ記念館（日文：トルコ軍艦遭難記念碑），又稱艾爾圖魯號紀念館（土耳其文：Ertuğrul Anıtı ve Müzesi），是為紀念1890年在日本和歌山縣串本外海沉沒的鄂圖曼帝國巡防艦艾爾圖魯號水兵而設的紀念碑與博物館。

15521b2bbbf78d7b.en: Yamaguchi Prefecture, which faces the Seto Inland Sea and the Sea of Japan, has long enjoyed the benefits of the sea, and processed foods using seafood have developed accordingly. In the Hagi area, kamaboko (fish cake) has a particularly long history, as records show that it was served at a tea ceremony in 1640 with Mori Hidenari, the first lord of the Choshu domain, as the main guest.Kamaboko is a grilled fish paste made without steaming, and the main ingredient is fresh eso fish landed in the rough seas of the Sea of Japan.
15521b2bbbf78d7b.zh: 山口縣面向瀨戶內海與日本海，自古受惠於海洋，使用海產的加工食品也隨之發展。萩地區的蒲鉾（魚板）歷史尤其悠久，據紀錄，1640年以長州藩初代藩主毛利秀就為主客的茶會上就曾端出蒲鉾。這裡的蒲鉾是不經蒸製、直接燒烤的魚漿製品，主要原料是在日本海波濤洶湧的海域捕獲上岸的新鮮えそ魚。

155ef0976f4e56e6.en: ‘Miso-nikomi Udon’ is one of the typical noodle dishes in Aichi Prefecture along with ‘Kishimen’ (=flat wheat noodle). It is prepared by simmering Hatcho-miso soup and chewy ‘udon’ (=thick wheat noodle). ‘Miso-nikomi Udon’ was a dish at home, but it was served at the restaurant in Ichinomiya City in Meiji Era. After that, it became popular around Nagoya City.
155ef0976f4e56e6.zh: 味噌煮込みうどん與きしめん（扁平小麥麵）同為愛知縣具代表性的麵食之一。做法是以八丁味噌湯頭燉煮有嚼勁的烏龍麵（粗小麥麵）。味噌煮込みうどん原本是家常料理，明治時代開始在一宮市的餐廳供應，之後在名古屋市一帶普及。

157764dbe3d1496c.en: Gunma Museum of Natural History (群馬県立自然史博物館, Gunma Kenritsu Shizenshi Hakubutsukan; formerly 群馬県立自然科学資料館) is a museum of the natural sciences in Tomioka, Gunma Prefecture, Japan.
157764dbe3d1496c.zh: 群馬縣立自然史博物館（舊稱群馬県立自然科学資料館）是位於日本群馬縣富岡市的自然科學博物館。

158df4e30aeba269.en: The Wakamiya Hachiman Shrine (若宮八幡社 Wakamiya Hachimansha) in Suehiro-chō, Sakae 3-chōme in the Naka ward of Nagoya is a historic Shinto shrine.
158df4e30aeba269.zh: 若宮八幡社位於名古屋市中區榮三丁目末廣町，是一座歷史悠久的神社。

158ffea230456a60.en: Shōyō-en (逍遥園) is a Japanese garden located next to the Sanbutsudō Hall of Rinnō-ji Temple in Nikkō.
