It  was constructed in early Edo period, but reformed in the beginning of 19th century. The garden was given its name by a Confucian scholar Issai Sato. There is a pond containing carp in the middle; stone lanterns, bridges, bamboo fences, a pagoda, and a small tea house adorn the garden.
158ffea230456a60.zh: 逍遙園是位於日光輪王寺三佛堂旁的日本庭園。庭園建於江戶時代初期，19世紀初改建，園名由儒學者佐藤一齋命名。園中央有養著鯉魚的池塘，並有石燈籠、橋、竹籬、塔與小茶室點綴。

159a166374851433.en: An ohitashi dish made using norabouna, a traditional vegetable said to have been cultivated in the Suge area of Tama, Kawasaki City, for about 800 years. Norabouna was historically grown to extract oil, and farmers practiced self-seeding for personal use. Known for its strong vitality, it is said to have saved many lives during the great famine of the Edo period.
159a166374851433.zh: 使用のらぼう菜製作的浸菜料理。のらぼう菜是一種傳統蔬菜，據說在川崎市多摩區菅地區已栽培約800年。のらぼう菜過去是為了榨油而種植，農家會自行採種供自家使用。它以生命力強韌著稱，據說在江戶時代的大饑荒中救了許多人的性命。

15a63cef3fcfa48b.en: The Hagi Falls (萩の滝, Hagi no Taki) is a waterfall located in Mount Dodo's small valley in the city of Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. In 1986, it was named one of Gifu Prefecture's "50 Famous Waters."
15a63cef3fcfa48b.zh: 萩の滝是位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市百々ヶ峰小溪谷中的瀑布。1986年獲選為岐阜縣「名水50選」之一。

15b43bb877fa4953.en: Musashi Kyūryō National Government Park (国営武蔵丘陵森林公園, Kokuei Musashi Kyūryō Shinrin Kōen) is a national government park located on the Hiki Hills (比企丘陵, Hiki Kyūryō) of the town of Namegawa, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. It is also known as a National forest park. In 1974, it opened as the first National Government Park. The park covers a vast area of forest and offers opportunities for various outdoor activities. The park has four entrances: the Central, North, West, and South Entrances.
15b43bb877fa4953.zh: 國營武藏丘陵森林公園是位於日本埼玉縣滑川町比企丘陵的國營公園，也被稱為國家森林公園。1974年作為第一座國營公園開園。公園涵蓋廣大的森林區域，可進行各種戶外活動。園內設有四個入口：中央口、北口、西口及南口。

15b494c1d002bb54.en: Yōrō Keikoku Okukiyosumi Prefectural Natural Park (県立養老渓谷奥清澄自然公園, Kenritsu Yōrō Keikoku Okukiyosumi shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in southern Chiba Prefecture, Japan. First designated for protection in 1935, the park's central features are the Yōrō Valley (養老渓谷) and Kiyosumi Mountains (清澄山地). The park spans the municipalities of Ichihara, Kamogawa, Kimitsu, and Ōtaki.
15b494c1d002bb54.zh: 縣立養老溪谷奧清澄自然公園（県立養老渓谷奥清澄自然公園）是位於日本千葉縣南部的縣立自然公園。1935年首度指定為保護區，園區主要景觀為養老溪谷與清澄山地。園區範圍橫跨市原市、鴨川市、君津市及大多喜町。

15df05ad59d95650.en: Goshiki-numa (五色沼), is a cluster of five volcanic lakes situated at the foot of Mount Bandai in the center of the lake district of the Bandai Highland (磐梯高原, Bandai-kōgen), Kitashiobara, Fukushima, Japan.
15df05ad59d95650.zh: 五色沼是位於日本福島縣北塩原村、磐梯高原湖沼區中央、磐梯山山麓的五座火山湖群。

15e1882d54888ac6.en: In Gunma, where there are many rivers with clear water, various river fish is grown, and local cuisines with these fish are familiar with the area. The type of fish often eaten varies depending on the region, but ‘Ayu’ Sweet fish is designated as a prefectural fish of Gunma Prefecture, and one of the main products in the prefecture. The locals often grill ‘Ayu’ with salt to enjoy its own flavor. Ueno Village, the least populated in Gunma, boasts ‘Ayu’ fishing the most.
15e1882d54888ac6.zh: 群馬有許多水質清澈的河川，孕育出各種河魚，以這些魚製作的鄉土料理在當地相當常見。常吃的魚種依地區而不同，而香魚被指定為群馬縣的縣魚，也是縣內主要的產物之一。當地人常以鹽烤香魚，品嘗其原本的風味。群馬人口最少的上野村，以香魚垂釣最為興盛。

15f1f03beed60597.en: Tainaigawa Dam (胎内川ダム) is a dam in Tainai, Niigata, Japan, completed in 1976.  It is a gravity-type concrete dam aiming for flood control and unspecified water intake.  It is 93 meters in height.
15f1f03beed60597.zh: 胎內川水壩（胎内川ダム）是位於日本新潟縣胎內市的水壩，1976年完工。為重力式混凝土壩，用途為防洪及不特定用水取水。壩高93公尺。

15f28e2dd7f0853f.en: Kanamura Wake Ikazuchi Shrine (金村別雷神社, kanamura wake ikazuchi jinja) is a Shinto shrine in Tsukuba, Ibaraki, Japan.  It is also called "Raijin-sama" and "Kanamura-sama" by locals. It is the second largest shrine in Tsukuba, after Mt. Tsukuba Shrine, and it is one of the three major Raijin shrines in the Kanto area. It is a Kamo shrine.
15f28e2dd7f0853f.zh: 金村別雷神社是位於日本茨城縣筑波市的神社，當地人也稱之為「雷神樣」或「金村樣」。本社是筑波市僅次於筑波山神社的第二大神社，也是關東地區三大雷神神社之一，屬於賀茂神社系統。

1613499cb356838c.en: In Kagoshima Prefecture, there is a record that since the Edo period, Satsuma Samurais actively held cockfights to raise the morale of the warriors, and the roosters that lost in such fights were shaved and eaten on the spot. Even after cockfighting was banned, each household kept poultries, which were clucked, cooked, and eaten when guests arrived or for celebrations. Thus, in Kagoshima prefecture, dishes using chicken have long been familiar.
1613499cb356838c.zh: 在鹿兒島縣，有紀錄顯示自江戶時代起，薩摩武士為提振武士士氣而盛行鬥雞，鬥敗的公雞會當場拔毛食用。鬥雞被禁止後，家家戶戶仍飼養家禽，在客人來訪或喜慶時宰殺、烹調食用。因此在鹿兒島縣，使用雞肉的料理自古以來便為人所熟悉。

16294b7fc722c804.en: Yamanashi Prefectural Museum (山梨県立博物館, Yamanashi kenritsu hakubutsukan) opened in Fuefuki, Yamanashi Prefecture, Japan in 2005. The collection relates to the natural history, history, and culture of Yamanashi Prefecture; special exhibitions are also held.
16294b7fc722c804.zh: 山梨県立博物館於2005年在日本山梨縣笛吹市開館。館藏與山梨縣的自然史、歷史及文化相關，另亦舉辦特展。

163b51748ea54cf2.en: Misasa-Tōgōko Prefectural Natural Park (三朝東郷湖県立自然公園, Misasa-Tōgōko kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Tottori Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1994, the park spans the municipalities of Kurayoshi, Misasa, and Yurihama.
163b51748ea54cf2.zh: 三朝東郷湖県立自然公園是日本鳥取縣的縣立自然公園，設立於1994年，範圍橫跨倉吉市、三朝町與湯梨濱町。

163e60a67833b9b1.en: Cold dry wind called ‘Karakkaze’ brows from mountains in winter in Gunma. Also, the climate is dry because it has less rain in winter. Therefore, the culture of drying konjac (yam cake) , potatoes, persimmons, and daikon radishes are prevailing, and dry food like dried persimmon, dried daikon radish splits or ‘imogara’ (dried potato stems) are produced a lot to make the most of dry climate. ‘Yuzu-maki’ is a one of local dishes delivered from such culture.
163e60a67833b9b1.zh: 群馬冬季會有稱為「空っ風」的乾冷強風從山上吹下。而且冬季雨量少，氣候乾燥。因此曬乾蒟蒻、芋頭、柿子、白蘿蔔的文化盛行，為善用乾燥氣候，大量生產柿餅、蘿蔔乾條、「芋がら」（芋莖乾）等乾貨。「ゆず巻き」就是由這樣的文化產生的鄉土料理之一。

164e6c44cca7c604.en: Senshu mizu-nasu is a brand-name vegetable representative of the Senshu area, which stretches across southern Osaka. These eggplants are pickled in bran or pickling seasoning for a short period of time.Compared to other eggplants, Senshu mizu-nasu has a plump, rounded shape, and its skin is thin and soft. As its name suggests, the eggplant has so much moisture that water drips down when squeezed tightly, and it is characterized by its freshness with a hint of sweetness.
164e6c44cca7c604.zh: 泉州水茄子是代表泉州地區的品牌蔬菜，泉州地區橫跨大阪南部。這道料理是將這種茄子用米糠或醃漬調味料短時間醃漬而成。與其他茄子相比，泉州水茄子外形飽滿圓潤，皮薄而柔軟。正如其名，這種茄子水分多到用力擠壓時會滴下水來，特色是新鮮並帶有淡淡甜味。

1697d23a0ed4b27e.en: Iwatayama Monkey Park (Japanese: 嵐山モンキーパーク, Arashiyama Monkī Pāku) is a commercial park located in Arashiyama in Kyoto, Japan. The park is located atop Mount Arashiyama, on the opposite side of the Ōi River of the train station. It is inhabited by a troop of over 120 Japanese macaque monkeys. The animals are wild but can be fed by the staff and visitors with food exclusively purchased at the site. The main reason why these wild macaques choose to stay in the park is so that they can feed on the food given by the staff.
1697d23a0ed4b27e.zh: 嵐山モンキーパークいわたやま是位於日本京都嵐山的商業園區。園區位於嵐山山頂，與車站隔著大堰川相對。園內棲息著一群超過120隻的日本獼猴。這些猴子是野生的，但工作人員與遊客可以用園區內販售的專用飼料餵食。這些野生獼猴選擇留在園區的主要原因，是為了取食工作人員提供的食物。

16986bc8521a665f.en: Joetsu Aquarium (上越市立水族博物館) is a Japanese public aquarium owned by Joetsu City, and located in Niigata Prefecture. Its origins date back to 1934, but it reopened in June 2018 under the nickname "Umigatari" (うみがたり). The aquarium is dedicated to the Sea of Japan, with the concept of discussing the sea.
16986bc8521a665f.zh: 上越市立水族博物館是上越市所屬的日本公立水族館，位於新潟縣。其起源可追溯至1934年，2018年6月以「うみがたり」為暱稱重新開館。水族館以日本海為主題，概念為談論海洋。

16b2b67021f55c51.en: "Yamato-mana to usuage no nimono" (simmered yamato-mana and fried thin tofu) is a home-style dish using yamato-mana, a traditional vegetable of Yamato (Nara Prefecture). Yamato-mana is a cruciferous vegetable, a type of "tsukena" that has been eaten since ancient times. It has its roots in "suzuna" leaves, which are mentioned in the Kojiki (records of ancient matters). It has a mild flavor and crunchiness, and is used in a variety of dishes. In particular, this home-style simmered dish with deep fried tofu has been loved among local people.
16b2b67021f55c51.zh: 「大和まなと薄揚げの煮もの」（燉煮大和真菜與薄炸豆皮）是使用大和（奈良縣）傳統蔬菜大和真菜製作的家常菜。大和真菜是十字花科蔬菜，屬於自古以來就被食用的「漬菜」之一，其起源可追溯到《古事記》中記載的「菘」葉。大和真菜風味溫和、口感爽脆，可用於各種料理，其中與油炸豆腐一起燉煮的這道家常菜特別受到當地人喜愛。

16b2bbff2b6e0b04.en: More than 500 species of fish and shellfish inhabit Toyama Bay, and seafood is caught throughout the year. Surimi-age, which makes use of fresh minced fish, is a flavor unique to Toyama, which is home to such a rich fishing ground. It is a familiar side dish often made at home and served at many izakaya because it goes well with sake. It's crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside, making it a favorite among both children and adults.
16b2bbff2b6e0b04.zh: 富山灣棲息著500種以上的魚貝類，全年都有漁獲。使用新鮮魚漿的すり身揚げ，是擁有如此豐富漁場的富山才有的風味。它是常在家中製作的家常菜，也因為適合配酒而在許多居酒屋供應。外酥內軟，深受大人小孩喜愛。

16e29466f2ac0c4c.en: Hikaru Museum (光記念館, Hikaru Kinenkan) is a museum in Takayama, Gifu Prefecture, Japan, comprising exhibition rooms for fine arts, archaeological research, and history, including exhibitions of artifacts excavated from civilizations across the world and displays of the history of the old Hida Province of Japan.
16e29466f2ac0c4c.zh: 光ミュージアム（光記念館）是位於日本岐阜縣高山市的博物館，設有美術、考古研究及歷史等展示室，展出世界各地文明出土的文物，以及舊飛驒國的歷史。

16ed6d4af0c08067.en: The Yokkaichi Port Building (四日市港ポートビル, Yokkaichi-kō Pōto Biru) is a skyscraper located in Yokkaichi, Mie Prefecture, Japan. Construction of the 100-metre, 14-storey skyscraper was finished in 1999.
16ed6d4af0c08067.zh: 四日市港ポートビル是位於日本三重縣四日市市的摩天大樓，高100公尺、地上14層，於1999年竣工。

16f35443a4cc698b.en: Oga Aquarium Gao (男鹿水族館ガオ, Oga Suizokukan Gao), officially Akita Prefectural Oga Aquarium,  is a public aquarium located along Oga Peninsula coast, Oga, Akita Prefecture, Japan. GAO stands for Globe, Aqua and Ocean, with the imagery of the logo inspired by Namahage.
16f35443a4cc698b.zh: 男鹿水族館ガオ，正式名稱為秋田縣立男鹿水族館，是位於日本秋田縣男鹿市男鹿半島沿岸的公立水族館。GAO代表Globe、Aqua與Ocean，標誌圖像的靈感來自生剝鬼（なまはげ）。

16f5589a22239ab2.en: Hitachi Kokubun-ji (常陸国分寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Fuchū neighborhood of the city of Ishioka, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Shingon-shū Chizan-ha sect, and its honzon is an image of Yakushi Nyōrai. It is the modern successor of the provincial temple ("kokubunji") of former Hitachi Province. The ruins of the Nara period temple and the nearby nunnery have been collectively protected as a National Historic Site since 1922. In 1952, the designation was upgraded to that of a Special National Historic Site.
16f5589a22239ab2.zh: 常陸國分寺是位於日本茨城縣石岡市府中的佛教寺院，屬真言宗智山派，本尊為藥師如來像。該寺為舊常陸國國分寺的現代傳承。奈良時代的寺院遺跡與附近的尼寺遺跡自1922年起合併列為國家史跡，1952年升格為特別史跡。

170abf245b494d13.en: Isawa Castle (胆沢城, Isawa-jō) was an early Heian period jōsaku-style Japanese castle located in what is now part of the city of Ōshū, Iwate in the Tōhoku region of far northern Honshu, Japan. The site was proclaimed a National National Historic Site in 1922.
170abf245b494d13.zh: 胆沢城是平安時代初期的城柵式日本城郭，位於今日本本州最北部東北地方岩手縣奧州市境內。遺址於1922年被指定為國家史跡。

172142d6ea32002d.en: Little is known of Sano Castle (佐野城, Sano-jō). It is mostly connected to its nearby castle, Karasawa Castle, both of which were next to Sano, the corresponding castle town
172142d6ea32002d.zh: 關於佐野城的資料不多。此城多與鄰近的唐澤城相關聯，兩城皆鄰接其對應的城下町佐野。

1726d4c82fecf593.en: Kurumi Mochi is a traditional confectionery that is unique to Sakai. Despite its name, it does not contain any walnuts. The name "Kurumi Mochi" comes from the fact that the rice cake is wrapped in a brownish-red bean paste. It can also be written in Chinese characters as "久留美," which means to keep the taste for a long time.
1726d4c82fecf593.zh: くるみ餅是堺特有的傳統點心。雖然名稱如此，其實不含任何核桃。「くるみ餅」的名稱來自於將麻糬包裹（くるむ）在紅褐色的豆餡中。也可以用漢字寫成「久留美」，意思是讓美味長久保留。

172d717c98f60a24.en: Saitama Prefecture, where wheat cultivation has flourished since ancient times, has a strong udon culture. Tsumikko, loved in Honjo City and the Chichibu area, is a local dish that was especially useful during busy times because it can be made more quickly than udon. It is a so-called "suiton," and depending on the region, it may be called "tochanage," "dango," or "tsumekko.
172d717c98f60a24.zh: 埼玉縣自古小麥栽培興盛，烏龍麵文化深厚。つみっこ是本庄市與秩父地區喜愛的鄉土料理，因為比烏龍麵做得快，在農忙時期特別實用。它就是所謂的「すいとん」，依地區不同，也稱為「とっちゃなげ」、「だんご」或「つめっこ」。

1768315527d47f3b.en: Mount Nakayama (中山, Nakayama) is a mountain in Takarazuka, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan.
1768315527d47f3b.zh: 中山是位於日本兵庫縣寶塚市的山。

17a6c73c08ac0c14.en: In the northern regions, February 15th is a day known as Nehan-e, commemorating the death of Buddha, and there is a custom to make "yashouma" and offer it on the Buddhist altar. Yashouma is a steamed rice-flour dumpling colored and molded, and it used to be made in almost every household.
17a6c73c08ac0c14.zh: 在北部地區，2月15日是紀念佛陀入滅的涅槃會，有製作「やしょうま」供奉在佛壇上的習俗。やしょうま是將米粉糰著色、塑形後蒸製而成，過去幾乎家家戶戶都會製作。

17ba2fea4b27c5d9.en: Hananoiwaya Shrine (Japanese: 花窟神社) is a Shinto shrine in the Arima neighborhood of the city of Kumano, Mie, Japan. It is a site of worship for the kami Izanami and Kagu-tsuchi. The shrine is the site of a cave, the Flower Cavern (花の窟), that is said to be the grave of Izanami. The cave is believed to mark the entrance to the underworld where Izanagi attempted to find Izanami after she died giving birth to Kagu-tsuchi.
17ba2fea4b27c5d9.zh: 花窟神社是位於日本三重縣熊野市有馬町的神社，祭祀伊弉冉尊與軻遇突智。神社所在地有一處洞窟「花の窟」，相傳為伊弉冉尊之墓。據信此洞窟是黃泉入口，伊弉冉尊生下軻遇突智而死後，伊弉諾尊曾試圖在此尋找她。

180d371dabd6f745.en: "Kasube no nitsuke" is a local winter dish, that is often cooked at home. "Kasube" is the Hokkaido dialect word for ray, and this dish uses the entire fish, including the bones since they are soft and edible. "Kasube" has a high collagen content, making it a popular choice for those who are interested in consuming beauty foods.There are various theories as to the origin of its name.
180d371dabd6f745.zh: 「カスベの煮付け」是冬季常在家中烹調的鄉土料理。「カスベ」是北海道方言中的鰩魚，這道料理使用整條魚，由於魚骨柔軟可食，連骨一起烹調。「カスベ」膠原蛋白含量高，因此受到注重美容飲食者的青睞。關於其名稱的由來有多種說法。

182983b6e996f2b4.en: In Fukushima Prefecture, there is a red lacquerware called Aizu-nuri. Kozuyu is a local dish made with a variety of ingredients such as kikurage (kikurage), warabi (bracken), and taro (taro) cooked in a soup stock made from scallops in a shallow "teshio dish".
182983b6e996f2b4.zh: 福島縣有一種稱為會津塗的紅色漆器。こづゆ是將木耳、蕨菜、芋頭等多種食材，以干貝熬製的高湯烹煮，盛裝在淺口「手塩皿」中的鄉土料理。

182a103a01b387a6.en: Chiba-dera (千葉寺, Chiba-dera), also known as Senyō-ji (千葉寺), is a Buddhist temple in the city of Chiba, Chiba Prefecture, Japan. The temple is located in the central Chūō District in the city of Chiba. Chiba-dera is one of many Buddhist temples in the region that, according to tradition, was established by the priest Gyōki (668–749). Chiba-dera is a temple of the Shingon-shu Buzan-ha, and its honzon is a Jūichimen Kannon Bosatsu. The temple is the 29th stop on the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route.
182a103a01b387a6.zh: 千葉寺（千葉寺，Chiba-dera），又稱千葉寺（Senyō-ji），是位於日本千葉縣千葉市的佛教寺院，位在千葉市中心的中央區。相傳千葉寺與該地區許多佛寺一樣，由行基（668–749）創建。千葉寺屬真言宗豐山派，本尊為十一面觀音菩薩，是坂東三十三所巡禮路線的第29番札所。

1832b79bd6af9c8e.en: The origin of the name "Kirisensho" is said to come from the fact that in the old days, the powder was kneaded with the juice soaked in chopped sansho (Japanese pepper), which was called "Kirisansho", which in turn became "Kirisensho".It has long been eaten mainly in the rice paddy fields of the central part of the prefecture, and has been cherished as an event food.
1832b79bd6af9c8e.zh: 「きりせんしょ」名稱的由來，據說是因為過去以浸泡切碎山椒的汁液揉製粉類，稱為「切山椒」，後來轉變為「きりせんしょ」。長久以來主要在縣中央部的稻作地區食用，作為節慶食物受到珍視。

183c06b38ca07b1c.en: Hunter Mountain Shiobara (ハンターマウンテン塩原, Hantā Maunten Shiobara) is a ski area in Nasushiobara, Tochigi Prefecture, Japan, which was developed by the owners of Hunter Mountain in New York.
183c06b38ca07b1c.zh: ハンターマウンテン塩原是位於日本栃木縣那須鹽原市的滑雪場，由美國紐約州Hunter Mountain的經營者開發。

187a7ae0196af073.en: Yōki-sō (揚輝荘) is a Japanese villa and gardens located in Chikusa-ku, Nagoya, central Japan. It is close to Nittai-ji temple.
187a7ae0196af073.zh: 揚輝荘是位於日本中部名古屋市千種區的日式別墅與庭園，鄰近日泰寺。

1885f9e00457036a.en: The Buzen Kokubun-ji (豊前国分寺) was a Buddhist temple located in the Kokubu neighborhood of the town of Miyako, Fukuoka, Japan. It  was one of the provincial temples per the system established by Emperor Shōmu during the Nara period (710 – 794) for the purpose of promoting Buddhism as the national religion of Japan and standardising imperial rule over the provinces. The temple no longer exists, but its ruins were designated as a National Historic Site in 1976.
1885f9e00457036a.zh: 豐前國分寺是一座佛教寺院，位於日本福岡縣みやこ町國分地區。為奈良時代（710－794年）聖武天皇所建立之國分寺制度下的寺院之一，目的在於推廣佛教作為日本國教，並統一朝廷對各令制國的統治。寺院已不存在，但其遺跡於1976年被指定為國家史跡。

189240e082c4ba2b.en: Kagoshima Prefecture is blessed with a wide range of fishing grounds, including Kagoshima Bay, the East China Sea, and the Pacific Ocean, and is rich in seafood. Among these, Kibinago is an indispensable fish in Kagoshima's local cuisine. Kibinago is a member of the herring family and measures about 10 cm in length.
189240e082c4ba2b.zh: 鹿兒島縣擁有鹿兒島灣、東海、太平洋等廣闊的漁場，海產豐富。其中，丁香魚（きびなご）是鹿兒島鄉土料理中不可或缺的魚。丁香魚屬於鯡科，體長約10公分。

189a9cf4eabd92cd.en: Tairyūji or Tairyū-ji (Tairyū Temple, Great Dragon Temple) (Japanese: 太龍寺) is a Koyasan Shingon temple in Anan city, Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. Temple # 21 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage. The main image is of Ākāśagarbha Bodhisattva.
189a9cf4eabd92cd.zh: 太龍寺是位於日本德島縣阿南市的高野山真言宗寺院，為四國八十八所巡禮第21號札所，本尊為虛空藏菩薩。

18bbd22ab56e7898.en: Utoro (Japanese: ウトロ地区, Hepburn: Utoro Chiku; Korean: 우토로) is a district in Uji, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. The district has historically been populated by Zainichi Koreans (Koreans who arrived during the Japanese colonial period and their descendants) ever since they were compelled to work in difficult conditions in the area in 1943.
18bbd22ab56e7898.zh: ウトロ地區（韓語：우토로）是日本京都府宇治市的一個地區。自1943年在日朝鮮人（日本殖民時期來到日本的朝鮮人及其後代）被迫在此地於艱苦條件下勞動以來，這個地區一直以在日朝鮮人居民為主。

18c7d276acd2da4e.en: "Konetsuke" is said to have been eaten by Yukimura Sanada, a feudal warlord, to fill his stomach before going into battle. Konetsuke is a local dish of the Hokushin and To-shin regions, made by mixing rice and flour and dipping it in miso sauce or soy sauce sauce. It is said that because rice was precious in those days, it was mixed with flour and baked to make people feel full when there was a poor rice harvest.
18c7d276acd2da4e.zh: 據說「こねつけ」是戰國武將真田幸村出征前用來填飽肚子的食物。こねつけ是北信與東信地區的鄉土料理，作法是將米與麵粉混合，沾上味噌醬或醬油醬汁。據說由於當時米很珍貴，在稻米歉收時便混入麵粉烤製，讓人有飽足感。

18e58a4ad26647b8.en: Itadori is a perennial herb of the Polygonaceae family that grows wild throughout Japan and is an indispensable spring wild plant. It is also called "gonpachi" and "sukampo". The Shimokitayama Village History (compiled in 1973) states that people in Shimokitayama Village, Yoshino County (Kinari no Sato) have long favored eating "gonpachi". The origin of the name "itadori" comes from the fact that when one is injured, rubbing it into the affected area can relieve pain.
18e58a4ad26647b8.zh: 虎杖（いたどり）是蓼科多年生草本植物，野生分布於日本各地，是春季不可或缺的山菜。也稱為「ごんぱち」及「すかんぽ」。《下北山村史》（1973年編纂）記載，吉野郡下北山村（きなりの郷）的居民自古以來就喜愛吃「ごんぱち」。「いたどり」這個名稱的由來，據說是因為受傷時將其搓揉塗在患處可以止痛。

18ee5688bb612022.en: In the mountainous regions of Niigata Prefecture, young shoots of Chishimazasa bamboo called "Hime-takenoko" are harvested from late May to early July. In the Joetsu region of Niigata Prefecture and the Hokushin region of Nagano Prefecture, when hime-takenoko are available, they are made into bamboo shoot soup and eaten. In addition to the bamboo shoots and canned mackerel, the Joetsu region often adds potatoes, carrots, onions, daikon radish, fried thin tofu, and other ingredients to the soup, which is then simmered with an egg.
18ee5688bb612022.zh: 新潟縣山區在5月下旬至7月上旬採收稱為「姬竹筍」的千島笹嫩芽。新潟縣上越地區和長野縣北信地區在姬竹筍產季時，會將其煮成竹筍湯食用。上越地區除了竹筍和鯖魚罐頭外，常加入馬鈴薯、紅蘿蔔、洋蔥、白蘿蔔、油豆腐皮等食材，燉煮後再加入蛋。

18f9b274de1c0d96.en: Seiken-ji (清見寺),  is a Buddhist temple belonging to the Myōshin-ji branch of the Rinzai school of Japanese Zen, located in the Okitsu neighborhood of Shimizu-ku ward of the city of Shizuoka, Shizuoka, Japan. Its main image is a statue of Shaka Nyōrai. It is also called Kiyomi-dera.
18f9b274de1c0d96.zh: 清見寺是位於日本靜岡縣靜岡市清水區興津地區的佛教寺院，屬日本禪宗臨濟宗妙心寺派。本尊為釋迦如來像。又稱「きよみでら」。

19005ea74f668d50.en: Pickles are indispensable for daily three meals. In Saga Prefecture, seasonal ingredients are utilized and pickles are made without interruption throughout the year: Takana pickles in spring, pickled plums and rakkyo pickles in early summer, typical pickled cucumbers in summer, and pickled Daikon radish in winter. Among them, the preserved food called "Okomoji" or "Okumoji" which is made by salting Takana and Shakushina is loved even today.
19005ea74f668d50.zh: 醃漬物是每日三餐不可或缺的食物。在佐賀縣，人們運用當季食材，一年到頭不間斷地製作醃漬物：春天是高菜漬，初夏是梅干和蕗蕎漬，夏天是常見的醃小黃瓜，冬天是醃白蘿蔔。其中，用鹽醃漬高菜和杓子菜製成、稱為「おこもじ」或「おくもじ」的保存食品，至今仍受到喜愛。

19078015c5075f6b.en: Aichi Museum of Flight (あいち航空ミュージアム, aichi-koukuu-myūjiamu) is an aviation museum located in Toyoyama, Aichi Prefecture. It was set up next to the Airport Walk Nagoya which was renovated from the former international terminal in the southwestern part of Nagoya Airfield.
19078015c5075f6b.zh: あいち航空ミュージアム是位於愛知縣豐山町的航空博物館，設於名古屋機場西南部由舊國際航廈改建而成的Airport Walk名古屋旁。

190e569040df6f3c.en: Yokosuka Castle (横須賀城, Yokosuka-jō) is a Japanese castle located in Ōsuka in the southern part of what is now the city of Kakegawa, Shizuoka,  Japan. It was built in the Sengoku period and was the capital of Yokosuka Domain under the Tokugawa shogunate of Edo period Japan. In 1981, the castle ruins were designated as a National Historic Site.
190e569040df6f3c.zh: 橫須賀城是位於今日本靜岡縣掛川市南部大須賀的日本城郭。此城建於戰國時代，江戶時代為德川幕府下橫須賀藩的藩廳所在地。1981年，城跡被指定為國家史跡。

194089c743ab3ffb.en: Mount Nagi (那岐山, Nagi-san), is a mountain located on the border of Chizu, Tottori Prefecture, and Nagi, Okayama Prefecture, Japan. The other reading of this mountain's kanji is Nagisen.
194089c743ab3ffb.zh: 那岐山（Nagi-san）是位於日本鳥取縣智頭町與岡山縣奈義町交界的山。其漢字另有「Nagisen」的讀法。

1944d013cbfe1de7.en: Sasa-dango, a well-known specialty of Niigata, is a bale-shaped dumpling wrapped in bamboo leaves and tied with a string of sedge or other material. It has been eaten in the Chuetsu and Shimoetsu regions of Niigata and parts of the Aizu region of Fukushima Prefecture for about 500 years. It is said that "Kenshin Uesugi used it as a portable food" because it was considered a portable preserved food in the Warring States period, as bamboo leaves have a sterilizing effect. It is also said that it was used as a portable food by Uesugi Kenshin.
1944d013cbfe1de7.zh: 笹団子是新潟知名的特產，是以竹葉包裹、用菅草等材料綁起的草包狀糰子。在新潟的中越、下越地區及福島縣會津地區部分地方，已有約500年的食用歷史。由於竹葉具有殺菌作用，在戰國時代被視為可攜帶的保存食品，因此有「上杉謙信將其作為攜帶食物」的說法。另據說上杉謙信曾將其當作攜帶食物。

197dd3aab4ec8683.en: Toyama Prefecture has a wide variety of oshizushi, such as trout sushi and sasazushi. Osezushi, whose name is said to have originated from a mispronunciation of “oshizushi,” is one such variety. It is a dish that is especially popular in the Shinkawa area, such as Uozu City and Kurobe City, where the mountainous area facing Toyama Bay has a large elevation difference with mountains as tall as 2,000m.
197dd3aab4ec8683.zh: 富山縣有鱒魚壽司、笹壽司等種類繁多的押壽司。據說名稱來自「押壽司」讀音訛轉的おせずし也是其中之一。這道料理在魚津市、黑部市等新川地區特別受歡迎，這一帶面向富山灣的山區有高達2,000公尺的山，高低落差很大。

19a46c19ec1a10b8.en: The Tōtōmi Kokubun-ji (遠江国分寺) was a Buddhist temple located in the Mitsuke neighborhood of what is now the city of Iwata, Shizuoka, Japan. It was one of the provincial temples established by Emperor Shōmu during the Nara period (710 – 794) for the purpose of promoting Buddhism as the national religion of Japan and standardising control of the imperial rule over the provinces. The original temple no longer exists, but the temple grounds are an archaeological site which was designated as a Special National Historic Site in 1962.
19a46c19ec1a10b8.zh: 遠江國分寺是位於今日本靜岡縣磐田市見付地區的佛寺。此寺是奈良時代（710－794年）聖武天皇為推廣佛教作為日本國教、統一朝廷對各國的統治而設立的國分寺之一。原寺院已不存在，寺域為考古遺址，於1962年被指定為國家特別史跡。

19c25086c7219ad5.en: Ōmiya Hachiman Shrine (大宮八幡宮, Ōmiya-Hachimangū) is a Shinto shrine in Miki, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan. It is a Hachiman Shrine that was founded in 1111 and was rebuilt in 1585 after having burned down.
19c25086c7219ad5.zh: 大宮八幡宮是位於日本兵庫縣三木市的神社。這是一座八幡宮，創建於1111年，曾遭燒毀，於1585年重建。

19d0f8765032d121.en: Zenjibu-ji is a Shingon Buddhist Temple located in Nankoku, Kōchi, Japan. It is the 32nd temple of the Shikoku 88 Temple Pilgrimage.
19d0f8765032d121.zh: 禅師峰寺是位於日本高知縣南國市的真言宗寺院，為四國八十八所巡禮第32號札所。

19e2cab3b51f5e0a.en: Mitama refers to black soybean okowa made by steaming black beans (black soybeans) and glutinous rice. Depending on the region and people, it may be called “medama” because of its appearance. While usually written in hiragana, mitama is sometimes written as “御霊” in kanji.
19e2cab3b51f5e0a.zh: みたま是指將黑豆（黑大豆）與糯米一起蒸製而成的黑豆糯米飯（おこわ）。依地區與個人不同，也有人因其外觀而稱之為「めだま」。みたま通常以平假名書寫，有時也以漢字寫作「御霊」。

19ee01c9796dd0a2.en: Nagano Prefectural Museum of History (長野県立歴史館, Nagano Kenritsu Rekishi-kan) opened in Chikuma, Nagano Prefecture, Japan, in 1994. Its focus is the archaeology (buried cultural properties) and documentary history of Nagano Prefecture.
19ee01c9796dd0a2.zh: 長野縣立歷史館於1994年在日本長野縣千曲市開館。以長野縣的考古（埋藏文化財）與文獻史為主題。

19f1aa4bc0974557.en: “Akakabu no senmaizuke” refers to traditional red turnip pickles of the Tsugaru region of Aomori prefecture. Red turnips are harvested just before the snowy season begins. They are pickled with Dashi(=Japanese soup stock) made with Kombu(=kelp), vinegar and Zarame(=coarse white sugar), which create a sweet and sour taste. Red turnips have been cultivated in Tsugaru for a long time and it has a soft flesh which makes it suitable for pickling. The skin and flesh are both red and once vinegar is added, the vinegar turns into a beautiful red color.
19f1aa4bc0974557.zh: 「赤かぶの千枚漬け」是青森縣津輕地區傳統的紅蕪菁醃漬物。紅蕪菁在降雪季節開始前採收，以昆布熬製的高湯、醋及粗粒白砂糖（ザラメ）醃漬，帶有酸甜滋味。紅蕪菁在津輕栽培已久，果肉柔軟，適合醃漬。其外皮與果肉皆為紅色，加入醋後，醋會變成漂亮的紅色。

19fd54f04f252352.en: The Toyota Municipal Museum of Art (豊田市美術館, Toyota-shi Bijutsukan) is an art museum located in the city of Toyota, Aichi Prefecture, Japan.
19fd54f04f252352.zh: 豐田市美術館是位於日本愛知縣豐田市的美術館。

1a1c21b157b4506e.en: "Hazushi" is a type of sushi wrapped in leaves of Aburagiri (Tung tree), a deciduous tall tree belonging to the Theaceae family. Aburagiri is originally from China and was cultivated south of the Yangtze River. Due to its seeds, known as "korobi," yielding tung oil (kiri-abura), the cultivation of Aburagiri was encouraged in Japan. Tung oil was valuable and used for various purposes, including lamp oil, water repellent for Japanese umbrellas, and as a raw material for candles.Especially in the Obama region, Aburagiri cultivation was thriving.
1a1c21b157b4506e.zh: 「葉ずし」是以油桐（アブラギリ）葉包裹的壽司。油桐是落葉喬木，屬於山茶科，原產於中國，栽培於長江以南。由於其種子「ころび」可榨取桐油，日本曾鼓勵栽培油桐。桐油十分珍貴，用途廣泛，包括燈油、和傘的防水劑，以及蠟燭的原料。尤其在小濱地區，油桐栽培相當興盛。

1a2a762331b1c30d.en: Hōyo Fortress (豊予要塞, Hōyo yōsai) was the name of a group of coastal fortifications built to guard the Hōyo Strait at the entrance to Bungo Channel between the Japanese islands of Kyushu and Shikoku and this the western entrance to the Seto Inland Sea. These gun batteries and fortifications ceased to be used after the end of World War II.
1a2a762331b1c30d.zh: 豊予要塞是一組海岸防禦工事的名稱，興建目的是守衛位於九州與四國之間豐後水道入口、同時也是瀨戶內海西側入口的豐予海峽。這些砲台與防禦工事在第二次世界大戰結束後停止使用。

1a327bcb9ccfeb04.en: The Shimada area was mostly surrounded by mountains and could not produce enough rice. A man named Ichirobe Yasumatsu, who was aware of this environment, cultivated the mountains and forests in 1846 (Koka 3). He moved the moso bamboo from Kiyomizu Temple in the town and began to increase the number of mother bamboos. The red clay soil encouraged the growth of Ichirobei's bamboo shoots, which grew quickly.
1a327bcb9ccfeb04.zh: 島田地區大多被山環繞，無法生產足夠的稻米。一位名叫安松市郎兵衛的人了解這樣的環境，於1846年（弘化3年）開墾山林。他從町內的清水寺移植孟宗竹，開始增加母竹的數量。紅色黏土促進了市郎兵衛竹筍的生長，竹筍長得很快。

1a32d0d9ff4c0c70.en: Biwako Hall Center for the Performing Arts, Shiga (滋賀県立芸術劇場びわ湖ホール, Shiga Kenritsu Geijutsu Gekijō Biwa-ko Hōru) is a performing arts centre that opened beside Lake Biwa in Ōtsu, Shiga Prefecture, Japan in 1998. Biwako Hall is one of Japan's leading centres for opera and is home to the Biwako Hall Vocal Ensemble. The three halls also host performances of ballet, orchestral and choral works, chamber music, world music, jazz, plays, and traditional performing arts.
1a32d0d9ff4c0c70.zh: 滋賀縣立藝術劇場びわ湖ホール是1998年於日本滋賀縣大津市琵琶湖畔開幕的表演藝術中心。びわ湖ホール是日本主要的歌劇中心之一，也是びわ湖ホール聲樂合唱團的駐團場地。館內三座廳另有芭蕾、管弦樂與合唱作品、室內樂、世界音樂、爵士樂、戲劇及傳統表演藝術等演出。

1a467b64e2dcfbdf.en: Terumo Shrine (光雲神社) is a Shinto shrine in Fukuoka City. Latterly located in Nishi Park in the Chūō-ku ward of the city, the shrine and all contents were destroyed in 1945; a reconstruction in modern materials was erected in 1966.
1a467b64e2dcfbdf.zh: 光雲神社是位於福岡市的神社，後來遷至該市中央區的西公園。神社及其所有物品於1945年被毀，1966年以現代建材重建。

1a49682a9d14eaee.en: Mimasaka Kokubun-ji (美作国分寺) is a Tendai sect Buddhist temple in the Kokubunji neighborhood of the city of Tsuyama, Okayama, Japan. Its honzon is a hibutsu statue of Yakushi Nyōrai. The temple claims to be the successor to one of the provincial temples established by Emperor Shōmu during the Nara period (710–794). Due to this connection, the foundation stones of the Nara period temple were designated as a National Historic Site in 2004 with the area under protection expanded in 2009.
1a49682a9d14eaee.zh: 美作國分寺是位於日本岡山縣津山市國分寺地區的天台宗佛寺，本尊為祕佛藥師如來像。該寺自稱是奈良時代（710–794年）聖武天皇所設諸國國分寺之一的後繼者。基於這層淵源，奈良時代寺院的礎石於2004年被指定為國家史跡，保護範圍並於2009年擴大。

1a55bc0678d215ad.en: The Akita Inu (秋田犬, Akita Inu, Akita Ken; Japanese pronunciation: [a.kʲi̥.ta(ꜜ) i.nɯ, -ta.keɴ]) is a Japanese dog breed of large size. Originating from the mountains of northern Japan, the Akita has a short double coat similar to that of many other northern spitz breeds.
1a55bc0678d215ad.zh: 秋田犬（日語讀音：[a.kʲi̥.ta(ꜜ) i.nɯ, -ta.keɴ]）是日本的大型犬種。秋田犬源自日本北部山區，與許多其他北方狐狸犬種一樣，具有短的雙層被毛。

1a624026ffd75a88.en: Akita Prefectural Central Park (Japanese: 秋田県立中央公園) is a group of sports facilities in Yuwa, Akita, Akita, Japan.
1a624026ffd75a88.zh: 秋田県立中央公園是位於日本秋田縣秋田市雄和的運動設施群。

1a6aa5fc4efb76b4.en: Niigata Prefectural Museum of History (新潟県立歴史博物館, Niigata Kenritsu Rekishi Hakubutsukan) is a prefectural museum in Nagaoka, Japan, dedicated to the history of Niigata Prefecture. The museum opened in 2000.
1a6aa5fc4efb76b4.zh: 新潟県立歴史博物館是位於日本長岡的縣立博物館，以新潟縣的歷史為主題，於2000年開館。

1a6fcc22838b1192.en: Dainichi-ji (大日寺) is a Shingon Buddhist temple in Tokushima. It is the 13th temple in the Shikoku Pilgrimage.
1a6fcc22838b1192.zh: 大日寺是位於德島的真言宗寺院，為四國遍路第13號札所。

1a9229485193c7f8.en: "Honekajiri" is a local dish from the Hitoyoshi and Kuma area in Kumamoto prefecture, particularly in the Oku-Kuma (including Kami-Kuma/Yunomae Town, Taragi Town, and Mizukami Village). It is a hearty dish where people gather in large numbers, often served at banquets.
1a9229485193c7f8.zh: 「骨かじり」是熊本縣人吉、球磨地區的鄉土料理，尤其流傳於奧球磨（包括上球磨／湯前町、多良木町、水上村）。這是一道份量十足、多人聚集時食用的料理，常在宴席上供應。

1a9a15c8f08382d7.en: Ichifusa Dam (Japanese: 市房ダム) is a gravity dam located in Kumamoto Prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for flood control and power production. The catchment area of the dam is 157.8 km2. The dam impounds about 165  ha of land when full and can store 40200 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1953 and completed in 1959.
1a9a15c8f08382d7.zh: 市房ダム是位於日本熊本縣的重力壩，用於防洪與發電。集水面積157.8平方公里。滿水時淹沒面積約165公頃，蓄水量4,020萬立方公尺。水壩於1953年動工，1959年完工。

1a9fee439e340c6b.en: Katō Shrine (加藤神社, Katō-jinja) is a shrine in Kumamoto Castle, Chūō-ku, Kumamoto, Kumamoto, Japan, in which daimyō or powerful territorial lord Katō Kiyomasa (1562–1611) is enshrined. Alongside Ōki Kaneyoshi and Kin Kan, who made junshi, are enshrined.
1a9fee439e340c6b.zh: 加藤神社是位於日本熊本縣熊本市中央區熊本城內的神社，供奉大名（握有實權的領主）加藤清正（1562–1611）。同時合祀殉死的大木兼能與金官。

1aa4f9342c4ee9d6.en: Takatenjin Castle (高天神城, Takatenjin-jō) was a Sengoku period yamashiro-style Japanese castle located in the Kamihijikata and Shimohijikata neighborhoods of the city of Kakegawa, Shizuoka prefecture. The ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1975, with the area under protection extended in 2007.
1aa4f9342c4ee9d6.zh: 高天神城是戰國時代的山城式日本城郭，位於靜岡縣掛川市上土方及下土方地區。城跡自1975年起被指定為國家史跡受到保護，2007年擴大保護範圍。

1aab4e31ccf72c12.en: Danrin-ji (檀林寺) was Japan's first Zen temple, founded in Saga, Kyōto, by order of Empress Danrin during the Jōwa era.
1aab4e31ccf72c12.zh: 檀林寺是日本第一座禪寺，承和年間奉檀林皇后之命創建於京都嵯峨。

1ac0ca549da0f3e9.en: Todoroki Arena is a multi-purpose indoor arena in the Todoroki Park in Kawasaki, Kanagawa, Japan. The capacity of the arena is 6,500 and was opened in 1995.
1ac0ca549da0f3e9.zh: 川崎市とどろきアリーナ是位於日本神奈川縣川崎市等等力公園內的多功能室內場館，可容納6,500人，於1995年啟用。

1ac16d3e30098794.en: Flying fish is the prefectural fish of Shimane Prefecture and is known as the fish that heralds early summer among the local people. In mid-May or later, it migrates to Oki island. There are two types of flying fish in Shimane Prefecture - the Hosotobi Uo and Tsukushi Uo. The former is called "maru (round) ago" and the latter "kaku (square) ago". Together, they are called "ago". Flying fish has been rooted as an everyday food since ancient times and is also known as "taue sakana".
1ac16d3e30098794.zh: 飛魚是島根縣的縣魚，當地人視之為宣告初夏到來的魚。5月中旬以後會洄游至隱岐島。島根縣的飛魚有細飛魚和筑紫飛魚兩種，前者稱為「丸（圓）アゴ」，後者稱為「角（方）アゴ」，合稱「アゴ」。飛魚自古以來就是日常食物，也被稱為「田植え魚」。

1ace5405c27f3185.en: Takino Suzuran Hillside National Government Park (国営滝野すずらん丘陵公園, Kokuei Takino Suzuran Kyūryō Kōen) is a Japanese national government park located in Sapporo, Hokkaido.  It is the only national government park in the northern island of Hokkaido.  The park area spreads over 395.7m hectares of hilly country and ranges in altitude between 160 and 320 m above sea level.  Currently, 192.3m is accessible to the public.
1ace5405c27f3185.zh: 國營滝野すずらん丘陵公園是位於北海道札幌市的日本國營公園，也是北海道唯一的國營公園。園區占地395.7公頃丘陵地，海拔介於160至320公尺之間，目前開放大眾使用的面積為192.3公頃。

1ad7c4f223c41ddf.en: Miyama Dam is an asphalt dam located in Tochigi prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for irrigation, water supply and power production. The catchment area of the dam is 65.9 km2. The dam impounds about 97  ha of land when full and can store 25800 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1968 and completed in 1973.
1ad7c4f223c41ddf.zh: 深山水壩是位於日本栃木縣的瀝青壩，用於灌溉、供水與發電。集水面積65.9平方公里，滿水時淹沒面積約97公頃，蓄水量2580萬立方公尺。水壩於1968年動工，1973年完工。

1ae111a830e4b72a.en: Hashira Island (Japanese: 柱島, Hepburn: Hashira-jima) is an island in southern Hiroshima Bay in the Inland Sea, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan. Located 26 kilometres (16 mi) southeast of Iwakuni, it is part of the Kutsuna Islands within the Bōyo Islands group. The island covers 3.12 square kilometres (1.20 mi2) and as of 2013 had a population of 184 residents.
1ae111a830e4b72a.zh: 柱島是位於日本山口縣瀨戶內海廣島灣南部的島嶼。位於岩國東南方26公里（16英里），屬於防予諸島中的忽那諸島。島嶼面積3.12平方公里（1.20平方英里），2013年時人口為184人。

1af1badaa7915649.en: The Hyogo Performing Arts Center (HPAC) (兵庫県立芸術文化センター, Hyōgo-kenritsu Geijutsu Bunka Sentā) is a performing arts center in the city of Nishinomiya, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan, next to Nishinomiya-Kitaguchi Station operated by Hankyu Corporation. The Center was opened in 2005 to mark the ten-year anniversary of the Great Hanshin earthquake which largely devastated Nishinomiya and the surrounding cities.
1af1badaa7915649.zh: 兵庫縣立藝術文化中心（HPAC）是位於日本兵庫縣西宮市的表演藝術中心，鄰近阪急電鐵的西宮北口站。中心於2005年開幕，以紀念阪神大地震十週年；該地震曾使西宮市及周邊城市受到嚴重破壞。

1afacd17cb6f8a51.en: On the night of New Year's Eve, the family gathers together to enjoy a lavish meal served on a high table tray to welcome the New Year. It is the time when 'Toshi-tori Zen' is eaten. The same dish is served as an offeriing to thank the Toshigami (the god celebrated at the beginning of the New Year) for a year of good health and to welcome the new Toshigami. On New Year's Eve, people stay up from midnight until dawn to celebrate and go and pay their respects at shrines and temples.
1afacd17cb6f8a51.zh: 除夕夜，家人團聚，享用盛在高腳膳上的豐盛餐點迎接新年，這時吃的就是「歳とり膳」。同樣的料理也會作為供品，感謝年神（新年之初所祭祀的神）保佑一年健康，並迎接新的年神。除夕夜，人們從半夜守到天亮慶祝，並前往神社和寺院參拜。

1b0842341c507ec1.en: Kinpōzan Prefectural Natural Park (金峰山県立自然公園, Kinpōzan kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in northwest Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1955, the park spans the municipalities of Gyokutō, Kumamoto, and Tamana. The park derives its name from Mount Kinbō and encompasses Honmyōji, Ohagi gardens, and Mount Sanno.
1b0842341c507ec1.zh: 金峰山縣立自然公園是位於日本熊本縣西北部的縣立自然公園。設立於1955年，範圍橫跨玉東町、熊本市與玉名市。公園名稱源自金峰山，範圍涵蓋本妙寺、ohagi庭園與三之岳。

1b30f7686368a03b.en: Uji tea is one of Japan's representative high-grade teas, and its cultivation began in 1191 when Zen monk Eisai brought back tea seeds from the sect of Zen Buddhism, and priest Meie sowed them in Toganoo, Ukyo-ku, Kyoto City. During the reigns of Ashikaga Yoshimitsu and Yoshimasa, tea cultivation was encouraged and tea gardens were opened in Uji City. As the custom of tea drinking spread, Uji tea became a first-class product used as a gift. People also enjoyed "tea fighting," in which they would try to guess where the tea was grown.
1b30f7686368a03b.zh: 宇治茶是日本代表性的高級茶之一，其栽培始於1191年，禪僧榮西從禪宗傳入地帶回茶種，由明惠上人播種於京都市右京區的栂尾。足利義滿與義政在位期間獎勵種茶，並在宇治市開闢茶園。隨著飲茶習慣普及，宇治茶成為用作贈禮的一級品。人們也喜愛猜測茶葉產地的「鬥茶」。

1b3c7a71dc640fce.en: The Nagai Botanical Garden (大阪市立長居植物園, Ōsaka Shiritsu Nagai Shokubutsuen) is a botanical garden located in the southern part of Nagai Park, Higashisumiyoshi-ku, Osaka, Japan. An admission fee is charged for adults, while middle school students and under are free.
1b3c7a71dc640fce.zh: 大阪市立長居植物園是位於日本大阪市東住吉區長居公園南側的植物園。成人需付費入園，國中生以下免費。

1b4df9280b963021.en: Shoyu-no-Mi" is a versatile seasoning made by fermenting soybeans, wheat (pressed barley is sometimes used), rice, and seed koji by adding salt water and letting it sit while stirring. Soy sauce and sake are added instead of salt water, and with this method, the soy sauce is ready to eat in about one week to 10 days. In the Shonai area, it is said to have been eaten since the Edo period (1603-1867).The flavor can be sweet or salty, depending on the amount of koji used. It is also called "amabisho" or "amapicho" in some regions.
1b4df9280b963021.zh: 「しょうゆの実」是將黃豆、小麥（有時使用押麥）、米與種麴加入鹽水，一邊攪拌一邊靜置發酵而成的萬用調味料。也有用醬油和酒代替鹽水的做法，以這種方法大約一週到10天就可以食用。在庄內地區，據說從江戶時代（1603－1867）就開始食用。依麴的用量不同，風味可甜可鹹。在部分地區也稱為「あまびしょ」或「あまぴちょ」。

1b52d7ef9526b2e3.en: Shimotsuke Yakushi-ji (下野薬師寺) was a Buddhist temple located in what is now the city of Shimotsuke, Tochigi Prefecture, in northern Kantō region of Japan. It is one of the earliest Buddhist temples in western Japan, having been founded in the Asuka period. The temple is now a ruin and an archaeological site and has been designated by the national government as a National Historic Site since 1921.
1b52d7ef9526b2e3.zh: 下野藥師寺（下野薬師寺跡）是曾位於今日本北關東地方栃木縣下野市的佛教寺院。此寺創建於飛鳥時代，是日本西部最早的佛教寺院之一。寺院現已成為遺跡及考古遺址，自1921年起被國家指定為國家史跡。

1b5560112e813c74.en: Cape Tappi (竜飛崎/龍飛崎, Tappimisaki) is a headland on the northwestern point of the island of Honshu in Japan. The name is believed to be derived from tampa which means "sword's edge" in the Ainu language. It is located on the northern tip of the Tsugaru Peninsula within the borders of the town of Sotogahama in Aomori Prefecture. Much of the cape is also a part of the Tsugaru Quasi-National Park. The cape marks the western limit of the Tsugaru Strait, separating it from the Sea of Japan. The area is known for its almost constant strong winds.
1b5560112e813c74.zh: 竜飛崎（龍飛崎）是位於日本本州島西北端的岬角。其名稱一般認為源自愛奴語中意為「刀刃」的「tampa」。岬角位於津輕半島北端，屬青森縣外濱町境內，大部分範圍也屬於津輕國定公園。此岬角為津輕海峽的西界，分隔津輕海峽與日本海。當地以幾乎終年不斷的強風聞名。

1b5bd9c93877fd11.en: Fukugon-ji (福厳寺) is an Ōbaku Zen temple in Yanagawa, Fukuoka, Japan.  Its honorary sangō prefix is Baigakuzan (梅岳山).
1b5bd9c93877fd11.zh: 福嚴寺是位於日本福岡縣柳川市的黃檗宗寺院，山號為梅岳山。

1b5e7355ff032cff.en: Mannenji Temple is a temple dedicated to the Jodo sect of Buddhism. It is located in the town of Iwamizawa, Japan. It is known to house the haunted doll Okiku. There are many versions of how the doll arrived at the temple, but all involve a girl dying and her family leaving the doll there.
1b5e7355ff032cff.zh: 萬念寺是淨土宗的佛教寺院，位於日本岩見澤。此寺以供奉鬧鬼人偶「阿菊」聞名。關於人偶如何來到寺中有許多說法，但都與一名少女過世、家人將人偶留在寺中有關。

1b844b9fe946f8d8.en: The Utsunoya-tōge Pass (宇津ノ谷峠, Utsunoya-tōge) is a mountain pass on the old Tōkaidō highway connecting eastern Japan with imperial capital of Kyoto. Located between former Mariko-juku in what is now Suruga-ku, Shizuoka, and Okabe-juku in what is now Fujieda, it is the only portion of the original Heian period road known to have survived to the present day, and a one kilometer stretch of the road was proclaimed a National Historic Site on February 22, 2010.
1b844b9fe946f8d8.zh: 宇津ノ谷峠是舊東海道上的山口，東海道連接日本東部與皇都京都。宇津ノ谷峠位於舊丸子宿（今靜岡市駿河區）與岡部宿（今藤枝市）之間，是已知唯一保存至今的平安時代原始道路路段，其中一公里長的路段於2010年2月22日列為國家史蹟。

1b8e21ea07378a09.en: Noda Castle (野田城, Noda-jō) was a Sengoku period castle located in eastern Mikawa Province in what is today part of the city of Shinshiro, Aichi Prefecture, Japan.
1b8e21ea07378a09.zh: 野田城是戰國時代的城池，位於三河國東部，即今日本愛知縣新城市境內。

1b93aea1eb455ebf.en: Katsuyama Castle (勝山城, Katsuyama-jō) was a Japanese castle located in the city of  Katsuyama Fukui Prefecture, in the Hokuriku region of Japan.  Built in the Sengoku period by the Shibata clan, it was occupied by a succession of daimyō of Echizen-Katsuyama Domain under the Edo period Tokugawa shogunate. The site is now a public park.
1b93aea1eb455ebf.zh: 勝山城是位於日本北陸地方福井縣勝山市的日本城郭。戰國時代由柴田氏興建，江戶時代德川幕府統治下由越前勝山藩的歷任大名居住。遺址現為公園。

1ba20be4ea845e8e.en: Tofu made throughout Japan is formed by adding bittern to soy milk, but “Go Dofu", which is mainly from the town of Arita Town in Saga Prefecture, is characterized by the addition of kudzu, starch, and other ingredients to soy milk to harden it.The major difference from conventional tofu is the texture, which is soft and chewy. It also has a glossy, pudding-like sheen. It is usually served as a side dish with sesame soy sauce, but it can also be enjoyed as a healthy sweet by pouring molasses or soybean flour over it.
1ba20be4ea845e8e.zh: 日本各地製作的豆腐是在豆漿中加入鹽滷凝固而成，但主要來自佐賀縣有田町的「呉豆腐」，特點是在豆漿中加入葛粉、澱粉等材料使其凝固。與一般豆腐最大的不同在於口感柔軟有嚼勁。它也帶有類似布丁的光澤。通常淋上芝麻醬油作為配菜食用，也可以淋上黑糖蜜或黃豆粉，當作健康的甜點享用。

1bbeec3a9afcd8bc.en: Tonomi Palisade (鳥海柵, Tonomi-no-saku) was an early Heian period jōsaku-style Japanese castle located in what is now the town of Kanegasaki in Isawa District, Iwate Prefecture in far northern Honshū, Japan. The site was proclaimed a National Historic Site of Japan in October 2013.
1bbeec3a9afcd8bc.zh: 鳥海柵是平安時代初期的城柵式日本城郭，位於今日本本州最北部岩手縣膽澤郡金崎町境內。遺址於2013年10月被指定為日本國家史跡。

1bd22b372ccc8044.en: Izaku Castle (伊作城, Izaku-jō) was a castle structure in Hioki, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan.
1bd22b372ccc8044.zh: 伊作城是位於日本鹿兒島縣日置市的城郭建築。

1bdc64ba462098bc.en: The Iwaseke Residence (岩瀬家住宅) is one of the gasshō-zukuri houses in Nishiakao-machi Village, Nanto City, Toyama Prefecture. It is designated as an Important Cultural Property of Japan.
1bdc64ba462098bc.zh: 岩瀨家住宅是富山縣南礪市西赤尾町的合掌造房屋之一，被指定為日本重要文化財。

1be4498fd0870aff.en: Karatsu Kunchi (唐津くんち; the suffix "kunchi" simply meaning festival) is a Japanese matsuri that takes place annually in November in the city of Karatsu, Saga Prefecture, on Japan's island of Kyūshū.
1be4498fd0870aff.zh: 唐津くんち（「くんち」一詞即為祭典之意）是每年11月在日本九州佐賀縣唐津市舉行的日本祭典。

1bfeb3212a13ec09.en: Chobo-jiru is a traditional local dish of Awaji Island that has been served since the Edo period (1603-1868). It consists of dumplings, common beans, and zuki beans in a thick broth. It looks similar to oshiruko (sweet bean soup), but it is not sweet. The dumplings made of sugar beans and glutinous rice flour are highly nutritious, and the zuiki is said to purge old blood and cleanse the blood.
1bfeb3212a13ec09.zh: ちょぼ汁是淡路島自江戶時代（1603-1868年）流傳至今的傳統在地料理，在濃稠的湯汁中加入糰子、菜豆與芋莖。外觀類似紅豆湯（お汁粉），但不是甜的。以菜豆與糯米粉製成的糰子營養豐富，芋莖據說能排出舊血、淨化血液。

1c27faffc03cf022.en: The Higashitakane site (東高根遺跡, Higashitakane iseki) is an archaeological site with the traces of a settlement group existing from the Yayoi to Kofun period, located in Miyamae-ku, Kawasaki, Kanagawa Prefecture in the Kantō region of Japan. It was designated a Kanagawa Prefecture Historic Site in 1971.
1c27faffc03cf022.zh: 東高根遺跡是一處考古遺址，保有彌生時代至古墳時代的聚落群遺跡，位於日本關東地方神奈川縣川崎市宮前區。1971年被指定為神奈川縣史跡。

1c2b1bb241e5a1cc.en: “Kuri Okowa”, also known as “Kuri Kowai” and “Kowai”, is a traditional dish of Saga prefecture and served at local festivals and celebrations at home. When the dish is made as offerings to gods, the rice is shaped in the form of circular cones or triangles called “Gokkusan”. “Kuri Okowa” is also an indispensable part of “Kunchi” or “Okunchi” (=festival) held in the northern Kyushu areas in autumn.
1c2b1bb241e5a1cc.zh: 「栗おこわ」又稱「栗こわい」、「こわい」，是佐賀縣的傳統料理，會在地方祭典和家中的慶祝場合端出。作為供品獻給神明時，米飯會塑成圓錐形或三角形，稱為「ごっくさん」。「栗おこわ」也是九州北部地區秋季舉行的「くんち」或「おくんち」（＝祭典）中不可或缺的一部分。

1c36b358d2cd0d1a.en: Tsunoshima (角島) is an island located in the Sea of Japan. Located in the north west of Yamaguchi Prefecture, it is a part of Shimonoseki city. The island has an area of 4.1 square kilometers (1.6 sq mi) and has a coastline of 17.1 kilometres (10.6 mi). The island consists primarily of basalt, and is a part of the Kita-Nagato Kaigan Quasi-National Park. As of 28 August 2008, the population of Tsunoshima is 907.
1c36b358d2cd0d1a.zh: 角島是位於日本海的島嶼，位在山口縣西北部，屬於下關市。島嶼面積4.1平方公里（1.6平方英里），海岸線長17.1公里（10.6英里）。島上主要由玄武岩構成，屬於北長門海岸國定公園的一部分。截至2008年8月28日，角島人口為907人。

1c4e45f963e5688e.en: The local dish eaten at New Year's Eve in Kochi Prefecture is "Kureno-ni-nimono" (simmered dishes at the end of the year), which contains whale meat. This dish was eaten with the wish that by eating something as large as a whale, one would "become a big fish. In the days when whales were readily available, it was a common sight to see them lined up at fish shops as New Year's Eve approached.
1c4e45f963e5688e.zh: 高知縣在除夕吃的地方料理是加入鯨魚肉的「暮れの煮物」（年末燉菜）。人們吃這道料理，是希望藉由吃下像鯨魚這麼大的東西，讓自己「成為大人物」。在鯨魚容易取得的年代，隨著除夕接近，魚店裡排滿鯨魚是常見的景象。

1c6a00e2e529de45.en: Sekiyado Castle (関宿城, Sekiyado-jō) is a Japanese castle located in Noda, northwestern Chiba Prefecture, Japan. At the end of the Edo period, Sekiyado Castle was home to the Kuse clan, daimyō of Sekiyado Domain.
1c6a00e2e529de45.zh: 関宿城（関宿城，Sekiyado-jō）是位於日本千葉縣西北部野田市的日本城郭。江戶時代末期，関宿城為関宿藩藩主久世氏的居城。

1c7170dd20cc3949.en: Nariai-ji (成相寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Nariai neighborhood of the city of Miyazu, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the  Hashidate Shingon sect of Japanese Buddhism and its honzon (primary image) is a hibutsu (secret / hidden image) statue of Sho-Kannon Bosatsu. The temple's full name is Nariai-san Nariai-ji (成相山 成相寺).The temple is the 28th stop on the 33 temple Saigoku Kannon Pilgrimage route.
1c7170dd20cc3949.zh: 成相寺是位於日本京都府宮津市成相地區的佛寺，屬橋立真言宗，本尊為祕佛聖觀音菩薩像。寺院全名為成相山成相寺。此寺為西國三十三所觀音巡禮的第28番札所。

1c7d0f7bd29eeda1.en: Kongōfuku-ji (金剛福寺) is a Buzan Shingon temple in Tosashimizu, Kōchi Prefecture, Japan. Temple 38 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage, the deity that is worshipped at this temple is Sahasra-bhuja, or Senju Kannon Bosatsu (千手観音菩薩) in Japanese. The temple is said to have been founded by Gyōki in 822.
1c7d0f7bd29eeda1.zh: 金剛福寺是位於日本高知縣土佐清水市的真言宗豐山派寺院，為四國八十八所巡禮第38號札所，寺內供奉千手觀音，日文稱千手観音菩薩。相傳此寺由行基於822年創建。

1cc2241cd89144f2.en: Miyakonojō City Museum of Art (都城市立美術館, Miyakonojō Shiritsu Bijutsukan) opened in Miyakonojō, Miyazaki Prefecture, Japan in 1981. The collection includes works by Yamauchi Tamon, Masuda Gyokujō, and Yamada Shin'ichi, and temporary exhibitions are also mounted.
1cc2241cd89144f2.zh: 都城市立美術館於1981年在日本宮崎縣都城市開館。館藏包括山內多門、益田玉城、山田新一等人的作品，也舉辦特展。

1cca00498794f86f.en: The Tanesashi Coast (種差海岸, Tanesashi kaigan) is section of the coastline on the Pacific Ocean, located in the southern portion of the city of Hachinohe, Aomori Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan. It is extends for 12 kilometres (7.5 mi) from the island of Kabushima south towards the city of Kuji in Iwate Prefecture. The coast was  nationally designated a Place of Scenic Beauty in 1937.
1cca00498794f86f.zh: 種差海岸是位於日本北部東北地方青森縣八戶市南部的一段太平洋海岸線。海岸從蕪島往南朝岩手縣久慈市方向延伸 12 公里（7.5 英里）。海岸於 1937 年獲指定為國家名勝。

1cd22bf70ebd950c.en: Combining seasonal ingredients and compatible ingredients is called “deaimon” in the world of Kyoto cuisine. There is ”taikabura” which combines sea bream and turnips, “ebi-imo to bodara no taitan” (shrimp-shaped taro and cod), ”buri daikon” (yellowtail and daikon cooked with soy sauce), etc. “Nishin nasu,” which combines fat-rich dried sliced herring and eggplants which readily absorb fat, is also beloved as a deaimon.Dried sliced herring is a preserved food where the herring has its innards removed and is then dried.
1cd22bf70ebd950c.zh: 在京都料理的世界裡，將當季食材與彼此相配的食材組合在一起，稱為「出会いもん」。例如鯛魚搭配蕪菁的「鯛蕪」、海老芋與棒鱈的「海老芋と棒鱈の炊いたん」、以醬油燉煮青甘與白蘿蔔的「鰤大根」等。將油脂豐富的身欠鯡魚乾與容易吸收油脂的茄子組合而成的「にしん茄子」，也是廣受喜愛的出会いもん。身欠鯡魚乾是將鯡魚去除內臟後乾燥製成的保存食品。

1cdf1081825c85b4.en: Tensha-en (天赦園) is a Japanese garden located in the city of Uwajima, Ehime south of Uwajima Castle on the island of Shikoku. Built by Date Munetada, the 7th daimyō of Uwajima Domain, in 1866, it is one of the last gardens built by a daimyō.
1cdf1081825c85b4.zh: 天赦園是位於四國愛媛縣宇和島市、宇和島城南側的日本庭園。由宇和島藩第7代藩主伊達宗紀於1866年建造，是最後一批由大名建造的庭園之一。

1ceadcfa2e5ba1df.en: Aterazawa Tateyama Castle (左沢楯山城, Aterazawa Tateyama-jō) was a Sengoku period yamashiro-style Japanese castle located in what is now part of the town of Ōe, Yamagata Prefecture in the Tohoku region of Japan. The site has been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 2009. The site is approximately a 20 minutes walk from JR East Aterazawa Line Aterazawa Station.
1ceadcfa2e5ba1df.zh: 左沢楯山城（Aterazawa Tateyama-jō）是戰國時代的山城式日本城郭，位於日本東北地方、今山形縣大江町境內。自2009年起由中央政府指定為國家史跡加以保護。遺址距JR東日本左澤線左澤站步行約20分鐘。

1d21c386a7bb888c.en: Tateyama Castle (館山城, Tateyama-jō) is a Japanese castle located in Tateyama, southern Chiba Prefecture, Japan. At the end of the Edo period, Tateyama Castle was home to the Inaba clan, daimyō of Tateyama Domain, but the castle is better known for its association with the former rulers of Awa Province, the Satomi clan. The castle was also known as "Nekoya-jō" (根古屋城).
1d21c386a7bb888c.zh: 館山城（館山城，Tateyama-jō）是位於日本千葉縣南部館山市的日本城郭。江戶時代末期，館山城為館山藩藩主稻葉氏的居城，但此城更為人所知的是與安房國舊領主里見氏的淵源。此城又稱「根古屋城」。

1d4572acdcbdc8bf.en: Fuchū-no-Mori Park (府中の森公園, Fuchū no Mori Kōen) is a public park in the Sengen-cho region of the city of Fuchū in Tokyo. It is located a little east of the center of the city, close to Higashi-fuchū Station.
1d4572acdcbdc8bf.zh: 府中の森公園是位於東京都府中市淺間町地區的公園，位置在市中心稍東，鄰近東府中站。

1d4f943281cf3fe3.en: Canal City Hakata (キャナルシティ博多) is a large shopping and entertainment complex in Fukuoka, Japan. Called the "city within the city," it hosts shops, cafes, restaurants, a theater, game center, cinemas, two hotels, and a canal, which runs through the complex.
1d4f943281cf3fe3.zh: キャナルシティ博多是位於日本福岡的大型購物娛樂複合設施，被稱為「城市中的城市」，設有商店、咖啡館、餐廳、劇場、遊樂中心、電影院、兩間飯店，以及一條貫穿整個設施的運河。

1d546cd1f869f3c6.en: Ryōgen-ji (良玄寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the town of Ōtaki in Chiba Prefecture, Japan. It is closely associated with Honda Tadakatsu, a daimyō of the late Sengoku through early Edo period loyal to Tokugawa Ieyasu.
1d546cd1f869f3c6.zh: 良玄寺是位於日本千葉縣大多喜町的佛教寺院，與本多忠勝關係密切。本多忠勝是戰國時代後期至江戶時代初期的大名，效忠德川家康。

1d5880f9bf4202c4.en: "Ita-wakame" is a simple product made by arranging freshly harvested wakame seaweed in a flat, board-like shape and drying it. No seasoning is added, relying solely on the natural saltiness and umami of wakame to make it a dish that pairs well with rice. The mountainous areas with abundant forests are home to several clear streams that flow into the Sea of Japan, bringing plenty of nutrients from the forest. The wakame grown with these nutrients has a delightful flavor and is delicious when consumed as is.
1d5880f9bf4202c4.zh: 「板わかめ」是將剛採收的裙帶菜排成平板狀後乾燥製成的簡單產品。不添加任何調味，僅靠裙帶菜本身的天然鹹味與鮮味，成為適合配飯的一道菜。森林豐富的山區有數條清澈溪流注入日本海，帶來大量來自森林的養分。以這些養分孕育的裙帶菜風味宜人，直接食用就很美味。

1d58ccc5b0498c77.en: Watanabe Museum Of Art (渡辺美術館, Watanabe Bijutsukan) opened in Tottori, Tottori Prefecture, Japan in 1978. It houses the 30,000-piece collection of Tottori resident Dr. Hajime Watanabe (1911–2017). It holds the largest collection of Samurai armour and weapons in any museum in Japan.
1d58ccc5b0498c77.zh: 渡辺美術館於1978年在日本鳥取縣鳥取市開館，收藏鳥取居民渡邊元博士（1911–2017）的3萬件藏品。其武士盔甲與武器收藏為日本各博物館中數量最多。

1d6d68757411c2c4.en: The Ariake Sea, in Saga Prefecture, is known for its vast tidelands, which appear during low tide, due to a wide tidal range of about 6 meters. The marine life which inhabit this area is unique and rare, and known as “maeumimon.” Symbolic of this genre of sea creatures is the mutsugoro (mudskipper), which can be found only in certain parts of the Ariake Sea and the Yatsushiro Sea (which is surrounded by the Kyushu mainland and the Amakusa Islands).
1d6d68757411c2c4.zh: 佐賀縣的有明海潮差約6公尺，以退潮時出現的廣大潮灘聞名。棲息在這一帶的海洋生物獨特而稀有，被稱為「前海もん」。這類海洋生物的代表是むつごろう（彈塗魚），只能在有明海和八代海（被九州本島與天草諸島環繞）的部分區域見到。

1d7ad9f8292defef.en: Ashigara Pass (足柄峠, Ashigara-tōge) is a mountain pass on the border of Kanagawa and Shizuoka Prefectures, near Mount Kintoki in Japan. The pass traverses the mountains at 759 metres (2,490 ft).
1d7ad9f8292defef.zh: 足柄峠是位於日本神奈川縣與靜岡縣交界、金時山附近的山口。此山口以759公尺（2,490英尺）的高度越過山脈。

1d8eeb3617ea269a.en: Eihō-ji (永保寺) is a Rinzai Zen Buddhist temple located in northern area of the city of Tajimi, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. Founded in the Kamakura period, two of the structures of the temple are designated National Treasures of Japan and its gardens are a nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty.
1d8eeb3617ea269a.zh: 永保寺（永保寺）是位於日本岐阜縣多治見市北部的臨濟宗禪寺，創建於鎌倉時代。寺內有兩座建築被指定為日本國寶，庭園則被指定為國家名勝。

1da04daf243bf88d.en: Birōjima is a small (8 ha in area and 75 m in height) uninhabited island lying off the coast of Miyazaki Prefecture, Kyushu, Japan. It has been recognised as an Important Bird Area (IBA) by BirdLife International because it supports a population of Pleske's grasshopper warblers as well as a breeding colony of Japanese murrelets.
1da04daf243bf88d.zh: 枇榔島是位於日本九州宮崎縣外海的無人小島（面積8公頃，高75公尺）。由於島上有史氏蝗鶯族群棲息，並有冠海雀的繁殖群，已被國際鳥盟列為重要野鳥棲地（IBA）。

1dae39c4240e0eda.en: "Aiso no Kanroni(candied japanise dace)" is a local dish of Tochigi Prefecture, in which "Aiso(=japanise dace)" caught in early spring at big river like Nakagawa River , Kinugawa River, are stewed in a sweetened broth.It is often softened and sweetened because of its slightly bony taste.In Tochigi Prefecture, which is located inland, it was not until refrigerators became widely available that people were able to eat an abundance of fresh seafood. Before that time, dried fish and salted salmon were the main products.
1dae39c4240e0eda.zh: 「あいその甘露煮」是栃木縣的鄉土料理，將早春在那珂川、鬼怒川等大河捕獲的珠星三塊魚（あいそ）以甜味湯汁燉煮而成。由於這種魚稍微多刺，常會燉軟並煮成甜味。位於內陸的栃木縣，直到冰箱普及之後，人們才能吃到大量新鮮的海產。在那之前，主要是魚乾和鹽漬鮭魚。

1dbb9f27d3d7c886.en: Nopporo Shinrin Kōen Prefectural Natural Park (道立自然公園野幌森林公園, Dōritsu shizen kōen Nopporo Shinrin Kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in western Hokkaidō, Japan. Established in 1968, the park spans the municipalities of Ebetsu, Kitahiroshima, and Sapporo.
1dbb9f27d3d7c886.zh: 道立自然公園野幌森林公園是位於日本北海道西部的道立自然公園，於1968年設立，範圍橫跨江別市、北廣島市和札幌市。

1dd8238e79374867.en: Kannonzaki Park (Japanese: 観音崎公園) is a prefectural-level combined scenic-city park, located at Cape Kannon (Kannonzaki), the northeastern tip of the Miura Peninsula, Yokosuka City, Kanagawa, Japan. It is a park that makes the most of the rich nature, such as the laurel forest and the coastal rocky shore of the area.
1dd8238e79374867.zh: 觀音崎公園是一座縣級風景兼都市公園，位於日本神奈川縣橫須賀市三浦半島東北端的觀音崎。公園充分利用當地照葉樹林與海岸岩礁等豐富的自然環境。

1ddb05bdf35d705a.en: Otoyo Town is located in the center of the Shikoku mountain range, about 40 km from Kochi City, the prefectural capital. The town was called Toyonaga-go in ancient times, and is a key transportation hub connecting the north and south since ancient times.The "Han-Ge Dango" (mid summer dumplings) is a local sweet that has been handed down from generation to generation in this town. The name "Han-Ge" refers to July 2nd.
1ddb05bdf35d705a.zh: 大豐町位於四國山地中央，距縣廳所在地高知市約40公里。此町古時稱為豐永鄉，自古即是連接南北的交通要地。「半夏だんご」（仲夏糰子）是這個町代代相傳的鄉土點心。「半夏」指的是7月2日。

1ddbbcf9f445b326.en: Shinshō-ji is a Shingon Buddhist temple located in Muroto, Kōchi, Japan. It is the 25th temple of the Shikoku Pilgrimage.
1ddbbcf9f445b326.zh: 津照寺是位於日本高知縣室戶市的真言宗寺院，為四國遍路第25號札所。

1de894941d04c4a6.en: Niigata Nippo Media Ship (新潟日報メディアシップ) is a skyscraper in Chūō-ku, Niigata, Japan. It is 105 metres (344 ft) tall, and has 20 floors.
1de894941d04c4a6.zh: 新潟日報メディアシップ是位於日本新潟市中央區的摩天大樓，高105公尺（344英尺），共20層。

1df05c04993f02f0.en: In the southern region of the prefecture, where fishing and forestry are thriving, mehari-zushi became popular as an easy-to-eat lunch between busy fishing and mountain work. It is made by wrapping a large rice ball in salt-pickled takana. There are various theories as to the origin of the name "mehari-zushi" (meaning "eye-opening mouth" or "eye-wateringly delicious"), or "because the rice ball is completely wrapped as if it is eye-opening.
1df05c04993f02f0.zh: 在漁業與林業興盛的縣南地區，めはりずし作為在忙碌的漁撈與山林工作之間方便食用的便當而普及。做法是用鹽漬高菜包裹大飯糰。「めはりずし」名稱的由來有多種說法，例如「張大眼睛、張大嘴巴」、「好吃到睜大眼睛」，或是「飯糰被完整包起來，看起來像睜大的眼睛」。

1e06e1fb5d22fdee.en: “Korogaki” is a candy-colored dried persimmon that is often made in Koshu City and Minami-Alps City. It is made from a larger variety of persimmon that has a moisture content of around 25% to 30% and a crystallized sweetness and white powder. This type of persimmon is called “korogaki”, and it is dried for a longer period of time than a soft persimmon, which has a moisture content of around 50% named"Anpogaki". The name “Korogaki” comes from the way the peeled persimmons are dried in the sun.
1e06e1fb5d22fdee.zh: 「枯露柿」是呈糖果般色澤的柿餅，多產於甲州市與南アルプス市。以較大品種的柿子製成，水分約25%至30%，帶有結晶般的甜味與白粉。這種柿餅稱為「枯露柿」，乾燥時間比水分約50%、名為「あんぽ柿」的軟柿餅更長。「枯露柿」之名源自去皮柿子在日光下曝曬的方式。

1e10cf7ef72009a1.en: Tanesato Castle (種里城, Tanesato jō) was a Muromachi period Japanese castle located in what is now the town of Ajigasawa, Aomori Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of far northern Japan. The site has been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site, collectively with Hirosaki Castle and Horikoshi Castle as the "Tsugaru clan Castle Sites" since 2002.
1e10cf7ef72009a1.zh: 種里城是室町時代的日本城郭，位於日本最北部東北地方、今青森縣鰺澤町境內。自2002年起，該城跡與弘前城、堀越城合稱「津輕氏城跡」，受中央政府指定為國家史跡加以保護。

1e17df816fbcfaad.en: Taijima (Japanese: 鯛島) is an uninhabited set of rocky islands off the coast of the Shimokita Peninsula in Mutsu Bay. The island is a part of the city of Mutsu in Aomori Prefecture. The island has 0.4 kilometers (0.25 mi) of coastline and an area of 0.016 square kilometers (0.0062 sq mi). It is a part of the prefecture-managed, Shimokita Hantō Quasi-National Park.
1e17df816fbcfaad.zh: 鯛島是位於陸奧灣、下北半島外海的一組無人岩礁島，隸屬青森縣陸奧市。該島海岸線長0.4公里（0.25英里），面積0.016平方公里（0.0062平方英里），屬於由縣管理的下北半島國定公園的一部分。

1e3cc642ee1c3489.en: Rikan Castle (利神城, Rikan-jō) was a Nanboku-chō to Sengoku period yamashiro-style Japanese castle located in the Hirafuku neighborhood of the town of  Sayō, in far western Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan. The ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2017.
1e3cc642ee1c3489.zh: 利神城是南北朝時代至戰國時代的山城式日本城郭，位於日本兵庫縣最西部佐用町平福地區。其遺跡自2017年起被指定為國家史跡受到保護。

1e41eb50ff8af580.en: Terushima Cormorant Habitat (照島ウ生息地, Terushima U Seisokuchi) is located in Shimokawa, Izumi-cho, Iwaki, Fukushima Prefecture, and is a habitat for Japanese cormorants designated as a national natural monument. Terushima is a small island made of tuffaceous sandstone with a cliff of 31 meters in height, located approximately 250 meters offshore from the coast of the mainland.
1e41eb50ff8af580.zh: 照島ウ生息地位於福島縣いわき市泉町下川，是被指定為國家天然紀念物的日本鸕鶿棲息地。照島是由凝灰質砂岩構成的小島，有高31公尺的斷崖，距本土海岸約250公尺。

1e43c727b3f5949c.en: The Tanigawadake Ropeway (谷川岳ロープウェイ, Tanigawadake Rōpuwei) is a Japanese cable car line, operated by Tanigawadake Ropeway Company. The Tōbu Group company also operates another aerial lift line, Harunasan Ropeway.  Opened in 1960, the line climbs Mount Tanigawa Tenjindaira Ski Resort, Minakami, Gunma. The line is operated all seasons, transporting skiers, hikers, or tourists.
1e43c727b3f5949c.zh: 谷川岳ロープウェイ是日本的纜車路線，由谷川岳纜車公司經營。這家東武集團旗下的公司另外也經營榛名山纜車。本線於1960年啟用，沿谷川岳天神平滑雪場登山，位於群馬縣水上。全年四季營運，載運滑雪客、登山客及觀光客。

1e7a64dfea080fe1.en: Koya tofu powder, also known as "tofu powder," is the powder produced during the process of making Koya tofu. In Taka Town, a dish made by stir-frying and simmering tofu powder with chopped vegetables is commonly enjoyed as a home-cooked meal.The production of Koya tofu in Taka Town began in 1852 when Teijiro Kadowaki, from the Kadota Village, learned the manufacturing method at Koyasan and started production upon returning home.
1e7a64dfea080fe1.zh: 高野豆腐粉又稱「豆腐粉」，是製作高野豆腐過程中產生的粉末。在多可町，將豆腐粉與切碎的蔬菜拌炒後燉煮的料理，常作為家常菜食用。多可町的高野豆腐生產始於1852年，門田村的門脇定次郎在高野山學得製法，返鄉後開始生產。

1e88b8489ae9759a.en: Matsuida Castle (松井田城, Matsuida-jō)) is the remains of a castle structure in Annaka, Gunma Prefecture, Japan.
1e88b8489ae9759a.zh: 松井田城是位於日本群馬縣安中市的城郭遺跡。

1e8e9777dcdf08ea.en: The term "Nousaba" refers to a regional dish where dried Hoshizame (a small type of shark found in various parts of Japan, characterized by star-like white spots on its back) is soaked in a seasoning liquid and eaten. Hoshizame is known for its relatively mild flavor among sharks.
1e8e9777dcdf08ea.zh: 「のうさば」是一種鄉土料理，將曬乾的星鯊（日本各地都有的小型鯊魚，背部帶有星狀白點）浸泡在調味汁中食用。在鯊魚之中，星鯊以味道較為溫和著稱。

1ea6cf8f5d54641e.en: Soybeans, are known as the "meat of the field" and are rich in high-quality protein with a good balance of essential amino acids. In addition, vitamins, minerals, isoflavones, saponins, dietary fiber, and other nutrients and functional ingredients are packed into small grains, making it a food that has supported the lives of Japanese people since ancient times.Miyagi Prefecture is the second largest producer of soybeans after Hokkaido. Miyagi-Shirome, Tanrei, Tachinagaha, and other varieties are grown in the prefecture.
1ea6cf8f5d54641e.zh: 黃豆被稱為「田裡的肉」，富含優質蛋白質，必需胺基酸均衡。此外，維生素、礦物質、異黃酮、皂素、膳食纖維等營養與機能成分都濃縮在小小的豆粒中，自古以來就是支撐日本人生活的食物。宮城縣的黃豆產量僅次於北海道，居全國第二，縣內栽培ミヤギシロメ、タンレイ、タチナガハ等品種。

1ea841870402d0ea.en: The Tottori Folk Crafts Museum (鳥取民芸美術館, Tottori Mingei Bijutsukan) opened in Tottori, Japan, in 1949. It was established as the Tottori Mingeikan by Yoshida Shōya (吉田璋也), local advocate of the mingei folk craft movement, who formed a craft guild in 1931 and opened the craft shop "Takumi" in the city the following year. In 1933, Yoshida opened a shop by the same name in Tokyo's Ginza district. Both shops are still in operation as of 2023.
1ea841870402d0ea.zh: 鳥取民藝美術館於1949年在日本鳥取開館。前身為鳥取民藝館，由當地民藝運動倡導者吉田璋也創立。吉田璋也於1931年組成工藝同業組合，翌年在市內開設工藝品店「たくみ」。1933年，吉田又在東京銀座開設同名店鋪。截至2023年，兩家店仍在營業。

1ebf4ce467a105d1.en: Kashiragashima Church is a Catholic church in Shin-Kamigotō, Nagasaki, Japan.
1ebf4ce467a105d1.zh: 頭ヶ島天主堂是位於日本長崎縣新上五島町的天主教堂。

1edbbfb93d017355.en: Sekkei-ji is a Shingon Buddhist Temple located in Kōchi, Kōchi, Japan. It is the 33rd temple of the Shikoku Pilgrimage.
1edbbfb93d017355.zh: 雪蹊寺是位於日本高知縣高知市的真言宗寺院，為四國遍路第33號札所。

1edd4e1bbf7e6b95.en: In Fukui Prefecture, there is a celebration called "Satsukiage" after the completion of rice planting in the village. One of the treats served during this celebration is "ho’obameshi," where hot rice and sweet kinako (soybean flour) are wrapped in hō (magnolia) leaves, pressed, and made into a compact form. The use of hō leaves allows the fragrance to blend well with the piping hot rice, enhancing its flavor.
1edd4e1bbf7e6b95.zh: 在福井縣，村裡插秧結束後會舉行名為「さつきあげ」的慶祝活動。此時供應的食物之一是「ほうばめし」，將熱騰騰的白飯與甜黃豆粉包在朴葉中，壓成小巧的形狀。使用朴葉能讓香氣與熱騰騰的白飯充分融合，增添風味。

1f02ad7f7382d932.en: The Peace Museum of Saitama (埼玉県平和資料館, Saitama-ken Heiwa Shiryōkan) opened in Higashimatsuyama, Saitama Prefecture, Japan, in 1993. The museum collects and exhibits materials relating to the burgeoning militarism of the early Shōwa era and to the Pacific War, with a particular focus on the connection of these events with Saitama Prefecture.
1f02ad7f7382d932.zh: 埼玉縣平和資料館於1993年在日本埼玉縣東松山市開館。館方收集並展示與昭和初期日益高漲的軍國主義及太平洋戰爭相關的資料，特別著重這些事件與埼玉縣的關聯。

1f0dfd38ca5b6b13.en: Nara Prefectural Museum of Folklore (奈良県立民俗博物館, Nara Kenritsu Minzoku Hakubutsukan) opened in Yamatokōriyama, Nara Prefecture, Japan, in 1974. Located at the foot of the Yata Hills (矢田丘陵) within the 26.6 hectare Yamato Folk Park (大和民俗公園), the museum collects, preserves, and displays artefacts relating to everyday life in Nara Prefecture from the Edo period to the Shōwa 40s.
1f0dfd38ca5b6b13.zh: 奈良県立民俗博物館於1974年在日本奈良縣大和郡山市開館。館舍位於矢田丘陵山麓、占地26.6公頃的大和民俗公園內，收集、保存並展示江戶時代至昭和40年代奈良縣日常生活相關的文物。

1f4506a95f49300e.en: Myōhōshō-ji (妙法生寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the town of Ōtaki in Chiba Prefecture, and is a temple of the Nichiren sect. The temple was given its name in 1253, and is a reference to the opening line of the Lotus Sutra. Myōhōshō-ji is located deep in the Bōsō Hill Range in the center of the Bōsō Peninsula. The temple had fallen into nearly complete ruin by 1904, but was slowly rebuilt starting in 1931 by Nichiren Buddhists.
1f4506a95f49300e.zh: 妙法生寺是位於千葉縣大多喜町的佛教寺院，屬日蓮宗。寺名於1253年訂定，取自《法華經》的開頭經文。妙法生寺位於房總半島中央的房總丘陵深處。本寺到1904年時幾乎完全荒廢，自1931年起由日蓮宗信徒逐步重建。

1f55e275a899a7f8.en: Cape Irago (伊良湖岬, Irago-misaki?) is the terminal point of land at the west end of Atsumi Peninsula in southern Aichi Prefecture, Japan.  The cape forms one side of the entrances to Ise Bay and Mikawa Bay, which are divided by the Chita Peninsula.  Because it is a crucial landmark for ships Irago Lighthouse is located in the cape to help guide and warn passing ships.
1f55e275a899a7f8.zh: 伊良湖岬是日本愛知縣南部渥美半島西端的陸地終點。此岬構成伊勢灣與三河灣入口的一側，兩灣由知多半島分隔。由於此地是船隻航行的重要地標，岬上設有伊良湖岬燈塔，為往來船隻提供導引與警示。

1f5b52e7c7476e44.en: The "Omizutori" ceremony held every March at Todaiji Temple has a history of more than 1,200 years, and the original chahan (rice with green tea), called "gecha," is served along with tea porridge in the menu for the procession of participants.Chahan originated in Nara, but did not spread widely among the common people. Travelers who liked chahan brought it back to Edo (present-day Tokyo), and many Nara chahan stores were established near Sensoji Temple in Edo (present-day Tokyo), serving "Nara-cha" markers to attract customers.
1f5b52e7c7476e44.zh: 東大寺每年3月舉行的「お水取り」儀式已有超過1,200年的歷史，參與行列人員的餐點中，會供應稱為「げちゃ」的原始茶飯（以茶炊煮的飯）及茶粥。茶飯起源於奈良，但並未在一般百姓間普及。喜愛茶飯的旅人將其帶回江戶（今東京），江戶（今東京）淺草寺附近開設了許多奈良茶飯店，以「奈良茶」的招牌吸引顧客。

1f690113199ef022.en: Hoki Museum (ホキ美術館, Hoki Bijutsukan) is located in Midori-ku, Chiba, Japan. It opened on 3 November 2010 and is the country's first museum dedicated to Realist painting. The collection of over three hundred works includes pieces by Morimoto Sōsuke (森本草介), Noda Hiroshi (野田弘志), Aoki Toshiro (青木敏郎), Isoe Tsuyoshi (磯江毅) and Masayuki Hara. Tomohiko Yamanashi & Taro Nakamoto (Nikken Sekkei） were the architects.
1f690113199ef022.zh: ホキ美術館位於日本千葉市綠區，於2010年11月3日開館，是日本第一座專門收藏寫實繪畫的美術館。館藏三百多件作品，包括森本草介、野田弘志、青木敏郎、磯江毅及原雅幸等人的作品。建築由日建設計的山梨知彥與中本太郎設計。

1f911c1e01757b59.en: Aichi Prefecture is blessed with a mild climate throughout the year, partly due to the influence of the Kuroshio Current running through the Pacific Ocean. In addition, agriculture has long flourished due to the large rivers represented by the Kiso San-river (the generic name for the three rivers flowing through the Nobi Plain: the Kiso, Nagara, and Ibi Rivers) and water for agricultural use.
1f911c1e01757b59.zh: 愛知縣部分受到流經太平洋的黑潮影響，全年氣候溫和。此外，以木曾三川（流經濃尾平原的木曾川、長良川、揖斐川三條河川的總稱）為代表的大型河川與農業用水，使農業自古便十分興盛。

1fbeb9185917abe7.en: The Satsuma Kokubun-ji (薩摩国分寺) was a Buddhist temple in located in the Kokubunchō neighborhood of the city of Satsumasendai, Kagoshima Prefecture in the Kyushu region of Japan. It was the provincial temple ("kokubunji") of former Satsuma Province. Its location is now an archaeological site, which has been preserved as a National Historic Site since 1944. with the area under protection expanded in 1976 and 1982.
1fbeb9185917abe7.zh: 薩摩國分寺（薩摩国分寺）是位於日本九州地區鹿兒島縣薩摩川內市國分寺町的佛教寺院，為舊薩摩國的國分寺。其所在地現為考古遺址，自1944年起作為國家史跡受到保護，保護範圍於1976年及1982年擴大。

1fc412414e356776.en: During the Edo period (1603-1867), the teaching that "if you eat tree leaves or grass roots without using Miso, you will be exposed to its poison" spread, and Miso was used when eating tree leaves or grass roots. It is believed that Miso gradually developed from raw Miso to kneaded Miso, in which ingredients are kneaded together.Therefore, Miso paste made with seasonal ingredients has been handed down to the present. Among these seasonal Miso paste, "Bakke-miso" is the most commonly eaten Miso in Miyagi Prefecture.
1fc412414e356776.zh: 江戶時代（1603-1867），「吃樹葉或草根時若不用味噌，就會中毒」的說法流傳開來，因此人們在吃樹葉或草根時會搭配味噌。一般認為味噌逐漸從生味噌發展成將食材揉合在一起的練味噌。因此，用當季食材製作的味噌醬一直流傳至今。在這些當季味噌醬中，「ばっけ味噌」是宮城縣最常吃的味噌。

200986cbfe5f6ae0.en: The Saijō Sake Festival (西条酒まつり, Saijō Sake Matsuri) is a sake (rice wine) matsuri festival held annually in Saijō Higashihiroshima, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan.
200986cbfe5f6ae0.zh: 西條酒祭（西条酒まつり）是每年在日本廣島縣東廣島市西條舉行的日本酒祭典。

200f6a16b5a11be5.en: Oita Prefecture has a well-developed plateau and much of its land is unsuitable for rice cultivation, so field-based grain cultivation, such as wheat, has been popular for centuries. Since most of the grain was made into flour, the flour-based food culture has taken root in many places in Oita Prefecture. “Dango Jiru” (dumpling soup) is a good example of this.
200f6a16b5a11be5.zh: 大分縣台地發達，許多土地不適合種植稻米，因此數百年來盛行以旱田種植小麥等穀物。由於收成的穀物大多製成麵粉，以麵粉為主的飲食文化在大分縣各地紮根。「だんご汁」（麵疙瘩湯）就是其中一個代表例子。

2018c19151797691.en: Hatahata (a small-sized Japanese sandfish), with the head and entrails removed, is deep-fried whole in oil. Hatahata (a small-sized Japanese sandfish) is an easy-to-cook fish because it has no scales and its flesh peels off easily, and it is easy to eat because it is light tasting. It is therefore a familiar fish in households in the Tajima region.
2018c19151797691.zh: 將去除頭部與內臟的鰰（體型較小的日本叉牙魚）整條下油鍋油炸。鰰沒有魚鱗，魚肉容易剝離，烹調方便，加上味道清淡，容易入口，因此是但馬地區家庭中常見的魚。

2065b108db8e3a9f.en: Kyoto Prefecture has the Tango Mountains in the north, the Tanba Mountains in the center, and a low mountain range of less than 1000 meters, and most of the area from the Chutan region to the Nantan region is mountainous.
2065b108db8e3a9f.zh: 京都府北部有丹後山地，中部有丹波山地，為海拔不到1000公尺的低矮山地，中丹地區到南丹地區大部分為山區。

206af9f2d297bc23.en: Himakajima (日間賀島) is an inhabited island in Mikawa Bay in Aichi Prefecture, Japan off the coast of the Chita Peninsula, which is administered by the town of Minamichita, Aichi. All of the island is within the borders of the Mikawa-wan Quasi-National Park.  It draws many tourists who come to eat the octopus and blowfish caught off the island and prepared there, to enjoy the onsen, to fish, or to spend time on the beach. Per the 2015 Japanese census, the island had  a population of 1896 people in 607 households.
206af9f2d297bc23.zh: 日間賀島是日本愛知縣三河灣內、知多半島外海的有人島，由愛知縣南知多町管轄。全島位於三河灣國定公園範圍內。許多遊客前來品嘗在島周邊捕獲並於島上料理的章魚與河豚，或享受溫泉、釣魚、在海灘休憩。根據2015年日本國勢調查，島上有607戶、1896人。

206f9b07ff87f78f.en: Kumamoto City Zoological and Botanical Gardens (Japanese: 熊本市動植物園) is a 24 acre (9.7 ha) zoo and botanical garden located in Higasi-ku of Kumamoto, Japan. It was opened in 1969 and houses 550 animals, representing 110 species, and 70,000 plants across 700 species. In 2024, the park received 590,000 visitors; it offers educational programs for elementary and junior secondary schools.
206f9b07ff87f78f.zh: 熊本市動植物園是位於日本熊本市東區、面積24英畝（9.7公頃）的動物園及植物園。1969年開園，飼養110種、550隻動物，並種植700種、70,000株植物。2024年入園人數為59萬人；園方為小學及國中提供教育課程。

2073bea3dfa635a4.en: The Izumo Tamazukuri site (出雲玉作跡, Izumo tamazukuri iseki) is an archaeological site in the Tamayu-chō neighborhood of the city of Matsue, Shimane Prefecture, in the San'in region of western Japan. It contains the traces of a number of  workshops from the Kofun period where magatama and other beads were produced, It was designated a National Historic Site in 1922, with the area under protection expanded in 2004. The excavated items from this site were collectively designated a National Important Cultural Property in 1977.
2073bea3dfa635a4.zh: 出雲玉作跡是位於日本西部山陰地方島根縣松江市玉湯町的考古遺址，保存多處古墳時代製作勾玉及其他珠玉的工坊遺跡。1922年被指定為國家史跡，2004年擴大保護範圍。此處出土文物於1977年整體被指定為國家重要文化財。

209c96b46ec3eddc.en: Iwaya-ji (Japanese: 岩屋寺) is a Buddhist temple belonging to the Shingon-shū Buzan-ha sect, located in Nanatori, Kumakogen Town, Kamiukena District, Ehime Prefecture. Its sangō (mountain name) is Kaiganzan. The principal deity is Fudō Myōō. It is the 45th temple on the Shikoku Pilgrimage of 88 Temples.
209c96b46ec3eddc.zh: 岩屋寺（日語：岩屋寺）是位於愛媛縣上浮穴郡久萬高原町七鳥的真言宗豐山派寺院。山號為海岸山。本尊為不動明王。為四國八十八所靈場第45號札所。

20c52f6d353631fc.en: Hinase is a town located in the southeastern part of Okayama prefecture, on the border of Hyogo prefecture. As sung in the ancient Hinase Kouta, many fish come to the Seto Inland Sea to spawn in the spring, thus animating the fishing grounds. As depicted in its kanji character, Spanish mackerel is particularly representative of a springtime fish. From the middle of the Meiji era, Sawara no Kōko Sushi started being made with Spanish mackerel to celebrate a bountiful catch and to pray for the safety of fishermen.
20c52f6d353631fc.zh: 日生是位於岡山縣東南部、與兵庫縣交界的城鎮。如古老的日生小唄所唱，春天有許多魚來到瀨戶內海產卵，使漁場熱鬧起來。正如其漢字所示，鰆魚（土魠魚）是特別具代表性的春季魚種。從明治時代中期起，人們開始用鰆魚製作さわらのこうこずし，以慶祝豐收並祈求漁民平安。

20e7871218f802d7.en: This is an everyday staple in the Tsugaru region, handed down in each family since olden times, that combines the aubergines and shiso leaves that are gathered in large quantities during summertime. It is quite a simple dish: the aubergines are cut into long slices and spread with miso, then wrapped in shiso leaves and fried. While often made with red shiso leaves, green ones can be used too. They are served as a regular side dish, and are not made especially for any festivals or seasonal celebrations.
20e7871218f802d7.zh: 這是津輕地區的家常菜，自古以來在各家庭代代相傳，將夏季大量採收的茄子與紫蘇葉組合而成。做法相當簡單：茄子切成長片後抹上味噌，再以紫蘇葉包起來煎炸。通常使用紅紫蘇葉，也可以用青紫蘇葉。這道菜是日常配菜，並非特別為祭典或節令慶祝而做。

20e970dea2ef7f7d.en: Cape Toi (都井岬, Toi-misaki?) is a cape located in Kushima, Miyazaki, Japan, on the Nichinan coast bordering the Pacific Ocean. The cape is renowned for its beauty and for the wild horses that roam freely. A strip of land in the heart of Cape Toi includes Mount Ōgi and Komatsugaoka, which are classified as a national natural monument by the Agency for Cultural Affairs.
20e970dea2ef7f7d.zh: 都井岬是位於日本宮崎縣串間市的海岬，地處面向太平洋的日南海岸。此岬以景色優美及自由漫步的野馬聞名。都井岬中心地帶的一片土地包含扇山與小松丘，被文化廳列為國家天然紀念物。

20ebf18417fe8343.en: Nagao Shrine (長尾神社, Nagao-jinja) is a Shinto shrine dedicated to the goddesses Amaterasu-ōmikami,
20ebf18417fe8343.zh: 長尾神社是供奉天照大御神等女神的神社。

20f37b712929c6b9.en: Neiraku Museum (寧楽美術館, Neiraku Bijitsukan) is an art museum in the city of Nara, central Japan.
20f37b712929c6b9.zh: 寧楽美術館是位於日本中部奈良市的美術館。

211ad08547f1997d.en: “Satsuma Jiru" is a miso soup with a lot of ingredients including chicken. “Satsuma” is present-day Kagoshima Prefecture. According to the "Satsuma Kyudenshu" (the old biography of Kagoshima), the tradition of eating chicken by boiling it is said to have existed since old times. In Kagoshima Prefecture, since the Edo period (1603 - 1867), samurai of the Satsuma used to hold cockfighting competitions in order to raise their morale.
211ad08547f1997d.zh: 「さつま汁」是加了雞肉等大量配料的味噌湯。「薩摩」即現在的鹿兒島縣。根據《薩摩舊傳集》（鹿兒島的古代傳記），據說將雞肉煮來吃的傳統自古就有。在鹿兒島縣，自江戶時代（1603 - 1867）起，薩摩的武士為了提振士氣，會舉行鬥雞比賽。

212cf37d20c32239.en: Ogisai Kurokawa noh (王祗祭黒川能, Ōgisai Kurokawa nō) (or simply Kurokawa noh) is a noh festival in Kushibiki in Tsuruoka, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan.  It became an official Intangible Cultural Asset in 1976.
212cf37d20c32239.zh: 王祗祭黒川能（或簡稱黒川能）是在日本山形縣鶴岡市櫛引舉行的能樂祭典，於1976年成為官方認定的無形文化財。

2135316915ba596b.en: "Torimeshi chicken and rice" is a mixed rice dish for refreshments and handed down in the Meshiro area of Isahaya.From a long time ago, the custom during the New Year and Bon Lantern Festival was for men at home to cut, trim, and prepare chicken that they had raised. Even now, it is basically assumed that men prepare the dish. "Torimeshi chicken and rice" is also called "toimeshi." The name "toimeshi" derives from chicken being called "toi" in the locality.
2135316915ba596b.zh: 「鶏飯」是諫早目代地區流傳、用於招待的什錦飯。自古以來，新年與盂蘭盆節時，習俗上由家中男性宰殺、處理自家飼養的雞並烹調。即使現在，基本上仍由男性製作。「鶏飯」又稱「といめし」，此名稱來自當地將雞稱為「とい」。

21384ec4c41d873a.en: Shionomisaki Lighthouse (潮岬灯台, Shionomisaki tōdai) is a lighthouse located on Cape Shionomisaki, on the southern coast of Kii Peninsula in the Kansai region of Japan. Administratively, it is within the town of Kushimoto, Wakayama Prefecture.
21384ec4c41d873a.zh: 潮岬燈塔是位於日本關西地區紀伊半島南岸潮岬的燈塔。行政區劃屬和歌山縣串本町。

213b75b0cb56e414.en: Aoshima Shrine (青島神社, Aoshima jinja) is a Shinto shrine located on Aoshima island, Miyazaki Prefecture, Japan. It is dedicated to Hikohohodemi no Mikoto and Toyotama-hime.
213b75b0cb56e414.zh: 青島神社是位於日本宮崎縣青島上的神社，祭祀彥火火出見尊與豐玉姬。

214d6a54590ad073.en: Okudōgo Tamagawa Prefectural Natural Park (奥道後玉川県立自然公園, Okudōgo Tamagawa kenritsu shizen-kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Ehime Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1962, the park spans the borders of the municipalities of Imabari and Matsuyama. The area is centered around the upper reaches of the Ishite River in Matsuyama City.
214d6a54590ad073.zh: 奧道後玉川縣立自然公園（奥道後玉川県立自然公園）是位於日本愛媛縣的縣立自然公園。1962年設立，園區範圍橫跨今治市與松山市。區域以松山市石手川上游一帶為中心。

2152b5b04dc43b63.en: Ise-no-Umi Prefectural Natural Park (伊勢の海県立自然公園, Ise-no-Umi kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park on the coast of Mie Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1953, the park spans the municipalities of Suzuka and Tsu.
2152b5b04dc43b63.zh: 伊勢の海縣立自然公園是位於日本三重縣沿岸的縣立自然公園，1953年設立，範圍橫跨鈴鹿市與津市。

21592e279509d474.en: In Miyazaki Prefecture, sweet potatoes are called "Kansho", and "Nerikuri" made from sweet potatoes is eaten mainly in the vicinity of Miyakonojo City. It is also called "Nettabo," "Nettakuri," or "Karaimo-mochi" depending on the region. This dish has been made since the Edo period (1603-1867) and is a type of sweet potato rice cake made by combining rice cake and steamed sweet potato. In the old days, when pounding rice cakes for New Year's, boiled sweet potatoes were put into the last mortar of the rice and pounded up.
21592e279509d474.zh: 在宮崎縣，番薯被稱為「甘藷」，以番薯製作的「ねりくり」主要在都城市一帶食用。依地區不同，也被稱為「ねったぼ」、「ねったくり」或「唐芋餅」。這道料理自江戶時代（1603-1867）起便有人製作，是將麻糬與蒸番薯結合而成的一種番薯麻糬。從前在新年搗麻糬時，會將煮好的番薯放入最後一臼米中一起搗。

2159b1525bc13e19.en: Miharu Dam (三春ダム) is a concrete gravity dam on the Ōtakine River, a branch of the Abukuma River in the town of Miharu, Fukushima in the Tōhoku region of Japan. The dam was completed in 1997.
2159b1525bc13e19.zh: 三春水壩（三春ダム）是位於日本東北地方福島縣三春町、建於阿武隈川支流大滝根川上的混凝土重力壩，於1997年完工。

215bffda3046e079.en: The Ken Domon Museum of Photography (土門拳記念館, Domon Ken kinenkan) was opened in 1983 in Sakata, Yamagata (Japan), the birthplace of the photographer Ken Domon.
215bffda3046e079.zh: 土門拳記念館（Domon Ken kinenkan）於1983年在攝影家土門拳的出生地——日本山形縣酒田市開館。

21770802a8b69556.en: “Tamu dingaku”, also called“ sata dammu”, is a dish in which taimo are mashed and sweetened. It is also prepared as a dessert which pairs well with a fatty pork meal. Taimo are a local specialty of Okinawa, and are a variety of taro cultivated in clean water paddies.Also called mizuimo, in Okinawa Prefecture they are well-known and called tammu. Since the secondary and tertiary taro corm grow around the parent taro, it is considered a portentous ingredient for the flourishing of one's descendants, and is indispensable for celebratory meals.
21770802a8b69556.zh: ターンムディンガク又稱「サーターダーンム」，是將田芋搗成泥並加糖調味的料理。也會作為甜點，與油脂豐富的豬肉料理很搭。田芋是沖繩的特產，是在清水田中栽培的芋頭品種。也稱為水芋，在沖繩縣廣為人知，稱作ターンム。由於子芋、孫芋會圍繞著母芋生長，被視為象徵子孫繁榮的吉祥食材，是喜慶料理中不可或缺的。

2184b6bd49adf5f3.en: Hōtoku Ninomiya Shrine (報徳二宮神社) is a Japanese Shinto shrine dedicated to Ninomiya Sontoku (二宮尊徳) and is located in the City of Odawara in Kanagawa prefecture, Japan.
2184b6bd49adf5f3.zh: 報德二宮神社是一座祭祀二宮尊德的日本神社，位於日本神奈川縣小田原市。
