218ff7d17ce805ad.en: Kameyama Castle (沼城, Kameyama-jō), also well known as Numa Castle, is the remains of a castle structure in Higashi-ku, Okayama Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as an Okayama City Designated Historic Site.
218ff7d17ce805ad.zh: 亀山城 (備前国)，又以沼城之名廣為人知，是位於日本岡山縣東區的一處城郭遺跡。其遺跡已被指定為岡山市史跡加以保護。

21a50a37fefebb62.en: Sugi no Osugi (杉の大スギ), also known as "Osugi-san" by locals, is the world's tallest Japanese Cedar (Cryptomeria japonica) and is said to be over 3000 years old. It is located within the grounds of Yasaka Jinja in Ōtoyo, Kōchi Prefecture on Shikoku island in Japan.
21a50a37fefebb62.zh: 杉の大スギ又被當地人稱為「大杉さん」，是世界上最高的日本柳杉（Cryptomeria japonica），據說樹齡超過3000年。位於日本四國高知縣大豐町的八坂神社境內。

21a7674a7bff37bd.en: Shorenji Dam (青蓮寺ダム, Shōrenji damu) is a dam in Nabari, Mie Prefecture, Japan, completed in 1970. The dam impounds the Shorenji River, a left tributary of the Nabari River.
21a7674a7bff37bd.zh: 青蓮寺ダム是位於日本三重縣名張市的水壩，1970年完工，攔截名張川左岸支流青蓮寺川。

21a9af1c6d37baeb.en: "Kuwai(=arrowhead)," which is planted in late June to early July in rice fields, is a short-season ingredient with harvesting typically from late November to mid-December. Kuwai has been cultivated in the low-lying wetlands of the Ayase River basin in the southeastern part of the prefecture, which are unsuitable for rice cultivation. It is said that during a major flood in the Kanto region in 1786 (Tenmei 6), when rice cultivation suffered devastating damage, farmers were saved because Kuwai sold at high prices.
21a9af1c6d37baeb.zh: 「慈姑」於6月下旬至7月上旬種植在水田中，通常在11月下旬至12月中旬收成，產季很短。慈姑一直栽培於縣東南部綾瀨川流域不適合種稻的低窪濕地。據說1786年（天明6年）關東地區發生大洪水，稻作嚴重受災時，農民因慈姑賣得高價而得以度過難關。

21b02b4cd10b6488.en: Dōchi-yokan is a specialty of Shiga Prefecture, made by steaming wheat flour (or rice powder) mixed with a paste made from red beans and sugar. Another characteristic is that the yokan is wrapped in bamboo skin, and with a faint scent of bamboo, a springy texture, and a simple taste, this yokan is popular. When making kneaded yokan, agar is used, but it is said that wheat flour was used as a binding agent instead of agar because it was difficult to obtain in Omi, where there is no direct access to the sea.
21b02b4cd10b6488.zh: 丁稚羊羹是滋賀縣的特產，將小麥粉（或米粉）與紅豆和砂糖製成的豆沙混合後蒸製而成。另一項特色是用竹皮包裹，帶有淡淡竹香、口感有彈性、味道樸素，頗受歡迎。製作煉羊羹時會使用寒天，但據說由於不臨海的近江難以取得寒天，因此改用小麥粉作為黏合劑。

21b92402ed5ec54e.en: Obama Castle (小浜城, Obama-jō) was a mountain castle in the former Iwashiro (now Nihonmatsu), Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. The ruins of the inner tower are now part of a historical park.
21b92402ed5ec54e.zh: 小浜城是位於日本福島縣舊岩代町（今二本松市）的山城。內城塔樓遺址現為歷史公園的一部分。

21cb57825a75470e.en: Mekari Shrine (和布刈神社, Mekari-jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Moji-ku, Kitakyūshū, Fukuoka, Japan.
21cb57825a75470e.zh: 和布刈神社是位於日本福岡縣北九州市門司區的神社。

21cd9c50870d5515.en: Wat Paknam Japan (Thai: วัดปากน้ำญี่ปุ่น; Japanese: ワットパクナム日本別院) is the largest Thai Buddhist temple ('Wat') in Japan, located in Narita City, Chiba Prefecture. It was founded in 1998 as a branch temple of Wat Paknam, a temple in Thailand, to serve as a spiritual center for residents of Thai descent.
21cd9c50870d5515.zh: ワットパクナム日本別院（泰文：วัดปากน้ำญี่ปุ่น）是日本規模最大的泰國佛寺，位於千葉縣成田市。於1998年作為泰國寺院北欖寺的分寺創立，作為泰裔居民的心靈中心。

21dc01fa48489f08.en: Nanatsu Falls (七ツ滝, Nanatsu-taki) is a waterfall located in the city of Tsuruoka, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan, on a branch of the Bonji River. It is one of "Japan's Top 100 Waterfalls", in a listing published by the Japanese Ministry of the Environment in 1990.
21dc01fa48489f08.zh: 七ツ滝是位於日本山形縣鶴岡市、梵字川支流上的瀑布。為日本環境省於1990年公布的「日本瀑布百選」之一。

21de742e6ccb506b.en: Jōraku-ji (常楽寺) is a Buddhist temple in the city of Konan, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Tendai school of Japanese Buddhism. Its main image is a hibutsu statue of Senjū Kannon. Its Hondō and Three-story Pagoda are both National Treasures.: It is also referred to as Nishi-dera (西寺), whereas the temple of Chōjū-ji (長寿寺) is referred to as Higashi-dera (東寺).
21de742e6ccb506b.zh: 常樂寺是位於日本滋賀縣湖南市的佛寺，屬日本佛教天台宗。本尊為祕佛千手觀音像。本堂與三重塔皆為國寶。該寺又稱西寺，而長壽寺則稱為東寺。

21e5dfca73548745.en: The Izumo Kokufu (出雲国府) was the provincial capital of Izumo Province in the late Nara period though Heian period. It was located in the Okusa-cho, Yamashiro-cho, and Takeya-cho, neighborhoods of the city of Matsue, Shimane Prefecture in the San'in region of Japan. The ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1971.
21e5dfca73548745.zh: 出雲國府是奈良時代後期至平安時代出雲國的國府所在地，位於日本山陰地區島根縣松江市的大草町、山代町與竹矢町。遺跡自1971年起列為國家史跡受到保護。

21fece06dfbaf19a.en: Sōji-ji (総持寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Sōjiji neighborhood of the city of Ibaraki, Osaka Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the  Kōyasan Shingon-shū sect of Japanese Buddhism and its honzon (principle image) is a hibutsu (hidden / concealed image) statue of Senjū Jūichimen Kannon Bosatsu (Sahasrabhuja). The temple's full name is Fudaraku-san Katsuō-ji (補陀洛山 総持寺).The temple is the 22nd stop on the Saigoku Kannon Pilgrimage route.
21fece06dfbaf19a.zh: 總持寺是位於日本大阪府茨木市總持寺地區的佛教寺院，屬於高野山真言宗。本尊為祕佛千手十一面觀音菩薩像。寺院全名為補陀洛山總持寺。本寺是西國三十三所觀音巡禮的第22號札所。

21feef0ed3dc0edc.en: Yakuo-ji or Yakuō-ji (Yakuo Temple) (Japanese: 薬王寺) is a Koyasan Shingon temple in Minami, Kaifu District, Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. It is temple #23 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage. The main image is of Yakushi Nyorai (Bhaiṣajyaguru: "King of Medicine Master and Lapis Lazuli Light").
21feef0ed3dc0edc.zh: 薬王寺是位於日本德島縣海部郡美波町的高野山真言宗寺院，為四國八十八所巡禮第23號札所，本尊為藥師如來（藥師琉璃光王如來）。

220b29cc535fb0e0.en: Imabota, a recipe passed down from olden times on the Yumihama Peninsula, is a sweet rice ball made from sweet potatoes. Due to its soft, sandy solid, the Yumihama Peninsula was unsuitable for growing rice. During the Edo period, Ido Heizaemon, the Omori governor of the Iwami Silver Mine, ordered sweet potato seeds suitable for the soil from Satsuma Province to Sanin. Afterwards, the cultivation of sweet potatoes flourished. After the 20th year of the Meiji Era, sweet potatoes were grown as the primary crop.
220b29cc535fb0e0.zh: 「いもぼた」是弓濱半島自古流傳的做法，是用番薯製成的甜飯糰。弓濱半島因土質鬆軟多沙，不適合種稻。江戶時代，石見銀山的大森代官井戶平左衛門從薩摩國訂購適合當地土壤的番薯種苗送往山陰。此後番薯栽培興盛起來。明治20年以後，番薯成為主要作物。

220b322a84287a93.en: In the Edo period (1813) “Matsuzaka Fuzokuki” (previously called “Matsuzaka”), which recorded the annual events and customs of Matsuzaka, there’s a record which is thought to indicate “bon jiru.” It states: “The soup is made of burdock, eggplant, and dried gourd shavings.
220b322a84287a93.zh: 江戶時代（1813年）記錄松坂年中行事與風俗的《松坂風俗記》（舊稱《松坂》）中，有一段被認為是指「盆汁」的記載，內容為：「湯以牛蒡、茄子、干瓢製成。」

220ba6c0304ce328.en: It is said that "Sakura-mochi" was invented in 1717 by a man named Shinroku Yamamoto, who lived in front of the Chomeiji Temple and worked as an official of the temple. Since that time, Sumida-zutsumi (Bokutei Street) has been a famous cherry blossom viewing spot.The idea came to him while he was cleaning up the large number of fallen cherry leaves on the bank of the river, so he pickled the leaves in salt and wrapped a rice cake with sweet bean paste inside.
220ba6c0304ce328.zh: 據說「桜もち」是由住在長命寺門前、擔任寺院職員的山本新六於1717年所發明。從那時起，隅田堤（墨堤通）便是著名的賞櫻地點。他在清掃河岸上大量掉落的櫻葉時想到這個點子，於是將葉子用鹽醃漬，包住內有甜豆沙餡的米糕。

2215e1e9eb519c09.en: Hōzen-ji (法善寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Jōdo-shū sect in Chūō-ku, Osaka, Japan. The temple is located in the Dotonbori district, near Namba Station. It has a reputation in Japan for helping women who are about to give birth.
2215e1e9eb519c09.zh: 法善寺是位於日本大阪市中央區的淨土宗佛教寺院，地處道頓堀一帶，鄰近難波站。在日本以保佑即將生產的婦女而聞名。

2227258fbc134359.en: Saku Children's Science Dome for the Future (佐久市子ども未来館) is a science museum located in Saku, Nagano, Japan. The mission of the museum is "Bringing up of highly creative children through spreading and enlightening them of scientific knowledge".
2227258fbc134359.zh: 佐久市子ども未来館是位於日本長野縣佐久市的科學館，宗旨為「透過普及與啟發科學知識，培育富有創造力的孩子」。

2228fa95c759ed8c.en: Shigitatsu-an (Japanese: 鴫立庵) is a haikai dojo (Japanese: 俳諧道場) in Ōiso, Kanagawa, Japan, where people learn haiku poetry from the master there or from each other. It is one of the three important such dojo, the other two being Rakushi-sha (落柿舎) in Sagano, Kyoto, and Mumei-an (無名庵) in Ōtsu, Shiga.
2228fa95c759ed8c.zh: 鴫立庵是位於日本神奈川縣大磯的俳諧道場，人們在此向庵主或彼此學習俳句。它是三大俳諧道場之一，另外兩處為京都嵯峨野的落柿舍，以及滋賀大津的無名庵。

2231627a1d7ef447.en: The Museum of Shiga Prefecture Biwako-Bunkakan (滋賀県立琵琶湖文化館) is a museum in the capital city of Shiga Prefecture, Japan.
2231627a1d7ef447.zh: 滋賀縣立琵琶湖文化館是位於日本滋賀縣縣廳所在地的博物館。

223203fb4a3cfed6.en: The Gifu Memorial Center (岐阜メモリアルセンター, Gifu Memoriaru Sentā) is a collection of sports facilities located in Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It is a prefectural facility and its purpose is to promote sports and other events within the prefecture.
223203fb4a3cfed6.zh: 岐阜メモリアルセンター是位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市的綜合運動設施群。屬於縣立設施，目的在推廣縣內的體育及其他活動。

22370548d7c2a83e.en: The Sakai clan Gardens (酒井氏庭園, Sakai-shi teien) is a traditional Japanese garden located in the city of Tsuruoka, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan, which is a nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty
22370548d7c2a83e.zh: 酒井氏庭園是位於日本山形縣鶴岡市的傳統日本庭園，為國家指定名勝。

2263a6a8e8cad6f5.en: Mount Hinokizukia Okumine (桧塚奥峰, Hinokizuka-okumine) is a 1,420 m (4,659 ft) mountain, in Matsusaka, Mie, Japan.
2263a6a8e8cad6f5.zh: 桧塚奥峰是位於日本三重縣松阪市的山，海拔1,420公尺（4,659英尺）。

227121aff3b82b6d.en: Gunma Insect World (ぐんま昆虫の森, Gunma Konchū-no Mori) Insect Observation Facility in Kiryū, Gunma, Japan is a learning facility for observing the ecology of insects. The building was designed by Tadao Ando, built by Takenaka Corporation with three other firms, and opened in 2005. The facility offers outdoor hands-on experience to allow visitors to observe and learn more about the world of insects.
227121aff3b82b6d.zh: ぐんま昆虫の森是位於日本群馬縣桐生市的昆蟲觀察設施，為觀察昆蟲生態的學習設施。建築由安藤忠雄設計，竹中工務店與另外三家公司共同施工，於2005年開幕。設施提供戶外實地體驗，讓參觀者觀察並進一步認識昆蟲的世界。

22854ab6accdb1b6.en: Kakunodate-matsuri (角館祭り) is a Japanese festival celebrated from 7 to 9 September in Kakunodate, Akita. Its rites centre on Shinmei-sha shrine. As well as a procession and traditional dances, it is celebrated for the oyamabayashi in which the floats collide into each other. It has a 350-year history, and in 1991 was designated an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property.
22854ab6accdb1b6.zh: 角館祭（角館祭り）是9月7日至9日在秋田縣角館舉行的日本祭典，祭儀以神明社為中心。除了遊行與傳統舞蹈外，以山車互相衝撞的「おやまばやし」聞名。祭典已有350年歷史，1991年被指定為重要無形民俗文化財。

229a6a39637057ed.en: The Yōrō River (養老川, Yōrōgawa) is a river in Chiba Prefecture, Japan. It is 73.4 kilometers (45.6 mi) in length and has a drainage area of 260 square kilometers (100 sq mi). Under the Rivers Act of 1906 the Yōrō is designated as a Class 2 River. The Yōrō originates near Mount Kiyosumi on the border of Amatsukominato area of Kamogawa and Ōtaki, and then passes through Ōtaki and Ichihara.
229a6a39637057ed.zh: 養老川是日本千葉縣的河川，全長73.4公里（45.6英里），流域面積260平方公里（100平方英里）。依據1906年的《河川法》，養老川被指定為二級河川。養老川發源於鴨川市天津小湊地區與大多喜町交界的清澄山附近，之後流經大多喜町與市原市。

229c00aa80672397.en: It is a local dish of boiled anglerfish dipped in vinegared miso paste with liver. Anglerfish is a local product of Ibaraki prefecture, highly regarded for its quality, especially as that of the Hitachi region. Anglerfish fishing has been popular off the coast of Ibaraki for a long time, and it had been presented to Tokugawa Shogun as a delicacy of the Mito Domain in the Edo period (1603-1867). Although anglerfish dishes are also available in other prefectures, the one dipped in miso-vinegar is unique to Ibaraki.
229c00aa80672397.zh: 這是將燙熟的鮟鱇魚沾上加入魚肝的醋味噌食用的在地料理。鮟鱇魚是茨城縣的特產，品質受到高度評價，尤其是常陸地區所產。茨城近海自古盛行捕撈鮟鱇魚，江戶時代（1603-1867年）曾作為水戶藩的珍饈進獻給德川將軍。其他縣也有鮟鱇魚料理，但沾醋味噌食用的吃法為茨城獨有。

229f495038cb443b.en: Mount Yudono (湯殿山, Yudono-san) is one of the Three Mountains of Dewa in the ancient province of Dewa (modern-day Yamagata Prefecture). The Yudonosan Shrine, the most holy of the Dewa Sanzan shrines, is located on the mountain.
229f495038cb443b.zh: 湯殿山（Yudono-san）是位於古代出羽國（今山形縣）的出羽三山之一。出羽三山神社中最神聖的湯殿山神社即位於此山。

22a20931336eb853.en: Oyama, located 1,252 meters above sea level and part of the Tanzawa Oyama National Park, is famous for its tofu, which makes use of the good quality water of the Tanzawa mountain range. Tofu is very soft with high water content and has a light flavor. Because it can be easily combined with any ingredients, a variety of tofu dishes are served in local households, but the two most popular are "chilled tofu" and "yudofu," which allow the flavors of the ingredients to be enjoyed as they are.Because Mt.
22a20931336eb853.zh: 大山海拔1,252公尺，屬於丹澤大山國定公園，以利用丹澤山系優質水源製作的豆腐聞名。豆腐含水量高、質地非常柔軟，風味清淡。由於容易與各種食材搭配，當地家庭會做各式豆腐料理，其中最受歡迎的是能品嘗食材原味的「冷豆腐」與「湯豆腐」。因為大山

22a6315d4433c99b.en: Botan-nabe" is a local dish of Tamba Sasayama City. It is a one-pot dish of wild boar meat and seasonal vegetables simmered in a broth based on a combination of white and red miso.It is said to have originated around 1908, when the 70th Infantry Regiment of the Army was stationed in Sasayama Town, Taki County, and the meat of wild boar captured during training was put into a miso soup and eaten, or brought to ryokan (Japanese inns) and made into a miso-based nabe.
22a6315d4433c99b.zh: 「ぼたん鍋」是丹波篠山市的在地料理，是將山豬肉與當季蔬菜放入以白味噌和紅味噌調和的湯底燉煮的火鍋。據說起源於1908年左右，當時陸軍步兵第70聯隊駐紮於多紀郡篠山町，將訓練時捕獲的山豬肉放入味噌湯食用，或帶到旅館做成味噌鍋。

22a65c6f25f560b4.en: Mount Ōmuro (大室山, Ōmuroyama) is a mountain at an altitude of 1,588 m on the border between Yamanashi and Kanagawa Prefectures in the northern part of the Tanzawa Mountains. It used to be called "Omureyama". It is counted as one of the 100 famous mountains in Yamanashi, and the Kanagawa side is designated as Tanzawa-Ōyama National Monument.
22a65c6f25f560b4.zh: 大室山是位於丹澤山地北部、山梨縣與神奈川縣交界的山，海拔1,588公尺，過去稱為「おむれやま」。名列山梨百名山之一，神奈川縣一側被指定為丹澤大山國定公園。

22af0f14b65ce910.en: Sobieto (Japanese: ソビエト) is an uninhabited islet in Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. It is famous for its unusual name resembling the Soviet Union ("sobieto" means "Soviet" in Japanese) and the unknown origin of the name.
22af0f14b65ce910.zh: ソビエト是位於日本和歌山縣的無人小島。此島以酷似蘇聯的特殊名稱（日語「ソビエト」意為「蘇維埃」）以及名稱由來不明而聞名。

22d39a942ead7c3d.en: Trout Ankake is a springtime dish representative of the Shonai area. It is made from the most delicious of all trout, “Sakuramasu” or cherry trout. When cherry trout is young, they fight for their territory. The losing fish go down to the sea and become “Sakuramasu” or cherry trout, while the winning fish stay in the river to grow to become “yamame” or landlocked trout.
22d39a942ead7c3d.zh: 鱒のあんかけ是庄內地區具代表性的春季料理。使用鱒魚中最美味的「櫻鱒」製作。櫻鱒幼魚時會爭奪地盤，落敗的魚游向大海成為「櫻鱒」，獲勝的魚則留在河川中長成「山女魚」（陸封型鱒魚）。

22f080e1f5b4ed82.en: Kenchū-ji (建中寺) is a Jōdo-shū Buddhist temple in Tsutsui, Higashi-ku, Nagoya, central Japan. Starting in the Edo period, the mausoleums of the lords of the Owari Domain were located there, making it the Bodaiji of the Owari Tokugawa family.
22f080e1f5b4ed82.zh: 建中寺是位於日本中部名古屋市東區筒井的淨土宗佛教寺院。自江戶時代起，尾張藩歷代藩主的陵墓設於此處，使其成為尾張德川家的菩提寺。

23038f970f59373f.en: Kawagoe Sports Park Athletics Stadium (川越運動公園陸上競技場) is an athletics stadium in  Kawagoe, Saitama, Japan. It is located within the Kawagoe Sports Park, which also includes a general gymnasium, and tennis courts.
23038f970f59373f.zh: 川越運動公園陸上競技場是位於日本埼玉縣川越市的田徑場，位於川越運動公園內，園內另設有綜合體育館及網球場。

233c4ee97f57bd34.en: All sakura shrimp caught in Japan come from the Suruga Bay of Shizuoka prefecture. Sakura shrimp live in schools at sea depths of 400 to 600 meters. Their spawning season is between June to August, and during this period, fishing is prohibited to protect natural resources. Fishing in the spring takes place from mid-March to early June, and fishing in the autumn takes place between the end of October to the end of December. When catching sakura shrimp, only those floating on the surface of the ocean at night are caught.
233c4ee97f57bd34.zh: 日本捕獲的櫻花蝦全部來自靜岡縣的駿河灣。櫻花蝦成群棲息於水深400至600公尺的海中。產卵期為6月至8月，這段期間為保護自然資源而禁止捕撈。春季漁期為3月中旬至6月上旬，秋季漁期為10月底至12月底。捕撈櫻花蝦時，只捕捉夜間浮到海面上的蝦。

236aaf2171b94506.en: Known as the “gangster of the sea”, the utsubo (moray eel) has an unpredictable temperament as well as sharp upper and lower teeth. The fierce-looking utsubo only consumed in several regions, including the southern region of Wakayama Prefecture. There are about 200 recognized species of utsubo, most of which are 1-1.5 meters long and weigh 1-5 kilograms. Utsubo are in season from November to March, but those caught during the cold season are more delicious because they are fatty and do not smell as much.
236aaf2171b94506.zh: 有「海中流氓」之稱的うつぼ（裸胸鯙）性情難以捉摸，上下顎都有銳利的牙齒。這種外表兇猛的うつぼ只在和歌山縣南部等少數地區食用。已知的うつぼ約有200種，大多長1至1.5公尺、重1至5公斤。うつぼ的產季為11月到3月，寒冷季節捕獲的較肥美、腥味較少，因此更美味。

237ab0c47be043d3.en: Hirosaki City Museum (弘前市立博物館, Hirosaki Shiritsu Hakubutsukan) opened in Hirosaki, Aomori Prefecture, Japan in 1977. It lies within Hirosaki Park, in the former grounds of Hirosaki Castle. As of March 2016, the collection numbered some eighteen thousand items, including an assemblage of artefacts excavated from the Sunazawa Site that have been designated an Important Cultural Property.
237ab0c47be043d3.zh: 弘前市立博物館於1977年在日本青森縣弘前市開館，位於弘前公園內、弘前城舊址範圍中。截至2016年3月，館藏約一萬八千件，其中包括被指定為重要文化財的砂澤遺跡出土文物。

23b91117de05ffc1.en: The Okyōzuka Site  (御経塚遺跡, Okyōzuka iseki) is an archaeological site with the ruins of a middle to final Jōmon period  (around 1700–500 BC) settlement in the Kyōzuka neighborhood of the city of Nonoichi, Ishikawa in the Hokuriku region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1977.
23b91117de05ffc1.zh: 御經塚遺跡是位於日本北陸地區石川縣野野市市經塚一帶的考古遺址，保存有繩文時代中期至晚期（約西元前1700年至前500年）聚落的遺跡。1977年被指定為日本國家史跡。

23bcf65bc4e7e627.en: The Chiba Zoological Park is located in Chiba Prefecture, east of Tokyo, Japan, and near the shore of Tokyo Bay. The park can be accessed by the Chiba Monorail and is open between 9:30am and 4:30pm.
23bcf65bc4e7e627.zh: 千葉市動物公園位於日本東京以東的千葉縣，鄰近東京灣沿岸。可搭乘千葉單軌電車前往，開放時間為上午9:30至下午4:30。

23e3d10e56f6e983.en: In Yamagata Prefecture, it was common for people to make natto (fermented soybeans) at home as a way of preserving food to get through the winter when foodstuffs are in short supply. Natto was made by stuffing boiled soybeans into a tube made of straw and placing it in a warm place such as beside the kotatsu (heating table covered with a blanket) for one or two nights. In the Murayama area of Oe Town, fermented soybeans without strings are made into "Natto Jiru” (natto soup).
23e3d10e56f6e983.zh: 在山形縣，為了度過食材短缺的冬季，人們普遍在家自製納豆作為保存食物的方法。納豆的做法是將煮好的黃豆塞進稻草做成的筒子裡，放在暖桌（蓋著被子的取暖桌）旁等溫暖處一到兩晚。在大江町的村山地區，會將不牽絲的發酵黃豆做成「納豆汁」（納豆湯）。

23e805fad43ab39b.en: Chōjū-ji (長寿寺) is a Buddhist temple in the city of Konan, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Tendai school of Japanese Buddhism. Its main image is a hibutsu statue of Jizō Bosatsu. Its Hondō is a National Treasure.: It is also referred to as  Higashi-dera (東寺), whereas the temple of Jōraku-ji (長寿寺) is referred to as Nishi-dera (西寺).
23e805fad43ab39b.zh: 長壽寺是位於日本滋賀縣湖南市的佛教寺院，屬日本佛教天台宗。主尊為秘佛地藏菩薩像。其本堂為國寶。本寺又稱東寺，而常樂寺則稱西寺。

23ec6d90fa8b93b9.en: Komaru Castle (小丸城, Komaru-jō) was a Japanese castle located in what is now the city of  Echizen Fukui Prefecture, in the Hokuriku region of Japan.  Built in the Sengoku period by Sassa Narimasa, the ruins are now a Fukui Prefectural Historic Site.
23ec6d90fa8b93b9.zh: 小丸城是位於今日本北陸地方福井縣越前市的日本城郭。由佐佐成政於戰國時代興建，遺址現為福井縣史跡。

2406c1b0b0302d09.en: The Sezon Museum of Modern Art is an art museum located in Karuizawa, Nagano Prefecture, Japan. The museum hosts exhibitions on contemporary art.
2406c1b0b0302d09.zh: セゾン現代美術館是位於日本長野縣輕井澤的美術館，舉辦當代藝術展覽。

240d8c86a8cba05e.en: "Mozuku-don" is a dish fried "mozuku" seaweed with meat and vegetables, then put on top of cooked rice. It is loved by people regardless of age or gender because it tastes sweet-and salty and does not have unique seaweed smell by adding ginger juice. It became famous due to its popularity in the school lunch, and now it is prepared at home, too. It is said that "mozuku", you can easily buy at supermarkets, is good for beauty and health because it has plenty of minerals and vitamins to moisturize skin and fucoidan to antioxidant.
240d8c86a8cba05e.zh: もずく丼是將海蘊與肉、蔬菜一起炒過，再蓋在白飯上的料理。口味甜鹹，加入薑汁後沒有海藻特有的腥味，因此不分男女老少都喜愛。因在學校營養午餐中大受歡迎而出名，如今家庭也會製作。在超市就能輕鬆買到的海蘊，含有豐富的礦物質與維生素，能滋潤肌膚，還有具抗氧化作用的褐藻醣膠，據說有益美容與健康。

2424000d9952a526.en: Taku Seibyō (多久聖廟)  is a Confucian temple in the city of Taku, Saga Prefecture, Japan. It was designated a National Historic Site in 1921 and a National Important Cultural Property in 1933.
2424000d9952a526.zh: 多久聖廟是位於日本佐賀縣多久市的孔廟。1921年被指定為國家史跡，1933年被指定為國家重要文化財。

244546a68a660f59.en: Narezushi has long been a common sight at festivals as well as local and regional events. It is a preserved food that makes use of fermented rice to preserve fish, and the technique involved in making narezushi is still in use today. Wakayama's narezushi is said to be one of the three most famous narezushi in Japan, with a history of more than 800 years. There are various theories about the origin of narezushi, but it is said to have originated when salted mackerel was stuffed with rice and wrapped in leaves.
244546a68a660f59.zh: なれずし長久以來常見於祭典及地方、地區的活動中。這是利用發酵的米飯保存魚類的保存食品，製作なれずし的技法至今仍在使用。和歌山的なれずし據說是日本三大なれずし之一，歷史超過800年。關於なれずし的起源有多種說法，據說源自將米飯塞進鹽漬鯖魚中、再以葉子包裹的做法。

246de30c3371616f.en: Mount Ikeda (池田山, Ikeda-san, Ikeda-yama) is a mountain located in the towns of Ikeda and Ibigawa, in Ibi District, Gifu Prefecture, Japan.
246de30c3371616f.zh: 池田山是位於日本岐阜縣揖斐郡池田町與揖斐川町的山。

2475d2f6e664147b.en: Satake-ji (佐竹寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Tenjinbayashi-chō neighborhood of the town of Hitachiōta, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Buzan-branch of Shingon Buddhism and its honzon is a statue of Jūichimen Kannon Bosatsu, also popularly known as the Kitamuke Kannon (北向観音).  The temple's full name is Myōfuku-zan Myōn-in Satake-ji (妙福山 明音院 佐竹寺).The temple is the 22nd stop on the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route.
2475d2f6e664147b.zh: 佐竹寺是位於日本茨城縣常陸太田市天神林町的佛教寺院，屬真言宗豐山派，本尊為十一面觀音菩薩像，俗稱「北向觀音」。寺院全名為妙福山 明音院 佐竹寺。該寺為坂東三十三所朝聖路線的第22番札所。

248c393ef9366ce3.en: Brown sugar" is sugar made by cutting sugarcane into small pieces and boiling down the juice squeezed out by a press. It is known as a specialty of the Amami region and Okinawa Prefecture.The Amami Islands are said to have been under the rule of the Ryukyu Kingdom until the 16th century, then under the Satsuma Domain in the Edo period (1603-1868), and then under the rule of the U.S. after the war. The area has been influenced by the history of brown sugar, which was a very high quality foodstuff.
248c393ef9366ce3.zh: 「黑糖」是將甘蔗切成小段，以壓榨機榨出汁液熬煮而成的糖，以奄美地區和沖繩縣的特產聞名。據說奄美群島在16世紀前受琉球王國統治，江戶時代（1603-1868）受薩摩藩統治，戰後則受美國統治。這個地區受到黑糖歷史的影響，黑糖曾是非常高級的食品。

24a66132c92bc511.en: Zuiraku-en (瑞楽園) (also Tsushima Family Gardens) is a Japanese dry landscape garden and nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty in the city of Hirosaki, Aomori Prefecture, Japan. The gardens are a nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty.
24a66132c92bc511.zh: 瑞樂園（瑞楽園）（又稱津島家庭園）是位於日本青森縣弘前市的日本枯山水庭園，為國家指定名勝。此庭園為國家指定名勝。

24d7b8d87dbb50ff.en: Shiga Kogen (志賀高原, Shiga-kōgen) is a ski resort and hiking spot, located in the Jōshin'etsu-kōgen National Park in the highlands of Yamanouchi, Nagano, Japan. In 1980, an area of 13,000 hectares (50 sq mi) was designated a UNESCO Man and the Biosphere Reserve.
24d7b8d87dbb50ff.zh: 志賀高原是位於日本長野縣山之內町高原、上信越高原國立公園內的滑雪場及健行地點。1980年，其中13,000公頃（50平方英里）的區域被指定為聯合國教科文組織人與生物圈保護區。

25026872ea375c10.en: Kiyotsu Gorge (清津峡, Kiyotsu-kyō) is a nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty and Natural Monument  on the border between Yuzawa and Tōkamachi, Niigata Prefecture, Japan.
25026872ea375c10.zh: 清津峡是位於日本新潟縣湯澤與十日町交界處的國家指定名勝及天然紀念物。

253a01bcc678d310.en: Mount Sekidō (石動山, Sekidōzan) is a 564 metres (1,850 ft) mountain on the border of Nanao and Nakanoto in Ishikawa Prefecture and the town of Himi, in Toyama Prefecture. It is also called Mount Isurugi (伊須流岐山, Isurugizan). Mount Sekidō was considered a holy mountain and was the center of a mountain cult since the Heian period. It was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1978. It is located with the borders of the Noto Hantō Quasi-National Park.
253a01bcc678d310.zh: 石動山是一座高564公尺（1,850英尺）的山，位於石川縣七尾市、中能登町與富山縣冰見市的交界處，又稱伊須流岐山。石動山自平安時代起被視為聖山，是山岳信仰的中心。1978年被指定為日本國家史跡。位於能登半島國定公園範圍內。

2554d2d5b85b2132.en: Iizushi, a type of narezushi (matured sushi) that has been handed down from generation to generation in Murakami City, originated as a preserved food. It is a local dish made by marinating thin slices of salmon, herring roe, carrots, daikon radish, salmon roe, hizu (cartilaginous part of the tip of the nose of salmon), and yuzu in rice and koji (malt) and fermenting it. The slow fermentation at low temperatures gives the koji a mild sourness, aroma, and sweetness. Salt-dried salmon, a specialty of Murakami City, is used.
2554d2d5b85b2132.zh: 飯ずし是村上市代代相傳的一種熟壽司，起源於保存食品。這道鄉土料理是將鮭魚薄片、鯡魚卵、紅蘿蔔、白蘿蔔、鮭魚卵、氷頭（鮭魚鼻尖的軟骨部分）和柚子以米飯和麴醃漬發酵而成。在低溫下緩慢發酵，使麴帶有溫和的酸味、香氣和甜味。使用村上市特產的鹽引鮭。

2561a4ec759ada44.en: Sabishiro Beach (淋代海岸, sabishirokaigan) is a recreational beach in Misawa, Aomori, Japan. The beach is known for being the site where the Miss Veedol departed from to become the first plane to complete a non-stop flight across the Pacific Ocean. Between 1930 and 1932 five planes attempted the journey. The long, flat shoreline composed of a stable mixture of sand and clay was well suited for developing a runway for such attempts.
2561a4ec759ada44.zh: 淋代海岸是位於日本青森縣三澤市的休閒海灘。此處以「Miss Veedol號」的起飛地點聞名，該機為首架完成不著陸飛越太平洋的飛機。1930年至1932年間，共有五架飛機嘗試這段航程。這片海岸線長而平坦，由穩定的砂土與黏土混合而成，適合闢建供這類嘗試使用的跑道。

25645aca5b9ed238.en: Murodō (室堂, Muro-do; IPA: [Murodo]) is a volcanic plateau located near Tateyama in Toyama Prefecture, central Honshu, in Japan.
25645aca5b9ed238.zh: 室堂是位於日本本州中部富山縣立山附近的火山高原。

259ef300bb2c662d.en: Tanabata-jinja (七夕神社), also known as Himekoso-jinja (媛社神社), is a Shinto shrine located in Ogōri, Fukuoka prefecture, Japan. It is dedicated to Orihime, the Japanese name of the Weaver Girl from the Chinese folk tale The Weaver Girl and the Cowherd. The weaver is celebrated in Tanabata, a Japanese festival.
259ef300bb2c662d.zh: 七夕神社又稱媛社神社，是位於日本福岡縣小郡市的神社，供奉織姬，即中國民間故事《牛郎織女》中織女的日本名稱。織女在日本的七夕祭中受到慶祝。

25a199d51ead4bef.en: The Iruma River (入間川, Iruma-gawa), is a river in Saitama Prefecture, Japan. It is 63 kilometres (39 mi) long and has a watershed of 721 square kilometres (278 sq mi).
25a199d51ead4bef.zh: 入間川是日本埼玉縣的河川，全長63公里（39英里），流域面積721平方公里（278平方英里）。

25dd2cbf183493f9.en: Fukuoka Dam (Japanese: 福岡堰, fukuoka seki) is a dam that spans the Kokai River in Tsukubamirai, Ibaraki, Japan. It is one of the three largest dams in the Kanto Region. It is also the location of the Fukuoka Dam Sakura Park.
25dd2cbf183493f9.zh: 福岡堰（日語：福岡堰，ふくおかせき）是橫跨日本茨城縣筑波未來市小貝川的堰壩，為關東地區三大堰之一。此處也是福岡堰櫻公園的所在地。

26118542476aa505.en: When it comes to rice balls, it is standard practice for Toyama residents to roll them in tororo kombu, or dried kelp shavings, rather than toasted nori seaweed. They are representative of local dishes that make use of dried kelp shavings. Although Toyama Prefecture is one of the largest consumers of kelp in Japan, kelp is actually rarely harvested in the prefecture. The origin of the kelp culture in Toyama can be traced back to the Kitamaebune ships that operated along the Japan Sea coast during the Edo period (1603-1867).
26118542476aa505.zh: 說到飯糰，富山人的慣例是裹上とろろ昆布（乾昆布刨絲），而不是烤海苔。這是運用とろろ昆布的代表性鄉土料理。富山縣雖然是日本昆布消費量最大的地區之一，縣內其實幾乎不產昆布。富山昆布文化的起源可追溯到江戶時代（1603-1867）航行於日本海沿岸的北前船。

262da73c41829252.en: Ondō Bridge (音戸大橋, Ondō Ōhashi) also known as Ondoo Bridge and Ondo Bridge is a red road bridge that connects the mainland of Kure City, Hiroshima, with Kurahashi Island (formerly Ondo Town, Aki District).
262da73c41829252.zh: 音戶大橋（音戸大橋），又稱Ondoo Bridge或Ondo Bridge，是一座紅色公路橋，連接廣島縣吳市本土與倉橋島（舊安藝郡音戶町）。

263b29d99a43348c.en: “Grilled Mackerel Simmered Dish” has been cherished as a commoner's taste in the eastern region for a long time. In the Sea of Japan, a large quantity of mackerel was caught, but in an era without advanced preservation techniques, many vendors would grill and then ship the mackerel to extend its shelf life. The readily available grilled mackerel became a convenient and simple fish dish for farmers, even during busy farming seasons.Grilled Mackerel Simmered in soy based sauce originated from the wisdom of common people.
263b29d99a43348c.zh: 「焼き鯖の煮付け」長久以來在東部地區作為庶民的味道而受到喜愛。日本海捕獲大量鯖魚，但在保存技術不發達的年代，許多商販會先將鯖魚烤過再運送，以延長保存期限。容易取得的烤鯖魚，即使在農忙時期，也成為農家方便又簡單的魚料理。以醬油為基底的醬汁燉煮烤鯖魚，源自庶民的智慧。

2656ded623e8a947.en: "Saba Stick Sushi" is a traditional local dish that is a staple during festivals. In addition to "Saury Stick Sushi," there are many other sushi dishes using mackerel, such as grilled mackerel sushi, whole mackerel sushi, and pickled mackerel sushi. The reason for the abundance of mackerel-based dishes is that mackerel is readily available in the Kohoku and Kosei regions. There has been a historical route for transporting seafood caught in Wakasa Bay to Kyoto, passing through the Kosei region.
2656ded623e8a947.zh: 「鯖の棒ずし」是祭典時不可或缺的傳統鄉土料理。除了「秋刀魚棒壽司」之外，還有許多使用鯖魚的壽司，例如烤鯖魚壽司、整尾鯖魚壽司、醋漬鯖魚壽司等。鯖魚料理之所以豐富，是因為湖北和湖西地區容易取得鯖魚。歷史上有一條將若狹灣捕獲的海產運往京都的路線，途經湖西地區。

266051d74434bdf7.en: Kangi-in (歓喜院) is a Buddhist temple in Kumagaya, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. It was founded in 1179 and is affiliated with the Kōyasan Shingon-shū sect of Buddhism. The temple's Shōden Hall (聖天堂, shōden-dō) was designated as a Japanese National Treasure in 1984. It is the only building in Saitama to have been designated as a national treasure.
266051d74434bdf7.zh: 歡喜院是位於日本埼玉縣熊谷市的佛教寺院，創建於1179年，屬高野山真言宗。寺內的聖天堂於1984年獲指定為日本國寶，是埼玉縣唯一獲指定為國寶的建築。

26644cce9aec346a.en: Nasu Imperial Villa, located in the town of Nasu, Nasu District in Tochigi Prefecture, is a retreat used by the Japanese Imperial Family. The structure dates to 1926, a further addition came in 1935.
26644cce9aec346a.zh: 那須御用邸位於栃木縣那須郡那須町，是日本皇室使用的避暑別邸。建築建於1926年，1935年又有增建。

2677f9cd484674d0.en: Taishu Soba refers to a variety of soba (buckwheat noodles) that has been cultivated on Tsushima, an island with a history of soba production. The term Taishu in the name refers to the former Tsushima Province.The original species of soba is believed to have originated from southern China to the Himalayas, and it is said to have been introduced to Tsushima via the Korean Peninsula during the Jomon period.
2677f9cd484674d0.zh: 「対州そば」是指在具有蕎麥生產歷史的對馬島上栽培的蕎麥品種。名稱中的「對州」是指舊時的對馬國。蕎麥的原生種據信源自中國南部至喜馬拉雅一帶，據說在繩文時代經由朝鮮半島傳入對馬。

2687a66270c920d6.en: Iwabitsu Castle (岩櫃城, Iwabitsu-jō) is a "yamashiro"-style (castle located on Mount Iwabitsu in Higashiagatsuma, Gunma Prefecture, Japan. The ruins have been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 2019.
2687a66270c920d6.zh: 岩櫃城是位於日本群馬縣東吾妻町岩櫃山的山城。城跡自2019年起由中央政府指定為國家史跡加以保護。

268b3e4dc053831d.en: The Botanic Gardens of Toyama (富山県中央植物園, Toyama-ken Chūō Shokubutsuen; 24.7 hectares) are botanical gardens located at 42 Kamikutsuwada, Fuchu-machi, Nei-gun, Toyama, Toyama, Japan. They are open daily except Thursdays; an admission fee is charged.
268b3e4dc053831d.zh: 富山縣中央植物園（面積24.7公頃）位於日本富山縣富山市婦負郡婦中町上轡田42。除星期四外每日開放，需購票入園。

268d8f1265723c4b.en: Tenkyōkaku (天鏡閣) is a Western-style French Renaissance style residence built as a summer villa for Prince Arisugawa Takehito located in Inawashiro, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan.
268d8f1265723c4b.zh: 天鏡閣是位於日本福島縣豬苗代、為有栖川宮威仁親王所建的避暑別墅，屬於西式的法國文藝復興風格宅邸。

269952958956e7b7.en: “Jibuni” is a simmered dish that represents Ishikawa Prefecture. It is simmered with duck, sudare-fu (wheat-gluten bread) and seasonal vegetables. The duck is coated with flour, which makes it thickened. This samurai dish is believed to have been eaten since at least the Edo period (1603 - 1868).
269952958956e7b7.zh: 「じぶ煮」是代表石川縣的燉煮料理，以鴨肉、簾麩（麵筋製品）和當季蔬菜燉煮而成。鴨肉裹上麵粉，使湯汁變得濃稠。這道武士料理據信最晚自江戶時代（1603－1868）起便有人食用。

26c21f5daaa6bb4a.en: Gushikawa Castle (具志川城, Gushikawa jō; Okinawan: Gushichan Gushiku) is a Ryukyuan gusuku fortification in the city of Itoman, Okinawa, Japan. The castle ruins were designated a National Historic Site on May 15, 1972.
26c21f5daaa6bb4a.zh: 具志川城（沖繩語：Gushichan Gushiku）是位於日本沖繩縣糸滿市的琉球御城（グスク）要塞。城跡於1972年5月15日被指定為國家史跡。

26c87846ecfd53ac.en: In mountain villages, "fried royal fern with oil," tofu paste, and simmered vegetables have been eaten since ancient times.Otoyo Town, located in the central part of the Shikoku mountain range, is one of the most famous places in Kochi Prefecture for the production of royal ferns. The town covers a vast area of 315.06 km2, more than 80% of which is covered by mountains and forests. Settlements and arable lands dot the steep slopes at elevations of 200 to 850 meters, where paddy rice and yuzu are cultivated in addition to royal ferns.
26c87846ecfd53ac.zh: 在山村，自古以來便食用「油炒紫萁」、白和豆腐及燉蔬菜。位於四國山地中央的大豐町，是高知縣最知名的紫萁產地之一。町域廣達315.06平方公里，其中80%以上為山林。聚落與耕地散布在海拔200至850公尺的陡坡上，除了紫萁之外，也栽培水稻與柚子。

26d227c6839a2206.en: The largest event of the year in Jodo Shinshu Buddhism, called Hoonko, takes place from fall to New Year’s around the anniversary of sect founder Shinran’s death (November 28 in the lunar calendar, January 16 in the Gregorian calendar); in Fukui Prefecture, it is called Honkosan or Okosama. Touching on Shinran’s teachings, people eat vegetarian Buddhist cuisine with the intent to devote themselves religiously once again.
26d227c6839a2206.zh: 淨土真宗年度最大的活動「報恩講」，在宗派開祖親鸞的忌日（農曆11月28日，國曆1月16日）前後，從秋季至新年期間舉行；在福井縣稱為「ほんこさん」或「お講様」。人們藉此接觸親鸞的教誨，食用精進料理，表達重新虔心向佛之意。

26ddabbf0cd9ba7e.en: "Shishamo kanroni" is a local dish that uses "shishamo smelt", one of the fish that represents Hokkaido. "Shishamo" has deep roots in Hokkaido's regional cuisine: as well as "shishamo kanroni", where the fish is sweetened and boiled, it is also pickled in oil or vinegar, or made into "konbumaki (where it is dried and sliced before being wrapped in kombu kelp and boiled)"."Shishamo" is an indigenous species of Hokkaido, only inhabiting rivers on the Pacific coast.
26ddabbf0cd9ba7e.zh: 「ししゃもの甘露煮」是使用北海道代表性魚類之一「柳葉魚」的鄉土料理。「柳葉魚」與北海道鄉土料理淵源深厚：除了加糖燉煮的「ししゃもの甘露煮」之外，也會用油或醋醃漬，或做成「昆布巻き」（將魚乾燥切片後用昆布捲起燉煮）。「柳葉魚」是北海道特有種，只棲息於太平洋沿岸的河川。

26df829d961ab97a.en: The Seizansō  (西山荘), also known as the Nishiyama Goten (西山御殿) was the retirement villa of Tokugawa Mitsukuni, the second daimyō of Mito Domain under the Edo Period Tokugawa shogunate of Japan. It  is located in the city of Hitachiōta, Ibaraki. The villa was designated a National Historic Site and its gardens a National Place of Scenic Beauty in 2007.
26df829d961ab97a.zh: 西山荘又稱西山御殿，是日本江戶時代德川幕府體制下第二代水戶藩藩主德川光圀的隱居別墅，位於茨城縣常陸太田市。2007年，別墅被指定為國家史跡，庭園被指定為國家名勝。

26fd142ced94816e.en: Sankai Falls (三階の滝, Sankai-no-taki) is a waterfall in Zaō, Katta District, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan, in on the Sumikawa River. It is one of "Japan’s Top 100 Waterfalls", in a listing published by the Japanese Ministry of the Environment in 1990.
26fd142ced94816e.zh: 三階の滝是位於日本宮城縣刈田郡藏王町澄川上的瀑布，名列日本環境省於1990年公布的「日本瀑布百選」。

27021e0079d4e7e3.en: The Museum of Nature and Human Activities, Hyōgo (兵庫県立人と自然の博物館, Hyōgo kenritsu hito to shizen no hakubutsukan), sometimes referred to by its abbreviated Japanese name of Hitohaku (ひとはく), is a prefectural museum of natural history in Sanda, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan. The museum opened in 1992. The collection includes many geological and biological specimens.
27021e0079d4e7e3.zh: 兵庫縣立人と自然の博物館有時以日文簡稱「ひとはく」稱呼，是位於日本兵庫縣三田市的縣立自然史博物館。博物館於1992年開館，館藏包括許多地質與生物標本。

27142c018335722b.en: Niigata Prefecture, the largest consumer of eggplant in Japan, has a local dish called "Fukashi Nasu (steamed eggplant). In some areas, it is called "Nasu Bukashi. In the Niigata style, steamed eggplants are cooled in a refrigerator and dipped in soy sauce mixed with Japanese mustard. It is also eaten by hand breaking pieces off and dipped in ginger soy sauce or Pon-zu (soy sauce with Japanese citrus juice).Niigata Prefecture boasts the nation's largest eggplant acreage (2019) and grows many varieties of eggplant.
27142c018335722b.zh: 日本茄子消費量最大的新潟縣，有一道稱為「ふかしなす」（蒸茄子）的鄉土料理，部分地區稱為「なすぶかし」。新潟的吃法是將蒸好的茄子放進冰箱冷卻，沾加了日式黃芥末的醬油食用。也有人用手剝成小塊，沾薑汁醬油或ポン酢（加入日本柑橘果汁的醬油）食用。新潟縣的茄子栽培面積為全國第一（2019年），並種植許多品種。

272091e3269f9c68.en: This is one of offering dishes during "obon" (mid-August) in Shingon Buddhism. "Nanairo" (=seven colors) indicates seven kinds of season vegetables (e.g. eggplant, pumpkin, gobou (=burdock root), carrot, green beans, "zuiki"(=Japanese taro stem), "myoga" (=Japanese ginger), etc., and "oae" means "aemono" (=mixed salad with dressing).
272091e3269f9c68.zh: 這是真言宗盂蘭盆節（8月中旬）的供品料理之一。「七色」是指七種當季蔬菜（例如茄子、南瓜、牛蒡、紅蘿蔔、四季豆、芋莖（ずいき）、茗荷等），「お和え」則是指「和え物」（涼拌菜）。

2729129662656093.en: Saruka Jinja (猿賀神社), sometimes rendered Saruga, is a Shinto shrine in Hirakawa, Aomori Prefecture, Japan. The shrine is said to have been founded in 807, when Sakanoue no Tamuramaro came north during the campaigns against the Ezo. The Honden, dating to 1826, is a Prefecturally-designated Important Cultural Property. Preserved building records (棟札) are a City-designated Important Cultural Property (Historic Materials). There is an annual rice-planting festival and a pond of pink lotus.
2729129662656093.zh: 猿賀神社（有時寫作Saruga）是位於日本青森縣平川市的神社。據說創建於807年，當時坂上田村麻呂在征討蝦夷的戰役中北上。建於1826年的本殿為縣指定重要文化財。保存下來的棟札為市指定重要文化財（歷史資料）。每年舉行插秧祭，境內另有一座粉紅色蓮花池。

27401d00b182b05f.en: Tateyama Castle (舘山城, Tateyama-jō) was a Sengoku period Japanese castle located in what is now the city of Yonezawa, southern Yamagata Prefecture, Japan.  The site of the castle was designated a National Historic Site in 2016. The castle grounds are a 20 minutes walk from Nishi-Yonezawa Station on the JR East Yonesaka Line. It should not be confused with Tateyama Castle in Tateyama, Chiba, whose name is written with slightly different kanji.
27401d00b182b05f.zh: 館山城（舘山城，Tateyama-jō）是戰國時代的日本城郭，位於今日本山形縣南部米澤市境內。城址於2016年被指定為國家史跡。城址距JR東日本米坂線西米澤站步行20分鐘。此城不應與千葉縣館山市的館山城混淆，兩者名稱的漢字寫法略有不同。

275a51bfa7936704.en: Mount Senjō (船上山, Senjō-san) is a mountain in the town of Kotoura, Tottori Prefecture, Japan. It has an elevation of 687 metres and is part of the Daisen volcanic belt. It is within the borders of the Daisen-Oki National Park.
275a51bfa7936704.zh: 船上山是位於日本鳥取縣琴浦町的山，海拔687公尺，屬於大山火山帶，位於大山隱岐國立公園範圍內。

278f620fee409926.en: Aomori Contemporary Art Centre (青森公立大学国際芸術センター青森, Aomori Kōritsu Daigaku Kokusai Geijutsu Sentā Aomori) opened in Aomori, Aomori Prefecture, Japan in 2001. Designed by architect Tadao Ando and operated by Aomori Public University, the institution's activities include exhibitions, education initiatives, and an artist-in-residence programme.
278f620fee409926.zh: 青森公立大學國際藝術中心青森於2001年在日本青森縣青森市開館。由建築師安藤忠雄設計，青森公立大學營運，活動包括展覽、教育計畫及駐村藝術家計畫。

2797f5d50d4469e3.en: Hotsumisaki-ji (最御崎寺) is a Shingon Buddhist temple located in Muroto, Kōchi, Japan. It is the 24th temple of the Shikoku Pilgrimage, and the first located in Kochi, representing the start of the "austerity and discipline" (修行, shugyō) stage of the pilgrimage.
2797f5d50d4469e3.zh: 最御崎寺是位於日本高知縣室戶市的真言宗寺院，為四國遍路第24號札所，也是位於高知的第一座札所，代表巡禮進入「修行」階段的起點。

27a73145dad11e1b.en: Miyahata ruins  (宮畑遺跡, Miyahata iseki) is an archaeological site and archaeological park located in what is now part of the city of Fukushima, Fukushima Prefecture in the Tōhoku region of Japan with the ruins of a Jōmon period settlement. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 2003.
27a73145dad11e1b.zh: 宮畑遺跡是位於日本東北地方福島縣今福島市境內的考古遺址及考古公園，保有繩文時代聚落的遺跡。遺址於2003年被指定為日本國家史跡。

27a8e01c338ec71f.en: Yuda Dam (湯田ダム) is a multipurpose dam located in the town of Nishiwaga, Iwate, in the Tohoku region of northern Japan. Completed in 1964, it is managed by the Tohoku Regional Development Bureau of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport. Located on the Waga River, a branch of the Kitakami River, it is the third largest of the dams built as part of the Kitakami Area Comprehensive Development Plan (KVA). The dam creates Lake Kinshu, a popular sightseeing spot.
27a8e01c338ec71f.zh: 湯田水庫（湯田ダム）是位於日本北部東北地方岩手縣西和賀町的多功能水庫。1964年完工，由國土交通省東北地方整備局管理。水庫位於北上川支流和賀川上，是北上特定地域綜合開發計畫（KVA）中興建的水庫裡規模第三大者。水庫形成的錦秋湖是熱門的觀光景點。

27b3ad7c4fdcb491.en: Myōō-in (明王院) is a Buddhist temple in Fukuyama, Hiroshima, Japan.
27b3ad7c4fdcb491.zh: 明王院是位於日本廣島縣福山市的佛教寺院。

27bd23d36be27646.en: Imamiya Shrine (今宮神社, Imamiya-jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Kita-ku, Kyoto, Japan. It was originally established for patrons to pray for safety from an epidemic, though it has evolved into a shrine where patrons can pray for general good health. The shrine complex is embedded in a forest of large trees northwest of Daitoku-ji and includes many minor shrines in addition to the main shrine, or honden. On every second Sunday in April, one of the 3 major festivals in Kyoto, Yasurai Matsuri, is held at the shrine.
27bd23d36be27646.zh: 今宮神社是位於日本京都北區的神社。最初是為了讓信眾祈求免受疫病之害而設立，後來演變為祈求身體健康的神社。神社境內位於大德寺西北方的大樹林中，除主殿（本殿）外還有許多小型攝末社。每年4月第二個星期日，會在此舉行京都三大奇祭之一的やすらい祭。

27be28860e6e72fd.en: Shiromine-ji (Japanese: 白峯寺) is a temple belonging to the Omuro School of Shingon Buddhism, situated near an elevation of 271 meters  on the slopes of Mt. Shiramine, located within the Goshikidai highlands in Sakaide, Kagawa Prefecture. Its formal mountain name is Ryōshōzan, and its institutional name is Dōrinin. The principal deity is Senju Kannon Bosatsu (Thousand-armed Kannon). It serves as the 81st temple on the Shikoku 88-Temple Pilgrimage.
27be28860e6e72fd.zh: 白峯寺是真言宗御室派的寺院，位於香川縣坂出市五色台高原內白峰山山腰約海拔271公尺處。山號為綾松山，院號為洞林院。本尊為千手觀音菩薩。為四國八十八所遍路第81號札所。

27d23a72b4e1901a.en: The Museum of Modern Art, Ibaraki (茨城県近代美術館, Ibaraki-ken kindai bijutsukan) opened on the shore of Lake Senba (千波湖) in Mito, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan, in October 1988.
27d23a72b4e1901a.zh: 茨城縣近代美術館於1988年10月在日本茨城縣水戶市千波湖畔開館。

27f4546eb13ec741.en: Koromo Castle (挙母城, Koromo-jō) is a Japanese castle located in Toyota, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. At the end of the Edo period, Koromo Castle was home to the Naitō clan, daimyō of Koromo Domain. The castle was also known as Shichishū-jō (七州城).
27f4546eb13ec741.zh: 舉母城（Koromo-jō）是位於日本愛知縣豐田市的日本城郭。江戶時代末期，舉母城為舉母藩藩主內藤氏的居城。此城又稱七州城。

27fa0cb71725a1ee.en: The Ebisugahana Shipyard (恵美須ヶ鼻造船所跡, Ebisugahana sōzenjo ato)  was a shipyard opened in 1865 in Bakumatsu period Japan, located in the Chinto neighborhood of the city of Hagi, Yamaguchi Prefecture in the San'yō region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 2013. In 2007, it was certified as a modern industrial heritage by the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry.
27fa0cb71725a1ee.zh: 恵美須ヶ鼻造船所跡是日本幕末時期於1865年開設的造船所，位於日本山陽地方山口縣萩市椿東。2013年被指定為日本國家史跡。2007年獲經濟產業省認定為近代化產業遺產。

28099415ac8a01db.en: The Naga region is situated in the eastern part of the Kino River Plain. The area is known for producing rice, persimmons, peaches, and other crops that are well-suited to the climate. During the Edo period, irrigation canals were built which helped the region develop into a granary in the prefecture. The region has a long-standing tradition of making sushi, which is prepared using rice, dried foods, and seasonal vegetables grown in the area.
28099415ac8a01db.zh: 那賀地區位於紀之川平原東部。此地以出產稻米、柿子、桃子等適合當地氣候的作物聞名。江戶時代修築了灌溉水道，使這一帶發展為縣內的糧倉。當地有長久的壽司製作傳統，使用米、乾貨及當地種植的時令蔬菜製作。

2818317bab400553.en: The Tatsumi Canal (辰巳用水, Tatsumi yōsui) is an 11 kilometer long canal built in the Edo period in the city of Kanazawa, Ishikawa Japan. A 8.7 kilometer portion of this canal was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 2010.
2818317bab400553.zh: 辰巳用水是位於日本石川縣金澤市、建於江戶時代的水道，全長11公里。其中8.7公里的區段於2010年被指定為日本國家史跡。

2819ec6425d7a2d5.en: Aburatsubo (油壺) is an inlet on the west side of the Miura Peninsula in Kanagawa, Japan, facing Sagami Bay on the Pacific Ocean. It exits into neighbouring Moroiso inlet.
2819ec6425d7a2d5.zh: 油壺（油壺）是位於日本神奈川縣三浦半島西側的海灣，面向太平洋的相模灣，出口通往相鄰的諸磯灣。

2857b3da40844f71.en: Rice cooked with tofu and locally grown vegetables is called "dondoroke-meshi" in the eastern to central areas of Tottori Prefecture. "Dondoroke" means "thunder" in the regional dialect. The name comes from the fact that the powerful, repeated sounds tofu makes when added to a hot pan with oil in it resembles thunder.In the past, tofu was a delicacy and a precious source of protein. It is said that village had its own tofu cabin, where a number of people gathered and made tofu from home-grown soybeans.
2857b3da40844f71.zh: 在鳥取縣東部至中部地區，用豆腐和當地種植的蔬菜一起炊煮的米飯稱為「どんどろけ飯」。「どんどろけ」在當地方言中是「雷」的意思。這個名稱源自豆腐放入加了油的熱鍋時，接連發出的響亮聲音很像打雷。過去豆腐是珍饈，也是珍貴的蛋白質來源。據說各村落都有自己的豆腐小屋，許多人聚集在那裡，用自家種植的黃豆製作豆腐。

2863a209dd8d4cbb.en: The Komaki Dam is an arch-gravity dam on the Shō River about 2.5 km (1.6 mi) southeast of Shogawa in Toyama Prefecture, Japan. It was constructed between 1925 and 1930. The dam has an associated 90.2 MW hydroelectric power station which was commissioned in 1930. Of the nine dams on the Shō River, it is the second-furthest downstream.
2863a209dd8d4cbb.zh: 小牧水壩是位於日本富山縣庄川東南約2.5公里（1.6英里）處、庄川上的拱形重力壩，建於1925年至1930年間。水壩附設90.2百萬瓦的水力發電廠，於1930年啟用。在庄川的九座水壩中，位置為下游算起第二座。

2870edf40061d769.en: The Matsukawa Geothermal Power Plant (松川地熱発電所, Matsukawa Jinetsu Hatsudensho) is Japan's first commercial geothermal power station. It is located in the city of  Hachimantai, Iwate Prefecture in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan.
2870edf40061d769.zh: 松川地熱発電所是日本第一座商業地熱發電廠，位於日本北部東北地方岩手縣八幡平市。

2879fb31db0c83b3.en: Kōyama Castle (高山城, Kōyama-jō) was a yamajiro-style Japanese castle located in the Shintomi-honjō neighborhood of the town of Kimotsuki, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1945.
2879fb31db0c83b3.zh: 高山城（高山城）是位於日本鹿兒島縣肝付町新富本城的山城式日本城堡。其遺跡自1945年起作為國家史跡受到保護。

287ecf81fb44213c.en: The Kakoinohara Site (栫ノ原遺跡)  is an archaeological site with traces of an early Jōmon period settlement, located in the Makishima neighborhood of the city of Minamisatsuma, Kagoshima, Japan. The tumulus was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1997.
287ecf81fb44213c.zh: 栫ノ原遺跡是保有繩文時代早期聚落遺跡的考古遺址，位於日本鹿兒島縣南薩摩市牧島地區。該古墳於1997年被指定為日本國家史跡。

2888b8c53c688847.en: Kiritappu Wetland (霧多布湿原; きりたっぷしつげん) is a 3,168ha. wetland area in Hamanaka-cho, Akkeshi District, Hokkaidō, Japan. It is also called Wetland of flowers (花の湿原) because numerous flowers can be seen in summer.
2888b8c53c688847.zh: 霧多布湿原（きりたっぷしつげん）是位於日本北海道厚岸郡濱中町、面積3,168公頃的濕地，因夏季可見到大量花卉，又稱為「花の湿原」。

288bc3ba292cacf1.en: "Arumado" is a local specialty from the Hirado area, which served as a key point for overseas trade until the early Edo period. It is a molded dish containing boiled eggs, and its distinctive feature is the pink color outlining the cut section, achieved by using food coloring.While primarily associated with Hirado, a similar molded dish is known as "Arimado" in Sasebo, with just a slight difference in spelling. In Nagasaki, it is called "Ryugan," named after the dragon-like appearance of the cut section.
288bc3ba292cacf1.zh: 「アルマド」是平戶地區的鄉土料理，平戶直到江戶時代初期都是海外貿易的重要據點。這是包有水煮蛋的成形料理，特色是使用食用色素，使切面輪廓呈粉紅色。雖然主要與平戶相關，但佐世保也有類似的成形料理，稱為「アリマド」，名稱只差一點。在長崎則因切面形似龍眼，稱為「竜眼」。

28b4a0186f8a805c.en: Kirishima Open Air Museum (霧島アートの森, Kirishima āto no mori) opened in Yūsui, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan, in 2000. Located in the foothills of Mount Kirishima, at an elevation of 700 m (2,300 ft) above sea level, the Museum encompasses an area of 20 ha (49 acres). Works are displayed in the open air as well as in the Art Hall.
28b4a0186f8a805c.zh: 霧島アートの森於2000年在日本鹿兒島縣湧水町開館。美術館位於霧島山山麓，海拔700公尺（2,300英尺），占地20公頃（49英畝）。作品展示於戶外及藝術館內。

28b932a56cfb90e5.en: Asahiyama Memorial Park (旭山記念公園, Asahiyama Kinen Kōen) is a park located in Chūō-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaidō, Japan. The park's peak, at 137.5 metres (451 ft) above sea level, offers a great panoramic view of Sapporo, and the Sea of Japan beyond.
28b932a56cfb90e5.zh: 旭山記念公園是位於日本北海道札幌市中央區的公園。公園最高處海拔137.5公尺（451英尺），可眺望札幌全景以及更遠處的日本海。

28c7960341904589.en: The Muro Saisei Kinenkan Museum (Japanese: 室生犀星記念館) is a museum in Kanazawa, Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan. The museum is about the Japanese poet Murō Saisei.
28c7960341904589.zh: 室生犀星紀念館（日語：室生犀星記念館）是位於日本石川縣金澤市的博物館，以日本詩人室生犀星為主題。

28f639b2a9a2b739.en: Ōsumi Nanbu Prefectural Natural Park (大隅南部県立自然公園, Ōsumi Nanbu kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in southeast Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1977, the park spans the municipalities of Kinkō, Kimotsuki, and Minamiōsumi.
28f639b2a9a2b739.zh: 大隅南部縣立自然公園是位於日本鹿兒島縣東南部的縣立自然公園，1977年設立，範圍橫跨錦江町、肝付町與南大隅町。

29138139207dc532.en: Kamiyodo temple ruins (上淀廃寺跡, Kamiyodo Haiji ato) is an archeological site  with the ruins of a Hakuhō period Buddhist temple located in the Yodoe neighborhood of the city of  Yonago, Tottori prefecture, in the San'in region of Japan. It was designated a National Historic Site in 1996, with the area under protection expanded in 2005. The current designated area is 25,560 square meters. The site is about a 20-minute walk from Yodoe Station on the JR West San'in Main Line.
29138139207dc532.zh: 上淀廢寺跡是位於日本山陰地方鳥取縣米子市淀江地區的考古遺址，留有白鳳時代佛寺的遺跡。1996年被指定為國家史跡，2005年擴大保護範圍，目前指定面積為25,560平方公尺。遺址距JR西日本山陰本線淀江站步行約20分鐘。

2917f11f2b86e32b.en: "Kakinamasu" is a local dish made with daikon radish and carrots, seasoned with vinegar and added with dried persimmons. It is considered an essential dish for the New Year's festivities in some regions. Persimmons are broadly categorized into sweet persimmons and astringent persimmons. Gifu Prefecture, one of the leading persimmon-producing regions in the country, is known as the birthplace of the "Fuyu Gaki," known as the king of persimmons. In the prefecture, high-quality persimmons with a sugar content exceeding 17 degrees are cultivated.
2917f11f2b86e32b.zh: 「柿なます」是以白蘿蔔和紅蘿蔔用醋調味，再加入柿餅製成的鄉土料理。在部分地區被視為新年不可或缺的料理。柿子大致可分為甜柿與澀柿。全國主要柿子產地之一的岐阜縣，是被譽為柿中之王的「富有柿」的發源地。縣內栽培糖度超過17度的高品質柿子。

292edbb5d6c0f32d.en: The Kōjindani Site (荒神谷遺跡, Kōjindani iseki) is an archaeological site consisting of the remains of a Yayoi period ritual site located in the Hikawa-cho neighborhood of the city of Izumo, Shimane Prefecture in the San'in region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1987.
292edbb5d6c0f32d.zh: 荒神谷遺跡是位於日本山陰地方島根縣出雲市斐川町的考古遺址，為彌生時代祭祀場所的遺跡。1987年被指定為日本國家史跡。

2931a37f34446fdd.en: The Chidōkan (致道館) was the Domain academy of Shōnai Domain under the Edo period Tokugawa shogunate located in what is now part of the city of Tsuruoka in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan. It is one of over 250 han schools which existed in Japan during the Bakumatsu period, it is one of the few to retain some of its original structures. It was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1951.
2931a37f34446fdd.zh: 致道館是江戶時代德川幕府治下庄內藩的藩校，位於日本北部東北地方、今鶴岡市境內。幕末時期日本有超過250所藩校，致道館是少數保留部分原有建築的藩校之一。1951年被指定為日本國家史跡。

294ef1e5dbeebb7c.en: “Casa muchi” (also called muchi, casa muchi, onimochi) is a steamed rice cake wrapped in a shell ginger leaf. It is offered to the gods to dispel evil spirits on December 8th of the lunar calendar, an annual event in which the health of the family is prayed for. The origin of the name “onimochi” is based on folklore, and is said to be from folk tales which remain in Shurikinjocho.
294ef1e5dbeebb7c.zh: 「カーサームーチー」（又稱ムーチー、カーサームーチー、鬼餅）是用月桃葉包裹的蒸米糕。在農曆12月8日供奉神明以驅除邪靈，這是祈求家人健康的年度活動。「鬼餅」這個名稱的由來根據民間傳說，據說出自首里金城町流傳的民間故事。

295fde1cf80f2be8.en: Mamebu-jiru" is a local dish of Yamagata-machi, Kuji City (former Yamagata Village), in which ingredients such as familiar vegetables and baked tofu are simmered in a soy sauce-based soup flavored with dried sardines and kelp dashi, along with "mamebu," flour dumplings with walnuts.It is said that during the Edo period (1603-1867), when bad harvests continued, people ate dumplings made of wheat flour wrapped in walnuts as a substitute for noodles in "Hare no Meal".
295fde1cf80f2be8.zh: 「まめぶ汁」是久慈市山形町（舊山形村）的鄉土料理，將常見蔬菜、烤豆腐等配料與「まめぶ」（包有核桃的麵粉糰子）一同放入以小魚乾和昆布高湯調味的醬油湯底中燉煮。據說在歉收連年的江戶時代（1603－1867），人們在「晴れの食事」中以包入核桃的麵粉糰子代替麵條食用。

2966cdaecee5f57b.en: Shike-michi (四間道) is a small historical street in Nishi-ku, Nagoya in central Japan.
2966cdaecee5f57b.zh: 四間道是位於日本中部名古屋市西區的一條歷史小街。

29689258bd4f5d90.en: It is a dish simmered chicken and konjac noodle, Japanese leek, tofu, onion, gobou(=Burdock root) or other vegetables, and is cooked at home. The name "Jabu" came from liquid out a lot (in Japanese ‘jabu jabu’ to express liquid is flowing) from tofu and vegetables while simmering them although water is not added unlike other simmered dishes. It was a feast used precious chicken during the time when it was hard to get meat. It is a hospitality home dish cooked in big pots when many people gather like "hare no hi" (=special occasions, e.g.
29689258bd4f5d90.zh: じゃぶ是將雞肉與蒟蒻絲、日本大蔥、豆腐、洋蔥、牛蒡等蔬菜一起燉煮的料理，屬於家常菜。與其他燉煮料理不同，這道菜不加水，燉煮時豆腐與蔬菜會釋出大量水分（日文以「じゃぶじゃぶ」形容液體流動的樣子），じゃぶ之名由此而來。在肉類取得不易的年代，這是使用珍貴雞肉的豐盛料理。在「晴れの日」（特殊節日，例如

296e946d5fbb9a81.en: Tappizaki Lighthouse (龍飛埼灯台, Tappizaki tōdai) is a lighthouse located on the outermost extremity of Cape Tappi, the northernmost point of Tsugaru Peninsula, Honshu, in Sotogahama, Aomori Prefecture, Japan. It is located within the Tsugaru Quasi-National Park and on clear days, Hokkaido can be seen across the Tsugaru Strait.
296e946d5fbb9a81.zh: 龍飛埼燈塔位於日本青森縣外濱町，坐落在本州津輕半島最北端龍飛崎的最尖端。燈塔位於津輕國定公園內，天氣晴朗時可隔著津輕海峽望見北海道。

29813e2975410642.en: In Yamagata Prefecture, dishes using agar have been eaten for a long time, and it is also served as a tea snack. In the Shonai area, agar as a sweet dessert is mainstream, and the most popular one is "egg agar". It has a sweet soy sauce flavor and is made for celebratory occasions such as festivals and the New Year. It is said that the combination of agar, which is deeply rooted in the Japanese diet, and eggs, which were a valuable commodity at the time, has become popular as an event food.
29813e2975410642.zh: 在山形縣，使用寒天的料理自古就有人食用，也作為配茶的點心。在庄內地區，以甜點形式食用的寒天是主流，其中最受歡迎的是「卵寒天」。帶有甜醬油風味，在祭典、新年等喜慶場合製作。據說是因為深植於日本飲食中的寒天，與當時屬於珍貴物品的雞蛋組合在一起，而成為受歡迎的節慶食物。

2992bdfebdc426da.en: The Habake Residence (羽馬家住宅) is one of the gasshō-zukuri houses in Tamukai Village, Nanto City, Toyama Prefecture. It is designated as an Important Cultural Property of Japan.
2992bdfebdc426da.zh: 羽馬家住宅是富山縣南礪市田向村的合掌造民宅之一，已被指定為日本重要文化財。

2993d4bfd049493b.en: The name "Yatara-zuke" comes from the idea of using a variety of vegetables, such as eggplant, cucumber, perilla seeds, and myoga, and creating something "delicious with an abundance of vegetables". This pickling method takes about six months and is a traditional winter preserved food that incorporates multiple types of vegetables. Unlike typical pickling, where all vegetables are pickled simultaneously, "Yatara-zuke" involves salting each vegetable separately based on its harvest season.
2993d4bfd049493b.zh: 「やたら漬け」之名，來自使用茄子、小黃瓜、紫蘇籽、茗荷等多種蔬菜，做出「蔬菜豐富的美味」之意。這種醃漬方法約需六個月，是加入多種蔬菜的傳統冬季保存食。與一般將所有蔬菜同時醃漬的做法不同，やたら漬け是依各種蔬菜的收成季節，分別以鹽醃漬。

299bb7454bf50f7c.en: ”Egg kanten” is a food made by mixing egg and sugar into ”kanten” liquid and then solidifying it.”Kanten” is made from the seaweed known as tengusa. After being dissolved and filtered, it is allowed to dry outside to solidify. By repeatedly freezing it during intensely cold nights and sun-drying it during the day, the result is a naturally dried stick of kanten. ”Kanten” is characterized by being more elastic and hardening more firmly than either gelatin or agar.
299bb7454bf50f7c.zh: 「卵寒天」是在「寒天」液中加入雞蛋和砂糖混合後凝固而成的食物。「寒天」以名為石花菜的海藻製成，經溶解、過濾後，放在戶外乾燥凝固。在嚴寒的夜晚反覆冷凍，白天日曬乾燥，便成為自然乾燥的棒寒天。「寒天」的特色是比明膠或洋菜更有彈性，凝固得也更紮實。

299c4fb2a4911ace.en: The Kasho Museum (高畠華宵大正ロマン館, Takabatake Kashō Taishō Roman-kan) is a private museum that opened in Tōon, Ehime Prefecture, Japan, in 1990. The collection includes some 4,300 works (paintings, drawings, illustrations, etc.) by Takabatake Kashō (1888–1966), who was born in Uwajima, hundreds of his letters, photographs, and personal effects, works by contemporaries, and other items from the Taishō and early Shōwa eras.
299c4fb2a4911ace.zh: 高畠華宵大正ロマン館是1990年於日本愛媛縣東溫市開館的私立博物館。館藏包括出身宇和島的高畠華宵（1888–1966）約4,300件作品（繪畫、素描、插畫等）、數百封書信、照片與遺物，以及同時代畫家的作品和其他大正至昭和初期的物品。

29b7b297c299e8cb.en: The whale food culture was developed around Hachinohe City because there were whaling bases in Hachinohe City. There is a saying "One whale brings lots of benefits to seven fisher villages" to express how whale brought many blessings to the locals. The taste of whale varies in each part, but "shiromi" (=white part) close to the back skin is used for "Kujira Jiru". As this part is the bunch of fat, you need to repeat parboiling it or fry without oil to remove excess fat before cooking.
29b7b297c299e8cb.zh: 由於八戶市曾有捕鯨基地，八戶市一帶發展出食用鯨魚的文化。當地有「一頭鯨魚養七個漁村」的說法，形容鯨魚為當地人帶來的諸多恩惠。鯨魚各部位的味道不同，「くじら汁」使用的是靠近背皮的「白身」（白色部分）。這個部位是一整塊脂肪，烹調前需反覆汆燙或以不加油的方式煎炒，去除多餘的油脂。

29daa03b0eb3daca.en: Kakunodate Castle (角館城, Kakunodate-jō), also known as Asakura Castle and Ryugasaki Castle, was a mountaintop castle (yamashiro) located in Kakunodate, Akita Prefecture, Japan. Its roots can be traced to when Moriyasu Tozawa was given the area in 1590, though it may have been constructed prior to this. Due to a Shogunal decree that each domain was to retain only one castle, it was demolished in 1620. Only ruins remain at the site on Mount Furushiro.
29daa03b0eb3daca.zh: 角館城又稱朝倉城、龍崎城，是位於日本秋田縣角館的山城。其起源可追溯至1590年戶澤盛安受封此地之時，但城郭可能在此之前便已建造。由於幕府下令每個藩只能保留一座城，角館城於1620年遭拆除。現今古城山上僅存遺跡。

29fd4f65ef5ba31a.en: Mount Hongū (本宮山, Hongū-san) is a mountain located on the border of three cities in Aichi Prefecture, Toyokawa, Okazaki, and Shinshiro.
29fd4f65ef5ba31a.zh: 本宮山（Hongū-san）是位於愛知縣豐川市、岡崎市、新城市三市交界處的山。

2a031c23c6d24e43.en: The Kushimoto Ōkyo Rosetsu Art Museum (串本応挙芦雪館, Kushimoto Ōkyo Rosetsu Kan) is an art museum in Kushimoto, Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. The museum opened on the grounds of Muryō-ji in 1961 and comprises five exhibition rooms in two single-story reinforced concrete buildings.
2a031c23c6d24e43.zh: 串本應舉蘆雪館是位於日本和歌山縣串本町的美術館，1961年於無量寺境內開館，由兩棟單層鋼筋混凝土建築組成，設有五間展示室。

2a19b2d7126aa0db.en: "Persimmon pickle" is a pickle made with plenty of radish and astringent persimmon, and pickled with salt and sugar.In Akita Prefecture, where fermentation culture has taken root, a variety of pickles have been handed down from generation to generation, including smoky pickled radish and pickled radish with amazake. One such pickle is persimmon pickle, which is made from an astringent persimmon called Kumoshikari persimmon, which is grown in the gardens of households in Kakunodate-cho, Senboku City, Akita Prefecture.
2a19b2d7126aa0db.zh: 「柿漬け」是使用大量蘿蔔與澀柿，以鹽和糖醃漬而成的醃漬物。發酵文化深植的秋田縣代代傳承各種醃漬物，包括煙燻醃蘿蔔、甘酒醃蘿蔔等。柿漬け就是其中之一，使用秋田縣仙北市角館町家庭庭院種植的澀柿「雲然柿」製作。

2a254772eebb580d.en: In times of food scarcity, when meat and fish were unavailable, soybeans came in very handy as a source of protein. While soybeans are prepared in various forms, such as miso and soy sauce, Gunma prefecture is especially known for tofu. Not only is it rich in nutrition, it also keeps well once it's cooked, which is why it is used in local cuisine. The representative local tofu dish is "shime tofu". A simple side dish of boiled tofu seasoned with soy sauce and sugar, it is mainly eaten as a seasonal food at festivals.
2a254772eebb580d.zh: 在糧食匱乏、無法取得肉類和魚類的時代，大豆是非常重要的蛋白質來源。大豆可加工成味噌、醬油等各種形式，而群馬縣特別以豆腐聞名。豆腐不僅營養豐富，煮熟後也耐保存，因此被用於鄉土料理中。具代表性的鄉土豆腐料理是「しめ豆腐」，這是用醬油和砂糖調味的燉煮豆腐，是一道簡單的配菜，主要在祭典時作為應節食物食用。

2a272ff676f3c81b.en: Daifuku-ji (大福寺) is a Buddhist temple in the Japanese city of Tateyama in Chiba Prefecture, pertaining to the Chizen Sect of Shingon Buddhism. According to tradition, the temple was founded by Gyōki (668–749) in 717, early in the Nara period. It was later revived by a visit by the Tendai Buddhist priest Ennin (794–864), early in the Heian period. The date at which the temple returned to the Shingon sect is unknown. The establishment received a juinjō (朱印状) seal of certification from the Tokugawa shogunate during the Edo period.
2a272ff676f3c81b.zh: 大福寺是位於千葉縣館山市的佛教寺院，屬於真言宗智山派。據傳該寺由行基（668–749）於奈良時代初期的717年創建。其後於平安時代初期，天台宗僧人圓仁（794–864）造訪，使寺院得以復興。該寺何時回歸真言宗不詳。江戶時代，該寺獲德川幕府頒發朱印狀。

2a28283ef0854fe1.en: The Kiusu Earthwork Burial Circles (キウス周堤墓群, Kiusu shūtei bogun) is an archaeological site with multiple burial mounds believed to have been constructed during the late Jōmon period (approximately 3200 years ago) located in the city of Chitose, Hokkaidō, Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site in 1979.  It became a component of  UNESCO World Heritage Site Jōmon Prehistoric Sites in Northern Japan on 27 July 2021.
2a28283ef0854fe1.zh: キウス周堤墓群是位於日本北海道千歲市的考古遺址，有多座據信建於繩文時代晚期（約3200年前）的墓葬。該遺址於1979年被指定為國家史跡，並於2021年7月27日成為聯合國教科文組織世界遺產「北日本繩文遺址群」的構成資產之一。

2a35a66147720955.en: The Osaka Bay Tower (大阪ベイタワー), also known as ORC 1, is a mixed-use, mainly hotel and office, skyscraper in the Osaka Resort City 200 building complex located in the Minato-ku ward of Osaka, Japan. Completed in March 1993, it stands at 200 m (656 ft) tall, with the top floor located at 188.7 m (619 ft). It is the 5th tallest building in Osaka Prefecture and the 36th tallest building in Japan.
2a35a66147720955.zh: OSAKA BAY TOWER又稱ORC 1，是位於日本大阪市港區大阪Resort City 200建築群內的複合用途摩天大樓，主要作為飯店及辦公室使用。大樓於1993年3月完工，高200公尺（656英尺），最高樓層位於188.7公尺（619英尺）。為大阪府第5高、日本第36高的建築。

2a7645d0d82a4c57.en: Shimokubo Dam is a dam in the Gunma Prefecture of Japan, completed in 1968.
2a7645d0d82a4c57.zh: 下久保ダム是位於日本群馬縣的水壩，1968年完工。

2a842319c18f886b.en: "Nara-ae" is a dish that uses Nara's specialty, "Nara-zuke", and is a popular dish even among children.
2a842319c18f886b.zh: 「奈良和え」是使用奈良特產「奈良漬」製作的料理，連小孩子也很喜歡。

2a9557b55c43aef6.en: Mizushima (水島) is a small uninhabited coastal limestone island at the mouth of the Kuma River at the northern end of the Yatsushiro Sea in Yatsushiro, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan. An episode in the Nihon Shoki explains how the isle gained its name: on the eleventh day of the fourth month of the eighteenth year of the reign of Emperor Keikō (AD 88), the Emperor, near the end of his tour of inspection of Tsukushi, laid anchor at the island and partook of food.
2a9557b55c43aef6.zh: 水島是位於日本熊本縣八代市、八代海北端球磨川河口的小型無人石灰岩海岸島。《日本書紀》中記載了此島名稱的由來：景行天皇十八年（西元88年）四月十一日，天皇在巡視筑紫即將結束時，於此島停泊並進食。

2acbd8d8f950ac3b.en: Chinen Castle (知念城, Chinen jō; Okinawan: Chinin Gushiku) is a  Ryūkyūan  gusuku fortification located in the city of Nanjō, Okinawa. The castle ruins were designated a National Historic Site on May 15, 1972.
2acbd8d8f950ac3b.zh: 知念城（知念城，Chinen jō；沖繩語：Chinin Gushiku）是位於沖繩縣南城市的琉球御城（グスク）防禦設施。城址於1972年5月15日被指定為國家史跡。

2acc40c9bca2a8f6.en: The 11th day after the summer solstice is known as "Hagessho." In the Nara Basin, the wheat harvest ends and the first stage of the rice planting is completed around the time of "Hagessho," so "Hagessho Mochi" is made as a way to take a break. "Hagessho Mochi" is made by mixing tsubushi komugi (crushed wheat) and glutinous rice, so it is sometimes referred to as "Komugi Mochi." It is also called "Sanaburi Mochi," as it is eaten at the Sanaburi ceremony to thank the gods of the rice paddies after the rice planting.
2acc40c9bca2a8f6.zh: 夏至後第11天稱為「半夏生」。在奈良盆地，大約在「半夏生」前後小麥收成結束、第一階段的插秧也已完成，因此會製作「半夏生餅」作為休息。「半夏生餅」是將つぶし小麦（壓碎的小麥）與糯米混合製成，因此有時也稱為「小麦餅」。由於會在插秧後感謝田神的「さなぶり」儀式中食用，也稱為「さなぶり餅」。

2ad7954ed1e3bd40.en: Mount Gusuku (Japanese: 城山, Hepburn: Gusuku-yama; Kunigami: Tatchū-yama) is a mountain on the island of Iejima, northwest of Okinawa Island. At 172.2 m (565.0 ft) tall, it is the highest point on Iejima. Mount Gusuku is considered a symbol of Iejima due to its distinctive conical shape.
2ad7954ed1e3bd40.zh: 城山（日語：城山，平文式羅馬字：Gusuku-yama；國頭語：Tatchū-yama）是位於沖繩本島西北方伊江島上的山。標高172.2公尺（565.0英尺），為伊江島最高點。城山因其獨特的圓錐形外觀，被視為伊江島的象徵。

2ae73ef698927218.en: Kaiwo Maru (海王丸) is a Japanese former training barque. She was built by Kawasaki Shipbuilding Corporation in Kobe, and was launched on 27 January 1930 alongside her sister ship Nippon Maru. She was operated by the Tokyo Institute for Maritime Training to train officers for Japan's merchant marine. At the beginning of World War II, her sailing rig was removed and she served as a training and postwar transport motorship.
2ae73ef698927218.zh: 海王丸是日本的退役三桅訓練帆船，由川崎造船所於神戶建造，1930年1月27日與姊妹船日本丸一同下水。該船由航海訓練所營運，用於培訓日本商船隊的船員幹部。第二次世界大戰初期，船上的帆裝被拆除，改作為訓練船，戰後則作為運輸用機動船使用。

2af8548ccfd6e2d9.en: Kamome Island (鷗島, Kamome Jima) is an island (or more precisely, peninsula) in the Sea of Japan just off the coast of the town of Esashi, Hokkaidō, Japan. The island serves as a breakwater for the Esashi port. It has several historical sites and is protected as a part of the Hiyama Prefectural Natural Park. Every July, there is a two-day festival that attracts tourists to the island. People visit the island throughout the year for swimming, camping, fishing and other recreational activities.
2af8548ccfd6e2d9.zh: 鴎島是日本海上的一座島嶼（更精確地說是半島），位於日本北海道江差町沿岸外側。該島是江差港的防波堤，島上有多處史蹟，並作為檜山道立自然公園的一部分受到保護。每年7月會舉行為期兩天的祭典，吸引遊客前來。全年都有人到島上游泳、露營、釣魚及從事其他休閒活動。

2b00565b88b1cf81.en: Maxell Aqua Park Shinagawa (ja: マクセルアクアパーク品川, Makuseru Akua Pāku Shinagawa), formerly Epson Aqua Park Shinagawa, Epson Shinagawa Aqua Stadium is a public aquarium located inside the Shinagawa Prince Hotel in Minato, Tokyo. It can be accessed from Shinagawa Station. It is a member of the Japanese Association of Zoos and Aquariums (JAZA).
2b00565b88b1cf81.zh: Maxell Aqua Park品川（マクセルアクアパーク品川），舊稱Epson Aqua Park品川、Epson品川Aqua Stadium，是位於東京都港區品川王子大飯店內的公共水族館，可從品川車站前往。該館為日本動物園水族館協會（JAZA）會員。

2b09e65a18ae3c2b.en: Dainichi-ji (大日寺) is a Tōji Shingon temple in Itano, Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. Temple 4 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage, the main image is of Dainichi Nyorai. The temple is said to have been founded by Kōbō Daishi, who carved the image.
2b09e65a18ae3c2b.zh: 大日寺是位於日本德島縣板野的東寺真言宗寺院。為四國八十八所遍路第4番寺院，本尊為大日如來。據傳由弘法大師創建，本尊亦為其所雕。

2b19c2af47f22326.en: Tōmyō-ji (Japanese: 東明寺, Hepburn: Eastern Bright Temple) is a Buddhist temple in Kawagoe, Saitama, Japan. It is noted as a principle location of the night battle during the Siege of Kawagoe Castle on April 20, 1546.
2b19c2af47f22326.zh: 東明寺是位於日本埼玉縣川越市的佛教寺院，以1546年4月20日河越城之戰中夜戰的主要地點之一而聞名。

2b1d2a91a6a0e4c0.en: Butterbur sprouts, also known as "Fukinoto", are a well-known delicacy in spring. Shimane Prefecture is particularly famous for this wild vegetable, which is abundant in its clean water and fertile land. The arrival of spring is heralded by these sprouts, which can be found growing in rice paddies, mountain forests, city banks, and parks. They are picked by elderly people on their walks, and children on their way home from school.
2b1d2a91a6a0e4c0.zh: 款冬花莖又稱「ふきのとう」，是知名的春季美味。島根縣水質清澈、土地肥沃，這種野菜相當豐富，特別有名。這些花莖預告春天的到來，在水田、山林、市區河堤和公園都能看到。散步的老人和放學回家的孩子都會摘採。

2b1d6b745a165cad.en: The Fuji Sengen Shrine (富士浅間神社, Fuji Sengen Jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Ōsu in central Nagoya, central Japan.
2b1d6b745a165cad.zh: 富士淺間神社是位於日本中部名古屋市中心大須的神社。

2b30ef2012b58d2b.en: Mount Kami (Kami-yama (神山; lit. 'god mountain')) is the highest peak of Mount Hakone, at  1,438 metres (4,718 ft), in Hakone, Kanagawa, Japan. Worshipping Mount Hakone with its highest peak is recorded in a 12th-century document, as having started at the time of the legendary Emperor Kōshō (475 BC to 393 BC).
2b30ef2012b58d2b.zh: 神山是日本神奈川縣箱根町箱根山的最高峰，海拔1,438公尺（4,718英尺）。根據12世紀的文獻記載，以其最高峰為中心的箱根山信仰始於傳說中的孝昭天皇時代（西元前475年至西元前393年）。

2b3854c5e52c6f88.en: "Garagara-Oroshi" is a local dish of Mie Prefecture made with a special bamboo grater which is named “Oni-Oroshi-Ki” (Demon grater).During the Edo period (1603-1868), rice was paid as annual tribute, but when rice could not be delivered, it was offered as a substitute for rice.
2b3854c5e52c6f88.zh: 「ガラガラおろし」是三重縣的鄉土料理，使用一種名為「鬼おろし器」（鬼磨泥器）的特製竹製磨泥器製作。江戶時代（1603-1868）以米繳納年貢，無法繳交米時，便以此作為米的替代品上繳。

2b415eb3e1a38179.en: Kōsan-ji (耕三寺) is a Hongan-ji school Jōdo Shinshū temple on the island of Ikuchijima in Onomichi, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. Founded by the industrialist Kōzō Kanamoto (later Koso Kōsanji) in 1936 in honour of his deceased mother, and with an area of approximately fifty thousand square metres, many of its structures are modelled upon the country's most famous historic temples and shrines.
2b415eb3e1a38179.zh: 耕三寺是位於日本廣島縣尾道市生口島上的淨土真宗本願寺派寺院。1936年由實業家金本耕三（後改名耕三寺耕三）為紀念亡母而創建，面積約五萬平方公尺，寺內許多建築仿照日本國內最著名的歷史寺社建造。

2b65e33870b6eab0.en: "Imabari Yakitori" is a type of yakitori in which the un-skewered skin is lightly grilled on a griddle and pressed with a small plate of iron weight, invented about 50 years ago. The fact that the chicken skin is grilled on a thick iron plate and not skewered is a unique Imabari cooking method. By grilling on a Teppan(iron griddle), the fat from the chicken is used to fry it, and the pressing steams it, allowing it to be cooked quickly and served faster.
2b65e33870b6eab0.zh: 今治燒鳥是約50年前發明的一種燒鳥，將不串籤的雞皮放在鐵板上略煎，並用小盤狀的鐵製重物壓著。雞皮在厚鐵板上煎烤而不串籤，是今治獨特的烹調方式。在鐵板上煎烤時，利用雞肉本身的油脂來煎，再加上壓製時的蒸氣，能快速煮熟，更快上桌。

2bb631ab82fc781a.en: "Hasu" (Opsariichthys uncirostris/Three-lips) is originally a species endemic to the Lake Biwa and "Mikata Goko" (five lakes in Fukui Prefecture), and piscivore freshwater fish, which is rare to cyprinidae. "Hasu" has characteristic to swim around quick and sharp to chase its prey, and it becomes weaker if it doesn’t keep swimming. It starts weaken suddenly right after being caught with fishing nets, and most of fish died when it was removed from the nets. Therefore, it isn’t distributed widely and eaten in the limited area.
2bb631ab82fc781a.zh: 「ハス」（Opsariichthys uncirostris／三口魚）原本是琵琶湖與「三方五湖」（福井縣的五座湖）的特有種，是鯉科中少見的肉食性淡水魚。ハス的特性是會快速而敏捷地游動追捕獵物，若不持續游動就會變得虛弱。被漁網捕獲後會突然衰弱，從網中取出時大多已經死亡。因此並未廣泛流通，只在有限的地區食用。

2bc151a5c850646a.en: Omi beef marinated in miso is a local dish of Shiga Prefecture, where Omi beef is marinated in white miso paste and left to rest for several days before being grilled.In the Edo period (1603-1867), it was against the law to slaughter cattle and horses, but in 1781, the Hikone clan offered miso-marinated beef to the shogunate and the three Tokugawa families as a complementary medicine, and the dish came to be consumed publicly.
2bc151a5c850646a.zh: 「近江牛の味噌漬」是滋賀縣的鄉土料理，將近江牛醃漬在白味噌中，靜置數日後再燒烤。江戶時代（1603-1867）法律禁止宰殺牛馬，但1781年彥根藩將味噌醃牛肉作為輔助藥物獻給幕府及德川御三家，這道料理此後便公開被食用。

2bc3b9acc563d1aa.en: Agriculture has been practiced since ancient times in Ibaraki prefecture to take advantage of the year-round temperate climate and good water quality. Living up to its reputation as an "Agricultural Prefecture," Ibaraki boasts the top-class production in Japan of numerous vegetables including napa cabbage, lotus root, green bell pepper, and produces all kinds of ingredients ranging from vegetables to meat.
2bc3b9acc563d1aa.zh: 茨城縣自古以來利用全年溫和的氣候與良好的水質發展農業。茨城不負「農業縣」之名，大白菜、蓮藕、青椒等多種蔬菜的產量居日本前列，從蔬菜到肉類，各種食材皆有生產。

2bd181fa8dd3fe11.en: Shirongo Matsuri (しろんご祭) is a Japanese festival that takes place on the island of Sugashima in Toba, Mie Prefecture, Japan in early July each year.
2bd181fa8dd3fe11.zh: しろんご祭り是每年7月上旬在日本三重縣鳥羽市菅島舉行的日本祭典。

2beb7a410607905f.en: There are three origins of the name of "oyster Dote-nabe". The first is that miso is coated on the inside of the pot like a bank. The second is that Chokichi Dote was the inventor of this nabe dish. The third is said to be because oyster boats that transported oysters from Hiroshima to Osaka during the Edo period served the nabe on the river bank. The characteristic feature of this way of eating is that the taste is adjusted by breaking up the miso paste coated on the edge of the nabe.
2beb7a410607905f.zh: 「牡蠣土手鍋」的名稱有三種由來。第一種是味噌像堤防一樣塗在鍋子內側。第二種是這道鍋料理的發明者名叫土手長吉。第三種據說是江戶時代從廣島運送牡蠣到大阪的牡蠣船，在河岸邊供應這道鍋料理。這種吃法的特色是一邊把塗在鍋緣的味噌弄散，一邊調整味道。

2bf41f8acb79f1ef.en: The Porte Kanazawa (ポルテ金沢, Porute Kanazawa) is a skyscraper located in Kanazawa, Isikawa Prefecture, Japan.
2bf41f8acb79f1ef.zh: ポルテ金沢是位於日本石川縣金澤市的摩天大樓。

2c0e28865ba55054.en: Kujukuri area is rich in seafood and local delicacies, and it has been known for its favorable fishing grounds since long ago. Sardines are the representative seafood of the Kujukuri area, and they are nicknamed the "Rice of the Sea" because they have been caught in large quantities since the Edo period. There are a large variety of dishes that take advantage of the deliciousness and nutritious value of sardines, which are a mainstay of dining tables throughout the Kujukuri area.
2c0e28865ba55054.zh: 九十九里地區海產與當地美食豐富，自古以來即以優良漁場聞名。沙丁魚是九十九里地區的代表性海產，自江戶時代起漁獲量就很大，因而有「海之米」的稱號。運用沙丁魚美味與營養價值的料理種類繁多，是九十九里地區各家餐桌上的常見菜色。

2c0ffe3b4799ed85.en: Fukagawa-meshi" is said to have been originally made by quickly boiling leeks and raw clams in miso and pouring the broth over rice. Today, there are two types of "Fukagawa-meshi": bukkake and takikomi. There is also "Fukagawa nabe" which is not served over rice.In the Edo period, there were many mud flats in what is now Tokyo Bay, which were a treasure house of shellfish.
2c0ffe3b4799ed85.zh: 據說「深川めし」最初的做法，是將蔥和生的蛤蜊放入味噌中快煮，再將湯汁淋在飯上。現在的「深川めし」有淋飯（ぶっかけ）與炊飯（炊き込み）兩種，另外也有不搭配米飯的「深川鍋」。江戶時代，現在的東京灣有許多泥灘，是貝類的寶庫。

2c309170a6d19a25.en: Chiringashima (知林ヶ島) is an island in Ibusuki, Kagoshima, Japan.
2c309170a6d19a25.zh: 知林島是位於日本鹿兒島縣指宿市的島嶼。

2c34634feeaf12d7.en: The Aomori City Forestry Museum (青森市森林博物館, Aomori-shi Shinrin Hakubutsukan) is a natural history museum located in the city of Aomori in Aomori Prefecture, Japan. The museum focuses primarily on the forest ecosystems of Aomori Prefecture and the history of the lumber industry in the prefecture, though other unrelated exhibits are also maintained.
2c34634feeaf12d7.zh: 青森市森林博物館是位於日本青森縣青森市的自然史博物館。館內主要介紹青森縣的森林生態系與縣內木材產業的歷史，另外也設有其他無關的展覽。

2c3835a42d0925df.en: Fuukashi made with asari clams is a local dish in the Bay Area stretching from Futtsu City to Funabashi City. During the Edo period, Funabashi City prospered as a post town along the major transportation route, boosting their agricultural and fishing industry. The fresh seafood caught in Funabashi Bay was even offered to the shogun’s clan. In particular, asari clams were abundant, meaty, and incredibly delicious. Since there were no refrigeration facilities back then, the fishermen steamed the asari before transporting them.
2c3835a42d0925df.zh: 以蛤蜊製作的「ふうかし」，是從富津市到船橋市的東京灣沿岸地區的鄉土料理。江戶時代，船橋市作為主要交通路線上的宿場町而繁榮，帶動了農業與漁業發展。船橋灣捕獲的新鮮海產甚至進獻給將軍家。其中蛤蜊產量豐富，肉質飽滿，非常美味。由於當時沒有冷藏設備，漁民會先將蛤蜊蒸熟再運送。

2c52bed6317dada1.en: Seiryū-ji (青龍寺) is a Kōyasan Betsuin (affiliate temple) located in Aomori, Aomori Prefecture. The temple was founded by a Great Acharya Ryūkou Oda (織田隆弘), who later built Shōwa Daibutsu (昭和大仏) in 1984. Roughly 21.35 meters in height, it is the tallest seated bronze figure of Buddha in Japan.
2c52bed6317dada1.zh: 青龍寺是位於青森縣青森市的高野山別院。由大阿闍梨織田隆弘創建，他後來於1984年建造了昭和大佛。大佛高約21.35公尺，為日本最高的青銅坐佛。

2c59d2ab11028235.en: Okuhino Prefectural Natural Park (奥日野県立自然公園, Okuhino kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in southwest Tottori Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1994, the park spans the municipalities of Hino and Nichinan.
2c59d2ab11028235.zh: 奧日野縣立自然公園位於日本鳥取縣西南部，為縣立自然公園。1994年設立，範圍橫跨日野町與日南町。

2c684c33484d4e69.en: Snow crab is called “Matsuba Crab” in the San'in region and “Echizen Crab” in the Hokuriku region. Matsuba Crab is a specialty of the Tajima region facing the Sea of Japan and is characterized by its freshly boiled meat that is flaky but still has the slight sweetness of crab even when cold. Some people believe that the crab is called Matsuba Crab because pine needles were used as fuel when boiling the crab, or because the crab meat spreads out like pine needles when dipped in water.
2c684c33484d4e69.zh: 松葉蟹（ズワイガニ）在山陰地區稱為「松葉蟹」，在北陸地區稱為「越前蟹」。松葉蟹是面向日本海的但馬地區特產，特色是剛煮好的蟹肉鬆軟，即使放涼仍帶有蟹肉淡淡的甜味。有人認為松葉蟹之名，是因為煮蟹時以松葉為燃料，或是因為蟹肉泡入水中時會像松葉般散開。

2c73650ddfeee517.en: It is a dish in eastern-central Tottori Prefecture used fava beans. Fava beans are heavy and has a bit sweet flavor. There are two types of fava beans; dried ripen fava beans and young fava beans. Dried one is used for ‘Soramame no Kofuki’.The best season for fava bean is early summer, from April until June. It loses its freshness very quickly, and it is said it loses its fresh taste after 3days. Therefore, drying beans is the best way to keep beans tasty for a long time.
2c73650ddfeee517.zh: 這是鳥取縣東部至中部使用蠶豆製作的料理。蠶豆口感厚實，帶有些許甜味。蠶豆分為兩種：成熟後乾燥的蠶豆和嫩蠶豆。「そら豆の粉吹き」使用的是乾燥蠶豆。蠶豆的盛產期是初夏的4月至6月。蠶豆很快就會失去新鮮度，據說3天後就會失去鮮味。因此，乾燥是讓豆子長時間保持美味的最佳方法。

2c8c9bb2aafb202b.en: "Orido-nasu" is a native species of eggplant from Miho area in Shimizu Ward, Shizuoka City, and its characteristics are round shape, sharp thorns, dark purple skin and rich and sweet teste. Its richer flavor compared with regular eggplants goes well with dishes with miso like "dengaku", and makes popular. It is said that it is an eggplant in Japanese saying "First Mt. Fuji, Second Hawk, Third Eggplant." (This saying explains what is the lucky sign when you have the first dream of the new year. Mt.
2c8c9bb2aafb202b.zh: 折戸なす是靜岡市清水區三保地區的原生種茄子，特徵是外形圓、刺尖銳、外皮深紫色，味道濃郁甘甜。風味比一般茄子濃郁，與田樂等使用味噌的料理很搭，因而受到歡迎。據說日本俗諺「一富士、二鷹、三茄子」中的茄子就是指這種茄子。（這句俗諺說明新年第一個夢見到什麼是吉兆。富士

2cadf3f3b9b15a36.en: Abalone shellfish is a specialty of Yamanashi Prefecture. There are various theories as to why abalone, a seafood, became a specialty in an inland area surrounded by mountains and not facing the sea. One of them is that it was not easy to transport abundant seafood from the neighboring Suruga Bay (Shizuoka Prefecture) across mountains without transportation and refrigeration facilities as is the case today, and only a few salted or dried fish were delivered.
2cadf3f3b9b15a36.zh: 鮑魚是山梨縣的名產。為何身為海產的鮑魚，會成為群山環繞、不臨海的內陸地區名產，有各種說法。其中一說是，當時不像今天有交通運輸和冷藏設備，要將鄰近駿河灣（靜岡縣）豐富的海產翻山越嶺運來並不容易，只有少數鹽漬或乾燥的魚能送達。

2cb1321c63b0f040.en: A traditional fermented food representing Ishikawa Prefecture, with Salted yellowtail sandwiched between salted pickled Kabura (turnips). It is one of the "Nare-zushi", which is different from the traditional Sushi using Vinegared Rice, and is similar to pickles.There are various theories as to its origin.
2cb1321c63b0f040.zh: 代表石川縣的傳統發酵食品，將鹽漬鰤魚夾在鹽醃的蕪菁之間製成。屬於「熟壽司」的一種，與使用醋飯的傳統壽司不同，較接近醃漬物。關於其起源有多種說法。

2cbb440cf5b95090.en: Geto Onsen is an onsen town with traditional ryokan (Japanese inn) and natural hot spring baths. It was founded in 1134, and is one of the oldest establishments in Japan.
2cbb440cf5b95090.zh: 夏油溫泉是一處溫泉鄉，有傳統旅館及天然溫泉浴池。創立於1134年，是日本歷史最悠久的設施之一。

2cbec0c2357887fa.en: When it comes to the cuisine of Children's Day (Tango no Sekku), "Chimaki" and "Kashiwamochi" are representative, but in Aichi Prefecture, in addition to these, there is a custom of eating "Kii-nai Okowa". It is also known as "Kiihan" or "Kimeshi." While similar dishes exist in Oita and Shizuoka Prefectures, the names differ, with them being called "Ouhan" and "Someii" respectively.During Children's Day, various prayers and rituals are performed to wish for the healthy growth and well-being of boys.
2cbec0c2357887fa.zh: 說到兒童節（端午節）的料理，以「粽子」和「柏餅」為代表，但在愛知縣，除了這些之外，還有吃「黄いないおこわ」的習俗。這道料理也稱為「黄飯」或「黄飯（きめし）」。大分縣和靜岡縣也有類似的料理，但名稱不同，分別稱為「黄飯（おうはん）」和「染飯」。兒童節期間會舉行各種祈禱與儀式，祈求男孩健康成長、平安順遂。

2cc1a55d93434d21.en: "Barazushi" is made by mixing vinegared rice with seasonal vegetables and other ingredients, and it is mainly eaten on special occasions. When serving to guests, it usually features Spanish mackerel, mackerel, and gizzard shad marinated in vinegar, conger eel teriyaki, shredded egg crepe, red pickled ginger, and sansho pepper leaves.
2cc1a55d93434d21.zh: 「ばらずし」是將醋飯與當季蔬菜等食材拌勻製成，主要在特殊場合食用。招待客人時，通常會加上醋漬的土魠魚、鯖魚和窩斑鰶，以及照燒星鰻、蛋絲、紅薑和山椒葉。

2cd4fe1d43a33d28.en: Rōken Shrine (老犬神社, Rōken jinja) is a small Shintō shrine in Ōdate, Akita Prefecture, Japan dedicated to dogs.
2cd4fe1d43a33d28.zh: 老犬神社是位於日本秋田縣大館市的一座小型神社，供奉的對象是狗。

2cd9c8ffef38701a.en: The Tajima Yahei Sericulture Farm (旧田島弥平旧宅, Tajima Yahei kyū-taku) is located in the Sakaishima neighbored of the city of Isesaki, Gunma. It was the former home of an influential silk farmer in the early Meiji period, known for writing a new sericulture theory which laid the foundations for modern sericultural production. The building has been protected as a National Historic Site since 2012. It was subsequently included as part of The Tomioka Silk Mill and Related Industrial Heritage UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2013.
2cd9c8ffef38701a.zh: 田島弥平旧宅位於群馬縣伊勢崎市境島村。這裡是明治初期一位具影響力的養蠶農家的故居，他以撰寫新的養蠶理論而聞名，該理論奠定了近代養蠶生產的基礎。建築自2012年起作為國家史跡受到保護，其後於2013年納入聯合國教科文組織世界遺產「富岡製絲場與絲綢產業遺產群」。
