2cfd60a662474ea3.en: Toneri Park (舎人公園, Toneri Kōen) is a public park in Adachi Ward, Tokyo, Japan. It is the third biggest park in the 23 special wards of Tokyo. It was opened in 1981 to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the Showa Emperor's ascension. The park can be accessed from the adjacent Toneri-kōen Station.
2cfd60a662474ea3.zh: 舎人公園（舎人公園）是位於日本東京都足立區的公園，是東京23區內第三大的公園。公園於1981年開放，以紀念昭和天皇即位50週年。可從鄰近的舎人公園站前往。

2d066e24271a2c3a.en: The Chikugo River Lift Bridge (筑後川昇開橋, Chikugo-gawa shōkaikyō) is a vertical lift railway bridge across the Chikugo River in Kyūshū, Japan. It was completed in 1935. The bridge has a total length of 507.2 metres (1,664 ft), with a moveable span of 24.2 metres (79 ft) long and a vertical rise of 23 metres (75 ft). It links Ōkawa, Fukuoka with Saga, Saga, and used to be part of the Saga Railway Line. When that line ceased operation in 1987 the bridge was closed to traffic.
2d066e24271a2c3a.zh: 筑後川昇開橋是日本九州橫跨筑後川的垂直升降式鐵路橋，1935年完工。全長507.2公尺（1,664英尺），可動段長24.2公尺（79英尺），垂直升起高度23公尺（75英尺）。此橋連接福岡縣大川市與佐賀縣佐賀市，過去是國鐵佐賀線的一部分。該線於1987年停駛後，此橋即封閉停止通行。

2d2ae9066f859b09.en: "Takana (=giant red mustard)" is a type of leaf mustard, and its leaves and stems have a tangy and pungent taste. "Pickled takana" was introduced to the market during the Meiji Period. Takana were produced by mixing a mustard green from Sichuan, China with a local variety. This new vegetable was named the “Miike Takana”. Miike "Takana" have crispy leaves and its scent and spiciness are well-balanced. This vegetable was first grown in the Chikugo district, particularly in the town of Setakamachi in Miyama city.
2d2ae9066f859b09.zh: 「高菜（大紅芥菜）」是葉芥菜的一種，葉與莖帶有嗆辣味。「高菜漬」在明治時代開始上市。高菜是由中國四川的芥菜與當地品種交配而成，這種新蔬菜被命名為「三池高菜」。三池高菜葉片爽脆，香氣與辣味均衡。這種蔬菜最早在筑後地區栽種，尤其是三山市的瀨高町。

2d2c7f1e136bc09a.en: Nanzo-in (南蔵院) is a Shingon Buddhist temple in Sasaguri, Fukuoka, Japan. It is notable for its bronze statue of a reclining Buddha, said to be the largest bronze statue of the Buddha reclining as he enters Nirvana in the world.
2d2c7f1e136bc09a.zh: 南藏院是位於日本福岡縣篠栗町的真言宗寺院，以青銅臥佛像聞名，據說是世界最大的佛陀入涅槃青銅臥像。

2d38ac2698e44d64.en: Fumi-shima (経島) is an islet 180 metres (590 ft) from the shore near Izumo, Shimane, Japan. It is a nesting place for around 5,000 Black-tailed Gulls each Spring, and has been recognised as an Important Bird Area (IBA) by BirdLife International. The islet used to have a shrine  dedicated to Hinomisaki Jinja. Only the shrine priests were allowed to visit the island so the gulls settled virtually undisturbed.
2d38ac2698e44d64.zh: 経島是位於日本島根縣出雲市附近、距岸邊180公尺（590英尺）的小島。每年春季約有5,000隻黑尾鷗在此築巢，並經國際鳥盟認定為重要野鳥棲地（IBA）。島上過去有一座奉祀日御碕神社的神社，只有神職人員可以登島，因此海鷗幾乎不受干擾地在此棲息。

2d3d7d41344fd6ef.en: Chua Vietnam (Vietnamese: Chùa Việt Nam / 厨越南) is a Vietnamese Buddhist temple in Aikawa town, Aikō District, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. It was established in 2006 and the current building was completed in 2017.
2d3d7d41344fd6ef.zh: チュアベトナム（越南語：Chùa Việt Nam／厨越南）是位於日本神奈川縣愛甲郡愛川町的越南佛教寺院。創立於2006年，現有建築於2017年完工。

2d5d4e94610695d7.en: Daikon radich has been consumed since ancient times and is mentioned in Japan's oldest documents, the "Kojiki" and "Nihon Shoki." The name "daikon" itself is said to have originated from its large size, being called "oone" or from its white color and cool appearance, referred to as "suzushiro." The Shosoin documents mention the use of Chinese characters to represent daikon radish.
2d5d4e94610695d7.zh: 白蘿蔔自古即被食用，在日本最古老的文獻《古事記》與《日本書紀》中都有記載。「大根」這個名稱據說源自其體型碩大而被稱為「おおね」，或是因其白色清涼的外觀而被稱為「すずしろ」。正倉院文書中也記載了以漢字表示白蘿蔔的用法。

2d6427c580780eb2.en: Ōya-dera (大谷寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the city of Utsunomiya, Tochigi Prefecture, in northern Kantō region of Japan. The temple is famous for its bas-relief carvings on a cliff face.  It belongs to the  Tendai sect and its honzon is a statue of Senjū Kannon Bosatsu (Sahasrabhūja). The temple's full name is Tenkai-zan Jodo-in Ōya-ji (天開山 浄土院 大谷寺).The temple is the 19th stop on the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route.
2d6427c580780eb2.zh: 大谷寺是位於日本北關東地方栃木縣宇都宮市的佛教寺院，以崖壁上的浮雕聞名。此寺屬天台宗，本尊為千手觀音菩薩像。寺院全名為天開山 淨土院 大谷寺。此寺為坂東三十三所巡禮路線的第19番札所。

2d6e3515e18114c4.en: Kōnomine Castle (高嶺城, Kōnomine-jō) is a castle structure in Yamaguchi, Japan. It is located on a 338 meter mountain.
2d6e3515e18114c4.zh: 高嶺城是位於日本山口的城郭建築，坐落於一座高338公尺的山上。

2db2d2fe2bfba0a2.en: In the past, the Iya region of Tokushima was surrounded by mountains, and the climate was considered difficult for rice to grow. It is said that when the Heike clan came to the Iya region after losing the Genpei War, they grew buckwheat seeds, which were a good substitute for rice and had a short growing season, and began to produce buckwheat noodles. Soba-mai Zosui (buckwheat rice porridge) is a local dish born from this soba culture.
2db2d2fe2bfba0a2.zh: 過去德島的祖谷地區四面環山，氣候被認為不易種植稻米。據說平家在源平合戰落敗後來到祖谷地區，種植了可作為稻米替代品、生長期又短的蕎麥，並開始製作蕎麥麵。そば米雑炊（蕎麥米雜炊）就是從這種蕎麥文化中誕生的鄉土料理。

2db7a05253756842.en: "Hoya" (=Sea Squirt) is called ‘Pineapple in the sea’, and is known as a food contains all five tastes; sweetness, sourness, saltiness, "umami" (=savoriness) and bitterness. It also contains plenty of nutrients like taurine, glycogen, zinc, vitamin E or vitamin B12. It is characteristic as well that it gets smelly and harsh taste when it is not fresh. It takes 3~4 years to grow. Its best season is summer, but from December to January, season for bearing eggs, is also great.
2db7a05253756842.zh: 「海鞘」（ほや）被稱為「海中鳳梨」，以同時具備甜、酸、鹹、鮮、苦五種味道的食材聞名。也富含牛磺酸、肝醣、鋅、維生素E、維生素B12等營養素。另一個特點是不新鮮時會產生腥味與澀味。需要3～4年才能長成。盛產期是夏季，但12月至1月的產卵期也很美味。

2dcc7fc134b79e49.en: Kuwai no Ama-ni is a stew that is known for its sweet taste, which is seasoned with broth, sugar, and mirin. The dish is named after "kuwaimo," a potato-like fruit that grows under the leaves shaped like a hoe for digging up the earth. There are three types of arrowhead: ao kuwai (blue arrowhead), shiroi kuwai (white arrowhead), and suita kuwai. Ao kuwai, the main type grown in Japan, is characterized by its round, spherical shape and vivid blue surface.
2dcc7fc134b79e49.zh: くわいの甘煮是以高湯、砂糖和味醂調味的燉煮料理，以甜味著稱。料理名稱取自「くわい芋」，這是一種生長在形似掘土用鋤頭的葉子下方、類似芋頭的果實。慈姑有三種：青慈姑、白慈姑和吹田慈姑。青慈姑是日本栽培的主要品種，特徵是呈圓球形，表面為鮮明的青色。

2e0cb0029769b9f0.en: Ikehara Dam is an arch dam located in Nara prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for power production. The catchment area of the dam is 300 km2. The dam impounds about 843  ha of land when full and can store 338373 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1962 and completed in 1964.
2e0cb0029769b9f0.zh: 池原水壩是位於日本奈良縣的拱壩，用於發電。集水面積為300平方公里，滿水時淹沒面積約843公頃，蓄水量為338373千立方公尺。水壩於1962年動工，1964年完工。

2e18be22fce1a97e.en: Sōfuku-ji (崇福寺) is a Buddhist temple located in Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. The temple has strong ties to both Saitō Dōsan and Oda Nobunaga. Gifu's Sōfuku-ji is famed throughout Japan for both the number of monks it produces and for its "Blood Ceiling". Shortly after its founding, it was also known as Kōsai-ji (弘済寺), but that name is no longer used. It is also one of the Mino Thirty-three Kannon.
2e18be22fce1a97e.zh: 崇福寺是位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市的佛寺，與齋藤道三及織田信長都有深厚淵源。岐阜的崇福寺以培育眾多僧侶及「血天井」聞名全日本。創建後不久亦稱弘濟寺（弘済寺），但此名稱已不再使用。本寺也是美濃三十三觀音之一。

2e21b93ccd09532f.en: Katsumoto Castle (勝本城, Katsumoto-jō) was an Sengoku period yamajiro-style Japanese castle located in the Katsumoto neighborhood of the city of Iki, Nagasaki Prefecture, Japan.  Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2002. It was also known as Azamoto Castle (別称風本) or Amasekane Castle (武末城・雨瀬包).
2e21b93ccd09532f.zh: 勝本城是戰國時代的山城式日本城郭，位於日本長崎縣壹岐市勝本地區。其遺址自2002年起被指定為國家史跡。別稱風本城或武末城（雨瀨包）。

2e356def848a850f.en: Invented by "Ohara Yugaku", a farmer leader active in the late Edo period. The name 'Seigaku mochi' is a reference to the study of 'seigaku' taught by Ohara Yugaku.
2e356def848a850f.zh: 由江戶時代後期活躍的農民指導者「大原幽學」所發明。「性学もち」的名稱來自大原幽學所教授的「性學」。

2e55f0dc0274bb67.en: “Taipiien” is a local dish served at Chinese restaurants and at home. It is a soup made with “harusame”(=glass noodles) and stir-fried vegetables, pork, shrimp, bamboo shoot, kamaboko(=Fish cake), shiitake mushroom and other ingredients. The dish is served with a fried hard-boiled egg on top.This dish was influenced by a soup dish from Fuzhou, Fujian of China, eaten on special occasions such as during the Bon holiday, New Year’s, and other celebrations.
2e55f0dc0274bb67.zh: 「太平燕」是在中華料理店和家庭中都會出現的鄉土料理。這是一道湯品，以「春雨」（冬粉）加上拌炒過的蔬菜、豬肉、蝦、竹筍、魚板、香菇等材料製成，上面放一顆炸過的水煮蛋。這道料理受到中國福建福州的一道湯品影響，那道湯在盂蘭盆節、新年及其他慶祝活動等特殊場合食用。

2e5b91fdd89ee958.en: ‘Tonkotsu’ is a local dish simmered roasted spare rib with ‘shochu’ distilled spirit after grilled, with konjac (yam cake), daikon radish or other vegetables, miso and brown sugar.
2e5b91fdd89ee958.zh: 「豚骨」是一道鄉土料理，將烤過的豬肋排加入燒酎燉煮，再與蒟蒻、白蘿蔔或其他蔬菜、味噌及黑糖一同烹煮。

2e6095f971dc16fd.en: Satake Historical Museum (秋田市立佐竹史料館, Akita Shiritsu Satake Shiryōkan) opened in Akita, Akita Prefecture, Japan in 1990. Located in the grounds of Kubota Castle in Senshū Park (千秋公園), the collection relates to the Satake clan, daimyō of the Akita Domain.
2e6095f971dc16fd.zh: 秋田市立佐竹史料館於1990年在日本秋田縣秋田市開館。館址位於千秋公園內的久保田城遺址，館藏與秋田藩大名佐竹氏相關。

2e6b5b67b4e47136.en: The Tokuyama Dam (徳山ダム, Tokuyama damu) is an embankment dam near Ibigawa, Ibi District, Gifu Prefecture in Japan. The dam was completed in 2008 and will support a 153 MW hydroelectric power station that is expected to be fully operational in 2015. Unit 1 at 23 MW was commissioned in May 2014. The dam was originally intended to withhold the upper reservoir of a 400 MW pumped-storage power station until a design change in 2004. The dam is also intended for flood control and water supply.
2e6b5b67b4e47136.zh: 徳山ダム是位於日本岐阜縣揖斐郡揖斐川町附近的填築式水壩。水壩於2008年完工，將供應一座153百萬瓦的水力發電廠，預計於2015年全面運轉。23百萬瓦的1號機組已於2014年5月啟用。在2004年變更設計之前，這座水壩原本預定作為一座400百萬瓦抽蓄發電廠的上池。水壩也具有防洪及供水功能。

2e962ee84ab9aea1.en: "Beko mochi" is a local sweet shaped like leaves with branch-like patterns on it with mainly black and white, and has been very familiar with Hokkaido locals. People eat this mochi during the Boy’s festival, May 5th in Hokkaido. There is also a sweet called "Beko mochi" in Aomori Prefecture, with same ingredient but different shape and patterns.It is common to see leave-like black and white two color "Beko mochi" but you can find ones with various shapes and colors, especially in the southern Hokkaido.
2e962ee84ab9aea1.zh: 「べこ餅」是一種葉子形狀、帶有枝狀花紋的鄉土甜點，以黑白兩色為主，北海道人對它相當熟悉。北海道人在5月5日端午節（男孩節）時食用這種餅。青森縣也有名為「べこ餅」的甜點，材料相同，但形狀與花紋不同。常見的是葉子形狀的黑白雙色「べこ餅」，但也能找到各種形狀和顏色的，尤其在北海道南部。

2ea4f7dbd2f800be.en: "Barrappa Manju" has been made in the Hokuso region of Chiba Prefecture since ancient times and is eaten on special occasions such as summer festivals and Obon(=Buddhist festival for honoring the spirits of ancestors). Around the end of the wheat harvest season, wheat that has finished harvesting is ground into flour, and homemade sweet bean paste is used to make wheat steamed buns.
2ea4f7dbd2f800be.zh: 「ばらっぱまんじゅう」自古以來在千葉縣北總地區製作，於夏季祭典與盂蘭盆節（祭祀祖先靈魂的佛教節日）等特別場合食用。在小麥收成季節接近尾聲時，將收成的小麥磨成麵粉，搭配自製紅豆餡，做成小麥蒸饅頭。

2ec01a26369e29da.en: Takadachi Gikeidō (高館義経堂) is a Buddhist chapel located in Hiraizumi in what is now southern Iwate Prefecture in the Tōhoku region of Japan, dedicated to Minamoto no Yoshitsune. It was designated a nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty in 2014 as part of the Landscapes of the Oku no Hosomichi. It is managed by neighboring Mōtsū-ji.
2ec01a26369e29da.zh: 高舘義経堂是位於日本東北地方、今岩手縣南部平泉的佛堂，供奉源義經。2014年作為「奧之細道風景地」的一部分，被指定為國家名勝。由鄰近的毛越寺管理。

2efa8d2e633f1f6b.en: Fukuyama City Zoo (福山市立動物園, Fukuyama Shiritsu Dōbutsuen)  is a zoological park in Fukuyama, Hiroshima, Japan.
2efa8d2e633f1f6b.zh: 福山市立動物園是位於日本廣島縣福山市的動物園。

2f0a064fc07a1474.en: According to the Kojiruien, an encyclopedia from the Meiji period, it has been eaten since the time of Emperor Shomu, and even today, after the Omizutori at Nigatsu-do Hall, a chagayu dish prepared with bancha called “gobo” is eaten at the accommodation. It seems that chagayu has a long history. It is a local dish that was invented in an area with low rice yields, where rice is conserved by increasing the amount of water used. In areas where chagayu is prepared, tea plants are planted near homes.
2f0a064fc07a1474.zh: 根據明治時代的百科全書《古事類苑》，茶粥自聖武天皇時代起就有人食用，至今在二月堂的修二會（お水取り）結束後，住宿處仍會食用以番茶煮成、稱為「ごぼ」的茶粥。茶粥似乎有著悠久的歷史。這是在稻米產量少的地區所發明的鄉土料理，藉由增加水量來節省稻米。在製作茶粥的地區，住家附近會種植茶樹。

2f0b0e3bcbb766aa.en: Saba-zushi is a traditional Japanese dish made from salted mackerel that has been pickled in vinegar. It can be served in various forms, such as sugata-zushi, bo-zushi and nigiri-zushi. Sugata-zushi is shaped like a mackerel, with its head and tail left intact.
2f0b0e3bcbb766aa.zh: 鯖寿司是以鹽漬後再用醋醃漬的鯖魚製成的日本傳統料理。有姿壽司、棒壽司、握壽司等多種形式。姿壽司保留魚頭與魚尾，做成鯖魚的形狀。

2f156851a078d839.en: Yamaguchi prefecture is famous for its fugu dishes. There are several types of pufferfish, and most have poisonous ovaries and livers. Each prefecture in Japan issues a license to professionals who are permitted to prepare the pufferfish to be eaten. In Yamaguchi, there are several good fishing grounds and fugu has been prepared and eaten in this prefecture for a long time.
2f156851a078d839.zh: 山口縣以河豚料理聞名。河豚有好幾個種類，大多數的卵巢和肝臟有毒。日本各都道府縣會核發執照給獲准處理河豚供食用的專業人員。山口縣有數個優良漁場，長久以來縣內就有處理及食用河豚的傳統。

2f1e3c43e3aed6c7.en: Otsu Lakeside Nagisa Park (大津湖岸なぎさ公園, Ōtsu Kogan Nagisa Kōen) is a park in Otsu City, Shiga Prefecture, Japan, on the shores of Lake Biwa. It is renowned for its views, being one of the top 100 Views of Nature in Kansai, and is popular with both locals and visitors.
2f1e3c43e3aed6c7.zh: 大津湖岸なぎさ公園位於日本滋賀縣大津市的琵琶湖畔，以景色聞名，名列關西自然景觀100選之一，受到當地居民與遊客喜愛。

2f227db07a12d2dd.en: Miyagiken Gokoku Shrine (宮城縣護國神社, Miyagiken gokoku jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Sendai, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan. It enshrines the kami of "martyrs of the state" (国事殉難者) and its annual festivals take place on April 30, May 1, and October 23. It was established in 1904 and originally referred to as Shōkonsha (招魂社). Its current name dates to 1939.
2f227db07a12d2dd.zh: 宮城縣護國神社是位於日本宮城縣仙台市的神社，祭祀「國事殉難者」之神，例祭於4月30日、5月1日及10月23日舉行。神社創建於1904年，原稱招魂社，現名始於1939年。

2f263e75faaa5818.en: Representative confectionery of Matsuyama City. In Matsuyama City, a rolled cake-like confection with anko (sweet red bean paste) wrapped in castella sponge cake is called "Tart." In the 4th year of Shoho (1647), Sadayuki Matsudaira, the first lord of the Matsuyama domain of the Hisamatsu family, heard news of a Portuguese ship entering Nagasaki. When he went to patrol the seas near Nagasaki, he encountered a tart, a Nanban-gashi (confectionery influenced by Portuguese culture), where jam was rolled inside castella.
2f263e75faaa5818.zh: 松山市的代表性點心。在松山市，以長崎蛋糕包裹餡（紅豆餡）製成的捲狀點心稱為「タルト」。正保4年（1647年），久松松平家首任松山藩主松平定行得知葡萄牙船隻駛入長崎的消息，前往長崎附近海域巡視時，接觸到一種將果醬捲在長崎蛋糕內的南蠻菓子（受葡萄牙文化影響的點心）——塔。

2f33ae4fb83bc59a.en: Tatsue-ji (Tatsue Temple) (Japanese: 立江寺) is a Koyasan Shingon temple in Komatsushima, Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. It is Temple # 19 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage. The main image is of Jizō Bosatsu (Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva).
2f33ae4fb83bc59a.zh: 立江寺是位於日本德島縣小松島市的高野山真言宗寺院，為四國八十八所巡禮第19號札所，本尊為地藏菩薩。

2f408cf958d866a0.en: Lake Nojiri Naumann Elephant Museum (野尻湖ナウマンゾウ博物館, Nojiri-ko Nauman-zō Hakubutsukan) opened on the shore of Lake Nojiri in Shinano, Nagano Prefecture, Japan, in 1984. Initially the Nojiri-ko Museum (野尻湖博物館), it was renamed the Lake Nojiri Naumann Elephant Museum in 1996.
2f408cf958d866a0.zh: 野尻湖ナウマンゾウ博物館於1984年在日本長野縣信濃町的野尻湖畔開館。原名野尻湖博物館，1996年改為現名。

2f4431aa849bb790.en: Pike conger eel, often referred to as Hamo, plays an essential role in Kyoto's cuisine. It thrives in the seas influenced by warm currents, and several tons are caught annually in the Tango waters. However, most of the Hamo consumed in Kyoto comes from the Seto Inland Sea or the Genkai Sea.Resembling eels or conger eels in shape, some Hamo can reach almost 2 meters in length. The larger ones are often over ten years old.
2f4431aa849bb790.zh: 海鰻（はも）在京都料理中扮演重要角色。牠棲息在受暖流影響的海域，丹後海域每年捕獲數公噸。不過京都食用的海鰻大多來自瀨戶內海或玄界灘。海鰻外形類似鰻魚或星鰻，有些長度可達近2公尺，較大的個體往往超過十歲。

2f4dd6cd00fe3dd7.en: In 1249, Kakushin (Houtou Kokushi), a high priest in Yura, learned how to make Kaizanji miso in Sou (China), where he had trained, and brought it back to Japan. When he built Koukokuji Temple, he introduced the method to Yuasa Town and the surrounding area, where the water quality was suitable for manufacturing miso and soy sauce, and it is said to have spread. It is believed to be the founder of soy sauce and miso.
2f4dd6cd00fe3dd7.zh: 1249年，由良的高僧覺心（法燈國師）在其修行之地宋（中國）學得金山寺味噌的製法，並帶回日本。據說他興建興國寺時，將這種製法傳授給水質適合釀造味噌與醬油的湯淺町及周邊地區，因而流傳開來。一般認為這是醬油與味噌的起源。

2f4e675b845ea1b3.en: In sandy area with soft ground along the Kinokawa River (like Kasei and Nunohiki area in Wakayama City), ginger has been grown since early Era (early 20th century) to make most of its mild climate. Authentic open-field culture of ginger started in 1947, and greenhouse cultivation became common during the 4th decade of Showa Era (1965~1974). Therefore, the cultivation area of ginger has been getting bigger.Young ginger, planted in winter and harvested in summer, is mainly grown, and the area is one of famous place for producing ginger in Japan.
2f4e675b845ea1b3.zh: 在紀之川沿岸地盤鬆軟的砂質地區（如和歌山市的加勢、布引一帶），為了善用溫暖的氣候，自（20世紀）初期起就開始種植生薑。1947年開始正式的露地栽培，昭和40年代（1965～1974年）溫室栽培普及，生薑的栽培面積因而持續擴大。當地主要種植冬季種植、夏季收成的嫩薑，是日本知名的生薑產地之一。

2f59ff4bba908125.en: Yamaguchi Prefectural Museum of Art (山口県立美術館, Yamaguchi Kenritsu Bijutsukan), in Yamaguchi City is the main art gallery of Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan.
2f59ff4bba908125.zh: 山口県立美術館位於山口市，是日本山口縣的主要美術館。

2f6f023dcad9a511.en: Yonezawa City Uesugi Museum (米沢市上杉博物館, Yonezawa-shi Uesugi hakubutsukan) opened in the former grounds of Yonezawa Castle in Yonezawa, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan, in 2001. The collection of some 18,800 objects includes the National Treasures Scenes In and Around the Capital (紙本金地著色洛中洛外図), by Kanō Eitoku, and Uesugi Family Documents (上杉家文書).
2f6f023dcad9a511.zh: 米沢市上杉博物館（Yonezawa-shi Uesugi hakubutsukan）於2001年在日本山形縣米澤市的米澤城舊址開館。館藏約18,800件，包括國寶狩野永德《紙本金地著色洛中洛外圖》及《上杉家文書》。

2f8f6ab096752a74.en: Gotemba City and Oyama Town are semi-high temperature areas with cold winters and cool summers. In this area, there is an abundance of groundwater from the snowmelt of Mt. Mizukakena" is a traditional vegetable of this area, and is a specialty that can only be enjoyed in early spring from February to March. It is cultivated in winter by making high ridges in the rice paddies and letting the spring water flow through them to keep the fields warm.
2f8f6ab096752a74.zh: 御殿場市與小山町屬於冬季寒冷、夏季涼爽的高冷地區。這一帶富含富士山融雪形成的地下水。「水かけ菜」是當地的傳統蔬菜，只有在2月至3月的早春才能品嘗。冬季時在水田中做出高畦，引湧泉水流過以保持田地溫暖來栽培。

2f9a99253435e186.en: Marunuma Dam is a buttress dam located in Gunma Prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for power production. The catchment area of the dam is 25.9 km2. The dam impounds about 68  ha of land when full and can store 13600 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1928 and completed in 1931.
2f9a99253435e186.zh: 丸沼ダム是位於日本群馬縣的扶壁式水壩，用於發電。水壩集水面積為25.9平方公里，滿水時淹沒面積約68公頃，蓄水量為1,360萬立方公尺。水壩於1928年動工，1931年完工。

2fadb20e01dd6d79.en: "Kurumi-dofu" is made with strained walnut after crushed, water and sugar and set by kudzu (arrowroot) starch. This dish is particular to Oushu City Esashi region in Iwate prefecture, and it is prepared as a "shoujin ryori" (=vegetarian food for Buddhist monk) to replace sashimi (=thinly sliced fish) at the memorial services. It is common that julienne-cut daikon radish and miso sauce with sugar and ginger juice are added when it is served. Sometimes it can be a tea snack without sauce.
2fadb20e01dd6d79.zh: 「くるみ豆腐」是將核桃搗碎後過濾，加入水與砂糖，再以葛粉凝固製成。這道料理是岩手縣奧州市江刺地區特有的，在法事時作為「精進料理」（僧侶的素食）用以取代生魚片。供應時通常會加上白蘿蔔絲，以及加入砂糖與薑汁的味噌醬。有時也不加醬汁，作為茶點。

2fbc0b717acea333.en: Hōfuku-ji (宝福寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Ijirino neighborhood of the city of Sōja, Okayama, Japan. It belongs to the Tōfuku-ji sect of the Rinzai school of Japanese Zen and its honzon is a statue of Kokuzō Bosatsu. It is noted for its connection with the Muromachi period painter-monk Sesshū. The graves of politicians Ryugo Hashimoto (who served as Minister of Education and Minister of Health) and his son Ryutaro Hashimoto (82nd and 83rd Prime Minister of Japan) are located here.
2fbc0b717acea333.zh: 宝福寺是位於日本岡山縣總社市井尻野地區的一座佛寺，屬於日本禪宗臨濟宗東福寺派，本尊為虛空藏菩薩像。此寺以與室町時代畫僧雪舟的淵源而聞名。政治人物橋本龍伍（曾任文部大臣及厚生大臣）及其子橋本龍太郎（第82、83任日本首相）的墓位於此地。

2fc4865aa24dc288.en: The Nagi Museum of Contemporary Art (Nagi MOCA) (奈義町現代美術館, Nagi-chō Gendai Bijutsukan) is a museum in Nagi, Okayama, Japan. It was jointly created by architect Arata Isozaki and artists whose works are displayed.
2fc4865aa24dc288.zh: 奈義町現代美術館（Nagi MOCA）是位於日本岡山縣奈義町的美術館，由建築師磯崎新與館內展出作品的藝術家共同創作而成。

2ff1a500b84c2d32.en: Hachimori Iwadate Prefectural Natural Park (八森岩館県立自然公園, Hachimori Iwadate kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Akita Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1964, the park lies within the municipality of Happō (formerly within Hachimori).
2ff1a500b84c2d32.zh: 八森岩館県立自然公園是日本秋田縣的縣立自然公園，設立於1964年，位於八峰町境內（舊屬八森町）。

2ff495cf290c94e3.en: Yokohama International Swimming Pool (横浜国際プール, Yokohama Kokusai Pūru) is a swimming venue in Yokohama, Japan. The main pool is converted to a basketball arena in fall and winter by setting up panels on the floor. This sports court can be slippery.  This arena is home of the B.League basketball club Yokohama B-Corsairs.
2ff495cf290c94e3.zh: 橫濱國際泳池是位於日本橫濱的游泳場館。主泳池在秋冬兩季會於地面鋪設板材，改作籃球場使用，此球場地面可能較滑。此場館為B.League籃球隊橫濱B-Corsairs的主場。

30009ae1c5022730.en: Nangū Taisha (南宮大社) is a Shinto shrine located in the town of Tarui in Fuwa District, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It is the ichinomiya of former Mino Province. The main festival of the shrine is held annually on  May 25. The shrine precincts contain 18 structures from the Edo period, which are designated national Important Cultural Properties. The main building of the shrine is rebuilt every 51 years.
30009ae1c5022730.zh: 南宮大社是位於日本岐阜縣不破郡垂井町的神社，為舊美濃國一宮。神社的例大祭每年於5月25日舉行。境內有18棟江戶時代的建築，被指定為國家重要文化財。神社本殿每51年重建一次。

3000d36c90890d82.en: Nabekura Castle (鍋倉城, Nabekura-jō) was a Sengoku period yamajiro-style Japanese castle located in the city of Tōno, Iwate Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2023. It is also known as Tōno Castle (遠野城, Tōno-jō) or Yokota Castle (横田城, Yokota-jō).
3000d36c90890d82.zh: 鍋倉城是戰國時代的山城式日本城郭，位於日本岩手縣遠野市。城跡自2023年起被指定為國家史跡加以保護。又稱遠野城或橫田城。

3004128131e60835.en: Hanawa Town is known for its production of konjac, and "Fujiemon Festival", to commemorate Fujiemon, who prevailed how to make konjac in the town, is held. Konjac has been produced since Edo Era, and became more active around 1955. Although the production is lower now than its peak, there are still many konjac factories and konjac is familiar as a special product in the area. Regarding dishes using konjac, "Sashimi konjac" (thinly sliced konjac like sashimi) is famous, and "konjac no shira-ae" is often cooked at home.
3004128131e60835.zh: 塙町以生產蒟蒻聞名，當地會舉辦「藤右衛門祭」，紀念在町內推廣蒟蒻製法的藤右衛門。蒟蒻自江戶時代開始生產，約1955年前後更加興盛。雖然現在產量已不及高峰期，但仍有許多蒟蒻工廠，蒟蒻是當地為人熟悉的特產。使用蒟蒻的料理中，「刺身蒟蒻」（像生魚片一樣切成薄片的蒟蒻）很有名，「こんにゃくの白和え」則是家中常做的料理。

3021636fc43821f3.en: Naso no Shirataki (奈曽の白滝, Naso no Shirataki) is a waterfall located in  Nikaho, Akita Prefecture, Japan. It became a nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty in 1932. Although not selected as one of "Japan’s Top 100 Waterfalls", it was included in the listing of the "100 New Tourist Attractions of Japan" in a contest sponsored by the Mainichi Shinbun newspaper in 1950.
3021636fc43821f3.zh: 奈曽の白滝是位於日本秋田縣にかほ市的瀑布，1932年被指定為國家名勝。雖未入選「日本瀑布百選」，但在1950年每日新聞社主辦的評選中列入「日本觀光地百選」。

303373a0d2afb460.en: The Ōfune Site (大船遺跡, Ōfune iseki) is an archaeological site consisting of a series of large shell middens and the remains of an adjacent settlement from the Jōmon period. The site is in what is now part of the city of Hakodate in Oshima Subprefecture on the island of Hokkaido in northern Japan. It has been protected by the central government as a Historic Site since 13 August 2001. The site covers an area of 71.832 square kilometers (7,183.2 ha; 27.734 mi2).
303373a0d2afb460.zh: 大船遺跡是由一系列大型貝塚及相鄰的繩文時代聚落遺構組成的考古遺址，位於日本北部北海道渡島綜合振興局，現屬函館市。自2001年8月13日起由中央政府指定為史跡加以保護。遺址面積71.832平方公里（7,183.2公頃；27.734平方英里）。

304d453e0e646258.en: Char is a fish only lives in the upper stream of headwater areas where clear water flows. It is very difficult to catch.Miyagi Prefecture was the first area in Japan to farm char, which is difficult to catch. Farmed char raised in clean water has no off-smells and tastes sweet. It has soft skin and is best enjoyed simply with salt-grilled. It has been popular with ordinary people since ancient times.
304d453e0e646258.zh: 岩魚只棲息在清水流經的源流上游，非常難以捕捉。宮城縣是日本最早養殖這種難捕岩魚的地區。在乾淨水中養大的岩魚沒有腥味，味道甘甜。魚皮柔軟，最適合簡單地以鹽烤享用。自古以來就深受一般民眾喜愛。

30542b63411d8e72.en: Obama was the center of Wakasa Bay, and was the starting point of the "saba kaido" (mackerel road), which was used to transport fish on foot to Kyoto, called "seoi" (back-breaking). Known as the "Miketsukuni" (province of foodstuffs) since the Asuka and Nara periods, Obama played an important role regarding food. It is said that the salt used to prevent spoilage was just the right amount by the time the mackerel arrived in Kyoto.
30542b63411d8e72.zh: 小濱是若狹灣的中心，也是「鯖街道」（鯖魚之路）的起點；這條路線用於以徒步方式將魚運往京都，稱為「背負」。小濱自飛鳥、奈良時代起被稱為「御食國」（食材之國），在飲食方面扮演重要角色。據說為了防止腐壞而抹上的鹽，到鯖魚運抵京都時正好入味得恰到好處。

30829411ba564981.en: The Kuzuryu Dam (九頭竜ダム, Kuzuryū-damu) is a dam in the city of Ōno in the Fukui Prefecture of Japan. The dam supports a 220 MW hydroelectric power station.
30829411ba564981.zh: 九頭竜ダム是位於日本福井縣大野市的水壩，供應一座220 MW的水力發電廠。

3082de09e6e9512e.en: Inujima (犬島; [inɯdʑima], lit. "Dog Island") is a Japanese island in the Seto Inland Sea, located near the coast of Okayama Prefecture. It is part of Higashi-ku, Okayama.
3082de09e6e9512e.zh: 犬島（[inɯdʑima]，字面意思為「狗島」）是日本瀨戶內海的島嶼，位於岡山縣沿岸附近，隸屬岡山市東區。

308cdbde79127183.en: Jōgashima Lighthouse (城ヶ島灯台, Jōgashima tōdai) is a lighthouse located on the island of Jōgashima (Japanese: 城ヶ島) in the city of Miura, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan, off the southernmost and western tip of Miura Peninsula, facing Sagami Bay. It is the fourth oldest western style lighthouse to be built in Japan, and the second oldest surviving to the present day.
308cdbde79127183.zh: 城ヶ島燈塔位於日本神奈川縣三浦市的城ヶ島上，地處三浦半島最南端西側外海，面向相模灣。為日本第四座興建的西式燈塔，也是現存第二古老的西式燈塔。

309cd66c76f51a2e.en: Chiba Museum of Science and Industry (千葉県立現代産業科学館, Chiba-kenritsu gendai sangyō kagaku-kan) is a science museum located in Ichikawa, Chiba Prefecture, Japan. The museum introduces mainly topics related to technology, for modern industry. The museum sets up its goal as to provide a place for experiencing various aspects of science and technology which is applied in industry to people at all ages.
309cd66c76f51a2e.zh: 千葉縣立現代產業科學館是位於日本千葉縣市川市的科學博物館，主要介紹與現代產業相關的技術主題。博物館的目標是提供各年齡層的人一個體驗產業所應用之科學與技術各個面向的場所。

30cb24e016bbfaf1.en: The Serada Tōshō-gū (世良田東照宮) is a Shinto shrine located in the city of Ōta Gunma Prefecture, Japan. It enshrines the deified first Shōgun of the Tokugawa shogunate, Tokugawa Ieyasu. In the year 2000, it was one of the eleven sites connected with the Nitta-no-shō which were collectively designated a National Historic Site of Japan.
30cb24e016bbfaf1.zh: 世良田東照宮是位於日本群馬縣太田市的神社，祭祀被神格化的德川幕府初代將軍德川家康。2000年，這裡與新田莊相關的十一處遺址一同被指定為日本國家史跡。

30d49f01741b9ee1.en: Shōkaku-ji (正覚寺) is a Rinzai temple in Jōnan-ku, Fukuoka, Japan. Its honorary sangō prefix is Higashiaburayama (東油山). It is also known as Aburayama Kannon (油山観音).
30d49f01741b9ee1.zh: 正覺寺是位於日本福岡市城南區的臨濟宗寺院，山號為東油山，又稱油山觀音。

30e6b89caa3f781e.en: A long time ago in this region, "tokibimeshi (rice with Corn)" was a staple food item that played a central role with boiled barley and rice. The seeds of Corn (corn) were planted during the summer in fields and land cleared by the slash-and-burn method. Corn was harvested about the middle of autumn. It was boiled and eaten like that as a snack or grilled and eaten.When Corn is harvested, it is tied in bundles and hung from bamboo poles under the eaves of stables and thoroughly dried.
30e6b89caa3f781e.zh: 很久以前，在這個地區，「とうきびめし」（玉米飯）與麥飯、米飯同為主食，扮演核心角色。玉米的種子於夏季播種在田地及以火耕法開墾的土地上，約在仲秋收成。可直接水煮當點心吃，或烤來吃。玉米收成後，會綁成一束束，掛在馬廄屋簷下的竹竿上徹底晾乾。

30f0d41622ef29e5.en: Shimo-Akasaka Castle (下赤坂城, Shimo-Akasaka-jō) is a late Kamakura period Japanese castle located in the village of  Chihayaakasaka, Osaka Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1934. It is also referred to as simply Akasaka Castle (赤坂城, Akasaka-jō).
30f0d41622ef29e5.zh: 下赤坂城是位於日本大阪府千早赤阪村的鎌倉時代後期日本城郭。其遺址自1934年起被列為國家史跡保護，也簡稱為赤坂城。

30fc7ab161458e32.en: There are two types of "juicy": kufa (hard) juicy, which is cooked with rice, and yafala (soft) juicy (also called boro boro juicy), which is cooked with rice in a porridge. Kufa Juicy is cooked with pork, which adds a nice fatty sheen to the dish, and is served with a vinegared "usachi" to refresh the slight greasiness that remains in the mouth after the meal. Originally, it was a dish for special occasions and celebrations, but in recent years, it has become a popular home-style dish as well.
30fc7ab161458e32.zh: 「ジューシー」有兩種：與米一起炊煮的クファ（硬）ジューシー，以及煮成粥狀的ヤファラ（軟）ジューシー（也稱為ボロボロジューシー）。クファジューシー與豬肉一起炊煮，讓飯帶有誘人的油亮光澤，並搭配醋漬的「ウサチ」，以化解飯後口中殘留的些許油膩感。原本是特別場合與喜慶時的料理，近年也成為受歡迎的家常菜。

30fffb66a9b6d49e.en: Zoyama kōgoshi (女山神籠石, Zoyama-kōgoshi) was an ancient castle (also known as a Korean-style fortress (朝鮮式山城, Chōsen-shiki yamajiro) located in the Ōkusa, Setaka-chō neighborhood of the city of Kōge, Chikujō District, Fukuoka Prefecture Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1953, with the area under protection expanded in 1977.
30fffb66a9b6d49e.zh: 女山神籠石是一座古代城郭（亦稱為朝鮮式山城），位於福岡縣築上郡上毛町（原文作Kōge）瀨高町大草地區。其遺跡自1953年起列為國家史跡受到保護，1977年擴大保護範圍。

311babb5531e83f9.en: "Karanamasu" is a vinegared dish made from sardines and okara (bean curd). Karanamasu is eaten at festivals and other gatherings, as well as in everyday life. For festive occasions, it is made in the shape of a rabbit and served on a platter, while for festive occasions, it is served on a regular plate.In Sangen-cho, Tateyama City, Chiba Prefecture, a "Housogomori" is held every year on January 15, when everyone gathers in one house. Karanamasu" is still served as a standard dish at the Housogomori.
311babb5531e83f9.zh: 「からなます」是以沙丁魚和豆渣（おから）製成的醋拌料理。からなます在祭典等聚會以及日常生活中都會食用。喜慶場合會做成兔子形狀盛在大盤上，而喜慶場合則盛在一般盤子上。千葉縣館山市山莖町每年1月15日會舉行「ほうそうごもり」，大家聚集在一戶人家中。からなます至今仍是ほうそうごもり的固定菜色。

312d5da1aec82a05.en: The Sōrinbaru kuyōtō (宗麟原供養塔) is a stone monument with erected in the Sengoku period to honor the dead of the Battle of Mimigawa, located in the town of Kawaminami, Miyazaki Prefecture, Japan. It was designated a National Historic Site in 1933.
312d5da1aec82a05.zh: 宗麟原供養塔是戰國時代為悼念耳川之戰陣亡者而建立的石造紀念碑，位於日本宮崎縣川南町。1933年被指定為國家史跡。

31305dd2c1b1c2bc.en: "Hoonko” is an annual major event of the Jodo Shinshu sects of Buddhism, in honor of the anniversary of the passing of its founder, Shinran Shonin. It is celebrated between autumn and the new year, either on the 28th day of the 11th month of the lunar calendar or January 16th of the Gregorian calendar.
31305dd2c1b1c2bc.zh: 「報恩講」是佛教淨土真宗各派每年的重大活動，為紀念開山祖師親鸞聖人的忌日而舉行。舉行時間在秋季至新年之間，日期為農曆11月28日或國曆1月16日。

3135dd66ce648c09.en: "Oyaki" is a local dish representing Shinshu, made by mixing flour such as wheat and buckwheat flour with water or hot water, kneading it, wrapping seasonal ingredients such as sweet red bean paste or vegetables in thinly rolled-out dough, and then baking it. In some regions, "oyaki" is also referred to as "yakimochi." It is said to have originated in the Nishiyama area of Kamiminochi District, and its history is ancient. Traces of kneaded and baked coarse grain flour have been discovered at the Jomon archaeological site in Ogawa Village.
3135dd66ce648c09.zh: 「おやき」是代表信州的鄉土料理，作法是將小麥粉、蕎麥粉等粉類加水或熱水揉製，以擀薄的麵皮包入紅豆餡或蔬菜等當季食材後烘烤。部分地區也稱「おやき」為「焼き餅」。據說起源於上水內郡西山地區，歷史悠久。小川村的繩文遺址曾發現雜穀粉揉製後烤過的痕跡。

313c201745bf125a.en: Matsumoto City, situated in the almost exact center of Nagano Prefecture, offers views of the Northern Alps to the west and the Utsukushi-gahara Plateau to the east. It is a mountainous city that prospered as the castle town of Matsumoto Castle. The charming streets, resonating with history, have been selected as part of the "Matsumoto City Scenic Selection." In Matsumoto, a city where urban and rural areas coexist harmoniously, peaceful fields and rice paddies stretch just a short distance away from the city center.
313c201745bf125a.zh: 松本市位於長野縣幾乎正中央，西可眺望北阿爾卑斯山，東可望見美之原高原。這是一座以松本城城下町而繁榮的山城。充滿歷史氛圍的街道已被選入「松本市景觀選」。在都市與農村和諧共存的松本，離市中心不遠處便是寧靜的田地與稻田。

3151c3eb6a0bc3d1.en: ‘Uzumi’ is a clear soup made from ‘dashi’ soup stock from shiitake mushroom or kombu(=kelp) placed cooked rice at the bottom of a bowl berried by tofu and shiitake mushroom. It is served at memorial services. Add sesame seeds, green onion, ginger or yuzu as condiments.‘Uzumi’ is a local food from Hirai Village located in the furthest of the Kozagawa River in Higashimuro District, and it is passed down this area exclusively.
3151c3eb6a0bc3d1.zh: 「うずみ」是一種清湯，在碗底放入米飯，上面以豆腐和香菇覆蓋，再倒入以香菇或昆布熬成的高湯。於法事時供應。可加入芝麻、蔥、薑或柚子作為佐料。「うずみ」是位於東牟婁郡古座川最上游的平井村的鄉土料理，僅在這個地區流傳。

316256bfca2fc922.en: Tofu is said to have been introduced from China as early as the Nara and Heian periods, and was eaten by aristocrats and warrior families as a valuable protein source in vegetarian cuisine.
316256bfca2fc922.zh: 據說豆腐早在奈良、平安時代便從中國傳入，在素食料理中作為珍貴的蛋白質來源，為貴族與武家所食用。

316c2a36e9a7c934.en: Kamonyama Park (Japanese: 掃部山公園) is a park in Nishi-ku, Yokohama City, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. Located on a hill overlooking Minato Mirai 21, a statue of Naosuke Li, who played key role in the opening of Yokohama Port in 1859, stands in the park. the park is also a popular destination for cherry blossoms during spring.
316c2a36e9a7c934.zh: 掃部山公園是位於日本神奈川縣橫濱市西區的公園，坐落於可俯瞰港未來21的山丘上。園內立有井伊直弼的銅像，他在1859年橫濱開港一事中扮演重要角色。此公園也是春季熱門的賞櫻地點。

316fbc79217d58ed.en: The Nagoya Shrine (那古野神社, Nagoya-jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Marunouchi in the Naka Ward in Nagoya, central Japan.
316fbc79217d58ed.zh: 那古野神社是位於日本中部名古屋中區丸之內的神社。

31893ff6078e47f6.en: "Ball-shaped konjac", nicknamed Tamakon, is the soul food of the people of Yamagata Prefecture. As the name suggests, it is a spherical konjac about 3 cm in diameter and is sold on skewers at tourist attractions and event halls. While square konjac and konjac noodles are popular throughout Japan, "ball-shaped konjac "is a food culture unique to Yamagata Prefecture.
31893ff6078e47f6.zh: 「玉こんにゃく」暱稱「玉こん」，是山形縣民的靈魂食物。如名稱所示，它是直徑約3公分的球狀蒟蒻，在觀光景點和活動會場串成串販售。方形蒟蒻和蒟蒻絲在日本各地都很常見，而「玉こんにゃく」則是山形縣獨有的飲食文化。

318a6133d1785ad9.en: The Joshitei (如斯亭), also known as the Former Akita Domain Satake Clan Villa Gardens  (旧秋田藩主佐竹氏別邸, kyū-Akita-han-shu Satake-shi bettei teien) is a Japanese landscape garden and nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty in the city of Akita, Akita Prefecture, Japan.
318a6133d1785ad9.zh: 如斯亭，又稱舊秋田藩主佐竹氏別邸庭園，是位於日本秋田縣秋田市的日本庭園，為國家指定名勝。

31a171b72121fea4.en: Gokiso Hachiman-gū (御器所八幡宮) is a Shinto shrine located in the city of Nagoya, central Japan.
31a171b72121fea4.zh: 御器所八幡宮是位於日本中部名古屋市的神社。

31c6926653659724.en: The Setagaya Literary Museum (世田谷文学館, Setagaya Bungakukan) is an art museum in Minami-Karasuyama, Setagaya, Tokyo. It is owned by Setagaya City and operated by Setagaya Cultural Foundation (Setagaya Bunka Zaidan).  The museum was founded in April 1995 as a comprehensive museum of modern literature originated from Setagaya. It also functions as a library, as well as museum and archives.
31c6926653659724.zh: 世田谷文学館是位於東京都世田谷區南烏山的美術館，由世田谷區所有，世田谷文化財團營運。本館於1995年4月成立，是以源自世田谷的近代文學為主題的綜合博物館，同時兼具圖書館、博物館與檔案館的功能。

31e4bea8c63ce6c2.en: Ōkubo-ji (大窪寺) is a Shingon temple in Sanuki, Kagawa Prefecture, Japan. It is Temple 88 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage. Pilgrims leave their kongō-zue at the temple when completing the circuit. The Ōkubo-ji temple bell and pilgrim bells have been selected by the Ministry of the Environment as one of the 100 Soundscapes of Japan.
31e4bea8c63ce6c2.zh: 大窪寺是位於日本香川縣讚岐市的真言宗佛寺，為四國八十八所遍路的第88番札所。遍路者完成巡禮時會將金剛杖留在寺中。大窪寺的寺鐘與遍路者的鈴聲獲環境省選為日本音風景百選之一。

31f1d16ea5fa08cf.en: Nagao-ji (長尾寺) is a Tendai Buddhist temple in Sanuki, Kagawa, Japan. It is the 87th site of the Shikoku Pilgrimage.
31f1d16ea5fa08cf.zh: 長尾寺是位於日本香川縣讚岐市的天台宗佛寺，為四國遍路第87番札所。

321a82933cb326e1.en: Kōko-en (好古園) is a Japanese garden located next to Himeji Castle in Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan.
321a82933cb326e1.zh: 好古園是位於日本兵庫縣姬路城旁的日本庭園。

325f3b0a16751848.en: Mount Abura (油山, Abura-yama) is a 597 m (1,959 ft) mountain located on the border of Minami-ku, Fukuoka, Sawara-ku, Fukuoka and Jonan-ku, Fukuoka, Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan. Mount Abura is the location where the Indian Buddhist priest Seiga produced the first camellia oil from seeds made in Japan during the Nara period. Abura means oil in Japanese.
325f3b0a16751848.zh: 油山是位於日本福岡縣福岡市南區、早良區與城南區交界處的山，高597公尺（1,959英尺）。奈良時代，印度僧人清賀在油山以日本產的種子首度製成山茶油。「油」在日文中即為油之意。

32652e6487f687a5.en: The Tobata Gion Yamagasa festival (戸畑祇園山笠) is a popular local Japanese festival (matsuri) which takes place annually in Tobata, a ward of Kitakyushu in Fukuoka prefecture, Kyūshū, Japan. It is held for three days (Friday–Sunday) before and after the fourth Saturday of July. The festival is a national cultural asset of Japan, and is centred on the parading of the "Yamagasa" (山笠).
32652e6487f687a5.zh: 戶畑祇園大山笠（戸畑祇園山笠）是每年在日本九州福岡縣北九州市戶畑區舉行的知名地方祭典。於7月第四個星期六前後共三天（星期五至星期日）舉行。這項祭典是日本國家文化財，以「山笠」的遊行為中心。

328ac0605dc85e4c.en: Hyōgo Prefectural Museum of Archaeology (兵庫県立考古博物館, Hyōgo kenritsu kōko hakubutsukan) opened next to the Ōnaka Site in Harima, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan in 2007. The museum exhibits archaeological finds from all over the prefecture. The collection includes two Important Cultural Properties — assemblages of artefacts excavated from Ikeda Kofun in Asago and Miidani No.2 Tumulus in Yabu — and a number of Prefectural Tangible Cultural Properties.
328ac0605dc85e4c.zh: 兵庫縣立考古博物館於2007年在日本兵庫縣播磨町開館，位於大中遺跡旁。博物館展示來自全縣各地的考古出土物。館藏包括兩件重要文化財——朝來市池田古墳與養父市箕谷2號墳的出土文物群，以及多件縣指定有形文化財。

329885904afe4223.en: Winter-caught Kanburi, known as the "natural fish tank" in Toyama Bay, was designated as "Toyama Prefecture's Fish" in 1996 and is a representative fish of the prefecture, also known as the king of Toyama Bay. During this season, Kanburi migrates south along the Sea of Japan, and its firm flesh and rich fat content receive high praise nationwide for its quality.
329885904afe4223.zh: 在被稱為「天然魚池」的富山灣冬季捕獲的寒鰤，於1996年被指定為「富山縣魚」，是縣的代表魚，也被稱為富山灣之王。這個季節，寒鰤沿日本海南下洄游，結實的魚肉和豐富的油脂，其品質在全國獲得高度評價。

329bb88cd0dc7027.en: The Tokugawa Garden (徳川園 Tokugawa-en) is a Japanese garden in the city of Nagoya, central Japan. It is located next to the Tokugawa Art Museum.
329bb88cd0dc7027.zh: 德川園是位於日本中部名古屋市的日本庭園，緊鄰德川美術館。

32a8044f199b5194.en: Moto-Yakushi-ji ruins (本薬師寺, Moto-Yakushi-ji ato) is an archeological site  with the ruins of an Asuka period Buddhist temple located in the city of Kashihara, Nara, Japan. It was designated as a National Historic Site in 1921, with the classification changed to Special Historic Site in 1952. It is the predecessor of the famous Yakushi-ji in Nara, and its name "Moto Yakushi-ji" (元薬師寺 moto, "original Yakushi-ji"), and the site is now a Special National Historic Site.
32a8044f199b5194.zh: 本薬師寺跡是位於日本奈良縣橿原市的考古遺址，留有飛鳥時代佛教寺院的遺跡。1921年被指定為國史跡，1952年升格為特別史跡。本寺為奈良知名的藥師寺的前身，故名「元藥師寺」（元薬師寺，意為「原本的藥師寺」），遺址現為國特別史跡。

32b60a3b5d900e7c.en: Shimane Prefecture has a coastline 1.026 km (637 miles) long, the 10th longest in the country. Offshore, the Tsushima warm current flows toward the northeast, providing an ideal environment for fishing. Fishing methods are diverse, including seine, trawl, set-net, and single-line fishing.
32b60a3b5d900e7c.zh: 島根縣的海岸線長1,026公里（637英里），居全國第十。外海有對馬暖流向東北流動，提供了理想的漁業環境。漁法多樣，包括圍網、拖網、定置網及一支釣。

32d9f9b622d0860e.en: The boar, worshipped as the god of agriculture since ancient times, is said to visit in the spring of the second month of the lunar calendar to create rice and barley fields and engage in farming. After completing agricultural work, the boar returns in the autumn of the tenth month of the lunar calendar. In the northern regions where rice cultivation was prosperous, there was a tradition of offering "Inoko Mochi," rice cakes coated with sweet red bean paste, to express gratitude for the harvest on the day of the boar in autumn.
32d9f9b622d0860e.zh: 自古被奉為農業之神的亥神，據說在農曆二月的春天來臨，開闢稻田與麥田、從事農耕。農事結束後，於農曆十月的秋天離去。在稻作興盛的北部地區，有在秋天亥日供奉裹上甜紅豆餡的年糕「いのこ餅」，以感謝收成的傳統。

32f4d9a47e3f4cca.en: Daihō-ji (Japanese: 大寶寺) This is a temple belonging to the Buzan branch of the Shingon school of Buddhism, located in Kumakogen Town, Kamiukena District, Ehime Prefecture. Its formal mountain name is Sugouzan, and its institute name is Daikaku-in. The principal deity is the Eleven-faced Kannon Bodhisattva. It serves as the 44th temple on the Shikoku Pilgrimage of 88 Temples and is referred to as the "Middle Temple" (Chū-fudasho). Situated in the Kumakogen highlands, the temple stands at an elevation of 579 meters.
32f4d9a47e3f4cca.zh: 大寶寺（日語：大寶寺）是位於愛媛縣上浮穴郡久萬高原町的真言宗豐山派寺院。山號為菅生山，院號為大覺院。本尊為十一面觀音菩薩。為四國八十八所靈場第44號札所，被稱為「中札所」。寺院位於久萬高原，海拔579公尺。

3302a4ee7c112fa2.en: “Iriko mochi” literally means rice cake made from parched rice flour. The dish has been handed down in the Satsuma domain since the Edo period. “Iriko mochi” was handed out to the local people at ceremonies to celebrate and wish for the healthy growth of children. In the middle of the Edo period, “iriko mochi” became a snack that could also be enjoyed by commoners. It is often served during the Bon holidays. Glutinous rice is roasted and ground into a powder. The powder is then kneaded with starch syrup and other ingredients.
3302a4ee7c112fa2.zh: 「いりこもち」字面意思是以炒過的米粉製成的餅。這道點心自江戶時代起在薩摩藩流傳。「いりこもち」曾在慶祝並祈求兒童健康成長的儀式上分發給當地民眾。到了江戶中期，「いりこもち」成為一般百姓也能享用的點心，常在盂蘭盆期間食用。做法是將糯米炒過後磨成粉，再加入麥芽糖等材料揉製。

334b5f8e342197ed.en: Cape Hachiman (八幡岬, Hachiman-misaki) is a cape on the Pacific Ocean, in the city of Katsuura, in the southeast area of Chiba Prefecture, Japan. There are two Cape Hachimans located near one another: Cape Hachiman in Katsuura, and Cape Hachiman a few kilometers to the north in Isumi City. The cape is named after Hachiman, a mythological Japanese god of archery and war.
334b5f8e342197ed.zh: 八幡岬（八幡岬，Hachiman-misaki）是位於日本千葉縣東南部勝浦市、面向太平洋的海岬。附近有兩處八幡岬：一處在勝浦，另一處在其北方數公里的いすみ市。海岬以日本神話中掌管弓術與戰爭的神祇八幡命名。

3363050d1e61c60a.en: The Yahikoyama Ropeway (弥彦山ロープウェイ, Yahikoyama Rōpuwei) is a Japanese aerial lift line in Yahiko, Niigata. This is the only line Yahiko Kankō Ropeway (弥彦観光索道, Yahiko Kankō Sakudō; "Yahiko Sightseeing Ropeway") operates. The company is a subsidiary of Juraku, which operates hotels and restaurants. Opened in 1958, the line climbs Mount Yahiko (弥彦山) of Yahiko Shrine (弥彦神社). There is Panorama Tower at the summit, a tower with the observatory that moves like a rotating elevator. The observatory has a view of Sado Island on a clear day.
3363050d1e61c60a.zh: 弥彦山ロープウェイ是位於新潟縣彌彥村的空中纜車路線，是彌彥觀光索道（弥彦観光索道）經營的唯一路線。該公司為經營飯店與餐廳的Juraku（聚樂）旗下子公司。路線於1958年開通，登上彌彥神社所在的彌彥山。山頂設有全景塔（Panorama Tower），其觀景台會像旋轉電梯般移動。天氣晴朗時，可從觀景台望見佐渡島。

3366c0fbe7ca2053.en: "Mazemeshi" is a dish that always appears at local events and celebrations where people gather. Also called "Gumeshi", it is made by chopping and stir-frying ingredients such as chicken, gobou(=burdock), carrots, dried shiitake mushrooms, bamboo shoots, fried thin tofu, etc., seasoned with soy sauce and sugar, and mixed with freshly cooked warm rice.
3366c0fbe7ca2053.zh: 「まぜ飯」是當地人們聚集的活動和慶祝場合必定會出現的料理。又稱「具飯」，做法是將雞肉、牛蒡、紅蘿蔔、乾香菇、竹筍、油豆腐皮等材料切碎拌炒，以醬油和砂糖調味，再拌入剛煮好的熱白飯。

3370313ce3426639.en: Konsen-ji (金泉寺) is a Kōya-san Shingon temple in Itano, Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. Temple 3 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage, the main image is of Shaka Nyorai. Said to have been founded by Gyōki, it was rebuilt in the Edo period after being burned by the Chōsokabe.
3370313ce3426639.zh: 金泉寺是位於日本德島縣板野的高野山真言宗寺院。為四國八十八所遍路第3番寺院，本尊為釋迦如來。據傳由行基創建，遭長宗我部氏焚毀後於江戶時代重建。

3370333af0c86953.en: "Nankan-Agemaki Sushi" is a type of rolled sushi that uses "Nankan-Age," a deep-fried tofu specialty that has been passed down in Nankan Town since the Edo period. It's so beloved in the Nankansen region that when people talk about rolled sushi there, they are usually referring to this dish.Nankan-Age is a large piece of oil-fried tofu measuring around 20-30 cm on each side, known for its crispy texture. The process involves compressing tofu, thoroughly removing its moisture, and then double-frying it at both low and high temperatures.
3370333af0c86953.zh: 「南関あげ巻き寿司」是使用「南関あげ」製作的捲壽司。南関あげ是南關町自江戶時代流傳至今的特產油豆腐。在南關地區非常受喜愛，當地人說到捲壽司時，通常指的就是這道料理。南関あげ是每邊約20-30公分的大片油炸豆腐，以酥脆口感著稱。製作過程是將豆腐壓實、徹底去除水分，再以低溫和高溫兩度油炸。

3387715e74199deb.en: Tōshō-ji (東勝寺) was the Hōjō clan's family temple (bodaiji) in Kamakura during the Kamakura period. Its founder was Taikō Gyōyū and it was constructed in 1237 by Hōjō Yasutoki in memory of his mother, who had her tomb there. According to the Taiheiki, from its foundation until the end of the Kamakura shogunate every regent (shikken) was buried there. The temple no longer exists, since it was set on fire by the Hōjō themselves when the entire family committed suicide after Nitta Yoshisada's invasion of Kamakura on July 4, 1333.
3387715e74199deb.zh: 東勝寺（東勝寺）是鎌倉時代北條氏位於鎌倉的家族寺院（菩提寺）。開山為退耕行勇，1237年由北條泰時為紀念其母而建，其母之墓亦在此。據《太平記》記載，自創建至鎌倉幕府滅亡，歷任執權皆葬於此。1333年7月4日新田義貞攻入鎌倉後，北條一族集體自盡，並由北條氏自行縱火焚寺，寺院因此不復存在。

33a879dc9ace4d5b.en: Utsubo Park (靱公園, Utsubo-Kōen) is a large public, urban park, situated at Utsubo-Hommachi in Nishi-ku, Osaka, Japan.
33a879dc9ace4d5b.zh: 靱公園是位於日本大阪市西區靱本町的大型公共都市公園。

33b2837fa2962e42.en: Kuroshima and Taijima (九龍島と鯛島, Kuroshima to Taijima) are a set of islands about one kilometer off the coast of Honshū in Japan by the mouth of the Koza River, a five-minute ride by ferry from Koza Port. The islands are part of Kushimoto, Wakayama Prefecture. The islands were used as a naval base of operations during the Genpei War.
33b2837fa2962e42.zh: 九龍島與鯛島是位於日本本州外海約一公里、古座川河口附近的一組島嶼，從古座港搭渡輪約五分鐘。這些島嶼屬於和歌山縣串本町。源平合戰期間，這些島嶼曾被用作水軍的作戰據點。

33ba4753432bb36d.en: Nirayama Castle (韮山城, Nirayama-jō) was a hilltop Japanese castle, now in ruins, located in the Nirayama neighborhood of the city of Izunokuni, Shizuoka, in the Tōkai region of Japan. It existed from the late Muromachi period to the Azuchi-Momoyama period.  Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2025.
33ba4753432bb36d.zh: 韮山城是位於日本東海地區靜岡縣伊豆之國市韮山地區的山城，現已成為遺跡。此城存在於室町時代後期至安土桃山時代。城跡自2025年起被指定為國家史跡受到保護。

33bee8b9fc62a021.en: Takuanzuke is Akita's typical smoked and dried daikon pickles. It is now made throughout the prefecture, but in the past it was a local dish made by farmers in the land area of the prefecture.In Akita, where winter comes early, especially in the southern land area of the prefecture, the moist westerly winds from the Sea of Japan are blocked by the Ou Mountains from late autumn to winter, resulting in more rainfall and snowfall, shorter hours of sunlight, and lower temperatures.
33bee8b9fc62a021.zh: いぶりがっこ是秋田具代表性的煙燻乾燥蘿蔔醃漬物（澤庵漬）。現在全縣各地都有製作，過去則是縣內陸地區農家製作的地方料理。秋田冬季來得早，尤其縣南部內陸地區，從晚秋到冬季，來自日本海的潮濕西風受奧羽山脈阻擋，因此雨雪較多，日照時間較短，氣溫也較低。

33f87912ad17e4d6.en: In Osaka, a city that has prospered from the shipping and commercial industries since ancient times, a large amount of hamo eel has been sold and distributed. Summer is considered to be the popular season, and it is said that the eel becomes delicious when it drinks the water of the rainy season. Therefore, at the Tenjin Festival held in summer, various side dishes using eel are lined up on the tables.In Osaka, eel is used as a raw material for kamaboko paste. When the flesh of the eel is stripped off to make kamaboko, only the skin remains.
33f87912ad17e4d6.zh: 大阪自古以來因航運和商業而繁榮，大量的鱧魚在此販售流通。夏季被視為盛產期，據說鱧魚喝了梅雨季的雨水後會變得美味。因此在夏季舉行的天神祭，餐桌上會擺出各種使用鱧魚的配菜。在大阪，鱧魚被用作魚板的原料。剝下鱧魚的魚肉製作魚板後，只剩下魚皮。

342b9127e8ac3486.en: "Imobota" refers to botamochi (adzuki-bean covered glutinous rice balls) with taro inside. Glutinous rice was valuable, so taro was instead added to Rice flour, and its stickiness was used to make botamochi resembling that made with glutinous rice. It originates from the lifelong wisdom of farmers who value rice. It can be easily digested without feeling heavy, even if you eat a lot. In other prefectures, "Imobota" is made with potato or sweet potato, but "Imobota" in Nara is distinguished by its use of taro.
342b9127e8ac3486.zh: 「いもぼた」是指內含芋頭的牡丹餅（外裹紅豆餡的糯米糰）。過去糯米珍貴，因此改在米粉中加入芋頭，利用芋頭的黏性做出近似糯米製的牡丹餅。這源自珍惜米糧的農家代代相傳的生活智慧。即使吃得多也容易消化，不會覺得負擔。其他縣的「いもぼた」使用馬鈴薯或地瓜，而奈良的「いもぼた」特色在於使用芋頭。

343f3a85c56d6713.en: The name "Ego" comes from boiled and kneaded seaweed called "egogusa," and it is a regional cuisine passed down throughout Niigata Prefecture. Egogusa is said to have been brought to mountain villages in Shinshu by peddlers from fishing villages along the Sea of Japan, and "Ego" is mainly eaten along the "Shio no Michi" (Salt Road) extending from the Daihoku area to the Nagano Nishiyama area (Shinshushinmachi, Ogawa, Nakajo, Naniai, etc.).
343f3a85c56d6713.zh: 「えご」的名稱來自將名為「えご草」的海藻煮過並揉製而成的食品，是新潟縣各地流傳的鄉土料理。據說えご草是由日本海沿岸漁村的行商帶到信州山村，「えご」主要在從大北地區延伸到長野西山地區（信州新町、小川、中條、七二會等）的「鹽之道」沿線食用。

344a87b15ebe3ce3.en: The Ogasawara clan castle sites (小笠原氏城跡, Ogasawara-shi jō-seki) were a number Sengoku period yamashiro-style Japanese castles located in what is now part of the city of Matsumoto, Nagano prefecture. These fortifications were built in the Muromachi period by the Ogasawara clan, who ruled the area at the time. Two of the castle ruins, that of Igawa Castle and Hayashi Castle, have been protected collectively as a National Historic Sites since 2017.
344a87b15ebe3ce3.zh: 小笠原氏城跡是多座戰國時代的山城式日本城堡，位於今長野縣松本市境內。這些城砦由當時統治該地區的小笠原氏於室町時代興建。其中井川城與林城兩處城跡自2017年起合併列為國家史跡加以保護。

346d7c7b6c336813.en: The Kawahara Shrine (川原神社, Kawahara-jinja), or the Benten of Kawana, is a Shinto shrine and Buddhist Benten-dō located in Shōwa-ku, Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. Its name means "riverbank", referring to its historic location in an area of farmland near the Yamazaki River. Its primary deity is the goddess Izanami.
346d7c7b6c336813.zh: 川原神社又稱川名的弁天，是位於日本愛知縣名古屋市昭和區的神社兼佛教弁天堂。其名意為「河岸」，指其昔日位於山崎川附近農田地帶的位置。主祭神為女神伊邪那美。

34706442ec53b82f.en: Shōryaku-ji (正暦寺) is a Shingon temple in the southeast of Nara, Japan. Founded in 992, it is the head temple of the Bodaisen Shingon sect. The temple is considered the birthplace of modern methods of refined sake production.
34706442ec53b82f.zh: 正曆寺是位於日本奈良市東南部的真言宗寺院，創建於992年，為菩提山真言宗大本山。該寺被視為近代清酒釀造法的發源地。

34ae132a637f7709.en: Nago Castle (名護城, Nago jō; Okinawan: Nagu gushiku) is a Ryukyuan gusuku in Nago, Okinawa. It was built in the 14th century and served as the home of the Aji of Nago Magiri. In 1416, the army of Chūzan, led by Shō Hashi, attacked and captured the castle during the invasion of Hokuzan.
34ae132a637f7709.zh: 名護城（沖繩語：Nagu gushiku）是位於沖繩名護的琉球御城（グスク）。建於14世紀，曾為名護間切按司的居城。1416年，中山軍在尚巴志率領下進攻北山，攻下此城。

34cffb0699d799f7.en: Biwa trout, endemic species exclusively in the Lake Biwa, is fresh water fish belongs to Salmonidae. There are more than 84 kinds of fish inhabit in Shiga Prefecture, and 16 species are endemic species inhabit only in the Lake Biwa. Biwa trout likes low temperature water (below 15 Celsius) and inhabits in deep down in the lake. Therefore, it is believed that it inhabits only in the Lake Biwa because the lake meets all conditions. The size of fish is from 30cm~60cm (12 inches ~23.5 inches) and 2kg of weight for big one.
34cffb0699d799f7.zh: 琵琶鱒是只分布於琵琶湖的特有種，屬於鮭科淡水魚。滋賀縣有超過84種魚類棲息，其中16種是只棲息於琵琶湖的特有種。琵琶鱒喜歡低溫（攝氏15度以下）的水域，棲息在湖的深處。因此一般認為，由於琵琶湖符合所有條件，牠才只棲息於琵琶湖。魚體長30cm～60cm（12吋～23.5吋），大型個體重達2kg。

34e0fe782c13de1b.en: The Gifu City Science Museum (岐阜市科学館, Gifu-shi Kagakukan) is a city-supported museum in Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It was built in 1955 and was moved to its present location and renamed the Gifu City Children's Science Center in 1980. When the planetarium was added in 1988, the name was again changed to the Gifu City Science Museum. There are many hands-on exhibits in the museum.
34e0fe782c13de1b.zh: 岐阜市科学館是位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市、由市政府支持營運的博物館。該館建於1955年，1980年遷至現址，並更名為岐阜市兒童科學中心。1988年增設天文館後，再度更名為岐阜市科学館。館內有許多可親手操作的展品。

34eab0ba865db6e6.en: Bamboo shoots are often eaten in Kōchi prefecture. mōsō bamboo is in season at the beginning of spring, followed by Henon bamboo, and madaké bamboo. Square bamboo is a local specialty of Nankoku City that is harvested in the fall.
34eab0ba865db6e6.zh: 高知縣常吃竹筍。初春是孟宗竹的產季，接著是淡竹，然後是真竹。四方竹是南國市的特產，於秋季採收。

34eba37079c65221.en: Tokugen-in (徳源院) is a Buddhist temple in the Kiyotaki neighborhood of the city of Maibara, Shiga Prefecture Japan. It belongs to the Tendai school of Japanese Buddhism and its main image is a hibutsu statue of Sho-Kannon Bosatsu.  The temple is noted as the bodaiji of the Kyōgoku clan, a prominent Sengoku and Edo period daimyō clan. The clan cemetery was designated a National Historic Site in 1936.
34eba37079c65221.zh: 德源院是位於日本滋賀縣米原市清瀧地區的佛寺，屬日本佛教天台宗，本尊為祕佛聖觀音菩薩像。該寺以作為京極氏的菩提寺而聞名，京極氏是戰國時代至江戶時代著名的大名家族。京極氏墓所於1936年被指定為國家史跡。

34fdeb5583782ac1.en: Kinkaku-ji (金閣寺; Japanese pronunciation: [kʲiꜜŋ.ka.kɯ.dʑi], lit. 'Temple of the Golden Pavilion'), officially named Rokuon-ji (鹿苑寺; [ɾoꜜ.kɯ.oɲ.dʑi], lit. 'Deer Garden Temple'), is a Zen Buddhist temple in Kyoto, Japan and a tourist attraction. It is designated as a World Heritage Site, a National Special Historic Site, a National Special Landscape, and one of the 17 Historic Monuments of Ancient Kyoto. The temple is nicknamed after its reliquary (shariden), the Golden Pavilion (金閣, Kinkaku), whose top two floors are coated in 0.5 μm gold leaf.
34fdeb5583782ac1.zh: 金閣寺（意為「金色樓閣之寺」），正式名稱為鹿苑寺（意為「鹿園之寺」），是位於日本京都的禪宗寺院，也是觀光景點。被列為世界遺產、國家特別史跡、國家特別名勝，也是古都京都的17處文化財之一。寺院的通稱來自其舍利殿「金閣」，舍利殿上兩層貼有0.5微米的金箔。

350de2372a678fe8.en: Kamiyodo Hakuhō-no-Oka Exhibition Hall (上淀白鳳の丘展示館, Kamiyodo Hakuhō-no-oka tenjikan) opened in Yonago, Tottori Prefecture, Japan in 2011.  It replaced the Yonago Yodoe Folk History Museum (米子市淀江歴史民俗資料館), which closed in 2009. The three rooms of the exhibition hall display Yayoi decorated pottery, haniwa statues, fragments of early Buddhist wall painting from Kamiyodo Haiji, and a reconstruction of the temple kondō, with its paintings and sculptures.
350de2372a678fe8.zh: 上淀白鳳の丘展示館於2011年在日本鳥取縣米子市開館，取代2009年關閉的米子市淀江歷史民俗資料館。展示館的三間展示室展出彌生時代的裝飾陶器、埴輪、上淀廢寺早期佛教壁畫的殘片，以及該寺金堂連同壁畫與雕刻的復原。

350ec142485f4c9d.en: Nawa Jinja (名和神社) is a Shinto shrine in Daisen, Tottori Prefecture, Japan. It is celebrated for its cherry blossoms. It is one of the Fifteen Shrines of the Kenmu Restoration, dedicated to the memory of Nawa Nagatoshi.
350ec142485f4c9d.zh: 名和神社是位於日本鳥取縣大山町的神社，以櫻花聞名。為建武中興十五社之一，祭祀名和長年。

35463a0ed7429129.en: Nyudozaki Lighthouse (入道崎灯台, Nyūdōzaki tōdai), or Nyūdō Saki Lighthouse,  is a lighthouse on the northwest top of Oga Peninsula in the city of Oga, Akita Prefecture, Japan.
35463a0ed7429129.zh: 入道埼灯台（又稱入道崎燈塔）是位於日本秋田縣男鹿市男鹿半島西北端的燈塔。

3567d3c257bb402c.en: Katsurahama Aquarium (桂浜水族館, Katsurahama suizokukan) is an aquarium located in Kōchi, Kōchi Prefecture on Katsurahama.
3567d3c257bb402c.zh: 桂浜水族館是位於高知縣高知市桂濱的水族館。

35783ddceeca44e5.en: Kichijō-ji (Japanese: 吉祥寺) is a temple belonging to the Toji School of Shingon Buddhism, located in Saijo City, Ehime Prefecture. Its formal mountain name is Mikkyozan, and its sub-temple name is Taizoin. The principal deity is Bishamonten (spelled "Bishamon-ten" at this temple). It serves as the 63rd pilgrimage site of the Shikoku Pilgrimage. It is the only temple among the 88 sites to enshrine Bishamonten as its principal deity.
35783ddceeca44e5.zh: 吉祥寺（日語：吉祥寺）是位於愛媛縣西條市的真言宗東寺派寺院。山號為密教山，院號為胎藏院。本尊為毘沙門天。為四國八十八所靈場第63號札所，也是八十八所中唯一以毘沙門天為本尊的寺院。

35954bb98484eca2.en: Jukō-in (聚光院) is a sub-temple of Daitoku-ji, Kyoto, Japan. It was founded in 1566 as the mortuary temple of Miyoshi Nagayoshi. In 1589 Sen no Rikyū designated it as the mortuary temple for his family. The Hondō (1583) and chashitsu (1739) are Important Cultural Properties and the gardens have been designated a Place of Scenic Beauty. A painting of Miyoshi Nagayoshi (1566) has also been designated an Important Cultural Property. The temple also contains a great number of fusuma paintings done by Kanō Eitoku.
35954bb98484eca2.zh: 聚光院是日本京都大德寺的塔頭寺院，創建於1566年，為三好長慶的菩提寺。1589年，千利休將此處定為其家族的菩提寺。本堂（1583年）與茶室（1739年）為重要文化財，庭園則被指定為名勝。三好長慶畫像（1566年）亦被指定為重要文化財。寺內另藏有大量狩野永德所繪的襖繪。

35998c096dc9de0f.en: Ichinomiya Castle is a mountaintop castle in Tokushima, Japan.
35998c096dc9de0f.zh: 一宮城是位於日本德島的山城。

35a73d2353a6be13.en: Ibaraki Prefecture is still famous for its rice fields and is one of the best rice-producing regions in Japan. Taking advantage of its mild year-round climate and rich water quality, rice cultivation has flourished in Ibaraki since ancient times.
35a73d2353a6be13.zh: 茨城縣至今仍以稻田聞名，是日本屈指可數的稻米產地。茨城利用全年溫和的氣候與豐沛的水資源，自古稻作便很興盛。

35abc5db71c86b98.en: Sōma Nakamura Castle (相馬中村城, Sōma Nakamura-jō) was a Japanese castle that formed the administrative center of Sōma Domain, a feudal domain of the Sōma clan under the Tokugawa shogunate, located in what is now the city of  Sōma in northern Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. The castle was also called "Nakamura Castle" or "Mutsu-Nakamura Castle". The castle's contemporary nickname was Baryū Castle (馬陵 城) from a place name mentioned in the Chinese Spring and Autumn Annals.
35abc5db71c86b98.zh: 相馬中村城是日本城郭，為德川幕府治下相馬氏封地相馬藩的行政中心，位於今日本福島縣北部相馬市。此城又稱「中村城」或「陸奧中村城」。當時的別稱為馬陵城，取自中國《春秋》中提及的地名。

35cd0f9c1f427f7b.en: In the past, Oita Prefecture had many areas with poor drainage, making it unsuitable for rice cultivation that required water retention. As a result, wheat cultivation flourished in the region. With this background, a culture of flour-based dishes developed across various localities. "Yudemochi" is one such local sweet from Oita Prefecture, alongside "Ishigaki mochi," "Jiri-yaki," and "Yaseuma." These treats were not only enjoyed by children as snacks but also consumed during short breaks while working in the fields.
35cd0f9c1f427f7b.zh: 過去大分縣有許多排水不良的地區，不適合需要蓄水的稻作，因此當地小麥栽培興盛。在這樣的背景下，各地發展出以麵粉為主的飲食文化。「ゆでもち」與「石垣餅」「じり焼き」「やせうま」同為大分縣的鄉土點心。這些點心不僅是孩子們的零食，也會在田間工作的短暫休息時食用。

36013c516e0fecfc.en: The Kyushu Historical Museum (九州歴史資料館, Kyushu-rekishi-shiryokan) is a history museum in Ogōri, Fukuoka, Japan.
36013c516e0fecfc.zh: 九州歷史資料館是位於日本福岡縣小郡市的歷史博物館。

3601e6d86abdeb92.en: Tsunoshima Lighthouse (角島灯台, tsunoshima tōdai) is a lighthouse on the island of Tsunoshima in the city of Shimonoseki, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan. It is notable as being one of only six lighthouses in Japan which had a first order Fresnel lens, the most powerful type of Fresnel lens.
3601e6d86abdeb92.zh: 角島灯台是位於日本山口縣下關市角島上的燈塔。這座燈塔是日本僅有的六座裝設第一等菲涅耳透鏡的燈塔之一，第一等菲涅耳透鏡是功率最強的菲涅耳透鏡類型。

360cd05249aadefa.en: Miyajima-numa (宮島沼) is a near-circular shallow freshwater oxbow lake located some 45 kilometres (28 mi) northeast of Sapporo on the Japanese island of Hokkaidō. Situated in the Ishikari peatlands and formed by the meandering Ishikari River that flows a short distance to the west, with the Kabato Mountains rising behind, there is no river inflow; instead it is fed by rainwater and melting snow, while being drawn on for the irrigation of the surrounding rice fields, developed since the Taishō era.
360cd05249aadefa.zh: 宮島沼是位於日本北海道札幌東北方約45公里（28英里）處、近乎圓形的淺水淡水牛軛湖。湖泊位於石狩泥炭地，由流經西側不遠處的石狩川蜿蜒形成，後方有樺戶山地。湖泊沒有河川流入，水源來自雨水與融雪，同時供應周邊自大正時代開墾的稻田灌溉用水。

3684d16f05218867.en: Anegawa Castle (姉川城, Anegawa-jō) was a hirayama-style Japanese castle located in the city of Kanzaki, Saga Prefecture, on the island of Kyushu, Japan. During the Sengoku period, it was the stronghold of Ryūzōji Takanobu. The castle site has been a National Historic Site since 2010.
3684d16f05218867.zh: 姉川城是位於日本九州佐賀縣神埼市的平山城式日本城郭。戰國時代為龍造寺隆信的據點。城址自2010年起列為國家史跡。

3685383ff7621ab4.en: The Inaba Provincial Capital Site (因幡国庁跡, Inaba Kokufu ato) is an archaeological site consisting of the ruins of the Nara period to early Heian period Provincial Capital of Inaba Province, located in the Nakago, Kokufu neighborhood of the city of Tottori, Tottori Prefecture in the San'in region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1978.
3685383ff7621ab4.zh: 因幡国庁跡是一處考古遺址，為奈良時代至平安時代初期因幡國國府的遺跡，位於日本山陰地方鳥取縣鳥取市國府町中鄉。該遺址於1978年被指定為日本國家史跡。

36a0fd3dcd1329a7.en: Several varieties of daikon radish are enjoyed in Kyoto. Among them are the "Aomi Daikon" from Nakagyo Ward, "Karashi Daikon" from Kita Ward, and "Sawaga Daikon" from Maizuru City in the Chutan area. However, the most well-known is the Shogoin daikon. This radish's ancestor, "Miyashige Daikon," was cultivated from seeds brought from Owari during the Bunsei period (1818-1830). Farmers in the Shogoin area of Otagi County (now Shogoin, Sakyo Ward) selectively bred a round variety of Miyashige Daikon that became known as Shogoin Daikon.
36a0fd3dcd1329a7.zh: 京都有好幾個品種的白蘿蔔，例如中京區的「青味大根」、北區的「辛味大根」，以及中丹地區舞鶴市的「佐波賀大根」。不過最知名的是聖護院大根。其祖先「宮重大根」是以文政年間（1818-1830）從尾張帶來的種子栽培而成。愛宕郡聖護院地區（今左京區聖護院）的農民從宮重大根中選育出圓形品種，後來被稱為聖護院大根。

36a5da3bcf553ac9.en: Mount Hōman (宝満山, Hōman-san) is a mountain on the border between the cities of Chikushino and Dazaifu in Fukuoka Prefecture in Kyūshū, Japan. It has an elevation of 829.6 metres (2,722 ft) meters. It is regarded as a sacred mountain and one of the three major centers for Shugendō.  It was designated a National Historic Site in 2013. The mountain is also called Mount Mikasa (御笠山) and Mount  Kamado (竈門山)
36a5da3bcf553ac9.zh: 宝満山是位於日本九州福岡縣筑紫野市與太宰府市交界的山，海拔829.6公尺（2,722英尺）。此山被視為聖山，也是修驗道的三大據點之一，於2013年被指定為國家史跡。又稱御笠山、竈門山。

36d8a4314f008f0f.en: DSK International (DSKI; 神戸ドイツ学院 Kobe Doitsu Gakuin) is an international school on Rokkō Island, in Higashinada-ku, Kobe, Japan. DSK International is an International IB school in Kobe for ages 2 to 12. The school provides curriculum in three languages: German, English and Japanese in two branches (German and International). DSK International offers three programmes for learners ages 2–12: Playgroup, Early Years and Primary Years Programme (PYP).
36d8a4314f008f0f.zh: 神戸ドイツ学院インターナショナル（DSKI）是位於日本神戶市東灘區六甲アイランド的國際學校，為神戶一所招收2至12歲學生的IB國際學校。學校分德國部與國際部兩個部門，以德語、英語、日語三種語言授課，為2至12歲的學習者提供三種課程：遊戲班、幼兒課程及小學課程（PYP）。

36f3b0a00f392f37.en: The Kishiwada Danjiri Matsuri (岸和田だんじり祭), held in Kishiwada, Osaka, is one of the most famous Danjiri Matsuri festivals in Japan. The festival is a parade involving large wooden shrine floats that are pulled at a high speed by a large team of men. During the dangerous runs, several men are standing on top of the shrine float.
36f3b0a00f392f37.zh: 岸和田だんじり祭在大阪岸和田舉行，是日本最著名的だんじり祭之一。祭典是一場遊行，由大批男性隊伍高速拉動大型木造神社山車。在危險的奔跑過程中，有數名男性站在山車頂上。

36face06f86061ec.en: The Chubu International Airport Connecting Road (中部国際空港連絡道路, Chūbu Kokusai Kūkō Renraku Dōro) is a 4-laned toll road in Tokoname, Aichi, Japan. It is managed by Aichi Prefectural Road Public Corporation.
36face06f86061ec.zh: 中部國際機場聯絡道路是位於日本愛知縣常滑市的四線道收費道路，由愛知縣道路公社管理。

36ff554540e2caec.en: Teshima (豊島) is an island located in the inland sea of Japan, between Naoshima and Shōdoshima islands, and is part of Kagawa Prefecture.  It has an area of 14.5 square kilometres (5.6 square miles) and a population of about 1,000 people.
36ff554540e2caec.zh: 豊島是位於日本瀨戶內海的島嶼，介於直島與小豆島之間，屬於香川縣。面積14.5平方公里（5.6平方英里），人口約1,000人。

3705f68a159063a0.en: Nōhi Gokoku Shrine (濃飛護國神社, Nōhi Gokoku Jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Ōgaki, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It is located near the base of Ōgaki Castle.
3705f68a159063a0.zh: 濃飛護國神社（濃飛護國神社）是位於日本岐阜縣大垣市的神社，鄰近大垣城的城基。

370ffe15549eb100.en: Mount Iō (医王山, Iō-zen), also Iozen, is a 939-metre (3,081 ft) tall mountain in Japan, on the border of Kanazawa City, Ishikawa and Nanto City, Toyama.
370ffe15549eb100.zh: 醫王山（いおうぜん），亦稱Iozen，是位於日本石川縣金澤市與富山縣南砺市交界處的山，高939公尺（3,081英尺）。

3710e3e434616c51.en: Nagoya Tōshō-gū (名古屋東照宮)  is the memorial shrine of Tokugawa Ieyasu located in the Marunouchi district of Naka-ku, Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture, Japan.
3710e3e434616c51.zh: 名古屋東照宮是位於日本愛知縣名古屋市中區丸之內地區、祭祀德川家康的神社。

37136eba64b9d04c.en: Furuwatari Castle (古渡城, Furuwatari-jō) is a former Japanese castle located in Nagoya.
37136eba64b9d04c.zh: 古渡城是位於名古屋的日本城堡舊址。

37240f3e7ec1bdd5.en: Renge-in Tanjō-ji (蓮華院誕生寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Shingon Risshu, or Shingon-Vinaya Buddhism, in Tamana, Kumamoto Prefecture. It is the head temple of the Shingon Ritsu school in Kyūshū and a branch temple of Saidai-ji (西大寺) in Nara (奈良). It venerates Mahābodhisattva Kōen (皇円大菩薩, Kōen Daibosatsu) as its patron deity. The temple stands on the site of Jōkō-ji Renge-in which was founded either at the end of the Heian period or the beginning of the Kamakura period and burnt down during the wars of the Sengoku period.
37240f3e7ec1bdd5.zh: 蓮華院誕生寺是位於熊本縣玉名市的真言律宗佛教寺院。該寺是真言律宗在九州的總本山，也是奈良西大寺的別院。寺中奉皇円大菩薩為守護神。寺院所在地原為淨光寺蓮華院舊址，該寺創建於平安時代末期或鎌倉時代初期，於戰國時代的戰亂中燒毀。

372683ad1d376f8f.en: "Sanpei-jiru" is a local dish consisting of salted fish, such as salmon or herring, stewed together with vegetables, such as carrots, and daikon radishes.
372683ad1d376f8f.zh: 「三平汁」是將鮭魚或鯡魚等鹽漬魚，與紅蘿蔔、白蘿蔔等蔬菜一起燉煮的鄉土料理。

372b079fcc1e5642.en: Kuritsubo is a traditional simmered dish that has been enjoyed in Kawatana Town and Higashisonogi Town for a long time. The name Kuritsubo comes from the use of chestnuts as ingredients, with kuri meaning chestnut, and tsubo referring to the bowl used to serve the dish as a jar.
372b079fcc1e5642.zh: 「くりつぼ」是川棚町與東彼杵町長久以來食用的傳統燉煮料理。名稱的由來是以栗子為食材，「くり」意為栗子，「つぼ」則是指盛裝這道料理、形似壺的碗。

373683810e5baf5e.en: Shizuoka Prefecture boasts one of the largest catches of bonito in Japan. The bonito landed in May is called "Hatsukatsuo" (first bonito) and is especially popular, and the "bonito streamers" displayed around Omaezaki Port on the occasion of Dragon Boat Festival have become a summer tradition.Gawa" is a chilled miso soup made by chopping raw bonito, cucumbers, pickled plums, green perilla, etc., and adding them to water with miso paste, and was first made by fishermen on board their boats when they went bonito fishing.
373683810e5baf5e.zh: 靜岡縣的鰹魚漁獲量居日本前列。5月上岸的鰹魚稱為「初鰹」，特別受歡迎；端午節時在御前崎港一帶懸掛的「鰹魚旗」已成為夏季的傳統景象。「がわ」是將生鰹魚、小黃瓜、梅干、青紫蘇等切碎，加入溶有味噌的水中製成的冷味噌湯，最初是漁夫出海捕鰹魚時在船上做的料理。

373afd81fa6463ea.en: Wakayama Prefecture Kii-fudoki-no-oka Museum of Archaeology and Folklore (和歌山県立紀伊風土記の丘, Wakayama kenritsu fudoki-no-oka) is an archaeology museum located in the outskirts of the city of Wakayama, Wakayama Prefecture, Japan.
373afd81fa6463ea.zh: 和歌山縣立紀伊風土記之丘是位於日本和歌山縣和歌山市郊區的考古與民俗博物館。

374c32920928d7d2.en: Akita Prefectural Library (秋田県立図書館, Akita Kenritsu Toshokan) opened in Akita, Akita Prefecture, Japan in 1899, and it is one of the oldest libraries in the country. The facilities reopened in a new building in 1993. The collection numbers some 805,000 items in 2012. 441,642 published material are available online through the library's digital archive. This was done through the AMLAD digital archiving service that connects it to other participating facilities in the prefecture.
374c32920928d7d2.zh: 秋田県立図書館於1899年在日本秋田縣秋田市開館，是日本歷史最悠久的圖書館之一。1993年遷入新館重新開放。2012年館藏約805,000件。透過該館數位典藏，有441,642件出版品可於線上取用。此服務係透過AMLAD數位典藏系統建置，與縣內其他參與機構相連。

374db8b540124092.en: Miwa, Sakurai City, Nara prefecture is known as the birthplace of somen, and the somen made in this region is called Miwa Somen. Over 1200 years ago at Omiwa Shrine, the oldest shrine in Japan dedicated to Mt. Miwa, when people prayed for relief from plague and starvation, they received a revelation from the gods and began sowing wheat in the village of Miwa, then milling it into powder, adding water, and stretched it into thin strings. This is said to be the origin of somen.
374db8b540124092.zh: 奈良縣櫻井市三輪被視為素麵的發源地，當地製作的素麵稱為三輪素麵。1200多年前，在祭祀三輪山、日本最古老的神社大神神社，人們祈求免於瘟疫與饑荒時，得到神明的啟示，開始在三輪村播種小麥，再將小麥磨成粉、加水，拉成細線。據說這就是素麵的起源。

37618e08571c68e3.en: "Kaki zoni" is a "sumashi-jiru" (=clear soup) made with dried sardines, kombu (=kelp), and bonito soup stock. The soup contains oysters, yellowtail, and vegetables. Sometimes, miso is used for the soup. Yellowtail is fatty and remains fresh for a long time, which is why it is used for "zoni" eaten during the New Year holidays. An entire yellowtail is used to make sashimi and "zoni" with the leftover fish.
37618e08571c68e3.zh: 「かき雑煮」是以小魚乾、昆布和柴魚高湯製成的「清湯」（澄清的湯）。湯中有牡蠣、鰤魚和蔬菜，有時也會用味噌做湯底。鰤魚油脂豐富，能長時間保持新鮮，因此用於新年期間食用的「雜煮」。一整條鰤魚會用來做生魚片，剩下的魚肉則用來做「雜煮」。

3778a55a8aec9a94.en: Miyazaki Prefecture produces a large amount of satoimo(=Japanese taro), and its harvest is always ranked at the high in Japan, along with Saitama and Chiba prefectures. "Nuta-Imo" is a local dish using satoimo(=Japanese taro) that has been commonly eaten since long ago. It is rarely found on menus at restaurants, but it is sometimes served as an appetizer.
3778a55a8aec9a94.zh: 宮崎縣的里芋產量很大，收穫量與埼玉縣、千葉縣同樣長年名列全國前茅。「ぬた芋」是使用里芋製作、自古以來普遍食用的鄉土料理。餐廳菜單上很少見到，但有時會作為前菜供應。

3782a0a0e9244840.en: Senjōjiki Cirque (千畳敷カール) is a cirque (glacial landform) that lies just under Mount Hōken, Kiso Mountains in Nagano prefecture, Japan. It is called "Senjōjiki Kaaru" in Japanese. "Senjōjiki" means the wideness of 1000 tatami mats.
3782a0a0e9244840.zh: 千畳敷カール是位於日本長野縣木曾山脈寶劍岳正下方的冰斗（冰河地形），日文稱為「千畳敷カール」。「千畳敷」意指有1000張榻榻米那麼寬廣。

379071f5bedd751a.en: In the Kyushu region, there is a familiar seasoning called "yuzugosho." There are various theories about its origin, and one of them is said to be in the vicinity of Mount Hikosan in Fukuoka Prefecture. Mount Hikosan is known as a sacred mountain where many yamabushi (ascetic monks) lived in the mountain lodges.
379071f5bedd751a.zh: 九州地區有一種常見的調味料「ゆずごしょう」。其起源有多種說法，其中一說是在福岡縣英彥山一帶。英彥山是知名的靈山，過去有許多山伏（修行僧）住在山中的宿坊。

379b9464885b484e.en: Mount Yakeishi (jp: 焼石岳) is a mountain in the Ōu Mountains on Honshu, the largest of the four main islands of Japan. The mountain, which rises to a height of 1,548 meters, is part of Kurikoma Quasi-National Park.
379b9464885b484e.zh: 焼石岳是位於日本四大主島中最大的本州島奧羽山脈的山。海拔1,548公尺，屬於栗駒國定公園。

37bb51c3e7215c02.en: "Niaekko" is a local dish of the Shimokita region. In the Shimokita region, where rice cultivation was difficult due to the many cold weather damages caused by Yamase, various ingenuity was developed to secure food. Most of the vegetables were roots such as radishes, carrots, and burdock roots, and wild vegetables were preserved by salting or drying them. ""Niaekko" was made using such ingredients when the autumn radish harvest began.
37bb51c3e7215c02.zh: 「煮あえっこ」是下北地區的鄉土料理。下北地區因山背風帶來多次冷害，稻作困難，人們為確保糧食發展出各種巧思。蔬菜多為蘿蔔、紅蘿蔔、牛蒡等根菜類，山菜則以鹽漬或乾燥保存。「煮あえっこ」便是在秋季蘿蔔開始收成時，以這些食材製作而成。

37c0f07c66cbcca5.en: Bairin-ji (梅林寺) is a Rinzai temple in Kurume, Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan. Its honorary sangō prefix is Kōnanzan (江南山). It is known as a representative training dojo temple of the Myōshin-ji school.
37c0f07c66cbcca5.zh: 梅林寺是位於日本福岡縣久留米市的臨濟宗寺院，山號為江南山。此寺是妙心寺派具代表性的修行道場寺院。

37c1c20b9219f27e.en: Juniso Kumano Shrine (Japanese: 熊野神社) is a Kumano shrine in Nishi-Shinjuku (west Shinjuku), Tokyo, Japan, on the western side of Shinjuku Central Park.
37c1c20b9219f27e.zh: 十二社熊野神社（熊野神社）是位於日本東京西新宿的熊野神社，在新宿中央公園西側。

37d341c56dcb8548.en: Lake Senba (千波湖, senbako) is a lake in Mito, Ibaraki, Japan.
37d341c56dcb8548.zh: 千波湖是位於日本茨城縣水戶市的湖泊。

37e801607855b54b.en: The Buzen Sea, covering eastern Fukuoka and the northern coast of Oita prefecture, has shallow waters and tidal flats, which make it home to many rare creatures. Usa, Nakatsu, Bungotakada cities of Oita prefecture face the Buzen Sea, and net fishing is very popular in this area. Shrimps, soles, and darkfin pike eels are caught using small trawls and octopuses and squids are caught using net baskets or gillnets. Seaweed are cultivated in the tidal flats, and sea cucumbers are caught by underwater fishing.
37e801607855b54b.zh: 豐前海涵蓋福岡縣東部和大分縣北部沿岸，水淺且有潮間帶，棲息著許多珍稀生物。大分縣的宇佐市、中津市、豐後高田市面臨豐前海，當地網漁業十分興盛。以小型拖網捕撈蝦、鰨魚和海鰻，以籠網或刺網捕撈章魚和魷魚。潮間帶養殖海藻，海參則以潛水捕撈。

38007b2427d504c8.en: The Aoki Site (青木遺跡, Aoki iseki) is an archaeological site with the traces of a late-Yayoi period (3rd century) to early-Nara period (6th century) settlement located in the Nagae neighborhood of the city of Yonago, Tottori Prefecture, in the San'in region of Japan. It was designated a National Historic Site in 1978.
38007b2427d504c8.zh: 青木遺跡是一處考古遺址，有彌生時代後期（3世紀）至奈良時代初期（6世紀）的聚落遺跡，位於日本山陰地方鳥取縣米子市永江地區。1978年被指定為國家史跡。

380ec30efd0a83ee.en: The Kanagawa Prefectural Ofuna Botanical Garden (神奈川県立フラワーセンター 大船植物園, Kanagawa Kenritsu Furawāsentā Ōfuna Shokubutsuen) is a botanical garden located at 1018 Okamoto, Kamakura, Kanagawa, Japan. It is open daily except Mondays; an admission fee is charged.
380ec30efd0a83ee.zh: 神奈川縣立花卉中心大船植物園（神奈川県立フラワーセンター 大船植物園，Kanagawa Kenritsu Furawāsentā Ōfuna Shokubutsuen）是位於日本神奈川縣鎌倉市岡本1018號的植物園。週一以外每日開放，需收門票。

3816b469d9519a84.en: Among the many regional dishes of Saga Prefecture, the standard is gameni chicken stew. The stew is called "chikuzenni chicken stew" nationwide. It is also loved as a regional dish in other regions of Kyushu, including Hakata. The stew is a dish in which a lot of root vegetables and chicken are fried and thoroughly simmered. It is said that the dish was created when Hideyoshi Toyotomi was sending troops to Korea during the Imjin War.
3816b469d9519a84.zh: 在佐賀縣眾多的鄉土料理中，最具代表性的是がめ煮。這道燉雞肉料理在全國稱為「筑前煮」，在博多等九州其他地區也作為鄉土料理受到喜愛。做法是將大量根莖類蔬菜和雞肉炒過後充分燉煮。據說這道菜是豐臣秀吉在文祿之役出兵朝鮮時誕生的。

3861a2a6872feb01.en: Saitama Prefecture as a whole has a dish where leftover rice is mixed with a dough made from dissolved wheat flour and then baked. In the Chichibu region, it's called "Meshimochi," in the eastern lowlands including Kazo, it's known as "Yakibin," and in the northeastern and Iruma regions, it's referred to as "Yakimochi." In the past, when manual labor was used for farming, working hours were long, and there wasn't much time for meal preparation on farms.
3861a2a6872feb01.zh: 埼玉縣全境都有一種料理，將剩飯拌入麵粉調成的麵糊後煎烤。秩父地區稱為「飯餅」，加須等東部低地稱為「やきびん」，東北部及入間地區則稱為「やきもち」。過去以人力務農的年代，工作時間長，農家沒有太多時間準備餐食。

3870b579a47311d4.en: Mount Rebun (礼文岳, Rebun-dake) is the highest point on Rebun Island in Rebun,  Hokkaidō, Japan. The mountain consists of marine sedimentary rocks from the Early Cretaceous period, 149–97 million years ago.
3870b579a47311d4.zh: 礼文岳是日本北海道禮文町禮文島的最高點。山體由白堊紀早期（1億4900萬至9700萬年前）的海相沉積岩構成。

38817effa0c10ab3.en: Ganjōju-in (願成就院) is a Buddhist temple of the Kōyasan Shingon-shū sect in the Hike neighborhood of the city of Izunokuni, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. Its main image is a statue of Amida Nyōrai. The temple grounds were designated a National Historic Site on February 14, 1973. The temple is noted for a set of statues by the famed Kamakura period sculptor Unkei which are collectively designated a National Treasure of Japan.
38817effa0c10ab3.zh: 願成就院是位於日本靜岡縣伊豆之國市寺家地區的高野山真言宗佛寺，本尊為阿彌陀如來像。寺域於1973年2月14日被指定為國家史跡。此寺以鎌倉時代著名雕刻家運慶所作的一組佛像聞名，這組佛像整體被指定為日本國寶。

3897597c70473bb5.en: The Tale of Genji Museum is in Uji, Kyoto, Japan. It displays the world of  the early 11th century Japanese classic novel The Tale of Genji with projected images, models, and exhibitions. The culture of the Imperial Court of the Heian period, the aristocrats' costumes, and the furnishings of their residences are shown.
3897597c70473bb5.zh: 宇治市源氏物語博物館位於日本京都宇治，以投影影像、模型與展覽呈現11世紀初日本古典小說《源氏物語》的世界，展示平安時代的宮廷文化、貴族服飾及其宅邸陳設。

389ff3791c929e6b.en: A local dish that has been passed down from generation to generation in the coastal areas of the Boso Peninsula in Chiba Prefecture, which faces the Pacific Ocean on the Kuroshio Current. It was invented by fishermen in Kamisusa and Awa (today's southern part of Chiba Prefecture) in order to cook freshly caught fish on board their boats, which are unstable. Miso (soybean paste) was used instead of soy sauce because soy sauce would spill over in the rough seas on the boat.
389ff3791c929e6b.zh: 在面向黑潮流經之太平洋的千葉縣房總半島沿海地區代代相傳的鄉土料理。由上總與安房（今千葉縣南部）的漁夫所發明，用來在搖晃不穩的船上料理剛捕到的魚。由於海浪大時醬油會灑出來，因此改用味噌代替醬油。

38a0f0feb4b9223c.en: Surrounded by the sea, Oki Islands is home to a wide variety of seaweed, such as wakame and nori. There are extensive seaweed beds within a range of depths from 0 to 20 meters, where seaweed can be harvested. The rough seas of the Sea of Japan provide delicious seaweed. At depths from 0 to 10 meters, seaweed beds of sargasso such as narasamo and isomoku, and the seaweed ebiamamo are formed. At depths from 10 to 20 meters, there are few species of seaweed, mainly kurome and nokogirimoku.
38a0f0feb4b9223c.zh: 隱岐群島四面環海，有裙帶菜、海苔等多種海藻。水深0至20公尺範圍內有廣大的藻場，可採收海藻。日本海的洶湧海浪孕育出美味的海藻。水深0至10公尺處，形成ナラサモ、イソモク等馬尾藻類及エビアマモ的藻場；水深10至20公尺處的海藻種類較少，以クロメ和ノコギリモク為主。

38b840f9dfc85678.en: Saimyō-ji (西明寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Mashiko neighborhood of the town of Mashiko, Tochigi Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the  Buzan-branch of Shingon Buddhism and its honzon is a statue of Jūichimen Kannon Bosatsu.  The temple's full name is Tokkō-zan Fumon-in Saimyō-ji (独鈷山 善門院 西明寺).The temple is the 20th stop on the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route.
38b840f9dfc85678.zh: 西明寺是位於日本栃木縣益子町益子的佛寺，屬真言宗豐山派，本尊為十一面觀音菩薩像。寺院全名為獨鈷山善門院西明寺。本寺為坂東三十三所巡禮的第20番札所。

38d28e95317c9505.en: Kōkokuji Castle (興国寺城, Kōkokuji-jō) was a Sengoku period yamashiro-style Japanese castle located in the Negoya neighborhood of the city of Numazu, Shizuoka prefecture. The ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1975.
38d28e95317c9505.zh: 興国寺城是戰國時代的山城式日本城堡，位於靜岡縣沼津市根古屋地區。遺址自1975年起受指定為國家史跡加以保護。

38e1426f15f2e1b7.en: The Kawagoekan (河越館) was a hirayama-style Heian period Japanese castle located in the Uwado neighborhood of what is now the city of Kawagoe, Saitama Prefecture, in the Kantō region of Japan. The ruins been protected as a National Historic Site since 1984.
38e1426f15f2e1b7.zh: 河越館是平安時代的平山式日本城郭，位於今日本關東地方埼玉縣川越市上戶地區。遺址自1984年起受指定為國家史跡並受到保護。

38ee02bc89445e2d.en: Byodo-ji (Byodo Temple literally: Equality Temple) (Japanese: 平等寺) is a Koyasan Shingon temple in Anan, Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. Temple # 22 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage. The main image is of Yakushi Nyorai (Bhaiṣajyaguru: "King of Medicine Master and Lapis Lazuli Light"). It is designated as Anan Muroto Historical Cultural Road.
38ee02bc89445e2d.zh: 平等寺是位於日本德島縣阿南市的高野山真言宗寺院，為四國八十八所巡禮第22號札所，本尊為藥師如來（藥師琉璃光王如來）。此寺被指定為阿南室戶歷史文化道。

390960ab4471e3ac.en: Bekko, a soy-sauce flavored agar-agar with beaten eggs poured over it, is a classic dish that has been made on festive occasions such as celebrations and Buddhist memorial services, as well as at festivals and other events. In the past, eggs were a luxury item, so "bekko" was loved as a special treat to be eaten only on special occasions. Bekko was named after the candy-colored agar with eggs scattered on it like a cloud, which looks like a tortoiseshell hairpin, and it is called "Bekko" mainly in the eastern part of the prefecture.
390960ab4471e3ac.zh: べっこう是在醬油調味的寒天中倒入打散的蛋液製成，是喜慶、佛教法事，以及祭典等活動時製作的經典料理。過去雞蛋是奢侈品，因此「べっこう」是只在特殊場合才吃得到的珍貴食物，深受喜愛。蛋液如雲般散布在糖色寒天上，看起來像玳瑁髮簪，因而得名，主要在縣東部稱為「べっこう」。

390f038d995834ba.en: The Nabegataki Falls is a waterfall located in Oguni, Aso District, Japan, on the border between Kumamoto and Ōita Prefectures. The waterfall is 9m tall with a width of 20m.
390f038d995834ba.zh: 鍋ヶ滝是位於日本阿蘇郡小國町的瀑布，地處熊本縣與大分縣交界。瀑布高9公尺，寬20公尺。

3931b08224f7d7bf.en: Narumi-juku (鳴海宿, Narumi-juku) was the fortieth of the fifty-three stations of the Tōkaidō. It is located in former Owari Province in what is now part of the Midori-ku section of the city of Nagoya, in Aichi Prefecture, Japan.
3931b08224f7d7bf.zh: 鳴海宿（Narumi-juku）是東海道五十三次的第四十個宿場，位於舊尾張國，即今日本愛知縣名古屋市綠區。

3934fcda1705d645.en: Kongōrin-ji (金剛輪寺), also known as Matsuo-dera (松尾寺) (from its location) is a Buddhist temple of the Tendai sect located in the town of Aishō, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. The honzon of the temple is Kannon Bosatsu. The temple was founded in the early Heian period and together with Saimyō-ji in Kōra and Hyakusai-ji in Higashiōmi the temple forms a group of three temples known as Kotō-sanzan (湖東三山; lit. '"three mountains east of the lake"').
