3934fcda1705d645.zh: 金剛輪寺又稱松尾寺（名稱源自所在地），是位於日本滋賀縣愛莊町的天台宗佛教寺院。本尊為觀音菩薩。寺院創建於平安時代初期，與甲良町的西明寺、東近江市的百濟寺合稱湖東三山（字面意思為「湖東的三座山」）。

395722a2e2c6caa2.en: “Obaku” is made with round barley (barley without outer husk) soaked in water overnight as well as other ingredients such as potato, sweet potato, daikon radish, “satoimo” (=Japanese taro), and azuki beans or red kidney beans. All the ingredients are cooked in plenty of water until soft. One way to eat this dish is by adding grinded roasted sesame seeds and miso and pouring cold soup over the “obaku.” In the mountainous areas, rice was hard to come by and could only be enjoyed on special occasions.
395722a2e2c6caa2.zh: 「おばく」是以浸水一晚的圓麥（去除外殼的大麥），加上馬鈴薯、地瓜、白蘿蔔、「里芋」（日本芋頭）以及紅豆或紅腰豆等材料製成。所有材料用大量的水煮到軟爛。一種吃法是加入磨碎的炒芝麻與味噌，再將冷湯淋在「おばく」上。在山區，米很難取得，只有特殊場合才吃得到。

39588779da43736f.en: In Nara, it is a white miso soup with tofu, festive radish, carrot, taro, and round rice cake, etc. In many areas, the rice cake is taken out of the soup and dipped in soybean flour with sugar. Each ingredient has its own story. Tofu is a symbol of a storehouse with white walls, and is believed to wish for the building of a storehouse. Round rice cakes are used and vegetables are sliced into rounds to ensure that the family can live happily throughout the year.
39588779da43736f.zh: 奈良的雜煮是白味噌湯，加入豆腐、祝大根、紅蘿蔔、芋頭和圓形年糕等。許多地區會將年糕從湯中取出，沾加了砂糖的黃豆粉食用。每種食材都有其由來。豆腐象徵白牆的倉庫，寓意祈求建起倉庫。使用圓形年糕，蔬菜也切成圓片，是為了祈願家人一整年都能和樂度日。

396a85849f2a242d.en: Also called “shimotsukare,” “sumitsukari,” and “shimitsukare,” this is a dish made by simmering leftovers from celebratory feasts, such as salmon head eaten during the New Year and beans left over from "Setsubun". In addition, leftover vegetables such as radishes and carrots that were harvested the previous year and are past their ripeness are often added. In addition to Gunma, it is an event food that is popular mainly in the northern Kanto region, such as Tochigi and Ibaraki.
396a85849f2a242d.zh: 又稱為「しもつかれ」、「すみつかり」、「しみつかれ」，是把喜慶宴席的剩餘食材，例如新年時吃的鮭魚頭和「節分」剩下的豆子，一起燉煮而成的料理。此外，也常加入前一年收成、已過了最佳熟度的蘿蔔、紅蘿蔔等剩餘蔬菜。除了群馬之外，這也是主要在栃木、茨城等北關東地區常見的節慶食物。

397557d313623cb5.en: It is a delicacy that is made by cutting the Japanese flying squid into small pieces and aging it with squid ink. The unique black appearance of this dish surprises many people. Historical records show that the lord of the Kaga domain presented it to the shogun during his visit to the shogunate, indicating that it has been a specialty of the area for centuries. Squid ink is rich in the components of umami, such as glutamate and taurine, and is believed to have a deeper and more addictive taste than a typical salted fish called “akazukuri”.
397557d313623cb5.zh: 這是將日本魷（スルメイカ）切成小塊，加入墨汁熟成製成的珍味。這道菜獨特的黑色外觀讓許多人感到驚訝。史料記載，加賀藩主拜訪幕府時曾將其獻給將軍，可見數百年來一直是當地名產。墨汁富含麩胺酸、牛磺酸等鮮味成分，據說比一般稱為「赤づくり」的鹽辛滋味更深厚、更讓人吃上癮。

397e260fd1ec2235.en: Honren-ji (本蓮寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Ushimado neighborhood of the city of Setouchi, Okayama Prefecture, Japan.  The temple's full name is Kyōōsan Honren-ji (経王山 本蓮寺), and it belongs jointly to the Hokkeshū Honmonryū branch of the Nichiren-shu of Japanese Buddhism.
397e260fd1ec2235.zh: 本蓮寺是位於日本岡山縣瀨戶內市牛窗地區的一座佛寺。寺院全名為經王山本蓮寺，屬於日本佛教日蓮宗的法華宗本門流。

399504ce59ceb727.en: Kuryū Rakusen-en Sanatorium, or National Sanatorium Kuryū Rakusen-en is a sanatorium for leprosy or ex-leprosy patients situated at Kusatsu-machi, Azuma-gun, Gunma Prefecture in Japan, which started in 1932.
399504ce59ceb727.zh: 国立療養所栗生楽泉園是位於日本群馬縣吾妻郡草津町、收容痲瘋病患者及已治癒患者的療養所，1932年開設。

39b152ba56c12463.en: The great sugi of Kayano (栢野大杉, Kayano Ōsugi) is a Cryptomeria (Sugi) tree at Yamanaka Onsen in Kaga, Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan. One of the four trees believed to be sacred in the precincts of the Sugawara Shrine, it has received the distinction of designation as a Special Natural Monument from the Agency for Cultural Affairs of Japan.
39b152ba56c12463.zh: 栢野大杉是位於日本石川縣加賀市山中溫泉的一棵杉樹（柳杉）。為菅原神社境內被視為神木的四棵樹之一，已獲日本文化廳指定為特別天然紀念物。

39bb7e8797fd3300.en: “Yaseuma” is a traditional snack made with kneaded wheat flour, which is flattened and boiled, and sprinkled with kinako (=roasted soybean flour) and sugar. It is a popular local dish along with dango jiru (=dumpling soup), also from Oita, made with kneaded wheat flour and eaten with a barley miso-based soup. There is a trick to rolling out the dough, and it is said that the more experienced one is, the thinner and longer the dough can be rolled out.“Yaseuma” is said to have originated from Furuno of Yufu city of Oita.
39bb7e8797fd3300.zh: 「やせうま」是將揉好的麵粉麵團壓扁後水煮，再撒上黃豆粉與砂糖的傳統點心。與同樣來自大分、以揉好的麵粉製作並搭配大麥味噌湯食用的團子汁並列為受歡迎的鄉土料理。擀麵團有訣竅，據說越熟練的人，越能將麵團擀得又薄又長。「やせうま」據說起源於大分縣由布市古野。

39bd1dd3aee4c725.en: Senzanki is a local dish of the Toyo region (mainly around Imabari City), where chicken cooking is popular. It is a deep-fried dish using various parts of chicken meat with bones, and is said to have originated in the Edo period (1603-1867) when pheasants were captured from Mount Chikami and deep-fried. It is said to have originated in the Edo period (1603-1867), when pheasants were captured and deep-fried on Mt.
39bd1dd3aee4c725.zh: せんざんき是盛行雞肉料理的東予地區（主要在今治市周邊）的鄉土料理。將帶骨雞肉的各個部位油炸而成，據說起源於江戶時代（1603-1867），當時人們在近見山捕捉雉雞油炸食用。

39f658c368b62f21.en: “Zoni” is unique in its ingredients in each region of Japan. The ingredients and taste of the soup stock, the ingredients that go into it, and the shape of the rice cake vary from region to region. The custom of eating zoni on the first three days of the New Year started during the Muromachi period (1336-1573), when zoni was served to the samurai family as a festive meal, and then it spread to the common people.
39f658c368b62f21.zh: 日本各地的「雜煮」材料各有特色。高湯的材料與味道、放入的食材以及年糕的形狀都因地區而異。新年頭三天吃雜煮的習俗始於室町時代（1336-1573），當時雜煮作為慶賀的餐點供武士家族食用，之後才普及到一般百姓。

3a00eb42ae927d1c.en: Shiraito Falls (白糸の滝, Shiraito-no-taki) is a waterfall in the Furukuchi district of Tozawa, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan, on a branch of the Mogami River. It is one of "Japan’s Top 100 Waterfalls", in a listing published by the Japanese Ministry of the Environment in 1990.
3a00eb42ae927d1c.zh: 白糸の滝（白糸の滝，Shiraito-no-taki）是位於日本山形縣戶澤村古口地區的瀑布，位在最上川的支流上。1990年日本環境省公布的「日本瀑布百選」中列有此瀑布。

3a212071f2261f36.en: Sagara Castle (相良城, Sagara-jō) was a Japanese castle located in what is now the city of  Makinohara, central Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. At the end of the Edo period, Sagara Castle had been degraded to a jin'ya and was home to the Tanuma clan, daimyō of Sagara Domain.
3a212071f2261f36.zh: 相良城是位於現今日本靜岡縣中部牧之原市的日本城堡。江戶時代末期，相良城已降格為陣屋，為相良藩大名田沼氏的居所。

3a2645073f0dd533.en: Tsuchiyu Onsen (土湯温泉, Tsuchiyu-onsen)  is a hot spring resort located approximately 16 kilometers west of the city centre of Fukushima, Fukushima, Japan. It is near the source and built along the shores of the Arakawa River, at the foot of Mt. Azuma.
3a2645073f0dd533.zh: 土湯溫泉（土湯温泉）是位於日本福島縣福島市市中心以西約16公里的溫泉鄉，位於吾妻山山腳，靠近荒川源頭，沿荒川兩岸而建。

3a6b37624160bbdf.en: The Tonkararin (トンカラリン, Tonkararin) or Tonkararin tunnel structure is a 464.6 m (1,524 ft) long, tunnel-like structure of unknown origin, situated in Nagomi, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan. It lies on a plateau called Seibaru Daichi, around which are many kofun or tumuli, such as Eda-Funayama Kofun. It consists of very shallow natural slits of the ground covered with stones and man-made stone-structured underdrains. The name of Tonkararin came from the sound of a stone, when the stone is thrown into the tunnel.
3a6b37624160bbdf.zh: トンカラリン（トンカラリン隧道狀遺構）是一座全長464.6公尺（1,524英尺）、起源不明的隧道狀構造物，位於日本熊本縣和水町。它位於名為清原台地的台地上，周圍有許多古墳，例如江田船山古墳。結構由覆蓋石塊的極淺天然地面裂縫，以及人工石造暗渠組成。「トンカラリン」之名來自將石頭丟進隧道時發出的聲響。

3a9f25f4664641c0.en: The Hakkōda Ropeway (八甲田ロープウェー, Hakkōda Rōpuwē) is the name of a Japanese aerial lift line, as well as its operator. Opened in 1968, the line climbs Mount Tamoyachi in the Hakkōda Mountains in Aomori, Aomori.  It transports skiers and rime spectators in winter, and hikers in other seasons.
3a9f25f4664641c0.zh: 八甲田纜車（八甲田ロープウェー）是日本一條空中纜車路線的名稱，也是其經營者的名稱。路線於 1968 年開通，沿青森縣青森市八甲田山的田茂萢岳而上。冬季載運滑雪者及觀賞樹冰的遊客，其他季節則載運登山健行者。

3aad99392b6cd4aa.en: "Otoshi no Gottso" is eaten throughout Gifu Prefecture from New Year's Eve on December 31st to the third day of the New Year. It has been handed down under various other names depending on the region, such as "Toshikoshi Ryori," "Toshikoshi-ni," and "Otoshikoshi." A large pot of Otoshi no Gottso is made at a time and reheated before eating to give the kitchen appliances and utensils a rest on New Year's Day, so the family can relax together.
3aad99392b6cd4aa.zh: 「大歳のごっつぉ」在岐阜縣各地從12月31日除夕至新年第三天食用。依地區不同，也以「年越料理」「年越煮」「大年越」等各種名稱流傳下來。大歳のごっつぉ會一次煮一大鍋，食用前再加熱，好讓廚房器具在元旦休息，家人也能一起放鬆。

3ab6a966bf0ea307.en: “Koshu ko-umezuke” is made by harvesting Koshu mini plums―a special product of Yamanashi Prefecture―when they are still green and finishing the pickling by the end of May. The climate with a unique temperature difference, especially in the Kofu basin, is suitable for growing mini plums. The seeds are small and the flesh is thick, so they’re small but have a good texture. Plum cultivation became popular with the decline of sericulture.
3ab6a966bf0ea307.zh: 「甲州小梅漬」是將山梨縣特產甲州小梅趁青綠時採收，並於5月底前完成醃漬而成。特別是甲府盆地，溫差獨特的氣候適合種植小梅。小梅籽小肉厚，雖然個頭小，口感卻很好。梅子栽培隨著養蠶業衰退而興起。

3abd6490062f6f5a.en: Kiyotaki-ji (清滝寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Ono neighborhood of the city of Tsuchiura, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Buzan-branch of Shingon Buddhism and its honzon is a statue of Kannon Bosatsu, also popularly known as the Kiyotaki Kannon (清滝観音).  The temples full name is Nanmyō-zan Jigen-in Seirū-ji (南明山慈眼院清滝寺). The temple is the 26th stop on the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route.
3abd6490062f6f5a.zh: 清滝寺是位於日本茨城縣土浦市小野地區的佛教寺院，屬於真言宗豐山派，本尊為觀音菩薩像，一般也稱為清滝觀音。寺院全名為南明山慈眼院清滝寺。本寺為坂東三十三所巡禮路線的第26番札所。

3ad6428421945f2b.en: In Wakayama Prefecture, chagayu is affectionately called "okai-san" or "okayu-san. It was created to fill the stomach even with a small amount of rice because rice was precious in this mountainous prefecture, which is also known as "tree country. Especially in the southern part of the prefecture, where there is little flat land suitable for rice cultivation, it was a daily staple food, eaten five or six times a day. In the past, tea trees were also grown at home, supporting the establishment of the chagayu culture.
3ad6428421945f2b.zh: 在和歌山縣，茶粥被親切地稱為「おかいさん」或「おかゆさん」。這個縣多山，又被稱為「木之國」，米很珍貴，因此發展出即使米量少也能填飽肚子的茶粥。尤其在適合種稻的平地稀少的縣南地區，茶粥是日常主食，一天要吃五、六次。過去家家戶戶也種植茶樹，支撐了茶粥文化的形成。

3ae4054d22cdf70f.en: "Tara-Jiru(Codfish soup)" is a one-pot dish of codfish and spring onions simmered in a miso-based broth. In Akita Prefecture, "Tara (=Codfish)" is a typical winter fish as well as "Hatahata(=sandfish)" and in season in winter because they come up to the shallows around February to spawn.
3ae4054d22cdf70f.zh: 「鱈汁（鱈魚湯）」是將鱈魚與青蔥放入味噌湯底燉煮的火鍋料理。在秋田縣，「鱈（鱈魚）」與「鰰（雷魚）」同為冬季代表性的魚，由於牠們約在2月左右游到淺海產卵，因此冬季為產季。

3af0810a6cf9ffaa.en: The Himeji Central Park (姫路セントラルパーク, Himeji Sentoraru Pāku) is a safari park in Himeji, Hyōgo, Japan. The park opened in March 1984, and is the only safari park in Kansai region. It has a "sister park" agreement with Nairobi National Park, Kenya. The park also incorporates an amusement park. It is operated by Himeji Park Management (姫路パークマネジメント, Himeji Pāku Manejimento), a Kamori Kankō Group company.
3af0810a6cf9ffaa.zh: 姫路セントラルパーク是位於日本兵庫縣姬路市的野生動物園，1984年3月開園，是關西地區唯一的野生動物園。該園與肯亞奈洛比國家公園締結「姊妹園」協定，園內也設有遊樂園。由加森觀光集團旗下的姬路パークマネジメント經營。

3af953afd658d4ec.en: Morioka Takaya Arena is an arena in Morioka, Iwate, Japan. It is the home arena of the Iwate Big Bulls of the B.League, Japan's professional basketball league.
3af953afd658d4ec.zh: 盛岡市総合アリーナ（盛岡タカヤアリーナ）是位於日本岩手縣盛岡市的體育館，為日本職業籃球聯賽B.League球隊岩手Big Bulls的主場。

3afe378ae1d82d2f.en: Mount Apoi (アポイ岳, Apoi-dake) is located in the Hidaka Mountains, Hokkaidō, Japan. It is near the town of Samani. It is well known for hosting a large number of plants that are found only on Hokkaidō, such as Callianthemum miyabeanum (ヒダカソウ, Hidaka-sō). The mountain is made from ultramafic rock of unknown age.
3afe378ae1d82d2f.zh: アポイ岳位於日本北海道日高山脈，鄰近樣似町。以生長大量僅見於北海道的植物而聞名，例如ヒダカソウ（Callianthemum miyabeanum）。山體由年代不明的超基性岩構成。

3b2b952aa0773641.en: Eisan-ji (栄山寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the city of Gojō, Nara Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the  Shingon sect of Japanese Buddhism and its honzon is a statue of Yakushi Nyorai.  The temple's full name is Gakushō-san Eisan-ji (学晶山 栄山寺).The temple is noted for its Nara period octagonal hall, which is designated as a National Treasure.
3b2b952aa0773641.zh: 栄山寺是位於日本奈良縣五條市的佛教寺院，屬於日本佛教真言宗，本尊為藥師如來像。寺院全名為學晶山榮山寺（学晶山 栄山寺）。本寺以奈良時代的八角堂聞名，該堂被指定為國寶。

3b3625023d436851.en: Shiroyama Hachimangū (城山八幡宮), also known as Shiroyama Hakusan, is a Shinto shrine located in the city of Nagoya, central Japan.
3b3625023d436851.zh: 城山八幡宮又稱城山白山，是位於日本中部名古屋市的神社。

3b43b40ad40ce230.en: Kaiten Memorial Museum (回天記念館, Kaiten Kinen-kan) is a museum on the island of Ōzushima in the Inland Sea, in Shūnan, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan, dedicated to the history and memory of the Kaiten, a Special Attack Unit of the Imperial Japanese Navy. The museum first opened near the remains of the island's training base in 1968, reopening in today's building in 1998. The collection of some one thousand items includes wills, letters, uniforms, personal belongings, and photographs.
3b43b40ad40ce230.zh: 回天記念館是位於日本山口縣周南市瀨戶內海大津島上的紀念館，記述並紀念日本帝國海軍特攻部隊「回天」的歷史。該館於1968年首度在島上訓練基地遺跡附近開館，1998年遷入現今建築重新開館。館藏約一千件，包括遺書、信件、制服、個人遺物與照片。

3b4687e57fee33bb.en: The Paantu (Miyako: パーントゥ) festival is an annual festival on the island of Miyako-jima in Japan's Okinawa Prefecture.
3b4687e57fee33bb.zh: パーントゥ（宮古語）是日本沖繩縣宮古島每年舉行的祭典。

3b524b74dcf30e05.en: "Botecha" is a recipe that was created during the Matsuyama Domain as it followed the rules of living simply and frugally. The ingredients used were grown locally and the meal matched the climate of the region. The wives of the feudal lord came up with this recipe using simple and affordable ingredients and created a meal to serve when entertaining guests. Tea ceremonies were often held in the Matsuyama region which is said to be one of the reasons for "botecha" being created.
3b524b74dcf30e05.zh: ぼて茶是松山藩時期遵循簡樸節儉的生活規範而產生的料理。使用的食材都是當地栽種的，餐點也配合這個地區的氣候。藩主的妻室們以簡單又便宜的食材想出這道料理，作為招待客人的餐點。松山地區經常舉行茶會，據說這也是ぼて茶誕生的原因之一。

3b548cd3ebcb9e17.en: Shōjō-ji (勝常寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Shingon-shu Buzan-ha sect in Yugawa, Kawanuma District, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan.
3b548cd3ebcb9e17.zh: 勝常寺是位於日本福島縣河沼郡湯川村的真言宗豐山派佛寺。

3b59423eb0f31e43.en: Mount Mizugaki (瑞牆山 Mizugaki-san) is a mountain located in Hokuto-city, in the Yamanashi Prefecture, within Chichibu Tama Kai National Park. It is one of the 100 Famous Japanese Mountains. It is part of the Okuchichibu Mountains. It has an altitude of 2230m. The mountain is located just across from Mount Kinpu.
3b59423eb0f31e43.zh: 瑞牆山是位於山梨縣北杜市的山，在秩父多摩甲斐國立公園範圍內，為日本百名山之一，屬於奧秩父山塊，海拔2230公尺。此山與金峰山隔谷相對。

3b64e2e542f76faa.en: Oguni Castle (小国城, Oguni-jō) was a Nanboku-chō period yamashiro-style Japanese castle located in what is now part of the city of Tsuruoka, Yamagata Prefecture in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan. The site has been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 2002. The site is approximately 30 minutes by car from Atsumi Onsen Station on the JR East Uetsu Main Line. It should not be confused with another Oguni Castle in Dewa Province, located in the Mogami region.
3b64e2e542f76faa.zh: 小国城是南北朝時代的山城式日本城郭，位於今日本東北地區山形縣鶴岡市境內。該遺址自2002年起受中央政府保護，列為國家史跡。從JR東日本羽越本線溫海溫泉站開車約30分鐘可達。不應與位於最上地區的另一座出羽國小國城混淆。

3b902295050c0056.en: Magi Mahiru Prefectural Natural Park (真木真昼県立自然公園, Magi Mahiru kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Akita Prefecture, Japan.
3b902295050c0056.zh: 真木真昼県立自然公園是位於日本秋田縣的縣立自然公園。

3b950bdcdc5dcca8.en: "Nanatoko zushi" is a traditional dish from the Miyakonojo region dating back to the Satsuma Domain when the Shimazu clan was in rule. Although the name of the dish is referred to as a sushi, in this region, sushi means "zosui" (=Japanese rice soup) and the seventh day of the New Year is called "nanatoko san no hi." January 7th of each year is a day to celebrate the health and growth of children that are seven years old.
3b950bdcdc5dcca8.zh: 「七とこずし」是都城地區的傳統料理，可追溯至島津氏統治的薩摩藩時代。雖然菜名稱為壽司，但在這個地區，「すし」指的是「雜炊」（日式粥湯），而新年第七天稱為「七とこさんの日」。每年1月7日是慶祝七歲孩童健康成長的日子。

3b9911fc982acc35.en: The Yomomine Site (横峯遺跡)  is an archaeological site with traces of a late Japanese Paleolithic period, located in the town of Minamitane, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan, on the island of Tanegashima.  The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 2003, and subsequently the designation was expanded to include the nearby Tachikiri Site in 2022.
3b9911fc982acc35.zh: 横峯遺跡是保有日本舊石器時代後期遺跡的考古遺址，位於日本鹿兒島縣種子島的南種子町。該遺址於2003年被指定為日本國家史跡，其後於2022年擴大指定範圍，納入鄰近的立切遺跡。

3b9953d3b89c9f62.en: Niekawa-juku (贄川宿, Niekawa-juku) was the thirty-third of the sixty-nine stations of the Nakasendō. It is located in the present-day city of Shiojiri, Nagano Prefecture, Japan.
3b9953d3b89c9f62.zh: 贄川宿是中山道六十九宿中的第三十三宿，位於今日本長野縣鹽尻市。

3badb4eac717dcd8.en: The Onohiyoshi Shrine (大野日吉神社, Ōno hiyoshijinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Kanazawa, Ishikawa. The shrine is dedicated to deities Oyamakui no Kami and Ōmononushi. It is said to have been founded in 733.
3badb4eac717dcd8.zh: 大野日吉神社是位於石川縣金澤市的神社，供奉大山咋神與大物主神。據傳創建於733年。

3bc1fb89cf2619c9.en: It is a traditional early summer dish made by wrapping vinegared rice in the leaves of a magnolia tree, and has been eaten as a feast during the farming holidays such as rice planting.In the area where it has been handed down from generation to generation, there is always a magnolia tree planted in the garden or in the surrounding area, with large leaves growing thickly. The leaves of the magnolia tree are believed to have antifungal properties as well as bactericidal properties.
3bc1fb89cf2619c9.zh: 這是以朴樹葉包裹醋飯製成的傳統初夏料理，在插秧等農忙休息日作為款待的佳餚食用。在代代相傳這道料理的地區，庭院或周邊必定種有朴樹，大片葉子生長茂密。朴樹葉被認為具有抗菌及殺菌的特性。

3bd0bc5efa97757c.en: The Takase Stone Buddhas (高瀬石仏, Takase sekibutsu) is a group of religious statues carved in bas-relief into a tuff cliff in Takase neighborhood of the city of Ōita, Ōita Prefecture on the island of Kyushu, Japan.  The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1934.
3bd0bc5efa97757c.zh: 高瀬石仏是位於日本九州大分縣大分市高瀨地區、在凝灰岩崖壁上以淺浮雕刻成的一組宗教造像。此地於1934年被指定為日本國家史跡。

3bd2c60eb78f27dd.en: The Komakino Site (小牧野遺跡, Komakino iseki) is an archaeological site located in the city of Aomori, Aomori Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan containing the ruins of a late Jōmon period (approx. 2000–1500 BC) settlement.  The remains were designated a National Historic Site in 1995 by the Japanese government. The site is located a short distance (approximately 20 minutes by car) to the south of the famous Sannai-Maruyama Site.
3bd2c60eb78f27dd.zh: 小牧野遺跡是位於日本北部東北地方青森縣青森市的考古遺址，保存有繩文時代晚期（約西元前2000年至前1500年）的聚落遺跡。該遺跡於1995年由日本政府指定為國家史跡。遺址位於知名的三內丸山遺跡南方不遠處（車程約20分鐘）。

3bdb387a5f1b1ba6.en: Wakayama Prefecture is one of the top mandarin oranges producing prefecture. Especially Arita area, origin of ‘Arita Mikan’, most mountains are covered with mandarin plantation. In 1574, Magoemon Ito, local farmer from Arita City, brought young mandarin trees from Yatsushiro, (current Kumamoto Prefecture), then planted in Arita. It is the origin of ‘Arita Mikan’. Arita City is mountainous and faces at the sea, and has less flat land. On the other hand, its mild climate is advantage for growing mandarin.
3bdb387a5f1b1ba6.zh: 和歌山縣是主要的柑橘產縣之一。尤其在有田蜜柑的發源地有田地區，大部分的山都覆蓋著柑橘園。1574年，有田市當地農民伊藤孫右衛門從八代（今熊本縣）帶回柑橘樹苗，種植於有田，這就是有田蜜柑的起源。有田市多山且面海，平地較少；另一方面，溫暖的氣候有利於柑橘栽培。

3becd36274880ce8.en: The Tsugaru Plain has a relatively mild climate for a snow country, and rice cultivation is said to have been practiced since the late “Jomon” period (about 3,000 years ago), which led to the development of rice culture. Successive lords of the Tsugaru domain also put a lot of effort into developing new rice fields, which resulted in a large amount of rice production. "Inarizushi" in general refers to a dish where vinegared rice or glutinous rice is stuffed inside sweet and savory fried tofu pouches.
3becd36274880ce8.zh: 津輕平原的氣候以雪國而言相對溫和，據說從繩文時代晚期（約3,000年前）起就已種稻，因而發展出稻米文化。歷代津輕藩主也致力開發新田，使稻米產量大增。「いなりずし」一般是指將醋飯或糯米填入甜鹹口味油豆腐皮中的料理。

3bf15e6a1c790b78.en: The Miomote River, where salmon run upstream, flows through Murakami City, which is known as “Salmon City,” and in autumn, the city is filled with salmon. It is said that there are more than 100 cooking methods in Murakami City, where the culture of eating salmon carefully from head to tail has taken root. One of these salmon dishes is “salmon yakizuke” . As the name suggests, it is a simple dish in which grilled salmon is marinated in soy sauce mixed with sake and mirin and served as is or broiled.
3bf15e6a1c790b78.zh: 鮭魚洄游的三面川流經有「鮭魚之城」之稱的村上市，秋天時市內到處都是鮭魚。村上市深植從頭到尾珍惜食用鮭魚的文化，據說烹調方法超過100種。「鮭の焼漬け」就是其中一道鮭魚料理。如其名稱所示，這是將烤好的鮭魚浸漬在加了酒和味醂的醬油中，直接食用或再炙烤後食用的簡單料理。

3bf18c182fe21ac1.en: A local dish passed down in the Shimabara Peninsula of Nagasaki Prefecture."Igirisu" is said to have its roots in the dish "Igisu Tofu" from the Imabari region in Ehime Prefecture, which uses Igisu seaweed. Although the ingredients and methods vary slightly, a dish similar to those in Imabari started being made in Shimabara after the Shimabara Rebellion in 1637. This occurred when the Tokugawa Shogunate resettled farmers from various domains in Shikoku as part of reconstruction efforts after the rebellion.
3bf18c182fe21ac1.zh: 長崎縣島原半島流傳的鄉土料理。據說「いぎりす」源自愛媛縣今治地區使用海藻いぎす製作的「いぎす豆腐」。雖然食材與做法略有不同，但1637年島原之亂後，島原開始製作與今治相似的料理。這是因為德川幕府在亂後的重建工作中，將四國各藩的農民遷居至此。

3c1cefab4904f310.en: Fukushima city concert hall (福島市音楽堂, Fukushima ongakudō) is a concert hall in Fukushima city, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. It opened in 1984 and has a shoebox-style auditorium with 1,000 seats and a smaller hall with a capacity of 200. Okada & Associates were the architects, with acoustical design by Nagata Acoustics. The 41 stop organ is by Marcussen.
3c1cefab4904f310.zh: 福島市音樂堂是位於日本福島縣福島市的音樂廳，1984年啟用，設有1,000席的鞋盒式大廳及可容納200人的小廳。建築設計為岡田新一設計事務所，音響設計為永田音響設計。41音栓的管風琴由Marcussen製作。

3c3acb85ae3383ee.en: The Ōnodai Dolmen Cluster (大野台支石墓群, Ōnodai shisekibo-gun)  is an archaeological site with a late Jōmon cemetery containing at least 71 dolmens, located in the Shikamachi neighbourhood of city of Sasebo, Nagasaki Prefecture Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1985. It is the oldest in Japan, along with the Harayama Dolmen Cluster on the Shimabara Peninsula.
3c3acb85ae3383ee.zh: 大野台支石墓群是位於日本長崎縣佐世保市鹿町地區的考古遺址，為繩文時代晚期的墓地，至少有71座支石墓。該遺址於1985年被指定為日本國家史跡，與島原半島的原山支石墓群並列為日本最古老的支石墓群。

3c42e5f8a524acef.en: Tenjinyama Castle (天神山城, Tenjinyama-jō) also known as Fuse-Tenjinyama  Castle is the remains of a castle structure in Tottori (city), Tottori Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a Prefectural Historic Sites. The castle was the Shogosho (Shugo daimyo's residence or main bastion) of the Inaba Yamana clan.
3c42e5f8a524acef.zh: 天神山城又稱布勢天神山城，是位於日本鳥取縣鳥取市的城郭遺跡。其遺跡列為縣史跡受到保護。此城為因幡山名氏的守護所（守護大名的居所或主要據點）。

3c6765e6f1ad81c4.en: The Kuma River, Kumamoto's largest first-class river, runs through the Hitoyoshi Basin, flows through the Yatsushiro Plain, and empties into the Yatsushiro Sea. It has long been known as a source of ayu because of its rapid current, which is one of the three most rapid rivers in Japan, and the quality of its water, which is said to be clear. The reason for this is that the ayu's body is trained by the fierce current, and the clear water allows sunlight to reach the bottom of the river, which provides an abundance of algae as food.
3c6765e6f1ad81c4.zh: 球磨川是熊本縣最大的一級河川，流經人吉盆地與八代平原，注入八代海。球磨川以水流湍急聞名，為日本三大急流之一，水質據說也相當清澈，因此自古以來就是知名的香魚產地。原因在於香魚的身體經湍急水流鍛鍊，而清澈的河水讓陽光能照到河底，提供大量藻類作為食物。

3c6e9076d86c3286.en: “Toyama-Kabu” (turnip) is a traditional vegetable of Yamagata Prefecture that originated in Yonezawa City. Its name comes from the Toyama area of Yonezawa City, where it was brought by the Uesugi family when they came to Yonezawa City in 1600.
3c6e9076d86c3286.zh: 「遠山かぶ」（蕪菁）是起源於米澤市的山形縣傳統蔬菜。名稱來自米澤市的遠山地區，是上杉家於1600年來到米澤時帶來的。

3c73bd78ee2564e6.en: This is a local dish eaten during break time from farm work mainly in the eastern low land like Chichibu area and Kazo City. Producing wheat flour is very active in Saitama and this dish is really Saitama snack. It’s easy to make and doesn’t take time like making ‘udon’ thick wheat noodle or ‘manjyu’ dumpling, so it’s handy to prepare. Basically, just make dough with wheat and water then bake. The ingredients vary depending on family or season; sometimes finely minced vegetables or left-over rice are mixed with dough.
3c73bd78ee2564e6.zh: 這是主要在秩父地區、加須市等東部低地，農事休息時吃的鄉土料理。埼玉的小麥生產非常興盛，這道菜可說是道地的埼玉點心。它不像製作烏龍麵或饅頭那樣費工費時，做法簡單，方便準備。基本上只要用麵粉和水調成麵糊後煎烤即可。材料依家庭或季節而不同，有時會在麵糊中拌入切碎的蔬菜或剩飯。

3c782f27d0ac3791.en: Tanaka Castle (田中城, Tanaka-jō) was a Sengoku period Japanese castle located in the town of Nagomi, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2002.
3c782f27d0ac3791.zh: 田中城是戰國時代的日本城郭，位於日本熊本縣和水町。其遺址自2002年起被列為國家史跡保護。

3c7d193aaa094923.en: Ishikawa Prefecture has moderately low winter temperatures, although there is some snowfall, and summers are hot and humid. Fermented food culture took root by taking advantage of its unique climate. For example, “ishiru” is considered one of Japan's three major fish sauces. The main ingredient is the innards of the common squid, but the ingredients used vary depending on the region, such as Japanese sardines, round herring, mackerel, and horse mackerel.
3c7d193aaa094923.zh: 石川縣冬季雖有降雪，但氣溫並不算太低，夏季則炎熱潮濕。當地利用這種獨特氣候，孕育出發酵食品文化。例如「魚醬（いしる）」被視為日本三大魚醬之一。主要原料是北魷的內臟，但依地區不同，也會使用日本沙丁魚、脂眼鯡、鯖魚、竹筴魚等。

3c81af436f8a9b0e.en: The Tagoyano Shell Midden (田小屋野貝塚, Tagoyano kaizuka) is an archaeological site in what is now the city of Tsugaru, Aomori Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan with an early Jōmon period shell midden.  The site was designated a  National Historic Site in 1944 by the Japanese government.  It is a rare example of a shell midden to be found near the coast of the Sea of Japan.
3c81af436f8a9b0e.zh: 田小屋野貝塚是位於日本北部東北地方青森縣今津輕市的考古遺址，保存有繩文時代早期的貝塚。遺址於 1944 年由日本政府指定為國家史跡。這是在日本海沿岸附近發現的貝塚中少見的例子。

3ca853e2b1418ec0.en: In 1756, Lake Nakaumi, which straddles the boundary between the cities of Matsue and Yasugi, suddenly experienced a bountiful catch of eels. Sagoemon, a merchant from Matsue, took notice of the bumper catch and set out to sell eels in Osaka. He put the eels in baskets and left Yasugi Port, carrying them on his back with a balance bar. He transported them via the Izumo Highway to Okayama Prefecture and Osaka, making full use of overland and water routes.
3ca853e2b1418ec0.zh: 1756年，橫跨松江市與安來市交界的中海突然出現鰻魚大豐收。松江商人佐五右衛門注意到這次豐收，便著手將鰻魚運到大阪販賣。他把鰻魚裝進籠子，從安來港出發，用扁擔挑在肩上，經由出雲街道運往岡山縣與大阪，充分利用陸路與水路。

3cc3600225684907.en: Pork is one of the specialties of Kagoshima Prefecture. It has the largest number of pigs raised in Japan, and "Kagoshima Kurobuta" is well-known as a pork brand throughout the country. It was taboo to eat animals during the Edo period due to the influence of Buddhism, which discouraged killing, but it is said that pork, wild boar, and deer were eaten often in the "Satsuma Domain". A native breed called "Shimabuta" was also bred in the Amami region.
3cc3600225684907.zh: 豬肉是鹿兒島縣的特產之一。鹿兒島縣的豬隻飼養頭數為全國最多，「鹿兒島黑豚」作為豬肉品牌全國知名。江戶時代受戒殺生的佛教影響，吃動物是禁忌，但據說在薩摩藩常吃豬、山豬和鹿。奄美地區也飼養名為「島豚」的在地品種。

3d1290cc9c01a11d.en: Tako meshi or octopus rice, is said to originate from when fisherman on boats would catch octopus and then cook it with rice. Originally, the sea around Ehime’s coast had a sandy seabed, with many small shrimps, crabs, and shellfish, making it a great environment for octopus to live in. In early spring, small octopuses weighing from 200 to 400 grams, called “kinome-dako” are found, which are believed to be tasty because of their firm meat.
3d1290cc9c01a11d.zh: たこ飯（章魚飯）據說起源於漁夫在船上捕獲章魚後與米一同炊煮。愛媛沿岸海域原本為沙質海底，有許多小蝦、螃蟹和貝類，是適合章魚棲息的環境。初春時可捕獲重約200至400公克的小章魚，稱為「木の芽ダコ」，因肉質緊實，被認為特別美味。

3d219c9d266da797.en: Museum of Tin Toys (ブリキのおもちゃ博物館, Buriki no Omocha Hakubutsukan) is a museum in Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. It was founded by Teruhisa Kitahara, a prominent tin toy collector, in 1986. In addition to the museum's permanent exhibition in Yokohama, Japan, it also has created a changing collection in Haneda Airport in Tokyo.
3d219c9d266da797.zh: 鐵皮玩具博物館（ブリキのおもちゃ博物館，Buriki no Omocha Hakubutsukan）是位於日本神奈川縣橫濱市的博物館，1986年由知名鐵皮玩具收藏家北原照久創立。除了在橫濱的常設展外，該館也在東京羽田機場設有更換展品的展覽。

3d37ad5f23e3b34d.en: Kiyomizu-dera (清水寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the city of Isumi, Chiba Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the  Tendai sect and its honzon is a statue of Senjū Kannon Bosatsu ( Sahasrabhūja).  The temple's full name is  Otowa-yama Senjū-in Seisui-ji (音羽山 千手院 清水寺).The temple is the 32nd stop on the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route. It is also called the "Kiyomizu Kannon".
3d37ad5f23e3b34d.zh: 清水寺是位於日本千葉縣いすみ市的佛教寺院，屬天台宗，本尊為千手觀音菩薩像（Sahasrabhūja）。寺院全名為音羽山 千手院 清水寺，是坂東三十三所巡禮路線的第32番札所，也稱為「清水觀音」。

3d3b70b88a86567b.en: Hōheikyō Dam (Japanese: 豊平峡ダム, Hepburn: Hōhei-kyō Damu) is a concrete Arch dam in Sapporo, Hokkaidō; Japan. It dams the Toyohira River. It is situated in Toya National Park. The dam was created for Irrigation as well as Flood control. The road leading to the dam has been closed off for regular car use, instead Hybrid electric buses are operated so the natural environment is protected. The dam's lake is known as Jozan Lake (定山湖),
3d3b70b88a86567b.zh: 豊平峡ダム是位於日本北海道札幌的混凝土拱壩，攔截豐平川，位於洞爺國立公園內。水壩用於灌溉及防洪。通往水壩的道路已禁止一般車輛通行，改以油電混合巴士營運，以保護自然環境。水壩形成的湖稱為定山湖。

3d5851e624b7584e.en: Shichinohe Castle (七戸城, Shichinohe-jō) was a Japanese castle located in what is now the town of Shichinohe, in Kamikita District of Aomori Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of far northern Japan. On December 13, 1941, the area was proclaimed a National Historic Site by the Japanese government.
3d5851e624b7584e.zh: 七戶城是位於日本最北部東北地方、今青森縣上北郡七戶町一帶的日本城郭。1941年12月13日，該地區由日本政府指定為國家史跡。

3d6e4d753e344867.en: The Hongan-ji Nagoya Betsuin (本願寺派名古屋別院) is a Jōdo Shinshū Buddhist temple located in Naka ward, Nagoya in central Japan.
3d6e4d753e344867.zh: 本願寺名古屋別院是位於日本中部名古屋中區的淨土真宗佛寺。

3d796868127770b9.en: The northern parts of Iwate Prefecture are affected by the Yamase, a cold east wind, and the winter climate there is extremely cold. As a result, there were not so many rice paddy fields and different types of millets such as wheat and buckwheat were grown instead and ground into flour. “Soba Kakke” is a traditional dish born during the rule of the Nanbu clan.Buckwheat flour is kneaded and flattened, then cut into small triangles. The triangles of flour are boiled with daikon radish and tofu, and eaten with garlic miso.
3d796868127770b9.zh: 岩手縣北部受到名為「山背」的寒冷東風影響，冬季氣候極為寒冷。因此水田不多，改為種植小麥、蕎麥等各種雜糧，並磨成粉使用。「そばかっけ」是南部藩統治時期誕生的傳統料理。將蕎麥粉揉製並壓平後，切成小三角形。三角形的麵片與白蘿蔔、豆腐一起煮，沾蒜味味噌食用。

3db162d60fa8b932.en: "Nishin soba(Herring soba)" is a local dish of Hokkaido, made by boiling and sweetening dried herring known as “Migaki herring” and putting it on soba. Kyoto is famous for herring soba, but it has also been eaten in Hokkaido for a long time. Kyoto's "Nishin soba" is lightly seasoned with kombu seaweed and light soy sauce, while in Hokkaido, it is seasoned strongly, resulting in a slightly sweet soup.From the late Edo period to the Meiji period, herring fishing was popular along the coast of Hokkaido.
3db162d60fa8b932.zh: 「ニシン蕎麦」（鯡魚蕎麥麵）是北海道的鄉土料理，將稱為「身欠き鯡」的鯡魚乾煮成甜味後放在蕎麥麵上。京都以鯡魚蕎麥麵聞名，但北海道也早已食用這道料理。京都的「ニシン蕎麦」以昆布和淡口醬油清淡調味，北海道則調味較重，湯頭略帶甜味。從江戶時代後期到明治時代，北海道沿岸的鯡魚捕撈相當興盛。

3db24bce66dc3880.en: Seichō-ji (Japanese: 清澄寺), also known as  Kiyozumi-dera (清水寺),   is a Nichiren Buddhist temple located in the city of Kamogawa in Chiba Prefecture, Japan. Along with Kuon-ji in Yamanashi Prefecture, Ikegami Honmon-ji in the south of Tokyo, and Tanjō-ji also in Kamogawa City, Seichō-ji is one of the "Four Sacred Places of Nichiren Shū."
3db24bce66dc3880.zh: 清澄寺（日語：清澄寺），又稱「きよずみでら」（清水寺），是位於日本千葉縣鴨川市的日蓮宗寺院。清澄寺與山梨縣的久遠寺、東京南部的池上本門寺，以及同在鴨川市的誕生寺，並列為「日蓮宗四大靈場」。

3dc5c2e9b7d9754a.en: Saiki City, located in southeastern Oita Prefecture, is the largest city in Kyushu. It covers an area of 903.12 km2 and has a coastline extending about 270 km. The topography of the city consists of mountainous areas stretching from the Kyushu Mountains, plains spreading downstream from the Banjo River, a first-class river, and coastal areas with a rias coastline. The bounty of the sea brought by the Bungo Channel supports the region's fishery industry.
3dc5c2e9b7d9754a.zh: 佐伯市位於大分縣東南部，是九州面積最大的城市，面積903.12平方公里，海岸線長約270公里。市內地形包括從九州山地延伸而來的山區、一級河川番匠川下游展開的平原，以及谷灣式海岸的沿海地區。豐後水道帶來的海洋資源支撐著當地的漁業。

3dca690752d54aea.en: “Konnyaku no Shiraae” is a traditional local dish made with Konjac, mashed tofu and sesame seeds.It is said that Konjac(=yam cake) was first introduced to Japan as a vegetarian food when Buddhism came to Japan or that one of the envoys brought it from China during the Tang Dynasty. It did not spread to the common people until the Edo period though. In Kagawa prefecture, the cultivation of konjac potatoes began during the Meiji period, and they are still grown today in the mountainous areas.
3dca690752d54aea.zh: 「こんにゃくの白あえ」是以蒟蒻、搗碎的豆腐和芝麻製作的傳統鄉土料理。據說蒟蒻是在佛教傳入日本時作為素食傳入，也有一說是唐朝時由遣使從中國帶回。不過直到江戶時代才普及到一般百姓。香川縣自明治時代開始種植蒟蒻芋，至今山區仍有栽種。

3dcfaddac78cea07.en: Mount Ogura (御座山, Ogura-san) is a mountain located between Kitaaiki and Minamiaiki Villages, Minamisaku District, Nagano Prefecture, Japan.  With its summit being 2,112 meters above sea level, it is the tallest mountain in Minamiaiki, Nagano.
3dcfaddac78cea07.zh: 御座山是位於日本長野縣南佐久郡北相木村與南相木村之間的山。山頂海拔2,112公尺，是長野縣南相木村最高的山。

3de76af51845d3ba.en: Okyuto is a local delicacy unique to Fukuoka Prefecture, which faces the sea. It is also called "oki-udo," and was once an indispensable part of breakfast, so much so that until before the Asian-Pacific War, there were "oki-udo vendors" who sold oki-udo every morning.There is a theory that it was called "okyuto" or "savior" because many people were saved from starvation by using okyuto as food during times of famine, or that it was named "oki-jin" or "oki-dukkatsu" because fishermen accidentally created it from seaweed.
3de76af51845d3ba.zh: おきゅうと是面海的福岡縣特有的鄉土食物，又稱「沖獨活」，過去是早餐不可或缺的一道菜，在太平洋戰爭之前，甚至有每天早上叫賣的「おきゅうと小販」。關於名稱有幾種說法：一說是饑荒時許多人靠它充飢免於餓死，因此稱為「お救人」（救人者）；另一說是漁夫意外以海藻做出這種食物，因而命名為「沖人」或「沖獨活」。

3e06f5020b539e84.en: The Yasunagata Site (安永田遺跡) is an archaeological site with the traces of a Yayoi period settlement and bronze casting center, located in the Yubi neighborhood of the city of Tosu,  Saga Prefecture, Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1982.
3e06f5020b539e84.zh: 安永田遺跡是位於日本佐賀縣鳥栖市柚比地區的考古遺址，保有彌生時代聚落及青銅鑄造據點的遺跡，1982年指定為日本國家史跡。

3e12ab899797f1da.en: Suzuo Castle (鈴尾城) was the main castle of the Fukubara clan. It is located in Fukubara of Akitakata, Hiroshima, in what used to be Aki Province. It is also known as "Fukubara Castle" (福原城). It is also famous as the birthplace of the warlord Mōri Motonari.
3e12ab899797f1da.zh: 鈴尾城是福原氏的主城，位於舊安藝國、今廣島縣安藝高田市福原，又稱「福原城」。此城也以戰國大名毛利元就的出生地而聞名。

3e16458332a37fd5.en: 'Chitake udon' is an udon dish unique to the plains of Tochigi Prefecture, where flatland forests abound, and it consists of udon noodles in a broth made from stir-fried chitake mushrooms and eggplant.Tochigi Prefecture, with its extensive fields and double-cropped rice paddies, is one of the largest wheat-growing areas in Japan, and udon noodles were made from freshly ground wheat flour during the Bon Festival when the barley and wheat harvests were still in progress.
3e16458332a37fd5.zh: 「ちたけうどん」是平地林眾多的栃木縣平原地區特有的烏龍麵料理，將烏龍麵搭配用炒過的ちたけ菇與茄子製成的湯汁。栃木縣田地廣大且有二期作水田，是日本最大的小麥產區之一，在大麥與小麥收成仍在進行的盂蘭盆節期間，人們會用剛磨好的麵粉製作烏龍麵。

3e3d7c89f3aab7fa.en: The “Kounago”, which is said to be the fish that heralds spring, is another name for the “Ikanago”. In Mie Prefecture, it is called” Kounago “exclusively.
3e3d7c89f3aab7fa.zh: 據說是報春之魚的「こうなご」，是「玉筋魚（いかなご）」的別名。在三重縣則專稱為「こうなご」。

3e433703d5ad8dd2.en: The Yura River (由良川, Yuragawa) is a Class A river in Kyoto Prefecture and Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan
3e433703d5ad8dd2.zh: 由良川是流經日本京都府與兵庫縣的一級河川。

3e638ec4700f8ae4.en: Heirin-ji (平林寺) is a Rinzai temple of the Myoshin-ji branch located in Niiza city, Saitama prefecture, Japan, a city just outside Tokyo.
3e638ec4700f8ae4.zh: 平林寺是位於日本埼玉縣新座市的臨濟宗妙心寺派寺院，新座市緊鄰東京。

3e884996ab6b8573.en: "Sasazushi" is a traditional local dish from the Hokushinetsu region., In Niigata Prefecture, it is mainly enjoyed in the Joetsu region. While a similar dish in Ishikawa Prefecture called "Oshizushi" is made by pressing down on vinegared rice wrapped in bamboo leaves, Niigata's "Sasazushi" is made by placing vinegared rice on kuma bamboo leaves and arranging various ingredients and seasonings on top.
3e884996ab6b8573.zh: 笹寿司是北信越地區的傳統鄉土料理，在新潟縣主要流行於上越地區。石川縣有一道類似的料理稱為「押寿司」，是將包在竹葉中的醋飯壓製而成；新潟的笹寿司則是將醋飯放在隈笹葉上，再在上面擺放各種配料和調味料。

3e931a0223a1e07c.en: The Yuwaku Onsen (湯涌温泉) is a hot spring resort in Kanazawa, Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan.
3e931a0223a1e07c.zh: 湯涌溫泉是位於日本石川縣金澤市的溫泉鄉。

3ea574fa6f44b354.en: The Kamitakatsu Shell Midden (上高津貝塚, Kamitakatsu kaizuka) is an archaeological site in the Shishitsuka, Kamitakatsu, and Nakatakatsu neighborhoods of the city of Tsuchiura, Ibaraki Prefecture, in the northern Kantō region of Japan containing a late Jōmon period  shell midden. The site was designated a National Historic Site in 1977.
3ea574fa6f44b354.zh: 上高津貝塚是位於日本北關東地區茨城縣土浦市宍塚、上高津及中高津一帶的考古遺址，包含繩文時代後期的貝塚。1977年被指定為國家史跡。

3ebbcf8ec1684abd.en: Takayama Uichi Memorial Museum of Art (七戸町立鷹山宇一記念美術館, Shichinohe chōritsu Takayama Uichi kinen bijutsukan) opened in Shichinohe, Aomori Prefecture, Japan, in 1994 as a part of Roadside Station Shichinohe.
3ebbcf8ec1684abd.zh: 七戶町立鷹山宇一紀念美術館於1994年在日本青森縣七戶町開館，為道路休息站七戶的一部分。

3ec844285e8dd38c.en: The Katsunuma clan residence ruins (勝沼氏館跡, Katsunuma-shi yakata ato) is an archaeological site consisting of the ruins of a Sengoku period fortified residence, located in what is now part of the city of Kōshū, Yamanashi in the Chūbu region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1981.
3ec844285e8dd38c.zh: 勝沼氏館跡是戰國時代設防宅邸的遺址，位於今日本中部地方山梨縣甲州市境內。該遺址於1981年被指定為日本國家史跡。

3ed0463d2f7bf8f4.en: Tanagura Castle (棚倉城, Tanagura-jō)  a flatland-style Japanese castle located in the town of Tanagura, Tamura District, Fukushima Prefecture, in the southern Tōhoku region of Japan. It also called Kamegajō Castle (亀ケ城) .  Built in 1625 by Niwa Nagashige, the castle was occupied by a succession of daimyō of Tanagura Domain under the Edo period Tokugawa shogunate.
3ed0463d2f7bf8f4.zh: 棚倉城是平城式的日本城郭，位於日本東北地方南部福島縣田村郡棚倉町，又稱龜ケ城。1625年由丹羽長重興建，江戶時代德川幕府治下由棚倉藩歷代大名相繼入主。

3ed0a9f6bec7ec13.en: The Arai Barrier (新居関所, Arai Sekisho) was a security checkpoint which was established by the Tokugawa Shogunate on the Tōkaidō highway connecting the capital of Edo with Kyoto in Edo period Japan. Its official name was the Imagire Barier (今切関所; Imagire-sekisho).  In 1921, the site was recognized as a National Historic Site, and in recognition that it had only surviving Edo-period checkpoint structure remaining in the country, its status was upgraded to that of a Special National Historic Site in 1962.
3ed0a9f6bec7ec13.zh: 新居関所是日本江戶時代德川幕府在連接江戶與京都的東海道上設置的關所，正式名稱為今切関所。1921年列為國家史蹟；由於這是日本國內唯一現存江戶時代關所建築的關所，1962年升格為國家特別史蹟。

3ed34cd4f14ff6f6.en: Hirosaki Tōshō-gū (弘前東照宮) was a Shinto shrine located in Hirosaki, Aomori Prefecture, Japan.
3ed34cd4f14ff6f6.zh: 弘前東照宮是過去位於日本青森縣弘前市的神社。

3ee6d7a40d798ad6.en: The Usuzan Ropeway (有珠山ロープウェイ, Usuzan Rōpuwei) is a Japanese aerial lift line in Sōbetsu, Hokkaidō, operated by Wakasa Resort (ワカサリゾート). Opened in 1965, the line climbs Mount Usu, the active volcano in Shikotsu-Tōya National Park. The observatory has a view of Lake Tōya, Shōwa Shinzan, and the central crater of Mount Usu. The ropeway provides access to hiking trails that lead to several crater viewing platforms of the volcanic landscape formed by past eruptions.
3ee6d7a40d798ad6.zh: 有珠山ロープウェイ是位於北海道壯瞥町的空中纜車路線，由ワカサリゾート經營。路線於1965年開通，登上支笏洞爺國立公園內的活火山有珠山。觀景台可眺望洞爺湖、昭和新山及有珠山中央火山口。纜車可通往健行步道，步道連接數座觀景台，可觀看歷次噴發形成的火山地形與火山口。

3ef3be8d9486c5b8.en: The okonomiyaki made in Hiroshima is a dish wherein thinly spread batter is cooked in a pan and piled with heaps of cabbage, pork, yakisoba, a thinly fried egg, or other ingredients. While topping it with a rich, sweet sauce is universal, mayonnaise is also often added if you like. A spatula is used as the eating utensil when okonomiyaki is eaten from the steel plate griddle it’s cooked on.
3ef3be8d9486c5b8.zh: 廣島的お好み焼き是將麵糊在鍋上攤薄煎製，再堆上大量高麗菜、豬肉、炒麵、薄煎蛋或其他食材的料理。一般都會淋上濃郁偏甜的醬汁，也常依喜好加上美乃滋。直接在煎製用的鐵板上食用時，會以鍋鏟作為餐具。

3f04e6492ac19fb5.en: Mount Iyogatake (伊予ヶ岳, Iyoga-take) is a mountain on the border of the city of Minamibōsō, Chiba Prefecture, Japan with an altitude of 336.6 m (1,104 ft). Mount Iyogatake is on the western side of Mineoka Mountain District of the Bōsō Hill Range, near Mount Tomi. The mountain takes its name from its resemblance to Mount Ishizuchi in Ehime Prefecture, formerly in Iyo Province.
3f04e6492ac19fb5.zh: 伊予ヶ岳是位於日本千葉縣南房總市境內的山，海拔336.6公尺（1,104英尺）。伊予ヶ岳位於房總丘陵嶺岡山地的西側，鄰近富山。此山因外形與舊屬伊予國的愛媛縣石鎚山相似而得名。

3f096be429016d2c.en: "Komo dofu" is made by wrapping tofu in "komo", a mat made of woven straw, and then boiling it. "Komo dofu" is characterized by the small holes in the tofu, the aroma of the straw, and the patterns made by the straw.In the past, people made "komo dofu" with leftover pieces of homemade tofu. Nowadays, tofu is wrapped in a bamboo mat or the "komo dofu" is store-bought.
3f096be429016d2c.zh: 「こも豆腐」是以稻草編成的蓆子「こも」包裹豆腐後煮製而成。特色是豆腐上的小孔、稻草香氣，以及稻草留下的紋路。過去人們用自製豆腐剩下的碎塊製作こも豆腐。現在則改用竹簾包裹豆腐，或直接購買市售的こも豆腐。

3f1426912bc67af3.en: Namaribushi is one step before becoming dried bonito, which are soft and can be cut into thin slices and eaten like sashimi. Shizuoka Prefecture accounts for 51% of the nation's production of bonito namaribushi, ranking first in Japan (2019). Bonito landed at the port of Yaizu is boiled in an iron pot and smoked.
3f1426912bc67af3.zh: 生利節是製成柴魚前一個階段的產品，質地柔軟，可切成薄片像生魚片一樣食用。靜岡縣的鰹魚生利節產量占全國51%，居日本第一（2019年）。在燒津港卸貨的鰹魚會放入鐵鍋煮熟後再燻製。

3f242ed3d8d3e32a.en: Mefu Jinja (売布神社, Mefu-jinja) is a Shinto shrine in Takarazuka, Hyōgo, Japan established in 610, covering an area of 13,000m2. The shrine is dedicated to the Shinto gods of food, clothing, wealth and marriage.
3f242ed3d8d3e32a.zh: 売布神社是位於日本兵庫縣寶塚市的神社，創建於610年，占地13,000平方公尺。神社供奉掌管食物、衣物、財富與婚姻的神道神祇。

3f30594cd518948d.en: Fukuoka Oriental Ceramics Museum (福岡東洋陶磁美術館, Fukuoka tōyō tōji bijutsukan) opened in Fukuoka, Japan, in 1999. The rotating displays of Chinese, Korean, and Japanese ceramics draw from the collection of some four hundred pieces.
3f30594cd518948d.zh: 福岡東洋陶瓷美術館於1999年在日本福岡開館。館內輪流展出中國、韓國及日本陶瓷，展品取自約四百件的館藏。

3f9375e98243aab8.en: Nanbu senbei is a traditional food from southeastern Aomori Prefecture to northern Iwate Prefecture, which was the territory of the former Nanbu domain. It is made by mixing flour with salt and water and baking rounds in iron molds. Before World War II, many farmers had iron molds, and rice crackers were a valuable preserved food in areas where rice was often damaged by cold weather and could not be harvested well. These rice crackers were boiled in miso soup or in a pot, which is called "senbei soup.
3f9375e98243aab8.zh: 南部煎餅是從青森縣東南部到岩手縣北部、舊南部藩領地一帶的傳統食物。做法是將麵粉加鹽和水混合，放入鐵模烤成圓片。二次世界大戰前，許多農家都有鐵模，在稻米常受冷害而收成不佳的地區，煎餅是珍貴的保存食。將這些煎餅放入味噌湯或鍋中煮，便稱為「せんべい汁」。

3f9f23fe1ea10fdb.en: "Karakai" is a dry food made by drying the cartilage of kasube (stingray) fins that are caught in Hokkaido. In the past, the fish eaten in inland areas far from the sea were dried fish such as Shiobiki-zake (salted salmon), Bodara (dried cod), and Karakai. It was originally introduced from Hokkaido and called "Karage" from the expression "Juppahitokarage" (to make sweeping generalizations), but it took root in Yamagata and the name was changed to "Karakai." The name "Karage" still remains in the Shonai region.
3f9f23fe1ea10fdb.zh: 「からかい」是將北海道捕獲的かすべ（魟魚）魚鰭軟骨曬乾製成的乾貨。過去，在遠離海洋的內陸地區所吃的魚，是塩引き鮭（鹽漬鮭魚）、棒鱈（鱈魚乾）、からかい等乾貨。它原本從北海道傳入，取「十把一からげ」（一概而論）的說法稱為「からげ」，後來在山形落地生根，名稱改為「からかい」。庄內地區至今仍保留「からげ」的名稱。

3fc3d699f06b27d3.en: Karimori and Early Harvest Karimori are types of white melons cultivated for pickling in the Nobi Plain region since the Meiji era. They are recognized as traditional vegetables of Aichi Prefecture. Currently, they are mainly produced in Kiyosu City and Oguchi Town, Niwa District. As the alternative name "Katauri" suggests, they are very firm melons and are rarely consumed outside of pickling.
3fc3d699f06b27d3.zh: かりもり與早生かりもり是自明治時代起在濃尾平原地區栽培、用於醃漬的白瓜品種，被認定為愛知縣的傳統蔬菜。目前主要產於清須市與丹羽郡大口町。正如其別名「堅瓜」所示，這種瓜質地非常硬，除了醃漬之外很少食用。

3fccf2ad06a0a14c.en: The Nakabaru Site (仲原遺跡, Nakabaru iseki) is an archaeological site with traces of a mid-Okinawan Shellmidden Period (2000–2500 years ago) settlement located in the island of Ikejima in the city of Uruma, Okinawa Prefecture, Japan. It was designated a National Historic Site in 1986.
3fccf2ad06a0a14c.zh: 仲原遺跡是位於日本沖繩縣宇流麻市伊計島的考古遺址，留有沖繩貝塚時代中期（距今2000至2500年前）的聚落痕跡。1986年被指定為國家史跡。

3ffa076951e90cb0.en: Wakasa Oniga Castle (若桜鬼ヶ城, Wakasa Oniga-jō) was a Sengoku period mountain-top Japanese castle located in what is now the town of Wakasa,  Tottori Prefecture, in the San'in region of Japan. The ruins of the castle were designated a National Historic Site in 2008.
3ffa076951e90cb0.zh: 若桜鬼ヶ城是戰國時代的山城，位於今日本山陰地方鳥取縣若櫻町。城跡於2008年被指定為國家史跡。

3fff2214854d92ae.en: Kawagoe Festival Museum (川越まつり会館) is a Kawagoe City local museum in Kawagoe City, Saitama Prefecture.
3fff2214854d92ae.zh: 川越まつり會館是位於埼玉縣川越市的川越市立地方博物館。

400547cf7712b051.en: Yūsentei Park (友泉亭公園, Yūsentei-kōen) is a park in Jōnan-ku, Fukuoka, Japan. It was originally built in the mid-Edo period (1754) for Kuroda Tsugutaka, the 6th domain head of the Kuroda clan. It was named Yūsentei after a later lord's tanka poetry.
400547cf7712b051.zh: 友泉亭公園位於日本福岡市城南區。原建於江戶時代中期（1754年），為黑田氏第6代藩主黑田繼高所建。之後一位藩主的短歌，成為友泉亭這個名稱的由來。

40118139ec6a4e9d.en: Fish rice is a dish consisting of grilled and loosened white fish topped with colorful ingredients such as kinshi tamago (thin cut omelets), mitsuba, shiitake mushrooms, shrimp, seaweed, and bamboo shoots, and served on rice with soup made from the bones. The city of Takehara, where the dish is mainly handed down, used to be a shallow sea, but it was reclaimed during the Edo period (1603-1868) and salt fields were built, and it flourished as a salt town for more than 320 years from 1650 to 1970.
40118139ec6a4e9d.zh: 魚飯是將白身魚烤過後撥散，再放上錦絲蛋（切細的薄蛋皮）、鴨兒芹、香菇、蝦、海苔、竹筍等色彩豐富的配料，盛在米飯上，並淋上以魚骨熬成的湯汁食用。這道料理主要流傳於竹原市，當地原本是淺海，江戶時代（1603-1868）經填海造地並建造鹽田，從1650年到1970年的320多年間，作為製鹽城鎮而繁榮。

401bb7b8ec4e37ae.en: The Gotemba Premium Outlets (Japanese: 御殿場プレミアム・アウトレット, Hepburn: Gotemba Puremiamu Autoretto) is an outlet mall located in Gotemba, Shizuoka, Japan, near Mount Fuji. It was opened on July 13, 2000, and contains over 200 stores. The mall is managed by Mitsubishi Estate Simon Co., Ltd., a joint venture between Mitsubishi Estate and Simon Property Group.
401bb7b8ec4e37ae.zh: 御殿場プレミアム・アウトレット是位於日本靜岡縣御殿場市、鄰近富士山的暢貨中心。於2000年7月13日開幕，設有200多家店鋪。由三菱地所與西蒙地產集團合資成立的三菱地所西蒙株式會社經營。

4024295a87ac4d20.en: Ito Castle (怡土城, Ito-jō) was an ancient castle (also known as a Korean-style fortresses in Japan (朝鮮式山城, Chōsen-shiki yamajiro) located in the city of  Itoshima, Fukuoka Prefecture Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1938, with the area under protection expanded in 1944 and in 2007.
4024295a87ac4d20.zh: 怡土城是位於日本福岡縣糸島市的古代城郭（亦屬日本的朝鮮式山城）。其遺跡自1938年起被指定為國家史跡受到保護，保護範圍於1944年及2007年擴大。

403e63c9c5c87d8d.en: Yonago City Museum of Art (米子市美術館, Yonago-shi Bijutsukan) is a municipal art gallery in Yonago, Tottori Prefecture (Japan) that opened in 1983.
403e63c9c5c87d8d.zh: 米子市美術館（米子市美術館，Yonago-shi Bijutsukan）是位於日本鳥取縣米子市的市立美術館，1983年開館。

40845cdcb6bf8a2d.en: Soup with mochi rice cakes is an indispensable dish during the New Year. Various forms of the soup exist depending on the region. In Okayama Prefecture's southern area, near the sea, the standard is to put Japanese amberjack in the soup. The Japanese amberjack is a fish that is called by the different names "yazuinada," "hamachi," and "buri (amberjack)" as it grows larger. Thus, the fish is considered a good omen and is used for auspicious seated receptions.
40845cdcb6bf8a2d.zh: 加入年糕的雜煮是新年不可或缺的料理，依地區不同而有各種形式。在岡山縣靠海的南部地區，一般會在雜煮中放入鰤魚。鰤魚隨著成長會依序被稱為「やずいなだ」「はまち」「ぶり（鰤魚）」等不同名稱，因此被視為吉祥的魚，用於喜慶宴席。

4092f3bdd330b649.en: Kanmurijima (冠島), also known as Oshima (冠島, O-shima) in the Oomoto religion, is an island in the Sea of Japan administered under Maizuru in Kyoto Prefecture. It is about 2 km from Kutsujima, a similar smaller island. Nakatsu reef (中津ぐり, Nakatsu-guri) is located just midway between islands. A breeding ground for streaked shearwaters, the island was designated a Japanese natural monument (天然記念物, tennen-kinenbutsu) in 1924. It has also been recognised as an Important Bird Area (IBA) by BirdLife International.
4092f3bdd330b649.zh: 冠島在大本教中又稱「大島」（冠島），是日本海上的一座島嶼，隸屬京都府舞鶴市管轄。距離另一座類似但較小的島嶼沓島約2公里，兩島正中間有中津礁（中津ぐり）。此島為大水薙鳥的繁殖地，於1924年被指定為日本天然紀念物，亦被國際鳥盟列為重要鳥類棲地（IBA）。

40b618d3cf4194c6.en: Suko Castle (須古城, Suko-jō) is the site of a castle structure in Shiroishi, Saga Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a Prefectural Historic Site.
40b618d3cf4194c6.zh: 須古城是位於日本佐賀縣白石町的城郭遺址，其遺跡列為縣指定史跡受到保護。

410301d06b642979.en: Sumiyoshi Park (住吉公園 Sumiyoshi Kōen) is an Osaka prefectural park in Hamaguchi-higashi Itchome, Suminoe-ku, Osaka, Japan.
410301d06b642979.zh: 住吉公園是位於日本大阪市住之江區濱口東一丁目的大阪府立公園。

4122cf605b65a5f1.en: The Nishi-Harima Astronomical Observatory (NHAO) is a research facility and a public observatory operated by the University of Hyogo since 2012. The observatory is located on the top of Mount Onade in Sayo Town, Japan.
4122cf605b65a5f1.zh: 兵庫縣立西はりま天文台（NHAO）是一座研究設施兼公共天文台，自2012年起由兵庫縣立大學營運。天文台位於日本佐用町大撫山山頂。

412aee76ed078fda.en: The Mizuko Shell Midden (水子貝塚, Mizuko kaizuka) is an archaeological site in the Mizuko neighborhood of the city of Fujimi, Saitama Prefecture, in the Kantō region of Japan containing am early Jōmon period  shell midden and settlement ruin. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1969.
412aee76ed078fda.zh: 水子貝塚是位於日本關東地方埼玉縣富士見市水子地區的考古遺址，包含繩文時代早期的貝塚與聚落遺跡。該遺址於1969年被指定為日本國家史跡。

41302ab09a55c465.en: Yumeji Art Museum (夢二郷土美術館, Yumeji Kyōdo Bijutsukan) is an art museum in Okayama Prefecture split between the main museum in Naka-ku, Okayama and the Yumeji Seika and Shonen Sanso annex built in Setouchi, the birthplace of Yumeji Takehisa, a poet and artist who was active in the early 1900s.
41302ab09a55c465.zh: 夢二鄉土美術館是位於岡山縣的美術館，分為岡山市中區的本館，以及建於瀨戶內市的夢二生家與少年山莊分館。瀨戶內市是活躍於1900年代初期的詩人兼畫家竹久夢二的出生地。

4148187e4c30343e.en: The Tōzan or Sueyama Shrine (陶山神社) is located in Arita, Nishimatsuura District, Saga Prefecture. The shrine has a porcelain archway and other items of porcelain which, at other shrines, are usually made of stone. This Shinto shrine was and still is particularly revered by Arita's ceramists.
4148187e4c30343e.zh: 陶山神社（讀作Tōzan或Sueyama）位於佐賀縣西松浦郡有田町。神社內有瓷製鳥居及其他瓷製物品，這些在其他神社通常是石造的。這座神社過去和現在都特別受到有田陶藝家的崇敬。

415ba0fb0e9c2c6f.en: The Ubayama Shell Mound (姥山貝塚, Ubayama kaizuka) is an archaeological site in the Kashiwai neighborhood of the city of Ichikawa, Chiba Prefecture, in the Kantō region of Japan, containing a mid-to-late Jōmon period  shell midden, designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1967.
415ba0fb0e9c2c6f.zh: 姥山貝塚是位於日本關東地區千葉縣市川市柏井的考古遺址，包含繩文時代中期至後期的貝塚，於1967年被指定為日本國家史跡。

4163e9e403f78d91.en: Ogawayama (小川山) is a 2,418m tall mountain on the border of Nagano and Yamanashi prefectures in Japan. It is a famous rock climbing area.  The rock in Ogawayama consists of granite.
4163e9e403f78d91.zh: 小川山是位於日本長野縣與山梨縣交界、高2,418公尺的山，是知名的攀岩地點。小川山的岩石為花崗岩。

417f90bc878d10b0.en: Achara-zuke is a vinegared dish of chopped seasonal vegetables with red chili pepper. The refreshing sweetness and sourness are accented by the spiciness of the red chili pepper. Since the days when there were no refrigerators, achara-zuke has been valued as a long-lasting summer dish.The word “achara-zuke” is written “阿茶羅漬け" in Chinese characters and is said to be derived from the Portuguese word “achar,” which means pickled vegetables or fruits.
417f90bc878d10b0.zh: あちゃら漬け是將切碎的當季蔬菜加上紅辣椒製成的醋漬料理。清爽的酸甜味中帶有紅辣椒的辣味。從沒有冰箱的年代起，あちゃら漬け就作為能久放的夏季料理而受到重視。「あちゃら漬け」的漢字寫作「阿茶羅漬け」，據說源自葡萄牙語「achar」，意思是醃漬的蔬菜或水果。

418367a1e347ed85.en: "Shidami" refers to acorns, and "Shidami-dango" can be made by adding sugar to "Shidami" and forming them into dumplings, or by making "Shidami" into paste and wrapping them in a dough kneaded from wheat flour.Northern areas, Ouu area, Kitakami mountain range area, there were often bad harvests due to the cold winds (yamase) in summer blowing from the Pacific Ocean.
418367a1e347ed85.zh: 「しだみ」指橡實，「しだみだんご」的做法有兩種：在「しだみ」中加入砂糖做成糰子，或將「しだみ」做成餡，用小麥粉揉成的麵皮包起來。在北部地區、奧羽地區、北上山地一帶，夏季從太平洋吹來的冷風（山背）常造成歉收。

418ba949c6823003.en: Koriyama City in Fukushima Prefecture is a major Koi (carp) producer. In addition to production, the city is also making efforts to expand awareness and promote Carp food by launching the "Koi ni Koisuru (Love with Carp) Koriyama Project" to preserve the Carp-eating culture. Koi from Koriyama grown in the mineral-rich water of Lake Inawashiro is fresh, odorless, and fatty, and is used in a wide variety of dishes, from Japanese to Western cuisine.“Koikoku” is one of the typical local dishes that uses carp.
418ba949c6823003.zh: 福島縣郡山市是鯉魚的主要產地。除了生產之外，市府也推動「鯉に恋する郡山プロジェクト」，致力於推廣鯉魚料理、提高認知度，以保存食鯉文化。郡山的鯉魚在豬苗代湖富含礦物質的水中成長，新鮮、無腥味且油脂豐富，從日式到西式料理都廣泛使用。「鯉こく」是使用鯉魚的代表性鄉土料理之一。

41ac2c82956f2996.en: Maki Ōdō (真木大堂) is an historic temple in Bungotakada, Ōita Prefecture, Japan. The current buildings are the Edo-period Hondō and an exhibition hall dating to 1955. Inside are nine Heian-period statues that have been designated Important Cultural Properties.
41ac2c82956f2996.zh: 真木大堂是位於日本大分縣豐後高田市的歷史寺院。現存建築為江戶時代的本堂及1955年建造的展示館。館內有九尊平安時代的佛像，已被指定為重要文化財。

41ca5f946b948779.en: Enkōji (延光寺) is a Chisan Shingon temple in Sukumo, Kōchi Prefecture, Japan. Temple 39 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage, the main image is of Yakushi Nyorai, the Buddha of healing and medicine. The temple is said to have been founded by Gyōki in the first year of the Jinki era.
41ca5f946b948779.zh: 延光寺是位於日本高知縣宿毛市的真言宗智山派寺院，為四國八十八所巡禮第39號札所，本尊為掌管醫療與藥的藥師如來。相傳此寺由行基於神龜元年創建。

41d157b371320a49.en: Takisan Tōshō-gū (滝山東照宮) is a Shinto shrine in Okazaki, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. It enshrines the first Shōgun of the Tokugawa Shogunate, Tokugawa Ieyasu.
41d157b371320a49.zh: 滝山東照宮是位於日本愛知縣岡崎市的神社，供奉德川幕府初代將軍德川家康。

41dcf1478d1f7d19.en: Hie temple ruins (比江廃寺跡, Hie haiji ato) is an archeological site  with the ruins of a Hakuhō period Buddhist temple located in the Hie neighborhood of what is now the city of Nankoku, Kōchi, Japan. The foundations of its pagoda were designated as a National Historic Site in 1934, with the area under protection extended in 1982.
41dcf1478d1f7d19.zh: 比江廃寺跡是一處考古遺址，保存白鳳時代佛寺的遺跡，位於今日本高知縣南國市比江地區。其佛塔基座於1934年被指定為國家史跡，1982年擴大保護範圍。

41e2c26a6043c365.en: Buri daikon," made with yellowtail and daikon (Japanese radish), a specialty of Kagoshima Prefecture, is a popular winter dish. It is a classic winter dish that combines the delicious taste of yellowtail and the sweetness of daikon.Kagoshima Prefecture, which has many inner bays where yellowtail fry (mojako) can be caught, boasts the nation's largest production of cultured yellowtail.
41e2c26a6043c365.zh: 以鰤魚和蘿蔔製作的「ぶり大根」是鹿兒島縣的特產，也是受歡迎的冬季料理。這是結合鰤魚美味與蘿蔔甜味的經典冬季菜餚。鹿兒島縣有許多可捕撈鰤魚苗（もじゃこ）的內灣，養殖鰤魚產量居全國之首。

41e50d1f3db2bd79.en: “Inaka-zushi” is a type of Sushi using vegetables that are rare in Japan. It is a traditional event food in the mountainous areas of Kochi Prefecture, and the ingredients for the Sushi are made with vegetables from the mountains.
41e50d1f3db2bd79.zh: 「田舍壽司」是使用在日本少見的蔬菜製作的壽司。這是高知縣山區的傳統節慶料理，壽司的食材使用山中的蔬菜。

41fb72d8bb4ad687.en: The gorge of Kankakei (寒霞渓, Kanka-kei; literally 'cold mist valley') is a nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty on the island of Shōdo-shima, Kagawa Prefecture, Japan. Part of the Setonaikai National Park, the heights rise to 812 m. The area is celebrated for its Japanese maple trees. Volunteers formed a preservation society in 1898 and when, in 1912, expropriation of the area was attempted, a soy sauce magnate stepped in to ensure its preservation. In 1927 Kankakei was selected as one of the 100 Landscapes of Japan.
41fb72d8bb4ad687.zh: 寒霞溪（字面意思為「寒冷霧氣的溪谷」）是位於日本香川縣小豆島的國家指定名勝，屬瀨戶內海國立公園的一部分，高度達812公尺。此地以日本楓樹聞名。1898年志工成立了保存會；1912年有人試圖徵收此地時，一位醬油業鉅子出面確保其得以保存。1927年寒霞溪入選日本百景。

421a2989bd7b954f.en: Kagomori Castle (河後森城, Kagomori-jō) was a Sengoku period Japanese castle located in the Matsumaru neighborhood of the town of Matsuno, Ehime Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1997.
421a2989bd7b954f.zh: 河後森城（河後森城）是位於日本愛媛縣松野町松丸地區的戰國時代日本城郭。其遺跡自1997年起被列為國家史跡加以保護。

42201608575706d8.en: Kasumigaura is the second largest lake in Japan. It is abundant in freshwater fish like smelt, whitebait, eels, and crucian carp because of the rich plankton and interaction with the sea. The natural eels caught in Kasumigaura and the Tone River basin are famous, making the area a popular destination. Ryugasaki City's Ushiku-numa is considered the birthplace of eel bowls.
42201608575706d8.zh: 霞浦是日本第二大的湖泊。由於浮游生物豐富且與海水相通，盛產公魚、白魚、鰻魚、鯽魚等淡水魚。在霞浦及利根川流域捕獲的野生鰻魚相當有名，使此地成為熱門去處。龍崎市的牛久沼被視為鰻魚飯的發源地。

4222d45e54119b25.en: Kahadakyō Prefectural Natural Park (香肌峡県立自然公園, Kahadakyō kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in central Mie Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1953, the park spans the municipalities of Matsusaka and Taki.
4222d45e54119b25.zh: 香肌峡県立自然公園是位於日本三重縣中部的縣立自然公園，設立於1953年，範圍橫跨松阪市與多氣町。

4224c9d222f2cb53.en: The Teshima Art Museum (豊島美術館, Teshima Bijitsukan) hosts a single piece of artwork and is located on the island of Teshima, Kagawa Prefecture, Japan, in the Seto Inland Sea. It is operated by the Benesse Foundation.  The architect is Ryue Nishizawa (co-founder of SANAA). The museum building is made of a freestanding concrete shell which is 25 cm-thick, 40 by 60 meters, and 4 meters at its highest point.
4224c9d222f2cb53.zh: 豊島美術館只展出一件藝術作品，位於日本香川縣瀨戶內海的豐島上，由福武財團營運。建築師為西澤立衛（SANAA共同創辦人）。美術館建築為一座獨立的混凝土薄殼結構，厚25公分，面積40×60公尺，最高處為4公尺。

42383796c7735f73.en: Shiga Museum of Art (滋賀県立美術館, Shiga Kenritsu Bijutsukan) opened under the former name Museum of Modern Art, Shiga (滋賀県立近代美術館) in Ōtsu, Shiga Prefecture, Japan in 1984, changing its name to broaden its scope on 1 April 2021. As of 31 March 2024, the collection numbered some 2,589 works, including a Brâncuși Bird in Space, paintings by Rothko and Yukihiko Yasuda, and art brut.
42383796c7735f73.zh: 滋賀縣立美術館於1984年在日本滋賀縣大津市開館，舊名為滋賀縣立近代美術館，2021年4月1日為擴大收藏與展示範圍而更名。截至2024年3月31日，館藏約有2,589件作品，包括布朗庫西的《空間中的鳥》、羅斯科與安田靫彥的畫作，以及原生藝術作品。

4257386252bdf0d8.en: Ishiizan Chōshō-ji (石井山長勝寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Nichiren Shū  in Kamakura, Kanagawa, Japan. It's one of a group of three built near the site in Matsubagayatsu (Valley of Pine Needles (松葉ヶ谷)) where Nichiren, founder of the Buddhist sect that bears his name, is supposed to have had his hut. The first part of its name is derived from the founder's last name (Ishii), the second is an alternative reading of the characters for Nagakatsu, the founder's first name.
4257386252bdf0d8.zh: 石井山長勝寺是位於日本神奈川縣鎌倉的日蓮宗佛寺。日蓮宗創始人日蓮據傳曾在松葉ヶ谷結庵，附近建有三座寺院，本寺為其中之一。寺名前半取自創建者的姓氏（石井），後半則是創建者名字「長勝」的另一種讀法。

42598f35d300f300.en: Ama-natto no Osekihan (red rice with sweetened soybeans)" is, as the name suggests, red rice cooked with ama-natto (sweetened soybeans). It tastes sweet, and is popular among the locals for its delicious sweetness when sprinkled with sesame salt. Since it is made without using sasage or azuki beans, the glutinous rice does not turn red, but is instead colored with food coloring.
42598f35d300f300.zh: 「甘納豆のお赤飯」（甘納豆紅豆飯）顧名思義，是加入甘納豆（甜煮豆）煮成的紅豆飯。味道甜，撒上芝麻鹽後甜味可口，深受當地人喜愛。由於製作時不使用豇豆或紅豆，糯米不會變紅，而是以食用色素上色。

425eb7338c1097ec.en: Canadian Academy (Japanese: カネディアン・アカデミイ, Hepburn: Kanedian Akademii), also known as CA, is an independent pre-K–12 international school in Kobe, Japan which was founded in 1913. The not-for-profit day and boarding school consists of an elementary school, middle school, and high school all located on the campus on Rokkō Island, a man-made island. The school is approved by the Japanese Ministry of Education and accredited by the U.S. based Western Association of Schools and Colleges (WASC) and the Council of International Schools (CIS).
425eb7338c1097ec.zh: カナディアン・アカデミー（簡稱CA）是位於日本神戶的獨立國際學校，涵蓋學前至12年級，創立於1913年。這所非營利的走讀兼寄宿學校包含小學、初中與高中，全部位於人工島六甲島上的校園內。學校獲日本文部省認可，並取得美國西部學校與大學協會（WASC）及國際學校協會（CIS）的認證。

4260dc31ed70b258.en: In the harsh cold of the prefecture, as winter approaches, no greenery can be harvested from the fields. Therefore, in late autumn, a large amount of preserved pickles are prepared. The pickling of vegetable varieties is called 'o-ha-zuke,' and it involves the use of vegetables such as 'Nozawana,' 'Inanohana,' 'Gensuke Kabuna,' and 'Kisona. Among them, 'Nozawana-zuke' is one of the two representative pickles in the prefecture and an essential ingredient during the winter in Shinshu.
4260dc31ed70b258.zh: 在縣內嚴寒的氣候下，冬季將近時田裡便採收不到綠色蔬菜，因此會在晚秋大量醃製保存用的醃菜。以葉菜類醃製稱為「お葉漬」，使用「野澤菜」、「稻核菜」、「源助蕪菜」、「木曾菜」等蔬菜。其中「野澤菜漬」是縣內兩大代表性醃菜之一，也是信州冬季不可或缺的食物。

426fad5ff3d0ee7b.en: Itakura Town, located in the Toumou area of Gunma Prefecture, is so rich in water resources that it is called "Gunma's Water Town".Even today, the town is home to nationally famous first-class rivers such as the Tone River and the Watarase River, the largest rivers in Japan, but in the past, there were many more rivers, ponds, and swamps. The river fish from these rich water sources is well known as a local specialty, and a variety of river fish such as eels, carp, and loach are eaten.
426fad5ff3d0ee7b.zh: 位於群馬縣東毛地區的板倉町，水資源豐富，被稱為「群馬的水鄉」。如今町內仍有利根川、渡良瀨川等日本最大級、全國知名的一級河川，而過去河川、池塘與沼澤更多。這些豐沛水域出產的河魚是著名的地方特產，當地人食用鰻魚、鯉魚、泥鰍等各種河魚。

42867fcafdb43cea.en: Shinzenkōji Castle (新善光寺城, Shinzenkōji-jō) was a flatland castle located in Echizen, Fukui Prefecture, Japan. Today, a memorial to the castle can be seen at what is now Shōgaku-ji.
42867fcafdb43cea.zh: 新善光寺城是位於日本福井縣越前市的平城。現今在正覺寺可以看到此城的紀念碑。

4287eeeb604dd616.en: There are many local dishes in Gunma used wheat flour, like ‘okirikomi’ (type of simmered noodle dish), ‘suiton’ (soup with flour dumplings), ‘tansan manjyu’ (buns used baking soda) and so on. Especially ‘jiriyaki’ is much popular in the farmers villages than any other wheat flour dishes. It is a miso-flavored pancake grilled with remaining heat from clay in ‘irori’ (=Japanese traditional heater). It is said that its name ‘jiriyaki’ came from the sound while grilling (‘jiri-jiri’ in Japanese).
4287eeeb604dd616.zh: 群馬有許多使用麵粉的鄉土料理，例如「おきりこみ」（一種燉煮麵料理）、「すいとん」（麵疙瘩湯）、「炭酸まんじゅう」（使用小蘇打的饅頭）等。其中「じりやき」在農村比其他麵粉料理更受歡迎。這是用「囲炉裏」（日本傳統火爐）中灰燼的餘熱煎烤的味噌口味煎餅。據說「じりやき」的名稱來自煎烤時發出的聲音（日文的「じりじり」）。

4289557ec6fa7214.en: Ōike (大池) is a  karst pond on Minamidaitōjima, Okinawa Prefecture, Japan.  Ōike is the largest pond containing both freshwater and seawater. It covers 0.31 square kilometres (0.12 sq mi), the circumference is 5.50 kilometres (3.42 mi), and it is 1.3 metres (4 ft 3 in) at its deepest point. Fresh water is mixed with seawater beneath.
4289557ec6fa7214.zh: 大池是位於日本沖繩縣南大東島的喀斯特池沼。大池是同時含有淡水與海水的池沼中規模最大者，面積0.31平方公里（0.12平方英里），周長5.50公里（3.42英里），最深處1.3公尺（4英尺3英寸）。下層的淡水與海水相混。

4291e41ec0eca3c6.en: In Kochi Prefecture, taro is called taimo and has been eaten since long ago as a valuable source of nutrients that ranks second to rice. It does not lack sweetness and has a soft and flaky texture. It also has a unique viscosity. Large ones were made into "taimo rice;" it is said that this was a way to bulk up meals during the war when rice was difficult to obtain. Smaller ones were used as an ingredient in miso soup, candied mash, and stews.
4291e41ec0eca3c6.zh: 在高知縣，芋頭稱為田芋，自古以來被當作僅次於米的珍貴營養來源食用。甜味充足，口感鬆軟綿密，並帶有獨特的黏性。大顆的會做成「田芋飯」，據說這是戰時米難以取得時增加飯量的方法。小顆的則用作味噌湯、甜芋泥及燉菜的食材。

42afbf0843b75b53.en: For rice farmers, the seed sowing in the seedbeds around the beginning of spring, known as "Minakuchi Matsuri" is considered the most crucial ritual of the year. During this event, farmers welcome the harvest deity to the irrigation gate (rice paddy entrance) to pray for a bountiful harvest.
42afbf0843b75b53.zh: 對稻農而言，初春前後在秧田播種，稱為「水口祭」，被視為一年中最重要的儀式。在這項活動中，農民將豐收之神迎至灌溉水口（稻田入口），祈求豐收。

42badbc0c60d086d.en: The Shimokamo Tropical Botanical Gardens (下賀茂熱帯植物園, Shimokamo Nettai Shokubutsuen), also known as the Shimokamo Tropical Garden, are botanical gardens located at Shimokamo Spa, 255 Shimokamo, Minami Izu-cho, Kamo, Shizuoka, Japan.
42badbc0c60d086d.zh: 下賀茂熱帯植物園又稱下賀茂熱帶花園，是位於日本靜岡縣賀茂郡南伊豆町下賀茂255、下賀茂溫泉的植物園。

42e1ab81eaa3c999.en: Adashino Nenbutsu-ji (化野念仏寺, Adashino Nenbutsuji) is a Buddhist temple in Ukyo-ku, Kyoto, Japan. In 811 Kūkai is said to have founded a temple, then Honen altered it to the present Nenbutsuji. Situated high on a hill overlooking the city from the northwest, it sits in an area where since the Heian period people abandoned the bodies of the dead, exposing them to the wind and rain. Now, some eight thousand Buddhist statuettes, which had been scattered around Adashino then collected about 1903, memorialize the souls of the dead.
42e1ab81eaa3c999.zh: 化野念佛寺是位於日本京都右京區的佛教寺院。相傳空海於811年在此創建寺院，之後法然將其改為現在的念佛寺。寺院位於自西北方俯瞰市區的高丘上，自平安時代起，人們便在這一帶棄置遺體，任其風吹雨打。現在約有八千尊佛像供養亡者之靈，這些佛像原本散落在化野各處，約於1903年收集至此。

4316d141b9222849.en: "Hitokawa sushi" is a pressed sushi prepared for gathering events often made in Gamou District Sakuragawa Village in Shiga Prefecture. Currently it moved to Higashi Oumi City, and is found in Sakuragawa-Nishi, Sakuragawa-Higashi and around Higashi Oumi around Aisho Town. Rice and ingredients are layered four or five in the sushi tub which can hold 2 "sho" of rice, then pressed to make box sushi. Various ingredients are used and it has many layers, so it looks gorgeous and colorful.
4316d141b9222849.zh: 「ひとかわすし」是滋賀縣蒲生郡櫻川村常在聚會時製作的押壽司。該地現已併入東近江市，可見於櫻川西、櫻川東及愛莊町周邊的東近江一帶。在可容納2「升」米的壽司桶中，將米飯與食材疊成四到五層，再壓製成箱壽司。使用多種食材且層次豐富，外觀華麗多彩。

431ddd1f05de93fd.en: “Kujira-jiru” is a local dish consisting of salted whale blubber, and vegetables, simmered in miso. Because of the influence of Kitamae-bune, various cultures of other places have taken root in Niigata, and “Kujira-jiru” is one of them. Once upon a time, whales caught in western Japan were salted and transported to Niigata by Kitamae-bune.Whale fat is high in unsaturated fatty acids, which are considered to be good for health. In Niigata, whale fat was eaten as a stamina food, especially during the hot midsummer season.
431ddd1f05de93fd.zh: 「鯨汁」是以鹽漬鯨魚脂肪和蔬菜用味噌燉煮而成的鄉土料理。受北前船影響，各地的文化在新潟扎根，「鯨汁」就是其中之一。過去在西日本捕獲的鯨魚會經鹽漬，再由北前船運到新潟。鯨魚脂肪富含被認為有益健康的不飽和脂肪酸。在新潟，鯨魚脂肪被當作補充體力的食物，特別在炎熱的盛夏時節食用。

432036fd9201d729.en: Nagano Olympic Memorial Arena (長野市オリンピック記念アリーナ, Nagano-shi Orinpikku Kinen Ari-na), or M-Wave (エムウェーブ, emu-ue-bu), is a covered speed skating oval in the city of Nagano, Japan. M-Wave, which opened in November, 1996, was constructed for the speed skating events at the 1998 Winter Olympics. It was Japan's first International Skating Union (ISU) standard indoor 400m double-track, and only second indoor track speed skating in Japan. The other, Meiji Hokkaido-Tokachi Oval, is located in Obihiro, Hokkaido.
432036fd9201d729.zh: 長野市奧林匹克紀念體育館，又稱エムウェーブ（M-Wave），是位於日本長野市的室內競速滑冰場。エムウェーブ於1996年11月啟用，為1998年冬季奧運競速滑冰項目而建，是日本第一座符合國際滑冰總會（ISU）標準的室內400公尺雙道滑冰場，也是日本第二座室內競速滑冰場。另一座是位於北海道帶廣的明治北海道十勝Oval。

43270934fd16ab24.en: Alpas (Japanese: アルパス) is a group of sports facilities in Kazuno, Akita, Japan. Full-scale alpine, jumping ski, cross-country skiing  and Nordic combined competitions can be held in one place.
43270934fd16ab24.zh: アルパス是位於日本秋田縣鹿角市的運動設施群。可在同一地點舉辦正式規模的高山滑雪、跳台滑雪、越野滑雪及北歐兩項比賽。

433973c58633e4c7.en: Mount Kasagi (笠置山, Kasagi-yama) is a 289-meter mountain located in the town of Kasagi, Soraku District, Kyoto Prefecture in the Kansai area of Japan. The mountain is known for its many oddly shaped rocks and as a battlefield during the wars of the Kenmu Restoration at the end of the Kamakura period. The mountain has been protected from 1932 as a nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty and National Historic Site. The mountain is also located within the borders of the Kasagiyama Prefectural Natural Park.
433973c58633e4c7.zh: 笠置山是位於日本關西地區京都府相樂郡笠置町的一座山，海拔289公尺。此山以眾多形狀奇特的岩石聞名，也是鎌倉時代末期建武新政相關戰爭的戰場。此山自1932年起被指定為國家名勝及國家史跡而受到保護，並位於笠置山府立自然公園範圍內。

43469f78495351c4.en: Kabashima (樺島), also known as Kabajima, is a small Japanese island off the southern coast of Nagasaki Prefecture on the Kyushu island.
43469f78495351c4.zh: 樺島，又讀作Kabajima，是位於九州長崎縣南部海岸外的日本小島。

438f1fc88eca5391.en: In the Kansai region, chicken that is eaten is called "Kashiwa." The guardian deity of Tenjin is a cow, so chicken sukiyaki (hot pot) was eaten during the autumn festivals at Tenmangu Shrine. The name Kashiwa is said to come from the reddish-brown feathers of the chicken that resembles Kashiwa (oak tree) leaves. To revive the flavor of the "Yamato no Kashiwa" chicken, which was famous before the war for its "high-quality meat," "Yamato Nikudori" chicken was bred in the prefecture through trial and error.
438f1fc88eca5391.zh: 在關西地區，食用的雞肉稱為「かしわ」。由於天神的守護神獸是牛，因此在天滿宮的秋祭期間會吃雞肉壽喜燒（火鍋）。據說「かしわ」這個名稱，來自雞的紅褐色羽毛與柏樹（槲樹）葉相似。為了重現戰前以「肉質優良」聞名的「大和のかしわ」雞的風味，縣內經過反覆嘗試，培育出「大和肉鶏」。

43ad928e807a890b.en: Fukuoka's Hakata area has a history of serving fresh seafood. Due to its delicate nature, mackerel was not commonly eaten raw nationwide, but in Hakata, it has been enjoyed as sashimi for a long time. One well-known local dish featuring raw mackerel is "Hakata Sesame Mackerel." It consists of thinly sliced mackerel sashimi, mixed with soy sauce, toasted sesame seeds, and mirin (a sweet rice wine). Grated ginger, wasabi, and shredded seaweed might be added as condiments.
43ad928e807a890b.zh: 福岡的博多地區素有供應新鮮海產的歷史。鯖魚因容易腐壞，在全國各地並不常生食，但在博多，人們長久以來都以生魚片的方式食用。以生鯖魚製作的知名鄉土料理之一是「博多の胡麻鯖」。做法是將切成薄片的鯖魚生魚片，拌入醬油、炒過的芝麻與味醂（一種帶甜味的米酒）。可依喜好加入薑泥、山葵及海苔絲作為佐料。

4402e5f3bdb92a2d.en: Sakaigawa Dam (境川ダム, Sakaigawa damu) is a dam in Nanto, Toyama Prefecture and Shirakawa, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It is named for the Sakaigawa River (a tributary of the Shō River), upon which it is built. The dam has an associated 27 MW hydroelectric power station about 2.9 km (1.8 mi) downstream. It was commissioned in June 1993.
4402e5f3bdb92a2d.zh: 境川ダム是位於日本富山縣南砺市與岐阜縣白川村的水壩，名稱取自其所在的境川（庄川支流）。水壩下游約2.9公里（1.8英里）處設有一座附屬的27百萬瓦水力發電廠，於1993年6月啟用。

440f02f40c00045d.en: The Saji Observatory is located in Saji, Tottori, Japan. Distance from rotation axis and height above equatorial plane (in Earth radii): 0.81671 +0.57522. Longitude (degrees East): 134.1222
440f02f40c00045d.zh: 鳥取市さじアストロパーク（佐治天文台）位於日本鳥取縣鳥取市佐治。與自轉軸的距離及赤道面以上的高度（以地球半徑計）：0.81671 +0.57522。經度（東經度數）：134.1222

44277926b40b914e.en: Chicken and vegetables are mixed with a special sauce and stir-fried, although the seasoning varies from region to region and from household to household.It is said that it was first made around 1950, imitating Genghis Khan, which was eaten in some regions of Gifu Prefecture.
44277926b40b914e.zh: 將雞肉與蔬菜拌上特製醬汁後拌炒，不過調味依地區和家庭而有所不同。據說最早約於1950年前後，模仿岐阜縣部分地區食用的成吉思汗烤肉而製成。

443642ca00ad36d6.en: Ikameshi is a famous local dish of the Hakodate and Oshima regions. It is said that ikameshi was originally invented as a boxed lunch at Mori Station on the Hakodate Main Line during World War II, when rice was in short supply due to food control measures.
443642ca00ad36d6.zh: いかめし是函館與渡島地區著名的鄉土料理。據說いかめし最初是在第二次世界大戰期間，因糧食管制導致米糧短缺時，於函館本線森站作為便當而發明的。

44397e399a3b2886.en: Mount Himekami (Japanese: 姫神山, Himekami-san) is a mountain in Morioka, Iwate Prefecture, Japan. It lends its name to the band Himekami.
44397e399a3b2886.zh: 姫神山是位於日本岩手縣盛岡市的山。樂團「姫神」即以此山命名。

4456360c0c8a851f.en: The Aichi Prefecture Gokoku Shrine is a Shinto shrine located in the Sannomaru compound, next to Nagoya Castle, in central Nagoya, Japan.
4456360c0c8a851f.zh: 愛知縣護國神社是位於日本名古屋市中心、名古屋城旁三之丸區域的神社。

445717b56d81414a.en: Asamushi-Natsudomari Prefectural Natural Park (浅虫夏泊県立自然公園, Asamushi-Natsudomari kenritsu shizen-kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park on the north coast of Aomori Prefecture, Japan, overlooking Mutsu Bay. Established in 1953, the park spans the borders of the municipalities of Aomori and Hiranai. It encompasses Asamushi Onsen and the coastline of the Natsudomari Peninsula (夏泊半島).
445717b56d81414a.zh: 淺蟲夏泊縣立自然公園是位於日本青森縣北岸、面向陸奧灣的縣立自然公園。設立於1953年，範圍橫跨青森市與平內町，涵蓋淺蟲溫泉及夏泊半島的海岸線。

445d1066af01cad4.en: The Nanbu region of Aomori has a very cold climate and has experienced many famines which is why the region has a culture of eating millets. The word "Jyune" refers to egoma (perilla) and "Jyune-mochi" is eaten with a paste made with roasted perilla seeds which are grinded and mixed with miso and sugar. "Kannakake-imo" powder is a powder made from dried white potatoes with the starch removed.
445d1066af01cad4.zh: 青森的南部地區氣候非常寒冷，歷經多次饑荒，因此當地有食用雜糧的文化。「じゅね」指的是荏胡麻（紫蘇籽），「じゅね餅」是搭配將烘烤過的荏胡麻籽磨碎、拌入味噌與砂糖製成的醬料食用。「かんなかけ芋」粉是用去除澱粉後乾燥的白色馬鈴薯製成的粉。

445df170d648eb9f.en: Tatebayashi Castle (館林城, Tatebayashi-jō) is a Japanese castle located in Tatebayashi, southern Gunma Prefecture, Japan. At the end of the Edo period, Tatebayashi Castle was home to the Akimoto clan, daimyō of Tatebayashi Domain, but the castle was ruled by a large number of different clans over its history. The castle was also known as "Obiki-jō" (尾曳城).
445df170d648eb9f.zh: 館林城是位於日本群馬縣南部館林市的日本城郭。江戶時代末期，館林城為館林藩大名秋元氏的居城，但在其歷史中曾由許多不同的氏族統治。此城又稱「尾曳城」。

448223a9120dcd82.en: The Mount Shura Site (首羅山遺跡, Shurasan iseki) is the ruins of a medieval Buddhist temple located in town of Hisayama, Fukuoka Prefecture on the island of Kyushu, Japan.  The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 2013.
448223a9120dcd82.zh: 首羅山遺跡是位於日本九州福岡縣久山町的中世佛教寺院遺址，於2013年被指定為日本國家史跡。

4482e28dbdf9ee20.en: "Anbin" is a local specialty in Kyonan area. It is made by kneading a dough of sweet potato flour, wheat flour, and diced sweet potatoes with boiling water, wrapping it around sweet red bean paste, flattening it, and then steaming it. The name "Anbin" comes from the process of strongly pounding it (in Japanese, Slapping is “Binta") after putting in the sweet red bean paste.
4482e28dbdf9ee20.zh: 「あんびん」是鋸南地區的地方名產。做法是將甘藷粉、麵粉和切丁的甘藷以熱水揉成麵團，包入紅豆餡後壓扁蒸熟。「あんびん」的名稱來自放入紅豆餡後用力拍打的步驟（日文中拍打稱為「ビンタ」）。

448f70d0e8c6761e.en: The Kamagaya Great Buddha (鎌ヶ谷大仏, Kamagaya Daibutsu) is the smallest Daibutsu (Buddhist statue) in Japan. It is located in the city of Kamagaya, Chiba Prefecture, to the north of Tokyo.
448f70d0e8c6761e.zh: 鎌ヶ谷大仏（鎌ヶ谷大仏，Kamagaya Daibutsu）是日本最小的大佛（佛像），位於東京北方的千葉縣鎌谷市。

449cf8e764f0b4d6.en: Hokkaido herring occupied a major position among the goods carried by the Kitamae-bune (northern-bound ships) because it did not last long in its raw state. In the days when refrigeration technology was not yet developed, herring was removed from its entrails and head, dried, and processed into fertilizer, fish oil, and other products before being transported to various regions on the Kitamae-bune.
449cf8e764f0b4d6.zh: 北海道的鯡魚生鮮狀態下無法久放，在北前船（北行船）運送的貨物中占有重要地位。在冷藏技術尚未發達的年代，鯡魚去除內臟和頭部後曬乾，加工成肥料、魚油等產品，再由北前船運往各地。

44a3bb4d4d842921.en: In Japanese mythology, Yomotsu Hirasaka (黄泉比良坂 or 黄泉平坂) is a slope or boundary between the world of the dead (Yomi) and the world of the living.
44a3bb4d4d842921.zh: 在日本神話中，黄泉比良坂（又作黄泉平坂）是死者世界（黃泉）與生者世界之間的坡道或交界。

44ab880c8f292c02.en: Matsutake mushroom production thrives in the Nantan region's city of Nantan and the cities of Ayabe and Fukuchiyama in the Chutan region. These regions market their mushrooms as "Tamba matsutake," known for their fragrant aroma and elastic texture. The scent is particularly prized, and it's often said that a car filled with freshly harvested Tamba matsutake will be permeated with its rich fragrance.
44ab880c8f292c02.zh: 南丹地區的南丹市，以及中丹地區的綾部市、福知山市松茸生產興盛。這些地區以「丹波松茸」之名銷售，以香氣濃郁、口感富彈性聞名。其香氣特別受重視，常有人說，載滿剛採收丹波松茸的車子，車內會充滿濃郁的香氣。

44b41e5db16792ae.en: In Kyoto, where underground water flows, vegetables have been cultivated in various parts of the city since ancient times. As a result, a culture of pickles using vegetables has developed. Shibazuke" is one of Kyoto's representative pickles, and along with "sukkizuke" and "senmaizuke," is regarded as one of the three most popular pickles in Kyoto. Shibazuke is made by pickling eggplant, cucumber, myoga, etc. in salt with shiso leaves.
44b41e5db16792ae.zh: 京都地下水豐沛，自古便在市內各地栽培蔬菜，因而發展出以蔬菜製作醃菜的文化。「しば漬け」是京都代表性的醃菜之一，與「すぐき漬け」、「千枚漬け」並列為京都三大醃菜。しば漬け是將茄子、小黃瓜、茗荷等與紫蘇葉一起以鹽醃漬而成。

44cc354a4c0f706e.en: Kitashōji Falls (北精進ケ滝, Kitashōji-ga-taki) is a waterfall in northern Yamanashi Prefecture Japan, on the Ishiutoro River, an upper tributary of the Fuji River. It is located in the Minami Alps National Park, in the city of Hokuto. The falls have a width of 35 metres (115 ft) and a drop of 121 metres (397 ft).
44cc354a4c0f706e.zh: 北精進ケ滝是位於日本山梨縣北部的瀑布，位在富士川上游支流石空川上，屬於南アルプス國立公園，所在地為北杜市。瀑布寬35公尺（115英尺），落差121公尺（397英尺）。

44d8d7f959f70710.en: A local dish from the Tsukui area of Sagamihara City in which udon noodles are simmered directly in a vegetable soup. Even within a region, there are distinctive flavors depending on the area, such as miso flavor, soy sauce flavor, or both.
44d8d7f959f70710.zh: 相模原市津久井地區的鄉土料理，將烏龍麵直接放入蔬菜湯中燉煮。即使在同一地區內，也依區域而有味噌口味、醬油口味或兩者兼具等不同風味。

45030389f47fcb1d.en: The Kaigarayama shell midden (貝殻山貝塚, Kaigarayama kaizuka) is an archaeological site containing the ruins of a large-scale Yayoi period settlement with an associated shell midden located in what is now part of the city of Kiyosu, Aichi in the Tōkai region of Japan.  The shell midden was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1971.
45030389f47fcb1d.zh: 貝殼山貝塚是位於今日本東海地方愛知縣清須市一帶的考古遺址，包含大規模彌生時代聚落遺跡及相關貝塚。此貝塚於1971年被指定為日本國家史跡。

45074f10d7233087.en: The Yanagi Palace (柳之御所, Yanagi-no-gosho) was the late Heian period palace complex of the Northern Fujiwara clan, the rulers of Hiraizumi,  in what is now southern Iwate Prefecture, Japan. It is protected by the central government as a National Historic Site.
45074f10d7233087.zh: 柳之御所是平安時代後期統治平泉的奧州藤原氏的宮殿建築群，位於今日本岩手縣南部。受中央政府保護，列為國家史跡。

4510d0a1bf44dd44.en: Nobeoka City, located in the northeastern part of Miyazaki Prefecture and facing the Sea of Hyuga to the east with five rivers flowing through it, is rich in nature and has a popular snack called "Futatabi Dango" among the locals.The process begins with mixing glutinous rice flour and wheat flour in the ratio of 6 to 4, adding water, and kneading until the mixture is as soft as earlobes. The key to making "futatabi dango" lies in this process, which is also the origin of its name.
4510d0a1bf44dd44.zh: 延岡市位於宮崎縣東北部，東臨日向灘，有五條河川流經，自然資源豐富，當地有一種受居民喜愛的點心「ふたたびだんご」。製作時先將糯米粉與麵粉以6比4的比例混合，加水揉至如耳垂般柔軟。製作「ふたたびだんご」的關鍵就在這道工序，這也是其名稱的由來。

451cbe7ec27fc177.en: Tsuburo Dam is a concrete gravity dam located in Nara prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for agriculture and water supply. The catchment area of the dam is 38.8 km2. The dam impounds about 150  ha of land when full and can store 25650 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1952 and completed in 1962.
451cbe7ec27fc177.zh: 津風呂水壩是位於日本奈良縣的混凝土重力壩，用於農業及供水。集水面積為38.8平方公里，滿水時淹沒面積約150公頃，蓄水量為25650千立方公尺。水壩於1952年動工，1962年完工。

45266a1e317b66ba.en: Nanshū-ji (南宗寺) is a Buddhist temple in the Sakai ward of the city of Sakai, Osaka Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Daitoku-ji-branch of the Rinzai school of Japanese Zen. Its main image is a Shaka Sanzon. Its Japanese garden, laid out by Furuta Oribe in 1619, is designated a National Place of Scenic Beauty. The temple is the bodaiji of the Miyoshi clan and for many schools of the Japanese tea ceremony.
