45266a1e317b66ba.zh: 南宗寺是位於日本大阪府堺市堺區的佛寺，屬日本禪宗臨濟宗大德寺派。本尊為釋迦三尊。寺內的日本庭園由古田織部於1619年規劃，被指定為國家名勝。本寺為三好氏的菩提寺，也是多個日本茶道流派的菩提寺。

454058548bf04fdb.en: Ryukyu Mura (Japanese: 琉球村, Hepburn: Ryūkyū Mura; lit. 'Ryukyu Village') is a theme park and folk museum in Onna, Okinawa Prefecture, Japan. It is an open-air museum featuring ten traditional Ryukyuan residences brought over from different parts of the prefecture, seven of which are Nationally Registered Tangible Cultural Properties. It is also a living museum where visitors may partake in Ryukyuan cultural activities led by staff, who are dressed in traditional Ryukyuan attire.
454058548bf04fdb.zh: 琉球村（日語：琉球村，平文式羅馬字：Ryūkyū Mura）是位於日本沖繩縣恩納村的主題樂園兼民俗博物館。此為露天博物館，展示從縣內各地遷建而來的十棟傳統琉球民宅，其中七棟為國家登錄有形文化財。這裡也是一座生活博物館，遊客可參加由身穿琉球傳統服裝的工作人員帶領的琉球文化體驗活動。

4561eac3add386a0.en: Tottori Prefectural Museum of Art (鳥取県立美術館, Tottori Kenritsu Bijutsukan) is scheduled to open in Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture, Japan, on 30 March 2025. Located adjacent to Ōmidō temple ruins, the new museum's artworks are to be transferred from the collection of Tottori Prefectural Museum.
4561eac3add386a0.zh: 鳥取県立美術館預定於2025年3月30日在日本鳥取縣倉吉市開館。新美術館鄰近大御堂廢寺遺跡，館內藝術品將由鳥取縣立博物館的收藏移轉而來。

456c053e12c334e7.en: "Gomafugu" are caught in the Sea of Japan from June to July. The ovaries are salted for two years or more, and then aged for a long time in Sado's sake lees to make "Fugunoko-kasuzuke." In Niigata Prefecture, it is unique to Sado, and similar processed products exist in Ishikawa and Fukui prefectures. It is said to have been made on Sado Island since the Edo period.Fugu processing requires a special license, a Fugu Chef's License.
456c053e12c334e7.zh: 「胡麻河豚」於6月至7月在日本海捕獲。將其卵巢鹽漬兩年以上，再以佐渡的酒粕長期熟成，製成「ふぐの子の粕漬け」。在新潟縣內為佐渡獨有，石川縣和福井縣也有類似的加工品。據說佐渡島自江戶時代就開始製作。河豚加工需要特別執照，即河豚料理師執照。

4578ab6bfb07c5f1.en: “Ikasumi-jiru(Squid ink soup)” is a jet-black soup made with squid ink. Bigfin reef squid, also known as white squid, lean pork, and nigana (a type of flowering daisy), called "njana", are simmered and squid ink is added at the end. It is a unique local dish that turns your mouth black when you eat it as if you had blackened your teeth.
4578ab6bfb07c5f1.zh: イカスミ汁（墨魚汁）是以墨魚墨汁製作的漆黑湯品。將又稱白烏賊的萊氏擬烏賊、豬瘦肉，以及稱為「ンジャナ」的苦菜（一種菊科開花植物）一起燉煮，最後加入墨汁。這是一道獨特的鄉土料理，吃了以後嘴巴會變黑，就像把牙齒染黑一樣。

458135b943aacdce.en: In a time when rice was in short supply, various dishes were devised to supplement rice. In addition to using wheat as a staple food, such as using wheat to make “okirikomi,” various ingredients were added to rice to make it bulkier and more filling. Katemeshi was originally one of those thought-up dishes. It refers to rice mixed with filling ingredients such as barley, beans, radish, and seaweed. Kate refers to ingredients that are added to rice to increase the volume of the rice.
458135b943aacdce.zh: 在米糧短缺的年代，人們想出了各種補充米飯的料理。除了以小麥作為主食，例如用小麥製作「おきりこみ」之外，也會在米飯中加入各種食材，使分量增加、更有飽足感。かて飯原本就是這類料理之一，指的是在米飯中混入大麥、豆類、蘿蔔、海藻等增加分量的食材。「かて」指的是為了增加米飯分量而加入的食材。

45831062ec1ec753.en: "Hatoshi" is a dish introduced to Nagasaki from Qing (then China) during the Meiji period. The Chinese term "Hatoshi" is pronounced as "há duō shì." It refers to a dish where shrimp paste is sandwiched between slices of bread, then deep-fried. Initially, it was one of the dishes served around a round table, belonging to the cuisine known as shippoku ryouri.Nowadays, it has become one of the familiar dishes to the public, to the extent that it is sold on the streets and in shops.
45831062ec1ec753.zh: 「ハトシ」是明治時期從清朝（當時的中國）傳入長崎的料理。「ハトシ」的中文讀音為「há duō shì」，是將蝦泥夾在麵包片之間後油炸的料理。最初是名為卓袱料理的菜色之一，圍著圓桌享用。如今已成為一般民眾熟悉的料理，街頭和店鋪都有販售。

458655f512cf2030.en: Wakasa Jinja (若桜神社) is a Shinto shrine in Wakasa, Tottori Prefecture, Japan. The main festival is held in May.
458655f512cf2030.zh: 若櫻神社是位於日本鳥取縣若櫻町的神社，例大祭於5月舉行。

45a7e69f7ed13d46.en: The Kobe Golf Club (神戸ゴルフ倶楽部, Kōbe Golf Club) is Japan's first golf course, built on Mount Rokko in 1903 by English expatriate Arthur Hasketh Groom. The club began as a nine-hole course on May 24, 1903, but quickly expanded to eighteen the following year.
45a7e69f7ed13d46.zh: 神戶高爾夫俱樂部是日本第一座高爾夫球場，由英國僑民Arthur Hasketh Groom於1903年建於六甲山。俱樂部於1903年5月24日以九洞球場起步，隔年即擴建為十八洞。

45c595b093640c64.en: "Furai" in the northern Saitama region, including Gyoda City, is not a fried dish but rather a grilled one. It involves cooking a batter made of wheat flour and water, then adding vegetables, meat, and other ingredients. It is a dish similar to okonomiyaki or crepes. Originally, "Furai" was a simple snack made by farmers. The dish gained popularity, especially in the early Showa period, among female workers at sock factories in Gyoda, where it was easy to make, affordable, portable, and filling.
45c595b093640c64.zh: 行田市等埼玉縣北部地區的「フライ」並非油炸料理，而是煎烤料理。做法是將麵粉與水調成麵糊下鍋煎，再加入蔬菜、肉類等配料，類似大阪燒或可麗餅。「フライ」原本是農家製作的簡單點心，昭和初期在行田的足袋工廠女工之間特別受歡迎，因為容易製作、價格便宜、方便攜帶又有飽足感。

45db3b9002d95d9f.en: Kogane Shrine (金神社, Kogane Jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in the city of Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. Claimed to have been first built in 135, it has long been considered a place to pray for financial blessings. Because it is located near the city center, approximately 150,000 worshippers visit the shrine over the three-day New Year's period. On April 5, the shrine hosts the Gifu Festival with Inaba Shrine and Kashimori Shrine. The nearby Kogane Hall can be used as a communications place for the citizens of the city.
45db3b9002d95d9f.zh: 金神社是位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市的神社。據稱創建於135年，長久以來被視為祈求財運的場所。由於鄰近市中心，新年三天期間約有15萬名參拜者造訪。每年4月5日，本神社與伊奈波神社、加納天滿宮共同舉辦岐阜祭。附近的金會館可作為市民交流的場所。

45db69f9f4e30d7f.en: In Fukui Prefecture, Buddhism, especially Jodo Shinshu, has long been a fervent religion, and from around the anniversary of the founder Shinran Shonin's death (November 28th of the lunar calendar, January 16th of the new calendar) through the New Year, Hoonko, the largest annual event of the Jodo Shinshu sect, is held in various places. In Fukui Prefecture, it is called "Honkosan" or "Oko-sama. It is meant to honor Shinran's teachings and to express gratitude for his virtues. Hoonkosan can be held at temples, homes, or community halls.
45db69f9f4e30d7f.zh: 福井縣自古佛教信仰虔誠，尤其是淨土真宗。從開祖親鸞聖人的忌日（農曆11月28日，國曆1月16日）前後到新年期間，各地會舉行淨土真宗年度最大的活動「報恩講」。在福井縣稱為「ほんこさん」或「お講様」，旨在尊崇親鸞的教誨，並感念其德行。ほんこさん可在寺院、住家或社區會館舉行。

45e8440e0492997d.en: The Institute for Nature Study (国立科学博物館附属自然教育園, Kokuritsu Kagaku Hakubutsukan fuzoku Shizen Kyōiku-en) is a Japanese nature preserve park associated with the National Museum of Nature and Science, located in the Shirokanedai neighborhood of Minato, Tokyo, extending into the Kamiōsaki neighborhood of Shinagawa, Tokyo.  It is a Natural Monument and a National Historic Site of Japan.
45e8440e0492997d.zh: 国立科学博物館附属自然教育園（国立科学博物館附属自然教育園）是隸屬國立科學博物館的自然保護園區，位於東京都港區白金台，並延伸至東京都品川區上大崎。為日本的天然紀念物及國家史跡。

45f8a923b816d612.en: The Naha Great Tug-of-War Festival (那覇大綱挽まつり, Naha Dai Tsunahiki Matsuri) is an annual event held in Naha, Okinawa Prefecture, Japan. Its roots may be traced back to the 15th century. Held on Route 58, it is a battle between the East and West teams.
45f8a923b816d612.zh: 那覇大綱挽まつり是每年在日本沖繩縣那霸市舉行的活動。其起源可追溯至15世紀。活動在58號國道上舉行，由東、西兩隊對抗。

45fd0b74b6e4b2b4.en: Kotjitsunomata, which is the origin of "Kaisou," is a seaweed about 20 cm in height that adheres to rocks in the intertidal zone. It grows in a regular pattern, branching out in two halves. It is said that its name comes from the shape of its branches, which resemble the strings of a koto (Japanese zither). The seaweed is thickened when heated and coagulates when cooled, and was used as a soap and adhesive in the olden days.
45fd0b74b6e4b2b4.zh: 「かいそう」的原料「コトジツノマタ」是附著在潮間帶岩石上、高約20公分的海藻，以一分為二的規則方式分枝生長。據說其名稱來自分枝形狀像箏（日本古箏）的弦。這種海藻加熱後會變得濃稠，冷卻後則會凝固，從前曾被用作肥皂和黏著劑。

46007f6fd0c0edd9.en: The Bon-odori, a Japanese dance which is part of the Obon Festival, is widely enjoyed by the people in Tottori during the summer. There are various bon-dances throughout Japan, and the dances in Tottori can be categorized as Kasa-odori (a dance with a paper umbrellas) and te-odori (hand dance).
46007f6fd0c0edd9.zh: 盆踊是盂蘭盆節的一部分，為日本的一種舞蹈，夏季在鳥取廣受民眾喜愛。日本各地有各式各樣的盆踊，鳥取的舞蹈可分為傘踊（持紙傘跳的舞）與手踊（以手部動作為主的舞）。

461a1718c0b0392f.en: Tōgan-ji (桃巌寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Sōtō Zen sect located in Nagoya, central Japan. In 16th Century Toganji Temple has a Shiva-Lingam from 16th century.
461a1718c0b0392f.zh: 桃巌寺是位於日本中部名古屋的曹洞宗佛寺。寺內有一座16世紀的濕婆林伽。

4621bdf0a0102d09.en: Megami Lake (Japanese: 女神湖, Hepburn: Megami-ko) is a lake located in Tateshina, Nagano Prefecture. An artificial lake constructed for agricultural purposes, it is also known as Akanuma Reservoir. A development to make it into a resort site is also underway. It is in Yatsugatake-Chūshin Kōgen Quasi-National Park.
4621bdf0a0102d09.zh: 女神湖是位於長野縣蓼科的湖泊。這是為農業用途而建的人工湖，也稱為赤沼貯水池。目前也正進行將其開發為度假地的計畫。女神湖位於八ヶ岳中信高原國定公園內。

462d40456bd18f96.en: "Ego" is a dish made from "Egokusa" seaweed boiled to dissolve, then set in rectangular shape. It’s like Kanten (=agar-agar) or jelly, and eaten with mustard soy sauce. This is a local dish mainly eaten in the Sea of Japan side, and it is said that it was brought to Fukushima as an appetizer with sake from Niigata in the late Edo Era, and it was prevailed because the place was "shukuba" (post station). Now it is eaten not only in Nishi Aizu, but also in the river basins of the Aga River and the Tadami River.
462d40456bd18f96.zh: 「えご」是將「えご草」海藻煮至溶化後，凝固成長方形的料理。口感類似寒天或果凍，沾芥末醬油食用。這是主要在日本海側食用的鄉土料理，據說在江戶時代後期作為下酒菜從新潟傳入福島，由於當地是「宿場」（驛站）而普及開來。現在不只在西會津，阿賀川與只見川流域也有食用。

46363c65ee4e2b13.en: Ashino Chishōgun Prefectural Natural Park (芦野池沼群県立自然公園, Ashino Chishōgun kenritsu shizen-kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park on the Tsugaru Peninsula in northwest Aomori Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1958, the park spans the borders of the municipalities of Goshogawara and Nakadomari. It encompasses Lake Ashino (芦野湖) and Ashino Park, which is planted with 2,300 cherry trees.
46363c65ee4e2b13.zh: 芦野池沼群縣立自然公園（芦野池沼群県立自然公園）是位於日本青森縣西北部津輕半島的縣立自然公園。公園設立於 1958 年，橫跨五所川原市與中泊町。園區範圍包括芦野湖，以及種植了 2,300 棵櫻花樹的芦野公園。

4637cac62e8b2c60.en: The Sasebo Zoological Park and Botanical Garden (西海国立公園九十九島動植物園, Saikai Kokuritsu Kōen Kujūkushima Dōshokubutsuen) is a zoo and botanical garden located at 2172, Funakoshi-cho, Sasebo, Nagasaki, Japan. It is open daily; an admission fee is charged.
4637cac62e8b2c60.zh: 西海国立公園九十九島動植物園是一座動物園兼植物園，位於日本長崎縣佐世保市船越町2172。每日開放，需付費入園。

4653e3f0bff5b1be.en: Nisseki-ji (日石寺) is a Buddhist temple in the town of Kamiichi, Toyama Prefecture, Japan. The temple belongs to the Shingon sect of Japanese Buddhism. It is more popularly known by the name of Ōiwa Fudō (大岩不動) after its main image.
4653e3f0bff5b1be.zh: 日石寺是位於日本富山縣上市町的佛教寺院，屬日本佛教真言宗。因其本尊而更廣為人知的名稱為大岩不動。

46653b65d3998f4e.en: Seson-ji (世尊寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Hiso neighborhood of the town of Ōyodo, Nara Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the  Sōtō school of Japanese Zen and its honzon is a statue of Amida Nyorai. Founded by Prince Shōtoku, it is 7th of the Historical Sites of Prince Shōtoku and the temple precincts have been designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1927.
46653b65d3998f4e.zh: 世尊寺是位於日本奈良縣大淀町比曾的佛教寺院，屬於日本禪宗曹洞宗，本尊為阿彌陀如來像。該寺由聖德太子創建，為聖德太子遺跡第七號，寺域於1927年被指定為日本國家史跡。

466a80c60b988576.en: The Hiroshima City Ebayama Museum of Meteorology (広島市江波山気象館, Hiroshima-shi Ebayama Kishōkan) was the first museum of meteorology in Japan. It is located in Ebayama Park in the city of Hiroshima, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan.
466a80c60b988576.zh: 廣島市江波山氣象館（広島市江波山気象館）是日本第一座氣象博物館，位於日本廣島縣廣島市的江波山公園內。

4675cd80357384f1.en: Watazumi Shrine, also known as Watatsumi Shrine, is a Shinto shrine in Tsushima, Nagasaki.
4675cd80357384f1.zh: 和多都美神社（又讀作Watatsumi）是位於長崎縣對馬市的神社。

467666926899f342.en: In the Tohoku region, where the weather is severely cold, there has long been a custom of making preserved foods by exposing vegetables and fish to the cold wind. "Heso-Daikon" is one such preserved food, produced in Marumori Town in the southern part of the prefecture.
467666926899f342.zh: 在氣候嚴寒的東北地區，自古就有將蔬菜和魚吹寒風製成保存食品的習俗。「へそ大根」就是其中一種保存食品，產於縣內南部的丸森町。

469b63ae13505fb7.en: Dako-jiru" is a soup made by kneading wheat flour (rice flour) with water, letting it sit for a while, then spreading it by hand and filling it with dumplings, and adding seasonal vegetables such as taro and burdock root, and eating it with miso or soy sauce. It is easy to make, nutritious, and filling, so it has long been eaten between farm chores. Dago" means "dango" in the Kumamoto dialect and is also called dango soup. It is eaten throughout Kyushu, but in Kumamoto, sweet potatoes are used for dango in many areas.
469b63ae13505fb7.zh: だご汁是將小麥粉（米粉）加水揉合，靜置一段時間後用手延展成糰子放入湯中，再加入芋頭、牛蒡等當季蔬菜，以味噌或醬油調味食用的湯品。做法簡單、營養豐富又有飽足感，因此自古以來就在農忙之間食用。「だご」在熊本方言中是「糰子」的意思，也稱為糰子湯。九州各地都有食用，但在熊本，許多地區會用番薯來做糰子。

46b18f363dba3476.en: The Saga Arashiyama Museum of Arts and Culture (SAMAC; formerly known as Shigureden (時雨殿)) is a museum in Arashiyama, Kyoto, Japan, centered on the Ogura Hyakunin Isshu anthology of waka poems compiled by Fujiwara no Teika in the 13th century. The museum was founded by former Nintendo president Hiroshi Yamauchi, who invested more than $20 million in the facility. Shigureden's Autumn Shower Palace hall was designed by Nintendo game producer Shigeru Miyamoto.
46b18f363dba3476.zh: 嵯峨嵐山文華館（SAMAC，舊稱時雨殿）是位於日本京都嵐山的博物館，以藤原定家於13世紀編選的和歌集《小倉百人一首》為主題。博物館由任天堂前社長山內溥創立，他為此設施投入超過2,000萬美元。時雨殿的「秋時雨殿」展廳由任天堂遊戲製作人宮本茂設計。

46d53cf23fb4aa99.en: Miyagi prefecture is rich in fishing grounds, with fishing ports in Kesennuma, Ishinomaki, Shiogama, and Yuriage, and large amounts of fish such as flounder, sea bass, and sea bream have been caught there since the middle of the Meiji period. In those days, when transportation was not as developed as it is today, "Grilled Kamaboko" emerged as a method for preservation.
46d53cf23fb4aa99.zh: 宮城縣漁場豐富，設有氣仙沼、石卷、鹽竈、閖上等漁港，自明治中期起便捕獲大量比目魚、鱸魚、鯛魚等魚類。在交通不如今日發達的當時，「烤魚板」作為一種保存方法應運而生。

46db93a5dd1108f0.ja: グランモール（英称：GRAND MALL）は、福岡県遠賀郡水巻町にあるショッピングモール。
46db93a5dd1108f0.zh: グランモール（英文名稱：GRAND MALL）是位於福岡縣遠賀郡水卷町的購物中心。

46f869634fa64eca.en: Yōrō Falls (養老の滝, Yōrō no Taki) is a waterfall in Yōrō Park located in the town of Yōrō, Yōrō District, Gifu, Japan.
46f869634fa64eca.zh: 養老の滝是位於日本岐阜縣養老郡養老町養老公園內的瀑布。

470b1b5f1a1a49c0.en: Ikari Dam is a gravity dam located in Tochigi prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for flood control and power production. The catchment area of the dam is 271.2 km2. The dam impounds about 310  ha of land when full and can store 55000 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1941 and completed in 1956.
470b1b5f1a1a49c0.zh: 五十里水壩（五十里ダム）是位於日本栃木縣的重力壩，用於防洪及發電。集水面積為271.2平方公里，滿水時淹沒面積約310公頃，可蓄水5,500萬立方公尺。水壩於1941年動工，1956年完工。

471477e809f13f96.en: In Hokkaido, especially in the East Hokkaido region, miso soup with crab is called "Teppo-jiru." "Teppo-jiru" has long been eaten as a fisherman's dish in the Nemuro region.
471477e809f13f96.zh: 在北海道，尤其是道東地區，加了螃蟹的味噌湯稱為「てっぽう汁」。「てっぽう汁」在根室地區自古以來就是漁夫料理。

472db15d1e97bc6e.en: Shōkoku-ji (星谷寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Iriya-nishi neighborhood of the city of  Zama, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Shingon-shū Daikaku-ha sect and its honzon is a statue of Shō-Kannon Bosatsu.  The temple's full name is Myōhō-san Jihō-in Shōkoku-ji (妙法山 持寶院  星谷寺).The temple is the 8th stop on the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route.  It is also called the "Hoshiya Kannon".
472db15d1e97bc6e.zh: 星谷寺是位於日本神奈川縣座間市入谷西的佛教寺院，屬真言宗大覺寺派，本尊為聖觀音菩薩像。寺院全名為妙法山持寶院星谷寺。本寺為坂東三十三所巡禮路線的第8番札所，又稱「星谷觀音」。

473967fa9bc58069.en: Matsukura Castle (松倉城, Matsukura-jō) was a Muromachi period yamajiro-style Japanese castle located in what is now the city of Uozu, Toyama Prefecture, in the Hokuriku region of Japan. It was one of the three major mountain-castles in Etchū Province, along with Matsuyama Castle in central Etchū and Moriyama Castle in western Etchū.
473967fa9bc58069.zh: 松倉城是室町時代的山城形式日本城郭，位於今日本北陸地區富山縣魚津市境內，與越中中部的松山城、越中西部的守山城並列為越中國三大山城。

473cf9239ad4e67f.en: Iwatsurugi Castle (岩剣城, Iwatsurugi-jō) was a medieval Japanese castle located near the city of Aira, Japan. The castle is known as the site of the first battle of Shimazu Yoshihiro and, allegedly, the first place in Japan where matchlock firearms were used in battle.
473cf9239ad4e67f.zh: 岩剣城是位於日本姶良市附近的中世日本城郭。該城以島津義弘初次上陣之地聞名，據稱也是日本最早在戰鬥中使用火繩槍的地方。

474dd7da196422aa.en: Mount Miyama (深山, Miyama) is a 790.5 m (2,594 ft)　mountain, located on the border of Nose, Osaka and Nantan, Kyoto, Japan.
474dd7da196422aa.zh: 深山是一座海拔790.5公尺（2,594英尺）的山，位於日本大阪府能勢町與京都府南丹市的交界。

475e99d3dbc2c8f9.en: Kōrankei (Japanese: 香嵐渓) is a gorge created by the Yodo River, a tributary of the Yahagi River. It is a part of Asuke Town, Toyota City, Aichi Prefecture. Kōrankei has over 4000 maple trees said to have been planted in 1634. It sits next to Aichi Kōgen Quasi-National Park, and is a popular tourist destination, famous for its autumn foliage and its Erythronium japonicum flowers.
475e99d3dbc2c8f9.zh: 香嵐溪是由矢作川支流巴川所形成的溪谷，位於愛知縣豐田市足助町。香嵐溪有4000多棵楓樹，據說種植於1634年。此地鄰接愛知高原國定公園，是熱門觀光地，以秋季紅葉及豬牙花聞名。

47ac6dc1b3fd955d.en: Morioka Hachimangū (盛岡八幡宮) is a Shinto shrine in the city of Morioka, Iwate in northern Japan. The shrine is noted for its annual festival on the second Saturday in June, which is famous for the Chagu Chagu Umakko, a horse parade which was recognized in 1978 as an Intangible Folk Cultural Property. In 1996 the sound of the bells of the Chagu Chagu Umakko was selected by the Ministry of the Environment as one of the 100 Soundscapes of Japan.
47ac6dc1b3fd955d.zh: 盛岡八幡宮是位於日本北部岩手縣盛岡市的神社。該社以每年6月第二個星期六的例祭聞名，祭典中的馬匹遊行「チャグチャグ馬コ」於1978年被認定為無形民俗文化財。1996年，チャグチャグ馬コ的鈴聲被環境省選為「日本音風景100選」之一。

47b4897dd5a851e2.en: Matsumoto City Museum of Archaeology (松本市立考古博物館, Matsumoto Shiritsu Kōko Hakubutsukan) opened in Matsumoto, Nagano Prefecture, Japan in 1986, superseding and replacing Nakayama Kōkokan, which opened in Nakayama Elementary School in 1931. The collection and displays relate to the archaeology of the area, including Jōmon pottery and a doban from the Eriana Site and Haji pottery, weapons, bronze mirrors, and glass beads from Kōbōyama Kofun.
47b4897dd5a851e2.zh: 松本市立考古博物館於1986年在日本長野縣松本市開館，取代1931年於中山小學內開設的中山考古館。館藏與展示以當地考古為主，包括繩文陶器、出自エリ穴遺跡的銅鐸，以及出自弘法山古墳的土師器、武器、銅鏡與玻璃珠。

47b51b4582500893.en: Entsū-in (円通院) is a Buddhist temple located in the town of  Matsushima, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan. Belonging to the  Myōshin-ji-branch of Rinzai Zen, it was founded in 1647 next to Zuigan-ji as the memorial temple for Date Mitsumune, the grandson of Date Masamune. The temple is noted for its rose gardens. The mausoleum of Date Mitsumune is decorated with Namban art motifs inspired by late Sengoku period contact with the West, and has been designated an Important Cultural Property. The temple also has a Japanese garden attributed to Kobori Enshū.
47b51b4582500893.zh: 円通院是位於日本宮城縣松島町的寺院，屬臨濟宗妙心寺派，1647年創建於瑞巖寺旁，為伊達政宗之孫伊達光宗的菩提寺。此寺以玫瑰園著稱。伊達光宗的靈廟飾有受戰國時代晚期與西方接觸影響的南蠻美術圖案，已獲指定為重要文化財。寺內另有一座相傳出自小堀遠州之手的日本庭園。

47be45a94307f14e.en: Vegetables grown in Kanazawa city using traditional methods are called “Kaga Yasai”. Yasai is the Japanese word for vegetable. Vegetables that can be sold under the brand name “Kaga Yasai” are those that are locally grown and have been produced since 1945 or before that. Currently, there are 15 different types of vegetables being sold under the brand name.
47be45a94307f14e.zh: 在金澤市以傳統方法栽培的蔬菜稱為「加賀野菜」。野菜是日文中蔬菜的意思。能以「加賀野菜」品牌名稱販售的蔬菜，必須是在當地栽培，且自1945年或更早以前就已生產的品種。目前共有15種蔬菜以此品牌名稱販售。

47bf55ca230cf83c.en: Higashiyoka-higata (ja:東よか干潟) is a tidal flat in Japan at the north end of the Ariake Sea, in Saga prefecture. It is designated as a protected wetland under the Ramsar Convention.
47bf55ca230cf83c.zh: 東よか干潟是位於日本佐賀縣、有明海北端的潮間帶灘地，被列為《拉姆薩公約》保護濕地。

47c42c1a67921b53.en: Omura Shrine (小村神社, Omura-jinja; often misspelled as "Komura Shrine") is a Shinto shrine in Hidaka, Takaoka District, Kōchi Prefecture, Japan.
47c42c1a67921b53.zh: 小村神社（常被誤拼為「Komura Shrine」）是位於日本高知縣高岡郡日高村的神社。

47cad01b7c7227e6.en: Fukagawa Matsuri (深川祭, Fukagawa Matsuri; formerly 深川八幡祭 Fukagawa Hachiman Matsuri) or the Fukagawa Festival, is one of the three great Shinto festivals of Tokyo, along with the Kanda Matsuri and Sannō Matsuri.
47cad01b7c7227e6.zh: 深川祭（舊稱深川八幡祭）是東京三大神道祭典之一，另外兩個是神田祭與山王祭。

47d4556c5a67601b.en: Goshogatani Kōgoishi (御所ヶ谷神籠石) was an ancient castle (also known as a Korean-style fortresses in Japan (朝鮮式山城, Chōsen-shiki yamajiro) straddling the border between the Katsuyama Okubo townships of Miyako and the Tsuzumi neighborhood of the city of Yukuhashi, Fukuoka Prefecture Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1953, with the area under protection expanded in 1998.
47d4556c5a67601b.zh: 御所ヶ谷神籠石是一座古代山城（又稱朝鮮式山城），橫跨日本福岡縣京都郡みやこ町勝山大久保與行橋市津積地區的交界。其遺跡自1953年起被列為國家史跡加以保護，1998年擴大保護範圍。

47da9e7e2c1cd56c.en: Gifu-Kakamigahara Air and Space Museum is an aviation museum located in Kakamigahara in Gifu Prefecture in Japan. It is at Gifu Air Field of the Japan Air Self-Defense Force.
47da9e7e2c1cd56c.zh: 岐阜各務原航空宇宙博物館（岐阜かかみがはら航空宇宙博物館）是位於日本岐阜縣各務原市的航空博物館，位於航空自衛隊岐阜基地。

47dbca637153bd53.en: Kami-Akasaka Castle (上赤坂城, Kami-Akasaka-jō) is a late Kamakura period Japanese castle located in the village of  Chihayaakasaka, Osaka Prefecture, Japan.  Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1934. It is also referred to as Kusunoki Castle (楠木城, Kusunoki-jō) or Kiriyama Castle (桐山城, Kiriyama-jō),
47dbca637153bd53.zh: 上赤坂城是位於日本大阪府千早赤阪村的鎌倉時代後期日本城郭。其遺址自1934年起被列為國家史跡保護，又稱楠木城或桐山城。

47e030fab58a9d12.en: Iwasaki Castle (岩崎城, Iwasaki-jō) is a hill castle (平山城 hirayamajiro) located in the city of Nisshin, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. It was built during the Sengoku period in Owari Province and was a support castle to Shobata Castle (勝幡城 Shobata-jō).
47e030fab58a9d12.zh: 岩崎城（Iwasaki-jō）是位於日本愛知縣日進市的平山城，建於戰國時代的尾張國，是勝幡城的支城。

47f13af0780fe540.en: Yamanashi Science Museum (山梨県立科学館, Yamanashi-kenritsu kagaku-kan) is a science museum located in Kōfu, Yamanashi Prefecture, Japan. The museum specializes in astronomy and technology.
47f13af0780fe540.zh: 山梨縣立科學館是位於日本山梨縣甲府市的科學博物館，以天文與科技為專門領域。

47f826886229134c.en: Mount Yoko (横岳, Yoko-dake) also known as Mount Kita Yoko, is an active lava dome located in the Northern Yatsugatake Volcanic Group of the Yatsugatake Mountains, Honshū, Japan. Mount Yoko has shown the most recent activity and is now considered an active volcano. It last erupted approximately 800 years ago. The eruption consisted of ash with a lava flow of some 3 million cubic meters. The eruption was dated by corrected radiocarbon dating. The next previous eruption was in or after 400 BCE.
47f826886229134c.zh: 北橫岳（橫岳），又稱北橫岳，是位於日本本州八岳山脈北八ヶ岳火山群的活火山熔岩穹丘。北橫岳是該火山群中最近期有活動紀錄的火山，目前被列為活火山。最近一次噴發約在800年前，噴出火山灰並伴隨約300萬立方公尺的熔岩流，噴發年代經校正後的放射性碳定年法測定。再前一次噴發發生在西元前400年或之後。

47fa0ddaeb21501f.en: Nemichi Shrine (根道神社, Nemichi jinja) is a Japanese Shinto shrine located in the city of Seki, Gifu Prefecture.  Nemichi Shrine has become famous for its koi pond, which has been compared to the Water Lilies paintings of Claude Monet.
47fa0ddaeb21501f.zh: 根道神社（根道神社）是位於岐阜縣關市的日本神社。根道神社以其錦鯉池聞名，這座池塘曾被比喻為克勞德·莫內的《睡蓮》畫作。

47fbf9a01f8b165c.en: The Tago Stele (多胡碑, Tago hi) is a Nara period stele discovered in the city of Takasaki, Gunma Prefecture, in the northern Kantō region of Japan.  The stele was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1921, and was raised in status to that of a Special National Historic Site in 1954. As one of the "Three Stelae of Kōzuke", it was submitted by Japan for inclusion into the UNESCO  Memory of the World Programme in 2017.
47fbf9a01f8b165c.zh: 多胡碑是在日本北關東地區群馬縣高崎市發現的奈良時代石碑。此碑於1921年被指定為日本國家史跡，1954年升格為特別史跡。作為「上野三碑」之一，日本於2017年將其提報聯合國教科文組織世界記憶計畫。

480b3f06251eaf18.en: Mizunokojima Lighthouse (水ノ子島灯台, Mizunokojima Tōdai) is an active lighthouse located in Japan's Bungo Channel.
480b3f06251eaf18.zh: 水ノ子島灯台是位於日本豐後水道的一座現役燈塔。

480d6b97ecb25a6c.en: Awashima (粟島) is an inhabited island in the Seto Inland Sea of Japan, about 4.5 km northwest of the port of Takuma in the city of Mitoyo, Kagawa Prefecture. The total area is 3.72 km2 with a population of 216 (as of 2015). The island was the site of a maritime school that operated from 1897 to 1987, now preserved as a museum. The former post office is the site of the Missing Post Office.
480d6b97ecb25a6c.zh: 粟島是日本瀨戶內海的有人島，位於香川縣三豐市詫間港西北約4.5公里處。總面積3.72平方公里，人口216人（2015年）。島上曾有一所於1897年至1987年間運作的海員學校，現保存為博物館。舊郵局現為「漂流郵局」所在地。

4819076156a55408.en: Osaka International Convention Center (大阪府立国際会議場, Ōsaka Furitsu Kokusai Kaigijō), also known as
4819076156a55408.zh: 大阪府立国際会議場，又稱

481bf46f0325c96f.en: It is a regional confectionery that has been traditionally made at home. Fukuoka Prefecture is known for its vigorous wheat production, boasting a high volume production area. Over the years, different varieties of wheat suitable for the local climates have been cultivated, and wheat flour has been used as a familiar ingredient."Mitori Manju" is characterized by the distinctive aroma and subtle bitterness of baking soda. Adding baking soda causes the dough to expand when steamed, resulting in a beautifully round manju.
481bf46f0325c96f.zh: 這是一種傳統上在家中製作的地方點心。福岡縣小麥生產興盛，是產量很高的產地。多年來培育出適合當地氣候的各種小麥品種，麵粉也成為常見的食材。「みとり饅頭」的特色是帶有小蘇打獨特的香氣與淡淡苦味。加入小蘇打後，麵團在蒸製時會膨脹，做出圓潤漂亮的饅頭。

4828c12d5ac4a8fa.en: Yosakoi (よさこい) is a unique style of dance that originated in Japan and that is performed at festivals and events all over the country. The first yosakoi festival was held in 1954 in Kōchi, Japan, on the island of Shikoku. Yosakoi-style dancing has spread throughout much of Japan. The style of dance is highly energetic, combining traditional Japanese dance movements with modern music. The choreographed dances are often performed by large teams.
4828c12d5ac4a8fa.zh: よさこい是源自日本的獨特舞蹈形式，在全國各地的祭典與活動中演出。第一屆よさこい祭典於1954年在日本四國的高知舉行。よさこい舞蹈已傳播至日本大部分地區。這種舞蹈充滿活力，結合了日本傳統舞蹈動作與現代音樂。編排好的舞蹈通常由大型隊伍演出。

482ba845f2c744a5.en: Mount Myōken (妙見山, Myōken-san) is a 1,135.5 m (3,725 ft) mountain on the border of Yabu and Kami, Mikata, Hyogo, Japan. This mountain is one of Hyōgo 50, and a part of Hyonosen-Ushiroyama-Nagisan Quasi-National Park. The other name of this mountain is Mount Ishihara.
482ba845f2c744a5.zh: 妙見山是位於日本兵庫縣養父市與美方郡香美町交界處的山，海拔1,135.5公尺（3,725英尺）。此山為兵庫50山之一，屬於冰之山後山那岐山國定公園的一部分。此山別名石原山。

484e025c0f78b90b.en: The Itadori River (板取川, Itadori-gawa) is a river in Japan which flows through Gifu Prefecture. It is part of the Kiso River system.
484e025c0f78b90b.zh: 板取川是流經日本岐阜縣的河川，屬於木曾川水系。

48a46d07ee93b0bd.en: Makomanai Park (真駒内公園) is a city park in Minami-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan. It is home to attractions such as Makomanai Open Stadium, Makomanai Ice Arena and the Sapporo Salmon Museum. It also contains a small gymnasium, restaurant and a shop.
48a46d07ee93b0bd.zh: 北海道立真駒内公園是位於日本北海道札幌市南區的城市公園，園內有真駒內露天體育場、真駒內冰上競技場及札幌鮭魚博物館等設施，另有小型體育館、餐廳和商店。

48abf85eaaa12236.en: Takanashi clan residence ruins (高梨氏館跡, Takanashi-shi yakata ato) is an archaeological site containing the ruins of the Kamakura to early Sengoku period fortified residence of the Takanashi clan, local warlords in northern Shinano Province during that period. The site is located in the Otate neighborhood of the city of Nakano, Nagano in the Chūbu region of Japan. The ruins were designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 2007.
48abf85eaaa12236.zh: 高梨氏館跡是考古遺址，保存鎌倉時代至戰國時代初期高梨氏設防宅邸的遺構；高梨氏是當時信濃國北部的地方豪族。遺址位於日本中部地方長野縣中野市小館。2007年被指定為日本國家史跡。

48b6c57eb80d0b5c.en: While Ibaraki Prefecture is renowned as one of the most agricultural prefectures in Japan, it is also a fishery prefecture. The offshore areas of the prefecture are rich in fishing grounds where the Oyashio and Kuroshio currents intersect, and a variety of seafood is landed every season. The Otsu and Hiragata fishing ports in Kitaibaraki City catch a large amount of mackerel and sardines, and the Otsu fishing port is the largest net fishing port in the prefecture, boasting an annual catch of several tens of thousands of tons.
48b6c57eb80d0b5c.zh: 茨城縣以日本屈指可數的農業縣聞名，同時也是漁業縣。縣內近海是親潮與黑潮交會的豐富漁場，每季都有多種海產上岸。北茨城市的大津漁港與平潟漁港捕獲大量鯖魚與沙丁魚，其中大津漁港是縣內最大的網漁漁港，年漁獲量達數萬噸。

48bbd2d21e4d17f4.en: ‘Kuurijishi’ is an egg soup with pork belly, ‘Shibui’ (‘Tougan’ wax gourd), and ‘Gumbo’ (‘Gobou’ burdock). They use pork, bonito or shiitake mushroom for ‘dashi’ soup stock to make soup taste rich and mild. Also, the texture of ‘Shibui’ melting in mouth and fluffy egg are mild. ‘Kuuri’ in the dish’s name means ice, ‘jishi’ means boar meat in Okinawa dialect. It is said that its name came from the eggs spreading in a soup bowl like snow.
48bbd2d21e4d17f4.zh: クーリジシ是加入豬五花、「シブイ」（冬瓜）與「グンボウ」（牛蒡）的蛋花湯。高湯使用豬肉、鰹魚或香菇，讓湯頭濃郁溫和。入口即化的「シブイ」與鬆軟的蛋，口感也很溫和。料理名中的「クーリ」在沖繩方言中意為冰，「ジシ」意為山豬肉。據說名稱來自蛋花在湯碗中如雪般散開的樣子。

48d225790776d4c9.en: Ryūsō Falls (龍双ケ滝, Ryūsō-no-taki) is a waterfall in the town of Ikeda, Fukui Prefecture, Japan, on a branch of the Kuzuryū River.
48d225790776d4c9.zh: 龍双ケ滝是位於日本福井縣池田町的瀑布，位於九頭龍川的支流上。

48d49f9326f61361.en: The Hata temple ruins (幡多廃寺跡, Hata Haiji ato) is an archaeological site with the ruins of a Hakuhō period Buddhist temple located in the Akoda neighbourhood of what is now Naka-ku in the city of Okayama, Okayama Prefecture, in the San'yō region of Japan. The temple no longer exists, but the foundation stone of the pagoda which once existed in the temple grounds was designated as a National Historic Site in 1944.
48d49f9326f61361.zh: 幡多廃寺塔跡是位於日本山陽地方岡山縣岡山市中區赤田地區的考古遺址，留有白鳳時代佛寺的遺跡。寺院今已不存，昔日寺域內佛塔的礎石於1944年被指定為國家史跡。

48d7d910a1333089.en: Amanoiwato-jinja (天岩戸神社) is a Shinto shrine located in Takachiho, Miyazaki Prefecture, Japan. It is dedicated to the sun goddess Amaterasu and sits above the gorge containing Ama-no-Iwato, the cave where, according to Japanese legend, the goddess hid after battle with her brother, plunging the world into darkness until lured out by the spirit of merriment Ame-no-Uzume.
48d7d910a1333089.zh: 天岩戶神社是位於日本宮崎縣高千穗町的神社，祭祀太陽女神天照大神。神社位於天岩戶所在峽谷的上方。根據日本傳說，天照大神與弟弟爭鬥後躲進這個洞窟，使世界陷入黑暗，直到被歡樂之神天宇受賣命引出。

48f5d19fa62afd4d.en: Mutsu Kokubun-niji (陸奥国分尼寺) is a Buddhist temple in Wakabayashi-ku, Sendai, Japan,  belonging to the Sōtō Zen sect, and is the  provincial convent ("kokubun-niji") of former Mutsu Province. The grounds of the temple are  a National Historic Site.
48f5d19fa62afd4d.zh: 陸奥国分尼寺是位於日本仙台市若林區的曹洞宗寺院，為舊陸奧國的國分尼寺。寺院境內為國家史跡。

4916c3774640f900.en: Kasama Castle (笠間城, Kasama-jō) is a Japanese castle located in Kasama, central Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan. At the end of the Edo period, Kasama Castle was home to a junior branch of Makino clan, daimyō of Kasama Domain, but castle and domain went through many changes in clans during the early Edo period.
4916c3774640f900.zh: 笠間城是位於日本茨城縣中部笠間市的日本城郭。江戶時代末期，笠間城為笠間藩藩主牧野氏分家的居城，但在江戶時代初期，城主與藩主家族曾多次更替。

491daf3218a8bc2b.en: Takayama Castle (高山城, Takayama-jō) of Aki Province was a yamajiro-style Japanese castle located in what is today the Hongō neighborhood of the city of Mihara in Hiroshima Prefecture. Its ruins have been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 1957.
491daf3218a8bc2b.zh: 高山城是安藝國的山城式日本城郭，位於今廣島縣三原市本鄉地區。其遺址自1957年起由中央政府列為國家史跡加以保護。

4932147077fe0a31.en: The airbase at Chiran, Minamikyūshū, on the Satsuma Peninsula of Kagoshima, Japan, served as the departure point for hundreds of Special Attack or kamikaze sorties launched in the final months of World War II. A peace museum dedicated to the pilots, the Chiran Peace Museum for Kamikaze Pilots (知覧特攻平和会館, Chiran Tokkō-Heiwa-Kaikan), now marks the site.
4932147077fe0a31.zh: 位於日本鹿兒島薩摩半島南九州市知覽的機場，在第二次世界大戰最後幾個月曾是數百架次特別攻擊（神風特攻）出擊的起點。如今此地設有紀念這些飛行員的和平博物館——知覽特攻平和會館。

493fbcbb80fe9266.en: The main ingredients of ordinary chikuwa(=fish cake) are walleye pollock, shark, and atka mackerel, but “Ago-Chikuwa" is made from flying fish. In Tottori Prefecture, flying fish is called “Ago," hence the name “Ago-Chikuwa," which is made from “Ago" fish paste. The hard surface of the “Ago-Chikuwa" is baked to a crisp, creating a delicious crunchy sound and aroma when the knife is inserted. It has a firm chewy texture and allows you to enjoy the whole flying fish.
493fbcbb80fe9266.zh: 一般竹輪（魚板）的主要原料是黃線狹鱈、鯊魚和遠東多線魚，而「あごちくわ」則以飛魚製成。鳥取縣將飛魚稱為「あご」，因此以「あご」魚漿製成的竹輪便稱為「あごちくわ」。「あごちくわ」堅硬的表面烤得酥脆，下刀時會發出清脆的聲響並散發香氣。口感紮實有嚼勁，可品嘗到飛魚的整體風味。

494a5c6ac43af788.en: Known for being the production area of Tosa washi paper, Ino-machi is located in the central part of the prefecture.
494a5c6ac43af788.zh: 伊野町位於縣中部，以土佐和紙的產地聞名。

498faf89140b63ba.en: The Obitsu River (小櫃川, Obitsu-gawa) is a river in Kimitsu, Kisarazu, and Sodegaura, Chiba Prefecture, Japan. The river is 88 kilometers (55 mi) in length and has a drainage area of 273.2 square kilometers (105.5 sq mi).
498faf89140b63ba.zh: 小櫃川是流經日本千葉縣君津市、木更津市與袖浦市的河川，全長88公里（55英里），流域面積273.2平方公里（105.5平方英里）。

49b89adc73873dd2.en: Shiroyama Park (城山公園, Shiroyama Kōen) is a public park located in Takayama, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. In 1873, the park was established in the mountainous area around the ruins of Takayama Castle. The park's name means "castle mountain."
49b89adc73873dd2.zh: 城山公園是位於日本岐阜縣高山市的公園。1873年於高山城遺址周邊的山區設立。公園名稱意為「城之山」。

49e9c0eeadfc0c91.en: The Hakone Resort Complex or Hakone-en (Japanese:箱根園, meaning the "Hakone Garden") is a resort complex located on the east side of Lake Ashi, along Kanagawa Prefectural Route 75 in Motohakone, Hakone-machi, Ashigarashimo-gun, Kanagawa Prefecture. It is run by Prince Hotels & Resorts (until March 2006, Kokudo and Seibu Railway). It consists of cottages, a botanical garden, an aquarium, a shopping mall, a ropeway to Mount Koma, and a pier of the sightseeing ships on Lake Ashi.
49e9c0eeadfc0c91.zh: 箱根園（意為「箱根庭園」）是一座度假設施，位於神奈川縣足柄下郡箱根町元箱根、蘆之湖東側，沿神奈川縣道75號。由王子飯店度假村經營（至2006年3月為止由國土計畫與西武鐵道經營）。園區包括小屋、植物園、水族館、購物商場、通往駒岳的纜車，以及蘆之湖觀光船碼頭。

49eca60634c6318e.en: "Kanboshi" (=dried) daikon radish is a specialty of Hida city of Gifu prefecture. "Kanboshi Daikon Ni" is made by simmering "kanboshi" (=dried) daikon radish in dashi (=Japanese soup stock) and soy sauce."Kanboshi" (=dried) daikon radish is made in Yamanomura of Kamiokacho of Hida city, located along the northeastern tip of Gifu prefecture. It takes around 8 months for the dried daikon radish to be made from planting to completion.
49eca60634c6318e.zh: 「寒干」白蘿蔔是岐阜縣飛驒市的特產。「寒干大根煮」是將寒干白蘿蔔以高湯和醬油燉煮而成。寒干白蘿蔔產於位在岐阜縣東北端的飛驒市神岡町山之村。從播種到完成，寒干白蘿蔔約需8個月。

4a110d2e0a1c1b65.en: "Choji-fu no Karashi-ae" is a classic regional cuisine made with choji-fu, a type of wheat gluten from Shiga Prefecture. Choji-fu is a rectangular baked wheat gluten a little larger than the size of a matchbox. It is baked on all six sides so it can be used in various dishes such as hot pot and udon without falling apart in the broth, and it is a nutritious ingredient that is rich in plant-based protein. It is an essential ingredient in Buddhist cuisine, and is characterized by a chewy and smooth texture.
4a110d2e0a1c1b65.zh: 「丁字麩のからしあえ」是以滋賀縣的麩「丁字麩」製作的經典鄉土料理。丁字麩是比火柴盒稍大的長方形烤麩，六面都經過烘烤，因此可用於火鍋、烏龍麵等各種料理，在湯汁中不易散開，也是富含植物性蛋白質的營養食材。它是精進料理不可或缺的食材，特色是有嚼勁且滑順的口感。

4a1c6672657b1548.en: Shibireko Prefectural Natural Park (県立四尾連湖自然公園, Kenritsu Shibireko shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Yamanashi Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1959, the park's central feature is Lake Shibire (四尾連湖). The park is wholly within the municipality of Ichikawamisato.
4a1c6672657b1548.zh: 四尾連湖県立自然公園是位於日本山梨縣的縣立自然公園，設立於1959年，以四尾連湖為主要景觀。公園全區位於市川三鄉町境內。

4a1f018b8678ee0f.en: The Saruhashi Bridge (猿橋) is a historic arch bridge officially listed as a Place of Scenic Beauty of Japan in Ōtsuki, Yamanashi Prefecture. It is ranked as one of Japan's three unique bridges, along with the Kintai Bridge and the Shinkyo Bridge. It is also referred to as the monkey bridge
4a1f018b8678ee0f.zh: 猿橋是位於山梨縣大月市的歷史拱橋，被正式指定為日本國家名勝，與錦帶橋、神橋並列為日本三奇橋。又稱「猴橋」。

4a1f240cbea652dc.en: Aki Kokubun-ji (安芸国分寺) is an Omuro-school Shingon-sect Buddhist temple in the Yoshiyuki Saijomachi neighborhood of the city of Higashihiroshima, Hiroshima, Japan. It is one of the few surviving provincial temples established by Emperor Shōmu during the Nara period (710–794). Due to this connection, the foundation stones of the Nara period temple were designated as a National Historic Site in 1932, with the area under protection expanded in 1977, and again in 2002.
4a1f240cbea652dc.zh: 安芸国分寺是位於日本廣島縣東廣島市西條町吉行地區的真言宗御室派佛教寺院。它是聖武天皇於奈良時代（710–794年）設立的國分寺中少數留存至今者之一。基於這層淵源，奈良時代寺院的礎石於1932年被指定為國家史跡，保護範圍於1977年及2002年兩度擴大。

4a3bb9e3e902c9fe.en: Akita Shirakami Prefectural Natural Park (秋田白神県立自然公園, Akita Shirakami kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Akita Prefecture, Japan. Established in 2004, the park spans the borders of the municipalities of Fujisato and Happō, and takes its name from the Shirakami-Sanchi.
4a3bb9e3e902c9fe.zh: 秋田白神県立自然公園是位於日本秋田縣的縣立自然公園。公園設立於2004年，範圍橫跨藤里町與八峰町，名稱取自白神山地。

4a612d47562b901e.en: Momijidani Park (紅葉谷公園, Momijidani-Kōen) is one of the most famous maple leaves valley parks in Japan. The park is located at the foot of Mt. Misen, along Momijidani River, behind Itsukushima Shrine in Miyajima, Hatsukaichi, Hiroshima. There are more than 200 maples, including 110 Acer palmatum thunberg, 60 Palmatum var. matsumurae, 10 Acer rufinerve, Acer buergerianum, Acer sieboldianum miquel and Acer amoenum carriere var. amoenum.
4a612d47562b901e.zh: 紅葉谷公園是日本最著名的楓葉溪谷公園之一。公園位於廣島縣廿日市市宮島，嚴島神社後方、彌山山麓，沿紅葉谷川而設。園內有200多棵楓樹，包括110棵雞爪槭、60棵大紅葉、10棵瓜皮楓，以及三角楓、小羽團扇楓與山紅葉等。

4a6fad73d85d8e17.en: Sudare-bu with sesame paste is a local dish produced in Yuki City, Ibaraki Prefecture. The western part of the city, where Yuki City is located, has many sunny days throughout the year and has long been rich in agriculture, benefiting from the Tone and Kinugawa Rivers, and producing a variety of foods such as rice, wheat, soybeans, and buckwheat. The northern part, where Yuki Castle was located, prospered as a castle town, and many temples were built there. One of the ingredients used in the vegetarian dishes eaten there was sudare-bu.
4a6fad73d85d8e17.zh: 芝麻醋拌すだれ麩是茨城縣結城市的鄉土料理。結城市所在的縣西部全年晴天多，受惠於利根川與鬼怒川，自古農業發達，出產米、小麥、大豆、蕎麥等多種作物。結城城所在的北部作為城下町而繁榮，建有許多寺院。當地所吃的素食料理中，所用的食材之一便是すだれ麩。

4a7a7c7e4bef0d12.en: The Rusutsu Resort (ルスツリゾート, Rusutsu Rizōto) is the largest resort in Hokkaidō, Japan, operated by Kamori Kankō. The resort is famous for its ski slopes but also offers year-round attractions including an amusement park and golf courses.
4a7a7c7e4bef0d12.zh: ルスツリゾート是日本北海道規模最大的度假村，由加森觀光經營。度假村以滑雪場聞名，也全年提供遊樂園、高爾夫球場等設施。

4a7d1981e03d7d4d.en: Along with "Kabura-zushi", this is a traditional fermented food representing Kaga region. It is a fermented food made by marinating Kipper and Daikon radish in Amazake (sweet sake made from rice and malted rice).The background of "Daikon-zushi" is largely due to the “Kitamae-bune”, a group of merchant ships that have been in contact with the local people since the feudal domain period. The“ Kitamae-bune” was a group of merchant ships that carried rice and fish from Hokkaido to Edo and Osaka via the Sea of Japan.
4a7d1981e03d7d4d.zh: 與「かぶら寿司」同為代表加賀地方的傳統發酵食品。將鯡魚乾與白蘿蔔以甘酒（以米和米麴製成的甜酒）醃漬發酵而成。「大根ずし」的形成背景，很大程度與「北前船」有關。北前船是自藩政時期起便與當地居民往來的商船群，經由日本海將北海道的米和魚運往江戶與大阪。

4a9af1433feea1fa.en: Mukaihaguroyama Castle (向羽黒山城, Mukaihaguroyama-jō), also known as Iwasaki Castle (岩崎城, Iwasaki-jō), was an Edo period Japanese castle located in the town of Aizumisato, southern Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. The site has been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 2001. It is ranked as one of the five largest Sengoku period yamashiro (including Kasugayama Castle (Echigo province), Nanao Castle (Noto Province), Odani Castle and Kannonji Castle (Omi Province) and Gassantoda Castle (Iwami Province).
4a9af1433feea1fa.zh: 向羽黑山城，又稱岩崎城，是位於日本福島縣南部會津美里町的江戶時代日本城堡。城址自2001年起由中央政府指定為國家史跡加以保護。它名列戰國時代五大山城之一（其他包括越後國的春日山城、能登國的七尾城、近江國的小谷城與觀音寺城，以及石見國的月山富田城）。

4aa8846c8f49499e.en: Originally a deep-sea fish, hata-hata originally came to be called hata-hata because they appear in large schools in nearby waters only during their spawning season, when the sea is rough and thunder rumbles, hence the name "hatahatagami," an old word for thunderbolt. It is also known as the thunderfish. Hata-hata is sung in the folk song "Akita Ondo," and is so deeply rooted in the lives of the people of the prefecture that it is said, "I can't celebrate the New Year without hata-hata.
4aa8846c8f49499e.zh: ハタハタ原本是深海魚，只在產卵期、海象惡劣且雷聲轟鳴時成群出現在近海，因此以古語中指雷的「はたはたがみ」稱為ハタハタ，也稱為雷魚。ハタハタ出現在民謠〈秋田音頭〉中，深植於縣民生活，甚至有「沒有ハタハタ就過不了年」的說法。

4aae26bf50a04fa0.en: Despite being referred to as “Jelly Fry”, this dish is completely different from meats or fish fried in oil, as well as from traditional “jelly” which is a confectionery. Rather, the name “jelly fry” comes from its shape, which resembles a traditional “koban” oval gold coin. In fact, it apparently used to be called “Sen Fry” (i.e. “Money Fry”), before becoming called “Jelly Fry”. While it looks like an unbattered croquette, it is characteristically made from a mixed okara and potato base, with carrots and green onions.
4aae26bf50a04fa0.zh: 這道料理雖然叫做「ゼリーフライ」，卻與用油炸的肉類或魚類完全不同，也和屬於點心的傳統「果凍」無關。「ゼリーフライ」這個名稱來自它的形狀，形似傳統的橢圓形金幣「小判」。據說它原本叫做「錢フライ」（即「錢炸物」），後來才改稱「ゼリーフライ」。外觀看起來像沒有裹麵衣的可樂餅，特色是以豆渣和馬鈴薯為基底，再加入紅蘿蔔與蔥。

4ac222f69283ce99.en: Fu is a processed food whose main ingredient is gluten and is made by kneading wheat flour with water.
4ac222f69283ce99.zh: 麩是以麩質為主要原料的加工食品，將小麥粉加水揉製而成。

4ac443827235906a.en: “Fukuregashi” is a local sweet made by steaming a mixture of wheat flour, baking soda, brown sugar, and other ingredients. Because baking soda is used to make it plump, it is also referred to as “soda candy,” “fukurakan,” and “fukurekan.”It’s said that brown sugar strongly established itself as a sweetener in Kagoshima in the Edo period.
4ac443827235906a.zh: 「ふくれ菓子」是將麵粉、小蘇打、黑糖等材料混合後蒸製的鄉土甜點。因為使用小蘇打使其膨起，也被稱為「蘇打糖」、「ふくらかん」、「ふくれかん」。據說黑糖在江戶時代已在鹿兒島穩固確立為甜味料。

4acde212bb4b41a9.en: Kanmon Kaikyo Fireworks Festival (Japanese: 関門海峡花火大会, Hepburn: Kanmon Kaikyō Hanabi Taikai), also known as the Asiaport Festival in KANMON, is the annual fireworks display held at the Kanmon Strait every August 13.
4acde212bb4b41a9.zh: 關門海峽花火大會又稱Asiaport Festival in KANMON，是每年8月13日在關門海峽舉行的煙火大會。

4ae7d2eb78f5c63e.en: “Salmon Chanchan Yaki” is a dish of steamed salmon and seasonal vegetables caught from fall to winter and seasoned with miso. It is said to have originated in a fishing town in the Ishikari region, but it has become famous nationwide, and in 2007 it was selected as one of the "100 Best Local Dishes in Rural Areas (sponsored by the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries)" along with “Ishikari Nabe” and “Jingisukan” (mutton barbecue).
4ae7d2eb78f5c63e.zh: 「鮭のチャンチャン焼き」是將鮭魚與秋季至冬季採收的當季蔬菜蒸烤，並以味噌調味的料理。據說起源於石狩地區的漁村，後來聞名全國，2007年與「石狩鍋」、「ジンギスカン」（成吉思汗烤羊肉）一同入選「農山漁村鄉土料理百選（農林水產省主辦）」。

4af4441c671c13be.en: Usuki city is located in the southeastern part of Oita prefecture, stretching long and narrow in an oval shape toward the Hoyo Strait. This is the city where the Usuki Clan ruled by Otomo Sorin was located. The Usuki Clan often suffered financial difficulties, which is why the food they ate and the clothes they wore were frugal. Lords at the time had servants make “ohan” and “ohan kayaku” instead of “sekihan” (=red bean rice) because azuki beans use to make “sekihan” were expensive.
4af4441c671c13be.zh: 臼杵市位於大分縣東南部，呈細長的橢圓形向豐予海峽延伸。這裡是大友宗麟統治的臼杵藩所在地。臼杵藩經常面臨財政困難，因此飲食和衣著都很簡樸。由於製作赤飯（紅豆飯）所用的紅豆價格昂貴，當時的藩主便讓僕人以「黃飯」和「黃飯かやく」代替赤飯。

4b0406bea272dcf2.en: Kōshō-ji (Japanese: 興聖寺) is a Sōtō Zen in temple in Japan. It bears an abbreviated form of the name of the temple established by Eihei Dōgen in Kyoto, Kōshōhōrin-ji, but it was established four centuries after that temple was destroyed, and in a different location.
4b0406bea272dcf2.zh: 興聖寺是日本的一座曹洞宗寺院。其寺名取自永平道元在京都創建的寺院「興聖寶林寺」的簡稱，但本寺是在該寺毀壞四個世紀後才創建，且地點不同。

4b0e025d13177f18.en: The Tsubouchi Memorial Theatre Museum of Waseda University is a university museum devoted to the history of drama, with facilities used for cultural performances from all over the world. The museum was named for Tsubouchi Shōyō, a famous writer known for his work with theater and translation of the collected works of Shakespeare into Japanese. It is commonly known as Enpaku in Japanese.
4b0e025d13177f18.zh: 早稲田大学坪内博士記念演劇博物館是以戲劇史為主題的大學博物館，設有供世界各地文化表演使用的設施。博物館以坪內逍遙命名，他是知名作家，以戲劇方面的工作及將莎士比亞全集譯成日文而聞名。日文通稱「演博」。

4b192c061afdb7be.en: Sakitsu Church is a Catholic church in Amakusa, Kumamoto, Japan.
4b192c061afdb7be.zh: 崎津天主堂是位於日本熊本縣天草市的天主教堂。

4b225b4db42431b1.en: Wood One Museum of Art (ウッドワン美術館, Uddo-Wan Bijutsukan) opened in Hatsukaichi, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan in 1996. The collection of some 800 works acquired by the Wood One Company (株式会社ウッドワン) centres around Modern Japanese Painting, Meissen porcelain, Art Nouveau glass, Qing ceramics, and Satsuma ware of the Bakumatsu and Meiji periods, and includes paintings by Kishida Ryūsei, Renoir, and Van Gogh.
4b225b4db42431b1.zh: ウッドワン美術館於1996年在日本廣島縣廿日市開館。館藏約800件，由株式会社ウッドワン收購，以日本近代繪畫、麥森瓷器、新藝術風格玻璃、清代陶瓷，以及幕末與明治時期的薩摩燒為主，另有岸田劉生、雷諾瓦與梵谷的畫作。

4b3e2598aec04813.en: The Ōmachi Dam is a concrete gravity dam on the Takase River just west of Ōmachi in Nagano Prefecture, Japan. Construction of the dam began in 1975 and it was completed in 1985. The primary purpose of the dam is water supply and it also supports a 13 MW hydroelectric power station. It is owned by TEPCO.
4b3e2598aec04813.zh: 大町ダム是位於日本長野縣大町市西側高瀨川上的混凝土重力壩。水壩於1975年動工，1985年完工，主要用途為供水，並附設一座13百萬瓦的水力發電廠。水壩由東京電力（TEPCO）所有。

4b5c95af1a98c5f3.en: Nagashima Castle (長島城, Nagashima-jō), is a hirashiro-style Japanese castle located in northern part of the city of Kuwana, Mie Prefecture, Japan.  It was the administrative center of Nagashima Domain during the Edo period.
4b5c95af1a98c5f3.zh: 長島城是位於日本三重縣桑名市北部的平城式日本城郭。江戶時代為長島藩的藩政中心。

4b72b4445c637c9e.en: Osaka City Air Terminal (OCAT) is a multi-purpose commercial complex in Minatomachi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka housing South Osaka's inter-city bus terminal and coach ferry services to both Kansai International Airport and Osaka Itami Airport, JR Namba station and six floors of shops, restaurants, travel agencies and tourist offices. OCAT is also the venue for frequent musical performances and its outdoor Ponte Square area is the meeting place and practice area for Osaka's youthful street dance community.
4b72b4445c637c9e.zh: 大阪シティエアターミナル（OCAT）是位於大阪市浪速區湊町的多功能商業設施，設有南大阪的城際巴士總站、往返關西國際機場與大阪伊丹機場的接駁巴士服務、JR難波站，以及六層樓的商店、餐廳、旅行社與觀光服務處。OCAT也經常舉辦音樂表演，戶外的ポンテ廣場是大阪年輕街舞族群聚會與練習的地點。

4b78122b0a43360f.en: The Sarakurayama Cable Car (皿倉山ケーブルカー, Sarakurayama Kēburukā), formerly (until March 2015) known as the Hobashira Cable (帆柱ケーブル, Hobashira Kēburu), is a Japanese funicular line operated by the Sarakurayama Tozan Railway Company. The line climbs Mount Sarakura in Kitakyūshū, Fukuoka. The company is fully owned by the city of Kitakyūshū. It opened in 1957.
4b78122b0a43360f.zh: 皿倉山ケーブルカー（至2015年3月前稱為帆柱ケーブル）是由皿倉登山鉄道公司經營的日本纜索鐵道，路線登上福岡縣北九州市的皿倉山。該公司由北九州市全額持有。此線於1957年開通。

4b7fadf587e7e5db.en: Iino Castle (飯野城, Iino-jō) also known as Kame-jiro was a castle structure in Ebino, Miyazaki, Japan. Iino Castle was built by the Kusakabe clan and was later controlled by the Shimazu clan.
4b7fadf587e7e5db.zh: 飯野城又稱龜城，是位於日本宮崎縣えびの市的城郭。飯野城由日下部氏興建，後來由島津氏掌控。

4b856881f0bab268.en: This dish has spread from school lunches to the entire prefecture and has become the soul food of Yamaguchi Prefecture residents. It is made by mixing bite-sized fried chicken and deep-fried Gobou(=Burdock) root with sweet and spicy sauce, and is popular among children because it goes well with rice. It originated around 1995, when a nutrition teacher at an elementary school asked for original dishes from each family, saying that the recipes for school lunches were becoming "mannered". The dish was invented based on the recipes submitted.
4b856881f0bab268.zh: 這道料理從學校營養午餐普及到全縣，成為山口縣民的靈魂食物。做法是將一口大小的炸雞與炸牛蒡拌上甜辣醬汁，因為很下飯而受到孩子們歡迎。起源於1995年左右，一位小學的營養教師認為營養午餐的菜單逐漸「千篇一律」，於是向各家庭徵求原創料理，並根據提交的食譜研發出這道菜。

4bb35f9fa3422fd5.en: Tokoname ware (常滑焼, Tokoname-yaki) is a type of Japanese pottery, stoneware, and ceramics produced in and around the municipality of Tokoname, Aichi, in central Japan. Tokoname was the location of one of the Six Ancient Kilns of Japan.
4bb35f9fa3422fd5.zh: 常滑燒是在日本中部愛知縣常滑市及其周邊地區生產的日本陶器、炻器與瓷器。常滑是日本六古窯之一的所在地。

4bb838264e22ac9c.en: "Hoto" originated as something eaten in a red bean soup in the Heian Period, as recorded in the diaries of aristocrats. In Yamanashi after the Edo period, it was common to eat "hoto" stewed in miso, but "azuki hoto" was eaten during celebrations like New Year's and Obon as well as regional events such as during rice planting season.
4bb838264e22ac9c.zh: 根據貴族日記的記載，「ほうとう」起源於平安時代，原本是放在紅豆湯中食用。江戶時代以後的山梨，一般吃的是用味噌燉煮的「ほうとう」，而「小豆ほうとう」則在新年、盂蘭盆節等節慶，以及插秧時節等地方活動時食用。

4bdde1e14575923b.en: Gansen-ji (Japanese: 岩船寺) is a Japanese Buddhist temple of the Shingon Risshu sect in the city of Kizugawa in Kyoto Prefecture, Japan.
4bdde1e14575923b.zh: 岩船寺是位於日本京都府木津川市的真言律宗佛寺。

4bdfa6c7e1fc19cb.en: The Maizuru Naval Base (Japanese: 舞鶴基地, Hepburn: Maidzuru Kichi), also simply known as the JMSDF Maizuru Naval Base, is a group of ports and land facilities of the Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force (JMSDF), which are scattered in multiple districts of Maizuru City, Kansai region, and where the Maizuru District Force, etc. are located. It is not officially called a base, but it is used as a common name.
4bdfa6c7e1fc19cb.zh: 舞鶴基地，也簡稱為海上自衛隊舞鶴基地，是日本海上自衛隊分布於關西地區舞鶴市多個地區的港口與陸上設施群，舞鶴地方隊等單位設於此處。官方並未正式稱之為基地，但此名稱作為通稱使用。

4bffb4eb08f810d2.en: Sakai Lighthouse (堺燈台, Sakai tōdai) is a wooden lighthouse located in Sakai-ku, Sakai Osaka Prefecture, Japan.  It claims to be the oldest wooden lighthouse in Japan, and was designated a National Monument in 1972.
4bffb4eb08f810d2.zh: 舊堺燈台是位於日本大阪府堺市堺區的木造燈塔。據稱為日本現存最古老的木造燈塔，1972年被指定為國家史蹟。

4c20ed0f0d21ccfb.en: Shimonoseki City Archaeological Museum (下関市立考古博物館, Shimonoseki Shiritsu Kōko-hakubutsukan) opened in Shimonoseki, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan, in 1995. It is located next to the Ayaragigō Site, a Yayoi settlement that has been designated a national Historic Site.
4c20ed0f0d21ccfb.zh: 下関市立考古博物館於1995年在日本山口縣下關市開館。館址鄰接綾羅木鄉遺跡，該遺跡為彌生時代聚落，已被指定為國家史跡。

4c4aff2d482cd0c2.en: "Hechima Jiru" is a local dish from Kagoshima Prefecture. It consists of miso soup with luffa served in a bowl of somen noodles. While people in other regions use luffa as a scrubbing brush or lotion, Kagoshima locals have been eating it for a long time. In fact, the 1802 encyclopedia "Shaping Illustrations" compiled by Shigehisa Shimazu describes luffa cuisine. Luffa belongs to the Cucurbits family and is native to tropical Asia.
4c4aff2d482cd0c2.zh: 「へちま汁」是鹿兒島縣的鄉土料理，是以絲瓜煮成的味噌湯，盛在放有素麵的碗中。其他地區的人把絲瓜當作菜瓜布或化妝水使用，鹿兒島當地人則自古就食用絲瓜。事實上，1802年由島津重豪編纂的百科全書《成形圖說》中就記載了絲瓜料理。絲瓜屬於葫蘆科，原產於熱帶亞洲。

4c4eebe68fafdfe5.en: Kozukue Castle (小机城, Kozukue-jō) is the name for the earthly remains of a castle structure in Kozukue, Kōho-ku ward of Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan.
4c4eebe68fafdfe5.zh: 小机城是位於日本神奈川縣橫濱市港北區小机的城郭遺跡名稱。

4c60cdaca1e19853.en: Mount Chō (蝶ヶ岳, Chougatake) at 2,677 m (8,783 ft) is a mountain located in Japan. Mount Chō is part of the Hida Mountains (Northern Alps) in Chūbu-Sangaku National Park, and is located in the cities of Azumino and Matsumoto in Nagano Prefecture. It is located to the south of Mount Jōnen on the ridgeline of the Jōnen Mountain Range. Mount Chō is a popular destination for hikers because it offers views of other famous Japanese mountains, including Mount Yari and Mount Hotakadake along the Panorama Ginza.
4c60cdaca1e19853.zh: 蝶ヶ岳是日本的一座山，海拔2,677公尺（8,783英尺）。蝶ヶ岳屬於中部山岳國立公園內的飛驒山脈（北阿爾卑斯），位於長野縣安曇野市與松本市。它位於常念山脈稜線上、常念岳的南方。由於可沿著パノラマ銀座眺望槍岳、穗高岳等日本知名山岳，蝶ヶ岳是登山客喜愛的目的地。

4c60e7d0a2642352.en: In Kuki City, Kazo City, Gyoda City, and other areas from northern to eastern Saitama Prefecture, "shio anbin" has been eaten to celebrate the harvest of new rice since ancient times. Shio an-bin" is a rice cake filled with sweet bean paste seasoned with salt instead of sugar, and the salt enhances the natural sweetness of azuki beans and glutinous rice. The sweet bean paste is now the mainstream, but this type was created in the middle of the Edo period, when sugar was so precious that the common people could seldom eat it.
4c60e7d0a2642352.zh: 在久喜市、加須市、行田市等埼玉縣北部至東部地區，自古就有吃「塩あんびん」慶祝新米收成的習俗。「塩あんびん」是包入以鹽代替砂糖調味的紅豆餡的年糕，鹽能襯托出紅豆與糯米本身的甜味。現在甜的紅豆餡是主流，但這種鹹餡是在江戶時代中期出現的，當時砂糖非常珍貴，一般百姓很少能吃到。

4c81d58cdac417e7.en: Yude-rakkasei is peanuts boiled in their shells in salted water. The first peanut cultivated in Japan was in Kanagawa Prefecture. In the early Meiji period (1868-1912), farmers in Oiso began cultivating peanuts after acquiring them in Yokohama during Japan's opening to the outside world. As Mt. Fuji's volcanic ash piled up in the Hadano Basin, the soil was suitable for peanut cultivation. Since the Meiji Era, peanut cultivation has flourished as a rotation crop for leaf tobacco farmers.
4c81d58cdac417e7.zh: 茹で落花生是將帶殼花生放入鹽水中煮熟的食物。日本最早栽培花生的地方是神奈川縣。明治時代（1868－1912）初期，大磯的農民在日本對外開放期間於橫濱取得花生後開始栽培。秦野盆地堆積了富士山的火山灰，土壤適合種植花生。自明治時代起，花生作為菸葉農家的輪作作物而興盛栽培。

4c8811d223ebf6b1.en: Hayatozuka (隼人塚) is a Buddhist-related ruin located in located in the Uchiyamada, Hayato neighborhood of the city of Kirishima, Kagoshima, Japan. It was designated as a National Historic Site in 1921.
4c8811d223ebf6b1.zh: 隼人塚（隼人塚）是位於日本鹿兒島縣霧島市隼人町內山田的佛教相關遺跡，於1921年被指定為國家史跡。

4c8ddc038ec3c8e0.en: Mount Taishaku (帝釈山, Taishaku-san) is a 585.9 m (1,922 ft) mountain of Tanjō Mountains, located in Sakamoto, Yamada, Kita-ku, Kobe, Hyōgo, Japan.
4c8ddc038ec3c8e0.zh: 帝釋山是丹生山地的一座山，海拔585.9公尺（1,922英尺），位於日本兵庫縣神戶市北區山田町坂本。

4c9d8907aa1d957c.en: The Shiwaku Islands (塩飽諸島, Shiwaku-shotō) or Shiwaku-jima (塩飽島) are an archipelago in the Seto Inland Sea, between the larger Japanese islands of Honshu and Shikoku.
4c9d8907aa1d957c.zh: 塩飽諸島（Shiwaku-shotō），又稱塩飽島（Shiwaku-jima），是位於瀨戶內海、介於日本較大島嶼本州與四國之間的群島。

4ca31cbee77d8841.en: Whitebait fishing reaches its peak from late March until May. During that time, lots of young Japanese anchovy, Japanese sardine or round herring are caught. Especially, Kada area in Wakayama City and Yuasa in Arita-gun are prominent areas for whitebait industry; fresh whitebait in Kada and boiled whitebait in Yuasa. In Yuasa area, which boasts the top amount of catching whitebait, the fishers use the technique called ‘batch ami’ when catching whitebait. They pull the fine nets with two small boats to surround groups of fish.
4ca31cbee77d8841.zh: 魩仔魚漁期在3月下旬至5月達到高峰。這段期間會捕獲大量日本鯷、遠東擬沙丁魚或脂眼鯡的幼魚。尤其和歌山市的加太地區與有田郡的湯淺是魩仔魚產業的重要地區；加太以生魩仔魚、湯淺以水煮魩仔魚聞名。在捕獲量居首的湯淺地區，漁民捕魩仔魚時使用稱為「バッチ網」的技法，以兩艘小船拉著細網包圍魚群。

4cbdbe0308370b47.en: Inubōsaki Marine Park was a public aquarium and marine park located in Chōshi, Chiba Prefecture. It opened in 1954 and underwent renovation in 1993.It was closed on 31 January 2018, with the owners attributing the decision to a significant decline in visitors after the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and nuclear crisis.
4cbdbe0308370b47.zh: 犬吠埼マリンパーク是位於千葉縣銚子市的公共水族館暨海洋公園，1954年開幕，1993年整修。2018年1月31日閉館，業者表示原因是2011年東北地方太平洋近海地震及核災後遊客大幅減少。

4ccc8b3c8132cf03.en: Miharu Castle (三春城, Miharu-jō) is a hilltop-style Japanese castle located in the town of Miharu, Tamura District, Fukushima Prefecture, in the southern Tōhoku region of Japan. It is also called Maizuru Castle (舞鶴城).  Built in 1543, the castle and its surrounding land are maintained by the government of Japan as a public park. Constructed during the Sengoku period, the castle  was occupied by a succession of daimyō of Miharu Domain under the Edo period Tokugawa shogunate. Today, the site is a public park, renowned for its sakura.
4ccc8b3c8132cf03.zh: 三春城是位於日本東北地方南部福島縣田村郡三春町的山城式日本城堡，又稱舞鶴城。城堡建於1543年，城址及周邊土地由日本政府維護為公園。三春城建於戰國時代，江戶時代德川幕府治下由三春藩歷代大名相繼入主。現在城址為公園，以櫻花聞名。

4ccf7cba55d40d3b.en: Okioshio Castle (置塩城, Okioshio-jō)  is the remains of a Muromachi period Japanese castle structure located in the city of Himeji, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site as one of the Remains of Akamatsu-shi Castles, combining both Shirahata Castle and Kanjōsan Castle, since 1996.  It is also referred to as "Ojio Castle" after an alternative pronunciation of the kanji in its name.
4ccf7cba55d40d3b.zh: 置塩城是室町時代日本城郭的遺跡，位於日本兵庫縣姬路市。自1996年起，與白旗城、感状山城一同作為「赤松氏城跡」，被列為國家史跡加以保護。依名稱漢字的另一種讀法，也稱為「おじおじょう」。

4cf311e9bc2426ca.en: Mount Hōken (宝剣岳 (Hōken-Dake)) is one of major peaks in Kiso Mountains or Central Alps, Nagano Prefecture, Japan. It is 2,931 m (9,616 ft) high, and its shape is sharp pyramidal peak.
4cf311e9bc2426ca.zh: 宝剣岳是日本長野縣木曾山脈（中央阿爾卑斯）的主要山峰之一，海拔2,931公尺（9,616英尺），山形為尖銳的金字塔形山峰。

4d015cacfdc5854a.en: “Oni-manju” was made with sweet potatoes and wheat flour, which were relatively easy to obtain during and after the war when food was scarce, and it became popular as a staple food instead of rice. It is said that the name was given because the way the cubed sweet potatoes look like the horns or a metal stick of an oni (ogre). It has various names such as "Imo-uiro", "Imoman", and "Imo-manju" depending on the region.
4d015cacfdc5854a.zh: 「鬼まんじゅう」是以戰時與戰後糧食短缺時期較容易取得的地瓜和麵粉製成，曾作為代替米飯的主食而普及。據說名稱的由來是切成小塊的地瓜看起來像鬼的角或金棒。依地區不同，也有「芋ういろ」、「芋まん」、「芋まんじゅう」等各種名稱。

4d0624f29e2fcca2.en: Jōdo-ji (浄土寺) is a Shingon temple in Matsuyama, Japan. It is Temple 49 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage, and temple two on The Thirteen Buddhist Sites of Iyo.
4d0624f29e2fcca2.zh: 浄土寺是位於日本松山市的真言宗寺院，為四國八十八所巡禮的第49號札所，也是伊予十三佛靈場的第2號。

4d10fb63b65c94c6.en: The Fudōdō Site (不動堂遺跡, Fudōdō Iseki) is an archaeological site with the ruins of a middle Jōmon period (around 2500 BC) settlement in what is now part of the town of Asahi, Toyama Prefecture in the Hokuriku region of Japan. It was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1986.
4d10fb63b65c94c6.zh: 不動堂遺跡是一處考古遺址，保存繩文時代中期（約西元前2500年）的聚落遺跡，位於今日本北陸地區富山縣朝日町境內，1986年被指定為國家史跡。

4d2f4c835036a242.en: Mōri Museum (毛利博物館, Mōri Hakubutsukan) opened in Hōfu, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan, in 1966. It occupies part of the Former Mōri Clan Main Residence, dating from the Meiji and Taishō periods, of which twelve component structures have been jointly designated an Important Cultural Property and the gardens a Place of Scenic Beauty. The collection of some twenty thousand objects includes four National Treasures, nine Important Cultural Properties, and nine Prefectural Cultural Properties.
4d2f4c835036a242.zh: 毛利博物館於1966年在日本山口縣防府市開館。館舍位於明治至大正時期建造的舊毛利家本邸的一部分，其中十二棟建築一併被指定為重要文化財，庭園則被指定為名勝。館藏約兩萬件，包括四件國寶、九件重要文化財及九件縣指定文化財。

4d30406316ce3cff.en: Nakahara Chūya Memorial Museum (中原中也記念館, Nakahara Chūya Kinenkan) is a museum dedicated to the life and works of poet Nakahara Chūya in Yamaguchi, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan. Located on the site of his birthplace (other than for a storehouse and chashitsu, the original buildings were destroyed by fire in 1972), the museum opened in 1994. The museum was in 1998 selected among the 100 Top Public Buildings by the then Ministry of Construction.
4d30406316ce3cff.zh: 中原中也記念館是位於日本山口縣山口市、介紹詩人中原中也生平與作品的紀念館。館址為其出生地（除倉庫與茶室外，原有建築於1972年毀於火災），1994年開館。1998年獲當時的建設省選為「公共建築百選」之一。

4d3faf339fa2517c.en: Itokoku History Museum (伊都国歴史博物館, Ito-koku Rekishi Hakubutsukan) opened in Itoshima, Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan in 2004. It supersedes the former Ito Historical Museum (伊都歴史資料館), which opened in July 1987. With a focus on cultural properties excavated from the area, the museum's collection numbers some 19,500 objects. The display includes an assemblage of Yayoi-period artefacts excavated from the Hirabaru burial site (平原遺跡) that has been designated a National Treasure.
4d3faf339fa2517c.zh: 伊都国歴史博物館於2004年在日本福岡縣糸島市開館，前身為1987年7月開館的伊都歴史資料館。館藏以當地出土的文化財為主，約有19,500件。展品包括平原遺跡出土、已被指定為國寶的一批彌生時代文物。

4d42fdb9f6f1e431.en: Arakawa Dam is a rockfill dam located in Yamanashi Prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for flood control and water supply. The catchment area of the dam is 126.4 km2. The dam impounds about 41  ha of land when full and can store 10800 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1973 and completed in 1985.
4d42fdb9f6f1e431.zh: 荒川ダム是位於日本山梨縣的堆石壩，用於防洪及供水。集水面積為126.4平方公里，滿水時淹沒面積約41公頃，蓄水量為1080萬立方公尺。水壩於1973年動工，1985年完工。

4d647ac0ea4c5973.en: The Ōmazaki Lighthouse (大間埼灯台, Ōmazaki tōdai) is a lighthouse located at the northernmost extremity of the Shimokita Peninsula of Honshū island in Ōma, Aomori Prefecture, Japan. It is maintained by the Japan Coast Guard.
4d647ac0ea4c5973.zh: 大間埼燈塔（大間埼灯台）是位於日本青森縣大間町、本州下北半島最北端的燈塔，由日本海上保安廳維護管理。

4d97ed5d5823628a.en: Kinryūzan Shakuman-in Endon Hōkai-ji (金龍山釈満院円頓宝戒寺) is a Buddhist temple in Kamakura, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. Often called Hagidera (萩寺), or "bush-clover temple", because those flowers are numerous in its garden, its existence is directly linked to a famous tragedy that on July 4, 1333 wiped out almost the entire Hōjō clan, ruler of Japan for 135 years.
4d97ed5d5823628a.zh: 金龍山釈満院円頓宝戒寺（金龍山釈満院円頓宝戒寺）是位於日本神奈川縣鎌倉市的佛教寺院。因庭園中胡枝子花眾多，常被稱為萩寺（萩寺），即「胡枝子寺」。寺院的由來與一場著名的悲劇直接相關：1333年7月4日，統治日本135年的北條氏幾乎全族覆滅。

4da5648534d9271e.en: During the Edo period, barren land that could not be used for rice cultivation was exempt from payment of annual tribute. The Tanabe fief of the Kishu domain covered plenty of barren land, and the farmers were burdened by heavy annual tribute payments. To alleviate the farmers’ hardship, Naotsugu Ando, the lord of the Tanabe domain, turned his attention to the yabu-ume plum, which grew wild in the barren land, and encouraged the farmers to cultivate it. This is believed to be the beginning of large-scale plum cultivation in Wakayama Prefecture.
4da5648534d9271e.zh: 江戶時代，無法種稻的貧瘠土地可免繳年貢。紀州藩的田邊領內有許多貧瘠土地，農民承受沉重的年貢負擔。為了減輕農民的困苦，田邊藩主安藤直次注意到野生於貧瘠土地上的藪梅，並鼓勵農民栽培。這被認為是和歌山縣大規模種植梅子的開端。

4dbb702b36609a1f.en: Mount Oizuru (笈ヶ岳, Oizuru-ga-take) is located on the borders of Gifu, Ishikawa and Toyama prefectures in Japan. It is in the northern area of Hakusan National Park and is part of the Ryōhaku Mountains.
4dbb702b36609a1f.zh: 笈岳位於日本岐阜縣、石川縣與富山縣的交界處，在白山國家公園北部，屬於兩白山地。

4dc865526e1304cb.en: As the climate in northern region is cold and it’s hard to cultivate rice, they cultivated soybeans, which can grow in the harsh climate. Tofu is very nutritious and known as ‘meat from fields, so it was used often. There used to be a custom to make tofu at home. They exchanged tofu when they made one too much’ and there are many occasions to eat tofu, which have tofu culture take root. Home-made tofu was used in various menus, like simmered dish, soup, ‘shira-ae’ salad, hot pot and so on. They froze tofu in winter to keep ones until spring.
4dc865526e1304cb.zh: 北部地區氣候寒冷，不易種稻，因此種植能在嚴苛氣候中生長的大豆。豆腐營養豐富，被稱為「田裡的肉」，因此經常使用。過去有在家自製豆腐的習俗，做多了會互相交換，吃豆腐的場合很多，使豆腐文化扎根。自製豆腐用於燉菜、湯、白和拌菜、火鍋等各種菜色。冬天會把豆腐冷凍，保存到春天。

4dd2720407df2540.en: Sashiki Castle (佐敷城, Sashiki-jō) was a Sengoku period yamajiro-style Japanese castle located in the town of Ashikita, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan.  Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2008. It is also referred to as Sashiki Hanaoka Castle (佐敷花岡城, Sashiki Hanaoka-jō).
4dd2720407df2540.zh: 佐敷城是戰國時代的山城式日本城郭，位於日本熊本縣葦北町。其遺址自2008年起被列為國家史跡保護，又稱佐敷花岡城。

4dd3ba3cb86f7748.en: Mishima (Japanese: 見島, Hepburn: Mishima), is an island in the Hagi Archipelago in Hagi, in Yamaguchi Prefecture in the Chūgoku region of south-western Honshu, Japan. It lies in the Sea of Japan, approximately 44 km (27 mi) from Hagi. It has a surface area of approximately 7.73 km2 (2.98 sq mi), and a population of 829 in 458 households.
4dd3ba3cb86f7748.zh: 見島是位於日本本州西南部中國地方山口縣萩市萩諸島中的島嶼。位於日本海，距萩約44公里（27英里）。面積約7.73平方公里（2.98平方英里），人口829人，共458戶。

4dff838e131cc6b3.en: In Nara Prefecture, "Iro-gohan" refers to soy sauce-flavored mixed rice. The history of mixed rice dates back to the Nara period when rice was mixed with "awa" (foxtail millet) to increase its volume, and it was called "awa gohan." Mixed rice is said to have originated as a way to save rice during times when rice was precious by cooking it with various ingredients to conserve it.
4dff838e131cc6b3.zh: 在奈良縣，「色ご飯」是指醬油調味的什錦炊飯。什錦炊飯的歷史可追溯至奈良時代，當時為了增加分量而在米中混入「粟」（小米），稱為「粟ご飯」。據說什錦炊飯起源於米糧珍貴的年代，人們將米與各種食材一起炊煮以節省用米。

4e04ddc38f50f25b.en: Shimagawa Dam is a dam in the Gunma Prefecture of Japan.
4e04ddc38f50f25b.zh: 四万川ダム是位於日本群馬縣的水壩。

4e23f548b269db21.en: Tomburi is the dried, peeled outer skin of the 1 to 2 mm green fruit of the Houki-Gi(Kochia tree of the Akazaceae family) and known as "caviar of the field" because of its fish roe-like texture. It is said that the name "Toh-buriko" became "Tomburi" because it resembles the roe of Toh-no-Buriko(Sandfish) which derived from “Toh” (Tang dynasty) has been eaten in Akita for centuries.
4e23f548b269db21.zh: とんぶり是將藜科植物ホウキギ（地膚）直徑1至2公釐的綠色果實乾燥後去除外皮而成，因口感類似魚卵，被稱為「田裡的魚子醬」。據說因外觀類似源自「唐」的唐ブリコ（叉牙魚卵），「唐ブリコ」之名轉為「とんぶり」，在秋田已食用數百年。

4e2878c7838cf9f1.en: Kashiya Yokocho (Penny Candy Lane) is a shopping street in Kawagoe City, Saitama Prefecture. Confectionery stores including penny candy stores line both sides of the street.
4e2878c7838cf9f1.zh: 菓子屋橫丁是位於埼玉縣川越市的商店街，街道兩側林立著包括粗點心店在內的糕點店。

4e2e2fd0db9ee69b.en: Hachikokuyama (八国山緑地, Hachikokuyama Ryōkuchi) is a ridge and park in Higashimurayama, Tokyo along its border with Tokorozawa, Saitama. Its name translates literally into English as "Eight Country Mountain" since, in the past, one could view the eight surrounding provinces surrounding Musashi Province from its top including Suruga, Kai, Izu, Sagami, Hitachi, Kozuke, Shimotsuke, and Shinano. The park was opened in 1990. In Japanese it is designated as a ryokuchi (緑地, green zone) instead of a park.
4e2e2fd0db9ee69b.zh: 八国山緑地（八国山緑地）是位於東京都東村山市、與埼玉縣所澤市交界處的山脊及公園。名稱字面意思為「八國之山」，因為過去從山頂可以眺望武藏國周圍的八個令制國，包括駿河、甲斐、伊豆、相模、常陸、上野、下野及信濃。公園於1990年開放。在日文中，這裡被定為「緑地」（綠地）而非公園。

4e31597ccf7bf1f9.en: Lake Tōgō (東郷池, Tōgō-ike) is a brackish lake located in the town of Yurihama, Tottori Prefecture in the San'in Region of Japan. It has a circumference of 12 kilometers and is separated from the Sea of Japan by a narrow coastal strip.
4e31597ccf7bf1f9.zh: 東鄉池（東郷池，Tōgō-ike）是位於日本山陰地方鳥取縣湯梨濱町的半鹹水湖，周長12公里，與日本海之間隔著一道狹窄的海岸地帶。

4e46b4e53f411131.en: When you think of Japanese New Year’s dishes, osechi or zoni may come to mind but in the Amami island region, “sangon” is eaten instead. The name comes from the three dishes that are served: a rice cake soup served in a lacquered red bowl, sashimi, and chicken or pork soup served in a black bowl.The red bowl, sashimi, and black bowl are eaten in this order, and a cup of shochu is passed around all family members to sip in between each meal.
4e46b4e53f411131.zh: 說到日本的新年料理，可能會想到御節料理或雜煮，但在奄美群島地區，吃的是「三獻」。名稱來自端上的三道料理：盛在紅色漆碗中的年糕湯、生魚片，以及盛在黑色碗中的雞肉或豬肉湯。依紅碗、生魚片、黑碗的順序食用，每道之間全家人輪流啜飲一杯燒酎。

4e4d3993d6308b3e.en: Hijiri Aviation Museum (聖博物館, Hijiri hakubutsukan) is a local history museum located in Omi, Nagano. The museum was opened by the village of Omi on July 20, 1965, to contain displays of local natural history (birds, fish, insects, mineral samples and plants) and human history (Buddhist statues, historical documents and records pertaining to Omi Village). It was expanded on November 19, 1971, with the addition of an aviation pavilion and a number of outdoor static exhibits of former Japan Self-Defense Forces aircraft.
4e4d3993d6308b3e.zh: 聖博物館是位於長野縣麻績村的地方歷史博物館。博物館由麻績村於1965年7月20日開設，展示當地自然史（鳥類、魚類、昆蟲、礦物標本及植物）與人類歷史（佛像、與麻績村相關的史料及紀錄）。1971年11月19日擴建，增設航空館，並在戶外靜態展示多架日本自衛隊退役飛機。

4e679fa70d67f315.en: Yoichi distillery (Japanese: 余市蒸溜所, Hepburn: Yoichi jōryūsho) is a Japanese whisky distillery.  It is located at Yoichi, (余市町, Yoichi-chō) a town in the Yoichi District, Shiribeshi Subprefecture, Hokkaido, Japan.
4e679fa70d67f315.zh: 余市蒸溜所是日本威士忌蒸餾廠，位於日本北海道後志綜合振興局余市郡的余市町。

4e7436102f85dcdd.en: Namioka Castle (浪岡城, Namioka jō) was a Muromachi period Japanese castle located in what is now the city of Aomori, Aomori Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of far northern Japan. The ruins were designated a National Historic Site in 1940 by the Japanese government.
4e7436102f85dcdd.zh: 浪岡城是室町時代的日本城郭，位於日本最北部東北地方、今青森縣青森市境內。城跡於1940年由日本政府指定為國家史跡。

4e857f6086af100e.en: Ankoromochi is a flat dumpling made of wheat flour and shiratama (white bean curd) flour with an (sweet) bean paste. With its simple taste, it is a local dish that has been enjoyed by people of all ages, from children to the elderly.
4e857f6086af100e.zh: 這是一種以小麥粉和白玉粉製成的扁平糰子，搭配紅豆餡（甜豆沙）。味道樸實，是從小孩到長者各年齡層都喜愛的鄉土料理。

4e95136cdf5ecd6e.en: Bandai City (万代シテイ) is a commercial district in Chūō-ku, Niigata City. It is located north-west of Niigata Station, and faces the Shinano River.
4e95136cdf5ecd6e.zh: 万代シテイ是新潟市中央區的商業區，位於新潟車站西北方，面向信濃川。

4e9cc66a5f99a4c0.en: Hyakusai-ji (百済寺) is a Buddhist temple in the Hyakusaiji neighborhood of the city of Higashiōmi, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Tendai school of Japanese Buddhism, and together with Kongōrin-ji and Saimyō-ji is regard as one of the "Three Great Temples" east of Lake Biwa.  It was designated a National Historic Site in 2008.
4e9cc66a5f99a4c0.zh: 百濟寺是位於日本滋賀縣東近江市百濟寺町的佛教寺院，屬日本佛教天台宗，與金剛輪寺、西明寺並稱為琵琶湖東岸的「三大寺院」。2008年被指定為國家史跡。

4ea12bf4248fa9f2.en: Tai (sea bream) has long been an indispensable fish for celebrations and other occasions. Kumamoto prefecture has an abundance of fresh sea bream, and its consumption is always among the highest in the country. It is popularly served in a variety of ways, including sashimi, salt-grilled fish, and sea bream chazuke (rice in green tea). In the Amakusa region, “Tai Somen” (also known as ‘Tai Men’) involves making a broth from the head and bones leftover after filleting sea bream and pouring the broth over somen noodles before eating.
4ea12bf4248fa9f2.zh: 鯛魚自古以來就是慶祝等場合不可或缺的魚。熊本縣有豐富的新鮮鯛魚，消費量一直名列全國前茅。常見的吃法很多，包括生魚片、鹽烤及鯛魚茶泡飯（綠茶泡飯）。在天草地區，「鯛そうめん」（又稱「鯛麺」）是用鯛魚切片後剩下的魚頭和魚骨熬成高湯，淋在素麵上食用。

4ef4b08d04c82173.en: "Tobitsuki Dango" is a traditional sweets used to be cooked at home commonly as an offering for ancestors during "obon". It looks like "ohagi" (=rice ball coated with sweet red beans) at a glance, but it is a mochi made from glutinous rice with 10% of regular rice, and coated with "sasage" (=cowpea) simmered with keeping its shape. It is popular with simple and slightly sweet taste. "Sasage" is soaked into sugar water after simmered in water so that its outside skin won’t be broken. It tastes sweet these days, and it could be salty before.
4ef4b08d04c82173.zh: 「とびつき団子」是傳統點心，過去家家戶戶常在「盂蘭盆節」時製作，作為供奉祖先的供品。乍看之下很像「おはぎ」（裹上甜紅豆的飯糰），但其實是用糯米加入一成粳米做成的麻糬，外層裹上保持顆粒完整燉煮的「豇豆」。這種點心以樸素、微甜的口味受到喜愛。豇豆先用水煮過，再浸入糖水，以免外皮破裂。現在的口味偏甜，以前則可能是鹹的。

4efdd5a044a7cad3.en: Hōrin-ji (法輪寺; the 'temple of the Dharma Wheel') is a Shingon Buddhist temple in Arashiyama, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan.  The honorary sangō prefix is Chifuku-san (智福山).  The temple is said to have been constructed by Gyōki in 713 AD, and was originally named Kadonoi-dera (葛井寺).  It is dedicated to Ākāśagarbha (Sanskrit: आकाशकर्भ; Japanese: 虚空蔵, Japanese: kokūzō) the bodhisattva (Sanskrit: बोधिसत्त्वः; Japanese: 菩薩) of the boundless space.
4efdd5a044a7cad3.zh: 法輪寺（「法輪之寺」）是位於日本京都府嵐山的真言宗佛寺。山號為智福山。相傳此寺由行基於西元713年創建，原名葛井寺。寺中供奉虛空藏菩薩（梵語：आकाशकर्भ；日語：虚空蔵），為象徵無邊虛空的菩薩（梵語：बोधिसत्त्वः；日語：菩薩）。

4efddce7d27cf448.en: Yamada Castle (山田城, Yamada jō; Okinawan: Yamada Gushiku) was a Ryūkyūan gusuku fortification located in the village of  Onna, Okinawa Prefecture, Japan. It has been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 2008. It is famous for being the birthplace of the Ryūkyūan general Gosamaru.
4efddce7d27cf448.zh: 山田城（山田城，Yamada jō；沖繩語：Yamada Gushiku）是位於日本沖繩縣恩納村的琉球御城（グスク）防禦設施。自2008年起由中央政府指定為國家史跡加以保護。此地以琉球將領護佐丸的出生地而聞名。

4f08c4ff7f711376.en: The Toho region, composed of Takeda City and Bungo-ono City in the southwestern part of Oita Prefecture, is surrounded by the Zaozan Range, Aso Caldera, and Kuju Mountains, with Miyazaki and Kumamoto Prefectures neighboring across the mountains. "Sake Manju" is a regional confection enjoyed during summer events in the Toho region. Its unique feature is its expansion due to fermentation powered by rice koji.
4f08c4ff7f711376.zh: 由大分縣西南部竹田市與豐後大野市組成的豐肥地區，被祖母山系、阿蘇火山口與九重山群環繞，隔著山與宮崎縣、熊本縣相鄰。「酒まんじゅう」是豐肥地區夏季活動時享用的鄉土點心，其特色在於利用米麴發酵而膨脹。

4f17cd9c3d91d544.en: ”Yudedago” is a corrupted form of the term “yudedango” and refers to sweets made from wheat flour and brown sugar. It is sometimes called “flat dago.” In Saga Prefecture, double cropping has long been practiced, and since wheat was grown after the rice was harvested, many farmers constantly had home-grown wheat flour and rice flour on hand. Therefore, they were often used for daily meals and easy-to-make snacks, and “yudedago” is one of such local dishes.
4f17cd9c3d91d544.zh: 「ゆでだご」是「ゆでだんご」的訛音，指用小麥粉和黑糖做成的點心。有時也稱為「平だご」。佐賀縣自古實行二期作，收割稻米後會種植小麥，因此許多農家手邊經常有自家生產的小麥粉和米粉。這些粉類常用於日常餐食和簡單的點心，「ゆでだご」就是這類鄉土料理之一。

4f1fad776df4af35.en: The Ōhashi Junction (大橋ジャンクション) is a covered one-quadrant Interchange of the Shuto Expressway system in Tokyo. It connects the Shibuya Route and the Central Circular Route (C2). It was in construction from 2003 to 2013. It was partially opened in 2010 and fully completed in 2015. The completed interchange links the Central Circular Route (Shuto Expressway) through the Yamate Tunnel as far as the Bayshore Route in Shinagawa. The cost of the project was $90 billion yen.
4f1fad776df4af35.zh: 大橋交流道（大橋ジャンクション）是東京首都高速道路系統中一座有頂蓋的單象限交流道，連接澀谷線與中央環狀線（C2）。工程自2003年進行至2013年，2010年部分通車，2015年全面完工。完工後的交流道經由山手隧道將中央環狀線（首都高速道路）連接至品川的灣岸線。工程經費為900億日圓。

4f5552a9e96f0910.en: Hikarigaoka Park (光が丘公園, Hikarigaoka Kōen) is a metropolitan park located in the Hikarigaoka and Asahichō areas of Nerima Ward and the Akatsuka-shinmachi area of Itabashi Ward in Tokyo, Japan. Over 98% of the park lies within Nerima Ward, with only the north-eastern corner extending into Itabashi Ward. With an area of 607,823 square metres (150.196 acres), it is one of the largest metropolitan parks in Tokyo.
4f5552a9e96f0910.zh: 光が丘公園（光が丘公園）是位於日本東京都練馬區光丘、旭町及板橋區赤塚新町的都立公園。公園98%以上位於練馬區內，僅東北角延伸至板橋區。面積607,823平方公尺（150.196英畝），是東京最大的都立公園之一。

4f5626fc24fc1b50.en: Ōmiya Velodrome (大宮競輪場, Ōmiya Keirinjyō) is a velodrome located in Ōmiya-ku, Saitama that conducts pari-mutuel Keirin racing - one of Japan's four authorized "Public Sports" (公営競技, kōei kyōgi) where gambling is permitted. Its Keirin identification number for betting purposes is 25# (25 sharp).
4f5626fc24fc1b50.zh: 大宮競輪場是位於埼玉市大宮區的自行車競賽場，舉辦彩池投注制的競輪賽事。競輪是日本四種獲准博弈的「公營競技」之一。其投注用的競輪場代號為25#（25 sharp）。

4f5a68595d32af32.en: ‘Tako Momiuri’ is a salad marinated octopus, round-sliced cucumber salted and rubbed in salt, and Japanese vinegarette. Octopus is used wishing to grow rice grounded on the field, like octopus suckers sticking strong, and the dish is offered to the god of paddy fields in the end of the harvest to express appreciation for the year. Octopus is considered as a lucky food and often eaten in the auspicious occasions like weddings or shrine visits for babies.
4f5a68595d32af32.zh: 「蛸もみうり」是將章魚、切圓片後以鹽搓揉的小黃瓜，以日式醋汁醃拌而成的涼拌菜。使用章魚，是希望稻子能像章魚吸盤牢牢吸附般在田裡扎根生長；這道料理會在收成結束時供奉給田神，以表達對這一年的感謝。章魚被視為吉祥食物，常在婚禮或嬰兒參拜神社等喜慶場合食用。

4f6e4231d275d45f.en: Kunchi is a festival found around the northern area of Kyūshū including Saga prefecture. All called Okunchi, this is an autumn festival wherein the first crop of the year is offered to the local deity and thanks is given to the gods in heaven and earth for the bumper crop of grains. In the former town of Imari in what is now Imari City, Kunchi is also observed every year in October, where mikoshi and danjiri shrines are brought together for a so-called fight festival.
4f6e4231d275d45f.zh: くんち是包括佐賀縣在內的九州北部一帶都有的祭典。各地都稱為おくんち，是將當年最早收成的作物供奉給當地神明，並感謝天地神祇讓穀物豐收的秋季祭典。在現今伊萬里市的舊伊萬里町，每年10月也會舉行くんち，將神轎與だんじり聚在一起，進行所謂的「喧嘩祭」。

4f6eff92e0a4d75e.en: "Iidako(= Ocellated octopus)" are often caught in Okayama Prefecture in the Shimotsui area in the Kojima region of Kurashiki City in southern Japan. It is named "iidako" (meaning "rice octopus") because it carries many rice-grain-shaped eggs inside its body.The eggs are about 5-6 mm in diameter and each octopus contains about 200-500 eggs. Add salt, fir thoroughly, and drain before boiling. "Iidako" have ink, but even though squid ink is frowned upon, "the ink is worth the price of an iidako".
4f6eff92e0a4d75e.zh: 「飯蛸（短蛸）」在日本南部岡山縣倉敷市兒島地區的下津井一帶經常捕獲。因體內帶有許多米粒狀的卵，而被稱為「飯蛸」（意為「米章魚」）。卵的直徑約5至6公釐，每隻約有200至500顆卵。烹煮前加鹽充分搓揉並瀝乾。「飯蛸」有墨汁，雖然烏賊墨不受歡迎，但「飯蛸的墨才是值得的部分」。

4f74d5b482ccd12f.en: Shirasu are the 1-2 month old young of Japanese anchovy and Japanese pilchard, and Shizuoka Prefecture boasts the largest catch of shirasu in Japan.
4f74d5b482ccd12f.zh: 魩仔魚是日本鯷與遠東擬沙丁魚出生1至2個月的幼魚，靜岡縣的魩仔魚漁獲量為日本第一。

4f76d209dabc044b.en: The Ōita Motomachi Stone Buddhas (大分元町石仏, Ōita Motomachi sekibutsu) is a group of religious statues carved in bas-relief into a tuff cliff in Motomachi neighborhood of the city of Ōita, Ōita Prefecture on the island of Kyushu, Japan.  The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1934.
4f76d209dabc044b.zh: 大分元町石佛（大分元町石仏）是位於日本九州大分縣大分市元町地區、以淺浮雕刻於凝灰岩崖壁上的一組宗教雕像。1934年被指定為國家史跡。

4fa08b82b5326883.en: Einōsan Castle (永納山城, Einōsan-jō) was an ancient castle (also known as a Korean-style fortresses in Japan (朝鮮式山城, Chōsen-shiki yamajiro) located in the city of Saijō, Ehime, Japan.  Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2005 with the area under protection expanded in 2007.
4fa08b82b5326883.zh: 永納山城是位於日本愛媛縣西條市的古代城郭（也稱為朝鮮式山城）。其遺跡自2005年起被列為國家史跡加以保護，2007年擴大了保護範圍。

4fb7bfc6ad38e3e9.en: Mount Fuppushi (風不死岳, Fuppushi-dake) is a dormant volcano located in Shikotsu-Toya National Park in Hokkaido, Japan. It sits adjacent to Mount Tarumae and opposite Mount Eniwa. Mount Fuppushi is on the south shore of Lake Shikotsu, the caldera lake that spawned the volcanoes.
4fb7bfc6ad38e3e9.zh: 風不死岳是位於日本北海道支笏洞爺國立公園內的休火山，與樽前山相鄰，與惠庭岳相對。風不死岳位於支笏湖南岸，支笏湖即是孕育這些火山的破火山口湖。

4fc8f986618df009.en: Jōei-ji (常栄寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Miyanoshita neighborhood of the city of Yamaguchi, Yamaguchi Prefecture, in the San'yō region of Japan. The temple belongs to the Tofuku-ji branch of the Rinzai school of Japanese Zen and its honzon is a statue of Senju Kannon Bosatsu. The temple is also commonly called "Sesshu-ji", as it is famous for its garden, which is attributed to Sesshū Tōyō, which has been designated as a both a National Historic Site and a National Place of Scenic Beauty in 1926.
4fc8f986618df009.zh: 常栄寺是一座佛教寺院，位於日本山陽地方山口縣山口市宮野下。寺院屬於日本禪宗臨濟宗東福寺派，本尊為千手觀音菩薩像。此寺也常被稱為「雪舟寺」，因其庭園相傳出自雪舟等楊之手而聞名，該庭園於1926年同時被指定為國家史跡及國家名勝。

4fec1190ce713298.en: The Kakita River (柿田川, Kakita-gawa) is a river flowing through the town of Shimizu in the Suntō District, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan.
4fec1190ce713298.zh: 柿田川是流經日本靜岡縣駿東郡清水町的河川。

4ff21c6045ba0423.en: Isaza-mame" is a tsukudani (food boiled in soy sauce) dish made by combining isaza, a type of goby endemic to Lake Biwa, and soybeans. Isaza-mame" is a local dish that has spread throughout the prefecture, especially in the Kohoku region. Isaza, which is harvested from September to April in autumn, winter and spring, and soybeans, which are so rich in protein and nutritious that they are called the meat of the field, go together very well, and are still made in every household.
4ff21c6045ba0423.zh: 「いさざ豆」是將琵琶湖特有的鰕虎魚いさざ與黃豆一起做成的佃煮（用醬油煮的食物）。「いさざ豆」是流傳於全縣、特別是湖北地區的鄉土料理。秋、冬、春季9月至4月捕撈的いさざ，與富含蛋白質、營養豐富到被稱為「田裡的肉」的黃豆非常搭配，至今仍是家家戶戶都會製作的料理。

4ff956a742683cc7.en: Mount Myōjin or Myōjin-ga-take (Japanese: 明神ヶ岳) is a mountain with an altitude of 1,169 meters on the border of Minamiashigara and Hakone, Kanagawa.
4ff956a742683cc7.zh: 明神岳是位於神奈川縣南足柄市與箱根町交界的山，海拔1,169公尺。

4ffd2a7231ee9360.en: Furano Ski Resort (富良野スキー場, Furano Sukii-jō), also known as Furano Ski Area, is a resort in Furano, Hokkaido, Japan, owned and operated by Prince Hotels. The resort has hosted events by the International Ski Federation (FIS) Alpine Ski World Cup. In recent years, it has hosted the mid-February Snowboarding World Cup. Growing interest from international winter sports enthusiasts, particularly from Australia, has led to an annual rise in tourist numbers.
