4ffd2a7231ee9360.zh: 富良野スキー場，又稱Furano Ski Area，是位於日本北海道富良野的度假區，由王子飯店擁有並經營。曾舉辦國際滑雪總會（FIS）高山滑雪世界盃賽事，近年則於2月中旬舉辦單板滑雪世界盃。國際冬季運動愛好者（特別是來自澳洲者）的關注日增，使遊客人數逐年上升。

50028307d21768ff.en: Bonito, the prefectural fish of Kochi, is a common foodstuff eaten on a daily basis. “Bonito tataki " was a fisherman's meal on board a boat, and was later introduced to the public. At a time when preservation techniques were not available, a method of “tataki” had been developed as a way of eating less fresh bonito on board. “Bonito tataki” reduces the fishy smell of bonito. The word "tataki" means "tataku (“beat” in Japanese) as the name implies.
50028307d21768ff.zh: 鰹魚是高知的縣魚，是日常食用的普遍食材。「鰹魚たたき」原本是漁夫在船上的餐食，後來才傳到一般民眾。在沒有保存技術的年代，「たたき」是在船上食用不夠新鮮的鰹魚而發展出的方法。「鰹魚たたき」能減少鰹魚的腥味。「たたき」顧名思義，就是「たたく」（日文「拍打」之意）。

500a30445f1fcf19.en: "Abekawa Mochi" is a regional dish in the Chubu region, with Shizuoka City at its center. It consists of freshly made mochi (rice cakes) coated with kinako (roasted soybean flour) mixed with sugar. The name "Abekawa Mochi" is derived from the Abekawa River that flows through the prefecture.
500a30445f1fcf19.zh: 安倍川もち是以靜岡市為中心的中部地區鄉土料理，做法是在剛搗好的麻糬上裹滿拌了砂糖的黃豆粉。名稱來自流經縣內的安倍川。

500b2cefe3fa633e.en: The Ou Mountains at the border of Akita and Iwate prefectures has a very cold and snowy climate. In this area, diverse types of “sansai” (=wild mountain vegetables) grow in the spring, and mushrooms and freshwater fish are available in the autumn. “Mizu” (=wild nettle) is a wild mountain vegetable that grows in clusters along streams of mountainous areas where the water is clear. The leaves of the vegetable are a dark green and the stem becomes reddish closer to the root.
500b2cefe3fa633e.zh: 位於秋田縣與岩手縣交界的奧羽山脈，氣候非常寒冷多雪。這一帶春天生長多種山菜，秋天則有菇類與淡水魚。「みず」是一種山菜，叢生於水質清澈的山區溪流沿岸。葉子呈深綠色，莖越靠近根部越偏紅。

500d445b93177b56.en: Nakaenoshima (中江ノ島) is an uninhabited island 2 km off the coast of Hirado, Japan. It is located in the East China Sea.
500d445b93177b56.zh: 中江ノ島是位於日本平戶外海2公里處的無人島，位於東海。

50305ca8118f8b68.en: In the Motoyoshi region of Kesennuma, Bonito fish flocks have been migrating to the vicinity of the coast and were landed in large quantities since long ago. Most of them were distributed as salted bonito, but the marinade of Salted bonito, was called "Kigaki,".
50305ca8118f8b68.zh: 在氣仙沼的本吉地區，自古以來鰹魚群便會洄游到沿岸附近，並大量上岸。其中大多以鹽漬鰹魚的形式流通，而鹽漬鰹魚的醃汁被稱為「きがき」。

5031d19f7269054b.en: Nagahama Castle (長浜城, Nagahama-jō) was a Sengoku period flatland-style Japanese castle located in what is now part of the city of Numazu, Shizuoka prefecture. The ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1988, with the area under protection extended in 2002.
5031d19f7269054b.zh: 長浜城是戰國時代的平城式日本城郭，位於今靜岡縣沼津市境內。城跡自1988年起被指定為國家史跡受到保護，2002年擴大保護範圍。

5060c4c36f7aa4a9.en: Iwakisan Kōgoishi (石城山神籠石) was an ancient castle (also known as a Korean-style fortress (朝鮮式山城, Chōsen-shiki yamajiro) located on Mount Iwaki (石城山, Iwaki-san) in the city of Hikari, Yamaguchi Prefecture, in the San'yō region of Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1951.
5060c4c36f7aa4a9.zh: 石城山神籠石是一座古代城郭（又稱朝鮮式山城），位於日本山陽地方山口縣光市的石城山。其遺址自1951年起被列為國家史跡加以保護。

5065cf1c1cea6033.en: Saiki City, the largest city in Kyushu, is known as a fishing town blessed with an abundance of seafood. Saiki City is responsible for approximately 70% of the prefecture's fisheries production, with aquaculture, especially yellowtail and flatfish, accounting for the majority of the prefecture's total production. Fishing boats are also active in the fishing industry, which includes seine netting, bottom trawling, boat seine netting, pole-and-line fishing, and even diving.
5065cf1c1cea6033.zh: 九州面積最大的佐伯市，是以海產豐富而聞名的漁業城市。佐伯市約占全縣漁業產量的70%，其中養殖業，尤其是青甘魚和比目魚，占全縣總產量的大部分。漁船作業也很活躍，包括圍網、底拖網、船曳網、竿釣，甚至潛水捕撈。

506ea6533b5834a4.en: "Dengara" is a traditional confection, wrapping sweet bean paste-filled rice cakes in magnolia leaves. In the villages of Higashiyoshino and Kawakami, there is a custom of making chimaki (rice dumplings) and "dengara" during the Boys' Festival. Both are created with the wish for a boy's success, prosperity of descendants, and safe growth. The shapes of these confections are said to symbolize boys.In Kawakami, surrounded by mountains on all sides, there are no rice paddies to cultivate rice.
506ea6533b5834a4.zh: 「でんがら」是用朴葉包裹包有甜豆沙餡的餅製成的傳統點心。在東吉野村與川上村，有在端午節製作粽子和「でんがら」的習俗。兩者都寄託了祈求男孩出人頭地、子孫繁榮和平安成長的心願。據說這些點心的形狀象徵男孩。四面環山的川上村沒有可種植稻米的水田。

507061a8710b03fc.en: Yugeshima (弓削島) is an inhabited island located in northeastern Ehime Prefecture, Japan, in the Seto Inland Sea between Shikoku and Honshu. The island is part of the Geiyo Islands archipelago, and is administratively the seat of the town of Kamijima, Ehime.
507061a8710b03fc.zh: 弓削島（弓削島）是位於日本愛媛縣東北部的有人島，位於四國與本州之間的瀨戶內海。該島屬於藝予諸島，行政上為愛媛縣上島町的町公所所在地。

5073961e4f6309e8.en: Tokorozawa Sakura Town (Japanese: ところざわサクラタウン, Hepburn: Tokorozawa Sakura Taun) is a pop cultural attraction complex in Tokorozawa, Saitama, Japan which opened in the fall of 2020.  It is a joint project of the Kadokawa Corporation and the city of Tokorozawa. The development has five main components; the Kadokawa Culture Center, the Da Vinci store, the EJ Anime hotel (closed down in 2022) Japan Pavilion, and the Musashino Reiwa Shrine. It had a partial opening on April 1, 2020, and opened fully on November 6 of the same year.
5073961e4f6309e8.zh: ところざわサクラタウン是位於日本埼玉縣所澤市的流行文化綜合設施，於2020年秋季開幕。該設施由KADOKAWA株式會社與所澤市共同推動。開發案有五個主要部分：角川文化中心、達文西商店、EJ動畫飯店（2022年已歇業）、Japan Pavilion，以及武藏野令和神社。2020年4月1日部分開幕，同年11月6日全面開幕。

50838446cb7ca5f5.en: Cape Kamoda (蒲生田岬, Kamoda-misaki) is a headland at the easternmost point of the Japanese island of Shikoku, in the city of Anan, Tokushima Prefecture. The promontory extends into the Kii Channel and is situated within Muroto-Anan Kaigan Quasi-National Park. Above the cape is Cape Kamoda Lighthouse, which started operating in 1924; from its observatory it is possible to see Cape Hi in Wakayama Prefecture, Ōnaruto Bridge, and Awaji Island. In 2010 a stone sculpture known as "Wave Song" (「波の詩」) was erected nearby.
50838446cb7ca5f5.zh: 蒲生田岬是位於德島縣阿南市的岬角，為日本四國島的最東端。岬角伸入紀伊水道，位於室戶阿南海岸國定公園內。岬上有1924年啟用的蒲生田岬燈塔，從其展望台可望見和歌山縣的日御埼、大鳴門橋及淡路島。2010年，附近設置了一座名為「波の詩」的石雕。

509d709776fdcea0.en: Hamada City and Masuda City are located in the western part of Shimane Prefecture, facing the Sea of Japan. Iwami Sanda, which includes both cities and Ota, is the main city of the Iwami region. Both cities have thriving fishing industries. Hamada City has grown as a core fishing ground in the San'in region since the end of World War II, increasing its production through offshore trawl and purse seine fisheries. At its peak in 1990, the city landed approximately 200,000 tons of fish.
509d709776fdcea0.zh: 濱田市與益田市位於島根縣西部，面向日本海。包含這兩市與大田市的「石見三田」是石見地區的主要城市。兩市的漁業都很興盛。濱田市自二次世界大戰結束後，透過近海拖網與圍網漁業增加產量，發展成為山陰地區的核心漁場。在1990年的高峰期，該市的漁獲卸貨量約達20萬噸。

50cb5293f2864cfa.en: The Ayaragigō Site (綾羅木郷遺跡, Ayaragigō iseki) is an archaeological site with traces of a Yayoi period settlement, located in the Ayaragi neighborhood of the city of Shimonoseki, Yamaguchi in the San'yō region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site in 1969 with the area under protection expanded in 1981.
50cb5293f2864cfa.zh: 綾羅木郷遺跡是一處留有彌生時代聚落遺跡的考古遺址，位於日本山陽地方山口縣下關市綾羅木。1969年被指定為國家史跡，1981年擴大保護範圍。

50ce16c296c42417.en: Cod is an indispensable winter delicacy in Ishikawa Prefecture. In the region, the term "tara" often refers to Pacific cod (madara) more than Alaskan pollock (sketoudara).Nanao City, historically a thriving port town, is renowned for its winter yellowtail, but for locals, cod is a more familiar ingredient. Due to the intricate geography of Nanao Bay, cod, especially during the spawning season, has been abundantly caught.
50ce16c296c42417.zh: 鱈魚是石川縣不可或缺的冬季美味。在當地，「たら」一詞通常是指真鱈，而非黃線狹鱈（すけとうだら）。歷史上作為港町而繁榮的七尾市以寒鰤聞名，但對當地人而言，鱈魚是更為熟悉的食材。由於七尾灣地形複雜，鱈魚，尤其是產卵期的鱈魚，向來漁獲豐富。

50ce873a6bc7fd7e.en: The Nanatsujima islets are a group of uninhabited small islands with a collective land area of 24 ha. They lie in the Sea of Japan about 20 km off the northern tip of the Noto Peninsula in Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan. The archipelago comprises two islet groups; a northern group (Tatsujima, Ohshima and Karimatajima), and a southern group (Akashima, Aramikojima, Eboshijima and Mikuriyajima). They are composed of volcanic rocks, either andesite or tuff breccia.
50ce873a6bc7fd7e.zh: 七ツ島是一群無人小島，總面積24公頃，位於日本海，距日本石川縣能登半島北端約20公里。群島分為兩組：北群（竜島、大島、狩又島）與南群（赤島、荒三子島、烏帽子島、御厨島）。島嶼由火山岩構成，為安山岩或凝灰角礫岩。

50d80cbd2ab776b0.en: Rokkakudō (六角堂), was a hexagonal wooden retreat overlooking the sea along the Izura coast in Kitaibaraki, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan. Dating to 1905, it was part of the Izura Institute of Arts & Culture, Ibaraki University. Constructed in the sukiya-zukuri style, single-storey, with a tiled roof, an area of nine square metres, and painted red, it was designed by scholar and critic Okakura Tenshin who spent time there with painter Yokoyama Taikan. In 2003 it was added to the Tangible Cultural Properties Register.
50d80cbd2ab776b0.zh: 六角堂是一座六角形的木造休憩建築，位於日本茨城縣北茨城市五浦海岸，面向大海。建於1905年，屬於茨城大學五浦美術文化研究所。建築採數寄屋造樣式，單層、瓦頂，面積九平方公尺，外漆紅色，由學者兼評論家岡倉天心設計，他曾與畫家橫山大觀在此度過時光。2003年登錄為有形文化財。

50dd5181c591eda0.en: This noodle dish originated in Yokohama, Japan, and consists of stir-fried vegetables such as bean sprouts, Chinese cabbage, and pork in a thickened broth topped with ramen noodles.
50dd5181c591eda0.zh: 這道麵食發源於日本橫濱，在拉麵上鋪上以豆芽菜、白菜、豬肉等拌炒後勾芡的湯料。

50ec69e5717c0915.en: Numata Castle (沼田城, Numata-jō) is a Japanese castle located in Numata, northern Gunma Prefecture, Japan. At the end of the Edo period, Numata Castle was home to the Toki clan, daimyō of Numata Domain, but the castle was ruled by various clans over its history, and is noted as the site of a major battle in the Sengoku period. The castle was also known as "Kurauchi-jō" (倉内城).
50ec69e5717c0915.zh: 沼田城是位於日本群馬縣北部沼田市的日本城郭。江戶時代末期，沼田城為沼田藩大名土岐氏的居城，但在歷史上曾由多個氏族統治，並以戰國時代一場重大戰役的發生地而聞名。此城又稱「倉內城」（倉内城）。

50f06eaaa2d357c7.en: Saragamine Renpō Prefectural Natural Park (皿ヶ嶺連峰県立自然公園, Saragamine Renpō kenritsu shizen-kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Ehime Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1967, the park spans the borders of the municipalities of Iyo, Kumakōgen, Matsuyama, Tobe, and Tōon. The park's central feature is the eponymous Saragamine mountain range, Mount Saragamine itself lying at the western end of the Ishizuchi Mountains.
50f06eaaa2d357c7.zh: 皿ヶ嶺連峰縣立自然公園（皿ヶ嶺連峰県立自然公園）是位於日本愛媛縣的縣立自然公園。公園設立於1967年，範圍跨伊予市、久萬高原町、松山市、砥部町及東溫市。公園的主要景觀為同名的皿ヶ嶺連峰，皿ヶ嶺本身位於石鎚山脈西端。

5106b6c06c706c37.ja: 伊我理神社（いがりじんじゃ）は、伊勢神宮豊受大神宮（外宮）の末社。外宮の宮域林に鎮座する。
5106b6c06c706c37.zh: 伊我理神社是伊勢神宮豐受大神宮（外宮）的末社，坐落於外宮的宮域林中。

510b227b83ba2102.en: In Ishikawa Prefecture, when people mention "Tara" (Cod), it generally refers to Madara (Pacific cod) rather than Skesodara (Alaska pollock). As the temperature drops and spawning season arrives, Cod caught during this period is considered particularly delicious. Locals often say there's "no wasted part" of the fish, and various parts, from the head to the internal organs, are used in cooking. It can be served as sashimi with kombu(=kelp), and white cod roe is pickled in vinegar.
510b227b83ba2102.zh: 在石川縣，說到「鱈」，一般指的是真鱈（太平洋鱈），而非介黨鱈（阿拉斯加鱈）。隨著氣溫下降、產卵季到來，這段期間捕獲的鱈魚被認為格外美味。當地人常說這種魚「沒有一處浪費」，從頭部到內臟，各個部位都會用於烹調。可以做成昆布締生魚片，白色的鱈魚精巢則以醋醃漬。

512fbec3a22ecd2b.en: The Kobe Anpanman Children's Museum & Mall  (神戸アンパンマンこどもミュージアム＆モール) is an interactive children's museum located in Kobe, Japan dedicated to Takashi Yanase's popular Anpanman franchise. It is one of five such complexes in the country (the others being in Yokohama, Sendai, Nagoya and Fukuoka), and also the newest, having been opened in 2013.
512fbec3a22ecd2b.zh: 神戸アンパンマンこどもミュージアム&モール是位於日本神戶的互動式兒童博物館，以柳瀨嵩的人氣作品《麵包超人》為主題。全國共有五座同類設施（其他位於橫濱、仙台、名古屋及福岡），本館於2013年開幕，是其中最新的一座。

51306c0b185c27bb.en: Umeda Arts Theater (梅田芸術劇場, Umeda Geijutsu Gekijō) is a Japanese theater located at Chayamachi Applause in Chayamachi, Kita-ku, Osaka, operated by Umeda Arts Theater Co., Ltd. It opened in 1992.
51306c0b185c27bb.zh: 梅田藝術劇場（梅田芸術劇場）是位於大阪市北區茶屋町「茶屋町Applause」內的日本劇場，由梅田藝術劇場株式會社經營，1992年開幕。

513b0f2c3c78170a.en: Ōno Castle (大野城, Ōno-jō) is a Japanese castle located in Ōno, Chita District, Aichi, former Owari Province. It is also known as Miyayama Castle (宮山城).
513b0f2c3c78170a.zh: 大野城是位於愛知縣知多郡大野（舊尾張國）的日本城郭，又稱宮山城。

51464ae7f7195a5c.en: "Kuzumochi" is a transparent, pulpy mochi made from kudzu powder. Kudzu, the raw material of kudzu powder, is a perennial plant of the legume family and is widely distributed throughout Japan from Hokkaido in the north to Kyushu in the south.
51464ae7f7195a5c.zh: 「葛餅」是以葛粉製成的透明、軟Q的餅。葛粉的原料葛是豆科多年生植物，廣泛分布於日本各地，北至北海道、南至九州。

515c0a41e0415ef6.en: Iwate Prefecture boasts top-class catches of autumn salmon in Honshu. In particular, the Tsugaruishi River is a clear stream that flows into the innermost part of Miyako Bay and is famous as a river where salmon swim upstream.
515c0a41e0415ef6.zh: 岩手縣的秋鮭漁獲量在本州名列前茅。其中，津輕石川是流入宮古灣最深處的清流，以鮭魚洄游的河川而聞名。

516231ce3ba2be96.en: Shido-ji (志度寺) is a Buddhist temple in Sanuki, Kagawa, Japan. It is the 86th site of the Shikoku Pilgrimage.
516231ce3ba2be96.zh: 志度寺是位於日本香川縣讚岐市的佛教寺院，為四國遍路第86號札所。

516b2f66079b6918.en: Sainoo temple ruins (斎尾廃寺跡, Sai-no-o Haiji ato) is an archeological site  with the ruins of a Hakuhō period Buddhist temple located in the Tsukishita neighborhood of the town of Kotoura, Tottori prefecture, in the San'in region of Japan. It was designated as a National Historic Site in 1935 with the designation changed to that of a Special National Historic Site in 1952.
516b2f66079b6918.zh: 斎尾廃寺跡是一處考古遺址，有白鳳時代佛寺的遺跡，位於日本山陰地方鳥取縣琴浦町槻下地區。1935年被指定為國家史跡，1952年改為國家特別史跡。

51798799812327d6.en: Salmon that come back to the Hokkaido coast to spawn in the fall or early winter are called "fall salmon," while chum salmon that come back unseasonably in the spring or summer are called "Tokishirazu". In Chinese characters, it is written "時知不" or "時鮭", meaning that the fish is caught regardless of its season. What is different from the common autumn salmon caught in the fall is its birthplace.
51798799812327d6.zh: 秋季或初冬洄游到北海道沿岸產卵的鮭魚稱為「秋鮭」，而在春季或夏季不合時節洄游的白鮭則稱為「トキシラズ」。漢字寫作「時知不」或「時鮭」，意思是不分季節捕獲的魚。與秋季捕獲的一般秋鮭不同之處在於出生地。

517e7ca1a9e4f10d.en: Kasama Nichidō Museum of Art (笠間日動美術館, Kasama Nichidō Bijutsukan) opened in Kasama, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan, in 1972. It was established to celebrate the forty-fifth anniversary of the opening of the Galerie Nichidō (日動画廊), the first commercial art gallery in Japan specialising in yōga or Western-style painting.
517e7ca1a9e4f10d.zh: 笠間日動美術館於1972年在日本茨城縣笠間市開館，為紀念日動畫廊開業四十五週年而設立。日動畫廊是日本第一家專營洋畫（西洋風格繪畫）的商業畫廊。

518a955224c77cb8.en: Mount Iō (硫黄岳, Iō-dake) is a mountain on the border of Chino and Minamimaki, Nagano Prefecture, Japan. This mountain is one of the major mountains of Yatsugatake Mountains. Mount Iō literally means, sulphur mountain.
518a955224c77cb8.zh: 硫黄岳是位於日本長野縣茅野市與南牧村交界的山，為八岳連峰的主要山峰之一。硫黃岳字面意思為硫磺山。

51a12da86eca03be.en: "Bekomochi" has been passed down from generation to generation as a special sweet eaten during the Dragon Boat Festival, and is now eaten as a snack. "Bekomochi" originates from a sweet called "kujiramochi", which is made by steaming non-glutinous rice flour and glutinous rice flour with water and sugar, and was originally introduced by "kitamaebune ships" during the Edo period. In Hokkaido and Aomori Prefecture, people ate "kujiramochi" instead of "kashiwamochi" during the Dragon Boat Festival.
51a12da86eca03be.zh: 「べこもち」一直以來作為端午節食用的特別甜點代代相傳，現在則當作點心食用。「べこもち」源自名為「くじら餅」的甜點，做法是將粳米粉與糯米粉加水和砂糖蒸製而成，最初於江戶時代由「北前船」傳入。在北海道與青森縣，人們在端午節時以「くじら餅」取代「柏餅」。

51b0222e811596ae.en: The Shima ruins (嶋遺跡, Shima iseki) is an archaeological site containing the ruins of a Kofun period (4th to 7th century AD) settlement located in what is now part of the city of Yamagata in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan. The site received protection as a National Historic Site of Japan in 1966.
51b0222e811596ae.zh: 嶋遺跡是一處考古遺址，保存古墳時代（西元4至7世紀）聚落的遺跡，位於日本北部東北地方今山形市境內。該遺址於1966年被指定為日本國家史跡，受到保護。

51f5e3e924dfdc98.en: At first glance, it looks like “Ochazuke” (rice with green tea) with soup stock and wasabi (Japanese horseradish), but underneath the rice there are small pieces of sea bream and vegetables. Various theories remain as to the origins of this way of eating. For example, in the Edo period (1603 - 1868), when people were forced to be frugal and thrifty, they hid their extravagance from people, or they were embarrassed to be seen by others because the ingredients were poorly made.
51f5e3e924dfdc98.zh: 乍看之下像是加了高湯與山葵的茶泡飯，但米飯底下藏著小塊的鯛魚與蔬菜。關於這種吃法的由來，流傳著各種說法。例如，在江戶時代（1603－1868），人們被迫節儉度日，因此把奢侈的食材藏起來不讓人看見；或是因為食材粗陋，被別人看到會覺得難為情。

51ff026bccd1eafa.en: In Aomori city and surrounding areas, it is customary to eat Oden (=Japanese fishcake stew) with grated ginger and miso. People began to eat Oden in this way after the war. It was first sold at the black market by women to those who traveled to Hakodate, Hokkaido on the Seikan Liaison Ship in extreme cold weather. In Aomori, miso is used frequently for cooking.
51ff026bccd1eafa.zh: 在青森市及周邊地區，習慣在關東煮上加薑泥與味噌食用。這種吃法始於戰後，最初是婦女在黑市販售給在嚴寒中搭乘青函聯絡船前往北海道函館的旅客。青森的料理經常使用味噌。

51ff8fe7281447bc.en: "Obiten" is a local dish from the Obi area of Nichinan City, Miyazaki Prefecture, Japan. It is a type of fish paste product classified as fried "Kamaboko(=Fish cake)."It originated during the Edo period when Obi was under the rule of the Obi clan, and was created and passed down by the local residents.
51ff8fe7281447bc.zh: 「おび天」是日本宮崎縣日南市飫肥地區的鄉土料理，屬於魚漿製品中的油炸「蒲鉾」（魚板）。起源於飫肥由飫肥藩統治的江戶時代，由當地居民創製並流傳下來。

5206105b4b52dac5.en: Torigoe Hachiman Shrine (鳥越八幡神社, Torigoe Hachiman jinja, also called 鳥越八幡宮, Torigoe Hachimangū) is a Shinto shrine located in Shinjō, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan. It is a Hachiman shrine, dedicated to the kami Hachiman. The shrine was founded in 1229, and its annual festival is on August 15.
5206105b4b52dac5.zh: 鳥越八幡神社（Torigoe Hachiman jinja，又稱鳥越八幡宮）是位於日本山形縣新庄的神社，屬八幡神社，供奉八幡神。神社創建於1229年，每年例祭於8月15日舉行。

525754a010aae4e0.en: "Ebiko" is made by peeling and finely chopping boiled small shrimp (Akaebi) with a knife, and then sweetening and stir-frying them with sugar, mirin, sake, etc. Some people use a mortar and pestle instead of a knife.
525754a010aae4e0.zh: 「えび粉」的做法是將煮熟的小蝦（赤蝦）剝殼後用菜刀剁碎，再加入砂糖、味醂、日本酒等調成甜味並拌炒。也有人用研缽和研杵代替菜刀。

525b30afe7361ecf.en: "Karukan" is a famous confectionery of Kagoshima Prefecture, made from "karukan flour", Japanese yams, and water, and is well known throughout the country. There are various theories about its origin, but the most popular is that it was invented by Rokubei Yashima, a confectioner from Akashi city, who was invited from Edo to study preserved foods by Nariakira Shimazu, the 11th lord of the Satsuma Domain.Despite the geographical conditions that most of the land, except for Mt.
525b30afe7361ecf.zh: 「かるかん」是鹿兒島縣的知名點心，以「かるかん粉」、山藥和水製成，聞名全國。其起源有多種說法，最普遍的說法是由明石市出身的點心師傅八島六兵衛所發明；他是受薩摩藩第11代藩主島津齊彬之邀，從江戶前來研究保存食品。儘管地理條件上，除了霧島山以外大部分土地

525bab229c68f227.en: The Hyakumangoku Matsuri (百万石まつり) is the main annual festival taking place in Kanazawa, Japan. The festival commemorates the entry of Lord Maeda Toshiie into Kanazawa Castle in 1583. The highlight of the festival is the Hyakumangoku Parade, which has begun on the first Saturday in June since 2007.
525bab229c68f227.zh: 百萬石祭（百万石まつり）是日本金澤每年舉行的主要祭典，紀念藩主前田利家於1583年進入金澤城。祭典的重頭戲是百萬石遊行，自2007年起於6月第一個星期六舉行。

5273d6ef54868282.en: The Former Yamauchi Residence (旧山内家下屋敷長屋, Kyū Yamauchike shimoyashiki nagaya) in Kōchi, Kōchi Prefecture, Japan belonged to the Yamauchi daimyō of Tosa Domain. The nagaya of 1864, 33.4m x 5.7m, twin storey, with a hip-and-gable tiled roof, is an Important Cultural Property.
5273d6ef54868282.zh: 旧山内家下屋敷長屋位於日本高知縣高知市，原屬土佐藩大名山內家。這座建於1864年的長屋長33.4公尺、寬5.7公尺，兩層樓，覆有歇山式瓦頂，為重要文化財。

527cadcebbd00567.en: Ikoma Jinja (生駒神社) is a Shinto shrine in Ikoma, Nara, Japan. Generally called Ikoma Taisha (往馬大社). The formal name of the shrine is "Ikomaniimasu-Ikomatsuhiko Jinja (往馬坐伊古麻都比古神社)". The shrine is also known as "Ikoma-Taisha", which means "great shrine of Ikoma".
527cadcebbd00567.zh: 生駒神社是位於日本奈良縣生駒市的神社，一般稱為往馬大社。正式名稱為「往馬坐伊古麻都比古神社」。該神社也稱為「往馬大社」，意為「生駒的大社」。

5283c00c7b67b358.en: Gakuen-ji (鰐淵寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Besshō neighborhood of the city of Izumo, Shimane Prefecture, Japan.  The temple's full name is Uryōzan Gakuen-ji (浮浪山  鰐淵寺). It belongs to the Tendai sect of Japanese Buddhism, and its honzon is a statue of Senjū Kannon and Yakushi Nyōrai. Its ground so have been designated a National Historic Site since 2016
5283c00c7b67b358.zh: 鰐淵寺是位於日本島根縣出雲市別所町的佛教寺院，全名為浮浪山鰐淵寺，屬於日本佛教天台宗，本尊為千手觀音像與藥師如來像。寺域自2016年起被指定為國家史跡。

52c961fc259bff9f.en: Sankō Shrine (三光神社, Sankō-jinja) is a Shinto shrine on a hill named Mt. Sanada (真田山, Sanada-yama) in Tennōji-ku, Osaka, Japan. It is notable for being the possible location of a legendary tunnel used during the 17th century Siege of Osaka.
52c961fc259bff9f.zh: 三光神社是位於日本大阪市天王寺區真田山上的神社，因可能是17世紀大坂之役期間所用傳說中地道的所在地而知名。

52d45e9ce97d8698.en: The Shimōsa Kokubun-ji (下総国分寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the city of Ichikawa, Chiba, Japan. It belongs to the Shingon-shū Buzan-ha sect and its honzon is an image of Dainichi Nyorai. The present temple is of uncertain foundation, but claims to be the direct descendant of the original Nara period provincial temple ("kokubunji") of former Shimōsa Province. which fell into ruins sometime during the Kamakura period.
52d45e9ce97d8698.zh: 下総国分寺是位於日本千葉縣市川市的佛教寺院，屬真言宗豐山派，本尊為大日如來像。現今寺院的創建年代不明，但自稱是舊下總國奈良時代國分寺的直系傳承；原國分寺於鎌倉時代某時荒廢。

52e9beb5c0ab7a06.en: Mount Ōfuna (大船山, Ōfunayama) is a 653.1 metre high Japanese mountain in Sanda, Hyōgo, Japan.
52e9beb5c0ab7a06.zh: 大船山是位於日本兵庫縣三田市的山，海拔653.1公尺。

531685e70c0d7288.en: “Madaka-zuke” is a traditional pickled food of Miyazaki Prefecture. It is said that the name originated from people voicing complaints at not being able to wait for it to reach peak deliciousness (“mada ka” means “not yet?”). Containing sengiri daikon, roasted soybeans, carrots, squid, konbu, etc., it is a healthy food that is full of ingredients that are good for your body.Miyazaki Prefecture makes up a large part of the nation’s "sengiri daikon" production.
531685e70c0d7288.zh: 「まだか漬け」是宮崎縣的傳統醃漬食品。據說名稱源自人們等不及它醃到最美味時而發出的抱怨（「まだか」意為「還沒好嗎？」）。內含千切り大根、炒黃豆、紅蘿蔔、魷魚、昆布等，是含有大量有益身體食材的健康食品。宮崎縣的「千切り大根」產量占全國很大比例。

5322e38e4761dbf5.en: Ryōtan-ji (龍潭寺) is a Buddhist temple belonging to the Myōshin-ji branch of the  Rinzai school of Japanese Zen. located in Hamana-ku, Hamamatsu, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. It is the head temple of one of fourteen autonomous branches of the Rinzai school. Its main image is a hibutsu statue of Kokūzō Bosatsu. The temple, including its famed Japanese garden is not open to the general public.
5322e38e4761dbf5.zh: 龍潭寺是日本禪宗臨濟宗妙心寺派的佛寺，位於日本靜岡縣濱松市濱名區。此寺是臨濟宗十四個獨立派別之一的本山。本尊為祕佛虛空藏菩薩像。寺院及其著名的日本庭園不對一般民眾開放。

5326fe30f8f360bf.en: Tonokōri Castle (都於郡城, Tonokōri-jō) was a Sengoku period yamajiro-style Japanese castle located in the Tonokōri neighborhood of the city of Saito, Miyazaki Prefecture, Japan. It was also known as Ukibune Castle (浮船城). Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2000.
5326fe30f8f360bf.zh: 都於郡城是戰國時代的山城形式日本城郭，位於日本宮崎縣西都市都於郡地區，又稱浮船城。其遺跡自2000年起被列為國家史跡加以保護。

533a36b5a19e1d48.en: The Mt. Shosha Ropeway (書写山ロープウェイ, Shoshazan Rōpuwei) is a Japanese aerial lift line in Himeji, Hyōgo, operated by the city government. The actual operation is entrusted to Shinki Bus (神姫バス), a local bus company. Opened in 1958, the line climbs Mount Shosha of Engyō-ji, a famous temple.
533a36b5a19e1d48.zh: 書写山ロープウェイ是位於兵庫縣姬路市的空中纜車路線，由市政府經營，實際營運委託當地巴士公司神姬巴士（神姫バス）負責。這條路線於1958年開通，通往名剎圓教寺所在的書寫山。

5362c89a886b29ab.en: Sunfish are sometimes caught during the traditional fishing season along the Kumano-nada coast from the Shima region to the Nanki region. They are called the "carefree men of the sea" because they are seen lying in the waves, but there is still much that is unknown about their biology. It is chewy and has a texture similar to that of white fish or chicken meat. Because sunfish lose their flesh if they are left in boiling water for a long time, they are prepared by boiling them lightly without stewing them.
5362c89a886b29ab.zh: 從志摩地區到南紀地區的熊野灘沿岸，在傳統漁季中有時會捕獲翻車魚。因常見其躺在海浪中，而被稱為「海中的悠閒者」，但其生態仍有許多未解之處。肉質有嚼勁，口感近似白肉魚或雞肉。翻車魚若長時間放在滾水中肉會縮減，因此烹調時只稍微汆燙，不燉煮。

53a9ade216b8f209.en: The Hōsa Library (蓬左文庫) is a library located on the compound of the Ōzone Shimoyashiki in Nagoya, central Japan.
53a9ade216b8f209.zh: 蓬左文庫是位於日本中部名古屋市大曾根下屋敷用地內的圖書館。

53b89a9cff68bf4b.en: Hondōri Iwamura-chō (恵那市岩村町本通り, Ena-shi Iwamura-chō hondōri) is the name of the town center of Iwamura in Ena,  Gifu Prefecture, and was designated as one of the Important Preservation Districts for Groups of Traditional Buildings on April 17, 1998. It is the merchant district of a former castle town that prospered during the Edo period as a political, cultural and economic center of the Tōnō region.
53b89a9cff68bf4b.zh: 岩村町本通（惠那市岩村町本通り）是岐阜縣惠那市岩村的市街中心名稱，於1998年4月17日被選定為重要傳統的建造物群保存地區。這裡是昔日城下町的商人區，該城下町在江戶時代作為東濃地區的政治、文化及經濟中心而繁榮。

53bd7015d161cd10.en: Ōita City Historical Museum (大分市歴史資料館, Ōita-shi Rekishi Shiryōkan) opened in Ōita, Ōita Prefecture, Japan, in 1987. The collection comprises materials relating to Ōita. The museum itself is on the site of the former Bungo Kokubun-ji (豊後国分寺), the provincial temple of Bungo province.
53bd7015d161cd10.zh: 大分市歷史資料館（大分市歴史資料館）於1987年在日本大分縣大分市開館，收藏與大分相關的資料。館址位於豐後國的國分寺——豐後國分寺的舊址上。

53be7fcb9c5a07e0.en: The Senpukuji Cave (泉福寺洞窟, Senpukuji dōkutsu) is an archaeological site consisting of a Japanese Paleolithic period to the Yayoi period rock shelter dwelling in the Setogoshi neighborhood of the city of Sasebo, Nagasaki Prefecture on the island of  Kyushu, Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1986. The world's oldest bean-patterned pottery was excavated here.
53be7fcb9c5a07e0.zh: 泉福寺洞窟是位於日本九州長崎縣佐世保市瀨戶越地區的考古遺址，為日本舊石器時代至彌生時代的岩蔭住居。該遺址於1986年被指定為日本國家史跡。世界最古老的豆粒紋土器即出土於此。

53e2052371c67d34.en: The mountainous region of Hokushin, being surrounded by mountains, has many crop-growing fields situated on steep slopes, with few rice paddies, so wheat is mainly cultivated instead of rice. Additionally, wheat is also mainly grown in the crop rotation of the rice paddies located at the river basin of the Chikuma river. Rice is so precious that it cannot be eaten everyday at home.
53e2052371c67d34.zh: 北信的山區四面環山，耕地多位於陡坡上，水田很少，因此主要種植小麥而非稻米。此外，千曲川流域的水田在輪作時也主要種植小麥。米非常珍貴，在家中無法每天食用。

53e9708d58973802.en: At the Ubuta Shrine, located in the town of Arima, in Kumano City, the priests and priestesses perform a ritual called “Houhan,” during which children are served foods such as “Sanmazushi (a sushi made from Pacific Saury),” a dish which is served, in this case, with the backbone intact.
53e9708d58973802.zh: 位於熊野市有馬町的產田神社，神職人員會舉行名為「ほうはん」的儀式，儀式中會為孩童供應「さんまずし（以秋刀魚製作的壽司）」等食物，此時這道料理是保留魚骨供應的。

54108ba06a145882.en: Tamagusuku Castle (玉城城, Tamagusuku jō; Okinawan: Tamagushiku) is a Ryūkyūan gusuku fortification located in the city of Nanjō, Okinawa Prefecture, Japan. It is the oldest castle on Okinawa Island; according to the Chūzan Seikan, it was built by Amamikyu, the creation goddess of the Ryūkyūan religion.  It has been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 1987.
54108ba06a145882.zh: 玉城城（沖繩語：Tamagushiku）是位於日本沖繩縣南城市的琉球御城（グスク）要塞，為沖繩本島最古老的城。根據《中山世鑑》記載，此城由琉球宗教的創世女神阿摩美久所建。自1987年起被中央政府列為國家史跡加以保護。

5427c423bcbf2e45.en: The soil in the northern part of the Nishiyama region is suitable for soybean cultivation, and cultivation of barley and beans has been actively carried out in the region for a long time.
5427c423bcbf2e45.zh: 西山地區北部的土壤適合種植黃豆，該地區自古以來就盛行栽培大麥與豆類。

544f109ac178f21c.en: Hitachinokuni Sōshagū (常陸國總社宮, Hitachinokuni sōshagu, also 常陸国総社宮 and 總社神社) is a Shinto shrine located in Ishioka, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan. According to legend, it was founded in the Tenpyō period, c. 729-749.
544f109ac178f21c.zh: 常陸國總社宮（亦寫作常陸国総社宮、總社神社）是位於日本茨城縣石岡市的神社。據傳創建於天平年間（約729年至749年）。

546b164a9c7de447.en: The Aomori Prefectural Museum (青森県立郷土館, Aomori Kenritsu Kyōdokan) is a museum located in Aomori, Aomori Prefecture, Japan.
546b164a9c7de447.zh: 青森縣立鄉土館是位於日本青森縣青森市的博物館。

548f30616c10a811.en: Obukumayama Kōgoishi (帯隈山神籠石) was an ancient Korean-style fortress located in the Kuboizumimachi neighborhood of Saga, Saga Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1951.
548f30616c10a811.zh: 帶隈山神籠石是位於日本佐賀縣佐賀市久保泉町地區的古代朝鮮式山城，其遺跡自1951年起列為國家史跡受到保護。

54aa46251ec58982.en: Okawa Elementary School (Japanese: 大川小学校, Hepburn: Ōkawa Shōgakkō) was an educational institution in Ishinomaki City, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan. The school was destroyed in the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami. 74 of its 108 students, who had remained at the school on the instructions of their teachers rather than evacuating to higher ground, were killed as the tsunami ran up the nearby Kitakami River. Only four of the students present when the tsunami struck the school survived. Ten of the school's eleven teachers also died.
54aa46251ec58982.zh: 石巻市立大川小学校曾是日本宮城縣石卷市的一所學校，於2011年東北地方太平洋近海地震及海嘯中被毀。海嘯沿附近的北上川上溯時，全校108名學生中有74人罹難，他們依照老師指示留在學校，未撤往高處。海嘯襲擊學校時在場的學生僅有4人生還。全校11名教師中也有10人罹難。

54ba49af9bafca94.en: Facing the Sea of Japan, Hagi City in Yamaguchi Prefecture is a treasure house of marine products such as yellowfin puffer fish, amadai (Pacific bluefin bream), and settsuki horse mackerel. Among these, wakame seaweed heralds the arrival of spring in the Hagi area. In this area, freshly harvested wakame seaweed is hung to dry along the coast in the spring. The pleasant smell of the ocean spreading its fragrance is a well-known spring scene among the locals.
54ba49af9bafca94.zh: 面向日本海的山口縣萩市，是黃鰭河魨、甘鯛（方頭魚）、瀨付竹筴魚等海產的寶庫。其中，裙帶菜（海帶芽）是萩地區報知春天到來的食材。在這一帶，春天會將剛採收的裙帶菜掛在海岸邊晾乾。海潮香氣四散，是當地人熟知的春季景象。

54c8a545f9fa96f1.en: During the Edo period, the 8th shogun of the Tokugawa shogunate, Tokugawa Yoshimune, is said to have raised a breed of white cattle. This cattle (a type of zebu) is believed to have originated from India at the Mineoka Ranch in what is now Minamiboso City and Kamogawa City in Chiba Prefecture. From the milk of these white cattle, a dairy product known as "white cattle cheese" or "white cattle dairy" was produced, marking the beginning of dairy farming in Japan.
54c8a545f9fa96f1.zh: 據說江戶時代，德川幕府第8代將軍德川吉宗飼養了一種白牛。這種牛（瘤牛的一種）據信源自印度，飼養於現今千葉縣南房總市與鴨川市一帶的嶺岡牧場。以這些白牛的牛乳製成了稱為「白牛酪」的乳製品，成為日本酪農業的開端。

54cdcfdb73b3b048.en: In Saitama Prefecture, where a large amount of wheat is produced as a secondary crop during rice cultivation, a wide variety of udon noodles dishes have been created in different regions. These include "Niboto" which is eaten mainly in Fukaya City, "Himokawa" and "Uchiire" in Iruma District and Hiki District, and "Okkirikomi" in the Chichibu area.
54cdcfdb73b3b048.zh: 埼玉縣在種稻之餘大量種植小麥作為裏作，各地區因此發展出各式各樣的烏龍麵料理。其中包括主要在深谷市食用的「煮ぼうとう」、入間郡與比企郡的「ひもかわ」與「うちいれ」，以及秩父地區的「おっきりこみ」。

54d6276a807f0bd9.en: Noboribetsu Marine Park Nixe (登別マリンパークニクス, Noboribetsu marinpāku nikusu) is a Japanese public aquarium located in Noboribetsu, Hokkaido, Japan. It is the one of largest aquariums in Hokkaido, with several buildings constructed around a copy of Egeskov Castle. It is a member of the Japanese Association of Zoos and Aquariums (JAZA) and the aquarium is accredited as a Museum-equivalent facility by the Museum Act from the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology.
54d6276a807f0bd9.zh: 登別マリンパークニクス是位於日本北海道登別的公立水族館，為北海道規模最大的水族館之一，數棟建築圍繞一座仿伊格斯可城堡（Egeskov Castle）而建。本館為日本動物園水族館協會（JAZA）會員，並依文部科學省主管的《博物館法》獲指定為博物館相當設施。

54ea3bbfee992642.en: “Funayaki” is an afternoon snack made from flour which has been passed down in the Chikugo region since ancient times. Water and flour are mixed together and made into thin, circular discs which are then cooked.
54ea3bbfee992642.zh: 「ふなやき」是筑後地區自古流傳下來、以麵粉製作的午後點心。將水與麵粉混合，做成薄薄的圓餅後加熱烹煮。

54f9443569a20221.en: Michinoku Folklore Village (みちのく民俗村, Michinoku Minzoku Mura) is an open-air museum folk museum that opened in Kitakami, Iwate Prefecture, Japan in 1992. The twenty-eight buildings include ten thatched minka, among them the Former Kanno Family Residence, an Important Cultural Property.
54f9443569a20221.zh: みちのく民俗村是1992年在日本岩手縣北上市開館的戶外民俗博物館。園內二十八棟建築中有十棟茅草屋頂的民家，其中包括列為重要文化財的舊菅野家住宅。

5517a962d0bf3abc.en: Kamagatani (霞間ヶ渓) is a valley in the  town of Ikeda, Gifu Prefecture, Japan noted for a scenic valley. It is a noted spot for viewing cherry blossoms in spring and was designated both a nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty and Natural Monument, in 1928 It is located within the borders of the Ibi-Sekigahara-Yōrō Quasi-National Park.
5517a962d0bf3abc.zh: 霞間ヶ溪（霞間ヶ渓）是位於日本岐阜縣池田町的溪谷，以溪谷景色聞名。這裡是春季賞櫻名所，1928年同時被指定為國家名勝及天然紀念物。位於揖斐關原養老國定公園範圍內。

551c3127ffc229df.en: When it comes to rare fish in the Ariake Sea, the mudskipper (known as "Mutsugorou") is famous, but alongside it is the Warasubo, which is exclusive to the Ariake Sea in Japan. Belonging to the eel goby family, Warasubo has degenerated eyes, exposed sharp teeth, and a slimy, purple body that allows internal organs and blood vessels to be visible, giving it an appearance reminiscent of an "alien." However, locals appreciate its unique taste, which has become a beloved culinary specialty.
551c3127ffc229df.zh: 說到有明海的稀有魚類，大彈塗魚（稱為「ムツゴロウ」）很有名，與之並列的則是在日本只分布於有明海的わらすぼ。わらすぼ屬於鰕虎科，眼睛退化，露出尖銳的牙齒，身體黏滑呈紫色，可以看見內臟和血管，外觀令人聯想到「外星人」。不過，當地人欣賞牠獨特的風味，已成為深受喜愛的特色料理。

552cf46db782579a.en: Mount Ishikari (石狩岳, Ishikari-dake) is part of the Ishikari Mountains, Hokkaidō, Japan. On its slopes are the head waters of the Ishikari River.
552cf46db782579a.zh: 石狩岳屬於日本北海道的石狩山地，山坡上有石狩川的源頭。

554b3d3e0e6e8a46.en: “Kamo-Nasu” is one of the most popular traditional vegetables in Kyoto. Characterized by its round shape with a diameter of over 10 cm, the eggplant has a firm, heavy weight, and does not fall apart when cooked, thus it is called “The queen of eggplants" in the Kyoto area.According to one theory, the “Kamo-Nasu” was originally produced in” Serikawa”, “Shimotoba” Village, but was introduced to “Kamigamo” in the north and became a production center, hence the name, but this is not certain.
554b3d3e0e6e8a46.zh: 「賀茂茄子」是京都最受歡迎的傳統蔬菜之一。特徵是直徑超過10公分的圓形，果實緊實、沉甸甸，烹煮時不易煮散，因此在京都一帶被稱為「茄子女王」。有一說認為，賀茂茄子原本產於芹川、下鳥羽村，後來傳到北方的上賀茂並成為產地，因而得名，但此說並不確定。

5553622d7cc60f7c.en: Isshin-ji (一心寺) is a Pure Land Buddhist temple in Osaka, Japan. Starting in the Meiji period, thirteen images have been formed, each incorporating the ashes of tens of thousands of devotees. The annual burial ceremony on 21 April in turn draws tens of thousands of worshippers.
5553622d7cc60f7c.zh: 一心寺是位於日本大阪的淨土宗寺院。自明治時代起，已造立十三尊佛像，每尊都融入數萬名信徒的骨灰。每年4月21日舉行的納骨法會也吸引數萬名參拜者。

55655b276f603475.en: Mount Sanpō (三宝山, Sanpō-yama) is a mountain on the border between Chichibu, Saitama and Kawakami, Nagano in the Okuchichibu Mountains of Japan. At a height of 2,483 m (8,146 ft), it is the highest point in Saitama.
55655b276f603475.zh: 三寶山是位於日本奧秩父山地、埼玉縣秩父市與長野縣川上村交界的山，海拔2,483公尺（8,146英尺），為埼玉縣最高點。

556a23fb23f00d82.en: The Takase River (高瀬川, Takasegawa) is a Class A river system that flows through Aomori Prefecture, Japan. It flows from Mt. Yahata, through Lake Ogawara into the Pacific Ocean.
556a23fb23f00d82.zh: 高瀨川是流經日本青森縣的一級水系河川。發源於八幡岳，流經小川原湖後注入太平洋。

5575d12302d63b1a.en: “Odamaki-mushi” is a regional dish originating from Osaka, and it is a large Chawan-mushi (savory steamed egg custard) containing Udon noodles. The coiled object made from spun hemp thread is called “odamaki”, and this dish is named so because the Udon noodles resemble spun threads. The Chinese characters for “Odamaki” are used phonetically and are not direct translations. In the past, when eggs were a luxury item, Odamaki-mushi with plenty of eggs was popular as a feast for special occasions among merchant families in Semba area in Osaka.
5575d12302d63b1a.zh: 「小田巻き蒸し」是源自大阪的地方料理，是加了烏龍麵的大碗茶碗蒸。用麻線紡成並捲起的物品稱為「苧環（おだまき）」，因烏龍麵形似紡好的線而得名。「小田巻」的漢字是取其讀音的借字，並非直接的字義。過去雞蛋是奢侈品的年代，用了大量雞蛋的小田巻き蒸し在大阪船場一帶的商家中，作為特殊場合的大餐而受歡迎。

55b208cb69a9fc64.en: The first day of the sixth month of the lunar calendar, after rice planting was completed and the end of the rainy season was approaching, was a day when farmers everywhere took a break from work. This day also marks the border between the end of a bad year and the beginning of a new year, and various events are held on this day. During this period, farmers used to make "Kenbikiyaki," which is wrapped in myoga leaves and grilled.
55b208cb69a9fc64.zh: 農曆六月一日正值插秧結束、梅雨季即將結束之際，是各地農家休息不工作的日子。這一天也是壞年結束與新年開始的分界，會舉行各種活動。在這段期間，農家會製作用茗荷葉包起來烤的けんびき焼き。

55c742a970751d50.en: "Tsubo-jiru" is a local dish of the Yukinoura district of Saikai City. Depending on the region, it is also called "Ingen-jiru" or "Tsuboki". Although its roots are not known, it has long been eaten as a vegetarian dish for Buddhist memorial services.The "Tsubo" in the name is thought to come from the fact that the bowl in which the dish is served looks like a tsubo.
55c742a970751d50.zh: 「つぼ汁」是西海市雪浦地區的鄉土料理。依地區不同，也稱為「いんげん汁」或「つぼき」。其起源不明，但長久以來作為佛教法事的素食料理食用。名稱中的「つぼ」，一般認為是因為盛裝這道料理的碗看起來像壺。

55cd2df45e4d1e5a.en: "Shio-Kujira-Jiru" (salted whale soup) is a traditional nourishing meal to survive the hot inland summers. It is said that this dish was created to prepare for the hot summer by boiling salted whale, which was a handy as a source of animal protein in mountainous areas, and summer vegetables together.Salted whale is the fatty flesh of the whale, with its skin preserved in salt.
55cd2df45e4d1e5a.zh: 「塩くじら汁」（鹽漬鯨魚湯）是度過內陸炎熱夏季的傳統滋補料理。據說這道料理是為了準備迎接炎夏，將在山區作為方便動物性蛋白質來源的鹽漬鯨魚與夏季蔬菜一起煮而成。鹽漬鯨魚是帶皮的鯨魚脂肪部位以鹽醃漬保存而成。

55d4466108b2a448.en: Koga Castle (古河城, Koga-jō) was a Japanese castle located in Koga, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan. During the Muromachi period, Koga was the seat of the Kantō kubō, under the Ashikaga clan. At the end of the Edo period, Koga Castle was  the administrative center of Koga Domain, which was held by a large number of fudai daimyō clans, spending the longest time under the control of the Doi clan (1633-1681, 1762–1871).
55d4466108b2a448.zh: 古河城是曾位於日本茨城縣古河市的城郭。室町時代，古河是足利氏旗下關東公方的駐地。江戶時代末期，古河城為古河藩的治所，該藩先後由多個譜代大名家族統治，其中以土井氏統治時間最長（1633年至1681年、1762年至1871年）。

55e0ac02567b2cff.en: Kohada fish has been a representative ingredient of the "Edo-mae" style since the Edo period (1603-1867). It is an ingredient that requires the skill of craftsmen in preparation, and is so indispensable as an ingredient that kohada has become synonymous with Glistening fish in Edomae-zushi. In addition to Nigiri-zushi (hand-rolled sushi), kohada is often served in a "Su-jime" (vinegared dish), and “Kohada-awazuke" is one such dish.Kohada fish change their names as they grow.
55e0ac02567b2cff.zh: 自江戶時代（1603－1867年）以來，小鰭一直是「江戶前」風格的代表性食材。這種食材的處理需要職人的技術，在江戶前壽司中更是不可或缺，小鰭甚至成了亮皮魚的代名詞。除了握壽司之外，小鰭也常做成「酢じめ」（醋醃料理），「こはだの粟づけ」就是其中之一。小鰭會隨著成長而改變名稱。

5600e536f6a003cd.en: This is a local dish passed down from the Pacific coast of Hachinohe City and Hashikami Town, as well as others. It is a luxurious dish using only high quality ingredients, such as sea urchin and abalone in a clear broth soup. It is said to have originated in the old days when fishermen dived for sea urchins and abalone and heartily boiled them on the beach. In the Taisho era, it came to be a ryotei (Japanese-style restaurant) dish and was served in beautifully arranged bowls.
5600e536f6a003cd.zh: 這是八戶市、階上町等太平洋沿岸地區流傳的鄉土料理。在清湯中加入海膽、鮑魚等高級食材，是一道奢華的料理。據說起源於早年漁夫潛水採捕海膽和鮑魚後，在海邊豪邁地煮來吃。到了大正時代成為料亭料理，盛裝在精美的碗中供應。

560da6ceed63ae6a.en: Igoneri" is a local dish representative of Sado Island, made from the Japanese rush grass harvested from the Sea of Japan. It was made in every household from fall to winter. Igogusa is a type of seaweed that grows on large seaweed such as kombu and hondawara, and is widely used mainly on the Sea of Japan side. It is called "igo" in the Sado region and "ego" in the Niigata region. It is made by boiling and kneading sun-dried dried sea weed while adjusting the amount of water, then spreading it thinly and cooling it down to harden it.
560da6ceed63ae6a.zh: 「いごねり」是佐渡島具代表性的鄉土料理，以採自日本海的海藻製成，過去家家戶戶都會在秋季到冬季製作。いご草是一種附生在昆布、馬尾藻等大型海藻上的海藻，主要在日本海沿岸廣泛使用，佐渡地區稱為「いご」，新潟地區稱為「えご」。製作方式是將曬乾的海藻一邊調整水量一邊煮並揉製，再攤薄冷卻使其凝固。

561e06e58486773b.en: The Toyo Ito Museum of Architecture, Imabari (今治市伊東豊雄建築ミュージアム, Imabari-Shi Ito Toyo Kenchiku Museum) is a museum of contemporary architecture and design located in Imabari, Ehime Prefecture.
561e06e58486773b.zh: 今治市伊東豐雄建築博物館（今治市伊東豊雄建築ミュージアム）是位於愛媛縣今治市的當代建築與設計博物館。

561f0fc3eef0b82e.en: Ran no Yakata (ランの館) is a public orchid garden in Nagoya, central Japan.
561f0fc3eef0b82e.zh: 蘭之館是位於日本中部名古屋的公共蘭花園。

5635469124b88185.en: Sunport Takamatsu (サンポート高松, Sanpōto Takamatsu) is a commercial and residential area in Hamanochō, Takamatsu, Kagawa Prefecture, Japan. It is a redevelopment district located on the site of the former Takamatsu Freight Depot in Hamanochō. The development includes a shopping mall, hotel, apartments, convenience stores and several restaurants. Sunport also acts as the passenger terminal for JR Shikoku's Takamatsu Station, the ferries at Port of Takamatsu, a wide range of taxi and bus companies, and offers bicycle and car rentals.
5635469124b88185.zh: サンポート高松是位於日本香川縣高松市濱ノ町的商業與住宅區，為原高松貨物站舊址上的再開發區。區內設有購物中心、飯店、公寓、便利商店及數家餐廳。サンポート高松也是JR四國高松站、高松港渡輪及多家計程車與巴士公司的旅客轉運站，並提供自行車與汽車租借服務。

5646d71bb28aaa9e.en: Miyagi Prefectural Auditorium (宮城県民会館) is a 1,590-seat multi-purpose hall located in Sendai, Japan. It opened in 1964 and has hosted artists such as Cheap Trick, Whitesnake and Mötley Crüe. After the sale of the naming rights, Tokyo Electron Hall Miyagi became, on April 1, 2008, the preferred nickname for Miyagi Prefectural Auditorium.
5646d71bb28aaa9e.zh: 宮城県民会館是位於日本仙台市、設有1,590個座位的多功能廳，1964年開館，曾有Cheap Trick、Whitesnake及Mötley Crüe等藝人在此演出。命名權售出後，自2008年4月1日起，宮城県民会館的通稱改為「東京エレクトロンホール宮城」。

565ddb7871910e22.en: In some areas of Fukushima, such as Fudono-machi, potatoes are called 'kanpura,' and there is a deeply rooted culture of eating them as a staple food. It is said that because the original Dutch word 'aardappel' was difficult to pronounce it was changed to 'kanpura,' and the cities of Koriyama, Minamisoma, and Iwaki are cited as its main areas of production. 'Miso kanpura' is made by frying kanpura with the skin still on together with miso, sugar, mirin, and other ingredients.
565ddb7871910e22.zh: 在福島的部分地區，例如ふどの町等地，馬鈴薯被稱為「かんぷら」，當地有將其作為主食的深厚飲食文化。據說是因為原本的荷蘭語「aardappel」不容易發音，才變成「かんぷら」，主要產地有郡山市、南相馬市和磐城市。「みそかんぷら」是將帶皮的かんぷら與味噌、砂糖、味醂等材料一起炒製而成。

56645c790abbe94d.en: Shiwa Castle (志波城, Shiwa-jō) was an early Heian period jōsaku-style Japanese castle located in what is now part of the city of Morioka, Iwate Prefecture in the Tōhoku region of far northern Honshu, Japan. The site was proclaimed a National Historic Site of Japan in 1979.
56645c790abbe94d.zh: 志波城是平安時代初期的城柵式日本城郭，位於今日本本州最北部東北地方岩手縣盛岡市境內。遺址於1979年被指定為日本國家史跡。

566748a5670bff8f.en: Fukushima-juku (福島宿, Fukushima-juku) was the thirty-seventh of the sixty-nine stations of the Nakasendō highway connecting Edo with Kyoto during the Edo period. It was located in the present-day city of Kiso, in the Kiso District of Nagano Prefecture, Japan. It was also numbered as the fifth of eleven stations on the Kisoji highway.
566748a5670bff8f.zh: 福島宿是江戶時代連接江戶與京都的中山道六十九宿中的第三十七宿，位於今日本長野縣木曾郡木曾町。在木曾路十一宿中則為第五宿。

5683e7c56439114b.en: Mishima, located about 45 kilometers north of Hagi Port in Yamaguchi Prefecture, is a small island with a population of fewer than 1,000 people. This isolated island, floating away from the mainland, serves as a crucial resting point for migratory birds, and it is renowned as a sacred site for bird watching.
5683e7c56439114b.zh: 見島位於山口縣萩港以北約45公里處，是人口不到1,000人的小島。這座遠離本土的離島是候鳥重要的中繼休息地，被譽為賞鳥的聖地。

569210890fc82413.ja: 星溪園（せいけいえん）は、埼玉県熊谷市にある回遊式庭園。江戸時代末期から明治時代にかけて整備され、昭和29年（1954年）に熊谷市の名勝に指定された。
569210890fc82413.zh: 星溪園是位於埼玉縣熊谷市的迴遊式庭園，於江戶時代末期至明治時代間修建，昭和29年（1954年）被指定為熊谷市的名勝。

5693946196df80db.en: Cold soup" is a local dish that has developed in various places in Japan, using vegetables and fish from each region. Among them, "chilled soup" in Saitama has been eaten as a dipping sauce for udon noodles, which is unique to the "udon culture" in the area where wheat was widely cultivated as a back crop to rice cultivation. In the past, farmers who cultivated rice were very busy from rice planting to harvest, as manual labor was the basic method of farming.
5693946196df80db.zh: 「冷汁」是在日本各地發展出來的鄉土料理，使用各地的蔬菜和魚類。其中埼玉的「冷汁」被當作烏龍麵的沾汁食用，這是以小麥作為稻作裡作而廣泛栽培的地區所特有的「烏龍麵文化」。過去以人力為基本務農方式，種稻的農家從插秧到收成都非常忙碌。

56c960fb12bd0e70.en: The Ōtoriiyama ruins (大鳥井山遺跡, Ōtoriiyama iseki) is an archaeological site containing a large Heian period jōsaku-style fortification located in what is now part of the city of Yokote, Akita in the Tōhoku region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 2010.
56c960fb12bd0e70.zh: 大鳥井山遺跡是位於今日本東北地方秋田縣橫手市的考古遺址，保存有大型平安時代城柵式防禦設施，2010年被指定為國家史跡。

56d3578513bfe46f.en: The Kai Kokubun-ji (甲斐国分寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the city of Fuefuki, Yamanashi, Japan. It belongs to the Myōshin-ji branch of the Rinzai school of Japanese Zen and its honzon is a hibutsu statue of Yakushi Nyōrai. It is the descendant of one of the provincial temples established by Emperor Shōmu during the Nara period (710 – 794) for the purpose of promoting Buddhism as the national religion of Japan and standardizing control of the imperial rule to the provinces.
56d3578513bfe46f.zh: 甲斐國分寺是位於日本山梨縣笛吹市的佛教寺院，屬於日本禪宗臨濟宗妙心寺派，本尊為祕佛藥師如來像。此寺承續自奈良時代（710－794年）聖武天皇所設立的國分寺之一；設立國分寺的目的在於推廣佛教作為日本國教，並統一朝廷對各地方的統治。

56e48bd703d6f220.en: Each prefecture selects a prefectural flower that best represents the region. For Yamaguchi Prefecture, the native Summer Mandarin Orange from Ohibi in Nagato City was chosen. The Summer Mandarin Orange blooms fragrant white flowers in May, followed by yellow fruits known as "daidai," which are not only loved for their appearance but are also consumed as food. Particularly in Hagi City, harvesting takes place in early May, and souvenirs processed into jelly, juice, jam, and more are sold.
56e48bd703d6f220.zh: 各都道府縣都選定最能代表當地的縣花。山口縣選的是原產於長門市大日比的夏蜜柑。夏蜜柑在5月開出芳香的白花，之後結出被稱為「橙」的黃色果實，不僅外觀受人喜愛，也可食用。特別是在萩市，5月上旬進行採收，並販售加工成果凍、果汁、果醬等的伴手禮。

56e748163e348c0e.en: In Kobe, it is common to eat "miso-dare gyoza," which are pan-fried dumplings served with a miso-based sauce consisting of vinegar, soy sauce, and chili oil. Before World War II, among Japanese residents who lived in Manchuria, pan-fried gyoza was preferred over boiled ones which are similar to Chinese water dumplings. Many families in Kobe used to eat pan-fried gyoza with miso sauce due to nostalgia for their hometown.
56e748163e348c0e.zh: 在神戶，一般會吃「味噌だれ餃子」，也就是搭配以味噌為基底、加入醋、醬油和辣油的醬汁享用的煎餃。第二次世界大戰前，住在滿洲的日本人比起類似中國水餃的水煮餃子，更偏好煎餃。神戶有許多家庭因懷念故鄉，過去會將煎餃沾味噌醬食用。

56f806e916eedf69.en: Hōgon-ji (宝厳寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Ji sect in Matsuyama, Ehime, Japan. It is famed as the birthplace of the Buddhist sage Ippen, who founded the Ji (time) sect as an offshoot of the Jōdo (Pure Land Buddhism) sect in 1276.
56f806e916eedf69.zh: 寶嚴寺（宝厳寺）是位於日本愛媛縣松山市的時宗寺院。以佛教聖人一遍的出生地而聞名，一遍於1276年自淨土宗分出，創立時宗。

570b90757bfcf6aa.en: Hotokenuma (仏沼) is a wetland area located in the northern part of the city of Misawa, Aomori Prefecture, in the northern Tōhoku region of Japan. The wetland is connected to the eastern shores of Lake Ogawara at the base of the Shimokita Peninsula.
570b90757bfcf6aa.zh: 仏沼是位於日本東北地方北部青森縣三澤市北部的濕地，位於下北半島基部，與小川原湖東岸相連。

571307d4fdfcc39a.en: "Kashiwan" is a regional cuisine that has been passed down in Yamaguchi Prefecture, and is eaten for ceremonies and special occasions. It is a soup made of chicken and shiitake mushroom, and the "Kashiwa" part of the name comes from the word for chicken. This dish is made by carefully simmering each ingredient, adding seasoning, then finishing in a chilled soup.
571307d4fdfcc39a.zh: 「柏椀」是山口縣流傳下來的鄉土料理，於儀式及特殊場合食用。這是以雞肉和香菇製成的湯品，名稱中的「柏」來自雞肉的稱呼。做法是將各項食材分別細心燉煮、調味，最後做成冷湯。

572bf93525e408a7.en: Katsu-meshi" is a Western-style dish consisting of a flat beef cutlet on top of rice served on a Western-style plate, topped with demi-glace sauce and served with boiled cabbage on the side.It is a local dish of Kakogawa. It was first invented at a diner in town shortly after the war, when beef cutlets were still a rarity, as a Western-style dish that could be easily eaten with chopsticks without a knife and fork.
572bf93525e408a7.zh: 「かつめし」是一道西式料理，在西餐盤上的白飯上方放上扁平的牛排炸肉排，淋上多蜜醬，並附上燙高麗菜。這是加古川的在地料理。戰後不久，牛排炸肉排仍屬稀有之物，鎮上一家食堂為了做出不用刀叉、用筷子就能輕鬆食用的西式料理而首創此菜。

572c443fdfe0d853.en: The Aoyakamijichi Site (青谷上寺地遺跡, Aoyakamijichi iseki) is an archaeological site with a Yayoi period settlement, located in the Aoya neighborhood of the city of Tottori in the San'in region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site in 2008.
572c443fdfe0d853.zh: 青谷上寺地遺跡是一處考古遺址，有彌生時代的聚落，位於日本山陰地方鳥取市青谷地區。該遺址於2008年被指定為國家史跡。

57540a39081f97a2.en: The Daimokutate (題目立)  is a recitation show that is performed at Yahashira Shrine in Kami-fukawa village, near the city of Nara.
57540a39081f97a2.zh: 題目立是在奈良市附近上深川村八柱神社演出的吟誦表演。

57564e651957b417.en: Tachibana-dera (橘寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the village of Asuka, Nara Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the  Tendai sect and its honzon is a statue of Prince Shōtoku.
57564e651957b417.zh: 橘寺是位於日本奈良縣明日香村的佛教寺院，屬於天台宗，本尊為聖德太子像。

575a1687e15c8222.en: The fishing catch by fish species in Mie Prefecture is ranked first in the nation for spiny lobsters (Ise Ebi), second for Japanese pilchards (Katakuchi Iwashi), and sixth for sardines (Iwashi), indicating that sardine fishing is active in the region (Source: "Reiwa 1st Year Fisheries and Aquaculture Production Statistics," Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries). The 'Iwashi-zushi,' made using these sardines, is prepared and enjoyed during gatherings such as autumn festivals.
575a1687e15c8222.zh: 三重縣各魚種漁獲量中，龍蝦（伊勢海老）居全國第一，日本鯷（片口鰯）居第二，沙丁魚（鰯）居第六，可見當地沙丁魚漁業興盛（資料來源：農林水產省「令和元年漁業・養殖業生產統計」）。使用這些沙丁魚製作的「いわしずし」，會在秋季祭典等聚會時製作享用。

579783cf5d05d477.en: Northern Yatsugatake Volcanic Group (北八ヶ岳, Kita-Yatsugatake) is a volcanic group of stratovolcanoes and lava domes located in Nagano Prefecture on Honshū in Japan.
579783cf5d05d477.zh: 北八ヶ岳是位於日本本州長野縣的火山群，由層狀火山與熔岩穹丘組成。

57a5638af3e2c212.en: The dish is made by simmering beef tendons in miso or mirin for a long time. Its name originates from the practice of piling miso around the edge of the pot like a riverbank. It boasts a rich, sweet and savory flavor that pairs well with sake. Known as an affordable and enjoyable Osaka downtown specialty, and there are many restaurants in the Shinsekai area that serve it.
57a5638af3e2c212.zh: 這道料理是將牛筋用味噌或味醂長時間燉煮而成。名稱源自將味噌堆在鍋緣、形似河堤（土手）的做法。味道濃郁甜鹹，與日本酒很搭。以平價又好吃的大阪庶民美食聞名，新世界一帶有許多供應這道料理的店家。

57ab06e093e7a060.en: Birthplace of the Miyazaki Brothers (Japanese: 宮崎兄弟の生家, Hepburn: Miyazaki Kyōdai no Seika) is a cultural heritage site and museum in Arao City, Japan. It is a designated historical property of Kumamoto Prefecture. The site is dedicated to the Miyazaki Brothers: Hachirō, Tōten, Tamizō, and Yazō, and their connection to Sun Yat-sen, the leader of the 1911 Revolution. There is also a museum, the Miyazaki Brothers Museum built on the property.
57ab06e093e7a060.zh: 宮崎兄弟の生家是位於日本荒尾市的文化遺產與博物館，為熊本縣指定史跡。此處紀念宮崎兄弟：八郎、滔天、民藏與彌藏，以及他們與辛亥革命領導人孫中山的關係。園區內另建有宮崎兄弟資料館。

57d30b51841f3380.en: Kusaki Dam is a dam in the Gunma Prefecture of Japan.
57d30b51841f3380.zh: 草木ダム是位於日本群馬縣的水壩。

57dde0ef654a3395.en: ‘Imotako’ is a simple local cuisine which makes use of both land and sea produce. The result is a stewed dish consisting of fresh octopus caught at the Seto Inland Sea and Japanese taro.Whilst long-armed octopus is typically used for the dish, there are various other types of octopus you can also catch at the Seto Inland Sea including the common octopus and the webfoot octopus.
57dde0ef654a3395.zh: 「いもたこ」是同時運用陸地與海洋物產的簡樸鄉土料理，以瀨戶內海捕獲的新鮮章魚與芋頭燉煮而成。這道料理通常使用長腕章魚，但瀨戶內海也能捕到其他多種章魚，包括真蛸和短爪章魚。

57e251f0ccd26907.en: Tenjinyama Castle (天神山城, Tenjinyama-jō) was a castle located in Tatsuchi, Wake of the former Bizen Province (now Okayama Prefecture) in Japan. Its ruined remains have been protected as a Prefectural Historic Site.
57e251f0ccd26907.zh: 天神山城 (備前国)是位於日本舊備前國（今岡山縣）和氣町田土的一座城郭。其遺跡已被指定為縣史跡加以保護。

580d4407c4684e4c.en: The Miyakojima City Tropical Plant Garden (宮古島市熱帯植物園, Miyakojima-shi Nettai Shokubutsuen) is a botanical garden in Hirara, Miyako-jima, Okinawa Prefecture, Japan.
580d4407c4684e4c.zh: 宮古島市熱帯植物園是位於日本沖繩縣宮古島平良的植物園。

581a1ac599a251bf.en: Aizen-in (愛染院) is a Kōya-san Shingon temple in Itano, Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. This is the temple of Inner Sanctum of No.3 Konsen-ji Temple. The temple is said to have been founded by Kōbō Daishi in 815, who also carved the main image of Fudō Myōō. This temple is placed on the Shikoku Pilgrimage Trail. More 2 km to No.4 Dainichi-ji temple from here.
581a1ac599a251bf.zh: 愛染院是位於日本德島縣板野的高野山真言宗寺院，為第3番金泉寺的奧之院。據傳由弘法大師於815年創建，本尊不動明王亦為其所雕。本寺位於四國遍路道上，由此再走2公里可到第4番大日寺。

58398cf9bad01549.en: Fujii-dera (Japanese: 葛井寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Fujiidera neighborhood of the city of Fujiidera,  Osaka Prefecture Japan. It belongs to the Shingon-shū Omuro-ha sect of Japanese Buddhism and its honzon is a National Treasure statue of Senjū Jūichimen Kannon. The temple's full name is Shiun-san Fujii-dera (紫雲山 葛井寺). The temple is the 4th stop on the Saigoku Kannon Pilgrimage route.
58398cf9bad01549.zh: 葛井寺是位於日本大阪府藤井寺市藤井寺地區的佛教寺院，屬於日本佛教真言宗御室派，本尊為列為國寶的千手十一面觀音像。寺院全名為紫雲山 葛井寺，是西國觀音巡禮的第4站。

5840e6b370a7908b.en: Wadō Archaeological Site (和銅遺跡 (Wadō Iseki)) is the preserved remains of Japan’s earliest known copper mine, located in Chichibu, Saitama Prefecture. The site is famous for the 708 CE discovery of native copper, which prompted the issuance of Japan’s first official coin, the Wadōkaichin (和同開珎), and the start of the Wadō era.
5840e6b370a7908b.zh: 和銅遺跡是日本已知最早的銅礦遺址，位於埼玉縣秩父市。此地以西元708年發現自然銅而聞名，這項發現促成日本第一種官方貨幣「和同開珎」的發行，以及和銅年號的開始。

586792ea0a120e95.en: The Catholic Chikaramachi Church (カトリック主税町教会) is one of the oldest Christian churches in the city of Nagoya, central Japan.
586792ea0a120e95.zh: 天主教主稅町教會是日本中部名古屋市歷史最悠久的基督教教堂之一。

5883fa61cc742a77.en: In Niigata Prefecture, there is a simple and rustic tasting " Sankaku Chimaki" that is rare in Japan. It is a simple chimaki made of glutinous rice wrapped in bamboo leaf, folded into a triangular shape, tied with igusa (=rush), and boiled slowly in plenty of hot water for two hours. It is served with kinako (￢￢=soybean flour) sprinkled on top. Although slightly less well known than sasa dango, chimaki is said to be the oldest chimaki in Japan.
5883fa61cc742a77.zh: 新潟縣有一種在日本相當少見、風味簡樸的「三角ちまき」。這是將糯米包入竹葉，折成三角形，以藺草綁好，再用大量熱水慢煮兩小時的簡單粽子。食用時撒上黃豆粉。雖然知名度略遜於笹団子，但據說這是日本最古老的粽子。

588c8a8a60386145.en: In Tochigi, a prefecture without a sea, people ate sharks, called saganbo (Spiny dogfish) and moro (mouse shark), as raw fish from the sea before refrigerators became widely available.
588c8a8a60386145.zh: 在沒有海的栃木縣，冰箱普及之前，人們會將稱為「さがんぼ」（白斑角鯊）和「もろ」（鼠鯊）的鯊魚當作來自海洋的鮮魚食用。

5892696626d356b3.en: The Former Sagami River Bridge (旧相模川橋脚, kyū-Sagami-gawa kyōkyaku) is the ruins of a Kamakura period bridge over the former course of the Sagami River, located in what is now the city of Chigasaki, Kanagawa Prefecture in the southern Kantō region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1926, with the area under protection expanded in 2007. It was further designated as a Natural Monument in 2013.
5892696626d356b3.zh: 旧相模川橋脚是鎌倉時代架設於相模川舊河道上的橋梁遺跡，位於日本關東地方南部，今神奈川縣茅崎市。該遺址於1926年被指定為日本國家史跡，2007年擴大保護範圍，2013年又被指定為天然紀念物。

589dc65845c8002d.en: Tsuwabuki is native to Japan and grows wild south of Fukushima and Ishikawa prefectures in Honshu, but has long been used as a food mainly in Kyushu and some other regions. Today, it is cultivated in Miyazaki Prefecture, Saiki City in Oita Prefecture, and Kagoshima Prefecture, but it grows wild along the coastline in the southern part of Miyazaki Prefecture due to its mild climate.
589dc65845c8002d.zh: 石蕗原產於日本，野生於本州福島縣、石川縣以南，但長久以來主要在九州及其他部分地區作為食材。現在宮崎縣、大分縣佐伯市及鹿兒島縣有人工栽培，而宮崎縣南部因氣候溫和，沿海岸線也有野生石蕗生長。

58add93b39228ce2.en: Hinokuma-dera ruins (檜隈寺, Hinokuma-dera ato) is an archeological site  with the ruins of an Asuka period Buddhist temple located in the village of Asuka, Nara, Japan. It was designated as a National Historic Site in 2003. The site is currently occupied by a Shinto shrine, the Omiashi Jinja (於美阿志神社).
58add93b39228ce2.zh: 檜隈寺遺址（檜隈寺跡）是位於日本奈良縣明日香村的考古遺址，保存有飛鳥時代佛教寺院的遺跡，2003年被指定為國家史跡。遺址現為神社於美阿志神社所在地。

58b8b0d9567c4076.en: Hōnen'ike Dam (豊稔池ダム, Hōnen'ike damu) is a multiple-arch dam in the Sanuki Mountain range at Kan'onji, Kagawa Prefecture, Japan. The reservoir it creates is used for irrigation. Construction began in 1926 and was completed in 1930. The dam is 32 m high and has a crest length of 158 m. It is supported by six arched buttresses. Some renovation work has been needed to control leakage; special care has been taken due to its status as a cultural asset.
58b8b0d9567c4076.zh: 豊稔池ダム是位於日本香川縣觀音寺市讚岐山脈的連拱壩，其形成的水庫用於灌溉。工程於1926年開始，1930年完工。壩高32公尺，壩頂長158公尺，由六座拱形扶壁支撐。為控制滲漏曾進行部分整修；由於其文化財身分，整修時特別謹慎。

58bc2ca0af806660.en: Kurahashi-jima (倉橋島), also called Nagato-jima (長門島) in ancient texts, is an island in Hiroshima Bay located in southwestern Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan.
58bc2ca0af806660.zh: 倉橋島在古代文獻中又稱長門島，是位於日本廣島縣西南部廣島灣內的島嶼。

58bd0aa40d5af365.en: It is also called” Dongame-jiru” or “Dorogame-jiru”. “Dongame-jiru” is a miso soup made in the summer at the residence of an Omi merchant in the Gokasho area, and has spread throughout the prefecture, especially in the Koto region.The miso soup contains ground sesame seeds, and was named "Mud Turtle soup (Dongame-jiru)" because the sesame seeds in the soup look like mud and the slit in the eggplant skin looks like a turtle's shell.This “Dongame-jiru” contained eggplant, which is a summer vegetable.
58bd0aa40d5af365.zh: 又稱「どんがめ汁」或「どろがめ汁」。「どんがめ汁」是五個莊地區近江商人宅邸在夏季製作的味噌湯，後來流傳到全縣，特別是湖東地區。這道味噌湯加入磨碎的芝麻，因湯中芝麻看起來像泥巴、茄子皮上的切痕像烏龜殼，而被命名為「泥龜汁（どんがめ汁）」。這道「どんがめ汁」使用了夏季蔬菜茄子。

58c0c545006b0672.en: About 50km north of Wajima Port in Wajima City. On Hegurajima, a remote island in the Sea of Japan, female abalone divers (ama divers) are engaged in free-dive fishing. These women divers wear black wetsuits and goggles to catch turban shells and abalone with their hands. It’s said that turban shell fishing by these female divers has a history of more than 400 years.
58c0c545006b0672.zh: 位於輪島市輪島港以北約50公里處。在日本海的離島舳倉島上，女性鮑魚潛水夫（海女）從事徒手潛水捕撈。這些海女身穿黑色潛水衣、戴著蛙鏡，徒手捕捉蠑螺與鮑魚。據說海女捕撈蠑螺已有400多年的歷史。

58e671ae7cd8f605.en: Takanabe Museum of Art (高鍋町美術館, Takanabe-chō Bijutsukan) opened in Takanabe, Miyazaki Prefecture, Japan in 1999. Located inside the moat of Takanabe Castle, the museum's collection comprises some eight hundred artworks, including paintings by Kojima Torajirō, and temporary exhibitions are also mounted.
58e671ae7cd8f605.zh: 高鍋町美術館於1999年在日本宮崎縣高鍋町開館。美術館位於高鍋城的護城河內，館藏約八百件美術作品，包括兒島虎次郎的畫作，也舉辦特展。

58f31e47634da0b4.en: Hosomi Museum (細見美術館, Hosomi Bijutsukan) opened near Okazaki Park (岡崎公園) in Kyoto, Japan, in 1998. The collection, begun by Osaka industrialist Hosomi Ryō (細見良; 1901－1978), numbers some one thousand pieces including thirty Important Cultural Properties, ranging from haniwa and tea utensils to paintings of the Heian and Kamakura periods as well as by Itō Jakuchū and Katsushika Hokusai. These are exhibited on a rotating basis with four or five exhibitions each year.
58f31e47634da0b4.zh: 細見美術館於1998年在日本京都岡崎公園附近開館。館藏由大阪實業家細見良（1901－1978）開始收集，約有一千件，其中包括三十件重要文化財，範圍從埴輪、茶道具到平安與鎌倉時代的繪畫，以及伊藤若冲與葛飾北齋的作品。這些藏品以輪替方式展出，每年舉辦四至五檔展覽。

58f3867fd1c12beb.en: Kawamura Castle (河村城, Kawamura-jō) is a Kamakura period  Japanese castle located in what is now the town of Yamakita, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan.  Its ruins have been protected as a Kanagawa Prefectural Historic Site since 1996. It is said to have been built in the late Heian period and was a mountain castle built near a strategic point where the borders of Sagami, Kai, and Suruga Provinces intersected.
58f3867fd1c12beb.zh: 河村城是鎌倉時代的日本城堡，位於今日本神奈川縣山北町。其遺跡自1996年起列為神奈川縣史跡加以保護。據說建於平安時代末期，是一座山城，興建於相模、甲斐、駿河三國交界的戰略要地附近。

58f8611601f37d15.en: Kannonzaki Lighthouse (観音埼灯台) is a lighthouse on Cape Kannon, on Miura Peninsula, in Yokosuka, Kanagawa, Japan.
58f8611601f37d15.zh: 觀音埼燈塔是位於日本神奈川縣橫須賀市三浦半島觀音崎的燈塔。

5921dddab5c08e84.en: The stew made from Shogoin turnip and sea bream, known locally as "Taikabura," has long been a beloved dish in Kyoto City. A classic winter favorite, this stew allows you to savor the rich umami of sea bream along with the gentle, mellow flavor of turnip. The harmonious pairing of sea bream and turnip, enhancing each other's flavors, is referred to as "Deaimon."The Shogoin turnip utilized in Taikabura is among Kyoto's traditional vegetables.
5921dddab5c08e84.zh: 以聖護院蕪菁與鯛魚燉煮而成的料理，當地稱為「鯛蕪」，長久以來是京都市廣受喜愛的料理。這是冬季的經典菜色，可以品嘗鯛魚濃郁的鮮味與蕪菁溫和圓潤的風味。鯛魚與蕪菁相互襯托風味的和諧搭配，稱為「出会いもん」。鯛蕪所使用的聖護院蕪菁是京都的傳統蔬菜之一。

593795b5cacecf4b.en: Taiheizan Prefectural Natural Park (太平山県立自然公園, Taiheizan kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Akita Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1972, the park spans the borders of the municipalities of Akita, Gojōme, and Kamikoani, and takes its name from Mount Taihei (太平山).
593795b5cacecf4b.zh: 太平山縣立自然公園（太平山県立自然公園）是位於日本秋田縣的縣立自然公園。公園設立於1972年，範圍橫跨秋田市、五城目町與上小阿仁村，名稱取自太平山。

593d482533403aef.en: Araho Shrine (荒穂神社, Araho Jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Kiyama, Saga Prefecture, Japan.
593d482533403aef.zh: 荒穗神社是位於日本佐賀縣基山町的神社。

5947e797954602aa.en: This is "lotus root stuffed with red and white glutinous rice," where glutinous rice is filled into the holes of lotus root and then steamed. Lotus root is considered an auspicious vegetable for New Year's "Osechi "cuisine due to its holes symbolizing a clear vision of the future. It is known as a specialty in the Kawachi region, with many being cultivated in Kadoma City.Kadoma City has historically been an area with poor drainage, making it unsuitable for rice cultivation. However, lotus roots naturally thrived in this environment.
5947e797954602aa.zh: 這是「紅白糯米鑲蓮藕」，將糯米填入蓮藕的孔洞後蒸熟。蓮藕的孔洞象徵能看清未來，因此被視為新年「御節料理」的吉祥蔬菜。蓮藕以河內地區的特產聞名，門真市有許多栽培。門真市歷來排水不良，不適合種稻，但蓮藕在這樣的環境中自然生長茂盛。

594bf87b10c4552c.en: The Wakasa area has been known since the Asuka and Nara periods as a "miketsukuni" (province of food), where people were allowed to deliver foodstuffs to the Imperial Court in the capital, and the area played an important role in the food industry. Mackerel, in particular, was fatty and tasty, and large numbers were transported to Kyoto along the "saba kaido" (mackerel road) by "back-breaking" fish carriers who carried the fish on foot.
594bf87b10c4552c.zh: 若狹地區自飛鳥、奈良時代起就以「御食國」（食物之國）聞名，獲准向京城的朝廷進貢食材，在飲食方面扮演重要角色。其中鯖魚油脂豐富、滋味鮮美，由徒步背負漁獲的「背負」挑夫沿著「鯖街道」（鯖魚之路）大量運往京都。

595b3e8bbd87cb15.en: "Mimi" is a local dish mainly in the Toya area of Fujikawa Town. It is made by kneading flour and cutting it into bite-size pieces, then sticking the two corners of the dough together to make a triangular shape and stewing it with vegetables in a miso flavor. It is similar to "houtou," but "mimi" is so named because of its distinctive triangular shape, which resembles the shape of a "winnowing basket," a farming implement (some say it is because it resembles an ear).
595b3e8bbd87cb15.zh: 「みみ」主要是富士川町十谷地區的鄉土料理。做法是將麵粉揉成麵團，切成一口大小，再將麵片的兩角捏合成三角形，與蔬菜一起以味噌口味燉煮。與「ほうとう」相似，但「みみ」之名來自其獨特的三角形，形狀像農具「箕」（也有一說是因為像耳朵）。

5970e618301d14a4.en: Sakiyama shell midden (崎山貝塚, Sakiyama Kaizuka) is an archaeological site consisting of a  Jōmon period shell midden and the remains of an adjacent settlement located in what is now the city of Miyako, Iwate Prefecture in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan.  It has been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 1996.
5970e618301d14a4.zh: 崎山貝塚是位於日本北部東北地方、今岩手縣宮古市境內的考古遺址，包括繩文時代的貝塚及鄰近的聚落遺跡。自1996年起由中央政府指定為國家史跡加以保護。

5977764c288a3fbe.en: Kūtei-kan (空挺館, Sky-Volunteer Hall) is an exhibition institution in Ground Self-Defense Force Narashino Camp.
5977764c288a3fbe.zh: 空挺館是位於陸上自衛隊習志野駐屯地內的展示設施。

59865d829da9190c.en: Anraku-ji (安楽寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Kōyasan Shingon-shū in Kamiita, Tokushima, Japan. Temple 6 on the Shikoku Pilgrimage, the main image is of Bhaisajyaguru (Yakushi Nyōrai). The temple is said to have been founded by Kūkai, who carved the image. The Hōjō (1751–1829) has been placed on the cultural properties register. Anraku-ji has played an influential role in the Shikoku Reijōkai (Shikoku Pilgrimage Association), providing its first head in 1956.
59865d829da9190c.zh: 安樂寺（安楽寺）是位於日本德島縣上板的高野山真言宗佛寺。為四國遍路第6番寺院，本尊為藥師如來。據傳由空海創建，本尊亦為其所雕。方丈（1751–1829）已登錄為文化財。安樂寺在四國靈場會（四國遍路協會）中具有影響力，1956年該會首任會長即出自本寺。

59d5f2f597b23afa.en: “Imoni” (taro soup) is said to have originated in the mid-1600s. At that time, the Nakayama-machi Nagasaki area, the last stop for the Mogami River boat service, was a place to pick up cargo brought from the Kamigata (Kyoto-Osaka area) via Sakata. However, at that time there was no way to communicate to announce the arrival of a boat, so the boatmen had to wait for days before the consignee showed up, and they would hold a party around a pot on the riverbank to pass the time.
59d5f2f597b23afa.zh: 「芋煮」據說起源於1600年代中期。當時，最上川舟運的終點中山町長崎一帶，是領取從上方（京都、大阪一帶）經酒田運來之貨物的地方。然而當時沒有辦法通知船隻抵達，船夫必須等上好幾天收貨人才會出現，於是他們在河岸邊圍著鍋子舉辦宴會打發時間。

59dc5061e75ef7d3.en: The stems of the satoimo(=japanese taro) plant, known as “zuiki,” especially those of the Yatsugashira variety, were traditionally consumed as a preserved food called “imogara.” In times of food scarcity, people often cooked them by boiling and mixing with rice or preparing them in simmered dishes. It was considered good for women's health and was referred to as the “medicine for the blood path.” The stems of Yatsugashira taro were harvested in autumn, peeled, thoroughly dried, and stored as preserved food.
59dc5061e75ef7d3.zh: 里芋（芋頭）的莖稱為「ずいき」，尤其是八頭品種的莖，傳統上作為名為「芋がら」的保存食食用。在糧食匱乏的時期，人們常將其煮過後拌入米飯，或做成燉煮料理。據說對女性健康有益，被稱為「血道之藥」。八頭的莖在秋季採收，削皮後充分乾燥，作為保存食儲存。

59f7b73e44643bd6.en: Ishikawa Ongakudō (石川県立音楽堂, Ishikawa kenritsu ongakudō) is a concert hall in Kanazawa, Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan. It opened in 2001 and has two principal performances spaces: the shoebox-style Concert Hall, which seats 1,560; and the Hōgaku Hall, with a capacity of 720, for traditional Japanese music, kabuki, and bunraku. The walls of the main auditorium are finished with urushi. Yoshinobu Ashihara was the architect with acoustic design by Nagata Acoustics, who trialled their concept with a 1:10 scale model.
59f7b73e44643bd6.zh: 石川県立音楽堂是位於日本石川縣金澤市的音樂廳，2001年開幕，設有兩個主要表演空間：鞋盒式的音樂廳，可容納1,560席；以及邦樂廳，容量720席，供日本傳統音樂、歌舞伎及文樂演出使用。主廳牆面以漆塗裝修。建築師為芦原義信，音響設計由永田音響設計負責，並以1:10比例模型測試其設計概念。

5a02fb4055b7c179.en: Otaru Music Box Museum (小樽オルゴール堂) is a music museum in the Otaru Orgel-do II building in Otaru, Japan. It includes various examples of music boxes as well as CDs that have music box-esque versions of various songs. Chris Bamforth of The Japan Times wrote that it had an "absolutely phenomenal" variety of music.
5a02fb4055b7c179.zh: 小樽オルゴール堂是位於日本小樽「小樽オルゴール堂II」建築內的音樂博物館，收藏各式音樂盒，並有以音樂盒風格演奏各種歌曲的CD。The Japan Times的Chris Bamforth寫道，其音樂種類「極為豐富」。

5a0dd94f1b7d4c63.en: Fugaku Wind Cave (Japanese: 富岳風穴) is a lava tube at the northern foot of Mount Fuji, Japan. It is the largest of the several lava tubes that are found in the Aokigahara forest in Fujikawaguchiko Town, Yamanashi Prefecture.
5a0dd94f1b7d4c63.zh: 富岳風穴是位於日本富士山北麓的熔岩洞，為山梨縣富士河口湖町青木原樹海中數個熔岩洞裡規模最大者。

5a10795bea0ca5e5.en: Izushi Sara Soba is a local dish of Izushi Town, Toyooka City, where several pieces of soba are served on small white porcelain plates with sauce and condiments in a small sake cup. 5 pieces of soba are one serving. Locals say that a serving of soba is equal to the height of a pair of chopsticks held up by an adult male.It began in 1706, when Masaaki Sengoku, a feudal lord from Ueda in Shinshu (Nagano Prefecture), brought a soba craftsman with him.
5a10795bea0ca5e5.zh: 出石皿そば是豐岡市出石町的鄉土料理，將數份蕎麥麵分盛在白色小瓷盤上，醬汁與佐料則裝在小酒杯中。5盤蕎麥麵為一人份。當地人說，一人份的蕎麥麵相當於成年男性手持一雙筷子豎起來的高度。起源於1706年，信州（長野縣）上田的藩主仙石政明帶著蕎麥麵師傅一同前來。

5a1634a91debddaf.en: Nobeoka Castle (延岡城, Nobeoka-jō) is the remains of a castle structure in Nobeoka, Miyazaki Prefecture, Japan.
5a1634a91debddaf.zh: 延岡城是位於日本宮崎縣延岡市的城郭遺跡。

5a19e3b4874c4341.en: It is said that the origin of ‘kiriboshi imo’ is Shizuoka Prefecture. In Edo Era, Gon’emon Ohsawa rescued the ship from Satsuma (current Kagoshima Prefecture) wrecked at the offshore of Omaezaki. This made sweet potato introduced in Shizuoka Prefecture. After that, the cultivation of sweet potato has been prevailing in the prefecture, and ‘nikiriboshi-hou’, the method to dry sliced boiled sweet potato under the sunshine, was invented. They say that it is the origin of ‘hoshi-imo’ (dried sweet potato).
5a19e3b4874c4341.zh: 據說切り干しいも起源於靜岡縣。江戶時代，大澤權右衛門救助了一艘在御前崎外海遇難的薩摩（今鹿兒島縣）船隻，番薯因此傳入靜岡縣。此後番薯栽培在縣內普及，並發明了將煮過的番薯切片後日曬乾燥的「煮切干法」。據說這就是番薯乾的起源。

5a1bdeb19c4cac3b.en: Hiruzen Okowa is a type of rice with many ingredients, generally called Gomoku Okowa. It is a local delicacy representative of Hiruzen, and always appears at festivals and celebrations. It is characterized by the sumptuous contents of chicken, chestnuts, burdocks, carrots, konnyaku, azuki beans, and seasonal wild vegetables from the Hiruzen area.
5a1bdeb19c4cac3b.zh: 蒜山おこわ是一種加入多種配料的米飯，一般稱為五目おこわ。是蒜山具代表性的鄉土美食，在祭典和喜慶場合必定出現。特色是配料豐盛，包含雞肉、栗子、牛蒡、紅蘿蔔、蒟蒻、紅豆，以及蒜山地區的當季山菜。

5a26c9f0380541bd.en: Nanzen-in (南禅院) is one of the tatchu sub-temples of Nanzen-ji, a Rinzai school Zen Buddhist temple in the Fukuchi neighborhood of Sakyō-ku in the city of Kyoto Japan. Its honzon is a Kamakura period statue of Emperor Kameyama, which is a National Important Cultural Property.
5a26c9f0380541bd.zh: 南禪院是日本京都市左京區福地町臨濟宗禪寺南禪寺的塔頭之一。本尊為鎌倉時代的龜山天皇像，為國家重要文化財。

5a3a441a3d6cc9ff.en: Myōkoku-ji (妙国寺) is a Buddhist temple in Sakai, Osaka Prefecture, Japan and one of head temples of the Nichiren Sect. It is known as the location of the 1868 Sakai incident.
5a3a441a3d6cc9ff.zh: 妙国寺是位於日本大阪府堺市的佛教寺院，為日蓮宗的本山之一。以1868年堺事件的發生地而聞名。

5a49cbf438771b56.en: The Gozaisho Ropeway (御在所ロープウェイ, Gozaisho Rōpuwei) is the name of a Japanese aerial lift line, as well as its operator. Opened in 1959, the lift carries passengers up to Mount Gozaisho (御在所岳) in Komono, Mie, offering views of Yokkaichi and Ise Bay. The mountain is known for its scenery and the nearby Yunoyama Onsen. The line links to a chairlift line that goes to the summit.
5a49cbf438771b56.zh: 御在所ロープウェイ是日本的一條空中纜車路線名稱，也是其營運公司的名稱。1959年啟用，載運乘客登上三重縣菰野町的御在所岳，可眺望四日市與伊勢灣。此山以景色及鄰近的湯之山溫泉聞名。纜車另與通往山頂的登山吊椅相連。

5a53074f6d5a6ca6.en: In Gunma, where wheat is actively produced, many local dishes using wheat flour are popular. Especially, various types of "Manju" (steamed bun with filling) such as those containing baking soda or "Soba" (buckwheat) are made, and among them, the distinctive one is "Yakimanju" (grilled manju), where sweet miso sauce is applied to "Manju" skewered on a stick and then grilled.
5a53074f6d5a6ca6.zh: 在小麥生產興盛的群馬，許多使用麵粉的鄉土料理廣受歡迎。尤其會製作加入小蘇打或「蕎麥」等各種「饅頭」（有餡的蒸包），其中別具特色的是「焼きまんじゅう」，作法是將饅頭串在竹籤上，塗上甜味噌醬後燒烤。

5a82ef282fe75599.en: Ayabe Shrine (綾部神社) is a shrine of the kami Hachiman, located in Miyaki, Saga, Saga Prefecture, Japan.
5a82ef282fe75599.zh: 綾部神社是供奉八幡神的神社，位於日本佐賀縣三養基郡みやき町。

5a8c33dd15789477.en: The Chido Museum (致道博物館, Chidō hakubutsukan) is a private museum in Tsuruoka, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan.
5a8c33dd15789477.zh: 致道博物館（Chidō hakubutsukan）是位於日本山形縣鶴岡市的私立博物館。

5a92fdba62f30e36.en: Iwakuni Chōkokan (岩国徴古館) is a public museum in Iwakuni, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan. Constructed between 1942 and March 1945 for the storage and display of the works of art and craft and historical materials donated by the Kikkawa family, former lords of Iwakuni Domain, the facility first opened in April 1944, operating fully as a museum from the beginning of the 1950s.
5a92fdba62f30e36.zh: 岩国徴古館是位於日本山口縣岩國市的公立博物館。為收藏及展示前岩國藩主吉川家捐贈的美術工藝品與歷史資料，於1942年至1945年3月間興建，設施於1944年4月首度開放，1950年代初起正式作為博物館全面營運。

5a969865fcd82aeb.en: Mizuta Tenmangū (水田天満宮) is a Shinto shrine in Chikugo, Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan.
5a969865fcd82aeb.zh: 水田天滿宮是位於日本福岡縣筑後市的神社。

5a9a503ca148230c.en: Kashiwa (chicken meat) has been a favorite dish in Aichi Prefecture. Poultry farming in Aichi Prefecture began in the late Edo period (1603-1868), and developed into the famous "Nagoya Cochin" in the early Meiji period (1868-1912). Poultry farming has continued to flourish until the present day. The reason for this is said to be the abundance of wild birds in the Satoyama areas of Aichi.For this reason, many chicken dishes are prepared in Aichi.
5a9a503ca148230c.zh: かしわ（雞肉）一直是愛知縣人喜愛的料理。愛知縣的養雞業始於江戶時代（1603-1868）後期，到明治時代（1868-1912）初期發展出知名的「名古屋交趾雞」。養雞業至今仍持續興盛。據說原因在於愛知的里山地區野鳥眾多。因此，愛知有許多雞肉料理。

5a9c9e810b9afc74.en: The Katsurazawa Dam is a dam in Hokkaidō, Japan. It was Hokkaido's first multipurpose dam and the post-war Ishikari River watershed development plan's starting point. The dam is a 63.6m in height Concrete Gravity dam, immediately downstream from the Shinkatsurazawa Dam. The artificial lake resulting from the construction of the Katsurazawa Dam is known as the Katsurazawa Lake.
5a9c9e810b9afc74.zh: 桂沢ダム是位於日本北海道的水壩，為北海道第一座多功能水壩，也是戰後石狩川流域開發計畫的起點。水壩為高63.6公尺的混凝土重力壩，位於新桂沢水壩的正下游。興建桂沢水壩所形成的人工湖稱為桂沢湖。

5aa48306e5987527.en: The Ōsumi Kokubun-ji (大隅国分寺) was a Buddhist temple located in what is now the Kokubu neighborhood of the city of Kirishima, Kagoshima, Japan. It was one of the provincial temples per the system established by Emperor Shōmu during the Nara period (710 – 794) for the purpose of promoting Buddhism as the national religion of Japan and standardising imperial rule over the provinces. The temple no longer exists, but the temple grounds were designated as a National Historic Site in 1921.
5aa48306e5987527.zh: 大隅國分寺是位於現今日本鹿兒島縣霧島市國分地區的佛教寺院。該寺是奈良時代（710–794）聖武天皇所建立之國分寺制度下的各國寺院之一，目的在於將佛教推廣為日本國教，並統一朝廷對各地方的統治。寺院現已不存，但寺域於1921年被指定為國家史跡。

5ac2cf15c14e73db.en: Tanjō-ji (誕生寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Nichiren Shū located in the city of Kamogawa in Chiba Prefecture, Japan. Along with Kuon-ji in Yamanashi Prefecture, Ikegami Honmon-ji in the south of Tokyo, and Seichō-ji also in Kamogawa City, Tanjōji is one of the "Four Sacred Places of Nichiren Shū."
5ac2cf15c14e73db.zh: 誕生寺（誕生寺）是位於日本千葉縣鴨川市的日蓮宗寺院。誕生寺與山梨縣的久遠寺、東京南部的池上本門寺，以及同在鴨川市的清澄寺，並列為「日蓮宗四大靈場」。

5ac676aed8f19085.en: Ryōgonzan Renge-in Myōhō-ji (楞厳山蓮華院妙法寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Nichiren sect in Kamakura, Kanagawa, Japan. It is one of a group of three built near the site in Matsubagayatsu, or the Valley of Pine Needles (松葉ヶ谷), where Nichiren, founder of the Buddhist sect that bears his name, is supposed to have had his hut. The temple has also close ties with Prince Morinaga and the Imperial House.
5ac676aed8f19085.zh: 楞嚴山蓮華院妙法寺是位於日本神奈川縣鎌倉的日蓮宗佛寺。日蓮宗創始人日蓮據傳曾在松葉ヶ谷結庵，附近建有三座寺院，本寺為其中之一。本寺與護良親王及皇室也有密切關係。

5ad1f1809c76083d.en: Surugamaru Castle (駿河丸城, Surugamaru-jō) was a Japanese castle located in  Kitahiroshima, Hiroshima Prefecture.  Its ruins have been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 1986 as part of the "Kikkawa clan fortification ruins" along with Ogurayama Castle and Hinoyama Castle.
5ad1f1809c76083d.zh: 駿河丸城是位於廣島縣北廣島町的日本城郭。其遺址自1986年起與小倉山城、日野山城一同作為「吉川氏城館遺址」的一部分，由中央政府列為國家史跡加以保護。

5af21a068fe0bdcd.en: Nanko Park (南湖公園, Nanko kōen) is considered to be the oldest public park in Japan, having been founded in 1801 by Matsudaira Sadanobu, the 12th daimyō of Shirakawa Domain.  It was designated as both a National Historic Site of Japan and as a National Place of Scenic Beauty in 1934.
5af21a068fe0bdcd.zh: 南湖公園被視為日本最古老的公園，由白河藩第12代大名松平定信於1801年創設。1934年同時被指定為日本國家史跡及國家名勝。

5b158097e5956c63.en: Sobo Katamuki Prefectural Natural Park (祖母傾県立自然公園, Sobo Katamuki kenritsu shizen kōen) was a Prefectural Natural Park in southern Ōita Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1951, the park spanned the municipalities of Bungo-ōno, Saiki, and Taketa. In 2017 it was incorporated into the Sobo, Katamuki and Okue Biosphere Reserve.
5b158097e5956c63.zh: 祖母傾県立自然公園曾是位於日本大分縣南部的一座縣立自然公園。公園設立於1951年，範圍橫跨豐後大野市、佐伯市與竹田市。2017年併入祖母・傾・大崩生物圈保留區。

5b394b2fe04614c9.en: The Amakusa region, consisting of some 120 islands of various sizes, is blessed with an abundance of seafood, especially the specialty octopus, which grows on shrimp and crabs and is known for its quality, including its elastic texture.
5b394b2fe04614c9.zh: 由大小約120座島嶼組成的天草地區海產豐富，特別是特產章魚，以蝦蟹為食成長，以富有彈性的口感等品質著稱。

5b4e5f30bf6852c5.en: Mount Hakkyō (八経ヶ岳, Hakkyō-ga-take) is a mountain within the Omine Mountains, which are located on the border of Tenkawa and Kamikitayama,  Yoshino District, Nara Prefecture, Japan. At 1,914.6 m (6,281 ft), it's the tallest mountain in the in Nara Prefecture and Kansai region.
5b4e5f30bf6852c5.zh: 八経ヶ岳是大峰山脈中的一座山，位於日本奈良縣吉野郡天川村與上北山村交界。標高1,914.6公尺（6,281英尺），為奈良縣及近畿地方最高峰。

5b6c3aa0a1b0d5aa.en: "Takuan no Kimpira" is a stir-fry of old "takuan" (=daikon radish pickles) after removing salt. Daikon radish, harvested from winter until spring, has cultivated in many areas in Kagawa prefecture since long time ago. It contains amylase, digestive enzyme of starch, and carotenes and Vitamin C are taken from its leaves. It is used not only in miso soup and simmered dishes, but also for local dishes like "Teppai" or "Shippoku Udon".
5b6c3aa0a1b0d5aa.zh: 「たくあんのきんぴら」是將醃久的澤庵（＝醃蘿蔔）去鹽後拌炒而成的料理。冬季至春季收成的蘿蔔，自古就在香川縣許多地區栽培。蘿蔔含有分解澱粉的消化酵素澱粉酶，葉子則可攝取胡蘿蔔素與維生素C。除了用於味噌湯和燉煮料理，也用於「てっぱい」、「しっぽくうどん」等鄉土料理。

5b6e0b3302d7121d.en: Yamamiya Sengen-jinja (山宮浅間神社) is a shrine in Fujinomiya, Shizuoka, Japan. The shrine is unique as it lacks a honden and instead only has an altar. It uses a Kannabi instead
5b6e0b3302d7121d.zh: 山宮浅間神社是位於日本靜岡縣富士宮市的神社。此神社特別之處在於沒有本殿，只有祭壇，改以神奈備作為信仰對象。

5b7ca36aee265ed8.en: Arafune-Azumaya Cold Storage Facilities (荒船・東谷風穴蚕種貯蔵所跡, Arafune-Azumaya fūketsu sanshu chozō sho ato) are natural refrigerators used in silkworm production in association with the Tomioka Silk Mill in the towns of Shimonita and Nakanojō, Gunma Prefecture Japan. They are jointly designated as a National Historic Site and, together with the Tomioka Silk Mill, inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List as part of the serial nomination Tomioka Silk Mill and Related Sites
5b7ca36aee265ed8.zh: 荒船・東谷風穴蚕種貯蔵所跡是位於日本群馬縣下仁田町與中之條町的天然冷藏設施，用於與富岡製絲場相關的養蠶生產。兩處共同被指定為國家史跡，並與富岡製絲場一同以「富岡製絲場與絲綢產業遺產群」的系列提名列入聯合國教科文組織世界遺產名錄。

5bb1e7564c385bd3.en: Kitsune Udon in Osaka is a dish where udon noodles are topped with a broth made primarily from ingredients like kombu (kelp) and mackerel flakes. This flavorful broth is complemented with sweet and savory simmered aburaage (deep-fried tofu pockets).
5bb1e7564c385bd3.zh: 大阪的きつねうどん是在烏龍麵上淋上主要以昆布、鯖魚片等食材熬成的湯頭。這道風味豐富的湯頭再搭配甜鹹燉煮的油豆腐皮。

5bb293438a71e1de.en: The Chikamori Site  (チカモリ遺跡, Chikamori iseki) is an archaeological site with the ruins of a late Jōmon period settlement in what is now the Shinbohon neighbourhood of the city of Kanazawa, Ishikawa in the Hokuriku region of Japan. It was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1987.
5bb293438a71e1de.zh: チカモリ遺跡是日本北陸地區石川縣金澤市新保本一帶的考古遺址，保存有繩文時代晚期聚落的遺跡。1987年被指定為日本國家史跡。

5bbacb5a0246f816.en: The Atsumi Peninsula faces Mikawa Bay to the north and the Pacific Ocean to the south, and is blessed with the natural beauty of the sea and mountains. The mild climate due to the influence of the Kuroshio Current flowing offshore, the long hours of sunlight, and the large number of sunny days make it a very suitable environment for agriculture. However, the Atsumi Peninsula used to have no major rivers and was always plagued by drought damage, and the soil was barren, hardly fertile.
5bbacb5a0246f816.zh: 渥美半島北臨三河灣、南面太平洋，擁有海洋與山林的自然美景。受外海黑潮影響，氣候溫和，日照時間長，晴天日數多，是非常適合農業的環境。然而，渥美半島過去沒有大型河川，長年苦於旱災，土壤也貧瘠不肥沃。

5bf43927edec4fcb.en: Facing the Ariake Sea, Shiraishi Town boasts a rich natural landscape of mountains, plains, sea, and rivers.
