Particularly, the Shiraishi Plains were reclaimed through repeated land reclamation projects from the medieval era to the present, becoming a fertile land for cultivating rice, wheat, vegetables, and more. Rice, in particular, has been a focus of continuous quality improvement efforts for centuries.
5bf43927edec4fcb.zh: 白石町面向有明海，擁有山、平原、海、河川等豐富的自然景觀。尤其是白石平原，從中世到現在經過一次次的填海造地，成為適合種植稻米、小麥、蔬菜等作物的肥沃土地。其中稻米更是數百年來持續致力改良品質的作物。

5bf7c0b83efc1a74.en: “Papaya Pickles” are made by pickling young papaya fruit in salt, followed by additional pickling in miso paste or soy sauce, and are popular as a type of pickled vegetable that can be made easily at home. These pickles are eaten in Okinawa Prefecture as well as the Amami Region.
5bf7c0b83efc1a74.zh: 「パパイヤ漬け」是將未成熟的木瓜果實用鹽醃漬後，再以味噌或醬油醃漬而成，是在家中也能輕鬆製作、受歡迎的醃菜。沖繩縣與奄美地區都有食用。

5c116258ef6e40be.en: Mount Yae (八重岳, Yae-dake; Kunigami: Yē-dakī, Okinawan: Yē-daki), also known as Mount Yaedake or Yae-take, is a mountain in Motobu, Okinawa on Okinawa Island. It is the tallest mountain on the Motobu Peninsula, standing at 453.4 m (1,487 ft 6+1⁄2 in). Nakijin Castle and Nago Castle were built nearby in the 14th century. The mountain itself was used as a major Japanese defensive position during the Battle of Okinawa. Today it is famous for its annual Cherry Blossom Festival (桜祭り, Sakura Matsuri) held in March.
5c116258ef6e40be.zh: 八重岳（八重岳，Yae-dake；國頭語：Yē-dakī，沖繩語：Yē-daki），又稱Yaedake山或Yae-take，是位於沖繩本島本部町的山。為本部半島最高峰，標高453.4公尺（1,487英尺6½英寸）。14世紀時，今歸仁城與名護城建於附近。沖繩戰役期間，此山曾作為日軍的主要防禦陣地。現今以每年3月舉辦的櫻花祭（桜祭り，Sakura Matsuri）聞名。

5c15bcc68a116c73.en: Shirakawa Castle (白川城, Shirakawa-jō) was a Sengoku period Japanese castle located in what is now the city of Shirakawa, northern Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. It should not be confused with the later "Shirakawa Castle" of the Edo period, which was more properly known as  Komine Castle. The old Shirakawa Castle was also known as Karame-jō (搦目城) or Yūki-Shirakawa-jō (結城白川城). The castle site was granted government protection as a National Historic Site of Japan in 2016.
5c15bcc68a116c73.zh: 白川城是戰國時代的日本城郭，位於今日本福島縣北部的白河市。不應與江戶時代後來的「白河城」混淆，後者正式名稱為小峰城。舊白川城又稱搦目城或結城白川城。城址於2016年獲指定為日本國家史跡，受政府保護。

5c1ad3d00a3c1976.en: Asuka Pond Workshop Site (飛鳥池工房遺跡, Asuka-ike kōbō iseki) is an archaeological site with the remains of an Asuka period industrial complex, located in the village of Asuka, Nara  in the Kansai region of Japan. Its ruins were designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 2001.
5c1ad3d00a3c1976.zh: 飛鳥池工房遺跡是位於日本關西地區奈良縣明日香村的考古遺址，保存有飛鳥時代工業設施群的遺跡。其遺跡於2001年被指定為日本國家史跡。

5c204e9460779409.en: Akiu Great Falls (秋保大滝, Akiu Ōtaki) is a waterfall located in  Taihaku-ku, Sendai, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan. It is a nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty. It is one of "Japan’s Top 100 Waterfalls", in a listing published by the Japanese Ministry of the Environment in 1990.
5c204e9460779409.zh: 秋保大滝是位於日本宮城縣仙台市太白區的瀑布，為國家指定名勝，也名列日本環境省於1990年公布的「日本瀑布百選」。

5c5992b5185d771b.en: Kawasaki Velodrome (川崎競輪場, Kawasaki Keirinjyō) is a velodrome located in Kawasaki, Kanagawa that conducts pari-mutuel Keirin racing - one of Japan's four authorized "Public Sports" (公営競技, kōei kyōgi) where gambling is permitted. Its Keirin identification number for betting purposes is 34# (34 sharp).
5c5992b5185d771b.zh: 川崎競輪場是位於神奈川縣川崎市的自行車競賽場，舉辦彩池投注制的競輪比賽。競輪是日本四種獲准投注的「公營競技」之一。該場用於投注的競輪識別編號為34#（34 sharp）。

5c6fcafcdd240cfd.en: Choju Namasu is a dish that is popular during the New Year's holiday. Its name implies that it brings about longevity. The dish contains daikon radish, which is rich in an enzyme called diastase. This enzyme is believed to help in the recovery of the digestive tract after consuming too much New Year's food. Additionally, the dish also includes carrots, a nutritious vegetable, thick fried tofu that is protein-rich, and healthy sesame seeds.
5c6fcafcdd240cfd.zh: 長壽なます是新年期間常見的料理，其名寓意帶來長壽。料理中的白蘿蔔富含名為澱粉酶的酵素，一般認為有助於在吃了過多年菜後恢復消化道機能。此外還加入營養豐富的紅蘿蔔、富含蛋白質的厚炸豆腐，以及有益健康的芝麻。

5c712b41a174bcbe.en: Shiiba Village, located in the mountains which border Kumamoto Prefecture, is a quiet village in which the legend remains that a member of the Heike family fled there after an enemy defeat. In this village, the Kyoto dialect continues to be used in daily conversation, and there are dishes reminiscent of Kyoto cuisine in the food culture as well.
5c712b41a174bcbe.zh: 椎葉村位於與熊本縣交界的山區，是一座寧靜的村落，流傳著平家一族戰敗後逃到此地的傳說。村裡日常對話至今仍使用京都方言，飲食文化中也有令人聯想到京料理的菜色。

5c722b48530d9a23.en: Chihen-ji ruins (池辺寺跡, Chihen-ji ato) is an archeological site  with the ruins of a Heian period Buddhist temple located in the Ikegami neighborhood of the city of Kumamoto, Japan. The temple no longer exists, and its ruins were designated a National Historic Site in 1997.
5c722b48530d9a23.zh: 池辺寺跡是考古遺址，保存平安時代佛教寺院的遺跡，位於日本熊本市池上町一帶。寺院已不存在，遺址於1997年被列為國家指定史跡。

5c74c26d3f29c4b5.en: Saitama Prefectural Museum of History and Folklore (埼玉県立歴史と民俗の博物館, Saitama Kenritsu Rekishi to Minzoku no Hakubutsukan) is a prefectural museum in Saitama, Japan, dedicated to the history and folklore of Saitama Prefecture. The museum opened in 1971.
5c74c26d3f29c4b5.zh: 埼玉縣立歷史與民俗博物館是位於日本埼玉縣埼玉市的縣立博物館，以埼玉縣的歷史與民俗為主題。該館於1971年開館。

5c79f46018e5dd51.en: Ishikawa Prefecture was once known as a production area of the somen (thin noodles). In Wajima City, Okunoto, which used to be a major production area, the production of somen was rooted in the Muromachi period (1336 - 1573) and has a longer history than the lacquerware “Wajimanuri”. In the Edo period (1603-1868), the reputation grew even more, and it was exported to various regions. The common people used it as a specialty gift, and the famous brands were even used as a gift to the shogun (general).
5c79f46018e5dd51.zh: 石川縣過去是知名的素麵產地。曾為主要產地的奧能登輪島市，素麵生產可追溯至室町時代（1336－1573），歷史比漆器「輪島塗」更悠久。到了江戶時代（1603－1868）名聲更加響亮，並銷往各地。一般百姓將其作為特產贈禮，知名品牌甚至被當作獻給將軍的禮品。

5c85ee36fb7d31f6.en: Tondabayashi Jinaimachi (富田林寺内町) is a popular name of the old temple-based town (Jinaimachi) located in Tondabayashi City, Osaka Prefecture, Japan. It is one of the Important Preservation Districts for Groups of Traditional Buildings (1997) in Tondabayashi-shi Tondabayashi (富田林市富田林重要伝統的建造物群保存地区). The town retains town blocks from the Sengoku period, along with machiyas (traditional wooden town residences) built from the mid-Edo period on.
5c85ee36fb7d31f6.zh: 富田林寺內町是位於日本大阪府富田林市、以寺院為中心發展的舊市街（寺內町）的通稱。此地是重要傳統建造物群保存地區之一（1997年），名稱為「富田林市富田林重要傳統的建造物群保存地區」。町內保留戰國時代的街區，以及江戶時代中期以後建造的町家（傳統木造町屋住宅）。

5c9eff8e2ee50cf8.en: The Suwa region’s kanten (agar agar) producing industry developed due to the area’s low temperatures and stable weather, which allowed for longer production seasons than other areas, and the opening of the railroad at the end of the Meiji period (1868 - 1912). The kanten industry started in the Edo period (1603 – 1868). It is said that Kumezaemon Kobayashi, a migrant kanten producer, brought the process back to his hometown.
5c9eff8e2ee50cf8.zh: 諏訪地區的寒天產業之所以發展，是因為當地氣溫低、天氣穩定，生產季節比其他地區長，加上明治時代（1868－1912）末期鐵路開通。寒天產業始於江戶時代（1603－1868）。據說是外出從事寒天生產的小林粂左衛門將製法帶回家鄉。

5cb3ecacb3dbc85a.en: Shōfuku-ji (正福寺; lit. Temple of the Correct Fortune) is a Rinzai Zen Buddhist temple in Higashimurayama, Tokyo, Japan. Its early 15th century Jizō hall is a registered National Treasure of Japan. It is considered to be the oldest intact building in Tokyo Prefecture and a unique example of Kamakura period architecture.
5cb3ecacb3dbc85a.zh: 正福寺（正福寺；字面意思為「正福之寺」）是位於日本東京都東村山市的臨濟宗禪寺。寺內建於15世紀初的地藏堂為日本國寶，被視為東京都現存最古老的完整建築，也是鎌倉時代建築的獨特實例。

5ce2561e4a126bb3.en: Usuki City is located in southeastern Oita Prefecture, and stretches out in an oval shape towards Hoyo Strait. It is on Usuki Bay facing Bungo Channel to the east, and the ridges of Mount Chinnan and Mount Himedake to the southwest. Fishing has long been practiced in the coastal communities, where single-hook handline fishing, longline fishing, and small trawl fishing are used. Specialty products include hairtail, yellowtail and blowfish. “Kirasumameshi” is a local cuisine of Usuki City, along with “Ohan” and “Chadaizushi”.
5ce2561e4a126bb3.zh: 臼杵市位於大分縣東南部，呈橢圓形向豐予海峽延伸。東臨面向豐後水道的臼杵灣，西南有鎮南山與姬岳的山脊。沿海聚落長年從事漁業，採用一支釣、延繩釣與小型拖網等漁法。特產有白帶魚、鰤魚和河豚。「きらすまめし」與「黃飯」、「茶台ずし」同為臼杵市的鄉土料理。

5cedc0a37fab7c6d.en: Muryōkōin (無量光院) is a temple of Koyasan Shingon Buddhism, located on Mount Kōya (高野山, Kōya-san), Wakayama prefecture, Japan. Its name means "Temple of limitless light" and is the Japanese transliteration of Amitābha.
5cedc0a37fab7c6d.zh: 無量光院是高野山真言宗的寺院，位於日本和歌山縣高野山。其名意為「無限光明之寺」，是阿彌陀佛（Amitābha）的日文譯名。

5d14654d252daa6b.en: Mangetsu-ji (満月寺) is a temple beside Lake Biwa in Ōtsu, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. The Heian period statue of Shō Kannon is an Important Cultural Property.
5d14654d252daa6b.zh: 滿月寺是位於日本滋賀縣大津市琵琶湖畔的寺院。寺內平安時代的聖觀音像為重要文化財。

5d2adcdbd7c9d515.en: Toyama Prefecture is known as the "Shinshu Kingdom" and is home to a thriving Jodo Shinshu sect. On the anniversary of the death of Shinran Shonin, the founder of Jodo Shinshu, Hoyo and Houon-ko are held to remember his legacy, and 'Houon-ko cuisine' is served on a vermilion-lacquered table.The types and number of dishes vary from region to region, but it is customary to save the best vegetables and wild plants harvested that year for Houon-ko, apart from for everyday use.
5d2adcdbd7c9d515.zh: 富山縣被稱為「真宗王國」，淨土真宗十分興盛。在淨土真宗開山祖師親鸞聖人的忌日，會舉行法要與報恩講以緬懷其遺德，並以朱漆膳端上「報恩講料理」。菜色種類和數量因地區而異，但習俗上會把當年收成最好的蔬菜和山菜留給報恩講，不作日常之用。

5d30c44bbdf211ef.en: The Gifu Sekigahara Battlefield Memorial Museum (岐阜関ケ原古戦場記念館, Gifu Sekigahara Kosenjō Kinenkan) opened in Sekigahara, Gifu Prefecture, Japan in 2020. It tells the story of the 1600 Battle of Sekigahara and promotes the "charm and fascination" of the battlefield, which has been designated a national Historic Site. The Sekigahara Town History and Folklore Museum (関ケ原町歴史民俗学習館) opened in an adjacent facility on the same day.
5d30c44bbdf211ef.zh: 岐阜關原古戰場紀念館（岐阜関ケ原古戦場記念館）於2020年在日本岐阜縣關原町開館。館內介紹1600年的關原之戰，並推廣已被指定為國家史跡的古戰場的「魅力與吸引力」。關原町歷史民俗學習館（関ケ原町歴史民俗学習館）於同日在相鄰設施開館。

5d31984d609b0acc.en: The Amami Islands Botanical Garden (奄美アイランド植物園, Amami Airando Shokubutsuen) is a zoo and botanical garden located on the grounds of the Amami Cultural Foundation, Yanma 811-1, Sumiyo-cho, Amami, Kagoshima, Japan. It is open daily except Tuesdays and Wednesdays; an admission fee is charged.
5d31984d609b0acc.zh: 奄美アイランド植物園（奄美島嶼植物園）是位於日本鹿兒島縣奄美市住用町山間811-1、奄美文化財團園區內的動物園兼植物園。除週二、週三外每日開放，需購票入園。

5d3bbf3155cb6028.en: Fukasawa Castle (深沢城Fukasawa-jō) was a Sengoku period flatland-style Japanese castle located in what is now the city of Gotemba, Shizuoka prefecture. The ruins have been protected as a Shizuoka Prefectural Historic Site since 1960.
5d3bbf3155cb6028.zh: 深沢城是戰國時代的平城式日本城堡，位於現今靜岡縣御殿場市。遺址自1960年起受指定為靜岡縣史跡加以保護。

5d40f6165cca09c3.en: In the Sanpoku district of Murakami City, located on the border with Yamagata Prefecture, slash-and-burn fields are planted in mid-August to grow red turnips. Yakibata was one of the primitive farming methods often practiced in mountainous areas where arable land was scarce, but it has declined with the passage of time.
5d40f6165cca09c3.zh: 在與山形縣交界的村上市山北地區，會在8月中旬於燒墾田播種，栽培紅蕪菁。燒畑是過去常見於耕地稀少的山區的一種原始農法，但隨著時代變遷已逐漸式微。

5d41a95d2175501f.en: Mitami Shrine Mitami-jinja 美多彌神社 (also 美多弥神社) is a Shinto shrine in Sakai, Osaka Prefecture, Japan. It is located in Senboku New Town near Komyoike Station. It is accessible on the Nankai bus line or the Semboku Rapid Railway. Mitami-jinja is mentioned in the Heian period chronicle Engishiki compiled in the early tenth century. The shrine buildings were destroyed by Oda Nobunaga's troops in 1577, but they were rebuilt in 1592 by Wada Dosan 和田道讃.
5d41a95d2175501f.zh: 美多彌神社（亦寫作美多弥神社）是位於日本大阪府堺市的神社，位於泉北新城，鄰近光明池站，可搭乘南海巴士或泉北高速鐵道前往。美多彌神社見於十世紀初編纂的平安時代典籍《延喜式》。社殿於1577年遭織田信長軍隊燒毀，1592年由和田道讃重建。

5d41d1bc0061d071.en: The Yamashiro Hōfun (山代方墳)  is a Kofun period burial mound, located in the Yamashiro-cho neighborhood of the city of Matsue, Shimane in the San'in region of Japan. The tumulus was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1941. It is one of the largest burial mounds in Shimane Prefecture, and one of the last major burial mounds to have been constructed in the Izumo region.
5d41d1bc0061d071.zh: 山代方墳是古墳時代的墳丘，位於日本山陰地區島根縣松江市山代町。此古墳於1941年被指定為日本國家史跡，是島根縣規模最大的古墳之一，也是出雲地區最後興建的大型古墳之一。

5d587661cde0a42a.en: Tamanawa Castle (玉縄城, Tamanawa-jō) was a castle structure in Tamanawa ward of Kamakura, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. The adopted brother of Hōjō Ujiyasu, Hōjō Tsunashige, was commander of the castle.
5d587661cde0a42a.zh: 玉縄城是位於日本神奈川縣鎌倉市玉繩地區的城郭。北條氏康的義兄弟北條綱成曾任該城城主。

5d7142fce05f8eec.en: Mount Utatsu (卯辰山, Utatsu-yama) is a mountain in Kanazawa, Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan. It is also known by a number of other names, including Mount Mukai (向山, Mukai-yama), Mount Mukō (夢香山, Mukō-yama), Mount Garyū (臥竜山, Garyū-zan), and Mount Kasuga (春日山, Kasuga-yama). It is visible to the east of Kanazawa Castle and has Toyokuni Shrine located on its slopes.
5d7142fce05f8eec.zh: 卯辰山是位於日本石川縣金澤市的山，另有多個別名，包括向山、夢香山、臥竜山及春日山。從金澤城往東可見此山，山坡上有豐國神社。

5dabc2f02852ef38.en: "Ebisu" is a chilled Kanten (agar-agar) jelly with whisked eggs. It is an essential ceremonial dish for festivals and celebrations. It is said to have its roots in "Tamago Kanten" (egg agar-agar) documented in Edo-period cookbooks such as 'Edo Ryōri Tsū' and 'Ryōri Hyakuchin'. It was a delicacy crafted from eggs and sugar, which were precious commodities at that time. It is a staple item in osechi cuisine, and is placed on the first layer along with herring roe and kamaboko (red and white fish paste).
5dabc2f02852ef38.zh: 「えびす」是加入打散蛋液的冷藏寒天凍，是祭典與喜慶場合不可缺少的儀式料理。據說源自《江戶料理通》、《料理百珍》等江戶時代料理書中記載的「玉子寒天」（蛋寒天）。這是以當時珍貴的雞蛋和砂糖製成的佳餚。它是御節料理的固定菜色，與鯡魚卵、紅白魚板一同放在第一層。

5dde78112ac0c1ec.en: The Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi UFJ Money Museum (三菱東京UFJ銀行貨幣資料館) is a numismatic museum located in Nagoya, central Japan.
5dde78112ac0c1ec.zh: 三菱東京UFJ銀行貨幣資料館是位於日本中部名古屋的錢幣博物館。

5dee4eb1254f0a5f.en: From spring to early summer, as the mung beans begin to bear fruit and the wheat begins to ripen, Spanish mackerel, loaded with fat, enter the Seto Inland Sea from the open sea, and the season for Spanish mackerel begins. During the off-season before wheat harvesting and rice planting, Sanuki farmers have a custom called "harui-oi," in which they buy a Spanish mackerel and prepare various Spanish mackerel dishes, inviting their relatives to join in the festivities.
5dee4eb1254f0a5f.zh: 從春天到初夏，綠豆開始結實、小麥逐漸成熟之際，油脂豐厚的土魠魚從外海游入瀨戶內海，土魠魚的季節隨之開始。在收割小麥與插秧前的農閒期，讚岐的農民有名為「春祝い」的習俗，會買一條土魠魚做成各種土魠魚料理，邀請親戚一同慶祝。

5e0a07b80a67f18c.en: Aka-mochi is a red-colored rice cake made from red corn flour. It is said that around the Kamakura period (1185-1333), Anyo Shonin, the founder of Amidadera Temple, brought the seeds of corn, the ingredient of "aka-mochi" (red rice cake), from his native Gunma Prefecture to Nagasu, Bando City, and introduced them there. When the Tone River floods due to heavy rainfall, most crops along the river are adversely affected by water damage, but only tall corn avoided flood damage.
5e0a07b80a67f18c.zh: 赤餅是以紅色玉米粉製成的紅色麻糬。據說在鎌倉時代（1185-1333年）前後，阿彌陀寺的開山祖師安養上人將赤餅的原料玉米的種子，從其故鄉群馬縣帶到坂東市長須並傳入當地。利根川因大雨氾濫時，沿岸大部分農作物都會遭受水害，唯有植株高的玉米能避開水災。

5e109939597d3864.en: The Ōita Prefectural Museum of History (大分県立歴史博物館, Ōita kenritsu rekishi hakubutsukan) opened in Usa, Ōita Prefecture, Japan in 1998, replacing the Usa Fudoki-no-Oka (宇佐風土記の丘) of 1981.  It is one of Japan's many museums which are supported by a prefecture.
5e109939597d3864.zh: 大分県立歴史博物館於1998年在日本大分縣宇佐市開館，取代1981年設立的宇佐風土記之丘。這是日本眾多由縣府支持的博物館之一。

5e2032ce92dd5b15.en: Adventure World (アドベンチャーワールド; Adobenchā Wārudo) is an amusement park with a zoo and public aquarium located in the town of Shirahama, Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. It is operated by Hours Co., Ltd. (AWS), an affiliate of Marusue Co., Ltd. headquartered in Matsubara, Osaka Prefecture. The park opened on April 22, 1978, as Nanki Shirahama World Safari.
5e2032ce92dd5b15.zh: アドベンチャーワールド是位於日本和歌山縣白濱町、設有動物園與水族館的遊樂園。由總部位於大阪府松原市的丸末株式會社旗下關係企業Hours株式會社（AWS）經營。園區於1978年4月22日以「南紀白濱World Safari」之名開幕。

5e35182cf6981e2f.en: Kukitachi-nimono" is a local dish using "kukitachi", a cruciferous vegetable. Kukitachi has a strong vitality, and its side branches grow after the core is picked, so it can be harvested one after another.Dried kukitachi are made by boiling the kukitachi caught in spring and drying them in the sun for four to five days. The secret to making tasty dried kukitachi-hairi is to give it a slight rub when drying it.
5e35182cf6981e2f.zh: 「くきたち煮物」是使用十字花科蔬菜「くきたち」的鄉土料理。くきたち生命力強，摘下主莖後會長出側枝，因此可以陸續採收。くきたち干し是將春天採收的くきたち燙煮後，在陽光下曬四到五天製成。要做出好吃的くきたち干し，訣竅是曬乾時稍微搓揉。

5e3bed0ecdbfad93.en: Kyoto Pharmaceutical University (京都薬科大学, Kyoto yakka daigaku) is a private university in Kyoto, Kyoto, Japan. The school's predecessor was founded in 1884. It was chartered as a university in 1949. Because it trains pharmacist-scientists, pharmacists that also possess research skills, Kyoto Pharmaceutical University has laboratories in a wide range of fields. Each laboratory has about 10 members that focus on their research. Students perform research for their pharmaceutical specializations.
5e3bed0ecdbfad93.zh: 京都薬科大学（京都藥科大學）是位於日本京都府京都市的私立大學。學校前身創立於1884年，1949年獲認可為大學。由於培育兼具研究能力的藥劑師科學家，京都藥科大學設有涵蓋廣泛領域的研究室。每個研究室約有10名成員專注於研究，學生則依各自的藥學專業進行研究。

5e9a9d1eef37a3ed.en: The Showa Museum of Art (昭和美術館 Shōwa Bijitsukan) is a private art museum located in the Shiomi district of Shōwa-ku, Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture, Japan.
5e9a9d1eef37a3ed.zh: 昭和美術館是位於日本愛知縣名古屋市昭和區汐見地區的私立美術館。

5ead6d3ef393666c.en: Hiruzen (蒜山; ひるぜん) is the name of an area located in the north of Maniwa City in the north of Okayama Prefecture, Japan. Hiruzen was formed of 3 small towns: Chuka, Yatsuka, and Kawakami, which together were known as the town of Hiruzen, which was merged with several other towns to become current Maniwa City in 2005. Its main feature is the Hiruzen Sanza (蒜山三座), a mountain located on the border of Okayama and Tottori prefectures on the main island of Honshu in Japan.
5ead6d3ef393666c.zh: 蒜山（ひるぜん）是日本岡山縣北部真庭市北部一帶的地區名稱。蒜山原由中和、八束、川上3個小村鎮組成，三者合稱蒜山町，2005年與其他數個町村合併為現在的真庭市。當地主要特色為蒜山三座，這是位於日本本州岡山縣與鳥取縣交界處的山。

5eee64b1808ca4b0.en: Chiiwa Gorge (乳岩峡, Chiiwa-kyō) is a river gorge and scenic spot located within the city of Shinshiro, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. It has been protected as both a Place of Scenic Beauty and Natural Monument since 1934.
5eee64b1808ca4b0.zh: 乳岩峽是位於日本愛知縣新城市內的河川峽谷與名勝，自1934年起同時受名勝及天然紀念物保護。

5ef38f53db2d9d95.en: Mount Kabuto (甲山, Kabuto-yama) is a mountain in Nishinomiya, Hyōgo, Japan. It is located in the east end of the Rokko Mountains, and the height is 309.2m.
5ef38f53db2d9d95.zh: 甲山是位於日本兵庫縣西宮市的山，位於六甲山地東端，海拔309.2公尺。

5f00946a2f363987.en: Mount Mikuni (三国山, Mikuni-yama) is the name of three mountains in Gifu Prefecture, Japan. One of the mountains is on the border of Gifu and Aichi prefectures. Another mountain is on the border of Gifu and Nagano prefectures. The third mountain is located on the border of all three prefectures. All three mountains are included in this article.
5f00946a2f363987.zh: 三国山是日本岐阜縣內三座山的名稱。其中一座位於岐阜縣與愛知縣交界，另一座位於岐阜縣與長野縣交界，第三座則位於三縣交界處。本條目涵蓋這三座山。

5f3f4d87aac2c745.en: Nagara Tenjin Shrine (長良天神神社, Nagara Tenjin Jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in the Nagara area of Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It is a Tenman-gū dedicated to the worship of Sugawara no Michizane.
5f3f4d87aac2c745.zh: 長良天神神社是位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市長良地區的神社，為供奉菅原道真的天滿宮。

5f5335b12744fcc0.en: Kotohiki Park (琴弾公園, Kotohiki kōen) is a city park located in the city of Kan'onji, Kagawa Prefecture, Japan on the island of Shikoku inside Setonaikai National Park. The park is known for its Zenigata suna-e (銭形砂絵) (lit. 'coin-shaped sand-drawing'), dating in origins to 1633 when it was created by the local people to greet their new daimyō Ikoma Takatoshi; Its gardens were designed by gardener Ozawa Keijiro.
5f5335b12744fcc0.zh: 琴弾公園是位於日本四國香川縣觀音寺市、瀨戶內海國立公園內的市立公園。公園以「錢形砂繪」（意為「錢幣形狀的沙畫」）聞名，其起源可追溯至1633年，當地居民為迎接新任大名生駒高俊而製作；園內庭園由造園師小澤圭次郎設計。

5f57d0c0007dc72c.en: Ryūshō-in (龍正院) is a Buddhist temple located in the Namegawa neighborhood of the city of Narita, Chiba Prefecture, Japan. It is a temple of the Tendai school and its honzon is a statue of Jūichimen Kannon Bosatsu, called the Namegawa Kannon (滑河観音).  The temples full name is Namegawa-zan  Ryūshō-in Shōfuku-ji (滑河山龍正院 勝福寺). The temple is the 28th stop on the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route.
5f57d0c0007dc72c.zh: 龍正院是位於日本千葉縣成田市滑川的佛寺，屬天台宗，本尊為十一面觀音菩薩像，稱為滑河觀音。寺院全名為滑河山龍正院勝福寺。該寺為坂東三十三箇所巡禮的第28番札所。

5f5bb07a76985f97.en: The Ishikawa Prefectural Museum of Traditional Arts and Crafts (Japanese: 石川県立伝統産業工芸館) is a museum about traditional arts and crafts located in Kenroku-en, Kanazawa, Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan.
5f5bb07a76985f97.zh: 石川縣立傳統產業工藝館（日語：石川県立伝統産業工芸館）是位於日本石川縣金澤市兼六園內，以傳統工藝為主題的博物館。

5f6395377e53078a.en: Fushimi Togarashi" is a traditional Kyoto vegetable cultivated in the Fushimi Ward area of Kyoto City. Although the details are not clear, it is recorded in "Yongshu fushi," a geographical journal compiled in 1684, that it was cultivated in Yamashiro-no-kuni (present-day southern part of Kyoto Prefecture). Kyoto Prefecture has designated vegetables that have been cultivated in the prefecture since ancient times as "Kyoto's traditional vegetables" and is attempting to brand them.
5f6395377e53078a.zh: 「伏見辣椒」是在京都市伏見區一帶栽培的京都傳統蔬菜。詳細來歷雖不清楚，但1684年編纂的地誌《雍州府志》中記載，山城國（今京都府南部）有栽培這種辣椒。京都府將自古在府內栽培的蔬菜指定為「京之傳統蔬菜」，並致力於品牌化。

5f674ac278efb5fa.en: Yuzu is a seasonal fruit which adds a pleasant aroma and flavor to dishes. They are harvested each year from around October and are in season in December. "Yuzu miso" is made with yuzu peel, yuzu juice, and miso. It is an all-purpose seasoning that is made throughout the country where yuzu is grown. Ibara city is one of the largest producers of yuzu in Okayama prefecture and the recipe for "yuzu miso" is handed down from generation to generation in this region.
5f674ac278efb5fa.zh: 柚子是一種季節性水果，能為料理增添宜人的香氣與風味。每年約從10月開始採收，12月為產季。柚子味噌以柚子皮、柚子汁和味噌製成，是全國各地柚子產地都會製作的萬用調味料。井原市是岡山縣最大的柚子產地之一，柚子味噌的做法在這個地區代代相傳。

5f730646fc6aee20.en: Taiyū-ji (太融寺) is a Buddhist temple in Osaka Prefecture, Japan. It was founded in 821.
5f730646fc6aee20.zh: 太融寺是位於日本大阪府的佛教寺院，創建於821年。

5f7b4bdba124915e.en: Jinnouchi Castle (陣ノ内城, Jinnouchi-jō)  was a flatlands-style Japanese castle located in the Nishikatahonjō neighborhood of the town of  Kōsa,  Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan.  The ruins were designated a National Historic Site in 2021.
5f7b4bdba124915e.zh: 陣ノ内城是平城形式的日本城池，位於日本熊本縣甲佐町西寒野本庄一帶。遺址於2021年被列為國家指定史跡。

5f7d605f68d13be7.en: Tokachi International Speedway (十勝インターナショナルスピードウェイ) is a motor racing circuit in Takikubo, Sarabetsu, Hokkaido, Japan.
5f7d605f68d13be7.zh: 十勝スピードウェイ（十勝インターナショナルスピードウェイ）是位於日本北海道更別村瀧窪的賽車場。

5f805e2e42fc86b4.en: Tsutsumori Shrine (筒森神社, Tsutsumori-jinja) is a Shinto shrine in Ōtaki, Chiba, in Chiba Prefecture, Japan.
5f805e2e42fc86b4.zh: 筒森神社是位於日本千葉縣大多喜町的神社。

5f8a0a9864330732.en: Mutsure Island (Japanese: 六連島) is an island due west of Shimonoseki in the Sea of Japan.
5f8a0a9864330732.zh: 六連島是位於下關正西方日本海上的島嶼。

5f9097dabb31c2fa.en: Narai-juku (奈良井宿, Narai-juku) was the thirty-fourth of the sixty-nine stations of the Nakasendō, as well as the second of eleven stations along the Kisoji. It is located in the present-day city of Shiojiri, Nagano Prefecture, Japan.
5f9097dabb31c2fa.zh: 奈良井宿是中山道六十九宿中的第三十四宿，也是木曾路十一宿中的第二宿，位於今日本長野縣鹽尻市。

5f936550d426359e.en: "Ochirashi-ame" is a confectionery made by kneading Ochirashi powder with Starch syrup. Ochirashi is a type of barley called Hadaka-mugi, also known as "Hattai," which is why "Ochirashi-ame" is sometimes called "Hattai-ame". In Kagawa Prefecture, barley has long been grown extensively as a back crop to rice because of its suitable climate and other growing conditions. Hadaka-mugi is used to make miso and barley tea, and approximately 40% of its yield is shipped out of the prefecture.
5f936550d426359e.zh: 「おちらしあめ」是將おちらし粉與麥芽糖揉合製成的點心。おちらし是用一種名為裸麥的大麥製成，又稱「はったい」，因此「おちらしあめ」有時也稱為「はったいあめ」。香川縣因氣候等栽培條件適宜，長久以來廣泛以大麥作為稻米的裏作。裸麥用於製作味噌和麥茶，約40%的產量運銷縣外。

5f99a88be5f28371.en: Miwa Dam (Japanese: 美和ダム) is a dam in the Nagano Prefecture, Japan, completed in 1959.
5f99a88be5f28371.zh: 美和ダム是位於日本長野縣的水壩，1959年完工。

5f9cf62cd65b51cc.en: The Shinhotaka Ropeway (新穂高ロープウェイ, Shinhotaka Rōpuwei) is an aerial lift system in Takayama, Gifu Prefecture, Japan, and is operated by Okuhi Sightseeing Development (奥飛観光開発, Okuhi Kankō Kaihatsu). The Meitetsu Group company also operates hotels in the area. Opened in 1970, the line climbs to the hillside of the Hida Mountains' Mount Hotaka, the third tallest mountain in Japan.
5f9cf62cd65b51cc.zh: 新穂高ロープウェイ是位於日本岐阜縣高山市的空中纜車系統，由奥飛観光開発經營。這家名鐵集團旗下的公司也在當地經營飯店。路線於1970年開通，可登上飛驒山脈穗高岳的山腰；穗高岳是日本第三高的山。

5fa143dc5affd140.en: The Mt. Kinka Ropeway (金華山ロープウェー, Kinkazan Rōpuwē) is a Japanese aerial lift line in Gifu, Gifu. This is the only line Gifu Kankō Ropeway (岐阜観光索道, Gifu Kankō Sakudō) operates. The company belongs to Meitetsu Group. The line, opened in 1955, climbs Mount Kinka, linking Gifu Park and Gifu Castle.
5fa143dc5affd140.zh: 金華山ロープウェー是位於岐阜縣岐阜市的日本空中纜車路線，也是岐阜観光索道經營的唯一路線。該公司隸屬名鐵集團。路線於1955年開通，沿金華山而上，連接岐阜公園與岐阜城。

5fc36cc5bcff639d.en: Bettara-zuke is pickled radish that is pre-pickled in salt and then pickled in rice malt and sugar.The origin of bettara-zuke is the lightly pickled radish that was sold at Ebisuko in the Edo period.
5fc36cc5bcff639d.zh: 「べったら漬け」是將白蘿蔔先以鹽醃漬，再以米麴和砂糖醃漬而成的醃菜。べったら漬け的起源是江戶時代在惠比須講上販售的淺漬白蘿蔔。

5fd0fe09d80d3027.en: In Fukui Prefecture, where life expectancy is one of the highest in Japan, the most commonly eaten soba is “Oroshi Soba”, “Soba” Noodles with grated Daikon radish.
5fd0fe09d80d3027.zh: 福井縣的平均壽命居日本前段，當地最常吃的蕎麥麵是「おろしそば」，也就是搭配白蘿蔔泥的蕎麥麵。

5ff4ebbc7e521d51.en: The Sugao Stone Buddhas (菅尾磨崖仏, Sugao magaibutsu) is a group of religious statues carved in bas-relief into a tuff cliff in Mie neighborhood of the city of Bungo-Ōno, Ōita Prefecture on the island of Kyushu, Japan.  The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1934, and was designated a National Important Cultural Property in 1964.
5ff4ebbc7e521d51.zh: 菅尾磨崖仏是位於日本九州大分縣豐後大野市三重地區、在凝灰岩崖壁上以淺浮雕刻成的一組宗教造像。此地於1934年被指定為日本國家史跡，1964年被指定為國家重要文化財。

6024ad96147f09c8.en: As there is lots of sunshine and the average of temperature is high in the south of Eastern Kishu region and Chunanzei region, these areas are suitable for growing peanuts. Therefore, many peanuts have been cultivated. It is said that the origin of this dish is boiled peanuts not grown enough yet. They eat peanuts not only by roasting, but also using various dishes. There are variety of dishes using peanuts; simmered peanuts, simmered with vegetables, or peanuts rice.
6024ad96147f09c8.zh: 東紀州地區南部與中南勢地區日照充足、平均氣溫高，適合種植落花生，因此一直有大量栽培。據說這道料理源自將尚未長成的落花生煮熟食用。當地人吃落花生不只是烘烤，也做成各種料理，例如煮落花生、與蔬菜同煮，或落花生飯。

60255885b95c0c58.en: Kitakami Michinoku Traditional Dance Festival (Japanese: 北上・みちのく芸能まつり) is a summer festival held in Kitakami, Iwate, Japan, where Devils Sword (鬼剣舞), Deer (鹿踊), Tiger and other traditional dances of Michinoku, Japan's northeast region, are performed. A recent program of this festival included: Bon dance on the first day, the parade of the traditional dances on the second, and the Fireworks display over the Kitakami River on the third day.
60255885b95c0c58.zh: 北上・みちのく芸能まつり是在日本岩手縣北上市舉行的夏季祭典，會演出鬼劍舞、鹿踊、虎舞等日本東北地區「陸奧」的傳統舞蹈。近年的祭典節目包括：第一天的盆舞、第二天的傳統舞蹈遊行，以及第三天在北上川上空施放的煙火。

60282e93e77450fb.en: Matoya Bay (的矢湾, Matoya-wan) is a bay in the city of Shima and Toba, Mie Prefecture, Japan.  It is part of the Ise-Shima region.
60282e93e77450fb.zh: 的矢湾是位於日本三重縣志摩市與鳥羽市的海灣，屬於伊勢志摩地區。

6031ef01dc3ecb91.en: The Banshu Yamasaki Iris Garden (播州山崎花菖蒲園, Banshu Yamasaki Shobuen) is an iris flower garden approximately 1.25 km (2 miles) northeast of Shisō in Hyōgo Prefecture, in the Kansai region of Japan.
6031ef01dc3ecb91.zh: 播州山崎花菖蒲園是位於日本關西地區兵庫縣宍粟市東北方約1.25公里（2英里）處的花菖蒲園。

604aa50bc3327b7d.en: Inba Tega Prefectural Natural Park (県立印旛手賀自然公園, Kenritsu Inba Tega shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in northern Chiba Prefecture, Japan. First designated for protection in 1952, the park's central features are Inba Marsh (印旛沼) and Tega Marsh (手賀沼). The park spans the borders of seven municipalities: Abiko, Inzai, Kashiwa, Narita, Sakae, Sakura, and Shisui. The marshes provide an important wetland habitat for wild birds.
604aa50bc3327b7d.zh: 千葉県立印旛手賀自然公園（県立印旛手賀自然公園，Kenritsu Inba Tega shizen kōen）是位於日本千葉縣北部的縣立自然公園。1952年首度劃定為保護區，園區的主要景觀為印旛沼與手賀沼。公園橫跨我孫子、印西、柏、成田、榮、佐倉、酒酒井七個市町。這些沼澤是野鳥重要的濕地棲息地。

604b033d6b48f5d8.en: Jappa" is a word of Tsugaru dialect, which means "something to be thrown away". It is usually made from fish heads, bones, skins and entrails, which are thrown away without being eaten. Cod is an indispensable "New Year's fish" in the Tsugaru region, and there is even a local saying, "cod New Year's." In the old days, a whole large cod was called "jappa-jiru" (cod soup). In the old days, it was a tradition to buy a whole big cod and drag it home along the snowy road at the end of the year.
604b033d6b48f5d8.zh: 「じゃっぱ」是津輕方言，意思是「要丟掉的東西」，通常指不吃而丟棄的魚頭、魚骨、魚皮和內臟。鱈魚在津輕地區是不可或缺的「年魚」，當地甚至有「鱈魚過年」的說法。從前，整條大鱈魚被稱為「じゃっぱ汁」（鱈魚湯）。從前在年底時，有買一整條大鱈魚，沿著雪路拖回家的傳統。

6068ee45c1ec576e.en: The Tottori Domain Ikeda clan cemetery  (鳥取藩主池田家墓所, Tottori-han-shu Ikeda-ke bosho) is located in the Kokufu neighborhood of the city of Tottori, Tottori Prefecture,  Japan. The cemetery contains the graves of the successive daimyō of Tottori Domain. The cemetery was designated a National Historic Site in 1981.
6068ee45c1ec576e.zh: 鳥取藩主池田家墓所位於日本鳥取縣鳥取市國府地區，葬有鳥取藩歷代大名。該墓所於1981年被指定為國家史跡。

606b05ccd252a6b3.en: Lake Jūsan (Japanese: 十三湖, Hepburn: Jūsan-ko), also known locally as Jūsan Lagoon (Japanese: 十三潟, Hepburn: Jūsan-gata) is a brackish-water lagoon-type estuary located in the city of Goshogawara in Aomori Prefecture, Japan. It is the third-largest lake in Aomori Prefecture, after Lake Towada and Lake Ogawara, with a  shoreline of 30 kilometers (19 mi) and a maximum depth of 3 meters.
606b05ccd252a6b3.zh: 十三湖在當地又稱十三潟，是位於日本青森縣五所川原市的潟湖型半鹹水河口。十三湖為青森縣第三大湖，僅次於十和田湖與小川原湖，湖岸線長30公里（19英里），最大水深3公尺。

60a0ca1e25ad8b5c.en: The Nagasaki National Peace Memorial Hall for the Atomic Bomb Victims (国立長崎原爆死没者追悼平和祈念館, Kokuritsu Nagasaki Genbaku Shibotsusha Tsuitō Heiwa Kinenkan) is a commemorative monument in Nagasaki, Japan, situated next to its Atomic Bomb Museum. The Peace Park is nearby.
60a0ca1e25ad8b5c.zh: 国立長崎原爆死没者追悼平和祈念館是位於日本長崎的紀念設施，緊鄰長崎原爆資料館，附近有和平公園。

60a224fee58b1721.en: Mama Kannon Temple (間々観音), officially known as Ryūon-ji (龍音寺), is a Jōdo-shū Buddhist temple located in Komaki, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. It is the 24th temple on the Owari Thirty-three Kannon pilgrimage.
60a224fee58b1721.zh: 間々觀音正式名稱為龍音寺，是位於日本愛知縣小牧市的淨土宗寺院，為尾張三十三觀音靈場的第24番札所。

60be275d34b7d217.en: "Ayu-rousui" refers to a porridge containing a whole Ayu (Sweetfish). Ayu-rosui is a Japanese word for "zosui," which is sometimes called "ire-rosui". Vegetables such as eggplant, potatoes, and onions, rice, and Ayu (Sweetfish) are simmered in dashi (Japanese soup stock) and seasoned with miso. The flavor of the Ayu (Sweetfish) makes this dish distinctive and rich in flavor.
60be275d34b7d217.zh: 「鮎ろうすい」是指加入整尾香魚的粥。ろうすい是「雜炊」的日文說法，有時也稱為「いれろうすい」。將茄子、馬鈴薯、洋蔥等蔬菜、米和香魚放入高湯中燉煮，再以味噌調味。香魚的風味使這道料理獨具特色、滋味濃郁。

60c0bd6dfbe2e243.en: Kusatsu-juku (草津宿, Kusatsu-juku) was the fifty-second of the fifty-three stations of the Tōkaidō as well as the sixty-eighth of the sixty-nine stations of the Nakasendō. It is located in the downtown area of the present-day city of Kusatsu, Shiga Prefecture, Japan.
60c0bd6dfbe2e243.zh: 草津宿是東海道五十三次中的第五十二個宿場，同時也是中山道六十九次中的第六十八個宿場。位於今日日本滋賀縣草津市的市中心。

60c9df13158d2883.en: Nagashima Museum (長島美術館, Nagashima bijutsukan) opened in Kagoshima, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan, in 1989, the centenary of the city's official foundation. Located on a hill overlooking Sakurajima and Kagoshima Bay, at an elevation of 110 metres, the museum's collection of some thousand objects amassed by businessman Nagashima Kōsuke (長島公佑), includes works by Kuroda Seiki, Rodin, and Chagall, as well as Satsuma ware.
60c9df13158d2883.zh: 長島美術館（長島美術館）於1989年在日本鹿兒島縣鹿兒島市開館，該年為鹿兒島市正式建市一百週年。美術館位於海拔110公尺、可俯瞰櫻島與鹿兒島灣的山丘上，館藏約一千件，由企業家長島公佑（長島公佑）蒐集，包括黑田清輝、羅丹、夏卡爾的作品，以及薩摩燒。

60f723ce8d797e78.en: "Abuttekamo" is salt-roasted damselfish mainly eaten in the coastal areas of Fukuoka City. It is characterized by the aroma of the skin and scales and the slight bitterness of the liver. The damselfish is a small fish with a body length of about 10 cm and is found widely in the Sea of Japan. There are few regions that actively eat it because it has many small bones and a thin body.
60f723ce8d797e78.zh: 「あぶってかも」是鹽烤斑鰭光鰓雀鯛，主要在福岡市沿海地區食用。特色是魚皮與魚鱗的香氣，以及魚肝略帶的苦味。這種魚體長約10公分，屬小型魚，廣泛分布於日本海。由於細刺多、魚身薄，積極食用的地區並不多。

6116d276ef2bf427.en: Mount Furano (富良野岳, Furano-dake) is a mountain located in the Tokachi Volcanic Group, Hokkaidō, Japan.
6116d276ef2bf427.zh: 富良野岳是位於日本北海道十勝火山群的一座山。

611cf146a7a9101b.en: The meaning of "sukume" is ‘to wrap with vinegar’. It is pronounced "sugume" in Tsugaru region. It is known by the research of ruins in Joumon Era (AC 14,000 and 300 BC) that people ate shark in Tsugaru region, and shark is inseparable with the local food culture. Especially, Pacific spiny dogfish dominates the 90% caught of shark in the prefecture, and you can still find its head and slices at fish stores.
611cf146a7a9101b.zh: 「すくめ」的意思是「以醋包覆」，在津輕地區讀作「すぐめ」。根據繩文時代（西元前14,000年至西元前300年）遺跡的調查得知，津輕地區的人們當時就已食用鯊魚，鯊魚與當地飲食文化密不可分。尤其白斑角鯊占縣內鯊魚漁獲量的9成，至今仍可在魚店看到其魚頭與切片。

612708d1519617c0.en: Kiba Park (木場公園, kiba kōen) is a Tokyo metropolitan park in Kōtō, Tokyo. The park includes jogging paths, playgrounds, tennis courts, a BBQ area, and spaces for events. The park is divided into two parts, north and south, connected by a pedestrian bridge. The Museum of Contemporary Art Tokyo is located in this park.
612708d1519617c0.zh: 木場公園（木場公園）是位於東京都江東區的都立公園，設有慢跑步道、遊樂場、網球場、烤肉區及活動空間。公園分為南北兩區，以人行橋連接。東京都現代美術館位於園內。

6135d85d3eaf1dbd.en: Iwadeyama Castle (岩出山城, Iwadeyama-jō) was a castle in Ōsaki, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan.
6135d85d3eaf1dbd.zh: 岩出山城是位於日本宮城縣大崎市的城堡。

613be505c6ff7275.en: Tsuruga Red Brick Warehouse (敦賀赤レンガ倉庫, Tsuruga Aka-Renga Sōko) is a pair of warehouse buildings located within the Port of Tsuruga in the city of Tsuruga, Fukui Prefecture, Japan. The buildings are preserved as a historical monument, and have been renovated for use as a restaurant hall (south-wing) and a diorama exhibition depicting Tsuruga during the Shōwa era with a model railroad (north wing).
613be505c6ff7275.zh: 敦賀赤レンガ倉庫是位於日本福井縣敦賀市敦賀港內的兩棟倉庫建築。建築作為歷史紀念物保存，並經整修，南棟作為餐廳館使用，北棟則為搭配鐵道模型、呈現昭和時代敦賀風貌的立體模型展示。

614a024964bb72ea.en: The Omori Nori Museum (Japanese: 大森 海苔のふるさと館) is a museum dedicated to the history, culture and creation process of nori, a type of edible Japanese seaweed.
614a024964bb72ea.zh: 大森海苔のふるさと館（大森 海苔のふるさと館）是介紹海苔（一種日本食用海藻）歷史、文化與製作過程的博物館。

615c21f2a114c85f.en: The siege of Marune (丸根砦の戦い) was a battle during the Sengoku period (16th century) of Japan.
615c21f2a114c85f.zh: 丸根砦之戰是日本戰國時代（16世紀）的一場戰役。

615d8159936223a9.en: The Misuji temple ruins (三栖廃寺塔跡, Misu Haiji ato), is an archaeological site with the ruins of a late Hakuhō period Buddhist temple located in the Shimomisu neighborhood of the city of Tanabe, Wakayama, Japan. The temple no longer exists, but the temple grounds were designated as a National Historic Site in 1935, with the area under protection expanded in 1985.
615d8159936223a9.zh: 三栖廃寺跡是一處考古遺址，保存著白鳳時代晚期佛教寺院的遺跡，位於日本和歌山縣田邊市下三栖地區。寺院已不存在，但寺院範圍於1935年被指定為國家史跡，1985年擴大了保護範圍。

617f5df7101f8155.en: Shintomiza (進富座) is an independent movie theater in the city of Ise, Mie Prefecture, Japan.
617f5df7101f8155.zh: 伊勢進富座是位於日本三重縣伊勢市的獨立電影院。

6192c16cc88df618.en: Kunisaki City occupies the eastern part of the Kunisaki Peninsula jutting out into the Seto Inland Sea, facing the Suo Nada and Iyonada Seas. It consists of radiant valleys centered around Mt. Futago and Mt. Monju located in the central part of the Eastern Peninsula, and quiet small rivers that flow through the mountains. At the foot of Mt. Futago, there are temples of the Shinto-Buddhist custom culture of Rokugo Manzan.
6192c16cc88df618.zh: 國東市位於突出瀨戶內海的國東半島東部，面向周防灘與伊予灘。市內由以半島中央的兩子山與文殊山為中心呈放射狀分布的山谷，以及流經山間的平靜小河所構成。兩子山山麓有六鄉滿山神佛習合文化的寺院。

619d5b31e9b34b60.en: Tsushima Maru (Japanese: 対馬丸) was a Japanese passenger/cargo ship that was sunk by the submarine USS Bowfin during World War II, while carrying hundreds of schoolchildren from Okinawa to Nagasaki.
619d5b31e9b34b60.zh: 對馬丸是日本的客貨船，第二次世界大戰期間載運數百名學童從沖繩前往長崎途中，遭美國潛艇鮑鰭號（USS Bowfin）擊沉。

61a3d6fa3e9694b1.en: Sapporo Satoland (サッポロさとらんど, Sapporo Satorando) is an amusement park located in Higashi-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaidō, Japan. Sapporo Satoland, which has an agricultural theme, was opened in 1995. Its official name is Sapporo Facility of Agricultural Experience and Interchange (札幌市農業体験交流施設, Sapporo Nōgyō Taiken Kōryū Shisetsu).
61a3d6fa3e9694b1.zh: サッポロさとらんど是位於日本北海道札幌市東區的遊樂園，以農業為主題，於1995年開園。正式名稱為札幌市農業体験交流施設。

61a62258e264250e.en: "Hiyajiru(cold soup)" is a local delicacy of the plains in Miyazaki Prefecture. It has become increasingly popular in recent years as information about the food culture has spread throughout the region. The soup is made using fresh and abundant seafood from the Hyuga Sea, which is rich in nature and faces the Kuroshio Current, as well as vegetables and crops that benefit from the region's sunny climate. The dish is said to have originated when farmers ate barley rice topped with raw miso paste and sprinkled with water during hot summers.
61a62258e264250e.zh: 「冷汁」是宮崎縣平原地區的鄉土料理。近年隨著飲食文化資訊在地區內傳播，越來越受歡迎。這道湯品使用面向黑潮、自然豐饒的日向灘所產的新鮮豐富海產，以及受惠於當地日照充足氣候的蔬菜和作物製成。據說這道料理起源於炎熱的夏天，農民將生味噌放在麥飯上、再淋上水來食用。

61daf3d33166c8e4.en: The Himeji City Tegarayama Botanical Garden (姫路市立手柄山温室植物園, Himeji Shiritsu Tegarayama Onshitsu Shokubutsuen), also known as the Himeji Tegarayama Green House, is a botanical garden located within a greenhouse in Tegarayama Central Park at 93 Tegara, Himeji, Hyogo, Japan.
61daf3d33166c8e4.zh: 姬路市立手柄山溫室植物園，又稱姬路手柄山溫室，是位於日本兵庫縣姬路市手柄93號手柄山中央公園內的溫室植物園。

61e0c52c91495b5b.en: The Samuel Cocking Garden (江の島サムエル・コッキング苑, Enoshima Samueru Kokkingu En), also known as the Enoshima Tropical Plants Garden, is a small botanical garden on the small island of Enoshima in Japan. The address is 2-3-28 Enoshima, Fujisawa, Kanagawa.
61e0c52c91495b5b.zh: 江之島山繆・柯金苑又稱江之島熱帶植物園，是位於日本江之島這座小島上的小型植物園，地址為神奈川縣藤澤市江之島2-3-28。

61ed3c17598465a4.en: Sushi is a type of sushi that has been handed down from farmers to ordinary households, with a history dating back to the Kansei era.It has been eaten at festivals, peach festivals, cherry blossom viewing, entrance ceremonies, and other annual, weddings, funerals, and family events. Before World War II, it was made and served by local men of honor, but after the war, due to various circumstances, the role of the makers was shifted to women, and it has evolved into a more colorful and festive dish.
61ed3c17598465a4.zh: 這種壽司由農家流傳至一般家庭，歷史可追溯至寬政年間。在祭典、女兒節、賞櫻、入學典禮等年中行事，以及婚禮、喪禮與家庭活動時食用。二次世界大戰前由當地有名望的男性製作招待，戰後因種種原因，製作者轉為女性，並演變為更加色彩繽紛、喜氣的料理。

61f141f8edfd3e32.en: Shin-Yakushi-ji (新薬師寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Kegon sect in Nara, Japan. It was founded in 747 by Empress Kōmyō. Initially a large complete Shichidō garan temple, it suffered from fire damage and deteriorated during the Heian period. The temple was revived during the Kamakura period. Only one building, the present main hall or Hon-dō (本堂), has survived from the 8th century. All other structures date to the Kamakura period.
61f141f8edfd3e32.zh: 新藥師寺是位於日本奈良的華嚴宗佛教寺院，747年由光明皇后創建。最初是具備完整七堂伽藍的大型寺院，後於平安時代遭受火災並逐漸衰微，至鎌倉時代復興。8世紀的建築只有現在的主殿「本堂」留存至今，其他建築皆為鎌倉時代所建。

622820c359849463.en: In the old days, Aizuwakamatsu, located inland, faced challenges in obtaining fresh seafood. As a result, dried seafood such as pickled herring, "Boutara" (dried codfish), and dried scallops were commonly consumed, as they could be processed to have a longer shelf life. Furthermore, due to the long and cold winter season, dried cod, particularly in the form of "Boutara" (dried codfish), was highly valued as a protein source in Aizuwakamatsu.
622820c359849463.zh: 過去，位於內陸的會津若松難以取得新鮮海產。因此，經加工可延長保存期限的乾貨海產，如醃鯡魚、「棒鱈」（鱈魚乾）和干貝等，十分常見。此外，由於冬季漫長寒冷，鱈魚乾，尤其是「棒鱈」，在會津若松被視為重要的蛋白質來源。

622b946720206c33.en: The weather from late autumn to early winter, when fierce winds blow and thunder rumbles violently, is called "buri-okoshi" in Toyama, and is said to be when the yellowtail fishing in Toyama Bay is at its peak. Yellowtail caught during this season are particularly fatty and firm, and yellowtail caught in Himi City, where fishing is flourishing, are branded as "Himi Kanburi" (yellowtail caught during the cold season) due to their excellent taste.
622b946720206c33.zh: 晚秋到初冬之間狂風大作、雷聲轟鳴的天氣，在富山稱為「鰤起し」，據說此時正是富山灣鰤魚漁獲的高峰。這個季節捕獲的鰤魚特別肥美緊實，而漁業興盛的冰見市所捕獲的鰤魚因風味絕佳，以「冰見寒鰤」（寒冷季節捕獲的鰤魚）為品牌。

6237a1cc92be1a2d.en: “Oshaka kogori” is eaten on Buddha’s Birthday which is on April 8th of each year and is served with “amacha” (=Japanese herbal tea made with fermented five-leaf ginseng leaves). “Oshaka kogori” is “dango” (=Japanese dumpling) made with wheat flour, sugar, and roasted soybeans. The ingredients used differ depending on the family and region that makes it and sometimes, rice flour is used instead of wheat flour. Some people also like to add small rice crackers, walnuts, and raisins.
6237a1cc92be1a2d.zh: 「おしゃかこごり」在每年4月8日的佛誕日食用，並搭配「甘茶」（以發酵的五葉參葉製成的日本草本茶）。「おしゃかこごり」是用麵粉、砂糖和炒黃豆做成的「團子」（日式丸子）。使用的材料依製作的家庭與地區而異，有時會以米粉取代麵粉。也有人喜歡加入小米果、核桃和葡萄乾。

626e3da422b28ade.en: Gifu Prefectural Museum (岐阜県博物館, Gifu-ken Hakubutsukan) opened in Seki, Gifu Prefecture, Japan, in 1976. The collection and its display relate the natural and cultural history of the area.
626e3da422b28ade.zh: 岐阜縣博物館（岐阜県博物館）於1976年在日本岐阜縣關市開館，館藏及展示介紹當地的自然史與文化史。

627ffc45dc5214c2.en: The Hachimanyama Ropeway (八幡山ロープウェー, Hachiman'yama Rōpuwē) is a Japanese aerial lift line in Ōmihachiman, Shiga, operated by Ohmi Railway. Opened in 1962, the line climbs Mount Hachiman, where there was Hachiman Castle built by Toyotomi Hidetsugu. The observatory has a view of Lake Biwa, as well as the city of Ōmihachiman, known for its traditional buildings lasting from Edo period.
627ffc45dc5214c2.zh: 八幡山纜車是位於滋賀縣近江八幡市的日本空中纜車路線，由近江鐵道經營。路線於1962年開通，登上八幡山，山上曾有豐臣秀次所築的八幡山城。展望台可眺望琵琶湖，以及以保存自江戶時代傳統建築聞名的近江八幡市街。

628ade1400ed0c20.en: Tofu is an ingredient frequently used for Buddhist vegetarian cuisine. It was served by merchant families for Buddhist ceremonies. Tofu is inexpensive and easily available which is why it is used for a variety of local dishes. Raw tofu is mashed and then boiled. The water of the tofu is drained by squeezing the tofu with a cloth. It is then roasted, seasoned with soy sauce, and strained. The tofu is placed on top of a bowl of rice along with a variety of vegetables. This dish is eaten with soup.
628ade1400ed0c20.zh: 豆腐是佛教素食料理中常用的食材，過去商家在舉行佛事時會端出這道料理。豆腐價格便宜又容易取得，因此被運用在各種鄉土料理中。做法是將生豆腐壓碎後水煮，再用布包住豆腐擠乾水分，接著炒乾，以醬油調味後過篩。將豆腐與各種蔬菜一起鋪在一碗白飯上，搭配湯品食用。

628ae79248114e20.en: Yamashiro Futagozuka (山代二子塚)  is a Kofun period burial mound, located in the Yamashiro-chō neighborhood of the city of Matsue, Shimane in the San'in region of Japan. The tumulus was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1924.
628ae79248114e20.zh: 山代二子塚是古墳時代的墳丘，位於日本山陰地區島根縣松江市山代町。此古墳於1924年被指定為日本國家史跡。

6291416fa0ebb7ab.en: ‘Oshimon’ is a local sweets made from rice flour kneaded with hot water and put into a mold, then colored with food coloring. It is offered to the Hina Dolls during the Girl’s Festival. When it comes to foods served during the Girl’s Festival, ‘Hina Arare’ (=colorful rice snack), ‘Hishi-mochi’ (=diamond-shaped colored mochi) or ‘Chirashi-zushi’ (=sushi with various ingredients placed on top of vinegar rice) are famous. In Aichi Prefecture, ‘Oshimon’ is prepared in addition to those foods.
6291416fa0ebb7ab.zh: 「おしもん」是將米粉加熱水揉合後放入模具成形，再以食用色素上色的鄉土甜點。在女兒節時供奉給雛人偶。說到女兒節的食物，以「雛霰」（彩色米果）、「菱餅」（菱形的彩色麻糬）或「散壽司」（在醋飯上鋪放各種配料的壽司）最為著名。在愛知縣，除了這些食物之外，還會準備「おしもん」。

62920fc9f2155025.en: "Tsushima" is a traditional local dish passed down in the Shūnan region, including Shūnan City in the southeastern part of Yamaguchi Prefecture. There are various theories about its origin, but it is said to have been created during the Edo period when fishermen in Kushi-gahama, Shūnan City, were tasked with guiding Korean trade envoys.
62920fc9f2155025.zh: 「つしま」是流傳於山口縣東南部周南市等周南地區的傳統鄉土料理。其由來眾說紛紜，據說是江戶時代周南市櫛ヶ濱的漁民負責引導朝鮮通商使節時所創。

62985775e7165c18.en: Satsukiyama Zoo (五月山動物園) is located at Satsukiyama Park, at the base of Mount Satsuki in Ikeda, Osaka, Japan. The zoo opened in April, 1957. The zoo is the municipal zoo of Ikeda.
62985775e7165c18.zh: 池田市立五月山動物園位於日本大阪府池田市五月山山麓的五月山公園內，1957年4月開園，是池田市的市立動物園。

62b1302b69751f0d.en: Niigata City History Museum (新潟市歴史博物館, Niigatashi Rekishi Hakubutsukan) is a museum in Chūō-ku, Niigata, Japan. It is also called MINATOPIA (みなとぴあ).
62b1302b69751f0d.zh: 新潟市歴史博物館是位於日本新潟市中央區的博物館，又稱みなとぴあ（MINATOPIA）。

62f96ef634cc37a6.en: Himejima is a remote island located in the western part of the Seto Inland Sea, and it's about 20 minutes away by ferry from Imi Port in Kunisaki City.
62f96ef634cc37a6.zh: 姬島是位於瀨戶內海西部的離島，從國東市的伊美港搭渡輪約20分鐘。

63022e39dfde791b.en: Sansho (=Japanese Pepper) is a kind of spices and used in various Japanese cuisines as seasoning. It is said that Sansho was delivered from China in Heian Era (AD794-AD1192) and it was written in many historical records like ‘Gishi Wajinden’ or ‘Kojiki’. Currently Asakura Sansho is dominant in the market, and Arima Sansho can rarely be seen. Sansho is typically cooked as ‘Tsukudani’, simmered with soy sauce, sake and ‘Mirin’ (=sweet rice wine).Asakura Sansho is grown in Yabu City Youka-cho Asakura area.
63022e39dfde791b.zh: 山椒是一種香辛料，在各種日本料理中用作調味。據說山椒於平安時代（西元794年～1192年）從中國傳入，在《魏志倭人傳》、《古事記》等許多史料中都有記載。目前市場上以朝倉山椒為主，有馬山椒則很少見。山椒通常做成「佃煮」，以醬油、酒和「味醂」（甜米酒）燉煮。朝倉山椒產於養父市八鹿町朝倉地區。

630882e26effce32.en: Shirakawa Dam is a rockfill dam located in Yamagata Prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for flood control, irrigation, water supply and power production. The catchment area of the dam is 205 km2. The dam impounds about 270  ha of land when full and can store 50000 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1968 and completed in 1981.
630882e26effce32.zh: 白川ダム是位於日本山形縣的堆石壩，用於防洪、灌溉、供水及發電。水壩集水面積為205平方公里，滿水時淹沒約270公頃土地，可蓄水5000萬立方公尺。水壩於1968年動工，1981年完工。

630d37ea7ce2686b.en: Ashiura Kannon-ji (芦浦観音寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Tendai sect located in the city of Kusatsu, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. The temple was founded in the Hakuho period and its grounds were designated a National Historic Site in 2004. The complex includes several Muromachi or Edo Period buildings, two of which are designated as Important Cultural Properties.
630d37ea7ce2686b.zh: 蘆浦觀音寺是位於日本滋賀縣草津市的天台宗佛教寺院。寺院創建於白鳳時代，寺域於2004年被指定為國家史跡。寺內有數棟室町時代或江戶時代的建築，其中兩棟被指定為重要文化財。

631a936026988080.en: "Zuiki" refers to the leaf stalks of satoimo, and it has been a traditional summer vegetable in the Kansai region for a long time. Particularly in the Senshu and Minami Kawachi regions, a type of "Zuiki" known as "Benizuiki(=red zuiki)" with reddish-brown leaf stalks is produced. Large ones can reach a height of about 2 meters, with leaves measuring up to 70 cm. They are rich in dietary fiber, calcium, potassium, and other nutrients.
631a936026988080.zh: 「芋莖」指里芋的葉柄，長久以來是關西地區傳統的夏季蔬菜。特別是在泉州和南河內地區，生產一種葉柄呈紅褐色、稱為「紅芋莖」的芋莖。大的可長到約2公尺高，葉片可達70公分。富含膳食纖維、鈣、鉀等營養素。

633e7785f0eb2890.en: Tobu Zoo (東武動物公園, Tōbu dōbutsu kōen lit. '’Tōbu Zoological Park’') is a combination of a zoo and an amusement park located in Miyashiro, Saitama Prefecture, Japan, owned by Tobu Railway.
633e7785f0eb2890.zh: 東武動物公園是位於日本埼玉縣宮代町、結合動物園與遊樂園的設施，由東武鐵道擁有。

63404d901eab1ce8.en: Honederamura Shōen ruins (骨寺村荘園遺跡, Honederamura Shōen iseki) is an archaeological site containing the ruins of a large-scale shōen manor from the Kamakura period, located in what is now part of the city of Ichinoseki, Iwate in the Tōhoku region of Japan. A portion of the site (48.8 hectares) was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 2005.
63404d901eab1ce8.zh: 骨寺村荘園遺跡是位於日本東北地方、今岩手縣一關市境內的考古遺址，保存有鎌倉時代大規模莊園的遺跡。遺址的一部分（48.8公頃）於2005年被指定為日本國家史跡。

636688bed42539c5.en: Fig has been used since antient time. In Japan, it is said that "Fig was introduced to Nagasaki via China", and was used for medicinal purposes. During the Meiji Era (1868-1912), Mr. Masui introduced “Masui Dauphine” variety, from the US, which now makes up about 80% of figs in the market. It is eaten all over the world because of its plump texture and sweetness.
636688bed42539c5.zh: 無花果自古就被利用。在日本，據說「無花果是經由中國傳入長崎」，當時作為藥用。明治時代（1868-1912），桝井先生從美國引進「桝井ドーフィン」品種，目前約占市面無花果的80%。無花果因口感飽滿、甜味十足，在世界各地都有人食用。

6378ecc5d89fd90c.en: Shimotabaru Castle (下田原城, Shimotabaru-jō) is a  Ryukyuan gusuku fortification located on Hateruma Island in the Yaeyama Islands (Taketomi, Okinawa Prefecture). Nanjō, Okinawa. The castle ruins were designated a National Historic Site in 2003.
6378ecc5d89fd90c.zh: 下田原城是位於八重山群島波照間島（沖繩縣竹富町）的琉球御城（グスク）要塞。南城市，沖繩。城跡於2003年被指定為國家史跡。

637f2b0be8d92aef.en: Nishiarida Prefectural Natural Park (西有田県立自然公園, Nishiarida kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1956, the park spans the borders of the municipalities of Arida, Hirogawa, and Yuasa. The park comprises the stretch of ria coast between Miyazaki-no-Hana (宮崎ノ鼻) in Arida and Karao Bay (唐尾湾) in Hirogawa, as well as the islands of Karumo-jima (苅藻島), Kenashi-jima (毛無島), and Takashima (鷹島).
637f2b0be8d92aef.zh: 西有田縣立自然公園是位於日本和歌山縣的縣立自然公園，設立於1956年，範圍橫跨有田市、廣川町與湯淺町。園區包括從有田市的宮崎ノ鼻到廣川町唐尾灣之間的谷灣海岸，以及苅藻島、毛無島與鷹島等島嶼。

6390979c039538a2.en: The Sapporo Ainu Culture Promotion Center (札幌市アイヌ文化交流センター, Sapporo-shi Ainu Bunka Kōryū Sentā), also known as Sapporo Pirka Kotan (サッポロピㇼカコタン) or "Beautiful Village", opened in Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan, in 2003. Dedicated to the Ainu people, their history, culture, and way of life, the museum has some three hundred artefacts on display and there is also a traditional-style cise (dwelling).
6390979c039538a2.zh: 札幌市アイヌ文化交流センター，又稱サッポロピㇼカコタン（意為「美麗的村落」），於2003年在日本北海道札幌開館。本館以愛努族及其歷史、文化與生活方式為主題，展出約三百件文物，另有一座傳統形式的チセ（住屋）。

6394da8ea5a2894f.ja: 御嶽山御嶽神明社（おんたけさんおんたけしんめいしゃ）は、岩手県一関市花泉町老松にある神社。
6394da8ea5a2894f.zh: 御嶽山御嶽神明社是位於岩手縣一關市花泉町老松的神社。

6395646ed011533b.en: The Ōmine Okugakemichi (大峯奥駈道, lit. “deep inner path of the grand peaks”) is a pilgrimage route on the Kii Peninsula in the Kansai region of Japan. It begins in Yanagi-no-shuku, a former ferry station on the Yoshino River in Nara prefecture, leads through the 1200-1900 meter Ōmine mountain region of Yoshino and Kumano in Wakayama Prefecture and ends after about 170 kilometers at the Kumano Hongū Taisha.
6395646ed011533b.zh: 大峯奥駈道（字面意思為「大峰群山的深奧之道」）是日本關西地區紀伊半島上的一條朝聖路線。起點為奈良縣吉野川畔昔日的渡船場柳之宿，途經海拔1200至1900公尺、從吉野延伸至和歌山縣熊野的大峰山區，全長約170公里，終點為熊野本宮大社。

63a754334ff37941.en: Ganzuki" is a sweet eaten throughout the prefecture, especially in the southern part of the prefecture. The name is said to come from its round shape and the sesame seeds placed on top of it in an M-shape, which resemble geese flying toward the full moon.It is a local confectionery made by steaming flour, sugar, eggs, and baking soda and vinegar to make it puff up. It contains sesame and walnuts, and its chunky texture has a simple taste. It has a simple taste with a chewy texture.
63a754334ff37941.zh: 「がんづき」是全縣都會吃的甜點，尤其是縣南部。名稱據說來自其圓形外觀與上面排成M字形的芝麻，看起來像雁群飛向滿月。這是將麵粉、砂糖、雞蛋，加上小蘇打與醋使其膨脹後蒸製而成的鄉土點心。內含芝麻與核桃，口感紮實，味道樸素。味道樸素，口感Q彈。

63b199db030f389d.en: The Narusawa Ice Cave (Japanese: 鳴沢氷穴, Narusawa Hyōketsu) is a lava tube located in the Aokigahara forest, in the part that belongs to Narusawa Village, Yamanashi Prefecture, Japan. It is one of the three larger lava tubes at the northern foot of Mount Fuji, the other two caves being Fugaku Wind Cave and Lake Sai Bat Cave. All three were designated as Natural Monuments of Japan in 1929.
63b199db030f389d.zh: 鳴沢氷穴是位於日本山梨縣鳴沢村境內青木原樹海中的熔岩洞，為富士山北麓三大熔岩洞之一，另外兩處為富岳風穴與西湖蝙蝠穴。三處皆於1929年被指定為日本天然紀念物。

63c99dff29f7b334.en: The people of Oita prefecture are one of the top consumers of chicken meat in the country. Chicken meat is a traditional ingredient used to make many local dishes. Usa city is where “karaage” (=Japanese fried chicken) was born. “Karaage,” “toriten” (=tempura style fried chicken) and “niwatorijiru” (=chicken soup) are some local chicken dishes from Oita.“Tori meshi” is mixed rice made with chicken meat, “gobou” (=burdock) and carrots. The number and types of ingredients used differ per region and the family that makes it.
63c99dff29f7b334.zh: 大分縣民的雞肉消費量位居全國前列。雞肉是製作許多鄉土料理的傳統食材。宇佐市是「唐揚げ」（日式炸雞）的發源地。「唐揚げ」、「とり天」（天婦羅式炸雞）和「鶏汁」（雞湯）都是大分的鄉土雞肉料理。「鶏めし」是用雞肉、牛蒡和紅蘿蔔做成的炊飯。使用的材料數量和種類依地區及製作的家庭而有所不同。

63f99a33c80799e4.en: Akita Museum of Modern Art (秋田県立近代美術館, Akita Kenritsu Kindai Bijutsukan) opened in Yokote, Akita Prefecture, Japan in 1994 and houses an important collection of Akita ranga .
63f99a33c80799e4.zh: 秋田県立近代美術館於1994年在日本秋田縣橫手市開館，收藏重要的秋田蘭畫作品。

6466fcf334ed74cb.en: "Ei no nikogori" is a stewed ray dish with sweet and spicy sauce. It is a standard local dish in the Katsuragi area and other areas in the prefecture. The gelatinous substance of the ray dissolves into the broth when it is boiled, and when it cools down, it hardens into a jelly-like substance. This jelly-like dish is called nikogori, which this ray stew dish’s name came from. The Katsuragi area had long been in close contact with Osaka's Kawachi district.
6466fcf334ed74cb.zh: 「エイの煮こごり」是以甜辣醬汁燉煮魟魚的料理，是葛城地區及縣內其他地區常見的鄉土料理。魟魚的膠質在煮的時候會溶入湯汁，冷卻後凝固成果凍狀。這種果凍狀的料理稱為「煮こごり」，這道燉魟魚的名稱即由此而來。葛城地區自古以來與大阪的河內地區往來密切。

646a41554e97af8e.en: Hosshō-ji (Japanese: 法勝寺, Hepburn: Hosshō-ji) was a  Buddhist temple in northeastern Kyoto, Japan, endowed by Emperor Shirakawa in fulfillment of a sacred vow.  The temple complex was located east of the Kamo River in the Shirakawa district; and its chief architectural feature was a nine-storied octagonal pagoda.
646a41554e97af8e.zh: 法勝寺是過去位於日本京都東北部的佛教寺院，由白河天皇為實踐誓願而捐建。寺院建築群位於鴨川以東的白河地區，主要建築特色為一座九層八角塔。

646ba894f6d2b6ef.en: Tempozan Ferris Wheel (Japanese: 天保山大観覧車, Hepburn: Tenpōzan Daikanransha) is a 112-meter-tall (367 ft) Ferris wheel located in Osaka, Japan, at Tempozan Harbor Village, next to Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan, one of the largest aquariums in the world. The wheel has a height of 112.5 metres (369 ft) and diameter of 100 metres (330 ft).
646ba894f6d2b6ef.zh: 天保山大観覧車是一座高112公尺（367英尺）的摩天輪，位於日本大阪的天保山港灣村，鄰近世界最大水族館之一的海遊館。摩天輪高112.5公尺（369英尺），直徑100公尺（330英尺）。

646bfd7cae7896c3.en: It is said that persimmons began to be eaten in Fukushima Prefecture around the Edo period. A man named Nanemon, who lived in the town of Yanagawa (current Date City), planted the first persimmon tree. Anpo persimmons are called 'Amahoshi Persimmons' because the persimmon peel is peeled off before sun-drying ('amahoshi' means sun-drying). Later, this term evolved into 'Anpo Persimmons' as it became commonly used.
646bfd7cae7896c3.zh: 據說福島縣大約從江戶時代開始食用柿子。住在梁川町（今伊達市）一位名叫Nanemon的男子種下了第一棵柿樹。あんぽ柿因為在日曬前先削去柿皮，而被稱為「天干柿」（「天干」即日曬之意）。後來隨著這個詞普遍使用，逐漸演變成「あんぽ柿」。

6488584f8409f698.en: Imotaki is a one-pot dish of chicken, taro, konnyaku, shiitake mushrooms, and other ingredients stewed in a pot, and has a history dating back more than 350 years to when the Kato family ruled as feudal lords. It is said to have originated when people brought their own taro, a local specialty, to be served at a traditional event called "Oroori".In 1966, the event became a city tourist attraction, attracting more than 70,000 visitors a year in its heyday, when people enjoyed taro with the moon on the riverbank.
6488584f8409f698.zh: いもたき是將雞肉、芋頭、蒟蒻、香菇等食材放入鍋中燉煮的鍋料理，歷史可追溯至350多年前加藤家擔任藩主的時期。據說起源於人們各自帶著當地特產芋頭，參加名為「お籠り」的傳統活動時食用。1966年這項活動成為市內的觀光活動，全盛時期每年吸引7萬多名遊客，人們在河岸邊賞月吃芋頭。

64927cb2fb1d7c8f.en: Aichi Prefecture is second only to Okinawa in the volume of shipments of "Tougan(=White gourd)", and "Tougan(=White gourd)" cuisine is widely popular in the prefecture. It is said that the "Tougan(=White gourd)" originated in India and was brought to Japan via China. It is mentioned in documents dating back to the Nara period (710-794), suggesting that it has been eaten since ancient times.
64927cb2fb1d7c8f.zh: 愛知縣的「冬瓜」出貨量僅次於沖繩，居全國第二，「冬瓜」料理在縣內廣受喜愛。據說「冬瓜」原產於印度，經由中國傳入日本。奈良時代（710-794）的文獻中已有記載，可見自古以來就有食用。

64977856809d9d0d.en: Sakurabora Castle (桜洞城, Sakurabora-jō) was a medieval Japanese castle built in the Hida Province. It is now located in the present-day city of Gero, Gifu Prefecture.  It was constructed by the daimyō Mitsuki Naoyori (三木直頼) in 1544, near the end of the Sengoku period.
64977856809d9d0d.zh: 櫻洞城（桜洞城）是建於飛驒國的日本中世城郭，現位於岐阜縣下呂市。由大名三木直賴（三木直頼）於1544年、戰國時代接近尾聲時建造。

64979c0c8ea7f122.en: The Yūbikan (有備館) is an Edo period structure located in what is now the city of Ōsaki, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan. It served as a han school for the Date clan of Sendai Domain, and is the oldest existing educational structure in Japan. The building, together with its surrounding gardens, were designated a nationally designated Historic Site and Place of Scenic Beauty in 1932.
64979c0c8ea7f122.zh: 有備館是江戶時代的建築，位於今日本宮城縣大崎市。曾作為仙台藩伊達氏的藩校，是日本現存最古老的教育建築。建築與周圍庭園於1932年獲指定為國家史跡及名勝。

64b59dec9ec253eb.en: Aichi Prefecture has the largest clam catch in Japan. Nishio City and Gamagori City have the highest catches, while the Atsumi Peninsula and Chita Peninsula also contribute to the clam industry. The supply of clams is supported by resource management, such as the creation of tidal flats and shallow areas in Mikawa Bay and the transplantation of young clams from the Rokujo Lagoon at the mouth of the Toyokawa River.
64b59dec9ec253eb.zh: 愛知縣的蛤蜊（花蛤）漁獲量居日本之冠。西尾市與蒲郡市的漁獲量最高，渥美半島與知多半島也是蛤蜊產業的重要產地。蛤蜊的供應仰賴資源管理維持，例如在三河灣營造潮間帶與淺灘，以及從豐川河口的六條潟移植幼貝。

64c8d345a416cbcc.en: The Taio mine (Japanese:鯛生金山) was the large gold mine in Oita, Japan. At its peak productivity between 1934 and 1938, it produced 2.3 tons of gold per year, being the most productive gold mine of Japan. Tunnels stretch for 500 meters below ground level, and total tunnels length is 110 km, although all tunnels below 4th are flooded. From 1983, the mine has become a museum, with 800-meter tunnel section opened to the visitors.
64c8d345a416cbcc.zh: 鯛生金山是日本大分縣的大型金礦。在1934年至1938年的產量高峰期，每年產金2.3噸，是日本產量最高的金礦。坑道延伸至地下500公尺，坑道總長110公里，但第4層以下的坑道均已淹水。1983年起礦山改為博物館，開放800公尺長的坑道區段供遊客參觀。

64d814ac011fd394.en: The Museum of Modern Art, Wakayama (和歌山県立近代美術館, Wakayama Kenritsu Kindai Bijutsukan) is a museum of modern art in the city of Wakayama, Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. The Museum first opened as the Wakayama Prefectural Museum of Art (和歌山県立美術館) in the grounds of Wakayama Castle in 1963, before reopening on the first floor of the Wakayama Prefectural Cultural Hall (和歌山県民文化会館) in 1970; in July 1994, together with the adjacent Wakayama Prefectural Museum, the Museum of Modern Art, Wakayama reopened in a new location close to the castle.
64d814ac011fd394.zh: 和歌山縣立近代美術館是位於日本和歌山縣和歌山市的近代美術館。本館於1963年以「和歌山縣立美術館」之名在和歌山城內首度開館，1970年遷至和歌山縣民文化會館一樓重新開館；1994年7月，與相鄰的和歌山縣立博物館一同在和歌山城附近的新址重新開館。

64db37a1188b1b65.en: Takahashi Inari Shrine (高橋稲荷神社, Takahashi inari jinja) is a Shinto Inari shrine, dedicated to the worship of the kami Inari. It is located in Kumamoto, Kumamoto Prefecture. Its main festival is held annually on November 8. It was founded in 1496.
64db37a1188b1b65.zh: 高橋稻荷神社是供奉稻荷神的神道教稻荷神社，位於熊本縣熊本市。主要祭典於每年11月8日舉行。創建於1496年。

64f49ab1a0baee1a.en: Sasuke Inari Shrine (佐助稲荷神社, Sasuke Inari Jinja) is a Shinto shrine in Kamakura and the site of the Hidden Village of Kamakura. It is located very near the Zeniarai Benzaiten Ugafuku Shrine.
64f49ab1a0baee1a.zh: 佐助稲荷神社（佐助稲荷神社，Sasuke Inari Jinja）是位於鎌倉的神社，也是「鎌倉隱里」所在地，距離錢洗弁財天宇賀福神社很近。

64ff5157fc66fbd6.en: Persimmons are grown throughout Japan. Saga prefecture does not produce large amounts of this fruit. Not much land is dedicated to growing persimmons but there are unique types of them grown in Saga. One type, with the brand name, “Onsen Bijin” (=Hot Spring Beauty) and grown in Takeo city, is a sour persimmon whose sourness has been taken out using special techniques. The fruit is left to ripen on the trees until they become a deep red color. The texture is crunchy, but the fruit is very juicy.
64ff5157fc66fbd6.zh: 日本各地都有種植柿子。佐賀縣的柿子產量不多，種植面積也不大，但有種植獨特的品種。其中一種是在武雄市種植、品牌名為「温泉美人」的澀柿，以特殊技術去除了澀味。果實留在樹上熟成，直到變成深紅色。口感爽脆，但汁液非常豐富。

65031f753676e140.en: Miyajidake Shrine (宮地嶽神社, Miyajidake-jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Fukutsu, Fukuoka, Japan. It is dedicated to Empress Jingū
65031f753676e140.zh: 宮地嶽神社是位於日本福岡縣福津市的神社，主祀神功皇后。

651e55de88f2592e.en: Ogurayama Castle (小倉山城, Ogurayama-jō) was a Japanese castle located in  Kitahiroshima, Hiroshima Prefecture.  Its ruins have been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 1986 as part of the "Kikkawa clan fortification ruins" along with Surugamaru Castle and Hinoyama Castle.
651e55de88f2592e.zh: 小倉山城是位於廣島縣北廣島的日本城堡。其遺跡自1986年起與駿河丸城、日山城一同作為「吉川氏城館跡」的一部分，被中央政府列為國家史跡加以保護。

6528976e22372bdb.en: Yakami Castle (八上城, Yakami-jō) was a Sengoku period Japanese castle located in what is now part of the city of Tamba-Sasayama Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2005. The castle was one of the largest in Tanba Province, along with Kuroi Castle and Yagi Castle.  It was the original base of power for the Hatano clan.
6528976e22372bdb.zh: 八上城是戰國時代的日本城郭，位於今日本兵庫縣丹波篠山市境內。其遺跡自2005年起被指定為國家史跡受到保護。該城與黑井城、八木城同為丹波國規模最大的城郭之一，是波多野氏最初的勢力據點。

652ec230edaa9bd8.en: River shrimp are bigclaw river shrimp. It is one of the specialties of Kochi Prefecture, taken from the Shimanto and Niyodo Rivers. This freshwater shrimp is about 9 cm long and is characterized by its long scissors, which are 1.5 times longer than its body length. The Shimanto River is inhabited mainly by two species of shrimp, the southern prawn and the Yamato prawn. Even today, the traditional fishing method "Shibazuke fishing", which takes advantage of the nocturnal nature of the fish, has been handed down.
652ec230edaa9bd8.zh: 川蝦指的是大螯沼蝦，是捕自四萬十川與仁淀川的高知縣特產之一。這種淡水蝦體長約9公分，特徵是螯很長，達體長的1.5倍。四萬十川主要棲息著兩種蝦：南方沼蝦與大和沼蝦。至今仍傳承著利用其夜行習性的傳統漁法「柴漬漁」。

653a45d1a6fce3e2.en: The Aya Biosphere Reserve (established in 2012) is a UNESCO Man and the Biosphere Programme in the south of Kyushu Island, Japan. It harbours one of the country’s largest remaining lucidophyllous forests. The forest shows high biodiversity and embraces many indigenous species. Forest therapy and traditional recycling based agriculture in Aya Town are an ecotourism draw to the Biosphere Reserve.
653a45d1a6fce3e2.zh: 綾生物圈保護區（2012年設立）是位於日本九州島南部的聯合國教科文組織人與生物圈計畫保護區。區內有日本現存規模最大的照葉樹林之一。這片森林生物多樣性高，有許多原生物種。綾町的森林療法與以傳統循環利用為基礎的農業，是吸引遊客前來此保護區進行生態旅遊的特色。

6542ba597e5f2a4e.en: Anglerfish is in season in winter. Anglerfish is said to be a fish that has nothing to throw away, and is often eaten not only for its meat but also for its liver. Anglerfish are often caught in Fukushima, and Iwaki City and Soma City are especially known for their anglerfish landing sites.A local dish using anglerfish, often eaten in Soma City, is "Anko no Tomo Ae".
6542ba597e5f2a4e.zh: 鮟鱇魚的產季在冬天。據說鮟鱇魚全身沒有可丟棄的部分，除了魚肉之外，魚肝也常被食用。福島常捕獲鮟鱇魚，其中以磐城市和相馬市作為鮟鱇魚的卸貨地特別有名。相馬市常吃的一道鮟鱇魚鄉土料理，就是「あんこうのとも和え」。

654e7f415c337969.en: Cape Hachiman (Isumi, Chiba) (八幡岬, Hachiman-misaki) is a cape on the Pacific Ocean, in the Ōhara area of the city of Isumi, in the southeast area of Chiba Prefecture, Japan. The cape is named after Hachiman, a mythological Japanese god of archery and war. There is another identically-named cape a few kilometers to the south in the city of Katsuura City, sharing the namesake.
654e7f415c337969.zh: 八幡岬（千葉縣夷隅市）是面向太平洋的海岬，位於日本千葉縣東南部夷隅市大原地區。海岬以日本神話中的弓箭與戰爭之神八幡命名。往南數公里的勝浦市另有一座同名海岬。

657155597bf5cd21.en: Sakurai Shrine (桜井神社, Sakurai jinja, also 櫻井神社) is a Shinto shrine located in Sakai, Osaka Prefecture, Japan. It was founded at an unknown date and holds its annual festival on the first Sunday in October. It enshrines Emperor Ōjin, Emperor Chūai, and Empress Jingū as kami. The oratory (拝殿, haiden) is designated as the only Japanese National Treasure in Sakai City.
657155597bf5cd21.zh: 櫻井神社（又寫作桜井神社）是位於日本大阪府堺市的神社。創建年代不詳，每年10月第一個星期日舉行例祭。祭神為應神天皇、仲哀天皇與神功皇后。其拜殿是堺市唯一的日本國寶。

65a4257be51f5912.en: ‘Azuki Battou’ is a dish simmered wide and short ‘udon’ noodle in sweet red bean soup, and mainly eaten in Sanriku Coast region. It is said that the name ‘Battou’ is a regional accent of ‘houtou’ (type of noodle). It is often served as a special feast at auspicious occasions like ‘Tatemae’ (topping out ceremony) or ‘Niwa-jimai’ (thanksgiving for farmers), as a snack during farm work, and as a treat for gathering in winter. In this case, it is separately served in a bowl, and eaten with soup, pickles and vinegar salad.
65a4257be51f5912.zh: 「小豆ばっとう」是將寬而短的烏龍麵放入甜紅豆湯中燉煮的料理，主要在三陸海岸地區食用。據說「ばっとう」這個名稱是「餺飥」（麵的一種）的方言。常在「上棟」（上樑儀式）、「庭じまい」（農家的收穫感謝）等喜慶場合作為特別的宴席料理，或作為農忙時的點心、冬季聚會的招待。此時會另外盛在碗中，搭配湯、醃菜及醋拌菜一起食用。

65abce136794fa59.en: This is a dish that is eaten on a daily basis in the area centering on the Tonami Plain located in the western part of Toyama Prefecture. The Tonami Plain is a place where the original Japanese landscape of "sanson"(dispersed settlement), dotted with farmhouses surrounded by compound forests called "kainyo", still remains. "Yogoshi" is a dish of boiled vegetables chopped into small pieces, mixed with miso, and stir-fried. It came to be called "Yogoshi" meaning "over night" because it is prepared at night and eaten the next morning.
65abce136794fa59.zh: 這是以富山縣西部的砺波平原為中心的地區日常食用的料理。砺波平原至今仍保留著日本原始風景「散村」（散居聚落），散布著被稱為「カイニョ」的屋敷林環繞的農家。「よごし」是將燙過的蔬菜切碎，拌入味噌後拌炒的料理。因為在晚上準備、隔天早上食用，所以被稱為意指「過夜」的「よごし」。

65b31861195ba81a.en: A Peace Pagoda is a Buddhist stupa: a monument to inspire peace, designed to provide a focus for people of all races and creeds, and to help unite them in their search for world peace. Most, though not all, peace pagodas built since World War II have been built under the guidance of Nichidatsu Fujii (1885–1985), a Buddhist monk from Japan and founder of the Nipponzan-Myōhōji Buddhist Order. Fujii was greatly inspired by his meeting with Mahatma Gandhi in 1931 and decided to devote his life to promoting non-violence.
65b31861195ba81a.zh: 平和パゴダ是一種佛塔，為啟發和平而建的紀念建築，旨在成為不同種族與信仰人們的共同焦點，協助他們在追求世界和平的過程中團結一致。第二次世界大戰後興建的和平塔，大多數（但並非全部）是在日本僧侶、日本山妙法寺創始人藤井日達（1885–1985）的指導下建造。藤井於1931年與聖雄甘地會面，深受啟發，決定終身推廣非暴力。

65b9a4e78bfb9403.en: The Ikegami-Sone site (池上・曽根遺跡, Ikegami-Sone iseki) is an archaeological site containing the ruins of a large-scale Yayoi period settlement straddling the Ikegami neighborhood in the city of Izumi and the Sone neighborhood in the city of Izumiōtsu in the Kansai region of Japan. It is a large settlement ruin with a total area of 600,000 m2, extending 1.5 kilometers north-to-south and 0.6 kilometers east-to-west. It was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1976 and has been maintained as an archaeological park since 2005.
65b9a4e78bfb9403.zh: 池上・曽根遺跡是位於日本關西地區的考古遺址，為大規模的彌生時代聚落遺跡，橫跨和泉市池上町與泉大津市曽根町。遺跡總面積達600,000平方公尺，南北長1.5公里、東西寬0.6公里。1976年被指定為日本國家史蹟，2005年起整備為史蹟公園。

65c5e7fe2c5abd44.en: Kōzō-ji (高蔵寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the city of Kakuda, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan.
65c5e7fe2c5abd44.zh: 高蔵寺是位於日本宮城縣角田市的寺院。

65d355fc465486b3.en: Mibu Castle (壬生城, Mibu-jō) is a Japanese castle located in Mibu, southern Tochigi Prefecture, Japan. At the end of the Edo period, Mibu Castle was home to a branch of the Torii clan, daimyō of Mibu Domain.
65d355fc465486b3.zh: 壬生城是位於日本栃木縣南部壬生的日本城郭。江戶時代末期，壬生城為壬生藩藩主鳥居氏一支的居城。

65e06973222539c2.en: The Yamatane Museum of Art (山種美術館, Yamatane Bijutsukan) is a museum in Japan specializing in the nihonga style of Japanese watercolour painting. It is run by the Yamatane Art Foundation. The museum holds 7-8 exhibitions per year.
65e06973222539c2.zh: 山種美術館（山種美術館）是日本一座專門收藏日本畫（日本水彩畫風格）的美術館，由山種美術財團營運，每年舉辦7至8檔展覽。

65e2b1c4cee56334.en: Ryōma's Birthplace Memorial Museum (高知市立龍馬の生まれたまち記念館, Kōchi Shiritsu Ryōma no Umareta Machi Kinenkan) opened in Kōchi, Kōchi Prefecture, Japan in 2004. It is dedicated to the life and times of Sakamoto Ryōma and to the local area of Kami-machi and Kōchi more generally during the Bakumatsu period.
65e2b1c4cee56334.zh: 高知市立龍馬の生まれたまち記念館於2004年在日本高知縣高知市開館，介紹坂本龍馬的生平與時代，以及幕末時期上町一帶與高知整體的地方樣貌。

65e37d94b94d9fa1.en: Suwa Jinja (諏訪神社) is a Shinto shrine in Chizu, Tottori Prefecture, Japan. Known from the time of the Mongol invasions, the shrine is celebrated for its Zelkova and momiji. The Honden dates to 1832. The Onbashira Festival, held in the Year of the Tiger and Year of the Rooster, sees pillars of Japanese cedar carried through the town.
65e37d94b94d9fa1.zh: 諏訪神社是位於日本鳥取縣智頭町的神社，自元寇時期即為人所知，以櫸樹與楓葉聞名。本殿建於1832年。御柱祭於寅年與酉年舉行，屆時人們扛著日本柳杉製成的柱子穿過町內。

65e7c29013fc7740.en: teamLab Planets TOKYO DMM.com is an art museum that utilizes digital technology and was established by teamLab and DMM.com. It is located in 6-chome, Toyosu, Koto-ku, Tokyo.
65e7c29013fc7740.zh: チームラボプラネッツ TOKYO DMM.com是由teamLab與DMM.com設立、運用數位科技的美術館，位於東京都江東區豐洲6丁目。

65f0dacafb03c435.en: Kyoto's bamboo shoots are particularly renowned for their high quality nationwide. It is said that they were introduced to Kyoto during the era of Emperor Saga (810 to 823). According to one account, the founder of Kaiinji Jakusho-in temple in Nagaokakyo City, Douyuu, brought back Mosochiku (Moso bamboo) from China, which became the catalyst for its spread in the Kansai region.Nagaokakyo City is famous as a production area for bamboo shoots.
65f0dacafb03c435.zh: 京都的竹筍品質優良，在全國特別知名。據說是在嵯峨天皇時代（810至823年）傳入京都。根據一種說法，長岡京市海印寺寂照院的開山祖師道雄從中國帶回孟宗竹，成為孟宗竹在關西地區普及的契機。長岡京市以竹筍產地聞名。

65f468256ebe0784.en: Oita Prefecture is home to 585 clear streams, including the Mikuma River, which is upstream from the main stream of the Chikugo River, a first-class river, and the Ono River, the largest river in the prefecture at 107 km in length, each of which brought bounty to the region. Ayu, in particular, was prized as a valuable source of protein in mountainous areas. The river basin is dotted with kapposai and Japanese restaurants that serve ayu dishes.Ayu dishes that have taken root in the river basin include "ayu uruka" (ayu fish).
65f468256ebe0784.zh: 大分縣境內有585條清流，包括一級河川筑後川主流上游的三隈川，以及全長107公里、縣內最大的大野川，各自為地方帶來豐饒的物產。其中香魚在山區被視為珍貴的蛋白質來源而備受重視。流域沿岸散布著供應香魚料理的割烹與日本料理店。在流域紮根的香魚料理之一是「あゆうるか」（香魚）。

660ef5af242a230e.en: Numazawa is a caldera and lake in Ōnuma District of Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. The caldera measures 2 km (1.2 mi) across and the lake that occupies it measures 96 m (315 ft) deep. The volcanic caldera was constructed within the older and larger Uwaigusa caldera which is 4.2 to 4.0 million years old. The volcano first erupted 110,000 years before present (BP) produced pyroclastics. At 71,000 BP, the Mukuresawa lava dome formed, and at 45,000 BP, a Plinian eruption occurred. Two additional lava domes developed in 43,000 BP and 20,000 BP.
660ef5af242a230e.zh: 沼澤是位於日本福島縣大沼郡的破火山口及湖泊。破火山口直徑2公里（1.2英里），其中的湖泊深96公尺（315英尺）。此火山破火山口形成於更古老、更大的上井草破火山口內，後者年代為420萬至400萬年前。該火山於距今11萬年前首次噴發，產生火山碎屑物。距今7萬1000年前形成椋澤熔岩穹丘，距今4萬5000年前發生普林尼式噴發。另於距今4萬3000年前及2萬年前形成兩座熔岩穹丘。

661980214b8c72bd.en: Shiro-ebi (White shrimp ) is said to be the jewel of Toyama Bay. Today, it is eaten in a variety of ways, such as sashimi, sushi, and kakiage, using it as a broth has been an unchanged utilization method since ancient times. While it is common to make broth using fresh white shrimp, drying them allows for long-term preservation, making it possible to use them even outside the peak season of white shrimp, which is summer. Eating somen noodles with a broth based on white shrimp dashi has become an essential summer dish in Toyama.
661980214b8c72bd.zh: 白蝦被譽為富山灣的寶石。如今有生魚片、壽司、炸什錦等多種吃法，而用來熬高湯則是自古不變的利用方式。用新鮮白蝦熬高湯很常見，但乾燥後可長期保存，即使在白蝦盛產期夏季以外也能使用。以白蝦高湯為基底的湯汁搭配素麵，已成為富山不可或缺的夏季料理。

661a4a0a0835d314.en: This dish is made with rice mixed with umeboshi (preserved Japanese plums) and dried young sardines, and cooked in dashi stock. It is perfect for summer, and allows you to enjoy the fresh aroma of Japanese plums and umami taste of sardines. A local woman from Kanagawa who became a "skills leader for old-fashioned living techniques" conceived of it as a dish that would bring out the features of Odawara cooking, and spread it to surrounding areas. It is regularly eaten as a staple meal by local families.
661a4a0a0835d314.zh: 這道料理是將米與梅乾、魩仔魚乾混合，以高湯炊煮而成，適合夏季食用，可品嘗梅子的清新香氣與沙丁魚的鮮味。一位成為「傳統生活技術技能指導者」的神奈川在地女性，將其構思為能展現小田原料理特色的菜色，並推廣至周邊地區。這是當地家庭平時常吃的主食。

66255363a2327555.en: “Uchikomi soup” is a soup commonly made on cold winter days in rural areas. It’s a quick dish made by adding generous amounts of seasonal vegetables to a stock made from dried sardines and then incorporating noodles made simply from wheat flour and water, without adding salt. The noodles can be either thick or thin, adding an element of fun to the preparation.
66255363a2327555.zh: 「打ち込み汁」是鄉村地區在寒冷冬日常做的湯。在小魚乾熬的高湯中加入大量當季蔬菜，再放入只用麵粉和水、不加鹽製成的麵條，是一道能快速完成的料理。麵條可粗可細，為製作過程增添樂趣。

66255996345a666d.en: Ōasayama Prefectural Natural Park (大麻山県立自然公園, Ōasayama kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Naruto, Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1967, the park encompasses Mount Ōasa (大麻山) and Ōasahiko Shrine.
66255996345a666d.zh: 大麻山県立自然公園是位於日本德島縣鳴門市的縣立自然公園。公園設立於1967年，園內涵蓋大麻山與大麻比古神社。

663ccb48e48737fe.en: Ozenuma (尾瀬沼) is a high altitude lake in the Oze National Park, Japan. It is located on the border of Fukushima and Gunma prefectures. In 2005 it was designated as a Ramsar Wetland.
663ccb48e48737fe.zh: 尾瀨沼是日本尾瀨國家公園內的高山湖泊，位於福島縣與群馬縣的交界。2005年被登錄為拉姆薩濕地。

668e2498599cbeab.en: Dōmyō-ji (道明寺) is a Buddhist temple and nunnery in Fujiidera, Osaka, Osaka Prefecture, Japan. It was founded in the sixth century, and is affiliated with Shingon Buddhism.
668e2498599cbeab.zh: 道明寺是位於日本大阪府藤井寺市的佛教寺院暨尼寺，創建於6世紀，屬真言宗。

66b4786791bd70df.en: Amakusa Christian Museum (天草市立天草キリシタン館, Amakusa shiritsu Amakusa kirishitankan) opened in Amakusa, Japan, in 1966 and in March 2014 received its four millionth visitor. The museum includes exhibits relating to the Shimabara Rebellion and Kakure kirishitan ('hidden Christians').
66b4786791bd70df.zh: 天草キリシタン館（天草市立天草キリシタン館）於1966年在日本天草市開館，2014年3月迎來第四百萬名參觀者。館內展示與島原之亂及隱匿切支丹（「隱藏的基督徒」）相關的內容。

66e99104efe90568.en: "Takenoko no Arame-ni" is a local dish mainly in the central area, and simmered bamboo shoot and "arame". ‘Arame’ is a type of kelp. Many kinds of kelps or sea weeds drifted to the sea shore along the central area and the locals brought them to home to cook. However, the catch of ‘arame’ has decreased for these 40 years, and it is not possible to catch one. In spite of this situation, "Arame-ni", simmered bamboo shoot with "arame" caught in other areas, is still served at home and the school lunch as a taste of spring.
66e99104efe90568.zh: 筍のアラメ煮是以中部地區為主的鄉土料理，是將竹筍與荒布一起燉煮。荒布是一種海帶類海藻。過去有許多種海帶和海藻漂到中部地區沿岸，當地人會撿回家烹煮。然而，近40年來荒布的漁獲減少，如今已無法採到。儘管如此，用其他地區採收的荒布與竹筍燉煮的「アラメ煮」，至今仍作為春天的味道出現在家庭餐桌與學校營養午餐中。

66ee5e8783a27d16.en: The Ōmura Cave Tomb Cluster (大村横穴群, Ōmura yokoana-gun) is a cluster of yokoanabo tombs dug in artificial caves in a tuff cliff of located in the Shiromoto-machi neighborhood of the city of Hitoyoshi, Kumamoto Prefecture in Kyushu Japan. It was designated as a National Historic Site in 1921.
66ee5e8783a27d16.zh: 大村橫穴群是位於日本九州熊本縣人吉市城本町的橫穴墓群，墓室開鑿於凝灰岩崖壁的人工洞穴中。1921年被指定為國家史跡。

66f4a64c65ca2325.en: "Chanpuru" is a popular dish from Okinawa that consists of stir-fried veggies and Okinawan tofu. Among the different types of "Chanpurus", "Goya Chanpuru" is the most popular one, both in Okinawa and throughout Japan. By stir-frying bitter melon with Okinawan tofu and eggs, the bitterness is reduced, making it easy to eat and enjoy. Tofu is a crucial ingredient for "Chanpuru", and the firmness of Okinawan tofu makes it perfect for stir-frying.
66f4a64c65ca2325.zh: 「チャンプルー」是沖繩受歡迎的料理，由蔬菜與沖繩豆腐拌炒而成。在各種チャンプルー中，ゴーヤーチャンプルー無論在沖繩或日本全國都最受歡迎。將苦瓜與沖繩豆腐和雞蛋一起拌炒，可減少苦味，容易入口享用。豆腐是チャンプルー不可或缺的食材，沖繩豆腐質地紮實，非常適合拌炒。

66fcc52178105e2d.en: Hakuto Shrine (白兎神社, Hakuto Jinja) is a Shinto shrine in Tottori, Tottori Prefecture, Japan. The shrine is dedicated to the Hare of Inaba, a legend originating in ancient Inaba province. In 1937, its trees were designated a Natural Monument.
66fcc52178105e2d.zh: 白兔神社（白兎神社，Hakuto Jinja）是位於日本鳥取縣鳥取市的神社。神社供奉因幡之白兔，這是源自古代因幡國的傳說。1937年，神社的樹林被指定為天然紀念物。

66fe67b1cd94af0b.en: In Saitama Prefecture, which has rivers such as the Arakawa and Tone Rivers originating in the Chichibu Mountains, people have enjoyed the rich bounty of the rivers. Eels, Ayu (sweetfish), catfish, carp, and other river fish were eaten as Sashimi (raw), grilled, or boiled.
66fe67b1cd94af0b.zh: 埼玉縣有發源於秩父山地的荒川、利根川等河川，人們享用豐富的河川資源。鰻魚、香魚、鯰魚、鯉魚等河魚，以生魚片、燒烤或燉煮的方式食用。

6721640bb2dc2cfd.en: From the Meiji period to the early Showa period, sericulture flourished in a lifestyle of self-sufficiency.
6721640bb2dc2cfd.zh: 從明治時期到昭和初期，在自給自足的生活中，養蠶業相當興盛。

6729b7bf4ac5bec7.ja: 沖縄市戦後文化資料展示館ヒストリート（おきなわしせんごぶんかしりょうてんじしつヒストリート）は沖縄県沖縄市にある資料館。沖縄市が運営している。
6729b7bf4ac5bec7.zh: 沖繩市戰後文化資料展示館ヒストリート是位於沖繩縣沖繩市的資料館，由沖繩市營運。

672bd1d3497a794a.en: Kawaguchiko Motor Museum / Fighter Museum (河口湖自動車博物館・飛行舘, Kawaguchiko Jidōsha Hakubutsukan / Hikōkan) is a museum located in Yamanashi prefecture, Japan. Founded in 1981 by former race driver and businessman Nobuo Harada, it has a collection of antique motor vehicles. In 2001 it opened a new area to display a collection of 20th century military aircraft used by Japan, from Japanese Imperial Forces during World War II and the Japan Self-Defense Forces in the postwar period.
672bd1d3497a794a.zh: 河口湖自動車博物館・飛行舘是位於日本山梨縣的博物館，由前賽車手兼企業家原田信雄於1981年創立，收藏古董汽車。2001年新設展區，展出20世紀日本使用過的軍用飛機，包括二次世界大戰時期的日本帝國軍及戰後自衛隊的機體。

67301dae65776bcd.en: Kandani Shrine (神谷神社, Kandani jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Sakaide, Kagawa Prefecture, Japan. It enshrines the kami Kagu-tsuchi (火結命), Okitsuhiko no mikoto (奥津彦命), and Okitsuhime no mikoto (奥津姫命). According to legend, this shrine was established in 812. The shrine's main hall (本殿, honden) has been designated a Japanese National Treasure.
67301dae65776bcd.zh: 神谷神社是位於日本香川縣坂出市的神社。祭祀火結命、奧津彥命與奧津姬命。相傳該神社創建於812年。神社本殿已被指定為日本國寶。

67332e9e0d2c4877.en: Takakoshi Castle (高越城, Takakoshi-jō) also well known as Takakoshi-yama Castle is the remains of a castle structure in Ibara, Okayama Prefecture, Japan. The castle was built in the Nanboku-chō period against a possible invasion of Kublai Khan's force.
67332e9e0d2c4877.zh: 高越城（又稱高越山城）是位於日本岡山縣井原市的城郭遺跡。此城建於南北朝時代，用以防範忽必烈軍隊可能的入侵。

6739689026eab364.en: A hot pot dish originating in Yokohama, where beef is simmered in a sauce made with miso or soy sauce. While similar to sukiyaki, which involves grilling meat before simmering, beef hot pot cooks the ingredients from the beginning in the sauce.The widespread consumption of beef in Japan began in the late Edo period, following the end of the country's long period of isolation. Yokohama, which opened as a port city in 1859, was quick to embrace Western culture, leading to the early spread of meat-eating culture within the country.
6739689026eab364.zh: 發源於橫濱的火鍋料理，以味噌或醬油調製的醬汁燉煮牛肉。與先煎肉再燉煮的壽喜燒相似，但牛鍋是從一開始就將食材放入醬汁中烹煮。日本普遍食用牛肉始於江戶時代末期，即長期鎖國結束之後。1859年開港的橫濱很早便接納西方文化，使吃肉的文化較早在國內傳開。

6741c9064118c0a4.en: Tokushima Modern Art Museum (徳島県立近代美術館, Tokushima Kenritsu Kindai Bijutsukan) is a prefectural art museum in Japan
6741c9064118c0a4.zh: 徳島県立近代美術館是日本的縣立美術館。

6775e64a61e5438b.en: Fukui Prefectural Museum of Cultural History (福井県立歴史博物館, Fukui Kenritsu Rekishi Hakubutsukan) is a prefectural museum in Fukui, Japan, dedicated to the history and culture of Fukui Prefecture. The museum opened in 1984 and reopened after refurbishment in 2003.
6775e64a61e5438b.zh: 福井縣立歷史博物館是位於日本福井市的縣立博物館，以福井縣的歷史與文化為主題。博物館於1984年開館，2003年整修後重新開館。
