6776f4e677f11c77.en: Kanpuku-ji (観福寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Shingon Buzan Sect located in Yamakura, Katori, Chiba Prefecture. The temple is one of two temples in Katori with the same name, the other being Makinosan Kanpuku-ji.
6776f4e677f11c77.zh: 観福寺是位於千葉縣香取市山倉的真言宗豐山派佛教寺院。香取市有兩座同名寺院，另一座為牧野山観福寺。

67799a3db5047b22.en: Kōchi Castle Museum of History (高知県立高知城歴史博物館, Kōchi Kenritsu Kōchi-jō Rekishi Hakubutsukan) opened in Kōchi, Kōchi Prefecture, Japan, in 2017. Located beside the main gate of Kōchi Castle, the collection tells the history of the Tosa Domain and of the Prefecture, and comprises the 67,000 items formerly preserved, researched, and exhibited at the Tosa Yamauchi Family Treasury and Archives.
67799a3db5047b22.zh: 高知県立高知城歴史博物館於2017年在日本高知縣高知市開館。館舍位於高知城大手門旁，館藏介紹土佐藩及高知縣的歷史，收藏品包括原本由土佐山內家寶物資料館保存、研究及展示的67,000件物品。

677acdbf4bf42e83.en: Iojimazaki Lighthouse (伊王島灯台, iōjima tōdai) is a lighthouse in Iōjima, Nagasaki, Japan.
677acdbf4bf42e83.zh: 伊王島灯台是位於日本長崎市伊王島的燈塔。

6783165f41a017a0.en: In Gunma, where farm products are grown a lot, many soybeans with rich flavor are cultivated. The prefecture is making efforts to improve the quality of soy beans by establishing ‘Kabura Soybean Producers Council’ to instruct about soybean production management, or to produce new species called ‘Sato no Hohoemi’. The dish which has been eaten since long ago in Gunma, boast of tasty soybean production, is ‘gojiru’, a miso soup with mashed soybeans. It is called ‘gojiru’ because they call mashed soybean ‘go’.
6783165f41a017a0.zh: 群馬農產品種植豐富，栽培許多風味濃郁的大豆。縣政府致力於提升大豆品質，例如成立「鏑大豆生產者協議會」指導大豆生產管理，並培育名為「里のほほえみ」的新品種。在以美味大豆自豪的群馬，自古以來食用的料理就是「呉汁」，也就是加入大豆泥的味噌湯。因為磨碎的大豆稱為「呉」，所以稱為「呉汁」。

6788ae7d3e809c29.en: The Japanese saltwort used in this dish was originally a wild plant that grew along the coast and came to be called okahijiki because it looks like hijiki, a seaweed. In Yamagata Prefecture, it is said that the seeds of the Japanese saltwort, which grew wild in the Shonai area by the sea, were introduced by boat across the Mogami River to Sunazuka Village (present-day Nanyo City), a sandy area under the Yonezawa Domain, where its cultivation began.
6788ae7d3e809c29.zh: 這道料理所使用的おかひじき（陸羊栖菜）原本是生長在海岸邊的野生植物，因外形像海藻羊栖菜而被稱為おかひじき。在山形縣，據說野生於臨海庄內地區的おかひじき種子，經由最上川以船運傳到米澤藩轄下的沙地砂塚村（今南陽市），並由此開始栽培。

67f9275a583ef04f.en: Agigawa Dam (阿木川ダム, Agigawa damu) is a dam built on the Kiso River system, located in the Higashino section of Ena City, in Gifu Prefecture, Japan.
67f9275a583ef04f.zh: 阿木川ダム是建於木曾川水系的水壩，位於日本岐阜縣惠那市東野地區。

67fb368c81174dde.en: Maruzen Intec Osaka Pool is a swimming venue in Osaka, Japan. It hosted the figure skating events for the 2000 Four Continents Figure Skating Championships.
67fb368c81174dde.zh: 丸善インテック大阪プール是日本大阪的游泳場館，曾舉辦2000年四大洲花式滑冰錦標賽的花式滑冰項目。

680dff254bdb3f07.en: In Kochi Prefecture, there is a food culture of eating sweet potatoes and pumpkin stems. The stem is the "petiole" that connects the leaves to the stem. When you say "Imo no kuki (potato stem)" dish, it is generally made with sweet potato stems. The climate of Kochi Prefecture has a lot to do with the fact that the locals started eating stems. Due to the hot and humid climate of Kochi Prefecture, the stems of sweet potatoes and pumpkins flourish in the fields during the summer months.
680dff254bdb3f07.zh: 高知縣有食用番薯和南瓜莖的飲食文化。這裡的莖是指連接葉片與莖的「葉柄」。說到「芋莖」料理，一般是用番薯莖製作。當地人開始食用莖，與高知縣的氣候有很大關係。由於高知縣氣候高溫潮濕，夏季田裡的番薯和南瓜莖生長茂盛。

68111c4ac32c2e7e.en: Tsuchiura Castle (土浦城, Tsuchiura-jō) is a flatland-style Japanese castle located in Tsuchiura, southern Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan. At the end of the Edo period, Tsuchiura Castle was home to the Tsuchiya clan, daimyō of Tsuchiura Domain. The castle was also known as "Ki-jō" (亀城, Turtle Castle).
68111c4ac32c2e7e.zh: 土浦城是位於日本茨城縣南部土浦市的平城。江戶時代末期，土浦城為土浦藩藩主土屋氏的居城。該城又稱「龜城」。

683f8cfe082115b7.en: In the area around the Boso Peninsula, horse mackerel, sardines, and Pacific saury catches have been abundant since ancient times."Namero" was the most convenient way for fishermen to prepare dishes from fresh fish on their unstable boats, as they only need to finely chop them together with miso. It turned out that the dish was so delicious that people couldn't help licking their plate clean, leading to "the name namero", which means to lick.
683f8cfe082115b7.zh: 房總半島一帶自古以來竹筴魚、沙丁魚、秋刀魚的漁獲豐富。對在搖晃船上的漁夫來說，「なめろう」是用新鮮魚料理最方便的方法，只需將魚與味噌一起剁細即可。這道料理美味到讓人忍不住把盤子舔乾淨，因而取名為意思是「舔」的「なめろう」。

68478c36bb346337.en: Hokkaido is famous throughout Japan for its Ikura("Ikura" is the result of breaking down raw "Sujiko." "Sujiko" refers to the ovaries of the salmon), which is greatly popular with people of all ages.In September to October, when the salmon fishing season peaks, the local supermarkets are filled with raw salmon roe “Sujiko”, which many households use in their cooking for Ikura. Most people use salt and soy sauce to marinate their salmon roe, but for household cooking soy sauce is more common.Sujiko used to be a common dish throughout Japan.
68478c36bb346337.zh: 北海道的鮭魚卵（「イクラ」是將生的「筋子」拆散而成，「筋子」指鮭魚的卵巢）聞名全日本，深受各年齡層喜愛。鮭魚捕撈季節高峰的9月至10月，當地超市擺滿生鮭魚卵「筋子」，許多家庭會用來製作鮭魚卵料理。多數人以鹽和醬油醃漬鮭魚卵，而家庭料理中較常使用醬油。筋子過去是日本各地常見的料理。

6865af2c855136dc.en: On Setsubun (the day that spring begins in the old Japanese calendar, nowadays usually marked between 2 and 4 February), it is customary to face the "lucky direction" for that year, and eat an entire makizushi (sushi roll) whole for good luck. These sushi rolls are referred to as ehomaki.
6865af2c855136dc.zh: 在節分（舊曆中春天開始的日子，現在通常在2月2日至4日之間），習俗是面朝當年的「吉利方位」，將一整條卷壽司整條吃下以求好運。這些卷壽司稱為恵方巻き。

687d5ddd2f3689d4.en: The Sakuramachi jin'ya  (桜町陣屋)  was a jin'ya built in the Edo period located in the city of Mooka, Tochigi Prefecture in the northern Kantō region of Japan. It was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1932.
687d5ddd2f3689d4.zh: 桜町陣屋是江戶時代興建的陣屋，位於日本北關東地區栃木縣真岡市，1932年被指定為國家史跡。

6894567670f29600.en: Hatto is a local flour dish eaten throughout the northern part of the prefecture. Water is added to flour, and the mixture is kneaded until it is the consistency of earlobes, then left to rest for an appropriate amount of time, spread thinly with fingers, and boiled. In the past, women were good at making it so thin that you could see through to the other side.In the Tome and Kurihara regions, it is called "hatto" or "hatto," in the Tamatsukuri region "tsumeiri" or "tsumire," and in other regions "hitotsumi.
6894567670f29600.zh: はっと是縣內北部一帶食用的鄉土麵粉料理。在麵粉中加水，揉到像耳垂般的軟硬度，靜置適當時間後，用手指拉薄再下鍋煮。過去婦女擅長把它拉得薄到可以透視另一側。在登米與栗原地區稱為「はっと」或「はっと」，在玉造地區稱為「つめいり」或「つみれ」，其他地區則稱為「ひっつみ」。

68a287a16e2b4751.en: "Mamakarizushi" is a type of "nigirizushi" (oval-shaped mounds of rice) made with "mamakari" (=Japanese scaled sardine) pickled in vinegar. A piece of pickled "mamakari" is placed on top of each mound of sushi rice. Another name for this ray-finned fish is "sappa". It is said that the fish became known as "mamakari" as people would often say, "mama wo kari ni iku hodo oishi", which means that the fish is so delicious that people would borrow rice to enjoy it.
68a287a16e2b4751.zh: ままかりずし是一種握壽司（橢圓形的飯糰），使用以醋醃漬的ままかり（日本小沙丁魚）製作。每一團醋飯上各放一片醋漬ままかり。這種條鰭魚的另一個名稱是「さっぱ」。據說人們常說「ままを借りに行くほどおいしい」，意思是這種魚好吃到要向人借飯來享用，因此被稱為「ままかり」。

68a2d049462428e5.en: Takayama Inari Shrine (高山稲荷神社, Takayama Inari Jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in the city of  Tsugaru, Aomori Prefecture, Japan. The shrine is dedicated to  Inari Ōkami. Takayama Inari Shrine is notable for the many red torii that wind along its path. It is said that this shrine had already been established in the late 17th century. Next to the shrine is a memorial dedicated to American sailors who died in 1889 when full-rigged ship Cheseborough wrecked off the coast of Shariki Village (now a part of Tsugaru) during a typhoon.
68a2d049462428e5.zh: 高山稻荷神社是位於日本青森縣津輕市的神社，供奉稻荷大神。以沿參道蜿蜒排列的眾多紅色鳥居聞名。據說本社在17世紀後期已經創建。神社旁有一座紀念碑，紀念1889年全帆裝船Cheseborough號在颱風中於車力村（今屬津輕市）外海失事罹難的美國水手。

68a8d644ccba612e.en: In the southern region, which has suffered from cold damage to rice cultivation caused by the "Yamase" (the name given to a cold Pacific wind) since ancient times, a culture of minor grains such as wheat, millet, Japanese millet and buckwheat developed. "Kinkamochi" is an unusual local delicacy born from this environment. It is made from brown sugar, walnuts and miso paste, wrapped in a flour skin, shaped into a half-moon shape and boiled.
68a8d644ccba612e.zh: 南部地區自古以來稻作常因「やませ」（太平洋吹來的冷風名稱）而遭受冷害，因而發展出小麥、粟、稗、蕎麥等雜糧文化。「きんかもち」是在這種環境中誕生的特殊在地美食，以黑糖、核桃和味噌為餡，用麵皮包起，捏成半月形後水煮而成。

68b37f0433e932f7.en: Anbo is a kind of steamed bun with a kneaded dough and filling made of red bean paste, vegetables, etc. It is a local dish in Niigata and northern Nagano prefectures. In some areas, it is called "anbu." "Anbo" look like "oyaki" in Nagano Prefecture, but the main difference is that the skin is made of rice flour instead of wheat flour.
68b37f0433e932f7.zh: あんぼ是一種蒸饅頭，以揉製的麵皮包入紅豆餡、蔬菜等內餡，是新潟縣及長野縣北部的鄉土料理。部分地區稱為「あんぶ」。あんぼ外觀和長野縣的「おやき」相似，主要差別在於外皮是用米粉而非小麥粉製作。

68bc4b531fc68ab0.en: Honshō-ji  (本證寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Ōtani-ha Jōdo Shinshū sect in the city of Anjō, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. Its main image is a statue of Amida Nyōrai. It is a rare surviving example of a fortified temple/monastery from the Sengoku period and as such, the temple grounds have been designated as Historic Site of Japanin 2016. The temple is also known as the Nodera Gohon-bō  (野寺御本坊).
68bc4b531fc68ab0.zh: 本證寺是位於日本愛知縣安城市的淨土真宗大谷派佛教寺院。本尊為阿彌陀如來像。此寺是戰國時代城郭化寺院中少數留存至今的例子，寺域因此於2016年被指定為日本史跡。此寺又稱野寺御本坊。

68d430a52eefa9ae.en: Gunma is famous for its flour. It grows vigorously in well-drained rice paddies and under the influence of the dry cold winds and gales that blow in winter, and its production is among the highest in Japan. The Agricultural Technology Center of Gunma Prefecture has improved the Kinu no Hami and Saton no Sora varieties, which are now widely produced throughout the country. Many local dishes make use of wheat flour, and okirikomi is a typical example.
68d430a52eefa9ae.zh: 群馬以麵粉聞名。小麥在排水良好的水田中，受到冬季乾冷的風與強風吹拂而生長旺盛，產量居日本前列。群馬縣農業技術中心改良了「きぬの波」與「さとのそら」品種，如今已在全國廣泛生產。許多鄉土料理都使用麵粉，おきりこみ就是代表例子。

68f16a77b2af610d.en: HEP is a major shopping mall and entertainment center in the Umeda commercial district of Kita-ku, Osaka, Japan. It is a shopping mall consisting of a HEP Five and HEP Navio.
68f16a77b2af610d.zh: HEP是位於日本大阪市北區梅田商業區的大型購物中心與娛樂設施，由HEP FIVE與HEP NAVIO組成。

68f3ab35f1be51b2.en: Tokushima Castle Museum (徳島市立徳島城博物館, Tokushima shiritsu Tokushima-jō hakubutsukan) opened in Tokushima, Japan, in 1992. The museum is located in a garden with the ruins of Tokushima Castle, and features exhibits about the history of the castle.
68f3ab35f1be51b2.zh: 徳島市立徳島城博物館於1992年在日本德島開館。館舍位於有德島城遺跡的庭園內，展示德島城的歷史。

690f45fc46be96fd.en: Saimyō-ji (西明寺), also known as Kotō-sanzan Saimyōji (湖東三山西明寺) or as Ryūōzan Saimyōji (龍應山西明寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Tendai sect located in the town of Kōra, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. The honzon of the temple is Yakushi Nyōrai, the Buddha of healing. The temple was founded in the early Heian period and together with Kongōrin-ji in Aishō and Hyakusai-ji in Higashiōmi the temple forms a group of three temples known as Kotō-sanzan (湖東三山; lit. "three mountains east of the lake").
690f45fc46be96fd.zh: 西明寺又稱湖東三山西明寺或龍應山西明寺，是位於日本滋賀縣甲良町的天台宗佛教寺院。本尊為藥師如來，即醫治之佛。寺院創建於平安時代初期，與愛莊町的金剛輪寺、東近江市的百濟寺合稱湖東三山（字面意思為「湖東的三座山」）。

6921118f26277a77.en: The Owari Kokubun-ji (尾張国分寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Yawase neighborhood of the city of Inazawa, Aichi, Japan. The temple belongs to the Myōshin-ji branch of the Rinzai school of Japanese Zen. Its main image is a statue of Yakushi Nyōrai. It is the modern successor of one of the provincial temples established by Emperor Shōmu during the Nara period (710 – 794) for the purpose of promoting Buddhism as the national religion of Japan and standardising control of imperial rule over the provinces.
6921118f26277a77.zh: 尾張国分寺是位於日本愛知縣稻澤市矢合地區的佛教寺院，屬日本禪宗臨濟宗妙心寺派。本尊為藥師如來像。此寺是奈良時代（710－794年）聖武天皇為推廣佛教作為日本國教、並統一朝廷對各令制國的統治而設立的國分寺之一的現代承繼者。

6922833687bd17b6.en: Mount Ashigara (足柄山), also known as Mount Kintoki (金時山), is the northernmost peak of the Hakone caldera, on the border of Kanagawa and Shizuoka prefectures, in the Fuji-Hakone-Izu National Park in Japan. Ashigara is not a remnant of the collapse of the old Hakone volcano itself, but rather a parasitic cone growing from its flank.
6922833687bd17b6.zh: 足柄山又稱金時山，是箱根火山口最北端的山峰，位於日本神奈川縣與靜岡縣交界處，屬富士箱根伊豆國立公園。足柄山並非舊箱根火山本體崩塌後的殘留部分，而是從其山腹生成的寄生火山。

69713417ab75f7d0.en: The Tsutsujigaoka Park (躑躅ヶ岡公園, Tsutsujigaoka Kōen) is a Japanese garden located in the city of Tatebayashi, Gunma Prefecture, Japan, which is a nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty. It is also one of then "100 Japanese historical parks" designated in 2006 by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism to mark the 50th anniversary of the Urban Parks Law.
69713417ab75f7d0.zh: つつじが岡公園（躑躅ヶ岡公園）是位於日本群馬縣館林市的日本庭園，為國家指定名勝。此外，這裡也是國土交通省為紀念《都市公園法》施行50週年，於2006年選定的「日本歷史公園100選」之一。

69732b06fb1dfad2.en: Kurushima (来島) is a Japanese island in the Inland Sea. Administratively, it forms part of the city of Imabari, Ehime Prefecture.
69732b06fb1dfad2.zh: 来島是日本瀨戶內海中的島嶼，行政上屬於愛媛縣今治市。

69979c22c0268804.en: Ibuki island (伊吹島, Ibukijima) is an inhabited island located in the Seto Inland Sea between Honshū and Shikoku. It is administratively part of the city of Kan'onji, Kagawa, Japan. It is famous for producing high-quality iriko (dried sardines).
69979c22c0268804.zh: 伊吹島是位於本州與四國之間瀨戶內海的有人島，行政上隸屬日本香川縣觀音寺市。以出產高品質的いりこ（小沙丁魚乾）聞名。

69abd77f45256039.en: Zakuzaku is also called “zakuzakuni” or “zakuzakujiru” and is one of the local dishes that has been popular since the Edo period. According to About Haikai Formulation, zakuzaku used to refer to “finely chopped greens,” but it is said that later, the perception of it changed to a soup made by dicing the ingredients.By the way, in Fukushima Prefecture, there is a boiled local dish called “kozuyu” that is eaten in Aizuwakamatsu.
69abd77f45256039.zh: ざくざく又稱「ざくざく煮」或「ざくざく汁」，是自江戶時代流傳至今的鄉土料理之一。根據《俳諧御傘》，ざくざく原本指的是「切碎的青菜」，據說後來認知轉變為將食材切丁製成的湯。另外，福島縣還有一道在會津若松食用的燉煮鄉土料理，稱為「こづゆ」。

69cb428e79bbd673.en: Fukushima Castle (福島城, Fukushima-jō) was a Japanese castle that formed the administrative center of Fukushima Domain, a feudal domain of the Itakura clan, located in the center  of what is now the city of Fukushima in Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. Nothing remains of the castle today, and the site is occupied by the Fukushima Prefectural Office and other public buildings.
69cb428e79bbd673.zh: 福島城是日本的城堡，曾是板倉氏所領福島藩的行政中心，位於今日福島縣福島市的市中心。城堡如今已無遺存，原址為福島縣廳及其他公共建築所使用。

69d1d744bc3214fe.en: Yatsu-higata (谷津干潟) is a tidal flat in Narashino, Chiba Prefecture, Japan, 2 km from Tokyo Bay. Once a part of the largest tidal flats in Japan, much of the area has been reclaimed. Forty hectares of wetland were designated a Ramsar Site in 1993.
69d1d744bc3214fe.zh: 谷津干潟是位於日本千葉縣習志野市的潮間帶灘地，距東京灣2公里。這裡曾是日本最大潮間帶灘地的一部分，其中大片區域已被填海造地。1993年，40公頃的濕地被指定為拉姆薩濕地。

69e3e44d322d2ba1.en: Japanese sandfish are a scaleless, mild-flavored fish that are favored in the Shonai region as the taste of autumn. The sandfish come to the shores of Shonai around December to lay their eggs. For this reason, the sight of fisherman congregating on Sakatakita Pier and other such places is a characteristic winter scene.The size of the Japanese sandfish catch declined precipitously from around the end of the Showa period until the Heisei period.
69e3e44d322d2ba1.zh: 日本叉牙魚是無鱗、味道清淡的魚，在庄內地區被視為秋天的滋味而受到喜愛。叉牙魚約在12月來到庄內沿岸產卵，因此漁民聚集在酒田北港碼頭等地的景象是當地特有的冬季風景。日本叉牙魚的漁獲量從昭和末期左右到平成年間急遽減少。

6a19b5126f850148.en: Rokusho Shrine (六所神社, Rokusho-jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in the city of Okazaki, Aichi Prefecture in Japan.
6a19b5126f850148.zh: 六所神社是位於日本愛知縣岡崎市的神社。

6a2993705dc11af3.en: Mount Misumi (三角山, Misumi-yama), also known as Mount Tokin (頭巾山, Tokin-yama) or Mount Tokkin (襟巾山, Tokkin-zan), is a mountain in Tottori (formerly Mochigase), Tottori Prefecture, Japan. It is one of the 100 Famous Mountains of Chūgoku and stands 516 metres (1,693 ft) tall.
6a2993705dc11af3.zh: 三角山（三角山，Misumi-yama），又稱頭巾山（頭巾山，Tokin-yama）或襟巾山（襟巾山，Tokkin-zan），是位於日本鳥取縣鳥取市（舊用瀨町）的山。為中國百名山之一，高516公尺（1,693英尺）。

6a3c3ecade9859c5.en: Horikoshi Castle (堀越城, Horikoshi jō) was a Muromachi period Japanese castle located in what is now the city of Hirosaki, Aomori Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of far northern Japan. It is protected by the central government as a National Historic Site, collectively with Hirosaki Castle and Tanesato Castle as the "Tsugaru clan Castle Sites".
6a3c3ecade9859c5.zh: 堀越城是室町時代的日本城郭，位於日本最北部東北地方、今青森縣弘前市境內。該城與弘前城、種里城合稱「津輕氏城跡」，受中央政府指定為國家史跡加以保護。

6a41ccae74af6305.en: Zoni is unique in its ingredients in each region of Japan. The ingredients and taste of the soup stock, the ingredients that go into it, and the shape of the rice cake vary from region to region. The custom of eating zoni with rice cakes on the first three days of the New Year is said to have existed in the Heian period (794 - 1185). Later, in the Muromachi period (1336-1573), zoni became a celebratory meal for samurai families, incorporating a variety of good luck ingredients and taking root in many areas.
6a41ccae74af6305.zh: 日本各地的雜煮在食材上各有特色。湯頭的材料與味道、放入的配料，以及年糕的形狀，都因地區而異。據說在新年前三天吃放有年糕的雜煮，這個習俗在平安時代（794-1185）就已存在。之後到了室町時代（1336-1573），雜煮成為武士家族的節慶料理，加入了各種吉祥食材，並在許多地區扎根。

6a43a6d3a780e82b.en: Hōrai-ji (鳳来寺) is a Shingon Buddhist temple located in the city of Shinshiro, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. Its main image is a statue of Yakushi Nyōrai. The temple is located on the 695 metres (2,280 ft)  Mount Hōrai and is accessed by a flight of 1425 steps. The grounds have been designated Place of Scenic Beauty and Natural Monument since 1931. The area is also noted for its population of Eurasian scops owl, the prefectural bird of Aichi Prefecture.
6a43a6d3a780e82b.zh: 鳳來寺是位於日本愛知縣新城市的真言宗寺院，本尊為藥師如來像。寺院位於海拔695公尺（2,280英尺）的鳳來寺山上，需登上1425級石階才能抵達。寺域自1931年起被指定為名勝及天然紀念物。此地也以棲息著愛知縣縣鳥東方角鴞而聞名。

6a5f9492915a609d.en: The Takasu Snow Park (高鷲スノーパーク, Takasu Sunō Pāku) is a ski area on Mount Dainichi in Gifu Prefecture, Japan. The resort opened in 1999, developed by Tōwa Kankō. J Mountains Group acquired the resort in 2006, and is the current operator. The resort is known for its gondola and 3 half-pipes.
6a5f9492915a609d.zh: 高鷲スノーパーク是位於日本岐阜縣大日岳的滑雪場。由東和觀光開發，於1999年開業。J Mountains Group於2006年收購並經營至今。滑雪場以纜車車廂及3座U型池聞名。

6a6b3a0a6a23628e.en: "Hinona Pickles" refer to pickles made using traditional vegetables from Shiga Prefecture and were designated as Shiga Prefecture's Selected Intangible Folk Cultural Property, "Shiga's Food Cultural Property," in 1998.Hinona are said to have originated in Hino Town, Gamou District, Shiga Prefecture, about 500 years ago when Gamou Sadahide, an ancestor and the founder of the Gamou family, discovered them during a visit to the Kannon temple in Kamakake, Hino Town.
6a6b3a0a6a23628e.zh: 「日野菜漬け」是使用滋賀縣傳統蔬菜製作的醃菜，1998年被指定為滋賀縣選定無形民俗文化財「滋賀的食文化財」。據說日野菜起源於約500年前的滋賀縣蒲生郡日野町，由蒲生家的祖先、創始者蒲生貞秀前往日野町鎌掛的觀音寺參拜時發現。

6a8bd561163b2a91.en: The Handa Red Brick Building (半田赤レンガ建物, Handa Akarenga Tatemono) is a historic brick warehouse located in Handa City, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. It is certified by the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry of Japan as one of the Heritage of Industrial Modernization of Japan sites and plaque locations. The site consists of three buildings: the original main building, a storage building, and a half-timbered building.
6a8bd561163b2a91.zh: 半田赤レンガ建物是位於日本愛知縣半田市的歷史磚造倉庫，獲日本經濟產業省認定為近代化產業遺產之一。此處由三棟建築組成：原本的主建築、倉庫建築，以及一棟半木造建築。

6a8c6ef0ef48d3a9.en: Matsumi Falls (松見の滝, Matsumi-no-taki) is a waterfall in the city of Towada, Aomori Prefecture, Japan, on a tributary of the Oirase River, which flows down from Lake Towada. It is one of "Japan’s Top 100 Waterfalls", in a listing published by the Japanese Ministry of the Environment in 1990.
6a8c6ef0ef48d3a9.zh: 松見の滝是位於日本青森縣十和田市的瀑布，位於發源自十和田湖的奧入瀨川支流上。1990年獲日本環境省選入「日本瀑布百選」。

6abde2c679f4fee2.en: Yamanoue Stele (山ノ上碑, Yamanoue hi) (also written 山上碑) is an Asuka period stele discovered in the Yamana neighborhood of the city of Takasaki, Gunma Prefecture, in the northern Kantō region of Japan. The stele was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1921, and was raised in status to that of a Special National Historic Site in 1954. It is associated with the adjacent Yamanoue Kofun (山ノ上古墳), a kofun burial mound, which is also covered under the Special Historical Site designation.
6abde2c679f4fee2.zh: 山ノ上碑（也寫作山上碑）是在日本北關東地區群馬縣高崎市山名地區發現的飛鳥時代石碑。此碑於1921年被指定為日本國家史跡，1954年升格為特別史跡。與其相關的鄰近古墳山ノ上古墳也同屬特別史跡範圍。

6ac6bda3015dc879.en: Gunma Prefectural Museum of History (群馬県立歴史博物館, Gunma kenritsu rekishi hakubutsukan) opened in Takasaki, Gunma Prefecture, Japan, in 1979.
6ac6bda3015dc879.zh: 群馬県立歴史博物館於1979年在日本群馬縣高崎市開館。

6af9738fa12ab717.en: The Teranohigashi Site (寺野東遺跡, Teranohigashi iseki) is a complex archaeological site in the city of Oyama, Tochigi Prefecture, in the northern Kantō region of Japan.  The site was designated a National Historic Site in 1995 by the Japanese government.
6af9738fa12ab717.zh: 寺野東遺跡是位於日本北關東地區栃木縣小山市的複合考古遺址。1995年由日本政府指定為國家史跡。

6b106459caaeb813.en: "Tare Katsu Don" is a dish where freshly fried thin pork cutlets are placed on top of rice and drizzled with a sweet and savory soy-based sauce. It doesn't include a scrambled egg topping. This simple dish features a unique characteristic of having two or more cutlets placed on a single bowl. The pork used in this dish is thinner than the typical pork cutlet found in other katsudon dishes, and it is coated with a light batter.
6b106459caaeb813.zh: タレかつ丼是將剛炸好的薄豬排放在白飯上，淋上甜鹹醬油醬汁的料理，不加蛋液。這道簡單料理的獨特之處在於一碗放兩片以上的豬排。使用的豬肉比其他豬排丼常見的豬排更薄，並裹上薄麵衣。

6b12aeeab5e0606e.en: The consumption of horse meat became widespread in Fukushima around the time of the Boshin War.It is said that the practice of feeding horse meat to the wounded individuals brought to the prefecture began at that time. Later, horse meat became popular in Aizu Wakamatsu as a valuable source of protein, and became a food commonly eaten at home like pork and chicken. Initially, it was common to cook horse meat thoroughly.
6b12aeeab5e0606e.zh: 福島食用馬肉的習慣大約在戊辰戰爭時期普及。據說當時開始讓被送到縣內的傷者食用馬肉。之後馬肉作為珍貴的蛋白質來源在會津若松普及，成為和豬肉、雞肉一樣家常食用的食物。最初，馬肉一般都會徹底煮熟再吃。

6b65ad7ba87939e8.en: This local dish, called “Noppei” or “Noppei-jiru (Noppei soup),” can be found throughout Japan, but the ingredients used can vary from region to region. The traditional style of “Noppei” in the city of Hagi (a “jokamachi” or “castle town” during the feudal era, which existed to serve a feudal lord’s castle), in Yamaguchi Prefecture, is not only served regularly in common households, but is also a dish that is served during festive and Buddhist ceremonial events, or as a delicacy to welcome guests.
6b65ad7ba87939e8.zh: 這道稱為「のっぺい」或「のっぺい汁」的鄉土料理在日本各地都有，但使用的食材因地區而異。山口縣萩市（封建時代為侍奉藩主城堡而存在的「城下町」）的傳統「のっぺい」，不僅是一般家庭平日常吃的料理，也會在喜慶及佛事場合端出，或作為款待客人的佳餚。

6b8bb80d37a10f2b.en: Hosshin-ji (発心寺) is a Soto Zen temple in Obama, Fukui Prefecture, Japan. The temple is known for its rigorous training. Harada Daiun Sogaku served as abbott in Hosshin-ji in 1924 before going on to serve at a number of other temples.
6b8bb80d37a10f2b.zh: 発心寺是位於日本福井縣小濱市的曹洞宗寺院，以嚴格的修行聞名。原田祖岳（大雲）於1924年擔任発心寺住持，之後又在多座寺院任職。

6b98265d69045fb8.en: "Gimburo beans" are a type of black turtle bean which has been grown in households of Nishi-Toyonaga (this village is now a part of Otoyo town) for a long time. This bean is known to be healthy and is often referred to as “beans of longevity”, which is considered good luck. The beans were mostly consumed within the region. When cooked, the skin of the beans become soft and absorbs the flavor of the seasonings.It is said that the beans have the word “gin” (=silver) in its name because of its distinctive black and glossy appearance.
6b98265d69045fb8.zh: 「銀ぶろう豆」是西豐永（此村現屬大豐町）家家戶戶長年種植的一種黑豆。這種豆子有益健康，常被稱為「長壽豆」，被視為吉祥之物。這種豆子大多在當地食用。煮過後豆皮會變軟，並吸收調味料的味道。據說名稱中帶有「銀」字，是因為其黑亮的獨特外觀。

6ba660f0cfd76c44.en: "Haba" refers to "Haba-nori," dried seaweed from Boshu. (Haba-nori is a greenish yellowish-brown to reddish-brown spatula-shaped seaweed 15-25 cm long and 1.5-5 cm wide that is collected in winter and spring, chopped into 2 cm pieces, arranged in a bamboo screen, and dried in the sun. Originally eaten as a substitute for asakusa-nori, it was mostly consumed by local fishermen, partly because of its ugly appearance. Because of its misshapen appearance, it was mostly consumed by local fishermen, and thus became a local foodstuff.
6ba660f0cfd76c44.zh: 「はば」指的是「はば海苔」，是房州的乾燥海藻。（はば海苔是長15～25公分、寬1.5～5公分，呈黃綠褐色至紅褐色的扁平鏟狀海藻，於冬季與春季採收，切成2公分小段，排在竹簾上曬乾。原本作為淺草海苔的替代品食用，部分因外觀不佳，主要由當地漁民食用。由於外形不佳，主要由當地漁民食用，因而成為當地的食材。

6bb41641c59d8d36.en: Japon Louvre Sculpture Museum (ルーブル彫刻美術館, Rūburu Chōkoku Bijutsukan) opened in Tsu, Mie Prefecture, Japan in 1987. The collection comprises some 1,300 replicas of famous statues from the Louvre—as agreed with then director Hubert Landais—and other collections, and includes those of the Venus de Milo, Winged Victory of Samothrace, Apollo Belvedere, Townley Discobolus, and Bust of Nefertiti, as well as of Michelangelo's Moses. The museum is managed and operated by the local Shingon temple of Daikannon-ji (大観音寺), which was established in 1982.
6bb41641c59d8d36.zh: ルーブル彫刻美術館（羅浮宮雕刻美術館）於1987年在日本三重縣津市開館。館藏包含約1,300件羅浮宮名雕像的複製品（經當時館長Hubert Landais同意）及其他收藏，其中有米洛的維納斯、薩莫色雷斯的勝利女神、觀景殿的阿波羅、湯利擲鐵餅者、娜芙蒂蒂胸像，以及米開朗基羅的摩西像。博物館由當地創建於1982年的真言宗寺院大觀音寺管理營運。

6bbce2fef3c3a0d7.en: Kanpyo-maki is a type of sushi roll that is made by boiling kanpyo in water to give it a sweet-salty flavor and then wrapping it with vinegared rice and seaweed.Kanpyo-maki is an indispensable dish as a standard item in Edomae-sushi. Kanpyo is a kind of dried food―thin strips of gourd pulp dried in the sun.
6bbce2fef3c3a0d7.zh: かんぴょう巻き是一種壽司卷，將葫蘆乾以水煮成甜鹹口味後，用醋飯和海苔捲起。かんぴょう巻き是江戶前壽司中不可或缺的基本品項。葫蘆乾是一種乾貨，將葫蘆果肉切成細條後日曬而成。

6bbf17991413a1af.en: Nagai Park (長居公園, Nagai kōen) is a large sports complex located in Higashisumiyoshi-ku, Osaka. Its facilities include three multipurpose sports stadiums, including 50,000-seat Nagai Stadium; Nagai Botanical Garden, which has over 1,000 species of trees and flowers; a swimming pool and gymnasium; and a tract of preserved local forest. It also hosts a large number of cherry trees and is a popular area for picnics during cherry blossom (sakura) season in early spring.
6bbf17991413a1af.zh: 長居公園是位於大阪市東住吉區的大型運動園區。設施包括三座多功能運動場（其中包括可容納50,000人的長居陸上競技場）、栽種超過1,000種樹木與花卉的長居植物園、游泳池與體育館，以及一片保留下來的當地森林。園內也種有大量櫻花樹，是早春櫻花季時熱門的野餐地點。

6bd36d1c8fafdf3a.en: Keitoku-in (景徳院) is a Buddhist temple located in the Tano Owadamachi neighborhood of the city of [[Kōshū, Yamanashi]|Kōshū]], Yamanashi Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Sōtō school of Japanese Zen and its honzon is a statue of Shakyamuni Buddha. The temple's full name is Tendōzan Keitoku-in (天童山 景徳院).  It is also known as Tano-dera .  The precincts of the temple are designated as a Yamanashi Prefectural Historic Siteand the temple's Sanmon gate (completed in 1779) is a Yamanashi Prefecture Tangible Cultural Property.
6bd36d1c8fafdf3a.zh: 景徳院是位於日本山梨縣甲州市田野大和町地區的佛教寺院，屬於日本禪宗的曹洞宗，本尊為釋迦牟尼佛像。寺院全名為天童山景徳院，又稱田野寺。寺院境內被指定為山梨縣指定史跡，寺院的山門（1779年完工）為山梨縣有形文化財。

6bdda1863a46d753.en: Salted Bamboo Shoot "Tempura" is a simple dish made from salted bamboo shoots, that have been washed, seasoned with seasonings, and then tempura-ed(deep fry with batter). The bamboo shoots used in salted bamboo shoot tempura are high quality bamboo shoots from Chiba Prefecture.Chiba Prefecture is a famous for its bamboo shoots, with Otaki Town, Nagara Town, Chiba City, Kimitsu City, and Katsuura City, being the main production areas.
6bdda1863a46d753.zh: 鹽漬竹筍天婦羅是一道簡單的料理，將鹽漬竹筍洗淨、調味後裹粉油炸成天婦羅。所用的竹筍是千葉縣產的優質竹筍。千葉縣以竹筍聞名，主要產地為大多喜町、長柄町、千葉市、君津市及勝浦市。

6bf58c869cc033ce.en: Nagoya International Exhibition Hall (名古屋市国際展示場, Nagoya-shi kokusai tenjijō), also known as Portmesse Nagoya (ポートメッセなごや, Pōto messe Nagoya), is an exhibition center in the city of Nagoya, Aichi, Japan.
6bf58c869cc033ce.zh: 名古屋市國際展示場又稱ポートメッセなごや，是位於日本愛知縣名古屋市的展覽中心。

6bffe8980d196854.en: Sendai Zoni has been eaten since the end of the Edo period. It is a beautifully colored meal for a special occasion with grilled hake so large that it protrudes from the bowl, harako (salmon roe), Sendai celeri, and omorina.Daikon, carrots, and burdocks are cut into small pieces and quickly blanched in hot water, and the "o-hinna" is divided into servings and frozen in the open air.
6bffe8980d196854.zh: 仙台雜煮自江戶末期開始食用。這是一道色彩美麗的節慶料理，有大到超出碗外的烤沙魚、はらこ（鮭魚卵）、仙台芹菜和おもりな。白蘿蔔、紅蘿蔔和牛蒡切成小塊，以熱水快速汆燙，再將「おひな」分成小份，置於室外冷凍。

6c061c6277701d1b.en: The "Kyoto bamboo shoots" are known for their soft, white flesh and lack of bitterness, and are cultivated in a unique way using the moso bamboo variety. The Kyoto-style softening method is used including processes such as “Shindome” to stop the ends of the parent bamboo, “Shikiwara” to spread straw over the entire field, and “Tsuchiire” which deepens the soil layer and prevents the skin of the bamboo shoots from oxidizing and turning black.
6c061c6277701d1b.zh: 「京都竹筍」以肉質柔軟潔白、沒有苦味著稱，以孟宗竹品種用獨特的方式栽培。所採用的京都式軟化栽培法包括：截斷母竹末端的「芯止め」、在整片竹林鋪上稻草的「敷き藁」，以及加深土層、防止竹筍外皮氧化變黑的「土入れ」等工序。

6c1b2e2d48856899.en: Port of Humanity Tsuruga Museum (人道の港 敦賀ムゼウム, Jindō no Minato Tsuruga Muzeumu) is a museum that displays the history of Tsuruga Port, located in Kanegasaki Park, Tsuruga, Fukui, Japan. It emphasizes Chiune Sugihara, who saved the lives of many Jewish refugees during World War II by issuing transit visas. He did this although he was forbidden by his country and issued over 2000 Visas in one month, eventually saving over 6,000 lives in the process. Tsuruga Port was the place they disembarked after their long journey from their native Europe.
6c1b2e2d48856899.zh: 人道の港敦賀ムゼウム是位於日本福井縣敦賀市金崎公園內、展示敦賀港歷史的博物館。館方著重介紹杉原千畝，他在第二次世界大戰期間核發過境簽證，救了許多猶太難民的性命。他雖遭本國禁止，仍在一個月內核發超過2000份簽證，最終救了超過6,000人。敦賀港是這些難民從故鄉歐洲長途跋涉後登岸的地方。

6c1eebd750458a0a.en: This dish is very popular not only as an attractive food for auspicious occasions, but also as a daily home food. People had no choice other than making tofu by themselves in mountainous area, where no tofu store was nearby. In Kawamata area or Serizawa area in Nikko City, neighbors shared the instrument and made tofu together. That’s why tofu was a precious food. They made tofu for special occasion like memorial service, ceremony or New Year, and cooked ‘Shira-ae’ at that time.
6c1eebd750458a0a.zh: 這道料理不僅作為喜慶場合的佳餚，也是日常的家常菜，相當受歡迎。在附近沒有豆腐店的山區，人們只能自己做豆腐。在日光市的川俣地區或芹澤地區，鄰居共用器具一起製作豆腐，因此豆腐是珍貴的食物。人們在法事、儀式或新年等特殊場合製作豆腐，並在那時做「白あえ」。

6c46b6ac627a07e1.en: Jion-ji (慈恩寺), (山号 宝珠山; Sangō Zuihō-zan) is a major Buddhist temple located in the city of Sagae, in Yamagata Prefecture, Japan.  Its main image is a hibutsu statue of Miroku Bosatsu. The temple has been a place for pilgrimage for centuries, and is designated as a National Historic Site in 2014  It occupies a mountain overlooking the Yamagata basin, and its main gate is at an altitude of 146 meters.
6c46b6ac627a07e1.zh: 慈恩寺（山號寶珠山）是位於日本山形縣寒河江市的重要佛教寺院。本尊為秘佛彌勒菩薩像。數百年來一直是朝聖地，並於2014年被指定為國家史跡。寺院位於俯瞰山形盆地的山上，山門海拔146公尺。

6c49991a7623a5ef.en: Ryōsen-ji (了仙寺) is a Nichiren-sect Buddhist temple in the city of Shimoda, Japan.
6c49991a7623a5ef.zh: 了仙寺是位於日本下田市的日蓮宗佛寺。

6c59d0b44d190b55.en: The people of Fukuoka began to eat chicken meat when Fukuoka prefecture experienced a famine, namely the Kyoho famine, during the Edo period and the Fukuoka Domain faced a financial crisis. The Fukuoka Domain created what was referred to as the “Chicken and Egg System” and recommended the local people to raise chickens and sell their eggs to other parts of the country to make money.
6c59d0b44d190b55.zh: 福岡人開始食用雞肉，是在江戶時代福岡遭遇享保饑荒、福岡藩面臨財政危機之時。福岡藩創設了所謂的「雞卵制度」，鼓勵當地人養雞，並將雞蛋銷往全國各地以賺取收入。

6c5c67f6c2e81590.en: Okada Museum of Art (岡田美術館, Okada Bijutsukan) opened in Hakone, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan, in 2013. The private museum was created by the Japanese billionaire Kazuo Okada and specializes in Asian art; the collection of some 450 pieces centers on early modern and modern Japanese painting while also including Chinese bronzes, lacquer, ceramics, and Buddhist sculpture. It has the largest indoor exhibition space in Hakone, extending over five floors..
6c5c67f6c2e81590.zh: 岡田美術館於2013年在日本神奈川縣箱根開館。這座私人美術館由日本億萬富豪岡田和生創設，專門收藏亞洲美術；約450件館藏以日本近世及近代繪畫為主，另有中國青銅器、漆器、陶瓷與佛教雕刻。館內展示空間橫跨五層樓，是箱根規模最大的室內展示空間。

6c664493084b2347.en: There is a festival called "Ta no Kami Matsuri", held mainly by children to celebrate successful completion of rice planting. In 15 villages in Obama City and upper-middle of Wakasa Town, it is held on their own holidays like "Gogatsu Yasumi" (holiday in May) or "Yasungyou" (off from work). They carry their "mikoshi" (portable shrine) with chanting their own "hayashi kotoba" (meaningless words to maintain the rhythm of chant) and walk along homes and rice fields. It is the festival rarely seen in other areas in Japan.
6c664493084b2347.zh: 有一個名為「田の神祭」的祭典，主要由孩子們舉行，慶祝插秧順利完成。在小濱市的15個村落及若狹町中上游地區，這個祭典在各自的休假日舉行，例如「五月休み」（五月的休假）或「やすんぎょう」（停工休息）。孩子們一邊唱著各地自有的「囃子詞」（為維持唱誦節奏而加入、本身沒有意義的詞語），一邊扛著「神輿」（可移動的神轎），沿著住家和稻田行走。這是在日本其他地區少見的祭典。

6c749917458426b9.en: Ōsakikamijima Island (大崎上島, Ōsakikamijima) is an island in the Inland Sea of Japan which is administratively part of the town of Ōsakikamijima, Hiroshima Prefecture. As of 2020, the population was about 7,158.
6c749917458426b9.zh: 大崎上島是位於日本瀨戶內海的島嶼，行政上屬於廣島縣大崎上島町。2020年時人口約7,158人。

6c7d938a62f843ba.en: Around the anniversary of founder Shinran's death (November 28th under the lunar calendar and January 16th under the solar calendar), from fall to the New Year, the biggest event of the year for all sects of Jodo Shinshu True Pure Land School of Buddhism is held. The event is called "Hoonko memorial services for the sect founder." In Fukui Prefecture, it is called "Honkosan" or "Oko(u)sama." Gojiru is one of the vegetarian dishes served to people who gather at the Hoonko memorial services for the sect founder.
6c7d938a62f843ba.zh: 在開祖親鸞的忌日（農曆11月28日，國曆1月16日）前後，從秋季到新年期間，淨土真宗各派會舉行年度最大的活動，稱為「報恩講」（紀念宗派開祖的法會）。在福井縣稱為「ほんこさん」或「お講様」。呉汁是供應給參加報恩講者的精進料理之一。

6c86bf27089f5251.en: Yatsushiro Castle (八代城, Yatsushiro-jō) is the remains of a castle structure in Yatsushiro, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan.
6c86bf27089f5251.zh: 八代城是位於日本熊本縣八代市的城郭遺跡。

6c93a96ff10aae9e.en: Hakodate Jōmon Culture Center (函館市縄文文化交流センター, Hakodate Jōmon Bunka Kōryū Senta—) is a history museum in Hakodate, Hokkaidō, Japan, opened in 2011. It has four exhibition rooms dedicated to the Jōmon period, displaying some 1,200 pieces of earthenware and stoneware excavated in Hakodate as well as the only National Treasure in Hokkaidō, the so-called "Hollow Dogū", excavated from the Chobonaino Site (著保内野遺跡) (designated in 2007). Hands-on activities, including magatama-making and "angin (編布)-knitting", are also available.
6c93a96ff10aae9e.zh: 函館市縄文文化交流センター是位於日本北海道函館的歷史博物館，2011年開館。館內設有四間以繩文時代為主題的展示室，展出在函館出土的約1,200件土器與石器，以及北海道唯一的國寶、出土於著保内野遺跡的「中空土偶」（2007年指定）。館內也提供勾玉製作與「編布」編織等體驗活動。

6ca3bf361359ed72.en: Saga Prefectural Nagoya Castle Museum (佐賀県立名護屋城博物館, Saga Kenritsu Nagoya-jō Hakubutsukan) opened in 1993 in Karatsu, Saga Prefecture, Japan, on the site of Nagoya Castle, built in 1591 as the base for Hideyoshi's invasions of Korea. It displays artefacts excavated from the castle site and other materials relating to three main themes: (1) the history of exchange between the Japanese archipelago and Korean peninsula; (2) the preservation of the Special Historic Site of Nagoya Castle; (3) cultural and academic exchange between Japan and Korea.
6ca3bf361359ed72.zh: 佐賀縣立名護屋城博物館於1993年在日本佐賀縣唐津市開館，館址位於名護屋城遺址。名護屋城建於1591年，是豐臣秀吉出兵朝鮮的據點。館內展示城址出土文物及其他資料，圍繞三大主題：（1）日本列島與朝鮮半島的交流史；（2）特別史跡名護屋城跡的保存；（3）日韓之間的文化與學術交流。

6ccb44ee47d01768.en: Ōzushima (大津島), or Ozu Island, is an inhabited island in the Inland Sea, Japan. Administratively, it forms part of the city of Shūnan, Yamaguchi Prefecture. Ōzushima is also known as "Kaiten Island".
6ccb44ee47d01768.zh: 大津島是日本瀨戶內海中的有人島。行政上屬於山口縣周南市。大津島也被稱為「回天島」。

6ccc8efca5444995.en: Eggplant is a representative vegetable from summer to autumn. Inland Tochigi Prefecture, where the temperatures soar during the summer, making it suitable for cultivation, eggplant was a familiar vegetable not only for farmers but also for those with even a small plot of land to cultivate it. There are numerous eggplant dishes, such as pickled in rice bran and miso soup, but one of the most popular during the summer is "Nasu to Ingen no Abura Miso," where chopped eggplant is stir-fried in oil and coated with a mixture of miso and sugar.
6ccc8efca5444995.zh: 茄子是夏季至秋季的代表性蔬菜。位於內陸的栃木縣夏季氣溫高，適合栽培茄子，不僅是農家，就連只有小塊土地可耕種的人家，茄子也是熟悉的蔬菜。茄子料理種類眾多，例如米糠醃漬和味噌湯，而夏季最受歡迎的之一是「なすといんげんの油味噌」，將切好的茄子用油炒過，再裹上味噌與砂糖的混合調味。

6cdb345643a019ab.en: Museum of Ehime History and Culture (愛媛県歴史文化博物館, Ehime-ken Rekishi Bunka Hakubutsukan) is a history museum located in Seiyo, Ehime, Japan. The museum introduces mainly the history and folklore of Ehime prefecture in general, and the southern region of it in specific.
6cdb345643a019ab.zh: 愛媛縣歷史文化博物館（愛媛県歴史文化博物館）是位於日本愛媛縣西予市的歷史博物館。館內主要介紹愛媛縣整體的歷史與民俗，特別是縣內南部地區。

6cedab050ccad921.en: The Higashimyō ruins (東名遺跡, Higashimyō iseki) is an archaeological site containing the ruins of a late early Jōmon period settlement and shell mound located in what is now the Chifu, Kinryū neighborhood of the city of Saga, Saga Prefecture, Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 2016 and is where the oldest woven baskets, combs, wooden plates, and organic remains yet discovered in Japan have been found.
6cedab050ccad921.zh: 東名遺跡是一處考古遺址，包含繩文時代早期後段的聚落與貝塚遺跡，位於今日本佐賀縣佐賀市金立町千布。該遺址於2016年被指定為日本國家史跡，並出土了日本迄今發現最古老的編織籃、梳子、木盤及有機遺物。

6cf2e72f7dbd810c.en: Peanuts, also known as "Nankin-mame", are said to have been introduced to Japan around the Edo period (1603-1868), but their cultivation did not begin in earnest until the Meiji period (1868-1912), making them a relatively recent addition to the bean category. In addition to Ibaraki Prefecture, Chiba Prefecture is well known for its production, and these two prefectures account for most of the production in Japan.
6cf2e72f7dbd810c.zh: 花生又稱「南京豆」，據說於江戶時代（1603-1868）前後傳入日本，但直到明治時代（1868-1912）才正式開始栽培，在豆類中屬於較晚加入的成員。除茨城縣外，千葉縣也以花生產地聞名，這兩縣占日本大部分的產量。

6cf641773d28ef46.en: "Tempura of Lake Fish" is a classic dish in Shiga Prefecture, featuring small sweetfish, Isaza, and smelt caught in Lake Biwa. The freshly fried lake fish has no unpleasant odor and is delicious. Shrimp with its shell, known as suji ebi, is also used for tempura and mixed tempura.The ideal fish for "Tempura of Lake Fish" is the small sweetfish from Lake Biwa. These sweetfish, which grow to only about 7 cm in length, concentrate a delicious flavor and have a soft texture, making them easy to eat.
6cf641773d28ef46.zh: 「湖魚の天ぷら」是滋賀縣的經典料理，使用琵琶湖捕獲的小香魚、いさざ和公魚。剛炸好的湖魚沒有腥味，十分美味。帶殼的蝦，也就是すじえび，也會用來做天婦羅和綜合炸物。最適合做「湖魚の天ぷら」的是琵琶湖的小香魚。這種香魚只長到約7公分，鮮味濃縮，口感柔軟，容易入口。

6d13643c969c9df6.en: Kashiwabara Museum (柏原美術館, Kashiwabara Bijutsukan) (formerly known as Iwakuni Art Museum) is a museum of traditional Japanese art in Iwakuni, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan. The museum opened in 1963. The collection includes a National Treasure sword (of the Nanboku-chō period, with an inscription in gold inlay of Tenshō 13 (1585)) and Important Cultural Property armour (haramaki, also of the Nanboku-chō period).
6d13643c969c9df6.zh: 柏原美術館（舊稱岩國美術館）是位於日本山口縣岩國市的日本傳統美術博物館，1963年開館。館藏包括一把國寶刀劍（南北朝時代，有天正13年（1585年）的金象嵌銘）以及重要文化財鎧甲（腹卷，同為南北朝時代）。

6d157c37c0585443.en: The "Kate" in the name refers to ingredients used to increase volume. This regional cuisine was created with the purpose of increasing the volume by adding daikon and nira (garlic chives). The practice of using daikon in the winter and soft nira in the early spring to improve the flavor while increasing the volume is said to have been started by common people when food was scarce.
6d157c37c0585443.zh: 名稱中的「かて」是指用來增加分量的食材。這道鄉土料理是為了加入蘿蔔和韭菜以增加分量而產生的。冬季用蘿蔔、早春用柔嫩的韭菜，在增加分量的同時提升風味，據說這種做法是平民在糧食匱乏時開始的。

6d4be7a1d93452af.en: The sericulture industry has been thriving in Gunma for quite some time, and even now the prefecture is focused on the industry’s further cultivation via such methods as the use of original silkworm breeds to make “Gunma silk,” as well as practical applications for genetically modified silkworms. For that reason, “cocoons” became highly valued and indispensable in the sericulture industry, and “cocoon balls,” an event food made from rolling right flour, millet flour, and corn flour became popular.
6d4be7a1d93452af.zh: 群馬縣的養蠶業長久以來十分興盛，至今縣內仍致力於進一步發展此產業，例如使用原創蠶種製作「群馬絹」，以及基因改造蠶的實際應用等。因此，「繭」在養蠶業中受到高度重視且不可或缺，而以米粉、小米粉和玉米粉搓圓製成的節慶食物「まゆ玉」也隨之普及。

6d75565583e832de.en: Unryū-in (雲竜院) is a sub-temple of Sennyū-ji in Kyoto, Japan. Founded in 1372, it was rebuilt after destruction in the Ōnin War. The Hondō of 1646 (13.8m x 12.9m, irimoya-zukuri, shake roof) is an Important Cultural Property. The Hōjō or abbot's quarters also date from the Edo period. A Kamakura period copy of the Lotus sutra has been designated an Important Cultural Property.
6d75565583e832de.zh: 雲龍院是日本京都泉涌寺的塔頭寺院，創建於1372年，於應仁之亂中被毀後重建。1646年建造的本堂（13.8公尺×12.9公尺，入母屋造，杮葺屋頂）為重要文化財。方丈（住持居所）亦建於江戶時代。院內一部鎌倉時代的《法華經》抄本被指定為重要文化財。

6d756f5b019f75d7.en: When talking about the local cuisines of the Yamanashi Prefecture, hōtō (flat udon noodles and vegetables stewed in miso soup) is often brought up as an example. However, as the Yamanashi Prefecture is one surrounded by mountains, winters are extremely cold whilst summers get extremely hot and this has led to ozara being more preferred over hōtō in the summer seasons. Using cooled noodles thinner than hōtō, ozara is a dish where you enjoy these noodles by dipping them into a warm soy sauce based dipping sauce.
6d756f5b019f75d7.zh: 提到山梨縣的鄉土料理，常會舉出餺飥（扁寬的烏龍麵與蔬菜以味噌湯燉煮而成）為例。不過，山梨縣四面環山，冬季嚴寒、夏季酷熱，因此夏季時人們較偏好おざら而非餺飥。おざら使用比餺飥更細的冷麵條，沾溫熱的醬油基底沾醬食用。

6d7c8a4b4839b2d1.en: “Sawasawa" is a local dish made of Konjac(=yam cake). It is said that the name "Sawasawa" came from the accent of the texture of this dish, which has a lot of soup and is smooth and thirst-quenching.Konjac(=yam cake) became popular as an ingredient for the common people during the Edo period (1603-1867). It used to be eaten on special occasions such as New Year's Day and Buddhist memorial services. In the mountainous areas of Kagawa Prefecture, Konjac(=yam cake) potatoes have been planted around houses for a long time.
6d7c8a4b4839b2d1.zh: 「さわさわ」是以蒟蒻製作的鄉土料理。據說「さわさわ」這個名稱來自這道料理湯汁多、口感滑順又解渴的口感特色。蒟蒻在江戶時代（1603-1867）成為一般百姓普及的食材，過去會在元旦、佛事法會等特別的日子食用。在香川縣的山區，很早以前就在住家周圍種植蒟蒻芋。

6d7ce75e7d2de142.en: Ondo-no-seto (音戸の瀬戸) is a strait in Seto Inland Sea in Kure, Hiroshima between the main island of Japan and Kurahashi Island.
6d7ce75e7d2de142.zh: 音戸の瀬戸是位於廣島縣吳市瀨戶內海的海峽，介於日本本州與倉橋島之間。

6d7d31e045adafa2.en: The Iga region, surrounded by mountains, used to be an area where seafood was scarce. Therefore, tofu, made from processed beans, was a crucial source of nutrition. Tofu is believed to have originated in China and was introduced to Japan by Japanese envoys to the Tang Dynasty. During the Heian period, the aristocracy is said to have eaten tofu, which was referred to as "okabe" in a wives' tale. However, it wasn't until the Edo period that tofu became widely available to the general public.
6d7d31e045adafa2.zh: 四面環山的伊賀地區過去海產稀少，因此以豆類加工製成的豆腐是重要的營養來源。豆腐據信源自中國，由遣唐使傳入日本。據說平安時代貴族已食用豆腐，在某民間傳說中稱為「おかべ」。不過，豆腐要到江戶時代才普及至一般大眾。

6dacd1ee9c137148.en: Rurikei Prefectural Natural Park (府立るり渓自然公園, Furitsu Rurikei shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in central Kyōto Prefecture, Japan. The park flanks the Sonobe River (園部川) within the municipality of Nantan. Rurikei is a nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty.
6dacd1ee9c137148.zh: 府立るり渓自然公園是位於日本京都府中部的府立自然公園，沿著南丹市境內的園部川兩岸分布。るり渓為國家指定名勝。

6dbbc5846c14e5af.en: Kirihata-ji (切幡寺) is a Kōya-san Shingon temple in Awa, Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. Temple 10 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage, the main image is of Senjū Kannon. The temple is said to have been founded by Kōbō Daishi, who carved the image. The five-bay, two-storey Daitō of 1618 has been designated an Important Cultural Property.
6dbbc5846c14e5af.zh: 切幡寺是位於日本德島縣阿波的高野山真言宗寺院。為四國八十八所遍路第10番寺院，本尊為千手觀音。據傳由弘法大師創建，本尊亦為其所雕。1618年建造的五間二層大塔已被指定為重要文化財。

6dec06850fb29f18.en: Udon noodle has been eaten as an auspicious food to pray longevity since an ancient time because it is thick and long. "Toshiake Udon" is a custom to eat udon noodle with red/white ingredients after welcoming new year to be superstitious, and it’s a new effort by "Sanuki Udon Promotion Council" in Kagawa Prefecture to promote new noodle eating events. It is eaten with something red until January 15th. It is prepared with wishing happiness all the year."Sanuki Udon" is now famous nationally, but it has a long history.
6dec06850fb29f18.zh: 烏龍麵粗而長，自古被視為祈求長壽的吉祥食物。「年明けうどん」是迎接新年後，為討吉利而吃加了紅白配料烏龍麵的習俗，也是香川縣「讚岐烏龍麵振興協議會」推廣新吃麵活動的新嘗試。在1月15日前搭配紅色的食材食用，並在製作時祈願一整年幸福。「讚岐烏龍麵」如今聞名全國，但其歷史悠久。

6e20ad7f2e6e7b37.en: The Global Arena (グローバルアリーナ) is a sports venue in Munakata, Fukuoka, Kyūshū, Japan. The 10,000-capacity Sanix Global Arena Stadium is the main stadium at the Global Arena sports complex. It was set up by the President of the Sanix company Mr. Munemasa and includes various sports grounds for rugby union, soccer, tennis etc. Also there are indoor facilities for sports such as kendo, judo and tennis. The Global Arena is now a separate company from Sanix, though they are closely related.
6e20ad7f2e6e7b37.zh: グローバルアリーナ是位於日本九州福岡縣宗像市的運動場館。可容納10,000人的Sanix Global Arena體育場是グローバルアリーナ運動園區的主場館。園區由Sanix公司社長宗政先生設立，設有橄欖球、足球、網球等各種運動場地，另有劍道、柔道、網球等運動的室內設施。グローバルアリーナ現已是獨立於Sanix的公司，但兩者關係密切。

6e43b67d0bba7bff.en: “Tai no karamushi” is a classic Kaga dish made with red seabream stuffed with okara, vegetables and other ingredients. This traditional dish is symbolic of samurai culture. Two red seabreams are stuffed and steamed and served on a platter with their stomachs facing each other.It is often served at weddings and other celebrations.
6e43b67d0bba7bff.zh: 「鯛の唐蒸し」是一道經典的加賀料理，在真鯛中填入豆渣、蔬菜等配料製成。這道傳統料理象徵著武士文化。兩尾填好餡料的真鯛經蒸製後，腹部相對盛放在大盤上。常在婚禮等喜慶場合中供應。

6e71ed33079e082a.en: “Sauce-marinated” is a local dish in the Minami-Boso region of Chiba prefecture, in which whale meat is marinated in a sauce and dried. It has the appearance of tree bark, and is colored black like charcoal or seaweed.
6e71ed33079e082a.zh: 「くじらのたれ」是千葉縣南房總地區的鄉土料理，將鯨魚肉以醬汁醃漬後曬乾。外觀像樹皮，顏色如木炭或海苔般黑。

6e79dbd6d8a4d67d.en: Kanegasaki Shrine (金崎宮, Kanegasaki-gū) is a Shinto shrine located in the city of  Tsuruga, Fukui, Japan. In the former Modern system of ranked Shinto Shrines, it was an imperial shrine of the second rank (官幣中社, Kanpei-chūsha). Its main festival is held annually on May 6.
6e79dbd6d8a4d67d.zh: 金崎宮是位於日本福井縣敦賀市的神社。在舊近代社格制度中列為官幣中社。例祭每年於5月6日舉行。

6e802c0d85f315e5.en: Yokkaichi Municipal Museum (四日市市立博物館, Yokkaichi Shiritsu Hakubutsukan) opened in Yokkaichi, Mie Prefecture, Japan in 1993. The displays relate to the history of the area from geological times to the present and there is also a planetarium.
6e802c0d85f315e5.zh: 四日市市立博物館於1993年在日本三重縣四日市市開館。展示內容涵蓋當地從地質年代至今的歷史，館內另設有天文館。

6ea3c4e5d1aad437.en: The Dotō (土塔, earth stupa), is a Nara period Buddhist relic located in the Dotō neighborhood of Naka-ku, in the city of Sakai, Osaka, Japan. It is also referred to as the Ōno-ji Dotō (大野寺土塔) after the temple on whose grounds it is located. It was designated as a National Historic Site in 1953, with the area under protection expanded in 2005.
6ea3c4e5d1aad437.zh: 土塔（土造的佛塔）是位於日本大阪府堺市中區土塔町的奈良時代佛教遺跡。因位於大野寺境內，又稱大野寺土塔。1953年被指定為國家史跡，2005年擴大保護範圍。

6ebd25ecc67f8b27.en: Niimi City has a soil unsuitable for rice cultivation, and buckwheat has long been cultivated in the area. Kenchin-soba, which makes use of this buckwheat, is a hot soba noodle topped with kenchin soup, which is made by simmering vegetables such as tofu, radish, carrots, and gobou(=burdock) root in a soy sauce-based chicken broth.
6ebd25ecc67f8b27.zh: 新見市的土壤不適合種稻，當地自古便栽種蕎麥。運用這些蕎麥製作的けんちんそば，是在熱蕎麥麵上淋上けんちん湯；けんちん湯是將豆腐、白蘿蔔、紅蘿蔔、牛蒡等蔬菜以醬油基底的雞高湯燉煮而成。

6edf0629c29e8fe3.en: Jikō-in (慈光院) is a Buddhist temple located in the Koizumi-chō neighborhood of the city of Yamatokōriyama, Nara Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Daitokuji-branch of the Rinzai school of Japanese Zen and its honzon is a statue of Shaka Nyorai.  The sangō of the temple is Entsuzan (圓通山). The Jikō-in garden has been designated Place of Scenic Beauty and National Historic Site since 1934.
6edf0629c29e8fe3.zh: 慈光院是位於日本奈良縣大和郡山市小泉町的佛教寺院，屬於日本禪宗臨濟宗大德寺派，本尊為釋迦如來像。山號為圓通山。慈光院庭園自1934年起被指定為名勝及國史跡。

6f1ccdbf2eb9f2a6.en: The Orix Theater (Japanese: オリックス劇場, Hepburn: Orikkusu Gekijō), formerly the Osaka Kōsei Nenkin Kaikan (大阪厚生年金会館), is a 2,400-seat concert hall in Nishi-ku, Osaka, Japan. Artists that performed in the main hall include Black Sabbath, Kiss, Pink Floyd, Deep Purple, Whitesnake, Robin Trower, Rainbow, Queen, Santana, The Jackson 5, James Brown, UFO, Iron Maiden, Red Velvet, Amalia Rodrigues, NCT 127, and Jun. K.
6f1ccdbf2eb9f2a6.zh: オリックス劇場舊稱大阪厚生年金會館，是位於日本大阪市西區、設有2,400個座位的音樂廳。曾在主廳演出的藝人包括Black Sabbath、Kiss、Pink Floyd、Deep Purple、Whitesnake、Robin Trower、Rainbow、Queen、Santana、The Jackson 5、James Brown、UFO、Iron Maiden、Red Velvet、Amalia Rodrigues、NCT 127與Jun. K。

6f26c45b64a91d0c.en: Hyogo Prefecture boasts the second largest catch of octopus in Japan and the largest catch of common octopus in Japan. The Harimanada octopus, which is landed on Awaji Island and between Kobe and Ako, is at its peak from June to August. During this period, the octopus is tossed by the tidal currents of the Akashi Strait, and its flesh becomes more elastic as it stores nutrients in preparation for spawning, resulting in its characteristic texture and sweet taste.
6f26c45b64a91d0c.zh: 兵庫縣的章魚漁獲量居日本第二，其中真章魚的漁獲量為日本第一。在淡路島及神戶至赤穗一帶上岸的播磨灘章魚，產季盛期為6月至8月。這段期間，章魚受明石海峽潮流沖刷，加上為產卵儲存養分，肉質變得更有彈性，形成其特有的口感與甜味。

6f350474703f41b7.en: The Fukuichi Site (福市遺跡, Fukuichi iseki) is an archaeological site with the traces of a late-Yayoi period(3rd century) to mid-Kofun period (5th century) settlement located in the "Chojabaru Plateau" area of the city of Yonago, Tottori Prefecture, in the San'in region of Japan. It was designated a National Historic Site in 1970.
6f350474703f41b7.zh: 福市遺跡是一處考古遺址，有彌生時代後期（3世紀）至古墳時代中期（5世紀）的聚落遺跡，位於日本山陰地方鳥取縣米子市的「長者原台地」一帶。1970年被指定為國家史跡。

6f389297301a0eaa.en: Kumamoto Prefecture is one of the largest producers of lotus root in Japan. The Ugi region, where new rice paddies were developed during the Tenpou era of the Hosokawa clan, is still the main production area.Karashirenkon is known as a dish associated with the Hosokawa clan. In 1632, Tadatoshi, the first lord of the Hosokawa clan, was sickly and weak from day to day, and a monk at Rahanji Temple, who was concerned about his health, painstakingly searched for something nutritious.
6f389297301a0eaa.zh: 熊本縣是日本蓮藕的主要產地之一。細川家天保年間開發新田的宇城地區，至今仍是主要產地。からし蓮根是與細川家有淵源的料理。1632年，細川家第一代藩主忠利體弱多病，日漸衰弱，羅漢寺的一位僧人擔心他的健康，費盡心思尋找有營養的食物。

6f44423216c20362.en: Shimane Prefectural Manyō Park (島根県立万葉公園, Shimane Kenritsu Manyō Kōen) is a park in Masuda, Shimane Prefecture, Japan. The park takes its name from the Man'yōshū, drawing on the historic connections between Kakinomoto no Hitomaro and Iwami Province, and includes within it a botanical garden with 153 of the species of plant that are named in the anthology.
6f44423216c20362.zh: 島根縣立萬葉公園是位於日本島根縣益田市的公園。公園名稱取自《萬葉集》，源於柿本人麻呂與石見國的歷史淵源，園內設有植物園，種植153種該歌集中提及的植物。

6f4c04940dd68dfa.en: Houkisugi or Hōkisugi at Nakagawa (箒スギ) is a 2000-year-old Japanese cedar (Cryptomeria) at Nakagawa Settlement, Yamakita town, Ashigarakami District, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan.
6f4c04940dd68dfa.zh: 中川的箒スギ（箒スギ）是一棵樹齡2000年的日本柳杉，位於日本神奈川縣足柄上郡山北町中川聚落。

6f5500e2cd80eab5.en: Igamanju, which is said to have originated in Konosu City (formerly Kawasato-cho), is a local delicacy for special occasions that has been handed down from generation to generation in the breadbasket region of northeastern Saitama Prefecture. In the area where many farmers have grown wheat as a back crop, flour dishes such as udon and manju have developed so much that the phrase "udon for lunch in the morning with manju" was born.
6f5500e2cd80eab5.zh: いがまんじゅう據說起源於鴻巢市（舊川里町），是在埼玉縣東北部穀倉地帶代代相傳、於特殊場合食用的鄉土美食。在許多農家以小麥作為裡作的地區，烏龍麵、饅頭等麵粉料理十分發達，甚至產生了「早上烏龍麵配午餐饅頭」這樣的說法。

6f5db17b6f6aa41d.en: Chōjagahara temple ruins (長者ヶ原廃寺跡, Chōjagahara Haiji) is an archaeological site with the ruins of a late Heian period Buddhist temple located in what is now the city of Ōshū, in northern Japan. The site was protected by the central government as a National Historic Site in the year 2002.
6f5db17b6f6aa41d.zh: 長者ヶ原廃寺跡是位於日本北部、今奧州市境內的考古遺址，保存有平安時代後期佛寺的遺跡。遺址於2002年由中央政府指定為國家史跡加以保護。

6fc132e3205c083f.en: Nagano Prefectural Art Museum (長野県立美術館, Nagano Kenritsu Bijutsukan) is a museum in Nagano, Nagano Prefecture, Japan.  It is one of Japan's many museums which are supported by a prefecture.
6fc132e3205c083f.zh: 長野県立美術館是位於日本長野縣長野市的美術館，為日本眾多由縣政府支持營運的美術館之一。

6ff87b140075b225.en: Dried bamboo shoots are enjoyed throughout the Kyushu region, but they are particularly popular in Kumamoto prefecture. In Kumamoto, there are numerous bamboo groves in satoyama (traditional rural landscape). Traditionally, people have harvested bamboo shoots abundantly in spring, dried and preserved them as a staple food. While the bamboo shoots are still fresh, cut them lengthwise and remove the inner knots, then boil them, and dry them slowly in the sun.
6ff87b140075b225.zh: 竹筍乾在九州各地都有人食用，其中在熊本縣特別受歡迎。熊本的里山（傳統農村景觀）中有許多竹林。人們自古就在春天大量採收竹筍，曬乾保存作為主食。做法是趁竹筍還新鮮時縱切，去除內側的節，接著水煮，再放在陽光下慢慢曬乾。

7035bb3ffbe27ea8.en: The Shōda temple ruins (賞田廃寺跡, Shōda Haiji ato) is an archaeological site with the ruins of a Hakuho period Buddhist temple located in the Shōda neighbourhood of what is now Naka-ku in the city of Okayama, in the San'yō region of Japan. The temple no longer exists, but the temple grounds were designated as a National Historic Site in 1972.
7035bb3ffbe27ea8.zh: 賞田廃寺跡是位於日本山陽地方，今岡山市中區賞田地區的考古遺址，留有白鳳時代佛寺的遺跡。寺院今已不存，寺域於1972年被指定為國家史跡。

703814372e6dc138.en: "Ganzuki", so named because of its resemblance to "Gan (goose in Japanese) meat", is a familiar snack for Miyagi residents. It is a simple steamed bread made with only wheat flour, baking soda, brown sugar and water. It is characterized by its fluffy yet firm texture, and is a simple local confectionery with a handmade feel. Not only as a casual everyday snack or light meal, they were also eaten to satisfy hunger between farm works. Also, It was also often eaten as a snack by children.
703814372e6dc138.zh: 「がんづき」因外觀像「雁（日文中的鵝）肉」而得名，是宮城縣民熟悉的點心。這是只用麵粉、小蘇打、黑糖和水做成的簡單蒸糕，特色是鬆軟又有嚼勁的口感，是帶有手作感的樸素鄉土點心。不只是日常的輕鬆點心或簡餐，過去也在農務空檔吃來充飢，也常是孩子們的點心。

70405aeb173d13b3.en: Nagasakibana (長崎鼻, Nagasakibana), also known as Cape Nagasakibana (長崎鼻岬, Nagasakibana Misaki) or Cape Ryūgū, is the most southern headland on the Satsuma Peninsula at the entrance to Kagoshima Bay. The cape has a lighthouse, is the location of a statue of Urashima Tarō, the fisherman in a Japanese fairy tale, and the Ryūgū Shrine.
70405aeb173d13b3.zh: 長崎鼻（長崎鼻），又稱長崎鼻岬（長崎鼻岬）或龍宮岬，是薩摩半島最南端的岬角，位於鹿兒島灣入口。岬上有燈塔，並設有日本童話中的漁夫浦島太郎的雕像，以及龍宮神社。

70517914f3f063d0.en: Seibu-en (西武園ゆうえんち, Seibuen Yuenchi) is an amusement park located near Tokyo in Tokorozawa, Saitama Prefecture. It is just outside the Seibuen-yūenchi Station, which is also owned and operated by the Seibu Railway. The park underwent a significant expansion and redesign for the 2021 season, focused around a Showa era themed marketplace, a Godzilla motion simulator attraction, and a children's area based on the work of Osamu Tezuka. An Ultraman attraction opened for the 2023 season, which shared the Yuhikan Theater with the Godzilla attraction.
70517914f3f063d0.zh: 西武園ゆうえんち是位於東京近郊埼玉縣所澤市的遊樂園，緊鄰同樣由西武鐵道擁有並經營的西武園ゆうえんち站。園區於2021年度進行大規模擴建與重新設計，重點包括以昭和時代為主題的商店街、哥吉拉動感模擬遊樂設施，以及以手塚治蟲作品為主題的兒童區。2023年度另開設超人力霸王遊樂設施，與哥吉拉設施共用夕日館劇場。

7058ec024ed2aa84.en: “Aburazomen” is a local dish of stir-fried pork, vegetables, and somen noodles. It is similar to “Okinawa’s somen chanpuru”, but “the Amami region's aburasomen” is characterized by the addition of dashi stock when stir-frying. The somen is integrated into the stir-frying oil and soup stock as they emulsify, so this dish goes down very smoothly.There are various theories as to why somen took root in the Amami region, which does not grow wheat or produce somen noodles.
7058ec024ed2aa84.zh: 「油ゾーメン」是將豬肉、蔬菜和素麵一起拌炒的鄉土料理。與沖繩的素麵チャンプルー相似，但奄美地區的油ゾーメン特色是在拌炒時加入高湯。炒油與高湯乳化後與素麵融為一體，因此十分順口。奄美地區不種小麥、也不生產素麵，素麵為何在此扎根，有各種說法。

706ab44c86f8821e.en: Around the death anniversary of Shinran, the founder of Jodo Shinshu Buddhism (January 16th), every branch of Jodo Shinshu holds the biggest event called "Hoonko" from autumn to the New Year, and the event is called "honko-san" or "okosama" in Fukui Prefecture. This event is to commemorate the founder Shinran and to appreciate his doctrine and virtue. "Otsubo" is one of "shojin ryori" (vegan cuisine for Buddhist monks) to be served to people joining the event, and served with "ozen" (four-legged small tray to serve meals) at "Hoonko".
706ab44c86f8821e.zh: 在淨土真宗開祖親鸞的忌日（1月16日）前後，從秋季到新年期間，淨土真宗各派都會舉辦年度最大的活動「報恩講」，在福井縣稱為「ほんこさん」或「お講様」。此活動旨在紀念開祖親鸞，並感念其教義與德行。「おつぼ」是供應給參加者的精進料理（僧侶的素食料理）之一，在「報恩講」時以「御膳」（盛裝餐點的四腳小膳台）供應。

7088ebb247969816.en: Ota Stadium (太田市運動公園陸上競技場) is an athletic stadium in Ota, Gunma, Japan. The stadium has a capacity of 3,223 people. It was used as the baseball and softball training venue for the Tokyo Olympics.
7088ebb247969816.zh: 太田市運動公園陸上競技場是位於日本群馬縣太田市的田徑場，可容納3,223人，曾作為東京奧運棒球與壘球項目的練習場地。

70993f5a812968df.en: In Gunma, there is a custom of eating "Kenchin Jiru" during such events as "Ebisu-ko in autumn", "New Year's Ebisu-ko (Spring Ebisu-ko)", and "Setsubun (the first day of spring)". A local dish similar to "Kenchin Jiru" and handed down in Takasaki City is "Zakuni".Like "Kenchin Jiru", it is generally eaten on celebratory occasions, but it is especially unique in that it is made on special occasions by chopping the ingredients into small pieces.
70993f5a812968df.zh: 群馬有在「秋季惠比壽講」、「新年惠比壽講（春季惠比壽講）」、「節分（立春前一天）」等節日吃「けんちん汁」的習俗。在高崎市流傳下來、與「けんちん汁」相似的鄉土料理就是「ざく煮」。與「けんちん汁」一樣，一般在喜慶場合食用，但特別之處在於，特殊場合時會把食材切成小塊來製作。

70ae502575fc14c6.en: The variety of Squid dishes varies depending on the season, but Squid is available year-round in Toyama, so there is a rich variety of Squid dishes.” Ika-Satoimo-Nimono” is a well-known home-style dish that offers the plump texture of Squid, the sticky softness of Satoimo(=Japanese taro), and the rich taste.One of the most commonly used Squid is” Surume-ika”, the top catch in Toyama Bay.
70ae502575fc14c6.zh: 魷魚料理的種類隨季節而不同，但富山全年都能取得魷魚，因此魷魚料理種類豐富。「いかと里芋の煮もの」是知名的家常菜，可品嚐魷魚的飽滿口感、里芋（日本芋頭）的黏軟，以及濃郁的滋味。最常使用的魷魚之一是富山灣漁獲量最多的「スルメイカ」。

70b24af45fd25cb9.en: Kōden-ji (高傳寺) is a Sōtō Zen temple in Saga, Saga Prefecture, Japan. It was the bodaiji or family temple of the Ryūzōji and Nabeshima clans, many of whom are buried in its grounds.
70b24af45fd25cb9.zh: 高傳寺是位於日本佐賀縣佐賀市的曹洞宗禪寺，為龍造寺氏與鍋島氏的菩提寺（家族寺院），兩氏許多成員葬於寺內。

70b88077f4d47d57.en: The Ōbaniwatorizuka (大庭鶏塚古墳)  is a Kofun period burial mound, located on the border of the Ōba-chō neighborhood of the city of Matsue, Shimane in the San'in region of Japan. The tumulus was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1924.
70b88077f4d47d57.zh: 大庭鶏塚古墳是古墳時代的墳丘，位於日本山陰地方島根縣松江市大庭町的交界處。1924年被指定為日本國家史跡。

70ca3e908f08b884.en: The Tsuruga Municipal Museum is a history and folklore museum located in Tsuruga-city, Fukui Prefecture Japan. It uses the former main branch of the Owada Bank (a nationally designated Important Cultural Property), which was completed in 1927 (Shōwa era 2), as its museum facility.
70ca3e908f08b884.zh: 敦賀市立博物館是位於日本福井縣敦賀市的歷史民俗博物館。館舍使用1927年（昭和2年）落成的舊大和田銀行本店（國家指定重要文化財）。

70e564ef8a0ca35f.en: Rokkosan Pasture (神戸市立六甲山牧場, Kōbe Shiritsu Rokkōsan Bokujō) is a public pasture farm situated in Mount Rokkō, Kobe, Japan.
70e564ef8a0ca35f.zh: 神戸市立六甲山牧場是位於日本神戶六甲山的公營牧場。

7104c03f4208af7d.en: When the hot summer is over and there are signs of autumn approaching, the season for chate arrives. Chaate is a plant of the Cucurbitaceae family that is native to tropical America. It was introduced to Kagoshima Prefecture from overseas in 1907, so it is commonly called “hayatouri.” It is a vine, and one of its characteristics is that it bears many fruits on its vines. It is also called “sennari” because a single plant produces 100 to 200 fruits.
7104c03f4208af7d.zh: 炎熱的夏天結束、秋意漸濃時，便到了佛手瓜的季節。佛手瓜是原產於熱帶美洲的葫蘆科植物。1907年從海外傳入鹿兒島縣，因此一般稱為「隼人瓜」。它是藤蔓植物，特徵之一是藤蔓上結實累累。一株可結100到200個果實，因此也稱為「千成」。

713a4be4cd984f97.en: "Suttate-jiru" is a soup made by grinding boiled soybeans in a mortar and pestle with miso or soy sauce, and is a popular local dish at festive occasions such as celebrations and "Houonko" ceremonies in Shirakawa Village, a World Heritage site famous for its "Gassho Zukuri" style architecture. Also known as "Suritate-jiru," it is also sometimes called "Dobu-jiru" because of its resemblance to Doburoku.
713a4be4cd984f97.zh: 「すったて汁」是將煮過的大豆加上味噌或醬油，用研缽和研杵磨碎製成的湯，是以「合掌造」建築聞名的世界遺產白川村，在喜慶和「報恩講」等節慶場合常見的鄉土料理。又稱「すりたて汁」，因為外觀類似濁酒，有時也被稱為「どぶ汁」。

716705d905734b7a.en: Obi (飫肥) is a district located in Nichinan, in the southern part of Miyazaki Prefecture, in the Kyushu region of Japan.  During the Edo period, it was the Jōkamachi (castle town) of Obi Castle, which was the seat of the Obi Domain, which was ruled by the Ito clan. The district was originally planned and laid out in the early Edo period, and the historical townscape has been preserved to this day.
716705d905734b7a.zh: 飫肥是位於日本九州地區宮崎縣南部日南市的地區。江戶時代為飫肥城的城下町，飫肥城是伊東氏統治的飫肥藩藩廳所在。此地區於江戶時代初期規劃建設，歷史街景保存至今。

7198182654e224f5.en: Kyoto Concert Hall (京都コンサートホール, Kyōto Konsāto Hōlu) is a concert hall in Sakyō-ku, Kyoto, Japan. It opened in 1995 as part of the 1200th anniversary celebrations of the foundation of Heian-kyō. The shoebox-style Main Hall seats 1833 and the Ensemble Hall Murata 500. It is the home of the Kyoto Symphony Orchestra (京都市交響楽団). Arata Isozaki was the architect, with acoustical design by Nagata Acoustics.
7198182654e224f5.zh: 京都コンサートホール（京都音樂廳）是位於日本京都市左京區的音樂廳，1995年為紀念平安京建都1200年而啟用。鞋盒式的主廳設有1833個座位，Ensemble Hall Murata則有500個座位。這裡是京都市交響樂團的駐地。建築師為磯崎新，音響設計由永田音響負責。

71afd662a78d7afd.en: Ibaraki Prefecture has been an "agricultural prefecture" since ancient times, taking advantage of its mild climate and rich water quality throughout the year to produce a variety of vegetables. At the same time, it is a “fishing prefecture” as the offshore area is a rich fishing ground where the Oyashio and Kuroshio currents intersect, and a variety of seafood is landed each season. “Garigari Namasu”, a local dish made in Ibaraki Prefecture, which is blessed with rich food materials, is made with the seasonal produce of the mountains and sea.
71afd662a78d7afd.zh: 茨城縣利用全年溫和的氣候與豐沛優良的水質，自古即是生產多種蔬菜的「農業縣」。同時，近海是親潮與黑潮交會的豐富漁場，每季都有多種海產上岸，也是「漁業縣」。食材豐富的茨城縣所做的在地料理「がりがりなます」，是以山與海的當季食材製成。

71bd6f315f7d8bed.en: Sumiyoshi Shrine (住吉神社, Sumiyoshi Jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Otaru, Hokkaido. Its annual festival is on July 15. The kami Kamitsusu no O no Ōkami (上筒之男大神), Nakatsutsu no O no Ōkami (中筒之男大神), Sokotsutsu no O no Ōkami (底筒之男大神), Okinagaranushihime no Ōkami (息長足姫大神), Onamochi no Ōkami (大名持大神), Sukunabikona no Ōkami (少彦名大神) and others are enshrined here.
71bd6f315f7d8bed.zh: 住吉神社是位於北海道小樽的神道神社，例祭於7月15日舉行。社內供奉上筒之男大神、中筒之男大神、底筒之男大神、息長足姬大神、大名持大神、少彥名大神等神祇。

71ece74a7c282d36.en: Chōhō-ji (Japanese: 長保寺) is a Buddhist temple in the city of Kainan, Wakayama Prefecture, Japan.  It belongs to the Tendai school of Japanese Buddhism. Its main image is a statue of Shaka Nyorai. Its main hall, pagoda and daimon are National Treasures of Japan, and its daimyō cemetery is a National Historic Site.
71ece74a7c282d36.zh: 長保寺是位於日本和歌山縣海南市的佛寺，屬日本佛教天台宗，本尊為釋迦如來像。其本堂、塔及大門為日本國寶，大名墓所則為國家史跡。

71ef92bab81ee65b.en: The Akiba Dam (秋葉ダム, Akiba damu) is a dam on the Tenryū River, located in Tenryū-ku, Hamamatsu, Shizuoka Prefecture on the island of Honshū, Japan.
71ef92bab81ee65b.zh: 秋葉ダム是位於日本本州靜岡縣濱松市天龍區、天龍川上的水壩。

72044158b7babaa3.en: Dried octopuses, hung with their legs spread out and swaying in the sea breeze, are a slightly humorous summer tradition in Ariake Town, Amakusa City.During the summertime up until September in Ariake, Amakusa, octopus are left out to dry in the salty breeze on sunny days for three to four days. The dried octopus is always soaked in water and softened before being eaten not eaten as it is, as is the case with the surume. Octopuses are caught using traditional methods, whereby octopus pots are submerged into the sea.
72044158b7babaa3.zh: 將章魚的腳張開吊掛，在海風中搖曳晒乾，是天草市有明町略帶幽默感的夏季傳統景象。在天草有明，夏季至9月為止，會在晴天將章魚放在帶鹹味的海風中晒三到四天。晒乾的章魚不像魷魚乾那樣直接吃，一定會先泡水泡軟後再食用。章魚以傳統方法捕捉，也就是將章魚壺沉入海中。

721735b262de416d.en: Sogi Park (Japanese: 曽木公園, Hepburn: Sogi kōen) is a park located in Toki, Gifu Prefecture, Japan.
721735b262de416d.zh: 曽木公園是位於日本岐阜縣土岐市的公園。

7228bffbffd79cfb.en: Miso soup made with genge, a long and slender deep-sea fish about 20 cm long that is white and transparent and has its entire body covered with thick gelatinous material, is a dish that was eaten only in the homes of fishing villages. Firefly squid, white shrimp, yellowtail, and crabs are well-known as representative fish of Toyama, but in recent years, this genge has been attracting attention. Until about 30 years ago, it was considered a lowly fish because of its grotesque appearance.
7228bffbffd79cfb.zh: げんげ是一種長約20公分、細長的深海魚，身體白色透明，全身覆蓋厚厚的膠狀物質。以げんげ煮的味噌湯，過去只在漁村家庭食用。螢烏賊、白蝦、鰤魚和螃蟹是知名的富山代表魚種，但近年げんげ也受到矚目。直到約30年前，牠因外表怪異而被視為低等的魚。

723e69169f534405.en: Taisho-roman Street, meaning Taisho Romance Street, is a local shopping street in Kawagoe City, Saitama Prefecture, Japan.
723e69169f534405.zh: 大正浪漫夢通り（意為「大正浪漫街」）是日本埼玉縣川越市的一條在地商店街。

724b9afdc6f20875.en: Kanpyo is a crucial ingredient for sushi rolls; it is simmered with sugar and soy sauce then rolled with rice alone or with omelette egg and cucumber. Kanpyo is a local specialty in Tochigi prefecture, which boasts more than 90% of its market. (researched by Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fishery in 2018) Kanpyo is made from ‘yugao’(moonflower) fruit cut into strip and dried.
724b9afdc6f20875.zh: 干瓢是壽司捲的重要食材，以砂糖和醬油燉煮後，單獨或搭配煎蛋與小黃瓜和醋飯一起捲起。干瓢是栃木縣的特產，市占率超過90%（農林水產省2018年調查）。干瓢是將葫蘆（夕顏）的果實切成條狀後乾燥製成。

7259311ff744c9f3.en: Ina Castle (伊奈城, Inajō) is a castle located in the Kozakai area of Toyokawa city in Aichi Prefecture, Japan.
7259311ff744c9f3.zh: 伊奈城是位於日本愛知縣豐川市小坂井地區的城郭。

726d9293b5632311.en: Kabushima Shrine (蕪島 神社, Kabushima Jinja), located in Hachinohe, Aomori, is a Shinto shrine in Japan. It was first built in 1269 on top of the Kabushima island by fishermen to pray for safety and good harvest at sea.  The shrine has been rebuilt several times throughout its history. It was burnt down in November 2015 and rebuilt in 2020.
726d9293b5632311.zh: 蕪嶋神社是位於日本青森縣八戶市的神社。1269年由漁民在蕪島上首次建立，用以祈求海上平安與漁獲豐收。神社歷史上曾多次重建，2015年11月遭焚毀，2020年重建完成。

728d2610a0b41602.en: Iimori Mountain (飯盛山, Iimori Yama) is a mountain near the city of Aizuwakamatsu, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. It is notable as the site where members of the Byakkotai (White Tiger Corps) committed ritual suicide in 1868, during the Boshin War. It is located about 1.5 kilometers northeast of Tsuruga Castle.
728d2610a0b41602.zh: 飯盛山是位於日本福島縣會津若松市附近的山。1868年戊辰戰爭期間，白虎隊隊員在此自刃，此地因而聞名。位於鶴ヶ城東北方約1.5公里處。

72901c8bc7e279a8.en: The Shimane Museum of Ancient Izumo (島根県立古代出雲歴史博物館, Shimane kenritsu kodai Izumo rekishi hakubutsukan) opened in Izumo, Shimane Prefecture, Japan in 2007.
72901c8bc7e279a8.zh: 島根県立古代出雲歴史博物館於2007年在日本島根縣出雲市開館。

72ae570c4b0cf56a.en: "Naabehraa" is a Japanese word for "Hechima(=Sponge cucumber)", and "nbusi" is a dish of tofu, vegetables, and pork simmered in miso paste, somewhere between a stew and a soup. The "Hechima", is the second most representative summer vegetable after the bitter gourd, and "Haebaru-cho" in the center of the main island is one of Japan's leading production centers.
72ae570c4b0cf56a.zh: 「ナーベーラー」是指絲瓜，「ンブシー」是將豆腐、蔬菜和豬肉以味噌燉煮的料理，介於燉菜與湯之間。絲瓜是僅次於苦瓜、第二具代表性的夏季蔬菜，位於本島中部的南風原町是日本主要產地之一。

72b2594253da23fc.en: Somin Tasiya" is an Okinawan home-style dish of stir-fried somen noodles. There are two types of stir-fried dishes in Okinawa, "tashiya" and "chanpuru," but "chanpuru" refers to stir-fried tofu, so "somen chanpuru" used to mean "stir-fried somen" is a misnomer. Soumin-tasiya is a simple dish made with vegetables, tuna, and other ingredients, and somen noodles with salt and soy sauce, making it a typical home-style dish and a popular snack with sake.
72b2594253da23fc.zh: ソーミンタシヤーは是沖繩炒素麵的家常料理。沖繩的熱炒料理有「タシヤー」與「チャンプルー」兩種，但「チャンプルー」指的是炒豆腐，因此用「素麵チャンプルー」來指「炒素麵」其實是誤稱。ソーミンタシヤー是用蔬菜、鮪魚等食材與素麵，以鹽和醬油調味的簡單料理，是典型的家常菜，也是受歡迎的下酒菜。

72b543c0c1845d22.en: Dochū-Kōtsu Prefectural Natural Park (土柱高越県立自然公園, Dochū-Kōtsu kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in northern Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. Established in 2005, the park encompasses a stretch of the Yoshino River, Mount Kōtsu (高越山), the temple of Kōtsu-ji (高越寺) and the earth pillars of Awa-no-Dochū (阿波の土柱).
72b543c0c1845d22.zh: 土柱高越縣立自然公園（土柱高越県立自然公園）是位於日本德島縣北部的縣立自然公園。設立於2005年，範圍包括吉野川的一段、高越山、高越寺及阿波土柱（阿波の土柱）。

72b961364896dba8.en: The  Asuka Mizuochi Site (飛鳥水落遺跡, Asuka Mizuochi iseki) was a water clock located in Asuka in the Kansai region of Japan during the Asuka period. Its ruins were designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1976 with the area under protection expanded in 1982.
72b961364896dba8.zh: 飛鳥水落遺跡是日本關西地區飛鳥地方於飛鳥時代設置的水鐘。其遺跡於1976年被指定為日本國家史跡，保護範圍於1982年擴大。

72ba1e0095aeddda.en: Midagahara   (弥陀ヶ原, Midaga-hara) is a wetlands located near Tateyama in Toyama Prefecture, in Japan. the remaining 80,000 ha of wetlands have been designated a Ramsar Site in 2012.
72ba1e0095aeddda.zh: 彌陀原是位於日本富山縣立山附近的濕地。現存的8萬公頃濕地於2012年被登錄為拉姆薩濕地。

72bc3f0c21807ae4.en: "Konnyaku no Shiraae" is a dish that uses konjac, dressed with a batter made of "tofu" and mashed sesame seeds. One of the characteristics of this dish, made in Gunma, is the use of konjac potato, which is a specialty of the region. Since the Muromachi period, which was between 1333 to 1573, research has been conducted to increase its cultivation. The cultivation of konjac potato is especially popular in Shimonita Town, which is famous for its "Shimonita negi" (green onion).
72bc3f0c21807ae4.zh: 「こんにゃくの白和え」是用「豆腐」與磨碎的芝麻調成的醬料拌蒟蒻的料理。群馬製作的這道料理，特色之一是使用當地特產蒟蒻芋。自室町時代（1333年至1573年）起，便有人研究如何擴大蒟蒻芋的栽培。蒟蒻芋的栽培在以「下仁田蔥」聞名的下仁田町特別盛行。

72bddcb00a6c8e68.en: The Agatsuma region grows a variety of agricultural and livestock products, including vegetables, Konjac(=yam cake) potatoes, and fruits. Among them, runner beans, also called "flower beans", are grown in the highlands of Nakanojo Town, Tsumakoi Village, Kusatsu Town, and Naganohara Town, and are a specialty of the Agatsuma region.
72bddcb00a6c8e68.zh: 吾妻地區生產蔬菜、蒟蒻芋、水果等多種農畜產品。其中又稱為「花豆」的紅花菜豆，栽種於中之條町、嬬戀村、草津町、長野原町的高原地帶，是吾妻地區的特產。

72d430a502a63c45.en: Handa Somen" produced in Handa district of Tsurugi-cho has a long history. There are various theories as to how Handa Somen began to be produced, but it is said that in the middle of the Edo period, boatmen brought Somen to Handa via Miwa-machi, Isogi-gun, Nara, Awaji, Naruto, etc. At first, the boatmen's families produced Somen for their own consumption.
72d430a502a63c45.zh: つるぎ町半田地區生產的「半田そうめん」歷史悠久。關於半田開始生產素麵的經過有多種說法，一說是江戶時代中期，船夫經由奈良磯城郡三輪町、淡路、鳴門等地將素麵帶到半田。起初是船夫的家人製作素麵供自家食用。

72f3a9e46fd5eaa8.en: Sugiyama Castle (杉山城, Sugiyama-jō), also known as Makino Castle,  was a Sengoku period Japanese castle located in what is now part of  the town of Ranzan, Hiki District, Saitama, in the Kantō region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site, since 2008.
72f3a9e46fd5eaa8.zh: 杉山城又稱牧野城，是戰國時代的日本城郭，位於今日本關東地方埼玉縣比企郡嵐山町境內。城址自2008年起受指定為國家史跡並受到保護。

72f72027b83a09b4.en: Kazusa Kokubun-ji (上総国分寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the city of Ichihara, Chiba, Japan. It belongs to the Shingon-shu Buzan-ha sect, and its honzon is a statue of Yakushi Nyōrai.  It is the  provincial temple ("kokubunji") of former Kazusa Province. The present temple is of uncertain foundation, but claims to be the direct descendant of the original Nara period kokubunji temple which fell into ruins sometime in the Muromachi period.
72f72027b83a09b4.zh: 上總國分寺（上総国分寺）是位於日本千葉縣市原市的佛寺，屬真言宗豐山派，本尊為藥師如來像。這是舊上總國的國分寺。現今寺院的創建年代不明，但寺方自稱為奈良時代原國分寺的直系傳承，原寺於室町時代某時荒廢。

730146f6d0a29825.en: "Sake zushi" was first said to be made during the Edo period when the Shimazu clan ruled the Satsuma Domain. It is said that the dish was made with leftover food and sake after cherry blossom viewing parties. A feudal lord of the clan put the leftovers in a sushi bucket and the following day, the ingredients were fermented and smelled delicious. The dish is similar to "oshizushi" (=pressed sushi) and is made with seasonal ingredients from the sea or mountains.
730146f6d0a29825.zh: 「酒ずし」據說最早是在島津氏統治薩摩藩的江戶時代製作。據說這道料理是用賞花宴後剩下的食物和酒做成的。藩中一位領主將剩菜放進壽司桶，隔天食材發酵，散發出美味的香氣。這道料理類似「押壽司」，使用當季的海產或山產製作。

7306ff39a90aaa00.en: Naeba Ski Resort (苗場スキー場, Naeba Sukī-jō) is a ski resort on the eastern slope of Mount Takenoko (筍山) in Yuzawa (湯沢町), Niigata Prefecture.
7306ff39a90aaa00.zh: 苗場スキー場是位於新潟縣湯沢町筍山東側山坡的滑雪場。

731b60f741872cdc.en: Ikuchijima (生口島) is one of the Geiyo Islands in the Seto Inland Sea, belonging to Hiroshima Prefecture in Japan. Ikuchijima is administered as part of Onomichi city. There are bridges connecting Ikuchijima to the mainland (Honshū) via Innoshima and to Shikoku via Ōmishima Island. The highest peak of this 31.21 km2 island is Mount Kanno at 472.3 m (1,550 ft).
731b60f741872cdc.zh: 生口島是瀨戶內海藝予諸島之一，屬日本廣島縣，由尾道市管轄。島上有橋梁經因島連接本州，並經大三島連接四國。這座面積31.21平方公里的島嶼，最高峰為海拔472.3公尺（1,550英尺）的觀音山。

736cc00c5bdbeb0e.en: Sardines have been eaten since the Heian period and are a familiar fish to the Japanese. The word "yowashi" was changed from "yowashi" to "iwashi" because sardines become weak as soon as they are brought ashore. The Kujukuri-hama beach in Chiba boasts the largest catch of sardines in Japan. Sardine fishing in this region has been active since the Edo period. It is said to have spread rapidly after fishermen from Kishu, Wakayama Prefecture, immigrated to the area and began seine fishing.
736cc00c5bdbeb0e.zh: 沙丁魚自平安時代起就被食用，是日本人熟悉的魚。由於沙丁魚一上岸就很快變得虛弱，因此名稱從「よわし」變成「いわし」。千葉的九十九里濱擁有日本最大的沙丁魚漁獲量。此地區的沙丁魚漁業自江戶時代起就很興盛，據說是在和歌山縣紀州的漁夫移居此地並開始圍網捕魚後迅速普及。

738430b6b10351e3.en: Mount Izumi Katsuragi (和泉葛城山, Izumi Katsuragi-san) is a mountain in the Kongō Range straddling the border between Osaka and Wakayama Prefectures in Japan. Its peak elevation is 858 metres (2,815 ft).
738430b6b10351e3.zh: 和泉葛城山是位於日本金剛山地的一座山，橫跨大阪府與和歌山縣交界。山頂海拔858公尺（2,815英尺）。

73a041f59d6cb11a.en: Kumano Shrine (熊野神社, Kumano-jinja) is  a historic Shinto shrine in the Miyauchi neighborhood of the city of Nan'yō, Yamagata, in the Tohoku region of northern Japan. It is commonly referred to as the "Kumano Taisha", although the shrine does not officially have a "Taisha" designation. The shrine is one of the three main centers of the Kumano cult within Shinto.
73a041f59d6cb11a.zh: 熊野神社（Kumano-jinja）是位於日本北部東北地方、山形縣南陽市宮內地區的歷史悠久神社。一般通稱「熊野大社」，但此神社在正式名義上並無「大社」稱號。此神社是神道中熊野信仰的三大中心之一。

73a5e23f8399d229.en: Nishime is a traditional dish prepared throughout the entire prefecture during weddings, funerals, New Year's, O-Bon (Festival of the Dead), and other gatherings. The main ingredients include tofu (grilled to prevent it from falling apart during cooking), carrots, konjac, butterbur, shiitake mushrooms, and wild vegetables such as Zenmai (Japanese royal fern) and bracken, often with dried and sliced herring added.
73a5e23f8399d229.zh: 煮しめ是全縣各地在婚禮、葬禮、新年、盂蘭盆節（祭祀祖靈的節日）及其他聚會時製作的傳統料理。主要材料包括豆腐（經過烤製以免烹煮時散開）、紅蘿蔔、蒟蒻、蜂斗菜、香菇，以及紫萁、蕨菜等山菜，也常加入切片的乾鯡魚。

73d325555bd94ecb.en: Moerenuma Park (モエレ沼公園, Moerenuma Kōen) is a municipal park in Sapporo, Japan. It has playground equipment, outdoor sports fields, and objects that are designed by Isamu Noguchi, a Japanese American artist. Construction began in 1988; the park opened in 2005. It won the Good Design Award in 2002.
73d325555bd94ecb.zh: モエレ沼公園是位於日本札幌的市立公園，設有遊樂器材、戶外運動場，以及由日裔美籍藝術家野口勇（Isamu Noguchi）設計的作品。公園於1988年動工，2005年開園，2002年獲得優良設計獎（Good Design Award）。

73f89070ba0c0271.en: Hidaka City is a renowned chestnut producing area in Saitama Prefecture that cultivates a variety of brand-name chestnuts, such as “Koraigawa Marron” weighing over 30 grams, and “Hidaka Poron” known for its easily peeled off, astringent skin. During autumn, many people flock to Hidaka City's direct sales centers to purchase chestnuts and their processed products. Customers can choose from various chestnut varieties and buy the ones that best suit their dish.
73f89070ba0c0271.zh: 日高市是埼玉縣知名的栗子產地，栽培多種品牌栗子，例如重量超過30公克的「高麗川マロン」，以及以澀皮容易剝除聞名的「日高ぽろん」。每到秋天，許多人湧向日高市的直售所購買栗子及其加工品。顧客可以從各種栗子品種中，挑選最適合自己料理的品種購買。

73fe7fad6d30ea5a.en: Ueno German Culture Village (うえのドイツ文化村, Ueno Doitsu Bunka Mura; German: Deutsches Kulturdorf Ueno) is a theme park in Miyakojima, Okinawa. It is located in Ueno district.
73fe7fad6d30ea5a.zh: うえのドイツ文化村（德語：Deutsches Kulturdorf Ueno）是位於沖繩宮古島的主題樂園，位於上野地區。

740ffc9efc20d459.en: Warner Bros. Studio Tour Tokyo – The Making of Harry Potter (ワーナー ブラザース スタジオツアー東京 ‐ メイキング・オブ・ハリー・ポッター, Wānā Burazāsu Sutajio Tsuā Tōkyō – Meikingu Obu Harī Pottā) is a walk-through exhibition tour in Tokyo, Japan, owned by Warner Bros. and operated by their Studio Tour division. It is located in Nerima, in northwest of Tokyo, and houses a permanent exhibition of authentic costumes, props, and sets utilised in the production of the Harry Potter films, as well as behind-the-scenes production of visual effects.
740ffc9efc20d459.zh: ワーナー ブラザース スタジオツアー東京 - メイキング・オブ ハリー・ポッター（ワーナー ブラザース スタジオツアー東京 ‐ メイキング・オブ・ハリー・ポッター）是位於日本東京的步行參觀展覽，由華納兄弟擁有，並由其片廠導覽部門營運。館址位於東京西北部的練馬，常設展出《哈利波特》系列電影製作時使用的真實服裝、道具與場景，也介紹視覺特效的幕後製作。

741fd9f6b38cd4d9.en: Okuyame in Fukuoka Prefecture is located upstream of the Yabe River, which flows from Hyuugami to Ariake. The Yugake district was established along the Yabe River and is located in the mountains on the border with Kumamoto Prefecture. The area was rich in wheat and potatoes, so they devised ways to feed their families. One of the dishes is "Imo-Manjuu". In the evening, I would eat it as a bridge until dinner was ready, or in place of rice when I didn't have enough food.
741fd9f6b38cd4d9.zh: 福岡縣的奧八女位於矢部川上游，矢部川由日向神流向有明。矢部川沿岸形成的湯掛地區，位於與熊本縣交界的山區。當地盛產小麥與芋頭，居民便設法以此餵飽家人，其中一道料理就是「いも饅頭」。傍晚時在晚餐準備好之前拿來墊肚子，或在糧食不足時用來代替米飯。

7420a0d362056cbc.en: Jōren Falls (浄蓮の滝, Jōren-no-taki) is a waterfall in the Yugashima district of Izu city, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan, in central Izu Peninsula, in the upper reaches of the Kano River. It is a Shizuoka Prefectural Natural Monument. It is one of "Japan’s Top 100 Waterfalls", in a listing published by the Japanese Ministry of the Environment in 1990.
7420a0d362056cbc.zh: 浄蓮の滝是位於日本靜岡縣伊豆市湯ヶ島地區的瀑布，地處伊豆半島中部、狩野川上游，為靜岡縣指定天然紀念物。1990年日本環境省公布的「日本瀑布百選」中，浄蓮の滝名列其中。

745f3b476c15a4ff.en: In the Arita region, various types of sushi such as "Narezushi" and "Hayazushi" have been made for seasonal events like rice planting, Obon, and autumn festivals since ancient times.In the Shimizu Area, "Hayazushi" wrapped in basho leaves is produced, but because wasabi naturally grew abundantly, households also make "Oshizushi" using wasabi leaves. Nowadays, when precious wasabi leaves are available, they are frozen for later use.
745f3b476c15a4ff.zh: 在有田地區，自古以來就會在插秧、盂蘭盆節、秋祭等季節性活動時製作なれずし、早壽司等各種壽司。清水地區製作以芭蕉葉包裹的早壽司，但由於當地野生山葵生長茂盛，家家戶戶也會用山葵葉製作押壽司。如今在能取得珍貴的山葵葉時，會將其冷凍以備日後使用。

745ffa0693df76d1.en: Tsue Sankei Prefectural Natural Park (津江山系県立自然公園, Tsue Sankei kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in western Ōita Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1951, the park is within the municipality of Hita and encompasses Mounts Gozen (御前岳), Shaka (釈迦岳), and Togami (渡神岳).
745ffa0693df76d1.zh: 津江山系県立自然公園位於日本大分縣西部，是一座縣立自然公園。公園設立於1951年，位於日田市境內，範圍包括御前岳、釈迦岳與渡神岳。
