7468a3ca09367919.en: Sōkō-ji (總光寺), is a Buddhist temple belonging to the Sōtō school of Japanese Zen located in the city of Sakata, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan.   Its main image is a statue of Sho-Kannon bosatsu. The Japanese garden at this temple was designated a National Place of Scenic Beauty in 1996.
7468a3ca09367919.zh: 總光寺是位於日本山形縣酒田市的佛教寺院，屬日本禪宗曹洞宗。本尊為聖觀音菩薩像。寺內的日本庭園於1996年被指定為國家名勝。

7488a26eef980800.en: Shin-Yokohama Park (新横浜公園, Shin-Yokohama Kōen) is a public park in Kōhoku Ward, Yokohama, Japan. It contains Nissan Stadium, a number of sporting fields and a birdwatching area. Nissan stadium is the largest stadium in Yokohama city and has a capacity of 72,000 spectators.
7488a26eef980800.zh: 新橫濱公園是位於日本橫濱市港北區的公園，園內有日產體育場、多座運動場及賞鳥區。日產體育場是橫濱市最大的體育場，可容納72,000名觀眾。

748bd855a8a564c4.en: Tajihi-Sarugake Castle (多治比猿掛城, Tajihi-Sarugake-jō) was a Japanese castle located in Akitakata, Hiroshima Prefecture.  Its ruins have been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site together with Yoshida-Kōriyama Castle since 1940.
748bd855a8a564c4.zh: 多治比猿掛城是位於廣島縣安藝高田的日本城堡。其遺跡自1940年起與吉田郡山城一併被中央政府列為國家史跡加以保護。

7492900eb4da5e63.en: Shiramizu Amida-dō (白水阿弥陀堂), is a chapel located within the Buddhist temple of Ganjō-ji (願成寺) in the city of Iwaki, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. The Amida-dō is a National Treasure and the temple, with its paradise garden, has been designated an National Historic Site.
7492900eb4da5e63.zh: 白水阿弥陀堂是位於日本福島縣いわき市佛寺願成寺內的佛堂。阿彌陀堂為國寶，寺院連同其淨土庭園被指定為國家史跡。

74b36006a6a7e7f1.en: Fukuoka Asian Art Museum (福岡アジア美術館, Fukuoka Ajia Bijutsukan) is a museum of Asian art that opened in Hakata, Fukuoka, Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan in 1999. The collection of modern and contemporary art comprises some three thousand works from twenty-three countries.
74b36006a6a7e7f1.zh: 福岡亞洲美術館（福岡アジア美術館）是一座亞洲藝術博物館，1999年於日本福岡縣福岡市博多開館。館藏近現代藝術作品約三千件，來自二十三個國家。

74bcd4301249f4a5.en: Habu Dam(羽布ダム) is a gravity dam located in Aichi Prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for irrigation. The catchment area of the dam is 51.3 km2. The dam impounds about 107  ha of land when full and can store 19363 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was completed in 1962.
74bcd4301249f4a5.zh: 羽布ダム是位於日本愛知縣的重力壩，用於灌溉。集水面積為51.3平方公里，滿水時淹沒面積約107公頃，蓄水量為19,363千立方公尺。水壩於1962年完工。

74c69f95002730f3.en: There are a variety of pickled vegetables in Mie Prefecture. The "Hinona (radish) pickles" are pickled in the Suzuka foothills area, as well as in the central Nansei and Higashi-Kishu areas. It is said that about 300 years ago, Ujisato Gamo, who built Matsuzaka Castle, introduced "Matsuzaka akana" from Omi (present-day Shiga Prefecture), and there is a record of a national scholar born in Matsuzaka City, Norinaga Motoori, enjoying it as a "savory" food.
74c69f95002730f3.zh: 三重縣有各式各樣的醃漬蔬菜。「日野菜（蕪菁）漬物」在鈴鹿山麓地區，以及中南勢、東紀州地區醃製。據說約300年前，興建松阪城的蒲生氏鄉從近江（今滋賀縣）引進了「松阪赤菜」，也有紀錄記載出生於松阪市的國學者本居宣長將其當作「美味」的食物享用。

74d1243b5af2dcad.en: Cod has long been an essential part of the New Year's celebration in Aomori Prefecture. Until around 1945, it was a tradition to thread a rope through the gills of a large cod and drag it along a snow-covered road to bring it home at the end of the year. After the fish had been cleaned, its head, middle bone, fins, and entrails were made into “jappa soup”, and its eggs were made into "cod roe," or preserved in a sweet salt.
74d1243b5af2dcad.zh: 鱈魚長久以來是青森縣過年不可或缺的食材。直到1945年左右，年底時仍有用繩子穿過大鱈魚的鰓，沿著積雪的道路拖回家的傳統。魚處理好後，魚頭、中骨、魚鰭和內臟做成「じゃっぱ汁」，魚卵則做成「鱈魚子」，或以甜鹽醃漬保存。

74d2e3906726795a.en: The central area of the prefecture, which is located along the Kitakami River basin, has an abundance of flat land. Paddy fields have been established since ancient times, and the scale of rice production was relatively large.
74d2e3906726795a.zh: 縣中部位於北上川流域，平地廣闊。自古便開闢了水田，稻米生產的規模相對較大。

74d6662b69960086.en: Seigan-ji (誓願寺) is a Buddhist temple located in Atsuta-ku, Nagoya, in central Japan. It is located on Fushimi-dōri (伏見通り), one of the main avenues of the city.
74d6662b69960086.zh: 誓願寺是位於日本中部名古屋市熱田區的佛教寺院，坐落於市內主要幹道之一的伏見通上。

74e5338c51659982.en: Amatsu Shrine (天津神社, Amatsu jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in the Ichinomiya neighborhood of the city of Itoigawa, Niigata, Japan. It is one of the three shrines claiming the title of ichinomiya of the former Echigo Province. The main festivals of the shrine are held annually on April 10 and October 24.
74e5338c51659982.zh: 天津神社是位於日本新潟縣糸魚川市一宮的神社，為自稱舊越後國一宮的三座神社之一。神社的主要祭典每年於4月10日及10月24日舉行。

7503d36e91b49245.en: In the case of the general "nikujaga" (meat and potato stew), it typically consists of potatoes, beef, and onions as the main ingredients, with variations in additional vegetables such as carrots and snap peas, all seasoned with soy sauce and sugar. However, "Kure's Nikujaga" features the use of "May Queen" potatoes, along with standard ingredients like beef, shirataki (konjac noodles), and onions. The unique aspect is that it is prepared with a fixed set of ingredients.
7503d36e91b49245.zh: 一般的「肉じゃが」（馬鈴薯燉肉）通常以馬鈴薯、牛肉和洋蔥為主要食材，另外搭配的蔬菜如紅蘿蔔、甜豆等有所不同，並以醬油和砂糖調味。而「呉の肉じゃが」的特色是使用「五月皇后」品種的馬鈴薯，搭配牛肉、蒟蒻絲和洋蔥等基本食材。其獨特之處在於使用固定的食材組合烹調。

75050a57240969ae.en: In the mountain villages of the northern Settsu region, the production of agar, known as "kanten," became active during the harsh winters of the late Edo period. Kanten is made in a process of freezing and thawing seaweed, removing any impurities with water, and then further drying the substance.
75050a57240969ae.zh: 在北攝地區的山村，江戶時代後期嚴寒的冬季裡，被稱為「寒天」的洋菜生產興盛起來。寒天的製作過程是將海藻反覆冷凍、解凍，用水去除雜質，再進一步乾燥。

751cae92136e74d3.en: Namekawa Great Falls (滑川の大滝, Namekawa-Ōtaki) is a waterfall located in the city of Yonezawa, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan, on a branch of the Abukuma River. It is one of "Japan’s Top 100 Waterfalls", in a listing published by the Japanese Ministry of the Environment in 1990.
751cae92136e74d3.zh: 滑川大滝（滑川の大滝，Namekawa-Ōtaki）是位於日本山形縣米澤市的瀑布，位在阿武隈川的支流上。1990年日本環境省公布的「日本瀑布百選」中列有此瀑布。

751df4cf520d871b.en: Takanoyu Onsen (鷹の湯温泉) is one of several hot springs in the Akinomiya Hot Springs area of the city of Yuzawa,  in southern Akita Prefecture. The onsen is nestled in a small gorge along the banks of the Yakunai River. Because of its secluded location, it is referred to as a Hitou, or hidden hot spring.
751df4cf520d871b.zh: 鷹の湯温泉是秋田縣南部湯澤市秋之宮溫泉鄉的數處溫泉之一。溫泉位於役內川沿岸的小峽谷中。由於地處偏僻，被稱為「祕湯」，即隱密的溫泉。

75304b92ee8a20b8.en: Arita, Saga Prefecture, is known as the birthplace of porcelain, and porcelain production began in the early 17th century with the discovery of ceramic stone, the raw material for magnetism, at Mount Izumiyama in Arita. One of the people who found the potter's stone at this time was a Korean potter, Sanbei Kanagae (a.k.a.
75304b92ee8a20b8.zh: 佐賀縣有田以瓷器發源地聞名，17世紀初在有田的泉山發現了瓷器原料陶石，瓷器生產由此開始。當時發現陶石的人之一，是朝鮮陶工金ヶ江三兵衛（又名

753b9aba199ad6dd.en: Abeno Cues Town (あべのキューズタウン) is the name of the Abeno A1 Area Urban Redevelopment Project A2 Building (阿倍野A1地区第二種市街地再開発事業A2棟, Abeno A1 Chiku Dainishu Shigaichi Saikaihatsu Jigyō A2 Tō) in Abeno-ku, Osaka, Japan.
753b9aba199ad6dd.zh: あべのキューズタウン是日本大阪市阿倍野區阿倍野A1地區第二種市街地再開發事業A2棟的名稱。

756af2535554b95e.en: The Yoshino Ropeway (吉野ロープウェイ, Yoshino Rōpuwei) is an aerial tramway in Mount Yoshino, Yoshino, Nara, Japan, operated by Yoshino Ōmine Kēburu Ropeway Bus Co., Ltd. This is the oldest surviving aerial lift line in the nation. The line opened on March 12, 1929, a year after Yoshino Railway, the current Kintetsu Yoshino Line, opened the railway line to Yoshino Station.
756af2535554b95e.zh: 吉野ロープウェイ是位於日本奈良縣吉野町吉野山的空中纜車，由吉野大峯ケーブル自動車株式會社經營，是日本現存最古老的空中纜車路線。該線於1929年3月12日開通，比吉野鐵道（現在的近鐵吉野線）通車至吉野站晚一年。

7574132959a75e3b.en: The name "Moburi" is derived from the Hiroshima dialect, meaning "to mix" or "to blend." Depending on the region, it is also known as "Mōburi-gohan" or "Moguri-meshi." Moburi is a dish where cooked rice is mixed with various vegetables such as dried shiitake mushrooms, burdock root, carrots, black beans, and snow peas. It can also include cooked or grilled seafood such as shrimp, fish, or clams, and instead of black beans, other beans like pinto beans may be used. The ingredients vary depending on the region and season.
7574132959a75e3b.zh: 「もぶり」之名源自廣島方言，意思是「混合」或「拌和」。依地區不同，也稱為「もうぶりご飯」或「もぐり飯」。もぶり是將煮好的米飯與乾香菇、牛蒡、紅蘿蔔、黑豆、荷蘭豆等各種蔬菜拌在一起的料理。也可加入煮過或烤過的蝦、魚、蛤蜊等海鮮，黑豆也可改用花豆等其他豆類。食材依地區和季節而有所不同。

75b2f9d2e07b6011.en: In Nara Prefecture, which does not face the sea, people used to eat a simmered dish of namabushi (half dried bonito), which lasts for a long time. Namabushi is a processed product made by roasting bonito in the manufacturing process. It can be used in a variety of dishes because it has no fishy smell, is easy to eat, and is a natural food with high protein and low calories.Namabushi is often cooked and eaten with seasonal vegetables such as Japanese leek, fuki butterbur, peas, and bamboo shoots.
75b2f9d2e07b6011.zh: 在不臨海的奈良縣，人們過去會吃以生節（半乾鰹魚）燉煮的料理，生節可以保存較長時間。生節是在製造過程中將鰹魚烘烤而成的加工品。由於沒有魚腥味、容易入口，又是高蛋白、低熱量的天然食品，可用於各種料理。生節常與青蔥、蜂斗菜、豌豆、竹筍等當季蔬菜一起烹煮食用。

75c247a2c5bb14a6.en: Mount Hiru (蛭ヶ岳 Hiru-ga-take) is the tallest mountain of the Tanzawa Mountains with a height of 1,675 metres (5,495 ft).
75c247a2c5bb14a6.zh: 蛭ヶ岳是丹澤山地的最高峰，標高1,675公尺（5,495英尺）。

75ec09c7a2e1ee72.en: The Maishima Sports Island (舞洲スポーツアイランド, Maeshima Supōtsu Airando) is a park with sports facilities in Maishima, Konohana-ku, Osaka, Japan. The official name in the Osaka City Ordinance is Osaka Port Sports Island (Osakakou Sports Island). The facility is owned by the city of Osaka, and is operated and managed by the Mizuno Group (a joint venture of Mizuno, Nankai Building Service, Japan Panause, and Hobby Life) as a designated manager.
75ec09c7a2e1ee72.zh: 舞洲スポーツアイランド是位於日本大阪市此花區舞洲的運動設施公園。大阪市條例中的正式名稱為大阪港スポーツアイランド。設施為大阪市所有，由美津濃集團（美津濃、南海ビルサービス、日本パナユーズ、ホビーライフ組成的共同事業體）以指定管理者身分營運管理。

75fd33dd2f9ebb98.ja: 鹿島神社（かしまじんじゃ）は、茨城県那珂市の神社。
75fd33dd2f9ebb98.zh: 鹿島神社是位於茨城縣那珂市的神社。

7601b3977ab51386.en: "Donko" (=dark sleepers) are brown hakelings or codlings caught along the Sanriku Coast. They are particularly delicious in the winter when the flesh of the fish become firm, and their liver becomes fatty. The white flesh is simple and refined and goes well as an ingredient for miso soups and hotpot dishes. When using fresh "donko" (=dark sleeper), the liver is also used.
7601b3977ab51386.zh: 「どんこ」是在三陸海岸捕獲的褐色鱈類魚。冬季魚肉緊實、肝臟豐腴時特別美味。白肉清淡高雅，適合作為味噌湯與火鍋的食材。使用新鮮的「どんこ」時，肝臟也會一起使用。

7615b3bf7ab52ec0.en: Prince Morinaga, the son of Emperor Go-Daigo and also known as Ootonomiya, was an early participant in the movement to overthrow the Kamakura shogunate.When Emperor Go-Daigo was exiled to Oki Island after the "Genkō no Hen" incident in 1331, Ootonomiya, in order to evade pursuit by the shogunate, entered Kumano disguised as a yamabushi (mountain ascetic). This event is known as the Ootonomiya’s Kumano Descent.
7615b3bf7ab52ec0.zh: 護良親王是後醍醐天皇之子，又稱大塔宮，很早就參與推翻鎌倉幕府的行動。1331年「元弘之變」後，後醍醐天皇被流放至隱岐島，大塔宮為躲避幕府追捕，扮成山伏（山中修行者）進入熊野。此事稱為大塔宮熊野落。

76441ffdabc7d196.en: Cold somen noodles have long been eaten in Saga Prefecture. Kanzaki Somen, a specialty of Kanzaki City located in the eastern part of the prefecture, is famous as one of the leading Somen brands in Kyushu. It is characterized by the umami and rich aroma of wheat, its crispy and strong texture, and its smooth and slippery texture. You can fully enjoy its charm by tightening it with ice water. In winter, it is enjoyed as Nyumen, as it does not fall apart while boiling.
76441ffdabc7d196.zh: 佐賀縣自古就有吃冷素麵的習慣。縣東部神埼市的特產神埼素麵，是九州具代表性的素麵品牌之一。其特色是有小麥的鮮味和濃郁香氣，口感有嚼勁且帶韌性，又滑順好入口。用冰水冰鎮緊實後，最能品嚐出它的魅力。冬天則做成煮麵（にゅうめん）食用，因為久煮也不會糊爛。

7659a2dd29bcf623.en: Wakame seaweed is cultivated through aquaculture in all prefectures in Japan that have oceans. Yamaguchi Prefecture ranks 11th in the country for its landed quantity, and it is particularly abundant in cities like Hagi and Nagato (according to the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, 2017 'Sea Fishery Production Statistics Survey'). Especially in Hagi City, wakame is harvested in early spring.
7659a2dd29bcf623.zh: 日本所有臨海的都道府縣都有養殖裙帶菜。山口縣的上岸量居全國第11位，萩市、長門市等地產量特別豐富（根據農林水產省2017年「海面漁業生產統計調查」）。尤其在萩市，裙帶菜於早春收成。

7660c50a6620c903.en: The Yoshigo Shell Midden (吉胡貝塚, Yoshigo kaizuka) is an archaeological site containing a Jōmon period shell midden located in the Yoshigo neighborhood of the city of Tahara, Aichi on the Atsumi Peninsula in the Tōkai region of Japan.  The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1951.
7660c50a6620c903.zh: 吉胡貝塚是位於日本東海地區渥美半島、愛知縣田原市吉胡地區的考古遺址，內有繩文時代的貝塚。1951年被指定為日本國家史跡。

767cfe3f70a40e08.en: Fuchu Dam (Japanese: 府中ダム) is a dam in Fuchu Town, Sakaide, Kagawa, Japan, completed in 1966. It dams the Aya River in the Aya River drainage system.
767cfe3f70a40e08.zh: 府中ダム是位於日本香川縣坂出市府中町的水壩，1966年完工，攔截綾川水系的綾川。

7681a558a31f2834.en: Seihaku-ji (清白寺),  is a Buddhist temple belonging to the Myōshin-ji branch of the Rinzai school of Japanese Zen Buddhism, located in the city of Yamanashi, Japan. Its main image is a statue of Shaka Nyōrai.
7681a558a31f2834.zh: 清白寺是屬於日本禪宗臨濟宗妙心寺派的佛教寺院，位於日本山梨縣山梨市，本尊為釋迦如來像。

76938c104538a2a0.en: Ballast Island, also known as Barasu Island (Japanese: バラス島, romanized: Barasu-shima), is a small uninhabited coral island or cay in the Yaeyama chain off the coast of mainland Japan, located between the islands of Iriomote and Hatoma. The island sits at the center of a coral reef composed primarily of species of the stony coral genus Acropora, most numerously Acropora muricata. At least four goby species have been found at the island, as well as a specimen of the moray eel Gymnothorax ryukyuensis.
76938c104538a2a0.zh: バラス島（日語：バラス島，羅馬字：Barasu-shima），英文又稱Ballast Island，是位於日本本土外海八重山群島中的無人小珊瑚島（沙洲），位於西表島與鳩間島之間。島嶼位於珊瑚礁中央，該珊瑚礁主要由石珊瑚中的軸孔珊瑚屬（Acropora）物種構成，其中以Acropora muricata數量最多。島上至少發現過四種鰕虎魚，以及一隻琉球裸胸鯙（Gymnothorax ryukyuensis）標本。

769d122fc03d2a33.en: Nippon Maru Memorial Park (日本丸メモリアルパーク, Nippon Maru Memoriaru Pāku) is a park in Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan.
769d122fc03d2a33.zh: 日本丸紀念公園是位於日本神奈川縣橫濱市的公園。

76a43290c0bfdc96.en: Tonogayato Garden (殿ヶ谷戸庭園, Tonogayato Teien) is a traditional Japanese garden located in  Kokubunji, Tokyo. Its name comes from the region's old name, Tonogayato, Kokubunji village. The garden covers an area of 21,124 square metres (5.2 acres).
76a43290c0bfdc96.zh: 殿ヶ谷戸庭園（殿ヶ谷戸庭園）是位於東京都國分寺市的傳統日本庭園，名稱來自該地區的舊地名國分寺村殿ヶ谷戸。庭園面積21,124平方公尺（5.2英畝）。

76df15d1dcd14b9a.en: The Nirayama daikansho (韮山代官所) was an Edo period administrative center for the tenryō territories in eastern Japan under the direct control of the Tokugawa shogunate. It was located in what is now part of the city of Izunokuni in the Tōkai region of Japan. There were once many daikansho located in various parts of Japan serving a similar function, and this is one of the few which remains relatively intact. It was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 2004.
76df15d1dcd14b9a.zh: 韮山代官所是江戶時代管理日本東部天領（德川幕府直轄領地）的行政機構，位於今日本東海地區伊豆之國市境內。過去日本各地設有許多功能相似的代官所，此處是少數保存較為完整的一處。2004年被指定為日本國家史跡。

76eab5019adf68f8.en: It is a home-cooked dish spread in Tsugaru region, and made from minced ‘Geso’, squid legs left over after preparing squid sashimi, mixed with vegetables like onions and carrots, and wheat flour, then deep-fried. There are some stories behind the dish, but it is mainly said that people cooked it not to waste precious squid and to make the most of vegetable scraps just after the end of the war When Food was scarce. The flavor of squid, popping texture, sweetness from vegetables and crunchy flavor have made the dish very popular among all ages.
76eab5019adf68f8.zh: 這是流傳於津輕地區的家常菜，將製作烏賊生魚片後剩下的烏賊腳（ゲソ）剁碎，與洋蔥、紅蘿蔔等蔬菜及麵粉混合後油炸而成。關於這道料理有幾種說法，主要的說法是戰爭剛結束、糧食短缺之際，人們為了不浪費珍貴的烏賊，並充分利用剩餘的蔬菜而製作。烏賊的風味、彈牙的口感、蔬菜的甜味與酥脆的滋味，使這道料理深受各年齡層喜愛。

76fda3248615b07c.en: In Naka town of Tokushima prefecture, yuzu named “Kitou Yuzu” is produced in large amounts. “Kitou Yuzu” are high in quality, relatively big and beautiful in color. This fruit is registered in the Geographical Indication (GI) Protection System, which protects products as intellectual property, and is well known throughout Japan. “Kitou Yuzu” is used in “yubeshi”, yuzu juice, and for “Yuzu Kan”, a popular refreshing dessert also known as yuzu jelly.
76fda3248615b07c.zh: 德島縣那賀町大量生產名為「木頭柚子」的柚子。「木頭柚子」品質優良，果實較大、色澤美麗。這種水果已登錄於將產品作為智慧財產加以保護的地理標示（GI）保護制度，在日本全國享有知名度。「木頭柚子」被用於「ゆべし」、柚子汁，以及「ゆずかん」——一種清爽的人氣甜點，也稱為柚子果凍。

7717c478ca944b18.en: Tamagoyaki is a dish made by seasoning eggs and frying them thickly.
7717c478ca944b18.zh: 玉子焼き是將雞蛋調味後煎成厚片的料理。

772fd908b84eca7e.en: Salted sushi, a local delicacy for special occasions, originated in Yonezawa City. It is pressed sushi made from salted salmon, and could be made even in inland Yonezawa City, where fresh fish was not available in the past.
772fd908b84eca7e.zh: 塩引きずし是特殊場合享用的鄉土料理，起源於米澤市。這是以鹽漬鮭魚製作的押壽司，即使在過去無法取得新鮮魚類的內陸米澤市也能製作。

776b2d9781f57429.en: Oguni-numa Pond (Japanese Kanji: 雄国沼; Japanese Hiragana: おぐにぬま) is a pond located at the western base of Mount Nekomadake in Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. The pond is situated on the remains of a crater and has a circumference of 4 km and an area of 45 hectares. The wetland flora of the pond is a nationally designated natural monument.
776b2d9781f57429.zh: 雄國沼（雄国沼，おぐにぬま）是位於日本福島縣貓魔岳西麓的池沼。池沼位於火山口遺跡上，周長4公里，面積45公頃。池沼的濕原植物群落是國家指定天然紀念物。

7780817975ca159c.en: There are two kinds of "Dojo-jiru". In "Marunabe", a live loach is put whole in boiling sake to make it drunk, and then stewed in an iron pot with a stockpot. Nuki nabe" is a dish in which boned loach, cut open at the back, is stewed with burdock root.Loach is a river fish characterized by its slimy surface and strong vitality. During the Edo period, when eating meat of animals was prohibited, loach was a familiar food for those who wanted to gain strength, just like carp and eel.
7780817975ca159c.zh: 「どじょう汁」有兩種。「丸鍋」是將活泥鰍整條放入煮沸的酒中使其醉倒，再放進鐵鍋以高湯燉煮。「抜き鍋」則是將從背部剖開、去骨的泥鰍與牛蒡一同燉煮。泥鰍是一種河魚，特徵是表面黏滑且生命力強。在禁止食用獸肉的江戶時代，泥鰍與鯉魚、鰻魚一樣，是想補充體力的人常吃的食物。

77862d5445a61987.en: Kashimori Shrine (橿森神社, Kashimori Jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in the city of Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. From long ago, it has been considered a good place for married couples and children to go for good luck. One legend associated with Kashimori Shrine is that when Tenma, a mythical horse, landed behind the shrine, it left a hoof print in stone that can still be seen today. Each year, on April 5, the shrine hosts the Gifu Festival, along with Inaba Shrine and Kogane Shrine.
77862d5445a61987.zh: 橿森神社（橿森神社）是位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市的神社。自古以來被認為是夫妻與孩童祈求好運的地方。與橿森神社相關的一則傳說是，神話中的天馬降落在神社後方時，在石頭上留下蹄印，至今仍可看見。每年4月5日，神社與伊奈波神社、金神社共同舉辦岐阜祭。

77939512551961e9.en: Yunomine Onsen is a hot spring system and resort town in Tanabe, near Hongu Town in southern Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. The Tsuboyu bath is located there, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
77939512551961e9.zh: 湯の峰溫泉是位於日本和歌山縣南部田邊市、鄰近本宮町的溫泉地與溫泉鄉。當地有聯合國教科文組織世界遺產「壺湯」。

77a44c60594c2e20.en: Ōizumi-Chūō Park (大泉中央公園, Ōizumi-Chūō Kōen) is a Tokyo metropolitan park located in Nerima Ward, Tokyo, Japan. It was opened in 1990 and covers an area of 103,000 m2.
77a44c60594c2e20.zh: 大泉中央公園（大泉中央公園）是位於日本東京都練馬區的都立公園，1990年開放，面積103,000平方公尺。

77a77aa6589f0150.en: Tochio Castle (栃尾城, Iino-jō) was a castle structure in Nagaoka, Niigata, Japan.  The site is located on a 227-meter mountain. Young Uesugi Kenshin spent five years in the castle.
77a77aa6589f0150.zh: 栃尾城是位於日本新潟縣長岡的城郭，所在地為一座227公尺高的山。上杉謙信年少時曾在此城度過五年。

77b167aedee1f97f.ja: 不動七重の滝（ふどうななえのたき）は、奈良県吉野郡下北山村にあり、吉野熊野国立公園の特別地域で、日本の滝百選の1つである。
77b167aedee1f97f.zh: 不動七重の滝位於奈良縣吉野郡下北山村，屬於吉野熊野國立公園的特別地域，為日本瀑布百選之一。

77b2518b6fa345f0.en: The Kii Kokubun-ji (紀伊国分寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Higashikokubu neighborhood of the city of Kinokawa, Wakayama, Japan. It was one of the provincial temples per the system established by Emperor Shōmu during the Nara period (710 – 794) for the purpose of promoting Buddhism as the national religion of Japan and standardising imperial rule over the provinces. The modern temple belongs to the Shingi Shingon sect and its main image is a statue of Yakushi Nyōrai.
77b2518b6fa345f0.zh: 紀伊國分寺是位於日本和歌山縣紀之川市東國分的佛寺。此寺為奈良時代（710－794年）聖武天皇所建立之國分寺制度下的諸國寺院之一，目的在於推廣佛教為日本國教，並統一朝廷對各地方的統治。現今寺院屬新義真言宗，本尊為藥師如來像。

77c944459ee87cfd.en: Seida no tamashi" is a local dish handed down from generation to generation in the Yuzurihara area of Uenohara City. It is made by boiling small potatoes with their skin on with miso paste. In the late Edo period, Nakai Seidayu, a deputy governor of Kofu, brought potatoes from Kyushu and gave them to villagers to grow, saving them from a severe famine. Nakai Seitao is enshrined as "Imo Daimyojin," and a monument to him remains at Ryusenji Temple in Uenohara City.
77c944459ee87cfd.zh: 「せいだのたまじ」是上野原市棡原地區世代相傳的鄉土料理，以帶皮的小馬鈴薯加味噌燉煮而成。江戶時代後期，甲府代官中井清太夫從九州引進馬鈴薯，交給村民種植，使他們度過嚴重的饑荒。中井清太夫被奉祀為「芋大明神」，上野原市的龍泉寺至今仍留有他的紀念碑。

77e4b6d7ee2b941c.en: Kiyoshiki Castle (清色城, Kiyoshiki-jō) was a Muromachi to Sengoku period Japanese castle located in the Iriki neighborhood of the city of Satsumasendai, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2004.
77e4b6d7ee2b941c.zh: 清色城是室町時代至戰國時代的日本城郭，位於日本鹿兒島縣薩摩川內市入來地區。其遺跡自2004年起作為國家史跡受到保護。

77e8250ed7afaacf.en: Naruko Dam (Japanese: 鳴子ダム, Naruko Damu) is a concrete gravity-arch dam on the Eaigawa River, a tributary of the Kitakami River system, located in the city of Ōsaki, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan. Completed in 1958 by Kajima Corporation, it is managed by the Tohoku Regional Development Bureau of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism.
77e8250ed7afaacf.zh: 鳴子ダム是位於日本宮城縣大崎市、北上川水系支流江合川上的混凝土重力拱壩。1958年由鹿島建設完工，由國土交通省東北地方整備局管理。

781878859f2762a2.en: "Tsuyama Horumon Udon" is a dish where fresh mixed horumon (beef or pork offal) is generously mixed and grilled together with udon (thick wheat noodles), coated with a miso or soy sauce-based sauce. The Tsuyama region, located in the northern part of Okayama Prefecture, has been a historical hub for the distribution of cattle and horses. Dating back to the year 705 AD, records indicate that a cattle and horse market was held in Tsuyama.
781878859f2762a2.zh: 「津山ホルモンうどん」是將大量新鮮綜合內臟（牛或豬的內臟）與烏龍麵（粗麵粉麵條）一起拌炒燒烤，並裹上味噌或醬油基底醬汁的料理。位於岡山縣北部的津山地區，自古便是牛馬流通的據點。據紀錄記載，早在西元705年，津山就曾舉辦牛馬市集。

78207a6296917d18.en: Daisen-ji (大山寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the town of Daisen, Tottori Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Tendai sect of Japanese Buddhism, and its honzon is a  statue of Jizo Bosatsu. The temple is built on the slopes of Daisen. The Amida-dō and other parts of the temple are designated National Important Cultural Properties. The temple precincts are protected as a National Historic Site
78207a6296917d18.zh: 大山寺是位於日本鳥取縣大山町的佛寺，屬日本佛教天台宗，本尊為地藏菩薩像。寺院建於大山山坡上。阿彌陀堂等部分被指定為國家重要文化財，寺域則被列為國家史跡加以保護。

783dd1d0731f236c.en: Moriyoshizan Prefectural Natural Park (森吉山県立自然公園, Moriyoshizan  kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Akita Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1968, the park lies within the municipality of Kitaakita, and takes its name from Mount Moriyoshi (森吉山).
783dd1d0731f236c.zh: 森吉山縣立自然公園（森吉山県立自然公園）是位於日本秋田縣的縣立自然公園。公園設立於1968年，位於北秋田市境內，名稱取自森吉山。

7850a74be99383df.en: The Bizen Kokubun-ji (備前国分寺) was a Buddhist temple located in what is now the city of Akaiwa, Okayama, Japan. It was one of the provincial temples per the system established by Emperor Shōmu during the Nara period (710 – 794) for the purpose of promoting Buddhism as the national religion of Japan and standardising imperial rule over the provinces. The temple no longer exists, but the temple grounds were designated as a National Historic Site in 1975.
7850a74be99383df.zh: 備前国分寺是位於今日本岡山縣赤磐市的一座佛寺。此寺是奈良時代（710－794年）聖武天皇所建立之制度下的國分寺之一，目的在於將佛教推廣為日本的國家宗教，並統一朝廷對各令制國的統治。寺院今已不存，寺域於1975年被指定為國家史跡。

786158f327093799.en: Manyō-no-Mori Park (万葉の森公園, Manyō-no-mori Kōen) opened in Hamamatsu, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan in 1992. The park takes its name from the Man'yōshū anthology of poems, four of which relate to the area. Within, as well as some three hundred kinds of plant featured in the anthology according to different theories as to their identification, there is a museum space with materials on Man'yō life and culture, facilities for experiencing Nara period cuisine and plant dyeing,  a camellia garden, and an hinoki forest.
786158f327093799.zh: 万葉の森公園於1992年在日本靜岡縣濱松市開園。公園名稱取自詩歌集《萬葉集》，其中有四首與此地相關。園內除了依各種鑑定說法栽植的約三百種集中出現的植物外，還設有展示萬葉時代生活與文化資料的展館、體驗奈良時代飲食與植物染的設施、山茶花園，以及檜木林。

7873e016d5a999d6.en: The Yamazaki Shell Midden (山崎貝塚, Yamazaki kaizuka) is an archaeological site in the Yamazaki-Kaizuka neighborhood of the city of Noda, Chiba Prefecture, in the Kantō region of Japan containing a Jōmon period  shell midden and settlement ruin. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1976, with the area under designation expanded in 1995.
7873e016d5a999d6.zh: 山崎貝塚是位於日本關東地方千葉縣野田市山崎貝塚町的考古遺址，保存有繩文時代的貝塚與聚落遺跡。遺址於 1976 年被指定為日本國家史跡，1995 年擴大指定範圍。

7895587e7fa5ca1e.en: ‘Kobe Beef Steak’, grilled beef on an iron plate flavored with salt and pepper and served with steak sauce or mustard, is famous overseas, too. Actually, however, there is no breed called ‘Kobe beef’. Kobe beef is actually ‘Tajima Ushi’, grown in Tajima Area in Hyogo Prefecture. We designate ‘Tajima Ushi’ beef as ‘Kobe Beef’ when ‘Tajima Ushi’ grown in Hyogo Prefecture was slaughtered at slaughtering centers in the prefecture and meets the strict standards.
7895587e7fa5ca1e.zh: 「神戶ビーフステーキ」是在鐵板上煎烤、以鹽和胡椒調味，並搭配牛排醬或芥末享用的牛肉，在海外也很有名。不過，實際上並沒有名為「神戶牛」的品種。神戶牛其實是在兵庫縣但馬地區飼養的「但馬牛」。在兵庫縣飼養的「但馬牛」於縣內屠宰場屠宰，並符合嚴格標準時，其牛肉才被認定為「神戶牛」。

78a47007fe698bae.en: "Decchi Yokan" is a soft sweet red bean jelly familiar as an ordinal taste of local people in Fukui, and served during cold time as a winter food. The origin of its name is that "decchi" (an apprentice) apprenticed in Kyoto brought "youkan" from there when they came back home in Fukui during the New Year. They re-made ‘yokan’ by diluting with water to distribute ‘yokan’ to their neighbors. This process made "yokan" soft and eaten in winter when the sugar content was low but not easily damaged.
78a47007fe698bae.zh: 「でっち羊かん」是福井當地人熟悉的日常口味，是口感軟嫩的紅豆羊羹，在寒冷時節作為冬季食物食用。其名稱的由來是：在京都當學徒的「でっち」新年返回福井老家時，從京都帶回「羊羹」，再加水稀釋重新製作，分送給鄰居。這樣的做法使「羊羹」變得軟嫩，雖然含糖量低，但在冬季不易變質，因此於冬天食用。

78ae6381f5d0ce69.en: In Kagawa Prefecture, "shiko-udon" is a dish made by simmering several kinds of vegetables and abura-age (fried bean curd), which are harvested in the fall and winter, in a soup stock made from simmered dried fish, and pouring it over boiled udon noodles with other ingredients.
78ae6381f5d0ce69.zh: 在香川縣，「しっぽくうどん」是將秋冬收成的數種蔬菜和油豆腐，放入以小魚乾熬煮的高湯中燉煮，再連同其他配料淋在煮好的烏龍麵上的料理。

78b17227d3ec88a4.en: "Kiri-Ae", which is to finely slice "Ukogi(=Araliad)" and dress it with miso paste, has been a common cooking method in the Okitama region, where there are the largest number of "Ukogi(=Araliad)" hedges.
78b17227d3ec88a4.zh: 「切り和え」是將五加（うこぎ）切細後拌上味噌的做法，在五加樹籬數量最多的置賜地方，一直是常見的烹調方式。

78b82fddbdfff975.en: Although the name “Hiyashiru” suggests soup, this is a boiled dish made by combining seasonal vegetables and cold dashi broth (soaking soup).
78b82fddbdfff975.zh: 冷や汁的名稱雖然讓人聯想到湯，但其實是將當季蔬菜與冷的高湯（浸泡用的湯汁）組合而成的燙煮料理。

78c3acf24e4cc6c8.en: Furusutobaru Castle (フルスト原城, Furusutobaru jō) are the ruins of stone ramparts that were thought to have been a Ryukyuan gusuku fortification, but are now thought to have been a residence site, as many household items have been excavated but no weapons have been found. Located in the city of Ishigaki, Okinawa, it was designated a National Historic Sites in 1978.
78c3acf24e4cc6c8.zh: フルスト原城是石牆遺跡，過去被認為是琉球御城（グスク）要塞，但由於出土了許多生活用品而未發現武器，現在則被認為是住居遺址。遺跡位於沖繩石垣市，1978年被指定為國家史跡。

78c4eefeecb2890a.en: The salt water-packed wetlands that sit between fresh and sea water are called brackish lakes. There are 18 such lakes in Japan, and Nakaumi Lake, spanning the border between Shimane and Tottori Prefectures, is one of them.Among the foodstuffs representative of Nakaumi Lake is the blood clam. The formal name of this clam in Japanese is salubowgai and it is of a different type than what is generally known as a blood clam. Though the two look alike, a salubowgai’s shell has about 32 grooves while a blood clam’s shell has about 42 grooves.
78c4eefeecb2890a.zh: 位於淡水與海水之間、含鹽分的濕地稱為汽水湖。日本有18座汽水湖，橫跨島根縣與鳥取縣交界的中海就是其中之一。中海的代表性食材之一是赤貝。這種貝的日文正式名稱為サルボウガイ，與一般所知的赤貝屬不同種類。兩者外觀相似，但サルボウガイ的殼約有32條溝，赤貝的殼則約有42條溝。

78cd62546f184db6.en: The Rokkosaki Lighthouse is a lighthouse located in Suzu, Ishikawa, Japan. Because of its location in the Noroshi neighborhood of Suzu, it is also called the Noroshi Lighthouse. The lighthouse's important cultural history has led it to be named as an A Rank on the "Lighthouse Preservation" list of lighthouses built during the Meiji Period. It has also been selected as one of "Japan's 50 Lighthouse," a survey conducted in 1998 asking respondents around Japan for their favorite lighthouse.
78cd62546f184db6.zh: 祿剛埼燈塔是位於日本石川縣珠洲市的燈塔。因位於珠洲市狼煙一帶，又稱狼煙燈塔。由於其重要的文化歷史，被列為明治時期所建燈塔「燈塔保存」名單中的A級。此外也入選「日本燈塔50選」，該調查於1998年進行，向日本各地民眾徵詢最喜愛的燈塔。

78d95b2a81f41c8d.en: The Solar Ark (ソーラーアーク, Sōrā Āku) is a Japanese arc-shaped solar photovoltaic power generation facility located in Anpachi, Gifu Prefecture The facility is 315 meters (1,033 ft) wide and 37 meters (121 ft) tall, one of the largest solar buildings in the world, and is located in the geographical center of Japan. It can be seen from the Tōkaidō Shinkansen, which runs past on an adjacent railway.
78d95b2a81f41c8d.zh: ソーラーアーク是位於岐阜縣安八町的日本弧形太陽能光電發電設施。設施寬315公尺（1,033英尺），高37公尺（121英尺），是世界上規模最大的太陽能建築之一，位於日本的地理中心。從行經旁邊鐵路的東海道新幹線上可以看見。

78dd859e7b18d2ac.en: Yokomi temple ruins (横見廃寺跡, Yokomi haiji ato) is an archeological site  with the ruins of a Nara period Buddhist temple located in the Hongō neighborhood of the city of Mihara, Hiroshima, Japan. It was designated as a National Historic Site in 1978.
78dd859e7b18d2ac.zh: 橫見廢寺跡（横見廃寺跡）是位於日本廣島縣三原市本鄉地區的考古遺址，保有奈良時代佛教寺院的遺跡。1978年被指定為國家史跡。

78e0d1d0b26b0fb4.en: Uzumine (宇津峰) was a Nanboku-chō period Yamashiro-style Japanese castle located on Mount Uzumine, a mountain with an altitude of 677 metres (2,221 ft), at the border between the cities of  Kōriyama and Sukagawa in Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. The castle was also known as "Hoshiga-jō" (星が城) of "Unsui-mine" (雲水峯). The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1951.
78e0d1d0b26b0fb4.zh: 宇津峰是南北朝時代的山城式日本城堡，位於日本福島縣郡山市與須賀川市交界、海拔677公尺（2,221英尺）的宇津峰山上。此城又稱「星が城」或「雲水峯」。城址於1951年被指定為日本國家史跡。

78e225a6ccbae37c.en: Lake Sai Bat Cave (Japanese: 西湖蝙蝠穴, Saiko Kōmori Ana) is the largest of the several lava tubes that are near Lake Sai, in the Aokigahara forest on the northern side of Mount Fuji, Japan. It is known as a cave where visitors can observe the bats which live there.
78e225a6ccbae37c.zh: 西湖蝙蝠穴是日本富士山北側青木原樹海中、西湖附近數個熔岩洞裡規模最大的一個，以可觀察棲息於洞內的蝙蝠而聞名。

78e5b96fc0482cd4.en: Ichigatsu-ji (一月寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the city of Matsudo in Chiba Prefecture, Japan. It was the home temple of the Fuke sect of Zen Buddhism.
78e5b96fc0482cd4.zh: 一月寺是位於日本千葉縣松戶市的佛教寺院，曾是禪宗普化宗的本山。

791df428bcfdf79a.en: Aoba Shrine (青葉神社, Aoba Jinja) is the memorial shrine of Date Masamune, located in Aoba-ku, Sendai, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan, near the site of the former Aoba Castle. The shrine was built in 1873 by petition of former retainers of the Date clan of former Sendai Domain to enshrine the deified spirit (kami) of Date Masamune under the name of Takefuruhiko-no-mikoto.
791df428bcfdf79a.zh: 青葉神社是祭祀伊達政宗的神社，位於日本宮城縣仙台市青葉區，鄰近青葉城舊址。1873年由舊仙台藩伊達氏的舊家臣請願興建，以武振彥命之名供奉伊達政宗的神靈。

793716c293b4ed5f.en: Mount Miminashi (耳成山, Miminashi-yama) is a mountain located in the Nara Basin, in the city of Kashihara, in the central-western part Nara Prefecture, Japan. Together with Mount Unebi and Mount Amanokagu, it belongs to the so-called "Yamato Sanzan".
793716c293b4ed5f.zh: 耳成山是位於日本奈良縣中西部橿原市奈良盆地內的山，與畝傍山、天香久山合稱「大和三山」。

793c8f5dd545c118.en: Osaka Prefectural Flowers Garden (大阪府立花の文化園, Osaka-furitsu Hanano-bunkaen), also known as "Fululu Garden," is a botanical garden in Kawachinagano, Osaka Prefecture, Japan.
793c8f5dd545c118.zh: 大阪府立花の文化園，又稱「フルルガーデン」，是位於日本大阪府河內長野市的植物園。

793c9ff6816fed17.en: Yaizu Jinja (焼津神社) is a Shinto shrine in the city of Yaizu in Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. The shrine is also referred to as the Irie Daimyojin (入江大明神).The main festival of the shrine is annually on August 13.
793c9ff6816fed17.zh: 焼津神社是位於日本靜岡縣燒津市的神社，也稱為入江大明神。神社的例大祭於每年8月13日舉行。

794c061b5e476bf8.en: Yūki Shrine (結城神社, Yūki jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in the city of Tsu, Mie Prefecture, Japan. Its main festival is held annually on May 1, 2 and 3. It is one of the Fifteen Shrines of the Kenmu Restoration.
794c061b5e476bf8.zh: 結城神社是位於日本三重縣津市的神社。例祭每年於5月1日、2日、3日舉行。為建武中興十五社之一。

7955fa42b6a3355f.en: Generally called uosuki or okisuki, this is a hotpot dish in which seafood, vegetables, and many other ingredients are simmered in a light broth, and it is a popular dish in fishing towns. In the Higashikishu region, it is a sukiyaki-style hotpot dish made with seasonal fish and seasonal vegetables from the rich fishing grounds of the Kumano Sea and seasoned with soy sauce.
7955fa42b6a3355f.zh: 一般稱為「魚すき」或「沖すき」，是將海鮮、蔬菜等多種食材以清淡湯底燉煮的火鍋料理，在漁村很受歡迎。在東紀州地區，則是使用熊野灘豐富漁場的當季魚類與當季蔬菜，以醬油調味的壽喜燒式火鍋。

796d3e0ac1d20fcb.en: In Tokushima Prefecture, sweet potatoes are extensively cultivated. Particularly famous nationwide is the "Naruto Kintoki". The climate of Tokushima, characterized by a gentle atmosphere and low precipitation, especially along the coast, provides a mineral-rich environment that is well-suited for sweet potato cultivation. Imo-mochi is a confection made by wrapping sweet red bean paste in a dough made from steamed glutinous rice flour and sweet potatoes.
796d3e0ac1d20fcb.zh: 德島縣廣泛種植地瓜，其中「鳴門金時」在全國特別有名。德島的氣候溫和、雨量少，尤其沿海一帶富含礦物質，環境很適合種植地瓜。いももち是以蒸過的糯米粉和地瓜製成麵糰，包入甜紅豆餡做成的點心。

797cf603d1178ce4.en: Ozoni is a traditional Japanese New Year's dish where grilled mochi is served with cooked chicken, leafy greens, and other ingredients, topped with a clear soup. During the Muromachi period, in Kyoto, the aristocracy served a miso-based ozoni with round mochi as a hospitality dish, while upper-class samurai enjoyed it as a celebratory meal. This dish was not limited to New Year's celebrations. The tradition of eating ozoni during New Year's festivities, regardless of social status, is said to have started during the Edo period.
797cf603d1178ce4.zh: 「お雑煮」是日本傳統新年料理，將烤過的麻糬與煮熟的雞肉、葉菜等食材盛在一起，再淋上清湯。室町時代的京都，貴族以加入圓麻糬的味噌底雜煮作為款待料理，上層武士則將其作為慶賀時的餐點。這道料理並不限於新年慶祝。不分身分地位、在新年期間吃雜煮的習俗，據說始於江戶時代。

799e293f638580b1.en: Tekone-zushi was originally called "tekone-zushi" because fishermen would cut the fish they caught on the boat and mix them together by hand on the spot, and has been eaten mainly in coastal areas.Mie Prefecture boasts one of the highest catches of skipjack in Japan ("Fishery and Aquaculture Production Statistics in 2028" by the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries ranked Mie 4th), and the Kumano-nada region is particularly active in pole-and-line fishing and tow-rope fishing.
799e293f638580b1.zh: てこねずし原本因漁夫在船上將捕獲的魚切好，當場用手拌合而得名「てこねずし」，主要在沿海地區食用。三重縣的鰹魚漁獲量居全國前列（農林水產省「2028年漁業・養殖業生產統計」中三重縣排名第4），熊野灘地區的竿釣漁業與曳繩釣漁業尤其興盛。

79a3b21c1c5cede9.en: Saga Prefecture, which is blessed with the Ariake Sea and Genkai Sea, has many regional dishes that benefit from the abundance of seafood. One such dish is "Tsugani Meshi," a dish that incorporates river delicacies. It is a rice dish where Tsugani (freshwater crab) is cooked together with rice, and the unique flavor of Tsugani permeating the rice is delicious.
79a3b21c1c5cede9.zh: 佐賀縣擁有有明海和玄界灘，有許多受惠於豐富海產的鄉土料理。其中之一是「つがにめし」，這道料理用上了河川的美味。這是將つがに（淡水蟹）與米一起炊煮的米飯料理，つがに的獨特風味滲入米飯，十分美味。

79bcbfc7c4c0e46e.en: Kanbe Castle (神戸城, Kanbe-jō) is a Japanese castle located in the city of Suzuka, northern Mie Prefecture, Japan. At the end of the Edo period, Kanbe Castle was home to a cadet branch of the Honda clan, daimyō of Kanbe Domain.
79bcbfc7c4c0e46e.zh: 神戸城是位於日本三重縣北部鈴鹿市的日本城郭。江戶時代末期，神戶城為神戶藩大名本多氏一分家的居城。

79e1556730ee748e.en: Kutsuki-Katsuragawa Prefectural Natural Park (朽木・葛川県立自然公園, Kutsuki-Katsuragawa kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in the mountains of western Shiga Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1971, the park spans the borders of the municipalities of Ōtsu and Takashima.
79e1556730ee748e.zh: 朽木・葛川縣立自然公園是位於日本滋賀縣西部山區的縣立自然公園。設立於1971年，範圍橫跨大津市與高島市。

79e3a507cc006217.en: Kanoya Air Base Museum (海上自衛隊鹿屋航空基地史料館, Kaijōjieitai kanoyakōkūkichishiryōkan) is an aerospace museum of the Japan Air Self-Defense Force in the city of Kanoya, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan. The museum is located adjacent to Kanoya Air Field.
79e3a507cc006217.zh: 鹿屋航空基地史料館（海上自衛隊鹿屋航空基地史料館）是日本航空自衛隊位於日本鹿兒島縣鹿屋市的航空博物館，鄰近鹿屋機場。

79fd69ef59d09c72.en: Shishijima (志々島) is an inhabited island located in the Shiwaku Islands in the Seto Inland Sea between Honshū and Shikoku. It is administratively part of the city of Mitoyo, Kagawa, Japan.
79fd69ef59d09c72.zh: 志志島（志々島）是位於本州與四國之間瀨戶內海塩飽諸島的有人島，行政上隸屬日本香川縣三豐市。

79ffddef946204bb.en: The Jizōden ruins (地蔵田遺跡, Jizōden iseki) is an archaeological site containing the ruins of a large-scale Yayoi period settlement located in the Goshono neighborhood of the city of Akita in the Tōhoku region of Japan. It also contains artifacts from the Jōmon period and the Japanese Paleolithic periods. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1996. The site is currently maintained as an archaeological park with some reconstructed buildings.
79ffddef946204bb.zh: 地蔵田遺跡是位於日本東北地方秋田市御所野地區的考古遺址，保存有大規模彌生時代聚落遺跡，另出土繩文時代及日本舊石器時代的遺物。遺址於1996年被指定為國家史跡，目前整備為考古公園，並有部分復原建築。

7a1da522fffd5cbe.en: The Akinada Bridge (安芸灘大橋, Akinada Ō-hashi) is a suspension bridge in Kure, Hiroshima, Japan that crosses the Seto Inland Sea. Completed in 1999, it has a main span of 750 m (2,460 ft). The first and largest bridge on the Akinada Tobishima Kaido, it was constructed by Penta-Ocean Construction, at a cost of 50 billion yen.
7a1da522fffd5cbe.zh: 安藝灘大橋（安芸灘大橋）是位於日本廣島縣吳市、橫跨瀨戶內海的吊橋，1999年完工，主跨徑750公尺（2,460英尺）。這是安藝灘飛島海道上的第一座、也是最大的一座橋，由五洋建設承建，造價500億日圓。

7a36c4f6809798f6.en: Taizō-in (退蔵院) is one of the tatchū (塔頭) sub-temples of Myōshin-ji, a Rinzai school Zen Buddhist temple in the Hanazono neighborhood of Ukyō-ku in the city of Kyoto, Japan.  It is one of the few of Myōshin-ji's sub-temples which are normally open to the public.
7a36c4f6809798f6.zh: 退藏院是妙心寺的塔頭寺院之一。妙心寺為臨濟宗禪寺，位於日本京都市右京區花園地區。退藏院是妙心寺塔頭中少數平時對外開放的寺院之一。

7a39386a9ad0daac.en: Sadamisaki Hantō-Uwakai Prefectural Natural Park (佐田岬半島宇和海県立自然公園, Sadamisaki Hantō-Uwakai kenritsu shizen-kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Ehime Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1965, the park spans the borders of the municipalities of Ikata, Seiyo, and Yawatahama. The park's central features are the eponymous Sadamisaki Peninsula and Uwa Sea, including the islands in the northern Uwa Sea and parts of the coastline.
7a39386a9ad0daac.zh: 佐田岬半島宇和海縣立自然公園（佐田岬半島宇和海県立自然公園）是位於日本愛媛縣的縣立自然公園。1965年設立，園區範圍橫跨伊方町、西予市及八幡濱市。園區主要景觀為公園名稱由來的佐田岬半島與宇和海，包括宇和海北部的島嶼及部分海岸線。

7a3c854f5ec28407.en: The Hōki Provincial Capital Site (伯耆国庁跡, Hōki Kokucho ato) is an archaeological site consisting of the ruins of the Nara period to early Heian period Provincial Capital of Hōki Province, located in the Kokufu, Kokubunji, neighborhood of the city of Tottori, Tottori Prefecture in the San'in region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1985 with the area under production expanded in 2000.
7a3c854f5ec28407.zh: 伯耆国庁跡是一處考古遺址，為奈良時代至平安時代初期伯耆國國府的遺跡，位於日本山陰地方鳥取縣鳥取市國分寺的國府地區。該遺址於1985年被指定為日本國家史跡，2000年擴大指定範圍。

7a52e65ccffc17cf.en: Otoyo is a valley town located in the center of the Shikoku Mountains area. "Konchin" is a local Otoyo confection in which ample amounts of flour batter are added to burdock root shavings. It has a simple taste like oyaki (wheel cakes), and is deeply familiar to men and women of all ages as a snack when one is hungry. The unique firmness of the burdock root becomes addictive, and one finds oneself reaching for more."Konchin" is made from all-purpose flour, the main ingredient in noodles.
7a52e65ccffc17cf.zh: 大豐是位於四國山地中央的山谷城鎮。「こんちん」是大豐的地方點心，在削成薄片的牛蒡中加入大量麵粉糊製成。味道樸素，類似おやき（車輪餅），作為肚子餓時的點心，深受男女老少熟悉。牛蒡特有的嚼勁讓人吃上癮，不知不覺又伸手去拿。「こんちん」是以製作麵條的主要原料中筋麵粉製成。

7a609606c7ecd7c6.en: Miyakubo Sign Language (Japanese: 宮窪手話, romanized: Miyakubo Shuwa) also known as Ehime-Oshima Sign Language, is a village sign language of Ōshima Island in the western Inland Sea of Japan. In the town of Miyakubo on the island, there exist a high incidence of congenital deafness. Three families are predominantly deaf, with 20 living deaf members (as of 2018), and in one of them all family members are deaf and have been for at least three generations.
7a609606c7ecd7c6.zh: 宮窪手話又稱愛媛大島手語，是日本瀨戶內海西部大島的村落手語。島上的宮窪町先天性聽障的發生率很高。有三個家族以聽障者為主，共有20名在世的聽障成員（截至2018年），其中一個家族所有成員皆為聽障，且至少已延續三代。

7a64bf18b2a093b5.en: Akashiyaki is a local dish of Akashi City. It is made by mixing flour, wheat starch, egg, and dashi broth, baking octopus in the batter, and dipping it in dipping sauce. Akashiyaki is similar to takoyaki in appearance, but the main difference is that takoyaki is eaten with sauce, while Akashiyaki is dipped in bonito or kelp broth. It has long been known locally as "Tamagoyaki," but around 1988, a city official decided to name it "Akashiyaki" in order to promote the town of Akashi, and the name spread to many other places.
7a64bf18b2a093b5.zh: 明石燒是明石市的在地料理。將麵粉、浮粉（小麥澱粉）、蛋與高湯混合成麵糊，包入章魚烤製，再沾湯汁食用。明石燒外觀與章魚燒相似，主要差別在於章魚燒是淋醬汁食用，明石燒則是沾柴魚或昆布高湯食用。當地長久以來稱之為「玉子燒」，約在1988年，一位市府職員為了宣傳明石，決定將其命名為「明石燒」，此名稱隨後傳播到各地。

7a65c84e1171cb6a.en: “Urajiro manjuu” is a traditional Japanese confectionary made using fresh leaves of the perennial plant “oyamabokuchi” (=synurus pungens), which grows in the sunny mountainous areas. The name “oyamabokuchi” comes from the fact that the hairs on the back of its leaves were used as tinder to start fires. In Japanese, tinder is “hokuchi” which is incorporated in the name of the plant. Also, the hairs on the back of the leaves make the back of the leaves white, which is how “urajiro manjuu” got its name.
7a65c84e1171cb6a.zh: 「うらじろまんじゅう」是使用多年生植物「オヤマボクチ」（山牛蒡）新鮮葉片製成的傳統日式點心，這種植物生長於向陽的山區。「オヤマボクチ」之名源自其葉背的絨毛曾被用作生火的火種。日文中火種稱為「ほくち」，因此納入植物名稱中。此外，葉背的絨毛使葉背呈白色，「うらじろまんじゅう」之名即由此而來。

7a8fd23448e08c83.en: It was not until the Meiji period (1868-1912) that napa cabbage began to be cultivated in Japan. In Miyagi Prefecture, seeds were brought back from China during the triumphant return of the Sino-Japanese and Russo-Japanese wars. In the Taisho era (1912-1926), "Matsushima Hakusai," one of the prototypes of Japanese napa cabbage, was born. Based on "Matsushima Hakusai," "Matsushima Jun-ni-go" and "Matsushima Shin-ni-go" were also bred, and Miyagi Prefecture became a major producer of Hakusai, boasting the largest shipment of Hakusai in Japan.
7a8fd23448e08c83.zh: 日本直到明治時代（1868-1912）才開始栽種大白菜。在宮城縣，種子是在中日甲午戰爭及日俄戰爭凱旋時從中國帶回的。大正時代（1912-1926），日本大白菜的原型之一「松島白菜」誕生。以「松島白菜」為基礎，又育成了「松島純二號」和「松島新二號」，宮城縣因而成為白菜的主要產地，出貨量居日本之冠。

7a90f9014c9ecf33.en: Hakodate Velodrome (函館競輪場, Hakodate Keirinjyō) is a velodrome located in Hakodate, Hokkaido that conducts pari-mutuel Keirin racing - one of Japan's four authorized "Public Sports" (公営競技, kōei kyōgi) where gambling is permitted. Its Keirin identification number for betting purposes is 11# (11 sharp).
7a90f9014c9ecf33.zh: 函館競輪場是位於北海道函館的自行車競技場，舉辦採彩池制投注的競輪賽事；競輪為日本四種經許可可下注的「公營競技」之一。其投注用的競輪場代號為11#（11 sharp）。

7ac1cb135ef4e192.en: Kabayama ruins (樺山遺跡, Kabayama Iseki) is an archaeological site consisting of  a Jōmon period settlement and possible ceremonial center located in the Inase neighborhood of Kitakami, Iwate, in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan. It has been designated as a National Historic Site since 1977.
7ac1cb135ef4e192.zh: 樺山遺跡是位於日本北部東北地方岩手縣北上市稻瀨地區的考古遺址，包括繩文時代的聚落及可能為祭祀中心的遺跡。自1977年起被指定為國家史跡。

7ad57128467a763f.en: Gandō Dam (岩洞ダム, Gandō damu) is a dam on the Tandogawa River, a branch of the Kitakami River in Morioka, Iwate Prefecture, Japan, completed in 1960.
7ad57128467a763f.zh: 岩洞ダム是位於日本岩手縣盛岡市、北上川支流丹藤川上的水壩，於1960年完工。

7ae9cdb2442ceec5.en: Gunma is an area of rich mountain ranges, so rich that 100 mountains have been selected as "Gunma Hyakumeizan" (Gunma's 100 Famous Mountains). The soil is often composed of volcanic ash and other volcanic eruptions, making it well drained and suitable for crop production. In addition, the long hours of sunlight in winter make it easy to grow wheat, which is used to make many local dishes. One of them is soda manju, which is made with wheat flour dough, filled with red bean paste, and steamed.
7ae9cdb2442ceec5.zh: 群馬縣山脈眾多，有100座山被選為「群馬百名山」。當地土壤多由火山灰等火山噴發物構成，排水良好，適合種植作物。此外，冬季日照時間長，容易栽種小麥，許多鄉土料理都以小麥製成，炭酸まんじゅう即是其中之一。這是用麵粉麵團包入紅豆餡後蒸製而成。

7aeb403ee265c331.en: Ibaraki Prefecture has one of the largest areas of arable land in Japan and harvests a large number of vegetables such as lotus roots, burdock roots and green onions throughout the year. Particularly in the lakeside area of Kasumigaura, the cultivation of lotus root is flourishing, and the amount of lotus root planted and produced is the largest in Japan. In Ibaraki Prefecture, a vegetable kingdom, local cuisine using local vegetables is still deeply rooted, and one of the dishes is "Niai".
7aeb403ee265c331.zh: 茨城縣擁有日本數一數二的耕地面積，全年收成大量蓮藕、牛蒡、蔥等蔬菜。尤其在霞浦湖畔一帶，蓮藕栽培興盛，種植面積與產量皆為日本第一。在蔬菜王國茨城縣，使用當地蔬菜的鄉土料理至今仍深植於生活中，「煮合い」便是其中之一。

7b0fe8a96876720d.en: Mount E (恵山, E-san) is an active stratovolcano of the Kameda peninsula, which is itself part of the larger Oshima Peninsula. It is in the rural, eastern region of Hakodate, Hokkaido, Japan. Mount E is part of Esan Prefectural Natural Park.
7b0fe8a96876720d.zh: 惠山（恵山）是位於龜田半島的活成層火山，龜田半島本身屬於較大的渡島半島的一部分。惠山位於日本北海道函館東部的鄉間地區，屬於惠山道立自然公園。

7b11c60705910e54.en: Yagisawa Dam (矢木沢ダム) is a dam in the Gunma Prefecture of Japan; it supports a 240 MW hydroelectric power station.
7b11c60705910e54.zh: 矢木沢ダム是位於日本群馬縣的水壩，供應一座240 MW的水力發電廠。

7b158d809653263d.en: Shiojiri-shuku (塩尻宿, Shiojiri-shuku) was the thirtieth of the sixty-nine stations of the Nakasendō. It is located in the central part of the present-day city of Shiojiri, Nagano Prefecture, Japan.
7b158d809653263d.zh: 鹽尻宿是中山道六十九宿中的第三十宿，位於今日本長野縣鹽尻市中心地區。

7b19be8b6bbc4e2c.en: Mount Nōtori (農鳥岳, Nōtori-dake), or Nōtoridake, is one of the major peaks in the northern Akaishi Mountains, along with Mount Kita and Mount Aino. The 3,026 m (9,928 ft) peak lies to the south of the other mountains, spanning the town of Hayakawa in Yamanashi Prefecture and Aoi-ku in the city of Shizuoka, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan.
7b19be8b6bbc4e2c.zh: 農鳥岳與北岳、間ノ岳同為赤石山脈北部的主要山峰。海拔3,026公尺（9,928英尺）的山頂位於另兩座山的南方，橫跨日本山梨縣早川町與靜岡縣靜岡市葵區。

7b424ab8112569ef.en: Ōta-juku Nakasendō Museum (太田宿中山道会館, Ōta-juku Nakasendō Kaikan) is a museum dedicated to the history and culture of the Nakasendō's Ōta-juku and is located in the city of Minokamo, Gifu Prefecture, Japan.
7b424ab8112569ef.zh: 太田宿中山道会館是介紹中山道太田宿歷史與文化的博物館，位於日本岐阜縣美濃加茂市。

7b5a8108dd2a6842.en: Urayama dam is a roller compacted concrete gravity dam located in Saitama prefecture in Japan. The dam serves for multiple purpose including water-supply for domestic purpose, power generation, and flood control. The catchment area of the dam is 51.6 km2. The dam impounds about 120ha of land when full and can store 58 million cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1972 and completed in 1988. The dam is constructed across the Urayama river which is a tributary of Arakawa River.
7b5a8108dd2a6842.zh: 浦山水壩是位於日本埼玉縣的滾壓混凝土重力壩，具有家庭用水供應、發電及防洪等多重用途。水壩集水面積為51.6平方公里，滿水時淹沒約120公頃土地，蓄水量可達5800萬立方公尺。水壩於1972年動工，1988年完工，橫跨荒川支流浦山川。

7b6a472d3c99f5e5.en: Mount Hachimen (八面山, Hachimen-zan) is a mesa in Nakatsu, Ōita Prefecture, Japan. Its elevation is 659.4 meter (2,163 feet). It is the most prominent mountain in Nakatsu and is seen as a symbol of the city.
7b6a472d3c99f5e5.zh: 八面山是位於日本大分縣中津市的方山（台地狀山體），海拔659.4公尺（2,163英尺）。是中津市最顯眼的山，被視為該市的象徵。

7b6c43505531f1fb.en: During periods when rice was insufficient, people commonly ate tubers in place of rice in the southern part of the prefecture, which includes Kaiyo Town. "Shusse imo" is a local food devised among the variety of tuber dishes that are made. Steamed taro were fit into a cylinder, wrapped with smooth red bean paste and sliced into rounds.
7b6c43505531f1fb.zh: 在稻米不足的時期，包括海陽町在內的縣南地區，人們普遍以薯芋類代替米飯。「出世いも」是在各式薯芋料理中發想出來的鄉土食物。將蒸熟的芋頭填入圓筒中，外面包上紅豆沙，再切成圓片。

7b78fe95b92e9716.en: Sakuragi Jinja (櫻木神社) is a Shinto shrine in Noda, Chiba. The shrine was founded in 851 CE by a member of the Fujiwara clan and is the oldest shrine in Noda city. The shrine is a famous spot for cherry blossom viewing and its Japanese language name means "cherry blossom tree shrine".
7b78fe95b92e9716.zh: 櫻木神社是位於千葉縣野田市的神社。神社於西元851年由藤原氏族人創建，是野田市歷史最悠久的神社。這裡是知名的賞櫻地點，日文名稱意為「櫻樹神社」。

7b9671b9680bcb1b.en: Kuro-shima (黒島) is a small, uninhabited island in the Uwa Sea (Pacific Ocean) off the coast of Shikoku, Japan.  It belongs to the town of Ikata, Ehime Prefecture.
7b9671b9680bcb1b.zh: 黒島是位於日本四國沿岸外宇和海（太平洋）中的無人小島，隸屬愛媛縣伊方町。

7bbd615863c75188.en: Naganuma Park (長沼公園, Naganuma Kōen) is a public park in the Naganuma-cho region of the city of Hachiōji in Tokyo, Japan.
7bbd615863c75188.zh: 長沼公園（長沼公園）是位於日本東京都八王子市長沼町地區的公立公園。

7bc8b2389fa24c9e.en: The Ōmori Katsuyama Site (大森勝山遺跡, Ōmori Katsuyama iseki) is an archaeological site in the city of Hirosaki, Aomori Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan that contains the ruins of a late Jōmon period settlement dating to approximately 2,000–1,500 BC. The remains were designated a National Historic Site in 2012 by the Japanese government.
7bc8b2389fa24c9e.zh: 大森勝山遺跡位於日本北部東北地方青森縣弘前市，是一處考古遺址，保存有年代約為西元前 2,000 至 1,500 年的繩文時代晚期聚落遺跡。遺跡於 2012 年由日本政府指定為國家史跡。

7bf46f47b85e8fd7.en: The Ōtsuka Museum of Art (大塚国際美術館, Ōtsuka Kokusai Bijutsukan) in Naruto, Tokushima Prefecture is an art museum founded in 1998 and is one of the largest exhibition spaces in Japan.
7bf46f47b85e8fd7.zh: 大塚國際美術館（大塚国際美術館）位於德島縣鳴門市，創立於1998年，是日本規模最大的展覽空間之一。

7bfbbdf6685bc11e.en: The Awa no Tanuki Festival (阿波の狸まつり) is a festival held each year in early November in Tokushima City, Tokushima Prefecture.
7bfbbdf6685bc11e.zh: 阿波の狸まつり是每年11月上旬在德島縣德島市舉行的祭典。

7bfeaba2ebd27dc9.en: Mount Yakushi (薬師岳, Yakushi-dake) is one of the 100 Famous Japanese Mountains, reaching the height of 2,926 m (9,600 ft). It is situated in Japan's Hida Mountains in Toyama Prefecture. It was specified for Chūbu-Sangaku National Park on December 4, 1934.
7bfeaba2ebd27dc9.zh: 藥師岳是日本百名山之一，標高2,926公尺（9,600英尺），位於富山縣境內的飛驒山脈，於1934年12月4日被劃入中部山岳國家公園。

7c0556974eb247d1.en: Okoshi-juku (起宿, Okoshi-juku) was the sixth of nine post stations along the Minoji. It is located in the present-day city of Ichinomiya, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. Established on edge of the Kiso River, the post station was also on the border of Mino and Owari provinces.
7c0556974eb247d1.zh: 起宿是美濃路九個宿場中的第六個，位於今日本愛知縣一宮市。此宿場設於木曾川畔，也位於美濃國與尾張國的交界。

7c3144545f2ba92a.en: Hoto Island is located in the Bungo Channel, around 14km from Tsukumi port in Tsukumi city. Fishing has been carried out on this island for many years and fishing villages on the island have been selected as a historical and cultural property which should be preserved for the future.
7c3144545f2ba92a.zh: 保戶島位於豐後水道，距津久見市的津久見港約14公里。島上長年從事漁業，島上的漁村已被選定為應保存給後世的歷史文化資產。

7c49967c4af696af.en: Nanzan Castle (南山城, Nanzan jō; Okinawan: Nanzan Gushiku), officially Shimajiri-Ōzato Castle (島尻大里城, Shimajiri-Ōzato jō; Okinawan: Shimajiri-Ufuzatu Gushiku), is a Ryūkyūan gusuku and was the largest in, and capital of, Nanzan until 1429. It is in ruins, and is located in Itoman.
7c49967c4af696af.zh: 南山城（南山城，Nanzan jō；沖繩語：Nanzan Gushiku），正式名稱為島尻大里城（島尻大里城，Shimajiri-Ōzato jō；沖繩語：Shimajiri-Ufuzatu Gushiku），是琉球御城（グスク），在1429年以前為南山規模最大的城，也是南山的都城。現已成廢墟，位於糸滿市。

7c5e0754076cfa0f.en: The Saitama Prefectural Museum of the Sakitama Ancient Burial Mounds (埼玉県立さきたま史跡の博物館, Saitama Kenritsu Sakitama Shiseki no Hakubutsukan) is a museum  in Gyōda, Saitama, Japan. The building is inside of Sakitama Kofun Park.  It is one of Japan's many museums which are supported by a prefecture.
7c5e0754076cfa0f.zh: 埼玉県立さきたま史跡の博物館是位於日本埼玉縣行田市的博物館，建築位於埼玉古墳公園內。是日本眾多由縣支持的博物館之一。

7c6a3799320ee54a.en: “Itadori” (Japanese knotweed) is a member of the buckwheat family that grows wild in the mountains. In some regions, it is called "sukampo" because its center is hollow like bamboo. You can eat them raw on the way to mountain climbing or hiking, but in Kochi Prefecture, they have been eaten in a variety of ways for many years.
7c6a3799320ee54a.zh: 「虎杖」是野生於山中的蓼科植物。因中心像竹子一樣中空，有些地區稱為「すかんぽ」。登山或健行途中可以生吃，而在高知縣，長年來以各種方式食用。

7c76e7c68aeda3b3.en: Ōshima (Japanese: 大島（おおしま）, Hepburn: Ōshima) is a rocky island off the northern coast of Natsudomari Peninsula in Mutsu Bay. The island is a part of Hiranai in Aomori Prefecture. The island has 3 km (1.9 mi) of coastline and an area of 0.16 km2 (0.062 sq mi). It is a part of the prefecture-maintained, Asamushi-Natsudomari Prefectural Natural Park.
7c76e7c68aeda3b3.zh: 大島是位於陸奧灣、夏泊半島北岸外海的岩島，隸屬青森縣平內町。該島海岸線長3公里（1.9英里），面積0.16平方公里（0.062平方英里），屬於由縣管理的淺蟲夏泊縣立自然公園的一部分。

7c777cdb4fd25a81.en: Enpuku-ji (円福寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Baba neighborhood of the city of Chōshi, Chiba Prefecture, Japan. It is an independent temple under Shingon Buddhism and its honzon is a statue of Jūichimen Kannon Bosatsu, also popularly known as the Iinuma Kannon (飯沼観音).  The temples full name is Iinuma-zan Enpuku-ji (飯沼山円福寺). The temple is the 27th stop on the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route.
7c777cdb4fd25a81.zh: 円福寺是位於日本千葉縣銚子市馬場町的佛教寺院，為真言宗單立寺院，本尊為十一面觀音菩薩像，俗稱「飯沼観音」。寺院全名為飯沼山円福寺，是坂東三十三所巡禮路線的第27番札所。

7c828ea77c631d70.en: Enmyō-ji (円明寺) is a Shingon Buddhist temple in Matsuyama, Ehime Prefecture, Japan. It is Temple 53 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage.
7c828ea77c631d70.zh: 圓明寺是位於日本愛媛縣松山市的真言宗寺院，為四國八十八所靈場第53號札所。

7c8e828efa18efae.en: Sumashi Zoni is eaten in a soy sauce-based dashi (=Japanese soup stock), similar to clear soup, with round rice cakes added to the broth. The ingredients vary by region, but there is a tradition of using round rice cakes. In the eastern part, the ingredients include only rock seaweed and bonito flakes. In the western part, dried sweetfish broth is sometimes used, and the ingredients may include tofu, konjac(=yam cake), etc. In the western part, there is also zoni made with only black soybeans and bonito flakes.
7c8e828efa18efae.zh: すまし雑煮是以類似清湯的醬油基底高湯（日式湯底）加入圓形年糕食用。食材因地區而異，但有使用圓形年糕的傳統。東部地區的配料只有岩海苔和柴魚片。西部地區有時會使用烤香魚乾熬的高湯，配料可能包括豆腐、蒟蒻等。西部地區也有只用黑豆和柴魚片做的雜煮。

7ca2a42de8e8766d.en: Tempura of thinly sliced pickled ginger. This dish is popular in the Kinki region, including Osaka, Nara, and Wakayama prefectures. The tartness of umeboshi vinegar and the spicy kick of ginger create a delightful flavor combination, making it a perfect accompaniment to sake.
7ca2a42de8e8766d.zh: 將切成薄片的紅薑做成的天婦羅。這道料理在大阪、奈良、和歌山等近畿地區很受歡迎。梅醋的酸味與薑的辛辣組合出好滋味，很適合搭配日本酒。

7cb287a71c5ef256.en: The Kagoshima University Museum (鹿児島大学総合研究博物館, Kagoshima Daigaku Sōgō Kenkyū Hakubutsukan) is a facility affiliated with Kagoshima University in Kagoshima, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan for the collection, preservation, research, display, and educational use of the various materials generated and acquired by the University. It was established in 2001 as the seventh museum attached to a national university.
7cb287a71c5ef256.zh: 鹿兒島大學綜合研究博物館是隸屬於日本鹿兒島縣鹿兒島市鹿兒島大學的設施，負責蒐集、保存、研究、展示該校產生及取得的各類資料，並將其用於教育。2001年設立，為第七座附設於國立大學的博物館。

7cb7fe1ce295b341.en: Yōgaiyama Castle (要害山城, Yōgaiyama-jō) was a Sengoku period yamajiro located in Kai Province (present day Yamanashi Prefecture), constructed in the 1520s by the Takeda clan. Since 1991, the ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1938. The castle is also known as the Sekisuiyama Castle (積翠山城, Sekisuiyama-jō).
7cb7fe1ce295b341.zh: 要害山城是戰國時代的山城，位於甲斐國（今山梨縣），由武田氏於1520年代興建。遺址自1938年起被列為國家指定史跡（原文另寫有1991年）。此城又稱積翠山城。

7cce85bba882fd9e.en: Senga Falls (仙娥滝, Senga-taki) is a waterfall in northern Kōfu, Yamanashi Prefecture, Japan, on the Arakawa River, an upper tributary of the Fuji River. It is located in the Shōsenkyō canyon, which is recognized by the national government as one of the protected Special Places of Scenic Beauty.
7cce85bba882fd9e.zh: 仙娥滝是位於日本山梨縣甲府市北部的瀑布，位在富士川上游支流荒川上。瀑布位於昇仙峽峽谷內，昇仙峽經國家指定為特別名勝。

7cd4de47b0c70bf3.en: The Kinjo Dam (金城ダム, Kinjō Damu) is a concrete gravity dam on the Li River in Naha, Okinawa Prefecture, Japan. It is designated as a cultural property and is located 500 m (1,640 ft) south of Shuri Castle. Construction on the dam began in 1989 and it was completed in 2000. Its main purpose is flood control and on average, it can control an intake of 40 m3/s (1,413 cu ft/s); releasing 23 m3/s (812 cu ft/s). The 19 m (62 ft) tall and 120 m (394 ft) long dam was constructed on fragile rock and is set on a deep concrete staircase foundation.
7cd4de47b0c70bf3.zh: 金城ダム是位於日本沖繩縣那霸市安里川上的混凝土重力壩，已被指定為文化財，位於首里城南方500公尺（1,640英尺）處。水壩於1989年動工，2000年完工。主要用途為防洪，平均可調控40立方公尺／秒（1,413立方英尺／秒）的入流量，放流量為23立方公尺／秒（812立方英尺／秒）。壩高19公尺（62英尺）、長120公尺（394英尺），建於脆弱的岩盤上，並設置於深層的階梯狀混凝土基礎之上。

7ce3c42b536bc7e1.en: Hiroshima City Asa Zoological Park (広島市安佐動物公園, Hiroshima-shi Asa Dōbutsukōen) is a zoo in Hiroshima, Japan.
7ce3c42b536bc7e1.zh: 廣島市安佐動物公園（広島市安佐動物公園）是位於日本廣島的動物園。

7ced61150506d25e.en: Umi Hachimangū (宇美八幡宮) is a Shinto shrine located in Umi, Fukuoka prefecture, Japan. It is dedicated to Emperor Ōjin, Empress Jingū, Tamayori-bime, Sumiyoshi sanjin and Izanagi. In the former Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines, it was classified as a prefectural shrine (県社, kensha).
7ced61150506d25e.zh: 宇美八幡宮是位於日本福岡縣宇美的神社，祭祀應神天皇、神功皇后、玉依姬、住吉三神及伊奘諾尊。在舊時的近代社格制度中，列為縣社。

7cffc05961a8bf50.en: Yasaka-ji (八坂寺) is a Buddhist temple in Matsuyama, Ehime Prefecture, Japan. Yasaka-ji is Temple 10 of the Thirteen Buddhist Sites of Iyo, and temple number 47 of the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage. It is traditionally believed to have been founded in 701.
7cffc05961a8bf50.zh: 八坂寺（八坂寺）是位於日本愛媛縣松山市的佛教寺院。八坂寺為伊予十三佛靈場第10號，也是四國八十八所靈場第47號札所。相傳創建於701年。

7d06244bae62e395.en: Sukayu Onsen (酸ヶ湯, Sukayu) is an onsen (hot spring) in the Hakkōda Mountains in the city of Aomori, Aomori Prefecture in Japan. It is known for its "Sen-nin-buro" or "Bath of a thousand bathers", a large mixed gender public bath.
7d06244bae62e395.zh: 酸ヶ湯溫泉（酸ヶ湯）是位於日本青森縣青森市八甲田山中的溫泉。以大型男女混浴公共浴場「千人風呂」（意為「可容千人的浴池」）聞名。

7d11cd8d95a59da0.en: Makonde Art Museum (マコンデ美術館, Makonde Bijutsukan) is a private museum of Makonde art that opened in Japan in 1984, reopening in its current location in Ise in 1991. The collection includes sculptures, Tingatinga-school paintings, batik, musical instruments, and other folk materials.
7d11cd8d95a59da0.zh: マコンデ美術館（馬孔德美術館）是收藏馬孔德藝術的私人博物館，1984年在日本開館，1991年於現址伊勢重新開館。館藏包括雕刻、汀加汀加派繪畫、蠟染、樂器及其他民俗資料。

7d1c2ea5d92ddfb6.en: Gonza is a simmered dish made with smashed soybeans and daikon radish. It received its name from someone named "Gonzaburou" who created it. The term "Gonza" may also come from the resemblance of the daikon to a pestle or "surikogi" in Japanese. It's also referred to as "Gonbe" due to the similarity of daikon to a grater ("gonbe" in Japanese), and is sometimes known as "Gonjinamasu." In some regions, it's called "babakoroshi," a unique name suggesting it's so delicious it could make grandmothers speechless.
7d1c2ea5d92ddfb6.zh: ごんざ是以搗碎的大豆與白蘿蔔燉煮而成的料理。名稱來自創製此料理、名為「權三郎」的人。「ごんざ」一詞也可能源自白蘿蔔形似研磨棒（日文「すりこぎ」）。因白蘿蔔形似磨泥器（日文「ごんべ」），也稱為「ごんべ」，有時又稱「ごんじなます」。在部分地區則稱為「ばばころし」，這個特別的名稱意指美味到讓老奶奶說不出話來。

7d32cdb0422d4e02.en: “Notamochi” is a local dish eaten in the Suwa and Kamiina regions. The “nota” in “notamochi” is made by boiling edamame beans, grinding them with a mortar and pestle, and adding sugar and salt. It is similar to Miyagi Prefecture’s "zundamochi", made by spreading "nota" (edamame bean paste) over half pounded rice. Made in every home, this dish is traditional for the O-Bon festival and fall offerings in the Suwa area. In the Kamiina, it is also called "jindamochi”.
7d32cdb0422d4e02.zh: 「のたもち」是在諏訪與上伊那地區食用的鄉土料理。「のたもち」的「のた」是將毛豆煮熟後用研缽與研磨棒磨碎，再加入砂糖與鹽製成。作法是將「のた」（毛豆泥）抹在半搗的米上，與宮城縣的「ずんだ餅」相似。這道料理家家戶戶都會製作，是諏訪地區盂蘭盆節與秋季供品的傳統料理。在上伊那也稱為「じんだもち」。

7d389359b0bc8c1b.en: In the Karo district of Tottori Prefecture, where there is a landing port for "Hatahata", there is Karo Shrine on a hill with a panoramic view of the Sea of Japan. Every two years, at the end of April, the Karo Shrine ”Hoenya Festival,” designated as the intangible folk cultural heritage of the prefecture, takes place. The festival features armored warriors, a parade of child "Daimyos (=feudal lords)," and a unique and lively ”Kirin Jishi Mai(=Kirin lion dance)" that parades through the town, attracting numerous spectators.
7d389359b0bc8c1b.zh: 鳥取縣賀露地區設有「ハタハタ」（雷魚）的卸貨港，在可眺望日本海全景的山丘上有賀露神社。每兩年於4月底舉行一次被指定為縣無形民俗文化財的賀露神社「ホーエンヤ祭」。祭典中有披甲武者、兒童「大名（＝封建領主）」遊行，以及在街上巡遊、獨特而熱鬧的「麒麟獅子舞」，吸引眾多觀眾。

7d3b85c0747dcc4a.en: Sendai City Museum of History and Folklore (仙台市歴史民俗資料館, Sendai-shi Rekishi Minzoku Shiryōkan) opened in Tsutsujigaoka Park, Sendai, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan in 1979. The museum building, the former barracks of the 4th Infantry Regiment, built in 1874 and extended in 1876, is the oldest surviving Western-style building in the prefecture and a Prefectural Tangible Cultural Property.
7d3b85c0747dcc4a.zh: 仙台市歷史民俗資料館於1979年在日本宮城縣仙台市榴岡公園開館。館舍原為步兵第4聯隊的兵營，建於1874年，1876年擴建，是縣內現存最古老的西式建築，並為縣指定有形文化財。

7d3db1ace684b561.en: Hanta-ji (Japanese: 繁多寺) is a temple belonging to the Buzan branch of the Shingon school, located in Hatadera-cho, Matsuyama City, Ehime Prefecture. Its formal mountain name is Higashiyama, and its hall name is Rurikō-in. Its principal deity is Yakushi Nyorai (the Medicine Buddha). It serves as the 50th temple on the Shikoku Pilgrimage.
7d3db1ace684b561.zh: 繁多寺是位於愛媛縣松山市畑寺町的真言宗豐山派寺院。山號為東山，院號為瑠璃光院。本尊為藥師如來。為四國遍路第50號札所。

7d4e90792ae43fff.en: Kanzeon-ji (観世音寺) is a seventh-century Buddhist temple in Dazaifu, Fukuoka, Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan. It was once the most important temple in Kyushu. Its bell, one of the oldest in the country, has been designated a National Treasure, and in 1996 the Ministry of the Environment designated its sound as one of the 100 Soundscapes of Japan. Many of its statues from the Heian period are Important Cultural Properties.
7d4e90792ae43fff.zh: 觀世音寺是位於日本福岡縣太宰府市的7世紀佛教寺院，曾是九州最重要的寺院。寺內的梵鐘是日本最古老的梵鐘之一，已被指定為國寶；1996年，環境省將其鐘聲選入「日本音風景百選」。寺內多尊平安時代的佛像為重要文化財。

7d56e7424c11972d.en: Kaze-no-Bon (風の盆) is a Japanese festival held every year from September 1 to 3 in Yatsuo, Toyama, Japan. Kaze-no-Bon literally translates to "Bon Dance of the Wind."
7d56e7424c11972d.zh: 風の盆是每年9月1日至3日在日本富山縣八尾舉行的祭典。「風の盆」字面意思為「風的盆舞」。

7d5ff8d7021d71f4.en: The Hakone Botanical Garden of Wetlands (箱根湿生花園, Hakone Shisseikaen) is a botanical garden located within the Fuji-Hakone-Izu National Park at 817 Sengokuhara, Hakone, Kanagawa, Japan. It is open daily in the warmer months; an admission fee is charged.
7d5ff8d7021d71f4.zh: 箱根濕生花園（箱根湿生花園，Hakone Shisseikaen）是位於日本神奈川縣箱根町仙石原817號、富士箱根伊豆國立公園內的植物園。溫暖月份每日開放，需收門票。

7d780099a34d196e.en: "Kokera-zushi" is a regional dish eaten in the Nishiura Coast area of Awaji Island, featuring dried and shredded sea bream, beltfish, gurnard, and other ingredients placed on vinegar-seasoned rice and pressed into sushi.
7d780099a34d196e.zh: 「こけらずし」是淡路島西浦海岸地區食用的鄉土料理，將乾燥後撕碎的鯛魚、白帶魚、角魚等食材鋪在醋飯上，壓製成壽司。

7dcc57faac6e9669.en: Shōjojidate Castle (聖寿寺館, Shōjojidate) was a Muromachi period Japanese castle located in what is now the town of Nanbu, in Sannohe District of Aomori Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of far northern Japan.  It was also known as the Moto-Sannohe Castle (本三戸城, Moto-Sannohe jō) (i.e. former Sannohe Castle). It was located at a strategic junction of the Ōshū Kaidō with the Kakuno Kaidō and the Mabechi River.
7dcc57faac6e9669.zh: 聖寿寺館是室町時代的日本城郭，位於日本最北部東北地方、今青森縣三戶郡南部町境內，又稱本三戸城（即舊三戶城）。該城位於奧州街道與鹿角街道及馬淵川交會的戰略要地。

7df3e2159c080e76.en: Natto soup is a miso soup mixed with carefully ground natto, and is a local dish of the southern region of Akita Prefecture. Natto soup is a local dish from the southern region of Akita Prefecture. Natto originated in various parts of Japan, and today Yokote City is one of them. During the military campaign of 1083-1087, which took place in Yokote City, farmers delivered boiled beans wrapped in straw to Minamoto no Yoshie's side, which was struggling with the supply of goods. The farmers tried it and found it tasty.
7df3e2159c080e76.zh: 納豆汁是加入仔細磨碎的納豆的味噌湯，是秋田縣南部地區的地方料理。納豆汁是秋田縣南部地區的地方料理。納豆的起源地遍布日本各地，現今橫手市也是其中之一。在橫手市發生的1083至1087年戰役中，農民將以稻草包裹的煮豆送到苦於物資補給的源義家一方。農民嘗試後發現很美味。

7dfe8fafbfa92cfe.en: “Yoshida no udon” is a local dish that originated in the area around the city of Fujiyoshida. It is made of flour noodles that have a chewy, firm, and thick texture, and is served in a broth of miso and soy sauce. Fujiyoshida City has a cool climate and volcanic ash soil at an altitude of 700-900 m, which makes rice cultivation unsuitable. Instead, wheat, barley, buckwheat, and minor grains were cultivated, leading to a culture of eating powdered foods.
7dfe8fafbfa92cfe.zh: 「吉田のうどん」是發源於富士吉田市一帶的鄉土料理。以麵粉製成的麵條口感有嚼勁、紮實且粗厚，搭配味噌與醬油調成的湯頭食用。富士吉田市位於海拔700～900公尺，氣候涼爽，土壤為火山灰土，不適合種植稻米。因此當地改種小麥、大麥、蕎麥及雜糧，進而形成以粉食為主的飲食文化。

7dff65707902cbf6.en: Fukui Prefectural Ichijodani Asakura Family Site Museum (福井県立一乗谷朝倉氏遺跡博物館, Fukui Kenritsu Ichijōdani Asakurashi Iseki Hakubutsukan) is a historical museum located in Fukui City, Fukui Prefecture, Japan. Asakura clan, a feudal lord in the Sengoku period, had their castle in the Ichijodani (Ichijo Valley), which was burnt down by Oda Nobunaga. The museum carries a collection of excavated remains from the valley and focuses on the history of the clan as well as living around the time.
7dff65707902cbf6.zh: 福井縣立一乘谷朝倉氏遺跡博物館是位於日本福井縣福井市的歷史博物館。戰國時代的大名朝倉氏將城設於一乘谷，後被織田信長燒毀。博物館收藏該谷地出土的遺物，著重介紹朝倉氏的歷史以及當時的生活。

7e1606a91477eeea.en: ”Uiro" is known to be produced in Nagoya, Kyoto, and Odawara. Nagoya is particularly famous for its efforts to procure raw materials amid postwar shortages and to make Japanese sweets, which were then sold throughout the country. Yamaguchi prefecture is also known as a production center for such "Uiro". Nagoya's "Uiro”, which is mainly made from rice flour and sugar, is a steamed confectionery with a chewy texture and heavy weight.
7e1606a91477eeea.zh: 「外郎」以名古屋、京都、小田原等地的產品為人所知。名古屋特別有名的是，戰後物資短缺之際，當地努力籌措原料製作和菓子，並銷往全國各地。山口縣也是這類「外郎」的知名產地。名古屋的「外郎」主要以米粉和砂糖製成，是一種口感有嚼勁、份量沉甸的蒸製點心。

7e28504dc47c9c76.en: Kofu Midorigaoka Sports Park Stadium (甲府市緑が丘スポーツ公園陸上競技場) is an athletic stadium in Kōfu, Yamanashi, Japan.
7e28504dc47c9c76.zh: 甲府市緑が丘スポーツ公園陸上競技場是位於日本山梨縣甲府市的田徑場。

7e2f87ee1300f83b.en: The Okawa Museum of Art (大川美術館, Ōkawa Bijutsukan) is an art gallery in Kiryū, Gunma Prefecture, Japan that concentrates on modern Japanese art.
7e2f87ee1300f83b.zh: 大川美術館是位於日本群馬縣桐生市的美術館，以日本近代美術為主。

7e56b25c4bf2de2b.en: Tea cultivation in Japan is said to have begun in the early 9th century when Kobo Daishi (Kukai) brought back tea seeds from Tang China and sowed them at Butsuryuji Temple in Uda City.The "Omizutori" ceremony held at Todaiji Temple every March has a history of more than 1,200 years, and "gobo" and "gotcha" appear in the menu of the procession. Gecha" is rice boiled in hojicha and the liquid removed (like the origin of chahan), and "gobo" is tea porridge with a lot of liquid.
7e56b25c4bf2de2b.zh: 日本的茶葉栽培，據說始於9世紀初弘法大師（空海）從唐朝帶回茶種，播種於宇陀市的佛隆寺。每年3月在東大寺舉行的「お水取り」儀式已有超過1,200年的歷史，行列的膳食中有「ごぼ」與「ごっちゃ」。「ごっちゃ」是用焙茶煮飯後去除湯汁的料理（類似炒飯的起源），「ごぼ」則是湯汁較多的茶粥。

7e5762f23047496d.en: The Shippōzan Motoyama-ji (Japanese: 七宝山 本山寺) is a Shingon Buddhist temple of the Kōyasan sect in Mitoyo, Kagawa Prefecture, Japan. It was established by Emperor Heizei's order in 807. Hayagriva is the principal image. The temple has undergone several reconstruction efforts since its founding, including the rebuilding of its Main Hall (which is a National Treasure of Japan) in 1300.
7e5762f23047496d.zh: 七寶山本山寺是位於日本香川縣三豐市的真言宗高野山派佛寺，807年奉平城天皇之命創建，本尊為馬頭觀音。創建以來歷經數次重建，其中包括1300年重建的本堂（日本國寶）。

7e651d481ddbfd14.en: The Kitayama Botanical Garden (北山緑化植物園, Kitayama Ryokka Shokubutsuen), sometimes called the Nigawa Botanical Garden, is a botanical garden located at 6-14-15 Nigawa-cho, Nishinomiya, Hyōgo, Japan. It  opened in 1982 and has a total area of 9 hectares. The garden is next to Kabutoyama Forest Park at Mount Kabutoyama, and contains a greenhouse, flower collections, and cherry trees.
7e651d481ddbfd14.zh: 北山綠化植物園，有時稱為仁川植物園，是位於日本兵庫縣西宮市仁川町6-14-15的植物園。於1982年開園，總面積9公頃。植物園緊鄰甲山的甲山森林公園，園內有溫室、花卉收藏與櫻花樹。

7ed2b419171d0d2f.en: The Kyoto Museum for World Peace (立命館大学国際平和ミュージアム, Ritsumeikan Daigaku Kokusai Heiwa Myūjiamu) is part of Ritsumeikan University in Kita-ku, Kyoto, Japan. The Museum is accessible to the public for a 200–400 Yen fee. The displays and materials are mostly in Japanese but there is a 25-page English booklet describing the exhibits. The museum is near Kinkaku-ji and just east of the main Ritsumeikan University campus.
7ed2b419171d0d2f.zh: 立命館大学国際平和ミュージアム（立命館大學國際和平博物館）隸屬於日本京都市北區的立命館大學。博物館對一般民眾開放，費用為200至400日圓。展示與資料大多為日文，但備有一本25頁的英文手冊介紹展品。博物館位於金閣寺附近，就在立命館大學主校區東側。

7efc6096571f6d04.en: The Tochibaraiwakage ruins (栃原岩陰遺跡, Tochibaraiwakage iseki) is an archaeological site consisting of a cave dwelling in use during the Jōmon period,  located in the Tochihara neighborhood of the village of Kitaaiki, Nagano in the Chūbu region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1987.
7efc6096571f6d04.zh: 栃原岩陰遺跡是位於日本中部地方長野縣北相木村栃原地區的考古遺址，為繩文時代使用的岩洞住居。1987年被指定為日本國家史跡。

7f05a73f3018b7f1.en: Miyagi Prefecture has an abundance of mochi dishes; there are said to be over 50 different kinds. Naturally, mochi is eaten during annual events like New Year’s celebrations, weddings, memorial services, and funerals, but it is also eaten during breaks while working on the farm.
7f05a73f3018b7f1.zh: 宮城縣的麻糬料理非常豐富，據說有50種以上。麻糬當然會在新年慶祝、婚禮、法事、喪禮等年節活動中食用，也會在農務休息時吃。

7f0681cc911a2568.en: Kikaku Prefectural Park (香川県立亀鶴公園, Kagawa kenritsu Kikaku Kōen) is a park located in Nagao-Myō, Sanuki, Kagawa Prefecture in Japan. It was designated as a prefectural park on June 1, 1949. The park is known for its flowers, particularly cherries and irises.
7f0681cc911a2568.zh: 香川県立亀鶴公園位於日本香川縣讚岐市長尾名，1949年6月1日被指定為縣立公園。公園以花卉聞名，尤其是櫻花與鳶尾花。

7f2445279b8c7074.en: Kōshū-ji (興宗寺), also pronounced as Kōsō-ji, is a Sōtō Zen Buddhist temple in Minami-ku, Fukuoka, Japan. The temple stands under the cavern of Takamiya where the old tombs existed.
7f2445279b8c7074.zh: 興宗寺（亦讀作こうそうじ）是位於日本福岡市南區的曹洞宗寺院。寺院位於高宮的洞窟下方，該處過去有古墓。

7f5c9d7d05bb5485.en: Facing the Seto Inland Sea and blessed with an abundance of seafood, Oita Prefecture is home to a wide variety of seafood for all four seasons, including horse mackerel, sea bream, hairtail, sardine, and mackerel. “Ryukyu" is a typical local dish of Oita Prefecture in which fresh local fish is served with a sauce made of soy sauce, sake, mirin, sesame and ginger. It became popular in the local area as a kind of preserved food. There are many theories about the name "Ryukyu.
7f5c9d7d05bb5485.zh: 大分縣面向瀨戶內海，海產豐富，四季都有竹筴魚、鯛魚、白帶魚、沙丁魚、鯖魚等多種海鮮。「りゅうきゅう」是大分縣具代表性的鄉土料理，將新鮮的當地魚類搭配由醬油、清酒、味醂、芝麻和薑調成的醬汁食用。這道料理作為一種保存食在當地普及。關於「りゅうきゅう」的名稱有許多說法。

7f84f917d84afdae.en: Mount Okukane (奥鐘山, Okukane-yama) is a mountain located between the towns of Tateyama and Kurobe in Toyama Prefecture, Japan. The mountain has an elevation of 1,543 m (5,062 ft). Mount Okukane rises dramatically between the Kurobe Gorge and the Haba Valley to form, at 600 metres (2,000 ft), one of the foremost sheer rock faces in Japan. The mountain is primarily composed of granite and is part of the Hida Mountains, also known as the Northern Japan Alps.
7f84f917d84afdae.zh: 奧鐘山是位於日本富山縣立山町與黑部市之間的山，標高1,543公尺（5,062英尺）。奧鐘山陡然聳立於黑部峽谷與ハバ谷之間，形成高達600公尺（2,000英尺）的岩壁，為日本最主要的絕壁之一。山體主要由花崗岩構成，屬於飛驒山脈，又稱北阿爾卑斯山。

7fa8a8446f56c861.en: Natural ‘Ayu’ (=sweetfish), grown in the clear stream in Yoshino mountains, eats algae on stones in the river. It is called ‘’kogyo’, meaning ‘fish with good smell’, because its smell is like watermelon or cucumber, and is also tasty. The sushi using this ayu is famous in Yoshino area. Originally ‘Ayu-zushi’ was a ‘nare-zushi’, sushi fermented from 1week to 1 month, but it had became less served as time went by because of its unique flavor.
7fa8a8446f56c861.zh: 在吉野山區清澈溪流中成長的天然香魚，以河中石頭上的藻類為食。因其氣味類似西瓜或小黃瓜，被稱為「香魚」，意為「氣味宜人的魚」，味道也很好。使用這種香魚製作的壽司在吉野地區相當有名。鮎寿司原本是熟壽司，即發酵1週至1個月的壽司，但因風味獨特，隨著時代演變而較少供應。

7faa6d5d6c908ef5.en: Tamagawa Hot Spring (玉川温泉, Tamagawa onsen)  is  a hot spring located in the city of Semboku, Akita in northern Japan.
7faa6d5d6c908ef5.zh: 玉川温泉是位於日本北部秋田縣仙北市的溫泉。

7fb6f7c894a88bfd.en: Seibu-en Velodrome (西武園競輪場, Seibuen Keirinjyō) is a velodrome located in Tokorozawa, Saitama that conducts pari-mutuel Keirin racing - one of Japan's four authorized "Public Sports" (公営競技, kōei kyōgi) where gambling is permitted. Its Keirin identification number for betting purposes is 26# (26 sharp).
7fb6f7c894a88bfd.zh: 西武園競輪場是位於埼玉縣所澤市的自行車競技場，舉辦採彩池制投注的競輪比賽。競輪是日本四種獲准投注的「公營競技」之一。該場的競輪投注代號為26#（26 sharp）。

7fc04b0ee624892e.en: Vinegared mamakari is widely known as a local dish of Okayama Prefecture. "Mamakari" is the name of a small fish called in the Okayama region, and "sappa" in the Kanto region. It is mainly caught in the Seto Inland Sea, and its season is around October, when it is at its most delicious with a lot of fat.
7fc04b0ee624892e.zh: 醋漬ままかり是廣為人知的岡山縣鄉土料理。「ままかり」是一種小魚在岡山地區的名稱，在關東地區則稱為「さっぱ」。主要捕撈於瀨戶內海，產季約在10月，此時油脂豐富，最為美味。

7fe06b1a8718528e.en: Mt. Sannomine (三ノ峰, San-no-mine) is located on the border of Takayama, Gifu Prefecture, and Hakusan, Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan, and rises to a height of 2,128 m (6,982 ft). It is located within the Hakusan National Park.
7fe06b1a8718528e.zh: 三ノ峰位於日本岐阜縣高山市與石川縣白山市交界，海拔2,128公尺（6,982英尺），位於白山國家公園範圍內。

7fe92ce50f10ab07.en: Karasuyama Castle (烏山城, Karasuyama -jō) is a Japanese castle located in Nasukarasuyama, northern Tochigi Prefecture, Japan. At the end of the Edo period, Karasuyama Castle was home to a branch of the Ōkubo clan, daimyō of  Karasuyama Domain. It was also called the Cactus Castle (臥牛, Gagyu- jō)
7fe92ce50f10ab07.zh: 烏山城是位於日本栃木縣北部那須烏山市的日本城郭。江戶時代末期，烏山城為烏山藩藩主大久保氏一支的居城。又稱臥牛城。

7ff02dd8cd65eed1.en: Tōkō-ji (Japanese: 東光寺) is a Zen Buddhist temple located in Hagi, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan. The temple is affiliated with the Ōbaku sect of Japanese Zen and its honzon is a statue of Shaka Nyorai. It is noted for hosting the tombs of several daimyōs of the Chōshū Domain and members of the Mōri clan.
7ff02dd8cd65eed1.zh: 東光寺是一座禪宗佛教寺院，位於日本山口縣萩市。寺院屬於日本禪宗黃檗宗，本尊為釋迦如來像。寺內有多位長州藩大名及毛利氏成員的墓所。

8001408e3c4939b6.en: Royal Hill is mount at the Nagano prefecture, Japan.
8001408e3c4939b6.zh: 白樺湖ロイヤルヒルスキー場是位於日本長野縣的山。

804d17c0dfacbf90.en: Daikō-ji (大興寺) is a Shingon Buddhist temple in Japan. It is the 67th site of the Shikoku Pilgrimage.
804d17c0dfacbf90.zh: 大興寺是日本的真言宗寺院，為四國遍路第67號札所。

80534dcc5a1a2e5a.en: "Tsubon-jiru" is a soup full of finely-chopped ingredients such as chicken, kamakobo fish cakes, and root vegetables like taro, burdock, carrot, and daikon radish. The ingredients are simmered in anchovy stock and flavored with soy sauce, with the stock taking on the delicate umami flavor of the vegetables. Originally included in kaiseki banquet cuisine served at autumn festivals in the Hitoyoshi Kuma region, tsubon-jiru is now also made at New Year's, festivals, and other such events.
80534dcc5a1a2e5a.zh: 「つぼん汁」是加入大量切碎材料的湯品，材料包括雞肉、魚板，以及芋頭、牛蒡、紅蘿蔔、白蘿蔔等根莖類蔬菜。材料以小魚乾高湯燉煮，用醬油調味，湯中帶有蔬菜細緻的鮮味。つぼん汁原本是人吉球磨地區秋季祭典時供應的會席宴客料理之一，現在新年、祭典等場合也會製作。

805f175c3983e974.en: Aizushingū Castle (会津新宮城, Aizushingū-jō) was a Kamakura to Muromachi period Japanese castle located in the city of Kitakata, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. The site has been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 2009.
805f175c3983e974.zh: 會津新宮城是鎌倉至室町時代的日本城郭，位於日本福島縣喜多方市。城址自2009年起獲中央政府指定為國家史跡加以保護。

807819214bdbf9f1.en: Kikuchi Valley is the located in Aso and Kikuchi, Kumamoto cities in Kumamoto Prefecture, on the island of Kyushu, Japan. It is the source of the Kikuchi River. The valley is an area known for its resorts and autumn leaves.
807819214bdbf9f1.zh: 菊池渓谷位於日本九州熊本縣的阿蘇市與菊池市，是菊池川的源頭。這座溪谷以度假設施和秋季楓葉聞名。

807f71173e349f8e.en: Nakatajima Sand Dunes (中田島砂丘, Nakatajima-sakyū) are located at the southern part of Hamamatsu, Shizuoka Prefecture at the Pacific Ocean coast of Japan.  The sand dune area measures approximately 0.6 km from north to south and 4.0 km from east to west. It is considered one of Japan's three largest sand dune areas along with the Tottori Sand Dunes in Tottori Prefecture and Kujyūkurihama  in Chiba Prefecture.
807f71173e349f8e.zh: 中田島砂丘位於靜岡縣濱松市南部的日本太平洋沿岸。砂丘南北長約0.6公里，東西長約4.0公里，與鳥取縣的鳥取砂丘、千葉縣的九十九里濱並列為日本三大砂丘。

8084b4e9f372e456.en: Located at the base of the Tango Peninsula in Kyoto Prefecture, Ōeyama (大江山) mountain range extends over Yosano-cho, Fukuchiyama and Miyazu. The highest peak, Senjogatake (千丈ヶ嶽) has an elevation of 832.5 meters. The range is also called Yosa-no-oyama (与謝大山) and is best known for the legend of Shuten-dōji. It is also known for the sea of clouds that is visible from points of high elevation. On August 3, 2007, the mountain range was designated as a Quasi-National Park under the name Tango-Amanohashidate-Ōeyama Quasi-National Park.
8084b4e9f372e456.zh: 大江山位於京都府丹後半島的根部，山脈橫跨與謝野町、福知山市與宮津市。最高峰千丈嶽海拔832.5公尺。此山脈又稱與謝大山，以酒吞童子傳說最為人所知，也以從高處可見的雲海聞名。2007年8月3日，此山脈以「丹後天橋立大江山國定公園」之名被指定為國定公園。

808ea3bb5452867d.en: Nozawa Onsen Snow Resort (野沢温泉スキー場, Nozawa Onsen Sukī-jō) is a skiing venue located in Nozawaonsen, Nagano, Japan.
808ea3bb5452867d.zh: 野沢温泉スキー場是位於日本長野縣野澤溫泉村的滑雪場。

80922981ef049461.en: Ōshio Hachiman Shrine (大塩八幡宮, Ōshio Hachimangū) is a Shinto shrine located in the city of Echizen, Fukui Prefecture, Japan. The main festival of the shrine is held annually on September 25.
80922981ef049461.zh: 大塩八幡宮是位於日本福井縣越前市的神社。神社的例大祭每年於9月25日舉行。

80993fd7a7c91d0c.en: This is a fisherman dish grilled minced pacific saury or sardine mixed with miso and Japanese leek. "Paita" is a paddle to row boats. In the days when boats were rowed by hand, sailors minced and grilled fish on the flat part of a paddle, which is said to be how the word “kai-ita” (paddle board) came to be called "paita." In Chiba Prefecture, there are several dishes made from chopped horse mackerel mixed with condiments like "Namerou" or "Sanga-yaki".
80993fd7a7c91d0c.zh: 這是將秋刀魚或沙丁魚剁碎，拌入味噌和蔥後燒烤而成的漁夫料理。「パイタ」是划船用的槳。在以人力划船的年代，船員在槳的平坦部分剁碎魚肉並燒烤，據說「櫂板」一詞後來便被稱為「パイタ」。千葉縣有數種將竹莢魚剁碎拌入佐料的料理，如「なめろう」和「さんが焼き」。

80bc08746cee5c39.en: Enkō-ji (圓光寺), is a Zen Buddhist temple located near the Shugakuin Imperial Villa at Sakyō-ku, Ichijo-ji, Kotani-cho, in northeast Kyoto, Japan. It is famous for its fall foliage and suikinkutsu.
80bc08746cee5c39.zh: 圓光寺是位於日本京都東北部左京區一乘寺小谷町、修學院離宮附近的禪宗寺院，以秋季紅葉及水琴窟聞名。

80dd1c45cf2d9617.en: Kyoto City Library of Historical Documents (京都市歴史資料館, Kyōto-shi rekishi shiryōkan) opened in Kyoto, Japan, in 1982. The museum's collection of over ninety thousand items relevant to the history of Kyoto includes materials relating to the Yase Dōji that have been designated an Important Cultural Property.
80dd1c45cf2d9617.zh: 京都市歷史資料館於1982年在日本京都開館。館內收藏超過九萬件與京都歷史相關的資料，其中與八瀨童子相關的資料已被指定為重要文化財。

80e9351482d8f9fc.en: Sesshū Memorial Museum (益田市立雪舟の郷記念館, Masuda Shiritsu Sesshū no Sato Kinenkan) opened in Masuda, Shimane Prefecture, Japan, in 1990. Located next to the site of the Daiki-an (大喜庵), said to have been the site of Sesshū's death and burial, the museum stages exhibitions relating to the artist and to the history of Masuda.
80e9351482d8f9fc.zh: 益田市立雪舟の郷記念館於1990年在日本島根縣益田市開館。館址鄰近大喜庵遺址，相傳該處是雪舟去世與埋葬之地。館內舉辦與雪舟及益田歷史相關的展覽。

810ea90a1ba2f507.en: Konpuku-ji (金福寺) is a Zen Buddhist temple in Sakyō-ku, Kyoto, Japan.
810ea90a1ba2f507.zh: 金福寺是位於日本京都左京區的禪宗寺院。
