8a86a2149d2eb78b.zh: 窪田椰子園是以棕櫚科植物為主的植物園，位於日本四國愛媛縣伊予郡松前町中川原928（郵遞區號791-3192），全年無休，免費入園。植物園約於1935年設立，目前在1.5公頃的園區內種有70種以上的棕櫚科植物。

8a88cdbd5e576106.en: The Togariishi Museum of Jōmon Archaeology (茅野市尖石縄文考古館, Chino-shi Togariishi Jōmon Kōkokan) is a municipal museum located in the city of Chino, Nagano Prefecture, Japan, specializing in artifacts of the Jōmon period (between  14,000 and 1000 BCE).
8a88cdbd5e576106.zh: 茅野市尖石縄文考古館是位於日本長野縣茅野市的市立博物館，專門收藏繩文時代（約西元前14,000年至前1000年）的文物。

8a912f73d61f2498.en: Daizen-ji (大善寺) is a Buddhist temple belonging to the Shingon school of Japanese Buddhism, located in the city of Kōshū, Yamanashi, Japan. Its main image is a hibutsu statue of Yakushi Nyōrai, shown to the public every five years,
8a912f73d61f2498.zh: 大善寺是屬於日本佛教真言宗的寺院，位於日本山梨縣甲州市。本尊為祕佛藥師如來像，每五年公開一次。

8a9e013abb8d1c03.en: Akita Senshū Museum of Art (秋田市立千秋美術館, Akita Shiritsu Senshū Bijutsukan) opened in Akita, Japan in 1989.
8a9e013abb8d1c03.zh: 秋田市立千秋美術館於1989年在日本秋田市開館。

8aa35e1381590606.en: Rice cooked with chestnuts, soybeans, azuki beans, millet, and tea. Originally, this dish was eaten by monks at Todaiji Temple and Kofukuji Temple in Nara, and was introduced to Kawasaki. During the Edo period (1603-1867), Kawasaki-juku, an inn town, one of the 53 stations of the Tokaido Road, was a busy place for people to come and go.
8aa35e1381590606.zh: 以栗子、黃豆、紅豆、小米和茶炊煮的飯。這道料理原為奈良東大寺與興福寺僧侶所食用，後傳入川崎。江戶時代（1603－1867），東海道五十三次宿場之一的川崎宿是人來人往的熱鬧之地。

8aa72479dda09adc.en: The Horinouchi Shell Midden (堀之内貝塚, Horinouchi kaizuka) is an archaeological site in the Horinouchi neighborhood of the city of Ichikawa, Chiba Prefecture, in the Kantō region of Japan containing a Jōmon period  shell midden and settlement ruin. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1964, with the area under designation expanded in 1967 and again in 1972.
8aa72479dda09adc.zh: 堀之內貝塚是位於日本關東地區千葉縣市川市堀之內的考古遺址，包含繩文時代的貝塚及聚落遺跡。該遺址於1964年被指定為日本國家史跡，指定範圍並於1967年及1972年兩度擴大。

8aba0f614a766023.en: "Hotayokan" is a steamed bread-like confection. In the Tokushima dialect, the word "hota" refers to the hollow space inside, and the fluffy, sponge-like appearance of the cake is what gives it this name. Because brown sugar is used, it is characterized by its dark brown appearance, chunky texture, and gentle sweetness. Until the Taisho era (1912-1926), people ate a steamed yokan called "Matsukaze" instead of Hotayokan, and it is said that it began to be sold at candy stores in the early Showa era (1926-1989).
8aba0f614a766023.zh: 「ほたようかん」是一種類似蒸麵包的點心。在德島方言中，「ほた」指內部中空的空間，這種點心蓬鬆如海綿的外觀便是名稱的由來。由於使用黑糖，特色是外觀呈深褐色、口感紮實、甜味溫和。直到大正時代（1912-1926年），人們吃的是一種名為「松風」的蒸羊羹，而非ほたようかん；據說ほたようかん是在昭和初期（1926-1989年）開始於糖果店販售。

8ac55520e5eaf5ce.en: Tensodo Cave (天窓洞, tensōdō) is a sea cave in Dogashima named after the skylight (tensō) that was created when a portion of the ceiling collapsed from erosion.
8ac55520e5eaf5ce.zh: 天窗洞（天窓洞）是堂島的一處海蝕洞，因洞頂部分受侵蝕崩落而形成天窗，故以此命名。

8ac8a1f2e9af7649.en: Niitakayama Castle (新高山城, Niitakayama-jō) of Aki Province was a yamajiro-style Japanese castle located in what is today the  Hongō neighborhood of the city of  Mihara in Hiroshima Prefecture. Its ruins have been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 1957.
8ac8a1f2e9af7649.zh: 新高山城是安藝國的山城式日本城郭，位於今廣島縣三原市本鄉地區。其遺址自1957年起由中央政府列為國家史跡加以保護。

8adb114c362b874e.en: Oasis 21 is a modern facility located adjacent to Nagoya TV Tower in Sakae, Nagoya which was opened to the public in 2002. It contains restaurants, stores, and a bus terminal, as well as an area for tourist information.
8adb114c362b874e.zh: 綠洲21是位於名古屋市榮、緊鄰名古屋電視塔的現代設施，2002年對外開放。設有餐廳、商店與巴士總站，另有旅遊服務區。

8ae4810677d2bcae.en: Miso soup with snow crab is a simple yet delicious soup that is made using female snow crab and daikon radish. It is a very popular dish in Tottori Prefecture, especially during winter when many snow crabs are caught in the region. The female snow crab is called "Oyagani" as it carries eggs that will produce offspring, while the male snow crab is known as "Matsuba Gani".
8ae4810677d2bcae.zh: 雪蟹味噌湯是用母雪蟹和白蘿蔔製作的湯品，做法簡單而美味。這在鳥取縣是很受歡迎的料理，尤其是當地捕獲大量雪蟹的冬季。母雪蟹因懷有孕育後代的蟹卵而被稱為「親ガニ」，公雪蟹則稱為「松葉ガニ」。

8af7ec9daae4d9c1.en: Heejaa means goat in Okinawan, also known as feejaa. A goat’s meat, bones, and entrails are slowly stewed in a large pot, and the strong-smelling hooch bar (mugwort) and njana (bitter greens) are added, finishing the dish with a salty flavor. It is characterized by its unique taste and strong smell, and is a dish that divides people into two camps, those who like it and those who dislike it. It is said that goat meat tastes best when eaten as soon as possible after it has been butchered, which is why it is often served in large gatherings.
8af7ec9daae4d9c1.zh: ヒージャー在沖繩語中意為山羊，也稱為フィージャー。將山羊的肉、骨頭與內臟放入大鍋慢慢燉煮，加入氣味濃烈的フーチバー（艾草）與ンジャナ（苦菜），最後以鹽味調味完成。這道料理以獨特的味道與強烈的氣味為特徵，喜歡與不喜歡的人分成兩派。據說山羊肉在宰殺後越早食用越美味，因此常在大型聚會中供應。

8afdec7014efeae2.en: Nata-dera (那谷寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the city of Komatsu, Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Kōyasan Shingon-shū sect of Japanese Buddhism and its honzon (primary image) is a hibutsu hidden statue of Senjū Kannon. The temple is connected by tradition to the 33-temple Saigoku Kannon Pilgrimage route, but is not a numbered temple on that pilgrimage.
8afdec7014efeae2.zh: 那谷寺是位於日本石川縣小松市的佛教寺院，屬於日本佛教高野山真言宗，本尊為祕佛千手觀音像。依傳統，此寺與西國三十三所觀音巡禮路線有所關聯，但並非該巡禮的編號札所。

8b00b3f19b27b718.en: Hiketa Castle (引田城, Hiketa-jō) was a Sengoku period Japanese castle located in what is now part of the city of  Higashikagawa, Kagawa Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 2020.
8b00b3f19b27b718.zh: 引田城是戰國時代的日本城郭，位於今日本香川縣東香川市境內。其遺跡自2020年起被中央政府列為國家史跡加以保護。

8b03ee2281d35010.en: Chinda Falls (沈堕の滝, Chinda no taki) is a double waterfall on the Ōno River in Bungo-ōno, Ōita Prefecture, Japan.
8b03ee2281d35010.zh: 沈堕の滝是位於日本大分縣豐後大野市大野川上的雙瀑布。

8b0de8f2d7660e5c.en: Ōjima Komatsugawa Park (大島小松川公園, Ōjima Komatsugawa Kōen) is a public park in Edogawa Ward and Kōtō Ward, Ojima, Tokyo, Japan.
8b0de8f2d7660e5c.zh: 大島小松川公園（大島小松川公園）是位於日本東京都江戶川區與江東區大島的公園。

8b14a389bcfe2693.en: Tanize Suspension Bridge (Japanese: 谷瀬の吊り橋, Hepburn: tanize no tsuribashi), alternatively known as the Tanise Suspension Bridge, is a bridge in Totsukawa, Nara. It is one of Japan's oldest and longest extant wire suspension bridges. The bridge, locally known as 谷瀬大橋 (Tanize-ōhashi, lit. 'tanize great bridge') has a commemorative plaque with 谷瀬橋 (tanize-bashi, lit. 'tanize bridge') engraved onto it.
8b14a389bcfe2693.zh: 谷瀨吊橋（日語：谷瀬の吊り橋，平文式羅馬字：tanize no tsuribashi），又稱Tanise吊橋，是位於奈良縣十津川村的橋，為日本現存最古老、最長的鋼索吊橋之一。這座橋在當地稱為谷瀨大橋，橋上的紀念牌刻有「谷瀨橋」字樣。

8b3423af2be535e9.en: Shōfū-en (松風園) is a Japanese garden attached to a former tea ceremony room in Chuo-ku, Fukuoka, Japan.
8b3423af2be535e9.zh: 松風園是位於日本福岡市中央區的日本庭園，附屬於一處舊茶室。

8b4f39fc990e0d4d.en: The dish made with kneaded wheat flour dough in a soup, known as "Suiton" or "Dango-jiru", is a regional specialty enjoyed throughout Japan. In Yamaguchi Prefecture, specifically in the southern part facing the Seto Inland Sea in Tabuse Town, Kumage district, there is a dish called "Ogousan Dango-jiru" that has been passed down. In this region, a newly-wed wife is referred to as "Ogousan", and this dish is traditionally prepared for a bride who has given birth.
8b4f39fc990e0d4d.zh: 將揉製的麵粉麵團放入湯中煮成的料理，稱為「すいとん」或「團子汁」，是日本各地都有的鄉土料理。在山口縣南部、面向瀨戶內海的熊毛郡田布施町，流傳著一道名為「お嫁さん団子汁」的料理。當地將新婚妻子稱為「おごうさん」，這道料理傳統上是為生產後的新娘製作的。

8b5343a885d4770a.en: “Kankoro Mochi” is a local specialty and has been enjoyed by the people of Goto region for many years. In this region, thin slices of sweet potato that are dried in the sun are referred to as “Kankoro”. A mixture of this kankoro and mochi is what makes “Kankoro Mochi”. In the past, this was a preservative food for the winter made by each household. The reason why kankoro was mixed with mochi was because glutinous rice used to make mochi was considered valuable at the time.
8b5343a885d4770a.zh: 「かんころ餅」是當地名產，長年受到五島地區居民喜愛。在這個地區，將番薯切成薄片曬乾後稱為「かんころ」。將かんころ與麻糬混合，就成了「かんころ餅」。過去這是各家各戶製作的冬季保存食品。之所以將かんころ混入麻糬，是因為當時製作麻糬用的糯米很珍貴。

8b5377045082b71d.en: Kotohira-gū (金刀比羅宮) (also known by the nickname Konpira-san (こんぴらさん) or Konpira Shrine in English) is a Shinto shrine in the town of Kotohira in Kagawa Prefecture, Japan. Prior to the separation of Shinto and Buddhism in the Meiji era, its name was Konpira Daigongen (金毘羅大権現). The shrine is believed to be a guardian of sailors and fishermen, though its faith also has aspects of mountain worship due to its location on the holy Mount Zōzu.
8b5377045082b71d.zh: 金刀比羅宮（暱稱こんぴらさん，英文亦稱Konpira Shrine）是位於日本香川縣琴平町的神社。明治時代神佛分離之前，名為金毘羅大權現。該神社被視為水手與漁民的守護神，由於位於神聖的象頭山上，其信仰也帶有山岳信仰的面向。

8b5f31ebb3586a57.ja: 諏訪湖祭湖上花火大会（すわこまつり こじょうはなびたいかい）は、長野県諏訪市の諏訪湖で毎年8月15日に行われる花火大会である。略称は「諏訪湖花火大会」「諏訪湖の花火」。
8b5f31ebb3586a57.zh: 諏訪湖祭湖上花火大会是每年8月15日在長野縣諏訪市諏訪湖舉行的煙火大會，簡稱「諏訪湖花火大會」、「諏訪湖的煙火」。

8b5ff74f0b0f1d8f.en: Nuta is a traditional seasoning from Kochi Prefecture, made by mixing miso and vinegar with garlic. It is commonly used to accompany raw fish or konjac(=yam cake).The culture of consuming garlic leaves is said to have originated from the Korean Peninsula. In the late 16th century, after returning from the Korean Campaign, Chosokabe Motochika, a warlord in Tosa Province, introduced this tradition to the region.In Kochi Prefecture, garlic leaves are widely used in various dishes, including sukiyaki, zosui (rice soup), stir-fries, and more.
8b5ff74f0b0f1d8f.zh: ぬた是高知縣的傳統調味醬，將味噌、醋與大蒜混合製成。常用來搭配生魚片或蒟蒻。據說食用蒜葉的文化源自朝鮮半島。16世紀後期，土佐國的戰國大名長宗我部元親從朝鮮出兵歸來後，將這項習慣引進當地。在高知縣，蒜葉廣泛用於壽喜燒、雜炊（米湯）、熱炒等各種料理。

8b7b0886e478abc4.en: Hiroshima Dreamination (ひろしまドリミネーション) is a winter festival of electric light held in Hiroshima, Japan since 2002. "Dreamination" is a composite word coined from "dream" and "illumination".
8b7b0886e478abc4.zh: ひろしまドリミネーション是自2002年起在日本廣島舉辦的冬季燈飾活動。「Dreamination」是由「dream」與「illumination」組成的合成詞。

8ba9206cfc4e5cfb.en: The Horikawa Canal (堀川用水, Horijkawa Yosui)  is an Edo period agricultural irrigation canal, located on the Chikugo River in the city of Asakura, Fukuoka Prefecture Japan. Together with the Asakura Waterwheel pumping system, it was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1979. It irrigates a total of 664 hectares of paddy fields..
8ba9206cfc4e5cfb.zh: 堀川用水是江戶時代的農業灌溉渠道，位於日本福岡縣朝倉市的筑後川。1979年與朝倉的水車揚水設施一同被指定為日本國家史跡。灌溉水田面積共664公頃。

8bb0362a740112c9.en: Yogoshiyama Forest Park (Japanese: 夜越山森林公園（よごしやましんりんこうえん）, Hepburn: Yogoshiyama Shinrin Kōen) is a forest park maintained by the municipal government of Hiranai located in Aomori Prefecture, Japan. Since 2015, Clean System Hiranai Co., Ltd. has been responsible for administrative duties within the park as appointed by the town government.
8bb0362a740112c9.zh: 夜越山森林公園是位於日本青森縣、由平內町政府管理的森林公園。自2015年起，由町政府指定的Clean System平內株式會社負責園內的管理業務。

8bbead5ed31721d3.en: Echizen-Fuchū Castle (越前府中城, Echizen-Fuchū-jō) was a flatland-style Japanese castle located in what is now part of the city of Echizen, Fukui Prefecture, Japan. The castle fell into ruins during the Sengoku period and the site was completely built over in the modern era, so nothing remains today.
8bbead5ed31721d3.zh: 越前府中城是平城式日本城郭，位於今日本福井縣越前市。城在戰國時代荒廢，城址在近代已完全被建物覆蓋，如今未留下任何遺跡。

8bc2426da4915c66.en: Mount Bunagatake (武奈ヶ岳, Bunagatake) is a 1,214.4-metre-high (3,984 ft) mountain in Ōtsu, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. This mountain is one of the 200 famous mountains in Japan and also one of the Kinki 100 mountains.
8bc2426da4915c66.zh: 武奈之岳是位於日本滋賀縣大津市、海拔1,214.4公尺（3,984英尺）的山。此山名列日本二百名山，也是近畿百名山之一。

8bcde93744372747.en: Iwakuni City, located in the eastmost region of Yamaguchi Prefecture, is a beautiful castle city filled with a history of scenic nature and culture. The local lotus root, an Iwakuni specialty, has nine holes unlike the eight holes a lotus root generally has. Approximately 200 years ago, a cultivator by the name of Sangoro Muramoto began growing lotus roots after returning with some from present-day Oita Prefecture.
8bcde93744372747.zh: 岩國市位於山口縣最東部，是自然景觀與文化歷史豐富的美麗城下町。岩國特產的在地蓮藕有九個孔，與一般蓮藕的八個孔不同。大約200年前，一位名叫村本三五郎的栽培者從現今的大分縣帶回蓮藕後開始種植。

8bd28d8e34b9be50.en: "Kuwanoki-mame ni" is made by simmering "kuwanoki-mame" (=mulberry beans) grown in Miyama area, located in the northern part of Yamagata city in Gifu, in soy sauce and sugar.When the "kuwanoki-mame" (=mulberry beans) ripen, the pod and the beans develop red patterns.
8bd28d8e34b9be50.zh: 「桑の木豆煮」是將岐阜縣山縣市北部美山地區種植的「桑の木豆」以醬油和砂糖燉煮而成。桑の木豆成熟時，豆莢和豆子會出現紅色花紋。

8bdf4b98d0ae32cf.en: Sanma(pacific saury) is a fish that represents the waters off Mt. Kinkasan and has long been a favorite autumn delicacy. Sanma(pacific saury) is born in the southern ocean, migrate north, feed in the northern ocean, and then move south to spawn. They migrate from north to south, from the Kuril Islands in the north to the vicinity of Okinawa in the south, and grow up.
8bdf4b98d0ae32cf.zh: 秋刀魚是金華山海域的代表性魚類，長久以來一直是受人喜愛的秋季美味。秋刀魚在南方海域出生，向北洄游，在北方海域覓食，再南下產卵。牠們北起千島群島、南至沖繩附近，由北向南洄游並成長。

8be09aa24319f72b.en: The Ōdara Yosemiya (大多羅寄宮) was a Shinto shrine located in the Ōdara neighbourhood of what is now Naka-ku in the city of Okayama, in the San'yō region of Japan. The shrine no longer exists, but its ruins were designated as a National Historic Site in 1927.
8be09aa24319f72b.zh: 大多羅寄宮是位於日本山陽地方，今岡山市中區大多羅地區的一座神社。神社今已不存，其遺跡於1927年被指定為國家史跡。

8bf0f33a63c75d2e.en: Cape Myōgane (明鐘岬, Myōgane-misaki) is a cape located on the border of Futtsu and Kyonan, Chiba, Japan, where Mount Nokogiri on its western end precipitously falls into the Uraga Channel to Tokyo Bay.
8bf0f33a63c75d2e.zh: 明鐘岬是位於日本千葉縣富津市與鋸南交界的海岬，鋸山西端在此陡然落入通往東京灣的浦賀水道。

8c02d5d59dc7d615.en: The annual major event in various schools of Jodo Shinshu (Pure Land Buddhism) known as “Hoonko,” is held around the anniversary of the death of the sect's founder, Shinran Shonin (November 28 on the lunar calendar or January 16 on the Gregorian calendar). It takes place from autumn to the beginning of the new year.
8c02d5d59dc7d615.zh: 淨土真宗各派年度的主要活動「報恩講」，在宗派開祖親鸞聖人的忌日（農曆11月28日或國曆1月16日）前後舉行，期間從秋季延續到新年初。

8c060106f4a1d1ca.en: The Akinomiya Hot Springs also known as Aki no Miya Onsenkyo is a thermal spring system and hot springs village in the Akinomiya Geothermal Area located along the western base of Mount Kurikoma in Akita Prefecture, Japan, (formerly Dewa Province, and after the Meiji era, Ugo Province). There are more than 50 hot springs and fumaroles in the area.
8c060106f4a1d1ca.zh: 秋之宮溫泉，又稱秋ノ宮温泉郷，是位於日本秋田縣（舊出羽國，明治時代後為羽後國）栗駒山西麓秋之宮地熱地帶的溫泉系統與溫泉村。此地區有50處以上的溫泉與噴氣孔。

8c11a8a0a2c3168c.en: Shōryū-ji (青龍寺 kana: しょうりゅうじ) is a Shingon Buddhist Temple located in Tosa, Kōchi, Japan. It is the 36th temple of the Shikoku Pilgrimage.
8c11a8a0a2c3168c.zh: 青龍寺（假名：しょうりゅうじ）是位於日本高知縣土佐市的真言宗寺院，為四國遍路第36號札所。

8c2e909ef9635f50.en: “Tachiuo”, are caught in many parts of Wakayama Prefecture. The Kii Channel, where the Minoshima fishing port in Arita City faces, is an excellent fishing ground where seawater from Osaka Bay meets the Kuroshio Current, and the small-scale bottom trawl fishing method using nets specially designed for “Tachiuo”, has been practiced for many years.
8c2e909ef9635f50.zh: 和歌山縣各地都能捕到白帶魚。有田市箕島漁港所面對的紀伊水道，是大阪灣海水與黑潮交會的優良漁場，多年來一直採用專為白帶魚設計的網具進行小型底拖網漁業。

8c36d8afa8f0d61c.en: The Karako-Kagi Site is an archaeological site in Tawaramoto, Nara Japan. It has a metallurgical facility, and is near other sites such as the Makimuku ruins. Chicken breeding is known from the site. However no rice paddy fields are associated with it.
8c36d8afa8f0d61c.zh: 唐古・鍵遺跡是位於日本奈良縣田原本町的考古遺址，設有金屬冶煉設施，鄰近纏向遺跡等其他遺址。已知此地曾飼養雞隻，但未發現相關的水田。

8c4900a704b4ea02.en: Hijikawa Prefectural Natural Park (肱川県立自然公園, Hijikawa kenritsu shizen-kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Ehime Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1960, the park spans the borders of the municipalities of Ōzu and Seiyo. The park's central feature is the eponymous Hiji River.
8c4900a704b4ea02.zh: 肱川縣立自然公園（肱川県立自然公園）是位於日本愛媛縣的縣立自然公園。公園設立於1960年，範圍跨大洲市與西予市。公園的主要景觀為同名的肱川。

8c68f6da141a3440.en: Paloma Mizuho Sports Park (Japanese: パロマ瑞穂スポーツパーク), formerly known as Nagoya City Mizuho Park (名古屋市瑞穂公園), is a sports park in Mizuho-ku, Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. It covers approximately 24.46 ha (60.4 acres) and contains a number of sports facilities, including an athletics stadium, rugby ground, baseball stadium, gymnasium, tennis courts and swimming facilities.
8c68f6da141a3440.zh: パロマ瑞穂スポーツパーク舊稱名古屋市瑞穂公園，是位於日本愛知縣名古屋市瑞穂區的運動公園。面積約24.46公頃（60.4英畝），設有多項運動設施，包括田徑場、橄欖球場、棒球場、體育館、網球場及游泳設施。

8c7cf8b043afa85c.en: Takashima (高島, Taka-shima) is a volcanic island in the Sea of Japan, 12 km from the coast of the Shimane prefecture in Japan. Takashima Island is administered as part of Masuda, Shimane Prefecture. Takashima takes its name, meaning "High Island" from its steep cliffs and mountains. The island was inhabited since at least 15th century, but was completely depopulated twice - in 1711 and 1975, when all inhabitants left the island following natural disasters. Currently (as in 2017) it is used as a fishing spot.
8c7cf8b043afa85c.zh: 高島是位於日本海的火山島，距離日本島根縣海岸12公里，行政上屬於島根縣益田市。高島意為「高的島」，名稱來自島上陡峭的懸崖與山地。島上至少從15世紀起就有人居住，但曾兩度完全無人，分別在1711年與1975年，都是因自然災害後全體居民離島。目前（2017年時）作為釣魚地點使用。

8cb840975aaa501b.en: Rakuhō-ji (楽法寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Motoki neighborhood of the city of Sakuragawa, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Buzan-branch of Shingon Buddhism and its honzon is a statue of Kannon Bosatsu named the Enmei Kanzeon Bosatsu (延命観世音菩薩), also popularly known as the Rain-bringing Kannon (雨引観音, Amebiki Kannon).  The temple is the 24th stop on the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route.
8cb840975aaa501b.zh: 楽法寺是位於日本茨城縣櫻川市本木地區的佛教寺院，屬於真言宗豐山派，本尊為名為延命觀世音菩薩的觀音菩薩像，一般也稱為雨引觀音。本寺為坂東三十三所巡禮路線的第24番札所。

8cd2ac1781693e68.en: Ōmiya Park (大宮公園, Ōmiya Kōen) is a public park located 1 km (0.62 mi) northeast of Ōmiya Station and the most visited park in Saitama. The park encompasses a huge area of 67.9 ha (168 acres) (as of 2004) and is famous for Japanese Red Pine forest and cherry blossoms. In particular, the park ranks in the Top 100 Locations in Japan for Cherry Blossoms.
8cd2ac1781693e68.zh: 大宮公園位於大宮站東北方1公里（0.62英里）處，是埼玉造訪人數最多的公園。園區面積廣達67.9公頃（168英畝）（2004年資料），以日本赤松林和櫻花聞名，並名列日本櫻花名所100選。

8cd74d7c7ad5defd.en: World Memorial Hall (ワールド記念ホール, Wārudo Kinen Hōru) or World Hall is a multi-purpose arena located in the Chūō-ku Ward of Kobe, Japan. It has a maximum capacity of 8,000 people and is optimized for large-scale meetings, sport events, trade shows and concerts. It is located on the artificial island of Port Island, along with numerous convention centers, hotels and universities.
8cd74d7c7ad5defd.zh: ワールド記念ホール（又稱World Hall）是位於日本神戶市中央區的多功能場館，最多可容納8,000人，適合舉辦大型會議、體育賽事、商展及演唱會。場館位於人工島港島上，島上另有多座會議中心、飯店及大學。

8cf9520bbe65142a.en: The Renjuku (廉塾) was a private academy in Edo period Japan. Located in the Kannabe neighborhood of the city of Fukuyama, Hiroshima Prefecture, it was designated a Special National Historic Site in 1934.
8cf9520bbe65142a.zh: 廉塾是日本江戶時代的私塾，位於廣島縣福山市神邊地區，1934年被指定為國家特別史跡。

8d0096136486cfe4.en: Himeyuri Peace Museum (ひめゆり平和祈念資料館, Himeyuri Heiwa Kinen Shiryōkan) opened in Itoman, Okinawa Prefecture, Japan in 1989. Located within Okinawa Senseki Quasi-National Park, it is dedicated to the Himeyuri Student Corps during the Battle of Okinawa and to the ideal of Peace.
8d0096136486cfe4.zh: ひめゆり平和祈念資料館於1989年在日本沖繩縣糸滿市開館，位於沖繩戰跡國定公園內，紀念沖繩戰役期間的姬百合學徒隊，並以和平理念為宗旨。

8d3295db71c2b475.en: Fukui Prefectural Varve Museum is a geological and archeological museum located in Wakasa, Mikatakaminaka District, Fukui Prefecture, Japan. It features varve ranging from 70,000 years ago to the present, as found at the bottom of Lake Suigetsu. The special chairman is Kazuma Yamane.
8d3295db71c2b475.zh: 福井県年縞博物館是位於日本福井縣三方上中郡若狭町的地質與考古博物館。館內展示在水月湖湖底發現、從7萬年前至今的年縞。特別館長為山根一眞。

8d39e73289e5cba7.en: The Mihashira or Onbashira (Japanese: 御柱; honorific prefix 御 on-/mi- + 柱 hashira 'pillar') are four wooden posts or pillars that stand on the four corners of local shrines in the Lake Suwa area of Nagano Prefecture (historical Shinano Province), Japan. The largest and most famous set of onbashira are those that stand on the four shrines that make up the Suwa Grand Shrine complex.
8d39e73289e5cba7.zh: 御柱（日語：御柱；敬語前綴「御」on-/mi- ＋「柱」hashira，意為「柱子」）是立於日本長野縣（舊信濃國）諏訪湖地區各地神社四個角落的四根木柱。規模最大、最知名的一組御柱，立於構成諏訪大社的四座神社。

8d5a80821963900a.en: Iwate Prefecture catches Pacific saury the most in Honshu Island in Japan. (from Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries “Fisheries and Aquaculture Production Statistics 2020”) People used to make minced sardine and cooked pacific saury with salt-grilled or simmered with salt. The catch of pacific saury has increased in 60 years, and they have started making soup with minced saury since then. The amount of saury catches, however, is decreasing these days.‘Samma no Surimi Jiru’ is a soup with pacific saury fish ball.
8d5a80821963900a.zh: 岩手縣的秋刀魚漁獲量為日本本州之冠（出自農林水產省「2020年漁業・養殖業生產統計」）。過去人們會製作沙丁魚漿，秋刀魚則以鹽烤或用鹽燉煮的方式烹調。60年來秋刀魚漁獲量增加，從那時起開始用秋刀魚漿煮湯。不過近年秋刀魚漁獲量正在減少。「さんまのすり身汁」是加入秋刀魚丸的湯。

8d7f8507e339ea39.en: Daisen-ji (大泉寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Kofuchūmachi neighborhood of the city of Kōfu, Yamanashi Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Sōtō school of Japanese Zen and its honzon is a statue of Shakyamuni Buddha. The temple's full name is Mannenzan Daisen-ji (万年山 大泉寺).
8d7f8507e339ea39.zh: 大泉寺是位於日本山梨縣甲府市古府中町的佛教寺院，屬於日本禪宗曹洞宗，本尊為釋迦牟尼佛像。寺院全名為万年山大泉寺。

8dcb1f967e0f3b57.en: Hida Tōshō-gū (飛騨東照宮) is a Shinto shrine in the city of Takayama, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It is dedicated to the first Shōgun of the Tokugawa Shogunate, Tokugawa Ieyasu.
8dcb1f967e0f3b57.zh: 飛驒東照宮（飛騨東照宮）是位於日本岐阜縣高山市的神社，供奉德川幕府第一代將軍德川家康。

8dd67062ea0bca9c.en: Kanzuri, a traditional fermented seasoning from Myoko City (formerly Arai City) in Niigata Prefecture, is also written in Japanese characters meaning “made in the cold” because it is made on the coldest day of the year. It is said that Kenshin Uesugi, a military commander in the Sengoku period, brought in the precious chili peppers from Kyoto and distributed them to farmers. It was initially made simply by mixing ground chili pepper with miso. Myoko City is located in the Joetsu region of Niigata Prefecture, adjacent to Nagano Prefecture.
8dd67062ea0bca9c.zh: かんずり是新潟縣妙高市（舊新井市）的傳統發酵調味料，因為在一年中最寒冷的日子製作，日文也寫作意為「寒中製作」的「寒造里」。據說戰國時代的武將上杉謙信從京都引進珍貴的辣椒並分送給農民。起初只是將磨碎的辣椒與味噌混合製成。妙高市位於新潟縣上越地區，與長野縣相鄰。

8de9b370d23befb3.en: Meta Shrine (賣太神社, Meta Jinja) is a Shinto shrine in Hieda, a moated village located in Yamatokōriyama in Nara Prefecture, Japan.
8de9b370d23befb3.zh: 賣太神社是位於日本奈良縣大和郡山市稗田的神社，稗田是一處環濠聚落。

8df929789fb72bd5.en: Ishibe-juku (石部宿) was the fifty-first of the fifty-three stations of the Tōkaidō highway connecting Edo with Kyoto in Edo period Japan. It was located in the present-day city of Konan, Shiga Prefecture, Japan.
8df929789fb72bd5.zh: 石部宿是日本江戶時代連接江戶與京都的東海道五十三次中的第五十一個宿場，位於今日本滋賀縣湖南市。

8e00996a7e55c889.en: Shirokuma is a frozen dessert known throughout Japan which is made by pouring condensed milk over shaved ice and topping it with various colorful toppings such as cherries, raisins, mikan, pineapple, adzuki beans, agar-agar jelly, etc.Shirokuma is said to have originated in a long-running restaurant founded in 1945-1955. At the start, it was a simple dish of shaved ice with white or red sugar syrup poured over it.
8e00996a7e55c889.zh: 「白熊」是日本全國知名的冰品，在刨冰上淋上煉乳，再放上櫻桃、葡萄乾、橘子、鳳梨、紅豆、寒天等各種色彩繽紛的配料。據說白熊起源於一家創立於1945-1955年的老字號餐廳。最初只是淋上白糖或紅糖糖漿的簡單刨冰。

8e080c72dac5660a.en: Mount Mitoku (三徳山, Mitoku-san) is a mountain located in Misasa, Tottori Prefecture. Mount Mitoku has an elevation of 900 m (2,953 ft). Mount Mitoku was known from ancient times as a place of both religious significance and scenic beauty. The mountain is home to Sanbutsu-ji, a historically significant temple designated an Important Treasure of Japan in 1952.
8e080c72dac5660a.zh: 三德山（三徳山，Mitoku-san）是位於鳥取縣三朝町的山，海拔900公尺（2,953英尺）。三德山自古即以宗教聖地與風景名勝聞名。山中有三佛寺，是具歷史意義的寺院，於1952年被指定為日本重要寶物。

8e0afec28da9dba2.en: Kagenouma Kōgoishi (鹿毛馬神籠石) was an ancient castle (also known as a Korean-style fortresses in Japan (朝鮮式山城, Chōsen-shiki yamajiro) located in the Kageuma neighborhood of the city of Iizuka, Fukuoka Prefecture Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1945, with the area under protection expanded in 2002.
8e0afec28da9dba2.zh: 鹿毛馬神籠石是一座古代城郭（亦稱為日本的朝鮮式山城），位於福岡縣飯塚市鹿毛馬地區。其遺跡自1945年起列為國家史跡受到保護，2002年擴大保護範圍。

8e2a07d32b7f4221.en: Otagi Nenbutsu-ji (Japanese: 愛宕念仏寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the hillside of the Arashiyama neighborhood of Kyoto, Japan. It is known for the 1,200 moss-covered arhat statues that cover the hillside around the temple grounds.
8e2a07d32b7f4221.zh: 愛宕念佛寺是位於日本京都嵐山地區山坡上的佛教寺院，以寺域周圍山坡上1,200尊覆滿青苔的羅漢像聞名。

8e309c24462a9da4.en: Hōzen-ji (法善寺),  is a Buddhist temple belonging to the Shingon school of Japanese Buddhism, located in the city of Minami-Alps, Yamanashi, Japan. Its main image is a statue of Amida Nyōrai.
8e309c24462a9da4.zh: 法善寺是屬於日本佛教真言宗的寺院，位於日本山梨縣南阿爾卑斯市，本尊為阿彌陀如來像。

8e3f30906c8cca7e.en: Ikanago no kugi-ni" is a local dish made by boiling raw ikanago fry in soy sauce, sugar, ginger, and other seasonings to a sweet and spicy consistency. It is called "kugi-ni" (meaning "nail stew") because the finished product looks like a rusty nail that has been bent. It is said to have originated in Kobe, where it was originally prepared in the homes of fishermen, but it became widely known to the general public in the 1980s.
8e3f30906c8cca7e.zh: 「イカナゴのくぎ煮」是將生的玉筋魚幼魚以醬油、砂糖、薑等調味料煮成甜辣口味的鄉土料理。因成品看起來像彎曲生鏽的釘子，所以稱為「くぎ煮」（意為「釘煮」）。據說起源於神戶，原本是漁夫家中製作的料理，1980年代起廣為一般大眾所知。

8e40d6872fdb0cca.en: Mie Prefectural Museum (三重県総合博物館, Mie-ken sōgō hakubutsukan) opened on a new site in Tsu, Mie Prefecture, Japan, in 2014. Also known as MieMu, it replaced the former Mie Prefectural Museum (三重県立博物館, Mie kenritsu hakubutsukan) which opened in 1953 and closed in 2014.
8e40d6872fdb0cca.zh: 三重県総合博物館（三重縣綜合博物館）於2014年在日本三重縣津市的新址開館，又稱MieMu，取代了1953年開館、2014年閉館的舊三重縣立博物館。

8e4bf67019898ed3.en: The Botanical Garden of Tohoku University (東北大学植物園, Tōhoku Daigaku Shokubutsuen; 490,000 m2) is a botanical garden operated by Tohoku University at Kawauchi 12-2, Aoba-ku, Sendai, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan. It is open daily.
8e4bf67019898ed3.zh: 東北大學植物園（東北大学植物園；490,000平方公尺）是由東北大學經營的植物園，位於日本宮城縣仙台市青葉區川內12-2，每日開放。

8e5a6e2aed0b0131.en: The Okukuji region in Ibaraki Prefecture has been known for its thriving konjac cultivation since ancient times and is considered the birthplace of konjac. This originated from the method devised by Nakashima Tōemon in the Mito domain, to powder konjac potatoes. Slicing the raw potatoes thinly, threading them onto skewers, drying and crushing them made storage and transportation easier, leading to a significant increase in konjac cultivation in the region. During the Edo period, it became a monopoly product supporting the domain's finances.
8e5a6e2aed0b0131.zh: 茨城縣的奧久慈地區自古以蒟蒻栽培興盛聞名，被視為蒟蒻的發源地。這源自水戶藩的中島藤右衛門所想出的蒟蒻芋製粉方法。將生芋切成薄片，串在竹籤上曬乾後磨碎，使保存與運輸更加容易，該地區的蒟蒻栽培因而大幅增加。江戶時代，蒟蒻成為支撐藩財政的專賣品。

8e74d9c782fd3b97.en: Sake manju are traditional Japanese pastries made by steaming a sweet bean paste wrapped in a dough made from sakadane, a natural leavening agent produced using rice and koji (malted rice), and flour.As Sagamihara was not suitable for rice cultivation due to large amounts of volcanic ash, the area flourished as a center for wheat and barley production, with various foods made from local flour becoming popular. Among them, sake manju came to be known as a delicacy served at festivals and other gatherings.
8e74d9c782fd3b97.zh: 酒饅頭是傳統日式點心，以米和麴製成的天然發酵種「酒種」加上麵粉做成麵皮，包入甜豆沙後蒸製而成。相模原因火山灰多，不適合種稻，因而發展成小麥與大麥的產地，以當地麵粉製作的各種食物隨之普及。其中，酒饅頭成為祭典等聚會時享用的美食。

8e82d07606779d36.en: The Ishitani Residence (石谷家住宅, Ishitanike Jūtaku) is a family residence in Chizu, Tottori Prefecture, Japan. In the Edo period Chizu flourished as one of Japan's largest shukuba (宿場) or post stations, the Chizushuku (智頭宿) in Inaba Kaidō. The Ishitani family, an upper-class family, built a residence in the area. In the early 20th century the residence was greatly expanded by incorporating Western-style elements into the Japanese-style structure. The residence is spread across two floors and forty rooms.
8e82d07606779d36.zh: 石谷家住宅是位於日本鳥取縣智頭町的家族宅邸。江戶時代，智頭作為因幡街道上的智頭宿而繁榮，是日本規模最大的宿場（驛站）之一。上層階級的石谷家在此地建造了宅邸。20世紀初，宅邸在日式建築中融入西式元素，大幅擴建。宅邸共兩層樓、四十個房間。

8e878ba6b31eb084.en: Cabbage rice cakes are a regional food which have been eaten in the Ose region of Koriyama City for over 80 years. It is said that they were created by rice- and cabbage-growing farmers while practicing self-sufficiency.
8e878ba6b31eb084.zh: キャベツ餅是郡山市逢瀨地區已食用超過80年的地方料理。據說是種植稻米與高麗菜的農家在自給自足的生活中創造出來的。

8e88ef8971e58d99.en: The Tottori City Historical Museum (鳥取市歴史博物館, Tottori-shi Rekishi Hakubutsukan) opened in Tottori, Japan, in 2000 and is dedicated to the history of the city.
8e88ef8971e58d99.zh: 鳥取市歷史博物館（鳥取市歴史博物館，Tottori-shi Rekishi Hakubutsukan）於2000年在日本鳥取市開館，以該市的歷史為主題。

8e959ff24d33636b.en: Soba (buckwheat) has been widely cultivated in Ibaraki Prefecture since the Edo period (1603 - 1868) due to the large temperature difference between morning and evening and the large amount of sloping land with good drainage. Even today, the region has one of the largest harvests after Hokkaido, Nagano and Tochigi prefectures, and is also known as a soba production area in the Kanto region. In 1978, Ibaraki Prefecture began breeding soba varieties to create "Hitachi Aki Soba," which is a high-quality brand name in terms of both taste and aroma.
8e959ff24d33636b.zh: 茨城縣因早晚溫差大，且多排水良好的坡地，自江戶時代（1603 - 1868）起即廣泛種植蕎麥。至今收穫量仍僅次於北海道、長野縣與栃木縣，名列前茅，也是關東地區知名的蕎麥產地。1978年，茨城縣開始進行蕎麥品種改良，培育出風味與香氣皆優的高品質品牌「常陸秋蕎麥」。

8ea3fd38c3953311.en: Susa Shrine (須佐神社, Susa Jinja) is a Shinto shrine in Izumo, Shimane, Japan. It is the 18th Shinto shrine in the Enza-no-kai Organization list of shrines and temples considered important to the historical region of Izumo, which includes other major shrines in Shimane and Tottori Prefectures including Izumo-taisha, Kumano-taisha, and Ōgamiyama Jinja.
8ea3fd38c3953311.zh: 須佐神社是位於日本島根縣出雲市的神社。在「縁座の会」所列、對出雲這一歷史地區具有重要意義的神社與寺院名單中排第18號；該名單也包括出雲大社、熊野大社、大神山神社等島根縣與鳥取縣的其他主要神社。

8eb4c4d539072127.en: Egami Church (江上天主堂, Egami Tenshudō) is a Catholic church in Gotō, Nagasaki, Japan.
8eb4c4d539072127.zh: 江上天主堂是位於日本長崎縣五島市的天主教堂。

8ec2cba5302314b6.en: Igisu" is a dish made from "Igisu grass", also called "egonori". It is said to have been sent to the Imperial Court as a gift as early as the Asuka and Nara periods. Igisu grass is a type of seaweed that washes ashore in the spring. It grows up to about 20 cm in length by entangling itself with the body branches of Hondawaras, and has many fine thread-like branches that split into two one after the other. It grows up to about 20 cm in length.
8ec2cba5302314b6.zh: 「いぎす」是用「いぎす草」（又稱「えごのり」）製成的料理。據說早在飛鳥、奈良時代就曾作為貢品送往朝廷。いぎす草是春季被沖上岸的一種海藻。它纏繞在馬尾藻的枝體上生長，長度可達約20公分，有許多細絲狀的分枝，一再分為兩叉。長度可達約20公分。

8ed617b26c2bfcfc.en: Minowa Dam (Japanese: 箕輪ダム) is a dam in the Nagano Prefecture, Japan, completed in 1992.
8ed617b26c2bfcfc.zh: 箕輪ダム是位於日本長野縣的水壩，1992年完工。

8ef365c3cec897f4.en: “Niku Tofu” is a simple dish made of beef, tofu, and green onions. The green onions used in the dish are often “kujo green onions”, a traditional vegetable of Kyoto. These onions are leaf onions (green onions) whose green leaves are eaten. Legend has it that in 771, when the Fushimi Inari Shrine was built, Hata Irogu planted green onions brought from Naniwa. These seeds have been passed down and protected by farmers from generation to generation, earning it the nickname "king of green onions".
8ef365c3cec897f4.zh: 「肉豆腐」是以牛肉、豆腐和蔥做成的簡單料理。這道菜使用的蔥多為京都傳統蔬菜「九條蔥」。九條蔥是食用綠色葉子的葉蔥（青蔥）。相傳771年伏見稻荷大社建立時，秦伊侶具種下了從難波帶來的蔥。這些種子由農家代代傳承守護，因而有「蔥中之王」的稱號。

8ef6c596956b36d9.en: The Shiroyama Dam (城山ダム, Shiroyama damu) is a multi-purpose dam on the main stream Sagami River in Sagamihara, Kanagawa Prefecture on the island of Honshū, Japan.
8ef6c596956b36d9.zh: 城山水壩是位於日本本州神奈川縣相模原市、建於相模川主流上的多功能水壩。

8f06759c3745652b.en: The Sata physic garden (佐多旧薬園, Sata kyu-Yakuen)  was an Edo period physic garden, located in the Sata Izashiki neighborhood of the town of Minamiōsumi, Kagoshima Prefecture Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1932.
8f06759c3745652b.zh: 佐多旧薬園是江戶時代的藥草園，位於日本鹿兒島縣南大隅町佐多伊座敷地區。該地於1932年被指定為日本國家史跡。

8f12e729a0a1d773.en: "Getanha" is one of Kagoshima's local sweets, made to serve tea to people who gathered in Yokogawa Town (now Kirishima City), which used to be a rice-gathering area. It is said that the unique name came from the fact that it resembled the tooth of a geta (Japanese wooden clogs) stained with mud. It was also called "triangular sweets" in those days.The rich brown sugar flavor of "Getanha" spreads in the mouth, and brown sugar is lavishly used in the dough and in the coating around it.
8f12e729a0a1d773.zh: 「げたんは」是鹿兒島的鄉土點心之一，起源於過去曾是稻米集散地的橫川町（現霧島市），用來配茶招待聚集於此的人。據說這個特別的名稱，是因為它的樣子像沾了泥巴的木屐（日本木製拖鞋）的齒。當時也被稱為「三角點心」。「げたんは」入口後散發濃郁的黑糖風味，麵團與外層的糖衣都使用了大量黑糖。

8f14fb1238a1aeae.en: "Teppo-maki", a local dish of Futtsu City, is a thick roll with Bonito flakes, seasoned with soy sauce, and its name comes from its resemblance to a gun.
8f14fb1238a1aeae.zh: 「鉄砲巻き」是富津市的鄉土料理，是以醬油調味的柴魚片為餡的粗卷壽司，因外形像槍而得名。

8f3bf588d6490ebb.en: The Izu Peninsula is Japan's largest producer of red algae, the raw material for tokoroten. Red algae has been harvested for about 1,600 years, and it was used as raw material for Tokoroten as well as fertilizer. Red algae from the Gelidiales order and Gelidiaceae family, known as makusa and oobusa, are commonly used to make tokoroten.
8f3bf588d6490ebb.zh: 伊豆半島是日本最大的石花菜產地，石花菜是ところてん的原料。石花菜的採收已有約1,600年歷史，除了作為ところてん的原料，也用作肥料。製作ところてん常用的是石花菜目石花菜科中稱為「まくさ」與「おおぶさ」的種類。

8f46ded55482fd49.en: The Korekawa Site (是川遺跡, Korekawa iseki) is an archaeological site in the city of Hachinohe, Aomori Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan containing the ruins of a middle to late Jōmon period (3000-1000 BC) settlement.  The remains were designated a National Historic Site in 1957 by the Japanese government.   It is also referred to as the "Korekawa Stone Age site", although the remains discovered are from the Jōmon period, rather than the Japanese Paleolithic period.
8f46ded55482fd49.zh: 是川遺跡是位於日本北部東北地方青森縣八戶市的考古遺址，保存有繩文時代中期至晚期（西元前3000年至前1000年）的聚落遺跡。該遺跡於1957年由日本政府指定為國家史跡。此遺址也稱為「是川石器時代遺跡」，但出土的遺物屬於繩文時代，而非日本舊石器時代。

8f6016f514c164cd.en: "Yan-gome" is a dish of roasted rice and boiled red beans cooked with sugar. While it looks like "Sekihan" (=red rice), it has a subtle sweetness and a light, fluffy texture. It is eaten during "Obon" festival, special occasions, and as a lucky charm dish for a bountiful harvest. It is also called by different names such as "Yan-gome," "Yaki-gome," "Ya-gome," or "Ei-gome," depending on the region. During "Obon" festival, when people do the welcoming and sending-off fires, it is a tradition to light straw on fire.
8f6016f514c164cd.zh: 「ヤンゴメ」是將炒過的米與煮好的紅豆加糖煮成的料理。外觀雖像「赤飯」，但帶有淡淡的甜味，口感輕盈鬆軟。在「盂蘭盆節」、特殊場合時食用，也作為祈求豐收的吉祥料理。依地區不同，也稱為「ヤンゴメ」「焼き米」「ヤゴメ」或「エイゴメ」等。盂蘭盆節期間點迎火與送火時，習俗上會點燃稻草。

8f6990211983147c.en: Hegisoba is a type of cut buckwheat noodle made with seaweed called funori as a binder and served in a wooden tray called a hegi. It is a local dish said to have originated in the Uonuma region, born from the fusion of Niigata Prefecture's textile culture and soba food culture. The "hegi" in hegisoba refers to a square tray made of stripped wooden pieces, and is derived from the Japanese word "hegu," which is a pun on the word "hagu" meaning to peel.
8f6990211983147c.zh: へぎそば是以名為布海苔的海藻作為黏合劑製成的切蕎麥麵，盛在稱為「へぎ」的木盤中上桌。這道鄉土料理據說起源於魚沼地區，由新潟縣的紡織文化與蕎麥飲食文化融合而成。へぎそば的「へぎ」是指用剝下的木片製成的方形盤子，名稱來自日語「へぐ」，是意為剝下的「はぐ」的諧音。

8f731a38075fb4b1.en: Taisan-ji (太山寺) is a Shingon temple in Matsuyama, Ehime Prefecture, Japan. It is Temple 52 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage, and Temple 3 on the Thirteen Buddhist Sites of Iyo. The Hondō is a National Treasure.
8f731a38075fb4b1.zh: 太山寺是位於日本愛媛縣松山市的真言宗寺院，為四國八十八所巡禮的第52號札所，也是伊予十三佛靈場的第3號。本堂為國寶。

8f7aa94505cab0ec.en: Lake Nakatsuna (中綱湖, Nakatsuna-ko) is a lake in Ōmachi Nagano Prefecture, Japan. It is one of the "Nishina Three Lakes" (Lake Aoki, Lake Nakatsuna and Lake Kizaki). Its sediments have been studied in an effort to better understand climate change in Japan, finding evidence of the Medieval Warm Period and Little Ice Age.
8f7aa94505cab0ec.zh: 中綱湖是位於日本長野縣大町市的湖泊，為「仁科三湖」（青木湖、中綱湖、木崎湖）之一。為進一步了解日本的氣候變遷，曾有人研究此湖的沉積物，並從中發現中世紀溫暖期與小冰期的證據。

8f9eccd3c660f582.en: According to statistics published in 2019 by the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries of Japan, Kumamoto prefecture is the highest producer of horsemeat in Japan. Other names for horsemeat aside from “baniku” are “sakura-niku” or “ketobashi.” Horsemeat sashimi is a specialty of this region. Japanese daimyo Kiyomasa Kato of the Higo domain had no choice but to eat the meat of a military horse during his expedition to Korea because he ran out of food.
8f9eccd3c660f582.zh: 根據日本農林水產省2019年公布的統計，熊本縣是日本馬肉產量最高的地區。馬肉除了「馬肉」之外，還有「櫻肉」或「けとばし」等名稱。馬肉刺身是此地區的特產。肥後藩的大名加藤清正在出兵朝鮮時因糧食耗盡，不得不吃軍馬的肉。

8fb1f18db97115e6.en: Asahi-ku (旭) is one of the 18 wards of the city of Yokohama in Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. As of 2010, the ward has an estimated population of 249,045 and a population density of 7,600 persons per km2. The total area is 32.77  km2.
8fb1f18db97115e6.zh: 旭區（旭）是日本神奈川縣橫濱市18個行政區之一。截至2010年，該區估計人口為249,045人，人口密度為每平方公里7,600人，總面積32.77平方公里。

8fda99d5784362c1.en: Iwakitaira Castle (磐城平城, Iwakitaira-jō) is a hilltop-style Japanese castle located in the city of Iwaki, Fukushima Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of Japan. It also called Ryūgajō Castle (龍ヶ城) .  Built in the early Edo period, it served as the headquarters for a succession of daimyō of Iwakitaira Domain under the Tokugawa shogunate. The site is now mostly on private lands, with only a small portion of the moats and ramparts remaining.
8fda99d5784362c1.zh: 磐城平城是山城式的日本城郭，位於日本東北地方福島縣磐城市，又稱龍ヶ城。建於江戶時代初期，德川幕府治下為磐城平藩歷代大名的據點。城址現今大多位於私有土地上，僅存少部分護城河與土壘。

8fdadf582a8962b9.en: "Kaiso Yose(=Seaweed yose)" is a local dish eaten along the Kashima coast, extending from Kashima in Ibaraki Prefecture to Choshi in Chiba Prefecture. One of these is kotojitsunomata and tsunomata, which are the main ingredients of "Kaiso Yose(=Seaweed yose)".The Katsuraura coast is blessed with various marine delicacies because it is a convergence point where the Kuroshio Current and Oyashio Current collide. Choshi Port boasts the highest volume of catches in Japan, and in addition to fish, you can also catch an abundance of seaweed.
8fdadf582a8962b9.zh: 「海藻よせ」是從茨城縣鹿嶋到千葉縣銚子一帶的鹿島沿岸所吃的鄉土料理。其中，琴爪角叉菜與角叉菜是「海藻よせ」的主要食材。桂浦海岸位於黑潮與親潮交會之處，海產豐富。銚子港的漁獲量為日本第一，除了魚類之外，也能採收大量海藻。

8fed3065cb70f539.en: The Niigata-City Performing Arts Center (新潟市民芸術文化会館, Niigata-shimin geijutsu-bunka-kaikan) is a large multi-purpose public cultural facility in Chūō-ku, Niigata, Japan, which opened on 22 October 1998.
8fed3065cb70f539.zh: 新潟市民芸術文化会館是位於日本新潟市中央區的大型多功能公共文化設施，於1998年10月22日開館。

8ffa507150886e85.en: Katashida Castle (堅志田城, Katashida-jō) was a Sengoku period yamajiro-style Japanese castle located in the Katashida neighborhood of the town of Misato, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2006.
8ffa507150886e85.zh: 堅志田城是戰國時代的山城式日本城郭，位於日本熊本縣美里町堅志田地區。其遺址自2006年起被列為國家史跡保護。

90254626bdb64c4a.en: “Megisu” (deep-sea smelt) is a slender fish about 20 cm long that live along the Pacific coast and the Sea of Japan. It is similar in appearance to “kisu” (=Japanese whiting) and another name for megisu is “nigisu”. The name megisu is said to come from the local dialect of Ishikawa meaning big, gaping eyes.The number of megisu caught in Japan is the highest in Ishikawa prefecture and about ten percent of the total is caught in Kanazawa city. The fish is not expensive, and so people use this fish for daily meals.
90254626bdb64c4a.zh: 「メギス」（深海胡瓜魚）是一種體長約20公分的細長魚類，棲息於太平洋沿岸及日本海。外觀與「鱚」（多鱗鱚）相似，別名「ニギス」。據說メギス一名源自石川方言，意思是眼睛又大又圓睜。日本的メギス漁獲量以石川縣最多，其中約一成在金澤市捕獲。這種魚價格不高，因此人們將其用於日常飲食。

902bdcfed54699a3.en: "Nasu no Hana-zushi" is a pickled dish made by layering large, sliced eggplants with glutinous rice, chrysanthemum flowers, and red chili peppers. It is called "Sushi" because it uses rice. In some regions, it might be called "Hanakko" or "Nasukko." In Akita, there are many pickled dishes, but "Nasu no Hana-zushi" is an indispensable dish for the New Year. The contrasting colors of the purple eggplant, yellow chrysanthemum flowers, and red chili peppers create a beautiful and festive appearance.
902bdcfed54699a3.zh: 「なすの花ずし」是將切開的大茄子與糯米、菊花、紅辣椒層層疊放醃漬而成的料理。因使用米飯，所以稱為「壽司」。部分地區也稱為「花っこ」或「なすっこ」。秋田有許多醃漬料理，其中「なすの花ずし」是新年不可或缺的一道菜。紫色茄子、黃色菊花與紅辣椒色彩對比，外觀美麗而喜慶。

902ed60aed29943f.en: The southern region of the prefecture has a comparatively warm climate, and has long produced primarily rice, which could be cultivated reliably. In the Edo period, by decree of the Sendai Clan that governed the Ichinoseki and Hiraizumi region, mochi rice cakes were to be made and offered to the gods and Buddha on the 1st and 15th of each month as prayers for peace and good health, with this practice then becoming tradition.
902ed60aed29943f.zh: 縣南部氣候較為溫暖，長久以來主要生產能穩定栽培的稻米。江戶時代，依統治一關與平泉地區的仙台藩之命，每月1日與15日須製作麻糬供奉神佛，祈求平安與健康，這個做法後來成為傳統。

903970b606a7bd58.en: Shimokoshiki Island (下甑島, Shimokoshiki-shima) is the largest island in the Koshikishima Islands. Its coasts are washed by East China Sea. The island's highest peak is Mount Otake 604 m (1,982 ft) housing a long-range radar station of the Japan Air Self-Defense Force at 31.694625°N 129.715992°E﻿ / 31.694625; 129.715992.
903970b606a7bd58.zh: 下甑島（下甑島）是甑島列島中最大的島嶼，沿岸面臨東海。島上最高峰為尾岳，高604公尺（1,982英尺），山上設有日本航空自衛隊的長程雷達站，位於北緯31.694625度、東經129.715992度。

90404fb03edbd993.en: Kasamori-ji (笠森寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the town of Chōnan, Chiba Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the  Tendai sect and its honzon is a hibutsu statue of Jūichimen Kannon Bosatsu shown to the public in the years of the Ox and Horse in the 12-year cycle of the Chinese zodiac.  The temple's full name is Daihi-zan Nankō-in Kasamori-ji (大悲山 楠光院 笠森寺).The temple is the 31st stop on the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route. The temple is also called "Kasamori-dera" using the alternate pronunciation of the Chinese character for temple (tera).
90404fb03edbd993.zh: 笠森寺是位於日本千葉縣長南町的佛教寺院，屬天台宗，本尊為祕佛十一面觀音菩薩像，於十二生肖的丑年與午年公開。寺院全名為大悲山 楠光院 笠森寺。本寺是坂東三十三所巡禮路線的第31番札所。由於「寺」字另有「tera」的讀法，本寺也稱為「Kasamori-dera」。

9061054d271b1731.en: Rakuju-en (楽寿園) is a public park with a Japanese garden and zoo, located in the city of Mishima, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. It was designated as a National Place of Scenic Beauty of Japan as well as a Natural monument of Japan in 1954. In 2012, the Rakuju-en was designated as part of the Izu Peninsula Geopark.
9061054d271b1731.zh: 楽寿園是位於日本靜岡縣三島市的公立公園，設有日本庭園與動物園。1954年受指定為日本國家名勝及天然紀念物。2012年，楽寿園被納入伊豆半島地質公園範圍。

909c5b3013e1a7a9.en: The Ichinomiya Sengen Jinja (一宮浅間神社) is a Shintō shrine in the Takata neighborhood of the town of Ichikawamisato, Nishiyatsushiro District in Yamanashi Prefecture, Japan. It is one of two shrines which vie for the title of ichinomiya of the former Kai Province. The main festival of the shrine is held annually on November 3. It is also known as simply the Ichikawa Ichinomiya (市川一の宮) or the  Ichinomiya Myōjin (一ノ宮明神) or the Ichinomiya Asama Jinja.
909c5b3013e1a7a9.zh: 一宮浅間神社是位於日本山梨縣西八代郡市川三鄉町高田的神社，是爭取舊甲斐國一宮名號的兩座神社之一。神社的例大祭每年於11月3日舉行。又稱市川一の宮、一ノ宮明神，或一宮淺間神社（Asama Jinja）。

909ecc3eb1eccd03.en: The Hanami River (花見川, Hanami-gawa) is a river in Yachiyo and Chiba, Chiba Prefecture, Japan. The river is 18.9 kilometers (11.7 mi) in length and has a drainage area of 94.5 square kilometers (36.5 sq mi). The Hanami is one part of the Inba Discharge Channel (印旛放水路, Inba Hōsuiro). The upper part of the drainage facility is designated as the Shin River. The lower part, the Hanami, ranges from the Ōwada Drainage Pump Station in Yachiyo City, and drains into Tokyo Bay in the Mihama Ward of Chiba City.
909ecc3eb1eccd03.zh: 花見川是流經日本千葉縣八千代市與千葉市的河川，全長18.9公里（11.7英里），流域面積94.5平方公里（36.5平方英里）。花見川是印旛放水路的一部分。這項排水設施的上游段稱為新川，下游段即花見川，自八千代市的大和田排水機場起，在千葉市美濱區注入東京灣。

90af514b4765fbca.en: Junjun is a hotpot dish of beef, chicken, lake fish, and so on seasoned in the style of sukiyaki. Junjun made with beef or chicken is eaten on special occasions such as the New Year and Obon. Junjun made with lake fish is mainly eaten around lakes such as the Kohoku region, Kosai region, Koto region, and Okishima.It is said that the name “junjun” comes from the sound that is made when the ingredients are boiled in a pot.
90af514b4765fbca.zh: 「じゅんじゅん」是以壽喜燒方式調味，放入牛肉、雞肉、湖魚等食材的火鍋料理。用牛肉或雞肉做的じゅんじゅん會在新年、盂蘭盆節等特別場合食用；用湖魚做的じゅんじゅん則主要在湖北地區、湖西地區、湖東地區及沖島等湖泊周邊食用。據說「じゅんじゅん」這個名稱來自食材在鍋中煮滾時發出的聲音。

90b1e0a227d4310c.en: Gunma Prefecture boasts its agricultural and livestock farm industry, and raising chicken is no exception. Especially ‘Joshu Jidori’, raised with feeding mulberry leaves and plum vinegar, is unique with fresh and juicy flavor. It is used in various dishes like ‘Sukiyaki’ or hotpot. ‘Tori Meshi’ has been popular for a long time in Gunma, which is very proud of its chicken. Sliced chicken grilled with sauce and served with rice. It is popular not only among with the local Gunma, but also with tourists.
90b1e0a227d4310c.zh: 群馬縣的農畜產業發達，養雞也不例外。其中以桑葉和梅醋飼養的「上州地雞」，風味鮮美多汁，別具特色，用於壽喜燒、火鍋等各種料理。在以雞肉自豪的群馬，「鶏めし」長久以來廣受喜愛，作法是將雞肉切片淋醬燒烤，搭配米飯。不僅受到群馬當地人歡迎，也很受觀光客喜愛。

90c55b1c18986f60.en: Nikaho Green Field (仁賀保グリーンフィールド, Nikaho Gurin Firudo)  is a football stadium in Nikaho, Akita Prefecture, Japan. The stadium has a capacity of 4,430 and was the home ground of J3 League club Blaublitz Akita.
90c55b1c18986f60.zh: 仁賀保グリーンフィールド是位於日本秋田縣にかほ市的足球場，可容納4,430人，曾是J3聯賽球隊秋田藍色閃電（Blaublitz Akita）的主場。

90c86b1aa272e4bb.en: In the Sanin region facing the northern side of the Chugoku region, there is a custom of eating whale on Setsubun, with the wish of "eating something big to grow old gracefully" or "eating something big to ward off evil spirits." Among them, Yamaguchi Prefecture has a long-standing connection with whales. Nagato, in particular, has a history of whaling, thriving as a town with whales until the end of whaling in 1910. Even now, the people have faith in whales that brought prosperity and conduct annual ceremonies.
90c86b1aa272e4bb.zh: 在面向中國地方北側的山陰地方，有在節分吃鯨魚的習俗，寄託「吃大的東西，安穩長壽」或「吃大的東西，驅除邪靈」的心願。其中，山口縣與鯨魚的淵源由來已久。尤其長門有捕鯨的歷史，直到1910年捕鯨結束為止，都是以鯨魚而興盛的城鎮。至今當地人仍敬奉帶來繁榮的鯨魚，每年舉行祭儀。

90dcc9467a3c04b1.en: An unprocessed dessert made by mixing and kneading flour and sugar into green soybeans that have been boiled and mashed. The “shitogi” part refers to the dish made with rice crushed into flour – said to be a prototype to present day mochi – and once used as an offering at shrines all over the country. The Nanbu region was often beset by cold weather that damaged crops, and with rice being so precious, soybeans were added to the recipe so it could still be made.
90dcc9467a3c04b1.zh: 將煮熟搗碎的青大豆拌入麵粉與砂糖揉製而成、不經加熱處理的點心。「しとぎ」指的是以米磨成粉製成的食物，據說是現今麻糬的原型，過去曾在全國各地的神社作為供品。南部地區常受冷害影響作物收成，米十分珍貴，因此在做法中加入大豆，使這道點心仍能製作。

90f9e7515e1cde7d.en: Pickles simmered in miso is a dish made by simmering pickled Napa cabbage in a pot of salty "Gujo miso," a soybean miso, and dried fish stock. This local dish was created by the wisdom of our ancestors, who used every available ingredient during the cold winter months when foodstuffs were scarce.It is said to have originated when people working in charcoal-making huts used a canned mackerel as a container and filled it with pickled Napa cabbage.
90f9e7515e1cde7d.zh: 漬物味噌煮是將醃白菜放入鍋中，以鹹味的豆味噌「郡上味噌」和小魚乾高湯燉煮而成的料理。這道鄉土料理出自先人的智慧，在食材匱乏的寒冷冬季善用每一樣可取得的食材。據說起源於在燒炭小屋工作的人，以鯖魚罐頭的空罐為容器，裝入醃白菜燉煮。

9115747312e5ae40.en: Tachiuo (=beltfish) is a saltwater fish of the cutlassfish family and its total length exceeds 2 meters (about 80 inches) in the largest fish. It is a tasty fish with little fishiness and fat, so even children who do not like fish can enjoy eating it. It is said that a long-established fishmonger in Uwajima City, which has been in business for 150 years, invented the tachiuo roll in 1987, in which the tachiuo is wrapped around a bamboo skewer.
9115747312e5ae40.zh: 太刀魚（白帶魚）是帶魚科的海水魚，最大的個體全長超過2公尺（約80英寸）。這種魚腥味少、油脂少，味道鮮美，連不喜歡吃魚的孩子也能吃得津津有味。據說宇和島市一家已營業150年的老字號魚店在1987年發明了太刀魚卷，將太刀魚捲在竹籤上。

91262c3a706147a6.en: Sun Arena is an indoor sporting arena located in the city of Ise, Mie Prefecture, Japan.  The capacity of the arena is 11,000. The arena was host to the 2009 World Rhythmic Gymnastics Championships.
91262c3a706147a6.zh: 三重縣營サンアリーナ是位於日本三重縣伊勢市的室內體育館，可容納11,000人。2009年世界韻律體操錦標賽曾在此舉行。

912e94d6849a3f70.en: Ikata-cho is located on the Sadamisaki Peninsula, the narrowest peninsula in Japan and it has two fishing grounds, one in Seto Inland Sea and the other in Uwakai Sea. Rice could not be grown on the coastal areas, so the local people grew barley and sweet potatoes and ate them instead. Sweet potatoes were dried to make them last longer. “Kankoro” is a traditional dessert made using these dried sweet potatoes. The name is said to come from the sound of the wooden rice paddle when mixing the potatoes and azuki beans in the pan.
912e94d6849a3f70.zh: 伊方町位於日本最細長的半島佐田岬半島上，擁有瀨戶內海與宇和海兩個漁場。沿岸地區無法種稻，當地人便種植大麥和番薯作為主食。番薯會曬乾以延長保存期限。かんころ是用這種番薯乾製成的傳統甜點。名稱據說來自在鍋中攪拌番薯和紅豆時，木飯勺發出的聲音。

9143065e9a23e253.en: The Hara Model Railway Museum (原鉄道模型博物館, Hara Tetsudō Mokei Hakubutsukan) is a model railway museum in Nishi-ku, Yokohama, Japan, which opened on 10 July 2012. Managed by Mitsui Fudosan, the museum houses the extensive collection of model trains built and amassed by the Japanese model railway enthusiast Nobutaro Hara (原 信太郎, Hara Nobutarō). The museum covers an area of approximately 1,700 m², with the display area covering an area of approximately 1,200 m².
9143065e9a23e253.zh: 原鉄道模型博物館（原鉄道模型博物館，Hara Tetsudō Mokei Hakubutsukan）是位於日本橫濱市西區的鐵道模型博物館，於2012年7月10日開館。該館由三井不動產管理，收藏日本鐵道模型愛好者原信太郎（原 信太郎，Hara Nobutarō）製作及蒐集的大量模型列車。博物館面積約1,700平方公尺，其中展示區約1,200平方公尺。

91581794b93b32b0.en: The Kora Taisha Festival (Korasan-Kunchi) held at the Kora Taisha Shrine, the number one shrine in Chikugo Province, is a festival that combines the celebration of Chou-you Festival and the autumn harvest festival. Chou-you is 9th of September in the old calendar and is considered to be a lucky day and is also known as "Kikuno-sekku". Korasan-Kunchi is a historic festival that has been worshipped by the lord of the Kurume domain since the Edo period (1603-1868).
91581794b93b32b0.zh: 在筑後國一宮高良大社舉行的高良大社祭典（高良山くんち），是結合重陽節慶祝與秋季收穫祭的祭典。重陽是舊曆9月9日，被視為吉日，又稱「菊の節句」。高良山くんち是歷史悠久的祭典，自江戶時代（1603-1868）起即受到久留米藩主的崇敬。

915e50e262e9a075.en: The Ryukyu Kingdom’s growth reflects the influence of China; in Ryukyuan sweets, too, Japanese and Chinese styles are intermixed. When the refined techniques of confectionary artisans were added to this mix, what emerged were treats well-suited to Okinawa Prefecture’s hot climate. Sweets that keep especially well, such as those that are fried or baked, are numerous. Such sweets are essential when putting on events like celebrations and rituals. One nationally recognized example of Okinawan sweets and snacks is sata andagi.
915e50e262e9a075.zh: 琉球王國的發展反映了中國的影響；琉球點心也融合了日本與中國的風格。再加上點心師傅的精湛技藝，便誕生了適合沖繩縣炎熱氣候的點心。油炸或烘烤等特別耐放的點心為數眾多。這類點心在舉辦慶祝與祭祀等活動時不可或缺。サーターアンダーギー就是全國知名的沖繩點心之一。

917e30b38f286f7f.en: Toyama Prefectural Museum of Art and Design (富山県美術館, Toyama-ken Bijutsukan) opened in Toyama, Toyama Prefecture, Japan in 2017, superseding and replacing the former Museum of Modern Art, Toyama (1981–2016). The collection combines 20th- and 21st-century art with design, and includes works by Pablo Picasso, Joan Miró, and Munakata Shikō, as well as posters and chairs.
917e30b38f286f7f.zh: 富山縣美術館於2017年在日本富山縣富山市開館，取代原本的富山縣立近代美術館（1981–2016）。館藏結合20世紀與21世紀的藝術與設計，包括畢卡索（Pablo Picasso）、米羅（Joan Miró）、棟方志功的作品，以及海報與椅子。

918116ff8c295d1a.en: Kagami-jinja (鏡神社) is a Shinto shrine located in Karatsu, Saga prefecture, Japan. The shrine is at the base of Mount Kagami (280 metres (920 ft)) in Genkai Quasi-National Park. It is now called Matsura Sōchinshu Kagami-jinja (松浦総鎮守鏡神社), and formerly known as the name of Kagami no mikoto Byōgū (鏡尊廟宮), Kagami-gū (鏡宮), Matsuura-gū (松浦宮), Itabitsu-sha (板櫃社) and Kuri Daimyōjin (久里大明神).
918116ff8c295d1a.zh: 鏡神社是位於日本佐賀縣唐津市的神社，坐落於玄海國定公園內鏡山（280公尺（920英尺））山腳。現稱松浦總鎮守鏡神社，舊稱鏡尊廟宮、鏡宮、松浦宮、板櫃社及久里大明神。

9184e3ee9b21e03f.en: Kumabe clan yakata ruins (隈部氏館跡, Kumabe-shi yakata ato) is the site of a Sengoku period fortified manor located  in the present-day Furushiro-cho neighborhood of the city of Yamaga, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2013. It is also called Nagano Castle (永野城跡).
9184e3ee9b21e03f.zh: 隈部氏館跡是戰國時代設防宅邸的遺址，位於今日本熊本縣山鹿市菊鹿町古城一帶。遺址自2013年起被列為國家指定史跡。又稱永野城跡。

9186600c73fd6d2f.en: Nakaiwa Dam is a gravity dam located in Tochigi prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for power production. The catchment area of the dam is 697 km2. The dam impounds about 12  ha of land when full and can store 1488 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1922 and completed in 1924.
9186600c73fd6d2f.zh: 中岩ダム是位於日本栃木縣的重力壩，用於發電。集水面積為697平方公里，滿水時淹沒面積約12公頃，蓄水量為148.8萬立方公尺。水壩於1922年動工，1924年完工。

91932a2600d114a0.en: The Hokkaido Museum of Northern Peoples (北海道立北方民族博物館, Hokkaidō-ritsu Hoppō Minzoku Hakubutsukan) opened in Abashiri, Hokkaidō, Japan in 1991. Dedicated to the various peoples of the North, across Eurasia and the Americas, the collection includes items relating to the Sámi, Nanai, Nivkhs, and Northwest Coast Indians, as well as the more local Okhotsk culture and Ainu.
91932a2600d114a0.zh: 北海道立北方民族博物館於1991年在日本北海道網走開館。該館以歐亞大陸及美洲各北方民族為主題，館藏包括與薩米人、那乃人、尼夫赫人、西北海岸印第安人，以及當地的鄂霍次克文化與愛努族相關的物品。

91df6dfc8239aa76.en: Kitsuki Castle (杵築城, Kitsuki-jō) is an Edo period yamajiro-style Japanese castle located in the city of Kitsuki, Ōita Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2020. The current castle, a replica tenshu built in 1970, is considered to be the smallest castle in Japan.
91df6dfc8239aa76.zh: 杵築城是江戶時代的山城式日本城郭，位於日本大分縣杵築市。其遺跡自2020年起受國家史跡保護。現存的城為1970年建造的天守複製建築，被認為是日本最小的城。

91e18252c79fc958.en: Nippara Shōnyūdō (Japanese: 日原鍾乳洞, lit. 'Nippara limestone cave'), located in Nippara, Okutama, Nishitama District, Tokyo, Japan, is a limestone cave. It is over 1270m long from the entrance to the end, and it measures 134m from the depths to the ceiling. It has been registered a natural monument in Tokyo; equally large as Roukokudō, the two caves are known as one of the largest caves in the Kanto region. The cave flourished as a sacred mountain in the past and is a well-known tourist site as of modern times.
91e18252c79fc958.zh: 日原鍾乳洞是位於日本東京都西多摩郡奧多摩町日原的石灰岩洞穴。從入口到盡頭全長超過1270公尺，最深處至洞頂高低差134公尺。已登錄為東京都天然紀念物；與規模相當的ろうこく洞並列為關東地區最大的洞穴之一。此洞過去作為靈山而興盛，現代則是知名的觀光景點。

91f18c7c51b8d6d3.en: Lemon Steak is a local specialty that has been enjoyed in Sasebo City, Nagasaki Prefecture, since around 1955. In Sasebo, the influence of the newly established United States Navy base shortly after World War II led to the early popularity of American-style steaks in the neighborhood. In the midst of this trend, around 1955 (Showa 30), two brothers working at a Western-style restaurant decided to create a steak with a refreshing taste more suited to Japanese palates.
91f18c7c51b8d6d3.zh: 「レモンステーキ」（檸檬牛排）是長崎縣佐世保市自1955年左右起受到喜愛的在地名產。在佐世保，受到二次世界大戰後不久新設立的美國海軍基地影響，美式牛排很早就在附近一帶流行。在這股風潮中，1955年（昭和30年）左右，在一家西餐廳工作的兩兄弟決定做出一種口味清爽、更符合日本人口味的牛排。

92110abc081a295f.en: Kurume City Art Museum (久留米市美術館, Kurume-shi Bijutsukan) opened as the successor to the Ishibashi Museum of Art in Kurume, Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan in 2016. It forms part of the Ishibashi Culture Center, which opened in 1956, alongside the studio of yōga painter Sakamoto Hanjirō (坂本繁二郎), relocated from Yame in 1980, and Shōjirō Ishibashi Memorial Museum, dedicated to the founder of Bridgestone and donated to the city by the Ishibashi Foundation after renovation in 2016, on the sixtieth anniversary of the Ishibashi Culture Center's opening.
92110abc081a295f.zh: 久留米市美術館於2016年在日本福岡縣久留米市開館，接續石橋美術館。美術館是1956年開館的石橋文化中心的一部分，中心內另有1980年從八女遷建而來的洋畫家坂本繁二郎畫室，以及紀念普利司通創辦人的石橋正二郎紀念館；該紀念館經整修後，於石橋文化中心開館六十週年的2016年由石橋財團捐贈給市政府。

9238e7345defa534.en: The Hotta-no-saku ruins (払田柵跡, Hotta-no-saku iseki) is an archaeological site containing the ruins of a large-scale Heian period josaku-style fortified settlement located in what is now part of the municipalities of Daisen and Misato in the Tōhoku region of Japan.  The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1931. The site is maintained  as an archaeological park with some reconstructed buildings.
9238e7345defa534.zh: 払田柵跡是位於今日本東北地方大仙市與美鄉町境內的考古遺址，保存有大規模平安時代城柵式防禦聚落遺跡。遺址於1931年被指定為國家史跡，現整備為考古公園，並有部分復原建築。

92472988b69216f0.en: The Moyoro Shell Midden (モヨロ貝塚, Moyoro kaizuka) is an archaeological site in the Kita 1-jo and Kita 3-jo Higashi 2-chome neighborhood of the city of Abashiri, Hokkaido, Japan with an Okhotsk culture shell midden.  The site was designated a  National Historic Site in 1936. Its name is also written in kanji as "最寄貝塚".
92472988b69216f0.zh: モヨロ貝塚是位於日本北海道網走市北1條及北3條東2丁目地區的考古遺址，為鄂霍次克文化的貝塚。該遺址於1936年被指定為國家史跡。其名稱的漢字寫法也作「最寄貝塚」。

926b60ea9c668f64.en: Kanō Tenman-gū (加納天満宮) is a Shinto shrine located in the city of Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It was built as the shrine to protect Izumii Castle (predecessor to Kanō Castle). As a Tenman-gū, it is dedicated to Tenjin, the deified form of Sugawara no Michizane. Additionally, Matsudaira Mitsushige, who first created Gifu Umbrellas, is also canonized on the shrine grounds. The shrine's festival is held on the third Saturday and Sunday of October each year.
926b60ea9c668f64.zh: 加納天滿宮（加納天満宮）是位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市的神社，當初作為守護沢井城（加納城的前身）的神社而建。作為天滿宮，祭祀的是菅原道真神格化後的天神。此外，首創岐阜和傘的松平光重也被奉祀於神社境內。神社祭典每年於10月第三個週六、週日舉行。

92743a08bdd71b8a.en: In Kagawa Prefecture, the farming season begins in May, when wheat is harvested, and ends in June, when rice planting takes place. Around July 2, which is called "Han-ge-sho," is a milestone, and farmers rush to finish rice planting by "Han-ge" or "Han-ge-han-tsukkuri," to avoid being behind schedule. It is also known as "Hange-no-hageagari" and is the time when the continuous rain stops and the rainy season ends. On this sunny day, people make and eat "hage dango" to relieve their fatigue for about half a day.
92743a08bdd71b8a.zh: 在香川縣，農忙期從5月收割小麥開始，到6月插秧結束。7月2日前後稱為「半夏生」，是一個重要節點，農民趕在「半夏」或「半夏半作」之前完成插秧，以免進度落後。這段時間也稱為「半夏のはげあがり」，正是連綿的雨停歇、梅雨季結束的時候。在這個晴天，人們製作並食用「はげ団子」，約休息半天以消除疲勞。

928be742219b1f24.en: "Izushi" is sushi made by lactic acid fermentation in low temperature with fish, vegetables and Rice koji (=malted rice). It is a local dish handed down in the coast area from Hokkaido to Tohoku region, known with low temperature. It is said that the origin is from a meal cooked in fishery family when they have first snow in the season. The recipe is different from the region.Various kinds of fish from Hokkaido, like atka mackerel, salmon, hatahata(=sandfish), herring or pacific saury, are used in "Izushi".
928be742219b1f24.zh: 「飯寿司」是以魚、蔬菜和米麴在低溫下經乳酸發酵製成的壽司，是流傳於北海道至東北地區、以氣溫低著稱的沿海一帶的鄉土料理。據說起源於漁家在當季初雪時烹調的餐食。做法因地區而異。「飯寿司」使用北海道產的多種魚類，如花魚、鮭魚、鰰（雷魚）、鯡魚或秋刀魚。

92901cc149bf04e8.en: Black soybeans from Tamba Sasayama are said to be of the highest quality among black soybeans, with large grains and high sugar content due to the clayey, fertile soil of the region and the intense temperature difference between day and night. They are characterized by their large size, slightly sweet taste, and the skin is difficult to tear. Farmers cultivated black soybeans for shipping and for their own consumption using the paths in the rice paddies.
92901cc149bf04e8.zh: 丹波篠山的黑豆據說是黑豆中品質最高的，由於當地土壤為黏質且肥沃，加上日夜溫差大，豆粒大且含糖量高。其特徵是顆粒大、味道微甜，豆皮不易破裂。農家利用稻田的田埂種植黑豆，供出貨及自家食用。

929a0cd18e7cd33b.en: Ibo No Ito, a Banshu soumen characterized by its firm, crisp texture and resistance to boil-through, is a specialty of the Harima region.The history of soumen in Japan dates back to the Nara period when Japanese envoys to the Tang Dynasty brought back from China a sweet called sakubei, from which soumen was derived. The connection with soumen in the Banshu area of Hyogo Prefecture can be seen in an ancient document from Ikaruga Temple (Taishi Town, Ibo-gun), which mentions soumen in a clause dated 1418 (Oei 25).
929a0cd18e7cd33b.zh: 「揖保乃糸」是口感緊實有嚼勁、久煮不易糊爛的播州素麵，為播磨地區的特產。日本素麵的歷史可追溯至奈良時代，當時遣唐使從中國帶回一種稱為索餅的點心，素麵即由此演變而來。兵庫縣播州地區與素麵的淵源，可見於斑鳩寺（揖保郡太子町）的古文書，其中1418年（應永25年）的條目中記載了素麵。

92d335768d4e96ff.en: In regions along the Kumano Sea, where there is limited flat land suitable for rice cultivation due to the proximity of mountains to the sea, sweet potatoes (satsuma imo) became a staple food alongside barley. The red soil plateau makes it easy to cultivate sweet potatoes, and the sweet flavor of the harvested produce makes it a daily dietary staple, often replacing rice.
92d335768d4e96ff.zh: 熊野灘沿岸地區山海相近，適合種稻的平地有限，因此甘藷（薩摩芋）與大麥同為主食。紅土台地容易栽種甘藷，收成的甘藷味道香甜，成為日常主食，常取代米飯。

92e68fd8b42c0037.en: The Yonezawa Domain Uesugi clan cemetery  (米沢藩主上杉家墓所, Yonezawa-han-shu Uesugi-ke bosho) is located in the city of Yonezawa, Yamagata. The cemetery contains the graves of the successive daimyō of Yonezawa Domain over a 390-year period, each housed in its own memorial wooden chapel. The cemetery was designated a National Historic Site in 1984.
92e68fd8b42c0037.zh: 上杉家廟所（米澤藩主上杉家墓所）位於山形縣米澤市。墓地內有米澤藩歷代大名390年間的墳墓，每座各自安置於木造的靈屋中。該墓地於1984年被指定為國家史跡。

93066cb64076906a.en: Ryuukou-ji (Japanese: 龍光寺) is a temple in Uwajima, Ehime Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Shingon-shū Omuro-ha sect of Japanese Buddhism. It is Temple # 41 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage. The main image is of Jūichimen Kannon (Ekādaśamukha).
93066cb64076906a.zh: 龍光寺是位於日本愛媛縣宇和島市的寺院，屬於日本佛教真言宗御室派。為四國八十八所靈場第41號札所。本尊為十一面觀音。

93133f9bc4cb90a4.en: Ichiuji Castle (一宇治城, Ichiuji-jō) is a castle structure in Hioki, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan.　Ichiuji Castle is also called Ijūin Castle.
93133f9bc4cb90a4.zh: 一宇治城是位於日本鹿兒島縣日置市的城郭建築。一宇治城又稱伊集院城。

931a53941b9a3364.en: Kitakyushu Museum of Natural History & Human History (北九州市立いのちのたび博物館[自然史・歴史博物館], Kitakyūshū Shiritsu Inochi-no-Tabi Hakubutsukan (Shizenshi-Rekishi Hakubutsukan)) opened in Kitakyushu, Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan, in 2002. Exhibiting materials relating to the city's natural history, archaeology, and history, it is successor of the Kitakyushu Museum of History (北九州市立歴史博物館), which opened in 1975, the Kitakyushu Museum of Natural History (北九州市立自然史博物館), which opened in 1981, and the Kitakyushu Museum of Archaeology (北九州市立考古博物館), which opened in 1983.
931a53941b9a3364.zh: 北九州市立いのちのたび博物館（自然史・歴史博物館）於2002年在日本福岡縣北九州市開館，展示與該市自然史、考古及歷史相關的資料。其前身為1975年開館的北九州市立歴史博物館、1981年開館的北九州市立自然史博物館，以及1983年開館的北九州市立考古博物館。

931adba7d4db5db2.en: "Seige (se-e-ge)" is a local dish in Fukui Prefecture, featuring the winter delicacy known as Echizen crab. Specifically, it uses female snow crabs called "seiko gani" . This dish is a regional specialty that highlights the unique flavors of the female snow crab in the Echizen region of Fukui. It is a local dish that has been eaten in the Kono district of Minami-Echizen Town, which has prospered from fishing since the Edo period, and each family has its own recipe.
931adba7d4db5db2.zh: 「せいげ」是福井縣的鄉土料理，使用冬季美味越前蟹，更確切地說，是使用稱為「せいこがに」的雌性松葉蟹。這道料理是福井縣越前地區的特色菜，呈現雌松葉蟹獨特的風味。這是南越前町河野地區自古食用的鄉土料理，當地自江戶時代起因漁業而繁榮，各家庭都有自己的做法。

932477e8d6640da1.ja: 嶋遺跡公園（しまいせきこうえん）は、山形県山形市嶋北2丁目3にある公園。園内には1966年（昭和41年）に国の史跡に指定された嶋遺跡がある。
932477e8d6640da1.zh: 嶋遺跡公園是位於山形縣山形市嶋北2丁目3的公園。園內有1966年（昭和41年）被指定為國家史跡的嶋遺跡。

93415d8824dc1216.en: Asahigawa Dam (Japanese: 旭川ダム) is a dam on Asahi River straddling the border between Kibichūō and northern Takebe, Okayama in Okayama Prefecture, Japan. The dam was completed in 1954.
93415d8824dc1216.zh: 旭川ダム是位於日本岡山縣旭川上的水壩，橫跨吉備中央町與岡山市建部北部的交界，於1954年完工。

934a5f83bd890a3d.en: The Great Hanshin-Awaji Earthquake Memorial Disaster Reduction and Human Renovation Institution (阪神・淡路大震災記念 人と防災未来センター) is the earthquake disaster memorial museum that located in Chūō-ku, Kobe (HAT Kobe), Hyōgo Prefecture in Japan. It collects and preserves materials related to the Great Hanshin-Awaji Earthquake and subsequent reconstruction.
934a5f83bd890a3d.zh: 阪神・淡路大震災記念 人と防災未来センター是位於日本兵庫縣神戶市中央區（HAT神戶）的地震災害紀念館，蒐集並保存與阪神・淡路大震災及其後重建相關的資料。

934c4a42b8f9b820.en: A local dish that has been passed down in Nagasaki since the early 1600s. Portuguese missionaries and traders in Nagasaki used to eat stews made with beef and pork during the cold months. The taste gradually spread among the locals, and later on, unique ways of making it using locally grown vegetables, chicken, and fish were established. This is said to be the origin of the version of “hikado” as it is known today.The name “hikado” comes from the Portuguese word “picado,” which means to chop meat into small pieces.
934c4a42b8f9b820.zh: 自1600年代初期在長崎流傳至今的鄉土料理。當時在長崎的葡萄牙傳教士與商人，在寒冷的月份會吃以牛肉和豬肉燉煮的料理。這種味道逐漸在當地人之間傳開，後來發展出使用當地蔬菜、雞肉與魚的獨特做法。據說這就是現今「ヒカド」的由來。「ヒカド」之名來自葡萄牙語「picado」，意思是把肉切成小塊。

93509fcc10bf5334.en: In Nagasaki, whaling has been conducted since the Jomon period, and during the Edo period, Sonogi, located on the east side of Omura Bay, prospered as a center for traditional whaling. Alongside this, a culture of consuming whale meat took root in Nagasaki, giving rise to various whale dishes over the years. "Kujirajaga" is one of them. It emerged in local households as a version of nikujaga (meat and potato stew) with whale meat, developed in the modern era after the birth of the traditional nikujaga.
93509fcc10bf5334.zh: 長崎自繩文時代就有捕鯨活動，江戶時代時，位於大村灣東側的彼杵作為傳統捕鯨的中心而繁榮。隨之而來，食用鯨肉的文化在長崎扎根，多年來發展出各種鯨魚料理，「鯨じゃが」就是其中之一。它是在傳統馬鈴薯燉肉誕生後的近代，於當地家庭中以鯨肉製作的馬鈴薯燉肉版本。

9357aafbb4e78eca.en: It is said that during the reign of the 6th lord of the Higo domain, Hosokawa Shigekata, when the domain's finances were in trouble and austerity measures were implemented to rebuild, "Ichimonji" green onions were conceived as an inexpensive and delicious accompaniment to sake, serving as a snack."Hitomoji" is another term for "Wakegi" green onions, derived from the appearance of the planted green onion resembling the character "Hito" (person).
9357aafbb4e78eca.zh: 據說在肥後藩第6代藩主細川重賢在位期間，藩的財政陷入困境，為重建財政而實施節約措施，於是構思出以「一文字」蔥作為便宜又美味的下酒菜。「一文字」是「分蔥」的別稱，由來是種下的蔥外觀像「人」字。

937319e933c23388.en: Harborland (神戸ハーバーランド, kōbe-hābārando) is a shopping district in Chuo-ku, Kobe, Japan. Kobe Port Tower is located there.
937319e933c23388.zh: 神戸ハーバーランド是位於日本神戶市中央區的購物區，神戶港塔即位於此地。

9389a482c4511e4c.en: Atago Shrine (愛宕神社, Atago jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Sendai, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan. It enshrines the kami Kagu-tsuchi (軻遇土神), and its annual festival takes place on July 24.
9389a482c4511e4c.zh: 愛宕神社是位於日本宮城縣仙台市的神社，供奉軻遇土神，例行祭典於每年7月24日舉行。

93d674bc91e8ec21.en: Masu-zushi, pressed Sushi with light Red Trout on vinegared rice, is Toyama's most famous local dish. The history of Trout Sushi dates back to the Kyoho period of the Edo period (1603-1867). Yoshimura Shinpachi, a samurai of the Toyama domain who was a skilled cook at the time, made” Ayu “(sweetfish) sushi for Maeda Toshioki, the third lord of the domain, who liked it so much that he presented it to Shogun Yoshimune.It became a Toyama specialty after Shogun Yoshimune praised its taste.
93d674bc91e8ec21.zh: ます寿司是在醋飯上放淡紅色鱒魚製成的押壽司，是富山最有名的鄉土料理。鱒魚壽司的歷史可追溯至江戶時代（1603-1867）的享保年間。當時擅長料理的富山藩武士吉村新八，為第三代藩主前田利興製作了「鮎」（香魚）壽司，藩主非常喜歡，便獻給將軍吉宗。將軍吉宗稱讚其滋味後，成為富山名產。

93e3b03d0da74e86.en: “Soba” is a noodle dish made from Buckwheat flour made by grinding Buckwheat seeds, adding a binder and water, and kneading the mixture before cutting it into long, thin strips.“Soba” itself has been eaten since ancient times, but it was not until the Edo period (1603-1867) that people began to eat “Soba” as noodles as we do today.For a long time,“ Soba” was made into flour and served as a kneaded dish or as a grain, but at the beginning of the Edo period, “Soba ”noodles were served in temples and gradually came to be sold alongside “Udon”（Wheat flour noodle） in Edo towns.Edo people preferred “Soba” to “Udon”, and the “Soba” restaurants, starting with “Kendon-Soba”, expanded from big “Soba” shops to “Yatai- Soba”( small-stalls). In the late Edo period, Soba noodle shop menus included “Mori-soba”(serve as cold), “Hanamaki-soba”(topped “Nori”seaweed on the hot “Soba”), “Tempura-soba”, “Arare-soba(topped grilled small mochi on the “Soba”)”, “Shippoku-soba(topped various vegetables on the “Soba”)”, and “Kamo-nanban(Duck on the”Soba”)”.It is said that "Udon in the west and Soba in the east" but it can be said that this dish was perfect for short-tempered Edo people. In the middle of the Edo period, 'Yotaka soba' (also called 'Fu-rin Soba'), which served hot “Bukkake” (broth poured over the “Soba”) a street stalls, also appeared.“Sunaba”, “Sarashina”, and” Yabu” are the three most famous”Soba” restaurants in Tokyo. “Sunaba” has thin white noodles, “Sarashina” has transparent noodles, and” Yabu” has greenish noodles made from the endocarp of the buckwheat plant. “Yabu-soba”, which is said to have its roots in “Zoshigaya”, is characterized by the salty broth favored by Edo people.
93e3b03d0da74e86.zh: 「そば」是將蕎麥籽磨成蕎麥粉，加入黏合劑和水揉成麵團後，切成細長條狀的麵食。蕎麥自古就有人食用，但直到江戶時代（1603－1867年）人們才開始像今天這樣把蕎麥做成麵條食用。長久以來，蕎麥都是磨成粉做成揉製的食物，或當作穀物食用；到了江戶時代初期，蕎麥麵開始在寺院中供應，並逐漸在江戶市街與烏龍麵（小麥麵）一同販售。江戶人比起烏龍麵更喜歡蕎麥麵，蕎麥麵店從「けんどんそば」開始，由大型蕎麥麵店擴展到「屋台そば」（小攤販）。江戶時代後期，蕎麥麵店的菜單上有「もりそば」（冷食）、「花巻そば」（熱蕎麥麵上放海苔）、「天ぷらそば」、「あられそば」（蕎麥麵上放烤小麻糬）、「しっぽくそば」（蕎麥麵上放各種蔬菜）以及「鴨南蛮」（鴨肉蕎麥麵）。有「西烏龍、東蕎麥」的說法，而這道料理可以說很適合性子急的江戶人。江戶時代中期，也出現了在路邊攤供應熱的「ぶっかけ」（將湯汁淋在蕎麥麵上）的「夜鷹そば」（又稱「風鈴そば」）。「砂場」、「更科」、「藪」是東京最有名的三大蕎麥麵店系統。「砂場」的麵條細白，「更科」的麵條透明，「藪」則使用蕎麥的內果皮製成帶綠色的麵條。據說源自「雑司ヶ谷」的「藪そば」，特色是江戶人偏好的鹹味湯汁。

93e87bc3b7968d3f.en: Fuji Hokuroku Stadium (富士北麓競技場) is an athletic stadium in Fujiyoshida, Yamanashi, Japan.
93e87bc3b7968d3f.zh: 富士北麓競技場是位於日本山梨縣富士吉田市的田徑場。

93f45251f705802b.en: A local cuisine passed down from long ago in the Kuriyama region located in Tochigi Prefecture’s Nikko city. Known for using Rice flour as opposed to glutinous rice, bandai mochi’s name is said to have been derived from how it was made in small mountain huts where the rice was placed on top of a board and pounded with things such as the butt of an axe.
93f45251f705802b.zh: 這是栃木縣日光市栗山地區自古流傳的鄉土料理。板台餅以使用米粉而非糯米聞名，其名稱據說源自製作方式：在山中小屋裡將米放在木板上，用斧頭背等物品搗製。

9411e69bd3e85c42.en: “Manamehari" is a type of mehari-zushi made with salted Shimokita harumana. While mehari-zushi made with takana is also a local delicacy in the Totsukawa area, mehari-zushi made with Shimokita-harumana is limited to the Shimokita-yama Village area.It is certified as a traditional vegetable of Yamato, and is grown only in Shimokita-yama Village in Nara Prefecture. Because it grows in a cold environment, the leaves are thick, bright green, and sweet. Because it can be harvested for only two months, it is said to be a rare vegetable.
9411e69bd3e85c42.zh: 「まなめはり」是以鹽漬下北春まな製作的一種めはり壽司。以高菜製作的めはり壽司也是十津川地區的鄉土美食，而以下北春まな製作的めはり壽司則僅限於下北山村一帶。下北春まな獲認定為大和傳統蔬菜，只在奈良縣下北山村栽種。由於生長在寒冷環境中，葉片厚實、翠綠且帶有甜味。因為只能採收兩個月，被稱為稀有的蔬菜。

941c4fb89b955d82.en: Ogura Castle (小倉城, Ogura-jō) was a  Sengoku period Japanese castle located in what is now part of the town of Ranzan, Hiki District, Saitama, in the Kantō region of Japan. The site has been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site, since 2008.
941c4fb89b955d82.zh: 小倉城是戰國時代的日本城郭，位於今日本關東地方埼玉縣比企郡嵐山町境內。該遺址自2008年起被中央政府指定為國家史跡加以保護。

9456b425b8e5a698.en: Yōrō Shrine (養老神社, Yōrō Jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in the town of Yōrō in Yōrō District, Gifu Prefecture, Japan.
9456b425b8e5a698.zh: 養老神社是位於日本岐阜縣養老郡養老町的神社。

94715f39fc26cff7.en: Yudonosan Shrine (湯殿山神社) is an important Beppyo shrine and one of the Three Mountains of Dewa. The shrine is unique in that it has no main building, but instead uses the mountain itself as a Kannabi, or a rock as an Iwakura. It is located in a valley between Mount Yudono and Shinakurasan Mountain.
94715f39fc26cff7.zh: 湯殿山神社是重要的別表神社，也是出羽三山之一。此神社的特殊之處在於沒有本殿，而是以山本身作為神奈備，或以岩石作為磐座。神社位於湯殿山與品倉山之間的山谷中。

94787d9ae94a16b3.en: Aritakisan Castle (荒滝山城, Aritakisan-jō) (also known as Aritaki Castle (荒滝城, Aritaki-jō)) was a Sengoku period yamajiro-style Japanese castle located in what is now the city of Ube, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan. The ruins have been protected as a Yamaguchi Prefectural Historic Site since 2008.
94787d9ae94a16b3.zh: 荒滝山城（又稱荒滝城）是戰國時代的山城式日本城郭，位於今日本山口縣宇部市。遺址自2008年起被列為山口縣史跡加以保護。

94827243490798a6.en: "Game-ni" is a typical local dish of Fukuoka Prefecture, and its name comes from the Hakata dialect word "gamekurikomu" (meaning "to gather together"). It is also said that the name "game-ni" originated during the Japanese invasion of Korea by Hideyoshi Toyotomi during the Japanese invasion of Korea in 1592, when soldiers who went to Korea ate game-ni by stewing suppon (a type of soft-shelled turtle) and other ingredients they had on hand.
94827243490798a6.zh: 「がめ煮」是福岡縣代表性的鄉土料理，名稱來自博多方言「がめくりこむ」（意為「聚集在一起」）。另有一說，「がめ煮」之名源於1592年豐臣秀吉出兵朝鮮時，前往朝鮮的士兵將甲魚（すっぽん，一種鱉）與手邊現有的食材一起燉煮食用。

949e711fb0ecda8e.en: Tsuru Shima (鶴島) is part of Okayama Prefecture, Japan. It is a small, uninhabited island located in the Inland Sea of Japan, hidden from the land by the much larger Kakuijima, and approximately 6 km off the border of Hyōgo and Okayama prefectures. During the early Meiji Period the island was used as a penal colony for Christians. The name means literally "Crane (bird) Island".
949e711fb0ecda8e.zh: 鶴島屬於日本岡山縣，是一座位於瀨戶內海的無人小島，被面積大得多的鹿久居島遮擋而無法從陸地看見，距離兵庫縣與岡山縣交界處約6公里。明治時代初期，此島曾作為流放基督徒的地方。島名字面意思為「鶴（鳥）之島」。

94aad17e708f6d2f.en: The Imari Ton-Ten-Ton Festival is a fighting festival held every year in the city of Imari, Saga Prefecture, Japan. Beginning at the Imari Shrine, the festival is well known as one of the three great fighting festivals of Japan. The festival has been held since 1829. Two shrines, Aramikoshi and Danjiri, meet at various points throughout central Imari. They are smashed together simultaneously until one shrine falls back. This is done to the sound of a beating drum within the shrine Danjiri, the sound of which gives Ton Ten Ton its name.
94aad17e708f6d2f.zh: 伊万里トンテントン祭り是每年在日本佐賀縣伊萬里市舉行的喧嘩祭。祭典從伊萬里神社開始，以日本三大喧嘩祭之一而聞名。祭典自1829年起舉行。荒神輿與だんじり兩座神轎在伊萬里市中心各處相會，同時相互撞擊，直到其中一座退後為止。過程中伴隨著だんじり內的鼓聲，「トンテントン」之名即來自此聲。

94bf59e8098ec24e.en: Mihara Castle (三原城, Mihara-jō) was a hirajiro-style Japanese castle located in what is today the city of Mihara in Hiroshima Prefecture. Its ruins have been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 1957.
94bf59e8098ec24e.zh: 三原城是一座平城形式的日本城郭，位於今日的廣島縣三原市。其遺跡自1957年起由中央政府列為國家史跡加以保護。

94c20a2d70a52c52.en: Hatogamine Hachiman Shrine (鳩峰八幡神社, Hatogamine Hachiman Jinja) is a Shintō shrine in Tokorozawa, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. In the former Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines, it was classified as a district shrine (郷社, gōsha).
94c20a2d70a52c52.zh: 鳩峯八幡神社是位於日本埼玉縣所澤市的神社。在過去的近代社格制度中，被列為鄉社。

94ecdc6183cc23f3.en: The Shōnai Greens (庄内 緑地, Shōnai ryokuchi), also known as Shōnai Park, are located in Nishi-ku, Nagoya in central Japan. The park is constructed around the Otai retention basin of the Shōnai River, which passes by south of the park.
94ecdc6183cc23f3.zh: 庄內綠地又稱庄內公園，位於日本中部名古屋市西區。公園圍繞庄內川的大野木調節池而建，庄內川流經公園南側。

94f314507d1ae346.en: Takataki Dam is a gravity dam located in Chiba Prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for flood control and water supply. The catchment area of the dam is 107.1 km2. The dam impounds about 199  ha of land when full and can store 14300 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1970 and completed in 1990.
94f314507d1ae346.zh: 高瀧水壩是位於日本千葉縣的重力壩，用於防洪及供水。水壩集水面積為107.1平方公里，滿水時淹沒面積約199公頃，蓄水量可達1,430萬立方公尺。水壩於1970年動工，1990年完工。

94ff43a30a86f6fb.en: Kōshō-ji (興正寺) is a Shingon Buddhist temple located in Yagoto, Nagoya, in central Japan. It belongs to the Owari Thirty-three Kannon.
94ff43a30a86f6fb.zh: 興正寺是位於日本中部名古屋八事的真言宗佛寺，屬於尾張三十三觀音之一。

95143dfc071e9942.en: The Taiki Multi-Purpose Aerospace Park (Japanese: 大樹町多目的航空公園, Hepburn: Taiki-chō Tamokuteki Kōkū Kōen) is an aerodrome in the town of Taiki, Hokkaido, Japan.
95143dfc071e9942.zh: 大樹町多目的航空公園是位於日本北海道大樹町的機場。

952e78f14df2ad66.en: The Kyoto City Archaeological Museum (京都市考古資料館) is located in Kyoto and showcases the city's archaeological findings. The building was constructed in 1914.
952e78f14df2ad66.zh: 京都市考古資料館位於京都，展示該市的考古出土文物。建築物建於1914年。

9533fd9155d78a59.en: The Uwajima Ushi-oni festival  (宇和島牛鬼祭り, Uwajima Ushi-oni matsuri) is a festival and purification event held annually July 22–24 in Uwajima, Ehime Prefecture, Japan. The festival derives from an incident in the 16th-century Japanese invasions of Korea, and includes an ushi-oni parade, bull fighting, fireworks and dancing.
9533fd9155d78a59.zh: 宇和島牛鬼祭（宇和島牛鬼祭り）是每年7月22日至24日在日本愛媛縣宇和島舉行的祭典暨淨化活動。祭典源自16世紀日本出兵朝鮮時的一段事件，內容包括牛鬼遊行、鬥牛、煙火及舞蹈。

954da1441279fc25.en: The Nebuta Museum Wa Rasse (ねぶたの家 ワ・ラッセ, Nebuta no ie Wa-Rasse) is a city-owned museum near Aomori Station in the city of Aomori in northern Japan. It displays a revolving exhibit of four Nebuta floats from the most recent Aomori Nebuta Matsuri summer festival, alongside media related to the festival. The museum opened in January 2011.
954da1441279fc25.zh: ねぶたの家 ワ・ラッセ是位於日本北部青森市青森站附近的市立博物館。館內輪替展出最近一屆夏季青森睡魔祭的四座睡魔燈籠山車，並展示與祭典相關的影音資料。博物館於2011年1月開館。

954f576aede7160c.en: There are a variety of sushi dishes in Oita prefecture. “Okata-Zushi” is a type of sushi from Takenaka district of Oita city. The sushi is bale-shaped and is made with grilled Japanese horse mackerel and cooked sweet pinto beans. The word “okata” refers to a village headman.In the past, there was an event named “jigoku-iri” which took place before the busy farming season. The village headman would hand out “Okata-Zushi” to the peasants as a token of his appreciation for their hard work.
954f576aede7160c.zh: 大分縣有各式各樣的壽司料理。「お方ずし」是大分市竹中地區的一種壽司，呈俵形，以烤竹筴魚和甜煮花豆製作。「お方」指的是村長。過去在農忙期前有一項名為「地獄入り」的活動，村長會分發「お方ずし」給農民，以感謝他們的辛勞。

9557566be515dfec.en: Tenno Matsuri (天王祭り) is a festival held annually, in July, in Tsushima, Aichi. The highlight of the two-day event is the evening festival in which a dozen boats, each decorated with nearly 400 paper lanterns, float down the Tenno River.  The festival honors the deity Gozu Tenno. This festival also takes place in Tokyo.
9557566be515dfec.zh: 天王祭（天王祭り）是每年7月在愛知縣津島舉行的祭典。為期兩天的活動中，最受矚目的是夜間祭典，十多艘各自裝飾近400盞紙燈籠的船隻沿天王川順流而下。祭典供奉的神祇為牛頭天王。東京也有舉辦這項祭典。

9566fd31c7acd519.en: "Nuppe" is a local dish that has been passed down from generation to generation in the Isahaya area.In fact, similar dishes exist all over Japan. In addition to the same name " Nuppe," there are many other names that differ by one character, such as "Nuppei" and " Noppe" (each of which is sometimes called by adding "soup" at the end). All of them have in common that root vegetables, mainly satoimo(=Japanese taro), are cut into small pieces and boiled, and that the soup is thickened.It is not known when and where they originated.
9566fd31c7acd519.zh: 「ぬっぺ」是諫早地區代代相傳的鄉土料理。其實日本各地都有類似的料理。除了同樣名為「ぬっぺ」之外，還有「ぬっぺい」、「のっぺ」等只差一個字的各種名稱（有時也會在後面加上「汁」）。共同點是將以芋頭為主的根莖類蔬菜切成小塊煮過，並將湯汁勾芡。其起源的時間與地點不明。

957d81ad450dc1ee.en: Oshizushi is made by layering thinly sliced vinegared mackerel and shiroita konbu on top of vinegared rice and pressing them in a wooden frame.In contrast to the nigirizushi of the Edo period (1603-1867), pressed sushi in a box or wooden frame is the norm in the Kansai region. Battera is the most popular taste among them. It is a local dish filled with Osaka's unique culture of pressed sushi and kelp, and is very familiar to residents of the prefecture.Battera was invented in 1894 by a restaurant called "Sushi Tsune" in Minami-Semba.
957d81ad450dc1ee.zh: 這是一種押壽司，做法是在醋飯上疊放切成薄片的醋漬鯖魚和白板昆布，再用木框壓製而成。相對於江戶時代（1603-1867）的握壽司，在關西地區，以箱子或木框壓製的壽司是主流。バッテラ是其中最受歡迎的口味。這道鄉土料理充分體現大阪獨特的押壽司與昆布文化，府民十分熟悉。バッテラ是1894年由南船場一家名為「すし常」的店所發明。
