9585581ca85cf3ca.en: Abe Monju-in (安倍文殊院, あべもんじゅいん) is a Buddhist temple in the Abe area of Sakurai, Nara Prefecture, Japan. Dating to the seventh century, it houses a sculptural group by Kaikei, and a kofun within its grounds has been designated a Special Historic Site.
9585581ca85cf3ca.zh: 安倍文殊院（あべもんじゅいん）是位於日本奈良縣櫻井市安倍地區的佛教寺院，歷史可追溯至七世紀，寺內藏有快慶的群像雕刻，境內的一座古墳被指定為特別史跡。

9598f16f1ba38679.en: “Mackerel somen” is a local dish eaten throughout the prefecture, mainly in the Kohoku region of Shiga Prefecture, where grilled mackerel is simmered and mixed with somen noodles.Since ancient times, there have been many routes to transport goods such as seafood from Wakasa, a “Mitsukekuni,” to Kyoto. It is called the “Mackerel Road” because mackerel was the representative commodity.
9598f16f1ba38679.zh: 「鯖そうめん」是以湖北地區為中心、在滋賀縣全縣食用的鄉土料理，做法是將烤鯖魚燉煮後與素麵拌在一起。自古以來，有多條路線將海產等物資從「御食國」若狹運往京都。由於鯖魚是代表性的貨物，這些路線被稱為「鯖街道」。

959e5ae3e52c5c32.en: Kyan Castle (喜屋武城, Kyan jō; Okinawan: Chan Gushiku) is a Ryukyuan gusuku in Uruma, Okinawa. It was controlled by the Ōgawa Aji of Agena Castle until it was destroyed by the Ryukyu Kingdom.
959e5ae3e52c5c32.zh: 喜屋武城（喜屋武城，Kyan jō；沖繩語：Chan Gushiku）是位於沖繩縣宇流麻市的琉球御城（グスク）。此城由安慶名城的大川按司掌控，直到遭琉球王國摧毀。

95a1c2b68b9a0bb2.en: Katsuona, an essential ingredient in Hakata Zoni, is a vegetable that has been used in Hakata since ancient times and is a kind of the takana vegetable.It is said to have gotten its name from the flavor of dried bonito flakes in its stems. It is dark green in color, and its thick-walled leaves are shriveled. Yellowtail is a fish that changes its name according to its size, from yazu to inada, hamachi, and finally yellowtail, and is used in dishes for festive occasions.
95a1c2b68b9a0bb2.zh: 勝男菜是博多雜煮不可或缺的食材，是博多自古使用的蔬菜，屬於高菜的一種。據說因莖部帶有柴魚片的風味而得名。顏色深綠，葉片厚實且帶皺縮。鰤魚是會隨體型大小改名的魚，依序稱為ヤズ、イナダ、ハマチ，最後稱為鰤魚，用於喜慶場合的料理。

95ccc75e4badbc19.en: In the waterfront of Owari region, which has many small rivers running everywhere, there are many local dishes used river fish like crucian carp, catfish and striped mullet. ‘Moroko-zushi’, pressed-sushi (‘hako-zushi’ in Japanese) used ‘moroko’ (=willow gudgeon), is also a local food from the waterfront area. ‘Moroko’ is freshwater fish, from carp family (Cyprinidae), and it grows up to 10cm (4inches). People used to catch ‘moroko’ a lot in the waterfront.
95ccc75e4badbc19.zh: 尾張地區的水鄉一帶小河流遍布各處，有許多使用鯽魚、鯰魚、鯔魚等河魚的鄉土料理。「もろこずし」是使用「諸子」（柳根魚）製作的押壽司（日文稱「箱壽司」），也是水鄉地區的鄉土料理。「諸子」是鯉科的淡水魚，體長可達10cm（4英寸）。過去水鄉一帶的人們常大量捕撈「諸子」。

95f33a93c15a8311.en: "Hamana Miso" is a seasonal local dish, available only in winter. It is made by creating amazake(= a sweet rice-based sake) from rice koji and adding ingredients such as soybean koji, soy sauce, salt-pickled eggplant, perilla seeds, ginger, and others. The mild sweetness of amazake combines with the richness of koji and the savory aroma of soy sauce, creating a highly appetizing flavor that represents the taste of the hometown.
95f33a93c15a8311.zh: 「はまなみそ」是只在冬季才有的季節性鄉土料理。做法是以米麴製作甘酒（以米為原料的甜酒），再加入大豆麴、醬油、鹽漬茄子、紫蘇籽、薑等材料。甘酒溫和的甜味結合麴的濃郁與醬油的香氣，形成十分開胃的風味，代表家鄉的味道。

95fd3088871ef43e.en: Miki City, known as the birthplace of metalworking in Japan, has its origins dating back approximately 1,500 years. The town has produced skilled craftsmen alongside the development of blacksmithing. "Kajiya-nabe" (blacksmith's hot pot) is said to have been favored by blacksmiths to boost their energy during the summer. During the Meiji and Taisho eras, it originated when itinerant merchants came to the village, selling octopus caught off the coast of Akashi and eggplants in season, which were then simmered in dashi and soy sauce.
95fd3088871ef43e.zh: 三木市被稱為日本金屬加工的發源地，其起源可追溯到約1,500年前。這座城鎮隨著鍛冶業的發展，培育出許多技藝精湛的工匠。「鍛冶屋鍋」（鐵匠火鍋）據說是鐵匠在夏季用來補充體力的料理。起源於明治、大正時期，行商來到村裡販賣明石外海捕獲的章魚和當令茄子，再以高湯和醬油燉煮。

96041d6da67882d4.en: "Funa Miso(Crucian carp Miso)" is a freshwater fish dish found in the lower reaches of the Kiso Three Rivers, which collectively refer to the three rivers, Kiso River, Nagaragawa River, and Ibigawa River, flowing through the Nobi Plain.
96041d6da67882d4.zh: ふな味噌（鯽魚味噌）是木曾三川下游一帶的淡水魚料理。木曾三川是流經濃尾平原的木曾川、長良川、揖斐川三條河川的總稱。

9613cd4bde1c6f84.en: ‘Ukogi’ is a deciduous shrub of araliaceae like ‘taranome’ (Japanese angelica tree) and ‘udo’ (Aralia cordata), and its height is around 2~7m. It has many small branches and 4~7mm (0.1~0.2 inch) of thin thorns. It grown wild in mountains and fields, but it has been used as fences and food from old times in Iwate Prefecture and Yamagata Prefecture. Young sprouts grown in spring are harvested and used as food.
9613cd4bde1c6f84.zh: 「五加」（うこぎ）與「楤芽」（楤木）、「土當歸」同為五加科落葉灌木，高約2～7公尺。枝條細多，帶有4～7公釐（0.1～0.2英寸）的細刺。野生於山野，但在岩手縣與山形縣自古被用作圍籬及食材。春天採收長出的嫩芽食用。

9617e425853dbb46.en: Mukibanda Yayoi Settlement Site (妻木晩田遺跡, Mukibanda-iseki) is an archaeological site with a large Yayoi period settlement remains, straddling the border between the municipalities of Yonago and Daisen, Tottori Prefecture in the San'in region of western Japan. The Mukibanda site was designated a National Historic Site in 1999.
9617e425853dbb46.zh: 妻木晚田遺跡（妻木晩田遺跡，Mukibanda-iseki）是留有大規模彌生時代聚落遺跡的考古遺址，橫跨日本西部山陰地方鳥取縣米子市與大山町的交界。妻木晚田遺跡於1999年被指定為國家史跡。

9619c2d84a445056.en: Hagushi bay is located in Yomitan, Okinawa. The bay is at the mouth of Hija River.  The north side of the mouth of the river has a public beach called Toguchi Beach.
9619c2d84a445056.zh: 嘉手納灣（Hagushi bay，渡具知灣）位於沖繩縣讀谷村，處於比謝川河口。河口北側有一處公共海灘，名為渡具知ビーチ。

9630a86c6f861aef.en: Kakunodate Kabazaiku Museum (仙北市立角館樺細工伝承館, Senboku Shiritsu Kakunodate Kabazaiku Denshōkan), also known in English as Kakunodate Cherry Bark Work Museum, opened in Kakunodate, now Semboku, Akita Prefecture, Japan in 1978. Dedicated to the traditional craft of kabazaiku, there are also displays on other local crafts, including Shiraiwa-yaki ceramics, Kakunodate-shunkei lacquerware, and Itaya-zaiku maple wickerwork.
9630a86c6f861aef.zh: 仙北市立角館樺細工傳承館（仙北市立角館樺細工伝承館），英文亦稱Kakunodate Cherry Bark Work Museum，於1978年在日本秋田縣角館（今仙北市）開館。館內以傳統工藝樺細工為主題，另展示其他當地工藝，包括白岩燒陶瓷、角館春慶漆器，以及板屋細工楓木編織品。

96380ddc10833978.en: Mitsuke-juku (見附宿, Mitsuke-juku) was the twenty-eighth of the fifty-three stations of the Tōkaidō. It is located in what is now the central part of the city of Iwata, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. The post station received its name, which means "with a view," because it was the first place from which Mount Fuji could be seen by travelers coming from Kyoto.
96380ddc10833978.zh: 見附宿是東海道五十三次的第二十八個宿場，位於現今日本靜岡縣磐田市中心一帶。這個宿場的名稱意為「看得見」，因為從京都方向來的旅人在此第一次能望見富士山。

963f999120c91bce.en: Kagoshima Prefectural Museum of Culture Reimeikan (鹿児島県歴史資料センター黎明館, Kagoshima-ken Rekishi Shiryō Sentā Reimeikan) opened in Kagoshima, Japan, in 1983. The museum, located in the grounds of Tsurumaru Castle, exhibits materials relating to the history and culture of Kagoshima Prefecture.
963f999120c91bce.zh: 鹿兒島縣歷史資料中心黎明館（鹿児島県歴史資料センター黎明館）於1983年在日本鹿兒島開館。博物館位於鶴丸城的城址內，展示與鹿兒島縣歷史及文化相關的資料。

965d5ed78f443040.en: Fukiware Falls (吹割の滝, Fukiware no taki) is a waterfall located in the city of Numata, Gunma Prefecture, Japan. It is a nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty and a Natural Monument. It is one of "Japan’s Top 100 Waterfalls", per a listing published by the Japanese Ministry of the Environment in 1990.
965d5ed78f443040.zh: 吹割の滝是位於日本群馬縣沼田市的瀑布，為國家指定的名勝及天然紀念物。依日本環境省於1990年公布的名單，這裡是「日本瀑布百選」之一。

9679139150f79e34.en: The dish called "Itokoni" refers to a simmered dish with azuki beans and vegetables. While it is commonly made with ingredients like pumpkin, "Awa no Itokoni" uses sweet potatoes. The sweet potatoes are first dried into sweet potato chips and then simmered together with azuki beans, resulting in a gentle sweetness. Incidentally, there are two methods of drying sweet potatoes: "Shiroboshi" involves cutting fresh sweet potatoes and air-drying them, while "Yudeboshi" involves boiling them once before drying.
9679139150f79e34.zh: 名為「いとこ煮」的料理，是指以紅豆和蔬菜燉煮的菜餚。一般常用南瓜等食材，「阿波のいとこ煮」則使用地瓜。先將地瓜曬成地瓜乾，再與紅豆一起燉煮，形成溫和的甜味。附帶一提，地瓜的乾燥方法有兩種：「白干し」是將生地瓜切開後風乾，「茹で干し」則是先煮過一次再曬乾。

9685d1072ede3b02.en: The Nisshinkan (Nisshin-kan) (Japanese: 日新館), located in Aizuwakamatsu, Fukushima, Japan, was the Aizu clan's official domain school (hankō).
9685d1072ede3b02.zh: 日新館位於日本福島縣會津若松市，是會津藩的官方藩校。

96925c07a665ecca.en: Mount Yasumandake (安満岳) is the highest peak on the island of Hirado, Japan. The mountain was sacred to Buddhists and Shintoists, and as Christianity became prevalent in Hirado it also became an object of Hidden Christian worship. In 2018 the mountain became a World Heritage Site as part of the "Hidden Christian Sites in the Nagasaki Region".
96925c07a665ecca.zh: 安満岳是日本平戶島的最高峰。此山為佛教與神道的聖山，隨著基督教在平戶傳播，也成為潛伏基督徒的信仰對象。2018年，此山作為「長崎地區潛伏基督徒相關遺產」的一部分，被列為世界遺產。

96f53aaa221593a0.en: Ishikawa Aviation Plaza (石川県立航空プラザ, ishikawakenritsu kouku puraza) is an aerospace museum in the city of Komatsu, Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan. It is located next to Komatsu Airport.
96f53aaa221593a0.zh: 石川縣立航空廣場（石川県立航空プラザ）是位於日本石川縣小松市的航空太空博物館，鄰近小松機場。

96f93a4b79660bd1.en: This dish is made from steamed glutinous rice and flour, which is then sprinkled with sugar and kinako. It is also referred to as "Hagessho mochi." Because it contains flour, the texture is less sticky compared to just glutinous rice, so you can enjoy a more crispy texture.Hagessho refers to the 11th day of the summer solstice from July second to July seventh.
96f93a4b79660bd1.zh: 這道點心是將糯米和麵粉一起蒸熟，再撒上砂糖和黃豆粉製成。也稱為「半夏生餅」。因為加了麵粉，口感比只用糯米來得不黏，可以享受較為爽脆的口感。半夏生指的是夏至後的第11天，約在7月2日到7月7日之間。

96fe990acf39cbeb.en: Cape Todo (とどヶ崎, Todogasaki), also written as "魹ヶ崎" is the easternmost point of the island of Honshu in Japan. It is located within the borders of the city of Miyako, Iwate, and is part of the Sanriku Fukkō National Park. Although referred to as a "cape", the area is not clearly a peninsula extending into the Pacific Ocean, but is simply the easternmost point on a coastline.
96fe990acf39cbeb.zh: 魹ヶ崎（とどヶ崎）是日本本州島的最東端。位於岩手縣宮古市境內，屬於三陸復興國立公園。雖然稱為「岬」，但此處並非明顯伸入太平洋的半島，只是海岸線上的最東點。

971a6f55b3fbc674.en: This is a typical local dish of Iki, a remote island in Nagasaki Prefecture.In the past, when Iki farmers had guests over for the Bon Festival, New Year's Day, and festivals, they would cook a nabe dish from the tasty chickens they kept at home, and entertain them by pulling them through to a tatami room in the back of the house.
971a6f55b3fbc674.zh: 這是長崎縣離島壹岐的代表性鄉土料理。過去壹岐的農家在盂蘭盆節、元旦和祭典有客人來訪時，會用家中飼養的美味雞隻煮成鍋料理，並將客人請到屋子後方的和室招待。

97236fd1bd63dafe.en: The Ibaraki Botanical Garden (茨城県植物園, Ibaraki-ken Shokubutsuen) is a botanical garden and arboretum located at 4589 To, Naka, Ibaraki, Japan. It is open daily except Mondays; an admission fee is charged.
97236fd1bd63dafe.zh: 茨城縣植物園是位於日本茨城縣那珂市戶4589的植物園兼樹木園。除星期一外每日開放，需購票入園。

972e62db266dd55d.en: The Yamashina Institute for Ornithology (山階鳥類研究所, Yamashina Chōruikenkyūsho) is a non-profit scientific research organization in Japan, specializing in ornithology.
972e62db266dd55d.zh: 山階鳥類研究所是日本的非營利科學研究機構，專門從事鳥類學研究。

973209f3d7c1befa.en: "O-Zou-ni," or simply “Zou-ni”, an essential New Year's dish, varies significantly in regional characteristics, and the ingredients and preparation methods differ from household to household. For example, in eastern Japan, particularly beyond the boundaries of Toyama, Gifu, and Aichi prefectures, it is common to use grilled square shaped mochi (rice cake), while in western Japan, there is a tendency to boil round mochi.
973209f3d7c1befa.zh: 「御雜煮」或簡稱「雜煮」，是新年不可或缺的料理，地方特色差異很大，食材與做法也因家庭而異。例如在東日本，特別是富山縣、岐阜縣、愛知縣交界以東，一般使用烤過的方形餅（年糕）；而西日本則傾向將圓形餅煮過使用。

9748a9a9a8c584be.en: The dish is called "tofumeshi (tofu and rice)," in which ingredients such as boiled tofu, carrots, burdock root, and mackerel boiled in water are fried and mixed with freshly cooked rice. It is a regional dish handed down from about 120 years ago in the Oyama district of Tamba-Sasayama. During gatherings in the region, preparing food for a crowd of people was no laughing matter, so it was suggested that seniors should prepare something by mixing side dishes with rice. It is said that the dish was born out of that suggestion.
9748a9a9a8c584be.zh: 這道料理稱為「とふめし（豆腐與米飯）」，將水煮豆腐、紅蘿蔔、牛蒡、水煮鯖魚等食材拌炒後，與剛煮好的米飯混合。這是丹波篠山大山地區約120年前流傳下來的鄉土料理。地區聚會時，要為眾人準備餐點並非易事，因此有人提議由長者將配菜拌入米飯來準備。據說這道料理就是從這個提議而來。

9755c8089912f7e2.en: The Hiroshima Children's Culture and Science Museum (広島市こども文化科学館 Hiroshima-shi Kodomo Bunka Kagakukan), also known as the 5-Days Children's Culture and Science Museum, is a culture and science museum for children in Hiroshima, Japan.
9755c8089912f7e2.zh: 広島市こども文化科学館又稱「5-Days兒童文化科學館」，是位於日本廣島市、以兒童為對象的文化科學館。

975820f121ce66b1.en: Noshikomi udon is a noodle dish made by simmering udon noodles in a broth made from dried sardines and shiitake mushrooms, seasoned with sake, salt, and soy sauce, and adding firm udon noodles and other ingredients such as green onions and deep-fried tofu.During the Edo period, the entire town of Okutama was under the direct control of the shogunate and was located in the mountains, the steepest mountains in Tokyo, and most of the town was covered with forests.
975820f121ce66b1.zh: のしこみうどん是以小魚乾和香菇熬成高湯，用酒、鹽、醬油調味，再放入較硬的烏龍麵以及蔥、油豆腐等配料燉煮而成的麵食。江戶時代，奧多摩全町屬於幕府直轄領地，位於東京最陡峭的山區，町內大部分覆蓋著森林。

97b2a40c1ce501b5.en: This is generally known as "Gomoku-zushi" (mixed sushi), a unique dish in the southern part of the Tokishu region, also referred to as "Omaze," "Kakimaze," or "Kakimaze-zushi." It is often consumed as a celebratory meal for special occasions such as weddings and funerals. It is also made when people gather or when unusual ingredients become available. In some regions, there are community events such as neighborhood meetings that are based on 210 days passing after the 1st date of Japanese spring around early February.
97b2a40c1ce501b5.zh: 這道料理一般稱為「五目壽司」（什錦壽司），是東紀州地區南部特有的料理，又稱「おまぜ」、「かきまぜ」或「かきまぜ壽司」。常在婚喪等特殊場合作為宴席料理食用，也會在人們聚會或取得少見食材時製作。部分地區有以立春（約二月初）起算第210天為依據的町內會聚會等社區活動。

97c89b79feb7f133.en: The Toda Rowing Course (戸田漕艇場, Toda Sōteijō) is a purpose-built rowing venue that hosted the rowing event at the 1964 Summer Olympics. Originally completed in 1939 for the 1940 Summer Olympics that were cancelled due to World War II. After World War II, the venue was left in disrepair. When Tokyo was awarded the 1964 Summer Olympics in 1958, the venue was expanded and reconstructed.
97c89b79feb7f133.zh: 戶田漕艇場是專為划船比賽興建的場地，曾舉辦1964年夏季奧運的划船項目。場地原本於1939年為1940年夏季奧運而完工，但該屆奧運因第二次世界大戰取消。戰後場地年久失修。1958年東京取得1964年夏季奧運主辦權後，場地進行了擴建與重建。

97cccec9e0452b22.en: One of the ways to eat small fresh fish with blue back in the fisher’s town from Shima region to Eastern Kishu region along the Kumano-nada Sea is "tataki" (=to mince fish). This is invented in order to enjoy freshly caught fish while it’s still fresh. A part of Shima region it is called "Namerou", but people in Eastern Kishu region don’t call same.
97cccec9e0452b22.zh: 在熊野灘沿岸從志摩地區到東紀州地區的漁村，食用新鮮小型青背魚的方法之一是「たたき」（將魚剁碎）。這是為了趁新鮮享用剛捕獲的魚而發明的做法。志摩地區部分地方稱之為「なめろう」，但東紀州地區的人不這樣稱呼。

980a17379b2817da.en: The pike conger, known as "Hamo" in Japanese, has been inhabiting Osaka Bay since ancient times, and was distributed in Osaka around the middle of the modern period. In Osaka and Kyoto, it is an essential ingredient for summer festivals and is renowned as a seasonal fish during the summer. However, "Hamo" caught after spawning in the autumn, when it has gained extra fat, is also considered delicious.
980a17379b2817da.zh: 日文稱為「鱧」的海鰻自古棲息於大阪灣，大約在近世中期於大阪流通。在大阪和京都，鱧是夏季祭典不可或缺的食材，以夏季的時令魚聞名。不過，秋季產卵後捕獲、脂肪增加的鱧，也被認為很美味。

980c720771ab83f8.en: The Mito Municipal Botanical Park (水戸市植物公園, Mito-shi Shokubutsu Kōen) is a botanical garden located at 504 Kobuki, Mito, Ibaraki, Japan. It is open daily except Mondays; an admission fee is charged.
980c720771ab83f8.zh: 水戶市植物公園是位於日本茨城縣水戶市小吹504號的植物園。除週一外每日開放，需收取入園費。

9815d827512922ae.en: The Tachiarai Peace Memorial Museum (筑前町立 大刀洗平和記念館, Chikuzen chōritsu tachiarai heiwakinenkan) is a historical museum located in the town of Chikuzen, Fukuoka, Japan.
9815d827512922ae.zh: 筑前町立大刀洗平和紀念館是位於日本福岡縣筑前町的歷史博物館。

9827aafc4a58fe67.ja: 一つ森公園（ひとつもりこうえん）は、秋田県秋田市にある都市公園（総合公園）である。
9827aafc4a58fe67.zh: 一つ森公園是位於秋田縣秋田市的都市公園（綜合公園）。

9837ac58e9928292.en: Mishima Dam is an earthfill dam located in Chiba Prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for irrigation. The catchment area of the dam is 26.1 km2. The dam impounds about 72  ha of land when full and can store 5400 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was completed in 1955.
9837ac58e9928292.zh: 三島水壩（三島ダム）是位於日本千葉縣的土石壩，用於灌溉。水壩集水面積為 26.1 平方公里，滿水時淹沒面積約 72 公頃，可蓄水 540 萬立方公尺。水壩於 1955 年完工。

983d19d5da016ed9.en: Toyama Gokoku Shrine (富山縣護國神社, Toyamaken gokoku jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Toyama, Toyama Prefecture, Japan. It enshrines the kami of "martyrs of the state" (国事殉難者) or soldiers whom have perished and its annual festivals take place on April 25 and October 5. It was established in 1913. In total, there are 28,679 people enshrined.
983d19d5da016ed9.zh: 富山縣護國神社是位於日本富山縣富山市的神社。祭祀「國事殉難者」，即殉職軍人之神靈，每年例大祭於4月25日與10月5日舉行。創建於1913年，合祀人數共28,679人。

985ba3e1a7d92d1e.en: Shigisan castle (信貴山城, Shigisanjō) was a Japanese castle of the Sengoku period, controlled by the Kizawa and Matsunaga clans.  There are little remains of the castle on the present day site, just some moats and earthworks.
985ba3e1a7d92d1e.zh: 信貴山城是戰國時代的日本城池，曾由木澤氏與松永氏掌控。現今遺址上城的遺跡很少，僅存部分壕溝與土壘。

98624e28ba89947f.en: Yoshiki-en (吉城園) is a Japanese garden in Nara, Japan, to the immediate southwest of Isui-en.
98624e28ba89947f.zh: 吉城園是位於日本奈良市的日本庭園，緊鄰依水園西南側。

98725db6dc505f70.en: Kobujime, which is made by sandwiching fresh sashimi with kombu, was created during the Edo period by combining Hokkaido kombu brought by Kitamaebune with fish caught in Toyama Bay.
98725db6dc505f70.zh: 昆布〆是用昆布夾住新鮮生魚片製成，誕生於江戶時代，結合了北前船運來的北海道昆布與富山灣捕獲的魚。

988e1ed5abf52247.en: Sendai Hi-Land Raceway was a 4.030 km (2.504 mi) motor racing circuit in 12 Hayasaka, Shinkawa, Aoba-ku, Sendai, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan.
988e1ed5abf52247.zh: 仙台ハイランド賽車場是一座全長4.030公里（2.504英里）的賽車場，位於日本宮城縣仙台市青葉區新川字早坂12。

98971b82ecde7cc2.en: In ancient times, sharks ("same" in Japanese) were also called "wani" or "fuka", and were an intimate part of people's lives, as can be seen in the myths, wooden message plates, and literature from that period. Sharks were eaten in many other regions outside of Mie Prefecture as well, such as Hiroshima,, Aomori,, and Miyagi Prefectures. In Mie, shark meat was used in food offerings made at Ise Grand Shrine, but there were also parts of the prefecture where this variety of shark was eaten.
98971b82ecde7cc2.zh: 古時候，鯊魚（日文「さめ」）也被稱為「わに」或「ふか」，從當時的神話、木簡與文學中可見，鯊魚與人們的生活關係密切。除三重縣外，廣島縣、青森縣、宮城縣等許多地區也食用鯊魚。在三重縣，鯊魚肉被用於伊勢神宮的神饌，縣內也有部分地區食用這種鯊魚。

989c8c11f8bdcb30.en: “Shimotsukare” is a local cuisine in the western part of Ibaraki that consists of leftover New Year's salmon heads, leftover beans from Setsubun (February 3), and root vegetables cooked in sake lees. Making full use of the leftovers from the New Year, this dish is filled with the wisdom of our forerunners, which is excellent in terms of nutrition and preservation during the winter months. In some areas it is also known as "Sumitukare”. “Shimotsukare” is also made in parts of Tochigi, Saitama and Chiba prefectures.
989c8c11f8bdcb30.zh: 「しもつかれ」是茨城西部的鄉土料理，將新年剩下的鮭魚頭、節分（2月3日）剩下的豆子及根莖類蔬菜，與酒粕一起烹煮而成。這道料理充分利用新年的剩餘食材，在營養及冬季保存方面都很出色，蘊含前人的智慧。部分地區也稱為「すみつかれ」。栃木、埼玉、千葉縣的部分地區也會製作「しもつかれ」。

98a7c4ce9384dc73.en: This nabe combines whale meat, which was once a familiar food for the common people, and potherb mustard, which has been cultivated mainly in the Kansai region since ancient times. The whale soup stock is mixed with the potherb mustard and is very tasty. It is said to have originated at Tokuya, a whale restaurant established in 1967 in Sennichimae, Osaka, and has been loved by Osaka residents as a winter delicacy.
98a7c4ce9384dc73.zh: 這道鍋物結合了過去庶民熟悉的鯨魚肉，以及自古主要在關西地區栽培的水菜。鯨魚高湯與水菜融合，風味十足。據說起源於1967年在大阪千日前創立的鯨魚料理店「徳屋」，作為冬季美味受到大阪人喜愛。

98a9a08c423eb1a8.en: Okayama Demikatsu Don,” a local bowl in Okayama, features freshly fried pork cutlet topped with piping hot demi-glace sauce. It is said to have been created by the founder of the longstanding Okayama restaurant “Ajitsukasa Nomura.” Impressed by the taste of demi-glace sauce in Tokyo hotels, the founder wondered if it could be utilized in his own restaurant. In Okayama, some regions also refer to green peas as "Alaska," and these "Alaska" peas add a colorful touch, evoking a nostalgic Western-style dish.
98a9a08c423eb1a8.zh: 「岡山デミかつ丼」是岡山的在地丼飯，在剛炸好的豬排上淋上熱騰騰的多蜜醬汁。據說是由岡山老字號餐廳「味司野村」的創辦人所創。創辦人對東京飯店多蜜醬汁的味道印象深刻，思考能否運用在自己的餐廳。在岡山，有些地區也把青豆稱為「アラスカ」，這些「アラスカ」青豆增添色彩，令人想起懷舊的西式料理。

98cc005bb006ed71.en: Grilled conger eel, known as "yaki anago," is a dish where open-cut (freshwater eel) conger eel is skewered and grilled. Harima-nada, which boasts one of the highest catches of conger eel in the country, is a suitable fishing ground for conger eel due to the abundant nutrients flowing in from many rivers and the rich feeding environment influenced by the topography and tidal currents.
98cc005bb006ed71.zh: 烤星鰻稱為「焼きアナゴ」，是將剖開的星鰻串起燒烤的料理。播磨灘的星鰻漁獲量為全國數一數二，由於許多河川流入豐富的養分，加上地形與潮流造就了豐富的餌料環境，是適合星鰻的漁場。

98ee3c5eb94da6df.en: Mount Shiroyama (城山, Shiroyama) is a mountain located in Kagoshima, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan. The true height is 107m. The original name is Tsuru ga mine (鶴ヶ峯, Tsuru ga mine) The mountain is famous as the site of the Battle of Shiroyama in 1877, at the end of the Satsuma rebellion.
98ee3c5eb94da6df.zh: 城山（城山）是位於日本鹿兒島縣鹿兒島市的山，實際高度為107公尺，原名鶴峯（鶴ヶ峯）。此山以1877年西南戰爭末期的城山之戰發生地而聞名。

99717af297338eef.en: “Kanzuke” is a pickle made by exposing radishes to the cold winter wind twice. It is a traditional specialty of the Ashikita and Minamata regions. Raw radishes are dried, then pickled in salt when they become wrinkled, and further dried for 1-2 months. Once dried to an amber color, they are thinly sliced and soaked in a mixture of soy sauce, mirin, and vinegar. After 1-2 days, when the flavor has seeped in, the pickles are ready. The crunch and unique flavor make them a perfect accompaniment to rice, so much so that you can eat several bowls.
99717af297338eef.zh: 「寒漬け」是讓蘿蔔兩度經冬季寒風吹晒製成的醃漬物，是蘆北、水俣地區的傳統特產。將生蘿蔔晒乾，待出現皺紋時以鹽醃漬，再晒乾1-2個月。晒成琥珀色後切成薄片，浸泡在醬油、味醂和醋調成的醬汁中。1-2天後入味即完成。爽脆的口感與獨特風味非常適合配飯，可以讓人吃上好幾碗。

999b1fdc0a9b1bd8.en: Akigase Park (秋ヶ瀬公園, Akigase kōen) is a park in Japan that occupies a section of flood plain of the Arakawa River, which is located at the western edge of Saitama City.  The park covers an area of 100.1ha on the eastern side of the river between its northern boundary, 3 km north of the Akigase Bridge, and the southern boundary, the Hanekura Bridge.
999b1fdc0a9b1bd8.zh: 秋ヶ瀬公園是位於日本的公園，占據荒川部分河漫灘，位於埼玉市西緣。公園面積100.1公頃，位於河川東側，北界在秋ヶ瀨橋以北3公里處，南界為羽根倉橋。

99c02f32e5d873de.en: "Shoyu Mame" or "Soy Sauce Beans" is a fermented food traditional to the northern and central Shinshu region. It is made by fermenting steamed soybeans or black beans with seed koji(seed malt), creating a fermented product with the savory flavor of soy sauce, akin to "eating soy sauce." It should not be confused with the regional dish "Shoyu Mame" from Kagawa Prefecture, which uses soramame (fava beans).For "Shoyu Mame" in Nagano, steamed soybeans or black beans are fermented with rice koji, and then soaked in raw soy sauce.
99c02f32e5d873de.zh: 「しょうゆ豆」又稱「醬油豆」，是信州北部與中部地區傳統的發酵食品。作法是將蒸熟的黃豆或黑豆加入種麴發酵，製成帶有醬油鮮味的發酵食品，類似「吃醬油」的感覺。不要與香川縣使用蠶豆（そら豆）製作的鄉土料理「醬油豆」混淆。長野的「しょうゆ豆」是將蒸熟的黃豆或黑豆以米麴發酵後，再浸泡於生醬油中。

9a075d956ba8d46d.en: “Ishikari Nabe” (Ishikari hot pot) is a typical local cuisine of Hokkaido. As the name suggests, it is a fisherman's dish from Ishikari Town, located at the mouth of the Ishikari River, famous for salmon. Salmon fishing has been popular in the Ishikari region since the Edo period (1603 - 1868). When celebrating a big catch, fishermen are said to have been rewarded with chunks and bony parts of freshly caught salmon, which they would put directly into a pot of miso soup.
9a075d956ba8d46d.zh: 「石狩鍋」是北海道代表性的鄉土料理。如其名稱所示，這是源自位於石狩川河口、以鮭魚聞名的石狩町的漁夫料理。石狩地區自江戶時代（1603－1868年）起鮭魚捕撈便很興盛。據說在慶祝大豐收時，漁夫會獲得剛捕到的鮭魚塊和帶骨部位作為犒賞，並直接放進味噌湯鍋中煮食。

9a1738cc48ed05e1.en: Nakajima Park (中島公園, Nakajima Kōen) is a city park in Chūō-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan. The park has a lake, two streams, a museum, a concert hall, an observatory, a historical building housing a tea shop, and several lawns and forests. At the south end, there are two shrines.
9a1738cc48ed05e1.zh: 中島公園是位於日本北海道札幌市中央區的都市公園。園內有一座湖、兩條溪流、一座博物館、一座音樂廳、一座天文台、一棟設有茶屋的歷史建築，以及數片草坪與樹林。公園南端有兩座神社。

9a436f57e0f0e4ae.en: Yato Castle (谷戸城, Yato-jō) was a Heian period yamashiro-style Japanese castle located in the Ōizumi neighborhood of the city of Hokuto, Yamanashi prefecture, Japan. It was the primary fortress of the warlord Henmi Kiyomitsu, ancestor of the Takeda clan. The ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1993.
9a436f57e0f0e4ae.zh: 谷戸城是平安時代的山城式日本城郭，位於日本山梨縣北杜市大泉地區，曾是武田氏祖先、武將逸見清光的主要據點。遺址自1993年起被列為國家指定史跡。

9a481d6a24c54423.en: Goō Shrine (護王神社 ごおうじんじゃ Goō Jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in the Kamigyō-ku district of Kyoto, Japan.
9a481d6a24c54423.zh: 護王神社（ごおうじんじゃ）是位於日本京都上京區的神社。

9a59b5dc84fa9c14.en: The Himegamisha Shrine (Japanese: 比売神社, Himegamisha) is a Shinto shrine in the city of Nara, in Nara Prefecture, Japan. It is built in 1981 by the people of this neighborhood on the tomb called Hime-zuka (princess' tomb) that is estimated to be a burial place of Princess Tōchi, an Empress-consort of Emperor Kōbun. It is a sessha (subsidiary shrine) of the Kagami Shrine.
9a59b5dc84fa9c14.zh: 比賣神社是位於日本奈良縣奈良市的神社。1981年由當地居民建於名為「姬塚」（公主之墓）的墳墓上，此墓推測為弘文天皇皇后十市皇女的葬地。該社為鏡神社的攝社（附屬神社）。

9a77cd2810c84149.en: Flat udon (thick Japanese noodles) about 1 mm thick and 7 to 8 mm wide are called “Kishimen”. It is the soul food of Aichi Prefecture, eaten everywhere, and has its roots in the flat udon (called "Himokawa") that were a specialty of present-day Kariya City. There are many theories about the origin of the name "Kishimen", but it is said to have derived from the Chinese confectionery "Kishimen".
9a77cd2810c84149.zh: 厚約1毫米、寬7至8毫米的扁平烏龍麵（粗的日本麵條）稱為「きしめん」。這是愛知縣的靈魂食物，各地都吃得到，起源於現今刈谷市的名產扁平烏龍麵（稱為「ひもかわ」）。關於「きしめん」名稱的由來有許多說法，一般認為源自中國點心「きしめん」。

9a7ed87b2e189328.en: Mimi Udon" is a traditional dish in the Kuzuu area of Sano City and the Shiroyama area of Utsunomiya City. Udon noodles are generally thought of as long and thin strings, but Mimi Udon has a slightly different shape. It is called "Mimi Udon" because the shape made from kneaded flour resembles the shape of an ear. In Sano City, there is a custom of holding an ear-shaped udon in one's hand and putting it to one's ear to pray for good things in the coming year.
9a7ed87b2e189328.zh: 「耳うどん」是佐野市葛生地區與宇都宮市城山地區的傳統料理。一般認為烏龍麵是細長條狀，但耳うどん的形狀略有不同。因為揉好的麵團做成的形狀像耳朵，所以稱為「耳うどん」。佐野市有將耳朵形狀的烏龍麵拿在手中、貼近耳朵，祈求來年好事的習俗。

9a8693eaacab12dc.en: Ryōzen Shrine (霊山神社, Ryōzen Jinja) is a Shinto shrine located on Mount Ryōzen in the former town of Ryozen, within the city of Date, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. Its main festivals are held annually on April 22 and October 10.
9a8693eaacab12dc.zh: 靈山神社是位於日本福島縣伊達市舊靈山町靈山上的神社。主要祭典每年於4月22日及10月10日舉行。

9a8d47e38896c7b8.en: Kakarajima or Kagarashima (加唐島), also known as Kakara, is an island to the north of Yobuko, which is in the Higashimatsuura District of Saga Prefecture, Japan.
9a8d47e38896c7b8.zh: 加唐島（Kakarajima或Kagarashima，也稱Kakara）是位於日本佐賀縣東松浦郡呼子北方的島嶼。

9a91352f5cf41014.en: The Nagoya City Tram & Subway Museum (レトロでんしゃ館, 'Retoro densha-kan) is a museum located in the city of  Nisshin, Aichi, Japan.  It is owned and operated by the Transportation Bureau of the City of Nagoya.
9a91352f5cf41014.zh: レトロでんしゃ館（名古屋市電・地下鐵博物館）是位於日本愛知縣日進市的博物館，由名古屋市交通局擁有並經營。

9aa2e4d5d0f32fcc.en: Tsugaru Fujimi Lake (津軽富士見湖, Tsugaru Fujimi-ko) also known as Mawarizeki Ōtameike (廻堰大溜池) is a reservoir that is located almost entirely within the town of Tsuruta in Aomori Prefecture, Japan, though a portion of its southern shore lies within the city of Hirosaki. It was built in 1660 to collect snowmelt in order to irrigate the fields in the surrounding area.
9aa2e4d5d0f32fcc.zh: 津軽富士見湖又稱廻堰大溜池，是一座水庫，幾乎全部位於日本青森縣鶴田町境內，南岸一部分則屬於弘前市。該水庫建於1660年，用以蓄積融雪水，灌溉周邊農田。

9ab22fe23a337d01.en: Yanagase (柳ヶ瀬) is a downtown covered shopping arcade that serves as the main shopping area in the city of Gifu in Gifu Prefecture, Japan.
9ab22fe23a337d01.zh: 柳ヶ瀬是位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市市中心的有頂棚商店街，為該市的主要購物區。

9ac6737b4cbee363.en: Keishun-in (桂春院) is one of the 48  tatchu sub-temples  Myōshin-ji, a Rinzai school Zen Buddhist temple in the Hanazono neighborhood of Ukyō-ku in the city of Kyoto Japan. It is one of the Myōshin-ji's sub-temples which are normally open to the public.
9ac6737b4cbee363.zh: 桂春院是日本京都市右京區花園臨濟宗禪寺妙心寺的48座塔頭之一，也是妙心寺平時對外開放的塔頭之一。

9ad8bd35ef4320b8.en: Ōtani Hongan-ji Hakodate Betsu-in (大谷派本願寺函館別院) is a branch temple of Higashi Hongan-ji in Hakodate, Hokkaidō, Japan. Rebuilt after a fire in 1907, it is the first temple in Japan built with reinforced concrete. The Hondō (1915), Shōrō (1912–1925), and Shōmon (1912–1925) have all been designated Important Cultural Properties.
9ad8bd35ef4320b8.zh: 真宗大谷派函館別院（大谷派本願寺函館別院）是位於日本北海道函館的東本願寺別院。1907年火災後重建，是日本第一座以鋼筋混凝土建造的寺院。本堂（1915年）、鐘樓（1912–1925年）與正門（1912–1925年）皆已列為重要文化財。

9ae4745b6775673d.en: Ikushina Jinja (生品神社) is a Shinto shrine located in the city of Ōta, Gunma, Japan, dedicated to the kami Ōkuninushi. The precincts of this shrine was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1934.
9ae4745b6775673d.zh: 生品神社是位於日本群馬縣太田市的神社，祭祀大國主神。神社境內於1934年被指定為日本國家史跡。

9aecc231c1dd4017.en: Asty Tokushima (アスティとくしま) or the Tokushima Industry and Tourism Exchange Center (徳島県立産業観光交流センター, Tokushima Kenritsu Sangyō Kankō Kōryū Sentā) is an indoor arena and conference venue in Tokushima, Tokushima, Japan. The arena opened in 1993.
9aecc231c1dd4017.zh: アスティとくしま，又稱徳島県立産業観光交流センター，是位於日本德島縣德島市的室內體育館兼會議場地。體育館於1993年啟用。

9aee717cbd7ab3bc.en: Goshono ruins (御所野遺跡, Goshono iseki) is a middle Jōmon period archaeological site in the town of Ichinohe, Iwate Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan. Discovered during the construction of an industrial park in 1989, the area was designated a National Historic Site in 1993 by the Japanese government.
9aee717cbd7ab3bc.zh: 御所野遺跡是位於日本北部東北地方岩手縣一戶町的繩文時代中期考古遺址。1989年興建工業園區時發現，1993年由日本政府指定為國家史跡。

9b24b5ed6cf7544f.en: The Ōyu Stone Circles (大湯環状列石, Ōyu Kanjyō Resseki) is a late Jōmon period (approx. 2,000 – 1,500 BC) archaeological site in the city of Kazuno, Akita Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan.  The remains were designated a Special National Historic Site of Japan in 1956 by the Japanese government.  The site is located approximately ten minutes by car from Towada-Minami on the JR East Hanawa Line of the Towada Interchange on the Tohoku Expressway.
9b24b5ed6cf7544f.zh: 大湯環状列石是位於日本北部東北地方秋田縣鹿角市的繩文時代晚期（約西元前2,000年至1,500年）考古遺址，1956年由日本政府指定為國家特別史跡。遺址距JR東日本花輪線十和田南站或東北自動車道十和田交流道開車約十分鐘。

9b2e86493fb7c592.en: The Kawagoe Festival, officially named the Kawagoe Hikawa Festival (川越氷川祭, Kawagoe Hikawa Matsuri) is a traditional Japanese festival held annually on the third weekend of October in Kawagoe City, Saitama Prefecture. It is Kawagoe's biggest event and the festival has more than a 360-year history. It attracts around one million tourists during the two days. The grand pageant of the festival takes place in the castle town of Kawagoe including in the old storehouse zone called Kurazukuri Zone.
9b2e86493fb7c592.zh: 川越祭，正式名稱為川越氷川祭，是每年10月第三個週末在埼玉縣川越市舉行的日本傳統祭典。這是川越最大的活動，已有超過360年的歷史。兩天期間吸引約100萬名遊客。祭典的盛大遊行在川越的城下町舉行，包括稱為藏造地區的舊倉庫街區。

9b5a7d0c2f94e61f.en: The freshwater crucian carp found in reservoirs scattered throughout the Sanuki Plain are also referred to as teppo. Teppo-ae, or Teppai, is a salad consisting of chopped green onions mixed with crucian carp that is filleted, thinly sliced, sprinkled with salt and vinegar, then seasoned with a vinegar-miso sauce containing daikon radish and Sanuki white miso. This taste of Sanuki is an essential drinking accompaniment or side dish.
9b5a7d0c2f94e61f.zh: 散布於讚岐平原各處蓄水池中的淡水鯽魚，也被稱為「鐵砲」。鐵砲拌，也就是「てっぱい」，是將鯽魚剖片、切薄片，撒上鹽和醋，再與切碎的蔥混合，以加入蘿蔔與讚岐白味噌的醋味噌調味的涼拌菜。這道讚岐風味是不可或缺的下酒菜或配菜。

9b8360f4c05be723.en: Chitose Aquarium or The Salmon Hometown Chitose Aquarium (サケのふるさと 千歳水族館, Sake no furusato Chitose Suizokukan) is a public aquarium located in Chitose City, Hokkaido, Japan. The aquarium specializes in freshwater fish, Researching in salmon and sturgeon. It is a member of the Japanese Association of Zoos and Aquariums (JAZA), and the aquarium is accredited as a Museum-equivalent facilities by the Museum Act from Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology.
9b8360f4c05be723.zh: 千歳水族館，又稱サケのふるさと 千歳水族館，是位於日本北海道千歲市的公立水族館。館方以淡水魚為主，並從事鮭魚與鱘魚的研究。本館為日本動物園水族館協會（JAZA）會員，並依文部科學省主管的《博物館法》獲指定為博物館相當設施。

9bc004752fb2a04a.en: Mount Bizan (眉山, Bizan) is a mountain in the city of Tokushima in Tokushima Prefecture. The mountain's name is written with the characters for eyebrow and mountain. Bizan is said to have earned this name because the mountain resembles the contures of an eyebrow from all directions. Regarded as a symbol of Tokushima City, the name Mount Bizan appears in many school songs in the city district, such as the Tokushima Prefectural Jonan High School, Tokushima Municipal High School and many more.
9bc004752fb2a04a.zh: 眉山是位於德島縣德島市的一座山。山名由「眉」與「山」二字組成。據說眉山得名的原因，是從任何方向看，山形都像眉毛的輪廓。眉山被視為德島市的象徵，市內許多學校的校歌都出現眉山之名，例如德島縣立城南高等學校、德島市立高等學校等。

9bc5b409fb81f534.en: Ryūfuku-ji (龍福寺) is a Buddhist temple, formally known as Sentakisan Ryūfuku-ji (仙滝山龍福寺), located in the Iwai district of the city of Asahi in Chiba Prefecture, Japan.  The temple is also known as the Iwai no Taki Fudō (岩井の滝不動), a reference to a Fudō-myōō statue located under a waterfall on the site.
9bc5b409fb81f534.zh: 龍福寺是位於日本千葉縣旭市岩井地區的佛教寺院，正式名稱為仙滝山龍福寺。本寺又稱「岩井の滝不動」，名稱源自寺內瀑布下方的不動明王像。

9be8687bb3de65e3.en: The spawning season of Pacific cod comes in the rough seas of the Sea of Japan, and it is a popular winter delicacy in the Shonai region. Cod, as shown in its kanji character ('snow' on the right and the 'fish' radical on the left), comes into season during the snowy season. Especially in the Shonai region, the cod caught during the cold season of the 24 divisions of the old calendar (from early January to early February) is called "Kandara (cold cod)". At this time of year when the fish gather to spawn, Kandara trawl fishery is very popular.
9be8687bb3de65e3.zh: 太平洋鱈的產卵期在波濤洶湧的日本海到來，是庄內地區受歡迎的冬季美味。正如其漢字（右邊是「雪」，左邊是「魚」部首）所示，鱈魚在下雪的季節當令。尤其在庄內地區，於舊曆二十四節氣中的寒季（1月上旬至2月上旬）捕獲的鱈魚稱為「寒鱈」。在魚群聚集產卵的這個時期，寒鱈拖網漁業相當興盛。

9beceaee7abed01c.en: Hakata Island (伯方島, Hakatajima) is an island in the Inland Sea of Japan. Administratively, it is part of the city of Imabari, Ehime Prefecture. Originally, there was a town of the same name on this island, but it was merged into Imabari in 2005.
9beceaee7abed01c.zh: 伯方島是日本瀨戶內海中的島嶼，行政上屬於愛媛縣今治市。島上原有同名的町，2005年併入今治市。

9c1fa0cbc0842f2d.en: Korekawa Archaeological Institution (Korekawa Jōmon Kan) (八戸市埋蔵文化財センター 是川縄文館, Hachinohe-shi Maizō Bunkazai Sentā (Korekawa Jōmon-kan)), more literally the Hachinohe City Buried Cultural Property Center, opened in Hachinohe, Aomori Prefecture, Japan in 2011. It exhibits Jōmon materials from the nearby Korekawa Site and Kazahari I Site (風張１遺跡), finds at the latter including the "Palms Together Dogū" (合掌土偶) that has been designated a National Treasure.
9c1fa0cbc0842f2d.zh: 八戶市埋藏文化財中心 是川繩文館（八戸市埋蔵文化財センター 是川縄文館）於2011年在日本青森縣八戶市開館。館內展示鄰近是川遺跡與風張1遺跡出土的繩文時代資料，後者的出土文物包括已被指定為國寶的「合掌土偶」。

9c6286d1abd76a46.en: The Yunokawa Onsen (湯の川温泉) is a well known onsen in Japan on the northern island of Hokkaidō. It is located on the outskirts of Hakodate city close to Hakodate Airport.
9c6286d1abd76a46.zh: 湯の川温泉是位於日本北方島嶼北海道的知名溫泉，位於函館市郊區，鄰近函館機場。

9c6b6002102ef8b4.en: The famous red turnip in Fukui Prefecture is a traditional vegetable known as "Kochi Akakabura," cultivated vigorously in the Kohi community of the Miyama area in Fukui City for over 800 years. Surrounded by mountains and benefiting from heavy snowfall and significant temperature variations, the cultivation of red turnips is well-suited in Fukui Prefecture.
9c6b6002102ef8b4.zh: 福井縣著名的紅蕪菁是傳統蔬菜「河內赤かぶら」，在福井市美山地區的河內聚落已持續大量栽培超過800年。福井縣四面環山、降雪量大、溫差顯著，適合栽培紅蕪菁。

9c71cffaecd31cca.en: Suwahara Castle (諏訪原城, Suwahara-jō) was a Sengoku period yamashiro-style Japanese castle located in the Kanaya neighborhood of the city of Shimada, Shizuoka prefecture, Japan. The ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1975.
9c71cffaecd31cca.zh: 諏訪原城是戰國時代的山城式日本城郭，位於日本靜岡縣島田市金谷地區。城跡自1975年起被指定為國家史跡受到保護。

9c7c2ad1eb6c1231.en: The practice of dolphin fishing in Shizuoka Prefecture has been conducted primarily in the Izu region. The gulfs of the Izu Peninsula serve as migration routes for the dolphins, while the complex geography of the peninsula makes it a suitable location for the dolphin drive fishing method, whereby dolphins are herded and driven into a bay or beach using boats. Dolphin bones found at Jomon period archaeological sites, as well as records from medieval and early modern eras, indicate that dolphin fishing has been practiced since ancient times.
9c7c2ad1eb6c1231.zh: 靜岡縣的捕海豚主要在伊豆地區進行。伊豆半島的海灣是海豚的洄游路線，而半島複雜的地形適合採用追込漁法，也就是以船隻驅趕海豚，將其趕入海灣或海灘。繩文時代遺址出土的海豚骨，以及中世與近世的紀錄，都顯示捕海豚自古以來就有。

9c99ca3619eb2cc6.en: Nii Ōshima (新居大島), or sometimes just Ōshima (大島), is an inhabited island located roughly 1.5 kilometers northeast of the city of Niihama (which it is officially a part of) in Ehime Prefecture, Japan.
9c99ca3619eb2cc6.zh: 新居大島，有時也簡稱大島，是位於日本愛媛縣新居濱市東北方約1.5公里處的有人島，行政上屬於新居濱市。

9cabe9a033304aef.en: In Okinawa Prefecture, "ina" means "wild boar" and "muduchi" means "imitation"; the local dish "inamuduchi" means "imitation wild boar. The local dish "inamduchi" means "wild boar meat" and is also called "inamuruchi. In the past, wild boar meat was used to make the soup, but since wild boar meat became hard to find, pork was used to make the soup, hence the name. Ingredients such as konnyaku and kamaboko are added and flavored with sweet soybean paste, resulting in a thick and filling dish.
9cabe9a033304aef.zh: 在沖繩縣，「イナ」意為「山豬」，「ムドゥチ」意為「模仿」，鄉土料理イナムドゥチ就是「仿山豬」的意思。這道料理也稱為「イナムルチ」。過去是用山豬肉煮湯，但後來山豬肉不易取得，改用豬肉煮湯，因而得名。湯中加入蒟蒻、魚板等食材，以甜味噌調味，成為濃稠而有飽足感的料理。

9cac1c717d3675bb.en: Kaga Yasai is a brand of vegetables recognized by Kanazawa City. This brand name was first used in earnest in the Heisei era (around 1990). To be certified as a brand, the vegetables must be grown mainly in Kanazawa City and have been cultivated since before 1945. There are 15 certified vegetables, including sweet potatoes, Kaga futo cucumber, Gensuke daikon radish, bamboo shoots, and Kaga lotus root.Of these, Kaga lotus root has a long history of cultivation dating back to the feudal domain era.
9cac1c717d3675bb.zh: 加賀蔬菜是金澤市認定的蔬菜品牌。這個品牌名稱自平成時代（1990年左右）開始正式使用。要獲得品牌認證，蔬菜必須主要在金澤市種植，且自1945年以前即開始栽培。認證蔬菜共有15種，包括番薯、加賀太黃瓜、源助白蘿蔔、竹筍、加賀蓮藕等。其中加賀蓮藕的栽培歷史悠久，可追溯至藩政時代。

9cb2c564b8bd7965.en: The salmon shark or moro, as it is called in Tochigi, is caught off the coast of northern Ibaraki, Fukushima, and Miyagi. Made by simmering salmon shark in soy sauce and sugar to make it tender, Moro no Nitsuke is a home-cooked dish well-known in Tochigi.Shark dishes were commonly consumed in inland areas far from the sea and were a valuable source of protein for the folks there. This is because shark meat was neither popular nor widely consumed by people near fishing ports where sharks were caught.
9cb2c564b8bd7965.zh: 鼠鯊在栃木稱為「モロ」，捕獲於茨城北部、福島和宮城外海。將鼠鯊以醬油和砂糖燉煮至軟嫩的「モロの煮付」，是栃木廣為人知的家常菜。鯊魚料理過去在遠離海洋的內陸地區普遍食用，是當地人寶貴的蛋白質來源。這是因為在捕獲鯊魚的漁港附近，鯊魚肉並不受歡迎，也很少有人吃。

9cbd7583d047d4fc.en: In Fukushima Prefecture, soybeans are extensively cultivated, and many varieties of soybeans are grown, such as "Oosuzu," "Fukuibuki," and "Sato no Hohoemi". Soybeans produced in this region are not only used for processed products like natto, tofu, miso, and soy sauce but are also integral to local cuisine."Mame Kazunoko" is one such regional dish that uses soybeans. This dish is prepared with a type of soybean called "Hiyashi Mame" alongside herring roe marinated in soy sauce.
9cbd7583d047d4fc.zh: 福島縣廣泛種植大豆，栽培的品種很多，例如「おおすず」、「ふくいぶき」和「里のほほえみ」。當地生產的大豆不僅用於納豆、豆腐、味噌、醬油等加工品，也是鄉土料理中不可或缺的食材。「豆数の子」就是使用大豆的鄉土料理之一。這道料理是用一種叫做「浸し豆」的大豆，搭配以醬油醃漬的鯡魚卵製成。

9cc3765febf19937.en: It is said that the dish began with Buddhist cuisine which does not use chicken, and is made without exception for Buddhist memorial services, and frequently made for celebrations such as weddings as well. An odd number of ingredients are selected from taro, konjac, carrots, shiitake, fried tofu skin, wheat gluten, and lotus root, and each are cut into 3-4 cubes. Soy sauce and salt are added with a subtle amount of sugar, and then boiled in dashi broth for the taste of a clear soup with many ingredients.
9cc3765febf19937.zh: 據說這道料理源自不使用雞肉的佛教料理，佛事法會時一定會製作，婚禮等喜慶場合也常製作。從芋頭、蒟蒻、紅蘿蔔、香菇、炸豆皮、麩及蓮藕中選取奇數種食材，各切成3至4公分見方的塊狀。加入醬油、鹽及少許砂糖，再以高湯煮成料多的清湯風味。

9cf1b0366d838f49.en: The Hokkaido Museum of Modern Art (北海道立近代美術館, Hokkaidō-ritsu Kindai Bijutsukan) opened in Sapporo, Hokkaidō, Japan in 1977. The collection includes works by Jules Pascin and the École de Paris as well as by modern Japanese artists, in particular those with a connection to Hokkaidō.
9cf1b0366d838f49.zh: 北海道立近代美術館於1977年在日本北海道札幌開館。館藏包括朱爾·帕斯金（Jules Pascin）及巴黎畫派的作品，以及日本近代藝術家的作品，尤其是與北海道有淵源的藝術家。

9cf78f4fd14c11e4.en: The Kanazawa Yuwaku Yumeji-kan Museum (Japanese: 金沢湯涌夢二館) is a museum in Yuwaku Hot Spring, Kanazawa, Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan dedicated to the works of the artist Yumeji Takehisa.
9cf78f4fd14c11e4.zh: 金沢湯涌夢二館是位於日本石川縣金澤市湯涌溫泉的博物館，專門展示藝術家竹久夢二的作品。

9d1d9b705b6f6e49.en: Sportsland Sugo (スポーツランドSUGO, Supōtsurando Sugo) is a motorsports facility in the town of Murata, Shibata District, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan.
9d1d9b705b6f6e49.zh: スポーツランドSUGO是位於日本宮城縣柴田郡村田町的賽車運動設施。

9d236e5a84c72976.en: Shuzen-ji (修禅寺, Shuzenji) is a Buddhist temple in Izu, Shizuoka Prefecture.
9d236e5a84c72976.zh: 修禅寺是位於靜岡縣伊豆市的佛教寺院。

9d2b192724981d32.en: Mount Odake (大岳山, Oodakesan) 1,266 m (4,154 ft)) is a mountain located within the Nishi-Okutama District, in the village of Hinohara and the town of Okutama, Tokyo, in western Tokyo, Japan, and located within Chichibu Tama Kai National Park.
9d2b192724981d32.zh: 大岳山（1,266公尺／4,154英尺）是位於日本東京都西部西多摩郡檜原村與奧多摩町的山，位於秩父多摩甲斐國立公園內。

9d3753d8e017f821.en: Tokyo Port Wild Bird Park (東京港野鳥公園, tōkyōkō yachō kōen) is a park and nature reserve located in Ōta Ward, Tokyo. The park was created on reclaimed land after local residents campaigned for its conservation, and comprises 36 hectares in area. It receives around 50,000 visitors annually.
9d3753d8e017f821.zh: 東京港野鳥公園（東京港野鳥公園）是位於東京都大田區的公園暨自然保護區。公園在當地居民爭取保護之後設立於填海造地上，面積36公頃。每年約有5萬名遊客造訪。

9d3ce8faf865da41.en: Mangan-ji (満願寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Izuru neighborhood of the city of Tochigi, Tochigi Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the  Chisan-branch of Shingon Buddhism and its honzon is a statue of Senjū Kannon Bosatsu ( Sahasrabhūja).  The temple's full name is Izuru-zan Senjū-in Mangan-ji (出流山 千手院 滿願寺).The temple is the 17th stop on the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route.
9d3ce8faf865da41.zh: 滿願寺是位於日本栃木縣栃木市出流町的佛寺，屬真言宗智山派，本尊為千手觀音菩薩像。寺院全名為出流山千手院滿願寺。本寺為坂東三十三所巡禮的第17番札所。

9d55832684f3e67f.en: One of the nationally renowned regional dishes, "Noppei," also known as "Noppei-jiru," "Noppe," "Nuppei," and called by various names in other prefectures, is a beloved cuisine. With satoimo(=Japanese taro) as a staple ingredient, it is often consumed in winter, aligning with the harvest season. The dish features root vegetables such as carrots, gobou(=burdock), and daikon radish, and is characterized by not being stir-fried. In the Iga region, it is enjoyed as a representative winter side dish.
9d55832684f3e67f.zh: 「のっぺい」是全國知名的鄉土料理之一，又稱「のっぺい汁」、「のっぺ」、「ぬっぺい」，在其他縣也有各種名稱，廣受喜愛。以里芋（日本芋頭）為主要食材，配合其收穫期，常在冬季食用。這道料理使用紅蘿蔔、牛蒡、白蘿蔔等根莖類蔬菜，特色是不經過炒製。在伊賀地區是具代表性的冬季配菜。

9d692a110e709de6.en: Wasabi pickles are made by marinating chopped wasabi leaves, stems, and roots in sake lees.Wasabi is said to have originated during the Keicho era (1596-1615), when wild wasabi, which had been growing wild on Bukkoku-san (Mt. Butsudani) in the Aoi Ward of Shizuoka City's Aoi Ward since before that time, was planted near a spring source in the same area. Tokugawa Ieyasu, who spent his later years at Sunpu Castle, forbade the wasabi from leaving the area, and for many years it never left the Aritogi district.
9d692a110e709de6.zh: 山葵漬是將切碎的山葵葉、莖和根以酒粕醃漬而成。據說山葵的栽培始於慶長年間（1596-1615），當時將此前就野生於靜岡市葵區佛谷山的山葵，移植到同一地區的湧泉附近。晚年居於駿府城的德川家康禁止山葵流出當地，因此多年來山葵都不曾離開有東木地區。

9d6ac735c3422a22.en: Ogura toast (小倉トースト, ogura tōsuto) is a  dish of thickly sliced toasted bread topped with ogura, a sweet jam made from adzuki beans. It is often served in cafés in Nagoya, Japan.
9d6ac735c3422a22.zh: 小倉トースト是在厚片烤吐司上放上小倉（以紅豆製成的甜餡）的料理，常見於日本名古屋的咖啡店。

9d74d6f3236c8246.en: Oita Prefecture is known for its frequent consumption of chicken. In 2019, the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications conducted a survey of annual chicken consumption per household for prefectural capitals and government-designated cities, and Oita City ranked first in Japan.In Oita Prefecture, various chicken dishes such as "Tori-Meshi," a mixed rice dish with chicken, and "Tori-Jiru," a soup with chicken broth, have been eaten.
9d74d6f3236c8246.zh: 大分縣以雞肉消費量高而聞名。2019年總務省針對各縣廳所在地及政令指定都市進行每戶年度雞肉消費量調查，大分市排名全國第一。在大分縣，以雞肉製成的炊飯「雞飯」、以雞高湯煮成的湯品「雞汁」等各種雞肉料理一直以來都有人食用。

9d96185547d256a9.en: “Koppa-mochi" is a traditional snack made from sweet potatoes, a specialty of the Amakusa region. The word "koppa" comes from a dialect word meaning “cut into small pieces,” and refers to peeled sweet potatoes that have been cut into 1- or 2-cm round slices, boiled, and dried in the sun. The sight of straw-threaded slices of sweet potatoes hanging from the eaves, signaling the arrival of winter, is a common scene in Amakusa.
9d96185547d256a9.zh: 「こっぱもち」是以番薯製作的傳統點心，為天草地區的特產。「こっぱ」一詞來自方言，意思是「切成小塊」，指的是將番薯去皮後切成1或2公分厚的圓片，煮過後放在陽光下晒乾的東西。用稻草串起的番薯片掛在屋簷下，宣告冬天的到來，是天草常見的景象。

9dc973bcbc3c5f96.en: The Matsuyama City Shiki Memorial Museum (子規記念博物館, Shiki Kinen Hakubutsukan) is a museum devoted mainly to the life and work of Japanese writer Masaoka Shiki, who was born and raised in Matsuyama.
9dc973bcbc3c5f96.zh: 松山市立子規記念博物館是以日本作家正岡子規的生平與作品為主要內容的博物館。正岡子規在松山出生並長大。

9dea1007df9182f5.en: Towatari Shrine (登渡神社, Towatari-jinja), also known as Nobuto Shrine (登戸神社, Nobuto-jinja), is a Shinto shrine located in Nobuto, Chūō-ku, Chiba City, Chiba Prefecture, Japan. Originally a branch temple of Kongojū-ji, a temple to the Buddhist deity Myōken founded by the Chiba clan (modern Chiba Shrine), it was converted into a Shinto shrine during the mid-19th century.
9dea1007df9182f5.zh: 登渡神社又稱登戶神社，是位於日本千葉縣千葉市中央區登戶的神社。原為千葉氏所創建、供奉佛教妙見菩薩的金剛授寺（今千葉神社）的分寺，於19世紀中葉改為神社。

9df3bbb90e2ee6ea.en: When ordering “katsudon” in Yamanashi prefecture, the rice dish is served with julienned cabbage and pork cutlet on top. A thick sauce is poured on top of the ingredients and when combined with the freshly cooked pork cutlet, the soup from the meat and the sauce are delicious together. The cabbage tones down the oil from the pork, and one can fully enjoy this dish until the end. In other prefectures of Japan, “katsudon” is made with egg but this dish is called “ni-katsudon” in Yamanashi.
9df3bbb90e2ee6ea.zh: 在山梨縣點「かつ丼」，端上來的是白飯上鋪高麗菜絲和炸豬排。食材上淋有濃稠醬汁，與剛炸好的豬排搭配，肉汁與醬汁相融，十分美味。高麗菜能中和豬排的油膩，可以一路吃到最後。日本其他縣的「かつ丼」是用蛋做的，這種做法在山梨稱為「煮かつ丼」。

9df6e96879abf983.en: "Wakegi" is called "Senbuki" in Fukuoka. It is a variant of the leek, softer and sweeter than the green onion. Although similar in appearance to the leek, the Wakegi is split in two at the root. It becomes delicious in February and March. The dish is named "Senbuki-Mage" because this "Senbuki" is quickly boiled, bent, and served. "Su-Miso-Ae (Vinegared miso paste)" is a typical dish, and it is always prepared for the Doll's Festival. Boil the senbuki, bend it several times from the root end and tie it.
9df6e96879abf983.zh: 「分蔥」在福岡稱為「せんぶき」。它是韭蔥的變種，比青蔥更柔軟、更甜。外觀雖與韭蔥相似，但分蔥在根部分成兩股。2月與3月時最為美味。將這種「せんぶき」快速汆燙後彎折盛盤，因此這道菜稱為「せんぶきまげ」。代表性的吃法是「酢味噌和え（醋味噌涼拌）」，女兒節時必定會準備。做法是將せんぶき汆燙後，從根部那端折數次再打結。

9dfc60455d4d81ec.en: In the Higashi-Kishu area, "oshi-zushi" is often made by pressing sushi into a mold and hardening it on occasions such as a gathering of people or on special occasions. It is said that the name "kokerazushi" comes from the fact that it was served on the occasion of "kokerashi-no-koshi" (a ceremony to welcome the new year), and that the ingredients were placed one on top of the other like the roof of a kokerabuki (a traditional Japanese roof).
9dfc60455d4d81ec.zh: 東紀州地區在人們聚會或特殊場合時，常將壽司壓入模具使其定型，製作「押壽司」。據說「こけらずし」之名，源自於在「こけらしのこし」（迎接新年的儀式）時供應，以及食材層層相疊，如同杮葺（日本傳統屋頂）的屋頂。

9e11a0477b367534.en: The Tenson Shrine (天孫神社, Tenson Jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Ōtsu, Shiga, Japan.
9e11a0477b367534.zh: 天孫神社是位於日本滋賀縣大津市的神社。

9e1b1814c646904d.en: “Tori Meshi” is a rice seasoned and cooked with vegetables and chicken meat and has been a popular recipe for years, particularly as a farmer’s dish. It is often eaten during short breaks when harvesting or engaging in farmwork. The rice is made into rice balls so that a family member can easily give the rice ball to someone working hard in a field. The people of Miyazaki and other areas of Kyushu eat a lot of chicken meat and this dish is enjoyed daily. When many people gather for an event, the dish is prepared in a large pot.
9e1b1814c646904d.zh: 「とりめし」是將米與蔬菜、雞肉一同調味炊煮的飯，多年來是很受歡迎的做法，尤其是作為農家料理。常在收割或農務的短暫休息時食用。飯會捏成飯糰，方便家人遞給在田裡辛勤工作的人。宮崎及九州其他地區的人吃很多雞肉，這道料理日常就會食用。有許多人聚集的活動時，會用大鍋烹煮。

9e206bb3bacc621b.en: Yamanashi, known as Kai Province since the Ritsuryo system era, has been recognized as a contributor of tribute horses. The "Kai no Kurokoma" (Black Horses of Kai) were a coveted brand among the aristocracy during that time. Furthermore, during the heyday of Mount Fuji's pilgrimage, many horses were kept for carrying the loads of climbers. Due to the proximity of horses, it is said that horse meat dishes became popular because they were readily available and affordable.
9e206bb3bacc621b.zh: 山梨自律令制時代起稱為甲斐國，以進貢馬匹而聞名。「甲斐の黒駒」（甲斐的黑馬）是當時貴族之間競相追求的名品。此外，在富士山參拜登山的全盛時期，當地飼養了許多馬匹為登山者馱運行李。據說由於馬匹就在身邊，馬肉容易取得且價格低廉，馬肉料理因而普及。

9e2637db746b3ec5.en: Senju-ji (専修寺), also known as Takadayama (高田山), refers to a pair of temples which are the chief Buddhist temples of the Takada branch of Jōdo Shinshū, a Japanese Buddhist sect. The current head temple, Honan Senju-ji, founded in the 15th century, is located in Mie Prefecture. The original head temple, Hon-ji Senju-ji, founded in 1225, is located in Tochigi Prefecture. Both temples are governed by the same abbot.
9e2637db746b3ec5.zh: 專修寺又稱高田山，指日本佛教宗派淨土真宗高田派的兩座本山寺院。現在的本山本山專修寺創建於15世紀，位於三重縣；原本的本山本寺專修寺創建於1225年，位於栃木縣。兩寺由同一位住持管理。

9e35b26007f5c944.en: The Futagami Manyo Botanical Gardens (二上山万葉植物園, Futagamiyama Man'yō Shokubutsuen) are botanical gardens located in Takaoka, Toyama, Japan.
9e35b26007f5c944.zh: 二上山萬葉植物園是位於日本富山縣高岡市的植物園。

9e6175b5c681891e.en: The Furogu Shrine (Japanese: 風浪宮, romanized: Palace of Wind and Waves is a shrine located in Okawa, Fukuoka Prefecture. It is a central shrine of the city. It has been traditionally served by the Azumi people.
9e6175b5c681891e.zh: 風浪宮（意為「風與浪之宮」）是位於福岡縣大川市的神社，為該市的中心神社，傳統上由阿曇族奉祀。

9e704637073afe32.en: This is a dish made by rehydrating "kiriboshi Daikon"(=Dried strips of Daikon radish), adding seasonings, and slowly simmering it. In winter, Tochigi Prefecture experiences dry winds and many continuous sunny days, making it conducive to the production of dried foods such as "Kiriboshi daikon(=dried shredded daikon radish)" and "Imogara (=dried Satoimo(=Japanese taro) stalk).
9e704637073afe32.zh: 這道料理是將「切干し大根」（蘿蔔乾絲）泡發，加入調味料後慢慢燉煮而成。栃木縣冬季吹乾燥的風，晴天持續多日，適合製作「切干し大根」和「芋がら」（乾燥的里芋莖）等乾貨。

9e8d331d04de3cfe.en: Iwakuni City is known as the eastern gateway to Yamaguchi Prefecture. The city has a history of prosperity as a castle town of 60,000 goku of the Yoshikawa domain, and even today, it is blessed with numerous historical and cultural assets as well as beautiful nature. The famous symbol of the city is the Kintai Bridge, a five-storied arched bridge that was built some 300 years ago.
9e8d331d04de3cfe.zh: 岩國市被稱為山口縣的東大門。該市曾作為吉川藩六萬石的城下町而繁榮，至今仍擁有眾多歷史文化資產與美麗的自然景觀。該市著名的象徵是約300年前建造的五連拱橋錦帶橋。

9ec6a4be3711c045.en: Tsunomure Castle (角牟礼城, Tsunomure-jō) was a yamajiro-style Japanese castle located in the town of Kusu, Ōita Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2005. It is on the list "Continued 100 Fine Castles of Japan".
9ec6a4be3711c045.zh: 角牟礼城是位於日本大分縣玖珠町的山城式日本城郭。其遺跡自2005年起列為國家史跡保護，並列入「續日本100名城」。

9ec828ebdcffb653.en: Iwasaki Art Museum (岩崎美術館, Iwasaki bijutsukan) opened in Ibusuki, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan, in 1983. Located in the gardens of a resort hotel and designed by Fumihiko Maki, the museum's collection includes works by Kuroda Seiki and Fujishima Takeji, as well as Western painters. The adjacent Iwasaki Yoshie Craft Gallery (岩崎芳江工芸館) was established by the bequest of Iwasaki Yoshie, wife of the museum's founder businessman Iwasaki Yohachirō (岩崎與八郎), and opened in 1998. It houses objects including Satsuma ware and folk art from Papua New Guinea.
9ec828ebdcffb653.zh: 岩崎美術館（岩崎美術館）於1983年在日本鹿兒島縣指宿市開館。美術館位於一座度假飯店的庭園內，由槇文彥設計，館藏包括黑田清輝、藤島武二及西洋畫家的作品。毗鄰的岩崎芳江工藝館（岩崎芳江工芸館）依岩崎芳江的遺贈設立，於1998年開館；岩崎芳江是美術館創辦人、企業家岩崎與八郎（岩崎與八郎）的妻子。館內收藏薩摩燒及巴布亞紐幾內亞的民俗工藝品等物件。

9ecd4fa210c4973c.en: Simmered dried gourd with egg" is a local dish using kanpyo, a specialty of Tochigi Prefecture. Tochigi Prefecture is a production center of kanpyo, which accounts for more than 90% of the total production in Japan. The history of its cultivation is long, beginning in 1712 when it was introduced to the Mibu domain in Shimono-kuni (present-day Mibu-cho, Tochigi Prefecture).
9ecd4fa210c4973c.zh: 「干瓢の卵とじ」是使用栃木縣特產干瓢的鄉土料理。栃木縣是干瓢的產地，產量佔全日本總產量的九成以上。干瓢栽培歷史悠久，始於1712年引進下野國壬生藩（今栃木縣壬生町）。

9ef6c999c9b1c6a0.en: Sunritz Hattori Museum of Arts (サンリツ服部美術館, Sanritsu Hattori bijutsukan) is located on the shore of Lake Suwa in Suwa, Nagano Prefecture, Japan. Designed by Shōzō Uchii, it opened in 1995. The collection includes works by Renoir and Chagall, Ogata Kōrin and Sakai Hōitsu, as well as one of the two Japanese National Treasure tea bowls, Fuji-san by Honami Kōetsu.
9ef6c999c9b1c6a0.zh: サンリツ服部美術館位於日本長野縣諏訪市的諏訪湖畔，由內井昭藏設計，1995年開館。館藏包括雷諾瓦與夏卡爾、尾形光琳與酒井抱一的作品，以及日本兩件國寶茶碗之一、本阿彌光悅的「不二山」。

9efa014d75446107.en: The Harunasan Ropeway (榛名山ロープウェイ, Harunasan Rōpuwei) is a Japanese aerial lift line in Haruna, Gunma, operated by Tanigawadake Ropeway Company. The Tōbu Group company also operates another aerial lift line, Tanigawadake Ropeway. The line climbs to the summit of Mount Haruna. The line opened in 1929, and refurbished in 1996 to the current system, which two smaller cabins are attached.
9efa014d75446107.zh: 榛名山ロープウェイ是位於日本群馬縣榛名的空中纜車路線，由谷川岳纜車公司經營。這家東武集團旗下的公司也經營另一條空中纜車谷川岳ロープウェイ。路線通往榛名山山頂，於1929年啟用，1996年更新為現行系統，連接兩節較小的車廂。

9f08c24cfe894792.en: “Nadazuke” are made by pickling daikon radishes cut by a hatchet (nada in Japanese) in amazake (sweet sake).The three great gakko (pickles) of Akita prefecture are iburigakko (smoked daikon), sotoboshi (outdoor dried pickles), and namazuke (raw pickles).
9f08c24cfe894792.zh: 「なた漬け」是將用柴刀（日文稱「なた」）切開的白蘿蔔，以甘酒醃漬而成。秋田縣的三大「がっこ」（醃漬物）為いぶりがっこ（煙燻白蘿蔔）、そとぼし（戶外乾燥的醃漬物）與なまづけ（生漬）。

9f0aeac47475c314.en: Mackerel has long been a popular fish among the people of Tango Peninsula, which faces Wakasa Bay. At a time when refrigeration technology was not yet developed, mackerel lost its freshness very quickly, so innovations were devised to prolong the enjoyment of mackerel. “Heshiko”, which is marinated in salt and then pickled in sake lees, is another dish that was created to prolong the quality of mackerel, and grilling is another method of preserving them.
9f0aeac47475c314.zh: 對面向若狹灣的丹後半島居民來說，鯖魚自古就是很受歡迎的魚。在冷藏技術尚未發達的年代，鯖魚很快就會失去鮮度，因此人們想出各種方法，讓鯖魚能吃得更久。先用鹽醃漬再以酒粕醃製的「へしこ」也是為了延長鯖魚品質而產生的料理，燒烤則是另一種保存方法。

9f0dc99596f5454f.en: Ōge-jima (大毛島) is an island in the Seto Inland Sea administered under Naruto in Tokushima Prefecture.
9f0dc99596f5454f.zh: 大毛島是瀨戶內海的島嶼，隸屬德島縣鳴門市管轄。

9f21f2324f67a402.en: "Asazuke" is a dish made by boiling rice, then seasoning vegetables and fruits with sugar and vinegar. It is completely different from the generally recognized "Asazuke" (lightly pickled vegetables), and instead is known as a sweet and sour dessert made with rice. This refreshing vinegary dish is eaten throughout Akita Prefecture during the summer.
9f21f2324f67a402.zh: 「あさづけ」是將米煮過後，與以砂糖和醋調味的蔬菜、水果一起製成的料理。它與一般所知的「淺漬」（淺醃蔬菜）完全不同，而是以米製成的酸甜甜點。這道清爽的醋味料理在夏季於秋田縣各地食用。

9f2597e1f78806da.en: Ōmi-dō (大御堂) is a Buddhist temple located in the city of Tsukuba, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the  Shingon-shu Buzan-ha sect and its honzon is a statue of Juichimen Kannon Bosatsu.  The temple's full name is Gokoku-ji Betsuin Tsukuba-zan Chisoku-in Chūzen-ji Ōmi-dō ( 護国寺別院  筑波山 知足院 中禅寺 大御堂).The temple is the 25th stop on the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route. It is a branch of Gokoku-ji in Tokyo.
9f2597e1f78806da.zh: 大御堂是位於日本茨城縣筑波市的佛教寺院，屬真言宗豐山派，本尊為十一面觀音菩薩像。寺院全名為護國寺別院 筑波山 知足院 中禪寺 大御堂。該寺為坂東三十三所朝聖路線的第25番札所，是東京護國寺的分院。

9f460e0f7626cc77.en: Spa Resort Hawaiians (スパリゾートハワイアンズ), located in the city of Iwaki, Fukushima Prefecture, is a resort and theme park in Japan. It opened on January 15, 1966 as the Joban Hawaiian Center, becoming the first in the country.
9f460e0f7626cc77.zh: スパリゾートハワイアンズ位於福島縣いわき市，是日本的度假村及主題樂園。1966年1月15日以「常磐ハワイアンセンター」之名開幕，為日本國內首座此類設施。

9f5da3e114155535.en: "Imo-yokan", a sweet potato cake, is made by steaming, kneading, and molding sweet potatoes and other ingredients. It is a Japanese confectionery created by a sweet potato wholesaler and a confectionery craftsman in Asakusa during the Meiji Era. At that time, "kneaded yokan" (=a bar of sweet bean paste) was expensive and common people did not have many opportunities to eat it.
9f5da3e114155535.zh: 「いもようかん」是將番薯等材料蒸熟、揉製並塑形而成的番薯糕。這是明治時代淺草的番薯批發商與和菓子師傅所創製的和菓子。當時「練羊羹」（條狀的甜豆沙）價格昂貴，一般百姓少有機會吃到。

9f63e0005c1201cc.en: Mame-shitogi is a fresh sweet made by kneading boiled and ground green soybeans with rice flour and sugar. “Shitogi” means “to grind,” and normally, it refers to food offerings made with rice flour. Mame-shitogi is made with beans as a substitute. It is also known as “mame-suttogi.”The northern part of Iwate Prefecture is extremely cold due to the cold wind from the east called “yamase,” and because rice paddies were scarce, rice was precious.
9f63e0005c1201cc.zh: 豆しとぎ是將煮熟磨碎的青大豆與米粉、砂糖揉合製成的生菓子。「しとぎ」意為「磨碎」，一般是指以米粉製作的供品，豆しとぎ則以豆類代替。又稱「まめすっとぎ」。岩手縣北部受到名為「やませ」的東風寒風影響，極為寒冷，加上水田稀少，稻米十分珍貴。

9f6f29f11a75cb90.en: The Makino Botanical Garden (高知県立牧野植物園, Kōchi Kenritsu Makino Shokubutsuen), also known as the Kochi Prefectural Makino Botanical Garden, is a botanical garden located at Godaisan 4200-6, Kōchi, Kōchi Prefecture, Japan. It is open to the public daily except Mondays; an admission fee is charged.
9f6f29f11a75cb90.zh: 高知県立牧野植物園又稱高知縣立牧野植物園，是位於日本高知縣高知市五台山4200-6的植物園。除週一外每日對外開放，需收取入園費。

9f965d1e77d30000.en: Taisan-ji An'yō-in (太山寺 安養院) is a temple of the Tendai sect in Kobe, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan.
9f965d1e77d30000.zh: 太山寺安養院是位於日本兵庫縣神戶市的天台宗寺院。

9fa2a49f3ac49580.en: The Oki Islands are an archipelago in the northeast of Shimane Prefecture, consisting of four main islands and more than 180 smaller islands. The area is 346.22 km2, and the coastline extends 468 km.Surrounded by the sea, the Oki Islands produce a wide variety of seaweed. In winter, seaweeds such as laver and arame are harvested, and in spring, tengusa and hijiki are harvested.From December to February, when the northerly winds blow, the rock seaweed fishing begins.
9fa2a49f3ac49580.zh: 隱岐群島是位於島根縣東北方的群島，由4座主要島嶼和180多座小島組成。面積346.22平方公里，海岸線長468公里。隱岐群島四面環海，出產多種海藻。冬季採收海苔、荒布等海藻，春季採收石花菜和羊栖菜。12月至2月吹北風時，岩海苔的採收便開始了。

9fab0141c7a31cf0.en: Hamamatsu Kite Festival (浜松まつり) is a Japanese festival in Hamamatsu. It is generally known to have multiple kites, along with a lot of kite battles through the days it is held. The festival also displays examples of Japanese culture through food, and general items available for purchase in merchant booths at the festival. The Hamamatsu Festival is held every year on May 3-5 in Hamamatsu City, Shizuoka Prefecture. This is citizen festival. Also, this is one of the largest festivals in Japan, attracting approximately 2 million visitors each year.
9fab0141c7a31cf0.zh: 浜松まつり是在濱松舉行的日本祭典。一般以眾多風箏以及舉辦期間的大量風箏對戰而聞名。祭典也透過食物及祭典攤位販售的各種商品展示日本文化。浜松まつり每年5月3日至5日在靜岡縣濱松市舉行。這是一項市民祭典，也是日本規模最大的祭典之一，每年吸引約200萬名遊客。

9fc49914a2ac44af.en: Taira Ski Area (たいらスキー場, Taira Sukī-jō) is a skiing venue located in Nanto, Toyama, Japan.
9fc49914a2ac44af.zh: たいらスキー場是位於日本富山縣南礪市的滑雪場。

9fcd2199ff090f24.en: Kawara-dera (川原寺) was a Buddhist temple established during the Asuka period in the village of Asuka, Nara Prefecture, Japan. Archaeological excavations have revealed a large-scale complex which included two Kondō, a pagoda, extensive priests' quarters, and roof tiles that are "among the most beautiful ever made in Japan".
9fcd2199ff090f24.zh: 川原寺是飛鳥時代創建於日本奈良縣明日香村的佛教寺院。考古發掘顯示這是一處大規模的寺院建築群，包括兩座金堂、一座塔、廣大的僧房，以及「日本有史以來最美的屋瓦之一」。

9fe1137280901d01.en: The Tower Osaka is a high rise apartment building situated at Hotarumachi, 1-1 Fukushima, Fukushima-ku, Osaka, Japan. It is the highest building in Fukushima ward.
9fe1137280901d01.zh: The Tower Osaka是位於日本大阪市福島區福島1-1螢町的高層公寓大樓，為福島區最高的建築。

a004af3e67e8cb79.en: Hashino iron mining and smelting site (橋野高炉跡, Hashino kōro ato) is the ruins of an iron smelting and primitive blast furnace built by the Tokugawa shogunate during the final years of the Edo period in the Hashino neighborhood of the city of Kamaishi, Iwate in the Tohoku region of northern Japan. It has been recognized as the oldest western-style blast furnace in Japan, and is part of the UNESCO World Heritage List as one of the Sites of Japan’s Meiji Industrial Revolution: Iron and Steel, Shipbuilding and Coal Mining.
a004af3e67e8cb79.zh: 橋野高炉跡是江戶時代末期德川幕府在日本北部東北地方岩手縣釜石市橋野地區興建的煉鐵設施與早期高爐遺址。被認定為日本最古老的西式高爐，並以「明治日本的產業革命遺產：製鐵・製鋼、造船、煤礦」之一列入聯合國教科文組織世界遺產名錄。

a0108ce618a4f724.en: Mount Shibutsu (至仏山 Shifutsu/Shibutsu-san) is a serpentine mountain in the north-east of Gunma Prefecture in Japan. It is 2,228.1 m (7,310 ft) tall and located between Minakami Machi and Katashina Villages. It's one of the 100 Famous Japanese Mountains and is home to a "treasure trove" of alpine plants. It is part of Oze National Park and the Minakami UNESCO Eco Park.
a0108ce618a4f724.zh: 至佛山（至仏山）是位於日本群馬縣東北部的蛇紋岩山，高2,228.1公尺（7,310英尺），位於水上町與片品村之間。此山為「日本百名山」之一，有豐富的高山植物，被稱為「寶庫」。這裡屬於尾瀨國家公園及聯合國教科文組織みなかみ生態公園的範圍。

a02a47f95e2275ac.en: The Ōdai Yamamoto I Site (Japanese: 大平山元I遺跡, Hepburn: Ōdaiyamamoto ichi iseki) is a Jōmon archaeological site in the town of Sotogahama, Aomori Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan. Excavations in 1998 uncovered forty-six earthenware fragments which have been dated as early as 14,500 BCE (ca 16,500 BP); this places them among the earliest pottery currently known. As the earliest in Japan, this marks the transition from the Japanese Paleolithic to Incipient Jōmon.
a02a47f95e2275ac.zh: 大平山元I遺跡是位於日本北部東北地方青森縣外ヶ濱町的繩文時代考古遺址。1998 年的發掘出土了 46 片陶器碎片，年代最早可推至西元前 14,500 年（約距今 16,500 年），屬於目前已知最早的陶器之一。作為日本最早的陶器，這標誌著從日本舊石器時代過渡到繩文草創期。

a04fe8cd6d3d06cb.en: Ishibashi Park (石橋記念公園, Ishibashi Kinen Kōen) is a park in Hama-machi, Kagoshima, Japan. At the end of the Edo period (late 19th century), local lord Shimazu Shigehide had five bridges, collectively called the Gosekkyō ("five stone bridges"), built across the Kōtsuki River. Two of them collapsed in floods in 1993. The remaining three were moved to a new location and restored. Ishibashi Park consists of these three bridges and a museum.
a04fe8cd6d3d06cb.zh: 石橋紀念公園是位於日本鹿兒島濱町的公園。江戶時代末期（19世紀後期），當地領主島津齊興在甲突川上興建了五座橋，合稱「五石橋」。其中兩座於1993年因洪水崩毀，其餘三座遷至新址修復。石橋紀念公園由這三座橋與一座博物館組成。

a068b1d1167462e5.en: The Yamagata Zao Onsen Ski Resort (山形蔵王温泉スキー場, Yamagata Zaō Onsen Skī-jō) is the largest ski resort in Tōhoku region, Japan, operated by Zao Onsen Tourism Association (蔵王温泉観光協会, Zaō Onsen Kankō Kyōkai).
a068b1d1167462e5.zh: 山形蔵王温泉スキー場是日本東北地方最大的滑雪場，由蔵王温泉観光協会經營。

a08269e3b3fd3c34.en: Shimane Prefecture boasts one of the highest annual catches of mackerel in Japan. The cold, rough seas of the Sea of Japan produce delicious, fatty mackerel. Sumoji is a type of chirashi-sushi, and is a type of sushi made with grilled mackerel, which is a specialty of the prefecture, served over vinegared rice.Sumoji is a specialty of the Kisuki and Mitoya areas of Unnan City, located inland. This area has long prospered as a transportation hub connecting the Izumo region and Hiroshima Prefecture.
a08269e3b3fd3c34.zh: 島根縣的鯖魚年漁獲量居日本前列。日本海寒冷洶湧的海域孕育出美味且油脂豐富的鯖魚。すもじ是散壽司的一種，是將縣內特產的烤鯖魚放在醋飯上製成的壽司。すもじ是位於內陸的雲南市木次、三刀屋地區的特色料理。這一帶自古即作為連接出雲地區與廣島縣的交通要地而繁榮。

a0895caa90641f6c.en: Chichibugahama Beach (父母ヶ浜) is a scenic beach in the city of Mitoyo, Kagawa Prefecture, Japan. It is renowned for its beauty and is listed as among "the planet's most spiritual places", and one of the 100 best sunsets in Japan. Japan National Tourism Organization says that the beach's renown for sunset photography is due to Seto-no-yunagi, a lull in the evening winds around Seto Inland Sea when the tide pools become mirror-like.
a0895caa90641f6c.zh: 父母ヶ浜是位於日本香川縣三豐市的海灘，以景色優美著稱，被列為「地球上最具靈性的地方」之一，也是日本夕陽百選之一。日本國家旅遊局表示，這片海灘之所以以夕陽攝影聞名，是因為「瀨戶の夕凪」——瀨戶內海一帶傍晚風勢平息的時段，此時潮池水面會如鏡面般平靜。

a0934d257d6227b2.en: Mama Kari Sushi is a type of nigiri sushi made with fish that has been marinated in vinegar. The distinctive feature is the use of okara (soy pulp) seasoned with vinegar instead of vinegared rice. In the past, when rice was scarce, okara, which was more readily available, was used as a substitute to conserve rice. This type of sushi is not limited to Mama Kari; it can also be made with fish such as Kohada (gizzard shad) or Konoshiro (dotted gizzard shad).
a0934d257d6227b2.zh: あずま是一種握壽司，使用醋漬的ままかり製作。其特色是以醋調味的豆渣取代醋飯。過去稻米稀少時，為了節省米，便以較容易取得的豆渣代替。這種壽司不限於ままかり，也可用小鰭或鰶魚等魚類製作。

a0a14abf5a42fd83.en: Iwaki City has seven beaches, called "Iwaki Nanahama," and there are many fishing ports around them. A wide variety of fish and shellfish are landed throughout the year, but saury is especially popular in the fall. Many local dishes are prepared using saury, including mirin-boshi (dried fish with mirin broth), grilled fish, and nanbanzuke (pickled saury), but the most commonly eaten dish is "po-po yaki" (grilled saury with pork belly).
a0a14abf5a42fd83.zh: 磐城市有七座海灘，稱為「磐城七濱」，周邊有許多漁港。一年四季都有多種魚貝類上岸，其中秋天的秋刀魚特別受歡迎。以秋刀魚製作的鄉土料理有味醂乾（以味醂醬汁醃漬的魚乾）、烤魚、南蠻漬（醃漬秋刀魚）等，其中最常吃的是「ポーポー焼き」（秋刀魚與豬五花一起燒烤）。

a0a1fd0b97014c4d.en: Ichinomiya-ji (Japanese: 一宮寺) is a temple of the Omuro School of Shingon Buddhism, located in Ichinomiya-cho, Takamatsu City, Kagawa Prefecture. Its formal mountain name is Shingōzan, and its sub-temple name is Daihōin. The principal deity is Shō Kannon Bodhisattva. It serves as the 83rd temple on the Shikoku Pilgrimage. It is situated adjacent to Tamura Shrine, the Ichinomiya (chief shrine) of the former Sanuki Province.
a0a1fd0b97014c4d.zh: 一宮寺是真言宗御室派的寺院，位於香川縣高松市一宮町。山號為神毫山，院號為大寶院。本尊為聖觀音菩薩。為四國遍路第83號札所。寺院緊鄰舊讚岐國一宮田村神社。

a0a6dedf76f9ea88.en: Kaimei School (開明学校, Kaimei gakkō) is a school located in Seiyo, Ehime, Ehime, Japan, which was built in 1882, and is considered to be the oldest school in Shikoku. With its rare Giyōfū architectural style on  kaimei school was designated as one of the important cultural properties of Japan in May 1997. Today the school is a museum where 6,000 precious documents are stored and displayed including school textbooks in the Edo period through the early Shōwa period and documents on school administration.
a0a6dedf76f9ea88.zh: 開明学校是位於日本愛媛縣西予市的學校，建於1882年，被認為是四國最古老的學校。由於其少見的擬洋風建築樣式，開明学校於1997年5月被指定為日本重要文化財。現在學校作為博物館，收藏並展示6,000件珍貴文獻，包括江戶時代至昭和初期的學校教科書及學校行政文件。

a0af2f232a40afb7.en: The entire area of Yamagata Prefecture was designated as a heavy snowfall area, and in those days when distribution was poor, securing food for the winter was essential for survival. Therefore, there was a culture of preserving foods such as wild vegetables and greens, which could be harvested in abundance from spring to fall, by drying them or pickling them in salt in preparation for the snowy winters. One of the traditional preserved foods in the Okitama and Murayama regions is "Hyo-Boshi" (dried purslane).
a0af2f232a40afb7.zh: 山形縣全境被指定為豪雪地帶，在物流不發達的年代，確保過冬的糧食攸關生存。因此當地有保存食物的文化，將春季到秋季能大量採收的山菜、青菜等曬乾或用鹽醃漬，以備雪季。置賜與村山地區的傳統保存食之一就是「ひょう干し」（曬乾的馬齒莧）。

a0d42854dd1ef6e4.en: Numazu Castle (沼津城, Numazu-jō) was a Japanese castle located in the city of Numazu, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. It was a hirayama-jō, a castle built on a plains rather than a hill or mountain. During the Edo period, Numazu castle was home to the Mizuno clan, daimyō of Numazu Domain under the Tokugawa shogunate.
a0d42854dd1ef6e4.zh: 沼津城是位於日本靜岡縣沼津市的日本城郭，屬於平山城，即建於平地而非山丘或山上的城。江戶時代，沼津城為德川幕府下沼津藩大名水野氏的居城。

a0e5f5cf0ea9d107.en: The Murakami Kaizoku Museum (今治市村上海賊ミュージアム, Imabari-shi Murakami Kaizoku Myūjiamu) is a museum on the island of Ōshima in Imabari, Ehime Prefecture, Japan, dedicated to the Murakami Kaizoku, the Murakami Clan "pirates" or "feudal navies" (suigun). The museum opened as the Imabari City Murakami Suigun Museum (今治市村上水軍博物館) in 2004, replacing the nearby Museum of Noshima Murakami Suigun (能島村上水軍資料館), and changed to its current name on 1 April 2020. The collection and displays include arms and armour, historic documents, and scale model boats.
a0e5f5cf0ea9d107.zh: 村上海賊ミュージアム（今治市村上海賊ミュージアム）是位於日本愛媛縣今治市大島的博物館，以村上海賊，即村上氏的「海盜」或「封建水軍」（水軍）為主題。本館於2004年以今治市村上水軍博物館之名開館，取代附近的能島村上水軍資料館，並於2020年4月1日改為現名。館藏與展示包括武器與甲冑、歷史文獻及船隻模型。

a0f1d1f390adcd4c.en: Kanegasaki Castle (金ヶ崎城, Kanegasaki-jō) was a Kamakura to Nanboku-cho period yamashiro-style Japanese castle located in what is now part of the city of Tsuruga, Fukui Prefecture in the Hokuriku  region of Honshu, Japan. It was also known as Tsuruga Castle. The ruins have been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 1934.
a0f1d1f390adcd4c.zh: 金ヶ崎城是鎌倉時代至南北朝時代的山城式日本城郭，位於今日本本州北陸地方福井縣敦賀市。又稱敦賀城。遺址自1934年起由中央政府列為國家史跡保護。

a11e1e18ff9c4190.en: Imamiya Ebisu Shrine (今宮戎神社, Imamiya Ebisu jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Naniwa-ku, Osaka Prefecture, Japan. According to legend, it was established in 600 during the reign of Empress Suiko. Its annual festival is held from January 9 to 11. The kami enshrined here included Amaterasu (天照皇大神), Kotoshironushi (事代主命, also known as Ebisu), Susanoo-no-Mikoto (素盞鳴尊), Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto (月読尊), and Wakahiru-me (稚日女尊).
a11e1e18ff9c4190.zh: 今宮戎神社是位於日本大阪府浪速區的神社。相傳創建於推古天皇在位期間的600年。例行祭典於每年1月9日至11日舉行。供奉的神祇包括天照皇大神、事代主命（又稱惠比壽）、素盞鳴尊、月讀尊及稚日女尊。

a1417b20facf3f7c.en: Aimata Dam (相俣ダム) is a dam built on the Akaya River, part of the class-A Tonegawa River system at Aimata in the city of Minakami (the former village of Nīharimura), in the Tone District of Gunma Prefecture, Japan.
a1417b20facf3f7c.zh: 相俣ダム是建於赤谷川上的水壩，赤谷川屬一級河川利根川水系，水壩位於日本群馬縣利根郡水上町（舊新治村）相俣。

a14361cab0872573.en: The Nishinumata ruins (西沼田遺跡, Nishinumata iseki) is an archaeological site containing the ruins of a late Kofun period (6th century AD) settlement located in what is now part of the city of Tendō, Yamagata in the Tōhoku region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1987.
a14361cab0872573.zh: 西沼田遺跡（Nishinumata iseki）是位於日本東北地方、今山形縣天童市境內的考古遺址，保存古墳時代後期（西元6世紀）的聚落遺跡。1987年被指定為日本國家史跡。

a14b9de0513b685f.en: Funaoka Onsen (船岡温泉) is an onsen (public bath house) in Kyoto, Japan.
a14b9de0513b685f.zh: 船岡溫泉是位於日本京都的一處溫泉（公共澡堂）。

a169db81da16b249.en: Ishikawa Nanao Art Museum (石川県七尾美術館, Ishikawa Nanao bijutsukan) opened in 1995 in Nanao, Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan. The main art gallery on the Noto Peninsula, the collection includes works by Hasegawa Tōhaku.
a169db81da16b249.zh: 石川縣七尾美術館於1995年在日本石川縣七尾市開館，是能登半島主要的美術館，館藏包括長谷川等伯的作品。

a18be62af21262bf.en: Enoshima Aquarium or  New Enoshima Aquarium (新江ノ島水族館, Shin Enoshima Suizokukan) is a public aquarium located on Katase Beach in Fujisawa City, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. Its nickname is "Enosui," an abbreviation of the Japanese name. The aquarium is accredited as a Museum-equivalent facilities by the Museum Act from Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology.
a18be62af21262bf.zh: 江之島水族館，又稱新江ノ島水族館，是位於日本神奈川縣藤澤市片瀨海岸的公共水族館，暱稱「えのすい」，為日文名稱的簡稱。該水族館依文部科學省主管的《博物館法》，獲認定為博物館相當設施。

a191f3c0b083da52.en: Sendai Umino-Mori Aquarium (仙台うみの杜水族館, Sendai Umino-Mori Suizokukan; lit. 'Sendai Ocean's Forest Aquarium') is a public aquarium located in Sendai, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan. It opened in 2015 as a successor to the Marinepia Matsushima Aquarium, which had been open for 88 years.
a191f3c0b083da52.zh: 仙台うみの杜水族館（意為「仙台海之森水族館」）是位於日本宮城縣仙台市的公共水族館。2015年開館，接替已營運88年的松島水族館（Marinepia Matsushima）。

a198200b2088dcf3.en: The Tairyūji Ropeway (太龍寺ロープウェイ, Tairyūji Rōpuwei) is a Japanese aerial lift line in Tokushima Prefecture, operated by Shikoku Cable. Opened in 1992, the line climbs to Tairyū-ji, the 21st temple of the Shikoku Pilgrimage.
a198200b2088dcf3.zh: 太龍寺ロープウェイ是位於德島縣的日本空中纜車路線，由四國纜車營運。路線於1992年啟用，通往四國遍路第21號札所太龍寺。

a19d6d8693a79bc4.en: The Kagawa Museum (香川県立ミュージアム, Kagawa Kenritsu Myūjiamu) is a prefectural museum in Takamatsu, Japan, dedicated to the history and art of Kagawa Prefecture.
a19d6d8693a79bc4.zh: 香川縣立博物館（香川県立ミュージアム）是位於日本高松市的縣立博物館，以香川縣的歷史與藝術為主題。

a1aa4cf8986e6184.en: Inazumi Underwater Cave (稲積水中鍾乳洞, Inadzumi-Suichūshōnyūdō) is an underwater limestone cave located in Bungo-Ōno, Ōita Prefecture, Japan. It is the longest underwater cave system in Japan.
a1aa4cf8986e6184.zh: 稻積水中鐘乳洞（稲積水中鍾乳洞）是位於日本大分縣豐後大野市的水中石灰岩洞穴，是日本最長的水中洞穴系統。

a1d0017a5a1f731a.en: Kanagawa Kenmin Hall (神奈川県立県民ホール) is a 2,493-seat performing arts venue located in Yokohama, Japan. The complex opened in 1975. Many international artists have performed at Kanagawa Kenmin Hall, including Mireille Mathieu, Linda Ronstadt, King Crimson, Chicago, Cheap Trick, Alanis Morissette, The Black Crowes, The Doobie Brothers, Diana Ross and Paul Rodgers.
a1d0017a5a1f731a.zh: 神奈川縣民會館（神奈川縣立縣民ホール）是位於日本橫濱、設有2,493個座位的表演藝術場館，於1975年開幕。許多國際藝人曾在此演出，包括Mireille Mathieu、Linda Ronstadt、King Crimson、Chicago、Cheap Trick、Alanis Morissette、The Black Crowes、The Doobie Brothers、Diana Ross及Paul Rodgers。

a1f49f34244063a9.en: Kōgaku-ji (向嶽寺), originally Kōgaku-an, is a Buddhist temple belonging to the Rinzai school of Japanese Zen. located in the city of Kōshū, Yamanashi, Japan. It is the head temple of one of fourteen autonomous branches of the Rinzai school. Its main image is a statue of Shaka Nyōrai. The temple, including its famed Japanese garden is not open to the general public.
a1f49f34244063a9.zh: 向嶽寺原名向嶽庵，是屬於日本禪宗臨濟宗的佛教寺院，位於日本山梨縣甲州市，為臨濟宗十四個獨立派別之一的大本山，本尊為釋迦如來像。寺院及其知名的日本庭園皆不對一般民眾開放。

a220192b7231b61b.en: The Sumaura Ropeway (須磨浦ロープウェイ, Sumaura Rōpuwei) is a Japanese aerial lift line in Kōbe, Hyōgo, operated by the Sanyō Electric Railway. Opened in 1957, the line climbs Mount Hachibuse, a 246-metre (807 ft) peak on the Suma coast.
a220192b7231b61b.zh: 須磨浦ロープウェイ是位於兵庫縣神戶市的空中纜車路線，由山陽電氣鐵道經營。該路線於1957年啟用，登上須磨海岸一座高246公尺（807英尺）的山峰鉢伏山。

a26aa09314b8ffd1.en: The Takashima Kōzaki Site (鷹島神崎遺跡, Takashima kōzaki iseki) is an underwater archaeological site containing artifacts from the Kamakura period Mongol invasions of Japan located offshore the east coast of the island of Takashima in the city of Matsuura, Nagasaki Prefecture Japan.  The 384,000 square meter area of the seabed was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 2012, and is the first underwater site so designated in Japan.
a26aa09314b8ffd1.zh: 鷹島神崎遺跡是位於日本長崎縣松浦市鷹島東岸外海的水下考古遺址，保存有鎌倉時代蒙古襲來（元寇）的遺物。該處384,000平方公尺的海底區域於2012年被指定為日本國家史跡，為日本首座獲此指定的水下遺址。

a2741946d516fed4.en: The waters around the Oki Islands, where the warm Tsushima current and the cold Liman current collide, are rich in plankton and nutrients, making it abundant in seafood. The high quality of the seafood has been known since ancient times, and during the Heian period, it was presented as one of the "Miketsukuni" (land of abundant food) offerings to the imperial family and the court.There is a diverse range of shellfish, including turban shells (Sazae), abalone, bay scallops, and unique local varieties.
a2741946d516fed4.zh: 隱岐群島周邊海域是溫暖的對馬海流與寒冷的里曼海流交會之處，富含浮游生物與養分，海產豐富。這裡海產的高品質自古聞名，平安時代曾以「御食國」（食物豐饒之地）的貢品之一獻給皇室與朝廷。貝類種類多樣，包括蠑螺（さざえ）、鮑魚、海灣扇貝以及當地特有的品種。

a275a107ce40a7d8.en: The Kitakami River basin in Japan has been known for growing taro since ancient times due to its suitability for taro production. Taro has an extensive history in Japan and is believed to have been introduced earlier than rice during the Jomon period. Taro finds mention in the "Manyoshu", the oldest Japanese poetry anthology.
a275a107ce40a7d8.zh: 日本的北上川流域適合栽種芋頭，自古以來便以芋頭產地聞名。芋頭在日本歷史悠久，一般認為早在繩文時代便比稻米更早傳入。日本最古老的詩歌集《萬葉集》中也提及芋頭。

a28156394ea7903b.en: Hirakata Park (ひらかたパーク, Hirakata Pāku) is an amusement park in Hirakata, Osaka, Japan, nicknamed "Hirapah". The park is managed by Keihan Leisure Service and is located on the Keihan line at Hirakata-kōen Station (枚方公園駅). It takes advantage of its hilly landscape to site 43 attractions on 160,000 square metres (40 acres).
a28156394ea7903b.zh: ひらかたパーク是位於日本大阪府枚方市的遊樂園，暱稱「ひらパー」。由京阪レジャーサービス經營，位於京阪線枚方公園站。園方利用起伏的地形，在16萬平方公尺（40英畝）的園區內設置43項遊樂設施。

a286bc20763a3ea2.en: The Ninja Museum of Igaryu (伊賀流忍者博物館, Iga-ryū Ninja Hakubutsukan) situated in a forested location in Iga, Mie Prefecture, Japan, is a museum dedicated to the history of the ninja and ninjutsu. It was established in 1964 and is located near Iga Ueno Castle. Jinichi Kawakami, who serves as the honorary director of the Iga-ryū Ninja Museum, is proclaimed to be the 21st head of Iga-ryū ninjutsu.
a286bc20763a3ea2.zh: 伊賀流忍者博物館位於日本三重縣伊賀市的森林中，是介紹忍者與忍術歷史的博物館。1964年設立，鄰近伊賀上野城。擔任該館名譽館長的川上仁一，自稱為伊賀流忍術第21代宗家。

a2a3715eebd5111c.en: This is a local dish in the Sagamihara region, a steamed bun made by mixing local flour and sweet potatoes. It offers a simple taste that highlights the natural sweetness of the ingredients.The Sagamihara plateau, covered with volcanic ash and poor in nutrients, has been a place where barley and sweet potatoes are widely cultivated. Therefore, local people have been familiar with local flour and sweet potatoes as common ingredients. Originally, this snack eaten during breaks from farming activities was called "okojū" (little daytime snack).
a2a3715eebd5111c.zh: 這是相模原地區的鄉土料理，將在地麵粉與番薯混合後蒸製而成的饅頭，滋味樸素，突顯食材本身的甜味。相模原台地覆蓋火山灰、土壤貧瘠，向來廣泛種植大麥和番薯，因此當地人對在地麵粉和番薯這類常見食材十分熟悉。這道在農活休息時吃的點心，原本稱為「おこじゅう」（白天的小點心）。

a2ab3f6d8058401c.en: Cape Shiriya (尻屋崎, Shiriyazaki) is a headland on the northeastern point of the island of Honshu in Japan. It is located within the borders of the town of Higashidōri, Aomori in northern Shimokita Peninsula, and is part of the Shimokita Hantō Quasi-National Park. The cape is on the border of Tsugaru Strait separating Honshu from Hokkaido, and the Pacific Ocean.
a2ab3f6d8058401c.zh: 尻屋崎是位於日本本州島東北端的岬角，位於下北半島北部的青森縣東通村境內，屬於下北半島國定公園的一部分。岬角位於分隔本州與北海道的津輕海峽與太平洋的交界處。

a2bac17c600d8301.en: The Nawa Insect Museum (名和昆虫博物館, Nawa Konchū Hakubutsukan) is a museum in the city of Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It is operated by the Nawa Insect Research Center.
a2bac17c600d8301.zh: 名和昆虫博物館是位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市的博物館，由名和昆蟲研究所營運。

a2cebb96c208839d.en: Seiunji ( Seiunji, Seiunji) is a temple in Yamato-cho, Kisai, Koshu City, Yamanashi Prefecture. It is a Kenchoji sect temple of the Rinzai school, with the mountain name of Tenmokuzan and the Honzon of Shakyamuni Buddha. At the time of its founding, the temple was called Gokoku Zenji.
a2cebb96c208839d.zh: 棲雲寺是位於山梨縣甲州市大和町木賊的寺院，屬臨濟宗建長寺派，山號為天目山，本尊為釋迦牟尼佛。創建時寺名為護國禪寺。

a2d6e20ae45cac4b.en: Takashima coal mine (高島炭鉱, Takashima Tankō) was a coal mine in Japan, located on the island of Takashima off the northern shore of the Nagasaki Peninsula.
