It was known as the town of Takashima but is now part of the city of Nagasaki, Nagasaki Prefecture. The entire 1.23 square kilometre island, including the areas under the ocean off the coast of the island, was a coal mine. There were 22 mining shafts covering 12,480 hectares.
a2d6e20ae45cac4b.zh: 高島炭鉱是日本的一座煤礦，位於長崎半島北岸外海的高島上。當地原為高島町，現屬長崎縣長崎市。面積1.23平方公里的整座島嶼，連同島嶼周邊海面下的區域，皆為煤礦。共有22座礦坑，範圍達12,480公頃。

a2def4008a6b6258.en: Kagoshima ramen (鹿児島ラーメン) is a ramen dish which is offered in Kagoshima Prefecture, in southern Japan.
a2def4008a6b6258.zh: 鹿兒島拉麵（鹿児島ラーメン）是在日本南部鹿兒島縣供應的拉麵料理。

a2ed708b08ca18b0.en: Fukuju-ji (福聚寺) is an Ōbaku Zen temple in Kokurakita-ku, Kitakyūshū, Fukuoka, Japan.  Its honorary sangō prefix is Kōjuzan (広寿山). Fukuju-ji is one of two bodaiji (菩提寺), or funeral temples, dedicated to Ogasawara Tadazane, the first daimyō of Kokura Domain. (The other is Toyokawa's Rinzai-ji.)
a2ed708b08ca18b0.zh: 福聚寺是位於日本福岡縣北九州市小倉北區的黃檗宗寺院，山號為廣壽山。福聚寺是供奉小倉藩首任藩主小笠原忠真的兩座菩提寺之一（另一座為豐川的臨濟寺）。

a2f834a14f21b621.en: In Shimane Prefecture, during the Boys' Festival (Tango no Sekku), a snack known as "kashiwamochi" is commonly made and enjoyed by children. Despite being called "kashiwa" (oak) mochi, the leaves of the kashiwa tree do not naturally grow in the area. Instead, a local tradition has developed using leaves from the sarutoriibara plant as a substitute.The name "kashiwamochi" varies by region.
a2f834a14f21b621.zh: 在島根縣，端午節（端午の節句）時常會製作名為「かしわ餅」的點心，供孩子們享用。雖然名為「柏」（槲樹）餅，但當地並不自然生長槲樹，因此發展出以菝葜（サルトリイバラ）的葉子代替的地方傳統。「かしわ餅」的名稱因地區而異。

a3292a3e5b6fae97.en: Okuike (奥池)（おくいけ）is a small lake with an adjoining reservoir lake called the "Okuyama Chosuichi". It is surrounded by a high-class residential area and is located in Ashiya, a city in the Hyogo Prefecture of Japan. It is close to the major cities of Kobe and Osaka, and is part of the Kansai region.  Okuike is located on a height of approximately 500–600 meters above sea level on the Southern aspect, and is located towards the Eastern part of Mount Rokkō (六甲山, Rokkō-san).
a3292a3e5b6fae97.zh: 奧池（おくいけ）是一座小湖，旁邊連接著名為「奧山貯水池」的蓄水湖。周圍為高級住宅區，位於日本兵庫縣蘆屋市。此地鄰近神戶與大阪等大城市，屬於關西地區。奧池位於南側坡面海拔約500–600公尺處，在六甲山東部一帶。

a33da4349db4e9a7.en: “Kasu-yose” is a home-cooked dish, primarily eaten in the town of Yamato and has been served for celebrations and festivals or when a large group of people gathered for an event. It looks similar to “Shira-ae” (=mashed tofu salad) in appearance, but this dish is unique in that it can be served as a main dish, side dish or snack. Taro, onions, carrots and dried shiitake mushrooms are finely chopped and stir-fried with chicken meat. Rice and soybeans are added, and all the ingredients are simmered.
a33da4349db4e9a7.zh: 「かすよせ」是家常料理，主要在山都町食用，會在慶祝活動、祭典或大批人聚集的場合端出。外觀類似「白和え」（豆腐泥拌菜），但這道料理的特色是可以當作主食、配菜或點心。將芋頭、洋蔥、紅蘿蔔和乾香菇切碎，與雞肉一起拌炒，再加入米和黃豆，將所有材料一起燉煮。

a343c02cbac1ebee.en: Kamosu Jinja (神魂神社) is a Shinto shrine in Matsue, Shimane Prefecture, Japan. The Taisha-zukuri Honden of 1583 is a National Treasure. The coeval branch Inari shrine is an Important Cultural Property.
a343c02cbac1ebee.zh: 神魂神社是位於日本島根縣松江市的神社。1583年建造的大社造本殿為國寶，同時期的末社稻荷社為重要文化財。

a34e28a7fa3018b3.en: Kinshako Prefectural Natural Park (金砂湖県立自然公園, Kinshako kenritsu shizen-kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in northeast Ehime Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1961, the park is wholly situated within the municipality of Shikokuchūō. The park's central feature is the eponymous Lake Kinsha.
a34e28a7fa3018b3.zh: 金砂湖縣立自然公園（金砂湖県立自然公園）是位於日本愛媛縣東北部的縣立自然公園。公園設立於1961年，全區位於四國中央市境內。公園的主要景觀為同名的金砂湖。

a34f5a3c7ec4ab93.en: The Asuka Historical Museum (飛鳥資料館, Asuka Shiryōkan) is a historical museum in Okuyama, Asuka, Nara Prefecture, Japan. The museum was founded in 1975 and is a unit of the Nara National Research Institute for Cultural Properties.
a34f5a3c7ec4ab93.zh: 飛鳥資料館是位於日本奈良縣明日香村奧山的歷史博物館，創立於1975年，隸屬奈良文化財研究所。

a35dd43c2c80800e.en: Saku City, located in the eastern part of Nagano Prefecture, has been cultivating carp using rice paddies in Saku-daira, where double cropping is difficult. In 1825, when Iwamurada feudal lord Naito Toyogomori returned from Osaka, he gave Yodo carp to Namiki Nanazaemon, a wealthy merchant in Nozawa, and the cultivation of Saku carp took root.
a35dd43c2c80800e.zh: 位於長野縣東部的佐久市，在難以進行兩期耕作的佐久平利用稻田養殖鯉魚。1825年，岩村田藩主內藤豐護守從大坂返回時，將淀鯉贈予野澤的富商並木七左衛門，佐久鯉的養殖由此扎根。

a36d01b2a6bff8e1.en: Jiyu Gakuen School Myonichikan (自由学園明日館) is a building in Toshima, Tokyo, designed by American architect Frank Lloyd Wright for the Jiyu Gakuen School. Jiyu (自由) means 'freedom', and gakuen (学園) is 'school'.
a36d01b2a6bff8e1.zh: 自由学園明日館（自由学園明日館）是位於東京都豐島區的建築，由美國建築師法蘭克・洛伊・萊特為自由學園設計。「自由」（自由）意為freedom，「學園」（学園）意為school。

a37c3cf1b54cf9bd.en: In 2005, Naka Town was born from the merging of five towns and villages in Tokushima Prefecture. It is an area abundant in nature, with over 90% of the town’s area taken up by forest. It is divided into the five areas of the Wakiji area, Aioi area, Kaminaka area, Kisawa area, and Kito area; each has their own culture and customs. Among them is “hangoroshi,” which resemble “ohagi” (rice ball coated in red bean paste), a local food particularly loved in the Aioi area that is made with both sticky and non-sticky rice. The name hangoroshi (lit.
a37c3cf1b54cf9bd.zh: 2005年，德島縣五個町村合併成立那賀町。這裡自然資源豐富，町內面積九成以上為森林。全町分為鷲敷、相生、上那賀、木沢、木頭五個地區，各有其文化與習俗。其中「半ごろし」外形類似「おはぎ」（裹紅豆餡的飯糰），是相生地區特別喜愛的鄉土食物，以糯米和粳米製成。半ごろし這個名稱（字面意思

a381911e6a907d65.en: KidZania (English:  kid-ZAY-nee-ə; Spanish: [kidˈsa.nja]) is a Mexican privately held international chain of indoor family entertainment centers currently operating in 30 locations worldwide, allowing children to role play adult jobs and earn currency. It receives at least 9 million visitors per year.
a381911e6a907d65.zh: キッザニア（英語讀音：kid-ZAY-nee-ə；西班牙語：[kidˈsa.nja]）是墨西哥的私人國際室內親子娛樂設施連鎖品牌，目前在全球30處營運，讓兒童扮演成人職業並賺取貨幣。每年至少接待900萬名遊客。

a385efe66b3c3844.en: "Zuiki no Taitan" is a simmered dish made with the stalk of the taro plant, known as "zuiki," and is a home-cooked dish enjoyed in households. "taitan" refers to a dish that is slowly simmered to allow the flavors to thoroughly penetrate the food.The stalks of Ebiimo (a traditional Kyoto taro variety) are also used as zuiki and are a crucial ingredient in obanzai, traditional Kyoto side dishes. When selecting zuiki, it is advisable to choose ones with a firm and thick stem.
a385efe66b3c3844.zh: 「ずいきの炊いたん」是以稱為「ずいき」的芋莖燉煮而成的料理，是家庭中享用的家常菜。「炊いたん」指的是慢火燉煮、讓味道充分滲入食材的料理。海老芋（京都傳統芋頭品種）的莖也作為ずいき使用，是京都傳統家常配菜「おばんざい」的重要食材。挑選ずいき時，建議選擇莖部結實粗壯的。

a395821dfd1244a0.en: Mount Inamura (稲叢山, Inamura-yama) is the highest mountain in Kōchi Prefecture, Japan, at 1,506 m (4,941 ft). Situated in the town of Tosa, Mount Inamura is famous for its Akebono-tsutsuji (Rhododendron pentaphyllum) flowers, which bloom during the middle of spring season (April–May).
a395821dfd1244a0.zh: 稲叢山是日本高知縣最高的山，海拔1,506公尺（4,941英尺）。稲叢山位於土佐町，以春季中期（4月至5月）開花的曙躑躅（Rhododendron pentaphyllum）聞名。

a3a13178939d841b.en: The history of "tai meshi" dates back as far as the time of Empress Jingu's campaign in Korea. It is said to have originated when she prayed to the Kashima Myojin shrine in the Hojo district of Matsuyama City for victory in battle, and was pleased with the tai presented by the fishermen as a good omen, and cooked rice with the tai and offered it as an offering.
a3a13178939d841b.zh: 「鯛めし」的歷史可追溯至神功皇后出兵朝鮮的時代。據說神功皇后向松山市北條地區的鹿島明神祈求戰勝時，對漁民獻上的鯛魚視為吉兆而感到欣喜，便將鯛魚與米一同炊煮作為供品，這就是鯛めし的起源。

a3b24ed43a0d60a1.en: The Shōko Shūseikan (尚古集成館, Shōko Shūseikan) is the site of a pre-modern industrial complex created in the Bakumatsu period by Satsuma Domain in the city of Kagoshima Japan.  It was designed a National Historic Site, with the designation expanded in 2013. (ID1484-006) It was later designed as a component of the Sites of Japan's Meiji Industrial Revolution: Iron and Steel, Shipbuilding and Coal Mining, which received UNESCO World Heritage Site status in 2015.
a3b24ed43a0d60a1.zh: 尚古集成館是幕末時期薩摩藩在日本鹿兒島市建立的近代以前工業設施群遺址。該地被指定為國家史跡，並於2013年擴大指定範圍。（ID1484-006）其後列為「明治日本的產業革命遺產：製鐵・製鋼、造船、煤礦產業」的構成資產之一，該遺產於2015年登錄為聯合國教科文組織世界遺產。

a3c663038f7e5ba2.en: In Nakatsu city, located on the northwestern edge of Oita Prefecture, and the neighboring city of Usa, “Mossou Zushi” has been eaten since ancient times. “Mossou” is a square wooden mold measuring 15 cm on each side and 15 cm in height. Pressed sushi made with this mold is called “Mossou Zushi”.Some believe that this recipe has been around for several hundred years. It is said that the “Mossou Zushi” was introduced during a time when rice was considered a delicacy, and the boxes were used to equally divide the rice among a group of people.
a3c663038f7e5ba2.zh: 在位於大分縣西北端的中津市及鄰近的宇佐市，自古以來就食用「物相ずし」。「物相」是長、寬、高各15公分的正方形木模，用這種木模製成的押壽司稱為「物相ずし」。有人認為這種做法已流傳數百年。據說「物相ずし」出現於米被視為珍饈的時代，木盒用來將米平均分給眾人。

a3f679c54959dbd1.en: Yokohama City is the largest consumer of“ Shumai” in Japan. While the average annual consumption of “Shumai ”(excluding frozen foods and meals at restaurants) in Japan is 1,093 yen, Yokohama is more than double at 2,248 yen. Kawasaki follows close behind at 1,951 yen（※）.This is largely due to the presence of Shumai from Kiyo-ken, a well-known specialty of Yokohama, and Yokohama Chinatown, the mecca of Chinese cuisine. Kiyo-ken was first established in 1908 at Yokohama Station (present-day Sakuragi-cho Station).
a3f679c54959dbd1.zh: 橫濱市是日本燒賣消費量最高的城市。日本全國燒賣（不含冷凍食品及外食）的年平均消費金額為1,093日圓，橫濱則超過兩倍，達2,248日圓，川崎以1,951日圓緊追在後（※）。這主要是因為有橫濱知名特產崎陽軒的燒賣，以及中華料理重鎮橫濱中華街。崎陽軒於1908年在橫濱站（今櫻木町站）創立。

a423cfca87644c72.en: Kawamura Art Museum (河村美術館, Kawamura Bijutsukan) is art museum in Karatsu, Saga Prefecture, Japan. The collection includes twenty works by Aoki Shigeru as well as paintings by Kuroda Seiki, Wada Eisaku, and Yamashita Shintarō. Temporary exhibitions are also mounted. In 2014 the museum became a Public Interest Incorporated Foundation.
a423cfca87644c72.zh: 河村美術館是位於日本佐賀縣唐津市的美術館。館藏包括青木繁的二十件作品，以及黑田清輝、和田英作、山下新太郎的畫作，也舉辦特展。2014年改制為公益財團法人。

a433ff1f9d563a6d.en: In Hokkaido, which is one of the largest producers of kelp in Japan, "Kombu-maki" (kelp rolls), in which fish such as salmon and herring are rolled in kelp, has taken root. Kombu-rolls are often made with Hidaka kelp, which is soft and low in fiber content and is found in the Hidaka region. Today, kelp rolls are also made throughout Japan, and are often served at New Year's. Hokkaido accounts for 90% of the nation's kelp roll production.Hokkaido is Japan's leading kelp producer, accounting for 90% of the nation's total production.
a433ff1f9d563a6d.zh: 北海道是日本昆布的主要產地之一，以昆布捲起鮭魚、鯡魚等魚類製成的「昆布巻き」（昆布捲）在當地已紮根。昆布捲多使用產於日高地區、質地柔軟且纖維含量低的日高昆布。如今日本各地也製作昆布捲，常在新年時食用。北海道占全國昆布捲產量的90%。北海道是日本首要的昆布產地，占全國總產量的90%。

a441b4ed2fced056.en: ‘Oiri’ is a snack made at home not to waste left over rice. Long time ago, in Inaba region, people washed left over rice and dried under sunshine to make ‘hoshi-ii’ (=dried rice), then made ‘Oiri’. The name came from the process to make this snack; to fry (‘iru’ in Japanese). Some homes used not only left over rice, but also added ingredients available at home. This snack was invented from the thought of not wasting food.
a441b4ed2fced056.zh: 「おいり」是為了不浪費剩飯而在家中製作的點心。很久以前，因幡地區的人們將剩飯洗淨後在陽光下曬乾，做成「干し飯」（乾燥米飯），再製成「おいり」。名稱來自製作過程中的「煎炒」（日文為「いる」）。有些家庭不只使用剩飯，還會加入家中現有的材料。這種點心源自不浪費食物的想法。

a44cbad4acac2e50.en: “Nagasaki Tempura” is a traditional dish, which dates to around 400 years ago, from the time of the Nanban trade period. This dish is inspired from fritters made by Portuguese people at the time. In Japan, tempura is usually eaten with a dipping sauce but in this region, the batter is flavored with sugar and other seasonings and does not require a sauce.
a44cbad4acac2e50.zh: 「長崎天ぷら」是可追溯至約400年前南蠻貿易時期的傳統料理，受到當時葡萄牙人製作的油炸麵衣料理啟發。在日本，天婦羅通常沾醬汁食用，但在這個地區，麵衣以砂糖等調味料調味，不需要沾醬。

a4629bef0ebf1bd8.en: Oyama Castle (小山城, Oyama-jō) was a Japanese castle located in what is now the city of Oyama, Tochigi Prefecture, in the Kantō region of Japan. In 1991 the ruins were proclaimed a National Historic Site by the Japanese government collectively with Nakakuki Castle and Washi Castle as the "Oyama clan castle ruins". The castle is also known as Gion Castle (祇園城, Gion-jō)
a4629bef0ebf1bd8.zh: 小山城是曾位於今日本關東地方栃木縣小山市的日本城郭。1991年，日本政府將其遺址與中久喜城、鷲城合併，以「小山氏城跡」之名指定為國家史跡。此城又稱祇園城。

a46a5a05e4f5c396.en: Ishimochi Jako is a small fish caught in the Seto Inland Sea from spring to summer. In some areas, it is called nebuto, and its standard Japanese name is tenjikudai. Because the otolith, a stone-like bone in the head, is larger than those of other fish, it cannot be eaten whole, but rather its head must be removed before cooking. Because it is a small fish, it has little flesh, but when fried and eaten bone by bone, it has a subtle sweetness to it. It is sweet and sticky, and is sometimes eaten as dumplings.
a46a5a05e4f5c396.zh: いしもちじゃこ是春季至夏季在瀨戶內海捕獲的小魚。有些地區稱為ねぶと，標準日文名稱為天竺鯛。由於頭部中名為耳石的石狀骨頭比其他魚大，無法整條食用，烹調前必須去頭。因為是小魚，魚肉不多，但油炸後連骨一起食用，帶有淡淡的甜味。也有人將其做成甜而黏的團子食用。

a4749c38699d707c.en: "Bokkake" is a local dish that has been enjoyed in Fukui Prefecture for over 100 years (since the early Taisho period). It involves pouring a hot soup, filled with ingredients such as root vegetables and Konjac noodles, over freshly cooked rice. There is a theory that the name "Bokkake" originated from the act of pouring (known as 'bokkakeru' in the local dialect) hot soup over freshly cooked rice.
a4749c38699d707c.zh: 「ぼっかけ」是福井縣流傳超過100年（自大正初期起）的鄉土料理，將加入根莖類蔬菜、蒟蒻絲等配料的熱湯淋在剛煮好的白飯上。有一說認為，「ぼっかけ」之名源自將熱湯淋在剛煮好的白飯上的動作（當地方言稱為「ぼっかける」）。

a4797ad43bd95233.en: Kyōdo-no-Mori or Native Forest (郷土の森博物館, Kyōdo-no-Mori Hakubutsukan) is an open-air folk museum in Fuchū, Tokyo. It features buildings of historical note from various times in Japanese history.
a4797ad43bd95233.zh: 府中市郷土の森博物館（郷土の森博物館）是位於東京都府中市的露天民俗博物館，展示日本歷史上不同時期具歷史意義的建築。

a47e17a68396e096.en: Sekihan (red rice) is often eaten on special occasions throughout Japan. In Hokkaido, there is a unique food culture to cook sekihan with ama-natto (sweet soybeans). In other regions, sekihan is cooked with azuki beans and seasoned with sesame salt, so it does not have a sweet taste, but sekihan in Hokkaido with ama-natto is sweet.The origin of "sekihan" with ama-natto is a matter of some debate, but it is said to have been invented in the late 1950s by Ms.
a47e17a68396e096.zh: 赤飯（紅豆飯）在日本各地常於特殊場合食用。北海道有以甘納豆（甜豆）煮赤飯的獨特飲食文化。其他地區的赤飯是用紅豆炊煮、以芝麻鹽調味，因此沒有甜味，但北海道加入甘納豆的赤飯則是甜的。使用甘納豆的「赤飯」起源眾說紛紜，據說是在1950年代後期由某位女士所發明。

a48444d5aa9a7615.en: The Sameura Dam (早明浦ダム Sameura-damu) is a dam on the Yoshino River on the island of Shikoku, Japan, completed in 1975. It has the largest storage capacity in Shikoku. The dam holds back a reservoir, named Lake Sameura (さめうら湖 Sameura-ko)
a48444d5aa9a7615.zh: 早明浦ダム是位於日本四國吉野川上的水壩，於1975年完工，是四國蓄水量最大的水壩。水壩形成的水庫名為さめうら湖。

a492fc23637775a6.en: Honpō-ji (本法寺) is a Nichiren Buddhist (specifically Nichiren-shū) temple in Kyoto, Japan. Its sangō (山号; lit., "mountain name"; a type of appellation carried by many Buddhist temples) is "Eishōzan" (叡昌山).
a492fc23637775a6.zh: 本法寺是位於日本京都的日蓮宗佛寺。山號（許多佛寺所使用的一種稱號）為「叡昌山」。

a4b22d3eeb4403cd.en: Ishidori Matsuri (石取祭) can be literally translated from Japanese as "stone bringing festival." It is a festival in Kuwana, located in Mie Prefecture. The festival starts on the first Saturday of August, at midnight, and runs throughout the weekend. Every town within the central part of the city has its own 3 wheeled, highly decorative festival cart. Each cart has a large taiko drum at the back and several kane along the sides. Each town has a particular sequence for each of those instruments, creating a unique and identifying sound.
a4b22d3eeb4403cd.zh: 石取祭的日文字面意思可譯為「運石祭」。這是三重縣桑名市的祭典。祭典於8月第一個星期六的午夜開始，持續整個週末。市中心的每個町都有自己的三輪、裝飾華麗的祭典花車。每輛花車後方有一面大型太鼓，兩側有數個鉦。各町對這些樂器各有特定的敲奏方式，形成獨特且可辨識的聲音。

a4b284038c470754.en: The Yahataya Sports Park Center (八幡屋スポーツパークセンター, Yahataya Supōtsu Pāku Sentā) also known as Yahataya Park (八幡屋公園, Yahataya kōen) is a park in Osaka, Japan
a4b284038c470754.zh: 八幡屋スポーツパークセンター，又稱八幡屋公園，是位於日本大阪的公園。

a4bdd425a4389017.en: Manabeshima (真鍋島, Manabe-shima) is an island in the Seto Inland Sea, part of the municipality of Kasaoka, Okayama Prefecture, Japan. The island has an area of 1.49 square kilometers (0.57 square miles) and is one of the seven inhabited islands of the Kasaoka Islands group. The island's main commercial activity is fishing.
a4bdd425a4389017.zh: 真鍋島是瀨戶內海的島嶼，隸屬日本岡山縣笠岡市。島嶼面積1.49平方公里（0.57平方英里），是笠岡諸島中七座有人島之一。島上主要的經濟活動為漁業。

a4c71a469795e0a7.en: Kannamesai Festival, sometimes called Ōmatsuri is one of the most important festivals of Ise Jingu. Held October 15-17 each year, this ritual makes offerings of the first harvest of crops for the season to Amaterasu. An imperial envoy carries the offering of rice harvested by the Emperor himself to Ise, as well as five-coloured silk cloths and other materials, called heihaku (幣帛).
a4c71a469795e0a7.zh: 神嘗祭，有時也稱為大祭，是伊勢神宮最重要的祭典之一。每年10月15日至17日舉行，這項儀式將當季最早收成的作物供奉給天照大神。敕使會將天皇親自收成的稻米，連同五色絹布及其他稱為幣帛的供品帶往伊勢。

a4cd73f4b7205f8e.en: Shimotsuke Kokubun-ji (下野国分寺) is a Buddhist temple in the city of Shimotsuke, Tochigi Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Shingon-shū Buzan-ha sect and its honzon is a statue of Dainichi Nyorai. It is the  provincial temple ("kokubunji") of former Shimotsuke Province. The present temple is of uncertain foundation, but claims to be the direct descendant of the original Nara period kokubunji temple which fell into ruins sometime in the Kamakura period.
a4cd73f4b7205f8e.zh: 下野國分寺（下野国分寺）是位於日本栃木縣下野市的佛教寺院，屬真言宗豐山派，本尊為大日如來像。此寺為舊下野國的國分寺。現今寺院的創建年代不詳，但自稱是奈良時代原國分寺的直系後繼；原寺約於鎌倉時代荒廢。

a4ce3c7c02e9fe1c.en: Wachūsan Honpo (和中散本舗, Wachūsan Honpo) is an early Edo period pharmacy located on the former Tōkaidō highway in the city of  Rittō, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. The building was designated an Important Cultural Property of Japan (ICP) in 1954 and a National Historic Site of Japan in 1949.  The ICP designation covers the main house and shop, main gate  and the shoin residence
a4ce3c7c02e9fe1c.zh: 和中散本舖是江戶時代初期的藥舖，位於日本滋賀縣栗東市的舊東海道上。建築於1954年被指定為日本重要文化財，並於1949年被指定為日本國家史跡。重要文化財的指定範圍包括主屋與店舖、正門及書院。

a4d2b2164f63aa97.en: Minami Alps Koma Prefectural Natural Park (県立南アルプス巨摩自然公園, Kenritsu Minami Arupusu Koma shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Yamanashi Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1966, the park's central feature is the Southern Alps. The park spans the municipalities of Fujikawa, Hokuto, Minami-Alps, Minobu, and Nirasaki.
a4d2b2164f63aa97.zh: 南アルプス巨摩縣立自然公園是位於日本山梨縣的縣立自然公園，於1966年設立，以南阿爾卑斯山脈為主要景觀。公園範圍橫跨富士川町、北杜市、南阿爾卑斯市、身延町及韮崎市。

a4daed0666d6b7cb.en: “Katemeshi” is a well-established local dish in Saitama Prefecture, and especially the Chichibu region. This dish seems to have been created by adding various ingredients to rice in order to increase the amount that could be eaten, particularly in areas with relatively low levels of rice production. It was difficult for rice to be a diet mainstay in areas unsuitable for rice cultivation.
a4daed0666d6b7cb.zh: 「かてめし」是埼玉縣，特別是秩父地區由來已久的鄉土料理。這道料理似乎是為了增加可食用的分量，在米飯中加入各種食材而產生，尤其常見於稻米產量較低的地區。在不適合種稻的地區，米飯很難成為主食。

a4db2521a6d17247.en: The coastline of Tottori Prefecture is approximately 130 km long, with much of it consisting of sandy beaches. During the Edo and Meiji periods, coastal areas like the Yumigahama Peninsula were characterized by beach seining and hand-net fishing, with species like Japanese anchovy being caught. "Iwashi Dango" is a traditional local dish made with fresh anchovies. The anchovies are finely chopped with a knife, mixed with eggs and other ingredients, and cooked in a broth.
a4db2521a6d17247.zh: 鳥取縣的海岸線全長約130公里，大部分為沙灘。江戶至明治時代，弓濱半島等沿岸地區以地曳網和手抄網漁業為特色，捕撈日本鯷等魚類。「いわし団子」是使用新鮮鯷魚製作的傳統鄉土料理。將鯷魚用菜刀剁碎，與蛋等材料混合，放入高湯中煮熟。

a4e938f8374fb440.en: Ine-ura (伊根浦) a.k.a.  Ine-chō Ine-ura (伊根町伊根浦) is a coastal settlement that extends along the shores of Ine Bay and is situated in Ine Town, Yoza District, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. It is designated as a national preservation district for traditional buildings. The residential cluster that lines the coast of Ine Bay is known as "Funaya," which are famous as National Preservation District for traditional buildings.
a4e938f8374fb440.zh: 伊根浦又稱伊根町伊根浦，是沿伊根灣岸延伸的海濱聚落，位於日本京都府與謝郡伊根町，被指定為國家重要傳統建造物群保存地區。沿伊根灣海岸排列的住宅群稱為「舟屋」，以國家重要傳統建造物群保存地區聞名。

a514ac7b923c36ec.en: It is said to have its roots in Buddhist vegetarian cuisine and was created long ago by the monks of the 33 temples of the "Hirosaki Zen Forest" who made “kuzuyose” from vegetables collected through almsgiving. The colorful vegetables are beautifully arranged to make them shine for a dish that is pleasing to the eye. Its name comes from the fact that "arrowroot (kudzu)" is added to boiled vegetables and kneaded.
a514ac7b923c36ec.zh: 據說起源於佛教素食料理，是很久以前「弘前禪林」33座寺院的僧侶，以托缽化緣得來的蔬菜製作「葛寄」而來。色彩繽紛的蔬菜排列得美觀亮眼，成為賞心悅目的一道菜。其名稱來自在煮好的蔬菜中加入「葛粉」並揉拌的做法。

a523fb4613bc322a.en: Mikawa Kokubun-niji (三河国分尼寺) is a Buddhist nunnery located in the Yahata neighborhood of the city of Toyokawa, Aichi, Japan. It is the modern successor of one of the provincial temples established by Emperor Shōmu during the Nara period (710 – 794) for the purpose of promoting Buddhism as the national religion of Japan and standardising control of the imperial rule over the provinces.
a523fb4613bc322a.zh: 三河國分尼寺是位於日本愛知縣豐川市八幡地區的佛教尼寺。它是奈良時代（710－794年）聖武天皇所設立的國分寺之一的現代承繼者；設立這些寺院的目的，是將佛教推廣為日本的國教，並使朝廷對各國的統治標準化。

a52c4893b0a30728.en: Hokekyō-ji (法華経寺) is a temple of the Nichiren-shū founded during the Kamakura period in Ichikawa, Chiba Prefecture, Japan. One of Nichiren's most important writings the Risshō Ankoku Ron, regarded as one of the National Treasures of Japan, is kept at the temple. Next to other documents it is being presented to the public on 3 November each year.
a52c4893b0a30728.zh: 法華經寺是日蓮宗的寺院，於鎌倉時代創建於日本千葉縣市川市。日蓮最重要的著作之一《立正安國論》被列為日本國寶，收藏於此寺。此書與其他文獻每年11月3日對外公開展示。

a54a955deb40ef35.en: The Osaka International Peace Center (大阪国際平和センター, Ōsaka-kokusai-heiwa-sentā), also known as Peace Osaka (ピースおおさか, Pīsu-Ōsaka), is a peace museum established in August 1991 based in the city of Osaka, Japan. It focuses on the destruction of the city during World War II and the broader themes of the tragedy of war and the importance of peace. It is funded by Osaka city and Osaka Prefecture.
a54a955deb40ef35.zh: 大阪国際平和センター，又稱ピースおおさか，是1991年8月設立於日本大阪市的和平博物館。館方著重介紹二次世界大戰期間大阪市遭受的破壞，以及戰爭的悲慘與和平的重要等更廣泛的主題。經費由大阪市與大阪府提供。

a567522da8a9975b.en: Ikuno Korea Town (Japanese: 生野コリアタウン; Korean: 이쿠노 코리아타운) is a Koreatown in Ikuno-ku, Osaka, Japan. It is one of the largest Koreatowns in the country and a significant tourist attraction, with around two million visitors in 2021.
a567522da8a9975b.zh: 生野コリアンタウン（日語：生野コリアタウン；韓語：이쿠노 코리아타운）是位於日本大阪市生野區的韓國城，為日本規模最大的韓國城之一，也是重要的觀光景點，2021年約有200萬名遊客造訪。

a57ba0184b751714.en: Okhotsk Tokkari Center – Seal Land (Japanese: オホーツクとっかりセンター（アザラシランド）) is a seal rescue center and sanctuary located in Monbetsu, Hokkaido, Japan. It is currently the only dedicated marine mammal rescue and rehabilitation facility in Japan, with a focus on caring for seals native to the Sea of Okhotsk.
a57ba0184b751714.zh: オホーツクとっかりセンター（アザラシランド）是位於日本北海道紋別的海豹救援中心暨保護設施。目前為日本唯一專門從事海洋哺乳類救援與復健的設施，以照顧鄂霍次克海原生的海豹為主。

a5a354ec6efc3654.en: In Saga Prefecture, known for its thriving rice cultivation, both short-grain rice and glutinous rice are widely grown, boasting some of the highest production volumes in the country. As a result, there are many local dishes made with glutinous rice, and Futsu Mochi is one of them. Futsu Mochi refers to what is commonly known as yomogi mochi, where futsu denotes the Japanese mugwort plant (yomogi).
a5a354ec6efc3654.zh: 佐賀縣稻作興盛，粳米和糯米都廣泛種植，產量在全國名列前茅。因此有許多使用糯米製作的鄉土料理，ふつもち就是其中之一。ふつもち就是一般所說的艾草麻糬，「ふつ」指的是艾草（よもぎ）。

a5bf255e09d358ad.en: This is a dish made by marinating high-quality domestic pork in special miso, belonging to an elevation of 1 in the Tanzawa Oyama National Park. It is a specialty dish of Atsugi City. The flavorful aroma of the crispy miso marinated with pork complements rice well, making it a delightful dish.Its roots date back to the end of the Edo period. During that time, samurai disliked consuming meat from quadrupeds like cows, pigs, and wild boars.
a5bf255e09d358ad.zh: 這道料理是將優質國產豬肉以特製味噌醃漬而成，與丹澤大山國定公園有關，是厚木市的特色料理。烤得香脆的味噌與豬肉香氣濃郁，十分下飯。其起源可追溯至江戶時代末期。當時武士忌諱食用牛、豬、山豬等四足動物的肉。

a5c3580c5c1b0d86.en: The Jōnokoshi site (城之越遺跡, Jōnokoshi iseki) is an archaeological site containing the ruins of a Kofun period settlement and ritual site located in the Hido neighborhood of the city of Iga in the Kansai region of Japan. It was designated as both a National Historic Site of Japan and a National Place of Scenic Beauty in 1993.
a5c3580c5c1b0d86.zh: 城之越遺跡是位於日本近畿地方伊賀市比土的考古遺址，保存有古墳時代聚落與祭祀場所的遺跡。1993年同時被指定為國家史跡及國家名勝。

a5c36d6c602fd6aa.en: Izu Shaboten Zoo (Japanese: 伊豆シャボテン動物公園, Hepburn: Izu Shaboten Dōbutsukōen) is a zoological park and botanical garden in Itō, Shizuoka, Japan. Founded in 1959, the zoo is currently notable for its exhibited capybaras and succulent greenhouses and is open year-round.
a5c36d6c602fd6aa.zh: 伊豆シャボテン動物公園是位於日本靜岡縣伊東市的動物園兼植物園。創立於1959年，目前以展示的水豚及多肉植物溫室聞名，全年開放。

a5c85dab420df79e.en: Chatan Castle (Japanese: 北谷城跡, romanized: Chatan jōato), or Chatan Gusuku (Okinawan: 北谷城, romanized: Chatan gusuku) is a Ryūkyūan gusuku located in Chatan, Okinawa.
a5c85dab420df79e.zh: 北谷城（日語：北谷城跡，Chatan jōato），又稱北谷城（沖繩語：Chatan gusuku），是位於沖繩北谷的琉球御城（グスク）。

a5cbf35461d7548e.en: Sakai City Museum (堺市博物館, Sakai-shi Hakubutsukan) is located within Daisen Park, in Sakai-ku, Sakai City, in Osaka Prefecture.
a5cbf35461d7548e.zh: 堺市博物館位於大阪府堺市堺區的大仙公園內。

a5d153d5f0662e15.en: Wakayama Prefecture is one of the top producer of green peas in Japan, and various kinds of green peas, like ‘Usui Endou’, ‘Kinusaya Endou’, ‘Holland Endou’, ‘Snap Endou’, etc., are grown in many areas in the prefecture (Inami-cho, Hidakagawa-cho, Minabe-cho, Gobo City, Mihama-cho, Yura-cho, etc.).Green pea has a long history, and it is said that green pea has been cultivated since ancient Greek Era in the world. In Mid-Edo Era, European variety for podded peas was introduced to Japan. ‘Usui Endou’ started to be grown in Wakayama after that.
a5d153d5f0662e15.zh: 和歌山縣是日本豌豆的主要產地之一，縣內許多地區（印南町、日高川町、南部町、御坊市、美濱町、由良町等）種植碓井豌豆、絹莢豌豆、荷蘭豌豆、甜豆等各種豌豆。豌豆歷史悠久，據說在世界上自古希臘時代就已開始栽培。江戶時代中期，歐洲的剝莢豌豆品種傳入日本，此後和歌山開始種植碓井豌豆。

a5d60728df82da4c.en: "Kumoji" is a dish made by simmering pickled leafy greens that have been soaked in water to remove excess salt. This dish emerged from the desire to cherish and utilize pickled vegetables that have become sour in spring rather than discarding them. The term "kumoji" dates back to the Heian period, and it referred to pickled vegetables.
a5d60728df82da4c.zh: 「くもじ」是將醃漬葉菜泡水去除多餘鹽分後燉煮而成的料理。這道料理源自於不願丟棄春天變酸的醃菜、想要珍惜利用的心意。「くもじ」一詞可追溯至平安時代，指的是醃漬蔬菜。

a5ee09c97e7f46b2.en: Kansai International Airport (Japanese: 関西国際空港, romanized: Kansai Kokusai Kūkō; IATA: KIX, ICAO: RJBB), commonly known as Kankū (Japanese: 関空) is the primary international airport in the Greater Osaka Area of Japan and the closest international airport to the cities of Osaka, Kyoto, and Kobe.
a5ee09c97e7f46b2.zh: 関西国際空港（IATA：KIX，ICAO：RJBB），通稱關空，是日本大阪都市圈的主要國際機場，也是距離大阪、京都、神戶等城市最近的國際機場。

a60f52064d7834d9.en: Amidst the many dried gourd strips dishes, “Kanpyo no gomasu-ae” is one of the dishes beloved by residents of the prefecture along with “Kanpyo no tamago-toshi.” Tochigi Prefecture’s dried gourd strip production accounts for over 99% of the country’s; its cultivation especially flourishes in the southern part of the prefecture. For the cultivation of bottle gourd which becomes dried gourd strips, light soil with good drainage is desirable; this area where the "Kanto Loam Formation" is widely distributed is suitable for its cultivation.
a60f52064d7834d9.zh: 在眾多干瓢料理中，「干瓢のごま酢あえ」與「干瓢の卵とじ」同為縣民喜愛的料理。栃木縣的干瓢產量占全國99%以上，尤其以縣南部栽培最為興盛。用來製作干瓢的葫蘆，適合種在排水良好的輕質土壤中；這一帶廣泛分布「關東壤土層」，適合栽培。

a6202f9f87f9150d.en: The Moto-Hakone Stone Buddhas (元箱根石仏群, Moto-Hakone sekibutsu) is a grouping of stone sculptures and associated tō (stone pagodas), dating from the late Kamakura period and located in the former village of Moto-Hakone, now merged into the town of Hakone in Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. The group has been designated an National Historic Site and includes a number of Important Cultural Properties.
a6202f9f87f9150d.zh: 元箱根石仏群（元箱根石仏群，Moto-Hakone sekibutsu）是一組石雕及相關石塔，年代為鎌倉時代後期，位於舊元箱根村，該村現已併入日本神奈川縣箱根町。此石佛群已被指定為國家史跡，其中包含多件重要文化財。

a628af87b0479d14.en: The Tottori Tōshō-gū (鳥取東照宮) is a Shinto shrine located in the city of Tottori, Tottori Prefecture, Japan. Until 2011, it was called the Ōchidani Jinja (樗谿神社). Four structures of the shrine, the Honden, Haiden and Heiden, and Karamon gate are designated National Important Cultural Properties. It is surrounded by a public park.
a628af87b0479d14.zh: 鳥取東照宮是位於日本鳥取縣鳥取市的神社。2011年以前稱為樗谿神社。神社的本殿、拜殿、幣殿及唐門四棟建築被指定為國家重要文化財。神社周圍為公園。

a6357f65fecfe714.en: The Shingen-kō Festival (信玄公祭り, Shingen-ko Matsuri) is a Japanese festival (matsuri) which is held annually to celebrate the legacy of daimyō Takeda Shingen in Kōfu, the capital city of Yamanashi Prefecture. It is the "largest gathering of samurai" in the world.
a6357f65fecfe714.zh: 信玄公祭り是每年在山梨縣縣廳所在地甲府舉行的日本祭典，紀念大名武田信玄的事蹟，為世界上「規模最大的武士集會」。

a64c6fbb99fe295c.en: Mukasa Castle (穆佐城, Mukasa-jō) was a Japanese castle located in the Takaoka neighborhood of what is now the city of Miyazaki, Miyazaki Prefecture, in southeastern Kyushu, Japan. Its ruins have been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 2002. It was also called Musain High Castle (穆佐院高城, Musain-Takajō). It is one of the 48 castles controlled by the Itō clan in Hyūga Province in the Sengoku period.
a64c6fbb99fe295c.zh: 穆佐城是位於日本九州東南部宮崎縣，今宮崎市高岡地區的日本城郭。其遺跡自2002年起由中央政府列為國家史跡加以保護。又稱穆佐院高城。為戰國時代日向國伊東氏掌控的四十八城之一。

a655960fde17926a.en: Kikkawa Historical Museum (吉川史料館, Kikkawa Shiryōkan) is a private museum of artefacts handed down by the Kikkawa clan, daimyō of Iwakuni Domain, in Iwakuni, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan. Located between Kintai-kyō bridge and Iwakuni Castle and opened by the Kikkawa Hōkōkai Society (吉川報效会) in 1995, the museum's collection totals some seven thousand items, including materials from the Heian and Kamakura periods, a painting attributed to Sesshū, and one National Treasure. There are four changing displays each year.
a655960fde17926a.zh: 吉川史料館是位於日本山口縣岩國市的私人博物館，收藏岩國藩藩主吉川家傳承下來的文物。館址位於錦帶橋與岩國城之間，由吉川報效會於1995年開設，館藏共約七千件，包括平安時代與鎌倉時代的資料、一幅傳為雪舟所繪的畫作，以及一件國寶。每年舉辦四次換展。

a65a22b3a33bf4f8.en: In the past, when ironing at home to achieve crispness, people used a mixture called "rice paste" applied to fabric. It was made by mushing soaked rice in water. The leftover rice residue, not well crushed during this process, was called "Nori-kasu." To avoid wasting it, people mixed it with black sugar, formed it into dough, and then pan-fried it to create a delicious snack. It is said to be called "Gappara-mochi" because the ingredients are transferred to the baking pan "Gapapp" (onomatopoeic word) at once and baked.
a65a22b3a33bf4f8.zh: 過去在家中熨燙衣物、為了讓布料挺括時，會在布上塗抹一種稱為「米糊」的混合物，做法是將浸泡過的米在水中搗爛。這個過程中未充分搗碎的剩餘米渣稱為「のりかす」。為了不浪費，人們將其拌入黑糖揉成麵團，再用平底鍋煎烤，做成美味的點心。據說之所以稱為「がっぱらもち」，是因為材料會「がっぱ」（擬聲詞）一下子全部倒進烤盤中烘烤。

a65d602d8027c0bf.en: "Ebi-imo and Boudara no Taitan (Simmered Dish)" is a local dish from Kyoto, featuring traditional Kyoto vegetables called ebi-imo, known for their shrimp-like shape and striped pattern, and Boudara, a dried type of cod from Hokkaido, which are slowly cooked by simmering them together.The ebi-imo has a dense and sticky texture with a unique richness in flavor, making it a popular traditional vegetable in ordinary households. Due to its resistance to falling apart during cooking, it is often used in simmered dishes.
a65d602d8027c0bf.zh: 「えびいもと棒だらの炊いたん（燉煮料理）」是京都的鄉土料理，將京都傳統蔬菜海老芋與北海道產的鱈魚乾「棒鱈」一起慢慢燉煮而成。海老芋因形狀像蝦、表面有條紋而得名。海老芋口感緊實黏稠，風味獨特濃郁，是一般家庭常用的傳統蔬菜。由於烹煮時不易煮散，常用於燉煮料理。

a66492a5b89f1ea6.en: The Kodaira Hirakushi Denchu Art Museum (小平市平櫛田中彫刻美術館, Kodaira-shi hirakushidenchū chōkoku bijutsukan) is an art museum in the city of Kodaira in western Tokyo, Japan, dedicated to the life and work of Japanese master wood sculptor Hirakushi Denchū (1872–1979). The museum preserves the last home and studio of Denchu, where he moved in 1970, and has a purpose-built exhibition annex building housing many of the sculptor's works.
a66492a5b89f1ea6.zh: 小平市平櫛田中彫刻美術館是位於日本東京西部小平市的美術館，以日本木雕大師平櫛田中（1872–1979）的生平與作品為主題。館內保存田中於1970年遷入的最後住所兼工作室，另設有專門興建的展示別館，收藏多件這位雕刻家的作品。

a670a63c61f0b181.en: Kengun Shrine (健軍神社) is the oldest traditional shrine in Kumamoto City, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan. It is one of the 4 shrines of Aso Shrine group (Aso Shrine, Kohsa Shrine and Kohnoura Shrine).
a670a63c61f0b181.zh: 健軍神社是日本熊本縣熊本市歷史最悠久的傳統神社，為阿蘇神社群四社之一（其他為阿蘇神社、甲佐神社與郡浦神社）。

a67e1ac1a8cd2ec6.en: Imuta-ike (藺牟田池) is a freshwater caldera lake in Satsumasendai, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan. It forms part of Imutaike Prefectural Natural Park. Its plant communities were designated a Natural Monument of Japan in 1921 and sixty hectares of wetlands were designated a Ramsar Site in 2005.
a67e1ac1a8cd2ec6.zh: 藺牟田池（藺牟田池）是位於日本鹿兒島縣薩摩川內市的淡水火山口湖，屬於藺牟田池縣立自然公園的一部分。其植物群落於1921年被指定為日本天然紀念物，60公頃的濕地於2005年被指定為拉姆薩濕地。

a68a269e9f817b0e.en: Noyamakita-Rokudōyama Park (野山北・六道山公園, Noyamakita-Rokudōyama Kōen) is a public park located in the Sayama hills and stretching from the city of Musashimurayama to the town of Mizuho in Tokyo, Japan. With an area of 1,323,900 m2, it is the second-largest park in the prefecture of Tokyo.
a68a269e9f817b0e.zh: 野山北・六道山公園（野山北・六道山公園）是位於狹山丘陵的公園，範圍從東京都武藏村山市延伸至瑞穗町。面積1,323,900平方公尺，是東京都第二大的公園。

a69e0772647ce204.en: “Shijimi-jiru” is a local dish of Shiga Prefecture that uses setashijimi.There are three native clams inhabiting Japan: “yamatoshijimi”,“ mashijimi”, and“ setashijimi”. Currently, most of the clams in circulation are said to be yamatoshijimi. The setashijimi used in Shiga Prefecture’s shijimi-jiru is an endemic species that lives only in Lake Biwa. (Compared to yamatoshijimi and mashijimi) Its shell is plump, large, and thick, and the flesh is rich in flavor.
a69e0772647ce204.zh: 「しじみ汁」是使用瀨田蜆的滋賀縣鄉土料理。日本原生的蜆有三種：「大和蜆」、「真蜆」和「瀨田蜆」。據說目前市面上流通的蜆大多是大和蜆。滋賀縣しじみ汁所用的瀨田蜆是只棲息於琵琶湖的特有種。（與大和蜆和真蜆相比）其殼飽滿、大且厚，肉質風味濃郁。

a6a051cd53044143.en: Haruna Shrine (榛名神社, Haruna Jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Takasaki, Gunma Prefecture, Japan. Mount Haruna, the mountain where the shrine is located, is one of the "Three Mountains of Jōmō" and the shrine has a close relationship with the shrines of the other two mountains, Mount Akagi and Mount Myōgi. It is dedicated to the gods of Water, Fire, and Agriculture. It also said to give blessings of prosperity in business and a good marriage.
a6a051cd53044143.zh: 榛名神社是位於日本群馬縣高崎市的神社。神社所在的榛名山為「上毛三山」之一，神社與另外兩座山赤城山、妙義山的神社關係密切。神社供奉水、火與農業之神，據說也能帶來生意興隆與良緣。

a6acf928d4c84e9e.en: Naka-in is a Tendai Buddhist temple in Kawagoe City, Saitama Prefecture.
a6acf928d4c84e9e.zh: 中院是位於埼玉縣川越市的天台宗寺院。

a6af322a0125a606.en: Nihonmatsu Lantern Festival(二本松の提灯祭り Nihonmatsu-chochinmatsuri) is a Japanese traditional festival, located in Nihonmatsu, Fukushima, Japan.
a6af322a0125a606.zh: 二本松の提灯祭り是在日本福島縣二本松舉行的日本傳統祭典。

a6b1abdabb90848a.en: Saihō-ji (西方寺) is a Buddhist temple built in 1706 belonging to the Jōdo-shū sect in Aoba-ku, Sendai, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan. It is rarely called by its formal name by locals, and is more often called Jogi Nyorai or Jogi-san.
a6b1abdabb90848a.zh: 西方寺是建於1706年的淨土宗寺院，位於日本宮城縣仙台市青葉區。當地人很少以正式名稱稱呼此寺，較常稱為「定義如來」或「定義さん」。

a6b9e397ee00c065.en: The Ariake Sea, which has Japan's highest tidal range and vast mud flats, is home to a variety of unique fish and shellfish, including “Mutsugoro", “Mekaja", “Sea mushrooms", and “Wrasses". The sole fish, which lives on sandy muddy bottoms of shallow waters throughout Japan, is also found in the Ariake Sea and is called “kuchizoko" in Saga Prefecture. Its body is characterized by its leaf-shaped body, with no distinguishable dorsal or caudal fins.
a6b9e397ee00c065.zh: 有明海擁有日本最大的潮差和廣大的泥灘，棲息著「むつごろう」、「メカジャ」、「海茸」、「隆頭魚」等各種獨特的魚貝類。棲息在日本各地淺海砂泥底的鰨魚也出現在有明海，在佐賀縣被稱為「くちぞこ」。牠的身體呈葉片狀，背鰭和尾鰭難以區分。

a6bf957a79a85a1f.en: Someii, also known as "Seto's Someii," has been sold at teahouses in the former Sechimachi Village (now part of Fujieda City) along the old Tokaido highway since the Warring States period. It has been known as a specialty of the Tokaido region.
a6bf957a79a85a1f.zh: 染飯又稱「瀨戶的染飯」，自戰國時代起，就在舊東海道沿線的舊瀨戶村（今屬藤枝市）的茶屋販售，作為東海道一帶的名產而為人所知。

a6c7b46b4e6df627.en: Rakan-ji (羅漢寺) is a Sōtō temple in Nakatsu, Oita Prefecture, Japan. The temple stands on the mountainside of Mt. Rakan, the rocky cliff of which has countless mouths of caves. The main gate and the main hall stand directly in the rocky cliff. In the caves, over 3,700 stone Buddhas are enshrined.
a6c7b46b4e6df627.zh: 羅漢寺是位於日本大分縣中津市的曹洞宗寺院。寺院位於羅漢山山腰，山上岩壁有無數洞口。山門與本堂直接建在岩壁之中。洞窟內供奉3,700尊以上的石佛。

a6cc629567a2bd57.en: Dewa Shrine (出羽神社, Dewa Jinja) is a major Shinto shrine associated with Shugendo on Mount Haguro, Japan. As the lowest of the three mountains, standing at 414 m (1,358 ft), it is the only one that is accessible throughout the year. By contrast Gassan Shrine and Yudonosan Shrine, which are closed during winter due to heavy snowfall. Because of this it is considered the main shrine.
a6cc629567a2bd57.zh: 出羽神社是位於日本羽黑山、與修驗道有關的重要神社。羽黑山海拔414公尺（1,358英尺），是三山中最低者，也是唯一全年可參拜的。相較之下，月山神社與湯殿山神社冬季因大雪而關閉。因此出羽神社被視為主社。

a6d3e8cfaca1acef.en: Rinzai-ji (Japanese: 臨済寺),  is a Buddhist temple belonging to the Myōshin-ji branch of the Rinzai school of Japanese Zen, Buddhism located in the Aoi ward of the city of Shizuoka, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. Its main image is a statue of Amida Nyōrai. It was the bodaiji of the Imagawa clan, a powerful Sengoku period daimyō clan.
a6d3e8cfaca1acef.zh: 臨済寺是位於日本靜岡縣靜岡市葵區的佛教寺院，屬日本禪宗臨濟宗妙心寺派。本尊為阿彌陀如來像。此寺為戰國時代有力大名今川氏的菩提寺。

a6d8a14e96dd21bd.en: This dish is prepared with white miso soup, round mochi, beautifully cut and arranged daikon radish, carrots, taro, and the like.The history of the Zoni New Year's Soup goes back an incredibly long time, and it's said that it was already eaten even during the Muromachi period. It was served to celebrate the societal elite, but it is said to have spread among the masses and common people during the Edo period.Even today, eating Zoni on New Year's Day is a nationwide custom, but the ingredients and seasonings used vary by region and household.
a6d8a14e96dd21bd.zh: 這道料理以白味噌湯為底，加入圓形年糕，以及切得美觀並擺放整齊的白蘿蔔、紅蘿蔔、芋頭等。年節雜煮的歷史非常悠久，據說在室町時代就已經有人食用。當時是供上層階級慶祝之用，據說到了江戶時代才普及到一般大眾與庶民之間。至今，元旦吃雜煮仍是全國性的習俗，但使用的食材和調味因地區和家庭而異。

a6db674728ab6926.en: Dried fava beans are roasted and soaked in soy sauce, sugar, and red pepper paste while still hot. Unlike boiled beans, roasted beans are soaked in soy sauce before being soaked in soy sauce, which gives them a unique texture that crackles in the mouth when lightly chewed.It is believed that soy sauce bean production began in Sanuki (present-day Kagawa Prefecture) during the Edo period.
a6db674728ab6926.zh: 將乾燥蠶豆炒過，趁熱浸入醬油、砂糖與辣椒醬中。與水煮的豆子不同，炒過的豆子再浸泡醬油，因而有獨特口感，輕輕一咬便在口中喀喀作響。一般認為しょうゆ豆的製作始於江戶時代的讚岐（今香川縣）。

a6e19b210defcabe.en: Yamaguchi Prefectural Museum (山口県立山口博物館, Yamaguchi Kenritsu Yamaguchi Hakubutsukan) is a prefectural museum in Yamaguchi, Japan, dedicated to the natural history and history of Yamaguchi Prefecture. It also has displays relating to science, technology, and astronomy. The museum opened as the Bōchō Educational Museum in 1912 and moved to its present location in 1917, reopening as the Yamaguchi Prefectural Educational Museum. The current building dates to 1967. The museum celebrated its one hundredth anniversary in 2012.
a6e19b210defcabe.zh: 山口県立山口博物館是位於日本山口的縣立博物館，以山口縣的自然史與歷史為主題，也有科學、技術及天文相關展示。博物館於1912年以防長教育博物館之名開館，1917年遷至現址，並以山口縣立教育博物館之名重新開館。現今建築建於1967年。博物館於2012年迎來一百週年。

a70a050b83e15e1f.en: Sushi culture is one of Kochi Prefecture's representative food cultures. There is a wide range of variations, including not only the common "Nigiri-Zushi", but also "Oshi-Zushi," "Sugata-Zushi," and "Vegetable-Zushi," to name just a few. In the days when rice was precious, sushi was the best feast of all. Sushi was always eaten on special occasions such as weddings, funerals, celebrations for success in life, and “Kanreki (60th birthday) celebrations”. One typical type of sushi is "Oshi-Zushi".
a70a050b83e15e1f.zh: 壽司文化是高知縣代表性的飲食文化之一。種類相當多樣，除了常見的「握壽司」之外，還有「押壽司」、「姿壽司」、「蔬菜壽司」等。在米還很珍貴的年代，壽司是最好的佳餚。婚禮、喪禮、慶祝出人頭地，以及「還曆（60歲生日）祝賀」等特別場合，一定會吃壽司。具代表性的壽司之一是「押壽司」。

a727d396a6294ded.en: Asari Dam (朝里ダム) is a dam in Otaru, Hokkaidō, Japan, completed in 1993. It is a Gravity dam of 73.9 m which is currently managed by the Hokkaido Construction Department. The man-made lake which resulted from the construction of the dam is called Otarunai Lake.
a727d396a6294ded.zh: 朝里ダム是位於日本北海道小樽的水壩，1993年完工。為高73.9公尺的重力壩，目前由北海道建設部管理。因興建水壩而形成的人工湖稱為オタルナイ湖。

a72addf350ffdd53.en: Mount Moriyoshi is an inactive volcano in Kitaakita, Akita Prefecture, Japan. The stratovolcano is basaltic-to-dacitic in composition. Its last eruptive activity is thought to be 1.1 million to 700 thousand years ago. The volcano appeared in the List of 100 Floral Mountains. The volcano contains about 300 species of alpine flora which has made it a tourist attraction.
a72addf350ffdd53.zh: 森吉山是位於日本秋田縣北秋田市的休火山。這座層狀火山的成分為玄武岩至英安岩。其最後一次噴發活動推測在110萬年至70萬年前。此山列名「花之百名山」。山上有約300種高山植物，因而成為觀光景點。

a751160b522db5fc.en: "Sasazushi" is a regional dish passed down in the city of Iiyama and the Joetsu region of Niigata Prefecture. It consists of vinegar rice spread on bamboo leaves, with various ingredients placed on top. The history of Sasazushi is ancient, dating back to the battles in the 22nd year of the Tenbun era (1553) during the Kawanakajima conflict, which lasted for 12 years.
a751160b522db5fc.zh: 「笹ずし」是流傳於飯山市與新潟縣上越地區的鄉土料理，作法是在竹葉上鋪上醋飯，再放上各種配料。笹ずし的歷史悠久，可追溯至歷時12年的川中島之戰中，天文22年（1553）的戰役。

a78148827676d2c3.en: In Obon holidays (mid-August), tofu merchants worked hard making fried thin tofu and fresh tofu for "Shojin ryori (vegan cuisine for Buddist monks)". However, they always faced a big issue; both fried and non-fried tofu were spoiled quickly because there wasn’t any refrigeration technology like we have today.
a78148827676d2c3.zh: 在盂蘭盆節假期（8月中旬），豆腐店為了「精進料理（僧侶的素食料理）」努力製作油豆腐皮和生豆腐。然而他們總是面臨一個大問題：當時沒有像現在這樣的冷藏技術，不論油炸或未油炸的豆腐都很快就會壞掉。

a78dabd153d2a395.en: Mizutaki" is one of the representative local dishes of Fukuoka Prefecture. It is a one-pot dish in which the chicken is simmered with its bones in a broth, and vegetables of your choice are added depending on the season, served with ponzu (Japanese sauce made of ponzu citrus juice).
a78dabd153d2a395.zh: 「水炊き」是福岡縣代表性的鄉土料理之一。這是一道火鍋料理，將帶骨雞肉放入湯中燉煮，再依季節加入喜好的蔬菜，搭配柑橘醋（以柑橘果汁製成的日式醬汁）食用。

a7a57c18ac2d12c8.en: “Mettajiru” is a hearty pork miso soup with plenty of ingredients; mainly root vegetables like sweet potato, daikon, and carrots. What makes this soup different from a traditional Tonjiru or pork miso soup is that it uses sweet potatoes instead of regular potatoes.
a7a57c18ac2d12c8.zh: 「めった汁」是一道配料豐富、份量十足的豬肉味噌湯，主要使用番薯、白蘿蔔、紅蘿蔔等根莖類蔬菜。這道湯與傳統豚汁（豬肉味噌湯）的不同之處，在於使用番薯而非一般的馬鈴薯。

a7b9fd962a027ca6.en: Kunisaki Hantō Prefectural Natural Park (国東半島県立自然公園, Kunisaki Hantō kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park on the Kunisaki Peninsula in northeast Ōita Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1951, the park spans the municipalities of Bungotakada, Kitsuki, Kunisaki, and Usa. The park encompasses the temples of Fuki-ji and Maki Ōdō as well as Kumano magaibutsu, and includes a marine zone of 41 km2.
a7b9fd962a027ca6.zh: 国東半島県立自然公園位於日本大分縣東北部的國東半島，是一座縣立自然公園。公園設立於1951年，範圍橫跨豐後高田市、杵築市、國東市與宇佐市。園內包括富貴寺、真木大堂以及熊野磨崖佛，並含有41平方公里的海域。

a7d25e6d231a71b4.en: Mount Ryōzen (霊山, Ryōzen) is a mountain on the border of Sōma and the former town of Ryōzen, in Date, Fukushima. It is 825 metres (2,707 ft) in height. Along the hiking trail are the sites of what were Ryōzen Temple and Ryōzen Castle. The mountain is listed as one of the 100 Landscapes of Japan in a contest sponsored by the Tokyo Nichi Nichi Shimbun and Osaka Mainichi Shimbun.
a7d25e6d231a71b4.zh: 靈山是位於福島縣相馬市與伊達市舊靈山町交界的山，高825公尺（2,707英尺）。登山步道沿途有靈山寺與靈山城的遺址。此山曾入選由東京日日新聞與大阪每日新聞主辦評選的日本百景之一。

a7d6224274e7a979.en: Yachū-ji (野中寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the city of Habikino, Osaka Prefecture, Japan, belonging to the Kōyasan Shingon-shū branch of Shingon Buddhism. Its main image is a statue of Yakushi Nyorai. The temple is also popularly known as Naka-no-Taisi (中の太子) as it is located in between the temples of Eifuku-ji and Taiseishōgun-ji, which also claim a connection with Prince Shōtoku.  The temple precincts are designated a National Historic Site
a7d6224274e7a979.zh: 野中寺是位於日本大阪府羽曳野市的佛教寺院，屬於真言宗高野山真言宗派。本尊為藥師如來像。由於位在同樣與聖德太子有淵源的叡福寺與大聖勝軍寺之間，一般又稱為「中之太子」。寺域被指定為國家史蹟。

a7da36de7d02cf5c.en: Flour has become a fundamental part of Oita Prefecture's food culture. Due to unsuitable conditions for rice cultivation, wheat and other grains grew and thrived after the construction of waterways. In the 1950s, rice farming in the area surpassed 40,000 hectares, leading to the spread of local dishes and confections that used flour as a staple food among the common people."Ishigaki-mochi" is a snack that originated from the flour-food culture, and served as a quick bite for farm workers.
a7da36de7d02cf5c.zh: 麵粉已成為大分縣飲食文化的基礎。由於不適合種植稻米，在水道建成後，小麥等穀物得以生長興盛。1950年代，當地稻作面積超過4萬公頃，以麵粉為主食的鄉土料理與點心也因此在庶民間普及。「石垣もち」是源自麵粉飲食文化的點心，曾作為農事工作者簡便的點心。

a7ef4a806c72b181.en: Mount Tsurumi (鶴見岳, Tsurumi-dake) is a 1,374.5 m (4,510 ft) volcano in Beppu, Ōita, Japan.
a7ef4a806c72b181.zh: 鶴見岳是位於日本大分縣別府市的一座火山，標高1,374.5公尺（4,510英尺）。

a81dec6924c6c458.en: Komikado Shrine (小御門神社, Komikado jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Narita, Chiba Prefecture, Japan. Its main festival is held annually on April 29. It was founded in 1882, and enshrines the kami of Kazan'in Morokata. It is one of the Fifteen Shrines of the Kenmu Restoration.
a81dec6924c6c458.zh: 小御門神社是位於日本千葉縣成田市的神社。例大祭每年於4月29日舉行。神社創建於1882年，祭祀花山院師賢。為建武中興十五社之一。

a83663839c854885.en: The Ikawa Dam (井川ダム, Ikawa damu) is a dam on the Ōi River in Aoi-ku, Shizuoka, Shizuoka Prefecture on the island of Honshū, Japan. It was the first hollow core concrete gravity dam to be constructed in Japan, and has a hydroelectric power generating station owned by the Chubu Electric Power Company.
a83663839c854885.zh: 井川ダム是位於日本本州靜岡縣靜岡市葵區、大井川上的水壩，是日本第一座中空重力式混凝土壩，並設有中部電力公司所屬的水力發電廠。

a8626457d52d50b0.en: The Cannabis Museum (Japanese: 大麻博物館, Hepburn: Taima Hakubutsukan) is a private museum located in Nasu, Tochigi Prefecture, Japan. Founded in December 2001 by Japanese hemp rights advocate Junichi Takayasu, it is the sole museum devoted to the history and cultivation of cannabis in Japan.
a8626457d52d50b0.zh: 大麻博物館是位於日本栃木縣那須町的私人博物館，由日本大麻權益倡議者高安淳一於2001年12月創立，是日本唯一以大麻的歷史與栽培為主題的博物館。

a8ae85c82b3ab279.en: Kashima (鹿島) is a small island off the coast of Hōjō, Matsuyama, in Ehime Prefecture, Japan. Aptly named "Deer Island," Kashima is home to a flourishing population of Sika deer. The island is about 1.5 km in circumference and 114 meters high at its peak with a 400-meter long white sand beach. Having inhabited the island for thousands of years, Kashima's deer are a designated "natural treasure of Ehime Prefecture." They are accessible for feeding and photos in an enclosure on the east end of the island, north of the ferry pier.
a8ae85c82b3ab279.zh: 鹿島（鹿島）是位於日本愛媛縣松山市北條外海的小島。島名意為「鹿之島」，島上棲息著數量繁盛的梅花鹿。島周長約1.5公里，最高點海拔114公尺，並有長400公尺的白沙海灘。鹿島的鹿在島上棲息已有數千年，被指定為「愛媛縣天然紀念物」。在島東端、渡輪碼頭北側的圍欄區內，可以餵食及拍照。

a8b01d967642aa60.en: “Fermented sweetfish sushi,” a preserved sweetfish dish, is a fermented food made by stuffing sweetfish full of freshly cooked rice and pickling it in a barrel for about two months. Salt, sweetfish, and rice are pickled with the help of bacteria, and the meal provides a valuable source of protein in the winter and increases the shelf life of the seasonal fish.The first thing that comes to one’s mind upon thinking of sweetfish in Gifu is cormorant fishing, with a history said to be over 1300 years old.
a8b01d967642aa60.zh: 「鮎なれずし」是一道保存用的香魚料理，將剛煮好的米飯塞滿香魚腹中，放入桶中醃漬約兩個月而成的發酵食品。鹽、香魚和米飯藉由細菌的作用醃漬發酵，在冬季提供珍貴的蛋白質來源，也延長了當季魚類的保存期限。提到岐阜的香魚，首先想到的就是據說擁有1300年以上歷史的鸕鶿捕魚。

a8ca05ac0f211a1b.en: It is said that the name "aimaze" comes from the fact that the ingredients are boiled separately, seasoned, and mixed together. Most of them are dressed with slightly sweetened vinegar, but it varies from household to household. Frozen konnyaku is also a characteristic of this dish. Compared to regular konnyaku, konnyaku becomes spongy when frozen, allowing the flavor of the broth and other ingredients to soak into the konnyaku, and the texture of konnyaku is similar to that of meat, unlike the plump texture of raw konnyaku.
a8ca05ac0f211a1b.zh: 據說「あいまぜ」這個名稱，來自將食材分別煮過、調味後再混合在一起。大多以略帶甜味的醋涼拌，但各家作法不同。使用凍蒟蒻也是這道料理的特色。與一般蒟蒻相比，蒟蒻冷凍後會變成海綿狀，讓高湯及其他食材的味道滲入其中，口感也與生蒟蒻的Q彈不同，近似肉類。

a8cf076a87cc342b.en: Yamagata Prefecture maintains a diversity of pickling traditions. "Omizuke" is a pickle made from a type of mustard green called "Yamagata seisai." Along with "seisaizuke," it is one of the representative pickles of Yamagata Prefecture.Seisai greens are said to have been imported from Chongqing, China in 1904, and the seeds were introduced from Nara Prefecture to Yamagata Prefecture in 1908, where they were prototyped at an agricultural experiment station.
a8cf076a87cc342b.zh: 山形縣保有多樣的醃漬傳統。「おみ漬」是用一種名為「山形青菜」的芥菜類蔬菜製成的醃漬物，與「青菜漬」同為山形縣具代表性的醃漬物。據說青菜於1904年從中國重慶引進，1908年種子從奈良縣傳入山形縣，在農業試驗場試作。

a8ddbd6e9efc14b2.en: “Takatsu-no-Torimeshi” is a local dish that originated in the Takatsu area of Yachiyo City, Chiba Prefecture. It is a simple dish where chicken simmered in soy sauce is mixed with rice, and it has been enjoyed in the Takatsu area for a long time. It was particularly consumed during events such as the “Koyasu-kou” (childbirth prayer gathering) where women gathered for safe childbirth prayers and during the “Hassaku” event, a celebration before the full-scale harvest, to wish for a bountiful harvest.
a8ddbd6e9efc14b2.zh: 「高津のとり飯」是源自千葉縣八千代市高津地區的鄉土料理。這是將以醬油燉煮的雞肉拌入米飯的簡單料理，在高津地區長久以來受到喜愛。特別是在婦女聚集祈求安產的「子安講」，以及正式收割前祈求豐收的慶祝活動「八朔」時食用。

a8f05cfb86e60d5d.en: Commonly known as “budai”, igami (Japanese parrotfish) is a typical inshore fish that can be found in the southern regions of Wakayama Prefecture. Igami has a distinctive fishy smell in summer, but from fall through winter, the smell disappears due to the fish’s staple food of seaweed found on rocky shores, and its thick white flesh is plump and succulent. In Tonda in Shirahama Town and around Tanabe City, it is customary to eat boiled whole igami instead of sea bream during the New Year.
a8f05cfb86e60d5d.zh: いがみ（日本鸚哥魚）俗稱「ぶだい」，是和歌山縣南部常見的近海魚。いがみ在夏季有特殊的腥味，但從秋季到冬季，由於以岩岸的海藻為主食，腥味會消失，厚實的白肉豐滿多汁。在白濱町富田及田邊市一帶，習慣在新年時吃整尾煮的いがみ，而不是鯛魚。

a9010e41568a3044.en: "Minudaru" is a thin slice of pork loin coated with black sesame sauce and steamed, also called "kuljin" (=black meat) because of its dark finish. The steaming process removes the fat from the meat, so despite its appearance, the taste is light. Sometimes squid ink is added to make it darker and richer. It has been used as a celebratory dish since ancient times, and has the advantage of not changing its flavor even after it cools down and can be re-steamed.
a9010e41568a3044.zh: ミヌダル是將豬里肌肉薄片裹上黑芝麻醬後蒸製而成，因成品顏色深黑，也稱為「クルジン」（黑肉）。蒸的過程會去除肉的油脂，因此儘管外觀如此，味道卻很清爽。有時會加入墨魚墨汁，使顏色更深、味道更濃郁。自古以來就作為喜慶料理，優點是冷掉後風味也不會改變，而且可以再次蒸熱。

a905641f371aca42.en: "Mossou meshi" is a type of rice that is molded into a certain shape using a wooden mold. Sushi rice or mixed rice is molded into a round or fan-shape. It is said to come from Buddhist vegetarian cuisine where monks prepared a single bowl of rice in a wooden mold so that each person would get an equal portion as that was all they ate for one meal.In the Seisan region and other parts of Kagawa prefecture, Momote festivals were held each year to wish for a bountiful harvest, safety at sea, and to drive away evil spirits.
a905641f371aca42.zh: 「もっそうめし」是用木模將米飯壓成特定形狀的料理，將醋飯或什錦飯壓成圓形或扇形。據說源自佛教的素齋：僧侶一餐只吃一碗飯，因此用木模盛飯，讓每人分得等量。在西讚地區及香川縣其他地方，每年都會舉行百手祭，祈求豐收、海上平安並驅除邪靈。

a91893992e2cd381.en: “Kuromame okowa (black soybean mochi rice)” is mainly eaten in the eastern regions of Toyama Prefecture, and is also known by the names “mitama” and “shiro gowai”. On special days like New Year, sekihan (red rice made using azuki beans) is prepared; “kuromame okowa”, made using black soybeans, is prepared for other festivals and special events. These days, the latter is eaten throughout almost the entire prefecture at funerals and Buddhist memorial services.
a91893992e2cd381.zh: 黒豆おこわ（黑豆糯米飯）主要在富山縣東部地區食用，也稱為「みたま」和「しろごわい」。新年等特別的日子會準備赤飯（用紅豆做的紅飯），其他祭典和特別活動則準備用黑豆做的黒豆おこわ。如今，後者在縣內幾乎所有地區都會於喪禮和佛教法事時食用。

a9483fffc9f59858.en: Nishio Castle (西尾城, Nishio-jō) is a Japanese castle located in the city of Nishio, eastern Aichi Prefecture, Japan. At the end of the Edo period, Nishio Castle was home to the Ogyu Matsudaira, daimyō of Nishio Domain. The castle was also known as Tsuru-jō (鶴城),  Tsuruga-jō (鶴ヶ城), or Saijo-jō (西条城).
a9483fffc9f59858.zh: 西尾城（Nishio-jō）是位於日本愛知縣東部西尾市的日本城郭。江戶時代末期，西尾城為西尾藩藩主大給松平氏的居城。此城又稱鶴城、鶴ヶ城或西條城。

a98b2e1cbbae4652.en: Sapporo Concert Hall Kitara (札幌コンサートホールKitara), is a municipal musical venue located in Nakajima Park, Sapporo, established in 1997, the building is owned by Sapporo City, The vineyard style  music hall, known for having a huge organ built by Alfred Kern & Fils Manufacture D'Orgues in the main music hall. When Simon Rattle visited with the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra in 1998, he described the hall as "the best modern concert hall in the world".
a98b2e1cbbae4652.zh: 札幌コンサートホールKitara是位於札幌中島公園內的市立音樂場館，1997年啟用，建築為札幌市所有。這座葡萄園式音樂廳以主廳內由Alfred Kern & Fils Manufacture D'Orgues建造的大型管風琴聞名。1998年Simon Rattle率伯明罕市立交響樂團來訪時，形容此廳為「世界上最好的現代音樂廳」。

a9b5733ce6d0e6fb.en: Alpine Skiing at the 1998 Winter Olympics consisted of ten alpine skiing events. The speed events were held at Hakuba and the technical events at Shiga Kogen. There were a number of race postponements due to weather; the events began on 10 February and ended on 21 February.
a9b5733ce6d0e6fb.zh: 1998年冬季奧運的高山滑雪共有十個項目。速度項目在白馬舉行，技術項目在志賀高原舉行。賽事因天候因素多次延期；比賽自2月10日開始，2月21日結束。

a9b5ee7884592322.en: A wide variety of vegetables have been cultivated in Fukushima Prefecture for many years. While some vegetables are grown nationwide, there are also many brand name vegetables that are unique to the prefecture, and these continue to be passed down as traditional vegetables. The “Aizu Akasuji Daikon Radish” is one such example and is said to have gotten its name from the red markings on its skin. It’s characterized by its thick flesh that doesn’t fall apart even when cooked thoroughly.
a9b5ee7884592322.zh: 福島縣長年來栽種多種蔬菜。有些蔬菜全國各地都有種植，但也有許多縣內獨有的品牌蔬菜，至今仍作為傳統蔬菜傳承下來。「會津赤筋大根」就是其中一例，據說因外皮上的紅色紋路而得名。其特徵是肉質厚實，即使充分燉煮也不易煮散。

a9bf00ce8e789678.en: Ika-ninjin is a side dish made by finely slicing surumeika and carrots and marinating them in a sweet and spicy sauce made of soy sauce, coarse soybean paste, and mirin (sweet sake). It has been eaten for more than 100 years, and the seasoning varies from household to household. It has been eaten for over 100 years, and each family has its own unique flavor.
a9bf00ce8e789678.zh: いかにんじん是將魷魚乾和紅蘿蔔切成細絲，再以醬油、粗粒黃豆醬和味醂調成的甜辣醬汁醃漬而成的配菜。這道菜已有100年以上的食用歷史，調味因家庭而異。每個家庭都有自己獨特的風味。

a9dcf25a4599ac6f.en: Minami-Alps Akaishi Onsen Shirakaba-so (Minnami-arupusu Akaishi-onsen Shirakaba-so (南アルプス赤石温泉白樺荘)) is the site of a hot spring, located in Shizuoka City in Shizuoka Prefecture.
a9dcf25a4599ac6f.zh: 南アルプス赤石温泉白樺荘是一處溫泉，位於靜岡縣靜岡市。

a9e1f87749237ebf.en: Higashimatsuyama City, where many restaurants around Higashimatsuyama Station display their yakitori (grilled chicken) brands, is called one of the seven largest "yakitori" cities in Japan, along with Bibai City and Muroran City in Hokkaido, Fukushima City in Fukushima Prefecture, Imabari City in Ehime Prefecture, Nagato City in Yamaguchi Prefecture, and Kurume City in Fukuoka Prefecture.
a9e1f87749237ebf.zh: 東松山市的東松山車站周邊有許多餐廳打出各自的やきとり（烤雞肉串）招牌，與北海道美唄市、室蘭市、福島縣福島市、愛媛縣今治市、山口縣長門市、福岡縣久留米市並稱日本七大「烤雞肉串」城市。

a9f428ee1224cfc9.en: “Tsutokko” is steamed glutinous rice wrapped in horse chestnut leaves (Tochi leaves), and tied with straw strings. That was originally a portable meal carried by samurai to the battlefield. During that time, samurai brought any packaged grains with them, steaming them before consumption. In the early Showa period, it was eaten as a lunch during farm work and served as a snack for children. It is also a festive dish for the May festival, when fresh green Tochi leaves are available.
a9f428ee1224cfc9.zh: 「つとっこ」是用栃葉（日本七葉樹葉）包裹糯米，以稻草繩綁起後蒸熟的食物。原本是武士帶上戰場的攜帶糧食，當時武士攜帶包好的穀物，在食用前蒸熟。昭和初期，它被當作農作時的午餐和孩子的點心。也是5月節慶的節日料理，此時正好能取得新鮮的綠色栃葉。

a9fb95f18d2fd2f0.en: Miyazu Castle (宮津城, Miyazu-jō) is a flatland-style Japanese castle located in  Miyazu, northern Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. At the end of the Edo period, Miyazu Castle was home to a branch of the Honjō-Matsudaira, daimyō of Miyazu Domain.
a9fb95f18d2fd2f0.zh: 宮津城是位於日本京都府北部宮津市的平城。江戶時代末期，宮津城是宮津藩大名本庄松平氏一支的居城。

aa0777bde1526254.en: The Lee Ufan Museum (李禹煥美術館) is an art museum on Naoshima, an island of Japan, dedicated to the work of Korean artist Lee Ufan. The first-ever museum in the world of such a kind, it was designed as a collaboration between Japanese architect Tadao Ando and Lee himself.
aa0777bde1526254.zh: 李禹煥美術館是位於日本直島上的美術館，專門展示韓國藝術家李禹煥的作品。這是全世界第一座此類美術館，由日本建築師安藤忠雄與李禹煥本人共同設計。

aa22f6387a76afd4.en: The Sakuya Konohana Kan (咲くやこの花館) is a botanical garden set within one of the world's largest greenhouses, located in Tsurumi Ryokuchi park at 2-163 Ryokuchi Koen, Tsurumi-ku, Osaka, Japan. It is open daily except Mondays; an admission fee is charged.
aa22f6387a76afd4.zh: 咲くやこの花館是設於世界最大溫室之一內的植物園，位於日本大阪市鶴見區緑地公園2-163的鶴見綠地公園內。除週一外每日開放，需付費入館。

aa3deaa9a486f606.en: "Hachihai-jiru" is a dish consisting of tofu, dried shiitake mushrooms, and green onions in a soy sauce-flavored dashi (Japanese soup stock), thickened with katakuriko (potato starch). It has long been eaten as a vegetarian dish at weddings, funerals, and Buddhist memorial services. The origin of the name is said to come from the fact that one block of tofu can make eight bowls of soup, or from the fact that it is so tasty that one can eat eight more bowls.Tofu is the main ingredient in this simple dish.
aa3deaa9a486f606.zh: 「八杯汁」是在醬油調味的高湯中加入豆腐、乾香菇與蔥，再以片栗粉勾芡的料理。長久以來在婚禮、喪禮及佛教法事中作為素食料理食用。名稱由來據說是一塊豆腐可做八碗湯，或是好吃到能再吃八碗。豆腐是這道簡樸料理的主要食材。

aa58d06c60c53b8f.en: Hottai Falls (法体の滝, Hottai-no-taki) is a waterfall in the city of Yurihonjō, Akita Prefecture, Japan, on the Akasawa River, a tributary of the Koyoshi River system in the foothills of Mount Chōkai. It is one of "Japan’s Top 100 Waterfalls", in a listing published by the Japanese Ministry of the Environment in 1990.
aa58d06c60c53b8f.zh: 法体の滝是位於日本秋田縣由利本莊市的瀑布，位在鳥海山山麓子吉川水系支流赤澤川上。此瀑布名列日本環境省於1990年公布的「日本瀑布百選」。

aa7b5c369a699587.en: The Kawaguchi Green Center (川口市立グリーンセンター, Kawaguchi Shiritsu Gurīnsentā), sometimes also called the Botanical Garden of Kawaguchi-City, is a city park and botanical garden located at Araijuku 700, Kawaguchi, Saitama, Japan.  Admission is 300 yen for adults and 100 yen for children.
aa7b5c369a699587.zh: 川口市立グリーンセンター有時也稱為川口市植物園，是位於日本埼玉縣川口市新井宿700的市立公園兼植物園。門票成人300日圓，兒童100日圓。

aa7f3caf664425d7.en: The Ryozen Museum of History (幕末維新ミュージアム 霊山歴史館, Bakumatsu Ishin Myūjiamu: Ryōzen Rekishikan) is a history museum located in Kyoto, Japan. It specializes in the history of the Bakumatsu period and the Meiji Restoration.
aa7f3caf664425d7.zh: 靈山歷史館（幕末維新ミュージアム 霊山歴史館）是位於日本京都的歷史博物館，專門介紹幕末與明治維新時期的歷史。

aa99f0c13c35eab1.en: Ikō-ji (医光寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Somebachō neighborhood of the city of Masuda, Shimane Prefecture, Japan. The temple belongs to the Tōfuku-ji branch of the Rinzai school. The temple's full name is Ryūzō-san Ikō-ji (滝蔵山 医光寺).
aa99f0c13c35eab1.zh: 醫光寺是位於日本島根縣益田市染羽町的佛教寺院，屬於臨濟宗東福寺派。寺院全名為瀧藏山醫光寺。

aaaa48d27cbeb4f4.en: "Tai Somen" is a dish where a sea bream is simmered whole and served on large plate with boiled somen noodles. The cooking liquid from the sea bream is used as a dipping sauce or poured over the dish. This dish is particularly popular along the coast of the Seto Inland Sea, and is served with shredded omelet, sliced shiitake mushrooms and herbal condiments in the Nanyo region.
aaaa48d27cbeb4f4.zh: 鯛そうめん是將整條鯛魚燉煮後，與煮好的素麵一起盛在大盤上的料理。燉煮鯛魚的湯汁可當沾醬，或淋在料理上。這道料理在瀨戶內海沿岸特別受歡迎，在南予地區會搭配蛋絲、香菇片和香草類佐料。

aaf0d96aeb47a423.en: The Tokushima Arts Foundation for Culture (徳島県郷土文化会館) is a multi-purpose cultural facility found in the Aiba-cho district in Tokushima City, Tokushima Prefecture. It sits on the grounds of the Aibahama Park and runs alongside the Shinmachi River.
aaf0d96aeb47a423.zh: 徳島県郷土文化会館是位於德島縣德島市藍場町地區的多功能文化設施。會館位於藍場濱公園園區內，沿新町川而建。

aaf55c593008963a.en: Lake Kizaki (木崎湖, Kizaki-ko) is a lake, situated near Ōmachi, Nagano, Japan, and located at the foot of the northern Japanese Alps mountain range. Mesotrophic and subalpine in nature, numerous lakeside attractions surround the lake, with the locale being a popular lakeside resort. Kizaki is also one of the "Nishina Three Lakes", which include Lake Aoki and Lake Nakatsuna.
aaf55c593008963a.zh: 木崎湖是位於日本長野縣大町市附近的湖泊，坐落於北阿爾卑斯山脈山腳。此湖屬中營養湖，位處亞高山帶，湖畔周圍有許多觀光設施，是熱門的湖畔度假地。木崎湖也是「仁科三湖」之一，另外兩湖為青木湖與中綱湖。

ab0d64fe140a6b0d.en: Kanehiranari-en (金平成園), also known as Sawanari-en (澤成園) is a Japanese landscape garden and nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty in the city of Kuroishi, Aomori Prefecture, Japan.
ab0d64fe140a6b0d.zh: 金平成園又稱澤成園，是位於日本青森縣黑石市的日本庭園，為國家指定名勝。

ab0ed00b2e7dced3.en: The name "nishime" comes from the way it is cooked, which is to simmer it slowly so that no liquid remains. Although it is now a side dish, it was originally an essential dish for celebrations, weddings, and funerals. It is laid on the third layer of the New Year's osechi (New Year's Day meal), and is served at the kagura dedication held throughout the night in Takachiho Town.In Takachiho Town, it is served as a side dish during the nightly Kagura (Shinto music and dancing) ceremonies.In addition, each region has its own unique ingredients.
ab0ed00b2e7dced3.zh: 「煮しめ」之名來自其烹調方式，也就是慢火燉煮至湯汁收乾。現在雖是家常配菜，原本卻是喜慶、婚禮和喪禮不可或缺的料理。它放在新年御節料理（元旦的料理）的第三層，也會在高千穗町通宵舉行的神樂奉納中端出。在高千穗町，它是夜間神樂（神道音樂與舞蹈）儀式中的配菜。此外，各地區也有各自獨特的食材。

ab2aa5ddaf2aaec5.en: In 1983, the 38th National Athletic Meet “Akagi National Athletic Meet” was held in Gunma Prefecture. This was a memorable event for Gunma, as the prefecture declared itself “Sports Prefecture Gunma" and it was the first time that “Gunma-chan” appeared as the mascot. Joshu Kimpira, or stir-fried carrot and burdock root, was invented especially for the event as a new local dish featuring Gunma's famous local products such as pork, shiitake mushrooms, konjac, and so on.
ab2aa5ddaf2aaec5.zh: 1983年，第38屆國民體育大會「赤城國體」在群馬縣舉行。這是群馬值得紀念的一場盛事，縣政府在此時宣布為「運動縣群馬」，「群馬醬」也首次以吉祥物身分登場。上州きんぴら（炒紅蘿蔔與牛蒡）是專為這項活動而設計的新鄉土料理，使用豬肉、香菇、蒟蒻等群馬知名的在地物產。

ab3a8eedaad4a08b.en: "Izumiya" is a local dish from the Niihama region in Ehime Prefecture. It is a type of sushi made using seasoned soy pulp (known as okara or u-no-hana) instead of vinegared rice. The origins of this dish trace back to the Edo period in 1691, when the Besshi Copper Mine was established in the region by the Sumitomo family, who played a significant role in the region's development. While the Sumitomo family ate sushi made with rice, rice was not easily accessible to the common people.
ab3a8eedaad4a08b.zh: いずみや是愛媛縣新居濱地區的鄉土料理，以調味過的豆渣（稱為おから或卯の花）取代醋飯製成的壽司。這道料理的起源可追溯至江戶時代的1691年，當時對地區發展有重大貢獻的住友家在此地開設別子銅山。住友家吃的是用米做的壽司，但一般百姓不容易取得米。

ab4aca49f256298c.en: “Rice porridge,” a dish said to have originated from the Nara region, has taken root as a local delicacy in other regions outside the Yamaguchi Prefecture. At the beginning of the 17th century in Yamaguchi, Yoshikawa, lord of the Iwakuni Domain, encouraged the practice of making rice porridge to save rice, and it supposedly spread to various parts of the prefecture, including Yanai City and Suooshima Town. The rice porridge of Yamaguchi Prefecture is characterized by boiling roasted coarse tea in a tea bag in a Kanko, a special iron kettle.
ab4aca49f256298c.zh: 據說起源於奈良地區的「粥」，在山口縣以外的其他地區也已扎根成為鄉土料理。在山口，17世紀初岩國藩主吉川為了節省米糧，鼓勵煮粥，據說因此傳到柳井市、周防大島町等縣內各地。山口縣的粥的特色是將焙炒過的粗茶裝入茶包，放進名為「かんこ」的專用鐵壺中熬煮。

ab5514de0bb48d8c.en: Nakagawa-machi Batō Hiroshige Museum of Art (那珂川町馬頭広重美術館, Nakagawa-machi Batō Hiroshige Bijutsukan) opened in the Batō area of Nakagawa, Tochigi Prefecture, Japan, in 2000. In a prize-winning building designed by Kuma Kengo, the museum's collection includes nikuhitsu-ga by Hiroshige, woodblock prints of the Utagawa school, Meiji-period prints by Kobayashi Kiyochika, and works by Kawamura Kiyoo.
ab5514de0bb48d8c.zh: 那珂川町馬頭廣重美術館於2000年在日本栃木縣那珂川町馬頭地區開館。建築由隈研吾設計並曾獲獎，館藏包括廣重的肉筆畫、歌川派木版畫、小林清親的明治時期版畫，以及川村清雄的作品。

ab6d9c9ca0a985cb.en: Ikime-jinja (生目神社) is a Shinto shrine located in Miyazaki, Miyazaki prefecture, Japan. It is dedicated to Emperor Ōjin and Taira no Kagekiyo.
ab6d9c9ca0a985cb.zh: 生目神社是位於日本宮崎縣宮崎市的神社，祭祀應神天皇與平景清。

ab8f413861d8c0d0.en: Nukabira Dam (Japanese: 糠平ダム) is a gravity dam located in Hokkaido Prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for power production. The catchment area of the dam is 387.8 km2. The dam impounds about 822  ha of land when full and can store 193900 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1953 and completed in 1956.
ab8f413861d8c0d0.zh: 糠平ダム是位於日本北海道的重力式水壩，用於發電。集水面積387.8平方公里，滿水時淹沒面積約822公頃，蓄水量1億9,390萬立方公尺。水壩於1953年動工，1956年完工。

abb29b6015d4ab7e.en: The Ichinomiya River (一宮川, Ichinomiyagawa) is a river in Chiba Prefecture, Japan. It is 37.3 kilometers (23.2 mi) in length and has a drainage area of 222 square kilometers (86 sq mi). Under the Rivers Act of 1906 the Ichinomiya is designated as a Class 2 River. The river basin of the Ichinomiya was a social, cultural, and economic center of Kazusa Province in pre-modern Japan. Although very shallow, the river was used to transport sardines from Kujukuri Beach to Tokyo Bay until the beginning of the Meiji period.
abb29b6015d4ab7e.zh: 一宮川是日本千葉縣的河川，全長37.3公里（23.2英里），流域面積222平方公里（86平方英里）。依據1906年的《河川法》，一宮川被指定為二級河川。在近代以前，一宮川流域是上總國的社會、文化與經濟中心。此河雖然水淺，但直到明治時代初期，仍被用於將沙丁魚從九十九里濱運往東京灣。

abc2a0e3fece6fd3.en: Fukuzen-ji (福禅寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Tomo-machi neighborhood of the city of Fukuyama, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan.  The temple's full name is Kaigan-zan Senjū-in Fukuzen-ji (海岸山 千手院 福禅寺), and it belongs Daikaku-ji branch of the Shingon-shu of Japanese Buddhism.
abc2a0e3fece6fd3.zh: 福禪寺（福禅寺）是位於日本廣島縣福山市鞆町地區的佛教寺院。全名為海岸山千手院福禪寺（海岸山 千手院 福禅寺），屬於日本佛教真言宗大覺寺派。

abd4b39687a15755.en: The Bandō POW camp (板東俘虜収容所, Bandō Furyoshūyōsho) was a prisoner-of-war camp during World War I in the western suburbs of what is now Naruto, Tokushima Prefecture, on the island of Shikoku, Japan. From April 1917 until January 1920, just under a thousand of the 3,900 soldiers of the Imperial German Army, Imperial German Navy, German Marine Corps and Austro-Hungarian Navy who had been captured at the Siege of Tsingtao in November 1914 were imprisoned at the camp.
abd4b39687a15755.zh: 板東俘虜收容所（板東俘虜収容所）是第一次世界大戰期間的戰俘營，位於日本四國島今德島縣鳴門市的西郊。1914年11月青島圍城戰中被俘的德意志帝國陸軍、德意志帝國海軍、德國海軍陸戰隊及奧匈帝國海軍士兵共3,900人，其中將近一千人自1917年4月至1920年1月被關押於此。

abe454fecd9187e7.en: Ibaraki Prefecture's lotus root ranks first in Japan in terms of both the volume of its shipments and the area where it is planted, boasting a share of over 50% of the domestic market. Areas around Kasumigaura are blessed with abundant water and fertile wetlands, so the cultivation of lotus root is thriving. The period in which lotus root is harvested in Kasumigaura is from July to March.
abe454fecd9187e7.zh: 茨城縣的蓮藕在出貨量與種植面積上皆為日本第一，國內市占率超過50%。霞浦周邊水源豐沛、濕地肥沃，蓮藕栽培興盛。霞浦的蓮藕採收期為7月至3月。

abee12164b18c4e4.en: Hōon-ji (報恩寺) is a Sōtō Zen Buddhist temple located in the city of Morioka, Iwate Prefecture, Japan. Its main image is a statue of Shaka Nyōrai, although the temple is more famous for its statues of the 500 Rakan.
abee12164b18c4e4.zh: 報恩寺是位於日本岩手縣盛岡市的曹洞宗佛寺。本尊為釋迦如來像，不過該寺更以五百羅漢像聞名。

ac022a5915e94dd4.en: Senyū-ji  (Japanese: 仙遊寺) is a temple belonging to the Koyasan Shingon sect, located in Bessho, Tamagawa-cho, Imabari City, Ehime Prefecture. Its formal mountain name is Sareizan, and its institutional name is Senkō-in. The principal deity is the Thousand-armed Kannon Bodhisattva. It serves as Temple No. 58 of the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage.
ac022a5915e94dd4.zh: 仙遊寺（日語：仙遊寺）是位於愛媛縣今治市玉川町別所的高野山真言宗寺院。山號為作禮山，院號為千光院。本尊為千手觀音菩薩。為四國八十八所靈場第58號札所。

ac0ca491358fa390.en: Towa Pharmaceutical Ractab Dome (東和薬品RACTABドーム, Tōwa Yakuhin Ractab Dōmu) is an indoor sporting arena located in Kadoma city in the Osaka Prefecture of Japan.
ac0ca491358fa390.zh: 東和藥品RACTAB巨蛋（なみはやドーム）是位於日本大阪府門真市的室內體育館。

ac15ae9c57cdd55b.en: Kegon-ji (華厳寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Tanigumi Tokuzumi neighborhood of the town of Ibigawa, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Tendai sect of Japanese Buddhism and its honzon is a hibutsu image of  Jūichimen Kannon. The temple's full name is Tanigumi-san Kegon-ji (谷汲山 華厳寺).The temple is the 33rd and final stop on the Saigoku Kannon Pilgrimage route, and is the only temple on the route outside of the Kansai region.
ac15ae9c57cdd55b.zh: 華嚴寺（華厳寺）是位於日本岐阜縣揖斐川町谷汲德積地區的佛教寺院，屬日本佛教天台宗，本尊為祕佛十一面觀音。寺院全名為谷汲山華嚴寺（谷汲山 華厳寺）。本寺是西國三十三所觀音巡禮路線的第33番，也是最後一站，並且是該路線上唯一位於關西地區以外的寺院。

ac29f0493b886102.en: Pork is cooked without wasting any part of it, and for this bone-in meat is frequently used. Clear soup with bone-in ribs that have been simmered to softness is called “soki soup ”(sokijiru), as well as “soki bone soup”. “Soki soba”, in which Okinawan soba is added to stewed pork ribs, is popular outside the prefecture, but within the prefecture, sokijiru is more popular. Pork ribs on the bone have a good balance of fat and meat, and also smells good, so cooking it as a simple soup allows you to directly enjoy the flavor.
ac29f0493b886102.zh: 豬肉的烹調不浪費任何部位，因此常使用帶骨肉。將帶骨排骨燉煮至軟爛的清湯稱為ソーキ汁，也稱為「ソーキ骨湯」。在燉豬排骨中加入沖繩麵的「ソーキそば」在縣外很受歡迎，但在縣內則是ソーキ汁更普遍。帶骨豬排骨的肥肉與瘦肉比例均衡，香氣也好，因此做成簡單的湯，就能直接品嘗它的風味。

ac300d1aad05f6c9.en: Taketa City, located in the southwestern part of Oita Prefecture, is an area rich in nature surrounded by the Kuju Mountain Range, the Aso Gairin Mountains, and the foothills of Mount Sobo. The city is situated along the Onogawa River, a first-class river, and boasts a group of springs said to produce tens of thousands of tons of water per day.“Aimaze” is an indispensable part of meals in the Kuju district of Taketa City. “Aimaze” is stir-fried vegetables mixed with grated tofu.
ac300d1aad05f6c9.zh: 竹田市位於大分縣西南部，被九重山脈、阿蘇外輪山和祖母山麓環繞，自然資源豐富。市區沿一級河川大野川分布，擁有據說每日湧出數萬噸水量的泉水群。「あいまぜ」是竹田市久住地區餐桌上不可或缺的一道菜，是將炒過的蔬菜與搗碎的豆腐拌在一起的料理。

ac4be881f3b91797.en: “Oname” is a fermented food made from barley koji and soybeans. It is useful as a preserved food that lasts for more than half a year in the refrigerator, and has been eaten on the daily table as a dish that goes well with rice. It is eaten mainly in the Chichibu area, but also in the northern and north-eastern parts of the Musashino Plateau and the Iruma Plateau. “Oname-Koji” is made by steaming soaked barley and roasted soybeans and mixing them with koji bacteria.
ac4be881f3b91797.zh: 「おなめ」是以大麥麴和黃豆製成的發酵食品，冷藏可保存半年以上，是實用的保存食，也作為配飯的小菜出現在日常餐桌上。主要在秩父地區食用，武藏野台地與入間台地的北部及東北部也有。「おなめ麴」的做法是將浸泡過的大麥蒸熟，與炒過的黃豆混合後加入麴菌。

ac6b7319720e5dbb.en: Yushima is an island situated between Ōyano-jima in the Amakusa Islands and the Shimabara Peninsula.. It is located in Oyano-machi, Kamiamakusa City, Kumamoto Prefecture. This article also covers Yushima Village (Yushima-mura), Amakusa District, which was formerly situated within this same area.
ac6b7319720e5dbb.zh: 湯島是位於天草諸島的大矢野島與島原半島之間的島嶼，屬於熊本縣上天草市大矢野町。本條目也涵蓋過去位於同一地區的天草郡湯島村。

ac969e3a7f275505.en: In the area around Nihonmatsu City, where there are many fields and fresh vegetables are abundant, a local cuisine using vegetables has taken root. "Sagohachi Zuke" is a pickle in which vegetables are pickled in "San Go Hachi" (=three, five, eight), a mixture of rice, Rice koji(=malted rice), and salt.
ac969e3a7f275505.zh: 二本松市一帶農田眾多，新鮮蔬菜豐富，以蔬菜為材料的鄉土料理在此扎根。「三五八漬け」是將蔬菜醃漬在「三五八」（即三、五、八）中的醃菜，「三五八」是米、米麴和鹽的混合物。

ac9e97f202f3c805.en: Yugao (evening glories) are a summer delicacy in the Fuji Hokuroku region, and "yugao no miso soup" is frequently served at the dinner table. It is generally called "yugao", but in Yamanakako Village it is often called "yugo". The yugao cultivated in this area is a different plant from the morning glory, and is not the "maru-yugao" used to make kanpyo, but the "naga-yugao" with a long, gourd-like shape. Yugao has long been used as a diuretic in the diet of people suffering from kidney disease.
ac9e97f202f3c805.zh: 夕顏是富士北麓地區的夏季美味，「夕顏のみそ汁」經常出現在餐桌上。一般稱為「夕顏」，但在山中湖村多稱為「ゆうご」。當地栽培的夕顏與牽牛花是不同的植物，也不是用來製作干瓢的「丸夕顏」，而是外形細長如葫蘆的「長夕顏」。夕顏自古便作為利尿食材，用於腎臟病患者的飲食中。

aca801c4f1ff948a.en: Yasu Falls (安の滝, Yasu-no-taki) is a waterfall in the Ani district of Kitaakika, Akita Prefecture, Japan, on the Yoneshiro River. It was named one of Japan's Top 100 Waterfalls by the Japanese Ministry of the Environment in 1990.
aca801c4f1ff948a.zh: 安の滝是位於日本秋田縣北秋田市阿仁地區米代川流域的瀑布，1990年獲日本環境省選為日本瀑布百選之一。

aca9e04a03a2ea0c.en: Mie Castle (三重城, Mie jō; Okinawan: Mii gushiku) is a Ryūkyūan gusuku in Naha, Okinawa, Japan. It is located on the northern mouth of the Kokuba River in Naha Port.
aca9e04a03a2ea0c.zh: 三重城（三重城，Mie jō；沖繩語：Mii gushiku）是位於日本沖繩縣那霸市的琉球御城（グスク），位於那霸港國場川河口北側。

acadf809db027930.en: Ōbai-in (黄梅院) is an autonomous sub-temple of Daitoku-ji, Kyoto, Japan, the headquarters of the Daitoku-ji school of the Rinzai sect of Zen Buddhism.  The Hondō (1586) and Kuri (1589) have been designated Important Cultural Properties. Momoyama period monochrome fusuma paintings of Seven hermits in a bamboo grove (16 panels), Landscape with figures (14 panels), and Geese (14 panels), by Unkoku Tōgan (1588), have also been designated Important Cultural Properties.
acadf809db027930.zh: 黃梅院是日本京都大德寺的獨立塔頭寺院。大德寺為臨濟宗大德寺派的大本山。本堂（1586年）與庫裏（1589年）已被指定為重要文化財。雲谷等顏所繪（1588年）的桃山時代水墨襖繪〈竹林七賢圖〉（16面）、〈山水人物圖〉（14面）與〈雁圖〉（14面）亦被指定為重要文化財。

acb9c544f16ab606.en: The Izu Peninsula in Shizuoka Prefecture is a production area for Kinmedai (splendid alfonsino), and Shimoda Port is Japan's leading fishing port for the catch of Kinmedai. There are three types of Kinmedai caught in Izu: Jikinmedai (local Kinmedai, also known as Inatori Kinmedai or Himodori Kinmedai), Shimakinmedai (Island Kinmedai), and Okikinmedai (Offshore Kinmedai). Among them, Jikinmedai is considered the finest Kinmedai, known for its excellent richness and flavor.
acb9c544f16ab606.zh: 靜岡縣伊豆半島是金目鯛的產地，下田港是日本金目鯛漁獲量首屈一指的漁港。伊豆捕獲的金目鯛有三種：地金目鯛（當地金目鯛，又稱稻取金目鯛或日歸金目鯛）、島金目鯛與沖金目鯛。其中地金目鯛被視為最高級的金目鯛，以濃郁的油脂與風味著稱。

acbd735474a046ba.en: Bungo Kokubun-ji (豊後国分寺) is a Buddhist temple in the Kokubu neighborhood of the city of Ōita, Ōita Prefecture Japan. It belongs to the Tendai sect, and its honzon is a statue of  Yakushi Nyōrai.  It claims to be the successor of the provincial temple established by Emperor Shōmu during the Nara period (710 – 794). Its honzon is a statue of  Yakushi Nyōrai.  The foundation stones and remaining traces of the Nara-period temple were designated as a National Historic Site in 1933.
acbd735474a046ba.zh: 豊後国分寺是位於日本大分縣大分市國分地區的佛教寺院，屬天台宗，本尊為藥師如來像。該寺自稱是奈良時代（710－794年）聖武天皇所設國分寺的後繼寺院。其本尊為藥師如來像。奈良時代寺院的礎石與殘存遺跡於1933年被指定為國家史跡。

acc73d890f3c6ec0.en: The Hizen Provincial Capital site (肥前国庁跡, Hizen Kokuchō ato) is an archaeological site consisting of the ruins of the Nara period to early Heian period Provincial Capital of Hizen Province, located in the Yamato neighborhood of the city of Saga, San'yō region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1989.
acc73d890f3c6ec0.zh: 肥前國廳跡是考古遺址，為奈良時代至平安時代初期肥前國國府的遺跡，位於日本山陽地區佐賀市大和地區。1989年指定為日本國家史跡。

accf6f575f0b38f7.en: Kinkasan (金華山, Kinkasan; or Kinkazan) is a small island in Miyagi Prefecture in north-eastern Japan. It lies in the Pacific Ocean approximately one kilometer off the Oshika Peninsula.
accf6f575f0b38f7.zh: 金華山（又讀Kinkazan）是位於日本東北部宮城縣的小島，位在太平洋上，距牡鹿半島約一公里。

acfb592242550270.en: “Jubako-iri Botamochi” is not made by rolling each botamochi individually. Instead, it consists of layers of glutinous rice and sweet bean paste arranged in a tiered box, and people can take as much as they like. This tradition originated from the custom of making and distributing “Jubako-iri Botamochi” as a celebration three days after the birth of the first child.
acfb592242550270.zh: 「重箱入りぼたもち」並非將牡丹餅一個個搓圓製作，而是在多層餐盒中層層鋪上糯米與紅豆餡，大家可以依喜好取用。這項傳統源自頭胎孩子出生三天後，製作「重箱入りぼたもち」分送慶祝的習俗。

ad17efe3890cc58a.en: Lake Utonai (ウトナイ湖, Utonai-ko) is a shallow freshwater lake in Tomakomai, Iburi Subprefecture, Hokkaidō, Japan. It is within the Lake Utonai Sanctuary, created in 1981 as the first bird sanctuary designated in Japan. It later became the fourth Ramsar site in Japan in 1989.
ad17efe3890cc58a.zh: ウトナイ湖是位於日本北海道膽振綜合振興局苫小牧市的淺水淡水湖。湖泊位於1981年設立的ウトナイ湖鳥類保護區內，該保護區是日本第一個指定的鳥類保護區。1989年成為日本第四處拉姆薩濕地。

ad216585c33dbe17.en: The Matsushiro Underground Imperial Headquarters (松代大本営, Matsushiro Daihon'ei; "Matsushiro Imperial Headquarters Site") was a large underground bunker complex built during the Second World War in the town of Matsushiro, which is now a suburb of Nagano, Japan.
ad216585c33dbe17.zh: 松代大本營（「松代大本營遺址」）是第二次世界大戰期間在松代町興建的大型地下碉堡群，松代町現為日本長野市的郊區。

ad39763250b3fd23.en: "Sanbai-miso" is a rice cake dish made from a combination of glutinous rice flour, short-grain rice flour, and azuki beans. It is said that the name came from the fact that it was made by adding one cup of each three ingredients. Although miso is not used as an ingredient, it is said that this is because the combination of the ingredients looked like miso, and also because miso used to be used in the past.
ad39763250b3fd23.zh: 「三杯みそ」是以糯米粉、粳米粉與紅豆組合製成的年糕料理。據說名稱來自三種材料各加入一杯製作。雖然材料中沒有使用味噌，但據說是因為材料混合後看起來像味噌，也因為過去曾使用味噌。

ad42e0e0492c4c57.en: Miyagi Prefecture is home to a variety of rivers, large and small, including the Kitakami, Naruse, and Abukuma Rivers, where salmon return every autumn to spawn. The prefecture has a history of protecting and nurturing salmon, including an artificial hatching and stocking program that began more than 100 years ago. Today, there are 20 hatcheries in Miyagi Prefecture, and efforts are being made to propagate and conserve the resource.The most famous local dish using salmon in Miyagi is "harako-meshi" (harako rice).
ad42e0e0492c4c57.zh: 宮城縣有北上川、鳴瀨川、阿武隈川等大大小小的河川，每年秋天鮭魚都會洄游至此產卵。該縣有保護、培育鮭魚的歷史，包括100多年前開始的人工孵化放流事業。目前宮城縣有20座孵化場，致力於資源的繁殖與保育。宮城最有名的鮭魚鄉土料理是「はらこ飯」。

ad4316e1a078fc47.en: Jōruri-ji (Japanese: 浄瑠璃寺) is a temple belonging to the Buzan branch of the Shingon school of Buddhism, located in Jōruri-chō, Matsuyama City, Ehime Prefecture. Its formal mountain name is Iōzan, and its institutional name is Yōju-in. Its principal deity is Yakushi Nyorai (the Medicine Buddha). It serves as the 46th temple on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage. The temple grounds are adorned with a vibrant array of seasonal blossoms, including Taiwan cherry blossoms, lotuses, peonies, hydrangeas, and acanthus flowers.
ad4316e1a078fc47.zh: 淨瑠璃寺是位於愛媛縣松山市淨瑠璃町的真言宗豐山派寺院。山號為醫王山，院號為養珠院。本尊為藥師如來。為四國八十八所靈場第46號札所。寺域內有各季節的花卉，包括台灣櫻花、蓮花、牡丹、繡球花及老鼠簕。

ad43d6b53f85212e.en: "Iragimun" is made with papayas that are still green and not ripe, and this type is referred to as "vegetable papaya." Meat, tofu, and kombu (=kelp) are simmered with papaya and seasoned with miso. In the past, people made miso at home and homemade miso was used to make this dish. When papayas are boiled, its texture becomes similar to daikon radish. Papayas before they ripen are treated like vegetables in Okinawa and are used to make a variety of dishes such as stir-fries, salads, meat or fish dishes, and "chanpuru" made with tofu.
