ad43d6b53f85212e.zh: イラギムン使用尚未成熟的青木瓜製作，這種木瓜被稱為「蔬菜木瓜」。將肉、豆腐、昆布與木瓜一起燉煮，再以味噌調味。過去人們會在家自製味噌，並用自製味噌來做這道料理。木瓜煮過後，口感會變得類似白蘿蔔。在沖繩，未成熟的木瓜被當作蔬菜，用來製作熱炒、沙拉、肉類或魚類料理，以及加入豆腐的「チャンプルー」等各式料理。

ad6ef2048faa67c2.en: Uegusuku Castle (宇江城城, Uegusuku jō; Okinawan: Wiigushiku) is a Ryūkyūan gusuku fortification located in the town of  Kumejima, Okinawa, on Kume Island, Japan.  Its ruins have been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 2009.
ad6ef2048faa67c2.zh: 宇江城城（宇江城城，Uegusuku jō；沖繩語：Wiigushiku）是位於日本沖繩縣久米島町、久米島上的琉球御城（グスク）防禦設施。其城址自2009年起由中央政府指定為國家史跡加以保護。

ad7ae263dfa9ad32.en: Within Shizuoka Prefecture, there are two main production zones for farming eels: Lake Hamana and the Oi River basin, with Yoshida Town corresponding to the Oi River basin production zone. Eel farming began in Yoshida Town with the formation of eel ponds on unused rice paddies flooded out by the Oi River during the Taisho era, and utilized the basin’s underground water. Yoshida Town’s eels are well known for being fatty and soft.“Bokumeshi” is a mixed rice made by combining boiled eel and burdock root to cooked rice.
ad7ae263dfa9ad32.zh: 靜岡縣內的鰻魚養殖主要有濱名湖與大井川流域兩大產區，吉田町屬於大井川流域產區。大正時代，吉田町利用被大井川氾濫淹沒而閒置的水田開闢鰻魚池，並使用流域的地下水，開始養殖鰻魚。吉田町的鰻魚以油脂豐富、肉質柔軟著稱。ぼくめし是將煮過的鰻魚與牛蒡拌入煮好的米飯中做成的拌飯。

ad85152c242bd8c1.en: Nagamori Castle (長森城, Nagamori-jō) was a castle built in Mino Province, Japan, by Tosanobō Shōshun (土佐坊昌俊), in 1185, and lasted from the Heian period to the early Sengoku period. It is located in the Kiridōshi area of the city of Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. After the castle was dismantled in the beginning of the Sengoku period, the Kiridōshi Jin'ya was built on the same spot. It served as the base for the area shugo until the construction of Kawate Castle nearby.
ad85152c242bd8c1.zh: 長森城（長森城）是土佐坊昌俊於1185年在日本美濃國建造的城，存續於平安時代至戰國時代初期，位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市切通地區。戰國時代初期城被拆除後，同一地點建造了切通陣屋。在附近的川手城建成之前，此城一直是當地守護的據點。

ad9439187f023cb6.en: Kururi Castle (久留里城, Kururi-jō) is a Japanese castle located in Kimitsu, southern Chiba Prefecture, Japan. At the end of the Edo period, Kururi Castle was home to a branch of the Kuroda clan, daimyō of Kururi Domain. The castle was also known as Rain Castle (雨城, U-jō), after a legend that it rained twenty-one times during its construction, or, on average, once every three days. It is located on a 227 meter hill.
ad9439187f023cb6.zh: 久留里城（久留里城，Kururi-jō）是位於日本千葉縣南部君津市的日本城郭。江戶時代末期，久留里城為久留里藩藩主黑田氏一支的居城。此城又稱雨城（雨城，U-jō），源於傳說築城期間下了二十一次雨，平均每三天一次。城址位於一座227公尺高的山丘上。

ad9b897c11685031.en: The Tareyanagi Site (垂柳遺跡, Tareyanagi iseki) is an archaeological site in the Tareyanagi and Takahi neighborhoods of the village of Inakadate, Aomori Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan. It contains the remains of rice paddy field from the middle of the Yayoi period (approx. 300 BC to 300 AD). The remains were designated a National Historic Site in 2000 by the Japanese government.
ad9b897c11685031.zh: 垂柳遺跡是位於日本北部東北地方青森縣田舍館村垂柳及高樋地區的考古遺址，保存有彌生時代中期（約西元前300年至西元300年）的水田遺構。該遺跡於2000年由日本政府指定為國家史跡。

ad9c71fbe40b4c2f.en: Eboshigata Castle (烏帽子形城, Eboshigata-jō) is a late Kamakura period Japanese castle located in the city of Kawachinagano, Osaka Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2012. It is also a site registered under Japan Heritage.
ad9c71fbe40b4c2f.zh: 烏帽子形城是位於日本大阪府河內長野市的鎌倉時代後期城郭。其遺址自2012年起被列為國家史蹟保護，也是日本遺產的構成文化財之一。

ada289d405e506b4.en: "Nmu-kuji Puttu-ru" is made by dissolving "Nmu-kuji" (=sweet potato starch) in water and stir-frying to a paste. "Puttu-ru" refers to the starchy, sticky glue-like texture. The word "Nmu" means "sweet potato," and it was first brought back from China in 1605 by “Noguni Soukan“（= the governor of Noguni, Kadena-cho in Okinawa）. This led to the cultivation of sweet potatoes, which were used as relief food to alleviate the suffering of starvation. With the availability of sweet potato starch, "Nmu-kuji" became a staple in households.
ada289d405e506b4.zh: ンムクジプットゥルー是將「ンムクジ」（＝地瓜澱粉）溶於水中，炒成糊狀而成。「プットゥルー」指的是含澱粉、黏稠如膠的口感。「ンム」意為「地瓜」，1605年由「野國總管」（＝沖繩嘉手納町野國的長官）首次從中國帶回。此後開始栽種地瓜，作為救荒食物以減輕飢荒之苦。隨著地瓜澱粉普及，「ンムクジ」成為家家戶戶的常備食材。

adabb662e51b97cb.en: Aquamarine Fukushima (アクアマリンふくしま, Akuamarin Fukushima), officially the Marine Science Museum, Fukushima Prefecture (ふくしま海洋科学館, Fukushima Kaiyō Kagakukan), is a public aquarium located in Iwaki, Fukushima, Japan. The aquarium opened on 15 July 2000. It is the largest in the Tohoku region and focuses on environmental education. It is a member of the Japanese Association of Zoos and Aquariums (JAZA).
adabb662e51b97cb.zh: アクアマリンふくしま正式名稱為福島縣海洋科學館，是位於日本福島縣いわき市的公立水族館，2000年7月15日開館。為東北地區最大的水族館，著重環境教育，是日本動物園水族館協會（JAZA）的會員。

add6b9a3b0f42e4c.en: Toyota Athletic Stadium (豊田市運動公園, Toyota-shi Undō-kōen) is an athletic stadium in Toyota, Aichi, Japan.
add6b9a3b0f42e4c.zh: 豊田市運動公園是位於日本愛知縣豊田市的田徑場。

ade1b13c0ff3436a.en: In Yamagata Prefecture, where edible chrysanthemums (except for small ones used as a garnish for sashimi, etc.) are widely produced, there are many local dishes using them. The custom of eating chrysanthemum petals became popular during the Edo period (1603 - 1868), and it is said that the famous poet Matsuo Basho loved this food. In Yamagata Prefecture, the culture of eating this flower is still strong, and “Ohitashi of edible chrysanthemums” (boiled and eaten with soy sauce) is a typical example.
ade1b13c0ff3436a.zh: 山形縣廣泛生產食用菊（用於生魚片等配飾的小菊除外），因此有許多使用食用菊的鄉土料理。食用菊花瓣的習慣在江戶時代（1603－1868）開始流行，據說知名俳人松尾芭蕉也很喜愛這種食物。在山形縣，吃這種花的文化至今依然盛行，「食用菊的おひたし」（燙過後佐醬油食用）就是代表性的例子。

ae17a5cdf799b8a1.en: The Ichiriki Teahouse (一力茶屋, Ichiriki Chaya), formerly Ichiriki Mansion (一力亭, Ichiriki-tei), is an historic ochaya ("tea house") in Kyoto, Japan. It is located on the southeast corner of Shijō Street and Hanami Lane, its entrance right at the heart of Gion's Kobu district.
ae17a5cdf799b8a1.zh: 一力茶屋，舊稱一力亭，是日本京都一間歷史悠久的御茶屋（「茶屋」）。位於四條通與花見小路的東南角，入口正處於祇園甲部的中心地帶。

ae250f26f9c6eac0.en: “Kakiae namasu” is a local dish that uses reddish-purple edible chrysanthemums. The custom of eating chrysanthemum flowers is unique to the culture of the Tohoku region as well as Niigata Prefecture, and it is said that people began eating chrysanthemum flowers around the Edo period. Kakinomoto is a chrysanthemum called Enmeiraku, which has long been cultivated in the gardens of farmers and in the corners of fields in Niigata Prefecture. It is characterized by its unique aroma, crunchy texture, and sweetness.
ae250f26f9c6eac0.zh: 「かきあえなます」是使用紅紫色食用菊的鄉土料理。食用菊花的習慣是東北地區和新潟縣特有的文化，據說人們約從江戶時代開始食用菊花。かきのもと是一種名為延命樂的菊花，長久以來種植於新潟縣農家的庭院和田邊角落，特色是獨特的香氣、爽脆的口感和甜味。

ae40868c2a40e264.en: It is one of Shimabara's representative local dishes. The origin of this dish is said to date back to the Shimabara Rebellion of 1637, when the general Amakusa Shiro and his 37,000 Christian followers holed up in the castle, and boiled rice cakes to nourish their strength and stamina for the long battle. It is known as a zoni with many ingredients made in an earthenware pot, a rarity in Japan, and many tourists visit Shimabara for the purpose of eating it.
ae40868c2a40e264.zh: 這是島原具代表性的鄉土料理之一。據說這道料理的起源可追溯至1637年的島原之亂，當時天草四郎率領37,000名基督徒據城固守，為了在長期戰鬥中補充體力而煮年糕。它以使用陶鍋烹煮、配料豐富的雜煮聞名，在日本相當少見，許多觀光客專程到島原品嘗。

ae78283b1ab7cc71.en: The Niigata Prefectural Botanical Garden (新潟県立植物園, Niigata Kenritsu Shokubutsuen) is a 19.8 hectares (49 acres) botanical garden and arboretum located at 186 Kanazu, Akiha-ku, Niigata, Niigata, Japan. It is open daily except Mondays; an admission fee is charged.
ae78283b1ab7cc71.zh: 新潟縣立植物園是位於日本新潟縣新潟市秋葉區金津186的植物園兼樹木園，面積19.8公頃（49英畝）。除星期一外每日開放，需收取入園費。

ae7a3e0547130566.en: Nagasaki Milkshake is an iced dessert that originated in Nagasaki City in the late Taisho and early Showa periods.The first tearoom in Kyushu, Tsuruchan, is said to have made milkshakes with crushed ice to make it easier to beat the scorching summer heat in Nagasaki. It became so popular that it was subsequently offered at numerous shops in the city. It is now known nationwide as "Edible Milkshake" in Nagasaki.
ae7a3e0547130566.zh: 「長崎ミルクセーキ」（長崎奶昔）是大正末期至昭和初期在長崎市誕生的冰品甜點。據說九州第一家喫茶店「ツル茶ん」為了讓人更容易度過長崎炎熱的夏天，製作了加入碎冰的奶昔。這種奶昔大受歡迎，之後市內許多店家也開始供應。如今在全國以長崎的「吃的奶昔」聞名。

aeb3d7809a8c41bf.en: Kokubu Castle (国分城, Kokubu-jō) also called Maizuru Castle is the remains of a castle structure in Kirishima, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan. The site is called a Kokubu castle, but it is a fortified residence rather than a castle.
aeb3d7809a8c41bf.zh: 国分城又稱舞鶴城，是位於日本鹿兒島縣霧島市的城郭遺跡。該地雖稱為国分城，但實際上是設防的宅邸，而非城郭。

aed4794a3c068027.en: “Hata-gonbo”, is a Burdock, grown in the Nishihata district of Hashimoto City, located halfway up the 552-meter-high Kunishiro Mountain. Its name is derived from "Hata”, in the Nishihata district and "Gombo", in the burdock dialect. It is not a special variety. When Burdocks, are cultivated in the hard red soil on the steep slope, they grow into a round and fat Hata-gonbo”.The particularly large ones are 5 to 10 cm in diameter and as long as 1 meter.
aed4794a3c068027.zh: 「はたごんぼ」是種植於橋本市西畑地區的牛蒡，該地區位於海拔552公尺的國城山半山腰。名稱來自西畑地區的「畑」與方言中指牛蒡的「ごんぼ」。它並不是特殊品種。牛蒡種在陡坡堅硬的紅土中，會長成圓胖的「はたごんぼ」。特別大的直徑5至10公分，長度可達1公尺。

aedfd126a493c96f.en: During the mid-18th century, from the middle of the Edo period to the Meiji 30s, merchant ships called "Kitamae-bune" sailed westbound from Hokkaido to Osaka, trading goods as they traveled from one port to another. The ships were not only used for transporting cargo but also for buying inexpensive goods in bulk at ports of call and selling them at high prices in other ports, making a large profit. Hokkaido is responsible for ninety percent of the kelp distributed in Japan, but it was transported to western Japan on the Kitamae-bune.
aedfd126a493c96f.zh: 18世紀中葉，從江戶時代中期到明治30年代，被稱為「北前船」的商船從北海道向西航行至大阪，沿途在各港口之間交易貨物。這些船不僅用於運送貨物，也在停靠的港口大量買進便宜的商品，再到其他港口以高價賣出，賺取豐厚利潤。日本流通的昆布有九成產自北海道，而這些昆布便是由北前船運往西日本。

aee68b8a904f7907.en: Miyanomae temple ruins (宮の前廃寺跡, Miyanomae haiji ato) is an archeological site  with the ruins of a Nara period Buddhist temple located in the Zaō neighborhood of the city of Fukuyama, Hiroshima, Japan. It was designated as a National Historic Site in 1969.
aee68b8a904f7907.zh: 宮の前廃寺跡是奈良時代佛寺遺跡的考古遺址，位於日本廣島縣福山市藏王地區。1969年被指定為國家史跡。

af01a9fb1a1d344f.en: "Mousou-jiru" is a local dish using "Mousou", a type of bamboo shoot. The season of "Mousou" starts from Kyushu and goes north along the season, then will be the peak season in mid-May in Tsuruoka City, considered as the most northern place to cultivate the bamboo shoot. There are many "Mousou" bamboo shoots growing around Yudagawa-Onsen, the hot spring in Tsuruoka City, and this are is famous for "Mousou" production.
af01a9fb1a1d344f.zh: 「孟宗汁」是使用竹筍的一種「孟宗」製作的鄉土料理。「孟宗」的產季從九州開始，隨季節北上，到了5月中旬在被視為竹筍栽培最北端的鶴岡市迎來盛產期。鶴岡市的溫泉湯田川溫泉周邊生長著許多「孟宗」竹筍，這一帶以生產「孟宗」聞名。

af04ae7ad690a84a.en: The Japan Spinning Top Museum (日本独楽博物館) is a toy museum located in the city of Nagoya, central Japan.
af04ae7ad690a84a.zh: 日本獨樂博物館是位於日本中部名古屋市的玩具博物館。

af095a4ecc8fcbab.en: ‘Gonbachi’ is officially called ‘Itadori’ and a Polygonaceae plant, and is a kind of wild vegetables grown in mountains in spring. It is found at sunny banks or riverbed, or remains of collapsed banks, and prevailed throughout in Japan. The consumption of ‘gonbachi’ is high in Wakayama Prefecture. It is also called ‘Sukampo’ or ‘Suppon’ in some areas.When you break thick, well-grown young stem from its root, you can hear popping sound.
af095a4ecc8fcbab.zh: 「ゴンバチ」正式名稱為「虎杖」，是蓼科植物，屬於春季生長於山中的山菜。分布於日本各地，生長在向陽的河堤、河床或崩塌的堤岸遺跡。和歌山縣的ゴンバチ消費量很高。有些地區也稱為「スカンポ」或「スッポン」。把粗壯、長得好的嫩莖從根部折斷時，會聽到啪的一聲。

af2adf322aad279b.en: Tomioka City, located in south Gunma Prefecture, is blessed with nature. It has Mt. Myogi, one of "Joumou Sanzan"(three mountain in Joumou, Gunma area) together with Mt. Akagi and Mt. Haruna, and the Kabura River, Class A river in the Tone River system, running in the central area of the city. Moreover, it produces various special products like meat and vegetables thanks to its mild climate. Especially, konjac (yam cake), shiitake mushroom and Japanese leek, which are produced in Kanra/Tomioka area, are very famous.
af2adf322aad279b.zh: 位於群馬縣南部的富岡市自然資源豐富。市內有與赤城山、榛名山並稱「上毛三山」（群馬上毛地區的三座山）的妙義山，利根川水系的一級河川鏑川流經市中心。此外，由於氣候溫和，也出產肉類、蔬菜等各種特產。其中甘樂、富岡地區生產的蒟蒻、香菇與日本大蔥特別有名。

af38740de2a4f588.en: The Miyagase Dam (宮ヶ瀬ダム, Miyagase damu) is a dam on the Nakatsu River, a main tributary of the Sagami River in Aikō District, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. It straddles the border between the village of Kiyokawa, town of Aikawa and the former town of Tsukui (now part of the city of Sagamihara).
af38740de2a4f588.zh: 宮ヶ瀬ダム是位於日本神奈川縣愛甲郡、相模川主要支流中津川上的水壩，橫跨清川村、愛川町與舊津久井町（現屬相模原市）的交界。

af3a8e3078917251.en: The Miyoshi Mononoke Museum, also known as the Yumoto Koichi Memorial Japan Yōkai Museum, or shortened to the Yōkai Museum, is located in Miyoshi, Hiroshima Prefecture, in western Honshu, Japan. The museum collection holds over 5,000 artworks and objects that represent yōkai, supernatural beings in Japanese folklore.
af3a8e3078917251.zh: 三次物怪博物館，又稱湯本豪一記念日本妖怪博物館，簡稱妖怪博物館，位於日本本州西部的廣島縣三次。館藏有超過5,000件表現妖怪（日本民間傳說中的超自然存在）的藝術品與物件。

af43abc0927032d5.en: In Tsugaru region, surrounded by snow during the winter, people harvest farm products and hunt fish as much as possible during the harvest season, and preserve food by drying or pickling them. Rice played many roles not only as a staple food, but also as a malted rice and bran. ‘Iizushi’ is one of the dished made as a preserved food by utilizing fermenting glutinous rice.
af43abc0927032d5.zh: 冬季被大雪包圍的津輕地區，人們在收穫季節盡可能收成農作物、捕撈魚類，並以乾燥或醃漬的方式保存食物。米不僅是主食，也作為米麴與米糠，扮演多種角色。「飯ずし」是利用糯米發酵製成的保存食之一。

af45efc4a03219ca.en: Itami City Museum of Insects (Japanese: 伊丹市昆虫館, Itami-shi konchūkan) is an insectarium in Itami, Hyogo Prefecture, Japan.
af45efc4a03219ca.zh: 伊丹市昆虫館是位於日本兵庫縣伊丹市的昆蟲館。

af56cf0a1b3fb7e5.en: Kotohiki Beach (琴引浜, Kotohikihama) is located in Kyōtango, Kyōto Prefecture, Japan. It is a nationally designated Natural Monument and Place of Scenic Beauty, and forms part of the Tango-Amanohashidate-Ōeyama Quasi-National Park. In 1996, the Ministry of the Environment selected the sound of the sands as one of the 100 Soundscapes of Japan. Its name refers to playing the koto stringed musical instrument.
af56cf0a1b3fb7e5.zh: 琴引濱位於日本京都府京丹後市，為國家指定的天然紀念物及名勝，屬於丹後天橋立大江山國定公園的一部分。1996年，環境省將此地的鳴沙聲選為「日本音風景100選」之一。其名稱指的是彈奏日本弦樂器箏（琴）。

af58712e2c8e3d59.en: The Isedōtai Ruins (伊勢堂岱遺跡, Isedōtai iseki) are a late Jōmon period archaeological site in the city of Kitaakita, Akita Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan.  Discovered during the construction of a highway to nearby Odate–Noshiro Airport, the remains were designated a National Historic Site of Japan  in 2001 by the Japanese government. The site is located approximately five minutes on foot from Ogata on the Akita Nairiku Railway.
af58712e2c8e3d59.zh: 伊勢堂岱遺跡是位於日本北部東北地方秋田縣北秋田市的繩文時代晚期考古遺址。遺跡是在興建通往附近大館能代機場的公路時發現，2001年由日本政府指定為國家史跡。遺址距秋田內陸縱貫鐵道緒方站步行約五分鐘。

af97bcae6c4ec36e.en: Lake Inba (印旛沼, Inba-numa) is a man-made polder lake consisting of northern and western sections connected by a canal and located in Inba Tega Prefectural Natural Park in the Tone River basin in Chiba Prefecture, Japan. It is the largest lake in the prefecture. It was formed from remnants of the Katori Sea after the Tone River was diverted.
af97bcae6c4ec36e.zh: 印旛沼是人工圩田湖，由北、西兩部分組成，以運河相連，位於日本千葉縣利根川流域的印旛手賀縣立自然公園內，是縣內最大的湖泊。利根川改道後，由香取海的殘存水域形成。

af99903a20555919.en: Oroshi-namasu," "kakiage," or "nutaage," a dish made by dressing seafood with radish or wakame seaweed, is found all over Japan. In Saga Prefecture, it is called "kake-waage" or "kake-yaa," and is eaten throughout the year as one of the daily side dishes. On the other hand, it is an indispensable dish on festive occasions such as festivals or when many people gather for rice planting or harvesting, and it is one of the dishes served at festivals, as people usually have a poor diet.
af99903a20555919.zh: 將海鮮與白蘿蔔或海帶芽拌在一起的料理，稱為「おろしなます」、「かきあえ」或「ぬたあえ」，日本各地都有。在佐賀縣稱為「かけあえ」或「かけやー」，一年四季都作為日常配菜食用。另一方面，它也是祭典等喜慶場合，或插秧、收割時許多人聚集時不可或缺的料理；由於人們平時飲食簡樸，這道菜也是祭典時端出的料理之一。

af9c053f9b7fe227.en: A local dish from Shimane Prefecture, which faces the Sea of Japan and has a long history of fishing. Called "Heka-nabe," it involves cooking seafood in an iron flat pot similar to a sukiyaki pot. In some cases, wild boar meat is used instead of seafood.The term "heka" refers to the metal part at the tip of a plow, an agricultural tool. It is said that the origin of the term comes from using this tool instead of a regular pot.In Oda City, there is a fishing method known as "Ichinichi-ryo" (One-Day Fishing).
af9c053f9b7fe227.zh: 這是島根縣的鄉土料理。島根縣面向日本海，漁業歷史悠久。這道料理稱為「へか鍋」，是將海鮮放入類似壽喜燒鍋的鐵製平鍋中烹煮。有時也會用山豬肉代替海鮮。「へか」指的是農具犁前端的金屬部分。據說這個名稱的由來，是因為使用這種工具代替一般的鍋子。大田市有一種稱為「一日漁」的捕魚方式。

afb5d74ea0ee705b.en: The Buzen Sea brings us abundant blessings. Located in the Suonada Sea, which stretches from the eastern coast of Fukuoka Prefecture to the northern coast of Oita Prefecture, it is an inland sea area with a muddy or sandy sea bottom and large tidal ebb and flow, with vast mud flats in the coastal area. Small bottom trawl nets and small fixed nets are the main fishing methods, and many fish such as flatfish and crustaceans such as shrimps and gourami are landed.Small, soft-shelled shrimps, similar to shibaebi, are often landed in the Buzen Sea.
afb5d74ea0ee705b.zh: 豐前海為我們帶來豐富的恩惠。豐前海位於從福岡縣東岸延伸到大分縣北岸的周防灘，是海底為泥質或沙質、潮差大的內海海域，沿岸有廣闊的泥灘。主要漁法為小型底拖網和小型定置網，捕獲的漁獲包括鰈魚等多種魚類，以及蝦類、gourami等甲殼類。豐前海常捕獲一種類似芝蝦、體型小而殼軟的蝦。

afc9afd9c3e0a807.en: There are many theories about the birthplace of natto throughout Japan, and Kyoto Prefecture is said to be one of them. It is said when the monk emperor Kōgon (1313-1364), who was undergoing ascetic training at Joshoko Temple in the Keihoku district of Ukyo Ward in Kyoto City, ate boiled beans wrapped in straw wrappings donated by the villagers, which became stringier and more delicious as the days went by. In the temple's stored picture scrolls, there is a depiction of the head priest serving straw-wrapped “Natto” (fermented soybeans).
afc9afd9c3e0a807.zh: 日本各地有許多關於納豆發源地的說法，京都府據說也是其中之一。相傳在京都市右京區京北地區常照皇寺修行的法皇光嚴天皇（1313-1364），吃了村民獻上、以稻草包裹的煮豆，這些豆子隨著時日變得更牽絲、更美味。寺中收藏的畫卷裡，描繪了住持端出以稻草包裹的「納豆」（發酵大豆）的情景。

afd7cd005d655a8d.en: Daikōzen-ji (大興善寺) is a Tendai temple in Kiyama, Saga Prefecture, Japan. Its honorary sangō prefix is Komatsuzan (小松山).
afd7cd005d655a8d.zh: 大興善寺是位於日本佐賀縣基山町的天台宗寺院，山號為小松山。

afe4e7543e77ac8e.en: Fukui Fine Arts Museum (福井県立美術館, Fukui kenritsu bijutsukan) opened in Fukui, Fukui Prefecture, Japan, in 1977. The collection, numbering some 2,840 pieces, includes prints by Goya and Picasso and paintings by Iwasa Matabei and artists associated with Okakura Tenshin and the beginnings of the Nihon Bijutsuin.
afe4e7543e77ac8e.zh: 福井縣立美術館於1977年在日本福井縣福井市開館。館藏約2,840件，包括哥雅與畢卡索的版畫，以及岩佐又兵衛和與岡倉天心及日本美術院創立初期相關的畫家作品。

b00c9b05d481c27c.en: Masuyama Castle (増山城, Masuyama-jō) was a Muromachi period yamashiro-style Japanese castle located in what is now part of the city of Tonami, Toyama Prefecture in the Hokuriku region of Honshu, Japan. The ruins have been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 2009. It was also known as Wada Castle (和田城, Wada-jō)
b00c9b05d481c27c.zh: 增山城是室町時代的山城式日本城郭，位於今日本本州北陸地方富山縣礪波市境內。城跡自2009年起由中央政府指定為國家史跡加以保護。亦稱和田城。

b062b000a8f003ee.en: The Katsusaka Site (勝坂遺跡, Katsusaka iseki) is an archaeological site containing the ruins of a large Jōmon period settlement located in what is now the Isobe neighborhood of Minami-ku, Sagamihara, Kanagawa Prefecture in the southern Kantō region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1974, with the area designated expanded in 1980, 1984, 2006 and 2019. The site was first discovered by Kashiwa Oyama (the son of General Oyama Iwao) in 1926.
b062b000a8f003ee.zh: 勝坂遺跡是一處考古遺址，保存繩文時代大型聚落的遺跡，位於日本關東地方南部，今神奈川縣相模原市南區磯部。該遺址於1974年被指定為日本國家史跡，並於1980年、1984年、2006年及2019年擴大指定範圍。遺址最早由大山柏（大山巖將軍之子）於1926年發現。

b072e7d505ee1489.en: The slime flounder is also known as “granny flounder” or “Indian flounder” in other regions. It is said that it came to be called “slime flounder” because it is very slimy. It is characterized by being larger than other flatfishes, and compared to the yellow striped flounder, which weighs around 300g per fish, the slime flounder grows to around 600g per fish during the winter period, almost double the size.
b072e7d505ee1489.zh: ナメタガレイ在其他地區也被稱為「婆鰈」或「印度鰈」。據說因為黏液很多，才被稱為「ナメタガレイ」。其特徵是體型比其他鰈類大，相較於每尾約300g的松皮鰈，ナメタガレイ在冬季可長到每尾約600g，大小將近兩倍。

b07abe92826f758d.en: “Shimazushi” is a local dish from Hachijojima, where fish for sushi is thinly sliced and marinated in a soy sauce-based liquid, then formed into sushi with vinegared rice. It is called "shima-zushi" (island sushi) because it is made from fish caught in the Izu Islands. It is known as "Zuke" in Tokyo, referring to the marinating process used for the sushi toppings.
b07abe92826f758d.zh: 「島ずし」是八丈島的鄉土料理，將壽司用的魚切成薄片，以醬油為基底的醬汁醃漬後，再與醋飯捏成壽司。因使用伊豆諸島捕獲的魚製作，所以稱為「島ずし」（島壽司）。在東京則稱為「づけ」，指的是壽司配料的醃漬手法。

b08237f1e9870f00.en: Tsubaki Grand Shrine (椿大神社, Tsubaki Okamiyashiro) is a Shinto shrine in the Yamamoto neighborhood of the city of Suzuka in Mie Prefecture, Japan. It is one of the two shrines which claim the title of ichinomiya of former Ise Province. The main festival of the shrine is held annually on October 11.
b08237f1e9870f00.zh: 椿大神社是位於日本三重縣鈴鹿市山本町的神社，為自稱舊伊勢國一之宮的兩座神社之一。例祭每年於10月11日舉行。

b097cef5f5284bea.en: Karasawa Cirque (涸沢カール, Karasawa ka-ru) is one of major glacial cirques in Japan, located in the Kamikochi region of Azumi, Matsumoto City, in Nagano prefecture. The entire cirque and surrounding mountains are all within Chūbu-Sangaku National Park, which was designated a national park on December 4, 1934.
b097cef5f5284bea.zh: 涸沢カール是日本主要的冰斗之一，位於長野縣松本市安曇的上高地地區。整個冰斗及周邊山岳都在中部山岳國立公園內，該公園於1934年12月4日被指定為國立公園。

b0b0fb19322d1576.en: Kiyomizu-dera (清水寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Hiraki neighborhood of the city of Katō,  Hyōgo Prefecture Japan. It belongs to the Tendai sect of Japanese Buddhism and its honzon (primary image) is a hibutsu (secret/concealed image) statue of Jūichimen Kannon. The temple's full name is Mitake-san Kiyomizu-dera (御嶽山 清水寺). The temple is the 25th stop on the 33 temple Saigoku Kannon Pilgrimage route. It is often referred to as Banshū Kiyomizu-dera (播州清水寺) to disambiguate it from the more famous Kiyomizu-dera in Kyoto.
b0b0fb19322d1576.zh: 清水寺是位於日本兵庫縣加東市平木地區的佛教寺院，屬於日本佛教天台宗，本尊為秘佛十一面觀音像。寺院全名為御嶽山清水寺，是西國三十三所觀音巡禮的第25番札所。為與京都較著名的清水寺區別，常稱為播州清水寺。

b0b56432cb9c854c.en: Mithila Museum is a cultural heritage art museum in Japan. It was created by the Maithil artist Karpuri Devi from the Mithila region. It is located at Tokamachi hills in the Nigata region of Japan. It is housed in a converted schoolhouse in Tokamachi. It was established by Tokio Hasegawa in the year 1982. He was a lover of the Madhubani art and painting. The museum exhibits around two thousand Madhubani paintings having different themes and styles. In the year 2008, it became a treasure house of 15,000 exquisite Madhubani paintings.
b0b56432cb9c854c.zh: ミティラー美術館是位於日本的文化遺產美術館，由來自米提拉地區的米提拉藝術家Karpuri Devi創立。美術館位於日本新潟地區的十日町山丘，設在十日町一棟改建的校舍內。美術館由長谷川時夫於1982年設立，他是馬杜巴尼藝術與繪畫的愛好者。館內展出約兩千幅主題與風格各異的馬杜巴尼繪畫。2008年，館藏已達15,000幅精美的馬杜巴尼繪畫。

b0c8ac74e668d4a9.en: Nakamurayama Castle (中村山城, Nakamurayama-jō) was a hirayamashiro (平山城, castle constructed on a hill) located
b0c8ac74e668d4a9.zh: 中村山城是一座平山城（建於丘陵上的城郭），位於

b0cc55d59a6cb629.en: The Ishi no Hōden (石の宝殿) is a megalithic monument located in the grounds of the Ōshiko Jinja (生石神社), a Shinto shrine located in the city of  Takasago, Hyōgo Prefecture in the Kansai region of Japan. Of unknown age, it was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1979 collectively with the nearby Tatsuyama Stone Quarries (竜山石採石遺跡, Tatsuyama Ishisaiseki iseki), which dates from the Kofun period. It is also called the Ame no Ukiishi (天の浮石).
b0cc55d59a6cb629.zh: 石の宝殿是位於日本關西地區兵庫縣高砂市生石神社境內的巨石遺構，年代不明。1979年與附近可追溯至古墳時代的竜山石採石遺跡一同被指定為日本國家史跡。也稱為「天の浮石」。

b0ecbd22a0c0334b.en: One of the specialities produced in Gunma Prefecture is spring onions. While Nefuka and Jyoshu spring onions are also produced, the most widely recognised is probably Shimonita spring onions. It is said that the Shimonita spring onion began to be produced in the Edo period (1603-1868) and is also known as 'Tonosama spring onion', as the spring onions were presented at the request of the feudal lords of Edo. Characteristics include a maximum thickness of 4-5 cm and a short length of 15-20 cm.
b0ecbd22a0c0334b.zh: 蔥是群馬縣的特產之一。當地也出產根深蔥和上州蔥，但知名度最高的應該是下仁田蔥。據說下仁田蔥從江戶時代（1603-1868）開始生產，因曾應江戶大名的要求進獻，又稱為「殿樣蔥」。其特徵是最粗可達4至5公分，長度則較短，為15至20公分。

b0f26dfc956d8e62.en: The Jō Palisade site (城生柵跡, Jō-no-saku ato) is an archaeological site with the ruins of a Nara period jōsaku-style Japanese castle, located in what is now part of the town of Kami in Kami District, Miyagi prefecture in the Tōhoku region of far northern Honshu, Japan. The site was proclaimed a National National Historic Site in 1979.
b0f26dfc956d8e62.zh: 城生柵跡是位於日本本州最北部東北地方宮城縣加美郡加美町的考古遺址，留有奈良時代城柵式日本城郭的遺跡。此遺址於1979年被指定為國家史跡。

b13a7692a05177d5.en: Uozu Aquarium (魚津水族館, Uozu Suizokukan) is an aquarium in Uozu, Toyama Prefecture, Japan. Opened on the 21st of September 1913, it claims to be the oldest aquarium in Japan still open.
b13a7692a05177d5.zh: 魚津水族館位於日本富山縣魚津市，於1913年9月21日開館，自稱是日本現存仍在營運的最古老水族館。

b18dfbf737f49531.en: "Gyujiru" is a nutritious dish made by simmering beef with carrots and other ingredients. It has been used as a nourishing food for a long time. Especially in winter, it is believed to be effective in preventing colds. In winter, a seasonal limited island carrot called "Chideekuni" is used. "Chideekuni" consists of "Chi" meaning yellow and "Deekuni" meaning Daikon radish. It is a carrot characterized by its slender and vibrant yellow appearance, like burdock. Similar to regular carrots, "Chideekuni" is rich in carotene.
b18dfbf737f49531.zh: 牛汁是將牛肉與紅蘿蔔等食材燉煮而成的營養料理，長久以來被當作滋補食物。特別是在冬季，被認為有預防感冒的效果。冬季會使用季節限定的島紅蘿蔔「チデークニ」。「チデークニ」由意為黃色的「チ」與意為白蘿蔔的「デークニ」組成。這種紅蘿蔔的特徵是像牛蒡一樣細長，呈鮮豔的黃色。與一般紅蘿蔔一樣，「チデークニ」富含胡蘿蔔素。

b18f9d992dadb833.en: Mie Prefectural Art Museum (三重県立美術館, Mie kenritsu bijutsukan) opened in Tsu, Mie Prefecture, Japan, in 1982. The collection has a particular emphasis on yōga.
b18f9d992dadb833.zh: 三重県立美術館（三重縣立美術館）於1982年在日本三重縣津市開館，館藏特別著重洋畫。

b1a60c18321cbc97.en: Keta Wakamiya Shrine (気多若宮神社, Keta Wakamiya Jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in the city of Hida, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It is commonly referred to as "Sugimoto-sama" (杉本さま).
b1a60c18321cbc97.zh: 氣多若宮神社（気多若宮神社）是位於日本岐阜縣飛驒市的神社，通稱「杉本さま」。

b1a79591d5456a8b.en: This home-style dish is made with seasonal eggplant and Shodoshima's specialty somen noodles and flavored with red pepper, making it a perfect staple or side dish. Somen is a convenient ingredient to have on hand when there is not enough rice to go around, and as the saying goes, "let the eggplant hold the somen," eggplant somen is a dish that is widely popular among housewives because it is very easy to handle and does not require a great deal of skill.
b1a79591d5456a8b.zh: 這道家常菜使用當季茄子與小豆島特產的素麵，以辣椒調味，適合當作主食或配菜。米不夠分時，手邊備有素麵很方便；正如俗話說「讓茄子抱住素麵」，なすそうめん做法簡單、不需要太多技巧，在主婦間廣受歡迎。

b1e2e25d836c8963.en: Sakuramochi is a confectionery characterized by a pink rice cake wrapped in salted cherry blossom leaves, symbolizing the arrival of spring. While Sakuramochi is enjoyed nationwide, there are regional variations. In the Kanto region, Sakuramochi features thin crepe-like wrappers enveloping "Anko," Kansai's version uses ”Domyojiko," a coarse glutinous rice flour, to create a textured rice cake that encases "Anko." Both styles share the common practice of wrapping the confection with salted cherry blossom leaves.
b1e2e25d836c8963.zh: 桜餅是以鹽漬櫻花葉包裹粉紅色米糕為特色的點心，象徵春天的到來。桜餅雖然全國各地都吃得到，但有地區差異。關東地區的桜餅是用薄如可麗餅的外皮包住「紅豆餡」，關西的版本則使用粗粒糯米粉「道明寺粉」，做成有顆粒口感的米糕來包住「紅豆餡」。兩種做法共同之處在於都用鹽漬櫻花葉包裹。

b2173a9e0446253c.en: The Paper Museum is a museum about paper in Asukayama Park in Kita-ku, Tokyo, Japan. Its area of focus is the production of Western paper in Japan, which was manufactured there as early as 1873.
b2173a9e0446253c.zh: 紙の博物館是位於日本東京都北區飛鳥山公園內、以紙為主題的博物館。展示重點為日本的西式紙張生產，日本最早在1873年即已製造西式紙張。

b2196b1628368d97.en: Aoi Aso Shrine (青井阿蘇神社, Aoi Aso Jinja) is a Shinto shrine in Hitoyoshi, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan. It is colloquially known as Aoi-san (青井さん). It was originally established as a prefectural shrine, but is currently designated as a national shrine (別表神社, Beppyo Jinja). Five of the structures within the shrine are listed as National Treasures of Japan.
b2196b1628368d97.zh: 青井阿蘇神社是位於日本熊本縣人吉市的神道教神社，俗稱「青井さん」。最初為縣社，現為別表神社。神社內有五棟建築被列為日本國寶。

b21de9da468e7df8.en: Around Tsugaru Bay, which has long been known as a scallop production area, people have been eating "shellfish miso" since the Edo period (1603-1868). It was a simple fisherman's dish, in which sardine or mackerel fillets and homemade miso were grilled on top, using a large shell (about 20 cm in diameter) as a pot.
b21de9da468e7df8.zh: 在自古以扇貝產地聞名的津輕灣一帶，人們從江戶時代（1603-1868）起就食用「貝焼き味噌」。這是一道簡樸的漁夫料理，以大型貝殼（直徑約20公分）當作鍋子，在上面燒烤沙丁魚或鯖魚魚片與自製味噌。

b223560fd611c225.en: The "Hakusai-no-tatamizuke", in which the leaves of the Napa cabbage, are peeled off one by one and pickled with Red chili pepper, and kelp, is an application of the leaf-stem pickling technique that has been eaten in the Kohoku region for a long time. It is said that pickling in the Anegawa River basin, where Mt. Ibuki can be seen, keeps the pickled vegetables from falling apart when cut with a knife.It is a unique pickle cultivated by the local climate.
b223560fd611c225.zh: 「白菜のたたみ漬け」是將白菜葉一片片剝下，與紅辣椒和昆布一起醃漬，是湖北地區長久以來食用的葉莖醃漬技法的應用。據說在可望見伊吹山的姉川流域醃漬，醃好的菜用刀切時不會散開。這是由當地風土孕育出的獨特醃菜。

b2743af1c85396d3.en: Hassō-an (八窓庵) is a historic chashitsu located today in Sapporo, Hokkaido, northern Japan. The name means “eight-window tea house”.
b2743af1c85396d3.zh: 八窓庵是現位於日本北部北海道札幌的歷史茶室。其名稱意為「有八扇窗的茶室」。

b277ae3cd8c5827b.en: Chōkō-ji (朝光寺 Chōkōji)  is a Buddhist temple, in Yashiro, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan.
b277ae3cd8c5827b.zh: 朝光寺是位於日本兵庫縣社町的佛教寺院。

b283b567de8e4336.en: Lake Hibara (桧原湖, Hibara-ko) is a lake located in Yama District, Fukushima, Japan. It is a part of the Bandai-Asahi National Park and is the largest of the lakes in the Bandai Highland.
b283b567de8e4336.zh: 桧原湖是位於日本福島縣耶麻郡的湖泊，屬於磐梯朝日國立公園，是磐梯高原最大的湖泊。

b289fa68dc6d9eef.en: "Zuiki" refers to the petiole (stalk) of a type of taro called "Yatsugashira." It is a summer vegetable that has been enjoyed in various regions across the country for a long time. In Niigata, it is cultivated extensively in the Shinano River basin and paddy field areas. Harvesting starts as early as June and continues until September. It is designated as Nagaoka vegetables, Joetsu vegetables, and Kashiwazaki vegetables.
b289fa68dc6d9eef.zh: 芋莖是指一種稱為「八頭」的芋頭的葉柄（莖）。這是自古以來在全國各地食用的夏季蔬菜。在新潟，信濃川流域和水田地區大量栽種，最早從6月開始採收，持續到9月。被指定為長岡蔬菜、上越蔬菜和柏崎蔬菜。

b29563a79b8d69dc.en: In Oita Prefecture, which is one of the top purchasers of chicken meat per household per year in Japan, local dishes using chicken meat have long been eaten. "Niwatori Jiru" was a feast when chicken meat was once a precious commodity.
b29563a79b8d69dc.zh: 大分縣每戶每年雞肉購買量位居日本前列，自古以來就食用以雞肉製作的鄉土料理。在雞肉曾是珍貴食材的年代，「鶏汁」是一道佳餚。

b2b0127a7aa057d3.en: Kasumigaura, with the second-largest lake surface area in Japan, is renowned for its thriving lotus root cultivation. Lotus root, a local specialty, is one of the products boasting the highest production volume in the country. Dishes like "Kinpira", made from local ingredients such as lotus root, Gobou, and carrots, continue to be cherished as traditional Ibaraki cuisine in households."Kinpira" is widely recognized nationwide as a home-cooked side dish.
b2b0127a7aa057d3.zh: 霞浦擁有日本第二大的湖面面積，以蓮藕栽培興盛聞名。當地特產蓮藕是全國產量最高的產品之一。以蓮藕、牛蒡、紅蘿蔔等當地食材製作的「金平」等料理，至今仍作為茨城的傳統料理在家庭中受到珍視。「金平」作為家常配菜，在全國廣為人知。

b2b918fc5b2a4e31.en: The Ibusuki Hashimuregawa Site (指宿橋牟礼川遺跡, Ibusuki Hashimuregawa iseki) is a complex archaeological site with traces from the Jōmon and Yayoi Periods, located in the Junicho  neighborhood of the city of Ibusuki, Kagoshima Prefecture Japan. It was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1924 under the name Ibusuki Site (指宿遺跡), but the area under protection was expanded in 1996 and the name changed to its present name.
b2b918fc5b2a4e31.zh: 指宿橋牟礼川遺跡是保有繩文時代與彌生時代遺跡的複合型考古遺址，位於日本鹿兒島縣指宿市十二町地區。該遺址於1924年以「指宿遺跡」之名被指定為日本國家史跡，1996年擴大保護範圍，並改為現名。

b2d2299d6eea854c.en: Suita City Football Stadium (市立吹田サッカースタジアム, Shiritsu Suita Sakkā Sutajiamu), a.k.a. Panasonic Stadium Suita (パナソニックスタジアム吹田, Panasonikku Sutajiamu Suita) for sponsorship reasons. is a stadium located in the city of Suita, Osaka Prefecture, Japan. It has a capacity of 39,694.
b2d2299d6eea854c.zh: 市立吹田サッカースタジアム因冠名贊助又稱為パナソニックスタジアム吹田，是位於日本大阪府吹田市的體育場，可容納39,694人。

b2eb3724585018b3.en: Mount Dainichi (大日ヶ岳, Dainichi-ga-take) is a mountain located in the cities of Gujō and Takayama in Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It is part of the Ryōhaku Mountains and has a height of 1,709 m (5,607 ft). The rain that falls on the mountain flows into three rivers: the Nagara River, the Shō River and the Kuzuryū River.
b2eb3724585018b3.zh: 大日岳（大日ヶ岳）是位於日本岐阜縣郡上市與高山市的山，屬於兩白山地，高1,709公尺（5,607英尺）。降落在山上的雨水分別流入長良川、庄川及九頭龍川三條河川。

b2f0341c6aa1d626.en: Oita Prefecture is home to many local sweets made from wheat flour, such as “Yaseuma”, “Jiriyaki” and “Yudemochi” (boiled rice cakes). The reason for this can be found in the flour-based food culture that was rooted in the past. Oita Prefecture has a well-developed plateau and much of its land is unsuitable for rice cultivation. After waterways were built in various areas, the cultivation of wheat in the fields developed. From there, flour came to be used in cooking and became a common ingredient in local sweets and cuisine.
b2f0341c6aa1d626.zh: 大分縣有許多以麵粉製作的鄉土點心，如「やせうま」、「じり焼き」和「ゆでもち」（水煮年糕）。其原因可從過去紮根的麵粉飲食文化中找到。大分縣台地發達，許多土地不適合種植稻米。各地修建水道後，旱田的小麥種植發展起來。從此麵粉開始用於烹飪，成為鄉土點心與料理中常見的材料。

b2f3feda57b29195.en: Doi taikomatsuri (土居太鼓祭り) is a festival held in Doi, Shikokuchūō, Ehime Prefecture, Japan every year from October 13 – 15. It is dedicated to wishing for a good harvest.
b2f3feda57b29195.zh: 土居太鼓祭（土居太鼓祭り）是每年10月13日至15日在日本愛媛縣四國中央市土居舉行的祭典，用以祈求豐收。

b305d51bda22962d.en: The Karatsu Kunchi, which includes the "Hikiyama-Gyouji", 'Yama, Hoko, and Yatai' events, has been registered as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage. It is the autumn festival of Karatsu Shrine in Karatsu City, Saga Prefecture, and is a grand celebration with the theme of gratitude for the harvest. While men from the town of Karatsu have traditionally participated in the festival, women at home, who take care of the households, have a custom of serving dishes to those who have been helpful.
b305d51bda22962d.zh: 唐津くんち的「曳山行事」已作為「山・鉾・屋台行事」之一登錄為聯合國教科文組織無形文化遺產。唐津くんち是佐賀縣唐津市唐津神社的秋季祭典，是以感謝豐收為主題的盛大慶典。傳統上由唐津町的男性參與祭典，而在家中操持家務的女性，則有以料理款待曾經關照過自己的人的習俗。

b308b85867d7d957.en: It is nationally known as "kashiwa mochi," a rice cake filled with sweet bean paste and wrapped in sarutori-ibara leaf (saltoleaf). Mochi is an essential part of celebratory meals on special occasions, particularly during the Children's Day season. In Hyogo Prefecture, as there were not many naturally occurring kashiwa (oak) leaves, saltoleaf was used as a substitute. The name "ibitsumochi" is said to originate from the irregular shape of the sarutori-ibara.
b308b85867d7d957.zh: 這道點心在全國一般稱為「柏餅」，是包入紅豆餡、再以菝葜葉包裹的麻糬。麻糬是節慶喜宴中不可或缺的食物，尤其在兒童節時期。兵庫縣自然生長的槲樹葉不多，因此改用菝葜葉代替。「いびつもち」之名據說源自菝葜葉不規則的形狀。

b31b58052380e47f.en: In the Edo period (1603-1868), when there was almost no distribution of raw fish in Fukushima, nishin caught in Hokkaido were dried and made into "migaki nishin" for distribution outside of Hokkaido. This fish was then transported to the Aizu region, where it came to be valued because it could be preserved and was a source of protein. In Fukushima, in particular, winters are long and crops are scarce for a long period of time, so food that could be stored for a long time was favored.
b31b58052380e47f.zh: 江戶時代（1603-1868），福島幾乎沒有生鮮魚類流通，在北海道捕獲的鯡魚會乾燥製成「身欠き鰊」，運往北海道以外的地方。這種魚運到會津地區後，因為可以保存又是蛋白質來源而受到重視。尤其福島冬季漫長，長時間缺乏農作物，因此偏好能長期保存的食物。

b3312274a8f4280a.en: Reikyū Shrine (霊丘神社, Reikyū Jinja) is a Shinto shrine in Shimabara, Nagasaki Prefecture, Japan. It enshrines the first Shōgun of the Tokugawa Shogunate, Tokugawa Ieyasu.
b3312274a8f4280a.zh: 霊丘神社是位於日本長崎縣島原市的神社，祭祀德川幕府第一代將軍德川家康。

b359f5c124a5abd5.en: Kamei-in (亀井院) is a Buddhist temple located in the city of Ichikawa in Chiba Prefecture. Kamei-in is a Nichiren Buddhist temple noted for the Mama Well.
b359f5c124a5abd5.zh: 亀井院是位於千葉縣市川市的佛教寺院，為日蓮宗寺院，以「真間之井」聞名。

b36bc59a4cc8e17c.en: Bungo Suidō Prefectural Natural Park (豊後水道県立自然公園, Bungo Suidō kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park on the east coast of Ōita Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1985, the park spans the municipalities of Saiki, Tsukumi, and Usuki. The park's central focus is upon the Bungo Strait.
b36bc59a4cc8e17c.zh: 豊後水道県立自然公園是位於日本大分縣東海岸的縣立自然公園，於1985年設立，範圍橫跨佐伯市、津久見市與臼杵市。公園以豐後水道為中心。

b37a4334b0ce8510.en: The dish known as "zushi" refers to a type of rice porridge. Rice was precious and consumed during New Year's and festive events, and in the past, the staple food was "hie meshi" made from foxtail millet. Foxtail millet (hie) is a type of cereal native to Japan that has been consumed since pre-Jomon times. Its tough outer husk allows it to be stored for extended periods, making it valuable. In slash-and-burn agriculture, it is cultivated alongside millet in the second year.
b37a4334b0ce8510.zh: 稱為「ずーしー」的料理是指一種米粥。過去米很珍貴，只在新年及節慶活動時食用，平時的主食是以稗製作的「稗飯」。稗是原產於日本的一種穀物，自繩文時代以前便被食用。其外殼堅硬，可長期保存，因此相當珍貴。在燒墾農業中，稗於第二年與粟一同栽種。

b39cf920ff0a8eae.en: "Uzumaki Mochi" is a local confectionery of the Hiketa area, made by rolling up Koshi-an(sweet bean paste) with rice cake. The Hiketa area is located on the border with Naruto City in Tokushima Prefecture, and the vortex in "Uzumaki Mochi" represents the sea of Naruto. Naruto used to be an important fishing ground for the Hiketa area, but the people of Naruto lost the battle, and it is said that "Uzumaki Mochi" was first made to regret the sea of Naruto.
b39cf920ff0a8eae.zh: 「うずまきもち」是引田地區的鄉土點心，以年糕捲起豆沙餡製成。引田地區位於與德島縣鳴門市交界處，「うずまきもち」的漩渦代表鳴門的海。鳴門過去是引田地區重要的漁場，但在與鳴門居民的爭鬥中落敗，據說「うずまきもち」最初就是為了惋惜失去鳴門的海而做的。

b3a0cfd709e2ac11.en: Kōrogi Athletic Park (愛知県口論義運動公園, Aichi-ken Kōrogi Undō Kōen), sometimes called the Kōrogi Sports Park, is a sports complex in Nisshin, Japan.
b3a0cfd709e2ac11.zh: 愛知県口論義運動公園，有時也稱為口論義體育公園，是位於日本日進市的綜合運動設施。

b3a24ec3b2c58894.en: As the old saying goes, "when a persimmon turns red, the doctor turns blue," persimmons are rich in vitamins A, C, folic acid, potassium, and other nutrients, especially vitamin C, which is said to be more than twice the amount found in lemons.When persimmons are dried, in addition to sugar, vitamin A and folic acid are concentrated. In Miyagi Prefecture, high-quality dried persimmons are produced from fall to winter, mainly in Marumori Town and Shiroishi City in the southern part of the prefecture.
b3a24ec3b2c58894.zh: 俗話說「柿子紅了，醫生臉就青了」，柿子富含維生素A、C、葉酸、鉀等營養素，尤其是維生素C，據說含量是檸檬的兩倍以上。柿子曬乾後，除了糖分，維生素A和葉酸也會濃縮。宮城縣在秋季到冬季生產優質柿餅，主要產地在縣南部的丸森町與白石市。

b3ad0d7f886ee2f6.en: In Iwate Prefecture, where the climate is cold and unsuitable for rice farming, different types of millets such as wheat, buckwheat and foxtail millet are grown. Due to this, many types of traditional dishes using wheat flour and millet flour were born. “Kamamochi” is one of such dishes.“Kamamochi” is made by creating a sweet paste using miso, brown sugar and walnuts and wrapping the paste in a flour dough. The “mochi” (=sticky cake) is shaped to look like half-moons.
b3ad0d7f886ee2f6.zh: 岩手縣氣候寒冷，不適合種植稻米，因此栽種小麥、蕎麥、小米等各種雜糧，也因而發展出許多使用麵粉與雜糧粉的傳統料理，「かまもち」便是其中之一。「かまもち」是以味噌、黑糖和核桃製成甜餡，再用麵粉糰包起來製成。這種「餅」做成半月形。

b3ae3da82d308df2.en: Konjac(=yam cake) has a long history. In the Kamakura period (1185-1333), it was consumed as a medicine and snack by nobles, monks, and other high-ranking people, and in the Muromachi period it became so widely eaten by the common people that merchants peddled it on the roadside. In the Azuchi-Momoyama period (1573-1600), there is an anecdote that Oda Nobunaga had red konjac made. The basis for the current Konjac(=yam cake) production method was created in 1776 in the Mito domain.
b3ae3da82d308df2.zh: 蒟蒻歷史悠久。鎌倉時代（1185-1333）時，是貴族、僧侶等上層人士食用的藥物與點心；到了室町時代，已普及到一般百姓，甚至有商人在路邊叫賣。安土桃山時代（1573-1600）有織田信長命人製作紅蒟蒻的軼事。現今蒟蒻製法的基礎，是1776年在水戶藩建立的。

b3b7305d59335c62.en: “Keihan (Chicken rice)" is a typical local dish of the Amami region. It consists of shredded chicken meat, dried shiitake mushrooms, thin strips of egg, papaya preserved in miso and mandarin orange peel on white rice, which is served with chicken stock soup. It is said to have originated in the Amami Islands, which were once under the control of the Satsuma domain, and was created to soften the intimidating attitude of officials coming from the Kagoshima mainland.
b3b7305d59335c62.zh: 「鶏飯」（雞肉飯）是奄美地區代表性的鄉土料理。在白飯上放上雞肉絲、乾香菇、蛋絲、味噌醃木瓜和橘子皮，再淋上雞高湯食用。據說起源於曾受薩摩藩統治的奄美群島，是為了緩和從鹿兒島本土前來的官員的威嚇態度而做的。

b3d2f8ef852cc6d6.en: Otsuboyama Kōgoishi (おつぼ山神籠石) was an ancient Korean-style fortress located in the Tachibana neighborhood of the city of Takeo, Saga Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1966.
b3d2f8ef852cc6d6.zh: おつぼ山神籠石是位於日本佐賀縣武雄市橘地區的古代朝鮮式山城，其遺跡自1966年起列為國家史跡受到保護。

b3d95543acccab91.en: Izumi no Mori (泉の森; lit. "Forest of Springs") is a park in Yamato, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. The springs in the park are the source of the Hikiji River that flows into Sagami Bay.
b3d95543acccab91.zh: 泉の森（意為「泉水之森」）是位於日本神奈川縣大和市的公園。園內的泉水為流入相模灣的引地川的源頭。

b3e2b1602efbd9e9.en: The Kawagoe City Industry and Tourism Center is a commercial facility in Kawagoe City, Saitama Prefecture. It was established by Kawagoe  City after converting sake storehouses (酒蔵) of the former sake brewery.
b3e2b1602efbd9e9.zh: 川越市產業觀光館是位於埼玉縣川越市的商業設施，由川越市將原酒廠的酒藏改建而成。

b3f2db8cb5d101b4.en: The Igai mussel has a triangular shape, blackish brown shell, and is found on reefs. It closely resembles mussels, and are also members of the mussel family. They are said to be called "Igai (unusual)” because they differ from clams and other bivalves in shape and soft body patterns.The mussels are found in the intertidal zone along the coast and at depths of up to 20 meters (21 yards), where the tides are clear and the reefs are well-developed.
b3f2db8cb5d101b4.zh: いがい（紫孔雀蛤）外形呈三角形，殼為黑褐色，棲息於礁岩上。牠與貽貝十分相似，同屬貽貝科。據說因其形狀與軟體部分的花紋不同於蛤蜊等其他雙殼貝類，而被稱為「いがい（意外、不尋常）」。這種貝類分布於沿岸潮間帶至水深20公尺（21碼）處，棲息在潮水清澈、礁岩發達的地方。

b413d0f8c34bfe88.en: Abeno Shrine (阿部野神社, Abeno jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Abeno-ku, Osaka Prefecture, Japan. Its main festival is held annually on January 24. It was founded in 1882, and enshrines the kami of Kitabatake Chikafusa and Kitabatake Akiie. It is one of the Fifteen Shrines of the Kenmu Restoration.
b413d0f8c34bfe88.zh: 阿部野神社是位於日本大阪府阿倍野區的神社，每年1月24日舉行例祭。創建於1882年，祭神為北畠親房與北畠顯家，是建武中興十五社之一。

b42159efbca3eddc.en: Aichiken Forest Park (Japanese: 愛知県森林公園) is a forest park located in the area encompassing Owariasahi and Moriyama-ku, Nagoya, Aichi. In its vast forest of about 468 hectares, it also includes a botanical garden and various sports facilities, such as tennis courts, baseball and archery fields, a horse riding course, a golf course, and sports plazas.
b42159efbca3eddc.zh: 愛知県森林公園是位於愛知縣尾張旭市與名古屋市守山區一帶的森林公園。園內約468公頃的廣大森林中，另設有植物園及各種運動設施，包括網球場、棒球場、射箭場、騎馬道、高爾夫球場與運動廣場。

b44ac9c4b797991f.en: Ogyū Castle (大給城, Ogyū-jō) was a Sengoku period flatland-style Japanese castle located in the Ōuchi neighborhood of the city of Toyota, Aichi in the Tōkai region of Japan. The ruins, together with other sites in Matsudaira-gō associated with the Matsudaira clan, have been collectively protected as a National Historic Site since 2000.
b44ac9c4b797991f.zh: 大給城是戰國時代的平城式日本城郭，位於日本東海地方愛知縣豐田市大內地區。遺跡與松平鄉內其他和松平氏相關的史蹟，自2000年起共同被指定為國家史跡。

b44c085d189f6be3.en: The Kitayatsugatake Ropeway (北八ヶ岳ロープウエイ, Kitayatsugatake Rōpuwei) is the name of a Japanese aerial lift line (known until 2012 as Piratasu Tateshina Ropeway) in Chino, Nagano, as well as its operator. The company also operates Pilatus Tateshina Snow Resort, a ski area served by the line. The company operates Tateshina Kōgen Art Museum at the submontane station as well. Opened in 1967, the line climbs Tateshina Highland (蓼科高原), transporting skiers and rime spectators in winter, hikers in other seasons.
b44c085d189f6be3.zh: 北八ヶ岳ロープウエイ是位於長野縣茅野市的日本空中纜車路線（2012年以前稱為ピラタス蓼科ロープウェイ），也是其營運公司的名稱。該公司另經營以此線路連接的ピラタス蓼科滑雪場，並在山麓站經營蓼科高原美術館。該線於1967年啟用，登上蓼科高原，冬季載運滑雪客與觀賞霧凇的遊客，其他季節則載運登山健行者。

b46512cc5f599cb2.en: “Noppejiru” is a soup that has been passed down through families in Saga Prefecture, and is sometimes called “Noppeijiru” or “Nuppeijiru.” “Noppe” or “noppei” means the soup’s consistency is thickened with potato starch. It’s characterized by its thickness and the presence of many root vegetables such as taro and burdock. It’s eaten as an everyday meal, especially in winter, as a dish to warm the body. It’s also often eaten on days when people gather, and the ingredients used vary depending on the event.
b46512cc5f599cb2.zh: 「のっぺ汁」是佐賀縣家庭代代相傳的湯品，也稱為「のっぺい汁」或「ぬっぺい汁」。「のっぺ」或「のっぺい」指的是用太白粉勾芡、讓湯變得濃稠。其特色是湯汁濃稠，並加入大量芋頭、牛蒡等根莖類蔬菜。作為暖身的料理，平日尤其在冬天常吃，在人們聚集的日子也常食用，使用的食材則依活動而有所不同。

b473aeb94f18b519.en: ‘Ashi Tibichi’ or ‘Tibichi’ is a dish of simmered pig’s feet (‘chimaguu’ in Okinawa dialect) with ‘kombu’ kelp (‘kuubu’ in Okinawa dialect) and daikon radish (‘deekuni’ in Okinawa dialect) for a long time. As the dish contains lots of gristle and gelatin, it is popular especially among the elderlies and women for anti-aging and beauty. The unique flavor of ‘chimaguu’ is rich, and its melty texture is exquisite. In Okinawa, famous for longevity, the idea of ‘Ishoku Dougen’ (a balanced food leads a healthy body) and ‘Irui Horui’ is common.
b473aeb94f18b519.zh: 足ティビチ又稱「ティビチ」，是將豬腳（沖繩方言稱「チマグー」）與昆布（沖繩方言稱「クーブ」）、白蘿蔔（沖繩方言稱「デークニ」）一起長時間燉煮的料理。由於含有大量軟骨與膠質，特別受到年長者與女性歡迎，用於抗老與美容。「チマグー」獨特的風味濃郁，入口即化的口感極佳。在以長壽聞名的沖繩，「醫食同源」（均衡飲食造就健康身體）與「醫類補類」的觀念相當普遍。

b47804ab052204ef.en: Tōrin-in (東林院), also known as Takamine-Daishi (種蒔大師), is a temple in Naruto, Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. It is the oku-no-in of Ryōzen-ji, Temple 1 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage. Said to have been founded by Gyōki, the main image is of Yakushi Nyorai. It is Temple 1 on the Shinshikoku Mandala Reijō. A Heian period seated wooden statue of Miroku Bosatsu has been designated an Important Cultural Property.
b47804ab052204ef.zh: 東林院又稱種蒔大師，是位於日本德島縣鳴門市的寺院，為四國八十八所遍路第1番靈山寺的奧之院。據傳由行基創建，本尊為藥師如來。本寺為新四國曼荼羅靈場第1番。平安時代的木造彌勒菩薩坐像已被指定為重要文化財。

b4b003f2dada9b14.en: Nigiri-zushi is a typical Japanese dish consisting of vinegared rice topped with ingredients.In the Heian period, salted fish was dipped in cooked rice as a preserved food, and the rice was fermented and pickled with a sour taste, which was called nare-zushi. During the Edo period, nare-zushi was transformed into various forms, including haya-zushi (fast sushi), oshi-zushi (pressed sushi), and nigiri-zushi (nigiri sushi). Today, hand-rolled sushi is also popular, and nigirizushi has spread throughout the world.
b4b003f2dada9b14.zh: 「にぎりずし」是在醋飯上放上配料的代表性日本料理。平安時代，人們將鹽漬的魚浸入米飯中作為保存食品，米飯發酵後帶有酸味，稱為熟壽司。到了江戶時代，熟壽司演變為早壽司、押壽司（壓製壽司）、握壽司等各種形式。如今手捲壽司也很受歡迎，握壽司則已推廣至全世界。

b4b8bd8051c16513.en: Jingamine Castle (陣が峯城, Jingamine jō) was a Heian period Japanese castle located in what is now the town of Aizubange, Fukushima Prefecture, in the southern Tōhoku region of Japan. The site has been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 2007.
b4b8bd8051c16513.zh: 陣が峯城是平安時代的日本城郭，位於今日本東北地方南部福島縣會津坂下町。城址自2007年起由中央政府指定為國家史跡加以保護。

b4bb572f242b860d.en: Saiki City, located in southeastern Oita Prefecture, is the largest city in Kyushu with an area of 903.12 km2. The city is divided into a mountainous area stretching from the Kyushu Mountains, a plain area spreading downstream from the Banjo River, a first-class river, and a coastal area on a rias coast. During the Seinan War of 1877 (Meiji 10), the mountainous area bordering Miyazaki Prefecture became a battleground. Part of Saigo's army, led by Saigo Takamori, also invaded Saiki city.
b4bb572f242b860d.zh: 佐伯市位於大分縣東南部，面積903.12平方公里，是九州面積最大的城市。市內分為從九州山地延伸而來的山區、一級河川番匠川下游展開的平原區，以及谷灣式海岸的沿海區。1877年（明治10年）西南戰爭期間，與宮崎縣交界的山區成為戰場，西鄉隆盛率領的西鄉軍也有部分攻入佐伯市。

b4c6bb9a50c75b9f.en: The Imanishi Family Residence (今西家住宅, Imanishi-ke jūtaku) is one of a Group of Traditional Buildings in Imai-cho, Kashihara, Nara Prefecture Japan. It dates to 1650 and has been designated an Important Cultural Property.
b4c6bb9a50c75b9f.zh: 今西家住宅是日本奈良縣橿原市今井町傳統建築群之一，建於1650年，已被指定為重要文化財。

b4c7993c08c92ac5.en: Shimizu Park (清水公園) is a privately owned park located in Noda City in north-eastern Chiba
b4c7993c08c92ac5.zh: 清水公園是位於千葉縣東北部野田市的私人公園

b4e3ea1d062c704f.en: Hitokura Dam (一庫ダム, Hitokura damu) is a dam in Kawanishi, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan.
b4e3ea1d062c704f.zh: 一庫ダム是位於日本兵庫縣川西市的一座水壩。

b4f31c5a125af505.en: Sakunami Onsen (作並温泉) is a hot spring resort district in northern Japan about 25 kilometres (16 mi) to the northwest of downtown Sendai, Miyagi Prefecture.
b4f31c5a125af505.zh: 作並溫泉是日本北部的溫泉區，位於宮城縣仙台市中心西北方約25公里（16英里）處。

b4fa59df3d1c3a90.en: Hokuchin Memorial Museum (Japanese: 北鎮記念館) is a history museum located in Asahikawa, Hokkaido, Japan. The museum is a JGSDF Public Relations facility displaying as many as 2,500 items concerning the history of the Tondenhei Army, which developed Hokkaido, the 7th Division of the old Imperial Japanese Army, and the activities of the 2nd Division of today's JGSDF. Admission is free.
b4fa59df3d1c3a90.zh: 北鎮記念館是位於日本北海道旭川的歷史博物館。本館為陸上自衛隊的公關設施，展示多達2,500件文物，內容涉及開拓北海道的屯田兵、舊日本帝國陸軍第7師團的歷史，以及現今陸上自衛隊第2師團的活動。免費入館。

b501508aaee69b9d.en: The Tado Festival (多度祭, Tado Matsuri) is a Japanese festival that takes place every year during Japan's Golden Week on May 4 and 5 at Tado Shrine in the city of Kuwana, Mie Prefecture.
b501508aaee69b9d.zh: 多度祭是每年日本黃金週期間的5月4日與5日，在三重縣桑名市多度大社舉行的日本祭典。

b52b351059b9b15b.en: The Hyūga Provincial Capital ruins (日向国府跡, Hyūga kokufu ato) is an archaeological site with the ruins of a Nara to Heian period government administrative complex located in what is now the Migimatsu neighborhood of the city of Saito, Miyazaki prefecture in the island of Kyushu, Japan. Identified as the ruins of the kokufu (provincial capital) of Hyūga Province, the site was protected by the national government as a National Historic Site since 2005.
b52b351059b9b15b.zh: 日向國府跡是奈良至平安時代官衙建築群的考古遺址，位於日本九州宮崎縣西都市今右松地區。此地經確認為日向國國府遺跡，自2005年起由國家列為國家史跡加以保護。

b5314923b64e1535.en: It is made by rolling kneaded rice flour with kumazasa (bamboo grass) and then boiling it. It is a traditional food for the lunar calendar's Children's Day (Tango no Sekku). Additionally, it is eaten during other events such as a break during rice planting, celebrations after rice planting (Taiman), and the event known as Hange on July 2nd.Kumazasa is believed to have sterilizing and preservative effects. In the past, it was used as a bandage for cuts and wounds.
b5314923b64e1535.zh: 將揉好的米粉以熊笹（山白竹）捲起後水煮而成，是農曆端午節（端午の節句）的傳統食物。此外，也會在插秧期間的休息、插秧後的慶祝（たいまん），以及7月2日稱為「半夏」的節日等場合食用。熊笹被認為具有殺菌與防腐效果，過去曾被用來包紮割傷與傷口。

b5385bebbed55701.en: Sayama Fudōson (Japanese: 狭山不動尊) is a Tendai sect temple located in Kamiyamaguchi, Tokorozawa, Saitama. It is noted for it containing a number of historically significant structures that were relocated from other parts of Japan.
b5385bebbed55701.zh: 狹山不動尊是位於埼玉縣所澤市上山口的天台宗寺院，以寺內有多座自日本各地遷建而來、具歷史意義的建築而聞名。

b543d18e02e3edee.en: The Pacific Music Festival (PMF) (パシフィック・ミュージック・フェスティバル札幌 (Pashifikku Myūjikku Fesutibaru Sapporo)) is an international classical music festival held annually in Sapporo, Japan. It was founded in 1990 by Leonard Bernstein, along with the London Symphony Orchestra, and 123 young musicians from 18 countries. The original artistic directors were Bernstein and Michael Tilson Thomas.
b543d18e02e3edee.zh: 太平洋音樂節（PMF，パシフィック・ミュージック・フェスティバル札幌）是每年在日本札幌舉辦的國際古典音樂節。1990年由李奧納德・伯恩斯坦（Leonard Bernstein）與倫敦交響樂團，以及來自18個國家的123名年輕音樂家共同創立。首任藝術總監為伯恩斯坦與麥可・提爾森・湯瑪斯（Michael Tilson Thomas）。

b54719268959e3d5.en: Yokosuka Arts Theatre (横須賀芸術劇場, Yokosuka Geijutsu Gekijō) is part of the mixed-use Bay Square complex in Yokosuka, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. It opened in 1994. The horseshoe-shaped theatre seats 1,806 and there is a smaller hall, the Yokosuka Bayside Pocket, with a capacity of 600. The Bay Square complex is by Kenzo Tange, with acoustical design of the halls by Nagata Acoustics.
b54719268959e3d5.zh: 橫須賀藝術劇場是日本神奈川縣橫須賀市綜合用途設施Bay Square的一部分，於1994年開幕。馬蹄形劇場設有1,806個座位，另有一座可容納600人的小型廳「橫須賀Bayside Pocket」。Bay Square由丹下健三設計，各廳的聲學設計由永田音響設計負責。

b55d82f6d2b72990.en: Narae is a dish made by blending seven ingredients (daikon radish, carrots, deep-fried tofu, sesame, lotus root, dried shiitake mushrooms, and konjac) with sanbaizu (vinegar). The name originates from the fact that it uses seven (nana) ingredients. However, some believe that the name comes from the inclusion of "Narazuke," which is vegetables pickled in salt and sake lees. In Tokushima, Narazuke was called "Naraware" or "Narae." One of the vegetarian dishes eaten around the time of the Taika Reform was narae.
b55d82f6d2b72990.zh: ならえ是將七種食材（白蘿蔔、紅蘿蔔、油豆腐、芝麻、蓮藕、乾香菇、蒟蒻）以三杯醋拌和而成的料理。名稱源自使用七（なな）種食材。不過也有人認為，名稱來自其中加入了以鹽和酒粕醃漬的蔬菜「奈良漬」。在德島，奈良漬被稱為「ならわれ」或「ならえ」。ならえ是大化革新前後食用的素食料理之一。

b57ae612bcb03cf4.en: In the days when homemade snacks and light meals were prevalent, rice cakes made from leftover rice mixed with flour and miso, shaped, flattened, and then grilled on a "hōroku (=traditional grilling implement)" or in a frying pan, were a beloved taste in households for their miso fragrance and rustic simplicity.
b57ae612bcb03cf4.zh: 在點心與輕食多為自家製作的年代，將剩飯與麵粉、味噌混合，捏成形並壓扁，再用「焙烙」（傳統烤具）或平底鍋烤製的餅，因味噌香氣與樸素的風味，是家家戶戶喜愛的味道。

b5825225a0bd1aa6.en: Kōri-Nishiyama Castle  (桑折西山城跡, Kōri-Nishiyama-jō) was a Sengoku period Japanese castle located in what is now part of the town of  Koori, northern Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. The site has been protected by the Japanese government as a National Historic Site since 1990.
b5825225a0bd1aa6.zh: 桑折西山城是戰國時代的日本城郭，位於今日本福島縣北部桑折町境內。城址自1990年起由日本政府指定為國家史跡加以保護。

b5830a19b8294d67.en: Futai-ji (不退寺), also known as Narihira-dera (業平寺), is a Buddhist temple in Nara, Japan.
b5830a19b8294d67.zh: 不退寺又稱業平寺，是位於日本奈良的佛教寺院。

b58fdac2da533544.en: Kōmyōzen-ji (光明禅寺) is a Zen temple in Dazaifu, Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan. It was founded by Tetsugyū Enshin of the Tōfuku-ji Rinzai school in 1273. Kōmyōzen-ji is celebrated for its karesansui garden, the only example in Kyushu.
b58fdac2da533544.zh: 光明禪寺是位於日本福岡縣太宰府的禪寺，1273年由臨濟宗東福寺派的鐵牛圓心創建。光明禪寺以枯山水庭園聞名，這是九州唯一的一例。

b5a1c84d4c5a4f56.en: In Saitama Prefecture, where yuzu fruit has long been cultivated, especially in Ogose-machi, Iruma-gun, there are many local dishes using yuzu fruit. Among them, "Yuzu Maki" is a pickle that is loved as a New Year's dish while having an aspect of winter preservation food.
b5a1c84d4c5a4f56.zh: 埼玉縣長年栽培柚子，尤以入間郡越生町為盛，因此有許多使用柚子的鄉土料理。其中「ゆず巻き」是一種醃漬物，兼具冬季保存食的性質，也作為新年料理受到喜愛。

b5a29b01e2227407.en: "Satsuma" is a local dish made by breaking up grilled white fish, basting it with grilled miso and fish dashi (=Japanese soup stock), and serving it over hot rice. In the past, when cooking miso, miso was spread on the lid of a pot or a mortar and covered with Shichirin to make it aromatic. There are various theories about its history, but it is said to have been introduced along the coast from Kyushu to Shikoku. The one made in Ehime Prefecture is called "Iyo Satsuma" and the one made in Kagawa Prefecture is called "Sanuki Satsuma".
b5a29b01e2227407.zh: 「さつま」是將烤過的白肉魚撥碎，加入烤過的味噌與魚高湯（＝日式湯底）調勻，淋在熱飯上食用的鄉土料理。過去煮味噌時，會把味噌抹在鍋蓋或研缽上，再蓋上七輪烘烤出香氣。其由來眾說紛紜，據說是沿著海岸從九州傳到四國。愛媛縣做的稱為「伊予さつま」，香川縣做的稱為「讚岐さつま」。

b5b2418ff65c4982.en: Shichikashuku Dam (Japanese: 七ヶ宿ダム) is a rock-fill dam in the town of Shichikashuku, Miyagi, Japan, completed in 1991. The dam crosses the Shiroishi River, a branch of the Abukuma River system.
b5b2418ff65c4982.zh: 七ヶ宿ダム是位於日本宮城縣七ヶ宿町的堆石壩，1991年完工。水壩橫跨阿武隈川水系支流白石川。

b5b7a348b2dd58d5.en: Toga Shrine (砥鹿神社, Toga Jinja) is a Shinto shrine in the city of Toyokawa in eastern Aichi Prefecture, Japan. It is the ichinomiya of former Mikawa Province. The main festival of the shrine is held annually from May 3 to May 5. Located on the borderland of Aichi with Shizuoka Prefecture, the summit of Mount Hongū 782 metres (2,566 ft) is a sacred mountain considered to be within the precincts of the shrine, and has a subsidiary chapel.
b5b7a348b2dd58d5.zh: 砥鹿神社是位於日本愛知縣東部豐川市的神社，為舊三河國的一宮。神社的例祭每年於5月3日至5月5日舉行。位於愛知縣與靜岡縣交界地帶、海拔782公尺（2,566英尺）的本宮山山頂為聖山，被視為神社境內的一部分，並設有攝社。

b5c8a8652b4f0e44.en: Kōyasanchō Ishimichi-Tamagawakyō Prefectural Natural Park (高野山町石道玉川峡県立自然公園, Kōyasan-chō Ishimichi Tamagawa-kyō kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1968, the park spans the borders of the municipalities of Hashimoto, Katsuragi, Kōya, and Kudoyama. The park comprises three non-contiguous areas, centred in turn upon Horaisan Jinja (宝来山神社) and the eponymous Kōyasan chōishi-michi and Tamagawa-kyō (玉川峡).
b5c8a8652b4f0e44.zh: 高野山町石道玉川峽縣立自然公園是位於日本和歌山縣的縣立自然公園。公園設立於1968年，範圍橫跨橋本市、葛城町、高野町與九度山町。公園由三個不相連的區域組成，分別以寶來山神社，以及同名的高野山町石道與玉川峽為中心。

b5cd17c509c05f5d.en: Maebashi Tōshō-gū (前橋東照宮) is a Shinto Shrine dedicated to Tokugawa Ieyasu in the city of Maebashi, Gunma Prefecture, Japan. It was established in 1624.
b5cd17c509c05f5d.zh: 前橋東照宮是位於日本群馬縣前橋市、供奉德川家康的神社，創建於1624年。

b5de0c9410e41479.en: Aki Castle (安芸城, Aki-jō) was a castle of the Aki clan in what is now the city of Aki, Kōchi Prefecture, Japan. Ruins still remain and the site was designated an Aki City Historic Site. It is believed the castle was built by Aki Chikauji in 1308.
b5de0c9410e41479.zh: 安藝城是安藝氏的城堡，位於今日本高知縣安藝市。城跡至今尚存，已被指定為安藝市史跡。一般認為此城由安藝親氏於1308年興建。

b5e65df9fb1b1311.en: The Hakkaisan Ropeway (八海山ロープウェイ, Hakkaisan Rōpuwei) is a Japanese aerial lift line in Minamiuonuma, Niigata, operated by Prince Hotels. The line opened in 1983 as a gondola lift line, and refurbished as an aerial tramway in 2001. It climbs Mount Hakkai (八海山) of Muikamachi Hakkaisan Ski Resort (六日町八海山スキー場). The line mainly transports skiers, but also hikers and autumn color spectators in other seasons. The line only operates in "winter" (from December to March) and "summer" (from May to October).
b5e65df9fb1b1311.zh: 八海山ロープウェー是位於新潟縣南魚沼市的空中纜車路線，由王子大飯店（Prince Hotels）經營。路線於1983年以吊廂式纜車開通，2001年改建為往復式空中纜車。路線登上六日町八海山滑雪場的八海山。主要載運滑雪客，其他季節也載運登山客與賞楓遊客。路線僅在「冬季」（12月至3月）與「夏季」（5月至10月）營運。

b5e706529732f414.en: Nebuto is a white-fleshed fish of 3 to 5 cm caught mainly in the Seto Inland Sea, and is commonly called tenjikudai. It is also called "ishimochi" or "ishikaberi" because of its hard head. Because its otolith bone is larger than those of other fish, it cannot be eaten whole from the head even though it is a small fish, so the head is removed and eaten.
b5e706529732f414.zh: ねぶと是主要在瀨戶內海捕獲、長3至5公分的白肉魚，一般稱為天竺鯛。因頭部堅硬，也被稱為「石持」或「いしかべり」。由於其耳石比其他魚類大，雖然是小魚，也無法連頭整條吃，因此會去頭後食用。

b5ee7cd08b7f7ccf.en: PokéPark Kanto is a Pokémon-branded theme park within Yomiuriland that opened to the public on February 5, 2026. The park is located in the Tama area. The theme park is a collaboration between The Pokémon Company and Yomiuriland. The name was chosen in reference to the fictional Kanto Region, the setting of Pokémon Red, Blue, and Yellow, which was inspired by the real-world Kantō region that Yomiuriland itself is also located in.
b5ee7cd08b7f7ccf.zh: ポケパーク カントー是位於讀賣樂園內的寶可夢主題樂園，於2026年2月5日對外開放，位於多摩地區。這座主題樂園由寶可夢公司與讀賣樂園合作設立。名稱取自虛構的關都地區，即《寶可夢 紅／藍／黃》的故事舞台；該地區以現實中的關東地方為原型，讀賣樂園本身也位於關東地方。

b5f7557fd406aab9.en: Matsura Historical Museum (松浦史料博物館, Matsura Shiryō Hakubutsukan) opened in Hirado, Nagasaki Prefecture, Japan, in 1955. The museum is housed in the 1893 Tsurugamine Mansion of the Matsura family, former daimyō of the Hirado Domain.
b5f7557fd406aab9.zh: 松浦史料博物館於1955年在日本長崎縣平戶市開館。博物館設於松浦家1893年建造的鶴ヶ峯邸內，松浦家為平戶藩的前大名。

b5fa4af2d26adca8.en: "Toridose" or Chicken porridge is a regional dish commonly consumed during special occasions such as New Year's, weddings, funerals, and community gatherings or festivals. In the past, as many households used to raise chickens, it was not only enjoyed during festive occasions but also served as a regular home-cooked meal. Additionally, "Toridose" is sometimes referred to in dialect as "Toddose," with a variation in pronunciation."Toridose" is made by chopping the bones well and mixing them into chicken balls.
b5fa4af2d26adca8.zh: 「とりどせ」即雞肉粥，是在新年、婚禮、喪禮及地方聚會或祭典等特殊場合常吃的地方料理。過去許多家庭都養雞，因此不只在喜慶場合享用，也是一般的家常菜。此外，「とりどせ」在方言中有時也因發音變化而稱為「とっどせ」。「とりどせ」的作法是將雞骨仔細剁碎，拌入雞肉丸中。

b6041ac872669edd.en: Meiseki-ji (Japanese: 明石寺) is a temple belonging to the Tendai Jimon sect, located in Seiyo City, Ehime Prefecture. Its formal mountain name is Genkōzan, and its institutional name is Enshuin. The main image is of Senju Kannon. It serves as the Temple #43rd on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage.
b6041ac872669edd.zh: 明石寺是位於愛媛縣西予市的天台寺門宗寺院。山號為源光山，院號為圓手院。本尊為千手觀音。為四國八十八所靈場第43號札所。

b60624fdb95a7ee2.en: The Mizunomori Water Botanical Garden (草津市立水生植物公園みずの森, Kusatsu Shiritsu Suiseishokubutsu Kōen Mizunomori), also known as the Kusatsu Aquatic Botanical Garden, is a botanical garden specializing in aquatic plants and best known for its extensive lotus display. Mizu-no-mori means "water forest" in Japanese.  It is located on Lake Biwa's southeastern shore on the Karasuma Peninsula in Oroshimo-cho, Kusatsu, Shiga, Japan, and open daily except Mondays. An admission fee is charged.
b60624fdb95a7ee2.zh: 草津市立水生植物公園水之森，又稱草津水生植物園，是專門栽培水生植物的植物園，以大規模的蓮花展示最為知名。「水之森」在日文中意為「水的森林」。位於日本滋賀縣草津市下物町、琵琶湖東南岸的烏丸半島，除週一外每日開放，需付費入園。

b60629001099b11b.en: The Kanaizawa Stele (金井沢碑, Kanaizawa hi) is a Nara period stele discovered in the Yamana neighborhood of the city of Takasaki, Gunma Prefecture, in the northern Kantō region of Japan.  The stele was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1921, and was raised in status to a Special National Historic Site in 1954. As one of the "Three Stelae of Kōzuke", it was submitted by Japan for inclusion into the UNESCO  Memory of the World Programme in 2017
b60629001099b11b.zh: 金井沢碑是在日本北關東地區群馬縣高崎市山名町發現的奈良時代石碑。該碑於1921年被指定為日本國家史跡，1954年升格為特別史跡。作為「上野三碑」之一，日本於2017年將其提報聯合國教科文組織世界記憶計畫。

b60ea725d62a7a4a.en: Sunshine City (サンシャインシティ, Sanshain Shiti) is a building complex located in East Ikebukuro, Toshima, Tokyo, Japan. It  consists of four buildings: the 240-meter Sunshine 60 skyscraper, which includes corporate offices and restaurants; the Prince Hotel; the World Import Mart; and the Bunka Kaikan building.  The complex sits on land once occupied by Sugamo Prison.
b60ea725d62a7a4a.zh: 太陽城（サンシャインシティ）是位於日本東京都豐島區東池袋的複合建築群，由四棟建築組成：設有企業辦公室與餐廳、高240公尺的Sunshine 60摩天大樓；王子大飯店；World Import Mart；以及文化會館。建築群所在地原為巢鴨監獄。

b60ebf4fef3b5d01.en: Kamayama Shrine (竈山神社, Kamayama jinja) is a Shinto shrine in the city of Wakayama, Wakayama Prefecture, Japan.
b60ebf4fef3b5d01.zh: 竈山神社是位於日本和歌山縣和歌山市的神社。

b61622115cbbd96a.en: Various local confections have developed in Kyoto, including rakugan, which is made by molding dough mixed with sugar and syrup in a wooden mold; wasanbon, which is made by molding high-quality wasanbon sugar in a wooden mold; and ariheito, which is made by boiling sugar and syrup together and molding it by hand. Mizunazuki" is another local confection traditionally eaten throughout the prefecture.
b61622115cbbd96a.zh: 京都發展出各種鄉土點心，包括將混合砂糖與糖漿的麵團放入木模成型的落雁、將高級和三盆糖放入木模成型的和三盆，以及將砂糖與糖漿一起熬煮後用手塑形的有平糖。「水無月」也是府內各地自古食用的鄉土點心。

b61cdff6ce63060d.en: Gifu Gokoku Shrine (岐阜護國神社, Gifu Gokoku Jinja) is a Shinto shrine located at the base of Mount Kinka in Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. The shrine is dedicated to the 37,000 residents of Gifu Prefecture who have died in wars since the Meiji Restoration. Official ceremonies are also held at the neighboring Hotel Seiran, which is part of the shrine facilities.
b61cdff6ce63060d.zh: 岐阜護國神社是位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市金華山山腳的神社。神社祭祀明治維新以來在戰爭中身亡的37,000名岐阜縣民。屬於神社設施的鄰近飯店「Hotel Seiran」也會舉行正式儀式。

b62bce0ef9733377.en: Harajiri Falls (原尻の滝, Harajiri-no-taki) is a waterfall located on the Ōno River in Ogata Town, Bungo-Ōno, Ōita Prefecture. It was selected by the Japanese Ministry of the Environment as one of the top 100 waterfalls in Japan.
b62bce0ef9733377.zh: 原尻の滝是位於大分縣豐後大野市緒方町大野川上的瀑布，獲日本環境省選為日本瀑布百選之一。

b63412c4e8a39a80.en: Hatori Dam (羽鳥ダム, Hatori damu) is a dam in Ten'ei, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. Hatori Dam is managed directly  by the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, and is intended to provide irrigation for the Shirakawa area of the Abukuma River Basin. The dam is an earth dam with a height of 37.1 meters. The reservoir created by the dam is called Lake Hatori, and has been developed as a resort area.
b63412c4e8a39a80.zh: 羽鳥ダム是位於日本福島縣天榮村的水壩，由農林水產省直轄管理，用於灌溉阿武隈川流域的白河地區。此壩為土壩，高37.1公尺。水壩形成的水庫稱為羽鳥湖，已開發為度假區。

b649bbd03dcff414.en: This is a typical local dish of Tsugaru region. There are various theories about its origin, such as that it is called "kuyu-no soup" because "ku (porridge)" is called "ke (rice porridge)" in Tsugaru dialect. It is said that chopped ingredients were eaten as if they were rice in the days when rice was precious. Some say that it has been passed down since the time of Tame-nobu, the founder of the Tsugaru Clan, about 400 years ago.
b649bbd03dcff414.zh: 這是津輕地區代表性的鄉土料理。關於其由來有各種說法，例如因為津輕方言將「粥」稱為「け」，所以稱為「粥の汁」。據說在米很珍貴的年代，人們將切碎的食材當作米飯來吃。也有人說，這道料理從約400年前津輕藩始祖為信的時代流傳至今。

b6522410d9926a9a.en: "Takomeshi" is octopus cooked with rice. Originally, fishermen would chop octopus on the boat and cook it into rice and eat it as fishermen's rice. The environment off the coast of Mihara is particularly suitable for growing octopus because of its good water quality, stable water temperature, and rocky areas with abundant bait, and octopus fishing has been popular since the Edo period. Even today, the Seto Inland Sea is one of the most important habitats for octopus.
b6522410d9926a9a.zh: 「たこめし」是章魚炊飯。起初是漁夫在船上將章魚切碎，與米一起炊煮，作為漁夫飯食用。三原外海水質良好、水溫穩定，且有餌料豐富的岩礁區，環境特別適合章魚生長，自江戶時代起章魚漁業便很興盛。至今瀨戶內海仍是章魚最重要的棲息地之一。

b67172114f7b1383.en: The Konosuke Matsushita Museum (松下幸之助歴史館, kōnosuke matsushita rekishikan; Konosuke Matsushita History Museum) is a corporate museum operated by Panasonic in Kadoma, Osaka, Japan. Until September 2008, the museum was called the Matsushita Electric Industrial History Museum (松下電器歴史館, matsushita denki rekishikan), but it was changed to its current name on October 1, 2008, to coordinate with the renaming of the company to Panasonic. The museum was temporarily closed in October 2017 and reopened in March 2018.
b67172114f7b1383.zh: パナソニックミュージアム 松下幸之助歴史館是由Panasonic營運的企業博物館，位於日本大阪府門真市。至2008年9月為止，館名為松下電器歴史館，為配合公司更名為Panasonic，於2008年10月1日改為現名。博物館於2017年10月暫時休館，2018年3月重新開館。

b673cfe783b40fc6.en: The Hayashibara Museum of Art (林原美術館, Hayashibara Bijutsukan) is an art museum owned by the Hayashibara Group, and located at 2-7-15 Marunouchi, Kita-ku, Okayama, Japan. It is on the site of a former guesthouse beside the inner moat of Okayama Castle. Its 6,832 square meter interior was designed by Kunio Maekawa.
b673cfe783b40fc6.zh: 林原美術館是林原集團所有的美術館，位於日本岡山市北區丸之內2-7-15，建於岡山城內護城河旁的舊迎賓館原址。館內面積6,832平方公尺，由前川國男設計。

b6830cc37c6e24dd.en: The Iya area of Miyoshi City is famous for soba (buckwheat noodles). It is said that when the Heike clan, defeated in the Genpei War, fled to Iya, they began to grow buckwheat seeds in the area. Since rice is difficult to grow in Iya, buckwheat, which is easy to grow and has a short growing season, has become a staple food. Iya soba is a local dish representative of the Iya region. Made with 100% local buckwheat flour, it is the soul food of the Iya region.
b6830cc37c6e24dd.zh: 三好市祖谷地區以蕎麥麵聞名。據說源平合戰中戰敗的平家一族逃到祖谷時，開始在當地種植蕎麥。祖谷不易種稻，容易栽培且生長期短的蕎麥因而成為主食。「祖谷そば」是祖谷地區具代表性的鄉土料理，以百分之百當地蕎麥粉製成，是祖谷地區的靈魂食物。

b692fd62bf5d815c.en: The Ōnuma no Ukishima (大沼の浮島) is a marsh located in the town of Asahi, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan, which is a nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty.
b692fd62bf5d815c.zh: 大沼の浮島是位於日本山形縣朝日町的一處沼澤，為國家指定名勝。

b69e7de76703127f.en: Sumida Triphony Hall (すみだトリフォニーホール, Sumida Torifonī Hōlu) is a concert hall in Sumida, Tokyo, Japan. It opened in 1997 and has two auditoria; the main hall, with 1,801 seats; and the small hall, with 252 seats. It is the home of the New Japan Philharmonic. Nikken Sekkei were the architects, with acoustical design by Nagata Acoustics, who tested their concept with a 1:10 model.
b69e7de76703127f.zh: すみだトリフォニーホール（すみだトリフォニーホール）是位於日本東京都墨田區的音樂廳，於1997年開幕，設有兩座表演廳：1,801席的大廳與252席的小廳。為新日本愛樂交響樂團的駐地。建築由日建設計負責，音響設計由永田音響設計負責，並以1:10模型測試其構想。

b6a3a71dcb3c80a8.en: The Ise Site (伊勢遺跡) is an archaeological site containing the traces of a large Yayoi period settlement and ritual area, located across the Ise and Amura neighborhoods of Moriyama and the Nojiri neighborhood of the city of Rittō, Shiga in the Kansai region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 2012.
b6a3a71dcb3c80a8.zh: 伊勢遺跡是保存彌生時代大型聚落與祭祀區遺跡的考古遺址，橫跨日本關西地區滋賀縣守山市的伊勢町、阿村町及栗東市的野尻。遺址於2012年被指定為日本國家史跡。

b70de6c424b39b29.en: Kameyama Hachimangū (亀山八幡宮, Kameyama Hachimangū) is a Shinto shrine located in Shimonoseki, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan. It is a Hachiman shrine, dedicated to the kami Hachiman. The kami enshrined there include Emperor Ōjin, Empress Jingū, and Emperor Chūai. It was established in 859, and has an annual festival on October 15.
b70de6c424b39b29.zh: 亀山八幡宮是位於日本山口縣下關市的神社，為供奉八幡神的八幡宮。祭神包括應神天皇、神功皇后與仲哀天皇。創建於859年，每年10月15日舉行例大祭。

b76aa1090e8eafef.en: "Heso mochi" is offered on the 15th day of August or the 13th day of September of the old calendar when the night is perfect for moon-viewing. This sweet is unique to the central and western regions of Shizuoka prefecture, located on the west of the Fuji River. Another name for this sweet is "heso dango". It is made with Joshinko(=short-grain rice flour), which is shaped into flattened "dango" (=Japanese dumpling) with a dent in the center of each piece.
b76aa1090e8eafef.zh: 「へそもち」是在舊曆8月15日或9月13日適合賞月的夜晚供奉的點心。這種甜點為靜岡縣富士川以西的中部與西部地區所特有，又稱「へそ團子」。以上新粉（短粒米磨成的米粉）製作，捏成扁平的團子，每塊中央壓出一個凹陷。

b787a01bfef0dc03.en: Lake Haruna (榛名湖, Haruna-ko) is a caldera lake. It lies near the summit of Mount Haruna, within the city limits of Takasaki, Gunma Prefecture, Japan. A former name for the lake is Lake Ikaho (伊香保沼, Ikaho-numa).
b787a01bfef0dc03.zh: 榛名湖是一座火山口湖，位於日本群馬縣高崎市境內的榛名山山頂附近。此湖舊稱伊香保沼。

b7b9384cbf4dc13b.en: The Okazaki Central General Park (岡崎中央総合公園, Okazaki Chūō Sōgō Kōen) is a park with a sports complex in Okazaki in the Aichi Prefecture, Japan.
b7b9384cbf4dc13b.zh: 岡崎中央総合公園是位於日本愛知縣岡崎市、設有綜合運動設施的公園。

b7bf9d38f7f08993.en: Tsuchizaki Shinmeisha Shrine Annual Celebration And The Float Festival ("土崎神明社例祭", "土崎神明社祭の曳山行事") is a Japanese festival celebrated from 20 to 21 July in Tsuchizaki (Tsuchizakiminato), the port area of Akita City, Akita Prefecture, Japan.
b7bf9d38f7f08993.zh: 土崎神明社例祭及曳山行事（「土崎神明社例祭」、「土崎神明社祭の曳山行事」）是7月20日至21日在日本秋田縣秋田市港區土崎（土崎港）舉行的日本祭典。

b7d66b8bbcf5ccd2.en: Bamboo shoots, which signal the arrival of spring, are in season from March to May. They grow rapidly and quickly turn into bamboo, making fresh bamboo shoots a rare spring delicacy enjoyed for only a limited time. However, preserved bamboo shoots, such as those in water, are available throughout the year, and it is a familiar ingredient on Japanese dining tables.
b7d66b8bbcf5ccd2.zh: 報知春天到來的竹筍，產季在3月到5月。竹筍生長迅速，很快就會長成竹子，因此新鮮竹筍是只能在短暫期間享用的珍貴春季美味。不過水煮竹筍等保存用的竹筍一年四季都買得到，是日本餐桌上常見的食材。

b7dbbac1b2c85318.en: It is a simple local confectionery with the texture of a mochi rice cake, and the flavor of yuzu and miso. The more you chew it, the more delicious it gets. Yubeshi, yuzu cake, is a Japanese confectionery found throughout Japan, but in this region, it is wrapped in bamboo bark and steamed. The antibacterial properties of the bamboo bark are used as a preservative.
b7dbbac1b2c85318.zh: 這是一種樸素的鄉土點心，口感像麻糬，帶有柚子與味噌的風味，越嚼越好吃。柚餅子是日本各地都有的和菓子，但在這個地區會用竹皮包起來蒸，利用竹皮的抗菌作用來保存。

b7e1294bbf4b61e7.en: "Akebi(=Chocolate vine)" has taken root as an indispensable local delicacy for the people of Yamagata Prefecture, with its sprouts edible in spring and its fruits in autumn. The vines are used for vine crafting and other purposes."Akebi(=Chocolate vine)" cultivation became popular in Yamagata Prefecture in the 1970s and 1980s. "Akebi(=Chocolate vine)" grown in Tendo City was well received in the Kanto region, and its cultivation began in earnest.
b7e1294bbf4b61e7.zh: 木通在山形縣人心中已扎根為不可或缺的鄉土美味，春天可食用嫩芽，秋天可食用果實。藤蔓則用於藤編工藝等用途。1970至1980年代，山形縣興起木通栽培。天童市種植的木通在關東地區獲得好評，栽培也隨之正式展開。

b7f0814acd9fb807.en: "Kashiwa (=chicken meat)" has long been a favorite dish in Aichi Prefecture. Poultry farming in Aichi Prefecture began in the late Edo period (1603-1868), and developed into the famous "Nagoya Cochin" in the early Meiji period (1868-1912). Poultry farming in Aichi Prefecture has continued to flourish to the present day. As a result, there are many chicken dishes in Aichi Prefecture.
b7f0814acd9fb807.zh: 「かしわ（雞肉）」長久以來在愛知縣廣受喜愛。愛知縣的養雞業始於江戶時代（1603-1868）後期，明治時代（1868-1912）初期發展出知名的「名古屋交趾雞」。愛知縣的養雞業至今依然興盛，因此愛知縣有許多雞肉料理。

b7f4409ddd5b3479.en: The Ohitayama Tatara Ironworks (大板山たたら製鉄遺跡, Ōitayama tatara seitetsu iseki)  was a premodern steelworks for the production of tatara steel located in the Shibuki neighborhood of the town of Hagi, Yamaguchi Prefecture in the San'yō region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 2012.
b7f4409ddd5b3479.zh: 大板山たたら製鉄遺跡是一處前近代以たたら製鐵法生產鋼鐵的製鐵所，位於日本山陽地方山口縣萩市紫福。2012年被指定為日本國家史跡。

b81094525ff31f9d.en: The Ōtsuka-Saikachido Site (大塚・歳勝土遺跡, Ōtsuka-Saikachido iseki) is an archaeological site located in the Nakagawa neighborhood of Tsuzuki-ku, Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture, in the southern Kantō region of Japan. The site contains traces of a Yayoi period settlement trace and was designated a National Historic Site in 1986.
b81094525ff31f9d.zh: 大塚・歳勝土遺跡是一處考古遺址，位於日本關東地方南部神奈川縣橫濱市都筑區中川。遺址保有彌生時代的聚落遺跡，於1986年被指定為國家史跡。

b8286ce9328234bd.en: Yuzu production is particularly active in Nakacho, Tokushima. The town is particularly suited for yuzu cultivation due to its abundant precipitation and the large temperature difference between daytime and nighttime, and boasts the second largest production of "Kitou Yuzu" in Japan (Tokushima Agricultural Support Center, "Kitou Yuzu" production area initiative). In addition, “Kitou yuzu” is relatively large, beautifully colored, and of high quality.
b8286ce9328234bd.zh: 德島縣那賀町的柚子生產特別興盛。該町雨量豐沛、日夜溫差大，特別適合種植柚子，「木頭柚子」的產量居日本第二（德島縣農業支援中心，「木頭柚子」產地的推動措施）。此外，「木頭柚子」果實較大、色澤美麗、品質優良。

b82e7447b9690dc0.en: Semba Tōshō-gū (仙波東照宮) is a Shinto shrine in Kawagoe, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. It enshrines the first Shōgun of the Tokugawa Shogunate, Tokugawa Ieyasu. It is enumerated as one of the Three Great Tōshō-gū Shrines (日本三大東照宮). The shrine was founded in 1617.
b82e7447b9690dc0.zh: 仙波東照宮是位於日本埼玉縣川越市的神社，供奉德川幕府第一代將軍德川家康，被列為日本三大東照宮之一。該神社創建於1617年。

b8438991de31517e.en: "Gonjuu" is a local dish in the southern region of Chiba Prefecture, in which pork belly and fried thin tofu are sweetened with mirin(=sweet rice wine) and soy sauce and then mixed with rice to create onigiri (rice balls). This regional specialty has been enjoyed in the area around Tateyama City for a long time.Traditionally, October of the lunar calendar has been considered a month when all the myriad gods gather in the Izumo region, and it is known as Kannazuki , the month without gods, in various parts of Japan.
b8438991de31517e.zh: 「ごんじゅう」是千葉縣南部的鄉土料理，將豬五花與油豆皮以味醂（甜米酒）和醬油調成甜味，再拌入米飯捏成飯糰。這道地方特色料理長久以來在館山市周邊地區受到喜愛。傳統上，農曆10月被認為是八百萬神明齊聚出雲地區的月份，在日本各地稱為「神無月」，即沒有神明的月份。

b85bbbe1ac1b8c7c.en: This is a local dish from Oshima, Imabari City, where the stone industry flourished in the old days. "Oshima stone" from the Miyakubo district in the northern part of the island is used for building materials and tombstones, and is known as one of the best high-grade stones in Japan. "Sekka-jiru" is a local dish that conveys the stone culture of Oshima in Imabari City. It was made in Oshima's stone quarries in the old days using stones that were close at hand.
b85bbbe1ac1b8c7c.zh: 這是今治市大島的鄉土料理，大島過去石材產業興盛。島北部宮窪地區出產的「大島石」用於建材和墓碑，是日本最優質的高級石材之一。石花汁是傳承今治市大島石材文化的鄉土料理，過去在大島的採石場以手邊的石頭製作。

b85cfc29cc327a68.en: The Former Nakagomi School (旧中込学校, kyū-Nakagomi gakkō) is a surviving Giyōfū-style building from the Meiji period located in the Nakagomi neighborhood of the city of Saku, Nagano、Japan. The building was designated a National Important Cultural Property of Japan in March 1969 and a National Historic Site of Japan in April 1969.
b85cfc29cc327a68.zh: 旧中込学校是現存的明治時代擬洋風建築，位於日本長野縣佐久市中込地區。1969年3月被指定為日本國家重要文化財，同年4月被指定為日本國家史跡。

b8a624b9282523aa.en: Hirabayashi Castle (平林城, Hirabayashi-jō) was a Sengoku period Japanese castle located in the Kamihayashi neighborhood of the city of Murakami, northern Niigata Prefecture, Japan. The castle ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1978.
b8a624b9282523aa.zh: 平林城是位於日本新潟縣北部村上市上林的戰國時代日本城郭。城跡自1978年起被指定為國家史跡加以保護。

b8f813fbbb7b3af3.en: Fujishima Shrine (藤島神社, Fujishima-jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in the city of  Fukui, Japan. In the former Modern system of ranked Shinto Shrines, it was a special shrine (別格官幣社, Bekkaku Kanpei-sha). Its main festival is held annually on August 25.
b8f813fbbb7b3af3.zh: 藤島神社是位於日本福井市的神社。在舊近代社格制度中列為別格官幣社。例祭每年於8月25日舉行。

b90e625d29313f03.en: The Saijo persimmon, produced throughout the prefecture, is the representative persimmon of Shimane Prefecture. It is often harvested in Shimane Prefecture because of the combination of the sea breeze, temperature, and red soil of the Sea of Japan. Saijo persimmons originated in the Saijo district of Higashihiroshima City in Hiroshima Prefecture and are widely spread throughout the Chugoku and Shikoku regions.
b90e625d29313f03.zh: 西條柿在全縣各地都有生產，是島根縣代表性的柿子。由於日本海的海風、氣溫與紅土等條件的結合，島根縣的柿子產量多。西條柿起源於廣島縣東廣島市的西條地區，廣泛分布於中國、四國地區。

b9962b86d023d8a8.en: INTEX Osaka (インテックス大阪, Intekkusu Ōsaka), officially known as International Exhibition Center, Osaka (大阪国際見本市会場, Ōsaka kokusai mihon-ichi kaijō), is a convention and exhibition center in Suminoe-ku, Osaka, Osaka Prefecture, Japan. The center is located on the Business Creation and Information Transmission Zone of Cosmosquare District in Sakishima Island, a planned business exchange and trading district in Osaka Bay area.
b9962b86d023d8a8.zh: インテックス大阪，正式名稱為大阪國際見本市會場，是位於日本大阪府大阪市住之江區的會議展覽中心。中心位於咲洲島宇宙廣場地區的商業創造及資訊傳播區，該地區是大阪灣一帶規劃的商業交流與貿易區。

b9acd4a2da0c9980.en: Chūzen-ji (中禅寺) is a Buddhist temple standing on the shore of Lake Chuzenji of the city of Nikkō, Tochigi Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Tendai school of Japanese Zen and its honzon is a statue of Jūichimen Senjū Kannon Bosatsu.  The temple's full name is Nikkō-san Rinaiji-betsuin Chūzen-ji (日光山 輪王寺別院 中禅寺).The temple is the 18th stop on the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route.
b9acd4a2da0c9980.zh: 中禪寺（中禅寺）是位於日本栃木縣日光市中禪寺湖畔的佛教寺院，屬日本禪宗天台宗，本尊為十一面千手觀音菩薩像。寺院全名為日光山 輪王寺別院 中禪寺。此寺為坂東三十三所巡禮路線的第18番札所。

b9cafd13ac6532a4.en: Sagiyama Castle (鷺山城, Sagiyama-jō) was a castle built in Mino Province in middle Japan during the late-Heian period (late 12th century); it was destroyed during the Sengoku period in the mid-16th century. The castle's ruins are located in the present-day city of Gifu, Gifu Prefecture. It stood at the peak of Mount Sagi, which was only 68 m (223 ft). Because the castle was built as a residence and not a defensive fortress, its location on a small mountain was of little consequence.
b9cafd13ac6532a4.zh: 鷺山城（鷺山城）是平安時代後期（12世紀後半）建於日本中部美濃國的城，於16世紀中葉的戰國時代被毀。城跡位於今岐阜縣岐阜市，原本建於高僅68公尺（223英尺）的鷺山山頂。由於此城是作為居館而非防禦要塞而建，位於小山上並無太大影響。

b9d0b202367b3588.en: The Kujukuri region is a treasure trove of food products from both the land and sea, and has long been known as a particularly good fishing ground.
