Sardines, a representative seafood of the Kujikuri region, have been caught in such large quantities since the Edo period that they are sometimes referred to as “the rice of the sea”. Being a familiar fish on Kujikuri tables, a wide variety of dishes exist to take advantage of the delicious taste and rich nutritional content of sardines.
b9d0b202367b3588.zh: 九十九里地區是山海物產的寶庫，自古以來即以特別優良的漁場聞名。九十九里地區的代表性海產沙丁魚，自江戶時代起漁獲量就很大，有時被稱為「海之米」。沙丁魚是九十九里餐桌上常見的魚，有各式各樣運用其美味與豐富營養的料理。

b9d7a1e2a27f713d.en: This local dish originated in the Urakami area of Nagasaki Prefecture.It is said to have originated in the late 1500s, when Portuguese missionaries who were proselytizing Christianity in the Urakami area tried to make the believers, who were not accustomed to eating meat at that time, eat pork as a "healthy food".
b9d7a1e2a27f713d.zh: 這道鄉土料理起源於長崎縣浦上地區。據說起源於1500年代後期，當時在浦上地區傳播基督教的葡萄牙傳教士，試圖讓當時不習慣吃肉的信徒把豬肉當作「健康食品」食用。

b9eb481a09056e64.en: Aibahama Park (藍場浜公園) is a park in Aiba-cho in Tokushima City in Tokushima Prefecture.
b9eb481a09056e64.zh: 藍場濱公園（藍場浜公園）是位於德島縣德島市藍場町的公園。

ba27857c12c1172b.en: Ojima Neputa festival is held on  August 14 and 15 every year at Ōta, Gunma, Ojima district, Japan. It is held at Ojima district's shopping street; people gather from neighborhood prefectures. More than 160,000 people participate every year within two days. Neputa Festival is one of the biggest events in Ota city.
ba27857c12c1172b.zh: 尾島ねぷた每年8月14日及15日在日本群馬縣太田市尾島地區舉行。會場為尾島地區的商店街，鄰近各縣的民眾都會前來。每年兩天內有超過16萬人參加。ねぷた祭是太田市規模最大的活動之一。

ba2b46e237124f84.en: The Rokkō Alpine Botanical Garden (六甲高山植物園, Rokkō Kōzan Shokubutsu-en) is a botanical garden located on Mount Rokkō, Kobe, Japan.
ba2b46e237124f84.zh: 六甲高山植物園是位於日本神戶市六甲山上的植物園。

ba98472df6b7e249.en: The Earth Observation Center is a Japanese Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) aeronautical research facility located in Hatoyama, Saitama, Japan. It utilizes remote sensing technologies such as satellites to study Earth's environment from outer space. The research done by this center has a substantial impact on the study of the Earth's environmental phenomena, such as global warming.
ba98472df6b7e249.zh: 地球観測センター是日本宇宙航空研究開發機構（JAXA）的航太研究設施，位於日本埼玉縣鳩山町。該中心利用衛星等遙測技術，從外太空研究地球環境。其研究對全球暖化等地球環境現象的研究有相當大的影響。

baa0a32f71406ccc.en: Matsushita Museum of Art (松下美術館, Matsushita bijutsukan) opened in Kirishima, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan, in 1983.
baa0a32f71406ccc.zh: 松下美術館（松下美術館）於1983年在日本鹿兒島縣霧島市開館。

baa43c34924bac0c.en: The Mietsu Naval Dock (三重津海軍所, Mietsu Kaigunsho) was a Bakumatsu period repair and shipbuilding facility, located in what is now the Hayatsue, Kawasoe-machi, neighborhood of the city of Saga,  Saga Prefecture Japan. Established by Saga Domain in 1858, it  also served as an educational and training institute for the operation of Western ships. It site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 2013 In 2015, it was registered as a World Heritage Site as part of the "Meiji Industrial Revolution Heritage Sites of Japan".
baa43c34924bac0c.zh: 三重津海軍所是幕末時期的船舶修理與造船設施，位於今日本佐賀縣佐賀市川副町早津江地區。1858年由佐賀藩設立，也作為操作西式船艦的教育訓練機構。其遺址於2013年指定為日本國家史跡，2015年以「明治日本的產業革命遺產」的一部分登錄為世界遺產。

baa4b2f54aac588b.en: Hakuba Happoone Winter Resort (白馬八方尾根スキー場, Hakuba Happōone Sukī-jō) is a ski resort located on Mount Karamatsu in Hakuba, Japan. For the 1998 Winter Olympics in Nagano, it hosted the alpine skiing downhill, super giant slalom, and combined slalom events.
baa4b2f54aac588b.zh: 白馬八方尾根スキー場是位於日本白馬村唐松岳的滑雪場。1998年長野冬季奧運時，在此舉行高山滑雪滑降、超級大曲道及全能項目的曲道賽事。

baa66064631b5112.en: Oden is generally served with mustard, but “Himeji Oden” is served with or without ginger soy sauce. This is the characteristic of Himeji oden, a local dish of Himeji.In Himeji, there are two types of oden: one with a thick, sweet flavor called Kanto nimono, and the other with a lighter flavor, but both are called “Himeji oden” when ginger soy sauce is used. Ginger soy sauce is made by adding grated ginger to soy sauce, and Himeji was originally a producer of ginger and soy sauce.
baa66064631b5112.zh: 關東煮一般搭配黃芥末食用，而「姬路關東煮」則是淋上或沾上薑汁醬油食用，這是姬路在地料理姬路關東煮的特色。姬路的關東煮有兩種：一種是味道濃郁偏甜、稱為關東煮物的，另一種味道較清淡，但只要使用薑汁醬油，兩者都稱為「姬路關東煮」。薑汁醬油是在醬油中加入薑泥製成，姬路原本就是生薑與醬油的產地。

babfaa54f35035b1.en: The Ina Valley in the southern part of Nagano Prefecture has a long-standing culture of eating insects, including locusts, bee larvae, cicadas, and grasshoppers. The consumption of such insects has been a tradition in the region, serving as a source of animal protein, especially in areas with limited access to seafood like mountainous regions such as Gunma Prefecture. During times of food shortages, such as during and after the war, locusts were eaten to fulfill nutritional needs and sustain life.
babfaa54f35035b1.zh: 長野縣南部的伊那谷長久以來有食用昆蟲的文化，包括蝗蟲、蜂蛹、蟬與蚱蜢等。食用這類昆蟲是當地的傳統，作為動物性蛋白質的來源，特別是在像群馬縣山區等不易取得海產的地區。在戰時及戰後等糧食短缺的時期，人們食用蝗蟲以補充營養、維持生命。

bae3fb9cc97bbdf6.en: Makabe Castle (真壁城, Makabe-jō) was a Sengoku period  "hirayama"-style castle located in the Makabe neighborhood of the city of Sakuragawa, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan. The ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1994.
bae3fb9cc97bbdf6.zh: 真壁城是戰國時代的平山城，位於日本茨城縣櫻川市真壁地區。遺跡自1994年起被指定為國家史跡。

baf92a9588ab80c5.en: Mount Kasa (笠ヶ岳, Kasa-ga-take) is one of the 100 Famous Japanese Mountains, reaching the height of 2,897 m (9,505 ft). It is situated in Japan's Hida Mountains in Gifu Prefecture and in Chūbu-Sangaku National Park. The shape of the mountain looks like the Umbrella("Kasa"-笠) in the triangle. Therefore, it became this name. There are many mountains with same name in Japan and this is the tallest.
baf92a9588ab80c5.zh: 笠ヶ岳為日本百名山之一，標高2,897公尺（9,505英尺），位於岐阜縣的飛驒山脈，屬中部山岳國立公園範圍。山形如三角形的斗笠（笠），因而得名。日本有許多同名的山，此山為其中最高者。

baff636070c651e8.en: It has long been a preserved food made during the extremely cold season to take advantage of the cold and humid climate. It is also called “Korimochi”, and made in the Tsugaru region, especially famous in Goshogawara City. In the past, frozen rice cakes that looked like a curtain hung from the eaves of houses were a midwinter tradition. The rice cakes are made by adding more water than usual, cutting them, tying them into long strips of straw.
baff636070c651e8.zh: 這是自古以來在嚴寒時期，利用寒冷潮濕的氣候製作的保存食品。又稱「凍り餅」，於津輕地區製作，以五所川原市尤其有名。過去在屋簷下像簾子一樣成排垂掛的冷凍年糕，是隆冬時節的傳統景象。年糕製作時加入比平常更多的水，切塊後以稻草綁成長串。

bb01417bfb0c7f8a.en: The Japanese horse chestnuts (“tochi”) used for “tochimochi” are so bitter that their intense taste causes a painful tingling sensation on the tongue when consumed raw. Thankfully, the wisdom and experience of our ancestors led to the invention of delicious ways to enjoy these chestnuts, and they are said to have been eaten since the Jomon era. The chestnuts were a valuable source of food in the past, since rice was scared in mountain villages.Each chestnut contains one or two nuts inside its thick shell.
bb01417bfb0c7f8a.zh: 「栃餅」所用的日本七葉樹果實（「栃」）非常苦，生吃時強烈的味道會讓舌頭產生刺痛的麻感。幸而先人的智慧與經驗發明了美味的食用方法，據說從繩文時代起就有人食用。過去山村米糧稀少，七葉樹果實是珍貴的糧食來源。每顆果實的厚殼內含有一至兩粒種子。

bb04cfcd72aa3f4e.en: Ninoshima (Japanese: 似島) is an island in the Seto Inland Sea, located near Hiroshima. Gakuen-mae pier on Ninoshima is located 4 km (2.5 mi) from Hiroshima (Ujina) Port. It takes only half an hour to get to Ninoshima from wharf 4 of Hiroshima Port (Ujina Port) by ferry. The island is 3.87 km2 (1.49 sq mi) in size, and topped with the mountain Aki-no-Kofuji (278 m). In Japanese, the mountain's name means "Little Fuji of Aki" (the former name of the Hiroshima area).
bb04cfcd72aa3f4e.zh: 似島是瀨戶內海上的島嶼，位於廣島附近。似島的學園前碼頭距離廣島（宇品）港4公里（2.5英里）。從廣島港（宇品港）4號碼頭搭乘渡輪前往似島僅需半小時。島嶼面積3.87平方公里（1.49平方英里），島上最高處為安藝小富士山（278公尺）。這座山的日文名稱意為「安藝的小富士」（安藝為廣島一帶的舊稱）。

bb080609381dcced.en: Tentoku-ji (天徳寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Izumimitakene neighborhood of the city of Akita, Akita Prefecture, Japan. It is a temple of the Sōtō school and its honzon is a statue of Sho-Kannon Bosatsu. The temple's full name is Mango-zan Tentoku-ji (萬固山 勝福寺). The temple is the bodaiji the Satake clan, daimyō of Kubota Domain in the Edo Period. Its grounds are designated an Akita Prefectural Historic Site.
bb080609381dcced.zh: 天徳寺是位於日本秋田縣秋田市泉三嶽根地區的佛教寺院，屬曹洞宗，本尊為聖觀音菩薩像。寺院全名為萬固山天徳寺（萬固山 勝福寺）。本寺為江戶時代久保田藩藩主佐竹氏的菩提寺，寺域被指定為秋田縣史跡。

bb1f2357c48ffa92.en: Ankoku-ji (安国寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Kokutai-ji branch of Rinzai school of Buddhism in Fukuyama, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. This temple was built by the priest Kakushin in 1273. Afterwards, it was revived by Ankokuji Ekei in 1579, though it remained in decline. This temple is classified as an Important Cultural Property.
bb1f2357c48ffa92.zh: 安国寺是位於日本廣島縣福山市的佛教寺院，屬臨濟宗國泰寺派。本寺由覺心禪師於1273年創建，其後於1579年由安國寺惠瓊復興，但仍持續衰微。本寺被列為重要文化財。

bb602b43cfe70665.en: Hario Island (針尾島) is a large island located in the mouth of Ōmura Bay, part of Nagasaki Prefecture, Japan. The island, 33.16 km² in area, had 9767 inhabitants as of 2015, making it the 7th largest and 6th most populous island in the prefecture. The island is dominated by Citrus unshiu plantations.
bb602b43cfe70665.zh: 針尾島是位於大村灣灣口的大島，屬日本長崎縣。島嶼面積33.16平方公里，2015年時有居民9767人，為縣內面積第7大、人口第6多的島嶼。島上以溫州蜜柑果園為主。

bb7a39db8e979bc2.en: Hikoshima (彦島) (also called Hikishima (引島) in Nihon Shoki) is an island on the south-west tip of Honshu, Japan.
bb7a39db8e979bc2.zh: 彦島（《日本書紀》中又稱引島）是位於日本本州西南端的島嶼。

bbaca276ec8c4ff7.en: Mashu Maru was a Tsugaru Maru-class ferry operated by JNR, and shortly, JR Hokkaido, before finally being taken out of service on March 13, 1988 with the opening of the undersea Seikan Tunnel.
bbaca276ec8c4ff7.zh: 摩周丸是日本國有鐵道營運的津輕丸級渡輪，後來短暫由JR北海道營運，1988年3月13日因海底青函隧道通車而退役。

bbd0e3d92da74eba.en: The Yokohama Curry Museum (横濱カレーミュージアム, Yokohama Karē Myūjiamu) was a restaurant and historic museum of curry in the Isezakichō district of the port city of Yokohama, Japan, between 2001 and 2007. Different types of curry were available from a selection or restaurants, ranging from a full meal to a quick taste option.
bbd0e3d92da74eba.zh: 橫濱咖哩博物館是2001年至2007年間位於日本港都橫濱伊勢佐木町一帶的餐廳兼咖哩歷史博物館。館內多家餐廳供應各種咖哩，從完整套餐到淺嘗的選擇都有。

bbe01e96b733c525.en: Nishime Country Park Soccer Field (由利本荘市西目カントリーパークサッカー場, Yurihonjoshi Nishime Kantori Paku Sakkajo)  is a football stadium in Nishime, Yurihonjo, Akita Prefecture, Japan. The stadium has a capacity of 4,328 and was the home ground of J3 League club Blaublitz Akita.
bbe01e96b733c525.zh: 由利本莊市西目カントリーパークサッカー場是位於日本秋田縣由利本莊市西目的足球場。球場可容納4,328人，曾為J3聯賽球隊秋田藍色閃電的主場。

bc0a3d4ac16c8f59.en: "Karaimo Netabo" is a local dish made from sweet potatoes, a specialty of Kagoshima Prefecture that is well known throughout the country. "Karaimo" means sweet potato.Kagoshima Prefecture is the largest producer of sweet potatoes in Japan. Kagoshima Prefecture is blessed with a mild climate, but most of the land, with the exception of Mount Kirishima, is a Shirasu plateau, which is very well drained.
bc0a3d4ac16c8f59.zh: 「からいもねったぼ」是以鹿兒島縣聞名全國的特產番薯製成的鄉土料理。「からいも」是番薯的意思。鹿兒島縣是日本最大的番薯產地。鹿兒島縣氣候溫和，但除了霧島山以外，大部分土地是排水性極佳的白砂台地。

bc16b2e304cb4437.en: Ojiro (小代) is an area located in Kami Town, Mikata District, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan.
bc16b2e304cb4437.zh: 小代是位於日本兵庫縣美方郡香美町的一個地區。

bc1a70ec6007a6a1.en: Tai-men is a dish featuring boiled somen noodles piled in waves on a large plate and topped with a whole boiled sea bream, garnished with prickly ash leaves, cucumber, shredded egg crepe, and salty-sweet simmered shiitake mushroom. It can also be garnished with pine branches. It is a ceremonial dish often served for special occasions such as house framing ceremonies, 77th birthdays, 88th birthdays, weddings, and ship unloading ceremonies.
bc1a70ec6007a6a1.zh: 鯛めん是將煮好的素麵以波浪狀盛放在大盤上，上面放一整條煮熟的鯛魚，並以山椒葉、小黃瓜、蛋絲及甜鹹口味的燉香菇點綴。也可用松枝裝飾。這是一道儀式性料理，常在上樑儀式、77歲壽辰、88歲壽辰、婚禮及船隻卸貨儀式等特殊場合供應。

bc3345ba277da721.en: Mitsumeno Botamochi' refers to the large rice cakes eaten three days after the birth of the first child. There is a theory that the origin of Botamochi dates back to a time when it was difficult to obtain sufficient food, when mothers were fed large Botamochi made of nutritious glutinous rice and red beans to nourish their children immediately after giving birth. It is also said that there was a custom of distributing food packed in boxes to relatives and neighbors, greeting them as the baby was born.
bc3345ba277da721.zh: 「みつめのぼたもち」是指第一個孩子出生後第三天所吃的大顆牡丹餅。關於牡丹餅的由來，有一說是在糧食難以充分取得的年代，母親生產後會吃以營養豐富的糯米和紅豆製成的大顆牡丹餅，以便哺育孩子。另有一說，過去有將食物裝入盒中分送親戚和鄰居、告知孩子誕生的習俗。

bc38e58ed8a0b0cc.en: In the Niigata prefecture where it snows heavily, 「pickled dried daikon radish」is a preserved food made to last throughout the winter. A representative dish of the Joetsu region, it is also known as 「hari hari pickles」due to the crunchy ‘hari hari’ sound it makes when eating it. However, the Niigata prefecture’s 「pickled dried daikon」 is slightly different from the「hari hari pickles 」found in other prefectures as it doesn’t use vinegar.
bc38e58ed8a0b0cc.zh: 在大雪紛飛的新潟縣，「干し大根漬け」是為了度過整個冬天而製作的保存食品。這是上越地區的代表性料理，由於吃的時候會發出「哈哩哈哩」的爽脆聲響，也稱為「はりはり漬け」。不過新潟縣的「干し大根漬け」不使用醋，與其他縣的「はりはり漬け」略有不同。

bc3d1bf762afbf17.en: Shōfuku-ji (正福寺) is a Buddhist temple located on Mount Sashiro in the city of Kasama, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Shingon-shū Fumon sect and its honzon is a statue of Senjū Kannon Bosatsu (Sahasrabhūja).  The temple's full name is Sashiro-zan Shōfuku-ji (佐白山  正福寺).The temple is the 23rd stop on the 33-temple Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route. It is also called the "Sashiro Kannon".
bc3d1bf762afbf17.zh: 正福寺是位於日本茨城縣笠間市佐白山的佛教寺院，屬於真言宗普門派，本尊為千手觀音菩薩像。寺院全名為佐白山正福寺。本寺為坂東三十三所巡禮路線的第23番札所，也稱為「佐白觀音」。

bc3f1ff7694f9ef1.en: Saitama Prefecture has a well-established wheat culture and has produced a variety of manju(buns). Tokorozawa City, in particular, used to be a field crop area, mainly for wheat, potatoes, and tea, with wheat being a typical winter crop. Wheat is a crop that is sown in late fall and harvested in late June of the following year. Therefore, new wheat with a particularly fragrant aroma was available during the Bon Festival. “Ude-manju" was made using this new wheat.
bc3f1ff7694f9ef1.zh: 埼玉縣小麥文化根基深厚，發展出多種饅頭。尤其所澤市過去是以小麥、薯類和茶為主的旱作地區，小麥是代表性的冬季作物。小麥於晚秋播種，隔年6月下旬收成，因此盂蘭盆節時能取得香氣特別濃郁的新麥。「うでまんじゅう」就是用這種新麥製作的。

bc61ae8405eb2411.en: The Matsuyama Central Park Baseball Stadium (松山中央公園野球場, Matsuyama Chūō Kōen Yakyūjō) is a multi-purpose stadium in Matsuyama Central Park, Matsuyama, Ehime, Shikoku, Japan.  It is currently used mostly for baseball matches.  The stadium holds 30,136 people.
bc61ae8405eb2411.zh: 松山中央公園野球場是位於日本四國愛媛縣松山市松山中央公園內的多功能體育場，目前主要用於棒球比賽，可容納30,136人。

bc74e18412a5bcf8.en: Kyoto Saga University of Arts (京都嵯峨芸術大学, Kyoto saga geijutsu daigaku) is a private university in Ukyo-ku, Kyoto, Kyoto, Japan. The school first opened as a junior college in 1971 and became a four-year college in 2001.
bc74e18412a5bcf8.zh: 嵯峨美術大学（京都嵯峨藝術大學）是位於日本京都府京都市右京區的私立大學。學校於1971年以短期大學開辦，2001年成為四年制大學。

bc826b5c732daed6.en: Ochagai" or "Ochagayu" is rice cooked with tea. It is said to have originated as a way to save rice in the closing days of the Tokugawa shogunate, when Naomasa Nabeshima, the 10th lord of the Saga Domain, who was suffering from financial difficulties, issued a frugal and thrifty decree that "not even a grain of rice should be wasted.
bc826b5c732daed6.zh: 「お茶がい」或「お茶がゆ」是用茶煮成的粥。據說起源於幕府末期，為財政困難所苦的佐賀藩第10代藩主鍋島直正頒布了「一粒米也不可浪費」的勤儉節約令，人們為了節省米而開始這樣煮食。

bcb67c042a1d0afe.en: This is a list of notable Shinto shrines in Japan. There are tens of thousands of shrines in Japan. Shrines with structures that are National Treasures of Japan are covered by the List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines). For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the See also section.
bcb67c042a1d0afe.zh: 本條目為日本著名神社列表。日本有數萬座神社。擁有國寶建築的神社收錄於日本國寶列表（神社）。其他國家的神社請參見下方「參見」一節。

bcb6825d4c4f98cd.en: The Ryūkoku Museum (龍谷ミュージアム) is a museum of Buddhist art and history in Kyōto, Japan. Conceived as part of the 370th anniversary celebrations of the foundation of what is now Ryūkoku University, it opened facing Nishi Hongan-ji in 2011. The museum displays works from its "vast" collection and there is also a digital recreation of the corridor of Cave 15 at Bezeklik. The façade has four thousand ceramic louvers, intended to give a feeling of traditional Kyōto while also helping regulate light and temperature within.
bcb6825d4c4f98cd.zh: 龍谷博物館是位於日本京都的佛教美術與歷史博物館。本館作為現今龍谷大學創立370週年紀念活動的一部分而構想，於2011年在西本願寺對面開館。館內展出其「龐大」館藏中的作品，並有柏孜克里克第15窟迴廊的數位重現。建築外觀設有四千片陶製百葉，用意在營造傳統京都的氛圍，同時協助調節館內的光線與溫度。

bce300012b2935ad.en: Yamashiro Onsen (山代温泉, Yamashiro onsen) is a hot spring resort in the city of  Kaga, Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan. It is one of the largest in the three prefectures which constitute the Hokuriku region of Japan.
bce300012b2935ad.zh: 山代溫泉是位於日本石川縣加賀市的溫泉鄉，為構成日本北陸地區的三縣中規模最大的溫泉鄉之一。

bcf2e0fcc9162863.en: Egoma (=Perilla) is actively produced in Fukushima, and local dishes using Egoma are often served. "Juunen" means Egoma, and the origin comes from the fact that the Egoma seeds can be preserved for 10 years. ("Juunen" means 10 years in Japanese.) It is expected to lower neutral fats and LDL cholesterol, and famous as a healthy food, too. There are various dishes using "Juunen", but the one often eaten in summer is "Juunen Hiyadare". It is a cold udon noodle dipping into sauce made from grated "Juunen", miso, sugar and soy sauce to eat.
bcf2e0fcc9162863.zh: 福島盛產荏胡麻（紫蘇籽），常見使用荏胡麻的鄉土料理。「じゅうねん」指的就是荏胡麻，名稱由來是荏胡麻的種子可保存10年（「じゅうねん」在日文中意為10年）。荏胡麻被認為有助於降低中性脂肪與LDL膽固醇，也以健康食品聞名。使用「じゅうねん」的料理有很多種，夏天常吃的是「じゅうねん冷やだれ」，做法是將冷烏龍麵沾取以磨碎的「じゅうねん」、味噌、砂糖和醬油調成的醬汁食用。

bd194069a0ec9716.en: Ishikawa Prefectural Museum of Art (石川県立美術館, Ishikawa Kenritsu Bijutsukan), also known as IPMA, is the main art gallery of Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan. It is one of Japan's many museums which are supported by a prefecture.
bd194069a0ec9716.zh: 石川県立美術館（簡稱IPMA）是日本石川縣的主要美術館，為日本眾多由縣政府支持的博物館之一。

bd2d3b09b9514ec4.en: Shikoku Karst Prefectural Natural Park (四国カルスト県立自然公園, Shikoku Karusuto kenritsu shizen-kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Ehime Prefecture, Japan.
bd2d3b09b9514ec4.zh: 四國喀斯特縣立自然公園（四国カルスト県立自然公園）是位於日本愛媛縣的縣立自然公園。

bd3b572a54f0d2b3.en: Ōdaka Castle (大高城, Ōdaka-jō) was a Sengoku period flatland-style Japanese castle located in what is now part of Midori Ward of the city of Nagoya, Aichi in the Tōkai region of Japan. The ruins, together with that of the detached fortresses of Marune-toride (丸根砦跡) and Washizu-toride (鷲津砦跡) have been collectively protected as a National Historic Site since 1944.
bd3b572a54f0d2b3.zh: 大高城是戰國時代的平城式日本城郭，位於今日本東海地方愛知縣名古屋市綠區一帶。遺跡與支城丸根砦跡、鷲津砦跡，自1944年起共同被指定為國家史跡。

bd4035ae39d243f3.en: Tokushima Prefectural Buried Cultural Properties Research Centre (徳島県立埋蔵文化財総合センター, Tokushima kenritsu maizō bunkazai sōgō sentā) opened in Itano, Tokushima Prefecture, Japan, in 1995. The collection includes a dōtaku excavated in Yano, Tokushima City which has been designated an Important Cultural Property. Publications include an Annual Bulletin (since 1989) and Research Reports (No.84 in 2014).
bd4035ae39d243f3.zh: 徳島県立埋蔵文化財総合センター於1995年在日本德島縣板野開館。館藏包括在德島市矢野出土、被指定為重要文化財的銅鐸。出版品有年報（自1989年起）及調查報告書（2014年出版第84號）。

bd5d4cad4f9eb4e3.en: “Gane" is a local dish made from sweet potatoes, a specialty of Kagoshima Prefecture. Kagoshima Prefecture is the number one producer of sweet potatoes in Japan. Although Kagoshima Prefecture is blessed with a mild climate, most of the prefecture, with the exception of Mount Kirishima, is on the Shirasu Plateau, which is very well drained, but is prone to crop damage caused by frequent typhoons.
bd5d4cad4f9eb4e3.zh: 「がね」是以鹿兒島縣特產番薯製成的鄉土料理。鹿兒島縣是日本番薯產量第一的縣。鹿兒島縣氣候溫和，但除了霧島山以外，縣內大部分位於排水性極佳的白砂台地，且常因頻繁的颱風造成農作物受損。

bd648d86e6978bd4.en: Okara, a byproduct of tofu production, is eaten in many parts of Japan and is called variously "Unohana", "Kirazu", "Kara", "Kasu", and "Otama". The name "kirizushi" is derived from "kirizushi," which means that it does not need to be cut with a knife when cooking. Also, dishes using "kirizushi" were served at wedding celebrations as a good luck charm, with the hope of "never breaking the marriage bond".Kirazu mochi is a local sweet made from this bean curd.
bd648d86e6978bd4.zh: 豆渣是製作豆腐的副產品，日本各地都有食用，名稱有「卯の花」「きらず」「から」「かす」「おたま」等。「きらず」之名源自烹調時不需用刀切。此外，使用「きらず」的料理也在婚禮上作為吉祥之物供應，寓意「婚姻之緣永不斷」。きらずもち是以豆渣製成的鄉土點心。

bd65c477d1eef8ed.en: The Suō Provincial Capital site (周防国衙跡, Suō Kokuga ato) is an archaeological site consisting of the ruins of the Nara period to early Heian period Provincial Capital of Suō Province, located in the Kokuga, Keigo and Katsuma neighborhoods of the city of Hōfu, Yamaguchi in the San'yō region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1937.
bd65c477d1eef8ed.zh: 周防国衙跡是一處考古遺址，為奈良時代至平安時代初期周防國國府的遺跡，位於日本山陽地方山口縣防府市的国衙、警固、勝間一帶。該遺址於1937年被指定為日本國家史跡。

bd6a4333c1144a3d.en: In the Yamato Kogen region, the day marking the beginning of rice planting is called "Sabiraki", and on this day, people create "Fukidawara" and offer it on household altars, praying for a bountiful harvest. Since it is made on the day of the start of rice planting, it is also called "Sabiraki Gohan" or "Daizu Gohan." The use of butterbur leaves for wrapping imparts a delightful fragrance to the dish. The soybeans cooked with rice symbolize the wish for the beans to grow large and abundant.
bd6a4333c1144a3d.zh: 在大和高原地區，開始插秧的日子稱為「さびらき」，這一天人們會製作「ふき俵」供奉在家中的神龕，祈求豐收。由於是在開始插秧當天製作，也稱為「さびらきご飯」或「大豆ご飯」。以蜂斗菜葉包裹，為料理帶來宜人的香氣。與米一起炊煮的大豆，寄託了希望豆子長得又大又多的心願。

bd6b822798b98bc2.en: The Kyushu Ceramics Museum (九州陶磁文化館, Kyūshū Toji Bunkakan) is a  museum located in Arita town, Saga Prefecture, Japan. It is one of Japan's many museums which are supported by a prefecture.
bd6b822798b98bc2.zh: 佐賀縣立九州陶磁文化館是位於日本佐賀縣有田町的博物館，為日本眾多由縣政府支持的博物館之一。

bd84decec89068ac.en: The Former Nate-juku Honjin (旧名手宿本陣, Kyū-Nate-juku honjin) is a  surviving Edo Period honjin complex located in the city of Kinokawa, Wakayama Prefecture in the Kansai region of Japan. Three of the buildings of the complex (the main building and two warehouses) have been designated National Important Cultural Properties and the entire complex was designated a National Historic Site in 1970.
bd84decec89068ac.zh: 舊名手宿本陣是現存的江戶時代本陣建築群，位於日本關西地區和歌山縣紀之川市。建築群中有三棟建築（主屋及兩棟倉庫）被指定為國家重要文化財，整個建築群並於1970年被指定為國家史跡。

bd876a4db450287f.en: Kyoto Prefecture has the “Tango” Mountains in the north, the” Tamba” Mountains in the center, and a low mountain range of less than 1,000 m. Most of the Nantan area from Nakatan to Nantan is mountainous. The Tamba Mountains are interspersed with “Satoyama”villages, and rivers of all sizes, including the Katsura River, flow between the mountains.
bd876a4db450287f.zh: 京都府北部有丹後山地，中部有丹波山地，為標高未滿1,000公尺的低矮山脈。從中丹到南丹的南丹地區大部分為山地。丹波山地中散布著「里山」村落，包括桂川在內的大小河川流經山間。

bdd11fa9f53b14a3.en: In Shimane Prefecture, the production of dry foods and preserved foods has been passed down from generation to generation. Daikons (Japanese radishes), especially those harvested from autumn to winter, have come to be made into dried daikons as a preserved food because there are not many vegetables that can be harvested in the spring after the winter. There are a lot of variations in the way daikons are stored. For example, in the Oki area, thick daikon is broken into four pieces and hung on the eaves to make dried daikon.
bdd11fa9f53b14a3.zh: 島根縣代代傳承著製作乾貨與保存食品的做法。由於冬季過後的春天可採收的蔬菜不多，蘿蔔（日本白蘿蔔），尤其是秋季到冬季採收的蘿蔔，便被製成蘿蔔乾作為保存食品。蘿蔔的保存方式有許多變化，例如在隱岐地區，會將粗大的蘿蔔分成四塊，掛在屋簷下製成蘿蔔乾。

bdf2c472723e5688.en: Because Chiba Prefecture produces a large amount of vegetables, they are boiled in sugar and made into a snack that can be preserved for a long period of time, known as "Tenmondou." "Tenmondou" was originally a Chinese herbal medicine made by blanching tubers of lilies, leaving the outer skin and drying them, and it is said that the name came from the medicine "Tenmondou" that was pickled in honey for one to two months and was expected of being a cough suppressant and nourishing.Citrus fruits, and Root ginger, boiled in honey and dried were the main ingredients, but over time a variety of vegetables were used.Fibrous vegetables such as burdock root, and lotus root are cut into thin slices and boiled once. If the vegetables have scum, boil them and drain, then put in the water again, add the sugar, and simmer slowly until reduce liquid . It is said that they made a lot of this food, stored it in large cans, and used it as a snack during the busy farming season to give them energy to work in the fields.Because it can be preserved for up to 10 months without the use of preservatives, it has been widely popular among farmers as a preserved food. In Togane City, "Tenmondo" is produced by effectively utilizing various agricultural products according to the season such as "yuzu," which originated from the hand-planted tangerines of Ieyasu Tokugawa, and other crops taking advantage of the city's multi-product production area.
bdf2c472723e5688.zh: 由於千葉縣蔬菜產量大，人們將蔬菜以糖熬煮，製成可長期保存的點心，稱為「てんもんどう」。「てんもんどう」原是一種中藥，將百合科植物的塊根汆燙後留下外皮曬乾製成；據說名稱來自以蜂蜜醃漬一至兩個月、被期待具有止咳與滋補功效的藥物「天門冬」。原本主要材料是以蜂蜜熬煮後曬乾的柑橘類和生薑，後來逐漸使用各種蔬菜。將牛蒡、蓮藕等富含纖維的蔬菜切成薄片先煮過一次。若蔬菜有澀味，煮過後瀝乾，再重新加水、加糖，慢慢熬煮至收汁。據說人們會大量製作，存放在大罐子裡，在農忙時期當作點心補充下田工作的體力。由於不使用防腐劑也能保存長達10個月，作為保存食品廣受農家喜愛。東金市利用身為多品項產地的優勢，依季節有效運用各種農產品製作「てんもんどう」，例如源自德川家康親手種植之橘子的「柚子」等作物。

be00486ca1f6999b.en: Fukushima Castle (福島城, Fukushima-jō) was a castle located on the Kiso river in Kiso, Nagano, Japan.
be00486ca1f6999b.zh: 福島城是位於日本長野縣木曾町木曾川畔的城。

be01fde2aab87854.en: “Myogabochi” is a local confection with a simple flavor made by wrapping bean paste made from broad beans in a skin made from wheat flour, then wrapping it in myoga leaves.Bochi refers to “mochi,” and in general, dumplings made with glutinous rice are called “mochi.” Around the area where myogabochi is tradition, however, kneaded wheat flour is called “bochi.”It’s said that each household would make myogabochi during early summer, when the leaves of myoga ginger grow lush, and enjoy them as a snack during breaks from rice planting and other agricultural tasks. In the past they were also known as “field planting bochi (tanue bochi)” or “field break bochi (nokyuumi bochi).”The myoga leaves essential for making myogabochi have antimicrobial properties, making them suitable as portable snacks during the perishable early summer to summer season. This reflects the wisdom of our ancestors from an era before refrigeration and food preservation devices were available. Additionally, the broad beans used for the bean paste contain iron and protein, making it an ideal snack for replenishing energy and healing fatigue during agricultural work.
be01fde2aab87854.zh: 「みょうがぼち」是以麵粉製成的外皮包入蠶豆做的豆餡，再用茗荷葉包裹而成、風味樸實的鄉土點心。「ぼち」指的是「餅」，一般用糯米做的糰子稱為「餅」，但在傳承みょうがぼち的地區，揉製的麵粉稱為「ぼち」。據說在茗荷葉生長茂盛的初夏，家家戶戶都會製作みょうがぼち，在插秧等農務的休息時間當作點心食用。過去也稱為「田植えぼち」或「野休みぼち」。製作みょうがぼち不可或缺的茗荷葉具有抗菌作用，適合在食物容易腐壞的初夏至夏季作為攜帶用點心，展現了沒有冰箱和食品保存設備時代先人的智慧。此外，豆餡使用的蠶豆含有鐵質與蛋白質，是農務期間補充體力、消除疲勞的理想點心。

be04fc3578b8ec9c.en: “Gane” is a traditional dish from Minamikyushu of Kagoshima prefecture and Miyakonojo city of Miyazaki prefecture. “Gane” means crab in the local dialect. Sweet potatoes are julienned and dipped in batter made with wheat flour. After that, the mixture is deep fried, and the finished dish resembles a crab which is how it got its name. Other ingredients such as carrots, Gobou(=Burdock root), and onions are used, and the recipe differs depending on the family that makes it.
be04fc3578b8ec9c.zh: 「がね」是鹿兒島縣南九州及宮崎縣都城市的傳統料理。「がね」在當地方言中是螃蟹的意思。將番薯切絲，沾裹以麵粉調成的麵衣，再下鍋油炸，成品形似螃蟹，因而得名。也會使用紅蘿蔔、牛蒡、洋蔥等其他食材，做法依各家庭而有所不同。

be20aa21181fbc1e.en: Tanzan Shrine (談山神社, Tanzan-jinja), also known as the Danzan Shrine, the Tōnomine Shrine (多武峯社, Tōnomine-sha) and the Tōnomine Temple (多武峯寺, Tōnomine-ji), is a Shinto shrine in Sakurai, Nara Prefecture, Japan. It is located 5 km from Ishibutai Kofun.
be20aa21181fbc1e.zh: 談山神社又稱Danzan神社、多武峯社或多武峯寺，是位於日本奈良縣櫻井市的神社，距離石舞台古墳5公里。

be47ce90925b32d6.en: Misaki Park (みさき公園) was an amusement park located in the town of Misaki in Osaka Prefecture, Japan, operated by Nankai Electric Railway Co., Ltd. The park was opened on April 1, 1957, coinciding with the 70th anniversary of Nankai Railway.
be47ce90925b32d6.zh: みさき公園是位於日本大阪府岬町的遊樂園，由南海電氣鐵道股份有限公司經營。該園於1957年4月1日開園，正值南海鐵道創立70週年。

be4a0d01fa1464aa.en: Iwaki Kōgen Prefectural Natural Park (岩木高原県立自然公園, Iwaki Kōgen kenritsu shizen-kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in southwest Aomori Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1958, the park lies wholly within the municipality of Hirosaki.
be4a0d01fa1464aa.zh: 岩木高原縣立自然公園是位於日本青森縣西南部的縣立自然公園，設立於1958年，範圍全部位於弘前市境內。

be963c4c56185f23.en: The ~Kawaguchiko~ Mt. Fuji Panoramic Ropeway (~河口湖~ 富士山パノラマロープウェイ, ~Kawaguchi-ko~ Fujisan Panorama Rōpuwei), is a Japanese aerial lift line in Fujikawaguchiko, Yamanashi, operated by Fuji Kyuko. Opened in 1959, the line climbs Mount Tenjō from the shores of Lake Kawaguchi, one of the Fuji Five Lakes. The observatory has a view of the lake, as well as Aokigahara forest, and Mount Fuji.
be963c4c56185f23.zh: 〜河口湖〜 富士山パノラマロープウェイ是位於山梨縣富士河口湖町的空中纜車路線，由富士急行經營。1959年啟用，從富士五湖之一的河口湖畔登上天上山。展望台可眺望河口湖、青木原樹海及富士山。

bee80a1bf042c2f1.en: Takkoku-no-Iwaya (達谷窟) is a Tendai sect Buddhist temple in Hiraizumi in southern Iwate Prefecture in the Tōhoku region of Japan. Its main image is a stone image of Bishamon-ten. Its formal name is the Takkoku no Iwaya Bishamon-do (達谷窟毘沙門堂). The grounds have been designated a National Historic Site since 2005
bee80a1bf042c2f1.zh: 達谷窟是位於日本東北地方岩手縣南部平泉的天台宗佛寺。本尊為石造毘沙門天像。正式名稱為達谷窟毘沙門堂。寺域自2005年起被指定為國家史跡。

bf19ebf565e6899e.en: Atera Seven Falls (阿寺の七滝, Atera-no-nana-taki) is a waterfall in the city of Shinshiro, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. It has been protected as both a Place of Scenic Beauty and Natural Monument since 1934.  The waterfalls was named one of "Japan’s Top 100 Waterfalls", in a listing published by the Japanese Ministry of the Environment in 1990.
bf19ebf565e6899e.zh: 阿寺の七滝（Atera-no-nana-taki）是位於日本愛知縣新城市的瀑布，自1934年起被指定為名勝及天然紀念物。1990年日本環境省公布的「日本瀑布百選」中，此瀑布名列其中。

bf5278b9a6505c26.en: Sakado Castle (坂戸城, Sakado-jō) was a Sengoku period yamajiro-style Japanese castle located in the Muikamachi neighborhood of the city of Minamiuonuma, Niigata Prefecture, in the Hokuriku region of Japan. The ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1979.
bf5278b9a6505c26.zh: 坂戸城是日本北陸地區新潟縣南魚沼市六日町的戰國時代山城式日本城郭。遺址自1979年起被指定為國家史跡加以保護。

bf563450c16444c8.en: In Kanazawa City, which once upon a time prospered as a castle town, specialty vegetables have been passed down since the feudal era. In order to hand down these locally-rooted vegetables to future generations, Kanazawa City has established a certification system for “Kaga vegetables” and is working to popularize and promote them.Kaga vegetables are defined as those which were cultivated before 1945 and are still being cultivated today in Kanazawa City.
bf563450c16444c8.zh: 昔日作為城下町繁榮的金澤市，自藩政時代起便傳承著特產蔬菜。為了將這些扎根於當地的蔬菜傳承給後代，金澤市建立了「加賀蔬菜」認證制度，致力於推廣與普及。加賀蔬菜的定義是1945年以前即已栽培、且至今仍在金澤市栽培的蔬菜。

bf5d48cd7729eee4.en: The Shiwaku Kinbansho (塩飽勤番所) is the former government office of the Shiwaku Islands in the Seto Inland Sea under the Tokugawa shogunate of Edo period Japan. It is located in the city of Marugame, Kagawa on the island of Honjima, and is now a museum exhibiting the history of the Shiwaku navy.  The site has been designated by the central government as a National Historic Site since 1970.
bf5d48cd7729eee4.zh: 塩飽勤番所是日本江戶時代德川幕府治下瀨戶內海塩飽諸島的舊官署。位於香川縣丸龜市本島，現為展示塩飽水軍歷史的博物館。自1970年起被中央政府指定為國家史跡。

bf6496247f67245d.en: Katsuyama Castle (勝山城, Katsuyama-jō), also known as Katsuyama Goten (勝山御殿, Katsuyama-goten) was a Japanese castle located in the city of  Shimonoseki, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan.The castle is a natural stronghold utilizing Mount Katsuyama, which is 400 meters above sea level.
bf6496247f67245d.zh: 勝山城又稱勝山御殿，是位於日本山口縣下關市的日本城郭。此城利用海拔400公尺的勝山而建，為天然要塞。

bf72ab928bb0a355.en: Shimonoseki City Museum of History (下関市立歴史博物館, Shimonoseki Shiritsu Rekishi Hakubutsukan) is a public museum that opened in Shimonoseki, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan, in 2016.
bf72ab928bb0a355.zh: 下関市立歴史博物館是2016年於日本山口縣下關市開館的公立博物館。

bf76cff50d1416fa.en: Bungo-Mori Roundhouse (Japanese: 豊後森機関庫, Hepburn: Bungo-Mori-Kikanko) was a railway roundhouse located to the east of Bungo-mori Station on the Kyūdai Main Line in Kusu, Ōita Prefecture, Japan.
bf76cff50d1416fa.zh: 豊後森機関庫是位於日本大分縣玖珠町、久大本線豐後森站東側的鐵路扇形車庫。

bf76fe2cf9a58073.en: Kongō-ji (金剛寺) is a Buddhist temple in Kawachinagano, Osaka, Japan. It is the head temple of the Shingon Omuro sect. and also known under its mountain-name as  Amanosan Kongō-ji (天野山 金剛寺). It is the 7th temple on the Shin Saigoku 33 Kannon Pilgrimage (新西国三十三箇所) and is notable for the large number of designated cultural properties. The precincts of the temple were designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1934 with the area under protection expanded in 2011.
bf76fe2cf9a58073.zh: 金剛寺是位於日本大阪府河內長野市的佛教寺院，為真言宗御室派的大本山，山號全名為天野山金剛寺。本寺是新西國三十三所觀音巡禮的第7號札所，以擁有大量指定文化財而聞名。寺域於1934年被指定為日本國家史蹟，2011年擴大保護範圍。

bf7773666f23baba.en: Takenoko jiru(Bamboo shoot soup) is a miso soup that uses Nemagari bamboo. It is a regional dish eaten in the Hokushin Region and Niigata Prefecture's Joetsu region. Nemagari bamboo is the young shoot of the sasa bamboo called "chimazasa" and is picked in mountainous regions. Because the bamboo shoots can be picked only during the short period at the height of early summer, these bamboo shoots arrive on the market in small quantities and are scarce and difficult to obtain.
bf7773666f23baba.zh: たけのこ汁（竹筍湯）是使用根曲竹的味噌湯，是北信地區與新潟縣上越地區食用的鄉土料理。根曲竹是一種名為「チシマザサ」的細竹的嫩筍，在山區採摘。由於只能在初夏盛產的短暫期間採摘，這種竹筍上市量少，稀少且不易取得。

bf81cd19537caced.en: Somayama Castle (杣山城, Somayama-jō) was a Kamakura period yamashiro-style Japanese castle located in the town of Nanjō (now part of the town of Minamiechizen), Fukui Prefecture in the Hokuriku region of Honshu, Japan. The ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1934, with the area under protection expanded in 1979.
bf81cd19537caced.zh: 杣山城是鎌倉時代的山城式日本城郭，位於日本本州北陸地方福井縣南條町（今南越前町）。遺址自1934年起被列為國家史跡，1979年擴大保護範圍。

bf84ea06eb3fe036.en: “Nishin Zuke” (pickled herring) is a local dish that conveys the history of the herring industry in Hokkaido. From the late Edo period (around 1750) to the Meiji period (1868 - 1912), the herring fishery in Hokkaido, especially on the Sea of Japan side, was at the height of its prosperity. In spring, when large schools of herring come to the coast to spawn (which is called “Kuki”), the sea is often seen to be dyed white.
bf84ea06eb3fe036.zh: 「ニシン漬け」（醃鯡魚）是傳承北海道鯡魚產業歷史的鄉土料理。從江戶時代後期（約1750年）到明治時代（1868－1912年），北海道的鯡魚漁業，尤其是日本海一側，處於鼎盛時期。春季大批鯡魚群來到沿岸產卵（稱為「群来」），海面常被染成白色。

bf8b400a211de04a.en: Mine Onsen, also known by the name of the public bathhouse facility, Odoriko Onsen, is a geothermal hot spring located in Daifunto park, Kawazu, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. The hot springs are accessible from Tokyo on the Odoriko or the Super View Odoriko  train lines.
bf8b400a211de04a.zh: 峰温泉又以公共浴場設施名稱「踊り子温泉」為人所知，是位於日本靜岡縣河津町大噴湯公園的溫泉。從東京可搭乘踊り子號或Super View踊り子號列車前往。

bfd32584b1d2e44a.en: Takayama Castle (高山城, Takayama-jō) was a Japanese castle located in the city of Takayama, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. The castle was built on a mountain nearly 687 m (2,254 ft) in height and had many typical castle features, including a stone base, earthen walls and a surrounding moat.
bfd32584b1d2e44a.zh: 高山城是位於日本岐阜縣高山市的日本城郭。城建於將近687公尺（2,254英尺）高的山上，具備許多典型的城郭特徵，包括石垣、土牆及環繞的護城河。

bfd6ba526f27132a.en: "Donko" is another name for the brown hakeling, a fish that is in season from fall to winter. It is mainly landed in Ishinomaki and Kesennuma ports in Miyagi Prefecture, and its catch has been decreasing year by year. The fish has a large mouth and a swollen belly that becomes narrower towards the tail. According to local beliefs, it is a lucky fish that helps people save money, as it is hard to get a lot in through the big mouth and out through the small buttocks.
bfd6ba526f27132a.zh: 「どんこ」是褐擬鱈的別名，這種魚的盛產期在秋季到冬季。主要在宮城縣的石卷港與氣仙沼港卸貨，漁獲量逐年減少。這種魚嘴巴大，腹部鼓起，往尾部逐漸變細。依當地的說法，大嘴進得多、小屁股出得少，因此被視為能幫人存錢的吉祥魚。

c000791bd1bbb3a3.en: Futago-ji (両子寺) is a Tendai Buddhist temple in Kunisaki, Ōita Prefecture, Japan. It is located on the slopes of Mount Futago (両子山, Futagosan), the highest mountain on the Kunisaki Peninsula.
c000791bd1bbb3a3.zh: 両子寺是位於日本大分縣國東市的天台宗佛教寺院，坐落於國東半島最高峰兩子山的山坡上。

c00ddfe046ce407f.en: The  Hiratsuka Kawazoe Site (平塚川添遺跡, Hiratsuka Kawazoe iseki) is an  archaeological site with the traces of a late Yayoi to early Kofun period settlement, located in the Hiratsuka neighborhood of the city of Asakura, Fukuoka Prefecture in Japan. It was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1994.
c00ddfe046ce407f.zh: 平塚川添遺跡是位於日本福岡縣朝倉市平塚地區的考古遺址，留有彌生時代後期至古墳時代前期的聚落遺跡，於1994年被指定為日本國家史跡。

c033da9e136ac46d.en: The Shōka-dō  (松花堂) is a hermitage built in the early Edo period, located in the city of Yawata, Kyoto, Japan. It was designated as a National Historic Site in 1957 under the name "Shōka-dō and its ruins" and its gardens were designated a National Place of Scenic Beauty under the name "Shōka-dō and Shoin Garden" the same year.
c033da9e136ac46d.zh: 松花堂是建於江戶時代初期的草庵，位於日本京都府八幡市。1957年以「松花堂及其遺址」之名被指定為國家史跡，同年其庭園以「松花堂及書院庭園」之名被指定為國家名勝。

c03b4ce53fc1f7ac.en: The vegetarian dish "Nigome" is made with diced and boiled azuki beans, daikon radish, carrots, dried shiitake mushrooms, burdock root, lotus root, taro, deep-fried tofu, and konjac. No meat or fish is used in the ingredients or broth. The western part of the prefecture is called "Aki no Kuni" and has many Jodo Shinshu followers, who were named "Aki followers". Shinran Shonin, the founder of the Jodo Shinshu sect, passed away on January 16th, which is celebrated as "Goshoiki".
c03b4ce53fc1f7ac.zh: 素食料理「煮ごめ」是將紅豆，以及切丁煮熟的白蘿蔔、紅蘿蔔、乾香菇、牛蒡、蓮藕、芋頭、油豆腐和蒟蒻一起烹煮而成。食材和湯底都不使用肉類或魚類。縣的西部稱為「安藝國」，有許多淨土真宗信徒，被稱為「安藝門徒」。淨土真宗的開山祖師親鸞聖人於1月16日圓寂，這一天被作為「御正忌」紀念。

c04aef6ba1ac3a29.en: Kishibe tile kiln ruins (吉志部瓦窯跡, Kishibe Kawara-gama ato) is an archaeological site consisting of the remains of Heian period kilns located in what is now the Kishibe-kita neighborhood of the city of Suita, Osaka Prefecture in the Kansai region of Japan.  It has been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 1971.
c04aef6ba1ac3a29.zh: 吉志部瓦窯跡是位於日本近畿地方大阪府吹田市今岸部北一帶的考古遺址，由平安時代的窯址遺跡構成。自1971年起由中央政府列為國家史跡加以保護。

c04e4e22a855fbd5.en: Tōchō-ji (東長寺) is a Shingon temple in Hakata, Fukuoka, Japan. Its honorary sangō prefix is Nangakuzan (南岳山). It was founded by Kūkai in 806, making it the oldest Shingon temple on the island of Kyushu.
c04e4e22a855fbd5.zh: 東長寺是位於日本福岡市博多的真言宗寺院，山號為南岳山。806年由空海創建，是九州最古老的真言宗寺院。

c05e8fd21351afaf.en: “Yatara” is a mixture of finely chopped vegetables and pickles, similar to a “furikake” (sprinkles) of summer vegetables. It is a local dish eaten mainly in the Hokushin region and is a popular summer dish. Summer vegetables such as myoga ginger, eggplant, botan pepper, and miso-pickled radish are chopped, mixed together, and served over warm rice. “Botan pepper ” is a green pepper than has been cultivated in the Hokushin region such ancient times, and is said to have been named botan pepper because it looks like a peony flower.
c05e8fd21351afaf.zh: 「やたら」是將蔬菜與醃菜切碎混合而成，類似夏季蔬菜做成的「香鬆」。這是主要在北信地區食用的鄉土料理，也是受歡迎的夏季菜色。將茗荷、茄子、ぼたんこしょう、味噌醃蘿蔔等夏季蔬菜切碎後拌在一起，放在溫熱的白飯上食用。「ぼたんこしょう」是北信地區自古栽培的青椒，據說因外形像牡丹花而得名。

c062a5506a0b75e0.en: Iwakiri Castle (岩切城, Iwakiri-jō) was a Muromachi period Japanese castle located in what is now the ward of Miyagino-ku, in the city of Sendai, Miyagi Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan. The site has been protected as a National Historic Site since 1982. It was also referred to as Takamori Castle (高森城, Takamori-jō) The castle was home castle of Rusu clan.
c062a5506a0b75e0.zh: 岩切城是室町時代的日本城堡，位於今日本東北地方宮城縣仙台市宮城野區。1982年起受指定為國家史跡保護。又稱高森城。此城為留守氏的居城。

c06406761eedc51c.en: Sennyo-ji (千如寺) is a Shingon temple in Itoshima, Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan. Its honorary sangō prefix is Sennyo-ji Daihiō-in (千如寺大悲王院). It is also referred to as Raizan Kannon (雷山観音).
c06406761eedc51c.zh: 千如寺是位於日本福岡縣糸島市的真言宗寺院，山號為千如寺大悲王院，又稱雷山觀音。

c0781c2589836569.en: Kahou dango (rice dumpling) is a confectionery dish offered on December 24th (November 24th in Japan's lunisolar calendar) for a folk event called "Daishiko." In the past, when Buddhist teacher Kobo Daishi stayed at a farmhouse of the poor, he was served dango made by the family and found that there was straw inside rice dumplings. There is a tale that says Kobo Daishi was not upset at this whatsoever, and instead went on to preach about kindness and hospitality towards others.
c0781c2589836569.zh: 果報だんご（米糰子）是在12月24日（日本陰陽曆的11月24日）為民俗活動「大師講」供奉的點心。相傳從前弘法大師借宿貧苦農家時，這家人端出自製的糰子，大師發現糰子裡摻有稻草。據說弘法大師對此毫不在意，反而開始宣講待人親切與款待之道。

c0b90001788698c6.en: In the past, wheat cultivation was thriving in Saitama Prefecture as a secondary crop to rice, leading to the preservation of dishes using wheat flour such as udon noodle and manju throughout the entire prefecture. Among the various types of manju that have developed rich variations in each region, one of the simplest is the "Komugi manju(=wheat manju)," also known simply as "Manju," which is made by wrapping red bean paste in wheat flour dough and steaming it.
c0b90001788698c6.zh: 過去埼玉縣盛行以小麥作為稻米的裡作，因此烏龍麵、饅頭等麵粉料理在全縣保存下來。在各地發展出豐富變化的饅頭中，最簡單的一種是「小麥まんじゅう」，也直接稱為「まんじゅう」，做法是以麵粉麵皮包入紅豆餡後蒸熟。

c0bd7b8bb961a932.en: Nomazaki Lighthouse (野間埼灯台, Nomazaki tōdai) or just Noma Lighthouse is a lighthouse  in town of Mihama, Chita District, Aichi, Japan built during the Taishō period, located on Chita Peninsula in Mikawa Bay.
c0bd7b8bb961a932.zh: 野間埼燈塔（或稱野間燈塔）是位於日本愛知縣知多郡美濱町的燈塔，建於大正時期，坐落於三河灣的知多半島上。

c0c3f4a803e83373.en: Festival Hall (フェスティバルホール) is a concert hall located in Kita-ku, Osaka, Japan. It is run by the Asahi Building Co., Ltd., a Japanese real estate company controlling properties of the Asahi Shimbun Company, and is housed in the Festival Tower, a skyscraper. The opening ceremony for the new hall was held on April 3, 2013. The new hall has 2,700 seats, the same number of seats as the original hall.
c0c3f4a803e83373.zh: フェスティバルホール是位於日本大阪市北區的音樂廳，由管理朝日新聞社旗下不動產的日本不動產公司朝日大樓股份有限公司經營，設於摩天大樓「フェスティバルタワー」內。新音樂廳的開幕典禮於2013年4月3日舉行。新廳有2,700個座位，與原本的音樂廳座位數相同。

c0e2e0feb0ec8902.en: It is said that about 800 years ago, a fallen Heike warrior who lost the battle with the Minamoto clan hid at the foot of the Higo Mountains and created and passed down this "tofu misozuke". Homemade tofu and barley miso are made using soybeans and barley grown in slash-and-burn fields in the "mountainous Gokansho (Izumi, Yatsushiro City)" area and Itsuki Village.
c0e2e0feb0ec8902.zh: 據說約800年前，在與源氏的戰役中落敗的平家落難武士藏身於肥後山麓，創造並傳承了這道「豆腐の味噌漬け」。自製豆腐和麥味噌使用的是在「五家荘山區（八代市泉町）」一帶及五木村的燒墾田中種植的黃豆和大麥。

c101dc138183e645.en: Okonomi-mura (お好み村; literally "Okonomiyaki Village") is a Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki food theme park located at 5-13 Shintenchi in Naka-ku, Hiroshima, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. It is near the east end of Hondōri and has over 25 okonomiyaki restaurants, each with a slightly different style and set of ingredients. The restaurants there use a specialty okonomiyaki sauce created especially for Okonomi-mura by Sun Foods.
c101dc138183e645.zh: お好み村（字面意思為「大阪燒村」）是以廣島風お好み焼き為主題的美食園區，位於日本廣島縣廣島市中區新天地5-13，靠近本通的東端，有超過25家お好み焼き店，每家的風格與食材組合略有不同。這裡的店家使用Sun Foods專為お好み村調製的お好み焼き醬。

c10556da1e3aaace.en: "Kanzarashi" is a traditional sweet that has been made in the entire area of Shimabara City for a long time. In the past, the common people in Shimabara couldn't afford to eat the rice, which they had to pay as taxes, and instead relied on eating crushed rice as their staple food. They ground it into rice flour that could be stored for a long time, and cooked and ate it each time. Rice flour also tends to go bad in summer. Therefore, people began to make dumplings, preserve them in spring water, and eat them.
c10556da1e3aaace.zh: 「かんざらし」是島原市全區長久以來製作的傳統甜點。過去島原的平民吃不起必須作為租稅繳納的米，改以碎米為主食。他們將碎米磨成可長期保存的米粉，每次再烹煮食用。但米粉在夏天也容易變質，因此人們開始將其做成糰子，浸泡在湧泉水中保存並食用。

c1266cdf415a2810.en: Ogaki Asanaka Stadium (大垣市浅中公園総合グラウンド陸上競技場) is an athletic stadium in Ōgaki, Gifu, Japan.
c1266cdf415a2810.zh: 大垣淺中田徑場（大垣市浅中公園総合グラウンド陸上競技場）是位於日本岐阜縣大垣市的田徑場。

c12ca3398d1a63e6.en: In Nara Prefecture, the traditional New Year's dish known as "Kaki-namasu" has been enjoyed for a long time. Kaki-namasu features a combination of daikon radish and carrot, creating a visually appealing red and white mixture symbolizing Mizuhiki (decorative Japanese cord). This color combination carries a wish for peace and harmony, harking back to the Heian period. The addition of dried persimmons to "Kaki-namasu" enhances the overall flavor with the sweetness and richness of the persimmons, resulting in a delightful vinegar-based dish.
c12ca3398d1a63e6.zh: 在奈良縣，名為「柿なます」的傳統新年料理長久以來受到喜愛。柿なます以白蘿蔔與紅蘿蔔搭配，形成象徵水引（日本裝飾繩結）的紅白配色，外觀賞心悅目。這種配色寄託了祈求平安和睦的心願，可追溯至平安時代。在「柿なます」中加入柿餅，以柿子的甜味與濃郁提升整體風味，成為一道美味的醋拌料理。

c140593e907aea95.en: Yamba Dam (八ッ場ダム, Yamba damu) is a dam in Naganohara, Agatsuma District, Gunma Prefecture, Japan. Construction began in 1967, with effective completion in October 2019 and the official opening on 1 April 2020.
c140593e907aea95.zh: 八ッ場ダム是位於日本群馬縣吾妻郡長野原的水壩。1967年開工，2019年10月實質完工，2020年4月1日正式啟用。

c145588d1d493674.en: Ehrismann Residence (Japanese: エリスマン邸) is a western-style residence built for Fritz Ehrismann, a 20th-century Swiss merchant, located at Motomachi, Naka-ku, Yokohama.
c145588d1d493674.zh: エリスマン邸是為20世紀瑞士商人Fritz Ehrismann建造的西式住宅，位於橫濱市中區元町。

c156276ac627ba03.en: This dish is prepared by spreading homemade koji miso paste onto hoba (magnolia leaves), which are then grilled. This dish is said to pair well with rice, and is also an excellent accompaniment to sake. Magnolia trees are large deciduous broad-leaved trees which can be found in mountains throughout Japan.
c156276ac627ba03.zh: 這道料理是將自製的麴味噌抹在朴葉（日本厚朴的葉子）上燒烤而成。據說很適合配飯，也是很好的下酒菜。日本厚朴是大型落葉闊葉樹，在日本各地的山區都能見到。

c176703f1c6cedb7.en: Sumitsukare is a dish served with azuki beans and rice to Inari-sama on Hatsuuma, the first horse day of February, and is made by cooking grated daikon radish and carrot with soybeans and sake lees for the Setsubun holiday. It is also eaten in Ibaraki, Tochigi, Saitama, and other prefectures in addition to Chiba Prefecture, and is called “Sumitsukare,” “Shimotsukare,” “Somotsukare,” and so on, depending on the region.
c176703f1c6cedb7.zh: すみつかれ是在2月第一個午日「初午」與紅豆飯一同供奉稻荷神的料理，在節分時將蘿蔔泥和紅蘿蔔泥與黃豆、酒粕一起煮製而成。除千葉縣外，茨城、栃木、埼玉等縣也有食用，依地區不同稱為「すみつかれ」「しもつかれ」「そもつかれ」等。

c19677aa77748915.en: Banshō-ji (万松寺) is a small temple located in Ōsu in central Nagoya, Japan.
c19677aa77748915.zh: 萬松寺是位於日本名古屋市中心大須的小寺院。

c1a63a00736e81d3.en: When talking about the traditional foods of Ishikawa Prefecture, yellowtail is indispensable. In early winter, when the thunderous sound of "Buri Okoshi" (yellowtail roar) is heard, full-scale yellowtail fishing using set nets begins in the Uchiura district of Noto. Farmed yellowtail is now common, but wild yellowtail is said to be far superior in terms of fatty flavor and firmness. The yellowtail is especially fatty during the harsh winter season, and if eaten as sashimi, it is so fatty that it even keeps away soy sauce.
c1a63a00736e81d3.zh: 談到石川縣的傳統飲食，鰤魚不可或缺。初冬時節，當「鰤起し」（鰤魚雷）的雷聲響起，能登內浦地區便正式展開以定置網捕撈鰤魚的作業。如今養殖鰤魚已很普遍，但據說野生鰤魚在油脂風味與肉質緊實度上遠勝養殖鰤魚。鰤魚在嚴冬時期特別肥美，做成生魚片食用時，油脂多到連醬油都會被排開。

c1e926212110b433.en: Kumagaya Rugby Stadium (熊谷ラグビー場), is a rugby stadium in Kumagaya, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. It is currently used mostly for rugby union matches. The stadium was built in 1991 and renovated between 2016 and 2018. Its capacity expanded from 20,000 (10,000 seated) to 24,000 (fully seated). The stadium is part of a larger sports complex which includes the Kumagaya Athletic Stadium, a smaller athletics stadium and a large arena. The complex is located in the Kumagaya Park.
c1e926212110b433.zh: 熊谷橄欖球場是位於日本埼玉縣熊谷市的橄欖球場，目前主要用於聯合式橄欖球比賽。球場建於1991年，並於2016年至2018年間整修，容量由20,000人（座位10,000席）擴增為24,000人（全座席）。球場屬於一處較大的運動設施群，其中還包括熊谷田徑場、一座較小的田徑場及一座大型體育館。整個設施群位於熊谷公園內。

c1f3a8cdf48546f7.en: Kaki-chisha is a traditional Shimonoseki vegetable that used to be cultivated in each family's garden. It is a shriveled leaf vegetable with a moderate bitterness and a hint of sweetness. It is called kakichisha because the leaves are harvested by plucking them from the bottom, hence the name "kagu," which means "to pluck" in the local dialect.A local dish using kaki-chisha, a traditional local ingredient, is "chisha namasu," which is made by mixing chopped kaki-chisha with vinegared miso paste and sesame seeds.
c1f3a8cdf48546f7.zh: かきちしゃ是下關的傳統蔬菜，過去各家庭都會在自家菜園栽種。這是一種葉面皺縮的葉菜，帶有適度苦味與些許甜味。因為葉子是從下方摘取收成，而當地方言中「摘取」稱為「かぐ」，所以叫做かきちしゃ。使用這項傳統在地食材的鄉土料理是「ちしゃなます」，做法是將切碎的かきちしゃ與醋味噌及芝麻拌勻。

c20b785fa9471948.en: The Kyōnin-ji, situated in Kamogawa, Chiba Prefecture, was founded on 5 March 1281 and is one of the most important historic temples of Nichiren-shū.
c20b785fa9471948.zh: 鏡忍寺位於千葉縣鴨川市，創建於1281年3月5日，是日蓮宗最重要的歷史寺院之一。

c221a2a5b0e1913c.en: Firefly squid with vinegared miso is a dish representative of spring in Toyama. Firefly squid live in deep water, but around March they gather along the coast of Toyama Bay to spawn, and are landed only during a certain period each year. Namegawa fishing port boasts one of the largest catches in Toyama Prefecture. There are historical records that indicate that firefly squid fishing was already practiced here during the Edo period.
c221a2a5b0e1913c.zh: 醋味噌拌螢烏賊是富山春季的代表料理。螢烏賊棲息於深海，但約在3月時會聚集到富山灣沿岸產卵，每年只在特定期間上岸。滑川漁港的漁獲量為富山縣數一數二。史料顯示，江戶時代這裡就已有螢烏賊漁業。

c2227aca1716f237.en: The Okinawa Convention Center (沖縄コンベンションセンター, Okinawa Konbenshon Senta) is a multi-purpose convention center in the city of Ginowan, Okinawa Prefecture, Japan. The center was opened in 1987. It has a capacity of 5,000. It is the former home arena of the Ryukyu Golden Kings basketball team.
c2227aca1716f237.zh: 沖縄コンベンションセンター是位於日本沖繩縣宜野灣市的多功能會議中心，1987年啟用，可容納5,000人。曾是琉球黃金國王籃球隊的主場。

c25deca3acff8143.en: Hajimomoi temple ruins (土師百井廃寺跡, Hajimomoi Haiji ato) is an archeological site with the ruins of a Hakuhō period Buddhist temple located in the Hajimomoi neighborhood of the town of  Yau, Tottori prefecture,  in the San'in region of Japan. The foundations of its Japanese pagoda were designated as a National Historic Site in 1931, and the designation expanded to cover then remaining temple ruins in 1980
c25deca3acff8143.zh: 土師百井廃寺跡是一處考古遺址，有白鳳時代佛寺的遺跡，位於日本山陰地方鳥取縣八頭町土師百井地區。其佛塔基座於1931年被指定為國家史跡，1980年指定範圍擴大至涵蓋其餘寺院遺跡。

c2643f285de101f0.en: The Aichi Arts Center (愛知芸術文化センター, Aichi Geijutsu Bunka Senta) is the main venue for the performing arts in Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture, Japan.
c2643f285de101f0.zh: 愛知藝術文化中心是日本愛知縣名古屋的主要表演藝術場館。

c287f3042e507c80.en: Osaka Metropolitan University Hospital (大阪公立大学医学部附属病院, Ōsaka kouritsu daigaku igakubu fuzoku byōin) is a university hospital in Japan. It's located in Abeno-ku, Osaka, and affiliated with Osaka Metropolitan University.
c287f3042e507c80.zh: 大阪公立大学医学部附属病院是日本的大學附設醫院，位於大阪市阿倍野區，隸屬大阪公立大學。

c2898299b034f6f2.en: Pork farming began in the Tokachi region around the end of the Meiji period (around 1910), and pork has been a popular food in the region since then. Obihiro City in the Tokachi region, where the pig farming industry used to thrive, is said to be the birthplace of "Butadon (pork bowl)". Thick slices of pork dipped in a sauce seasoned with sugar and soy sauce and topped with rice, called “Butadon”, is a specialty of Obihiro City.
c2898299b034f6f2.zh: 十勝地區約在明治時代末期（1910年前後）開始養豬，此後豬肉便成為當地普遍的食物。過去養豬業興盛的十勝地區帶廣市，據說是「豚丼（豬肉蓋飯）」的發源地。將厚切豬肉沾上以砂糖和醬油調味的醬汁，鋪在白飯上，稱為「豚丼」，是帶廣市的名產。

c296b25ab91b5160.en: “Taitan of Manganji Togarashi and Jako” is a popular home-style simmered dish using Manganji Togarashi (Manganji red pepper), one of the brand products of Kyoto, and Jako (dried young sardines). "Taitan" refers to a side dish made by cooking it in such a way that the ingredients slowly soak up the soup stock. Because Manganji Togarashi is a summer vegetable, it is often served on the table in summer.
c296b25ab91b5160.zh: 「萬願寺辣椒與魩仔魚乾的炊いたん」是一道受歡迎的家常燉煮料理，使用京都品牌產品之一的萬願寺辣椒，以及じゃこ（小沙丁魚乾）。「炊いたん」是指讓食材慢慢吸收高湯的燉煮配菜。萬願寺辣椒是夏季蔬菜，因此常在夏天上桌。

c2a56e0a7bfbdf40.en: Imakumano Kannon-ji (今熊野観音寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Yamauchicho, Sennyuji, neighborhood of Higashiyama-ku, Kyoto,  Japan. It belongs to the Shingon-shū Sennyūji-ha sect of Japanese Buddhism and its honzon (central image) is a hibutsu (concealed / secret image) statue of Jūichimen Kannon.The temple's full name is Shin-Nachisan Kannon-ji (新那智山 観音寺). The temple is the 15th stop on the Saigoku Kannon Pilgrimage route.  The official temple name is Kannon-ji, but it is commonly known as "Imakumano."
c2a56e0a7bfbdf40.zh: 今熊野觀音寺是位於日本京都市東山區泉涌寺山內町的佛教寺院。屬於日本佛教真言宗泉涌寺派，本尊為十一面觀音像，是不公開的祕佛。寺院全名為新那智山觀音寺。本寺是西國觀音靈場巡禮的第15番札所。正式寺名為觀音寺，但一般通稱「今熊野」。

c2a875577c1fb289.en: Kongō Sanmai-in (金剛三昧院, Kongō Sanmai-in) is a minor temple complex on Mount Kōya in Japan, founded in 1211 by order of Hōjō Masako for posthumous soul of Minamoto no Yoritomo and renamed "Kongō Sanmai-in" in 1219 for that of Minamoto no Sanetomo.
c2a875577c1fb289.zh: 金剛三昧院是位於日本高野山的一處小型寺院建築群，1211年奉北條政子之命為源賴朝的冥福而創建，1219年為源實朝的冥福改名為「金剛三昧院」。

c2c5a869fda88809.en: “Hebo” refers to the larvae of the common Asiatic yellowjacket and other ground bees, and are also known simply as "bee larvae”. In the past, hebo was a valuable source of protein in the mountainous area stretching from Shinshu to Okumikawa, and the adults and larvae of local bees were boiled in a sweet and spicy sauce and mixed with rice to make hebo rice, hebo kanroni (hebo simmered in soy sauce, mirin, sugar, and starch syrup), and hebo gohei-mochi (hebo rice cakes).
c2c5a869fda88809.zh: 「へぼ」指的是黑胡蜂等地蜂的幼蟲，也簡稱為「蜂子」。過去在信州到奧三河一帶的山區，へぼ是珍貴的蛋白質來源，人們將當地蜂類的成蟲與幼蟲以甜辣醬汁煮過，拌入米飯做成へぼ飯，也做成へぼ甘露煮（以醬油、味醂、砂糖和麥芽糖燉煮的へぼ）和へぼ五平餅（へぼ年糕）。

c2c932b84efe9137.en: Cape Suno (洲崎, Suno-saki) is a cape on the Pacific Ocean, in the city of Tateyama, Chiba Prefecture, Japan. The cape is located at the southwestern point of Bōsō Peninsula on the island of Honshu, and marks the point between the inner and outer parts of the peninsula.
c2c932b84efe9137.zh: 洲崎是面向太平洋的海岬，位於日本千葉縣館山市。海岬位於本州房總半島的西南端，是半島內側與外側的分界點。

c2cacb7d007c1cea.en: River crab caught in clear rivers in Tottori Prefecture is used for ‘Gancha-jiru. In Tottori Prefecture, Japanese mitten crab is called ‘kawagani’ (=river crab), and it was born in the sea, grown up in the river, then back to the sea to lay eggs. It has been called by various names like ‘kawagani’ (=river crab), ‘egani’ or ‘tsugani’, and is very popular among the locals. Male crab is bigger than female one, its shell is around 80mm (about 3inches).
c2cacb7d007c1cea.zh: 「がんちゃ汁」使用在鳥取縣清澈河川中捕獲的河蟹。在鳥取縣，日本絨螯蟹被稱為「河蟹」，牠在海中出生，在河川中成長，之後再回到海中產卵。牠有「河蟹」、「えがに」、「つがに」等各種稱呼，深受當地人喜愛。公蟹比母蟹大，蟹殼約80mm（約3吋）。

c2d1f0ea41fde057.en: Shōhō-ji (正法寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Ōbaku school of Buddhism in Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It is a branch temple of Mampuku-ji in Uji, Kyoto Prefecture. The temple has many aspects of the Ōbaku school, but its building style and sacraments are in the Chinese style. Additionally, it is much larger than the average Japanese temple. The temple's official name is Kinpōzan Shōhō-ji (金鳳山正法寺).
c2d1f0ea41fde057.zh: 正法寺是位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市的黃檗宗佛寺，為京都府宇治市萬福寺的末寺。寺院具有許多黃檗宗的特色，建築樣式與儀式皆為中國風格。此外，其規模遠大於一般日本寺院。正式名稱為金鳳山正法寺。

c2eeea5dd4eb784c.en: Takachiho Town in Miyazaki Prefecture is known as a town of myths and legends. In this region, bamboo is called “kappo.” In the past, bamboo was used as a vessel to boil water and hold tea in between farm work, and also as a water bottle. It is said that its name comes from the sound it makes, “kappo-kappo,” when pouring water into it.
c2eeea5dd4eb784c.zh: 宮崎縣高千穗町以神話與傳說之鄉聞名。在這個地區，竹子被稱為「かっぽ」。過去竹子被用來當作燒水的容器、在農事空檔盛裝茶水，也當作水壺使用。據說其名稱來自往竹筒中倒水時發出的「かっぽかっぽ」聲。

c2f07e719a5e7617.en: The Hishikari mine (Japanese: 菱刈鉱山) is the largest gold mine in Isa, Kagoshima, Japan. The mine has estimated reserves of 8 million oz of gold and is being developed by Sumitomo Metal Mining.
c2f07e719a5e7617.zh: 菱刈鑛山（日文：菱刈鉱山）是日本鹿兒島縣伊佐市最大的金礦。該礦估計蘊藏800萬盎司黃金，由住友金屬礦山開發。

c2f49e1e476f2e80.en: Saikazaki (雑賀崎, Saika-Zaki) is a cape in the southern part of Wakayama, Wakayama Prefecture, and is a specially designated region by Setonaikai National Park.
c2f49e1e476f2e80.zh: 雑賀崎是位於和歌山縣和歌山市南部的海岬，為瀨戶內海國立公園的特別指定地區。

c309b7bb9748e4b5.en: Honjō Castle (本荘城, Honjō-jō) is a Japanese castle located in Yurihonjō, southern Akita Prefecture, Japan. At the end of the Edo period, Honjō Castle was home to the Rokugō clan, daimyō of Honjō Domain. The castle was also known as "Tsurumai-jō" (鶴舞城) or "Ozaki-jō" (尾崎城).
c309b7bb9748e4b5.zh: 本荘城是位於日本秋田縣南部由利本莊市的日本城郭。江戶時代末期，本荘城為本莊藩大名六鄉氏的居城。此城又稱「鶴舞城」或「尾崎城」。

c3140832740e2e9e.en: The Ōnaka site (大中遺跡, Ōnaka iseki) is an archaeological site with traces of a late Yayoi to Kofun period settlement in the town of Harima, Hyōgo Prefecture, in the Kansai region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site in 1967.
c3140832740e2e9e.zh: 大中遺跡是位於日本關西地區兵庫縣播磨町的考古遺址，留有彌生時代後期至古墳時代的聚落遺跡。該遺址於1967年被指定為國家史跡。

c31c4cdba8199d61.en: Komagatake Ropeway (駒ヶ岳ロープウェイ, Komagatake Rōpuwei) is an aerial lift line in the Kiso Mountains range, Nagano Prefecture, Japan.
c31c4cdba8199d61.zh: 駒ヶ岳ロープウェイ是位於日本長野縣木曾山脈的空中纜車路線。

c3269913f0b6073e.en: Technoport Fukui Stadium (テクノポート福井スタジアム) is a baseball stadium in Sakai, Fukui, Japan.
c3269913f0b6073e.zh: テクノポート福井スタジアム是位於日本福井縣坂井市的棒球場。

c3483657c1bbdcea.en: In the center of the prefecture, the land along the Kitakami River is flat, and various kinds of crops, like rice, wheat, barley and buckwheat, have been grown. That made the locals develop many dishes using flour made from these crops. "Hina Manju" is also called "Hana Manju" or "Hana Dango", and made from rice flour stuffed with red bean paste, then shaped like flowers, peaches, leave or rabbits. It is served with "Kirisensho" on the Girl’s festival on March 3rd. It was also served during memorial services or "Higan" equinox in some areas.
c3483657c1bbdcea.zh: 縣中央部北上川沿岸地勢平坦，種植稻米、小麥、大麥、蕎麥等各種作物，因此當地人發展出許多使用這些作物製成的粉的料理。「ひなまんじゅう」又稱「花饅頭」或「花糰子」，以米粉包入紅豆餡，再做成花、桃子、葉子或兔子的形狀。三月三日女兒節時與「きりせんしょ」一同供應。部分地區也會在法事或「彼岸」時供應。

c34a983d587c4846.en: Nozori Dam (野反ダム) is a dam located in the town of Nakanojō, Agatsuma District, Gunma Prefecture, Japan. It is a hydroelectric dam operated by Tokyo Electric Power Company. The lake created by the dam is known as Lake Nozori (野反湖, nozori-ko).
c34a983d587c4846.zh: 野反ダム是位於日本群馬縣吾妻郡中之條町的水壩，為東京電力公司營運的水力發電水壩。水壩形成的湖泊稱為野反湖。

c368c1b4cba86479.en: Saga Prefecture has a mild climate throughout the year, but in the summer it gets hot, around 30 degrees Celsius every day. At such times, a vinegared taro called "Niimoji" or "Niimoji no Vinegared Food" is very useful. This dish is made by peeling and pickling mizuimo in nihaizu or sanhaizu vinegar, and is eaten daily as an everyday summer food, and is loved by the locals as "Saga's summer taste.
c368c1b4cba86479.zh: 佐賀縣全年氣候溫和，但夏季炎熱，每天都在攝氏30度左右。這時，稱為「にいもじ」或「にいもじの酢の物」的醋漬芋莖就很好用。這道菜是將水芋去皮後，用二杯醋或三杯醋醃漬而成，作為夏季家常菜每天食用，被當地人喜愛為「佐賀的夏日滋味」。

c36c710b7e351311.en: In the Ise food culture, people used to make thick udon noodles without the time and effort to stretch them, and eat them with miso dashi (miso paste). In the Edo period (1603-1867), when Ise visits became popular, restaurants began to serve noodles that had been continuously boiled and were ready to eat after being dipped in miso dama (miso paste) so that they could be eaten at any time by visitors to the Ise Shrine.
c36c710b7e351311.zh: 在伊勢的飲食文化中，人們過去會製作不費工夫拉麵的粗烏龍麵，搭配味噌高湯（味噌醬）食用。江戶時代（1603-1867）參拜伊勢蔚為風潮，為了讓前往伊勢神宮的參拜者隨時都能食用，餐館開始供應持續煮著、沾上味噌玉（味噌醬）即可食用的麵。

c36dca2bdde25cfa.en: Inano Shrine (猪名野神社, Inano jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in the Miyamae neighborhood of the city of Itami, Hyogo Prefecture, Japan.  The shrine grounds are designated as a national historic site as part of the ruins of Sengoku period Itami Castle.
c36dca2bdde25cfa.zh: 猪名野神社是位於日本兵庫縣伊丹市宮前地區的神社。神社境內作為戰國時代伊丹城遺跡的一部分，被指定為國家史跡。

c373e93556e98b68.en: Shojin ryori (vegetarian food) is eaten mainly in the southern part of the prefecture during the higan (equinox) and obon (Bon festival) seasons in spring and fall. It is also a form of hospitality for people gathered for Buddhist memorial services. It is eaten as an offering to the Buddha and as a home-style dish.It is made by simmering several kinds of vegetables, tofu, deep-fried tofu, and fu in shiitake mushroom mash, adding shiraishi hot noodles, and thickening the mixture with kuzu flour.
c373e93556e98b68.zh: 精進料理（素食）主要在縣南部於春秋兩季的彼岸及盂蘭盆期間食用，也是招待前來參加法事者的一種方式。它既是供佛的供品，也是家常料理。做法是將數種蔬菜、豆腐、油豆腐和麩放入香菇高湯中燉煮，加入白石溫麵，再以葛粉勾芡。

c374690b44e746cd.en: The Kyoto Ryozen Gokoku Shrine (京都霊山護国神社, Kyōto Ryōzen Gokoku Jinja) is a Shinto Shrine located in Kyoto, Japan. It honors the heroes of Japan, especially from the period of the Bakumatsu period and the Meiji Restoration, most famously Sakamoto Ryōma and his associate Nakaoka Shintarō, who are buried side by side in the shrine. Within the shrine is a monument in memory of the Indian jurist Radhabinod Pal.
c374690b44e746cd.zh: 京都靈山護國神社是位於日本京都的神社，供奉日本的英雄，尤其是幕末與明治維新時期的人物，其中最著名的是坂本龍馬及其同伴中岡慎太郎，兩人並葬於神社內。神社內設有紀念印度法學家拉達賓諾德・帕爾（Radhabinod Pal）的紀念碑。

c38cdf61c6081ea5.en: Yoron Castle (与論城, Yoron jō) was a northern Ryūkyūan fortification located on the island of Yoronjima, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan.  Its ruins have been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 2025.
c38cdf61c6081ea5.zh: 與論城是位於日本鹿兒島縣與論島上的北琉球城砦。其遺跡自2025年起由中央政府列為國家史跡加以保護。

c39de476646f9c41.en: Mount Goryū (五竜岳, Goryū-dake) is a mountain in the Ushirotateyama Mountains in the Hida Mountains. The mountain body straddles Kurobe, Toyama and Ōmachi, Nagano, and the summit is mostly located on the Toyama side. It is one of the 100 Famous Japanese Mountains. It is sometimes written as Goryū-dake (五龍岳) with only "dragon" in the old font.
c39de476646f9c41.zh: 五竜岳是飛驒山脈後立山連峰中的一座山。山體橫跨富山縣黑部市與長野縣大町市，山頂大部分位於富山縣一側。為日本百名山之一。有時以舊字體的「龍」寫作五龍岳。

c3a23eea71642df9.en: Yabiji (八重干瀬; Miyako: /jaːpɨ̥ɕi/), also known as Yaebiji, Yaebise, Yaebishi, and Yapiji and appearing on some historical Western nautical charts as Providence Reef, is the largest coral reef group in Japan. Located in the Miyako Islands, it contains over 100 coral reefs. Known for being above water level several times a year, most visibly around March 3 of the lunar calendar  (around the beginning of April in the Gregorian calendar), it was made a Natural Monument of Japan in 2013.
c3a23eea71642df9.zh: 八重干瀬（宮古語：/jaːpɨ̥ɕi/），又稱Yaebiji、Yaebise、Yaebishi、Yapiji，在部分早期西方海圖上標為Providence Reef，是日本最大的珊瑚礁群。位於宮古群島，包含100多個珊瑚礁。以每年數次露出水面而聞名，其中以農曆3月3日前後（約為新曆4月初）最為明顯。2013年被指定為日本天然紀念物。

c3b1d544b66fabc1.en: A traditional food handed down in Yamato-cho, Kamimashiki County, in the Uki area, famous for its dried persimmons. With the meaning of "attracting good fortune," persimmons are in demand as gifts at the end of the year and as good luck charms for New Year's.
c3b1d544b66fabc1.zh: 流傳於宇城地區上益城郡山都町的傳統食品，當地以柿餅聞名。柿子帶有「招來好運」的含意，在年底作為贈禮以及新年的吉祥物都很受歡迎。

c3ba3b5fcbf860ce.en: Muroran curry ramen (室蘭カレーラーメン, Muroran karē rāmen) is a curry-flavored ramen noodle dish provided at many ramen restaurants in the cities of Muroran, Noboribetsu, Date, and Tōyako in Hokkaido, Japan.
c3ba3b5fcbf860ce.zh: 室蘭カレーラーメン（室蘭咖哩拉麵）是一種咖哩風味的拉麵，在日本北海道室蘭市、登別市、伊達市及洞爺湖町的許多拉麵店都有供應。

c3c0fa8407235d88.en: Ame no Io Gohan" is rice cooked with Biwa trout, a species endemic to Lake Biwa. Ame-no-io" is another name for loach trout, which come up to the lake to spawn when the rains come and the rivers rise.In 1998, "Ame no io gohan" (rice with rice) using a whole loach trout, which spawns in the fall, was selected as one of Shiga Prefecture's Intangible Folk Cultural Assets of Shiga Prefecture.
c3c0fa8407235d88.zh: 「あめのいおご飯」是用琵琶湖特有種琵琶鱒炊煮的米飯。「あめのいお」是琵琶鱒的別稱，這種魚會在下雨、河水上漲時溯河產卵。1998年，使用整條秋季產卵琵琶鱒製作的「あめのいおご飯」，被選為滋賀縣無形民俗文化財。

c3dafb4e968aa00f.en: Hillsborough was a three-decker cargo ship launched in 1783. She completed six voyages to India and China as an East Indiaman for the British East India Company (EIC) between 1784 and 1798. In 1798, she was sold to new owners and repurposed to transport convicts from England to New South Wales. After disembarking her convicts in 1799, she was employed as a whaler in the South Seas fisheries until her dismantling in 1804.
c3dafb4e968aa00f.zh: 希爾斯伯勒號（Hillsborough）是1783年下水的三層甲板貨船。1784年至1798年間，以東印度船身分為英國東印度公司（EIC）完成六趟前往印度與中國的航程。1798年售予新船東，改為從英格蘭運送囚犯至新南威爾斯。1799年讓囚犯下船後，投入南海捕鯨業，直到1804年拆解。

c3e5026394aaa9cb.en: Because Nagano Prefecture is far from the sea, marine products were processed in the area where they were landed and transported via the "salt road. There were several salt roads, including "Chikuni Kaido (from Itoigawa to Matsumoto and Shiojiri)," "Kitakuni Kaido (from Naoetsu to Oiwake (now Oiwake, Karuizawa-cho, Kitasaku-gun)," "Kitakuni Kaido (from Okazaki to Shiojiri)" and "Akiba Kaido (from Omaezaki to Shiojiri)," used to carry salt and marine products inland.
c3e5026394aaa9cb.zh: 長野縣距離海洋遙遠，海產會在上岸地區加工後，經由「鹽之道」運送。鹽之道有好幾條，包括「千國街道（從糸魚川到松本、鹽尻）」、「北國街道（從直江津到追分（現北佐久郡輕井澤町追分））」、「北國街道（從岡崎到鹽尻）」及「秋葉街道（從御前崎到鹽尻）」，用來將鹽和海產運往內陸。

c3fa3774bfc05b9a.en: Nabatake Site (菜畑遺跡, Nabatake iseki) is an archeological site with a late Jōmon period to late Yayoi period settlement located in the city of Karatsu, Saga Prefecture, Japan. Along with the Itazuke Site in Hakata-ku, Fukuoka, it is the oldest known rice-growing village site in Japan. It was designated as a National Historic Site in 1983.
c3fa3774bfc05b9a.zh: 菜畑遺跡是位於日本佐賀縣唐津市的考古遺址，為繩文時代晚期至彌生時代後期的聚落。與福岡市博多區的板付遺跡同為日本已知最古老的稻作村落遺址。1983年被指定為國家史跡。

c40a532d6276cec1.en: Gunma has a rich source of water flowing from the Tone River and long hours of sunlight, one of the longest in Japan. The area is also blessed with a rich natural environment, with elevations ranging from 10 to 1,400 meters above sea level, and the benefits of this abundance of nature have resulted in an abundance of delicious agricultural and livestock products. In the plains of Gunma Prefecture, a double cropping of rice and wheat has been widely practiced since ancient times.
c40a532d6276cec1.zh: 群馬縣有來自利根川的豐沛水源，日照時間也是日本數一數二地長。當地自然環境豐富，海拔從10公尺到1,400公尺不等，得益於豐富的自然資源，出產許多美味的農產品與畜產品。在群馬縣的平原地區，自古以來便普遍實行稻米與小麥的二期耕作。

c4105aa570cbf5ac.en: The Mimasaka area is a nature-rich area located in the northern part of Okayama Prefecture. It is known for its abundant population of wild boars and deer, contributing to a long-standing local tradition of consuming wild boar and deer meat. Particularly, wild boar dishes are famous as a winter specialty in the Mimasaka area. "Shisshi Nabe(=Wild boar hot pot) ", known as "shishi-nabe," is enjoyed by many, including local hunters and families, making it a beloved and popular dish in the region.
c4105aa570cbf5ac.zh: 美作地區是位於岡山縣北部、自然資源豐富的地區。當地以野豬與鹿的數量眾多而聞名，自古就有食用野豬肉與鹿肉的傳統。其中野豬料理是美作地區著名的冬季特色料理。「しし鍋（野豬火鍋）」深受當地獵人與家庭等許多人喜愛，是當地受歡迎的料理。

c41361699abb680d.en: Chikuzen Kokubun-ji (筑前国分寺) is a Kōyasan Shingon-shū Buddhist temple in the Kokubunji neighborhood of the city of Dazaifu, Fukuoka, Japan. Its honzon is a statue of Yakushi Nyorai. It is one of the few surviving provincial temples established by Emperor Shōmu during the Nara period (710 – 794). Due to this connection, the foundation stones of the Nara period temple overlapping the present day complex were designated as a National Historic Site in 1922.
c41361699abb680d.zh: 筑前國分寺是位於日本福岡縣太宰府市國分寺地區的高野山真言宗寺院，本尊為藥師如來像。此寺是奈良時代（710–794年）聖武天皇所設立的國分寺中少數留存至今者之一。基於此淵源，與現今寺域重疊的奈良時代寺院礎石於1922年被指定為國家史跡。

c41943f7e88ebaf2.en: Mikawa Bay is situated between the Chita and Atsumi Peninsulas in Aichi Prefecture. It has a long stretch of shallow water and is home to tidal flats such as Rokujo Lagoon and Shiogawa Tidal Flat. The cultivation of sweet potatoes on the Atsumi Peninsula has contributed to the popularity of tsukudani (food boiled in soy sauce and sugar) in coastal areas, making it possible to preserve fish for a longer time.
c41943f7e88ebaf2.zh: 三河灣位於愛知縣的知多半島與渥美半島之間，擁有綿長的淺海，並有六條潟、汐川干潟等潮間帶。渥美半島的地瓜栽培促成了佃煮（以醬油和糖熬煮的食物）在沿海地區普及，使魚類得以保存更長時間。

c41df34adabdb6d8.en: The Akita Omoriyama Zoo (秋田市大森山動物園, Akitashi Omoriyama dōbutsuen), also known as “Milve”, is a municipal zoo opened in July 1967 in the city of Akita, Akita Prefecture, Japan.  Opened in 1972, the zoo covers 15 hectares, with 114 species on display. It is accredited by the Japanese Association of Zoos and Aquariums (JAZA).
c41df34adabdb6d8.zh: 秋田市大森山動物園，又稱「Milve」，是位於日本秋田縣秋田市的市立動物園，於1967年7月開園。動物園於1972年開園，占地15公頃，展示114種動物。該園為日本動物園水族館協會（JAZA）認證會員。

c42470a7028426cf.en: Tsushima Site (津島遺跡, Tsushima Iseki)  is an archaeological site with the traces of a Yayoi period settlement, located in the Izumi neighborhood of Kita-ku, Okayama,  Okayama Prefecture, in the San'yō region of Japan. It was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1971, with the area under protection expanded in 2002.
c42470a7028426cf.zh: 津島遺跡是位於日本山陽地方岡山縣岡山市北區伊島地區的考古遺址，留有彌生時代聚落的遺跡。1971年被指定為日本國家史跡，2002年擴大保護範圍。

c42e55e140fb36e1.en: Hotokegaura (仏ヶ浦 also 仏宇多, Hotoke-ga-ura) is a series of rock formations along the sea cliffs on the west coast of Shimokita Peninsula at the entrance to Mutsu Bay in far northern Japan. These rock formations were designed a Natural Monument of Aomori Prefecture in 1934, and became further protected from April 23, 1941 as a nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty and Natural Monument, From 1968, the rock formations were also located within the borders of the Shimokita Hantō Quasi-National Park.
c42e55e140fb36e1.zh: 仏ヶ浦（亦寫作仏宇多）是位於日本最北部、陸奧灣入口處下北半島西岸海崖沿線的一系列岩石地形。這些岩石地形於 1934 年被指定為青森縣天然紀念物，並自 1941 年 4 月 23 日起作為國家指定名勝及天然紀念物受到進一步保護。自 1968 年起，這些岩石地形也劃入下北半島國定公園範圍內。

c43bfb7044ff362d.ja: 呉橋（くれはし）は、大分県宇佐市南宇佐の宇佐神宮西参道にある屋根付きの木造橋。日本百名橋の一つ。
c43bfb7044ff362d.zh: 呉橋是位於大分縣宇佐市南宇佐宇佐神宮西參道上的有頂木造橋，為日本百名橋之一。

c442bf7a0cdb20bc.en: Moriyama-juku (守山宿)  was the sixty-seventh of the sixty-nine stations of the Nakasendō highway connecting Edo with Kyoto in Edo period Japan. It was located in the present-day city of Moriyama, Shiga Prefecture, Japan.
c442bf7a0cdb20bc.zh: 守山宿是日本江戶時代連接江戶與京都的中山道六十九次中的第六十七個宿場，位於今日日本滋賀縣守山市。

c4451e4b56d98a12.en: Dōgaku-ji (童学寺) is a Zentsū-ji Shingon temple in Ishii, Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. The Heian period seated wooden statue of Yakushi Nyorai has been designated an Important Cultural Property. The temple is the second of the 20 Fudasho Bangai.
c4451e4b56d98a12.zh: 童學寺（童学寺）是位於日本德島縣石井的善通寺派真言宗寺院。平安時代的木造藥師如來坐像已被指定為重要文化財。本寺為二十番外札所的第2番。

c45aa362727c188e.en: "Gaccho" refers to small fish, approximately 10-20 cm in length, commonly caught in Osaka Bay. The term encompasses several types of fish, including "Nezumigochi" and "Hatatatenumeri." It is said that the name "Gaccho" originated in the Izumi region because these fish eagerly bite at bait. "Gaccho" is representative of the region and is commonly enjoyed as a snack. One popular dish is "karaage" (deep-fried) made from “Gaccho”, which has been a beloved snack for a long time. It has become a specialty product of the Izumi region.
c45aa362727c188e.zh: 「がっちょ」指在大阪灣常捕獲、長約10至20公分的小魚。這個名稱包括數種魚類，例如「ネズミゴチ」和「ハタタテヌメリ」。據說「がっちょ」這個名稱起源於和泉地區，因為這些魚會猛烈咬餌。「がっちょ」是該地區的代表，常被當作下酒菜享用。其中一道受歡迎的料理是用「がっちょ」做的「唐揚」（油炸），長久以來是深受喜愛的小菜，已成為和泉地區的特產。

c464fc1bc95028e2.en: Mount Neko (根子岳, Neko-dake) is a mountain in Jōshin'etsu-kōgen National Park with an elevation of 2,207 m (7,241 ft), located near Ueda and Suzaka in Nagano Prefecture, Japan. It is one of the "100 famous flower mountains of Japan" (花の百名山, Hana no hyaku meizan) because of the flowers of Parnassia palustris which bloom in September. Along with Mount Azumaya, Mount Neko is one of the Shinshu Hometown 120 Mountains (信州ふるさと120山, Shinshuu furusato hyaku ni juu san) published by The Shinano Mainichi Shimbun.
c464fc1bc95028e2.zh: 根子岳是位於日本長野縣上田市與須坂市附近、上信越高原國立公園內的山，海拔2,207公尺（7,241英尺）。因九月盛開的梅花草，名列「花の百名山」之一。根子岳與四阿山同為信濃每日新聞社出版的「信州ふるさと120山」之一。

c4686229814a5fd2.en: In the Seto Inland Sea, many kinds of shrimps can be caught in abundance.Shrimps that grow only to about 10 cm in length are called "small shrimps," and the "shiba shrimps" used in "Ebi Misosiru(=Shrimp miso soup)" are also classified as small shrimps.The Ugajinja Shrine in Toyonaka-cho, Mitoyo City, holds an annual autumn festival to give thanks for a good harvest. Known as the "doburoku festival," it is a lively event that also includes an entertainment contest.
c4686229814a5fd2.zh: 瀨戶內海可大量捕獲多種蝦類。體長只長到約10公分的蝦稱為「小蝦」，「えびみそ汁（蝦味噌湯）」所用的「芝蝦」也屬於小蝦。三豐市豐中町的宇賀神社每年舉行秋季祭典以感謝豐收，被稱為「濁酒祭」，是熱鬧的活動，還有才藝比賽。

c46b6ad22eb8e635.en: The National Ainu Museum (国立アイヌ民族博物館, Kokuritsu Ainu Minzoku Hakubutsukan) is a museum located in Shiraoi, Hokkaidō, Japan. It is situated within the grounds of Upopoy (ウポポイ), a park complex that serves as a "symbolic space for ethnic harmony". The museum's mission is "to promote a proper understanding and awareness of Ainu history and culture in Japan and elsewhere out of respect for the dignity of the indigenous Ainu people, while contributing to the creation and development of new aspects of Ainu culture".
c46b6ad22eb8e635.zh: 國立愛努民族博物館位於日本北海道白老町，坐落於ウポポイ園區內，該園區定位為「民族共生象徵空間」。博物館的宗旨是「尊重原住民族愛努人的尊嚴，促進日本國內外對愛努歷史與文化的正確理解與認識，並致力於愛努文化新面向的創造與發展」。

c47186057e987a2d.en: The Matsushiro Literary and Military School (文武学校, Bunbu gakkō) was the Han school of Matsushiro Domain under the Edo period Tokugawa shogunate. It located in the Matsushiro neighborhood of the city of Nagano in the Chūbu region of Japan. Of the over 250 han schools which existed in Japan at the end of the Edo period, it is the only one to survive in almost an intact form. The school was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1953. 205373
c47186057e987a2d.zh: 文武学校是江戶時代德川幕府體制下松代藩的藩校，位於日本中部地方長野縣長野市松代地區。在江戶時代末期日本現存的250多所藩校中，這是唯一一所幾乎完整保存下來的。1953年被指定為日本國家史跡。205373

c47aa6faa384b71a.en: “Koayu-no-sanshoni” is a dish that has been handed down since ancient times. Koayu, a specialty of Lake Biwa which can be caught from May to early August, is used to make a sweet and salty tsukudani. Koayu, moroko, gori, and other fish are used for lake fish tsukudani. Freshwater fish have a unique odor, so ginger and Japanese pepper are often boiled together to eliminate that odor. In addition, care has been taken to prevent it from falling apart while simmering, such as using starch syrup and not turning the pot over.
c47aa6faa384b71a.zh: 「小あゆの山椒煮」是自古流傳下來的料理。使用琵琶湖特產、5月至8月上旬可捕獲的小香魚，製成甜鹹口味的佃煮。湖魚佃煮使用小香魚、諸子魚、ごり等魚類。淡水魚有特有的腥味，因此常與生薑、山椒一同煮，以去除腥味。此外，燉煮時也會使用麥芽糖、不翻動鍋子等，以防魚肉散開。

c47bf9d1d6468988.en: Matsushita IMP Hall (松下IMPホール; usually shortened to IMP Hall) is a multi-purpose venue located on the second floor of the Matsushita IMP Building, in Osaka, Japan. It has a floor area of 642.96m2 and 857 movable seats. It has hosted many notable international touring artists, such as Morrissey, Night Ranger, Alice Cooper, My Chemical Romance, Linkin Park, Cheap Trick, Kansas, Iron Maiden, UFO, Green Day, Rage Against the Machine and Björk.
c47bf9d1d6468988.zh: 松下IMPホール（通常簡稱IMPホール）是位於日本大阪松下IMPビル二樓的多功能場館，樓地板面積642.96平方公尺，設有857個活動座位。曾有許多知名國際巡演藝人在此演出，包括Morrissey、Night Ranger、Alice Cooper、My Chemical Romance、Linkin Park、Cheap Trick、Kansas、Iron Maiden、UFO、Green Day、Rage Against the Machine及Björk。

c4a372fdb87f80b5.en: Mount Yūbari (夕張岳, Yūbari-dake) is a mountain of the Yūbari Mountains. It is located on the border of Minamifurano, Yūbari, Hokkaido, Japan.
c4a372fdb87f80b5.zh: 夕張岳是夕張山地的一座山，位於日本北海道南富良野與夕張的交界處。

c4a4ef31ea450e1c.en: Lake Yogo (Japanese: 余呉湖, Hepburn: Yogo-ko) is freshwater lake in Nagahama, Shiga Prefecture, Japan.
c4a4ef31ea450e1c.zh: 余吳湖是位於日本滋賀縣長濱市的淡水湖。

c4b623fa9d0ca731.en: Mount Tomi (富山, Tomi-san) is a mountain on the border of the city of Minamibōsō, in southern Chiba Prefecture. The mountain is formed by two peaks. The north, called Konpira Peak, is 349.5 m (1,147 ft), and the south, called Kannon Peak, is 342 m (1,122 ft). Mount Tomi is one of the
c4b623fa9d0ca731.zh: 富山（とみさん）是位於千葉縣南部南房總市境內的山。此山由兩座山峰構成，北峰稱金比羅峰，高349.5公尺（1,147英尺）；南峰稱觀音峰，高342公尺（1,122英尺）。富山是

c4c19d3f92367ef3.en: The Oshirakawa Dam is a rock-fill dam on the Oshirakawa River (a tributary of the Shō River) about 16 km (9.9 mi) southwest of Shirakawa in Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It was constructed between 1961 and 1963. The dam has an associated 66.3 MW hydroelectric power station located about 7.1 km (4.4 mi) downstream which was commissioned in 1963.
c4c19d3f92367ef3.zh: 大白川水壩（大白川ダム）是位於日本岐阜縣白川村西南約16公里（9.9英里）、建於大白川（庄川支流）上的堆石壩，於1961年至1963年間興建。水壩附設一座66.3百萬瓦的水力發電廠，位於下游約7.1公里（4.4英里）處，於1963年啟用。

c4d85efef1c3081e.en: The Botanic Garden, Faculty of Science, Kanazawa University (金沢大学理学部附属植物園, Kanazawa Daigaku Rigakubu Fuzoku Shokubutsuen) is a botanical garden operated by Kanazawa University. It is located at the university's Kakuma Campus in Kakuma-machi, Kanazawa, Ishikawa, Japan.
c4d85efef1c3081e.zh: 金澤大學理學部附屬植物園是由金澤大學經營的植物園，位於日本石川縣金澤市角間町的該校角間校區。

c4dd2350941cb96e.en: In the northern parts of Iwate Prefecture, where the climate is cold and unsuitable for rice farming, different types of millets such as Japanese barnyard millet, foxtail millet and buckwheat are grown. Due to this, many types of traditional dishes using millets were born. The “Hechoko Dango” is made with millets such as sorghum flour, glutinous millet flour and sticky millet flour. The flour is rolled into ball shapes and then a dent is made with your index finger, creating a small indentation in each ball.
c4dd2350941cb96e.zh: 岩手縣北部氣候寒冷，不適合種植稻米，因此栽種稗、小米、蕎麥等各種雜糧，也因而發展出許多使用雜糧的傳統料理。「へっちょこだんご」以高粱粉、糯黍粉、糯小米粉等雜糧製成。將粉糰搓成圓球後，用食指壓出凹痕，使每顆糰子都有一個小凹洞。

c4dee99369add496.en: This dish is made by stewing tofu with the head of a grilled eel. It appears in the Kamigata rakugo "Yusanbune" and it's thought that even the general population from ancient times were familiar with this dish.The eel's head is called Hansuke. There are various theories surrounding its origin, such as one strainer of eel's head used to be sold for 50 sen (1／2 yen), so it came to be called Hansuke (han meaning half) of one yen (called ensuke).
c4dee99369add496.zh: 這道料理是將烤過的鰻魚頭與豆腐一起燉煮而成。它出現在上方落語《遊山船》中，一般認為自古以來一般民眾就很熟悉這道料理。鰻魚頭被稱為「半助」。關於名稱由來有各種說法，例如過去一篩鰻魚頭賣50錢（1/2圓），而1圓稱為「圓助」，因此就被稱為半助（半是一半的意思）。

c4e4aa23b92b9133.en: Mitaki-dera (三瀧寺) is a historic Japanese temple in the city of Hiroshima, Japan.
c4e4aa23b92b9133.zh: 三瀧寺是位於日本廣島市的歷史寺院。

c540e4095ab473c5.en: Nirengi Castle (二連木城, Nirengi-jō) was a Japanese castle in what is now the city of Toyohashi, Aichi Prefecture, during the Sengoku period.  There are no extant structures left; however, a park was built on the site where the castle once stood, and a stone monument and some explanatory signboards were erected by the city.
c540e4095ab473c5.zh: 二連木城是戰國時代的日本城池，位於今愛知縣豊橋市。城內建築已無留存，但城址上建有公園，市府並設置了石碑及數面解說牌。

c54ce0055eda698d.en: Gokuraki-ji (極楽寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the former Esahi District of what is now the city of Kitakami,  in Iwate Prefecture in the far northern Tōhoku region of Japan, located at the base of the 244 metres (801 ft) Mount Kunimi. The temple belongs to the Shingon sect and its main image is a statue of Amida Nyōrai. Gokuraku-ji is currently managed by Michio Shito. Michio Shito also practices in Anraku-ji l ocated in Inascho, Kitakami.
c54ce0055eda698d.zh: 極楽寺是位於日本最北部東北地方岩手縣北上市舊江刺郡地區的佛寺，坐落於海拔244公尺（801英尺）的國見山山腳。該寺屬真言宗，本尊為阿彌陀如來像。極楽寺目前由Michio Shito管理，Michio Shito也在北上市稻瀨町的安樂寺修行。

c5561acfbbc17fc5.en: Yabuhara-juku (藪原宿, Yabuhara-juku) was the thirty-fifth of the sixty-nine stations of the Nakasendō, as well as the third of eleven stations on the Kisoji. It is located in the present-day village of Kiso, in the Kiso District of Nagano Prefecture, Japan. Yabuhara-juku is located shortly before the Torii Pass, which was the most difficult part of the Kisoji. Presently, it is known for its omiyage, which are made out of the birch trees that grow nearby.
c5561acfbbc17fc5.zh: 藪原宿是中山道六十九宿中的第三十五宿，也是木曾路十一宿中的第三宿，位於今日本長野縣木曾郡木祖村。藪原宿位於鳥居峠之前不遠處，鳥居峠是木曾路最難走的路段。現今此地以用附近生長的樺木製成的伴手禮聞名。
