c55db0a0439bd368.en: Mount Mimuro (三室山, Mimuro-yama) is a mountain on the border of Shisō, Hyōgo Prefecture, and Wakasa, Tottori Prefecture, Japan. The height is 1,358.0 m (4,455 ft), and this mountains is the second highest mountain in Hyōgo Prefecture after Mount Hyōno.
c55db0a0439bd368.zh: 三室山是位於日本兵庫縣宍粟市與鳥取縣若櫻町交界的山，高1,358.0公尺（4,455英尺），是兵庫縣內僅次於冰之山的第二高峰。

c563037a0ccc2efa.en: Shinojima (篠島) is an inhabited island in Mikawa Bay on the Pacific coast of Japan. The island is administered as part of the town of Minamichita in Aichi Prefecture, Japan. As of 2015, the island's population was 1,653 inhabitants in 622 households. All of the island is within the borders of the Mikawa-wan Quasi-National Park.
c563037a0ccc2efa.zh: 篠島是位於日本太平洋沿岸三河灣內的有人島，行政上屬愛知縣南知多町。2015年時，島上人口為622戶、1,653人。全島位於三河灣國定公園範圍內。

c5691a7eb0123bd9.en: The Teramachi temple ruins (寺町廃寺跡, Teramachi Haiji ato) is an archaeological site with the ruins of a Hakuho period Buddhist temple located in the Mukaeda neighbourhood of what is now the city of Miyoshi, Hiroshima, in the San'yō region of Japan. The temple no longer exists, but the temple grounds were designated as a National Historic Site in 1984.
c5691a7eb0123bd9.zh: 寺町廃寺跡是一處考古遺址，保存白鳳時代佛教寺院的遺跡，位於日本山陽地區今廣島縣三次市向江田町。寺院現已不存，但寺域於1984年被指定為國家史跡。

c574fb2a412ab6be.en: The largest event of the year in Jodo Shinshu Buddhism, called Hoonko, takes place from fall to New Year’s around the anniversary of sect founder Shinran’s death (November 28 in the lunar calendar, January 16 in the Gregorian calendar); in Fukui Prefecture, it is called Honkosan or Okosama. "Suko" is one of the vegetarian dishes that is given out to the people who gather for Hoonko. The ingredient aka-zuiki is the stem of yatsugashira, a type of taro, and by pickling it its red color becomes even more vibrant.
c574fb2a412ab6be.zh: 淨土真宗一年中最大的活動稱為報恩講，在宗祖親鸞的忌日（農曆11月28日、國曆1月16日）前後，從秋季持續到新年舉行；在福井縣稱為「ほんこさん」或「お講さま」。「すこ」是報恩講時分送給前來聚會者的素食料理之一。所用的食材赤芋莖是八頭（一種芋頭）的莖，經過醋漬後紅色會更加鮮豔。

c578b527cd21b428.en: " Tsukudani, " which has been eaten as a preserved food since the Edo period (1603-1868), is a Tokyo specialty named after Tsukuda Island (current Tsukuda area in Chuo-ku). When the Edo shogunate was founded, Tokugawa Ieyasu moved fishermen from Tsukuda Village in Settsu Province to Tsukuda Island at the mouth of the Sumida River, making the area the center of the fishing industry.
c578b527cd21b428.zh: 「佃煮」自江戶時代（1603-1868）起便作為保存食品食用，是以佃島（今中央區佃一帶）命名的東京特產。江戶幕府創立時，德川家康將攝津國佃村的漁民遷至隅田川河口的佃島，使該地成為漁業中心。

c59b1b4413a08207.en: Anorisaki Lighthouse (安乗埼灯台, Anorisaki tōdai) is a lighthouse on the top of Shima Peninsula in the city of Shima, Mie Prefecture, Japan.
c59b1b4413a08207.zh: 安乗埼灯台是位於日本三重縣志摩市志摩半島頂端的燈塔。

c5a0d132e2443622.en: The Wakayama Prefecture Botanical Park (和歌山県植物公園緑花センター, Wakayama-ken Shokubutsu Kōen Ryokka Sentā) is a park with botanical garden located at Higashi Sakamoto 672, Iwade, Wakayama, Japan. It is open daily except Tuesdays; an admission fee is charged.
c5a0d132e2443622.zh: 和歌山県植物公園緑花センター是設有植物園的公園，位於日本和歌山縣岩出市東坂本672。除週二外每日開放，需付費入園。

c5a8f6fee2732f6c.en: Daruma-ji (Japanese: 達磨寺, lit. 'Daruma Temple', also called Daruma-dera) is a Zen Buddhist temple in the city of Ōji in the Kitakatsuragi District, Nara Prefecture, Japan and is one of the 28 historical Sites of Prince Shōtoku.
c5a8f6fee2732f6c.zh: 達磨寺（日語：達磨寺，意為「達磨的寺」，亦讀作Daruma-dera）是位於日本奈良縣北葛城郡王寺町的禪宗寺院，為聖德太子二十八處遺跡之一。

c5ab8adc8745dacd.en: Toyama Science Museum (富山市科学博物館, Toyama-shi Kagaku Hakubutsukan) is a museum located in Toyama, Toyama Prefecture, Japan.
c5ab8adc8745dacd.zh: 富山市科學博物館是位於日本富山縣富山市的博物館。

c5e76c91c7b440fa.en: "Ise Ebi," commonly known as Japanese spiny lobster, is renowned as a luxury ingredient. However, this "Ise Ebi no Miso Soup" is a rare home-cooked dish that has been passed down through generations. It is a miso soup made with a soup stock and meat that uses "agari," which are Ise Ebi that cannot be sold normally due to missing antennae, legs, etc. The live Ise Ebi is vertically halved and further chopped into pieces. The sand sac and dorsal cord are removed, and the remaining parts are used boldly in the miso soup.
c5e76c91c7b440fa.zh: 「伊勢エビ」一般稱為日本龍蝦，以高級食材聞名。不過這道「伊勢エビの味噌汁」是代代相傳、少見的家常料理。它使用「あがり」，也就是因觸角、腳等缺損而無法正常販售的伊勢龍蝦，以其熬煮的高湯和蝦肉做成味噌湯。將活的伊勢龍蝦縱向對半切開，再切成塊，去除砂囊和背部的腸線後，其餘部分大方地放入味噌湯中。

c60147eb0c52475e.en: "Pasty" is said to be a dish introduced by the Dutch who entered and exited Dejima during the period of Japan's isolation. The original form is introduced in the cookbook "Nanban Ryorisho" (Western Cooking Book from that time,) and a recipe close to the current one is found in the later "Shiki Ryorisho" (Four Seasons Cooking Book). The name "Pasty" in Roman letters is said to originate from either the Portuguese "Pastel," meaning pie, or "Pasta," meaning dough.
c60147eb0c52475e.zh: 「パスティー」據說是鎖國時期出入出島的荷蘭人傳入的料理。其原型記載於料理書《南蠻料理書》（當時的西洋料理書），與現今接近的食譜則見於後來的《四季料理書》。羅馬字名稱「Pasty」據說源自葡萄牙語意為派的「Pastel」，或意為麵團的「Pasta」。

c6110b5fce7cdc25.en: Kamikawa Shrine (上川神社, Kamikawa jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Asahikawa, Hokkaido. Established in 1883, it is dedicated to the kami Amaterasu (天照皇大御神), Ōkuninushi (大己貴大神), Sukunabikona no Ōkami (少彦名大神), Toyoukebime (豊受姫神), Ōmononushi (大物主神), Ame-no-Kaguyama-no-Mikoto (天乃香久山神), Takeminakata (建御名方神), Emperor Ōjin as Hondawake no Mikoto (譽田分命), and others. Its annual festival is on July 21.
c6110b5fce7cdc25.zh: 上川神社是位於北海道旭川的神道神社，創建於1883年，供奉天照皇大御神、大己貴大神、少彥名大神、豐受姬神、大物主神、天乃香久山神、建御名方神、譽田分命（應神天皇）等神祇。例祭於7月21日舉行。

c611c244f1df0c3c.en: Shiba Tōshō-gū (芝東照宮) is a Tōshō-gū Shinto shrine located in the Minato ward of Tokyo, Japan.
c611c244f1df0c3c.zh: 芝東照宮（芝東照宮）是位於日本東京都港區的東照宮神社。

c65af4b8e1764904.en: “Gudakusan miso soup” is a soup with lots of ingredients such as seasonal vegetables, meat, and fish. Miso soup is so nutritious that it is said to keep the doctor away, and a bowl of miso soup a day was a source of energy throughout the day, just as it is today. By adding lots of ingredients such as radish, carrots, taro, green onions, and fried tofu, you can fill your stomach and efficiently get the nutrients from vegetables. “Suiton” has also long been a popular food in areas where wheat can be grown.
c65af4b8e1764904.zh: 「具だくさん味噌汁」是加入大量當季蔬菜、肉類、魚類等配料的湯。味噌湯營養豐富，有「讓醫生遠離」的說法，一天一碗味噌湯是一整天的活力來源，這點與現今相同。加入蘿蔔、紅蘿蔔、芋頭、蔥、油豆腐等大量配料，既能填飽肚子，也能有效攝取蔬菜的營養。在能種植小麥的地區，「すいとん」也自古就是常見的食物。

c66efb8ceb2b3ca2.en: Eggplant is in season from summer to fall, and the types grown in different regions are quite different.It is said that eggplant cultivation began in Miyagi Prefecture around 1590, during the reign of Date Masamune, the feudal lord. It is believed that an eggplant brought back from Hakata by one of Date's vassals adapted to the Tohoku climate over a long period of time and took on a unique shape.
c66efb8ceb2b3ca2.zh: 茄子的產季是夏季到秋季，各地栽種的品種差異相當大。據說宮城縣的茄子栽培始於1590年左右，即藩主伊達政宗在位期間。一般認為，伊達的一名家臣從博多帶回的茄子，經過長時間適應東北的氣候，形成了獨特的形狀。

c67606264eb2d1b0.en: “Jimami” refers to raw peanuts, and the juice from the peanuts and “nmukuji” (=potato kudzu) are mixed with water and cooked over a stove. This dish is similar to sesame tofu and has a distinct flavor. The tofu is very firm but has a smooth and thick texture. This dish is high in calories and protein and is very nutritious. The word “Jimami” comes from the word “jimame”, which means peanut (a bean that grows in the ground). This tofu has been considered valuable since the Ryukyu Dynasty and was served on special occasions.
c67606264eb2d1b0.zh: 「ジーマーミ」指的是生花生，將花生汁與「ンムクジ」（＝地瓜葛粉）加水混合後放在爐上煮製而成。這道料理類似芝麻豆腐，風味獨特。口感十分紮實，但滑順濃稠。熱量與蛋白質都很高，營養豐富。「ジーマーミ」一詞源自「地豆（じまめ）」，意思是花生（長在土裡的豆子）。這種豆腐自琉球王朝時代起就被視為珍貴之物，在特別的場合才會端上桌。

c678f6d5c2c7c540.en: Kiyomizu-dera (清水寺) is a Tendai temple in Miyama, Fukuoka, Japan. Its honorary sangō prefix is Motoyoshizan (本吉山).
c678f6d5c2c7c540.zh: 清水寺是位於日本福岡縣みやま市的天台宗寺院，山號為本吉山。

c682963d6056aced.en: The term "Kofukumame" translates to "Happiness Beans" in English. It represents a traditional Shiga Prefecture snack made with soybeans. In the agricultural setting, soybeans were cultivated in the ridges of paddy fields, and wheat was grown in the back fields for self-consumption. Currently, wheat production is increasing in Shiga Prefecture, and many recipes use wheat flour.
c682963d6056aced.zh: 「幸福豆」的英文意思是「Happiness Beans」。這是以黃豆製成的滋賀縣傳統點心。在過去的農村，黃豆種在水田的田埂上，小麥則種在後方的旱田供自家食用。目前滋賀縣的小麥產量增加，許多食譜都使用麵粉。

c68582fb969bd23c.en: Sea squirts are raised in the coastal areas of Sanriku. The main kind of sea squirts cultivated are maboya, which are lowered by attaching oyster shells to ropes and attaching sea squirt spores. They are then grown in the sea for around three years while thinning out the oyster shells, and then they are brought up to land. Miyagi Prefecture accounts for 80% of sea squirt production.Sea squirts called the “pineapples of the sea” and are known as having all five tastes: sweet, sour, salty, umami, and bitter.
c68582fb969bd23c.zh: 三陸沿岸地區養殖海鞘。主要養殖的種類是真海鞘，做法是將牡蠣殼綁在繩子上，附著海鞘的孢子後垂入海中。之後一邊疏減牡蠣殼一邊在海中養約三年，再拉上岸。宮城縣的海鞘產量占全國80%。海鞘被稱為「海中鳳梨」，以兼具甜、酸、鹹、鮮、苦五種味道而聞名。

c68d3e72cb4a5560.en: The Former Ikeda Family Gardens (旧池田氏庭園) is a Japanese landscape garden and nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty in the city of Daisen, Akita Prefecture, Japan. The garden contains a western-style mansion (now a library), which is an Important Cultural Property of Japan. The gardens are located 15 minutes by car from Ōmagari Station on the Akita Shinkansen.
c68d3e72cb4a5560.zh: 舊池田氏庭園是位於日本秋田縣大仙市的日本庭園，為國家指定名勝。園內有一棟西式洋館（現為圖書館），屬日本重要文化財。庭園距秋田新幹線大曲站車程15分鐘。

c68e21119af233f6.en: The Hirugano Botanical Garden (ひるがの湿原植物園, Hirugano Shitsugen Shokubutsuen) is a botanical garden located in the skiing region near Mount Dainichi in the Takasu area of the city of Gujō, Gifu Prefecture, Japan.
c68e21119af233f6.zh: ひるがの濕原植物園（ひるがの湿原植物園）是位於日本岐阜縣郡上市高鷲地區、大日岳附近滑雪區的植物園。

c6944ee594552e96.en: Anrakuju-in (安楽寿院) is a Buddhist temple located in the Takeda neighborhood of Fushimi, Kyoto, Japan. The temple is associated with the Imperial family of Japan, originating from a Buddhist chapel built in the eastern palace of the Toba Imperial Villa (鳥羽離宮, Toba rikyu)  in 1137. The temple houses a number of Important Cultural Properties and the tombs of Emperor Toba and Emperor Konoe are on the grounds. The temple belongs to the Shingon sect, and its honzon is a statue of Amida Nyorai.
c6944ee594552e96.zh: 安樂壽院是位於日本京都伏見竹田地區的佛教寺院。本寺與日本皇室有淵源，起源於1137年在鳥羽離宮東殿興建的佛堂。寺內收藏多件重要文化財，境內並有鳥羽天皇與近衛天皇的陵墓。本寺屬於真言宗，本尊為阿彌陀如來像。

c6a0de21b04be057.en: The Menard Art Museum (メナード美術館) is a museum located in Komaki, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. The museum was founded by the owners of Nippon Menard Cosmetic Co. and opened in 1987.
c6a0de21b04be057.zh: メナード美術館是位於日本愛知縣小牧市的美術館，由日本メナード化粧品的經營者創設，於1987年開館。

c6a6cfcf285b1506.en: Chagu Chagu Umakko (チャグチャグ馬コ) is a horse festival in Iwate Prefecture, Japan. Held on the second Saturday in June, approximately one hundred horses with colourful fittings and bells parade depart from Onikoshi Sōzen Shrine(ja) in Takizawa to Morioka Hachiman-gū. The term chagu-chagu is an onomatopoeic expression for the sound made by the horses' bells. In 1978 the festival was recorded as an Intangible Folk Cultural Property.
c6a6cfcf285b1506.zh: チャグチャグ馬コ是日本岩手縣的馬匹祭典。於6月第二個星期六舉行，約100匹配戴色彩繽紛的馬具與鈴鐺的馬，從瀧澤的鬼越蒼前神社出發，遊行至盛岡八幡宮。「チャグチャグ」是模擬馬鈴聲響的擬聲詞。1978年此祭典被記錄為無形民俗文化財。

c6ad135eff681111.en: Yunoyama Onsen (湯の山温泉), or Yunoyama Hot Springs, is a hot springs resort located near Mount Gozaisho in the town of Komono (Mie District), Mie Prefecture, Japan. The area is within the borders of the Suzuka Quasi-National Park.
c6ad135eff681111.zh: 湯の山温泉是位於日本三重縣三重郡菰野町御在所岳附近的溫泉度假區，該地區位於鈴鹿國定公園範圍內。

c6c71cb3361304df.en: “Sushiko” is a traditional dish which has been eaten by the local people, particularly those living in the northwestern part of Tsugaru, along the Sea of Japan. Glutinous rice is steamed and mixed with “Furuzuke” (=well pickled vegetables) of red shiso leaves, cabbage, and cucumbers. The dish is left to ferment to create lactic acid. During the Edo period, the land of the northwestern part of Tsugaru was cultivated for rice farming.
c6c71cb3361304df.zh: 「すしこ」是當地人食用的傳統料理，尤其是住在津輕西北部、日本海沿岸一帶的居民。將糯米蒸熟後，與紅紫蘇葉、高麗菜、小黃瓜的「古漬」（醃漬較久的蔬菜）拌勻，再放置發酵產生乳酸。江戶時代，津輕西北部的土地被開墾為稻田。

c6cfd219ca67f078.en: Daishoji-machi in Kaga City once prospered as the gateway to Daishoji Temple, one of the five Hakusan temples (Hakusan-ji's five branch temples). Kishizu" is a vegetarian dish served at Buddhist memorial services and on the occasion of Hoonko (a traditional event held around the anniversary of the death of Shinran Shonin, the founder of Jodo Shinshu).Kishizu" is a dish of delicacies from the mountains and the sea arranged in a brocade dish (the sauce is called "kishizu").
c6cfd219ca67f078.zh: 加賀市的大聖寺町過去作為白山五院（白山寺的五座分寺）之一大聖寺的門戶而繁榮。「きしず」是在佛教法事及報恩講（於淨土真宗開祖親鸞聖人忌日前後舉行的傳統活動）時供應的素食料理。「きしず」是將山珍海味盛放在錦繡器皿中的料理（其醬汁稱為「きしず」）。

c6d937ddf0d4cb06.en: "Anago sushi" is a type of sushi where eel, simmered and cut into a fillet, is placed on top of vinegared rice and brushed with a sauce called "tsume." During the Edo period, Tokyo Bay was an excellent environment for fish farming due to nutrient-rich water flowing in from various rivers. Congruent with Edo's culinary culture, which included sushi and tempura dishes featuring fish like horse mackerel and flathead grey mullet, the eel, particularly in late spring and summer, was widely enjoyed.
c6d937ddf0d4cb06.zh: 「穴子寿司」是將燉煮後切成片狀的星鰻放在醋飯上，再刷上稱為「つめ」的醬汁的壽司。江戶時代，東京灣有多條河川注入富含養分的河水，是魚類生長的良好環境。在包括以竹筴魚、鯔魚等魚類製作壽司和天婦羅的江戶飲食文化中，星鰻尤其在晚春與夏季廣受喜愛。

c6fcc1a0df454acd.en: One of Kyoto's specialties is the "Tamba Kuri (chestnut)" harvested in the Tamba region. "Tamba Kuri" does not refer to a specific variety but rather to chestnuts grown in the Tamba region. The history of these large and sweet chestnuts dates back to ancient times, with the name "Tamba Kuri" mentioned in the "Engishiki (set of ancient Japanese governmental regulations)." They were consumed among the nobility from around the Heian period.
c6fcc1a0df454acd.zh: 京都的特產之一是丹波地區採收的「丹波栗」。「丹波栗」並非指特定品種，而是指在丹波地區種植的栗子。這種大而甘甜的栗子歷史可追溯至古代，《延喜式》（日本古代的政府法令集）中就出現「丹波栗」之名，約從平安時代起就為貴族所食用。

c716d6bec1a62fb4.en: Mobility Resort Motegi (モビリティリゾートもてぎ) is a motorsport venue located in Motegi, Tochigi Prefecture, Japan. Originally Twin Ring Motegi (ツインリンクもてぎ), the venue's name came from the facility having two race tracks: a 2.493 km (1.549 mi) oval track (that is currently being demolished) and a 4.801 km (2.983 mi) road course. It was built in 1997 by Honda Motor Co., Ltd., as part of the company's effort to bring the Championship Auto Racing Teams series to Japan, helping to increase their knowledge of American open-wheel racing.
c716d6bec1a62fb4.zh: モビリティリゾートもてぎ是位於日本栃木縣茂木町的賽車場。原名ツインリンクもてぎ，名稱來自場內有兩條賽道：一條2.493公里（1.549英里）的橢圓賽道（目前正在拆除）與一條4.801公里（2.983英里）的公路賽道。賽車場由本田技研工業於1997年興建，是該公司將CART系列賽引進日本的計畫之一，有助於增進其對美式開輪賽車的了解。

c72ee87efc0c10ae.en: Fuki (butterbur) grows wild in fields and mountains throughout Japan, from Hokkaido to Okinawa, and has been eaten since the Heian period. Most of the butterbur distributed today is "Aichi Wase Fuki," a traditional vegetable of Aichi Prefecture.The Chita Peninsula is a major production center of Aichi early-blooming butterbur, and its history dates back to the middle of the Meiji period. It was discovered in what is now Tokai City, and spread to the surrounding areas because of its quick leaf growth, thick stems, and good aroma.
c72ee87efc0c10ae.zh: 蜂斗菜（ふき）從北海道到沖繩，野生於日本各地的原野與山間，自平安時代起便被食用。現今流通的蜂斗菜大多是愛知縣傳統蔬菜「愛知早生ふき」。知多半島是愛知早生蜂斗菜的主要產地，歷史可追溯至明治中期。它在現今的東海市被發現，因葉片生長快、莖粗且香氣佳而傳播到周邊地區。

c732f1ad1d053c7c.en: Saitama Museum of Natural History (埼玉県立自然の博物館, Saitama kenritsu shizen no hakubutsukan) is a prefectural museum of natural history in Nagatoro, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. The museum opened in 1981 and replaced "史" with "の" in its Japanese name in 2006. The Museum supersedes the Chichibu Natural Science Museum (秩父自然科学博物館) (1949–1980) and the Mineral and Plant Specimen Gallery (鑛物植物標本陳列所) (1921–1949), founded by the Chichibu Railway Company.
c732f1ad1d053c7c.zh: 埼玉縣立自然の博物館是位於日本埼玉縣長瀞町的縣立自然史博物館。該館於1981年開館，2006年將日文名稱中的「史」改為「の」。本館的前身為秩父鐵道公司創設的秩父自然科學博物館（1949–1980）及鑛物植物標本陳列所（1921–1949）。

c733deace98432ba.en: "Tsukeage" is called "Satsumaage", "Tempura", or "Fried kamaboko” in other prefectures. The history of “Tsukeage” dates back to the Edo period (1603 - 1867), when Shimazu Nariakira, the 28th head of the Satsuma domain, took a cue from the Kishu-hanpen and kamaboko (steamed fish paste) that had been passed down through the generations in other domains and deep fried them to make them more suitable for the hot and humid climate of Kagoshima Prefecture.
c733deace98432ba.zh: 「つけあげ」在其他縣稱為「薩摩揚」、「天婦羅」或「炸蒲鉾」。「つけあげ」的歷史可追溯至江戶時代（1603－1867），薩摩藩第28代藩主島津齊彬參考其他藩代代相傳的紀州半平與蒲鉾（蒸魚漿），將其油炸，使之更適合鹿兒島縣高溫潮濕的氣候。

c73a994e5e7bfdd9.en: The Niihari Gunga ruins (新治郡衙跡, Niihari Gunga iseki) is an archaeological site with the ruins of a Nara to Heian period government administrative complex located in what is now the city of  Chikusei in Ibaraki prefecture in the northern Kantō region of Japan. The site has been protected as a National Historic Site from 1968.
c73a994e5e7bfdd9.zh: 新治郡衙跡是一處考古遺址，保存奈良時代至平安時代的官署建築群遺跡，位於日本北關東地區茨城縣今筑西市。此遺址自1968年起被指定為國家史跡。

c743be07047a8ab4.en: Daishō-in (大照院) is a Buddhist temple located in the Tsubaki-chō neighborhood of the city of Hagi, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan. The temple belongs to the Nanzen-ji branch of the Rinzai school of Japanese Zen and its honzon is a statue of Shaka Nyorai.
c743be07047a8ab4.zh: 大照院是一座佛教寺院，位於日本山口縣萩市椿町。寺院屬於日本禪宗臨濟宗南禪寺派，本尊為釋迦如來像。

c76ecd88131d6062.en: The Kamoiwakura Site (加茂岩倉遺跡, Kamoiwakura iseki) is an archaeological site located in the Kamo neighborhood of the city of Unnan, Shimane Prefecture, in the San'in Region of Japan. It was designated a National Historic Site in 2019.
c76ecd88131d6062.zh: 加茂岩倉遺跡是位於日本山陰地區島根縣雲南市加茂町的考古遺址，於2019年被指定為國家史跡。

c773d781cdd8ab2c.en: A local dish of the Mikuriya area in Gotemba City. As this area grew a lot of wheat and soba (buckwheat), farmers made soba noodles using native yams instead of water, eating it with a dipping sauce made with chicken stock. The soba had an unassuming flavor, with the added yam creating a pleasant eating experience. Chicken stock is used for the broth, with chicken, carrots and shiitake mushrooms as the characteristic ingredients.
c773d781cdd8ab2c.zh: 御殿場市御廚地區的鄉土料理。這一帶大量種植小麥與蕎麥，農家以當地的山藥代替水來製作蕎麥麵，並搭配雞湯做的沾醬食用。這種蕎麥麵風味樸實，加入山藥使口感良好。湯底使用雞高湯，特色配料為雞肉、紅蘿蔔與香菇。

c7973f175aaee469.en: The Noto Kokubun-ji (能登国分寺) was a Buddhist temple located in what is now the city of Nanao, Ishikawa, Japan. It was one of the provincial temples per the system established by Emperor Shōmu during the Nara period (710 – 794) for the purpose of promoting Buddhism as the national religion of Japan and standardising imperial rule over the provinces. The temple no longer exists, but the temple grounds were designated as a National Historic Site in 1974.
c7973f175aaee469.zh: 能登国分寺是位於今日本石川縣七尾市的佛教寺院。此寺為奈良時代（710－794年）聖武天皇所建立的國分寺制度中的諸國寺院之一，目的在於推廣佛教作為日本的國家宗教，並統一朝廷對各令制國的統治。寺院今已不存，但寺址於1974年被指定為國家史跡。

c7a67ff1c8e337f2.en: Mikado-jinja (神門神社) is a Shinto shrine located in Misato, Miyazaki prefecture, Japan. It is dedicated to Ōhoyamatsumi and other kami.
c7a67ff1c8e337f2.zh: 神門神社是位於日本宮崎縣美鄉町的神社，主祭神為大山祇神及其他神祇。

c7adf2a5661bcb22.en: The Kitaura area in northern Yamaguchi Prefecture facing the Sea of Japan has fertile fishing grounds and a history of supporting people's livelihoods through fishing, and this is reflected in the local cuisine. In particular, sardines are caught in large numbers regardless of the season. A particularly unique local dish made with sardines is “unohanakizushi”, also known as “tozushi” or “dakizushi”.
c7adf2a5661bcb22.zh: 位於山口縣北部、面向日本海的北浦地區擁有豐饒的漁場，自古以漁業支撐人們的生計，這一點也反映在鄉土料理上。尤其沙丁魚不論季節都能大量捕獲。以沙丁魚製作的鄉土料理中，特別具特色的是「うの花きずし」，又稱「とずし」或「だきずし」。

c7b0991efc3edb76.en: Chakkirako (Japanese: チャッキラコ) is a dance performed at a festival in Miura, Japan, to celebrate the New Year and bring good fortune, especially in fishing.
c7b0991efc3edb76.zh: チャッキラコ是日本三浦市祭典中表演的舞蹈，用以慶祝新年並祈求好運，特別是漁獲豐收。

c7d06568cbd8193b.en: Mago-chazuke is a local dish eaten throughout the Izu Peninsula, and was originally a fisherman's meal eaten on boats during fishing. The name is said to have come from the meaning of "eat quickly and don't be lazy," as it was eaten in between fishing trips.Mago-chazuke is easily prepared at home by pounding fresh horse mackerel, placing it on top of rice, and pouring hot tea or hot water over it.
c7d06568cbd8193b.zh: まご茶漬け是伊豆半島各地都吃的鄉土料理，原本是漁夫捕魚時在船上吃的餐點。由於是在捕魚空檔吃的，據說名稱來自「快點吃，不要偷懶（まごまごするな）」的意思。在家中也能輕鬆製作，將新鮮竹筴魚剁碎放在米飯上，再淋上熱茶或熱水即可。

c7e89b9f033a5d4e.en: A regional dish of konjac simmered with ingredients such as Satoimo, carrots, Shiitake mushrooms, and others in Dashi (=Japanese soup stock).
c7e89b9f033a5d4e.zh: 將蒟蒻與芋頭、紅蘿蔔、香菇等食材以高湯（日式湯底）燉煮的鄉土料理。

c7ea7b64371ee605.en: Mibuna is a traditional vegetable from Kyoto, originating in the Mibu area of Kyoto City. It is believed to have been developed in the 1800s as a natural hybrid of mizuna. The exact time when it was first distinguished from mizuna is unclear, but documents from 1804 (Bunka 1) mention "mibuna produced in Mibu."Unlike mizuna, mibuna has round, spoon-shaped leaves without notches at the edges. Its taste is spicier and slightly more bitter compared to the refreshing flavor of mizuna.
c7ea7b64371ee605.zh: 壬生菜是源自京都市壬生地區的京都傳統蔬菜，據信是在1800年代由水菜自然雜交而成。何時開始與水菜區分並不清楚，但1804年（文化元年）的文獻中有「壬生產的壬生菜」的記載。與水菜不同，壬生菜的葉子呈圓形湯匙狀，邊緣沒有缺刻。相較於水菜的清爽風味，壬生菜味道較辛辣，略帶苦味。

c81af328376ca835.en: Yamanashi Prefecture, comprising 80% forested areas, has a history of consuming game dishes through hunting. Particularly in the Mitomi region, upstream of the Fuefuki River, hunting has been prevalent since ancient times, and wild boar, in particular, was commonly eaten. After World War II, breeding "Inobuta", a crossbreed of male wild boar and female domestic pig, was encouraged. "Inobuta Nabe" is a hot pot dish that includes Inobuta meat in sesame miso soup, cooked with plenty of locally sourced vegetables and mushrooms.
c81af328376ca835.zh: 山梨縣有八成為森林，自古有狩獵並食用野味料理的歷史。特別是笛吹川上游的三富地區，自古狩獵盛行，尤其常吃野豬。二次大戰後，當地鼓勵飼養公野豬與母家豬交配而成的「いのぶた」。「いのぶた鍋」是在芝麻味噌湯中加入いのぶた肉，與大量當地產的蔬菜和菇類一同烹煮的火鍋料理。

c848c4680415b7fc.en: The Yoshizaki-gobō (吉崎御坊) was a Buddhist temple located in what is the Yoshizaki neighbourhood of the city of Awara, Fukui, Japan. It is known for its connection to Rennyo, the founder of the Ikkō sect of Japanese Buddhism. The ruins of the temple were designated a National Historic Site in 2012.
c848c4680415b7fc.zh: 吉崎御坊是過去位於今日本福井縣芦原市吉崎地區的佛教寺院，以與日本佛教一向宗創始者蓮如的淵源聞名。寺院遺址於2012年被指定為國家史跡。

c84faa802ffbbfef.en: Shibetsu Salmon Science Museum (標津サーモン科学館, Shibetsu Sāmon Kagaku-kan) opened in Shibetsu, Hokkaidō, Japan in 1991. It is dedicated to the ecology of the world's salmonids and to Hokkaidō's salmon culture. In 1992 there were 130,000 visitors, while in 2011 the number dropped to 50,000.
c84faa802ffbbfef.zh: 標津サーモン科学館於1991年在日本北海道標津開館，以世界鮭科魚類的生態及北海道的鮭魚文化為主題。1992年參觀人數為13萬人，2011年降至5萬人。

c85955af96f90467.en: "Tsuki no Shizuku" is a painstakingly crafted local confection from Yamanashi Prefecture. It features the representative grape variety of the region, the "Koshu grape." Each grape is coated with a layer of white syrup, which is kneaded with sugar, creating a unique and time-consuming delicacy. The confection features a delightful combination of a solidified syrup that offers a sweet and gently crumbly texture.
c85955af96f90467.zh: 「月の雫」是山梨縣費工製作的鄉土甜點，使用當地代表性葡萄品種「甲州葡萄」。每顆葡萄外層裹上以砂糖揉製的白色糖漿，是一道獨特且耗時的甜點。凝固的糖漿香甜，帶有輕柔的酥鬆口感。

c85d7935b881fdba.en: Hiroshima Gokoku Jinja (広島護国神社) is a Japanese Shinto Shrine in Hiroshima, Japan.
c85d7935b881fdba.zh: 廣島護國神社（広島護国神社）是位於日本廣島的神道神社。

c881352e3f2b921c.en: Nara Prefectural Museum of Art (奈良県立美術館, Nara kenritsu bijutsukan) opened in Nara, Japan in 1973. The collection numbers some 4,100 items and special exhibitions are also held.
c881352e3f2b921c.zh: 奈良県立美術館於1973年在日本奈良開館。館藏約4,100件，亦舉辦特別展。

c88649df71397cde.en: Hakkengū (Japanese: 八剣宮) is a Shinto shrine established in 708 located in Atsuta-ku, Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture, in Japan. It is the betsugū (auxiliary shrine) of the Atsuta Shrine. The legendary sword Kusanagi no Tsurugi, one of the three Imperial Regalia of Japan, is worshipped as the shintai of the shrine.
c88649df71397cde.zh: 八劍宮是創建於708年的神社，位於日本愛知縣名古屋市熱田區，為熱田神宮的別宮。日本三神器之一、傳說中的草薙劍作為神體受到奉祀。

c89bf6471dd452ad.en: Dabu" is a local dish made with chicken and seasonal vegetables, and has been handed down from Saga Prefecture to Fukuoka Prefecture. It is called "dabu" with an accent from the word "zabu" because it is made "zabu-zabu" with a lot of water without using ingredients that easily fall apart. This dish is served at weddings, funerals, and other occasions to which guests are invited, and differences arise in the ingredients and the way they are cut depending on the celebration or mourning.
c89bf6471dd452ad.zh: 「だぶ」是用雞肉和當季蔬菜做成的鄉土料理，在佐賀縣到福岡縣一帶流傳下來。由於不使用容易煮散的食材，加入大量的水「ざぶざぶ」地烹煮，因此由「ざぶ」一詞的口音轉為「だぶ」。這道菜會在婚禮、葬禮等招待客人的場合端出，依喜事或喪事的不同，食材和切法也有所差異。

c8aecc8cc572fb26.en: Uozu Momoyama Sports Park Stadium (魚津桃山運動公園陸上競技場) is an athletic stadium in Uozu, Toyama Prefecture, Japan.
c8aecc8cc572fb26.zh: 魚津市桃山運動公園（魚津桃山運動公園陸上競技場）是位於日本富山縣魚津市的田徑場。

c8b084d26deea394.en: The Nagabashiri Wind Caves (長走風穴, Nagabashiri fūketsu) are a system of talus caves about 15 km (9.3 mi) north of Ōdate along Japan National Route 7.
c8b084d26deea394.zh: 長走風穴是位於大館以北約15公里（9.3英里）、日本國道7號沿線的一處崖錐洞穴群。

c8b397ba96d4ca60.en: "Su-Mochi" is a local dish made by putting grated daikon radish, squeezed juice of daidai, soy sauce, and sugar in a bowl, cutting the last rice cake of the New Year into bite-size pieces by hand without adding "Katakuriko (=Potato starch)", and mixing them with freshly pounded rice cakes. In the Buzen area of eastern Fukuoka Prefecture, many rice cakes were pounded before New Year's, and the last rice cake was used to make "Su-Mochi" which was then eaten together. In some areas, it is also called "Oroshi-Mochi".
c8b397ba96d4ca60.zh: 「酢もち」是一道鄉土料理，做法是在碗中放入蘿蔔泥、橙（だいだい）的榨汁、醬油與砂糖，將新年最後一臼年糕不沾「片栗粉（馬鈴薯澱粉）」直接用手撕成一口大小，與剛搗好的年糕拌在一起。在福岡縣東部的豐前地區，新年前會搗許多年糕，最後一臼就拿來做「酢もち」大家一起吃。部分地區也稱為「おろし餅」。

c8d65804f4e21c34.en: Tenmusu, also spelled as ten-musu, is a dish in Japanese cuisine that consists of a rice ball wrapped with nori that is filled with deep-fried tempura shrimp. Tenmusu is sometimes included as a food in bento boxes.
c8d65804f4e21c34.zh: 天むす（也寫作ten-musu）是一道日本料理，以海苔包裹飯糰，內餡為炸天婦羅蝦。天むす有時也會放入便當中。

c8e76f741d6172db.en: Oita Prefecture has long been a flourishing grain-growing region based on its fields. Jigona(all purpose flour), flour ground from the harvested wheat, was used in dishes such as "koneri" and "yaseuma," thus laying the groundwork for a flour-eating culture."Houchou" is a noodle dish made by kneading wheat flour into thin udon noodles and dipping them in a dipping sauce (dashi (=Japanese soup stock)) with condiments.
c8e76f741d6172db.zh: 大分縣自古以來是以旱田為基礎、穀物種植興盛的地區。將收成的小麥磨成的地粉（中筋麵粉）用於「こねり」和「やせうま」等料理，奠定了食用麵粉的飲食文化。「鮑腸」是將麵粉揉製成細烏龍麵，再沾加了佐料的沾汁（高湯）食用的麵食。

c905d0960c8721e6.en: Ōyano-jima (大矢野島), also spelt as Ōyanojima  It is administered as part of the city of Kami-Amakusa. It is connected to the Japanese mainland since 1966 by Five Bridges of Amakusa. The Japan National Route 266 passes through the island. The island primary industry is aquaculture of fish and shrimps. Large part of island belongs to Unzen-Amakusa National Park.
c905d0960c8721e6.zh: 大矢野島，行政上屬於上天草市。自1966年起以天草五橋與日本本土相連，國道266號通過島上。島上的主要產業為魚類與蝦類養殖，島上大部分區域屬於雲仙天草國立公園。

c9270792a30179f0.en: “Miso potatoes” become well-known after it won the “5th Saitama B-Grade Local Gourmet Championship in Chichibu” (2009), but it is actually a local dish that has been passed down in the Chichibu area for generations. Farmland has long been cultivated in the Chichibu area, where there is little flat land. It is said that "miso potatoes" originated from dipping small potatoes roasted over an open fire in miso sauce. Farmers have eaten "miso potatoes" as light lunches (kojyuu-han), when they take breaks from farm work.
c9270792a30179f0.zh: 「みそポテト」在「第5屆埼玉B級鄉土美食王決定戰in秩父」（2009年）奪冠後廣為人知，但其實是秩父地區代代相傳的鄉土料理。秩父地區平地稀少，自古以來就開墾農地耕作。據說「みそポテト」起源於將用炭火烤過的小馬鈴薯沾上味噌醬食用。農民在農事休息時，會把「みそポテト」當作輕食（小中飯）來吃。

c93194a8ea96e4e5.en: Nogiwa Park (野木和公園, Nogiwa kōen) is an urban park in the western part of the city of Aomori, Japan. Major features of the park include a reservoir, various decorative trees, wetlands, several footbridges, and an observatory.
c93194a8ea96e4e5.zh: 野木和公園是位於日本青森市西部的都市公園。園內主要設施包括蓄水池、各種觀賞樹木、濕地、數座步道橋及一座展望台。

c9609ef23c44fec5.en: Kudara-ji (百済寺) was a Buddhist temple located in the city of Hirakata, Osaka, Japan. The temple is now in ruins, and its former precincts were designated a National Historic Site in 1941, with the designation changed to a Special National Historic Site in 1952. The site was opened to the public as one of Japan's first archaeological parks in 1965.
c9609ef23c44fec5.zh: 百濟寺是過去位於日本大阪府枚方市的佛教寺院。寺院現已成為遺址，舊寺域於1941年被指定為國家史蹟，1952年改列為國家特別史蹟。1965年作為日本最早的史蹟公園之一對外開放。

c968755ae25a8316.en: The Ariake Sea has a tidal range of about 6 meters, and at low tide, tidal flats extend 5 to 7 meters offshore. Although fish and shellfish of unusual shapes and sizes can be caught here, an alternative source of protein was needed during the off-season in winter. One such fish that was valued as a wintertime protein source was crucian carp, a river fish. It is the most common freshwater fish caught in Saga Prefecture, and is often caught in the creeks of Shiraishi and the Saga Plain, as well as in rivers.
c968755ae25a8316.zh: 有明海的潮差約6公尺，退潮時潮灘會向外延伸5至7公尺。這裡雖然能捕到形狀和大小都很少見的魚貝類，但冬季的淡季期間需要其他的蛋白質來源。其中一種被視為冬季蛋白質來源而受到重視的魚，是河魚鯽魚。鯽魚是佐賀縣捕獲量最多的淡水魚，常在白石及佐賀平原的水渠（クリーク）和河川中捕獲。

c97be7b58eae4c94.ja: 清武温泉（きよたけおんせん）は、宮崎県宮崎市清武町にある温泉。
c97be7b58eae4c94.zh: 清武温泉是位於宮崎縣宮崎市清武町的溫泉。

c9a3513ea8ca7d72.en: Mitake Castle (三岳城跡, Mitake-jō) was a Sengoku period yamashiro-style Japanese castle located in what is now part of the city of Hamamatsu, Shizuoka in the Tōkai region of Japan.  It was a fortress of the local Ii clan, which later rose to prominence under the Edo period  Tokugawa shogunate. The ruins have been protected  as a National Historic Site since 1944.
c9a3513ea8ca7d72.zh: 三岳城（三岳城跡）是戰國時代的山城式日本城郭，位於今日本東海地方靜岡縣濱松市境內。此城為當地井伊氏的據點，井伊氏後來在江戶時代的德川幕府之下崛起。遺跡自1944年起被列為國家史跡受到保護。

c9afdb7b60c006f4.en: Ōmiwa Shrine (大神神社, Ōmiwa-jinja) is a Shinto shrine that is located in  Ichinomiya, Aichi, Japan.  The honden is built in the nagare-zukuri style.
c9afdb7b60c006f4.zh: 大神神社是位於日本愛知縣一宮市的神社。本殿採流造樣式。

c9c45909ca8b2692.en: "Mushi-Dai " is one of the festive dishes served at an "okyaku" occasion in Kochi prefecture, such as weddings and New Year's celebrations. "Okyaku" means a banquet in the Tosa dialect. This “Okyaku” (banquetting) has influenced the food culture of Kochi prefecture, like "Sawachi(or Sahachi)-Ryori" is deeply rooted in the food customs of Kochi Prefecture. The "Mushi" in " Mushi-Dai " means “steam” and the dish refers to a steamed sea bream stuffed with “Okara”.
c9c45909ca8b2692.zh: 「蒸し鯛」是高知縣在婚禮、新年慶祝等「おきゃく」場合端出的喜慶料理之一。「おきゃく」在土佐方言中是宴會的意思。這種「おきゃく」（宴會）影響了高知縣的飲食文化，例如「皿鉢（さわち，或さはち）料理」便深植於高知縣的飲食習慣中。「蒸し鯛」的「蒸し」意思是「蒸」，這道料理是在鯛魚中塞入「豆渣」後蒸製而成。

c9e1c045366ba0a3.en: Northern Culture Museum (北方文化博物館, Hoppō Bunka Hakubutsukan) is an open-air museum in Kōnan-ku, Niigata, Japan. It contains the well known mansion of a wealthy farming family called gōnō (豪農), gardens and houses from the Edo period. There is also a branch in Chūō-ku, Niigata.
c9e1c045366ba0a3.zh: 北方文化博物館是位於日本新潟市江南區的戶外博物館，館內有一座知名的富裕農家（稱為「豪農」）宅邸，以及江戶時代的庭園與房舍。新潟市中央區另設有分館。

c9e49e86eac718ef.en: "Konoshiro no sugata sushi" is an essential dish for New Year's, festivals, celebrations, and other family gatherings in the Yatsushiro area. The region faces three seas - the Yatsushiro Sea, the Amakusa Sea, and the Ariake Sea. This dish has been passed down since the Edo period and is considered a symbol of good luck."Konoshiro fish" is a member of the herring family that lives in brackish water. Small fish that are as young as 5 cm in length are referred to as "shinko" and are a delicacy at sushi restaurants, commanding high prices.
c9e49e86eac718ef.zh: 「このしろの姿寿司」是八代地區新年、祭典、慶祝活動及其他家族聚會不可或缺的料理。這個地區面向八代海、天草海、有明海三片海域。這道料理自江戶時代流傳至今，被視為吉祥的象徵。「このしろ」是生活在半鹹水中的鯡科魚類。體長僅5公分左右的幼魚稱為「新子」，是壽司店的珍饈，價格昂貴。

c9e6b7b7dd6ff6dd.en: The Bandai-Atami Sports Park Koriyama Skating Rink (磐梯熱海スポーツパーク郡山スケート場, Bandai Atami supōtsupāku Kōriyama sukēto-jō) is an open-air ice rink in the city of  Kōriyama in Fukushima prefecture in Japan. It was opened in 1993 for the National Sports Festival of Japan (Kokutai) in Fukushima in 1995. It is located at 340 meters above sea level. The track serves as a roller-skating rink during the summer.
c9e6b7b7dd6ff6dd.zh: 磐梯熱海スポーツパーク郡山スケート場是位於日本福島縣郡山市的戶外溜冰場，為1995年在福島舉辦的日本國民體育大會（國體）而於1993年啟用，海拔340公尺。夏季時作為滑輪溜冰場使用。

c9e9cd282bb9afd8.en: In the southern part of Aomori, which is cold and often suffered from famine that lasted for several years during the Edo period (1603-1867), people developed the wisdom of eating minor grains in creative ways. "Kakke" is a dish made by kneading “Soba (buckwheat)” flour with a little salt, rolling out the dough thinly, cutting it into triangles, boiling them, and serving with garlic miso. "Kakke" means "piece" or "edge" in this local language.
c9e9cd282bb9afd8.zh: 青森南部氣候寒冷，江戶時代（1603-1867）常遭受連續數年的饑荒，人們因而發展出以各種方式食用雜糧的智慧。「かっけ」是將蕎麥粉加少許鹽揉成麵團，擀薄後切成三角形，煮熟後搭配大蒜味噌食用的料理。「かっけ」在當地方言中意為「碎片」或「邊角」。

c9fba84ff07193b8.en: The Mito Tokugawa clan cemetery  (水戸德川家墓所, Mito Tokugawa-ke bosho) is located in the city of Hitachiōta, Ibaraki. The cemetery contains the graves of the Mito Tokugawa clan and three of its four cadet houses. This includes the successive daimyō of Mito Domain (250,000 koku), Matsudaira clan of Moriyama Domain (20,000 koku), Matsudaira clan of Hitachi-Fuchū Domain (20,000 koku) and the Matsudaira clan of Shishido Domain, 10,0000 koku.
c9fba84ff07193b8.zh: 水戶德川家墓所位於茨城縣常陸太田市。墓所內有水戶德川家及其四個分家中三家的墓，包括歷代水戶藩（25萬石）藩主、守山藩（2萬石）松平家、常陸府中藩（2萬石）松平家，以及宍戶藩（10,0000石）松平家。

ca3fb715e431c0b2.en: In the Iga region, the heat and humidity characteristic of the basin increases during the summer months, causing people to lose their appetites.
ca3fb715e431c0b2.zh: 伊賀地區在夏季時，盆地特有的悶熱潮濕加劇，使人食慾不振。

ca4a1652ac1326ef.en: Mount Hotaka (武尊山 Hotakayama, 上州武尊山 Joshu Hotakayama) is a stratovolcano with its highest peak at the altitude of 2,158m.  It is located near Minakami-machi, Kawaba Village, and Katashina Village in the Gunma Prefecture.  In order to distinguish it from Mount Hotakadake in the Northern Alps, it is also called as Joshu Hotakayama(上州武尊山). This mountain has been selected as one of "100 Famous Japanese Mountains"  and the "New 100 Famous Flower of Japanese Mountains".
ca4a1652ac1326ef.zh: 武尊山（又稱上州武尊山）是一座層狀火山，最高峰海拔2,158公尺，位於群馬縣水上町、川場村與片品村附近。為了與北阿爾卑斯的穗高岳區別，也稱為上州武尊山。此山入選「日本百名山」及「新・花の百名山」。

ca6c7054fec420fd.en: The Uemachi plateau (上町台地, うえまちだいち, Uemachi Daichi) is a plateau in Osaka City, Japan, that extends from the Osaka Castle and Tenmabashi area to Tennōji in the south.
ca6c7054fec420fd.zh: 上町台地是位於日本大阪市的台地，從大阪城與天滿橋一帶向南延伸至天王寺。

ca6d2ff464ab88ab.en: Makidō (満奇洞) is one of many limestone caves located in the city of Niimi, in northwestern Okayama Prefecture, Japan.
ca6d2ff464ab88ab.zh: 滿奇洞是位於日本岡山縣西北部新見市的眾多石灰岩洞之一。

ca77e0570f9b27d1.en: "Hoshi-mochi" is a rice snack made by cutting and weaving rice cakes into a hanging braid, which contains a large amount of water and is then left out in the cold. "Hoshi-mochi" is a traditional preserved food that has been made in Akita Prefecture as well as Aomori and Nagano prefectures, and other cold-weather farming villages for centuries. It is a typical rice snack especially in Akita, a rice-producing region, and is also known as "frozen rice cake" because it is made using the cold winter weather.
ca77e0570f9b27d1.zh: 「干し餅」是將含大量水分的年糕切開、編成串吊掛，置於寒冷戶外製成的米菓。「干し餅」是秋田縣以及青森、長野等縣與其他寒冷地區農村數百年來製作的傳統保存食品。在產米的秋田尤其是代表性的米菓，因利用冬季寒冷氣候製作，也稱為「凍み餅」。

ca8076bac90a56e1.en: “Hine-zushi” is a fermented food made by marinating salted fish with rice and allowing it to mature. The main production areas of “Hine-zushi “are located in the Okunoto region, including Wajima City, Anamizu Town, and Noto Town. The mountain village area in the Okunoto region has long been a granary area, where rice necessary for” Hine-zushi” was grown.In addition, the rivers that flow through the area provide fish such as "ayu" (sweetfish) and “ugui” (Japanese dace).
ca8076bac90a56e1.zh: 「ひねずし」是將鹽漬魚與米飯一同醃漬、使其熟成的發酵食品。主要產地位於奧能登地區，包括輪島市、穴水町、能登町。奧能登地區的山村一帶自古即為穀倉地帶，種植製作「ひねずし」所需的稻米。此外，流經當地的河川也提供香魚、珠星三塊魚等魚類。

cab19d8bb858736f.en: Wakayama Prefectural Museum of Natural History (和歌山県立自然博物館, Wakayama Kenritsu Shizen Hakubutsukan) opened in Kainan, Wakayama Prefecture in 1982. The displays relate to the geology, flora, and fauna of the area, while the research collection includes some 167,000 specimens. The first exhibition room is an aquarium, and many specimens are displayed in the second room. The Museum is accredited as a Registered Museum by the Museum Act from Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology.
cab19d8bb858736f.zh: 和歌山縣立自然博物館於1982年在和歌山縣海南市開館。展示內容與當地的地質、植物及動物相關，研究收藏約有167,000件標本。第一展示室為水族館，第二展示室則展出許多標本。本館依文部科學省主管的《博物館法》獲認定為登錄博物館。

cac2258396981b3e.en: Rice cakes (mochi) are considered a food for celebratory occasions, so it is common to make them using a mortar and pestle and distribute them to neighbors. However, in everyday life, making mochi for personal consumption would attract attention. To avoid this, instead of using a mortar and pestle, people would steam rice in a pot, partially pound it, and then enjoy the resulting dish.
cac2258396981b3e.zh: 米餅（餅）被視為喜慶場合的食物，一般會用臼和杵搗製，並分送給鄰居。然而在日常生活中，為自家食用而搗餅會引人注目。為了避免這種情形，人們不用臼和杵，而是在鍋中蒸米，稍加搗碾後食用。

cacc927aa66981a0.en: Mount Unebi (畝傍山, Unebi-yama) is a mountain in the city of Kashihara, in the central-western part Nara Prefecture, Japan. Together with Mount Amanokagu and Mount Miminashi, it belongs to the so-called "Yamato Sanzan", in which it is the highest. At the foot of the mountain are gneiss new rocks, and part of the middle slope and higher are biotite and andesite. At the top is a funnel of an extinct crater.
cacc927aa66981a0.zh: 畝傍山是位於日本奈良縣中西部橿原市的山，與天香久山、耳成山合稱「大和三山」，為其中最高者。山麓為片麻岩新岩層，山腰中段以上部分為黑雲母及安山岩，山頂有死火山的火山口。

cad6974b7e58948e.en: "Korokaki Persimmon" are dried persimmon produced in Uji-Tawara Town using a type of astringent persimmon known as "Tsurunoko." In a time when dried persimmon was not yet well-known, a certain girl was selling sweet dried persimmon. Impressed by their deliciousness, the villagers asked the girl to teach them how to make them. Later, as they followed the girl who had left, she disappeared at Zenjoji Temple and then reappeared as the goddess Kannon.
cad6974b7e58948e.zh: 「古老柿」是宇治田原町以名為「鶴の子」的澀柿製成的柿乾。在柿乾還不普及的年代，有一名少女在販賣甜甜的柿乾。村民被其美味打動，請少女教他們做法。後來，村民跟隨離去的少女，少女在禪定寺消失，接著以觀音菩薩的樣貌現身。

cae3bfbc13a25d44.en: Mizusawa-dera (水澤寺) is a Buddhist temple  located in the city of Shibukawa in Gunma Prefecture, Japan.  It belongs to the  Tendai sect and its honzon is a statue of statue of Senjū Kannon Bosatsu (Sahasrabhūja).The temple's full name is Gotokuzan Muryōjū-in Jion-ji (五徳山 無量壽院 水澤寺).The temple is the 16th stop on the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route. The temple is also referred to as the Mizusawa-Kannon (水 澤 観 音).
cae3bfbc13a25d44.zh: 水澤寺是位於日本群馬縣澀川市的佛教寺院，屬天台宗，本尊為千手觀音菩薩像。寺院全名為五徳山無量壽院水澤寺。此寺為坂東三十三所朝聖路線的第16號札所，也稱為水澤觀音。

cafd5daed40f929c.en: Kawate Castle (川手城, Kawate-jō) was a castle that existed between the Nanboku-chō period and the Sengoku period. Its ruins are located in the present-day city of Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. An alternative way to write its name in Japanese is 革手城, which has the same pronunciation. It replaced Nagamori Castle as the base of operations for the area and served as home for regional shugo until Saitō Dōsan switched to Inabayama Castle.
cafd5daed40f929c.zh: 川手城（川手城）是存在於南北朝時代至戰國時代的城，遺址位於今日本岐阜縣岐阜市。其名稱在日文中也可寫作同音的「革手城」。它取代長森城成為當地的據點，並作為地方守護的居所，直到齋藤道三改以稻葉山城為據點為止。

cb0e6ab5ceb454b2.en: "Shokkara Soup" is a dish made by simmering minced small muroaji fish that has been fermented with salt (known as "shokkara"), along with vegetables such as ashitaba and satoimo (taro) that are found on the islands.
cb0e6ab5ceb454b2.zh: 「しょっから汁」是將以鹽發酵的小室鰺魚肉切碎（稱為「しょっから」），與明日葉、里芋（芋頭）等島上的蔬菜一同燉煮而成的料理。

cb167189f7287cea.en: Odashirogahara (小田代ヶ原) is a marshland located near Nikkō in Tochigi Prefecture, Japan, west of the river Yukawa.
cb167189f7287cea.zh: 小田代ヶ原是位於日本栃木縣日光附近的濕原，在湯川以西。

cb188dbe8aaed508.en: Ryūjin Onsen (龍神温泉) is an onsen (hot spring) located in Ryūjin village, now a part of Tanabe, Wakayama City in Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. Ryūjin Onsen was discovered in the 7th century by En no Gyōja, the founder of Shugendō. Kōbō Daishi, founder of Shingon Buddhism visited the spot in the 9th century. During the Edo period (1603-1868), the onsen was used as a resort area by the Tokugawa ruling family, whose castle was in Wakayama city.
cb188dbe8aaed508.zh: 龍神溫泉是位於日本和歌山縣龍神村（現屬田邊市）的溫泉。龍神溫泉於7世紀由修驗道創始者役行者發現。真言宗創始者弘法大師於9世紀曾造訪此地。江戶時代（1603－1868年），此溫泉為居城位於和歌山市的德川家所使用的休養地。

cb22445766fcdf8f.en: The Torihama shell mound (鳥浜貝塚, Torihama kaizuka) is a shell midden and remains of an Early Jōmon period settlement located in the Torihama neighbourhood of the town of  Wakasa, Fukui, in the Hokuriku region of Japan. It is a waterlogged midden site that was occupied mainly from the Incipient Jomon period to the Early Jomon period from 12,000 to 5,000 years ago (10,000–3,000 BC).
cb22445766fcdf8f.zh: 鳥濱貝塚是位於日本北陸地方福井縣若狹町鳥濱地區的貝塚及繩文時代前期聚落遺址。這是一處低濕地貝塚遺址，主要使用年代為繩文時代草創期至前期，距今12,000至5,000年前（西元前10,000至3,000年）。

cb3428be903217aa.en: Sea cucumbers have become a popular winter delicacy in the Noto Peninsula. The history of sea cucumbers in Noto is said to date back to the 8th century. A wooden plaque excavated from the Heijo Palace site (the Inner Palace of Heijo-kyo) states that six kilograms of sea cucumbers were transported from Noto to the capital. The Engishiki, a book compiled in the mid-Heian period and used to define the rituals of the Imperial Court, also contains a record of sea cucumbers from Noto.Nanao City, facing Nanao Bay, is known for its sea cucumbers.
cb3428be903217aa.zh: 海參是能登半島廣受歡迎的冬季美味。據說能登的海參歷史可追溯至8世紀。平城宮遺址（平城京的內裏）出土的木簡上記載，曾有六公斤的海參從能登運往都城。平安時代中期編纂、用以規範朝廷儀式的《延喜式》中，也有能登海參的記錄。面向七尾灣的七尾市以海參聞名。

cb438915d47f14c9.en: Tsuyama Railroad Educational Museum (津山まなびの鉄道館, Tsuyama Manabi no Tetsudōkan) is a railway museum in Tsuyama, Okayama, Japan, operated by West Japan Railway Company (JR West) since 2 April 2016. It is based around the former Tsuyama Depot roundhouse, which was used to house a number of preserved locomotives since 2007.
cb438915d47f14c9.zh: 津山まなびの鉄道館是位於日本岡山縣津山市的鐵道博物館，自2016年4月2日起由西日本旅客鐵道（JR西日本）營運。館區以舊津山機關區的扇形車庫為中心，該車庫自2007年起用於存放多輛保存機車。

cb77f2f4e385d52a.en: The Sano Art Museum (佐野美術館, Sano Bijutsukan) is a private art museum, located in the Nakata neighborhood of the city of Mishima, Shizuoka Prefecture, central Japan. The museum was founded in 1966 by Mishima-born Sano Ryūichi, founder of the chemical company Tekkōsha and recipient of the Second Order of the Sacred Treasure. The museum has a collection of over 2500 items, and is especially noted for its collection of Japanese swords.
cb77f2f4e385d52a.zh: 佐野美術館是位於日本中部靜岡縣三島市中田地區的私立美術館。由出身三島、化學公司鐵興社創辦人、曾獲頒勳二等瑞寶章的佐野隆一於1966年創立。館藏超過2500件，尤以日本刀收藏聞名。

cb7e44984f925dc2.en: The term 'Tohei' refers to a fish resembling a large eel that inhabits the coastal waters of central to southern Honshu, officially known as the 'Conger Eel' in the eel family. It is larger compared to other types of eels, with some reaching lengths of about 2 meters. Due to the difficulty of preparing the fish (as it has many small bones,) Tohei was initially discarded as it was not economically viable.
cb7e44984f925dc2.zh: 「とうへい」是一種形似大型鰻魚的魚，棲息於本州中部到南部的沿海，正式名稱為鰻類中的「海鰻」。牠比其他鰻類體型更大，有些長達約2公尺。由於處理不易（細刺很多），とうへい起初不具經濟價值而被丟棄。

cb95665ff8bb1fd5.en: Appi Kogen Ski Resort (安比高原スキー場, Appi Kōgen Sukī-jō), branded APPI, is one of the largest ski resorts in Japan, adjacent to the Towada-Hachimantai National Park. Operated by Iwate Hotel & Resort, the resort is most famous for its ski slopes, but it also has a guest ranch, golf courses, tennis courts, soccer fields, sports clubs, hot springs (onsen), and other amenities.
cb95665ff8bb1fd5.zh: 安比高原スキー場（品牌名APPI）是日本規模最大的滑雪場之一，鄰接十和田八幡平國立公園。由岩手飯店度假村經營，以滑雪道最為著名，另設有觀光牧場、高爾夫球場、網球場、足球場、運動俱樂部、溫泉等設施。

cbb46b97d334b3a2.en: The Ebina Service Area (海老名サービスエリア, Ebina Sābisueria) is a rest area located on the Tōmei Expressway in Ebina, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan, and is operated by Central Nippon Expressway Company. It is the only service area in Kanagawa, the first service area when coming from Tokyo, and the last service area when heading from Nagoya to Tokyo.
cbb46b97d334b3a2.zh: 海老名サービスエリア是位於日本神奈川縣海老名市東名高速道路上的休息站，由中日本高速道路公司經營。這是神奈川縣唯一的服務區，從東京出發時為第一個服務區，從名古屋前往東京時則為最後一個服務區。

cbc66f34e9f88b6e.en: Isaniwa Shrine (伊佐爾波神社, Isaniwa jinja) is a Shinto shrine in Matsuyama, Ehime Prefecture, Japan. Enshrined are Emperor Chūai, Empress Jingū, and Emperor Ōjin. A number of its buildings and treasures have been designated Important Cultural Properties.
cbc66f34e9f88b6e.zh: 伊佐爾波神社是位於日本愛媛縣松山市的神社，祭祀仲哀天皇、神功皇后與應神天皇。神社內多棟建築與寶物已被指定為重要文化財。

cbdc92dd0a5d3c6e.en: "Donko" (=Dark sleeper) is a fish inhabits from around Hakodate in Hokkaido to the coast along Hama-douri area in Fukushima Prefecture. The official name is "brown hakeling", and it is often cooked at home in the prefecture because of reasonable price and good taste. Various dishes using "donko" are taking root in many areas, and "donko-jiru" is eaten mainly in Soma City. It’s a soup simmered "donko" and vegetables. "Donko" meat and liver are used in this soup and it condensed savory flavors.
cbdc92dd0a5d3c6e.zh: 「どんこ」是一種棲息於北海道函館一帶至福島縣濱通地區沿岸的魚。正式名稱為「エゾイソアイナメ」，由於價格實惠、味道好，在縣內常見於家庭料理。使用「どんこ」的各種料理在許多地區落地生根，而「どんこ汁」主要在相馬市食用。這是將「どんこ」與蔬菜一起燉煮的湯，使用了「どんこ」的魚肉與肝臟，湯中濃縮了鮮美的滋味。

cbe2055f2fe5e779.en: The Ice Aquarium (氷の水族館, Kōri no Suizokukan) is a tourist attraction in the north-eastern port of Kesennuma, Miyagi, Japan, operated by the Okamoto Ice Refrigeration Plant. It features approximately 450 marine creatures that were flash-frozen into blocks of ice after being caught by local fishermen. The attraction was established in 2002. It showcases more than 70 different species of sea creatures, including crab, squid and octopus, Due to the extreme cold temperature inside the Ice Aquarium, visitors are advised to stay for only five minutes.
cbe2055f2fe5e779.zh: 氷の水族館是位於日本東北部港口宮城縣氣仙沼的觀光設施，由岡本製冰冷凍廠經營。館內展示約450隻由當地漁民捕獲後急速冷凍封入冰塊中的海洋生物。該設施於2002年設立，展出螃蟹、魷魚、章魚等70種以上的海洋生物。由於館內溫度極低，建議遊客停留時間僅五分鐘。

cc0cc3f030648fa5.en: This is a "sukiyaki"-like hotpot simmered mackerel, seasonal vegetables like Japanese leek and napa cabbage, and grilled tofu, and prepared by fishers in towns with fishing harbors in Tajima region. Mackerel was used in Takeno area in Toyooka City because they caught lots of small mackerels. On the other hand, "Jau" was cooked with fish they could not sell in markets, "hatahata" (=Japanese sandfish) or "Yama-garei" (a type of flatfish) in other area like Kami Town.
cc0cc3f030648fa5.zh: 這是類似「壽喜燒」的火鍋，以鯖魚、蔥和大白菜等當季蔬菜及烤豆腐燉煮而成，由但馬地區設有漁港的城鎮的漁夫製作。豐岡市竹野地區因捕獲大量小鯖魚而使用鯖魚。另一方面，在香美町等其他地區，「じゃう」則是用無法在市場販賣的魚，如「はたはた」（日本叉牙魚）或「ヤマガレイ」（一種鰈魚）來烹煮。

cc21e84e82b9c7ca.en: Kameoka Hachimangū (亀岡八幡宮) is a Shinto shrine in Aoba-ku, Sendai, Miyagi, Japan.  It is the tutelary shrine of the Date clan.
cc21e84e82b9c7ca.zh: 龜岡八幡宮是位於日本宮城縣仙台市青葉區的神社，為伊達氏的守護神社。

cc239ae20ae20794.en: Kagoshima Arena (also known as Nishihara Shokai Arena) is an indoor sporting arena located in Kagoshima, Japan. The capacity of the arena is 5,000 and was opened in 1992. It hosted some matches for the 2003 FIVB Women's World Cup.
cc239ae20ae20794.zh: 鹿兒島體育館（又稱西原商會體育館）是位於日本鹿兒島的室內體育館，可容納5,000人，於1992年啟用。2003年國際排球總會女子世界盃曾在此舉行部分賽事。

cc30af064a7cfc2f.en: Kannonshō-ji (観音正寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Azuchi neighborhood of the city of Ōmihachiman, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the  Tendai sect of Japanese Buddhism and its honzon is a statue of Senjū Kannon Bosatsu (Sahasrabhuja). The temple's full name is Kinugasa-san Kannonshō-ji (繖山 観音正寺).The temple is the 31st stop on the Saigoku Kannon Pilgrimage route.
cc30af064a7cfc2f.zh: 觀音正寺是位於日本滋賀縣近江八幡市安土町的佛教寺院，屬日本佛教天台宗，本尊為千手觀音菩薩像。寺院全名為繖山觀音正寺。本寺為西國觀音巡禮的第31號札所。

cc5844014ec53d39.en: Yubunezawa Stone Circle (湯舟沢環状列石, Yubunezawa kanjō resseki) is an archaeological site with the remains of a Late Jōmon (c. 4000 BP) stone circle in what is now the city of Takizawa, Iwate Prefecture, Japan. The site was designated a Prefectural Historic Site in 2013.
cc5844014ec53d39.zh: 湯舟沢環状列石是位於日本岩手縣、今瀧澤市境內的考古遺址，保存有繩文時代後期（約距今4000年）的環狀列石遺跡。遺址於2013年被指定為縣史跡。

cc5b475a111672c5.en: Gosen City, where the Agano and Hayade Rivers flow through, is blessed with fertile, well-drained soil and abundant water, which nurtures many prefectural brand vegetables. Among them, along with "Gosenbijin (lotus root)" and "Yawahada Negi (leek)," the Kinu Otome taro is a major product in Gosen City. In Gosen-shi, taro has long been grown by farmers as their own vegetable, and now boasts the largest production in Niigata Prefecture (according to the Gosen-shi website, 2048).
cc5b475a111672c5.zh: 阿賀野川與早出川流經的五泉市，擁有肥沃、排水良好的土壤和豐沛的水源，孕育出許多縣品牌蔬菜。其中，與「五泉美人（蓮藕）」和「やわ肌ねぎ（蔥）」並列，絹乙女芋頭是五泉市的主要產品。在五泉市，芋頭長久以來是農家自家食用而種植的蔬菜，如今產量為新潟縣第一（根據五泉市網站，2048）。

cc5e0c6f9f0f09c0.en: The traditional New Year's soup (Zou-ni) in Tokushima prefecture is known for its distinctive characteristics. For instance, the "Uchigae Zou-ni" enjoyed in Iya district features a soy sauce-flavored broth made with "iriko dashi" (Japanese soup stock with small dried fish), and instead of rice cakes, it includes hard and stone-like firm tofu called "Iwa-dofu" (Rock tofu). Other regions also use various types of rice cakes, such as round or square rice cakes, and clear Dashi(Japanese soup stock).
cc5e0c6f9f0f09c0.zh: 德島縣的傳統新年湯品（雜煮）以其獨特之處聞名。例如，祖谷地區食用的「うちがえ雑煮」，湯頭是以「いりこだし」（用小魚乾熬製的日式高湯）煮成的醬油口味，並以一種堅硬如石的豆腐「岩豆腐」取代年糕。其他地區也會使用圓形或方形等各種年糕，以及清澈的高湯。

cc5efc61c8d62dff.en: Shakujii Park (石神井公園, Shakujii Kōen) is a public park in the Japanese town of Shakujii, in Tokyo's Nerima ward. It is one of the larger parks in the metropolis. As of April 2006, the site is managed directly by the Tokyo Metropolitan Park Association, an arrangement which ended in March 2011.
cc5efc61c8d62dff.zh: 石神井公園（石神井公園）是位於東京都練馬區石神井的公園，是東京都內較大的公園之一。自2006年4月起由東京都公園協會直接管理，此安排於2011年3月結束。

cc601953067d2fa4.en: “Kakuzushi” and “Hakozushi” are both types of pressed sushi. The difference lies in the shape and size of the wooden box used. “Kakuzushi” is a type of sushi that can be easily made with “Mossou”, a small wooden box (about 5 cm square). In addition to the square shape, there are also flower shapes and pine, bamboo and plum shapes. On the other hand, the wooden box used in "Hakozushi" is larger than that of "Kakuzushi" and the finished product is cut into pieces before serving.
cc601953067d2fa4.zh: 「角壽司」與「箱壽司」都是押壽司的一種，差別在於所用木盒的形狀與大小。「角壽司」是用名為「もっそう」的小木盒（約5公分見方）就能輕鬆製作的壽司。除了方形之外，也有花形以及松、竹、梅等形狀。另一方面，「箱壽司」所用的木盒比「角壽司」大，做好後會切塊再上桌。

cc6df8e13c9cfbe3.en: Mount Yamizo (Japanese: 八溝山（やみぞさん）, Hepburn: yamizosan) is a mountain and it stretches Ibaraki Prefecture with Fukushima in Japan. Mount Yamizo is the highest mountain in Ibaraki Prefecture.
cc6df8e13c9cfbe3.zh: 八溝山（やみぞさん）是橫跨日本茨城縣與福島縣的山，為茨城縣最高峰。

cca91eb9c17e69c6.ja: 志の田うどん（しのだうどん）は、愛知県名古屋市周辺で食べられているうどん。
cca91eb9c17e69c6.zh: 志の田うどん是愛知縣名古屋市一帶食用的烏龍麵。

ccb560f68f4e4528.en: The Kōdōkan (弘道館) was the largest han school in Bakumatsu period Japan. Located in Mito, Ibaraki Prefecture, three of its buildings have been designated Important Cultural Properties and the school is a Special Historic Site.
ccb560f68f4e4528.zh: 弘道館是日本幕末時期規模最大的藩校，位於茨城縣水戶市。其中三棟建築被指定為重要文化財，學校本身則為特別史跡。

ccf8d9216383a5f6.en: Naganuma Futopia Park is a park in Hasamachokitakata in Tome, Miyagi, Japan. The park is known for its Dutch windmill, which was built in 1991.
ccf8d9216383a5f6.zh: 長沼フートピア公園是位於日本宮城縣登米市迫町北方的公園，以1991年建造的荷蘭風車聞名。

ccfbe1b576bbce54.en: Many people think of konjac potato when it comes to local special product in Gunma. The amount of harvest is the No.1 in Japan (from the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries ‘The size of cultivation area, production area and the amount of harvest of konjac potato in 2020’), which is 90% of the market. There are many local dishes used konjac in the prefecture, and "Konnyaku Miso Oden" is one of them. Boiled konjac is served with miso sauce, and it is often eaten in winter.
ccfbe1b576bbce54.zh: 說到群馬的地方特產，許多人會想到蒟蒻芋。其收穫量為日本第一（出自農林水產省「2020年蒟蒻芋栽培面積、生產面積及收穫量」），占市場的90%。縣內有許多使用蒟蒻的鄉土料理，「こんにゃく味噌おでん」就是其中之一。將煮好的蒟蒻搭配味噌醬，常在冬季食用。

cd18cc40c15cff85.en: Yanagawa Castle (梁川城, Yanagawa-jō) was a Sengoku period hirayama-style Japanese castle located in the Yanagawa neighborhood of the city of Date, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2019.
cd18cc40c15cff85.zh: 梁川城是戰國時代的平山城式日本城郭，位於日本福島縣伊達市梁川地區。其遺跡自2019年起列為國家史跡受到保護。

cd195ff7d4ae601f.en: Isawa Dam (胆沢ダム) is an embankment dam on the Isawa River in Iwate Prefecture, Japan. It was constructed between 1983 and 2013. Its reservoir, which submerged the smaller Ishibuchi Dam upstream, was full in May 2013. The dam's 15.7 MW power station was expected to be operational in July 2014.
cd195ff7d4ae601f.zh: 胆沢ダム是位於日本岩手縣膽澤川上的填築式水壩，於1983年至2013年間興建。其水庫淹沒了上游規模較小的石淵水壩，並於2013年5月蓄滿。水壩的15.7MW發電廠預計於2014年7月開始運轉。

cd297e3be0d157d4.en: Kakimochi is mainly eaten as a snack with tea, deep-fried in oil or grilled over charcoal, and is said to originate from the "kakimochi" that was made with rice cakes during the New Year in the lunar calendar. There are two ways to eat it: deep frying the dried rice cake in low-temperature oil or grilling it over charcoal, and it is said to taste best after one month.
cd297e3be0d157d4.zh: かき餅主要是配茶吃的點心，以油炸或炭火烤製，據說源自農曆新年時用年糕製作的「かきもち」。吃法有兩種：將乾燥的年糕以低溫油炸，或以炭火烤，據說放置一個月後最好吃。

cd4f53d2b353a59b.en: Saiki Castle (佐伯城, Saiki-jō) was an Edo period yamajiro-style Japanese castle located in the city of Saiki, Ōita Prefecture, Japan.  Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2023. It is No.194 on the list "Continued 100 Fine Castles of Japan".
cd4f53d2b353a59b.zh: 佐伯城是江戶時代的山城式日本城郭，位於日本大分縣佐伯市。其遺跡自2023年起受國家史跡保護。為「續日本100名城」第194號。

cd57ea6f3b8d37e7.en: The Seto Marine Biological Laboratory  (瀬戸臨海実験所, also known as SMBL), is a marine biology field station of Kyoto University. It is located in the small town of Shirahama in Wakayama Prefecture about 230 km from Kyoto.
cd57ea6f3b8d37e7.zh: 瀬戸臨海実験所（簡稱SMBL）是京都大學的海洋生物學野外研究站，位於和歌山縣的小鎮白濱，距離京都約230公里。

cd6b0f4786164acf.en: In the Tsugaru region, where extensive reclamation was carried out from the beginning of the Edo period, various rice dishes developed. The term "iro-meshi" or "iro-gohan" was used to refer to rice with various ingredients mixed in and flavored with soy sauce. "Goma-gohan" or "goma-mama" is one example of this.Because of its pitch-black color, it was made and offered at Buddhist altars on "Ke-no-hi," such as Buddhist memorial services and days of devotion.
cd6b0f4786164acf.zh: 津輕地區自江戶時代初期起進行大規模開墾，發展出各式各樣的米飯料理。「色飯」或「色ご飯」指的是拌入各種食材、以醬油調味的米飯，「ごまご飯」（又稱「ごままま」）即為其中一例。由於顏色烏黑，會在佛教法會、精進日等「褻の日」製作並供奉於佛壇。

cd6e28476b10eeba.en: Taki-no Castle (滝の城, Taki-no-jō; literally means "waterfall castle") is a flatland-hilltop Japanese castle ruin located in Tokorozawa, Saitama Prefecture. It was on a key route between the northern Kanto Plain and Hachioji.
cd6e28476b10eeba.zh: 滝の城（字面意思為「瀑布之城」）是位於埼玉縣所澤市的平山城遺跡。該城位於關東平原北部與八王子之間的要道上。

cd7730460ed37042.en: Kumano Magaibutsu (熊野磨崖仏) is a group of Buddhist statues carved in bas-relief into a tuff cliff on the Kunisaki Peninsula in Bungotakada, Ōita Prefecture on the island of Kyushu, Japan. In 1955, Kumano Magaibutsu, along with nearby Motomiya Magaibutsu (元宮磨崖仏) and Nabeyama Magaibutsu (鍋山磨崖仏), were designated as a National Historic Sites of Japan. The carvings were designated as a National Important Cultural Property in 1964.
cd7730460ed37042.zh: 熊野磨崖仏是位於日本九州大分縣豐後高田市國東半島、在凝灰岩崖壁上以淺浮雕刻成的一組佛像。1955年，熊野磨崖仏與附近的元宮磨崖仏、鍋山磨崖仏一同被指定為日本國家史跡。這些雕刻於1964年被指定為國家重要文化財。

cd8a4ba27c3a864a.en: Nippon Totor Green Dome Maebashi (日本トーターグリーンドーム前橋, Nihon Tōtā Gurīn Dōmu Maebashi) is an arena in Maebashi, Japan. With a capacity of 8,000, it is primarily used for indoor sports. One of its primary functions is as a velodrome - when it is known as Maebashi Velodrome (前橋競輪場, Maebashi Keirinjyō) - holding parimutuel Keirin races throughout the year.
cd8a4ba27c3a864a.zh: 日本トーターグリーンドーム前橋是位於日本前橋的室內場館，可容納8,000人，主要用於室內運動。其主要用途之一是作為自行車競賽場，此時稱為前橋競輪場，全年舉辦彩池投注制的競輪比賽。

cd946cc5867f9084.en: Enkō-in (円光院) is a Buddhist temple located in the Iwakubo neighborhood of the city of Kōfu, Yamanashi Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Myōshin-ji branch of Rinzai Zen and its honzon is a statue of Shakyamuni Buddha. The temple's full name is Zuiganzan Enkō-in (瑞巌山 円光院). It is one of the five temples in Kōfu established by Takeda Shingen during the Sengoku period, and is known as the family temple of Shingen's wife, Lady Sanjō.
cd946cc5867f9084.zh: 円光院是位於日本山梨縣甲府市岩窪町的佛教寺院，屬於臨濟宗妙心寺派，本尊為釋迦牟尼佛像。寺院全名為瑞巌山円光院。為戰國時代武田信玄在甲府設立的五座寺院之一，以信玄之妻三條夫人的菩提寺而聞名。

cdcc6cab9de0cd36.en: The Himi Seaside Botanical Garden (氷見市海浜植物園, Himi-shi Kaihin Shokubutsuen) is a botanical garden located at 3583 Banchi, Tanagida, Himi, Toyama, Japan. It is open daily except Tuesdays; an admission fee is charged.
cdcc6cab9de0cd36.zh: 冰見市海濱植物園位於日本富山縣冰見市柳田3583番地。除星期二外每日開放，需購票入園。

cdd0f3ad277b7199.en: The Sannō-Gakoi Site (山王囲遺跡, Sannō-Gakoi iseki) is an archaeological site located in the city of Kurihara, Miyagi Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan, containing the ruins of a  late Jōmon period to Yayoi period (approximately 500 BC to 0 BC) settlement. The site was designated a National Historic Site in 1991 by the Japanese government.
cdd0f3ad277b7199.zh: 山王囲遺跡位於日本東北地方宮城縣栗原市，是一處考古遺址，保存繩文時代晚期至彌生時代（約西元前500年至西元前0年）的聚落遺跡。1991年由日本政府指定為國家史跡。

cdf9e76d7bba40e6.en: "Hatto" is a dish made by kneading and rolling a mixture of buckwheat flour, rice flour, or glutinous rice flour, cutting it into diamond shapes, and boiling it. During the Edo period, there was a movement to restrict the consumption of excessive rice and soba, leading to a prohibition on flour-based foods. During this period, people secretly used normally prohibited ingredients such as buckwheat flour and rice flour for cooking, and it was said to be called "hatto" because they discreetly consumed it despite the restrictions.
cdf9e76d7bba40e6.zh: 「はっとう」是將蕎麥粉、米粉或糯米粉混合後揉捏擀開，切成菱形再煮熟的料理。江戶時代曾有限制過度食用米和蕎麥的政令，因而禁止以粉製作的食物。當時人們偷偷用蕎麥粉、米粉等原本被禁止的材料烹調，據說因為是違背禁令（法度）暗中食用，所以稱為「はっとう」。

ce093e6de799f17b.en: Mifune Dinosaur Museum (御船町恐竜博物館, Mifune-machi Kyōryū Hakubutsukan) opened in Mifune, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan in 1998. The museum collects, preserves, researches, and displays the dinosaur fossils found in the area; the collection, which includes Japan's first fossil from a meat-eating dinosaur, Mifunesaurus, numbers some 15,000 items.
ce093e6de799f17b.zh: 御船町恐竜博物館於1998年在日本熊本縣御船町開館。館方蒐集、保存、研究並展示當地發現的恐龍化石；館藏約15,000件，包括日本第一件肉食性恐龍化石「御船龍」。

ce2578d0dc1bf69f.en: Kuwabara Castle (桑原城, Kuwabara-jō), also known as Takatoya Castle and Suisho Castle, is a yamashiro (castle located on a mountain) situated in Suwa, Nagano Prefecture, Japan. The castle was constructed sometime in the fifteenth century by the Kuwabara clan. By the time it came under the control of the Suwa clan, it had become a satellite castle to Uehara Castle. When forces of the Takeda clan arrived in the area in 1542, the lord of Uehara Castle, Suwa Yorishige, retreated to Kuwabara Castle, which was soon surrounded by Takeda soldiers.
ce2578d0dc1bf69f.zh: 桑原城，又稱高鳥屋城、水晶城，是位於日本長野縣諏訪市的山城（建於山上的城）。此城於十五世紀某時由桑原氏所建。到了歸諏訪氏掌控時，已成為上原城的支城。1542年武田氏軍隊來到此地時，上原城城主諏訪賴重退守桑原城，該城不久即遭武田軍包圍。

ce37a2b6659f3fd8.en: ‘Kokera-Sushi’ is a kind of sushi. Grilled fish flake, Shiitake mushroom, carrots and thin omelette are placed on the vinegared rice into a wooden flame, then pressed. It is said that this dish is the original form of ‘Oshi-Zushi’ or ‘Hako-Zushi’. There are many stories behind the origin of the name. Some said that as wooden frame for sushi was made from ‘Kokera-Ita (=Shingle board)’ , this dish was called ‘Kokera-Sushi'. Others that the dish looked like ‘Kokera (=Woodchips)’ . The ingredients vary depending on the region.
ce37a2b6659f3fd8.zh: 「こけら寿司」是一種壽司。將烤魚肉鬆、香菇、紅蘿蔔與薄蛋皮鋪在放入木框的醋飯上，再加壓製成。據說這道料理是押壽司、箱壽司的原型。名稱由來有多種說法。有人說因為壽司木框是用「こけら板（木瓦板）」做成，所以稱為「こけら寿司」；也有人說是因為外觀看起來像「こけら（木屑）」。使用的食材依地區而異。

ce495af3b2a935fb.en: In Yamanashi Prefecture, "Imogara" is a commonly consumed food that is made from the peeled skin of various types of taro, such as Yattsu-Atama and Akameimo, or from the peeled stems of Hasuimo (taro) that are grown for harvesting the leaf stalks (the part between the leaf and stem). It is also known as "Hoshizuiki." Imogara is dried and used as a preserved food, finding its way into various dishes. When rehydrated, it absorbs broth and seasonings well and has a crunchy texture due to its fibrous nature.
ce495af3b2a935fb.zh: 在山梨縣，「いもがら」是常見的食材，以八頭、赤芽芋等各種芋頭削下的皮，或為採收葉柄（葉與莖之間的部分）而栽培的蓮芋（芋頭）剝皮後的莖製成，也稱為「干しずいき」。いもがら經乾燥後作為保存食品，用於各種料理。泡發後容易吸收高湯與調味料，且因富含纖維而口感爽脆。

ce4e2a731b931d1a.en: The Shodoshima Yokai Art Museum, also known as the Yokai Bijutsukan Art Museum is a small museum in Kagawa prefecture, which is focused on yōkai, supernatural entities in Japanese folklore.
ce4e2a731b931d1a.zh: 小豆島妖怪美術館，又稱妖怪美術館，是位於香川縣的一座小型博物館，以日本民間傳說中的超自然存在「妖怪」為主題。

ce76ba3a28bb55b6.en: Mount Nijō (二上山, Nijōzan) is a mountain in the Kongō Range straddling the prefectural border between Taishi, Osaka and Katsuragi, Nara in Japan. Mount Nijō has twin peaks, Odake (517m) and Medake (474m). From the top there are sweeping views of Nara's basin, Osaka plain and Osaka bay.
ce76ba3a28bb55b6.zh: 二上山是金剛山地中的一座山，橫跨日本大阪府太子町與奈良縣葛城市的府縣界。二上山有兩座山峰，雄岳（517公尺）與雌岳（474公尺）。從山頂可遠眺奈良盆地、大阪平原與大阪灣。

ce79d26db30d7912.en: Tokachi Millennium Forest is a project initiated by newspaper owner Mitsushige Hayashi. In 1990 he bought 400 hectares in Tokachi on the island Hokkaido, in the far north of Japan. His plan was to off-set the carbon footprint of his newspaper Tokachi Mainichi, creating a public park. The project is made up of woodland, gardens, productive areas, "land forms" earthworks, goat farm, rose garden, orchards, meadows and a cafe. It was designed by Dan Pearson, with head gardener Midori Shintani and her assistant Shintaro Sasagawa.
ce79d26db30d7912.zh: 十勝千年の森是報社老闆林光繁發起的計畫。他於1990年在日本最北方的北海道十勝買下400公頃土地，計畫抵銷旗下報紙《十勝每日新聞》的碳足跡，並打造一座公共公園。園區由林地、庭園、生產區、「地形」土方造景、山羊農場、玫瑰園、果園、草地和咖啡館組成，由Dan Pearson設計，首席園丁為新谷みどり，助理為笹川慎太郎。

ce96a22ce216a244.en: From late October to March, Pacific saury migrate south to the Kumano-nada Sea on the cold current from the Sanriku coast to spawn. Pacific saury can be caught all along the coast of Wakayama Prefecture, but the saury caught in the Kumano-nada Sea in the south is especially suitable for sushi because it has been caught in the tides for a long time and its meat is firm, small, and has a good amount of fat.Sanma-zushi was originally made to preserve rice and fish, and was a feast served at autumn festivals, New Year's, and other gatherings.
ce96a22ce216a244.zh: 從10月下旬到3月，秋刀魚會乘著寒流從三陸海岸南下至熊野灘產卵。和歌山縣沿岸各地都能捕到秋刀魚，但在南部熊野灘捕獲的秋刀魚因長時間在潮流中洄游，肉質緊實、體型較小、油脂適中，特別適合做成壽司。さんまずし原本是為了保存米與魚而製作，是秋祭、新年等聚會時享用的佳餚。

ce99716183464532.en: Yunogo Onsen (湯郷温泉, Yunogō Onsen) or simply Yunogō is a hot spring town located in Mimasaka city of Okayama Prefecture, Japan. The waters of the Yunogo hot springs (onsen in Japanese) are a mixture of sodium chloride and calcium chloride, with the amount of discharge at 540 L/min. The waters are said to have healing effects on those suffering from various health problems.
ce99716183464532.zh: 湯郷温泉（ゆのごうおんせん），或簡稱湯郷，是位於日本岡山縣美作市的溫泉町。湯郷溫泉（日語稱onsen）的泉質為氯化鈉與氯化鈣的混合，湧出量為每分鐘540公升。據說此溫泉對患有各種健康問題的人具有療效。

cea732f13e73bd94.en: Sasayama Prefectural Natural Park (篠山県立自然公園, Sasayama kenritsu shizen-kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in southern Ehime Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1964 and extended in 1972, the park spans the borders of the municipalities of Ainan and Uwajima. The park's central feature, the eponymous Mount Sasa, which rises to a height of 1,064.6 metres (3,493 ft), stands on the border between Ehime and Kochi prefectures.
cea732f13e73bd94.zh: 篠山縣立自然公園（篠山県立自然公園）是位於日本愛媛縣南部的縣立自然公園。公園設立於1964年，1972年擴大範圍，跨愛南町與宇和島市。公園的主要景觀為同名的篠山，海拔1,064.6公尺（3,493英尺），位於愛媛縣與高知縣交界。

ceafe7878eeab64e.en: A representative soul food of Yamaguchi Prefecture, widely known across Japan, is "Kawara Soba" (Tile Soba). This dish is served on a hot tile, topped with cha-soba (green tea buckwheat noodles), Kinshi Tamago (shredded omelet), beef, and other ingredients, and it is enjoyed with noodle dipping sauce. Often accompanied by lemon and grated daikon radish, "Kawara Soba" offers a variety of flavors. The origin of "Kawara Soba" dates back to 1961 (Showa 36).
ceafe7878eeab64e.zh: 山口縣具代表性、在日本廣為人知的靈魂美食是「瓦そば」（瓦片蕎麥麵）。這道料理盛在燒熱的瓦片上，鋪上茶蕎麥麵（綠茶蕎麥麵）、錦絲蛋（蛋絲）、牛肉等食材，沾麵汁享用。通常附有檸檬和白蘿蔔泥，「瓦そば」可品嘗到多種風味。「瓦そば」的起源可追溯至1961年（昭和36年）。

ceb6d8b14237f060.en: A local dish that has been passed down since the Edo Period in the Shimabara and Tsushima areas. Although there are slight differences in how it’s cooked, in both regions it’s a dish made by kneading flour made from sweet potatoes into an udon-like shape and putting it in a broth.In the Shimabara region in 1792, Mount Mayuyama collapsed due to a volcanic earthquake, causing a large amount of earth and sand to flow into the Ariake Sea, generating a tsunami. It widely swept across the coast, ravaging entire farmlands and causing famine.
ceb6d8b14237f060.zh: 自江戶時代起在島原與對馬地區流傳至今的鄉土料理。兩地的作法略有不同，但都是將番薯製成的粉揉成類似烏龍麵的形狀，放入湯汁中的料理。在島原地區，1792年眉山因火山地震崩塌，大量土砂流入有明海，引發海嘯。海嘯廣泛席捲沿岸，摧毀整片農地並造成饑荒。

cec32881ae4d38a7.en: The Mikekado area of Buzen City in the northeastern part of the prefecture is a production area for the large Japanese Mikekado pumpkins, which weigh nearly 4kg each and are used to make “pumpkin dangojiru”. The Mikekado pumpkin is said to be the oldest pumpkin in Japan, introduced from Portugal about 450 years ago.
cec32881ae4d38a7.zh: 位於縣東北部豐前市的三毛門地區，是大型日本南瓜「三毛門南瓜」的產地，每顆重近4公斤，用來製作「かぼちゃのだんご汁」。三毛門南瓜據說是日本最古老的南瓜，約450年前從葡萄牙傳入。

cec512a89b578a0b.en: Sugimoto-dera (杉本寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the city of Kamakura, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. The temple's full name is Taizō-zan Kannon-in Sugimoto-dera (大蔵山観音院杉本寺). It is one of the oldest temples in Kamakura and, together with Hōkai-ji, the only one of the Tendai denomination. The temple is Number one of the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage circuit. Two of the three statues of Jūichimen Kannon Bosatsu it enshrines are Important Cultural Properties.
cec512a89b578a0b.zh: 杉本寺（杉本寺）是位於日本神奈川縣鎌倉市的佛教寺院，全名為大蔵山観音院杉本寺（大蔵山観音院杉本寺）。本寺是鎌倉最古老的寺院之一，與宝戒寺同為鎌倉僅有的天台宗寺院。本寺是坂東三十三所巡禮路線的第一番札所。寺內供奉的三尊十一面觀音菩薩像中，有兩尊為重要文化財。

cecf11a55e4efc5b.en: "Kinzanji Miso" is a specialty product of Togane City in Chiba Prefecture and is a type of miso that has been produced in Chiba Prefecture since ancient times. This miso is made by combining soybeans with wheat gluten and adding vegetables such as winter melons, eggplants, and ginger.
cecf11a55e4efc5b.zh: 「金山寺みそ」是千葉縣東金市的特產，是千葉縣自古以來生產的一種味噌。這種味噌是將黃豆與麩質混合，再加入冬瓜、茄子、薑等蔬菜製成。

cee2ae382eff4c68.en: The Yamba Tenmei Mudflow Museum (やんば天明泥流ミュージアム) is a disaster museum located in Naganohara, Gunma prefecture, Japan. It opened on April 3, 2021.
cee2ae382eff4c68.zh: やんば天明泥流ミュージアム是位於日本群馬縣長野原町的災害博物館，於2021年4月3日開館。

ceef20cda354c1ac.en: With its characteristic topography and seawater of various different properties, Toyama Bay is rich in marine resources. Toyama is the only place in Japan that catches enough white shrimp ― a deep sea shrimp with a pale pink glow and the title of “Jewel of Toyama Bay” ― to be viable, with the primary fishing ports being Shinminato and Iwase. Alongside yellowtail and firefly squid, it is also recognized as a “Fish of Toyama Prefecture.” In the past, white shrimp were mostly dried with their shells and used as soup stock.
ceef20cda354c1ac.zh: 富山灣因其特有的地形及多種性質不同的海水，海洋資源豐富。白蝦是帶有淡粉紅光澤的深海蝦，有「富山灣寶石」之稱，富山是日本唯一捕獲量足以形成產業的地方，主要漁港為新湊與岩瀨。白蝦與鰤魚、螢火魷並列為「富山縣之魚」。過去白蝦大多連殼曬乾，用來熬湯頭。

cefe86fdef2d14b9.en: Cape Hedo (辺戸岬, Hedo-misaki; Okinawan: Fidu-misachi ,Kunigami:Pidu-sacii), also known as Hedo Point, is the northernmost point on Okinawa Island, located within Kunigami Village. A cape jutting out north from the island, it faces the East China Sea on the west, and the Pacific Ocean on the east. On a particularly clear day, the island of Yoron (Yoronjima) in Kagoshima Prefecture can be seen on the horizon. Yoron Island is located approximately 23 kilometres (14 mi) to the north.
cefe86fdef2d14b9.zh: 邊戶岬（辺戸岬，Hedo-misaki；沖繩語：Fidu-misachi，國頭語：Pidu-sacii），又稱邊戶角，是沖繩本島的最北端，位於國頭村境內。此岬由島嶼向北突出，西臨東海，東臨太平洋。天氣特別晴朗時，可在地平線上望見鹿兒島縣的與論島。與論島位於北方約23公里（14英里）處。

cf14067067d11e81.en: The Takayama Sericulture School (高山社, Takayama-sha), also known as the "Takayama-sha Sericulture School" or the "Takayama-sha Sericulture Improvement Society", was a school and research institute located in the city of Fujioka, Gunma. It was founded in 1884 by sericulturist Takayama Chōgorō to teach sericulture and conduct research on improvements to Japan's fledgling silk industry. The school building from 1887 was made a National Historic Site of Japan in 2009.
cf14067067d11e81.zh: 高山社又稱「高山社養蠶學校」或「高山社養蠶改良會」，是位於群馬縣藤岡市的學校兼研究機構。1884年由養蠶家高山長五郎創立，用以教授養蠶技術，並研究如何改良當時剛起步的日本絲綢產業。1887年建造的校舍於2009年被指定為日本國家史跡。

cf2b071585b6ba64.en: Kurodaizu is a black soybean that comes mainly from the Tamba area, including Kyotamba Town and Nantan City. The cultivation of soybeans has a long history, and soybeans themselves were counted as one of the five main grains by the time of “Kojiki” (record of ancient matters, edited in 712) and “Nihonshoki” (chronicles of Japan, edited in 720), but it is not known when a variety of soybeans, the Tamba black soybean, was established.
cf2b071585b6ba64.zh: 黑大豆是主要產自京丹波町、南丹市等丹波地區的黑色大豆。大豆的栽培歷史悠久，在《古事記》（712年編纂）和《日本書紀》（720年編纂）的時代，大豆本身已被列為五穀之一，但丹波黑大豆這個大豆品種何時確立則不得而知。

cf332464c5bb9717.en: “Oyaki ”,is a traditional confectionery made by wrapping Red bean paste with a crust made of” Mochi “Glutinous rice and baking it slightly.Shinshu” Oyaki”, with its Wheat flour, and Buckwheat flour skin, and” Nozawana,” or “Eggplant filling”, is well known as “Oyaki”, but Akita's “Oyaki”, is made from Glutinous rice, or Rice flou,r and is characterized by its Red bean paste, filling.It is said that “Oyaki,” has been offered to the mountain god every year on December 12, and in the southern part of the prefecture, it is still customary to grill and eat” Oyaki”, during this time of the year. In some areas of Daisen City, there is still a custom of make a wish to let the” Oyaki, “to take one's bad things away and pouring it into the river to pray for good health and good fortune.It is also famous as a specialty of the morning market, which has a history of more than 500 years in Gojome Town, and has long been enjoyed as a familiar snack. It is characterized by its gentle sweetness and additive-free flavor, which is made by focusing on bringing out the flavors of the ingredients themselves. The Rice cake, has been prepared in various ways in each household, such as by kneading ingredients such as Pumpkin, and “Yomogi,”(mugwort), into the Glutinous Rice, to add color.
cf332464c5bb9717.zh: 「おやき」是以糯米製成的外皮包裹紅豆餡，稍微烘烤而成的傳統點心。信州的「おやき」以小麥粉、蕎麥粉為皮，包入野澤菜或茄子餡，較廣為人知；秋田的「おやき」則以糯米或米粉製作，特色是紅豆餡。據說每年12月12日會將「おやき」供奉給山神，縣南部至今仍有在這個時期烤「おやき」來吃的習俗。大仙市部分地區仍保有一項習俗：許願讓「おやき」帶走自身的厄運，並將其投入河中，祈求健康與好運。它也是五城目町有500多年歷史的朝市名產，長久以來是熟悉的點心。特色是著重引出食材本身風味的溫和甜味與無添加的滋味。各家庭有各種做法，例如在糯米中揉入南瓜、艾草等食材增添顏色。

cf359d27fb255d1c.en: The Nipro Hachiko Dome (ニプロハチ公ドーム, Nipuro Hachikou Dōmu) is a large wooden stadium in Ōdate, Akita, in northern Japan. The stadium covers an area of 12,915 m2. It was completed in June 1997 and is made from 25,000 Akita cypress trees which are covered with a special double Teflon-coated membrane. This allows enough sunlight into the stadium so that during the day no artificial lights are needed.
cf359d27fb255d1c.zh: ニプロハチ公ドーム是位於日本北部秋田縣大館市的大型木造體育場，占地12,915平方公尺。1997年6月完工，使用25,000棵秋田杉建造，外覆特殊雙層鐵氟龍塗層膜，能讓足夠陽光進入場內，白天不需人工照明。

cf6934cf0207fee8.en: Jison-in (慈尊院) is a Buddhist temple in the town of Kudoyama that marks the entrance to the pilgrimage route of Koyasan.
cf6934cf0207fee8.zh: 慈尊院是位於九度山町的佛寺，為高野山朝聖路線的入口。

cf6bdb0cb07a3317.en: Ryukyu University Museum (Fūjukan) (琉球大学博物館（風樹館）, Ryūkyū Daigaku Hakubutsukan (Fūjukan)) is a university museum affiliated with the University of the Ryukyus in Nishihara, Okinawa Prefecture, Japan. Of the collection of 160,000 items, which includes zoological type specimens and cultural artefacts such as the remains of the sundial from Shuri Castle and examples of warazan, some fifteen hundred are included in the permanent exhibition.
cf6bdb0cb07a3317.zh: 琉球大學博物館（風樹館）（琉球大学博物館（風樹館），Ryūkyū Daigaku Hakubutsukan (Fūjukan)）是隸屬於琉球大學的大學博物館，位於日本沖繩縣西原町。館藏共16萬件，包括動物模式標本，以及首里城日晷殘件、藁算（わらざん）實例等文化文物，其中約1,500件列入常設展。

cf6beb41cd81bada.en: Hōraku-yaki is a specialty dish of Imabari City. It is a vibrant and hearty dish made using a flat roasting pan called a "hōraku-nabe" to roast a variety of fresh seafood, such as bream, octopus, turban shells, shrimp, and clams, all of which are caught in the rough waters of the Kurushima Strait, known as one of Japan's three major tidal currents. The seafood is seasoned only with salt and then steamed and roasted, resulting in a simple yet splendid and grandiose dish.
cf6beb41cd81bada.zh: 法樂燒是今治市的特色料理。使用稱為「法樂鍋」的平底烤鍋，烤製鯛魚、章魚、蠑螺、蝦、蛤蜊等各種新鮮海產，這些海產都捕自日本三大潮流之一、水流湍急的來島海峽。海產只用鹽調味，再蒸烤而成，是一道簡單卻豪華、豐盛的料理。

cf6d6b8344bbe9c4.en: Ubagami Daijingū (姥神大神宮) is a Shinto shrine in Esashi, Hokkaidō, Japan. Its foundation date is uncertain but its existence is documented from the Edo period. It is considered the oldest Shinto Shrine in Hokkaido. The Ubagami Daijingū Togyosai, when floats decked out with lanterns are paraded through the town, is celebrated in August.
cf6d6b8344bbe9c4.zh: 姥神大神宮是位於日本北海道江差的神社。創建年代不詳，但江戶時代已有記載，被認為是北海道最古老的神社。姥神大神宮渡御祭於8月舉行，屆時裝飾燈籠的山車會在町內遊行。

cf73ef70e720802c.en: Lake Miike (御池, Miike) is a lake in Miyakonojō and Takaharu in Miyazaki Prefecture, Japan.
cf73ef70e720802c.zh: 御池是位於日本宮崎縣都城市與高原町的湖泊。

cf749912418dadb4.en: Hōkō-ji (方広寺) is a Buddhist temple near Hamamatsu, Shizuoka Prefecture that dates from the 14th century.
cf749912418dadb4.zh: 方廣寺是位於靜岡縣濱松市附近的佛寺，歷史可追溯至14世紀。

cf942d44ff0933c0.en: A collective term for sushi made in Osaka, which includes pressed sushi, rolled sushi, and steamed sushi. While in Tokyo, "sushi" typically refers to hand-pressed nigiri sushi, the representative form of sushi in Osaka is oshizushi, where rice and ingredients are layered and firmly pressed.Among oshizushi, a particularly notable variety is the "nisun rokubu no kaiseki," also known as boxed sushi. Originally, pressed sushi featuring common fish like mackerel and horse mackerel was popular among the general public.
cf942d44ff0933c0.zh: 大阪製作的壽司的總稱，包括押壽司、卷壽司和蒸壽司。在東京，「壽司」通常指用手捏製的握壽司，而大阪壽司的代表形式是押壽司，將米飯和配料層層疊放並壓緊。押壽司當中，特別著名的是「二寸六分的懷石」，也稱為箱壽司。最初，以鯖魚、竹筴魚等常見魚類製作的押壽司在一般民眾之間很受歡迎。

cf958af3dea33359.en: Chūbu Sankei Prefectural Natural Park (中部山渓県立自然公園, Chūbu Sankei kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in central Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. Established in 2006, the park spans the borders of the municipalities of Kaiyō, Kamikatsu, Kamiyama, and Naka. Within the park is the temple of Shōsan-ji (焼山寺), temple 12 on the Shikoku pilgrimage.
cf958af3dea33359.zh: 中部山渓県立自然公園是位於日本德島縣中部的縣立自然公園。公園設立於2006年，範圍橫跨海陽町、上勝町、神山町及那賀町。園內有四國遍路第12號札所燒山寺。

cfa2e69b13d4995f.en: In Okinawa Prefecture, where pork is often eaten, it is said that "everything but the squeal is eaten up" because every last bit is used in cooking. Among them, "Nakami-no-suimono," also called "Nakami-no-suimono," is a local dish made from pork entrails such as large and small intestines and stomach, and is simply prepared in a clear soup. Despite the use of offal, the dish is characterized by its light and refreshing flavor.
cfa2e69b13d4995f.zh: 在常吃豬肉的沖繩縣，由於每一部分都會用來烹調，有「除了叫聲以外全都吃光」的說法。其中，中身汁又稱「中身の吸い物」，是以大腸、小腸、胃等豬內臟製作的鄉土料理，簡單地煮成清湯。雖然使用內臟，特色卻是風味清淡爽口。

cfa3bbfeac823cfe.en: Samegao Castle (鮫ヶ尾城, Samegao-jō) was a Sengoku period yamashiro-style Japanese castle located in what is now the Yukimori and Miyauchi neighborhoods of the city of Myōkō, Niigata Prefecture in the Hokuriku region of Honshu, Japan. The ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2008.
cfa3bbfeac823cfe.zh: 鮫ヶ尾城是位於日本本州北陸地區新潟縣妙高市，今雪森及宮內一帶的戰國時代山城式日本城郭。遺址自2008年起被指定為國家史跡加以保護。

cfae523055c9cc50.en: Kōtoku-in (高徳院) is a Buddhist temple of the Jōdo-shū sect in the city of Kamakura in Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. Its mountain name is Daii-zan (大異山), and its common temple name is Shōjōsen-ji (清浄泉寺).
cfae523055c9cc50.zh: 高德院是位於日本神奈川縣鎌倉市的淨土宗佛寺。山號為大異山，通稱寺名為清淨泉寺。

cfb543549a4dbcb5.en: “Egoma”（Perilla） is widely grown in Fukushima Prefecture. It is called “Junen” in the prefecture and is also used in various local dishes. The “Junen-miso” is made with“Junen” which is mashed and mixed with” Miso”, “Sake”, Sugar, and “Mirin” , then spread on mashed rice and baked.
cfb543549a4dbcb5.zh: 福島縣廣泛種植「荏胡麻」（紫蘇籽）。縣內稱之為「じゅうねん」，也用於各種鄉土料理。「じゅうねん味噌」是將じゅうねん搗碎，與味噌、酒、砂糖和味醂混合製成，再塗在搗碎的米飯上烘烤。

cfdd7e7b45b50d17.en: [1]Ishigaki City Yaeyama Museum (石垣市立八重山博物館, Ishigaki shiritsu Yaeyama hakubutsukan) opened in 1972 in Ishigaki, Okinawa Prefecture, Japan. The collection covers the archaeology, history, art, and folk traditions of Ishigaki and the Yaeyama Islands.
cfdd7e7b45b50d17.zh: 石垣市立八重山博物館（石垣市立八重山博物館，Ishigaki shiritsu Yaeyama hakubutsukan）於1972年在日本沖繩縣石垣市開館。館藏涵蓋石垣及八重山群島的考古、歷史、美術與民俗傳統。

cfe6b4936944c31f.en: The Gaiety Theatre (ゲーテ座) was a public hall in Naka-ku, Yokohama, Japan. It was built in 1866 by Dutch merchant MJB Noordhoek Hegt behind his office at Settlement plot 68. An amateur dramatic club was organized and performed at the public hall. Hegt rented the hall at a very reasonable price for the dramatic club's performances but it soon proved to be too small and was also being used for many other activities so, in 1870, another small theater was built on Honmachi Street and became the original Gaiety Theatre.
cfe6b4936944c31f.zh: ゲーテ座（ゲーテ座）是日本橫濱市中區的一座公共會堂，1866年由荷蘭商人MJB Noordhoek Hegt建於其位於居留地68號地的事務所後方。當時成立了一個業餘戲劇社，在此會堂演出。Hegt以相當低廉的價格出租會堂供戲劇社演出，但會堂很快就顯得過小，且也被用於許多其他活動，因此1870年在本町通另建了一座小劇場，成為最初的ゲーテ座。

d005d7dac3d5e2ba.en: The origin of "Aburage-zushi(Inari-zushi)" is a matter of some debate, but it is said to have originated when rice was stuffed into fried thin tofu that had been offered to "Inari-san" and made into a sushi. There are also various theories as to where it originated, and the town in front of "Toyokawa Inari Shrine", one of the three major Inari shrines in Japan, along with Edo and Nagoya, is said to be the birthplace of the dish.
d005d7dac3d5e2ba.zh: あぶらげずし（稻荷壽司）的起源眾說紛紜，據說是將供奉給「稻荷神」的油豆皮塞入米飯做成壽司而來。關於發源地也有各種說法，除了江戶與名古屋之外，日本三大稻荷之一「豐川稻荷」的門前町也被認為是這道料理的發祥地。

d0388f676b431ca8.en: Amago is a freshwater fish about 20 cm long (can reach 30 cm or more) and a member of the salmon family Satsukimasu. It is characterized by small oval-shaped spots called parr markings and fine vermilion dots, and is also called the "queen of mountain streams" because of its beautiful appearance. It has a mild flavor for river fish, and can be enjoyed in a variety of dishes such as tempura, grilled with salt, meuniere, and kanroni (sweetened and simmered).Also known as "Amenou" or "Amego", this trout is designated as Nara Prefecture's fish.
