d0388f676b431ca8.zh: アマゴ（天魚）是體長約20公分（可達30公分以上）的淡水魚，屬於鮭科的皐月鱒。特徵是有稱為幼鮭斑的橢圓形小斑紋與細小的朱紅色斑點，因外型美麗也被稱為「溪流女王」。以河魚而言風味溫和，可做成天婦羅、鹽烤、法式奶油煎魚、甘露煮（甜煮）等多種料理享用。這種鱒魚又稱「アメノウ」或「アメゴ」，被指定為奈良縣的縣魚。

d03f3f3f8408b1a3.en: The Kurokawa Institute of Ancient Cultures (黒川古文化研究所, Kurokawa Kobunka Kenkyūjo) is a private research institute in Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan that preserves, researches, publishes, and exhibits materials relating to the arts, crafts, archaeology, history, and cultures of East Asia, in particular China and Japan. Established in 1950, the Institute relocated from Ashiya to Nishinomiya in 1974. The collection numbers some 8,500 works (20,000 individual items).
d03f3f3f8408b1a3.zh: 黒川古文化研究所是位於日本兵庫縣的私立研究機構，從事東亞（特別是中國與日本）美術、工藝、考古、歷史及文化相關資料的保存、研究、出版與展示。該所成立於1950年，1974年由蘆屋遷至西宮。收藏約8,500件作品（20,000件單品）。

d042bffa628e6cd2.en: "Suizen " is one of the local dishes of Wajima that has been passed down the ages since ancient times. Tengusa is boiled, rice flour is added, and the mixture is left to harden. It has its roots in shojin ryori and is eaten in place of sashimi.It is a dish served at memorial services and funerals, and it was common for each family to make it before a funeral a long time ago. People from the neighborhood also gathered to help make it. Sesame saus is indispensable for suizen. This is a mixture of ground black sesame, brown sugar, and soy sauce.
d042bffa628e6cd2.zh: 「すいぜん」是輪島自古流傳至今的鄉土料理之一。將石花菜煮過後加入米粉，再靜置使其凝固。其源自精進料理，用來代替生魚片食用。這是在法會及葬禮上供應的料理，從前在葬禮前由各家自行製作十分普遍，鄰近的居民也會聚集幫忙。芝麻醬是すいぜん不可或缺的搭配，由磨碎的黑芝麻、黑糖和醬油混合而成。

d0589f408ea75239.en: In Fukuoka Prefecture, where wheat production is large, many farmers have been growing wheat in addition to rice. Wheat is powdered in each household and made into Dango, which is eaten as a snack during farm work or as a hospitality for guests, and is always made during "Sanabori". The word "Sanabori" is said to be derived from "Sanobori," or "ascending to the heavens," as the god of rice fields rises to the heavens after watching the planting of rice.
d0589f408ea75239.zh: 福岡縣小麥產量大，許多農家除了種稻也種植小麥。小麥在各家庭磨成粉後做成糰子，作為農忙時的點心或招待客人，在「さなぼり」時一定會製作。「さなぼり」一詞據說源自「さのぼり」，意為「升天」，因為田神看著插秧完成後便升天而去。

d061780c6d1d97cc.en: It is a type of oshizushi made by filling a square wooden mold with sushi rice and other ingredients, and is eaten in the Asakita-ku area of Hiroshima City and the Geihoku region of Hiroshima Prefecture. When pressed out of the wooden frame, six to eight pieces of the same size are formed at the same time, and the finished product is square, hence the name "kaku-zushi" (square sushi). It is sometimes called "oshizushi" or "Inaka sushi" (country sushi).
d061780c6d1d97cc.zh: 這是一種押壽司，將壽司飯和其他食材填入方形木模製成，在廣島市安佐北區及廣島縣藝北地區食用。從木框中壓出時，會同時形成6至8塊大小相同的壽司，成品呈方形，因此稱為「角寿司」。有時也稱為「押壽司」或「田舍壽司」。

d07195cd4d3c5139.en: In the old days, nukazuke was a preserved food of the Ogasawara clan, and it was handed down to an old family in Kokura, where it spread among the common people. In the old houses of Kokura, nukazuke pickles are made in lacquer or vermilion-lacquered tubs with the family name on them, and have been handed down from generation to generation, and are shared with daughters who marry into the family. Not a few families are proud of their "hundred-year old" pickles.
d07195cd4d3c5139.zh: 糠漬在過去是小笠原氏的保存食品，傳到小倉的舊家後，再普及至一般百姓。在小倉的舊家中，糠漬是用寫有家名的漆桶或朱漆桶醃製，代代相傳，並分給出嫁的女兒。以「百年」糠床自豪的家庭不在少數。

d08d3c063746e71c.en: The Amagasaki Cultural Center (尼崎市総合文化センター) is a complex located in Amagasaki, Japan. The building, which opened in 1975, has three concerts halls. The "Archaic Hall" is the largest and seats 2,030 people. Notable past performers include Roger Daltrey, Yes, The Smashing Pumpkins, INXS, Santana and Alcatrazz.
d08d3c063746e71c.zh: 尼崎市綜合文化中心是位於日本尼崎市的綜合設施。建築於1975年啟用，設有三座音樂廳，其中「Archaic Hall」規模最大，可容納2,030人。過去曾在此演出的知名表演者包括Roger Daltrey、Yes、The Smashing Pumpkins、INXS、Santana及Alcatrazz。

d094991fe2d93a1a.en: Ino Paper Museum (いの町紙の博物館, Ino-chō kami no hakubutsukan) is a museum of Japanese paper in Ino, Kōchi Prefecture, Japan. It focuses on the production of Tosa Washi, dating back over a thousand years, and paper is also made by hand in a workshop on site.
d094991fe2d93a1a.zh: いの町紙の博物館是位於日本高知縣伊野町的和紙博物館，以擁有千年以上歷史的土佐和紙製作為主題，館內工房也有手工造紙。

d0a2d978c7739371.en: Siebold Memorial Museum (シーボルト記念館, Shīboruto Kinenkan) was opened in Nagasaki city  on October 1, 1989 in honour of Philipp Franz von Siebold and his contributions to the development of modern science in Japan. The building is modeled on his former house in Leiden, and the entrance is modeled after the former home of Siebold's grandfather, Karl Caspar. The museum displays 206 items classified into six categories describing Von Siebold's six-year stay in Nagasaki, the so-called "Siebold incident", and his life work on Japan.
d0a2d978c7739371.zh: シーボルト記念館於1989年10月1日在長崎市開館，紀念菲利普・法蘭茲・馮・西博德（Philipp Franz von Siebold）及其對日本近代科學發展的貢獻。建築仿照他在萊登的故居，入口則仿照西博德祖父卡爾・卡斯帕（Karl Caspar）的故居。館內展出206件文物，分為六類，介紹西博德在長崎六年的生活、所謂的「西博德事件」，以及他畢生對日本的研究。

d0b6829ef7655ea4.en: The North Breakwater Dome (北防波堤ドーム, kita bōhatei dōmu) is a long arched "semi-domical" structure in the port area of Wakkanai, Hokkaidō, Japan. Rising to a height of 13.6 metres (45 ft) above the sea and extending some 427 metres (1,401 ft), with seventy columns, an intercolumniation of 6 metres (20 ft), and a width from column to wall of 8 metres (26 ft), the form, inspired by a Roman arcade, is said to be without parallel.
d0b6829ef7655ea4.zh: 北防波堤ドーム是位於日本北海道稚內港區的長形拱狀「半圓頂」結構物。高出海面13.6公尺（45英尺），全長約427公尺（1,401英尺），有七十根柱子，柱距6公尺（20英尺），柱子至牆面寬8公尺（26英尺）。其造型參考羅馬式拱廊，據稱獨一無二。

d0c40c71532d535c.en: Osaka Shirona is said to be a hybrid of Santona or Chinese cabbage and Taisai. Cultivation began in the Edo period (1603-1867), and in the early Meiji period (1868-1912), it was actively cultivated near Tenmabashi in the center of Osaka City, hence the name "Tenmana". Toward the end of the Meiji period, cultivation spread to the Higashiyodogawa, Joto, and Sumiyoshi areas. There are three different strains: early, mid, and late varieties, all of which have a clear white petiole with a flat shaft.
d0c40c71532d535c.zh: 據說大阪白菜是山東菜或大白菜與體菜的雜交種。栽培始於江戶時代（1603-1867），明治時代（1868-1912）初期在大阪市中心的天滿橋附近大量栽培，因此稱為「天滿菜」。明治末期，栽培擴展到東淀川、城東和住吉地區。有早生、中生、晚生三個品系，都具有潔白扁平的葉柄。

d0cb5bd0470f8533.en: Ashikuraji area in Tateyama Town is the gateway to Tateyama mountain range, one of the three sacred mountains in Japan. In the Edo period (1603-1867), it was a village of Tateyama worship, and there were many lodgings where worshippers would gathered. "Tsubo-ni" is one of the vegetarian dishes served at these lodgings, and nowadays it is also served at home. The name comes from the fact that it was served in a deep-bottomed vermilion lacquered bowl with a lid, called tsubo-bowl. The main ingredient is kugomi, a spring mountain vegetable.
d0cb5bd0470f8533.zh: 立山町的芦峅寺地區是日本三靈山之一立山連峰的入口。江戶時代（1603-1867），這裡是立山信仰的村落，有許多供參拜者聚集的宿坊。「つぼ煮」是這些宿坊供應的素食料理之一，現在也是家庭料理。名稱由來是以稱為壺碗、附蓋的深底朱漆碗盛裝。主要食材是春季山菜くごみ。

d0d832992b97fedb.en: Shōfuku-ji (聖福寺) is an Ōbaku Zen temple in Nagasaki, Nagasaki, Japan. Its honorary sangō prefix is Manjusan (万寿山).
d0d832992b97fedb.zh: 聖福寺是位於日本長崎縣長崎市的黃檗宗禪寺，山號為萬壽山。

d0dad012dd3525bd.en: The Chigasakikan (茅ヶ崎館) is a traditional Japanese inn situated in Chigasaki, Kanagawa, Japan. Chigasakikan opened in 1899, and is one of the last remaining seaside ryokan in the Shonan region, which were once abundant. Film directors such as Yasujirō Ozu and Kaneto Shindo were among those who regularly used the area as their holiday home.
d0dad012dd3525bd.zh: 茅ヶ崎館是位於日本神奈川縣茅崎市的傳統日式旅館，於1899年開業，是湘南地區過去為數眾多的海濱旅館中，少數僅存的一家。小津安二郎、新藤兼人等電影導演都曾經常把此地當作度假住處。

d0e099d79d6cd371.en: The Isumi River (夷隅川, Isumigawa) is a river in Chiba Prefecture, Japan. It is 68 kilometers (42 mi) in length and has a drainage area of 299 square kilometers (115 sq mi). Under the Rivers Act of 1906 the Isumi is designated as a Class 2 River. Additionally, the government has designated the Isumi River a national-level Natural Monument (天然記念物, tennen kinenbutsu).
d0e099d79d6cd371.zh: 夷隅川是日本千葉縣的河川，全長68公里（42英里），流域面積299平方公里（115平方英里）。依據1906年的《河川法》，夷隅川被指定為二級河川。此外，政府也將夷隅川指定為國家級天然紀念物。

d0e1d76adb2becbe.en: Shiobara Dam is a gravity dam located in Tochigi prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for flood control and irrigation. The catchment area of the dam is 119.5 km2. The dam impounds about 41  ha of land when full and can store 8760 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1969 and completed in 1978.
d0e1d76adb2becbe.zh: 鹽原水壩（塩原ダム）是位於日本栃木縣的重力壩，用於防洪及灌溉。集水面積為119.5平方公里，滿水時淹沒面積約41公頃，可蓄水876萬立方公尺。水壩於1969年動工，1978年完工。

d0ec34a17b1ff4ca.en: Yomiuri Giants Stadium is a baseball stadium in Kawasaki, Kanagawa, Japan. The stadium, which holds 4,000 people, also serves as the training home of the Yomiuri Giants.
d0ec34a17b1ff4ca.zh: 讀賣巨人球場是位於日本神奈川縣川崎市的棒球場，可容納4,000人，也是讀賣巨人隊的訓練基地。

d0f5b255ef133b8a.en: Harvest Festival (豊年祭, Hōnensai) is a fertility festival celebrated every year on March 15 in some locations in Aichi Prefecture, Japan. Hōnen means prosperous year in Japanese, implying a rich harvest, while a matsuri is a festival. The Hōnen festival and ceremony celebrate the blessings of a bountiful harvest and all manner of prosperity and fertility.
d0f5b255ef133b8a.zh: 豐年祭（豊年祭）是每年3月15日在日本愛知縣部分地區舉行的祈求豐饒祭典。日文「豐年」意為興旺的年份，意指豐收；「祭」則是祭典。豐年祭及其儀式慶祝豐收的恩賜，以及各種繁榮與豐饒。

d0fb9816c3ad4b18.en: Hachisun" is a stew made from a combination of mountain and sea vegetables that was eaten in areas where there were many Aki Monzoku (Jodo Shinshu sect members in the western part of Hiroshima Prefecture). Some say that the name comes from the fact that the lacquerware used to serve it has a diameter of eight inches (about 24 centimeters), while others say that it is made from "eight different ingredients. It is also called "ohasun.
d0fb9816c3ad4b18.zh: 「八寸」是一種結合山產與海產食材的燉煮料理，過去在安藝門徒（廣島縣西部的淨土真宗信徒）眾多的地區食用。有人說名稱來自盛裝這道菜的漆器直徑為八寸（約24公分），也有人說是因為使用「八種不同的食材」製作。也稱為「おはっすん」。

d0fd9670ac595b41.en: The Takamatsu Art Museum (高松市美術館, Takamatsu-shi Bijutsukan) opened in Takamatsu, Kagawa Prefecture, Japan, in 1988. The collection, totalling over 1,700 works, has three principal strands: post-war Japanese art, modern and contemporary world art, and the arts and crafts of Kagawa Prefecture. The Museum's predecessor institution, Takamatsu Bijutsukan (高松美術館), opened in Ritsurin Garden in 1949.
d0fd9670ac595b41.zh: 高松市美術館於1988年在日本香川縣高松市開館。館藏共逾1,700件，主要分為三大類：戰後日本美術、近現代世界美術，以及香川縣的美術工藝。美術館的前身高松美術館於1949年在栗林公園內開館。

d11392517dce4089.en: Hachigatsu Odori (八月踊り, Amami:Hachigwacï uduri, Ie dialect:Patigwatsi wudui; lit. "Eighth Month Dance") are Ryukyuan traditional dances performed during the eighth month of the lunar calendar to celebrate the harvest of agricultural crops.
d11392517dce4089.zh: 八月踊（八月踊り，奄美語：Hachigwacï uduri，伊江方言：Patigwatsi wudui；字面意思為「八月之舞」）是在農曆八月演出、慶祝農作物收成的琉球傳統舞蹈。

d125b9f90db8b0de.en: Mikasa Park (三笠公園, Mikasa Kōen) is a park located in Yokosuka, Kanagawa, Japan.
d125b9f90db8b0de.zh: 三笠公園是位於日本神奈川縣橫須賀市的公園。

d14bcd7af794a33b.en: Saitama Prefecture, which produced Aizo Gonda, who devoted himself to the development of high-yield cultivation methods that increased wheat yields by four to five times, such as "barley steeping," is one of the leading udon kingdoms in Japan.
d14bcd7af794a33b.zh: 埼玉縣出身的權田愛三致力於開發「麥踏」等使小麥產量提高四到五倍的高產栽培法，埼玉縣也是日本首屈一指的烏龍麵王國。

d19024a52addc80f.en: Kongōshō-ji (金剛證寺) is a Rinzai school Zen Buddhist temple in the Asamacho neighborhood of the city of Ise, Mie Prefecture Japan. Its main image is a statue of Kokūzō Bosatsu. Founded in the Asuka period, it has been closely associated with the Ise Grand Shrine throughout its history and contains numerous National Treasures and Important Cultural Properties. The sutra mounds found on Mount Asama behind the temple were designated a National Historic Site in 1936.
d19024a52addc80f.zh: 金剛證寺是位於日本三重縣伊勢市朝熊町的臨濟宗禪寺，本尊為虛空藏菩薩像。創建於飛鳥時代，歷來與伊勢神宮關係密切，寺內藏有多件國寶及重要文化財。寺後朝熊山上發現的經塚於1936年被指定為國家史跡。

d1ab2cdfb568ec9b.en: A specialty of Odawara City, it is made by steaming seasoned and well-kneaded fish paste on a wooden board. The main ingredient used is “Guchi”, (a white-fleshed fish). Before the fish is minced, it is cleansed with water several times to remove impurities and oil, resulting in“ kamaboko” with a fine, elastic texture.
d1ab2cdfb568ec9b.zh: 小田原市的特產，將調味並充分揉捏的魚漿放在木板上蒸製而成。主要原料為「グチ」（一種白肉魚）。魚在絞碎前會以清水反覆漂洗數次，去除雜質與油脂，製成口感細緻有彈性的蒲鉾。

d1afeb9baf26e53f.en: "Imonoko-jiru" is a soup dish made using taro and is also eaten as a hot pot dish.Known as a local dish of Iwate and Akita, it is also eaten in various areas including the Tohoku region.In Akita Prefecture, the buds and the buds of those buds that are attached to the parent taros are called “imonoko.” "Imonoko-jiru" uses these taro buds as the main ingredient and is filled with autumn delicacies such as chicken, mushrooms, and edible wild plants.
d1afeb9baf26e53f.zh: 「いものこ汁」是使用芋頭的湯品，也作為火鍋食用。它是知名的岩手與秋田地方料理，在東北地區等各地也有食用。在秋田縣，附著在母芋上的子芋及孫芋稱為「芋の子」。「いものこ汁」以這些子芋為主材料，加入雞肉、菇類、山菜等秋季美味。

d1d503f54986252d.en: Kabusan Prefectural Natural Park (加無山県立自然公園, Kabusan kenritsu shizen-kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Yamagata Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1963, the park lies within the municipalities of Kaneyama and Mamurogawa. The park's central feature is the eponymous Mount Kabu, which rises to a height of 997 metres (3,271 ft).
d1d503f54986252d.zh: 加無山県立自然公園是位於日本山形縣的縣立自然公園。設立於1963年，範圍跨金山町與真室川町。公園的主要景觀是同名的加無山，海拔997公尺（3,271英尺）。

d1e57dca7d286e19.en: The Yoshii Isamu Memorial Museum (香美市立吉井勇記念館, Kami Shiritsu Yoshii Isamu Kinenkan) opened in then Kahoku, now Kami, Kōchi Prefecture, Japan in 2003. It is dedicated to the life and works of poet Yoshii Isamu. In the grounds lies the Keiki-sō, his retreat of 1934, restored in 1964 and relocated to this site in 2006, a registered Tangible Cultural Property.
d1e57dca7d286e19.zh: 吉井勇記念館（香美市立吉井勇記念館）於2003年在日本高知縣當時的香北町（今香美市）開館，介紹詩人吉井勇的生平與作品。園區內有溪鬼莊，為他1934年的隱居處，於1964年修復，2006年遷移至此，是登錄有形文化財。

d207d5a5d139c1b6.en: Fukuyama Castle (福山城, Fukuyama-jō) of Bitchū Province was a Nanboku-chō period yamajiro-style Japanese castle located in what is today the Kiyonemiyori neighborhood of the city of Sōja in Okayama Prefecture. Its ruins have been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 1936.
d207d5a5d139c1b6.zh: 福山城 (備中国)是南北朝時代的山城式日本城郭，位於今岡山縣總社市清音三因地區。其遺跡自1936年起由中央政府指定為國家史跡加以保護。

d20ba5d9160b898c.en: Nakōdo-jima (媒島) is an uninhabited Japanese island in the Mukojima Islands (formerly known as the Parry Group), the northernmost island group of the Bonin Islands, in the village of Ogasawara, Tokyo Metropolis. The entire island and its surrounding waters form part of Ogasawara National Park, while an area of 147 hectares (360 acres) including surrounding reefs forms part of the Ogaswara Islands UNESCO World Heritage Site.
d20ba5d9160b898c.zh: 媒島是位於東京都小笠原村的日本無人島，屬於小笠原群島最北端的群島聟島列島（舊稱Parry群島）。全島及其周邊海域屬於小笠原國立公園，另有包含周邊礁岩在內的147公頃（360英畝）區域屬於聯合國教科文組織世界遺產小笠原群島的一部分。

d2244f5373a8d097.en: "Kurumi-zouni" is also called "Kurumi-mochi (rice cake with walnuts sauce)" and is a typical dish eaten on the morning of New Year's Day in the Miyako region along the Sanriku coast.
d2244f5373a8d097.zh: 「くるみ雑煮」又稱「核桃年糕」（沾核桃醬的年糕），是三陸海岸宮古地區元旦早上食用的代表性料理。

d225340718940e18.en: "Koneri" is a dish in which summer vegetables such as eggplant and bitter melon are stir-fried in oil, then seasoned with miso dissolved in dashi broth, and thickened with flour dissolved in water. It is an efficient way to get nutrients, because the wheat seals in the moisture containing nutrients from the vegetables. It is easy to eat even in the summer when appetites tend to decrease, so it is frequently made at home. It is said that the name "Koneri" comes from the fact that it is thickened ("neru") with flour.
d225340718940e18.zh: 「こねり」是將茄子、苦瓜等夏季蔬菜用油拌炒，再以溶於高湯的味噌調味，並加入麵粉水勾芡的料理。由於麵粉能鎖住蔬菜中含有營養的水分，可以有效率地攝取營養。即使在容易食慾不振的夏天也容易入口，因此常在家中製作。據說「こねり」的名稱來自以麵粉勾芡（「練る」）。

d22e370dbb4fe22a.en: Karasumi is said to have been made in the Tono region around the end of the Edo period for the Peach Festival."Karasumi" is a well-known delicacy made from salted and dried ovaries of mullet and other fish, but this is a Japanese confectionary made from kneaded rice flour and steamed. The characteristic feature of karasumi is its mountain-shaped cross section. The two peaks of the mountain are the most common, but in rare cases there are three. It is said that the mountain shape was created to imitate Mt.
d22e370dbb4fe22a.zh: からすみ據說是江戶時代末期左右，東濃地區為桃花節（女兒節）而製作的點心。「からすみ」原本是以鯔魚等魚類的卵巢鹽漬乾燥而成的知名珍饈，但這裡指的是以米粉揉製後蒸熟的和菓子。からすみ的特色是斷面呈山形，最常見的是兩座山峰，少數也有三座。據說山形是模仿某座山而做的。

d23e2b8f4fd9300f.en: Shirahata Castle (白旗城, Shirahata-jō)  is the remains of a Muromachi period Japanese castle structure located in the town of Kamigōri, Akō District, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site as one of the Remains of Akamatsu-shi Castles, combining both Okishio Castle and Kanjōsan Castle, since 1996.
d23e2b8f4fd9300f.zh: 白旗城是室町時代日本城郭的遺跡，位於日本兵庫縣赤穗郡上郡町。自1996年起，與置鹽城、感状山城一同作為「赤松氏城跡」，被列為國家史跡加以保護。

d275bf558fa91791.en: The inside of the gourd is hollowed out like a gun barrel, stuffed with chili peppers wrapped in perilla leaves as gunpowder, and marinated in a seasoning solution consisting mainly of additive-free soy sauce and mirin (sweet rice wine). The chili peppers make it spicy and crunchy. It is a dish that can be eaten as a side dish with rice or as a snack with sake. The name "Teppozuke" comes from the fact that a gourd with a hole in it looks like a cannonball and a green chili pepper looks like a bullet.
d275bf558fa91791.zh: 將瓜的內部像槍管一樣挖空，塞入以紫蘇葉包裹、作為火藥的辣椒，再以無添加醬油和味醂為主的調味液醃漬。辣椒帶來辣味，口感爽脆。這道料理可作為配飯的小菜，也可當作下酒菜。「鉄砲漬」的名稱來自挖了洞的瓜看起來像砲彈，青辣椒看起來像子彈。

d279374247e538c4.en: Honmyō-ji (本妙寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Nichiren sect, Rokujōmon-ryū (六条門流), in Nishi-ku, Kumamoto, Japan. It is the most high-ranking temple of the sect in Kyushu. In Honmyō-ji is the grave of Katō Kiyomasa, (1562–1611), a Japanese daimyō, builder of Kumamoto Castle and a dedicated buddhist of Nichiren Buddhism.
d279374247e538c4.zh: 本妙寺是位於日本熊本市西區的日蓮宗六條門流佛教寺院，為該宗在九州地位最高的寺院。寺內有加藤清正（1562–1611）之墓，他是日本大名、熊本城的建造者，也是虔誠的日蓮宗信徒。

d293a51abfa76a9d.en: Saioku-ji (柴屋寺) is a Buddhist temple belonging to the Myōshin-ji branch of Rinzai school of Japanese Zen located in Mariko-juku, Suruga-ku, Shizuoka, Japan.  Its main image is a statue of Jūichimen Kannon. The Japanese garden at this temple was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1936 and National Place of Scenic Beauty, with the borders of the historical site expanded in 1970.
d293a51abfa76a9d.zh: 柴屋寺是位於日本靜岡市駿河區丸子宿的佛教寺院，屬日本禪宗臨濟宗妙心寺派。本尊為十一面觀音像。寺內的日本庭園於1936年受指定為日本國家史跡及國家名勝，1970年擴大史跡範圍。

d2988ff300dc8470.en: Formerly, when we would help haul a seine ashore in the summer, the fishermen would share horse mackerel and sardines with us children or adults. Aji no Sanbai ("horse mackerel in sanbaizu sauce") is a regional dish that uses fresh small fish.
d2988ff300dc8470.zh: 從前夏天幫忙把地曳網拉上岸時，漁夫會把竹筴魚和沙丁魚分給我們這些小孩或大人。アジの三杯（「三杯醋竹筴魚」）是使用新鮮小魚的鄉土料理。

d299832b3d8dc639.en: Kawamata Dam is an arch dam located in Tochigi prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for flood control and power production. The catchment area of the dam is 179.4 km2. The dam impounds about 259  ha of land when full and can store 87600 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1957 and completed in 1966.
d299832b3d8dc639.zh: 川俁水壩（川俣ダム）是位於日本栃木縣的拱壩，用於防洪及發電。集水面積為179.4平方公里，滿水時淹沒面積約259公頃，可蓄水8,760萬立方公尺。水壩於1957年動工，1966年完工。

d29b53f257ec808f.en: The Yodokō Guest House (ヨドコウ迎賓館, Yodokōgeihinkan) is a summer villa in Ashiya, Hyōgo, Japan.  It was built for the well-to-do Japanese sake brewer of Sakura-Masamune, head of Tazaemon Yamamura, and is the only surviving Frank Lloyd Wright residence in Japan. The guest house was designed in 1918, and construction was completed in 1924.
d29b53f257ec808f.zh: ヨドコウ迎賓館是位於日本兵庫縣蘆屋市的避暑別墅。為富裕的日本「櫻正宗」釀酒商山邑太左衛門家家主所建，是日本唯一現存的法蘭克・洛伊・萊特設計住宅。迎賓館於1918年設計，1924年完工。

d29b72a16af02c44.en: Yokohama Anpanman Children's Museum (横浜アンパンマンこどもミュージアム, Yokohama Anpanman Kodomo Myūjiamu) is a complex in Minato Mirai 21, Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. It is a complex facility combining a participatory museum and shopping mall themed around 'Anpanman'. Dedicated to Takashi Yanase's popular Anpanman franchise. It is one of five such complexes in Japan (the others being in Kobe, Sendai, Nagoya and Fukuoka).
d29b72a16af02c44.zh: 橫濱アンパンマンこどもミュージアム是位於日本神奈川縣橫濱市港未來21的複合設施，結合以「麵包超人」為主題的參與型博物館與購物商場，以柳瀨嵩的人氣作品《麵包超人》系列為主題。日本共有五座同類設施，其餘位於神戶、仙台、名古屋與福岡。

d2ad8665b37a76c9.en: Omizutori (お水取り), or the annual sacred water-drawing festival, is a Japanese Buddhist festival that takes place in the Nigatsu-dō of Tōdai-ji, Nara, Japan.  The festival is the final rite in observance of the two-week-long Shuni-e ceremony. This ceremony is to cleanse the people of their sins as well as to usher in the spring of the new year. Once the Omizutori is completed, the cherry blossoms have started blooming and spring has arrived.
d2ad8665b37a76c9.zh: お水取り，即每年一度的汲取聖水祭典，是在日本奈良東大寺二月堂舉行的日本佛教祭典。這項祭典是為期兩週的修二會的最後一項儀式。修二會的目的是洗淨人們的罪業，並迎接新一年的春天。お水取り結束後，櫻花已開始綻放，春天也已來臨。

d2c331f95ac5b15e.en: Nagakusa Tenjinsha (長草天神社) is a Shinto shrine in Aichi Prefecture, Obu City.
d2c331f95ac5b15e.zh: 長草天神社是位於愛知縣大府市的神社。

d2ca2117505fee09.en: The Museum of Fine Arts, Gifu (岐阜県美術館, Gifu-ken Bijutsukan) is art museum located in the city of Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. The focus of the museum is on art and artists related to Gifu Prefecture, but the museum also collects pieces from other places in Japan and overseas.
d2ca2117505fee09.zh: 岐阜縣美術館是位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市的美術館。館藏以與岐阜縣相關的藝術作品及藝術家為主，也收藏日本其他地區及海外的作品。

d2dc89a6f4570c12.en: Igisu is a kind of seaweed that grows on rocks in shallow water, and is a kind of thin, branch-like red algae. It is caught in abundance on the coast around Imabari City in July and August. Igisu Tofu" is a dish made by boiling and dissolving haikisu and raw soybean flour in soup stock and hardening it like agar. The cool texture makes it easy to eat even in the hot summer when appetite is low. The "with ingredients" type includes shrimp, edamame (green soybeans), and other ingredients to make it look more colorful.
d2dc89a6f4570c12.zh: いぎす是生長在淺水岩石上的一種海藻，屬於細小、呈枝狀的紅藻。7月和8月在今治市周邊沿岸大量採收。いぎす豆腐是將いぎす和生黃豆粉放入高湯中煮至溶化，再像寒天一樣凝固而成的料理。口感清涼，即使在食慾不振的炎熱夏天也容易入口。「加料」款會加入蝦、毛豆等食材，讓外觀更加繽紛。

d2e515243b43120c.en: The Kasaoka Islands (笠岡諸島, Kasaoka Shotō) are a group of 31 islands in the Seto Inland Sea of Okayama Prefecture. They are part of the city of Kasaoka.
d2e515243b43120c.zh: 笠岡諸島是位於岡山縣瀨戶內海的31座島嶼群，隸屬笠岡市。

d2f71d42522e213c.en: Aioi Shinrin Museum of Art (相生森林美術館, Aioi Shinrin Bijutsukan) opened in Naka, Tokushima Prefecture, Japan, in 1993. The only town-operated art museum in the prefecture, the collection and displays relate to wood, in particular wood carvings and woodblock prints.
d2f71d42522e213c.zh: 相生森林美術館於1993年在日本德島縣那賀町開館，是縣內唯一由町營運的美術館，收藏與展示以木材為主題，特別是木雕與木版畫。

d307961787b8b7ae.en: Kōriyama City Museum of Art (郡山市立美術館, Kōriyama shiritsu bijutsukan) opened in 1992 in Kōriyama, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. The collection includes works by Thomas Gainsborough, John Constable, J. M. W. Turner, Edward Burne-Jones, and John William Waterhouse, as well as Japanese artists Shiba Kōkan, Takahashi Yuichi, Fujishima Takeji, and Kishida Ryūsei. The museum also includes works by artists associated with Kōriyama.
d307961787b8b7ae.zh: 郡山市立美術館於1992年在日本福島縣郡山市開館。館藏包括湯瑪斯·根茲巴羅、約翰·康斯特勃、J. M. W. 透納、愛德華·伯恩-瓊斯、約翰·威廉·沃特豪斯的作品，以及日本藝術家司馬江漢、高橋由一、藤島武二、岸田劉生的作品。館內亦收藏與郡山有淵源的藝術家作品。

d3127935f4d3a83c.en: Zenrakuji is a Shingon Buddhist temple located in Kōchi, Kōchi, Japan. It is the 30th temple of the Shikoku Pilgrimage.
d3127935f4d3a83c.zh: 善樂寺是位於日本高知縣高知市的真言宗佛教寺院，為四國遍路的第30番札所。

d316cb2f33a4a151.en: Asahi Town, located on the eastern edge of Toyama Prefecture, is rich in nature, with the Northern Alps on its mountain side and the beautiful jade coast where jade ore is extracted on the Sea of Japan side. Tara-jiru" is a traditional soup that originated in this town. The area around National Route 8 along the coast is lined with restaurants that serve cod roe, and is also called "Tara-jiru Kaido (cod soup road).
d316cb2f33a4a151.zh: 朝日町位於富山縣東端，自然資源豐富，山側有北阿爾卑斯山，日本海側則有出產翡翠原石的美麗翡翠海岸。「たら汁」是源自這個鎮的傳統湯品。沿海的國道8號一帶開著許多供應鱈魚的餐廳，也被稱為「たら汁街道（鱈魚湯之路）」。

d31b3607e5a377f1.en: Satsuma" is a well-known local dish in Yawatahama City and other areas in the Nanyo region. Although it is a white fish, "satsuma" is made all over the prefecture, and the fish varies from region to region.
d31b3607e5a377f1.zh: さつま是八幡濱市等南予地區知名的鄉土料理。使用白肉魚製作，さつま在全縣各地都有人做，使用的魚因地區而異。

d332f3aa9dcc261d.en: The Nakama River (仲間川, Nakama-gawa) is a river located on the southeast side of the island of Iriomote, one of the Yaeyama Islands of Japan.
d332f3aa9dcc261d.zh: 仲間川是位於日本八重山群島之一的西表島東南側的河川。

d35ac7d49bbe9be1.en: About 230 years ago on February 19th, a fire broke out in the Ifuku village in Saga Prefecture that destroyed most of the village. There is a legend that the residents of the time boiled, seasoned, and ate the wild plants left over from the fire, then joined together to rebuild the village. Since then, a village festival called "Oyogoshi Matsuri" is held on February 19th to commemorate the village predecessors who had suffered from the disaster.
d35ac7d49bbe9be1.zh: 約230年前的2月19日，佐賀縣伊福村發生火災，燒毀了村子大部分地區。傳說當時的村民將火災後留下的野菜煮熟、調味後食用，再齊心協力重建村子。從此以後，每年2月19日都會舉行名為「およごし祭」的村祭，以紀念受災的先人。

d37d4d217983473d.en: "Kasube-ni," is a dish of Dried Stingray, (dried Kasube) cooked in a sweet and spicy sauce.In Hokkaido and the Tohoku region, there has long been a tradition of skillfully cooking and eating Stingrays, which have a somewhat peculiar taste. Dried kasubes originated in Hokkaido and were brought to the ports of Noshiro and Tsuchizaki by the Kitamae-bune, which sailed around the Sea of Japan from Hokkaido to Osaka in the days when refrigerators were not yet widely available.
d37d4d217983473d.zh: 「かすべ煮」是將乾燥的魟魚（乾かすべ）以甜辣醬汁燉煮的料理。北海道與東北地區自古就有巧妙烹調、食用風味略特殊的魟魚的傳統。乾かすべ源自北海道，在冰箱尚未普及的年代，由往返北海道與大阪、繞行日本海的北前船運到能代與土崎港。

d38305c2ec8e05f9.en: The Hokkaido Maruseppu Recreation Forest Park Railway or Maruseppu Forest Park Ikoi-no-Mori Railway (Japanese: 丸瀬布森林公園いこいの森鉄道, Maruseppu Shinrinkōen Ikoi no Mori Tetsudō) is an approximately 1.24 miles (2.00 km) long narrow gauge heritage railway with a track gauge of 2 ft 6 in (762 mm) near the Japanese City of Engaru near Mombetsu in the Okhotsk Subprefecture on the island Hokkaidō.
d38305c2ec8e05f9.zh: 北海道丸瀬布森林公園休閒鐵道，又稱丸瀬布森林公園いこいの森鐵道（丸瀬布森林公園いこいの森鉄道），是一條長約1.24英里（2.00公里）、軌距2英尺6英寸（762公釐）的窄軌保存鐵道，位於北海道鄂霍次克綜合振興局紋別附近的遠輕町附近。

d388fad8ba1d81fe.en: The Tenshin Memorial Museum of Art, Ibaraki (茨城県天心記念五浦美術館, Ibaraki-ken Tenshin Kinen Izura Bijutsukan) opened in Kitaibaraki, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan in 1997. It has a memorial room dedicated to Okakura Tenshin and his works and displays other items of Japanese art, especially by the artists of the Izura coast.
d388fad8ba1d81fe.zh: 茨城縣天心紀念五浦美術館於1997年在日本茨城縣北茨城市開館。館內設有紀念岡倉天心及其作品的紀念室，並展出其他日本美術作品，特別是五浦海岸畫家的作品。

d3893e6dbcbcec79.en: Kikō-ji (喜光寺) is a Buddhist temple in Nara, Japan. Founded in the eighth century, its Muromachi-period Hondō and the Heian-period statue of Amida Nyorai enshrined within are Important Cultural Properties.
d3893e6dbcbcec79.zh: 喜光寺是位於日本奈良的佛教寺院，創建於8世紀。室町時代的本堂與堂內供奉的平安時代阿彌陀如來像皆為重要文化財。

d390467bd1442162.en: Since the Muromachi period (1333-1573), stir-fried soy sauce rice has been called "Shouyu meshi" and has been a popular local dish for celebrations and other occasions. It has been handed down in the Matsuyama area since ancient times. As it is a simple dish made with ingredients that common people had at hand, it was often made to entertain guests when they came to visit. It can be enjoyed throughout the year by adding seasonal ingredients such as Butterbur and Bamboo shoots in the spring, and Taro, Chestnuts, and Ginkgo nuts in the fall.
d390467bd1442162.zh: 自室町時代（1333-1573）起，炒過的醬油飯就被稱為しょうゆめし，是喜慶等場合常見的鄉土料理，自古在松山地區流傳。由於是用一般百姓手邊食材做成的簡單料理，常在有客人來訪時用來招待。可加入當季食材，春天有蜂斗菜、竹筍，秋天有芋頭、栗子、銀杏，一年四季都能享用。

d3911e0007d4c019.en: Tsukubusuma Shrine (都久夫須麻神社, Tsukubusuma Jinja) is a Shinto shrine on Chikubu Island in Shiga Prefecture, Japan. Its main hall (本殿, honden) is a National Treasure of Japan. The shrine's main festival is held annually on June 15. It is also called Chikubushima Shrine (竹生島神社, Chikubushima Jinja).
d3911e0007d4c019.zh: 都久夫須麻神社是位於日本滋賀縣竹生島上的神社。其本殿為日本國寶。神社的主要祭典於每年6月15日舉行。又稱竹生島神社。

d3a8168cce05db1e.en: In Hokkaido, soft roe of Pacific cod and Alaska pollack are distinguished. The soft roe of Pacific cod is called "Madachi" and the soft roe of Alaska pollack is called "Sukedachi". The miso soup using the whole soft roe of those codfish is called "Tachi miso soup" and is a typical winter soup in Hokkaido. “鱈(Codfish)” is a fish that is in season during the cold months when it snows, as can be seen in the Japanese character for codfish which depicts the character for snow to the right of the character for fish.
d3a8168cce05db1e.zh: 北海道會區分太平洋鱈與黃線狹鱈的白子。太平洋鱈的白子稱為「真だち」，黃線狹鱈的白子稱為「助だち」。使用整副鱈魚白子煮成的味噌湯稱為「たちの味噌汁」，是北海道典型的冬季湯品。「鱈」是在下雪的寒冷月份當令的魚，從日文漢字「鱈」在魚字旁右側寫著雪字即可看出。

d3afaf8feba1597e.en: Honjō Shrine (本荘神社, Honjō Jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. Alternative kanji for the shrine are 本庄神社 (Honjō Jinja).  Honjō Shrine was built as a larger shrine, but it was split into three separate shrines, of which the current Honjō Shrine is one. The other two are Yakumo Shrine (八雲神社 Yakumo Jinja) and Rokujō Shrine (六条神社 Rokujō Jinja), both of which are located nearby.
d3afaf8feba1597e.zh: 本莊神社（本荘神社）是位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市的神社，另一種漢字寫法為「本庄神社」。本莊神社原為一座較大的神社，後來分為三座，現在的本莊神社是其中之一，另外兩座為八雲神社（八雲神社）與六條神社（六条神社），都位於附近。

d3b5087964910868.en: One of the most famous foods in the Iwakuni region is a dish called “Ohira”―so named because it is served in a large, flat lacquer ware bowl (the term “Ohira” is a combination of two characters―“o” which means large, and “hira” which means flat) topped with a lid. It is a hearty stew featuring ingredients such as chicken, satoimo, renkon, nagaimo (Chinese yam), shiitake mushrooms, gobo (burdock root), and koya-dofu (freeze-dried tofu), and served with plenty of broth.
d3b5087964910868.zh: 岩國地區最有名的料理之一是「大平」，因盛在附蓋的大型扁平漆器碗中而得名（「大平」由兩個字組成，「大」意為大，「平」意為扁平）。這是一道份量十足的燉菜，使用雞肉、里芋、蓮藕、長芋（山藥）、香菇、牛蒡和高野豆腐（凍豆腐）等食材，並搭配大量湯汁。

d3b51faccf032fa0.en: Shōbō-ji (正法寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the city of Higashimatsuyama, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the  Shingon-shū Chisan-ha sect and its honzon is a statue of Senjū Kannon Bosatsu (Sahasrabhūja).  The temple's full name is Iwadono-san Shōbō-ji (巌殿山  正法寺).The temple is the 10th stop on the Bandō Sanjūsankasho pilgrimage route. It is also called the "Iwadono Kannon".
d3b51faccf032fa0.zh: 正法寺是位於日本埼玉縣東松山市的佛教寺院，屬真言宗智山派，本尊為千手觀音菩薩像。寺院全名為巖殿山正法寺。本寺為坂東三十三所巡禮路線的第10號札所，又稱「岩殿觀音」。

d3b59edb56f74e44.en: Eifuku-ji (叡福寺) is a Buddhist temple in Minamikawachi, Osaka, Japan. It is affiliated with Shingon Buddhism. According to legend, it was founded in 724 by Emperor Shōmu.
d3b59edb56f74e44.zh: 叡福寺是位於日本大阪府南河內的佛寺，屬真言宗。相傳由聖武天皇於724年創建。

d3ec5dbbfe213e20.ja: 富山県 立山カルデラ砂防博物館（とやまけんたてやまカルデラさぼうはくぶつかん、英: Tateyama Caldera Sabo Museum）は、富山県中新川郡立山町芦峅寺にある立山カルデラおよび立山砂防をテーマとした公立博物館である。
d3ec5dbbfe213e20.zh: 富山縣立山カルデラ砂防博物館（英文：Tateyama Caldera Sabo Museum）是位於富山縣中新川郡立山町蘆峅寺、以立山破火山口及立山砂防為主題的公立博物館。

d3fd89953503597e.en: Hyōgo Prefectural Museum of History (兵庫県立歴史博物館, Hyōgo kenritsu rekishi hakubutsukan) opened to the immediate northeast of Himeji Castle in Himeji, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan in 1983. The collection of over 200,000 items includes one Important Cultural Property — a painting on silk of the parinirvana of the Buddha, dating to the Kamakura period — and five Prefectural Tangible Cultural Properties.
d3fd89953503597e.zh: 兵庫縣立歷史博物館於1983年在日本兵庫縣姬路市開館，位於姬路城東北側緊鄰處。館藏超過20萬件，其中包括一件重要文化財——鎌倉時代的絹本佛涅槃圖，以及五件縣指定有形文化財。

d43f6d02be0d2f78.en: The Takekoma Inari Shrine (竹駒稲荷神社) is a Shintō shrine in the city of Iwanuma in Miyagi Prefecture, Japan. It is considered one of the three main shrines dedicated to the kami Inari, and claims to be the second-oldest Inari shrine in Japan. It was also referred to as the Takekoma Myojin (武隈明神)
d43f6d02be0d2f78.zh: 竹駒神社（竹駒稲荷神社）是位於日本宮城縣岩沼市的神社，被視為供奉稻荷神的三大神社之一，並自稱是日本第二古老的稻荷神社。過去也稱為武隈明神。

d46e488f9701521e.en: Inamura Castle (稲村城, Inamura-jō) was a Muromachi period Japanese castle located in what is now the city of Tateyama, Chiba Prefecture, Japan. The ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2012 together with Okamoto Castle as the Satomi clan castle ruins (里見氏城跡, Satomi-shi shiro ato).
d46e488f9701521e.zh: 稲村城（稲村城，Inamura-jō）是室町時代的日本城郭，位於今日本千葉縣館山市。城跡自2012年起與岡本城一同以「里見氏城跡」（Satomi-shi shiro ato）之名列為國家史跡。

d4859497505355bb.en: The mountains near the historical city of Kanazawa, which once flourished as a castle town, are now known as a production center of bamboo shoots.Kanazawa City has branded bamboo shoots from the Uchikawa, Nuka, and Kinjo districts as "Kaga vegetables" and is promoting them both within and outside the city. The moso bamboo, which is certified as a Kaga vegetable, is said to have been introduced from Edo (present-day Tokyo) during the Edo period (1603-1868). It is characterized by its unique sweetness and freshness.
d4859497505355bb.zh: 昔日作為城下町而繁榮的歷史城市金澤，其附近山區如今以竹筍產地聞名。金澤市將內川、額、金城地區出產的竹筍列為「加賀野菜」品牌，並在市內外推廣。獲認定為加賀野菜的孟宗竹，據說是江戶時代（1603－1868）從江戶（今東京）引進的，特色是獨特的甘甜與鮮嫩。

d48a998041f70f76.en: “Nishin to takenoko no nitsuke” is a dish made with dried herring and bamboo shoots simmered in a sweet and savory sauce. Tochigi prefecture is located inland, and local people were not able to enjoy fresh fish until refrigerators were introduced. “Migaki nishin” is dried herring with the entrails and head of the fish removed. It was an important source of protein in the days that fresh fish were hard to come by because it could be preserved.
d48a998041f70f76.zh: 「ニシンとタケノコの煮付け」是將乾鯡魚與竹筍以甜鹹醬汁燉煮而成的料理。栃木縣位於內陸，在冰箱普及之前，當地人無法享用新鮮的魚。「身欠き鯡」是去除內臟與頭部的乾鯡魚，因為可以保存，在新鮮魚類難以取得的年代是重要的蛋白質來源。

d49bf48b597907d2.en: Mount Ishigaki (Japanese: 石垣山) is a mountain located in Odawara, Kanagawa Prefecture. The altitude is 241 meters. It was designated as a national historic site in 1959.
d49bf48b597907d2.zh: 石垣山是位於神奈川縣小田原市的山，海拔241公尺，1959年被指定為國家史跡。

d4a235227266f1d4.en: Sanjō Falls (三条の滝, Sanjō-no-taki) is a waterfall in  Hinoemata, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan, on the Tadami River in Oze National Park. It is one of "Japan’s Top 100 Waterfalls", in a listing published by the Japanese Ministry of the Environment in 1990.
d4a235227266f1d4.zh: 三条の滝是位於日本福島縣檜枝岐、尾瀨國家公園內只見川上的瀑布，名列日本環境省於1990年公布的「日本瀑布百選」。

d4a933f651c55dfc.en: Nagasaki City Kakidomari Stadium (長崎市総合運動公園かきどまり陸上競技場) is an athletic stadium in Nagasaki, Nagasaki, Japan.
d4a933f651c55dfc.zh: 長崎市總合運動公園かきどまり陸上競技場是位於日本長崎縣長崎市的田徑場。

d4e7877ec730f04b.en: In Hokkaido, deep-fried chicken is called “zangi”. What sets “zangi” apart from other fried chicken dishes is its strong seasoning. Prior to frying, the chicken is marinated in a sweet and spicy soy sauce-based sauce. “Zangi” can be prepared in two variations: with bone and boneless.The dish is believed to have originated in 1955, when a chicken restaurant in Kushiro's Suehiro entertainment district cut a whole chicken into pieces and deep-fried it.
d4e7877ec730f04b.zh: 在北海道，炸雞稱為「ザンギ」。「ザンギ」與其他炸雞料理不同之處在於調味濃重。油炸前，雞肉會先以甜辣的醬油基底醬汁醃漬。「ザンギ」有帶骨與去骨兩種做法。這道料理據說起源於1955年，當時釧路末廣歡樂街的一家雞肉料理店將整隻雞切塊油炸。

d4f89e23d474c4b3.en: Toyoma Education Museum exhibits the history of education in Japan since the Meiji period. It is housed in the former Tome Elementary School Building (旧登米高等尋常小学校校舎) of 1888 in the city of Tome, Miyagi Prefecture. The U-shaped two-storey building around a courtyard, lined with balconies and with half-hexagons at the end of each wing, was designed by Kisaburo Yamazoe. It is representative of the western-inspired architecture of the Meiji period and in 1981 was designated an Important Cultural Property.
d4f89e23d474c4b3.zh: 登米教育資料館展示明治時代以來日本的教育歷史，館址位於宮城縣登米市1888年建造的舊登米高等尋常小學校校舍。這棟兩層樓建築呈U字形環繞中庭，設有陽台，各翼末端為半六角形，由山添喜三郎設計。此建築為明治時代西式建築的代表，1981年被指定為重要文化財。

d4fd38234050da4c.en: Kiritanpo nabe is a hot pot dish in which rice cooked in a broth made from chicken bones and seasoning is then mashed and combined with vegetables.
d4fd38234050da4c.zh: きりたんぽ鍋是將米飯搗碎，在以雞骨熬煮並調味的湯中與蔬菜一同烹煮的火鍋料理。

d517b0e4d75847fe.en: “Akagarei no komaburi” is a type of sashimi made from flathead flounder, which is topped with the fish's roe. This dish is a popular accompaniment to sake and rice, as the rich and flavorful roe perfectly complements the light and tender white meat. It is believed to have originated from the crucian carp dish that was also served with roe. The fishing season for flathead flounder runs from September to May. Winter is considered the peak season, as the fish is at its fattiest during this time.
d517b0e4d75847fe.zh: 「アカガレイの子まぶり」是以赤鰈製成、並在上面鋪上魚卵的生魚片。濃郁的魚卵與清淡柔嫩的白肉十分相配，因此是受歡迎的下酒菜與配飯菜。據信起源於同樣搭配魚卵食用的鯽魚料理。赤鰈的漁期為9月至5月。冬季魚肉最為肥美，被視為產季高峰。

d51af34d3d6a145c.en: Kunchi (くんち), also Nagasaki Kunchi (長崎くんち) or Nagasaki Okunchi (長崎おくんち), is the most famous festival held in Nagasaki, Japan. From October 7–9, the presentations of the festival, which vividly reflect Nagasaki's colourful history, spill over from the three festival sites into the streets and create an atmosphere of celebration throughout the city.
d51af34d3d6a145c.zh: くんち，又稱長崎くんち或長崎おくんち，是日本長崎最著名的祭典。10月7日至9日期間，鮮明反映長崎多彩歷史的祭典演出，從三處祭典會場延伸到街道上，使整座城市充滿節慶氣氛。

d54773dc985d135f.en: The name "kimpira" is said to be derived from the character "Sakata Kimpira" in the popular early Edo period "Jōruri" (a form of puppet theater) called "Kimpira Jōruri." Kimpira is depicted as the son of Sakata no Kintoki, more commonly known as Kintaro, a legendary hero. The term "kimpira" eventually became associated with a cooking style that involves stir-frying and simmering vegetables, typically julienned, or shredded, with soy sauce and sugar.
d54773dc985d135f.zh: 「きんぴら」之名據說源自江戶時代初期流行的淨瑠璃（一種人形劇）「金平淨瑠璃」中的角色「坂田金平」。金平被描繪成傳說英雄坂田金時（通稱金太郎）之子。後來「きんぴら」一詞逐漸用來指一種烹調方式：將通常切成細絲的蔬菜以醬油和砂糖拌炒並燉煮。

d589eb69daf410ef.en: Even in Yamanashi Prefecture, which has no sea, fresh, high-quality saury becomes available in autumn. “Sanmameshi” is a dish made by cooking this seasonal saury and new rice together. “Sanmameshi” was indispensable as a feast for farmers to celebrate the successful completion of their autumn harvest.
d589eb69daf410ef.zh: 即使是不靠海的山梨縣，秋天也能買到新鮮優質的秋刀魚。「さんまめし」是將當季秋刀魚與新米一起炊煮而成的料理。「さんまめし」是農家慶祝秋收順利完成時不可或缺的大餐。

d5986794b84d8f87.en: Mount Aka (赤岳, Aka-dake) is a 2,899m mountain on the border of Chino, Hara of Nagano, and Hokuto of Yamanashi in Japan. This mountain is the tallest mountain of Yatsugatake Mountains.
d5986794b84d8f87.zh: 赤岳是位於日本長野縣茅野市、原村與山梨縣北杜市交界的山，高2,899公尺，是八岳連峰的最高峰。

d5ae73b3e8b93883.en: Maisaka-juku (舞阪宿, Maisaka-juku) was the thirtieth of the fifty-three stations of the Tōkaidō. It is located in the western portion of Hamamatsu in Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. During the Edo period, the area was part of Tōtōmi Province. The kanji for the post station were originally written 舞坂 (Maisaka).
d5ae73b3e8b93883.zh: 舞阪宿是東海道五十三次的第三十個宿場，位於日本靜岡縣濱松市西部。江戶時代此地屬於遠江國。此宿場的漢字原寫作「舞坂」。

d5b4106c2e9be2ea.en: Shoimeshi is a traditional dish cooked with soy sauce, and is a traditional dish of the Shin-Asahi area of Takashima City.It has been made in a traditional way called the "nitate" or "yudate" method, in which the ingredients are boiled in dashi(=Japanese soup stock) and seasonings, and the rice is added to the boiling water and cooked. This method is believed to have originated from the ritual of "yudate," in which boiling water is used for divination and purification.
d5b4106c2e9be2ea.zh: 「しょいめし」是用醬油炊煮的傳統料理，為高島市新旭地區的傳統料理。其做法沿用稱為「煮立て」或「湯立て」的傳統方式，將食材放入高湯和調味料中煮滾，再把米加入滾水中炊煮。一般認為此做法源自以滾水進行占卜和淨化的「湯立」儀式。

d5bc9adb0f22d952.en: The Kyoikuto, or the Education Tower (Japanese: 教育塔; or  きょういくとう, literally "Education Tower") is a memorial tower located in Osaka Castle Park in Chuo Ward, Osaka City. It serves as a memorial for the victims of Muroto typhoon in 1934.
d5bc9adb0f22d952.zh: 教育塔（日文：教育塔，きょういくとう，字面意思為「教育之塔」）是位於大阪市中央區大阪城公園內的紀念塔，用以紀念1934年室戶颱風的罹難者。

d5c3b6974e96964e.en: Tempura is a fried dish where flour is sprinkled onto ingredients such as seafood and vegetables, dipped in a liquid coating of egg mixed with flour, and fried in vegetable oil.In contrast to the Kyoto area where minced fish was called tempura, Edo’s tempura indicates seafood fried in batter. Edo-style tempura uses fresh seafood and sesame oil, which one eats freshly fried, one after another. Its origin is reported to be the fritters of western European cuisine which were propagated by Portugal in the mid-16th century.
d5c3b6974e96964e.zh: 「てんぷら」是將麵粉撒在海鮮、蔬菜等食材上，沾上蛋與麵粉調成的麵衣，再以植物油油炸的料理。京都一帶將魚漿稱為天婦羅，而江戶的天婦羅則指裹上麵衣油炸的海鮮。江戶風天婦羅使用新鮮海鮮與芝麻油，現炸現吃、一個接一個。據說其起源是16世紀中葉由葡萄牙傳入的西歐料理中的油炸物。

d5cc4de58999ec57.en: Sanbaseki Gorge (三波石峡, Sanbaseki-kyō) is a ravine on the Kanna River in the city of Fujioka, Gunma Prefecture, and the town of Kamikawa, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. It has been designated a National Place of Scenic Beauty and a Natural Monument since 1957.
d5cc4de58999ec57.zh: 三波石峽是位於日本群馬縣藤岡市與埼玉縣神川町之間、神流川上的峽谷。自1957年起被指定為國家名勝及天然紀念物。

d5cf60fd649d331f.en: The Meguro Museum of Art, Tokyo (目黒区美術館, Meguro-ku Bijutsukan) is an art gallery in Meguro, Tokyo, Japan.
d5cf60fd649d331f.zh: 目黒区美術館（目黒区美術館）是位於日本東京都目黑區的美術館。

d5e52b74cb226080.en: The Karatsu Matsuura Sites (唐津松浦墳墓群, Karatsu Matsuura funbo-gun) is a group of mostly Yayoi Period archaeological sites, located in the city of  Karatsu, Saga Prefecture,  Japan. The Hayamajiri Dolmen Cluster was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1966, and three more locations were added in 2014.
d5e52b74cb226080.zh: 唐津松浦墳墓群是一處以彌生時代為主的考古遺址群，位於日本佐賀縣唐津市。其中葉山尻支石墓群於1966年指定為日本國家史跡，2014年再追加三處地點。

d5e565dcc134d417.en: The Sarobetsu Plain (サロベツ原野), derived from the Ainu sar (marsh) and pet (river), is a coastal plain and low-lying moor in northwestern Hokkaidō, Japan. With an area of approximately 20,000 ha or 200 km2 (77 mi2), it forms part of the Rishiri-Rebun-Sarobetsu National Park, and its wetlands are a Ramsar Site.
d5e565dcc134d417.zh: サロベツ原野之名源自愛努語的sar（沼澤）與pet（河川），是位於日本北海道西北部的海岸平原與低地濕原。面積約20,000公頃，即200平方公里（77平方英里），屬於利尻禮文サロベツ國立公園的一部分，其濕地為拉姆薩國際重要濕地。

d5e5e2a74035be8f.en: Shimonoseki City Art Museum (下関市立美術館, Shimonoseki Shiritsu Bijutsukan) is a public museum that opened in Shimonoseki, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan, in 1983. The collection of some 2,200 items (as of April 2017, including items on deposit) includes works by Kanō Hōgai, Kishida Ryūsei, Matsumoto Shunsuke, Takashima Hokkai (高島北海), Oka Shikanosuke (岡鹿之助), and Kazuki Yasuo (香月泰男), as well as a New Kingdom Egyptian shawabti and Late Period image of Horus in the guise of a falcon.
d5e5e2a74035be8f.zh: 下関市立美術館是1983年於日本山口縣下關市開館的公立美術館。館藏約2,200件（截至2017年4月，含寄存品），包括狩野芳崖、岸田劉生、松本竣介、高島北海、岡鹿之助、香月泰男等人的作品，以及一件埃及新王國時期的沙伯提俑和一件後期王朝時期的鷹形荷魯斯像。

d5fb5868a475a8eb.en: Shōhō-ji (正法寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Ishiyamauchihatachō neighborhood of the city of Ōtsu, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Shingon-shū Daigoji-ha sect of Japanese Buddhism and its honzon (primary image) is a statue of Senjū Kannon Bosatsu (Sahasrabhuja). The temple's full name is Iwama-san Shōhō-ji (岩間山 正法寺), but the temple is also popularly known as the Iwama-dera. The temple is the 12th stop on the 33 temple Saigoku Kannon Pilgrimage route.
d5fb5868a475a8eb.zh: 正法寺是位於日本滋賀縣大津市石山內畑町地區的佛寺，屬日本佛教真言宗醍醐派，本尊為千手觀音菩薩像。寺院全名為岩間山正法寺，一般也稱為岩間寺。該寺是西國三十三所觀音巡禮的第12番札所。

d5fe20892d2582ec.en: Kiyoshikōjin Seichō-ji (清荒神清澄寺) is a Shingon Buddhist temple in Takarazuka, Hyōgo, Japan. It is one of the typical type of mixture of Shinto and Buddhism temples in Japan, and temple's name has two Chinese letters of two religions in Japan together, 'Jin'(神) of Shinto and 'Ji'(寺) of Buddhism.
d5fe20892d2582ec.zh: 清荒神清澄寺是位於日本兵庫縣寶塚市的真言宗佛教寺院。這是日本神佛習合寺院的典型之一，寺名同時含有日本兩種宗教的漢字：神道的「神」與佛教的「寺」。

d6111e68847fd2a5.en: One of the Shiwaku Islands in the Seto Inland Sea is “Shishijima”island. On this small island with a circumference of 4 km, people used to eat tea porridge for breakfast. In the "Shiaku” Islands, where rice cannot be harvested due to the lack of rice paddies as in "Shishijima" island, this porridge has long been a staple food and is still eaten by some islanders today. Rice was a precious commodity obtained by selling fish, and tea porridge was a way to eat less rice so that it would last longer .
d6111e68847fd2a5.zh: 瀨戶內海鹽飽諸島之一的「志志島」，是周長4公里的小島，島上居民過去早餐吃茶粥。在鹽飽諸島中，像志志島這樣沒有水田、無法收成稻米的地方，這種粥長久以來都是主食，現在仍有部分島民食用。米是賣魚換來的珍貴物資，茶粥是減少用米量、讓米吃得更久的方法。

d626fdff9599d6d0.en: Namura Shrine (苗村神社) is a Shinto shrine located in the town of Ryūō, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. The shrine has many structures from the Muromachi period or older which are designated either National Treasures (NT) or Important Cultural Properties (ICP). Although the shrine holds annual festivals, the shrine's main festival is held only once every 33 years.
d626fdff9599d6d0.zh: 苗村神社是位於日本滋賀縣龍王町的神社。神社內有許多室町時代或更早的建築，分別被指定為國寶或重要文化財。神社雖每年舉行祭典，但主要祭典每33年才舉行一次。

d6374e35532f743a.en: Asahikawa Museum of Sculpture in Honor of Teijiro Nakahara (中原悌二郎記念旭川市彫刻美術館, Nakahara Teijirō Kinen Asahikawashi Chōkoku Bijutsukan) is a sculpture museum in Asahikawa, Hokkaidō, Japan. The building was called the Asahikawa Kaikōsha (旭川偕行社) and used as the officer's social club by the 7th Division of the Imperial Japanese Army from 1902 until 1945.  In 1968, it became the Asahikawa Museum of Local History (旭川市立旭川郷土博物館, Asahikawashiritsu Asahikawa Kyōdo Hakubutsukan). The building is designated an Important Cultural Property.
d6374e35532f743a.zh: 中原悌二郎記念旭川市彫刻美術館是位於日本北海道旭川的雕刻美術館。建築原稱旭川偕行社，1902年至1945年間作為大日本帝國陸軍第7師團的軍官俱樂部使用。1968年改為旭川市立旭川郷土博物館。建築已列為重要文化財。

d640229d4934acc8.en: Iwaki Yumoto Onsen (いわき湯本温泉) is an onsen resort in Iwaki, Fukushima Prefecture in Japan.
d640229d4934acc8.zh: いわき湯本温泉是位於日本福島縣いわき的溫泉勝地。

d6570817395a569c.en: "Meno mochi kazari" is a traditional event taking place in the southern Kyushu area on Little New Year. Decorations using rice cakes are put up in homes to wish for a bountiful harvest and safety of the family. Colorful "mochi" (=rice cakes) in the colors red and white, yellow, and green are made on the morning of every January 15th and hung up as decorations. Branches of Japanese hackberry are cut off in the early morning before birds start to chirp.
d6570817395a569c.zh: 「めの餅あられ」是九州南部地區在小正月舉行的傳統活動。家家戶戶裝飾用年糕做成的飾物，祈求豐收與闔家平安。每年1月15日早上製作紅白、黃、綠等顏色的彩色「餅」（年糕），掛起來作為裝飾。朴樹的樹枝要在清晨鳥兒開始鳴叫之前砍下。

d673fb2c1ea1a6b3.en: Kurumayama (車山) is mountain in Nagano Prefecture, Japan. A part of the Kirigamine volcano and is the highest point.
d673fb2c1ea1a6b3.zh: 車山是日本長野縣的一座山，屬於霧峰火山的一部分，也是其最高點。

d67d116587f48f4c.en: Mount Tō (塔ノ岳, Tō-no-dake) is a 1,490.9 m (4,891 ft) mountain of Tanzawa Mountains, located on the border of Kiyokawa, Hadano and Yamakita in Kanagawa, Japan.
d67d116587f48f4c.zh: 塔ノ岳是丹澤山地的一座山，標高1,490.9公尺（4,891英尺），位於日本神奈川縣清川村、秦野市與山北町的交界處。

d68a5fa058293b2d.en: Okayama Symphony Hall (岡山シンフォニーホール, Okayama Shinfonī Hōlu) is a concert hall in Okayama, Okayama, Japan. It opened in 1991 and seats 2,001. Yoshinobu Ashihara was the architect, with acoustical design by Nagata Acoustics.
d68a5fa058293b2d.zh: 岡山シンフォニーホール是位於日本岡山縣岡山市的音樂廳，1991年啟用，設有2,001個座位。建築設計為蘆原義信，音響設計由永田音響設計負責。

d68cdbcff68e0867.en: In Yamanashi Prefecture, where approximately 80% of the land is covered by forests, the use of vast land for rice cultivation is challenging, making rice a precious commodity. Instead, crops such as soba (=buckwheat), corn, sweet potatoes, and miscellaneous grains were cultivated as staple foods. Among them, wheat had high utility, and the development of flour culture was inevitable, as evidenced by "houtou" being a specialty of Yamanashi Prefecture, becoming ingrained in people's lives for many years.
d68cdbcff68e0867.zh: 山梨縣約有八成土地為森林，難以用大片土地種稻，因此米十分珍貴。取而代之的是種植蕎麥、玉米、地瓜及雜糧等作為主食。其中小麥用途廣泛，麵粉飲食文化的發展也是必然，從「餺飥」成為山梨縣名產即可看出，多年來已深植於人們的生活中。

d6b894ab7d620807.en: Anamizu Town is situated in the heart of the Noto Peninsula. The town is famous for the "Isaza" delicacy, which is a kind of ice goby fish. Locally, it is also known as "suberi" in the Kaga region. The fish has a clear body and is quite small, measuring only between 5 cm to 6 cm in length, and belongs to the goby family.The isaza fishing season begins in spring, which is considered the season of the fish. This is because the isaza swim up from the sea to spawn and gather in large numbers in the rivers of Anamizu Town.
d6b894ab7d620807.zh: 穴水町位於能登半島中心。該町以「いさざ」這道佳餚聞名，いさざ是一種冰蝦虎魚，在加賀地方也被稱為「すべり」。這種魚身體透明，體型很小，長度僅5至6公分，屬於蝦虎魚科。いさざ的捕撈季從春季開始，這也被視為其盛產期，因為いさざ會從海中溯游而上產卵，大量聚集在穴水町的河川中。

d6bc6374db11ffae.en: Naritasan Kurume Bunin (成田山久留米分院) or Kurume Narita-san (久留米成田山) is a Shingon Buddhist temple in Kurume, Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan. It is a direct branch of Narita-san Shinshō-ji in Narita, Chiba Prefecture.
d6bc6374db11ffae.zh: 成田山久留米分院，又稱久留米成田山，是位於日本福岡縣久留米市的真言宗寺院，為千葉縣成田市成田山新勝寺的直屬分院。

d6d555eaf756902f.en: Mount Nyukasa (入笠山, Nyūkasa-yama) is a mountain located on the northernmost edge of the Akaishi Mountains (also known as the Southern Alps), in Nagano Prefecture, Japan.
d6d555eaf756902f.zh: 入笠山是位於日本長野縣、赤石山脈（又稱南阿爾卑斯）最北端的山。

d705962811f7c43c.en: The Zutō (頭塔, head stupa), is a Nara period Buddhist relic located in the Takabatake neighborhood of Nara, Nara Prefecture, Japan. It was designated as a National Historic Site in 1953, with the area under protection expanded in 1922. It is an earthen step pyramid with seven square steps with stone images of Buddha on all four sides, and a total height of ten meters.
d705962811f7c43c.zh: 頭塔是位於日本奈良縣奈良市高畑町的奈良時代佛教遺跡，1953年被指定為國家史跡，保護範圍於1922年擴大。頭塔為七層方形階梯狀的土造金字塔，四面皆有石佛，總高十公尺。

d709b05df0539cb5.en: Seaweed, Maitake mushrooms, and river fish Haya, the bounties of the sea, mountains, and rivers are all incorporated in this well-balanced stew. used in stewed dishes. It is served in a flat bowl, hence the name "Ohira". Haya called "Aka-Hara (Red Belly)", whose bellies turn reddish in the spawning season, are grilled and dried for use. The Umami is well extracted into the broth, giving it a rich flavor.
d709b05df0539cb5.zh: 這道燉菜融合了海藻、舞茸和河魚鰷魚等海、山、河的物產，營養均衡。用於燉煮料理。因盛裝在扁平的碗中，故名「おひら」。使用的是在產卵期腹部會轉紅、被稱為「赤腹」的鰷魚，經燒烤並乾燥後使用。鮮味充分溶入湯汁，風味濃郁。

d74d74d52efe8f69.en: During the autumn festival season, "tadasushi," a type of sushi made by leaving various types of fish in their original form, is often eaten in Tokushima. Sushi rice is wrapped with fish that have been cut open on their backs. In addition to horse mackerel and konoshiro (white croaker), the main fish used in this dish is bouze, which was once considered a luxury fish. Bouze is a name in the Tokushima dialect, and is also called ibodai, uboze, or shizu, a white-fleshed fish caught from summer to autumn.
d74d74d52efe8f69.zh: 在秋季祭典時節，德島常吃一種將各種魚保留原形製成的壽司「姿壽司」。將從背部剖開的魚包住醋飯。除了竹筴魚和コノシロ（白姑魚）之外，這道料理主要使用的魚是曾被視為高級魚的ボウゼ。ボウゼ是德島方言的名稱，也稱為疣鯛、うぼぜ或しず，是夏季到秋季捕獲的白肉魚。

d751ea4a5d402e41.en: The Negoyadai Site (根古谷台遺跡, Negoyadai iseki) is an archaeological site in the city of Utsunomiya, Tochigi Prefecture, in the northern Kantō region of Japan with a Jōmon period settlement trace and necropolis. The site was designated a National Historic Site in 1988 by the Japanese government. It is also referred to as the Seizankōen isseki (聖山公園遺跡).
d751ea4a5d402e41.zh: 根古谷台遺跡是位於日本北關東地區栃木縣宇都宮市的考古遺址，留有繩文時代的聚落遺跡與墓地。1988年由日本政府指定為國家史跡。又稱聖山公園遺跡。

d7698e3a8d1dabc4.en: Mount Osorakan (恐羅漢山, Osorakan-zan) is a mountain on the border of Akitakata, Hiroshima Prefecture, and Masuda, Shimane Prefecture, Japan. Situated inside the Nishi-Chugoku Sanchi Quasi-National Park, the mountain is the tallest of both Hiroshima and Shimane prefectures.
d7698e3a8d1dabc4.zh: 恐羅漢山是位於日本廣島縣安藝高田市與島根縣益田市交界的山，位於西中國山地國定公園內，是廣島縣與島根縣兩縣的最高峰。

d769c8ebc7989ad7.en: Nare-zushi is an ancient type of sushi, made by fermenting salted fish and rice in a marinade. It is called nare-zushi because the fish becomes "acclimated" or "ripe" as fermentation progresses. Nare-zushi is a method of processing fish for long-term preservation, and is an excellent preservation method because it allows easily perishable fish to be fermented and eaten throughout the year. In Shiga Prefecture, crucian carp, Japanese carp, lotus root, moroko, ayu, hai, loach, carp, loach, and other fish are made into nare-zushi.
d769c8ebc7989ad7.zh: 熟壽司（なれずし）是一種古老的壽司，將鹽漬的魚與米飯一起醃漬發酵而成。之所以稱為熟壽司，是因為魚會隨著發酵進行而「熟成」。熟壽司是為了長期保存而加工魚類的方法，能讓容易腐壞的魚經過發酵後全年食用，是相當優秀的保存方法。在滋賀縣，鯽魚、日本鯉、ハス、モロコ、香魚、ハイ、泥鰍、鯉魚、泥鰍等魚類都會被做成熟壽司。

d769fa945d7cb9ac.en: The Shimōsa Kogane Nakano ranch  (下総小金中野牧跡, Shimōsa kogane nakano makiato)  was a government-operated horse ranch during he Edo Period of Japan, which operated to supply cavalry mounts for the Tokugawa shogunate. It was located in what is now part of the city of Kamagaya, Chiba Prefecture in the Kantō region of Japan. The location was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 2007.
d769fa945d7cb9ac.zh: 下総小金中野牧跡是日本江戶時代由官方經營的牧馬場，負責為德川幕府供應騎兵用馬。其位置在今日本關東地區千葉縣鎌谷市境內。該地於2007年被指定為日本國家史跡。

d78c6942dba2f7f3.en: Officially known as "Anajako," the Shaku, a summer delicacy in Kumamoto, lives in deep burrows in tidal flats in the Yatsushiro and Arao regions. Although it looks like “Shako,” “Shaku” is a shrimp, and is a completely different species from “Shako”. “Shaku fishing” is a unique method in which a brush is placed in a burrow that appears after the tide recedes, and Shaku are captured one by one as they come out to the entrance of the burrow in response to an external enemy.
d78c6942dba2f7f3.zh: シャク正式名稱為「アナジャコ」，是熊本的夏季美味，棲息在八代和荒尾地區潮間帶泥灘的深洞中。雖然外觀像「シャコ」（蝦蛄），但「シャク」屬於蝦類，與「シャコ」是完全不同的物種。「シャク釣り」是一種獨特的捕撈方法：在退潮後出現的洞穴中插入毛刷，シャク會為了應對外敵而來到洞口，再一隻一隻捕捉。

d7ac30130e0f2df3.en: The syrup is poured over fluffy shaved ice which is created in such shops. There is a reason why "shaved ice" in Nara Prefecture is becoming a new food fad.Himuro Shrine in Nara City is said to have originated in the 3rd year of the Wado era (710) when the capital was moved to Heijokyo, when the "ice god" was enshrined on a huge stone called "Tsukihiiwa" in the upper reaches of the "Yoshiki River" that flows near Mt. Wakakusa.
d7ac30130e0f2df3.zh: 在這類店家，糖漿淋在現刨的蓬鬆刨冰上。奈良縣的「刨冰」成為新的飲食風潮是有其緣由的。據說奈良市的冰室神社起源於和銅3年（710年）遷都平城京之時，當時在流經若草山附近的「吉城川」上游，於名為「月日磐」的巨石上祭祀「冰之神」。

d7c6c4420e3be29f.en: Saku City, located in the eastern part of the prefecture, is situated near the border with Gunma Prefecture and is blessed with clean water sources suitable for cultivating freshwater fish such as crucian carp and carp in rice fields. Practices such as "Suiden Yofuna" (cultivating crucian carp in paddy fields) and "Suiden Yori" (cultivating carp in paddy fields) were carried out.
d7c6c4420e3be29f.zh: 位於縣東部的佐久市鄰近群馬縣邊界，擁有乾淨的水源，適合在稻田中養殖鯽魚、鯉魚等淡水魚。當地曾有「水田養鮒」（在水田中養殖鯽魚）與「水田養鯉」（在水田中養殖鯉魚）等作法。

d7e6d6169d767115.en: Nokpe" is a typical Niigata home-style dish and a local delicacy found throughout Japan. Unlike "Nogei-jiru" found throughout the country, Niigata's "Nogpe" is more of a stew than a soup. The main ingredient is taro, and vegetables and mushrooms are simmered in a light flavor and thickened with saya-endo (pea pods) as the green seasoning. In winter, when saya-endo is unavailable, "to-tomame" is sprinkled on top of the taro. Totto-mame" are salmon roe.
d7e6d6169d767115.zh: のっぺ是新潟代表性的家常菜，也是日本各地都有的鄉土料理。與全國各地的「のっぺい汁」不同，新潟的のっぺ與其說是湯，更接近燉菜。主要食材是芋頭，與蔬菜、菇類以清淡口味燉煮並勾芡，再以莢豌豆作為綠色點綴。冬季沒有莢豌豆時，則在芋頭上撒「とっと豆」。とっと豆就是鮭魚卵。

d7f3c3882ba8284f.en: This is a local dish of Omura City, Nagasaki Prefecture, known for its peanuts.It is a stew characterized by the inclusion of thin-skinned boiled peanuts as one of the ingredients, and is said to have been introduced to Japan during the Edo period (1603-1868) when it was served as a hospitality dish in the Omura area.The name "nigomi" is derived from the word "nikomi" (stew). The dish is similar to "nikomi" in Kyushu, but differs in that the chicken, root vegetables, and other ingredients are cut into 1 cm cubes.
d7f3c3882ba8284f.zh: 這是以花生聞名的長崎縣大村市的鄉土料理。這是一道燉菜，特色是食材中包含薄皮的水煮花生，據說在江戶時代（1603-1868）傳入日本，當時在大村地區作為款待料理。名稱「にごみ」源自「にこみ」（燉煮）一詞。這道料理與九州的「にこみ」相似，不同之處在於雞肉、根莖類蔬菜等食材切成1公分見方的小丁。

d8063318df857a80.en: Oyaku-en (御薬園) is a medicinal herb garden in the city of Aizuwakamatsu, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. The garden was designated a Place of Scenic Beauty by the Japanese government in 1932. It is also known as the Aizu Matsudaira-clan Garden (会津松平氏庭園, Aizu Matsudaira-shi teien).
d8063318df857a80.zh: 御薬園是位於日本福島縣會津若松市的藥草園，1932年由日本政府指定為名勝，又稱會津松平氏庭園。

d8080db352c2833e.en: Yumura Onsen (湯村温泉) is a small village located in Shin'onsen town in Mikata District, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan. As of 2011, Yumura township had a population of 1,206, and its surrounding area (known as Onsen) had a total population of 6,454.
d8080db352c2833e.zh: 湯村溫泉是位於日本兵庫縣美方郡新溫泉町的小村落。截至2011年，湯村地區人口為1,206人，周邊地區（稱為溫泉）總人口為6,454人。

d810ddc73d39af63.en: "Nama-yuba" is a coating formed on the surface of boiled soybean milk which is made by boiling soybeans, grinding them, and squeezing them through a cloth. It is a specialty of Minobu Town, and there are many manufacturers. Despite being called "Namayuba," there are various types with different thicknesses and textures available for purchase. About 1200 years ago, during the Heian period, the monk Saicho brought "Yuba" back to Japan from China, along with Buddhism and tea.
d810ddc73d39af63.zh: 「生湯葉」是將黃豆煮過、磨碎，再用布擠出豆漿，豆漿加熱後在表面形成的薄膜。這是身延町的特產，當地有許多製造商。雖然都叫「生湯葉」，但市面上有各種不同厚度與口感的種類可供購買。約1200年前的平安時代，僧侶最澄從中國將「湯葉」連同佛教與茶一起帶回日本。

d82884361794935b.en: Erin-ji (恵林寺),  is a Buddhist temple belonging to the Myōshin-ji branch of the Rinzai school of Japanese Zen. Located in the city of Kōshū, Yamanashi, Japan. It is the clan temple of the Takeda clan, noted Sengoku period warlords and rulers of Kai Province from the Muromachi period. Its main image is a statue of Shaka Nyōrai.
d82884361794935b.zh: 恵林寺是屬於日本禪宗臨濟宗妙心寺派的佛教寺院，位於日本山梨縣甲州市。為武田氏的氏寺；武田氏是著名的戰國大名，自室町時代起統治甲斐國。主要供奉的佛像為釋迦如來像。

d8495625df1889c6.en: In the Hidaka region, “kaki-made rice” has traditionally been served at celebrations, memorial services, Hina-matsuri, festivals, and other gatherings. The dish consists of rice mixed with ingredients cooked in a broth made from grilled fish bones, seasoned with seasonal vegetables and sake―no vinegar is used. The term kaki-made is a colloquial expression of kaki-maze, which means “mixed.” The dish likely originated from the abundant mackerel caught in the Hidaka region.
d8495625df1889c6.zh: 在日高地區，「かきまでご飯」傳統上會在喜慶、法事、女兒節、祭典等聚會時供應。這道料理是將以烤魚骨熬成的高湯煮過的配料拌入米飯，以時令蔬菜和酒調味，不使用醋。「かきまで」是「かきまぜ」（攪拌混合）的口語說法。這道料理可能源自日高地區豐富的鯖魚漁獲。

d8549228b990e461.en: The Atsumi Peninsula is a peninsula situated on the eastern side of Aichi Prefecture; it is an area blessed with the natural wonders of the sea and mountains, with the Mikawa Bay in the north and the Pacific Ocean to the south. The Atsumi Peninsula is affected by the Kuroshio Current off the coast in its temperate climate, length of daylight hours, and numerous days with good weather; it is an environment extremely suited to agriculture.
d8549228b990e461.zh: 渥美半島位於愛知縣東側，北臨三河灣、南面太平洋，擁有海洋與山林的自然景觀。渥美半島受外海黑潮影響，氣候溫和，日照時間長，晴天日數多，是極適合農業的環境。

d870e125d53749ef.en: Shadai Stallion Station (社台スタリオンステーション, Shadai Sutarion Sutēshon) is a thoroughbred breeding facility located in Abira on the island of Hokkaido in Japan. The farm was begun in the late 1970s to early 1980s by the late Zenya Yoshida, and is now run jointly by his sons (Katsumi, Haruya, and Teruya Yoshida), known collectively as the Shadai Group. As of 2006, the brothers own 3,000 horses worldwide. The farm houses stallions from Japan and many other countries and racing circuits.
d870e125d53749ef.zh: 社台スタリオンステーション是位於日本北海道安平町的純種馬繁殖設施。牧場由已故的吉田善哉於1970年代末至1980年代初創立，現由其子吉田勝己、吉田晴哉、吉田照哉共同經營，合稱社台集團。截至2006年，三兄弟在全球擁有3,000匹馬。牧場飼養來自日本及其他許多國家與賽馬圈的種公馬。

d8774c19f49b52ac.en: The Kashima-nada Sea, which stretches from Oarai Cape in Ibaraki Prefecture to Inubosaki in Chiba Prefecture, is blessed with an abundance of seafood due to the tidal convergence of the Oyashio and Kuroshio currents. In the sandy coastal areas of Kashima-nada, large clams can be caught in spring before they release their eggs.
d8774c19f49b52ac.zh: 從茨城縣大洗岬延伸至千葉縣犬吠埼的鹿島灘，因親潮與黑潮交會，海產豐富。鹿島灘的沙岸地區，春季可在文蛤產卵前捕獲大顆的文蛤。

d8b9b6634e7b2e16.en: Unazuki Dam is a gravity dam located in Toyama prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for flood control, water supply and power production. The catchment area of the dam is 617.5 km2 (238.4 sq mi). The dam impounds about 88 ha (220 acres) of land when full and can store 24700 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam started in 1974 and completed in 2000.
d8b9b6634e7b2e16.zh: 宇奈月水壩是位於日本富山縣的重力壩，用於防洪、供水及發電。集水面積617.5平方公里（238.4平方英里）。滿水時淹沒面積約88公頃（220英畝），蓄水量2,470萬立方公尺。水壩於1974年動工，2000年完工。

d8c758503759be4c.en: The Takizawa Honjin (旧滝沢本陣, kyū-Takizawa honjin) is a building in the city of Aizuwakamatsu, Fukushima, Japan which was used as a honjin by the daimyō of Aizu Domain during the Edo period. The building was designated an Important Cultural Property of Japan in 1971 and a National Historic Site of Japan in 1970.
d8c758503759be4c.zh: 舊滝沢本陣是位於日本福島縣會津若松市的建築，江戶時代為會津藩大名所使用的本陣。該建築於1971年獲指定為日本重要文化財，並於1970年獲指定為日本國家史跡。

d8d59f6aef026ba3.en: Mount Iwafune (岩船山, Iwafunesan, Iwafuneyama) is a mountain located in Tochigi City, Tochigi Prefecture (formerly Iwafune Town), in Northern Kanto, with an elevation of 172.7 meters. It is the southernmost peak of the Ashio Mountains. The origin of the characters used in the name—"boat" (舟) for the stone quarried here and the former town name, and "ship" (船) for the mountain name—is unclear. The surrounding area is designated as a nature conservation area (designated on July 19, 1977), where the name is written as "岩舟山" (Iwafuneyama).
d8d59f6aef026ba3.zh: 岩船山位於北關東栃木縣栃木市（舊岩舟町），海拔172.7公尺，是足尾山地最南端的山峰。此地開採的石材及舊町名使用「舟」字，山名則使用「船」字，其用字由來不明。周邊地區被指定為自然環境保全地域（1977年7月19日指定），該處名稱寫作「岩舟山」。

d8e4f27ede54c1f7.en: Miyake-Hachimangū (三宅八幡宮) is a Shinto shrine, in Sakyo-ku, Kyoto, Japan. The shrine is famous for worship to beneficial to children, such as baby colic, academic achievement, safe delivery of childbirth. Because Mushi (虫, parasitic worms, insects, bugs) was thought to cause baby colic (疳の虫; kan-no mushi), the shrine also has worship for power to expel Mushi. Therefore the shrine is so-called Mushi-hachiman (虫八幡).
d8e4f27ede54c1f7.zh: 三宅八幡宮是位於日本京都市左京區的神社。此神社以祈求兒童相關的庇佑聞名，例如嬰兒夜啼、學業成就、生產平安等。由於過去認為嬰兒夜啼（疳の虫）是由「蟲」（寄生蟲、昆蟲、小蟲）所引起，神社也有驅蟲的祈願，因此又稱為「蟲八幡」。

d903e0fe332b45e7.en: Okunoin or Oku-no-in (Japanese: 奥之院, lit. 'inner sanctuary') is a sacred Buddhist site and cemetery on Mount Kōya, in Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. Opened in 835, it houses the mausoleum of Kūkai, founder of the Shingon school of esoteric Buddhism. It is considered the largest cemetery in Japan, with more than two hundred thousand graves and memorial monuments.
d903e0fe332b45e7.zh: 奥之院（字面意思為「內部聖域」）是位於日本和歌山縣高野山的佛教聖地與墓地。創建於835年，內有密教真言宗開祖空海的御廟。被認為是日本最大的墓地，有超過二十萬座墳墓與紀念碑。

d911526a34df0b95.en: Sado bugyō (佐渡奉行) were officials of the Tokugawa shogunate responsible for administration of the mining operations at Sado.
d911526a34df0b95.zh: 佐渡奉行是德川幕府的官職，負責管理佐渡的礦山事務。

d92032aab60953e2.en: Imo-Namasu" is a local dish using potatoes in the Iiyama City area. In Japan, "Namasu" is a dish made by dressing ingredients with vinegar, and is used as a New Year's osechi dish. In the Hokushin region, known as one of the heaviest snowfall areas in Japan, it has been difficult to obtain fresh vegetables in winter due to the heavy snowfall. For this reason, people in the Iiyama area made namasu with potatoes, which can be stored for a long time.
d92032aab60953e2.zh: 「いもなます」是飯山市一帶使用馬鈴薯製作的鄉土料理。在日本，「なます」是用醋涼拌食材的料理，也是新年御節料理之一。北信地區是日本數一數二的豪雪地帶，冬季因大雪而難以取得新鮮蔬菜。因此，飯山一帶的人便用可以長期保存的馬鈴薯來做なます。

d929e396d1c28659.en: Tanema-ji is a Shingon Buddhist Temple located in Kōchi, Kōchi, Japan. It is the 34th temple of the Shikoku Pilgrimage.
d929e396d1c28659.zh: 種間寺是位於日本高知縣高知市的真言宗寺院，為四國遍路第34號札所。

d9331e9be23a7e5f.en: Fighters Kamagaya Stadium is a stadium located in Kamagaya, Chiba Prefecture, Japan, and is primarily used for baseball. It is home to the Kamagaya Fighters, the Eastern League farm squad of the Hokkaido Nippon-Ham Fighters of the NPB. The stadium is also used as a training facility for the Fighters.
d9331e9be23a7e5f.zh: 鎌谷火腿鬥士球場（ファイターズ鎌ケ谷スタジアム）是位於日本千葉縣鎌谷市的球場，主要用於棒球。這裡是日本職棒北海道日本火腿鬥士隊東部聯盟二軍「鎌谷鬥士」的主場，也作為鬥士隊的訓練設施。

d9649043e860dfed.en: Oda Castle (小田城, Oda jō) is a hira-style Muromachi period Japanese castle located in what is now the city of Tsukuba, Ibaraki Prefecture, in the northern Kantō region of Japan. It has been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 1935.
d9649043e860dfed.zh: 小田城是室町時代的平城，位於日本北關東地區茨城縣今筑波市。自1935年起受中央政府保護，列為國家史跡。

d96f41746217b1a6.en: Kurita Museum (栗田美術館, Kurita Bijutsukan) opened in Ashikaga, Tochigi Prefecture, Japan, in 1975. Specializing in Imari ware and Nabeshima ware, the collection includes the Important Cultural Property "Large Nabeshima Plate with Rock and Peony Design".
d96f41746217b1a6.zh: 栗田美術館於1975年在日本栃木縣足利市開館。館藏以伊萬里燒與鍋島燒為主，包括重要文化財「色鍋島岩牡丹文大皿」。

d9812fcb6850e76b.en: Sabae City's Nishiyama Zoo (鯖江市西山動物園, Sabae-shi Nishiyama Dōbutsuen) is a small zoo in the city of Sabae, Fukui Prefecture, Japan. The admission-free municipal zoo is on a low hill (Nishiyama Park). It is known for its red pandas; the species is the official animal of the city.
d9812fcb6850e76b.zh: 鯖江市西山動物園是位於日本福井縣鯖江市的小型動物園。這座免費入園的市立動物園位於低矮的山丘（西山公園）上，以小貓熊聞名；小貓熊是鯖江市的市獸。

d99138373aaa1018.en: Nagasaki Gokoku Shrine (Japanese: 長崎護国神社) is a Gokoku Shrine located in Nagasaki, Nagasaki Prefecture, Japan. It is dedicated to the spirits of the approximately 60,000 people from Nagasaki Prefecture who died between the Meiji Restoration and Pacific War (World War II).
d99138373aaa1018.zh: 長崎縣護國神社是位於日本長崎縣長崎市的護國神社。祭祀從明治維新至太平洋戰爭（第二次世界大戰）期間犧牲的約6萬名長崎縣出身者之英靈。

d9946e4ccc57911d.en: In this local dish, pond smelt caught in Lake Ashi in Hakone on the western edge of Kanagawa Prefecture are flame-grilled without oil or seasonings and slowly stewed, and starch syrup is used to make it glossy. It has a strong sweet and spicy flavor, and since moisture has evaporated, it can be stored for a long time, making it a handy preserved food.Lake Ashi is a caldera lake with an altitude of 724 meters, created by the volcanic activity of the Hakone volcano. Known as a scenic spot to view Mt.
d9946e4ccc57911d.zh: 這道鄉土料理是將在神奈川縣西端箱根蘆之湖捕獲的西太公魚，不加油和調味料直接火烤後慢慢燉煮，並以麥芽糖增添光澤。口味甜辣濃重，由於水分已蒸發，可長期保存，是方便的保存食品。蘆之湖是箱根火山活動形成的火山口湖，海拔724公尺。作為眺望富士山的景點而聞名。

d9ba5a7278d60ac2.en: Kōjaku-in (香積院) is a Buddhist temple in Kawanayama-chō, Shōwa-ku, Nagoya, Aichi prefecture in central Japan.
d9ba5a7278d60ac2.zh: 香積院是位於日本中部愛知縣名古屋市昭和區川名山町的佛教寺院。

d9d4aee2fae844e6.en: Minakuchi Okayama Castle (水口岡山城, Minakuchi Okayama jō) was a Sengoku period Japanese castle located in what is now the city of  Kōka, Shiga Prefecture, in the Kansai region of Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2017.
d9d4aee2fae844e6.zh: 水口岡山城是戰國時代的日本城郭，位於今日本關西地區滋賀縣甲賀市。其遺址自2017年起被指定為國家史跡加以保護。

d9da5b12159351ac.en: The Little World Museum of Man (Japanese: リトルワールド, Hepburn: ritoruwārudo) is an open-air museum and amusement park near Inuyama, Aichi Prefecture, Japan.
d9da5b12159351ac.zh: リトルワールド（人類博物館）是位於日本愛知縣犬山市附近的戶外博物館兼遊樂園。

d9dab6d6965cc88d.en: In the Amakusa area, fish could not be used for Buddhist ceremonies, so instead, sweet potatoes were cut into thick slices and deep-fried in rapeseed oil, and "gane-age" is said to have originated as a vegetarian food.In the Amakusa dialect, "gane" means crab, and the name comes from the fact that the fried appearance looks like crab legs. Also known as "tsukiage," it is called "ganeage" at festive occasions and "tsukiage" at Buddhist ceremonies. The batter is flavored with chopped or shredded ginger and sweetened with sugar.
d9dab6d6965cc88d.zh: 在天草地區，佛教法事不能使用魚，因此改將番薯切成厚片，用菜籽油炸，據說「がね揚げ」就是起源於這種素食料理。在天草方言中，「がね」是螃蟹的意思，名稱來自炸好後的外觀看起來像蟹腳。又稱「つき揚げ」，喜慶場合稱為「がね揚げ」，佛教法事時則稱為「つき揚げ」。麵衣以切碎或切絲的薑調味，並以砂糖增加甜味。

d9ec33a89e539d5e.en: "Kanimaki-jiru" is a local dish of Kitago Town in southern Miyazaki Prefecture, using Yamataro-gani (officially called Mokuzu-gani in Kitago Town, a member of the Shanghai crab family), which are caught from fall to winter in the Sakatani River and Hiroto River that run through Kitago Town. Yamataro-gani are born in the ocean, grow upriver, and then migrate downriver to spawn in the ocean, which is where they are fished.
d9ec33a89e539d5e.zh: 「かに巻き汁」是宮崎縣南部北鄉町的鄉土料理，使用秋季至冬季在流經北鄉町的坂谷川與廣渡川捕獲的山太郎蟹（在北鄉町正式名稱為絨螯蟹，屬上海蟹的同類）。山太郎蟹在海中出生，溯河而上成長，之後再順流而下到海中產卵，便是在此時捕撈。

d9f430e0de8460f7.en: The Ariake Sea is surrounded by four prefectures in Kyushu. The sea bottom is muddy and shallow, with an average depth of about 20 m. It is home to the largest tidal flat in Japan, and is a bountiful sea inhabited by endemic species. Among the many species of fish that can be landed here is the sole.In the Ariake area, sole is called kutsuzoko. The sole has a unique appearance, with a flat, long, slender body that looks like a kutsuzoko (sole) hence the name. Locals call the black-skinned kuroshita and the reddish one akashita.
d9f430e0de8460f7.zh: 有明海由九州的四個縣環繞，海底為泥質且水淺，平均水深約20公尺。這裡有日本最大的潮間帶灘地，是孕育特有種生物的豐饒海域。在此捕獲的眾多魚種之中有鰨魚。有明地區稱鰨魚為「くつぞこ」（鞋底）。鰨魚外形獨特，身體扁平細長，看起來像鞋底，因而得名。當地人將黑皮的稱為「黒舌」，偏紅的稱為「赤舌」。

da02c0602e0d78e5.en: The Sendai City Tomizawa Site Museum (仙台市富沢遺跡保存館, Sendai-shi Tomizawa iseki hozonkan) is an archaeology museum in the city of Sendai in northern Japan that preserves a fossilized forest, where the remains of human habitation that occurred 20,000 years ago were discovered during surveying work in 1988. The museum opened in 1996.
da02c0602e0d78e5.zh: 地底の森ミュージアム（仙台市富澤遺跡保存館）是位於日本北部仙台市的考古博物館，保存一片化石森林；1988年調查工作中，在此發現了兩萬年前人類活動的遺跡。博物館於1996年開館。

da1f511a7a8e715a.en: The Okukuji region in the northern part of Ibaraki prefecture has long been a thriving Konjac cultivation area. During the Edo period (1603-1867), Konjac was the exclusive product of the Mito domain, and it has a history of supporting the domain's finances."Shimi Konjac"(=Freeze-dried Konjac) has been traditionally produced as a sideline during the agricultural off-season in the northern part of Ibaraki prefecture.
da1f511a7a8e715a.zh: 茨城縣北部的奧久慈地區自古即是蒟蒻栽培興盛的地區。江戶時代（1603-1867），蒟蒻是水戶藩的專賣品，曾支撐藩的財政。「凍みこんにゃく」（凍乾蒟蒻）傳統上是茨城縣北部在農閒期製作的副業。

da2598c942956860.en: The Towada Art Center (十和田市現代美術館, Towada-shi Gendai Bijutsukan) is an art museum in Towada, Aomori Prefecture, Japan.
da2598c942956860.zh: 十和田市現代美術館是位於日本青森縣十和田市的美術館。

da38e3506ec924dd.en: "Ozaku" is a vegetable soup made by boiling vegetables such as satoimo(=Japanese taro), daikon radish, and carrots in Dashi (=Japanese soup stock), soy sauce, and sugar. It is said to have come to be called "Ozaku" because it is made by chopping vegetables into chunks. In winter, root vegetables taste better because of frost and snow, and they are more flavorful and delicious when made in generous portions and cooked back. It was considered a feast when there were no bento stores or convenience stores.
da38e3506ec924dd.zh: おざく是將里芋、白蘿蔔、紅蘿蔔等蔬菜放入高湯、醬油與砂糖中煮成的蔬菜湯。據說因為是把蔬菜切成大塊來煮，所以被稱為「おざく」。冬季的根莖類蔬菜因霜雪而更加美味，大量製作並反覆加熱後風味更濃郁。在還沒有便當店和便利商店的年代，這被視為一道佳餚。

da3d7b857194bf5f.en: Kagoshima City Museum of Art (鹿児島市立美術館, Kagoshima shiritsu bijutsukan) opened within the Ninomaru (secondary enclosure) of Tsurumaru Castle in Kagoshima, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan, in 1985. The collection includes works by local artists Kuroda Seiki, Fujishima Takeji, and Wada Eisaku, as well as Western painters Claude Monet and Paul Cézanne.
da3d7b857194bf5f.zh: 鹿児島市立美術館於1985年在日本鹿兒島縣鹿兒島市鶴丸城的二之丸（次郭）內開館。館藏包括當地藝術家黑田清輝、藤島武二、和田英作的作品，以及西方畫家克勞德·莫內與保羅·塞尚的作品。

da72a95ed4779d8f.en: "Kushikatsu" is a dish where a variety of ingredients such as beef, vegetables, and seafood are skewered, coated with batter, and deep-fried. It is commonly eaten right after being fried and dipped into a container of sauce. There is a well-known rule among diners that sharing the sauce is allowed, but "double-dipping" is strictly prohibited.The origin of "kushikatsu" has various theories, but one account suggests that it originated in the "Shinsekai" district of Osaka, home to the Tsutenkaku Tower, during the late Taisho and early Showa eras.
da72a95ed4779d8f.zh: 「串カツ」是將牛肉、蔬菜、海鮮等各種食材串起，裹上麵衣後油炸的料理。通常在炸好後馬上沾容器裡的醬汁食用。食客之間有一條眾所周知的規則：醬汁可以共用，但嚴禁「二度沾醬」。串カツ的起源有各種說法，其中一說認為它起源於大正末期至昭和初期，大阪通天閣所在的「新世界」地區。

da7c6f70e1ed43c5.en: Nukui Dam (温井ダム) is a dam in Akiōta (former Kake), Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. In Japan, it is the second highest arch dam, and it generates a powerful discharge from a height of 156 meters (500 liters per second).
da7c6f70e1ed43c5.zh: 溫井水壩（温井ダム）是位於日本廣島縣安藝太田町（舊加計町）的水壩。在日本是高度第二的拱壩，從156公尺高處強力放水（每秒500公升）。

da7ed1e03f4b7259.en: Katsunoo Castle (勝尾城, Katsuno'o-jō) was a Muromachi to Sengoku period yamajiro-style Japanese castle located in the city of Tosu, Saga Prefecture, Japan.
da7ed1e03f4b7259.zh: 勝尾城是室町至戰國時代的山城式日本城郭，位於日本佐賀縣鳥栖市。

da85b46112a46892.en: Jikō-ji (持光寺) is a Buddhist temple in Onomichi, Hiroshima Prefecture, belonging to the Seizan Zenrin-ji of Jōdo-shū Buddhism. Its principal image is a seated image of Amida Nyōrai. The temple houses a National Treasure, an 1153 Heian Period hanging scroll of Fugen Enmei (Samantabhadra).
da85b46112a46892.zh: 持光寺是位於廣島縣尾道市的佛教寺院，屬於淨土宗西山禪林寺派。本尊為阿彌陀如來坐像。寺內收藏一件國寶，即1153年平安時代的普賢延命（普賢菩薩）掛軸。

da9512dd9f6d2794.en: Tokushima Archaeological Museum (徳島市立考古資料館, Tokushima-shi kōko shiryōkan) opened in Tokushima, Japan, in 1998. The collection includes artefacts from the Jōmon to the Nara and Heian periods.
da9512dd9f6d2794.zh: 徳島市立考古資料館於1998年在日本德島開館，收藏繩文時代至奈良、平安時代的文物。

daa6e78c724682cf.en: The Amagase Dam (天ヶ瀬ダム) is an arch dam on the Uji River just upstream from Uji, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. The main purpose of the dam is flood control but it supports a hydroelectric power station and creates the lower reservoir for the Kisenyama Pumped Storage Plant. The dam itself serves a 92 MW power station while the pumped-storage power station upstream has a 466 MW capacity. Construction on the dam began in 1955 and it was complete in 1964. The pumped-storage power station became operational in 1970.
daa6e78c724682cf.zh: 天ヶ瀨水壩是位於日本京都府宇治川、宇治上游不遠處的拱壩。水壩主要用途為防洪，同時供應一座水力發電廠，並構成喜撰山抽蓄發電廠的下池。水壩本身供應一座92百萬瓦的發電廠，上游的抽蓄發電廠裝置容量則為466百萬瓦。水壩於1955年動工，1964年完工。抽蓄發電廠於1970年開始運轉。

daa7cab6525a441a.en: Drum cakes, or kankoyaki, are a food made by packing a wheat-flower dough full of ingredients and then frying and steaming it. They are similar to oyaki dumplings. For the filling, people use local ingredients that match the season, such as edible wild vegetables, adzuki beans, pumpkin, mushrooms, and pickles.
daa7cab6525a441a.zh: かんこ焼き是在麵粉麵團中包入大量餡料，再煎過並蒸熟的食物，與おやき相似。餡料使用當季在地食材，如山菜、紅豆、南瓜、菇類及醃漬物。

dac41b554caaaaf8.en: Toguri Museum of Art (Japanese: 戸栗美術館) is located in Shoto, Shibuya, Tokyo. It mainly preserves and exhibits Asian ceramics collected by the businessperson Toru Toguri. The museum is located approximately 15 minutes walk from Shibuya Station.  The main collections are Hizen porcelain from Imari and Nabeshima, as well as Chinese and Korean ceramics. The collection has approximately 7,000 art pieces in its collection.
dac41b554caaaaf8.zh: 戸栗美術館位於東京都澀谷區松濤，主要保存並展示實業家戶栗亨收集的亞洲陶瓷。美術館距澀谷站步行約15分鐘。主要收藏為伊萬里與鍋島的肥前瓷器，以及中國與朝鮮陶瓷，館藏約7,000件藝術品。

dacef65c27896cf8.en: Cape Daiō (大王崎, Daiō-zaki) is a cape located in the Kii Peninsula in Shima, Mie in Japan.
dacef65c27896cf8.zh: 大王崎是位於日本三重縣志摩市紀伊半島的海岬。

dadc39a1b07d13e2.en: Kumamoto Prefectural Theater (熊本県立劇場, Kumamoto kenritsu gekijō) is a centre for the performing arts in Kumamoto, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan.
dadc39a1b07d13e2.zh: 熊本縣立劇場是位於日本熊本縣熊本市的表演藝術中心。

dae25bee9fc501bc.en: Yasugibushi is a folk song that has been passed down in Yasugi City since ancient times. The “loach scooping” movement, in which the dancer holds a colander and dances with humorous choreography, is well-known. According to one theory, this loach scooping gesture was adapted from the movements of men working in iron sand curation workshops.
dae25bee9fc501bc.zh: 「安來節」是自古在安來市流傳的民謠。舞者手持竹簍、以詼諧動作起舞的「撈泥鰍」舞蹈廣為人知。有一說認為，這個撈泥鰍的動作是從鐵砂精煉作業場中男性工作的動作改編而來。

dae82d4640af550f.en: “Goto udon” is a traditional specialty from the "Goto Islands", located in the westernmost part of Nagasaki Prefecture. It is said that Japanese emissaries to the Tang dynasty introduced the original form of the dish after learning various things in China, since the "Goto islands" were formerly a port of call for ships carrying such envoys.
dae82d4640af550f.zh: 「五島烏龍麵」是長崎縣最西端「五島列島」的傳統名產。據說由於「五島列島」過去是遣唐使船隻的停靠港，遣唐使在中國學習各種事物後，將這道料理的原型傳入。

dae8495e5d263786.en: The Teshima Yokoo House (豊島横尾館) is an art museum on Teshima, an island of Japan, designed by Japanese architect Yuko Nagayama in anticipation of the 2013 Setouchi Triennale. Involving a renovation of several old houses in Teshima's Ieura district, the Teshima Yokoo House showcases an exhibition of work by its namesake, the Japanese artist Tadanori Yokoo. Meant to evoke the simultaneity of life and death, much like Yokoo's themes in his own work, it was named one of Japan's best museums by Casa Brutus.
dae8495e5d263786.zh: 豊島橫尾館是位於日本豐島上的美術館，由日本建築師永山祐子為迎接2013年瀨戶內國際藝術祭而設計。該館改建豐島家浦地區的數棟老房子，展出與館名同名的日本藝術家橫尾忠則的作品。其設計意在喚起生與死的同時性，與橫尾作品中的主題相近，並曾獲《Casa Brutus》選為日本最佳美術館之一。

daf01f242efbda24.en: The Asia One Center (アジアワンセンター) is a 131 meter tall skyscraper located at Center of Rokkō Island, Kobe City, Japan. The 31-story building was previously named Procter & Gamble Technical Center and was the Asia headquarters of Procter and Gamble Group. Asia One Center was designed by the Takenaka Corporation.
daf01f242efbda24.zh: アジア・ワン・センター是位於日本神戶市六甲島中心、高131公尺的摩天大樓。這棟31層的建築原名為寶僑技術中心（Procter & Gamble Technical Center），曾是寶僑集團的亞洲總部。由竹中工務店設計。

daf7de21bd6e73a8.en: Mount Kurikoma, also known as Kurikomayama and Sukawadake, is an active stratovolcano in Japan that stands 1,627 m (5,338 ft) tall. The volcano is located in Iwate Prefecture on Honshu, the largest of the four main islands of Japan. In addition to recent eruptions, the volcano is seismically active. It is the main feature of Kurikoma Quasi-National Park and a tourist attraction due to its hot springs, hiking trails and flora.
daf7de21bd6e73a8.zh: 栗駒山，又稱栗駒山（くりこまやま）、須川岳，是日本的活躍成層火山，高1,627公尺（5,338英尺）。位於日本四大主島中最大的本州島岩手縣。除近期曾噴發外，此火山也有地震活動。栗駒山是栗駒國定公園的主要景觀，因溫泉、登山步道及植物而成為觀光地。

db02bcf2581ecbcf.en: Okinawa Prefectural Peace Memorial Museum (沖縄県立平和祈念資料館, Okinawa Kenritsu Heiwa Kinen Shiryōkan) is a museum in Itoman, Okinawa. It was established on June 11, 1975. The Cornerstone of Peace, a monument similar to the Vietnam Veterans Memorial, is located here.
db02bcf2581ecbcf.zh: 沖縄県平和祈念資料館（沖縄県立平和祈念資料館）是位於沖繩縣糸滿市的博物館，成立於1975年6月11日。館區內設有類似越戰陣亡將士紀念碑的紀念設施「和平基石」。

db0e87228e7abade.en: Nagoro (Japanese: 名頃), now known as Nagoro Doll Village (名頃かかしの里, Nagoro Kakashi-no-sato; lit. 'Nagaro Scarecrow village'), is a village in the Iya Valley in the city of Miyoshi, Tokushima Prefecture in the island of Shikoku in Japan. It is known for the large number of realistic dolls positioned throughout the village, which have made it a tourist attraction.
db0e87228e7abade.zh: 名頃現在稱為名頃人偶村（名頃かかしの里，意為「名頃稻草人之里」），是位於日本四國島德島縣三好市祖谷溪的一座村落。村內各處擺放了大量逼真的人偶，因此成為觀光景點。

db332bca697bb45a.en: Soma City has long been active in rice production. Even today, varieties such as Koshihikari and Hitomebore are produced, and the city is said to have the largest amount of shipments among the city's agricultural products (according to the Soma City website).In addition, Hokki-gai (shellfish) are often caught mainly in Matsukawaura, the only lagoon in Fukushima Prefecture.
db332bca697bb45a.zh: 相馬市自古稻米生產就很興盛。現今仍生產越光米、一目惚等品種，據說是該市農產品中出貨量最多的（根據相馬市官方網站）。此外，北寄貝主要在福島縣唯一的潟湖松川浦大量捕獲。
