db509ee9ef134555.en: Though the castle spanned the Sengoku and Edo periods, it barely did so as the castle was demolished in 1610. The castle supported the Saitō, Oda and Toyotomi clans.
db509ee9ef134555.zh: 這座城雖然橫跨戰國時代與江戶時代，但因在1610年遭拆除，僅勉強跨入江戶時代。此城曾支援齋藤氏、織田氏與豐臣氏。

db86dadf0e2ecee3.en: Sairin-ji (Japanese: 西林寺) is a Shingon Buddhist temple in the city of Matsuyama (Ehime prefecture). It is temple number 48 of the Shikoku Pilgrimage. According to legend, a stream running by the temple was found by Kōbō Daishi striking the ground with his cane.
db86dadf0e2ecee3.zh: 西林寺是位於愛媛縣松山市的真言宗寺院，為四國遍路第48號札所。相傳寺旁的溪流是弘法大師以錫杖擊地而發現的。

db8b3f3a648231f1.en: Manman-ji (万満寺) is a Buddhist temple belonging to the Rinzai school of Japanese Zen, located in the city of Matsudo in Chiba Prefecture, Japan. Its main image is a statue of Amida Nyōrai.
db8b3f3a648231f1.zh: 万満寺是位於日本千葉縣松戶市的佛教寺院，屬日本禪宗臨濟宗。主尊為阿彌陀如來像。

dbb0852a1f9711fc.en: Irie Taikichi Memorial Museum of Photography Nara City (入江泰吉記念奈良市写真美術館, Irie Taikichi Kinen Nara-shi Shashin Bijutsukan) opened in Nara, Japan, in 1992. Located near Shin-Yakushi-ji and designed by Kishō Kurokawa, the Museum was formerly known as the Nara City Museum of Photography (奈良市写真美術館).
dbb0852a1f9711fc.zh: 入江泰𠮷記念奈良市写真美術館於1992年在日本奈良開館。館舍位於新藥師寺附近，由黑川紀章設計，舊稱奈良市寫真美術館（奈良市写真美術館）。

dbb880abde6d1541.en: Hōki Kokubun-ji (伯耆国分寺) was a Buddhist temple located in the Kokubunji neighborhood of the city of Kurayoshi, Tottori, Tottori Prefecture, Japan. It was one of the provincial temples established by decree of Emperor Shōmu during the Nara period (710 – 794). The temple longer exists, but its ruins were designated as a National Historic Site in 1974.
dbb880abde6d1541.zh: 伯耆国分寺跡（伯耆国分寺）是曾位於日本鳥取縣倉吉市國分寺地區的佛寺，為奈良時代（710－794年）依聖武天皇詔令設立的國分寺之一。寺院已不存在，但其遺址於1974年被指定為國家史跡。

dbbf56bcdc75dd18.en: Lake Tanzawa (丹沢湖, Tanzawa-ko), is a lake located to the east of Mt. Fuji in Yamakita town, Ashigarakami district, in the Kanagawa Prefecture of Japan.  The lake and its surroundings are frequently visited during fall to admire autumn colors.
dbbf56bcdc75dd18.zh: 丹沢湖（丹沢湖，Tanzawa-ko）是位於日本神奈川縣足柄上郡山北町、富士山以東的湖泊。秋季常有遊客前來湖泊及周邊欣賞紅葉。

dbc22d0dbbb7ecf0.en: The Ōgushi Shell Midden (大串貝塚, Ōgushi kaizuka) is an archaeological site in the Shiozaki area of the city of Mito, Ibaraki Prefecture, in the northern Kantō region of Japan containing a Jōmon period  shell midden. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1970.
dbc22d0dbbb7ecf0.zh: 大串貝塚是位於日本北關東地區茨城縣水戶市鹽崎一帶的考古遺址，包含繩文時代的貝塚。1970年被指定為日本國家史跡。

dbc3a8679c0055c8.en: "Jisukeimo no Negimiso" is a dish in which potatoes called jisukeimo are steamed and dipped in Japanese leek miso.Jisuke-imo belongs to a potato variety and has been cultivated for more than 100 years mainly in the Ogouchi district of Okutama Town, Nishitama County.
dbc3a8679c0055c8.zh: 「治助芋のネギ味噌」是將名為治助芋的馬鈴薯蒸熟後，沾蔥味噌食用的料理。治助芋是馬鈴薯的一個品種，主要在西多摩郡奧多摩町小河內地區栽培，已有100年以上的歷史。

dbd254b568e81a53.en: Hamada Castle (浜田城, Hamada-jō) is a castle structure in Hamada, Shimane Prefecture, Japan.
dbd254b568e81a53.zh: 濱田城是位於日本島根縣濱田市的城郭建築。

dbe08142aa6c2c60.en: Kuroda Seri is a local vegetable of Matsue City, Shimane Prefecture, which has been handed down since the Edo period. The name "Kuroda" comes from the old name of the area, Kuroda-cho.The area around Kuroda-cho is said to have been a swampy area where wild Japanese parsley grew wild, and the 5th lord of the Matsue domain, Matsudaira Yoshitada, encouraged the breeding of the parsley. Since then, the cultivation of Japanese parsley began in earnest.
dbe08142aa6c2c60.zh: 黑田芹是島根縣松江市自江戶時代傳承至今的地方蔬菜。「黑田」之名來自該地區的舊名黑田町。據說黑田町一帶過去是野生水芹叢生的沼澤地，松江藩第五代藩主松平宣維鼓勵培育水芹，此後水芹的栽培便正式展開。

dbf12ca1f9a5961c.en: Carrot “Shiri-shiri” is a dish made by stir-frying carrots grated in a “shiri-shiri” pan (a larger grater with a big hole in it), before adding eggs. It is known as a home-style dish throughout Okinawa Prefecture, and is also becoming popular in other Prefectures as well. In Okinawan dialect, “shiri-shiri” is a word that refers to the action of grating. It an onomatopoeia for the sound made when grating ingredients. In the Prefecture, carrots are grated using a specialized, large grater-like pan called a “shiri-shiri” pan.
dbf12ca1f9a5961c.zh: 人参シリシリー是將紅蘿蔔用「シリシリー」器（孔洞較大的大型刨絲器）刨絲後拌炒，再加入雞蛋製成的料理。在沖繩縣全境以家常菜聞名，在其他縣也逐漸受到歡迎。在沖繩方言中，「シリシリー」是指刨絲的動作，是模仿刨食材時發出聲音的擬聲詞。在縣內，紅蘿蔔是用名為「シリシリー」器的專用大型刨絲器來刨絲。

dc0a4aade7761049.en: Jurokusage is a traditional vegetable of Aichi Prefecture, named after its pods, which contain 16 beans. In Aichi Prefecture, it is mainly grown in western Owari, such as Aisai City and Inazawa City, and is also produced in Gifu Prefecture and Okinawa Prefecture. It is said that production in the Chubu region began around the Taisho era (1912-1926).
dc0a4aade7761049.zh: 十六ささげ是愛知縣的傳統蔬菜，因豆莢內有16顆豆子而得名。在愛知縣主要種植於愛西市、稻澤市等尾張西部地區，岐阜縣和沖繩縣也有生產。據說中部地區的生產始於大正時代（1912-1926）前後。

dc34acfe18eb7eba.en: Hyotan Onsen (ひょうたん温泉) is a large onsen bathing facility located in Kannawa, Beppu, Ōita Prefecture. Opened in 1922, Hyotan Onsen is notable for being the only onsen facility in Japan to have received three Michelin Stars from Michelin Green Guides Japan.
dc34acfe18eb7eba.zh: ひょうたん温泉是位於大分縣別府市鐵輪的大型溫泉設施。ひょうたん温泉於1922年開業，是日本唯一獲《米其林綠色指南日本》評為三星的溫泉設施。

dc36f232494bc843.en: Hekirichi Bastion Fort (Japanese: 戸切地陣屋, romanized: Hekirichi Jinya, as historic site name: Hekirichi Bastion Fort of Matsumae clan site (松前藩戸切地陣屋跡, Matsumae Han Hekirichi Jinya ato) was a fortified administrative center of the Matsumae clan during the late Edo period, located in present-day Nozaki, Hokuto City, Hokkaido.
dc36f232494bc843.zh: 戸切地陣屋（史蹟名稱：松前藩戸切地陣屋跡）是江戶時代後期松前藩的設防行政據點，位於今北海道北斗市野崎。

dc82cd5c80fc9073.en: Kamochi Jinja (金持神社) is an ancient Shinto shrine in Hino, Tottori Prefecture, Japan. Its name is regarded as auspicious.
dc82cd5c80fc9073.zh: 金持神社是位於日本鳥取縣日野町的古老神社，其名稱被視為吉祥。

dc897ff28e2b7709.en: Ishikawa Prefecture is a place where the culture of eating rice cakes has taken root since ancient times. For example, "nenne dango" is a traditional Japanese snack in Noto. Nenne" means "baby," and this local dish was given to mothers after childbirth to help them produce good milk. Dumplings in two colors, red and white, are used as garnish for sushi or miso soup, and are also eaten as desserts such as zenzai (sweet red bean soup).
dc897ff28e2b7709.zh: 石川縣自古便扎根了吃米製糕點的文化。例如「ねんねだんご」是能登的傳統日式點心。「ねんね」意為「嬰兒」，這道鄉土料理是在產後給母親食用，以幫助分泌充足的母乳。紅白兩色的糰子用作壽司或味噌湯的配料，也會做成善哉（紅豆湯）等甜點食用。

dc89ea8a65b6bbdb.en: Iizaka Onsen (飯坂温泉) is an onsen (hot spring resort) located in the Iizaka district (former town of Iizaka) within the city of Fukushima, Japan. It is located to the northwest of the city center, and is connected to Fukushima Station by the Fukushima Kōtsū Iizaka Line railway.
dc89ea8a65b6bbdb.zh: 飯坂温泉是位於日本福島市飯坂地區（舊飯坂町）的溫泉地，在市中心西北方，有福島交通飯坂線鐵路與福島站相連。

dc95aa34a70b11a8.en: Mie Prefecture is a center for the cultivation of rice varieties such as Iga-gome and Musubi-no-Kami. In many areas of the prefecture, events are held to pray for a good harvest each year.
dc95aa34a70b11a8.zh: 三重縣是伊賀米、結神等稻米品種的栽培重鎮。縣內許多地區每年都會舉行祈求豐收的活動。

dc9dda85141a4943.en: "Suno shui" is a hot vinegar soup made with grated daikon radish and sardines simmered in vinegar and soy sauce. In Japanese, "shui" means soup. Other names for this dish are "sun shui" or "su no shiru." It is eaten on days when freshly pound "mochi" (=rice cake) is made. It is the perfect soup to make during cold winter days. Vinegar is said to have antibacterial properties and is also known to relieve fatigue. Rice vinegar was produced in large quantities from the Edo period and people began to use vinegar widely.
dc9dda85141a4943.zh: 「酢のしゅい」是用白蘿蔔泥和沙丁魚以醋和醬油燉煮而成的熱醋湯。日文中「しゅい」意為湯。這道料理的其他名稱有「すんしゅい」或「酢の汁」。在製作剛搗好的「餅」（年糕）的日子食用。是寒冷冬日最適合煮的湯。據說醋有抗菌作用，也以消除疲勞聞名。米醋自江戶時代起大量生產，人們開始廣泛使用醋。

dcd3eb4157f5c72a.en: The Iseji (伊勢路) is part of the Kumano Kodō (熊野古道) pilgrimage route system. It links the Ise Grand Shrine (伊勢神宮) with the three great shrines of Kumano — Hongu, Nachi, and Hayatama Shrines.
dcd3eb4157f5c72a.zh: 伊勢路是熊野古道朝聖路線系統的一部分，連接伊勢神宮與熊野三大神社——本宮、那智及速玉大社。

dcd59731d9d1c222.en: Saitō Garden (齋藤氏庭園, Saitōshi-teien) is a Japanese garden in the city of Ishinomaki, Miyagi Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan. It was established in the Meiji period by the ninth-generation head of the Saitō family, a prominent regional landlord.  In 2005 Saitōshi-teien was designated a national Place of Scenic Beauty.
dcd59731d9d1c222.zh: 齋藤氏庭園是位於日本北部東北地方宮城縣石卷市的日本庭園，由當地知名地主齋藤家第九代當家於明治時代建造。2005年，齋藤氏庭園被指定為國家名勝。

dce611260d05c880.en: Enmyō-in (圓明院) is a Buddhist temple of the Shingon Chisan-ha located in the city of Kimitsu in Chiba Prefecture. Its honzon, or primary object of veneration, is a statute of Fudō Myōō. A well-known kaya, or Japanese nutmeg-yew tree, of almost 5.4 meters in circumference is located within the temple grounds. A small hall was built at Enmyō-in in 1989 dedicated to prayers for traffic safety.
dce611260d05c880.zh: 圓明院是位於千葉縣君津市的真言宗智山派佛教寺院。本尊（主要供奉對象）為不動明王像。寺域內有一株知名的榧樹（日本榧），樹圍將近5.4公尺。1989年，圓明院建造了一座祈求交通安全的小堂。

dceadb31033e70dd.en: ‘Zuiki’ is a Japanese taro stem. Stems from red stem species like ‘tou no imo’ and ‘yatsugashira’ (both are species of Japanese taro) have relatively less scum, so it is suitable for food. Peeled and dried stem is a preserved food called ‘imo-gara’, and it is used in simmered dishes or miso soup after being dehydrated.
dceadb31033e70dd.zh: 「ずいき」是芋頭的莖。「唐芋」和「八頭」（兩者皆為芋頭品種）等紅莖品種的莖澀味相對較少，適合食用。去皮曬乾的莖是一種稱為「芋がら」的保存食品，泡發後用於燉菜或味噌湯。

dcf265ab9d4a4d9d.en: Shinpu Castle (新府城, Shinpu-jō) was a Sengoku period hirayama-style Japanese castle located in what is now part of the city of Nirasaki, Yamanashi prefecture. It was the primary fortress of the warlord Takeda Katsuyori. The ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1973.
dcf265ab9d4a4d9d.zh: 新府城是戰國時代的平山城式日本城郭，位於今山梨縣韮崎市境內，為武將武田勝賴的主要據點。遺址自1973年起被列為國家史跡加以保護。

dd1278b7265d4a26.en: "Zabu-Jiru" is said to have gotten its name from the fact that various ingredients, mainly root vegetables, are boiled "zabu-zabu". It is a local dish mainly from Tsuno-cho, located in the east-central part of the prefecture. The town of Tsuno-cho faces Mt. Ozuzu to the west and the Sea of Hyuga to the east, and is rich in natural blessings. It is one of the leading agricultural towns in the prefecture, blessed with long hours of sunshine, a mild climate throughout the year, and abundant, high-quality water resources.
dd1278b7265d4a26.zh: 「ざぶ汁」據說是因為以根莖類為主的各種食材「ざぶざぶ」地煮而得名。這是主要來自縣中東部都農町的鄉土料理。都農町西面尾鈴山、東臨日向灘，自然資源豐富。這裡日照時間長、全年氣候溫和，並擁有豐沛優質的水資源，是縣內數一數二的農業城鎮。

dd2044bfbb6a1751.en: Sakata City Museum of Art (酒田市美術館, Sakata-shi Bijutsukan) opened in Sakata, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan in 1997. Located on a small hill with views over the city as well as towards Mount Chōkai and the Mogami River, the collection focuses on works in the western tradition by Japanese artists.
dd2044bfbb6a1751.zh: 酒田市美術館（Sakata-shi Bijutsukan）於1997年在日本山形縣酒田市開館。美術館位於小山丘上，可眺望市區及鳥海山、最上川。館藏以日本藝術家的西洋風格作品為主。

dd40ad6d5d691829.en: Ioki Cave (伊尾木洞, Iokidō) is a cave located in Aki City, Kōchi Prefecture, Japan. The cave is known for its Ghibli-esque scenery.
dd40ad6d5d691829.zh: 伊尾木洞是位於日本高知縣安藝市的洞窟，以吉卜力風格的景色聞名。

dd78e1e377d604d9.en: Hiuchinada is full of fresh seafood and in Niihama and Kawanoe (now a part of Shikokuchuo) cities, small shrimps called “jakoebi” measuring to 2 to 5 cm in length were widely caught, and these shrimps have been used in home cooking for a long time. “Jakoebi” can be prepared in different ways, and it is delicious simmered or baked. People of all generations love this shrimp. “Ebiten” is a deep-fried dish made with mashed tofu, white fish and “jakoebi”.
dd78e1e377d604d9.zh: 燧灘有豐富的新鮮海產，在新居濱市與川之江市（現為四國中央市的一部分），過去廣泛捕撈一種長2至5公分、稱為「じゃこえび」的小蝦，這種蝦長久以來一直用於家常料理。じゃこえび有多種料理方式，燉煮或烤都很美味，深受各世代的人喜愛。えび天是將豆腐泥、白肉魚和じゃこえび混合後油炸而成的料理。

dd9094a16aa74a59.en: “Carp miso,” made by simmering unglazed crucian carp with miso, coarse grain, and soybeans. Within the prefecture, Seino, the basin of the Kiso Three Rivers (the general term for the Kiso, Nagara, and Ibi rivers flowing through the Nobi Plains), is the primary locale for the dish. Outside of Gifu, it is eaten in the Owari region of Aichi Prefecture, Nagashima Town in Mie Precture’s Kuwana City, and Kisomisaki Town. “Soybean miso,” also called “Tokai red miso,” is an irreplaceable seasoning in the Tokai region and is used to make carp miso.
dd9094a16aa74a59.zh: 「鮒味噌」是將未經處理的鯽魚與味噌、雜糧及大豆一同燉煮而成。在縣內，主要產地是西濃，即木曾三川（流經濃尾平原的木曾川、長良川、揖斐川的總稱）流域。在岐阜縣外，愛知縣尾張地區、三重縣桑名市長島町及木曾岬町也有食用。「豆味噌」又稱「東海赤味噌」，是東海地區不可或缺的調味料，也用於製作鮒味噌。

dd9cb28c95dd2e59.en: “Chicken Motsuni“ is a dish made from chicken innards such as liver, gizzard, heart, kinkan (unlaid eggs), and himo (fallopian tubes), simmered in a sweet soy-based sauce. Around 1950, shortly after the end of WWII, the second-generation owner of Okuto Honten Kunimoten, a soba noodle restaurant established in 1913 in Kofu City, was asked by a butcher if there was anything he could do with the chicken parts that were thrown away.
dd9cb28c95dd2e59.zh: 「鳥もつ煮」是將雞肝、雞胗、雞心、金柑（未產出的蛋）和ひも（輸卵管）等雞內臟，用甜醬油基底醬汁燉煮而成的料理。約1950年、二次大戰結束後不久，甲府市一家創立於1913年的蕎麥麵店「奧藤本店國母店」的第二代店主，被肉販詢問是否能利用那些被丟棄的雞內臟。

dda4244a2a7ca8c1.en: The Manyo Botanical Garden (萬葉植物園, Man'yō Shokubutsuen), also known as the Kasuga Taisha Garden, is a botanical garden located next to the Kasuga Shrine at 160 Kasugano-cho, Nara, Nara, Japan.
dda4244a2a7ca8c1.zh: 萬葉植物園（Man'yō Shokubutsuen）又稱春日大社庭園，是位於日本奈良縣奈良市春日野町160號、春日大社旁的植物園。

dda6fee66e4568a0.en: Boiled and Dried Daikon Radish and Kanboko is a local dish of Saikai City. The combination of boiled and dried daikon radish and kanboko produces a taste unique to Nagasaki.Boiled and dried daikon radish is a preserved food made in Saikai City during the cold season. It is made by cutting Daiei Okura Daikon Radish into strips, boiling them, and then exposing them to sunlight and cold ocean breezes for one to two days in a drying area in the hollow of a cliff facing the sea.
dda6fee66e4568a0.zh: 「茹で干し大根とかんぼこの煮物」（煮乾蘿蔔與魚板燉菜）是西海市的鄉土料理。煮乾蘿蔔與かんぼこ的組合，形成長崎獨有的味道。煮乾蘿蔔是西海市在寒冷季節製作的保存食品，作法是將大栄大蔵大根切成條狀後水煮，再放在面海崖壁凹處的乾燥場，以陽光和寒冷的海風曝曬一到兩天。

ddc53354f3e4ad66.en: This local dish is made in the Izu region for special days such as festivals. As it was originally made as a meal for fishermen, it uses locally caught mackerel. The fish is broken into small pieces, then seasoned and fried into a kind of mince (known locally as oboro). This is then laid on top of vinegared sushi rice in a serving box, along with stewed vegetables such as carrots or shiitake mushrooms, to make hakozushi - literally, box sushi.
ddc53354f3e4ad66.zh: 這是伊豆地區在祭典等特殊日子製作的鄉土料理。由於原本是作為漁夫的餐食，因此使用當地捕獲的鯖魚。將魚肉弄碎後調味炒成鬆狀（當地稱為「おぼろ」），再與紅蘿蔔、香菇等燉煮蔬菜一起鋪在盛於木盒中的醋飯上，做成箱壽司，也就是「盒子壽司」。

ddc76dbb9e5a40a7.en: The Suiboku Museum, Toyama (富山県水墨美術館, Toyama-ken Suiboku Bijutsukan) opened in Toyama, Toyama Prefecture, Japan in 1999. Dedicated to the art of suibokuga or Japanese ink wash painting, the collection includes works by Takeuchi Seihō, Yokoyama Taikan, and Hishida Shunsō, and there is also a garden and tea room.
ddc76dbb9e5a40a7.zh: 富山縣水墨美術館於1999年在日本富山縣富山市開館。館方專注於水墨畫藝術，館藏包括竹內栖鳳、橫山大觀、菱田春草等人的作品，館內另設有庭園與茶室。

ddca287b750b000e.en: ‘Hamo Suki’ is a famous hotpot in Awaji Island and simmered sea ell and onion locally grown in Awaji Island with Dashi (=broth). ‘Hamo’ grown in Awaji Island has thin and soft skin because of muddy and soft seabed, and its meat quality is good with rich flavor due to the effect from Naruto Strait. It is one of the features of summer because it becomes fatty from early summer to prepare for bearing eggs in autumn. Onion in Awaji Island is the harvest season as well when Hamo is in season.
ddca287b750b000e.zh: 「ハモすき」是淡路島有名的火鍋，以高湯燉煮海鰻與淡路島產的洋蔥。淡路島的海鰻因海底泥質柔軟，魚皮薄而柔軟，又受鳴門海峽的影響，肉質佳且風味濃郁。海鰻從初夏開始為秋季產卵做準備而變得肥美，是夏季的特色之一。海鰻當令時，也正是淡路島洋蔥的收成季節。

ddcbe7b7ed996c42.en: Koyadaira Dam is a gravity dam located in Toyama prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for power production. The catchment area of the dam is 404.8 km2. The dam impounds about 10  ha of land when full and can store 2122 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1933 and completed in 1936.
ddcbe7b7ed996c42.zh: 小屋平水壩是位於日本富山縣的重力壩，用於發電。集水面積404.8平方公里。滿水時淹沒面積約10公頃，蓄水量212.2萬立方公尺。水壩於1933年動工，1936年完工。

ddf06ddb691f9883.en: Kurokuma Falls (くろくまの滝, Kurokuma-no-taki) is a waterfall in the town of Ajigasawa, Higashitsugaru District Aomori Prefecture, Japan, on a tributary of the Akaishi River, which flows down from the World Heritage Site Shirakami Mountains. It is one of "Japan’s Top 100 Waterfalls", in a listing published by the Japanese Ministry of the Environment in 1990.
ddf06ddb691f9883.zh: くろくまの滝是位於日本青森縣東津輕郡鰺澤町的瀑布，位於赤石川的支流上，赤石川發源於世界遺產白神山地。此瀑布名列日本環境省於1990年公布的「日本瀑布百選」。

ddf18a17896b2e74.en: Daikoku Pier (大黒埠頭, Daikokufutō) is an area of Tsurumi-ku, Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture. Originally constructed as a freight base, it now serves as a transportation hub for traffic around Port of Yokohama. It provides access to the Shuto Expressway and serves as a docking point for large cruise ships. Due to its role as a hub for diverse economic activities, significant bridges such as the Daikoku Ohashi Bridge and Yokohama Bay Bridge have been constructed.
ddf18a17896b2e74.zh: 大黒埠頭是神奈川縣橫濱市鶴見區的一個區域。最初作為貨運基地興建，現為橫濱港周邊交通的轉運樞紐。此處可連接首都高速道路，也是大型郵輪的停靠地點。由於作為多元經濟活動的樞紐，這裡興建了大黑大橋與橫濱港灣大橋等重要橋梁。

ddf63d1e51911ce3.en: Kanjōsan Castle (感状山城, Kanjōsan-jō)  is the remains of a Muromachi period Japanese castle structure located in the city of Himeji, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site as one of the Remains of Akamatsu-shi Castles, combining both Shirahata Castle and Okishio Castle, since 1996.
ddf63d1e51911ce3.zh: 感狀山城是室町時代日本城郭的遺跡，位於日本兵庫縣姬路市。自1996年起，其遺跡與白旗城、置鹽城一同作為「赤松氏城跡」被指定為國家史跡受到保護。

de2266480236c130.en: Dried sweet potatoes are a processed sweet potato product that is popular among men and women of all ages. Ibaraki Prefecture is the top producer of dried sweet potatoes in Japan. Hitachinaka City, Tokai Village, and Naka City produce most of it.Dried sweet potatoes are said to have originated in Shizuoka Prefecture, where they were introduced to Japan after Osawa Gonemon saved a ship from Satsuma (now Kagoshima Prefecture) that was in distress.
de2266480236c130.zh: 干しいも是以番薯加工製成的食品，受到男女老少喜愛。茨城縣是日本干しいも產量最多的縣，大部分產自常陸那珂市、東海村及那珂市。據說干しいも起源於靜岡縣，當時大澤權右衛門救助了一艘遇難的薩摩（今鹿兒島縣）船隻，其後傳入日本。

de4683dafc0c7581.en: "Dojō-jiru(=loach soup)" is one of the dishes invariably made during the summer. It has been consumed to endure the harsh heat during the challenging summer months. Tochigi Prefecture, with its inland climate and significant temperature differences between seasons, experiences intense heat in the summer and continues with cold days in the winter.River fish, including "Dojō (=loach)," serve as a valuable source of protein in the inland areas away from the sea.
de4683dafc0c7581.zh: 「どじょう汁」（泥鰍湯）是夏季必定會做的料理之一，人們食用它來撐過艱難的酷暑時節。栃木縣屬內陸氣候，季節溫差大，夏季炎熱，冬季則持續寒冷。在遠離海洋的內陸地區，包括泥鰍在內的河魚是寶貴的蛋白質來源。

de588491510c0788.en: Isahaya Park (also known as Azalea Park) is in Isahaya in Nagasaki Prefecture, Japan. It was built on the ruins of Isahaya castle (also known as Takashiro) during the Taishō period. The park is famous for its azalea blooms, and the "Azalea Festival" is held here, on and around April 10 every year. The park is also known for its "Spectacles Bridge" (see below) over the pond. The park is about 50 minutes by bus from Nagasaki city.
de588491510c0788.zh: 諫早公園（又稱杜鵑公園）位於日本長崎縣諫早市。於大正時代建於諫早城（又稱高城）遺址上。公園以杜鵑花聞名，每年4月10日前後在此舉辦「杜鵑花祭」。公園也以池上的「眼鏡橋」（見下文）著稱。從長崎市搭乘巴士約50分鐘可抵達。

de5da6b9e48414df.en: Etsu fish, also known as "phantom fish," is found only in Japan in the area around the mouth of the Chikugo River, which flows into the Ariake Sea. A member of the Japanese anchovy family, it grows to about 30 cm in about three years. Juveniles stay in the river until they are around 5 cm in length, after which they migrate to saltwater areas. From May to July, adult fish migrate up the Chikugo River and other rivers to spawn. Only during this short period is the season open for fishing.
de5da6b9e48414df.zh: エツ又稱「幻之魚」，在日本只分布於注入有明海的筑後川河口一帶。屬於鯷科，約三年可長到約30公分。幼魚在河中待到約5公分長後，才遷移到鹹水區域。每年5月至7月，成魚會溯筑後川等河川而上產卵。只有在這段短暫期間開放捕撈。

de74c1bfe159de91.en: The Kitaema Cave Tombs (北江間横穴群, Kitaema Yokoana-kofun gun) is an archaeological site containing the ruins of a final Kofun period to early Nara period necropolis in what is now part of the city of Izunokuni, Shizuoka, in the Tōkai region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1976, with the area under protection expanded in 1985.
de74c1bfe159de91.zh: 北江間橫穴群（北江間横穴群）是位於日本東海地方靜岡縣伊豆之國市境內的考古遺址，保存古墳時代末期至奈良時代初期的墓葬群遺跡。該遺址於1976年被指定為日本國家史跡，1985年擴大保護範圍。

dea44646f76bda10.en: Shimonoseki City in Yamaguchi Prefecture, known for its ingrained fugu (blowfish) culinary culture, also has a long-term connection to whales, confirmed by evidence found in the excavation of whale bone fossils.
dea44646f76bda10.zh: 山口縣下關市以根深柢固的河豚飲食文化聞名，與鯨魚也有長久的淵源，這一點已由出土的鯨骨化石得到證實。

dea7551305771a2b.en: Eisho-ji (英勝寺) is a Jōdo-shū temple in Ogigayatsu, Kamakura, Kanagawa, Japan, and is the sole nunnery in Kamakura. The mountain name is Tokozan.
dea7551305771a2b.zh: 英勝寺是位於日本神奈川縣鎌倉市扇谷的淨土宗寺院，也是鎌倉唯一的尼寺。山號為東光山。

deb0d82d266a3fa8.en: “Sasamaki “is made by soaking and draining Glutinous rice, wrapping it in Bamboo leaves, tying a string around it, and boiling it in hot water. In other prefectures, it is also called "Chimaki. Bamboo leaves are said to have antiseptic and antibacterial properties, and have long been used to wrap preserved and portable foods.In Yamagata Prefecture, Rice cakes are often pounded to make and eaten throughout the year, not only for New Year's Eve and New Year's, but also for festivals and celebrations.
deb0d82d266a3fa8.zh: 「笹巻き」的做法是將糯米浸泡後瀝乾，用竹葉包起來，綁上繩子，再放入熱水中煮。在其他縣也稱為「粽」。據說竹葉具有防腐、抗菌的效果，自古就用來包裹保存食與攜帶用的食物。在山形縣，不只是除夕和新年，祭典與慶祝場合也常搗年糕食用，一年到頭都會做來吃。

dec0385327c5af8b.en: Daibu temple ruins (大分廃寺跡, Daibu Haiji ato) is an archeological site with the ruins of the foundations of a Japanese pagoda from a Nara period Buddhist temple located in the city of Iizuka, Fukuoka, Japan. It was designated as a National Historic Site in 1941.
dec0385327c5af8b.zh: 大分廃寺跡是位於日本福岡縣飯塚市的考古遺址，保存奈良時代佛教寺院的塔基遺跡，於1941年被指定為國家史跡。

dedc1f199d52a466.en: "Kouhaku Namasu" (vegetable salad marinated with vinegar), one of the must dishes in "osechi" new year dishes, is known with vinaigrette mixed vinegar and sugar and tastes sweet and sour. On the other hand, it is common to add roasted grounded peanuts to "kouhaku namasu" in Fujinomiya City, Fuji City and its surrounded eastern area, where peanuts is the main product. Adding grounded peanuts makes the salad less sour and adds rich flavor of peanuts, so it is easier for those who don’t like sour food to eat.
dedc1f199d52a466.zh: 紅白なます（醋漬蔬菜）是年菜中不可或缺的料理之一，一般使用醋與砂糖調成的調味醋，口味酸甜。另一方面，在以花生為主要產物的富士宮市、富士市及周邊的東部地區，常在紅白なます中加入炒過磨碎的花生。加入花生碎可減少酸味，並增添花生的濃郁風味，不喜歡酸味的人也比較容易入口。

dee614670cfa3722.en: "Mogura-uri-no-hiyashijiru " is a local dish from the Mogura region in Hayakawa Town, situated at the foothills of the Southern Alps at an altitude of 800 meters. This dish features Mogura melon, a type of melon that has been cultivated in the region for generations, with a tradition of self-seeding for 130 years. The melon is julienned and added to a cold broth, then seasoned with miso and condiments. It is served over rice, creating a refreshing mountain-style cold soup.
dee614670cfa3722.zh: 「茂倉瓜の冷や汁」是位於南アルプス山麓、海拔800公尺的早川町茂倉地區的鄉土料理。這道料理使用茂倉瓜，這是當地世代栽培的瓜類，有130年自家留種的傳統。將瓜切絲加入冷湯中，再以味噌和佐料調味，淋在白飯上食用，是一道清爽的山村風味冷湯。

dee818bd8de56665.en: “Taimeshi” is a local dish mainly eaten in the Seto Inland Sea coastal region. It’s made by putting a whole sea bream in a pot and cooking it with rice. It’s said that fishermen began making this dish during the Edo period when the village headman of Hashirishima started casting a sea bream fishing net. The Seto Inland Sea is characterized by a rocky and undulating seabed terrain, along with strong tidal currents, making it a suitable spawning environment and habitat for sea bream.
dee818bd8de56665.zh: 「鯛めし」是主要在瀨戶內海沿岸地區食用的鄉土料理。做法是將整條鯛魚放入鍋中與米一起炊煮。據說江戶時代走島的村長開始撒網捕鯛魚時，漁民開始製作這道料理。瀨戶內海海底地形多岩石且起伏不平，潮流湍急，適合鯛魚產卵與棲息。

deedc2f88ec0f71b.en: The Sōsei River is a man-made river that runs through the center of Sapporo City, Hokkaidō, Japan. It was built under the supervision of Otomo Kametaro in the late 1860s, and was one of the first things constructed on the city site. When it was built, the river ran in a straight line to the Ishikari River. It is the dividing point between east and west in Sapporo's grid-based address system.
deedc2f88ec0f71b.zh: 創成川是流經日本北海道札幌市中心的人工河川，於1860年代後期在大友龜太郎的監督下開鑿，是札幌市區最早興建的設施之一。建成時，河道呈直線通往石狩川。它是札幌棋盤式地址系統中劃分東西的分界。

def353700a570746.en: Hakusui Dam (白水ダム) is a stone masonry-faced concrete gravity dam on the upper reaches of the Ōno River in Taketa, Ōita Prefecture, Japan. Completed in 1938, the dam spans 86 m and stands 14 m tall. Designed by civil engineer Yasuo Ono (小野康夫) for irrigation purposes, it features a distinctive curved and stepped spillway that controls water flow and prevents erosion.
def353700a570746.zh: 白水溜池堰堤是位於日本大分縣竹田市大野川上游、以石砌面覆蓋的混凝土重力壩。水壩於1938年完工，長86公尺，高14公尺。由土木技師小野康夫（Yasuo Ono）為灌溉目的而設計，特色是具有控制水流、防止侵蝕的弧形階梯式溢洪道。

df099ecd9fe2a7c4.en: Kumagaya Uchiwa Festival is a yearly festival that occurs in Saitama Prefecture Kumagaya city. The festival is held for five days from July 19 to 23 annually. This festival is called Uchiwa and (matsuri), because Uchiwa, the traditional Japanese fans, were distributed to people during the festival in the Meiji era.
df099ecd9fe2a7c4.zh: 熊谷うちわ祭是每年在埼玉縣熊谷市舉行的祭典。祭典每年於7月19日至23日舉行五天。此祭典稱為「うちわ」祭，是因為明治時代祭典期間會向民眾分發日本傳統扇子「うちわ」。

df0c058b3337fcc5.en: Yamada-dera (山田寺) was a Buddhist temple established in the Asuka period in Sakurai, Nara Prefecture, Japan. The area was designated a National Historic Site in 1921, with its status elevated to a Special National Historic Site in 1952. It also forms part of a grouping of sites submitted in 2007 for future inscription on the UNESCO World Heritage List: Asuka-Fujiwara: Archaeological sites of Japan’s Ancient Capitals and Related Properties.
df0c058b3337fcc5.zh: 山田寺是飛鳥時代創建於日本奈良縣櫻井市的佛教寺院。該地於1921年被指定為國家史跡，1952年升格為特別史跡。它也是2007年提報、預定日後登錄聯合國教科文組織世界遺產名錄的「飛鳥・藤原：日本古代都城遺址及相關資產」遺址群之一。

df1dee4c91ac6f88.en: Yamagata Prefecture is known for its diverse pickling culture, with "Seisai mustard pickles" being one of its most popular varieties. These pickles are made from Yamagata seisai mustard, a type of leaf mustard, and are often paired with "Omizuke" to represent the prefecture's pickling traditions.The "pickled seisai mustard" has its roots in Chongqing, China, and was introduced to Yamagata Prefecture in 1908.
df1dee4c91ac6f88.zh: 山形縣以多樣的醃漬文化聞名，其中「青菜漬」是最受歡迎的種類之一。這種醃菜以葉芥菜的一種山形青菜製作，常與「おみ漬」並列為代表該縣醃漬傳統的醃菜。「青菜漬」源自中國重慶，於1908年傳入山形縣。

df255304c38f6a41.en: Kōnomine-ji is a Shingon Buddhist Temple located in Yasuda, Kōchi, Japan. It is the 27th temple of the Shikoku Pilgrimage.
df255304c38f6a41.zh: 神峯寺是位於日本高知縣安田町的真言宗寺院，為四國遍路第27號札所。

df32f49638563edc.en: The Kitano Museum of Art (北野美術館, Kitano Bijutsukan), which opened in 1968 as the first private art museum in Nagano Prefecture, is today run by a public interest incorporated foundation, in the Wakaho district, in the southeastern section of Nagano in Nagano Prefecture.  The museum is located next to the Yushimatenmangu Shrine, a branch of Yushima Tenman-gū which was founded in 458 in Bunkyō in Tokyo. The entrance to the museum is through the Yushimatenmangu Shrine.
df32f49638563edc.zh: 北野美術館於1968年開館，是長野縣第一座私立美術館，現由公益財團法人經營，位於長野縣長野市東南部的若穗地區。美術館位於湯島天滿宮旁，該神社是458年創建於東京文京區的湯島天滿宮的分社。美術館入口須經由湯島天滿宮進入。

df65f28d5195ed0e.en: Aoimori Park (青い森公園, Aoimori kōen) is a 1.8-hectare (4.4-acre) urban park in the central district of Aomori Prefecture's capital city, Aomori in northern Japan. Acting as an urban green space in the city's dense administrative district, it features various themed landscapes. It has been maintained by the prefectural government of Aomori since its opening in 1985. It is also the official ending point for National Route 4 and National Route 7. Various monuments and markers within and near the park denote the terminus of the two highways.
df65f28d5195ed0e.zh: 青い森公園是位於日本北部青森縣縣廳所在地青森市中心區的都市公園，面積 1.8 公頃（4.4 英畝）。公園作為市內行政機關密集地區的都市綠地，設有各種主題景觀。自 1985 年開園以來，由青森縣政府負責維護管理。這裡也是國道 4 號與國道 7 號的正式終點，公園內外設有多座紀念碑與標示，標明這兩條公路的終點。

df6d438ea45927f9.en: Aya Castle (綾城, Aya-jō) is a castle located in Aya, Miyazaki Prefecture, Japan.
df6d438ea45927f9.zh: 綾城是位於日本宮崎縣綾町的城郭。

df793a35dd2c0210.en: Murin-an (無鄰菴) is a Japanese garden in Kyoto, owned by political and military leader Gensui Prince Yamagata Aritomo, designed by Ogawa Jihei and built between 1894 and 1898. It is an example of a classical Japanese promenade garden of the Meiji Period.
df793a35dd2c0210.zh: 無鄰菴是京都的一座日本庭園，為政治與軍事領袖元帥山縣有朋公爵所有，由小川治兵衛設計，建於1894年至1898年間，是明治時期古典日本迴遊式庭園的例子。

df7ed64a2593ae69.en: Kongōchō-ji is a Shingon Buddhist Temple located in Muroto, Kōchi, Japan. It is the 26th temple of the Shikoku Pilgrimage.
df7ed64a2593ae69.zh: 金剛頂寺是位於日本高知縣室戶市的真言宗寺院，為四國遍路第26號札所。

dfad30ebf8bc3652.en: Ryōgen-in (龍源院) is a subtemple of the Daitoku-ji Buddhist complex, located in Kita-ku, Kyoto, Japan. It was constructed in 1502.
dfad30ebf8bc3652.zh: 龍源院是大德寺佛教寺院群中的塔頭寺院，位於日本京都北區，建於1502年。

dfc27498a101f0bc.en: The Kobe Sports Park (神戸総合運動公園, Kōbe Sōgō Undō Kōen) is a sports complex and urban park in Kobe, Japan.
dfc27498a101f0bc.zh: 神戸総合運動公園是位於日本神戶的綜合運動設施及都市公園。

dfed2a11fe4f5725.en: Kurohanpen is made by boiling ground mackerel, horse mackerel, or sardine, and is semi-circular in shape and gray in color. It is a specialty of Yaizu, but is eaten almost everywhere in the prefecture. Outside of the prefecture, hanpen is a white paste, but in Shizuoka Prefecture, it is usually called kuro-hanpen. White hanpen is white because only the meat of the fish is used, while black hanpen is gray because the bones and skin of the fish are kneaded into the paste.
dfed2a11fe4f5725.zh: 黑半片是將鯖魚、竹筴魚或沙丁魚絞碎後煮製而成，呈半圓形、灰色。它是燒津的名產，但在縣內幾乎各地都吃得到。在縣外，半片是白色的魚漿製品，但在靜岡縣，通常指的是黑半片。白半片因為只使用魚肉而呈白色，黑半片則因為將魚骨和魚皮一起揉入魚漿而呈灰色。

dffb0a46f8246017.en: This is a traditional local dish made by stuffing raw rice and vegetables inside a large piece of deep-fried tofu and cooking it slowly in broth.According to legend, around the middle of the Meiji period (1868-1912), the priest of a temple in Sakaiminato City visited a temple in Fukui Prefecture and was so pleased with the fried tofu that he brought it back to his temple and cooked it with rice and vegetables. There are various theories as to the origin of the name Itadare (meaning "to receive" in Japanese).
dffb0a46f8246017.zh: 這是一道傳統鄉土料理，將生米和蔬菜塞入大片油豆腐中，再以高湯慢慢燉煮而成。相傳明治時代（1868-1912）中期左右，境港市一座寺院的住持造訪福井縣的一座寺院時，非常喜歡那裡的油豆腐，便帶回自己的寺院，與米和蔬菜一同烹煮。關於「いただき」（日語意為「領受」）名稱的由來有各種說法。

e00d30bfdb6e672b.en: Hakusan Castle (白山城, Hakusan-jō) was a Heian period yamashiro-style Japanese castle located in the Kamiyamamachi neighborhood of the city of Nirasaki, Yamanashi prefecture. It was the primary fortress of the warlord Takeda Nobuyoshi, the ancestor of the Takeda clan. The ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2001. The castle is also known as Nabeyama Castle (鍋山城, Nabeyama-jō)
e00d30bfdb6e672b.zh: 白山城是平安時代的山城式日本城郭，位於山梨縣韮崎市神山町地區，曾是武田氏始祖、武將武田信義的主要據點。遺址自2001年起被列為國家指定史跡。此城又稱鍋山城。

e01308b17b96f713.en: Odaka Castle (尾高城, Odaka-jō)) was a hirayama-style Japanese castle located in the Odaka neighbourhood of the city of  Yonago, Tottori Prefecture in western  Japan. It was also known as Izumiyama Castle (泉山城, Izumiyama-jō)). Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2019.
e01308b17b96f713.zh: 尾高城是一座平山城形式的日本城郭，位於日本西部鳥取縣米子市尾高地區，又稱泉山城。其遺跡自2019年起列為國家史跡受到保護。

e01530da5ac4acb5.en: "Hana-hajiki" is a local dish of the Isahaya area.Various ingredients are arranged in a radial pattern on a plate and eaten while dipping them in hot and vinegared miso. It has long been served as a vegetarian dish for Buddhist memorial services.The unique name “Hana-hajiki" comes from the fact that the spiciness of the spicy vinegared miso makes one's nose prickle.There is a culture in and outside of Nagasaki Prefecture to eat pickled takana, which is also called "hana-hajiki," but as a dish it is completely different.
e01530da5ac4acb5.zh: 「鼻はじき」是諫早地區的鄉土料理。將各種食材呈放射狀擺在盤中，沾辛辣的醋味噌食用。長久以來作為佛教法事的素食料理。「鼻はじき」這個獨特的名稱，來自辛辣醋味噌的辣味會讓鼻子發刺。長崎縣內外也有食用醃高菜的文化，同樣稱為「鼻はじき」，但作為料理是完全不同的東西。

e02134a4f342de69.en: Paramita Museum (パラミタミュージアム, Paramita Myūjiamu) opened in Komono, Mie Prefecture, Japan  in 2003. The collection, numbering some 4,700 items as of March 2023, includes paintings, craftworks, Ikeda Masuo's Heart Sutra Series (般若心経シリーズ), and a standing wooden statue of Jūichimen Kannon by Chōkai that has been designated an  Important Cultural Property.
e02134a4f342de69.zh: パラミタミュージアム於2003年在日本三重縣菰野町開館。截至2023年3月，館藏約4,700件，包括繪畫、工藝品、池田滿壽夫的「般若心經系列」，以及被指定為重要文化財、由長快所作的木造十一面觀音立像。

e03dc944b49ccd13.en: “Nishime” is a local traditional dish served at festivals, home celebrations, and ceremonies. Another name for this dish is “imo-nishime” because satoimo(=Japanese taro) is always used as an ingredient. Satoimo(=Japanese taro) is a symbol of being blessed with many children and bountiful harvests because the young taro grow around the parent taro.
e03dc944b49ccd13.zh: 「煮しめ」是在祭典、家中喜慶及儀式時端出的鄉土傳統料理。因為一定會使用里芋作為材料，所以又稱為「芋煮しめ」。里芋的子芋長在母芋周圍，因此象徵多子與豐收。

e056749d4048a09d.en: Ishite-ji (石手寺) is a Shingon temple in Matsuyama, Ehime Prefecture, Japan. It is Temple 51 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage. Its name means Stone Hand Temple (石手寺). Seven of its structures have been designated National Treasures or Important Cultural Properties.
e056749d4048a09d.zh: 石手寺是位於日本愛媛縣松山市的真言宗寺院，為四國八十八所巡禮的第51號札所。寺名意為「石之手的寺院」。寺內有七棟建築被指定為國寶或重要文化財。

e05a4893984be8c5.en: Hiji Castle (日出城, Hiji-jō), also known as Yōkoku Castle, Aoyagi Castle, and Ukitsu Castle, was a castle located in Hiji, Ōita Prefecture, Japan. The construction of the castle began in 1601, under Kinoshita Nobutoshi's orders, when he was transferred to Hiji from Himeji. The castle was designed by Nobutoshi's brother-in-law, Hosokawa Tadaoki. It held a strategic location, as it overlooked Beppu Bay. The castle was destroyed after the Hiji Domain was abolished during the Meiji era.
e05a4893984be8c5.zh: 日出城又稱暘谷城、青柳城、浮津城，是位於日本大分縣日出町的城郭。1601年木下延俊從姬路轉封至日出，奉其命令開始築城。城郭由延俊的姊夫細川忠興設計。此城可俯瞰別府灣，位置具戰略意義。明治時代日出藩廢除後，城郭遭到拆毀。

e081be11885ef8f9.en: "Asuka Nabe" is a regional cuisine of Nara prefecture in which chicken and vegetables are simmered in a broth of milk and dashi. During the Asuka period, a messenger who came from China to Nara brought a dairy product resembling condensed milk and presented it to Emperor Kotoku, who was very pleased with it and began raising dairy cows in the Imperial Palace. This is said to be the first instance of drinking milk in Japan.
e081be11885ef8f9.zh: 「飛鳥鍋」是將雞肉和蔬菜放入牛奶與高湯中燉煮的奈良縣鄉土料理。飛鳥時代，從中國來到奈良的使者帶來一種類似煉乳的乳製品獻給孝德天皇，天皇十分喜愛，開始在宮中飼養乳牛。據說這是日本最早飲用牛奶的例子。

e081f0c498bcc83b.en: Edogawa City Natural Zoo (江戸川区自然動物園, Edokawaku-shizen-dōbu~tsuen) or Edogawa City Natural Zoo is a zoo located in Edogawa, Tokyo Prefecture, Japan.
e081f0c498bcc83b.zh: 江戸川区自然動物園（江戸川区自然動物園）是位於日本東京都江戶川區的動物園。

e086af365df8e33c.en: "Hirayachi" is made by mixing wheat flour with egg and Dashi (=Japanese soup stock) (or water), sprinkling with green onions, Chinese chives, and other ingredients, and baking. It is a salt-flavored “Okonomiyaki”-like dish and is often made with leftover vegetables or ingredients that are always on hand in the refrigerator. Recently, it is sometimes called "Okinawan-style Okonomiyaki" because many people eat it with sauce. It is called "Hirayachi," which means to grill flat. The texture is like the Korean pancake.
e086af365df8e33c.zh: ヒラヤーチー是將麵粉與蛋、高湯（或水）混合，撒上青蔥、韭菜等食材後煎烤而成。是一種鹽味、類似大阪燒的料理，常用剩餘的蔬菜或冰箱裡常備的食材製作。近年因為許多人會淋上醬汁食用，有時也被稱為「沖繩風大阪燒」。名稱「ヒラヤーチー」意為平平地煎烤。口感類似韓式煎餅。

e09272474a90e06b.en: Yanagawa City, which is located in the southwestern part of the Chikugo region, is almost entirely included in the Chikushi Plain and has a flat land profile. In the past, it was a marshy area, but by digging ditches (channels), the city has been able to secure water for daily use by improving the drainage of the land. The city is also known as the "City of Water" because of the ditches that run through the city. One of the specialties of Yanagawa City is "Yanagawa-nabe" made with loach.
e09272474a90e06b.zh: 柳川市位於筑後地區西南部，幾乎全境位於筑紫平原，地勢平坦。過去是沼澤地帶，透過開挖掘割（水道）改善土地排水，確保了生活用水。由於市內掘割縱橫，柳川市又稱為「水都」。柳川市的名產之一，是以泥鰍製作的「柳川なべ」。

e09bb36927ffbebe.en: The Arita Porcelain Park is a theme park located in Arita town, Saga Prefecture, Japan.
e09bb36927ffbebe.zh: 有田ポーセリンパーク是位於日本佐賀縣有田町的主題樂園。

e0a4645e976106a1.en: It is said that the cultivation of lotus root started in the Edo period when the priest of a temple in Aisai City, Aichi Prefecture, planted lotus root in the rice field in front of the temple gate. Aisai City accounts for most of the lotus root production in Aichi Prefecture.Aisai City is bordered by the Kiso River to the west and has very fertile soil, but because it is located at an elevation of 0 m above sea level, it was often plagued by flood damage.
e0a4645e976106a1.zh: 據說蓮藕的栽培始於江戶時代，當時愛知縣愛西市一座寺院的住持在寺門前的水田種植蓮藕。愛知縣的蓮藕產量大部分來自愛西市。愛西市西側與木曾川相鄰，土壤非常肥沃，但由於位於海拔0公尺，過去經常受水災所苦。

e0acecfb09dedd85.en: Kasamori Tsurumai Prefectural Natural Park (県立笠森鶴舞自然公園, Kenritsu Kasamori Tsurumai shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in central Chiba Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1966, the park spans the municipalities of Chōnan, Ichihara, and Nagara. Kasamori-dera is on the Bandō 33 Kannon pilgrimage route; its Kannon Hall is an Important Cultural Property dating to 1597 and related woodlands are a Natural Monument.
e0acecfb09dedd85.zh: 千葉縣立笠森鶴舞自然公園是位於日本千葉縣中部的縣立自然公園，設立於1966年，範圍橫跨長南町、市原市與長柄町。笠森寺是坂東三十三觀音巡禮路線上的寺院，其觀音堂為1597年的重要文化財，相關林地則為天然紀念物。

e0d8a4c37bd838f6.en: Lotus roots growing along Kosuigaike, a pond located on the banks of Mizunuma Shrine, were first planted when Akizuki Taneshige, the seventh lord of the Takanabe domain, brought over high-quality lotus roots from Yamato and recommended that it be grown locally. It was a way to overcome food scarcity and deal with financial crises. The lotus roots grown here are popular for their delicious taste, crunchiness, and stickiness.
e0d8a4c37bd838f6.zh: 生長在水沼神社旁小水池畔的蓮藕，最初是由高鍋藩第七代藩主秋月種茂從大和引進優質蓮藕、鼓勵在當地栽種而開始種植的。這是克服糧食短缺、因應財政危機的一種方法。此地種植的蓮藕以美味、清脆和黏性而受歡迎。

e0e475114a999c65.en: Shimizuyama Castle (清水山城, Shimizuyama-jō) is a Kamakura to Sengoku period Japanese castle located in the former town of Shin'asahi, now part of Takashima city, in Shiga Prefecture, Japan. It had curved rings arranged in three directions around the main enclosure, and the site of the vassals and other buildings at the foot of the mountain. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2004.
e0e475114a999c65.zh: 清水山城是鎌倉時代至戰國時代的日本城郭，位於日本滋賀縣舊新旭町，今屬高島市。主郭周圍朝三個方向配置彎曲的曲輪，山腳則有家臣宅邸等建築的遺址。其遺址自2004年起被指定為國家史跡加以保護。

e0e63241fcae8364.en: Sakurayama (桜山) is a mountain in the city of Fujioka, Gunma Prefecture,  Japan. It is 591 metres (1,939 ft) in height, and was named one of the "100 Sakura Spots in Japan" during Expo '90 by the International Flower and Green Expo Association. It is also a National Place of Scenic Beauty as determined by the Agency for Cultural Affairs in Japan.
e0e63241fcae8364.zh: 櫻山（桜山）是位於日本群馬縣藤岡市的一座山，海拔591公尺（1,939英尺），曾在90年國際花與綠博覽會期間由國際花與綠博覽會協會選為「日本櫻花名所100選」之一。這裡也是日本文化廳認定的國家名勝。

e0e8e345ee28eea2.en: Tōyama Memorial Museum (遠山記念館, Tōyama Kinenkan) opened in Kawajima, Saitama Prefecture, Japan, in 1970. The dedicated museum building is situated amongst those of the residence built by founder of Nikkō Securities Tōyama Genichi. The collection, his forming its core, includes six Important Cultural Properties.
e0e8e345ee28eea2.zh: 遠山記念館於1970年在日本埼玉縣川島開館。專用的美術館建築位於日興證券創辦人遠山元一所建宅邸的各棟建築之間。館藏以其個人收藏為核心，包括六件重要文化財。

e0f0f53cfbf70871.en: Saint Maur International School, established in 1872 in Yokohama within the Greater Tokyo Area, is the oldest international school in Japan. The school, which is co-educational, caters to students of all nationalities and faiths from ages 2½ through high school age. Saint Maur International School is located in a historically international district in Yokohama, Japan, one of the few places where foreigners were allowed entrance into the country during the Sakoku policy of the late Edo period.
e0f0f53cfbf70871.zh: サンモール・インターナショナル・スクール於1872年創立於首都圈的橫濱，是日本歷史最悠久的國際學校。該校採男女合校，招收各國籍、各信仰的學生，年齡自2歲半至高中。學校位於橫濱一處歷史上具國際色彩的地區，此地是江戶時代後期鎖國政策下，少數允許外國人入境的地方之一。

e0f18650ba324b76.en: Cape Futtsu (富津岬, Futtsu-misaki?) is a cape located east of Tokyo Bay in Futtsu, Chiba, Japan. The entire area in the cape has been developed as Chiba Prefectural Futtsu Park, and has been selected as one of Japan's Top 100 White Sand and Green Pines and one of Kanto's Top 100 Views of Fuji. Futtsu Tidal Flat on the north side of Cape Futtsu is included in Japan's 500 important wetlands.
e0f18650ba324b76.zh: 富津岬是位於日本千葉縣富津市、東京灣東側的海岬。整個岬區已規劃為千葉縣立富津公園，並入選日本白砂青松100選及關東富士見百景。富津岬北側的富津干潟列入日本重要濕地500。

e0f2f07c422f4610.en: The Murakamike Residence (村上家住宅) is one of the gasshō-zukuri houses in Kaminashi Village, Nanto City, Toyama Prefecture. It is designated as an Important Cultural Property of Japan.
e0f2f07c422f4610.zh: 村上家住宅是富山縣南礪市上梨村的合掌造民宅之一，已被指定為日本重要文化財。

e0f6c6c915260f20.en: Honkō-ji (本光寺) is a Buddhist temple belonging to the Sōtō sect of Japanese Zen located in the town of Kōta, Nukata District, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. The temple is noted for its hydrangea flowers in spring. Its main image is a statue of Shaka Nyōrai.
e0f6c6c915260f20.zh: 本光寺是位於日本愛知縣額田郡幸田町的佛教寺院，屬日本禪宗曹洞宗。此寺以春季的繡球花聞名。本尊為釋迦如來像。

e112a9ba8f440056.en: "Kamabuku" is a sweet cake made from boiled and mashed potatoes with glutinous rice flour and sugar, and formed into a half round shape. In Japan, rolled dishes, such as "Datemaki" and "Futomaki", have been widely eaten on special occasions. In Akita Prefecture, "Kamabuku" is made to resemble "Kamoboko" fish cake, and has been an indispensable treat for celebrations and festivals.
e112a9ba8f440056.zh: 「かまぶく」是將馬鈴薯煮熟壓泥後，加入糯米粉和砂糖，做成半圓形的甜點。在日本，「伊達卷」、「太卷」等卷狀料理在特殊場合廣為食用。在秋田縣，「かまぶく」做成類似「蒲鉾」魚板的樣子，一直是慶祝活動與祭典不可或缺的點心。

e1130d00e36a6a4d.en: Tshujido Seaside Park (Japanese: 辻堂海浜公園)  is a 19.9-hectare Kanagawa prefectural city park, located on the west coast of Tsujido, Fujisawa City, Kanagawa, Japan. It has been selected as one of the 50 best parks in Kanagawa.
e1130d00e36a6a4d.zh: 辻堂海浜公園是一座占地19.9公頃的神奈川縣立都市公園，位於日本神奈川縣藤澤市辻堂西海岸。曾獲選為「神奈川公園50選」之一。

e12281be75a59da7.en: Gifu prefecture has many clear streams such as Kiso River, Nagara River and Ibi River. From around June to October of each year, ayu (=sweetfish) fishing is active and fresh ayu (=sweetfish) can be enjoyed.Cormorant fishing is a traditional method of ayu (=sweetfish) fishing which dates to 1,300 years ago.
e12281be75a59da7.zh: 岐阜縣有木曾川、長良川、揖斐川等許多清流。每年約6月至10月，香魚捕撈盛行，可以品嚐到新鮮的香魚。鸕鶿捕魚是一種傳統的香魚捕撈方式，歷史可追溯至1,300年前。

e130595fe5db1b3f.en: Generally speaking, a chikuwa fish paste tube is usually made of fish meat, but “tofu chikuwa” is a unique processed food found in the central and eastern regions of Tottori Prefecture made by mixing firm tofu and white fish paste in a ratio of about 07時03分, then steaming it. The taste is very delicate, and when you chew it, you can smell the soft tofu.The development of fishing ports was slow in the Edo period, so fish was a precious food and was not eaten by the common people.
e130595fe5db1b3f.zh: 一般來說，竹輪通常以魚肉製成，但「とうふちくわ」是鳥取縣中部與東部特有的加工食品，將板豆腐與白身魚漿以約07時03分的比例混合後蒸製而成。味道十分清淡，咀嚼時可聞到柔和的豆腐香氣。江戶時代漁港發展緩慢，因此魚是珍貴的食物，一般百姓吃不到。

e1460a2639ab5af2.en: In Gunma, wheat is cultivated from the fall after the rice harvest is over, and a double cropping system is widely practiced. As a result, a flour-eating culture has taken root, and wheat dishes are sometimes a staple food, especially in areas where rice production is low. Ama-neji" is a local dish born from this flour-food culture. It is a snack-like dish made by boiling sweet red bean soup stock and adding bite-sized pieces of dough made from wheat flour kneaded with water.
e1460a2639ab5af2.zh: 在群馬縣，秋季稻米收成結束後便開始種植小麥，二期耕作的方式相當普遍。因此形成了以麵粉為食的飲食文化，尤其在稻米產量少的地區，小麥料理有時會作為主食。「あまねじ」就是從這種粉食文化中誕生的鄉土料理。做法是將甜紅豆湯煮滾，加入以麵粉加水揉成、切成一口大小的麵團，是一道類似點心的料理。

e1812b767243e410.en: Shallot cultivation in Tottori Prefecture is old, dating back to the Edo period. It’s said shallots were brought back by Koishikawa Yakuen during one of his official stays in Edo as a daimyo. The shallot has a robust vitality and can grow even in sand dunes, so at the time it was cultivated by a small number of farmers for their own use. An industrial union was established in the early Taisho period, and full-scale production began in earnest when sprinkler irrigation was introduced.
e1812b767243e410.zh: 鳥取縣的蕗蕎栽培歷史悠久，可追溯至江戶時代。據說是大名在某次參勤交代停留江戶期間，從小石川藥園帶回來的。蕗蕎生命力強韌，即使在沙丘也能生長，因此當時由少數農家種植自用。大正初期成立了產業組合，引進灑水灌溉後正式開始大規模生產。

e1920de4b74ead65.en: Lake Miyagase (宮ヶ瀬湖) is a lake within the Aiko District of Kanagawa, Japan, located between Sagamihara and Atsugi. The lake offers views of Tanzawa Mountains, including Mount Hiru. The lake is a man-made reservoir and formed by the Miyagase Dam, and is a source of drinking water for Yokohama and Tokyo.
e1920de4b74ead65.zh: 宮ヶ瀬湖是位於日本神奈川縣愛甲郡的湖泊，介於相模原與厚木之間。從湖畔可眺望包括蛭ヶ岳在內的丹澤山地。這座湖是由宮ヶ瀬ダム形成的人工水庫，為橫濱與東京的飲用水水源。

e1d965f4340edf56.en: "Ohagi" is a well-loved dish throughout Japan. The red color of azuki beans has long been believed to ward off evil spirits, and as such, it has been incorporated into various seasonal celebratory dishes. During the spring and autumn equinoxes, "Ohagi" is offered as an ancestral ritual.
e1d965f4340edf56.zh: 「おはぎ」是日本各地廣受喜愛的食物。紅豆的紅色自古被認為能驅邪，因此被用於各種季節性的節慶料理中。春分與秋分時節，人們會以「おはぎ」供奉祖先。

e1e29008f133b4f0.en: Mount Rai (雷山, Rai-zan) is a 954.5 m (3,132 ft) mountain located on the border of Itoshima, Fukuoka Prefecture, and Saga, Saga Prefecture, Japan.
e1e29008f133b4f0.zh: 雷山是位於日本福岡縣糸島市與佐賀縣佐賀市交界處的山，高954.5公尺（3,132英尺）。

e1fe09a68134cf3d.en: During the Edo period, a large amount of kombu was transported from Hokkaido by the Kitamaebune, which traveled across the Sea of Japan. This led to the establishment of today's kombu kingdom, Toyama. A number of kombu dishes have been passed down over generations, and kombumaki, which is fish wrapped in kombu, has become an indispensable feast for special occasions such as the New Year. The representative variation is kombumaki with migaki herring.
e1fe09a68134cf3d.zh: 江戶時代，大量昆布由航行於日本海的北前船從北海道運來，造就了今日的昆布王國富山。許多昆布料理代代相傳，其中以昆布包裹魚類的昆布巻き，已成為新年等特殊場合不可或缺的佳餚。代表性的種類是包身欠鯡魚的昆布巻き。

e2045bd38a8a9326.en: Shimane Aquarium or Shimane AQUAS Aquarium (島根県立しまね海洋館, Shimane kenritsu Shimane kaiyokan) is a prefectural public aquarium located in Hamada City and Gotsu City, Shimane Prefecture, Japan. It is managed and operated by the Shimane Aquarium Foundation. It is a member of the Japanese Association of Zoos and Aquariums (JAZA), and the aquarium is accredited as a designated facilities by the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology.
e2045bd38a8a9326.zh: 島根縣立島根海洋館（又稱島根水族館、島根AQUAS水族館）是位於日本島根縣濱田市與江津市的縣立公共水族館，由島根水族館財團管理營運。該館為日本動物園水族館協會（JAZA）會員，並獲文部科學省認定為指定設施。

e2072c6dcb3bdaec.en: The National Crafts Museum (国立工芸館, Kokuritsu Kōgei Kan) is a museum of Japanese crafts in Kanazawa, Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan. It forms part of the Independent Administrative Institution National Museum of Art (ja). As part of the government policy of regional revitalization, the facility relocated in 2020 from Kitanomaru Park in Tokyo, where it first opened in 1977.
e2072c6dcb3bdaec.zh: 國立工藝館是位於日本石川縣金澤市的日本工藝博物館，隸屬獨立行政法人國立美術館。依據政府的地方創生政策，該館於2020年從東京北之丸公園遷至現址；該館於1977年在北之丸公園首度開館。

e207c678a84bc6c3.en: The Atagawa Tropical & Alligator Garden (熱川バナナワニ園, Atagawa Banana Wani En) is a botanical garden with alligators located in the Fuji-Hakone-Izu National Park at 971-9 Naramoto, Higashiizu-cho, Kamo, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. It is open daily. An admission fee is charged.
e207c678a84bc6c3.zh: 熱川バナナワニ園是一座飼養鱷魚的植物園，位於日本靜岡縣賀茂郡東伊豆町奈良本971-9，在富士箱根伊豆國立公園範圍內。每日開放，需付費入園。

e21eb98a34a29a54.en: Nakata Museum (なかた美術館, Nakata bijutsukan) opened in Onomichi, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan, in 1997. The collection includes works by Corot, Renoir, Cézanne, Kobayashi Wasaku (小林和作), and Umehara Ryūzaburō.
e21eb98a34a29a54.zh: なかた美術館於1997年在日本廣島縣尾道開館。館藏包括柯洛、雷諾瓦、塞尚、小林和作與梅原龍三郎的作品。

e241ca0a3e49bb06.en: Mount Ōkueyama (大崩山), also known as Mount Ōkue, is a volcanic mountain on the Japanese island of Kyushu. Part of an ancient volcanic formation known as the Okueyama Volcano-plutonic Complex, Mount Ōkueyama (and possibly several nearby volcanoes) experienced a massive eruption ~13.7 million years before present (13.7 Ma); it has been postulated that this eruption measured 8 on the Volcanic Explosivity Index, making the Ōkueyama eruption larger than any eruption in recorded history. The volcano is now considered to be extinct.
e241ca0a3e49bb06.zh: 大崩山（又稱大崩）是位於日本九州的火山。大崩山屬於稱為大崩山火山－深成岩複合體的古老火山構造，約1370萬年前曾（可能連同附近數座火山）發生大規模噴發；有人推測此次噴發的火山爆發指數達8級，規模大於有歷史紀錄以來的任何噴發。此火山目前被視為死火山。

e26d358caff41a15.en: Hitsumabushi (ひつまぶし) is a local dish of Japan, consisting of sliced unagi (eel) grilled in kabayaki style on rice. Hitsumabushi became common in the 1950s, when farm-raised eel became widely available. It is considered one of the representative dishes of Nagoya cuisine.
e26d358caff41a15.zh: ひつまぶし是日本的鄉土料理，將以蒲燒方式烤製的鰻魚切片鋪在米飯上。1950年代養殖鰻魚普及後，ひつまぶし也隨之普遍。這道料理被視為名古屋料理的代表菜色之一。

e28daff55d145176.en: The Seto Inland Sea Folk History Museum (瀬戸内海歴史民俗資料館, Seto Naikai Rekishi Minzoku Shiryōkan) is a prefectural museum in Takamatsu, Japan, dedicated to the history and culture of the Seto Inland Sea and Setouchi region. It was established in 1973, and since 2008 has operated as an annex of The Kagawa Museum. The collection of some 22,000 items includes 5,966 that have been collectively designated as three Important Tangible Folk Cultural Properties.
e28daff55d145176.zh: 瀨戶內海歷史民俗資料館是位於日本高松市的縣立博物館，以瀨戶內海及瀨戶內地區的歷史與文化為主題。1973年設立，2008年起作為香川縣立博物館的分館營運。館藏約22,000件，其中5,966件合併被指定為三項重要有形民俗文化財。

e29a1a5f0a8949e1.en: Shōsan-ji (焼山寺) or Shozan-ji is a Shingon Buddhist temple in Kamiyama, Tokushima. It is the 12th temple in the 88 temple  Shikoku Pilgrimage. At at elevation of 706 metres, it is the second highest temple of the pilgrimage.
e29a1a5f0a8949e1.zh: 焼山寺是位於德島縣神山町的真言宗寺院，為四國八十八所遍路第12號札所。海拔706公尺，是遍路中位置第二高的寺院。

e2cc4d55415b2a63.en: Yasaka Kōshin-dō (八坂庚申堂), or in its full name Daikoku-san Kongō-ji Kōshin-dō (大黒山金剛寺庚申堂) is a small temple located in Higashiyama, Kyoto, Japan. The temple is located near Kiyomizu-dera.
e2cc4d55415b2a63.zh: 八坂庚申堂，全名大黑山金剛寺庚申堂，是位於日本京都東山的小型寺院，鄰近清水寺。

e2cce9dd195c28b9.en: Kannon-ji (Kannon Temple) (Japanese: 観音寺) is a Koyasan Shingon temple in Tokushima, Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. It is Temple # 16 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage. The main image is of Senju Kannon (Guan Yin Boddhisattva, Sanskrit: Avalokitasvara or Avalokiteśvara).
e2cce9dd195c28b9.zh: 觀音寺（日文：観音寺）是位於日本德島縣德島市的高野山真言宗寺院，為四國八十八所遍路的第16番寺院。本尊為千手觀音（觀音菩薩，梵文：Avalokitasvara或Avalokiteśvara）。

e2cd668e43074854.en: Tanaka Castle (田中城, Tanaka-jō) is a Japanese castle located in Fujieda, central Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. At the end of the Edo period, Tanaka Castle was home to a branch of the Honda clan, daimyō of Tanaka Domain.
e2cd668e43074854.zh: 田中城是位於日本靜岡縣中部藤枝市的日本城郭。江戶時代末期，田中城為田中藩大名本多氏一支的居城。

e2ddce670cd52adf.en: Higashi Sankei Prefectural Natural Park (東山渓県立自然公園, Higashi Sankei kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. Established in 2005, the park spans the borders of the municipalities of Kamiyama, Katsuura, Naka, Sanagōchi, and Tokushima. The park encompasses Mount Nakatsumine (中津峰山) and the Hata Five Falls (八多五滝) as well as the temples of Kakurin-ji (鶴林寺) and Tairyū-ji (太龍寺), temples 20 and 21 on the Shikoku pilgrimage.
e2ddce670cd52adf.zh: 東山渓県立自然公園是位於日本德島縣的縣立自然公園。公園設立於2005年，範圍橫跨神山町、勝浦町、那賀町、佐那河內村及德島市。園內涵蓋中津峰山與八多五瀧，以及四國遍路第20號與第21號札所鶴林寺與太龍寺。

e306c45e82cbb5b6.en: Kusagina are the dried young leaves of kusagi, a plant which grows wild in the countryside. It has an incredibly strong smell, so you'll know it's there even if you're just walking nearby. When you harvest it matters; select egg-sized ones that are neither too small nor too large. In the central region of Okayama Prefecture, it's picked and dried in late May. To dry it, quickly blanch the freshly picked leaves, then run it under cold water to remove the scum. It will not taste good unless all the scum is carefully removed.
e306c45e82cbb5b6.zh: くさぎ菜是將野生於鄉間的植物臭梧桐（くさぎ）的嫩葉乾燥而成。它的氣味非常強烈，即使只是從附近走過也能察覺。採收時機很重要，要選擇不會太小也不會太大、約雞蛋大小的葉子。在岡山縣中部地區，於5月下旬採摘並乾燥。乾燥時，先將剛摘下的葉子快速汆燙，再用冷水沖洗以去除澀味。若沒有仔細去除所有澀味，就不會好吃。

e30966cebee87727.en: Kōtō-in (高桐院) is a sub-temple of Daitoku-ji, Kyoto, Japan. It was founded by Hosokawa Tadaoki. There is a teahouse, the Shōkō-ken, and the gardens are celebrated for their momiji. A pair of Southern Song monochrome hanging scrolls with landscape have been designated a National Treasure. Many other works are aired annually in October.
e30966cebee87727.zh: 高桐院是日本京都大德寺的塔頭寺院，由細川忠興創建。寺內有茶室「松向軒」，庭園以紅葉著稱。一對南宋水墨山水掛軸被指定為國寶。另有許多作品每年10月曝涼展出。

e31733d342d96ec1.en: This is a dish in winter when it starts frosting in the south region of the prefecture, where river shrimp can be caught once it’s getting cold.
e31733d342d96ec1.zh: 這是縣南地區開始降霜的冬季料理，該地區在天氣轉冷後可以捕到河蝦。

e33e577b1855cd7d.en: Kami-shima (神島) is an inhabited island at the mouth of Ise Bay off the east coast of central Honshu, Japan. It is administered by the city of Toba in Mie Prefecture.
e33e577b1855cd7d.zh: 神島是位於日本本州中部東岸外、伊勢灣口的有人島，由三重縣鳥羽市管轄。

e3405704b77d11d3.en: The Aritaki Arboretum (アリタキアーボレータム, Aritaki Āborētamu) is a private arboretum located at 2566 Koshigaya, Koshigaya, Saitama, Japan. Its curator, Tadahiko Aritaki, traveled and collected plants throughout Asia.
e3405704b77d11d3.zh: 越谷アリタキ植物園是位於日本埼玉縣越谷市越谷2566的私人樹木園。其館長有瀧忠彥曾遊歷亞洲各地採集植物。

e34147f5b37c86dd.en: Mukaishima (向島, Mukaishima) is the northernmost island in the Geiyo Islands chain accommodating Nishiseto Expressway connecting Honshu and Shikoku islands. Its coasts are washed by Seto Inland Sea. The island's highest peak is Takamiyama (高見山) 283.2 m (929 ft) high.
e34147f5b37c86dd.zh: 向島是藝予諸島最北端的島嶼，有連接本州與四國的西瀨戶自動車道通過。海岸面臨瀨戶內海。島上最高峰為高見山，高283.2公尺（929英尺）。

e34a73bc535a717a.en: Shiryōkaku (四稜郭) (literally, "four-point fort") is a fort in the city of Hakodate in southern Hokkaidō, Japan. It was constructed in April 1869, during the Battle of Hakodate, three kilometres to the northeast of Goryōkaku by 200 soldiers of the former Tokugawa shogunate and 100 local villagers, likely under the direction of Ōtori Keisuke.  Shiryōkaku  has four bastions, and is sometimes known as the "butterfly fort" as opposed to the "star fort".
e34a73bc535a717a.zh: 四稜郭（字面意思為「四角堡壘」）是位於日本北海道南部函館市的堡壘。1869年4月箱館戰爭期間，由舊德川幕府士兵200人與當地村民100人在五稜郭東北方三公里處興建，可能由大鳥圭介指揮。四稜郭有四座稜堡，相對於「星形堡壘」，有時被稱為「蝴蝶堡壘」。

e34d13da13ec0d55.en: The Ogasawara Museum (or the O-Museum) is a located in the Shiroyama mountain range of Nagano Prefecture in the center of the Honshu island, Japan. The building was designed by the architecture firm, SANAA, run by Kazuyo Sejima and Ryue Nishizawa, and constructed between 1995 and 1999. It was one of the architect-duo's first projects together.
e34d13da13ec0d55.zh: 小笠原資料館（又稱O-Museum）位於日本本州中部長野縣的城山山區。建築由妹島和世與西澤立衛主持的建築事務所SANAA設計，於1995年至1999年間興建，是兩人最早的合作案之一。

e37509958ffea110.en: Sabukaze kiln ruins (寒風古窯跡群, Sabukaze koyōseki-gun) is an archaeological site consisting of the remains of kilns for firing Sue ware pottery from the start of the Asuka period to the Heian period  located in the Ushimado neighborhood of the city of Setouchi, Okayama Prefecture in the San'yō region of Japan. The site was the largest production area of Sue ware in western Japan, and the Sue ware from these kilns evolved into the current Bizen ware.  The site has been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 1986.
e37509958ffea110.zh: 寒風古窯跡群是位於日本山陽地方岡山縣瀨戶內市牛窗地區的考古遺址，由飛鳥時代初期至平安時代燒製須惠器的窯址組成。此地曾是西日本最大的須惠器產地，這些窯燒製的須惠器後來演變為今日的備前燒。遺址自1986年起由中央政府指定為國家史跡加以保護。

e37c1e14c284525c.en: Zoni" is a soup made with white miso paste, round rice cake with sweet bean paste, daikon radish cut into round slices to wish for family happiness, and kintoki carrots.During the Edo period , sugarcane cultivation was encouraged in Kagawa Prefecture, where the climate was mild and rainfall was scarce, as a way to promote agricultural production. White sugar from the Sanuki region was white in color and melt-in-your-mouth, making it one of the three "Sanuki whites" (along with cotton and salt) and a representative of local specialties.
e37c1e14c284525c.zh: 「雜煮」是以白味噌加入包有甜豆沙的圓年糕、切成圓片以祈求家庭圓滿的白蘿蔔，以及金時紅蘿蔔煮成的湯。江戶時代，氣候溫暖、雨量稀少的香川縣為振興農業生產而獎勵種植甘蔗。讚岐地區的白糖色白、入口即化，與棉花、鹽並列為「讚岐三白」，是代表性的地方特產。

e38188f7725198c1.en: The coastal areas of Hagi in Yamaguchi prefecture are a treasure trove of seafood. Sea urchin, a spiky marine creature known for its strong sweetness and rich flavor, is frequently caught, boasting the 7th highest production volume in the country (according to the 2016 Statistical Survey on Marine Fishery Production issued by Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry, and Fisheries). "Murasaki" (=purple) sea urchins and "Bafun" (=horse-dung) sea urchins are landed. Of note is the "Aka" (=red) Uni, which is harvested from early spring to summer.
e38188f7725198c1.zh: 山口縣萩市的沿海地區是海產的寶庫。海膽是一種帶刺的海洋生物，以甜味濃郁、風味醇厚著稱，在此地捕獲量很多，產量居全國第7位（根據農林水產省發布的2016年海面漁業生產統計調查）。上岸的有紫海膽與馬糞海膽。另有早春至夏季採收的赤海膽。

e381f9c6edc2b968.en: The Yokaren Peace Memorial Museum (予科練平和記念館, Yokaren Heiwa Kinenkan) opened in Ami, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan, in 2010. The museum preserves and displays materials relating to the young Naval Aviator Preparatory Course trainees, Yokaren (予科練) for short, including photographs by Ken Domon. In the adjacent garden, the Yūshō-en (雄翔園), there is a monument to the approximately nineteen thousand Yokaren who died in the war, while the Yūshō-kan (雄翔館) stores and displays their last testaments and other personal effects.
e381f9c6edc2b968.zh: 予科練平和記念館於2010年在日本茨城縣阿見町開館。館內保存並展示與海軍飛行預科練習生（簡稱予科練）相關的資料，包括土門拳拍攝的照片。相鄰的庭園雄翔園內有一座紀念碑，紀念在戰爭中死亡的約一萬九千名予科練學員；雄翔館則收藏並展示他們的遺書及其他遺物。

e3b7accce0bdf439.en: The Kazusa Kokubun-niji (上総国分尼寺跡) is the ruins of a Buddhist nunnery located in the city of Ichihara, Chiba, Japan, which was part of the  provincial temple complex ("kokubunji") of former Kazusa Province.The temple ruins were designated a National Historic Site in 1983, with the area under protection expanded in 1985.
e3b7accce0bdf439.zh: 上總國分尼寺跡（上総国分尼寺跡）是位於日本千葉縣市原市的佛教尼寺遺址，原為舊上總國國分寺建築群的一部分。寺院遺址於 1983 年被指定為國家史跡，1985 年擴大保護範圍。

e3ce9312ec7e42f1.en: "Kujira-jiru" is an essential New Year's Dish in Southern Hokkaido. As the New Year approaches, it is customary to simmer salted whale and vegetables in a large pot and eat it on the first three days of the New Year. It is repeatedly heated and eaten, so the vegetables in the soup are selected to not fall apart when reheated.
e3ce9312ec7e42f1.zh: 「鯨汁」是北海道南部不可或缺的新年料理。新年將近時，習慣在大鍋中燉煮鹽漬鯨肉與蔬菜，並在新年的頭三天食用。由於會反覆加熱食用，湯中的蔬菜會挑選重新加熱也不易煮散的種類。

e3de48f8bd4dacda.en: Rakusui-en (楽水園) is a garden in Hakata-ku, Fukuoka, Japan. It was originally built in 1906 for Shimozawa Zenemon Chikamasa, a Hakata merchant. In 1995, Fukuoka City overhauled the structure and reopened it as a Japanese garden where visitors can experience a tea ceremony; with four tea rooms (two of which are available for use by general visitors) it is often used for tea ceremonies and related training.
e3de48f8bd4dacda.zh: 楽水園是位於日本福岡市博多區的庭園，最初於1906年為博多商人下澤善右衛門親正所建。1995年福岡市將其整修，重新開放為可體驗茶道的日本庭園；園內有四間茶室（其中兩間開放一般遊客使用），常用於茶會及相關研習。

e405d5b11bd464db.en: Dekomawashi" is a local dish of Iya area in Miyoshi City. Bite-sized potatoes, buckwheat dumplings, rock tofu, and round konnyaku are skewered and grilled with miso sauce. The skewers are placed on the hearth and grilled, turning the skewers in a circular motion so that they cook all the way through. It is said that the name "dekkomawashi" comes from its resemblance to the way the heads of "deku" (wooden dolls) in Awa ningyo joruri (puppet theater) are turned.
e405d5b11bd464db.zh: 「祖谷のでこまわし」是三好市祖谷地區的鄉土料理。將一口大小的馬鈴薯、蕎麥糰子、岩豆腐和圓形蒟蒻串起，塗上味噌醬燒烤。竹串插在地爐旁燒烤，並以轉圈的方式轉動，使食材熟透。據說名稱源自其模樣類似阿波人形淨瑠璃（木偶戲）中轉動「でく」（木偶）頭部的動作。

e40bea52716c62b8.en: Tōsenkyō (唐船峡) is a gorge in Ibusuki, Kagoshima Prefecture, in southern Japan. It stands southwest of the Ikeda Lake. The name Tōsenkyō is derived from a place known as Tōsen-ga-saka, which had a deep cove in the Edo period (1603–1868) where many Chinese ships came to anchor in (tōsen means Chinese ships).
e40bea52716c62b8.zh: 唐船峡是位於日本南部鹿兒島縣指宿市的峽谷，在池田湖西南方。唐船峡之名源自一處名為唐船ヶ坂的地方，該地在江戶時代（1603–1868）有一處深灣，許多中國船隻曾在此停泊（唐船意為中國船隻）。

e430cbb9f8c6c96e.en: Mount Ōmuro (大室山, Ōmuroyama) is a 580 m (1,900 ft)-high cinder cone volcano in the Izu-Tobu volcano field of Itō, Shizuoka, Japan. At the independent peak, the yearly mountain burning that has been performed for more than 700 years is carried out in the early spring, so it is often covered with annual plants and is a symbol of Itō. The mountain is designated as a national natural monument and part of Fuji-Hakone-Izu National Park.
e430cbb9f8c6c96e.zh: 大室山是位於日本靜岡縣伊東市伊豆東部火山群中的火山渣錐，高580公尺（1,900英尺）。這座獨立山峰每年早春都會進行已延續700多年以上的燒山，因此山體多覆蓋一年生植物，是伊東的象徵。此山被指定為國家天然紀念物，並屬於富士箱根伊豆國立公園。

e435df064e0db07e.en: Soga Hachiman Shrine (曽我八幡宮, Soga Hachiman-gū) is a Shinto shrine in Kamiide, Fujinomiya, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. The shrine enshrines Emperor Ōjin, Soga Sukenari, Soga Tokimune and Tora Gozen. There are three Soga Hachiman bunsha, or branch shrines, in Fujinomiya.
e435df064e0db07e.zh: 曽我八幡宮是位於日本靜岡縣富士宮市上井出的神社。祭祀應神天皇、曾我祐成、曾我時致與虎御前。富士宮市內有三座曾我八幡的分社。

e43ec5d9caefecbe.en: Haji Dam (土師ダム, Haji damu) is a dam in Akitakata, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan.
e43ec5d9caefecbe.zh: 土師ダム是位於日本廣島縣安藝高田市的水壩。

e4475d9ecfb4d52d.en: The Nakanoshima Park (中之島公園, Nakanoshima kōen) is the first public park opened by Osaka in 1891, after its foundation as a city. It is located in Kita ward, on the Nakanoshima sandbank, lying between Dōjima and Tosabori Rivers. The 11 hectare park houses public facilities such as Osaka Central Public Hall (built in 1918), Osaka Prefectural Nakanoshima Library and Museum of Oriental Ceramics. It also holds a rose garden. The City Hall of Osaka building is located on its west end.
e4475d9ecfb4d52d.zh: 中之島公園是大阪建市後於1891年開設的第一座公共公園，位於北區中之島沙洲上，介於堂島川與土佐堀川之間。占地11公頃的園區內設有大阪市中央公會堂（建於1918年）、大阪府立中之島圖書館及東洋陶瓷美術館等公共設施，另有一座玫瑰園。大阪市政府大樓位於公園西端。

e44924eaad3e25d1.en: The Handayama Botanical Garden (岡山市半田山植物園, Okayama-shi Handayama Shokubutsuen) is a botanical garden located at 2-1319 Kitagata, Kita-ku, Okayama, Japan. It is open daily except Tuesdays; an admission fee is charged.
e44924eaad3e25d1.zh: 岡山市半田山植物園是位於日本岡山市北區法界院（北方）2-1319的植物園，除週二外每日開放，需收門票。

e46a0d00635eb01b.en: Edo Wonderland Nikko Edomura (江戸ワンダーランド 日光江戸村, Edo Wandārando Nikkō Edomura) is a Japanese cultural theme park  in the Kinugawa Onsen area of Nikkō, Tochigi. The park resurrects and showcases the life and culture of the Edo period.
e46a0d00635eb01b.zh: 江戶ワンダーランド 日光江戶村是位於栃木縣日光市鬼怒川溫泉地區的日本文化主題樂園，重現並展示江戶時代的生活與文化。

e47def9c9cf3f215.en: Kameyama Castle (亀山城, Kameyama-jō) is a Japanese castle located in Kameyama, northern Mie Prefecture, Japan. At the end of the Edo period, Kameyama Castle was home to the Ishikawa clan, daimyō of Ise-Kameyama Domain. The castle was also known as "Kochō-jō" (粉蝶城).
e47def9c9cf3f215.zh: 亀山城是位於日本三重縣北部龜山市的日本城郭。江戶時代末期，亀山城為伊勢龜山藩藩主石川氏的居城。此城又稱「粉蝶城」。

e49f34c7699e0fa3.en: One of Nara's local dishes, "Nokpe" is a stew of taro, radish, carrots, and other ingredients.
e49f34c7699e0fa3.zh: 「奈良のっぺ」是奈良的鄉土料理之一，以芋頭、白蘿蔔、紅蘿蔔等食材燉煮而成。

e4a22d3cddeaa7fe.en: The Ishikari coal basin lies in the tertiary mountains of the mining region of Sorachi, east of the Ishikari Plain in central Hokkaido. These coal veins contain the largest quantity of coal of Japan. Because of its late discovery the historical role of the coalfield could not be compared with that of the Chikuho coalfield, but its economic importance since the Japanese industrial revolution is comparable with that of the southern Chikuhō coalfield.
e4a22d3cddeaa7fe.zh: 石狩炭田位於北海道中部石狩平原以東、空知礦區的第三紀山地。這些煤層的蘊藏量居日本之冠。由於發現較晚，其歷史地位無法與筑豐炭田相比，但自日本工業革命以來，其經濟重要性可與南方的筑豐炭田相提並論。

e4a2870500597feb.en: Inubōsaki Lighthouse (犬吠埼燈台, Inubōsaki tōdai) is a lighthouse on Cape Inubō, in the city of Chōshi, Chiba Prefecture Japan.  It is notable as one of the few lighthouses whose original lens was a first order Fresnel lens, the strongest type of Fresnel lens.  It is a Registered Tangible Cultural Property of Japan. The lighthouse is located within the borders of the Suigo-Tsukuba Quasi-National Park.
e4a2870500597feb.zh: 犬吠埼燈台是位於日本千葉縣銚子市犬吠埼的燈塔。它是少數最初使用一等菲涅耳透鏡的燈塔之一，一等菲涅耳透鏡為菲涅耳透鏡中最強的類型。此燈塔為日本登錄有形文化財，位於水鄉筑波國定公園範圍內。

e4aa196aaad5632e.en: The Rakusan-en (楽山園, Sakai-shi teien) is a traditional Japanese garden located in the town of Kanra, Gunma Prefecture, Japan. It became a nationally designated Place of Scenic Beauty in 2000.
e4aa196aaad5632e.zh: 樂山園（楽山園）是位於日本群馬縣甘樂町的傳統日本庭園，於2000年成為國家指定名勝。

e4bba38790b71f7b.en: "Kaki meshi" is a mixed rice made with oysters from aquaculture in the areas around Etajima city. The local people of Hiroshima have been eating oysters for a long time. Shell middens have shown that wild oysters were eaten as far back as the Jomon and Yayoi periods. It is believed that aquaculture of oysters began between the 1500s and 1600s.
e4bba38790b71f7b.zh: 「かき飯」是以江田島市周邊地區養殖的牡蠣製作的炊飯。廣島當地人很早就開始食用牡蠣。從貝塚可知，早在繩文時代和彌生時代就已食用野生牡蠣。一般認為牡蠣養殖始於1500年代至1600年代之間。

e4bbae4a44977e24.en: “Iriko gohan” is a rice dish made with small, crunchy dried sardines known as iriko. The Japanese anchovies that become iriko are caught in the Seto Inland Sea. In particular, the area around Ibuki Island, located in the Seisan region of western Kagawa prefecture, is one of the most prominent areas for catching iriko.Freshness is vital when producing dried sardines. The anchovy catch is hauled to Ibuki Island in a mere 30 minutes before being boiled up.
e4bbae4a44977e24.zh: 「いりこ飯」是使用稱為いりこ的酥脆小沙丁魚乾製作的米飯料理。製成いりこ的日本鯷捕自瀨戶內海，其中位於香川縣西部西讚地區的伊吹島周邊，是捕撈いりこ最主要的地區之一。製作沙丁魚乾時，新鮮度至關重要。捕獲的鯷魚僅需30分鐘就運到伊吹島，隨即水煮。

e4be29097c8b7fa9.en: The Uwajima City Date Museum (宇和島市立伊達博物館, Uwajima Shiritsu Date Hakubutsukan) opened in Uwajima, Ehime Prefecture, Japan in 1974. The collection focuses on the local branch of the Date clan, who from 1615 and the time of Date Hidemune were daimyō of the Uwajima Domain, and includes a Momoyama-period painting of Toyotomi Hideyoshi that has been designated an Important Cultural Property.
e4be29097c8b7fa9.zh: 宇和島市立伊達博物館（宇和島市立伊達博物館）於1974年在日本愛媛縣宇和島市開館。館藏以伊達氏在當地的分家為主，該家族自1615年伊達秀宗時起擔任宇和島藩大名；館藏包括一幅被指定為重要文化財的桃山時代豐臣秀吉畫像。

e4cb508f73f97cf5.en: Tsuruoka Municipal Kamo Aquarium (鶴岡市立加茂水族館, Kamo Suizokukan) is a public aquarium located in Tsuruoka, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan. In 2005, it exceeded Monterey Bay Aquarium in California regarding the number of jellyfish display types and holds the Guinness World Record for this exhibition.
e4cb508f73f97cf5.zh: 鶴岡市立加茂水族館（Kamo Suizokukan）是位於日本山形縣鶴岡市的公立水族館。2005年，其水母展示種類數超越美國加州的蒙特雷灣水族館，並以此展示保有金氏世界紀錄。

e4d145b93b9231b3.en: Tsukiyomi Shrine (月読神社, Tsukiyomi jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in Nishikyō Ward, Kyoto, Japan. It was named as a Myōjin Taisha (名神大社, lit "Great shrine for notable god") in the ancient Japanese religious book Engishiki. Tsukiyomi Shrine is one of the "Matsuo Seven Shrines" (松尾七社), and a subsidiary shrine of Matsunoo Taisha 400 meters to the north. Its annual festival is on October 3.
e4d145b93b9231b3.zh: 月讀神社是位於日本京都市西京區的神社。在古代典籍《延喜式》中被列為名神大社。月讀神社是「松尾七社」之一，為北方400公尺處松尾大社的攝社。例祭於10月3日舉行。

e4dfa7eb520dfbcc.en: Sukikombu" is made by boiling young kelp from the Sanriku coast, cutting it into thin strips, and drying it into boards. Around 1969, kelp cultivation and processing of sukikombu began in the coastal village of Fudai, and it spread throughout the prefecture as a preserved food. Fudai's suki-kombu is made from young kelp that has not been thinned out, giving it a soft and chewy texture.Sukikonbu-nimono" is made by boiling sukikonbu with dried shiitake mushrooms, carrots, and other ingredients.
e4dfa7eb520dfbcc.zh: 「すき昆布」是將三陸海岸的嫩昆布煮過後切成細絲，再乾燥成板狀製成。1969年左右，沿海的普代村開始養殖昆布並加工製作すき昆布，作為保存食品推廣至全縣。普代的すき昆布使用未經疏苗的嫩昆布製成，口感柔軟有嚼勁。「すき昆布の煮物」是將すき昆布與乾香菇、紅蘿蔔等食材一起燉煮而成。

e4eae608b3d3a3be.en: The Izumi crane migration grounds cover a 245ha paddy field area of Izumi plain in the northwest of Kagoshima Prefecture known for the about ten-thousand cranes which pass the winter there from every year mid October to March.
e4eae608b3d3a3be.zh: 出水ツル渡来地涵蓋鹿兒島縣西北部出水平原245公頃的水田區域，以每年10月中旬至3月約有一萬隻鶴在此過冬而聞名。

e511d3dd585cee95.en: Sugashima Lighthouse (菅島灯台, Sugashima tōdai) is a lighthouse located on the island of Sugashima, in Ise Bay off the shores of the city of Toba, Mie Prefecture, Japan. It is located within the borders of the Ise-Shima National Park.
e511d3dd585cee95.zh: 菅島灯台是位於菅島上的燈塔，菅島位於日本三重縣鳥羽市外海的伊勢灣中。燈塔位於伊勢志摩國立公園範圍內。

e533cb5c435da828.en: Manpuku-ji (萬福寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Higashimachi neighborhood of the city of Masuda, Shimane Prefecture, Japan. The temple belongs to the Ji sect and its full name is Seiryūzan Jōkō-in Manpuku-ji (清瀧山浄光院萬福寺).
e533cb5c435da828.zh: 萬福寺是位於日本島根縣益田市東町的佛教寺院，屬於時宗，全名為清瀧山浄光院萬福寺。

e538f6dafd8f581e.en: "Tsuyu-ni-shime" is a dish made by simmering vegetables, herring, tofu, and other ingredients in broth, seasoned with soy sauce and sugar. This dish is also known as “tsuyuji” or “kotoji” in some regions, and is considered one of the local delicacies of the Minamiaizu area.One of the unique characteristics of this dish is the use of a particular type of tofu called "tsuto tofu". "Tsuto tofu" is wrapped in straw and was originally designed to preserve it for an extended period in the past when there were no refrigerators.
e538f6dafd8f581e.zh: 「つゆ煮しめ」是將蔬菜、鯡魚、豆腐等材料放入高湯中燉煮，再以醬油和砂糖調味的料理。這道料理在部分地區也稱為「つゆじ」或「こづゆ」，被視為南會津地區的鄉土美食之一。其特色之一是使用一種叫做「つと豆腐」的豆腐。「つと豆腐」以稻草包裹，原本是在沒有冰箱的年代為了長期保存而設計的。

e53f3626d63afdeb.en: In Kasumigaura, the second largest lake in Japan in terms of area, carp farming began in the late 1960s, mainly in the Kitaura area, and today it is the area that produces the most carp in the country. Carp has long been known as a high-grade fish along with sea bream, and was favored by the imperial family and aristocracy during the Nara and Heian periods. Later, carp became widespread among the populace, and a variety of carp dishes became popular.
e53f3626d63afdeb.zh: 霞浦是日本面積第二大的湖泊，1960年代後期起以北浦地區為中心開始養殖鯉魚，如今是全國鯉魚產量最多的地區。鯉魚自古與鯛魚同被視為高級魚，奈良、平安時代受到皇室與貴族喜愛。其後鯉魚普及於民間，各式鯉魚料理也隨之流行。

e54e3a9fdddee788.en: Kotō Prefectural Natural Park (湖東県立自然公園, Kotō kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Shiga Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1987, the park comprises areas of the eastern plains of Lake Biwa and the foothills of the Suzuka Mountains. It spans the municipalities of Aishō, Higashiōmi, Hikone, Kōra and Taga, and encompasses the temples of Hyakusai-ji (百済寺), Kongōrin-ji (金剛輪寺), and Saimyō-ji (西明寺).
e54e3a9fdddee788.zh: 湖東縣立自然公園是日本滋賀縣的縣立自然公園。設立於1987年，範圍包含琵琶湖東側平原及鈴鹿山脈山麓地帶，橫跨愛莊町、東近江市、彥根市、甲良町與多賀町，園區內有百濟寺、金剛輪寺與西明寺等寺院。

e5507bd1361563fa.en: Mochio-Sekinoo Prefectural Natural Park (母智丘関之尾県立自然公園, Mochio-Sekinoo kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in southern Miyazaki Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1958, the park is within the municipality of Miyakonojō. The area is celebrated for its cherry blossoms, waterfalls, and potholes - which have been designated a Natural Monument.
e5507bd1361563fa.zh: 母智丘・関之尾県立自然公園是位於日本宮崎縣南部的縣立自然公園，設立於1958年，範圍在都城市境內。當地以櫻花、瀑布及壺穴聞名，其中壺穴已被指定為天然紀念物。

e570b61c9063c65b.en: "Tai- somen" is a sumptuous large noodle dish decorated with Sea bream fish and “Somen noodles”, and is a traditional dish that is often eaten at weddings.To make it, add a whole salted sea bream fish, add soy sauce, sugar, and sake, simmer it in a large pot so that it does not break the form of the fish, and serve it on a platter with boiled somen noodles.
e570b61c9063c65b.zh: 「鯛そうめん」是以鯛魚與素麵裝飾的豐盛大盤麵料理，是婚禮上常吃的傳統料理。作法是將整尾鹽漬鯛魚放入大鍋，加入醬油、砂糖和酒，小心燉煮不弄散魚形，再與煮好的素麵一起盛在大盤上。

e571d2e84f53c979.en: The Koganeyama Jinja (黄金山神社) is a Shintō shrine in the town of Wakuya  Tōda District, Miyagi Prefecture in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan. It claims to have been built on the site of the first gold mine in Japan, and is protected by the central government as a National Historic Site.
e571d2e84f53c979.zh: 黄金山神社是位於日本東北地方宮城縣遠田郡涌谷町的神社。據稱建於日本第一座金礦的遺址上，受中央政府指定為國家史跡保護。

e57844de70c1ce0e.en: Tahara Castle (田原城, Tahara-jō) is a Japanese castle located in Tahara, southern Aichi Prefecture, Japan. At the end of the Edo period, Tahara Castle was home to the Miyake clan, daimyō of the 12,000 koku Tahara Domain.
e57844de70c1ce0e.zh: 田原城是位於日本愛知縣南部田原的日本城郭。江戶時代末期，田原城為1萬2千石田原藩大名三宅氏的居城。

e58d57f31b9db42d.en: The Nagaragawa Onsen (長良川温泉, Nagara River Hot Springs) are a group of onsen located along the banks of the Nagara River in Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. The source of the onsen are in the northern part of the city near the Mitabora Shinbutsu Onsen (三田洞神仏温泉). The group was included on the 16th edition of Japan's Top 100 Onsen.
e58d57f31b9db42d.zh: 長良川溫泉（長良川温泉）是分布於日本岐阜縣岐阜市長良川沿岸的溫泉群。溫泉源頭位於市區北部，靠近三田洞神佛溫泉（三田洞神仏温泉）。此溫泉群曾列入第16屆「日本溫泉百選」。

e5934548cd0d4038.en: Taking advantage of its mild year-round climate and abundant water quality, Ibaraki Prefecture has long been a center of agriculture. While the prefecture is famous for such crops as lotus root, green peppers, and burdocks, it also grows locally the soybeans that are used to make natto, Ibaraki Prefecture's signature fermented soybeans. Small soybeans are processed into natto (fermented soybeans) and large soybeans are processed into tofu.
e5934548cd0d4038.zh: 茨城縣利用全年溫和的氣候與豐沛的水資源，自古即是農業重鎮。縣內以蓮藕、青椒、牛蒡等作物聞名，也在當地種植用來製作茨城縣代表性發酵大豆食品「納豆」的大豆。小顆大豆加工成納豆，大顆大豆則加工成豆腐。

e5adcf05cc1eecfc.en: Tenninkyō Onsen (天人峡温泉) is a geothermal hot spring village with a small onsen resort in the Daisetsuzan National Park, Hokkaidō, Japan.
e5adcf05cc1eecfc.zh: 天人峡温泉是位於日本北海道大雪山國立公園內的溫泉村，設有小型溫泉度假區。

e5b432f333e86892.en: Fuji Yusui no Sato Aquarium(山梨県立富士湧水の里水族館) or Fuji Spring Water Aquarium　is a prefectural public aquarium specializing in freshwater fish, located in Oshino-mura, Minami-tsuru-gun, Yamanashi Prefecture.  It is a member of the Japanese Association of Zoos and Aquariums (JAZA).
e5b432f333e86892.zh: 山梨県立富士湧水の里水族館（又稱Fuji Spring Water Aquarium）是位於山梨縣南都留郡忍野村、以淡水魚為主的縣立公共水族館。為日本動物園水族館協會（JAZA）會員。

e5cac99bf75edc5a.en: "Myoga" is a perennial plant that grows in the wild from Honshu to Okinawa, and it is related to ginger. Both the flower and the stem have been used since long ago as potherbs, but Japan is said to be the only country that grows it for food. It is used in various ways, such as a condiment for udon and soba noodles, or lightly pickled with cucumber and eggplant.In Miyagi Prefecture, around the time that the "myoga leaves" grow large, "Myoga no Hayaki" is eaten as a children's' snack during breaks from farm work.
e5cac99bf75edc5a.zh: 「茗荷」是從本州到沖繩都有野生的多年生植物，與薑同類。花與莖自古就被當作香味蔬菜使用，但據說日本是唯一將其作為食用而栽培的國家。用法多樣，例如作為烏龍麵和蕎麥麵的佐料，或與小黃瓜、茄子一起淺漬。在宮城縣，到了「茗荷葉」長大的時候，會在農務休息時把「みょうがの葉焼き」當作孩子的點心。

e5e8d6bfd762b5b2.en: Yamada Tenman-gū is a Shinto shrine located in Nagoya, central Japan.
e5e8d6bfd762b5b2.zh: 山田天滿宮是位於日本中部名古屋的神社。

e5ecc32ff7fcdaff.en: A hot pot dish that has been passed down since ancient times in Tsushima, a remote island in the Sea of Japan. Since long ago, local households had a custom of slaughtering locally raised chickens to serve in a yosenabe hot pot for ceremonial family gatherings, and this is said to be connected to the "Iriyaki" of today. However, households by the sea in fishing villages were said to make their hot pot using fish caught in the nearby sea instead of chicken. Today, the basic "Iriyaki" recipe has two variations: one with chicken and one with fish.
e5ecc32ff7fcdaff.zh: 日本海離島對馬自古流傳至今的鍋料理。從前當地家庭有在家族儀式聚會時宰殺自家飼養的雞，做成什錦鍋款待的習俗，據說這與今日的「いりやき」有關。不過，據說漁村中靠海的人家會用附近海域捕獲的魚代替雞肉做鍋。如今，「いりやき」的基本作法有兩種：雞肉版和魚肉版。

e608673dad5d2b0c.en: "Karaimo Gohan"(=Sweet Potato Rice) is a local dish using sweet potatoes, a specialty of Kagoshima Prefecture that is well known throughout the country. Kagoshima Prefecture is blessed with a mild climate, but most of the land, with the exception of Mt. Kirishima, is a Shirasu plateau, which is very well drained. Therefore, the cultivation of sweet potatoes, which grows easily even in poor soil and is less susceptible to typhoon damage because it grows underground, has taken strong root.
e608673dad5d2b0c.zh: 「からいもごはん」（番薯飯）是使用鹿兒島縣聞名全國的特產番薯製成的鄉土料理。鹿兒島縣氣候溫和，但除了霧島山以外，大部分土地是排水性極佳的白砂台地。因此，即使在貧瘠土壤中也容易生長、且因長在地下而較不受颱風影響的番薯，在當地廣泛栽培。

e629211d5e09d689.en: Kurashiki Dam is a rock-fill dam located in Okinawa prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for flood control and water supply. The catchment area of the dam is 104.7 km2. The dam impounds about 77  ha of land when full and can store 7100 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1979 and completed in 1994.
e629211d5e09d689.zh: 倉敷水壩是位於日本沖繩縣的堆石壩，用於防洪與供水。集水面積為104.7平方公里，滿水時淹沒面積約77公頃，可蓄水7100千立方公尺。水壩於1979年動工，1994年完工。

e6317a501b64a4de.en: Kagawa Nutrition University (女子栄養大学, Joshi Eiyō Daigaku) is a private university in Japan.
e6317a501b64a4de.zh: 女子榮養大學是日本的一所私立大學。

e63c915eb6ea5c8e.en: New Aomori Prefecture General Sports Park (Japanese: 新青森県総合運動公園) is a group of sports facilities in Aomori, Aomori, Japan.
e63c915eb6ea5c8e.zh: 新青森縣綜合運動公園是位於日本青森縣青森市的一組運動設施。

e6480434d84789e3.en: "Tsugani-jiru" is one of the representative regional cuisines of Kochi prefecture. Tsugani refers to the mitten crabs that live in rivers such as the Shimanto River and Niyodo River. "Tsugani-jiru" is a soup made by crushing live crabs in a stone mill or blender to make soup stock. Tsugani are in season around autumn when Japanese knotweed and kudzu flowers begin to bloom. The fishing begins in the basin when the tsugani go downriver to spawn. Tsugani grow from a length of around 10cm to nearly 30cm.
e6480434d84789e3.zh: 「つがに汁」是高知縣代表性的地方料理之一。つがに指的是棲息在四萬十川、仁淀川等河川中的絨螯蟹。「つがに汁」是用石臼或果汁機將活蟹搗碎取湯頭製成的湯。つがに的產季在虎杖與葛花開始開花的秋季前後。當つがに順流而下產卵時，流域便開始捕撈。つがに可從約10公分長到將近30公分。

e648133537a4827b.en: This is a local dish to be prepared for gathering events. Originally, it is "shojin ryori" (vegan dish for Buddhist monks) prepared at "soudou" (Japanese meditation hall) or memorial events. The plate to serve this dish was a wooden lacquerware which had edge warped a bit toward outside and a little high rim at the bottom, and its name was "chatsu". It is said that as this dish was served with the "chatsu" plate, people also called the dish "chatsu". The characteristic of "chatsu" is not to use soy sauce to make this dish look white.
e648133537a4827b.zh: 這是在聚會活動時準備的鄉土料理。原本是在僧堂或法會中準備的精進料理（佛教僧侶的素食料理）。盛裝這道料理的器皿是邊緣略向外翻、底部有稍高圈足的木製漆器，名為「ちゃつ」。據說因為這道料理是用「ちゃつ」盛裝，人們也稱這道料理為「ちゃつ」。「ちゃつ」的特色是不使用醬油，使料理呈現白色。

e6558f9a7443bda5.en: Abukuma Keikoku Prefectural Natural Park (阿武隈渓谷県立自然公園, Abukuma Keikoku kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in southern Miyagi Prefecture, Japan. First designated for protection in 1988, the park is within the municipality of Marumori and centres upon the Abukuma River valley.
e6558f9a7443bda5.zh: 阿武隈渓谷県立自然公園是位於日本宮城縣南部的縣立自然公園。1988年首次指定保護，園區位於丸森町境內，以阿武隈川河谷為中心。

e65cf31d749b4df2.en: The Miyataki Site (宮滝遺跡, Miyataki iseki) is a complex archaeological site with traces from the Jōmon, Yayoi and early Nara periods, located in the Miyataki neighborhood of the town of Yoshino, Nara Prefecture Japan. It was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1924.
e65cf31d749b4df2.zh: 宮滝遺跡是一處複合型考古遺址，留有繩文、彌生及奈良時代初期的遺跡，位於日本奈良縣吉野町宮瀧地區。1924年被指定為日本國史跡。
