f0ee8585a3f9046c.zh: 「おみいさん」是指以味噌調味的粥。古時味噌稱為「みい」，加上敬稱「お」與「さん」便成為「おみいさん」。德島的土壤被認為不易種植稻米，因此改以蕎麥和大麥為主食，也常加入各種食材來增加米的份量。「おみいさん」加入大量白蘿蔔和里芋，是能吃得飽足、受人喜愛的一餐。

f10f5f126b8af2e0.en: It is said that the Ryukyuan cuisine of Okinawa Prefecture "begins and ends with pork." It is known that Okinawans make use of the meat, of course, but also the internal organs, face, ears, and even the blood. In particular, unskinned boneless ribs (boneless ribs) are often used. Also, during periods of poverty, lard was a valuable source of nutrients. The reason pork is often used is that pork culture developed under the influence of interchange with China during the Ryukyuan dynastic period.
f10f5f126b8af2e0.zh: 據說沖繩縣的琉球料理「始於豬肉，終於豬肉」。沖繩人不只利用豬肉本身，連內臟、臉、耳朵甚至血都會使用。其中特別常用的是帶皮去骨的五花肉（三層肉）。此外，在貧困時期，豬油是珍貴的營養來源。豬肉之所以常被使用，是因為琉球王朝時期受到與中國交流的影響，發展出豬肉文化。

f1188ee102cca9ae.en: In Wakasa Bay, mackerel has been abundantly caught and has been a popular fish among the common people since ancient times. In an era when refrigeration technology was not well developed, mackerel, known for its quick deterioration, led to creative methods for prolonging its enjoyment. One such dish that emerged as a result of this ingenuity was "heshiko", where mackerel is first salted and then further pickled in bran.
f1188ee102cca9ae.zh: 若狹灣自古鯖魚漁獲豐富，是一般百姓喜愛的魚種。在冷藏技術尚不發達的時代，鯖魚容易腐壞，因而衍生出各種延長保存、以便享用的方法。在這樣的巧思下產生的料理之一是「へしこ」，作法是先將鯖魚鹽漬，再以米糠醃漬。

f118d88cf89a642e.en: Neji, which has its roots in the town of Ogano in Chichibu County, is a local dish made by tossing short udon noodles twisted into spirals in red bean paste. A loose bean paste like oshiruko is sometimes used as well, in which case it is called “azuki boto.” It can be said to be a home-cooked dish unique to the Chichibu region, where wheat cultivation is thriving, but there is also a theory that it was created as a substitute food for those who were poor and could not afford mochi.
f118d88cf89a642e.zh: ねじ源自秩父郡小鹿野町，是將扭成螺旋狀的短烏龍麵拌上紅豆餡的鄉土料理。有時也會使用像紅豆湯（おしるこ）那樣較稀的紅豆餡，這時就稱為「あずきぼうと」。這可說是小麥栽培興盛的秩父地區特有的家常料理，但也有一說認為，它是為了買不起麻糬的貧困人家而創造的替代食物。

f11faa9efbe69ede.en: Wakayama City Museum (和歌山市立博物館, Wakayama shiritsu hakubutsukan) is a local history museum located in the city of  Wakayama, Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. It opened in November 1985 to commemorate the 400th anniversary of the construction of Wakayama Castle. The facility is adjacent to the Wakayama Civic Library.
f11faa9efbe69ede.zh: 和歌山市立博物館是位於日本和歌山縣和歌山市的地方歷史博物館，為紀念和歌山城築城400週年，於1985年11月開館。館舍鄰接和歌山市民圖書館。

f1358b9313c85c55.en: The Hatakeyama Memorial Museum of Fine Art (畠山記念館, Hatakeyama Kinenkan) is a private museum established in October 1964 in Tokyo, Japan.
f1358b9313c85c55.zh: 畠山記念館（畠山記念館）是1964年10月在日本東京設立的私立美術館。

f13821f09e530aee.en: The Banetsu Monogatari (ばんえつ物語, Ban'etsu Monogatari) is a locomotive-hauled set of "Joyful Train" railway coaches operated in Japan by the East Japan Railway Company (JR East), normally between Niigata and Aizu-Wakamatsu.
f13821f09e530aee.zh: ばんえつ物語是由東日本旅客鐵道（JR東日本）營運、以機車牽引的「Joyful Train」觀光列車車組，通常行駛於新潟與會津若松之間。

f15ee17cd4ba6905.en: Many different kinds of zoni soup are made throughout the country, but the "Uchigae zoni" made in the Iya area of Miyoshi city is particularly unique. Large, rock-hard tofu called iwadofu (stone tofu) is used in uchigae zoni in the place of the mochi that is used in most regions. In addition to using a large amount of soybeans and thoroughly removing the moisture, it is said to be hard because of the large amount of bittern that is added.
f15ee17cd4ba6905.zh: 日本各地有許多不同種類的雜煮，其中三好市祖谷地區的「うちがえ雑煮」特別獨特。うちがえ雑煮用一種叫做岩豆腐（石豆腐）的大塊堅硬豆腐，取代多數地區使用的年糕。據說這種豆腐之所以堅硬，除了使用大量黃豆並徹底去除水分之外，也因為加入了大量鹽滷。

f1a08f5ae1096ead.en: Nagara Dam is an earthfill dam located in Chiba Prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for water supply. The catchment area of the dam is 3.4 km2. The dam impounds about 81  ha of land when full and can store 10000 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1966 and completed in 1993.
f1a08f5ae1096ead.zh: 長柄水壩是位於日本千葉縣的土石壩，用於供水。水壩集水面積為3.4平方公里，滿水時淹沒面積約81公頃，蓄水量可達1,000萬立方公尺。水壩於1966年動工，1993年完工。

f1c7192fbf5c57d0.en: Kuwana Castle (桑名城, Kuwana-jō) is a Japanese castle located in Kuwana, northern Mie Prefecture, Japan. At the end of the Edo period, Kuwana Castle was home to a branch the Matsudaira clan, daimyō of Kuwana Domain. The castle was also known as "Ōgi-jō" (扇城) or "Asahi-jō" (旭城).
f1c7192fbf5c57d0.zh: 桑名城是位於日本三重縣北部桑名市的日本城郭。江戶時代末期，桑名城為桑名藩大名松平氏一支系的居城。此城又稱「扇城」或「旭城」。

f1ef64c4ef5f7a9d.en: The region known as Kinasa, also called the "Valley Capital," has a long-standing food culture of drying and preserving vegetables. Surrounded by mountains, the Kinasa region used to be cut off from external transportation when snow accumulated, leading to the practice of drying and preserving food to endure the long winters. Drying vegetables not only changes their taste and texture but also enriches their nutritional content.
f1ef64c4ef5f7a9d.zh: 被稱為「谷之都」的鬼無里地區，長久以來有將蔬菜曬乾保存的飲食文化。鬼無里地區四面環山，過去積雪時對外交通便會中斷，因此發展出將食物乾燥保存以度過漫長冬季的作法。蔬菜曬乾後不僅味道與口感改變，營養成分也更加豐富。

f20abd083cefaf0e.en: The Daisen-in (大仙院) is a sub-temple of Daitoku-ji, a temple of the Rinzai school of Zen in  Buddhism, one of the five most important Zen temples of Kyoto. The name means "The Academy of the Great Immortals." Daisen-in was founded by the Zen priest Kogaku Sōkō (古岳宗亘; 1464–1548), and was built between 1509 and 1513. The Daisen-in is noted for its screen paintings and for its kare-sansui, or dry landscape garden.
f20abd083cefaf0e.zh: 大仙院是大德寺的塔頭寺院。大德寺屬於佛教臨濟宗，是京都五大重要禪寺之一。寺名意為「大仙人之院」。大仙院由禪僧古岳宗亘（1464–1548）創建，於1509年至1513年間建造。大仙院以障壁畫及枯山水庭園聞名。

f217846136386ca4.en: Grilled conger eel is cut into smaller pieces and placed on top of warm rice cooked with dashi (=Japanese soup stock). Sometimes, the conger eel is steamed. Conger eels are caught in Miyajima Town and Hiroshima city and the local people have been eating them over a long time. "Geihan Tsushi," a geographical journal written during the Bunsei era of the Edo period by the Hiroshima Domain in Aki Province, describes conger eels along with "mebaru" (=Japanese red seaperch), and smelt as delicious fish from the region.
f217846136386ca4.zh: 將烤過的星鰻切成小塊，放在以高湯炊煮的溫熱米飯上。有時星鰻會以蒸的方式處理。星鰻在宮島町和廣島市捕獲，當地人長久以來都有食用的習慣。江戶時代文政年間由安藝國廣島藩編寫的地誌《藝藩通志》中，將星鰻與「メバル」（日本平鮋）、胡瓜魚並列為當地的美味魚類。

f25c9d5977056beb.en: Chōja Yashiki Kanga ruins (長者屋敷官衙遺跡, Chōja yashiki kanga iseki)  is an archaeological site with the ruins of a Heian period government administrative complex located in what is now the Nagazoe neighborhood of the city of Nakatsu, Ōita Prefecture, on the island of Kyushu, Japan. The ruins were designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 2010 with the area under protection expanded in 2017.
f25c9d5977056beb.zh: 長者屋敷官衙遺跡是位於日本九州大分縣中津市永添地區的考古遺址，留有平安時代官署建築群的遺跡。遺跡於2010年被指定為國家史跡，2017年擴大保護範圍。

f264959824649879.en: It is said that dumplings originated from a Tang Dynasty dessert called "Danki," which was brought to Japan during the Heian period (794-1185). Dumplings are made by shaping rice flour into balls and then boiling them. "Kushi-dango", which are dumplings skewered and grilled, date back to the Muromachi period (1333-1568).
f264959824649879.zh: 據說糰子起源於唐代一種名為「團喜」的點心，於平安時代（794-1185）傳入日本。糰子是將米粉揉成球狀後水煮而成。將糰子串起燒烤的「串だんご」則可追溯至室町時代（1333-1568）。

f278a9cc134f8b9f.en: Symbol Promenade Park is a park in Odaiba, Tokyo, Japan. The park opened in 1996.
f278a9cc134f8b9f.zh: シンボルプロムナード公園是位於日本東京台場的公園，於1996年開園。

f28200eb1fa99688.en: "Morobuta zushi" is a type of pressed sushi with a long tradition in the northern region of Nagasaki Prefecture.It is said to have originated in the Muromachi period (1336-1573), when Sumikore Omura, who was defeated in battle and had his territory taken from him, made oshizushi and served it to the people of his domain to celebrate his return.
f28200eb1fa99688.zh: 「もろぶた寿司」是長崎縣北部歷史悠久的一種押壽司。據說起源於室町時代（1336-1573），在戰爭中落敗、領地被奪的大村純伊，為慶祝重返領地而製作押壽司分送給領民。

f28490ba7590d750.en: The Fukushima Prefectural Culture Center (福島県文化センター, Fukushima-ken Bunka Sentā) is a large multi-purpose public cultural facility in the city of Fukushima, Japan, which opened in September 1970.
f28490ba7590d750.zh: 福島縣文化中心是位於日本福島市的大型多功能公共文化設施，於1970年9月啟用。

f293a2ab8220a913.en: Kōyasan Reihōkan (高野山　霊宝館; lit. "Kōyasan Museum of Sacred Treasures") is an art museum on Kōya-san, Wakayama Prefecture, Japan, preserving and displaying Buddhist art owned by temples on Kōya-san. The collection is centered around articles from the Heian and Kamakura periods and includes paintings, calligraphy, sutras, sculpture and Buddhist ritual objects. Among these are a set of the complete Buddhist canon (issaikyō), writings of Kūkai and  Minamoto no Yoritomo, founder of the Kamakura Shogunate, mandalas and portraits of priests.
f293a2ab8220a913.zh: 高野山靈寶館（字面意思為「高野山聖寶博物館」）是位於日本和歌山縣高野山的美術館，保存並展示高野山各寺院所擁有的佛教美術品。館藏以平安時代與鎌倉時代的文物為主，包括繪畫、書法、經典、雕刻及佛教法器，其中有一套完整的佛教大藏經（一切經）、空海與鎌倉幕府創立者源賴朝的書跡、曼荼羅及高僧肖像。

f2995fdc614a2e1b.en: Iwamoto-ji (岩本寺) is a Chisan Shingon temple in Shimanto, Kōchi Prefecture, Japan. Temple 37 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage, the deities that are worshipped at this temple are Fudō Myō-ō, Shō Kannon, Amida Nyōrai, Yakushi Nyorai, and Jizō Bosatsu. The temple is said to have been founded by Gyōki during 729–749.
f2995fdc614a2e1b.zh: 岩本寺是位於日本高知縣四萬十町的真言宗智山派寺院，為四國八十八所巡禮第37號札所，寺內供奉不動明王、聖觀音、阿彌陀如來、藥師如來與地藏菩薩。相傳此寺由行基於729至749年間創建。

f2ad542043abdf72.en: “Ibara mochi” is a rice cake wrapped in greenbriar leaves. “Ibara mochi,” which was eaten during the May Festival, has different names depending on the region.
f2ad542043abdf72.zh: 「いばら餅」是以菝葜葉包裹的米餅。「いばら餅」在五月節時食用，名稱因地區而異。

f2ce79c58fb8ca7b.en: Yamate (山手) is the name of a historic neighbourhood in Naka-ku, Yokohama often referred to in English as The Bluff. The neighbourhood is famous as having been a foreigners' residential area in the Bakumatsu, Meiji and Taishō periods. While still dominantly residential in character, with views over downtown Yokohama, historic residential properties, ornamental gardens and public parks, the area is also a popular visitor destination.
f2ce79c58fb8ca7b.zh: 山手是橫濱市中區的歷史街區名稱，英文常稱為The Bluff。此地以幕末、明治及大正時期的外國人居留地聞名。現今仍以住宅區為主，可眺望橫濱市中心，區內有歷史住宅建築、庭園及公共公園，也是熱門的觀光地區。

f2e75d6b1747058e.en: Sake hot pot is a simple dish made by cooking chicken, gizzard, pork, and vegetables with a straightforward seasoning of salt, pepper, and sake. It's light and lets you enjoy the natural flavors of the ingredients. It's said to have originated as a staff meal invented by a sake brewer in Nishijo, Hiroshima City, to satisfy hunger during breaks from sake-making. The simple seasoning is designed to not affect the ability to taste sake.
f2e75d6b1747058e.zh: 美酒鍋是將雞肉、雞胗、豬肉和蔬菜，僅以鹽、胡椒和日本酒簡單調味烹煮而成的料理。口味清淡，能品嘗食材本身的風味。據說起源於廣島市西條的釀酒師，為了在釀酒工作的休息時間充飢而發明的員工伙食。簡單的調味是為了不影響品酒的味覺。

f2f863d1c340cbdd.en: Oka-dera (岡寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Oka neighborhood of the village of Asuka, Nara Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Shingon-shū Buzan-ha sect and its honzon is a clay statue of Nyōirin Kannon Bosatsu.  The temple's full name is Tōkō-zan Shinjūin-in Ryūgai-ji (東光山 真珠院 龍蓋寺). The temple is the 7th stop on the Saigoku Kannon Pilgrimage pilgrimage route.
f2f863d1c340cbdd.zh: 岡寺是位於日本奈良縣明日香村岡地區的佛教寺院，屬真言宗豐山派，本尊為泥塑如意輪觀音菩薩像。寺院全名為東光山 真珠院 龍蓋寺。該寺是西國觀音巡禮路線的第7番札所。

f322492d3287fa29.en: Tamatsukuri Inari Shrine (玉造稲荷神社, Tamatsukuri-Inari-jinja) is a shrine dedicated to the Shinto kami ('god') Inari. Its construction can be traced to 12 BCE, and Inari was enshrined there by Toyotomi Hideyoshi in the 1580s to protect Osaka Castle.
f322492d3287fa29.zh: 玉造稲荷神社是供奉神道神祇稻荷神的神社。其創建可追溯至西元前12年，1580年代豐臣秀吉在此奉祀稻荷神以守護大坂城。

f329ff6db8cc58e5.en: Ōtawara Castle (大田原城, Ōtawara -jō) is a Japanese castle located in Ōtawara, southern Tochigi Prefecture, Japan. Throughout the Edo period, Ōtawara Castle was home to a branch of the Ōtawara clan, daimyō of  Ōtawara Domain. It was also called the "Dragon Castle" (龍城, Ryū-jō)
f329ff6db8cc58e5.zh: 大田原城是位於日本栃木縣南部大田原的日本城郭。整個江戶時代，大田原城為大田原藩藩主大田原氏一支的居城。此城又稱「龍城」。

f34c5e8a5077b12c.en: The Gifu Great Buddha (岐阜大仏, Gifu Daibutsu) is a large Buddhist statue located in Shōhō-ji in Gifu City, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It was conceived by the 11th head priest of Kinpouzan Shōhō temple, Ichyuu, around 1790, in hopes of averting large earthquakes and famines. Ichyuu died in 1815 before it was completed, but his successor, Priest Kohshuu completed it in April 1832, after 38 years of construction. It is one of the three great Buddha portrait statues in Japan.
f34c5e8a5077b12c.zh: 岐阜大佛（岐阜大仏）是位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市正法寺的大型佛像。約於1790年由金鳳山正法寺第11代住持惟中構想，以祈求免除大地震與饑荒。惟中於1815年在佛像完成前圓寂，其繼任者肯宗和尚歷經38年工程，於1832年4月完成。此像為日本三大佛像之一。

f36a64508613e817.en: Ibaraki Prefecture is a production area of high-quality pumpkins such as Edosaki pumpkins, which are highly evaluated in the market, Naka pumpkins, and Miyako pumpkins. Its pumpkin production volume is among the top in Japan as well, and pumpkin dishes were often eaten during the winter solstice. One of the most popular pumpkin dishes was pumpkin stew. Pumpkin itoko-ni, which is boiled with adzuki beans, has become a staple dish for the winter solstice.Itoko-ni refers to a stew made mainly from vegetables and beans.
f36a64508613e817.zh: 茨城縣是優質南瓜的產地，出產在市場上評價很高的江戶崎南瓜，以及那珂南瓜、都南瓜等。其南瓜產量也名列日本前茅，冬至時常吃南瓜料理。最受歡迎的南瓜料理之一是燉南瓜。與紅豆一起煮的南瓜いとこ煮，已成為冬至的固定料理。いとこ煮是指以蔬菜和豆類為主的燉煮料理。

f36ae649f2a4f175.en: “Koi (=Carp)“ farming began in Koriyama during the Meiji period (1868-1912). During the Edo period, the city began to build reservoirs in the city to secure a source of water due to the area's low rainfall. In the Meiji period, the Asaka Sosui Canal was completed, and people began to farm carp by utilizing unused reservoirs. Carp farmed in Koriyama grow in the rich minerals of Lake Inawashiro and are characterized by their freshness and low odor.
f36ae649f2a4f175.zh: 郡山的鯉魚養殖始於明治時代（1868-1912）。江戶時代，由於當地雨量少，為確保水源，開始在市內興建蓄水池。明治時代安積疏水完工後，人們便利用閒置的蓄水池養殖鯉魚。郡山養殖的鯉魚在豬苗代湖豐富的礦物質中成長，特點是新鮮且腥味少。

f380348d03441928.en: Frozen daikon" and "frozen rice cakes" are common preserved foods in the Tohoku region, and are made by taking advantage of the cold weather unique to the snow country. Frozen daikon" is prepared in January, when the weather is at its coldest. The daikon is peeled, cut into round slices or 20 cm in length, split lengthwise, pierced and boiled, then soaked in water to remove the scum before being placed on the snow and frozen. After that, they are hung to dry under the eaves of the roof, and finally completed around March.
f380348d03441928.zh: 「凍み大根」與「凍み餅」是東北地方常見的保存食品，利用雪國特有的寒冷氣候製成。「凍み大根」在天氣最冷的一月製作。將白蘿蔔去皮，切成圓片或20公分長段，再縱向剖開，穿孔後水煮，接著泡水去除澀味，再放在雪上使其結凍。之後掛在屋簷下風乾，大約三月時完成。

f38d3f7216c3681f.en: The Konoike Shinden (鴻池新田) was a new land development undertaken by a wealthy Osaka merchant, Konoike Zen'emon in mid-Edo Period Japan. It was located in central Kawachi Province in what is now part of the city of Higashiōsaka, Osaka Prefecture, Japan. The well-preserved buildings of the management office of the settlement were designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1976.
f38d3f7216c3681f.zh: 鴻池新田是江戶時代中期大坂富商鴻池善右衛門所進行的新田開發，位於河內國中部，即今日本大阪府東大阪市的一部分。聚落管理會所保存良好的建築群於1976年被指定為日本國家史跡。

f39d6108b5b214d2.en: The Hida River (飛騨川, Hida-gawa) has its source in Mount Norikura (乗鞍岳 Norikura-ga-take) in Takayama, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It flows from the northern to the southern section of the prefecture before emptying into the Kiso River in Minokamo.
f39d6108b5b214d2.zh: 飛驒川（飛騨川）發源於日本岐阜縣高山市的乘鞍岳，由縣北部向南部流動，在美濃加茂市注入木曾川。

f3abf9249e81e3fb.en: The important ingredient for the cuisine in Aichi Prefecture is bean miso (red miso), like Hatcho-miso, Aichi’s typical miso. ‘Koji’ mold is bred with soy beans to make soy bean ‘koji’ mold, and fermented and aged for a long time to make bean miso. It is fermented at least a year, or sometimes 2~3 years. Bean miso is rich in flavor and has sourness and unique bitterness.
f3abf9249e81e3fb.zh: 愛知縣料理的重要食材是豆味噌（赤味噌），例如愛知代表性的八丁味噌。將「麴」菌培養在黃豆上製成豆麴，再經長時間發酵、熟成，即成豆味噌。發酵時間至少一年，有時長達2~3年。豆味噌風味濃郁，帶有酸味與獨特的苦味。

f3cc029412b01ad3.en: “Nuta”, eaten all over Japan, is generally made with green onions and vinegared miso. It is a local dish that demonstrates the uniqueness of the ingredients used in each region. In the Kitaura region of northern Yamaguchi Prefecture, it is often made with a combination of green onions and obaike. Obaike is made by slicing and parboiling the tail of a whale.
f3cc029412b01ad3.zh: 「ぬた」在日本各地都有食用，一般以青蔥和醋味噌製作。這是一道展現各地食材特色的鄉土料理。在山口縣北部的北浦地方，常以青蔥搭配おばいけ製作。おばいけ是將鯨魚尾部切片後稍加汆燙而成。

f3d4c104d3a3f472.en: Tejikarao Shrine (手力雄神社, Tejikarao Jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in the city of Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan.
f3d4c104d3a3f472.zh: 手力雄神社是位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市的神社。

f3dcb2aa80609505.en: Ayu zosui is made by quickly simmering ayu fish, which has been grilled to a golden brown and fragrant, in rice and soup stock.It is said that in the old days, it was one of the ways to enjoy ayu fish that had been damaged during the catching process and was no longer marketable as it was.In Gifu Prefecture, which has many clear streams such as the Kiso, Nagara, and Ibi Rivers, ayu fishing is active from around June to October each year.There are two methods of fishing for ayu: tomozuri and fish weir fishing.
f3dcb2aa80609505.zh: 鮎ぞうすい是將烤至金黃、香氣四溢的香魚，與米飯和高湯一起快速燉煮而成。據說過去這是一種品嚐在捕撈過程中受損、無法直接販售的香魚的方式。在木曾川、長良川、揖斐川等清流眾多的岐阜縣，每年約6月至10月香魚捕撈盛行。香魚的捕撈方法有友釣和魚梁兩種。

f3dea082fbe78be9.en: Chiran Castle (知覧城, Chiran-jō) was a Japanese castle located in the Chiran area of the city of Minamikyūshū, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins were designated a National Historic Site in 1993.
f3dea082fbe78be9.zh: 知覽城（知覧城）是位於日本鹿兒島縣南九州市知覽地區的日本城堡。其遺跡於1993年被指定為國家史跡。

f3e0190fcffca4ad.en: “Guruni” is a simmered dish made mainly of winter root vegetables such as daikons, carrots and taros. These are all vegetables that are easy to obtain in the prefecture. The word "guru" means "company" or "everyone" in the Tosa (Kochi) dialect, and is said to have originated from the simmering of various ingredients together. At a time when it was more difficult to procure food than it is today, a large quantity of guruni was made from vegetables that were available and eaten by reheating them over and over again.
f3e0190fcffca4ad.zh: 「ぐる煮」是以白蘿蔔、紅蘿蔔、芋頭等冬季根莖類蔬菜為主的燉煮料理。這些都是縣內容易取得的蔬菜。「ぐる」在土佐（高知）方言中是「夥伴」或「大家」的意思，據說名稱源自將各種食材一起燉煮。在食物比現在難以取得的年代，人們用手邊的蔬菜大量製作ぐる煮，反覆加熱食用。

f3efe54bcdc25fd0.en: The Munakata Shiko Memorial Museum of Art (棟方志功記念館, Munakata Shikō Kinenkan) is a museum located in Aomori, Aomori Prefecture, Japan.  It features works from Shikō Munakata, a woodblock printmaker who was born in Aomori City.  The museum was serviced since 1975 to 2024.
f3efe54bcdc25fd0.zh: 棟方志功記念館是位於日本青森縣青森市的美術館，展出出身青森市的木版畫家棟方志功的作品。該館自1975年營運至2024年。

f3f6d12897be34f4.en: The Fuji Bamboo Garden (富士竹類植物園 Fuji Chikurui Shokubutsuen?) is Japan’s only botanical garden specializing in bamboo. Fuji Bamboo Garden is located in Nagaizumi, which is part of Japan's Shizuoka Prefecture (southwest of Tokyo). The garden is located at the base of Mount Fuji, from where the garden's name originated. The garden occupies over 2 acres of land. Fuji Bamboo Garden is said to be the world’s largest collection of bamboo, holding more than 450 varieties of bamboo from all around the world.
f3f6d12897be34f4.zh: 富士竹類植物園是日本唯一專門種植竹類的植物園，位於日本靜岡縣（東京西南方）長泉町。植物園位於富士山山腳，園名即由此而來。園區佔地超過2英畝。據說富士竹類植物園擁有世界最多的竹類收藏，種植來自世界各地的450多種竹子。

f403a9abeb3776d2.en: The Shinjō Matsuri (新庄まつりの山車行事) is a Japanese festival celebrated from 24 to 26 August in Shinjō, Yamagata Prefecture. Mikoshi and approximately twenty floats are drawn through the streets, accompanied by odori, drums, and other performers. It has a two hundred and fifty-year history and was designated as an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property in 2009.
f403a9abeb3776d2.zh: 新庄まつり是8月24日至26日在山形縣新庄舉行的日本祭典。神轎與約二十座山車在街上拖行，並有舞蹈、太鼓及其他表演者隨行。祭典已有兩百五十年歷史，2009年被指定為重要無形民俗文化財。

f40aeeded1468ffd.en: Bamboo shoots are an indispensable ingredient in Japanese cuisine, and there are records that they have been eaten since ancient times, as recorded in the Kojiki (Records of Ancient Matters). The bamboo shoots currently in circulation are mainly called Moso Bamboo, native to China, and are large and thick with brown hair on the skin, while the flesh is white and soft.
f40aeeded1468ffd.zh: 竹筍是日本料理中不可或缺的食材，據《古事記》的記載，自古以來便有食用竹筍的紀錄。目前市面上流通的竹筍主要是原產於中國的孟宗竹，筍體大而粗，外皮帶有褐色細毛，筍肉白而柔軟。

f41671d3e14cee95.en: Ritto Training Center (Japanese: 栗東トレーニングセンター, Rittō Torēningu Sentā) is a Japan Racing Association (JRA) facility in Rittō, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. It serves as the primary training base for West Japan (Kansai) racehorses.
f41671d3e14cee95.zh: 栗東トレーニングセンター是日本中央競馬會（JRA）位於日本滋賀縣栗東市的設施，為西日本（關西）賽馬的主要訓練基地。

f42acecc0b2c9f63.en: Shirahige-Tawara Shrine is a Shinto shrine located in Kitsuki City, in Oita Prefecture, Japan. It was ranked as a Gosha shrine. Known for its Doburoku festival.
f42acecc0b2c9f63.zh: 白鬚田原神社是位於日本大分縣杵築市的神社，曾列為鄉社，以どぶろく祭聞名。

f42b98caa1120e13.en: “Kakimaze”, also known as “omaze”, is a traditional local dish made with fresh ingredients from Shodoshima. Ingredients are flavored with seasonings such as soy sauce and added to cooked rice and mixed. Traditional soy sauce has been produced in Shodoshima for 400 years. The island’s climate is suitable for making salt, soybeans, and wheat, ingredients which are needed to make soy sauce. At its peak during the Meiji period, there were 400 soy sauce breweries in operation.
f42b98caa1120e13.zh: 「かきまぜ」又稱「おまぜ」，是使用小豆島新鮮食材製作的傳統鄉土料理。將食材以醬油等調味料調味後，加入煮好的米飯中拌勻。小豆島生產傳統醬油已有400年歷史。島上的氣候適合製作醬油所需的鹽、大豆和小麥。在全盛的明治時代，曾有400家醬油釀造廠營運。

f443b339f8195633.en: Nyoirin-ji (如意輪寺) is a Shingon temple in Ogōri, Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan. The temple, which is famed for its frog figurines, is commonly referred to as Kaeru-dera (カエル寺, frog temple), while the formal name is Seieizan Nyoirin-ji (清影山如意輪寺).
f443b339f8195633.zh: 如意輪寺是位於日本福岡縣小郡市的真言宗寺院，以青蛙像聞名，通稱カエル寺（青蛙寺），正式名稱為清影山如意輪寺。

f44c066ccc8bdb89.en: Shinko-ji (新光寺; "New Light Temple") is a Shingon Sect Buzan School Buddhist temple in Tokorozawa, Saitama, Japan. It is along the ancient Kamakura Kaidō road and traces its history to its founding by Minamoto no Yoritomo in 1193.
f44c066ccc8bdb89.zh: 新光寺（意為「新光之寺」）是位於日本埼玉縣所澤市的真言宗豐山派佛寺。寺院位於古代鎌倉街道沿線，其歷史可追溯至1193年由源賴朝創建。

f47c8236e88950e2.en: The Fukuoka Municipal Zoo and Botanical Garden (福岡市動植物園, Fukuoka-shi Dōshokubutsuen), also known as the Fukuoka City Zoological Garden, is a zoo and botanical garden established in 1953 and located within Minami-koen (En: "South park") at 1-1, Minami-Koen, Chūō-ku, Fukuoka, Fukuoka, Japan.
f47c8236e88950e2.zh: 福岡市動植物園，又稱福岡市動物園，是1953年設立的動物園及植物園，位於日本福岡縣福岡市中央區南公園1-1的南公園內。

f485df745d2c57b5.en: During the short summer of the Tsugaru region, locals enjoy a dish called "Hoya Mizu" which is made from seasonal ingredients. This dish is a combination of fresh "hoya(=Sea squirt)" and "mizu (=elatostema umbellatum)" mixed together with a "dashi(=Japanese soup stock)" made from "konbu(=kelp)". The locals say "hoya (=sea squirt) goes with mizu (=elatostema umbellatum)" because these two ingredients complement each other perfectly and are symbolic of summer cuisine.
f485df745d2c57b5.zh: 在津輕地區短暫的夏季，當地人會品嚐以當季食材製作、名為「ホヤミズ」的料理。這道料理是將新鮮的「ホヤ」（海鞘）與「ミズ」（赤車使者）以昆布高湯拌在一起。當地人說「ホヤ配ミズ」，因為這兩種食材彼此搭配得恰到好處，是夏季料理的代表。

f4969360b57c87a7.en: Okumiyagawa-Uchidani Prefectural Natural Park (奥宮川内谷県立自然公園, Okumiyagawa-Uchidani kenritsu shizen kōen) is a Prefectural Natural Park in Awa, Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. It was established in 1967.
f4969360b57c87a7.zh: 奥宮川内谷県立自然公園是位於日本德島縣阿波市的縣立自然公園，設立於1967年。

f4a0078e8772f3ac.en: Yonomori (夜ノ森) is a forest area located in the central Hamadōri area of Fukushima Prefecture, on the border between the towns of Tomioka and Ōkuma.
f4a0078e8772f3ac.zh: 夜ノ森是位於福島縣濱通中部的森林地帶，位在富岡町與大熊町的交界。

f4b58d4548460929.en: The Kozukappara execution grounds (小塚原刑場, Kozukappara keijō) were one of the three sites in the vicinity of Edo (the forerunner of present-day Tokyo, Japan) where the Tokugawa shogunate executed criminals in the Edo period. Alternate romanized spellings are Kozukahara and Kotsukappara.
f4b58d4548460929.zh: 小塚原刑場（小塚原刑場）是江戶時代德川幕府在江戶（今日本東京的前身）周邊處決罪犯的三處刑場之一。其他羅馬拼音寫法有Kozukahara與Kotsukappara。

f4b73b42b177e970.en: Hachinohe City Museum (八戸市博物館, Hachinohe-shi Hakubutsukan) opened in Hachinohe, Aomori Prefecture, Japan in 1983. The displays document the archaeology, history, and folkways of the area, the collection including an assemblage of artefacts excavated from the Tangotai Kofun Cluster that has been designated an Important Cultural Property.
f4b73b42b177e970.zh: 八戶市博物館於1983年在日本青森縣八戶市開館。館內展示當地的考古、歷史與民俗，館藏包括出土自丹後平古墳群、已被指定為重要文化財的一批文物。

f4c510110c399ca1.en: The Tokugawa Art Museum (徳川美術館, Tokugawa Bijutsukan) is a private art museum, located on the former Ōzone Shimoyashiki compound in Nagoya, central Japan. Its collection contains more than 12,000 items, including swords, armor, Noh costumes and masks, lacquer furniture, Chinese and Japanese ceramics, calligraphy, and paintings from the Chinese Song and Yuan dynasties (960–1368).
f4c510110c399ca1.zh: 德川美術館是位於日本中部名古屋舊大曾根下屋敷用地上的私立美術館。館藏超過12,000件，包括刀劍、甲冑、能劇服裝與面具、漆器家具、中國與日本陶瓷、書法，以及中國宋元時期（960–1368年）的繪畫。

f4dad48064f9e63e.en: Tōkamachi City Museum (十日町市博物館, Tōkamachi-shi Hakubutsukan) opened in Tōkamachi, Niigata Prefecture, Japan in 1979, reopening in a new building in 2020. The collection includes a grouping of 57 Jōmon pots from Sasayama Site that has been designated a National Treasure.
f4dad48064f9e63e.zh: 十日町市博物館於1979年在日本新潟縣十日町開館，2020年遷入新館重新開館。館藏包括出土自笹山遺跡、被指定為國寶的一組57件繩文陶器。

f4fa03d3b2c0c2c3.en: "Tamago fuwa fuwa" was served at Fukuroi-juku station during the Edo period and the Fukuroi-city Tourism Association has revived the dish as a new local specialty. According to "Sendai Gekkou Nikki", a written account from the Edo period, "tamago fuwa fuwa" was served for breakfast at Otawakihonjin of Fukuroi-juku station to guests staying there. The dish is made with two simple ingredients, eggs and dashi (=Japanese soup stock). The "fluffy" texture of the dish is what people enjoy the most about the dish.
f4fa03d3b2c0c2c3.zh: たまごふわふわ是江戶時代袋井宿供應的料理，袋井市觀光協會將其復興為新的在地名產。根據江戶時代的文獻《仙台下向日記》記載，袋井宿的太田脇本陣曾以たまごふわふわ作為早餐招待住宿的客人。這道料理只用雞蛋與高湯兩種簡單的食材製成，最受人喜愛的是其「蓬鬆」的口感。

f4fd41bb7c91819e.en: In the mountains, many wild vegetables are harvested in the springtime. It is said that wild vegetables grown under the snow are tastier and less bitter because when the snow melts, the acidity of the plants is removed. Zenmai or flowering fern is one of them, and when harvested in early spring and hung in the sun to dry, it was an especially useful as a preserved food in the wintertime. Since it can be used in a variety of ways, even stewing, Zenmai is indispensable food in Niigata prefecture.
f4fd41bb7c91819e.zh: 山區在春季可採收許多山菜。據說在雪下生長的山菜，因融雪時會去除植物的澀味，所以更美味、苦味較少。紫萁就是其中之一，早春採收後掛在陽光下曬乾，冬季是特別實用的保存食品。由於可用於燉煮等多種料理方式，紫萁是新潟縣不可或缺的食材。

f518111071abe30b.en: Shijimi clams are harvested from Lake Shinji, located at the lower reaches of the Hii River in the eastern part of Shimane Prefecture. Lake Shinji is the seventh-largest brackish lake in Japan. The large-sized Yamato Shijimi clams boast one of the top domestic catches in the country and are renowned nationwide. These clams are considered one of the "Shinji Lake Seven Delicacies," a collection of representative ingredients from Lake Shinji.
f518111071abe30b.zh: 蜆產自位於島根縣東部斐伊川下游的宍道湖。宍道湖是日本第七大汽水湖。大顆的大和蜆漁獲量居全國前列，聞名全國。這種蜆是「宍道湖七珍」之一，「宍道湖七珍」為宍道湖代表性食材的合稱。

f51ca54d82c17ee5.en: Tsurugisaki Lighthouse (剱埼灯台, Tsurugisaki tōdai) is a lighthouse located on Cape Tsurugi on the southeastern extremity of the city of Miura, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan on the southernmost and eastern tip of Miura Peninsula. (On the southernmost western tip of Miura Peninsula stands the Jōgashima Lighthouse.)
f51ca54d82c17ee5.zh: 劍埼燈塔位於日本神奈川縣三浦市東南端的劍崎，地處三浦半島最南端東側。（三浦半島最南端西側則為城ヶ島燈塔。）

f54d4c5c218345be.en: Izumo Dome (出雲ドーム, Izumo Dōmu) is an indoor sporting arena located in Izumo, Shimane, Japan. The capacity of the arena is 2,500 people and was opened in 1992 (1992).
f54d4c5c218345be.zh: 出雲ドーム是位於日本島根縣出雲市的室內運動場館，可容納2,500人，於1992年啟用。

f55a326c3ca1bc1c.en: Hataya Castle (畑谷城, Hataya-jō) was a castle built in Dewa Province, Japan. It is located in the town of Yamanobe in the Higashimurayama District of Yamagata Prefecture. It was the location of the Siege of Hataya in 1600, during which the castle's garrison of 300 men led by Eguchi Gohei was besieged by a 20,000 man force led by Naoe Kanetsugu. The garrison was defeated after a short siege.
f55a326c3ca1bc1c.zh: 畑谷城（Hataya-jō）是建於日本出羽國的城，位於山形縣東村山郡山邊町。1600年畑谷城之戰發生於此，當時由江口五兵衛率領的300名守軍遭直江兼續率領的2萬大軍圍攻，經短暫圍城後守軍戰敗。

f55eef58490a3e89.en: Hōsen-in (宝泉院) is a Buddhist temple of the Tendai-shū, located in Sakyō-ku of Kyoto-shi, in the prefecture of Kyoto, Japan. It is specified as a natural monument by the Kyoto government.
f55eef58490a3e89.zh: 寶泉院是位於日本京都府京都市左京區的天台宗佛寺，被京都府指定為天然紀念物。

f58c9dcc86034796.en: The Doigahama Site (土井ヶ浜遺跡, Doigahama iseki) is an archaeological site with a Yayoi period necropolis located in the Kandakami, Toyohoku-cho neighborhood of the city of Shimonoseki, Yamaguchi Prefecture, in the San'yō region of Japan. It was designated a National Historic Site in 1962.
f58c9dcc86034796.zh: 土井ヶ浜遺跡是一處擁有彌生時代墓地的考古遺址，位於日本山陽地方山口縣下關市豐北町神田上。1962年被指定為國家史跡。

f5ac314ddea0fe65.en: "Narezushi" is a traditional type of sushi, consisting of salt-pickled fish and rice fermented through lactic acid. The name "narezushi" is derived from the process of becoming accustomed or matured as fermentation progresses. Originally developed as a method to preserve fish for an extended period, the rice that encouraged fermentation was initially discarded.
f5ac314ddea0fe65.zh: 「なれずし」是一種傳統壽司，由鹽漬的魚與經乳酸發酵的米組成。「なれずし」之名源自隨著發酵進行而「熟成」的過程。原本是為了長期保存魚類而發展出的方法，促進發酵的米最初會被丟棄。

f5c0e92267dc6578.en: The Aibiki River (相引川, Aibiki-gawa) is a river located in Takamatsu, Kagawa, Japan.
f5c0e92267dc6578.zh: 相引川是位於日本香川縣高松市的河川。

f5ccc16fed8080a7.en: Iinoya-gū (井伊谷宮, Iinoya-gū) is a Shinto shrine in Hamana-ku, Hamamatsu, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. It was established in 1872, and its main festival is held annually on September 22. It is one of the Fifteen Shrines of the Kenmu Restoration.
f5ccc16fed8080a7.zh: 井伊谷宮是位於日本靜岡縣濱松市濱名區的神社。創建於1872年，例大祭每年於9月22日舉行。為建武中興十五社之一。

f5d99a0fb2efa901.en: small fish, 5-15 cm in length, caught off the coast of Nobeoka City in the Hyuga Sea at a depth of around 300 m. They are called "mehikari" because of their large, sparkling blue eyes. Its Japanese name is "aome-eso.In the past, it was treated as a small fish that could be caught in deep-sea shrimp trawl nets, and was used as a meal for fishermen and as bait for aquaculture.
f5d99a0fb2efa901.zh: 體長5至15公分的小魚，捕撈於延岡市外海日向灘約300公尺深處。因有一對閃著藍光的大眼睛，而被稱為「めひかり」。日文正式名稱為「アオメエソ」。過去被視為深海蝦拖網中順帶捕到的小魚，用作漁夫的餐食及養殖用的餌料。

f601e074080f9a68.en: Kobe Animal Kingdom (神戸どうぶつ王国, Kōbe Dōbutsu Ōkoku) is an animal and flower park located on Port Island in Kobe, Japan. It is mainly located in and around a greenhouse. It was called Kobe Kachoen (神戸花鳥園, Kōbe Kachōen) until 18 July 2014. It is one of several theme parks created by Japanese botanist and collector Kamo Mototeru, and was opened on 15 March 2006. This all-weather park is based on the concept of contact with birds and flowers. In the park, visitors are able to touch and feed birds.
f601e074080f9a68.zh: 神戶動物王國是位於日本神戶市港島的動物與花卉公園，主要設施位於溫室內及其周邊。2014年7月18日以前名為神戶花鳥園。這是日本植物學家暨收藏家加茂元照所創設的數座主題樂園之一，於2006年3月15日開園。這座全天候公園以與鳥類及花卉接觸為概念，遊客可在園內觸摸並餵食鳥類。

f603b5ade6749406.en: Myōtsū-ji (明通寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the city of Obama, Fukui Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Omuro-branch of the Shingon sect and its honzon is a statue of Yakushi Nyorai. Its sangō Its full name is 棡寺 明通寺 (Yuzurisan Myōtsū-ji).
f603b5ade6749406.zh: 明通寺是位於日本福井縣小濱市的佛教寺院，屬真言宗御室派，本尊為藥師如來像。其山號……全名為棡山明通寺。

f624135e1dab8716.ja: 日本平動物園（にほんだいらどうぶつえん、英: Shizuoka Municipal Nihondaira Zoo）は、静岡県静岡市駿河区池田にある静岡市が運営する動物園。
f624135e1dab8716.zh: 日本平動物園（英文：Shizuoka Municipal Nihondaira Zoo）是位於靜岡縣靜岡市駿河區池田、由靜岡市營運的動物園。

f6400032cce66f38.en: Ishikawa Prefectural History Museum (石川県立歴史博物館, Ishikawa Kenritsu Rekishi Hakubutsukan) is a prefectural museum in Kanazawa, Japan, dedicated to the history and culture of Ishikawa Prefecture. The three ICP red brick buildings date to 1909-14 and functioned first as the local arsenal, then after the Pacific War as the Kanazawa College of Art, before being converted into a museum in 1986.
f6400032cce66f38.zh: 石川県立歴史博物館是位於日本金澤市的縣立博物館，以石川縣的歷史與文化為主題。館舍為三棟建於1909至1914年的國家重要文化財紅磚建築，最初作為當地的兵器庫，太平洋戰爭後成為金澤美術工藝大學校舍，1986年改建為博物館。

f65b8af28dd32d12.en: The Narita Wholesale Market (成田市公設地方卸売市場) is a public wholesale fish, fruit, and vegetable market in Narita, Chiba, Japan. It is located near Narita International Airport.
f65b8af28dd32d12.zh: 成田市公設地方卸売市場是位於日本千葉縣成田市的公營魚類、水果與蔬菜批發市場，鄰近成田國際機場。

f666bc89cbf553f8.en: Hondōri (本通) is a commercial area in Naka-ku, Hiroshima, Japan, which centers on the Hondōri street which today is a shopping arcade.  Hondōri, which means "Main Street", runs from Hatchōbori to the Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park.  Hondōri was also previously called Hirataya-chō.  Hondōri prospered in the early 20th century, and in 1931, lily-of-the-valley lanterns were installed which allowed shops to stay open late.
f666bc89cbf553f8.zh: 本通是日本廣島市中區的商業區，以本通街為中心，該街如今為拱廊商店街。本通意為「主要街道」，從八丁堀延伸至廣島和平紀念公園，舊稱平田屋町。本通在20世紀初期繁榮發展，1931年設置了鈴蘭燈，使商店得以營業至深夜。

f66ef619c84ec8d6.en: Asamushi Onsen (浅虫温泉) is the site of a hot spring, on the eastern edge of the city of Aomori in Aomori Prefecture, Japan. It was developed as the downtown beside the onsen town and is sometimes known as "Atami in Tohoku" after the famous Atami Onsen in Shizuoka, central Japan.
f66ef619c84ec8d6.zh: 淺蟲溫泉（浅虫温泉）是位於日本青森縣青森市東緣的溫泉地。這裡作為溫泉街旁的市街發展而成，有時依日本中部靜岡縣著名的熱海溫泉，被稱為「東北的熱海」。

f69bda56a861b7c6.en: Shiso has been consumed by the Japanese since ancient times, so much so that fossils of the seeds have been excavated from Jomon ruins. There are red Shiso and green Shiso, and red Shiso is pickled with “Umeboshi” (Pickled plums) and cucumbers.
f69bda56a861b7c6.zh: 紫蘇自古以來就是日本人食用的植物，甚至在繩文時代遺跡中出土過種子的化石。紫蘇有紅紫蘇與青紫蘇，紅紫蘇會和「梅干」（醃梅）及小黃瓜一起醃漬。

f69f6f3fce1d395b.en: Kotonomama Hachiman-gū (事任八幡宮) is a Shinto shrine located in the city of Kakegawa, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. It is one of two shrines claiming the title of ichinomiya of former Tōtōmi Province, the other being the Oguni Jinja in the town of Mori    The shrine's main festival is held annually three days prior to Respect for the Aged Day in September.
f69f6f3fce1d395b.zh: 事任八幡宮是位於日本靜岡縣掛川市的神社。它是自稱舊遠江國一宮的兩座神社之一，另一座是森町的小國神社。神社的例大祭每年於九月敬老日的三天前舉行。

f6b99c994b553a4e.en: The Haya River (Japanese: 早川 = Hayakawa, literally a fast-flowing river) is a river that flows in Hakone and Odawara, Kanagawa, Japan. It is a 26 kilometres (16 mi) long river, starting from the Kojiri Water Gate (湖尻水門) at the northern tip of Lake Ashi, gathering rain and hot spring water as it flows in the Sengoku, the Mount Hakone caldera, running down beside the towns of Hakone Hot Springs, and emptying near Odawara Fishing Port (35°14′23.38″N 139°8′50.86″E) into Sagami Bay of the Pacific Ocean.
f6b99c994b553a4e.zh: 早川（字面意思為水流湍急的河川）是流經日本神奈川縣箱根與小田原的河川，全長26公里（16英里）。河川起自蘆之湖北端的湖尻水門，流經箱根山火山口內的仙石一帶，沿途匯集雨水與溫泉水，再沿箱根溫泉各溫泉街旁流下，最後在小田原漁港附近（北緯35°14′23.38″、東經139°8′50.86″）注入太平洋的相模灣。

f6b9fefe72507adf.en: In Toyama Prefecture, a major rice-producing region, rice cake-based dishes and sweets are a staple at every event and milestone in the lives of the people. The three-day dumpling soup is a traditional dish made on the third day after giving birth to nourish the mother and help her breast milk flow. Sometimes, the family of the bride who gave birth to the baby will put a noshi (gift wrapper) on the dumpling soup set and distribute it to relatives.
f6b9fefe72507adf.zh: 在稻米主要產地富山縣，以米、麻糬為主的料理和點心是人們生活中各種活動與人生階段的必備品。三日の団子汁是產後第三天製作的傳統料理，用來滋養母親並促進乳汁分泌。有時生產的新娘娘家會在團子湯組上貼上熨斗紙（禮品包裝）分送給親戚。

f6c951e28ec73425.en: Ōkōchi Sansō (大河内山荘, Ōkōchi Sansō; literally "Okochi Mountain Villa") is the former home and garden of the Japanese jidaigeki (period film) actor Denjirō Ōkōchi in Arashiyama, Kyoto. The villa is open to the public for an admission fee and is known for its gardens and views of the Kyoto area. Several of the buildings are recorded as cultural properties by the national government.
f6c951e28ec73425.zh: 大河内山荘（字面意思為「大河內山莊」）是日本時代劇演員大河內傳次郎位於京都嵐山的故居與庭園。山莊付費對外開放，以庭園及京都一帶的景觀著稱。其中數棟建築登錄為國家文化財。

f6e39227da320cf1.en: "Hasu-imo," a kind of Satoimo (Japanese taro), is widely found in the tropical regions of Southeast Asia. In Japan, it is cultivated in prefectures such as Kochi, Tokushima, and Okinawa. The edible part is the leaf stalk, which has small holes like lotus roots. It is rich in dietary fiber and vitamins, making it a versatile ingredient used in various cooking methods such as stir-frying, miso soup, and salads. In Hagi City, Yamaguchi prefecture, it is consumed as a pickled dish.
f6e39227da320cf1.zh: 「はすいも」是里芋（日本芋頭）的一種，廣泛分布於東南亞熱帶地區。在日本，高知、德島、沖繩等縣有栽培。可食用部分為葉柄，上面有如蓮藕般的小孔。富含膳食纖維與維生素，可用於熱炒、味噌湯、沙拉等多種烹調方式。在山口縣萩市則做成醋漬料理食用。

f6e3ab97aecbf4d2.en: Saitobaru Kofun Cluster (Japanese: 西都原古墳群) is a group of three hundred thirty three kofuns or tumuli in Saito city, Miyazaki Prefecture, Japan. This is one of the largest kofun groups in Japan, and the largest group in Kyushu situated on a 70-meter hill composed of diluvium. It is located within the Saitobaru-Sugiyasukyō Prefectural Natural Park.
f6e3ab97aecbf4d2.zh: 西都原古墳群是位於日本宮崎縣西都市的333座古墳群。這是日本規模最大的古墳群之一，也是九州最大的古墳群，位於由洪積層構成、高70公尺的台地上。古墳群位於西都原杉安峽縣立自然公園內。

f6fa7151baa5617a.en: Sasanagare Dam (Japanese: 笹流ダム) is a buttress dam located in Hokkaido Prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for water supply. The catchment area of the dam is 5.4 km2. The dam impounds about 7  ha of land when full and can store 606 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was completed in 1923.
f6fa7151baa5617a.zh: 笹流ダム是位於日本北海道的扶壁式水壩，用於供水。集水面積5.4平方公里，滿水時淹沒面積約7公頃，蓄水量60.6萬立方公尺。水壩於1923年完工。

f70e9b1d087221bc.en: Mount Echigo-Komagatake or Uonuma-Komagatake (越後駒ヶ岳 or 魚沼駒ヶ岳) is a mountain located on the border of Uonuma and
f70e9b1d087221bc.zh: 越後駒岳（越後駒ヶ岳，又稱魚沼駒ヶ岳）是位於魚沼與

f7169b31db7ed88c.en: Agatsuma Gorge (吾妻渓谷, Agatsuma Keikoku) is a two to three kilometer long ravine on the upper and middle reaches of the Agatsuma River in the towns of Highashiagatsuma and Naganohara, Gunma Prefecture, Japan. It has been designated a National Place of Scenic Beauty since 1935. It is featured on the "ya" card in Jomo Karuta.
f7169b31db7ed88c.zh: 吾妻溪谷（吾妻渓谷）是位於日本群馬縣東吾妻町與長野原町、吾妻川中上游的峽谷，全長約二至三公里。自1935年起被指定為國家名勝，也是上毛かるた中「や」牌的題材。

f71c2641c56f389e.en: Bibai torimeshi" is a local dish of Bibai City that is still enjoyed at home. It is said to have originated in the Meiji period (1868-1912), when the development of Hokkaido was promoted in earnest. Toyojiro Nakamura, a farmer who settled in the Nakamura area of present-day Bibai, encouraged chicken farming by giving his tenant farmers a pair of chickens to raise until rice cultivation got underway, out of concern for the health and livelihood of the farmers.
f71c2641c56f389e.zh: 「美唄のとりめし」是美唄市至今仍在家庭中食用的鄉土料理。據說起源於明治時代（1868-1912），當時北海道開拓正全面推動。在今日美唄中村地區定居的農民中村豐次郎，出於對農民健康與生計的關心，在稻作步上軌道之前，送給佃農一對雞飼養，以此鼓勵養雞。

f72078192c7fc743.en: Iida City Museum (飯田市美術博物館, Iida-shi bijutsu hakubutsu-kan) opened in  Iida, Nagano Prefecture, Japan in 1989. The museum's collections and display relate to the natural history, history, and art of the area and include a number of works by Hishida Shunsō, who was born locally.
f72078192c7fc743.zh: 飯田市美術博物館於1989年在日本長野縣飯田市開館。館藏與展示涵蓋當地的自然史、歷史與藝術，其中包括多件出身當地的菱田春草的作品。

f72a256da7a6df96.en: Meirinkan (明倫館) was a han school located in the Chōshū Domain of Japan. The school was one of the three major domain academies in Bakumatsu period Japan, along with the Kōdōkan in Mito Domain and Shizutani School in Okayama Domain.
f72a256da7a6df96.zh: 明倫館是日本長州藩的藩校。與水戶藩的弘道館及岡山藩的閑谷學校並列為幕末日本三大藩校之一。

f7529db6397c9360.en: Hiyoshi Tōshō-gū (日吉東照宮) is a Shinto shrine in Ōtsu, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. It enshrines the first Shōgun of the Tokugawa Shogunate, Tokugawa Ieyasu. It was established in 1623. The shrine's annual festival is held on June 1.
f7529db6397c9360.zh: 日吉東照宮是位於日本滋賀縣大津市的神社，祭祀德川幕府第一代將軍德川家康，創建於1623年。例祭於每年6月1日舉行。

f764b5ac2e4fb8d5.en: A local dish from Miura City, located at the tip of the Miura Peninsula. Daikon radish, a local specialty, is cut into "Wariboshidaikon (=split-dried daikon)," which is thicker than kiriboshi-daikon (dried daikon), and marinated in soy sauce, dashi (=Japanese soup stock), or other seasonings.Miura City is surrounded by the sea on three sides.
f764b5ac2e4fb8d5.zh: 位於三浦半島尖端的三浦市的鄉土料理。將當地特產白蘿蔔切成比切干大根（蘿蔔乾絲）更粗的「割り干し大根」（剖開曬乾的蘿蔔），再以醬油、高湯（日式湯底）或其他調味料醃漬。三浦市三面環海。

f76e9819237b7d52.en: Nina is a local dish made by boiling salted vegetable leaves and was eaten as a common household dish in Niigata Prefecture. Taina is mainly used. Taina was introduced from China in the early Meiji period and was bred to be adapted to Niigata. It is widely used as one of the Nagaoka vegetables. Depending on the region, nozawana or radish leaves are used as well. Nozawana is used in the Uonuma and Joetsu regions.
f76e9819237b7d52.zh: 煮菜是將鹽漬菜葉煮製而成的鄉土料理，在新潟縣是一般家庭常吃的菜色。主要使用體菜。體菜於明治初期自中國傳入，經改良以適應新潟的環境，作為長岡蔬菜之一廣泛使用。依地區不同，也會使用野澤菜或蘿蔔葉。魚沼和上越地區使用野澤菜。

f77ceab5b3c3c99b.en: Abukuma-dō (あぶくま洞 - Abukuma Cave) is a limestone cave located in Fukushima Prefecture, Japan.The cave was discovered on August 15, 1969, northeast of the city of Tamura and was originally named Kamayama Shonyu-do (釜山鍾乳洞). It was designated a natural heritage of the town on February 7, 1971, and renamed Abukuma-dō on June 1,1973. Visitors can traverse a 600-metre-long path inside the cave as well as a 120-metre-long exploration course to view the stalactites and stalagmites. Each stalactite has taken more than eighty million years to form.
f77ceab5b3c3c99b.zh: あぶくま洞（あぶくま洞穴）是位於日本福島縣的石灰岩洞穴。此洞於1969年8月15日在田村市東北方被發現，原名釜山鍾乳洞，1971年2月7日被指定為町的自然遺產，1973年6月1日改名為あぶくま洞。遊客可走洞內600公尺長的步道，以及120公尺長的探險路線，觀賞鐘乳石與石筍。每根鐘乳石都經過八千萬年以上才形成。

f7865dc5281c2fcd.en: In Tokushima prefecture, there are many traditional dishes which use “kintokimame” (=red kidney beans) in them, such as “barazushi” and “mametentama” (=type of okonomiyaki with sweet kintokimame in them). “Denbu” is one of such dishes and is also referred to as “odenbu”, “orenbu”, and “renbu”, and is similar to “gomoku mame” (=simmered soybeans with vegetables). Pre-cooked kintokimame or “kuromame” (=black soybeans) are simmered with daikon radish, “gobou” (=burdock) and other root vegetables and flavored with soy sauce and sugar.
f7865dc5281c2fcd.zh: 德島縣有許多使用「金時豆」（紅腰豆）的傳統料理，例如「ばらずし」和「豆天玉」（加入甜金時豆的一種大阪燒）。「でんぶ」也是其中之一，又稱「おでんぶ」、「おれんぶ」、「れんぶ」，類似「五目豆」（黃豆與蔬菜燉煮）。將預先煮好的金時豆或「黑豆」與蘿蔔、「牛蒡」等根莖類蔬菜一起燉煮，再以醬油和砂糖調味。

f78b8fa7c0b344e6.en: Zuiō-ji (瑞應寺) is a Sōtō Zen monastery in Niihama, Ehime Prefecture, in Japan.
f78b8fa7c0b344e6.zh: 瑞應寺是位於日本愛媛縣新居濱市的曹洞宗禪寺。

f794820c791f0a60.en: Originally, "Edomae (Edo original) " was a word related to eel and the term "Edomae eel" was first used to refer to eels caught near the mouth of the Okawa River (today's Sumida River). To cook Edomae-style "Unagi no Kabayaki (=Glaze-grilled Eel)", a live eel is split, skewered, grilled white, and steamed, then dipped in sauce and grilled again. In the Kanto and Kansai regions, the cooking method differs. In the Kanto region, the eel is opened from its back. Bones and entrails are removed, skewered, grilled, and steamed.
f794820c791f0a60.zh: 「江戶前」原本是與鰻魚有關的詞語，「江戶前鰻」一詞最初指在大川（今隅田川）河口附近捕獲的鰻魚。江戶前風格的「鰻のかば焼き」（蒲燒鰻）做法是將活鰻剖開、串起、白燒後再蒸，然後沾上醬汁再烤一次。關東與關西的烹調方式不同。在關東，鰻魚是從背部剖開，去除骨頭與內臟後串起、燒烤並蒸製。

f796c9f3c01bfcb2.en: Whales fed and fattened up in high latitude waters head for low latitude waters after summer to engage in breeding activities, passing through the Kumano-nada Sea in midwinter. This was the target of Kumano's traditional whaling. Wada Yorimoto started organized whaling in 1606 and is regarded as the founder of whaling.In 1675, Yoriharu, Yorimoto's grandson, invented the netting method, which enabled him to catch humpback whales that would sink after death, in addition to right whales and sperm whales that would stay afloat after death.
f796c9f3c01bfcb2.zh: 在高緯度海域覓食養肥的鯨魚，夏季過後會前往低緯度海域進行繁殖，並於隆冬時節通過熊野灘。這就是熊野傳統捕鯨的目標。和田賴元於1606年開始有組織的捕鯨，被視為捕鯨之祖。1675年，賴元之孫賴治發明了網取法，除了死後仍會浮在水面的露脊鯨與抹香鯨之外，也能捕獲死後會下沉的座頭鯨。

f79df3029c5fd5aa.en: Mount Funagata (船形山, Funagata-yama) is a mountain within the Ōu Mountains on the border of Miyagi Prefecture and Yamagata Prefecture in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan. It is listed as one of the "200 famous mountains of Japan" and has a height of 1,500.34 metres (4,922.4 ft). The mountain is also known as Mount Goshō (御所山, Gosho-yama) when viewed from Yamagata prefecture.
f79df3029c5fd5aa.zh: 船形山（Funagata-yama）是位於日本北部東北地方、宮城縣與山形縣交界處奧羽山脈中的山，列名「日本二百名山」，海拔1,500.34公尺（4,922.4英尺）。從山形縣一側稱此山為御所山（Gosho-yama）。

f7aa669f03dbafda.en: “Morokozushi“ is made by filling a sushi box with vinegared rice, topping it with sweet and spicy simmered “moroko”, and making this into pressed sushi. It is a local dish with a simple flavor that is valued as a hospitality dish for New Year's Day and festivals and is eaten not only in the Seino region but also in the northwestern part of Aichi Prefecture.“Moroko” is a freshwater fish that belongs to the Cyprinidae family and grows to about 10 cm in length as an adult.
f7aa669f03dbafda.zh: 「もろこずし」是在壽司模盒中填入醋飯，鋪上以甜辣口味燉煮的「もろこ」，製成押壽司。這是一道風味樸實的鄉土料理，被視為新年和祭典時款待客人的料理，不只在西濃地區，愛知縣西北部也有食用。「もろこ」是鯉科的淡水魚，成魚體長約10公分。

f7ce39d39045bf34.en: The Iwama Dōjō is a dōjō built by the founder of aikido, Morihei Ueshiba, who lived there from 1942 until his death in 1969.  It is located in the former town of Iwama and became an important historical location for the development of aikido and "a Mecca to the aikido community." This dojo is also where Morihiro Saito, one of the founder's closest students, learned and taught aikido from 1946 until 2002 developing what is often referred to as the Iwama Style.
f7ce39d39045bf34.zh: 岩間道場是合氣道創始人植芝盛平所建的道場，他自1942年起居住於此，直到1969年去世。道場位於舊岩間町，成為合氣道發展的重要歷史地點，也被稱為「合氣道界的聖地」。創始人最親近的弟子之一齋藤守弘，自1946年至2002年在此學習與教授合氣道，發展出通常稱為「岩間流」的風格。

f7cf7694c1f9ef95.en: Gifu City Tower 43 (岐阜シティ・タワー43) is a multipurpose skyscraper built in the Hashimoto-chō section in the capital city of Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. Officially opened on October 13, 2007, Gifu City Tower 43 is the tallest building in Gifu Prefecture, with its 43 above-ground floors reaching to a height of 163 m (535 ft). It is located just to the north and west of JR Gifu Station.
f7cf7694c1f9ef95.zh: 岐阜シティ・タワー43是位於日本岐阜縣縣廳所在地岐阜市橋本町的多用途摩天大樓。2007年10月13日正式啟用，地上43層，高163公尺（535英尺），為岐阜縣最高的建築物。位於JR岐阜站西北側不遠處。

f7fb111b041ae9b9.en: Okayama Prefecture's catch of octopuses is among the largest in the country. The sea near Shimotsui, Kurashiki has a particularly swift tidal current even for the Seto Inland Sea. They say that the octopuses that grow there have a characteristic chewiness, and their meat is firm and delicious. Kurashiki's special product is "takomeshi (octopus with rice)." For this dish, the octopus is cut into chunks and cooked with rice, and the quality of the ingredients, whose smell of the sea spreads out in abundance, is outstanding.
f7fb111b041ae9b9.zh: 岡山縣的章魚漁獲量居全國前列。倉敷市下津井附近的海域，即使在瀨戶內海中潮流也特別湍急。據說在此成長的章魚具有特有的嚼勁，肉質緊實美味。倉敷的特產是「たこめし（章魚飯）」。這道料理將章魚切塊後與米一起炊煮，海潮香氣四溢，食材品質出色。

f80a2a13feed61b8.en: Iwaki City Coal & Fossil Museum (いわき市石炭・化石館, Iwaki-shi sekitan・kaseki-kan), nicknamed Horuru (ほるる), opened in Iwaki, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan in 1984. The collection and displays relate to local fossil finds — including the plesiosaur Futabasaurus suzukii — and the Jōban coalfield, once the largest on Honshū.
f80a2a13feed61b8.zh: いわき市石炭・化石館，暱稱「ほるる」，1984年於日本福島縣いわき開館。館藏與展示內容與當地出土的化石（包括蛇頸龍雙葉鈴木龍）以及曾為本州最大煤田的常磐煤田有關。

f8312d1477f0d5c2.en: A local dish made at home and indispensable in winter in Akita, it consists of chicken, vegetables, and rice dumplings poked in a mortar and pestle in a chicken broth.It is said to have originated in the Minami-Aki region around Hachirogata. Originally, damako nabe was called "tsukego," a dish containing grilled fish such as wakasagi, crucian carp and whitebait, all of which are the produce of Hachiro Lagoon, and seasoned with miso.
f8312d1477f0d5c2.zh: 這是秋田冬季家庭不可或缺的地方料理，在雞湯中加入雞肉、蔬菜，以及用研缽和杵搗成的米糰子。據說起源於八郎潟周邊的南秋地區。だまこ鍋原本稱為「つけご」，是加入公魚、鯽魚、銀魚等八郎湖所產的烤魚，並以味噌調味的料理。

f83a39a0e45c5684.en: Hideshima islet is a small 8 ha island lying about 1 km off the coast of the Hinodejima fishery harbour of Miyako, Iwate Prefecture, Japan. It consists of a forested plateau surrounded by cliffs, the steep slopes used by burrow-nesting seabirds. The plateau forest is largely of Quercus crispula and Tilia japonica trees, with some Pinus densiflora and Cryptomeria japonica.
f83a39a0e45c5684.zh: 日出島是一座面積8公頃的小島，位於日本岩手縣宮古市日出島漁港外海約1公里處。島上為斷崖環繞的森林台地，陡坡為穴居築巢的海鳥所利用。台地森林主要為水楢與日本椴樹，另有部分赤松與柳杉。

f83cef356cf74c3d.en: A hot pot dish where soba flour is shaped like loaches (Japanese freshwater fish). This dish is eaten in mountainous areas and is known for being easily digestible and warming the body. It features dashi (=Japanese soup stock) made with river fish.
f83cef356cf74c3d.zh: 一道將蕎麥粉捏成泥鰍（日本的淡水魚）形狀的火鍋料理。這道料理在山區食用，以容易消化、能溫暖身體而聞名。特色是使用以河魚熬製的高湯（日式湯底）。

f86a515f187ec64a.en: Gokuraku-ji (極楽寺) is the head temple of the Ishizuchisan Shingon and Shugendō sect in Saijō, Ehime Prefecture, Japan. The principal images are Fudo Myōō, Aizen Myōō, and Zaō Gongen. It is the fundamental training center for Ishizuchisan sect, and has been a major training center for Shugendō for about 1,300 years.
f86a515f187ec64a.zh: 極樂寺是位於日本愛媛縣西條市的石鎚山真言宗暨修驗道總本山。本尊為不動明王、愛染明王及藏王權現。本寺是石鎚山真言宗的根本道場，約1,300年來一直是修驗道的主要修行道場。

f86bb71d037985c2.en: The recipe for "Kobu-Zushi" is different in the central and western parts of the prefecture. The central part of the prefecture eats "Ita-Kobu-Zushi". This is sushi rice wrapped in thin, white, "Shiroita-Kombu (=White kelp)". On the other hand, the western part of the prefecture eats "Kuro-Kobu-Zushi," which has a contrasting black appearance. This one is wrapped in Kombu (=Kelp). They were all served to guests on celebratory occasions such as weddings, funerals, and other festivals and events.
f86bb71d037985c2.zh: 「こぶずし」的做法在縣內中部與西部有所不同。縣中部吃的是「板昆布壽司」，是用薄而白的「白板昆布」包裹壽司飯而成。另一方面，縣西部吃的是外觀呈對比黑色的「黑昆布壽司」，這種是用昆布包裹。這些壽司都會在婚禮、喪禮及其他祭典、活動等喜慶場合招待客人。

f89e7bfebed3199e.en: Kuniyoshi Castle (国吉城, Kuniyoshi-jō) is a castle structure in Fukui, Fukui Prefecture, Japan.
f89e7bfebed3199e.zh: 國吉城是位於日本福井縣福井的城郭建築。

f8b00900ac68f538.en: The mountainous Kiso region has a unique culinary tradition that includes a dish called "Sunki-zuke," using the leaves of red turnips.
f8b00900ac68f538.zh: 多山的木曾地區有獨特的飲食傳統，其中包括一道使用紅蕪菁葉製作、稱為「すんき漬け」的料理。

f8b18b7157ef35d6.ja: 銚子漁港（ちょうしぎょこう）は、千葉県銚子市の太平洋に面する特定第3種漁港。
f8b18b7157ef35d6.zh: 銚子漁港是位於千葉縣銚子市、面向太平洋的特定第3種漁港。

f8ca19e42cbc53a9.en: Ōfuka onsen (大深温泉, Ōfuka onsen) is an onsen (hot spring) in Semboku, Akita, Japan. It is closed as of 2025 with no confirmed reopening date.
f8ca19e42cbc53a9.zh: 大深温泉是位於日本秋田縣仙北市的溫泉。截至2025年處於關閉狀態，尚無確定的重新開放日期。

f91b8a3628f191ba.en: Although it is called " Kujira-Mochi （whale cake）," it is not made with Whale meat. There are various theories as to the origin of the name.
f91b8a3628f191ba.zh: 雖然名為「くじら餅」（鯨魚餅），但並非用鯨魚肉製作。名稱的由來有各種說法。

f91bf3e33e363b09.en: The Bandai Highland (Japanese: 磐梯高原, Bandai Kōgen), also called Urabandai (裏磐梯), is a plateau on the north side of Mount Bandai, at an elevation of 800 meters above sea level, in West Fukushima, Japan. It is surrounded on other sides by Mount Adatara and Mount Azuma (吾妻山), and is part of Bandai-Asahi National Park.
f91bf3e33e363b09.zh: 磐梯高原又稱裏磐梯，是位於日本福島縣西部、磐梯山北側的高原，海拔800公尺。其他方向由安達太良山與吾妻山環繞，屬於磐梯朝日國立公園的一部分。

f9462f9f9cac0c9b.en: Lake Nojiri (野尻湖, Nojiri-ko) is in the town of Shinano, Kamiminochi District, Nagano Prefecture, Japan. Second to Lake Suwa among lakes in Nagano Prefecture, Nojiri is a resort, the location of the first pumped-storage hydroelectricity in Japan, and the site of a Japanese Paleolithic excavation.
f9462f9f9cac0c9b.zh: 野尻湖位於日本長野縣上水內郡信濃町。在長野縣的湖泊中規模僅次於諏訪湖，是度假地，也是日本第一座抽蓄水力發電的所在地，以及日本舊石器時代遺址的發掘地點。

f96fbcc042e3e7cf.en: "Happazushi" is a type of sushi that involves wrapping vinegared rice, Masu(=trout), and ginger in the leaves of the Vernicia (Aburagiri), a deciduous tall tree belonging to the Toadflax family. It is also known as "Koppazushi" in the Kuzuryu River basin, particularly in the vicinity of Eiheiji Town. The dish, with its pale red color, is an essential local specialty for festivals and celebrations.
f96fbcc042e3e7cf.zh: 「葉っぱずし」是將醋飯、鱒魚和薑包在油桐（アブラギリ）葉中的壽司。油桐是落葉喬木，屬於柳穿魚科。在九頭龍川流域，特別是永平寺町一帶，也稱為「こっぱずし」。這道呈淡紅色的料理，是祭典與喜慶場合不可或缺的地方特產。

f9880f13e708da67.en: Mount Kamui (カムイヌプリ, Kamui-nupuri ), also Kamuinupuri or Mount Mashū, a potentially active volcano, is a parasitic stratovolcano of the Mashū caldera (itself originally a parasitic cone of Lake Kussharo) located in the Akan National Park of Hokkaido, Japan.
f9880f13e708da67.zh: 摩周岳（カムイヌプリ，Kamui-nupuri），又稱Kamuinupuri或Mount Mashū，是一座可能仍具活動性的火山，為摩周破火山口的寄生成層火山（摩周破火山口本身原為屈斜路湖的寄生火山錐），位於日本北海道阿寒國立公園內。

f9895812844ab7dd.en: “Shimi-Dofu”, which is made by freezing the Tofu and then putting it back to dry, is a local dish unique to cold regions. The Tofu is exposed to the cold wind for about two weeks to remove the water. Fukushima, where the Abukuma River flows and is surrounded by the mountains of the Abukuma Highlands, is especially cold and windy in winter.
f9895812844ab7dd.zh: 「凍み豆腐」是將豆腐冷凍後再乾燥製成，是寒冷地區特有的鄉土料理。豆腐要在寒風中吹約兩週以去除水分。福島有阿武隈川流過，四周環繞著阿武隈高地的群山，冬季特別寒冷且風大。

f9be0f24b26fb540.en: Chōkaidō Museum (澄懐堂美術館, Chōkaidō Bijutsukan) opened in Yokkaichi, Mie Prefecture, Japan in 1994, reopening in a new site in the city in 2017. The collection, built up by Yamamoto Teijirō, focuses on Chinese calligraphy and paintings from the Song to the Qing.
f9be0f24b26fb540.zh: 澄懷堂美術館於1994年在日本三重縣四日市市開館，2017年遷至市內新址重新開館。館藏由山本悌二郎蒐集，以宋代至清代的中國書畫為主。

f9c7239b427dda97.en: ‘Hitoyama Rural Kabuki’ is held every year on May 3rd in Shodoshima Island located in Setouchi Ocean. It is a traditional event from Edo Era to celebrate the completion of construction for agricultural pond, and designated as an intangible folk cultural property in the prefecture. "Warigo Bento" was eaten during the break time of Kabuki performance.Most "Warigo Bento" are in rectangular wooden box separated in half diagostically.
f9c7239b427dda97.zh: 「肥土山農村歌舞伎」每年5月3日在瀨戶內海的小豆島舉行。這是自江戶時代流傳的傳統活動，用以慶祝農業用蓄水池完工，並列為縣指定無形民俗文化財。「わりご弁当」是在歌舞伎表演中場休息時吃的便當。多數「わりご弁当」裝在以對角線分隔成兩半的長方形木盒中。

f9c92dcee5e9a68e.en: Ad Museum Tokyo (アド・ミュージアム東京, Ado Myuciamu Tokyo) is an advertising museum in Shiodome in the Minato ward of Tokyo, Japan. Located in the basement of the Caretta Shiodome Building, it is the only museum in Japan dedicated to the promotion of studies in advertising.
f9c92dcee5e9a68e.zh: アドミュージアム東京是位於日本東京都港區汐留的廣告博物館。館址位於Caretta汐留大樓地下樓層，是日本唯一一座致力於推廣廣告研究的博物館。

f9cfef4750a5a326.en: Ibaraki is one of the prefectures in Japan thriving with agriculture, which boasts the top harvest of vegetables like green pepper, lotus root and Gobou (=Burdock), and yuzu is also harvested. In general, yuzu is grown in the mild climate and it’s often grown in Shikoku Region (South-east of Japan). On the other hand, it is also harvested in Saitama Prefecture and Ibaraki Prefecture in Kanto Region.
f9cfef4750a5a326.zh: 茨城是日本農業興盛的縣之一，青椒、蓮藕、牛蒡等蔬菜的收成量居全國之冠，也出產柚子。一般而言，柚子生長於氣候溫和的地方，多栽種於四國地方（日本東南部）。另一方面，關東地方的埼玉縣與茨城縣也有收成。

f9e632aa5a105245.en: Lagunasia (ラグナシア, Ragunashia) is an amusement park in Gamagōri, Aichi, Japan. It is home to the Aqua Wind, Pirates' Blast and Stellar roller coasters. The park was also the first Magiquest live role playing game location outside of the United States.
f9e632aa5a105245.zh: ラグナシア是位於日本愛知縣蒲郡市的遊樂園，設有Aqua Wind、Pirates' Blast與Stellar等雲霄飛車。該園也是Magiquest實境角色扮演遊戲在美國以外的第一個據點。

f9ef0f8a668470df.en: Minami Hokke-ji (南法華寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Tsubosaka neighborhood of the town of Takatori, Nara Prefecture Japan. It belongs to the Shingon sect of Japanese Buddhism and its honzon (primary image) is a statue of Jūichimen Senjū  Kannon. The temple's full name is Tsubosaka-san Minami-Hokke-ji (壺阪山 南法華寺), but it is more commonly known as "Tsubosaka-dera" (壺阪寺).  The temple is the 6th stop on the 33 temple Saigoku Kannon Pilgrimage route.
f9ef0f8a668470df.zh: 南法華寺是位於日本奈良縣高取町壺阪地區的佛教寺院，屬於日本佛教真言宗，本尊（主要供奉的佛像）為十一面千手觀音像。寺院全名為壺阪山南法華寺，但一般多稱為「壺阪寺」。本寺為西國三十三所觀音巡禮的第6番札所。

f9fa76f94d5d9824.en: Hirose Dam is a rockfill dam located in Yamanashi Prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for flood control, irrigation, water supply and power production. The catchment area of the dam is 76.6 km2. The dam impounds about 55  ha of land when full and can store 14300 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1965 and completed in 1974.
f9fa76f94d5d9824.zh: 広瀬ダム是位於日本山梨縣的堆石壩，用於防洪、灌溉、供水及發電。集水面積為76.6平方公里。滿水時淹沒面積約55公頃，可蓄水1,430萬立方公尺。水壩於1965年動工，1974年完工。

fa18b9dea104a347.en: In the central and southern inland parts of Tsugaru region, fresh seafood was hard to come by in the past. For this reason, fish were considered a delicacy. During the winter, the Tsugaru area experiences about four months of heavy snow and pickles were an important source of vegetables, which is why there are so many different types of pickles from this area. Salted trout used for “Kyabetsu to masu no tsukemono” was preserved over the winter and eaten daily with white rice.
fa18b9dea104a347.zh: 過去在津輕地區中南部的內陸地帶，新鮮海產不易取得，因此魚被視為珍饈。津輕地區冬季約有四個月大雪，醃漬物是重要的蔬菜來源，因此當地有許多不同種類的醃漬物。「キャベツとマスの漬物」所用的鹽漬鱒魚可保存過冬，每天配白飯食用。

fa2661f93c56d37d.en: "Awa uiro" is called one of Japan's top three uiro (sweet rice jelly) along with "Nagoya uiro" and "Yamaguchi uiro." Its history is long, dating back to the time of the 11th Tokugawa shogun, TOKUGAWA Ienari. During this period, sugarcane spread to Awa, and "Awa wasanbon (refined Japanese sugar)" came to be made from cultivated sugarcane; Awa uiro was then made to celebrate the completion of Awa wasanbon.
fa2661f93c56d37d.zh: 「阿波ういろ」與「名古屋ういろ」、「山口ういろ」並稱日本三大外郎（米製甜糕）。其歷史悠久，可追溯至江戶幕府第11代將軍德川家齊的時代。當時甘蔗傳入阿波，人們以栽培的甘蔗製作「阿波和三盆」（日本精製糖），為慶祝阿波和三盆製成而做出了阿波ういろ。

fa474ffeff77cd45.en: Deep in the mountains, where winter often brings heavy snow, pickled vegetables were a precious source of food in the Hida region.
fa474ffeff77cd45.zh: 在冬季常有大雪的深山中，醃漬蔬菜是飛驒地區珍貴的糧食來源。

fa549667057730d2.en: Ōgamiyama Jinja (大神山神社, Ōgamiyama Jinja) is a Shinto shrine, in Daisen, Tottori, Japan. A number of its structures have been designated Important Cultural Properties.
fa549667057730d2.zh: 大神山神社是位於日本鳥取縣大山町的神社，其中多棟建築被指定為重要文化財。

fa5d1439b42d8240.en: Ginowan City Museum (宜野湾市立博物館, Ginowan Shiritsu Hakubutsukan) opened in Ginowan, Okinawa Prefecture, Japan in 1999. The displays relate to the city's archaeology, history, and folklore.
fa5d1439b42d8240.zh: 宜野湾市立博物館於1999年在日本沖繩縣宜野灣市開館，展示內容與該市的考古、歷史及民俗相關。

fa6583f42892edca.en: Sakura Shrine (作楽神社, Sakura Jinja) is a Shinto shrine in the Jingo neighborhood of the city of Tsuyama in Okayama Prefecture, Japan. The main festival of the shrine is held annually on the second Sunday of April.The entire 30,189 square meters precincts of the shrine was designated a National Historic Site in 1922 as the 'Innoshō-no-yakata (Kojima Takanori Legendary place)'.
fa6583f42892edca.zh: 作楽神社是位於日本岡山縣津山市神戶地區的一座神社。神社的例大祭每年於4月第二個星期日舉行。神社境內全區30,189平方公尺於1922年以「院庄館跡（兒島高德傳說地）」之名被指定為國家史跡。

fa67b6401387d8ea.en: Ozanami myoga ginger is grown in the Ozanami district in the southeastern Toyama City (formerly Oyama Town). It is a traditional vegetable representative of Toyama Prefecture. It is characterized by its bright pink color, fragrance, and crunchy texture. In the past, myoga ginger was grown by every household, and it has been used in various dishes such as miso soup and condiments. Myoga zushi has a long history of being a delicacy that has always been made at home during festive occasions.
fa67b6401387d8ea.zh: 小佐波茗荷種植於富山市東南部（舊大山町）的小佐波地區，是富山縣代表性的傳統蔬菜，特色是鮮豔的粉紅色、香氣與爽脆口感。過去家家戶戶都種茗荷，用於味噌湯和佐料等各種料理。みょうが寿司歷史悠久，一直是喜慶時在家中製作的佳餚。

fa7a0ddef374665e.en: It is a local food representative of Fukui Prefecture, which has been loved since long ago. It is called "yomokonji" in the Kono area of Minamiechizen Town (formerly Kono Village).
fa7a0ddef374665e.zh: 這是自古以來深受喜愛的福井縣代表性鄉土料理。在南越前町河野地區（舊河野村）稱為「よもこんじ」。

fa7d027f4795d500.en: In Menuma area of Kumagaya City, during the Edo period, it flourished with the transportation of goods along the Tone River. The fertile land of rice paddies and fields in this area has been used for cultivating rice and Menuma indigenous soybeans. "Syoten-zushi", made with precious rice and fried thin tofu, which was expensive, was a special dish eaten on festive and ceremonial occasions. When speaking of "Syoten-sama (the Deified Spirit Shoden)" in Menuma, everybody imagines "Syoten-zushi" sold at the temple gate.
fa7d027f4795d500.zh: 熊谷市妻沼地區在江戶時代因利根川的貨物運輸而繁榮。當地肥沃的水田與旱田用於栽培稻米和妻沼在來種黃豆。「聖天ずし」使用珍貴的米和當時價格昂貴的油豆皮製成，是在喜慶與儀式場合吃的特別料理。提到妻沼的「聖天様」，大家都會想到在寺院門前販售的「聖天ずし」。

fa7f69b32eb17f35.en: The Bōyo Islands (防予諸島, Bōyo-shotō or Hōyo-shotō) are a group of 41 islands that belong to Yamaguchi and Ehime Prefectures in the Inland Sea. The largest by far is Suō-Ōshima, or Yashiro Island.
fa7f69b32eb17f35.zh: 防予諸島（ぼうよしょとう，或ほうよしょとう）是瀨戶內海中分屬山口縣與愛媛縣的41座島嶼組成的群島。其中面積最大者為周防大島，又稱屋代島。

fa8e65a040a100f3.en: The Gifu City Museum of History (岐阜市歴史博物館, Gifu-shi Rekishi Hakubutsukan) is a city-supported history museum located in the city of Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. Located in Gifu Park at the base of Mount Kinka, it is in the heart of Gifu City's sightseeing area.
fa8e65a040a100f3.zh: 岐阜市歷史博物館是位於日本岐阜縣岐阜市的市立歷史博物館，位於金華山山腳的岐阜公園內，處於岐阜市觀光區的中心地帶。

fa90ad53eba9e4d2.en: Rice ball wrapped in pickled Hiroshima mustard. Hiroshima-na is a type of Chinese cabbage belonging to the Brassicaceae family. Sown in September, it grows well in December, and the frost gives it a tangy flavor. It is said that the seeds were brought back from Kyoto during the Edo period (1603-1867), and many elderly people call it kyona (meaning Kyoto vegetable), suggesting that it has its roots in Kyoto's mibuna. Because of the shape of its stem, it is also called Hira-guki (flat stem). The name Hiroshima-na was given in 1933.
fa90ad53eba9e4d2.zh: 以醃漬廣島菜包覆的飯糰。廣島菜是十字花科的一種白菜類蔬菜，9月播種，12月長得最好，經霜後帶有酸香風味。據說種子是江戶時代（1603-1867）從京都帶回的，許多年長者稱之為「京菜」（意為京都的蔬菜），由此推測其源自京都的壬生菜。因莖的形狀，也稱為「平莖」。「廣島菜」這個名稱是在1933年定下的。

fa910456cee39054.en: Sengoku-mame, cultivated in the southern area of Gifu City since the Meiji era (1868-1912), is a type of Fuji-mame, so named because its pods resemble a Sengoku-bune (boat), and it is resistant to high temperatures and disease, and produces a lot of beans.It is used in a variety of dishes such as tempura and dishes dressed with sesame sauce.
fa910456cee39054.zh: 千石豆自明治時代（1868-1912）起在岐阜市南部栽培，是扁豆的一種，因豆莢形狀像千石船而得名。耐高溫、抗病害，產量多。可用於天婦羅、芝麻醬涼拌等各種料理。

fab37cdc9f9b380f.en: Kesennuma City, located in Miyagi Prefecture, is well-known for its fresh fish. During winter, ocean perch is abundant due to its high fat content. "Azara", a popular dish made from this fish, has been enjoyed by the locals for a long time. The old pickled Chinese cabbage is fermented through long-term pickling, increasing the sourness of the cabbage. It is then stewed with fresh ocean perch and sake lees to create a dish that has a concentrated umami flavor.
fab37cdc9f9b380f.zh: 位於宮城縣的氣仙沼市以新鮮漁獲聞名。冬季的平鮋油脂豐富，產量也多。用這種魚做成的人氣料理「あざら」，長久以來深受當地人喜愛。醃了很久的老白菜漬物經過長期醃漬而發酵，酸味增加，再與新鮮的平鮋和酒粕一起燉煮，做成鮮味濃縮的料理。

fab6cdc11ecc9be8.en: Hakodate Hachiman Shrine (函館八幡宮, Hakodate Hachimangū) is a Shinto shrine located in Hakodate, Hokkaido. It is a Hachiman shrine, dedicated to the kami Hachiman. It is also a Sōja shrine that  enshrines all the deities of its region, although it technically does not have a province.
fab6cdc11ecc9be8.zh: 函館八幡宮是位於北海道函館的神道神社，屬八幡神社，供奉八幡神。它也是供奉該地區所有神祇的總社，不過嚴格來說並沒有所屬的令制國。

fac2850e4cc4fcfb.en: Mizunami Fossil Museum (瑞浪市化石博物館, Mizunami-shi Kaseki Hakubutsukan) is a museum of fossils in Mizunami, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. The museum, which opened in 1974, has a special focus on the palaeoenvironment of the area and on the fossils of the Miocene Mizunami Group. The collection includes some 250,000 fossils, of which around 3,000 are included in the permanent display.
fac2850e4cc4fcfb.zh: 瑞浪市化石博物館是位於日本岐阜縣瑞浪市的化石博物館，於1974年開館，特別著重於當地的古環境及中新世瑞浪層群的化石。館藏約有25萬件化石，其中約3,000件列入常設展示。

fac2b0e6ea734f9f.en: Ogawa Falls (Japanese: 雄川の滝) is located in Minamiōsumi, Kagoshima, Japan, the town in the southern tip of the Osumi Peninsula. It is a 46-meter (151-foot) waterfall, 60 meters (197 feet) in extended width, in the midstream of the Ogawa River.
fac2b0e6ea734f9f.zh: 雄川瀑布位於大隅半島南端的日本鹿兒島縣南大隅町，是雄川中游一座高46公尺（151英尺）、寬60公尺（197英尺）的瀑布。

fac6da5a4857d99c.en: Located in Iruma County, in the center of Saitama Prefecture, Ogose Town is home to the "Ogose Plum Grove", known as one of the three largest plum groves in the Kanto region. Roughly 20,000 plum trees are cultivated in the surrounding area. The history of this area, which has long been known as the “village of plums”, can be traced back to the Nanboku-cho Period, when plum trees from Dazaifu, Kyushu, was introduced to the area, and subsequently widely planted and cultivated.
fac6da5a4857d99c.zh: 越生町位於埼玉縣中部的入間郡，町內的「越生梅林」被譽為關東三大梅林之一，周邊地區種植了約20,000棵梅樹。這個地區自古以來就以「梅之里」聞名，其歷史可追溯至南北朝時代，當時從九州太宰府引進梅樹，之後在此地廣泛種植栽培。

fad2e023653108de.en: "Simmered Deep-fried Yuba Roll" is a traditional Nikko City dish made by rolling up and deep frying yuba, seasoning it, and simmering it.It is said that "Yuba" was introduced as an ingredient in vegetarian cuisine by Buddhist monks returning from study in Tang Dynasty China, and spread throughout the country. “Shugenja", who abstained from eating meat, had a long-standing custom of eating "Yuba", which is thought to have spread to the general population.
fad2e023653108de.zh: 「揚げまき湯波の煮物」是日光市的傳統料理，將湯波捲起油炸後調味燉煮而成。據說湯波是由赴唐朝中國留學歸來的僧侶作為素食料理的食材傳入，並推廣到全國。不吃肉的「修驗者」長久以來有食用湯波的習慣，一般認為這個習慣後來也傳到一般民眾之間。

fad96b63432144e2.en: In Kochi prefecture, sardines were soaked in vinegar and made into sushi using “okara” (=soy pulp) instead of rice, and this was called “tamazushi” because in Kochi, people refer to okara as “otama”. Okara was used instead of rice because rice was considered a delicacy in the past. Okara is soy pulp which is a by-product of tofu and the people of Kochi made good use of it in this way. “Kibinago no Hokaburi” is a type of tamazushi using the fish “kibinago” (=silver-stripe round herring), which is a small fish measuring to around 10cm in length.
fad96b63432144e2.zh: 在高知縣，人們將沙丁魚以醋醃漬，用「豆渣」代替米飯做成壽司，由於高知人稱豆渣為「おたま」，因此稱為「玉壽司」。以豆渣代替米飯，是因為過去米被視為珍貴之物。豆渣是製作豆腐的副產品，高知人便以這種方式善加利用。「きびなごのほおかぶり」是使用「きびなご」（日本銀帶鯡）製作的玉壽司，這種小魚長約10公分。

faddb0f143534696.en: Nishikata Castle (西方城, Nishikata-jō)  was a yamajiro-style Japanese castle located in the Nishikatahonjō neighborhood of the city of  Tochigi,  Tochigi Prefecture, in the southern Tōhoku region of Japan.  The ruins were designated a National Historic Site in 2022.
faddb0f143534696.zh: 西方城是山城形式的日本城郭，位於日本東北地方南部栃木縣栃木市西方町本城。遺址於2022年指定為國家史跡。

faf4dc73eafaf243.en: Hoshizaki Castle (Japanese: 星崎城, romanized: Hoshizaki-jō) was a Japanese castle in Motohoshizaki-chō (本星崎町) neighbourhood, today a part of Minami-ku, Nagoya Japan.
faf4dc73eafaf243.zh: 星崎城（Hoshizaki-jō）是位於本星崎町的日本城郭，該地現屬名古屋市南區。

fb12ca403f6aab70.en: Bamboo shoots simmered in miso with the "umami" of Kombu (kelp) is one of the dishes that remind us of the arrival of spring. Within the prefecture, there is a famous production area called "Takenoko no Sato", one of which is the Kurokawa area in Imizu City. It started about 150 years ago when it was harvested in the bamboo bushes around private houses.
fb12ca403f6aab70.zh: 以昆布的「鮮味」燉煮的味噌竹筍，是讓人感受到春天到來的料理之一。縣內有被稱為「たけのこの里」的知名產地，射水市的黑河地區即是其中之一。約150年前，從採收民宅周圍竹林的竹筍開始。

fb365733632ad74f.en: Wakayama Prefectural Museum (和歌山県立博物館, Wakayama Kenritsu Hakubutsukan) is a history museum in located in the city of Wakayama, Wakayama Prefecture, Japan.
fb365733632ad74f.zh: 和歌山県立博物館是位於日本和歌山縣和歌山市的歷史博物館。

fb382731e77abedf.en: "Frozen Daikon Radish" is one of the preserved foods made by utilizing the cold of winter. It involves exposing daikon radishes to the cold outdoor air to dry them. In the past, people used to tie daikon radishes with straw and hang them under the eaves to freeze. The radishes would freeze overnight in the cold, and then thaw during the warmer daytime. This process was repeated several times to remove the water content from the daikon radishes. Also known as "Kanboshi Daikon," it offers a unique taste compared to fresh daikon radishes.
fb382731e77abedf.zh: 「凍み大根」是利用冬季寒冷製作的保存食品之一，作法是將蘿蔔置於寒冷的戶外使其乾燥。過去人們會用稻草綁住蘿蔔，吊在屋簷下使其結凍。蘿蔔在夜間的寒冷中結凍，白天較暖時再解凍，如此反覆數次以去除蘿蔔的水分。又稱為「寒干し大根」，風味與新鮮蘿蔔不同。

fb3f5ada0bf886b9.en: “Zeitaku-ni” is a local dish in which pickles "takuan" are soaked in water, the salt is removed, and then boiled. It is also a dish which can be found throughout the prefecture.There is a theory that the name comes from the time-consuming and labor-intensive process of making pickles into a stewed dish, or from the luxury of using a lot of Salt when pickling, then removing the salt from the "Takuan" and cooking it again with more Salt.“Zeitaku-ni” is one of the standard dishes essential for Buddhist ceremonies in the “Kohoku” region.
fb3f5ada0bf886b9.zh: 「ぜいたく煮」是將醃蘿蔔「たくあん」泡水去除鹽分後再煮的鄉土料理，在縣內各地都能見到。關於名稱由來，有一說是因為將醃菜做成燉煮料理費時費工，也有一說是因為醃漬時用了大量的鹽，之後又將「たくあん」去鹽，再加更多鹽烹煮，十分奢侈。「ぜいたく煮」是「湖北」地區佛事中不可或缺的基本料理之一。

fb83c70549a8b81a.en: Nakagawa Aquatic Park (栃木県なかがわ水遊園, Tochigi ken Nakagawa suiyu en) is an aquarium attached to the Tochigi Prefectural Fisheries Experiment Station, located on the banks of the Naka River in Sarado, Otawara, Tochigi Prefecture, Japan. Although saltwater fish are also kept here, the public aquarium is mainly for freshwater fish. The aquarium opened on July 15, 2001. The aquarium is accredited as a Museum-equivalent facilities by the Museum Act from Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology.
fb83c70549a8b81a.zh: 栃木縣なかがわ水遊園是附設於栃木縣水產試驗場的水族館，位於日本栃木縣大田原市佐良土的那珂川河畔。館內雖然也飼養海水魚，但這座公立水族館以淡水魚為主。水族館於2001年7月15日開幕，並依文部科學省《博物館法》獲指定為博物館相當設施。

fb87e82555ad41ff.en: In Shimane Prefecture, known for its abundant "Tobiuo(=Flying fish)" catch, these fish are affectionately called "Ago" by the locals. Among the approximately 30 species of "Tobiuo(=Flying fish)" identified in Japan, Shimane Prefecture primarily catches "Hoso Tobiuo" and "Tsukushi Tobiuo." The fishing methods for "Hoso Tobiuo" include fixed nets, gill nets, and encircling nets, while "Tsukushi Tobiuo" is also caught using scoop nets.
fb87e82555ad41ff.zh: 島根縣以飛魚（トビウオ）漁獲豐富聞名，當地人親切地稱之為「あご」。在日本已確認的約30種飛魚中，島根縣主要捕獲「ホソトビウオ」和「ツクシトビウオ」。「ホソトビウオ」的漁法包括定置網、刺網和圍網，「ツクシトビウオ」則也會使用抄網捕撈。

fb90768f868efb73.en: Nago Museum (名護博物館, Nago hakubutsukan) opened in 1984 in Nago, Okinawa Prefecture, Japan. The collection covers natural as well as cultural history and includes the shell of a giant clam which weighs over two hundred kilograms. In May 2023, the relocated museum reopened in a new facility, built with a total construction cost of ¥2.4 billion.
fb90768f868efb73.zh: 名護博物館（名護博物館，Nago hakubutsukan）於1984年在日本沖繩縣名護市開館。館藏涵蓋自然史與文化史，其中包括一枚重逾200公斤的巨蚌貝殼。2023年5月，博物館遷移至新館重新開館，新館總工程費為24億日圓。

fb91df17ad3f6685.en: The central region of the prefecture has a lot of flat land in the Kitakami River basin, which has long been open to rice paddies, and the scale of rice production has been large. However, there were years when rice could not be harvested due to severe cold weather and cold damage, so barley, wheat, and buckwheat were also produced to stabilize the diet. Therefore, many dishes were prepared using rice, wheat, and buckwheat flours, and the culture of "shitonemono," a dish made by kneading the flour with water, developed.
fb91df17ad3f6685.zh: 縣中央部的北上川流域平地廣闊，很早便開墾為水田，稻米生產規模大。然而也有因嚴寒及冷害而無法收成稻米的年份，因此也種植大麥、小麥與蕎麥以穩定飲食。因此以米、小麥、蕎麥粉製作的料理很多，發展出以水揉製粉類的「しとねもの」飲食文化。

fba46de67bc51491.en: The Izui Panorama Park (伊豆パノラマパーク, Izu panorama pāku) is a tourist attraction located in Izunokuni, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. This tourist attraction is a complex facility with a ropeway, observatory, and restaurant.
fba46de67bc51491.zh: 伊豆パノラマパーク是位於日本靜岡縣伊豆之國市的觀光設施，為設有纜車、展望台與餐廳的複合設施。

fbda22a160abe714.en: Bibai City sits between Sapporo and Asahikawa. The western part is on the low lying ground of the Ishikari Plain and is known as being one of Hokkaido’s bread baskets. On the eastern side, there is a hilly region which extends into the Yubari Mountains. Formerly one of the biggest coal mining towns in Japan, many mine workers used to bustle around here. At that time, "Bibai Yakitori" is said to have been a favorite place for the mine workers to come and eat at.
fbda22a160abe714.zh: 美唄市位於札幌與旭川之間。西部位於石狩平原的低地，是北海道著名的糧倉之一。東側則是延伸至夕張山地的丘陵地帶。這裡過去是日本最大的煤礦城鎮之一，曾有許多礦工在此往來。據說當時「美唄やきとり」是礦工們喜愛前往用餐的地方。

fc21a7b2aa5f6ce1.en: This pickle is made from a traditional vegetable known as the crimson turnip (hinokabu), which is featured in the Ehime folk song "Iyo Bushi." The pickles have an aroma of bitter orange and a sweet and tangy flavor, resulting in a clean yet rich finish.Historically, over 300 years ago, when Tadatomo Gamo was transferred to Matsuyama, he transplanted turnips from his ancestral land in Hino, Gamo County, Omi Province (now Shiga Prefecture), marking the beginning of the crimson pickle's history.
fc21a7b2aa5f6ce1.zh: 這種醃菜以傳統蔬菜緋蕪製成，緋蕪曾出現在愛媛民謠〈伊予節〉中。醃菜帶有苦橙的香氣，酸甜的風味清爽又濃郁。歷史上，300多年前蒲生忠知轉封至松山時，將祖先故地近江國蒲生郡日野（今滋賀縣）的蕪菁移植過來，這便是緋蕪漬歷史的開端。

fc3caea26d396ba6.en: "Akebono Soybeans" have been cultivated in the Akebono region of Minobu Town since the Meiji era. These soybeans are exceptional, with larger size and higher sugar content compared to regular soybeans. They are approximately 1.6 times the size of typical soybeans, and when lined up, 10 beans span about 6 sun (18cm or 7 inches), earning them the alternate name "Tourokusun".
fc3caea26d396ba6.zh: 「曙大豆」自明治時代起便在身延町曙地區栽培。這種大豆比一般大豆顆粒更大、糖度更高，品質出眾。大小約為一般大豆的1.6倍，排列10顆約長6寸（18公分，7英寸），因此又稱「十粒六寸」。

fc61ae6a1dcfc8a1.en: Yakuri-ji (八栗寺) is a Shingon Buddhist temple in Takamatsu, Japan. It is the 85th site of the Shikoku Pilgrimage.
fc61ae6a1dcfc8a1.zh: 八栗寺是位於日本高松市的真言宗寺院，為四國遍路第85號札所。

fc64aa5fe860cc2d.en: Kagawa Prefectural Higashiyama Kaii Setouchi Art Museum (Japanese: 香川県立東山魁夷せとうち美術館, romanized: Kagawa Kenritsu Higashiyama Kaii Setouchi Bijutsukan) is an art museum dedicated to Japanese painting master Kaii Higashiyama.  The museum is located in the city of Sakaide, Kagawa Prefecture, Japan, where Higashiyama's grandfather was born.  The museum features 350 works by Higashiyama that were donated by his wife after he died.
fc64aa5fe860cc2d.zh: 香川県立東山魁夷せとうち美術館（羅馬拼音：Kagawa Kenritsu Higashiyama Kaii Setouchi Bijutsukan）是專門展示日本畫大師東山魁夷作品的美術館。美術館位於日本香川縣坂出市，這裡是東山魁夷祖父的出生地。館內收藏東山魁夷的作品350件，由其妻子在他過世後捐贈。

fc72c1e8e2c43f5d.en: The Osaka State Guest House (大阪迎賓館 Ōsaka geihinkan) is located in the Nishinomaru area of Osaka Castle. The building is owned by City of Osaka, managed by Osaka Castle Management Consortium, and operated by Value Management.
fc72c1e8e2c43f5d.zh: 大阪迎賓館位於大阪城西之丸一帶。建築由大阪市所有，由大阪城管理共同體管理，並由Value Management營運。

fc78aec7e6886f7c.en: Raikyū-ji (頼久寺) is a Buddhist temple located in the Raikyūcho neighborhood of the city of Takahashi, Okayama Prefecture, Japan.  The temple's full name is Tenchū-zan Ankoku Raikyū-ji (天柱山安国頼久寺).  It belongs to the Eigen-ji branch of Rinzai school of Japanese Buddhism, and its honzon is a statue of Kannon Bosatsu. It is known for its Japanese garden, which was designated a NationalPlace of Scenic Beauty in 1974, with the area under protection expanded in 2009 to include the Main Hall and Shoin of the temple.
fc78aec7e6886f7c.zh: 賴久寺是位於日本岡山縣高梁市賴久寺町的佛寺，全名為天柱山安國賴久寺，屬於日本佛教臨濟宗永源寺派，本尊為觀音菩薩像。該寺以日本庭園聞名，庭園於1974年被指定為國家名勝，2009年保護範圍擴大，納入寺院的本堂與書院。

fc7fe5d3223c75a9.en: Iha Castle (伊波城, Iha jō; Okinawan: Ifa Gushiku) is a Ryukyuan gusuku in Uruma, Okinawa. It sits on a cliff that separates Iha from Ishikawa, with a grand view of the Ishikawa Isthmus. The castle is in ruins, with nothing left of the original structures save the walls. There are also multiple Ryukyuan shrines in the bailey. Based on artifacts found in and around the castle, it has been estimated to have been in use around the 13th to 15th centuries.
fc7fe5d3223c75a9.zh: 伊波城（伊波城，Iha jō；沖繩語：Ifa Gushiku）是位於沖繩縣宇流麻市的琉球御城（グスク）。城址坐落於分隔伊波與石川的斷崖上，可遠眺石川地峽。城已成廢墟，原有建築除城牆外皆已不存。郭內另有多座琉球祭祀場所。根據城內及周邊出土的文物推估，此城約於13至15世紀間使用。

fc9af44b820001be.en: Bonotsu History Museum Kishinkan (坊津歴史資料センター輝津館, Bōnotsu Rekishi Shiryō Sentā Kishinkan) opened in Minamisatsuma, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan, in 2004. The collection includes the Important Cultural Property Eight Aspects of the Buddha's Parinirvana.
fc9af44b820001be.zh: 坊津歷史資料中心輝津館（坊津歴史資料センター輝津館）於2004年在日本鹿兒島縣南薩摩市開館。館藏包括重要文化財《八相涅槃圖》。

fcb9f67bc123e0ea.en: Kushihiki Hachimangū (櫛引八幡宮, Kushihiki Hachimangū) is a Shinto shrine located in Hachinohe, Aomori Prefecture, Japan. It is a Hachiman shrine, dedicated to the kami Hachiman. It was established c. 1190-1199. Its main festivals are held annually on April 15 and August 15 according to the lunar calendar, and on May 14. In the former Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines, it was classified as a district shrine (郷社, gōsha).
fcb9f67bc123e0ea.zh: 櫛引八幡宮是位於日本青森縣八戶市的神社，屬於八幡神社，祭祀八幡神。約創建於1190年至1199年間。主要祭典每年於農曆4月15日與8月15日，以及5月14日舉行。在舊時近代社格制度中，列為鄉社。

fcce447f18ad8c49.en: Ushikubi Dam is a dam in the Fukuoka Prefecture of Japan.
fcce447f18ad8c49.zh: 牛頸ダム是位於日本福岡縣的水壩。

fcd71716f1041f7a.en: Kawatake (river mushroom) is a precious natural freshwater laver that can only be harvested from the Kogane River in Asakura City, Fukuoka Prefecture. It has long been treated as a luxury delicacy, and in the Edo period (1603-1867), it was a valuable item offered to the shogun.
fcd71716f1041f7a.zh: 川茸（河中的蕈菇）是只能在福岡縣朝倉市黃金川採收的珍貴天然淡水藻類。自古被視為高級珍饈，在江戶時代（1603-1867）是獻給將軍的珍貴物品。

fd1d678389b7f814.en: Kimiidera Park (Japanese: 紀三井寺公園, Hepburn: Kimiidera kōen) is a park and athletics facility in Wakayama, Wakayama Prefecture, Japan.
fd1d678389b7f814.zh: 紀三井寺公園是位於日本和歌山縣和歌山市的公園及田徑設施。

fd2204aac62bc068.en: Minakuchi-juku (水口宿, Minakuchi-juku) was the fiftieth of the fifty-three stations of the Tōkaidō highway connecting Edo with Kyoto in Edo period Japan. It was located in the Minakuchi neighborhood of the present-day city of Kōka, Shiga Prefecture, Japan.
fd2204aac62bc068.zh: 水口宿是日本江戶時代連接江戶與京都的東海道五十三次中的第五十個宿場，位於今日本滋賀縣甲賀市水口町。

fd244df4134b76b7.en: Zuki is a dish made by pickling taro leaf stalks (the part between the stem and leaves) in vinegar. It has been eaten for a long time with its refreshing taste and crunchy texture. There are three types of zuki: akazuki, which is made from the stems of yatsugashira and ebiimo (shrimp), shirozuki, which is made from soft white yam, and aoizuki, which is made from the stems of hasuimo (lotus root). In Fukui, also in the Hokuriku region, it is also called "suko.
fd244df4134b76b7.zh: ずき是將芋頭的葉柄（莖與葉之間的部分）用醋醃漬而成的料理。口味清爽、口感爽脆，長久以來為人食用。ずき分為三種：以八頭和海老芋的莖製成的あかずき、以柔軟的白芋製成的しろずき，以及以蓮芋的莖製成的あおずき。同屬北陸地區的福井也稱之為「すこ」。

fd2cca4addfcfddd.en: The Hiraide ruins (平出遺跡, Hiraide iseki) is a complex archaeological site containing the ruins of an early Jōmon period to early Heian period settlement located in the Soga neighborhood of the city of Shiojiri, Nagano in the Chūbu region of Japan. The site was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1952.
fd2cca4addfcfddd.zh: 平出遺跡是位於日本中部地方長野縣鹽尻市宗賀地區的複合型考古遺址，保存從繩文時代早期至平安時代早期的聚落遺跡。1952年被指定為日本國家史跡。

fd35fecf8c2d7dd1.en: There is a zoni in which rice cakes are put into azuki beans simmered for a little less sweetness. On New Year's Day, people eat "Sumashi-zoni" with iwanori seaweed in it, and in some areas they start eating "Azuki-zoni" on January 2. There is a tradition of using round rice cakes.
