This zoni is characterized by its light sweetness in comparison to “Zenzai” or “Oshiruko” (sweet azuki bean soup), although it looks similar in appearance to them.
fd35fecf8c2d7dd1.zh: 有一種雜煮是將年糕放入煮得甜度稍低的紅豆中。元旦時人們吃加了岩海苔的「すまし雑煮」，有些地區則從1月2日開始吃「小豆雑煮」。傳統上使用圓形年糕。這種雜煮外觀與「ぜんざい」或「おしるこ」（甜紅豆湯）相似，但特色是甜度較淡。

fd3e1ff9bbf33101.en: Sakima Art Museum (佐喜眞美術館, Sakima Bijutsukan) is a private art museum that opened in Ginowan, Okinawa Prefecture, Japan in 1994. The collection includes The Battle of Okimawa (沖縄戦の図) by Iri and Toshi Maruki, and works by Käthe Kollwitz, Georges Rouault, Yayoi Kusama, and Ueno Makoto.
fd3e1ff9bbf33101.zh: 佐喜眞美術館是1994年於日本沖繩縣宜野灣市開館的私立美術館。館藏包括丸木位里與丸木俊的《沖縄戦の図》，以及珂勒惠支（Käthe Kollwitz）、喬治・盧奧（Georges Rouault）、草間彌生與上野誠的作品。

fd4220de04c88297.en: Ōuchi-shi Yakata (大内氏館, Ōuchi-shi Yakata) was the fortified residence of the Ōuchi clan in Yamaguchi, Japan. Ōuchi-shi Yakata has been designated as a National Historic Sites along with Ryōun-ji temple.
fd4220de04c88297.zh: 大內氏館是大內氏位於日本山口的設防宅邸。大內氏館與瀧雲寺一同被指定為國家史跡。

fd4c5795a651a0f0.en: Mount Shiretoko (知床岳, Shiretoko-dake) is a volcano located on the Shiretoko Peninsula in Hokkaido, Japan. The mountain consists of non-alkali mafic rocks and andesite. Mount Shiretoko is in Shari town, in Shari District of Okhotsk Subprefecture.
fd4c5795a651a0f0.zh: 知床岳是位於日本北海道知床半島的一座火山。山體由非鹼性鎂鐵質岩與安山岩構成。知床岳位於鄂霍次克綜合振興局斜里郡斜里町。

fd56ecac231a5eca.en: The Ashigara Service Area (足柄サービスエリア, Ashigara Sābisueria) is a rest area located on the Tōmei Expressway between Gotemba and Oyama, in Shizuoka Prefecture. It has a smart interchange.
fd56ecac231a5eca.zh: 足柄サービスエリア是位於靜岡縣東名高速道路御殿場與小山之間的休息站，設有智慧型交流道。

fd597f216f66aa88.en: The Hitachi Kokufu (常陸国府) was the provincial capital of Hitachi Province in the late Nara period though Heian period. It was located in the Soja neighborhood of the city of Ishioka, Ibaraki Prefecture in the northern Kantō region of Japan. The ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2010.
fd597f216f66aa88.zh: 常陸國府是奈良時代後期至平安時代常陸國的國府所在地，位於日本北關東地區茨城縣石岡市總社地區。遺跡自2010年起被指定為國家史跡。

fd5e81d6e9b6539a.en: Doshi Dam (Japanese: 道志ダム) is a gravity dam located in Kanagawa Prefecture in Japan. The dam is used for power production. The catchment area of the dam is 112.5 km2. The dam impounds about 14 hectares of land when full and can store 1525 thousand cubic meters of water. The construction of the dam was started on 1952 and completed in 1955.
fd5e81d6e9b6539a.zh: 道志ダム是位於日本神奈川縣的重力壩，用於發電。集水面積為112.5平方公里，滿水時淹沒面積約14公頃，蓄水量為1525千立方公尺。水壩於1952年動工，1955年完工。

fd85a9eb533f83f9.en: The Futatsumori Site, known primarily in Japanese as the Futatsumori Shell Mound (二ツ森貝塚, Futatsumori Kaizuka), is an archaeological site consisting of a series of large shell middens and the remains of an adjacent settlement from the Jōmon period, located in what is now part of the town of Shichinohe in Aomori Prefecture in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan. It has been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 1998. The site covers an area of about 30 hectares.
fd85a9eb533f83f9.zh: 二ツ森遺跡，在日文中主要稱為二ツ森貝塚，是由一系列大型貝塚及相鄰聚落遺構組成的繩文時代考古遺址，位於日本北部東北地方青森縣今七戶町境內。自1998年起被中央政府列為國家史跡加以保護。遺址面積約30公頃。

fd99049949afb3fc.en: Pork bone vegetables" is a dish made by stewing large pieces of pork, tsuwabuki (a type of Japanese radish), kombu (kelp), daikon (Japanese radish), carrots, and koshaman (a native taro) in a large pot. It is also known as "uan finayasse". Uan" means pig, "finé" means bones, and "yasse" means vegetables. In the Amami area, black-haired island pigs have been raised since ancient times.
fd99049949afb3fc.zh: 「豚骨野菜」是將大塊豬肉、石蕗、昆布、蘿蔔、紅蘿蔔，以及在地芋頭「こーしゃまん」放入大鍋燉煮的料理，也稱為「うゎんふねやっせ」。「うゎん」是豬，「ふね」是骨頭，「やっせ」是蔬菜。奄美地區自古飼養黑毛的島豬。

fda6bf1035735e8f.en: Yonako Falls (米子大瀑布, Yonako Dai-Bakufu), literally "Yonako Large Waterfalls"  ) is a waterfall located in Yonako, Suzaka City, Nagano Prefecture, in the central part of Japan. The falls originate from Mount Azumaya and Mount Neko.
fda6bf1035735e8f.zh: 米子大瀑布（字面意思為「米子大型瀑布」）是位於日本中部長野縣須坂市米子的瀑布。瀑布源自四阿山與根子岳。

fdacfbb02bda5d54.en: “Fukumen” is said to have been passed down as an event food for the Uwajima clan, and the main ingredient, konjac, is made from konjac potatoes, which were often harvested during the famine of the Edo period, and at the time, it began to be cultivated for food security.
fdacfbb02bda5d54.zh: ふくめん據說是宇和島藩流傳下來的節慶料理。主要食材蒟蒻是以蒟蒻芋製成，江戶時代發生饑荒時常採收蒟蒻芋，當時為了確保糧食，開始栽種蒟蒻芋。

fdb4948ca664c1a4.en: "Kinzanji-Miso" is a fermented food made by fermenting grains, and contains Tougan(=White gourd), eggplant, perilla seeds, ginger, etc. It is a type of "Name-miso" that is eaten as is as a side dish or snack rather than as a seasoning. Originally, it was a preserved food for eating summer vegetables in winter at temples. There is a theory that miso was first introduced to Wakayama Prefecture in the Kamakura period (1185-1333) by a monk, Shinchikakushin, who returned from his training in the Sung Dynasty.
fdb4948ca664c1a4.zh: 金山寺味噌是以穀物發酵製成的發酵食品，裡面加有冬瓜、茄子、紫蘇籽、薑等。屬於「嘗味噌」的一種，不作為調味料，而是直接當作配菜或下酒菜食用。原本是寺院中為了在冬季吃到夏季蔬菜而製作的保存食品。有一說認為，這種味噌是鎌倉時代（1185－1333）由自宋朝修行歸來的僧人心地覺心傳入和歌山縣。

fdbeae27cf1e8a29.en: "Shizuoka Oden" is a local dish of Shizuoka City where all the ingredients such as beef tendon, black hanpen, fish paste, daikon radish, and eggs are skewered, stewed in a black colored Dashi (=Japanese soup stock), and served with "Aonori (green laver)" or fish stock powder.
fdbeae27cf1e8a29.zh: 静岡おでん是靜岡市的在地料理，將牛筋、黑半片、魚漿製品、白蘿蔔、雞蛋等所有食材串起，放入黑色高湯中燉煮，再撒上青海苔或魚粉食用。

fdd4b51269dd499b.en: Kinako-musubi is a round omusubi with dried plums and thinly sliced salted kelp, covered with kinako (roasted soybean flour). It was served between rice plantings and at the end of the rice planting season called “dai-mite”. In Hiroshima, "Mite" means "disappear,” and Kinako musubi along with "Bara Sushi" and "Grilled Mackerel Chishamomi" are eaten. It is said that the sushi was made in a round shape with the wish that the seedlings planted would bear a full crop in the fall.
fdd4b51269dd499b.zh: きなこむすび是包入梅乾和薄切鹽昆布、外層裹上黃豆粉的圓形飯糰。會在插秧期間，以及插秧季結束時稱為「大みて」的時候供應。在廣島，「みて」意為「結束」，人們會吃きなこむすび，以及「ばら寿司」和「烤鯖魚萵苣拌菜」。據說做成圓形，是希望種下的秧苗在秋天能結實飽滿。

fdf7025bc825ff82.en: Aji Island (網地島, Ajishima), an island in the Pacific Ocean off the eastern coast of Honshu, Japan's largest island is situated in the Miyagi Prefecture, southwest of the Oshika Peninsula. Aji Island neighbors Tashirojima Island, which is commonly known as "Cat Island" due to its large population of stray cats.
fdf7025bc825ff82.zh: 網地島是位於日本最大島本州東岸外太平洋上的島嶼，屬宮城縣，位於牡鹿半島西南方。網地島鄰近田代島，田代島因流浪貓眾多而通稱「貓島」。

fe1483d960b66180.en: Ohashi Kannon-ji (御橋観音寺) is a Buddhist temple of the Shingon-shū Chizan-ha in Sasebo, Nagasaki, Japan.  Its honorary sangō prefix is Sekkyōzan (石橋山).
fe1483d960b66180.zh: 御橋観音寺是位於日本長崎縣佐世保市的真言宗智山派佛寺，山號為石橋山。

fe1bf0180c9c6601.en: Nikke Colton Plaza is a shopping mall in Moto-Yawata, Ichikawa city, Chiba prefecture, Japan. In addition to shops, the mall has a tennis court, movie theatres, a park, and a fountain.
fe1bf0180c9c6601.zh: ニッケコルトンプラザ是位於日本千葉縣市川市本八幡的購物中心。除了商店之外，購物中心內還有網球場、電影院、公園和噴水池。

fe2544a0405a5330.en: The shrimp known as "Mosa Ebi(=Mosa shrimp)" in Tottori Prefecture is formally called "Kurozako Ebi." It is a type of shrimp that can only be caught in the Japan Sea, inhabiting deep-sea areas with a water temperature of around 5°C at depths of 200 to 250 meters.
fe2544a0405a5330.zh: 在鳥取縣被稱為「モサエビ」的蝦，正式名稱為「クロザコエビ」。這是只能在日本海捕獲的蝦類，棲息於水深200至250公尺、水溫約5°C的深海區域。

fe29c01f1b24df78.en: The Arimine Dam (有峰ダム, Arimine Damu) is located in Toyama, Toyama Prefecture, Japan built upon the Wada River. The two bends in the middle of the dam is the most defining feature. The Arimine Lake is an artificial lake that was created by construction of the dam.
fe29c01f1b24df78.zh: 有峰水壩位於日本富山縣富山市，建於和田川上。壩體中段的兩處彎折是其最主要的特徵。有峰湖是因興建這座水壩而形成的人工湖。

fe46c6d4a55cae24.en: The Sacred Nagi Tree of Kumano Hayatama Taisha is one of the Natural Monuments of Japan and is situated in Kumano Hayatama Taisha in Shingu city, Wakayama, Japan. Kumano Hayatama Taisha is one of three Kumano Sanzan shrine/temple sites, and is part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site "Sacred Sites and Pilgrimage Routes in the Kii Mountain Range". The nagi tree, Nageia nagi, is also called the broadleaf podocarpus.
fe46c6d4a55cae24.zh: 熊野速玉神社のナギ是日本的天然紀念物之一，位於日本和歌山縣新宮市的熊野速玉大社。熊野速玉大社是熊野三山的三處神社／寺院之一，也是聯合國教科文組織世界遺產「紀伊山地的靈場與參拜道」的一部分。ナギ（學名Nageia nagi）又稱竹柏。

fe736bdb5ccdbaff.en: The Suigō Sawara Aquatic Botanical Garden (水郷佐原水生植物園, Suigō Sawara Suisei-shokubutsu-en) is a botanical garden located at the eastern side of the Suigo-Tsukuba Quasi-National Park in Katori, Chiba, Japan. It is open 9 a.m.-4:30 p.m. (8 a.m.-7 p.m. during the Iris Festival) every day in May and June. July through April it is closed every Monday and from Dec.24 through Jan.4. Admission is charged.
fe736bdb5ccdbaff.zh: 水郷佐原あやめパーク（水鄉佐原水生植物園）是位於日本千葉縣香取市水鄉筑波國定公園東側的植物園。5月和6月每天開放，時間為上午9點至下午4點30分（菖蒲祭期間為上午8點至晚上7點）。7月至翌年4月每週一休園，12月24日至1月4日亦休園。需購票入園。

fe7a2306f875e26c.en: Sapporo Teine (サッポロテイネ) is a recreational center in Teine-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan. It comprises many facilities, such as the ski resort (with other facilities, besides ski), the Teineyama Ropeway, and the Sapporo Teine Golf Club fields.
fe7a2306f875e26c.zh: サッポロテイネ是位於日本北海道札幌市手稻區的休閒中心，包含滑雪場（另有滑雪以外的設施）、手稻山纜車及札幌手稻高爾夫俱樂部球場等多項設施。

fe89c678a479558a.en: Naganuma Castle (長沼城) was a Japanese castle located in Naganuma, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. The site has 300 cherry blossom trees.
fe89c678a479558a.zh: 長沼城是位於日本福島縣長沼的日本城郭。城址有300棵櫻花樹。

fe89df9b9cf626d1.en: The Hitachi Furyumono (日立風流物) is a parade in Hitachi city, Japan. It is held during Hitachi Sakura Matsuri (日立さくらまつり), the annual cherry blossom festival in April, and the Great Festival at the local Kamine Shrine once in every seven years in May. It is inscribed on the UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage Lists as a part of "Yama, Hoko, Yatai, float festivals in Japan", 33 traditional Japan festivals.
fe89df9b9cf626d1.zh: 日立風流物是日本日立市的遊行活動。於每年4月的賞櫻祭典「日立さくらまつり」，以及每七年一次於5月舉行的當地神峰神社大祭禮期間舉行。作為「日本山・鉾・屋台行事」所含33項傳統祭典之一，列入聯合國教科文組織非物質文化遺產名錄。

febcd2504b4e4c6a.en: Shinjiko (Lake Shinji) in the northeastern part of Shimane prefecture is said to have formed about 10,000 years ago. It is about 17 km wide and 6 km long with a circumference of about 47 km, making it the 7th largest lake in Japan. With its dignified lake surface, it was selected as one of the "100 Best Views in Japan."Shinjiko is a brackish lake with a mixture of freshwater and seawater, and this mixture changes depending on the water area and season. The local flavor is cultivated in this unique environment.
febcd2504b4e4c6a.zh: 位於島根縣東北部的宍道湖據說形成於約1萬年前。湖寬約17公里、長約6公里，周長約47公里，是日本第七大湖。湖面莊嚴，入選「日本百景」。宍道湖是淡水與海水混合的汽水湖，其混合比例隨水域與季節而變化。當地的風味便是在這種獨特的環境中培育而成。

fedba3c118c473b9.en: The Ibaraki Prefectural Museum of History (茨城県立歴史館, Ibaraki kenritsu rekishikan) is a local history museum in Mito, Ibaraki, Japan. It is one of Japan's many museums which are supported by a prefecture.
fedba3c118c473b9.zh: 茨城縣立歷史館是位於日本茨城縣水戶市的地方歷史博物館，為日本眾多由縣政府支持的博物館之一。

feddcbfbe953579b.en: The history of funameshi goes along with the history of Kojima Bay reclamation. The southern area of Okayama Prefecture has long been developed with rice paddies formed by reclamation. Full-scale development of new rice paddies began in the Edo period (1603-1867), and our predecessors labored hard to cultivate the land. Blessed with a water environment that connects rice paddies, canals, rivers, and Lake Kojima, the area is home to reeds, crucian carp, and freshwater mussel.
feddcbfbe953579b.zh: 鮒めし的歷史與兒島灣填海造地的歷史相伴。岡山縣南部地區自古便開發出由填海造地形成的稻田。正式的新田開發始於江戶時代（1603-1867），先人們辛勤耕作開墾土地。這一帶擁有連結稻田、水路、河川與兒島湖的水域環境，有蘆葦、鯽魚和淡水貝棲息。

fee56c2e4463ec75.en: This is a local dish that has been handed down in Omura City since ancient times.It is said to have originated in the Muromachi period (1336-1573), when Omura Sumikore, who was defeated in battle and had his territory taken away from him, returned to Omura City after making a counterattack and regaining his territory, and the local people made oshizushi to celebrate.The reason for the oshi-zushi was because there were not enough plates to feed the large number of soldiers.The local people prepared oshi-zushi by spreading a large amount of freshly cooked rice in a shallow wooden box (morobuta) and topping it with a double layer of ingredients, which the soldiers then cut into squares with a side knife and ate.According to this tradition, Omura-zushi became "sushi for victory celebrations," and is still valued as an indispensable dish for celebratory occasions.
fee56c2e4463ec75.zh: 這是大村市自古流傳至今的鄉土料理。據說起源於室町時代（1336-1573），當時戰敗而失去領地的大村純伊，反攻奪回領地後返回大村市，當地居民製作押壽司來慶祝。之所以做成押壽司，是因為盤子不夠供大批士兵用餐。當地居民在淺木箱（もろぶた）中鋪上大量剛煮好的米飯，再鋪上兩層配料做成押壽司，士兵們則用隨身短刀切成方塊食用。依此傳統，大村寿司成為「慶祝勝利的壽司」，至今仍被視為喜慶場合不可或缺的料理。

fef9a4e049873f91.en: The Jūroku Rakan Iwa (十六羅漢岩) or "Sixteen Rakan Rocks" is a monument to the local fishermen in Yuza, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan. Carved from volcanic rock by a Buddhist monk between 1864 and 1868, there are in total twenty-two figures: the Sixteen Arhats along with Shakyamuni, Manjusri, Fugen and his consort, Avalokitesvara, and the Sarira. A little to the south of the carvings is Dewa Futami, or the Wedded rocks of Dewa Province.
fef9a4e049873f91.zh: 十六羅漢岩是日本山形縣遊佐町一處紀念當地漁民的石刻群。由一位佛教僧侶於1864年至1868年間在火山岩上雕刻而成，共有二十二尊像：十六羅漢，以及釋迦牟尼、文殊、普賢及其配偶、觀世音與舍利。石刻稍南方為出羽二見，即出羽國的夫婦岩。

fefeb57a7c18f841.en: “Botamochi” is an indispensable dish eaten on “Higan” (=equinoctial week). It is mostly eaten during the week of the spring equinox when peony flowers bloom. For the autumnal equinox, when Japanese clovers are in bloom, “ohagi” is typically eaten. At local confectionary shops, “botamochi” is made by molding mashed glutinous rice and short-grain rice into barrel shapes and covering them in azuki bean paste. Local farmers were busy so when preparing “botamochi”, they would put the cooked rice in a “chawan” and place the azuki bean paste on top.
fefeb57a7c18f841.zh: 「ぼた餅」是「彼岸」（春分、秋分前後一週）不可或缺的食物。多在牡丹花盛開的春分那一週食用；在胡枝子開花的秋分時節，則通常吃「おはぎ」。在當地的和菓子店，ぼた餅是將搗碎的糯米與粳米捏成圓筒狀，再包覆紅豆餡製成。當地農家忙碌，製作ぼた餅時會把煮好的飯盛入「茶碗」，再將紅豆餡放在上面。

ff02195d6b3180e6.en: "Kashiwa Mochi" is a traditional Japanese snack made during the Boys’ Day celebration and is especially popular among children. Although it is typically eaten on Boys’ Day, the leaves of the Japanese emperor oak tree required to make it aren't found in Fukuoka Prefecture. As a result, an alternative snack has been created using leaves from the smilax glabra plant, known as sankira. In northern Fukuoka Prefecture, the local word for “turtle” or “soft-shelled turtle” is “game”, and the leaves of the sankira plant resemble the shell of the turtle.
ff02195d6b3180e6.zh: 「柏餅」是端午節（男孩節）時製作的日本傳統點心，特別受到孩童喜愛。雖然一般在男孩節食用，但製作所需的槲樹葉在福岡縣並不生長，因此改用菝葜類植物（俗稱山歸來）的葉子，做出替代的點心。在福岡縣北部，當地方言稱「龜」或「鱉」為「がめ」，而山歸來的葉子形似龜殼。

ff06fa3bff69fba5.en: Innoshima (因島) is an island in Onomichi, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. Originally, there was a city of the same name on this island, but it was merged into Onomichi in 2016.
ff06fa3bff69fba5.zh: 因島是位於日本廣島縣尾道的島嶼。島上原本有同名的市，但已於2016年併入尾道。

ff0b61a29aa78b06.en: Shinjiko is a brackish lake with a mixture of freshwater and seawater, connected to Nakaumi between the Shimane and Tottori prefectures. It is home to an abundance of marine life, including basket clams, pond smelt, ice fish, sea bass, greasyback shrimp, carp, and eel, which are known as "Shinjiko Shicchin," or the Seven Delicacies of Lake Shinji.Shinjiko's relatively low salinity enables a large catch of freshwater carp, some of which are said to weigh nearly 20 kg. They are generally eaten in "Koikoku (miso soup)" or as Arai (sashimi).
ff0b61a29aa78b06.zh: 宍道湖是淡水與海水混合的汽水湖，與島根縣和鳥取縣之間的中海相連。湖中水產豐富，包括蜆、公魚、白魚、鱸魚、蝦、鯉魚和鰻魚，合稱「宍道湖七珍」。宍道湖的鹽分相對較低，因此淡水鯉魚的漁獲量大，據說有些重達近20公斤。一般做成「鯉こく（味噌湯）」或「洗い（生魚片）」食用。

ff20bf139293d4ad.en: Akita-Yake-Yama is a small stratovolcano in Akita Prefecture, Japan, that is known for its radioactive waters. A small parasitic lava dome is located four kilometers from the volcano.
ff20bf139293d4ad.zh: 秋田燒山是位於日本秋田縣的小型層狀火山，以帶有放射性的泉水聞名。距火山四公里處有一座小型寄生熔岩穹丘。

ff36e589f60a3d97.en: ‘Zuiki’, petiole of ‘yatsugashira’ (a type of Satoimo(=Japanese taro)), is an ingredient often used in the local dishes in Tokushima. Dried ‘zuiki’ is used for local dishes like ‘Omiisan’ or ‘mixed sushi’, or miso soup, or simmered to serve as a side dish. ‘Zukigashi’ is also one of the local dishes. Boil raw ‘zuiki’ and toss it with vinegar. The tender purple ‘zuiki’, although initially turns black when boiled, transforms into a vibrant red when mixed with vinegar, becoming a colorful dish that enhances the dining table.
ff36e589f60a3d97.zh: 「芋莖」是「八頭」（里芋的一種）的葉柄，是德島鄉土料理中常用的食材。乾燥的芋莖用於「おみいさん」或「散壽司」等鄉土料理、味噌湯，或燉煮後當作配菜。「ずきがし」也是鄉土料理之一。將生芋莖煮過後以醋拌和。柔嫩的紫色芋莖煮過時雖然會先變黑，但拌入醋後會轉為鮮豔的紅色，成為讓餐桌增色的繽紛料理。

ff4a51a2cb54438e.en: Tottori Athletic Stadium (鳥取県立布勢総合運動公園陸上競技場, Tottori kenritsu Fuse sōgōundōkōen rikujō kyōgiba) is a multi-purpose stadium in the city of Tottori, Tottori Prefecture, Japan.
ff4a51a2cb54438e.zh: 鳥取縣立布勢綜合運動公園陸上競技場是位於日本鳥取縣鳥取市的多功能體育場。

ff95ed6576d91bc2.en: "The Kamogata-cho area of Asakuchi City", located in the southwestern part of Okayama Prefecture, has flourished as a production center of "hand-pulled noodles" since the Edo period (1603-1868) due to its sunny climate and availability of high-quality water, salt, and wheat. The ends of the "hand-pulled somen noodles" that are attached to utensils during the production process are called bachi, so named because they resemble a "Japanese shamisen bachi (plectrum)".
ff95ed6576d91bc2.zh: 位於岡山縣西南部的「淺口市鴨方町一帶」，因氣候晴朗，且能取得優質的水、鹽與小麥，自江戶時代（1603-1868）起便作為「手延麵」產地而興盛。製作「手延素麵」過程中掛在器具上的麵條末端，因形狀類似「日本三味線的撥子」，而稱為「ばち」。

ff9b24f034288244.en: “Oae Dango" is a local dish consisting of dumplings made of rice flour mixed with a tofu paste with Carrots, Shiitake mushrooms, and “Komatsuna”.“Oae Dango" is a traditional dish from the Moriyama and Yasu areas of Shiga Prefecture, and because it contains dumplings, it can be served as a tea snack. In addition to” Oae Dango”, it can also be enjoyed by mixing rice-flour Dumplings with vegetables dressed with miso instead of Tofu paste.
ff9b24f034288244.zh: 「おあえ団子」是將米粉製成的糰子，與拌入紅蘿蔔、香菇及「小松菜」的豆腐泥拌在一起的鄉土料理。「おあえ団子」是滋賀縣守山、野洲地區的傳統料理，因為含有糰子，也可作為配茶的點心。除了「おあえ団子」之外，也可以用味噌代替豆腐泥拌蔬菜，再與米粉糰子拌在一起食用。

ffc9ebb9688047b8.en: Kiwanosaku (城輪柵, Kiwanosaku) was a late Nara period though Heian period josaku-style Japanese castle located in what is now part of the town of Sakata, Yamagata Prefecture in the Tōhoku region of Japan. Its ruins are now an archaeological site and have been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 1932.
ffc9ebb9688047b8.zh: 城輪柵是奈良時代後期至平安時代的城柵式日本城郭，位於今日本東北地區山形縣酒田市境內。其遺跡現為考古遺址，自1932年起受中央政府保護，列為國家史跡。
